books.description_chinese: 勇敢的少年大明在去上学的路上，发现了一个发光的巨大房子。他将乘坐神秘的石车，开启一场不可思议的冒险！
books.description_english: On his way to school, a brave boy named Da Ming discovers a glowing, giant house. Step inside and join him on a mysterious stone carriage for an unforgettable adventure!

sentences.chinese: 在大山北边，住着一个勇敢的少年。
sentences.pinyin: Zài dà shān běi bian, zhù zhe yí gè yǒng gǎn de shào nián.
sentences.english: In the north of the great mountains, there lived a brave youth.

sentences.chinese: 他叫大明。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiào Dà Míng.
sentences.english: His name is Da Ming.

sentences.chinese: 大明每天上学，在学校上课。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng měi tiān shàng xué, zài xué xiào shàng kè.
sentences.english: Da Ming goes to school every day and attends class at school.

sentences.chinese: 他很喜欢写字，也喜欢听写。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐ huan xiě zì, yě xǐ huan tīng xiě.
sentences.english: He likes writing characters very much, and he also likes dictation.

sentences.chinese: 有一天，大明在书店买了一本书。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu yì tiān, Dà Míng zài shū diàn mǎi le yì běn shū.
sentences.english: One day, Da Ming bought a book at a bookstore.

sentences.chinese: 这本书很旧，像是一个秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū hěn jiù, xiàng shì yí gè mì mì.
sentences.english: This book was very old, like a secret.

sentences.chinese: 大明把书带回家，准备仔细看。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng bǎ shū dài huí jiā, zhǔn bèi zǐ xì kàn.
sentences.english: Da Ming brought the book home and prepared to look at it carefully.

sentences.chinese: 他想知道书里写了什么。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng zhī dào shū lǐ xiě le shén me.
sentences.english: He wanted to know what was written in the book.

sentences.chinese: 他的父亲是一个探险家，现在去上班了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de fù qīn shì yí gè tàn xiǎn jiā, xiàn zài qù shàng bān le.
sentences.english: His father is an explorer and has gone to work now.

sentences.chinese: 父亲告诉他：“如果你会读这本书，你就能找到宝藏。”
sentences.pinyin: Fù qīn gào su tā: “Rú guǒ nǐ huì dú zhè běn shū, nǐ jiù néng zhǎo dào bǎo zàng.”
sentences.english: His father told him: "If you can read this book, you will be able to find the treasure."

sentences.chinese: 大明在房间里做准备，他想出去探险。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng zài fáng jiān lǐ zuò zhǔn bèi, tā xiǎng chū qù tàn xiǎn.
sentences.english: Da Ming made preparations in his room; he wanted to go out and explore.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他听到一个奇怪的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, tā tīng dào yí gè qí guài de shēng yīn.
sentences.english: Suddenly, he heard a strange sound.

sentences.chinese: 他听见声音从书里出来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīng jiàn shēng yīn cóng shū lǐ chū lái.
sentences.english: He heard the sound coming out from the book.

sentences.chinese: 书页开始动了。
sentences.pinyin: Shū yè kāi shǐ dòng le.
sentences.english: The pages of the book began to move.

sentences.chinese: 书里的文字像是有生命一样，动作很快。
sentences.pinyin: Shū lǐ de wén zì xiàng shì yǒu shēng mìng yí yàng, dòng zuò hěn kuài.
sentences.english: The characters in the book were as if they had life, their movements were very fast.

sentences.chinese: 大明大叫一声：“这是什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng dà jiào yì shēng: “Zhè shì shén me?”
sentences.english: Da Ming shouted loudly: "What is this?"

sentences.chinese: 一个声音介绍自己是古老的守护者。
sentences.pinyin: Yí gè shēng yīn jiè shào zì jǐ shì gǔ lǎo de shǒu hù zhě.
sentences.english: A voice introduced itself as the ancient guardian.

sentences.chinese: 守护者说：“我们需要分工合作，才能找到北山的门。”
sentences.pinyin: Shǒu hù zhě shuō: “Wǒ men xū yào fēn gōng hé zuò, cái néng zhǎo dào běi shān de mén.”
sentences.english: The guardian said: "We need to divide the work and cooperate to find the gate of the North Mountain."

sentences.chinese: 大明决定现在就出发，他不再休息。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng jué dìng xiàn zài jiù chū fā, tā bú zài xiū xi.
sentences.english: Da Ming decided to set off right now; he would no longer rest.

sentences.chinese: 他快快地吃饭，然后拿起背包。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kuài kuài de chī fàn, rán hòu ná qǐ bēi bāo.
sentences.english: He ate his meal quickly and then picked up his backpack.

sentences.chinese: 他走出家门，向北走去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu chū jiā mén, xiàng běi zǒu qù.
sentences.english: He walked out of the house and headed north.

sentences.chinese: 他来到一个深山谷。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lái dào yí gè shēn shān gǔ.
sentences.english: He arrived at a deep mountain valley.

sentences.chinese: 这里很安静，没有一个人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ hěn ān jìng, méi yǒu yí gè rén.
sentences.english: It was very quiet here, with not a single person.

sentences.chinese: 大明看到一个巨大的石头门。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng kàn dào yí gè jù dà de shí tou mén.
sentences.english: Da Ming saw a huge stone gate.

sentences.chinese: 门上写着一个字。
sentences.pinyin: Mén shàng xiě zhe yí gè zì.
sentences.english: A character was written on the gate.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试用手动那个字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cháng shì yòng shǒu dòng nà gè zì.
sentences.english: He tried to move that character with his hand.

sentences.chinese: 突然，门开了，里面出了一道光。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, mén kāi le, lǐ miàn chū le yí dào guāng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the gate opened, and a beam of light came out from inside.

sentences.chinese: 光很亮，大明用手挡住眼睛。
sentences.pinyin: Guāng hěn liàng, Dàmíng yòng shǒu dǎngzhù yǎnjīng.
sentences.english: The light was very bright, and Daming used his hand to block his eyes.

sentences.chinese: 他走进了门，发现这里是一个巨大的房子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu jìnle mén, fāxiàn zhèlǐ shì yīgè jùdà de fángzi.
sentences.english: He walked through the door and found that this was a huge house.

sentences.chinese: 房间里在发光，像白天一样。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ zài fāguāng, xiàng báitiān yīyàng.
sentences.english: Inside the room, it was glowing, just like daytime.

sentences.chinese: 大明想，这里是什么地方？
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xiǎng, zhèlǐ shì shénme dìfāng?
sentences.english: Daming thought, what place is this?

sentences.chinese: 他看到一个奇怪的人坐在椅子上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào yīgè qíguài de rén zuò zài yǐzi shàng.
sentences.english: He saw a strange person sitting on a chair.

sentences.chinese: 那个人对他说话：“请坐下。”
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè rén duì tā shuōhuà: “Qǐng zuò xià.”
sentences.english: That person spoke to him: "Please sit down."

sentences.chinese: 大明很紧张，他问：“你是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng hěn jǐnzhāng, tā wèn: “Nǐ shì shuí?”
sentences.english: Daming was very nervous, he asked: "Who are you?"

sentences.chinese: 那个人回答：“我是这里的守护者。”
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè rén huídá: “Wǒ shì zhèlǐ de shǒuhùzhě.”
sentences.english: That person replied: "I am the guardian of this place."

sentences.chinese: 守护者告诉大明，这里有很多秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuhùzhě gàosù Dàmíng, zhèlǐ yǒu hěnduō mìmì.
sentences.english: The guardian told Daming that there are many secrets here.

sentences.chinese: 大明喜欢探险，所以他想学习这里的知识。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xǐhuan tànxiǎn, suǒyǐ tā xiǎng xuéxí zhèlǐ de zhīshì.
sentences.english: Daming likes adventure, so he wanted to study the knowledge of this place.

sentences.chinese: 守护者说：“你想学？那你要帮我工作。”
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuhùzhě shuō: “Nǐ xiǎng xué? Nà nǐ yào bāng wǒ gōngzuò.”
sentences.english: The guardian said: "You want to learn? Then you must work for me."

sentences.chinese: 大明问：“做什么工作？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng wèn: “Zuò shénme gōngzuò?”
sentences.english: Daming asked: "What work?"

sentences.chinese: 守护者说：“我太忙了，我需要你帮忙。”
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuhùzhě shuō: “Wǒ tài mángle, wǒ xūyào nǐ bāngmáng.”
sentences.english: The guardian said: "I am too busy, I need your help."

sentences.chinese: “我每天要和石头开会，但我忘了怎么唱。”
sentences.pinyin: “Wǒ měitiān yào hé shítou kāihuì, dàn wǒ wàngle zěnme chàng.”
sentences.english: "I have to hold meetings with stones every day, but I forgot how to chant."

sentences.chinese: 大明觉得这很奇怪，他问：“开会？唱？你在开玩笑吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng juédé zhè hěn qíguài, tā wèn: “Kāihuì? Chàng? Nǐ zài kāiwánxiào ma?”
sentences.english: Daming felt this was very strange, he asked: "Meetings? Chant? Are you joking?"

sentences.chinese: 守护者很难过，他说：“对不起，我太老了。”
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuhùzhě hěn nánguò, tā shuō: “Duìbuqǐ, wǒ tài lǎole.”
sentences.english: The guardian was very sad, he said: "I'm sorry, I am too old."

sentences.chinese: “我以前喜欢唱歌，现在我不记得了。”
sentences.pinyin: “Wǒ yǐqián xǐhuan chànggē, xiànzài wǒ bù jìdé le.”
sentences.english: "I used to like singing songs, but now I don't remember."

sentences.chinese: 守护者让大明唱一首歌。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuhùzhě ràng Dàmíng chàng yī shǒu gē.
sentences.english: The guardian asked Daming to sing a song.

sentences.chinese: 大明唱了起来，声音很好听。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng chàngle qǐlái, shēngyīn hěn hǎotīng.
sentences.english: Daming began to sing, and the sound was very pleasant.

sentences.chinese: 守护者听了很高兴，他说：“这就是我想要的！”
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuhùzhě tīngle hěn gāoxìng, tā shuō: “Zhè jiùshì wǒ xiǎng yào de!”
sentences.english: The guardian was very happy to hear it, he said: "This is exactly what I wanted!"

sentences.chinese: 守护者给了大明一杯奶，让他喝。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuhùzhě gěile Dàmíng yī bēi nǎi, ràng tā hē.
sentences.english: The guardian gave Daming a glass of milk and let him drink.

sentences.chinese: 大明喝了奶，觉得身体很有力量。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng hēle nǎi, juédé shēntǐ hěn yǒu lìliàng.
sentences.english: Daming drank the milk and felt his body had great strength.

sentences.chinese: 守护者说：“现在你可以得到这个钥匙。”
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuhùzhě shuō: “Xiànzài nǐ kěyǐ dédào zhège yàoshi.”
sentences.english: The guardian said: "Now you can obtain this key."

sentences.chinese: 大明拿到了钥匙，他想回家告诉爸爸妈妈。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng ná dào le yàoshi, tā xiǎng huí jiā gàosù bàba māma.
sentences.english: Daming got the key, and he wanted to return home to tell his parents.

sentences.chinese: 但守护者说：“你不能现在回去。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàn shǒuhùzhě shuō: “Nǐ bùnéng xiànzài huíqù.”
sentences.english: But the guardian said: "You cannot go back now."

sentences.chinese: “你必须学会怎么开车，开那个石车去深山。”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ bìxū xuéhuì zěnme kāichē, kāi nàgè shíchē qù shēnshān.”
sentences.english: "You must learn how to drive, drive that stone car into the deep mountains."

sentences.chinese: 大明看着石车，想回来看一看地图。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng kànzhe shíchē, xiǎng huílái kàn yī kàn dìtú.
sentences.english: Daming looked at the stone car and wanted to come back to look at the map.

sentences.chinese: 他现在不能回家，他必须在这里学习。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiànzài bùnéng huíjiā, tā bìxū zài zhèlǐ xuéxí.
sentences.english: He cannot return home now; he must study here.

sentences.chinese: 突然，石车动了，发出巨大的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, shíchē dòngle, fāchū jùdà de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the stone car moved, making a huge sound.

sentences.chinese: 石车要把大明带到哪里去？
sentences.pinyin: Shíchē yào bǎ Dàmíng dài dào nǎlǐ qù?
sentences.english: Where is the stone car taking Daming?

chapters.title_english: Chapter 3: Secrets of the Deep Mountains

sentences.chinese: 石车动了，速度很快。
sentences.pinyin: Shí chē dòng le, sù dù hěn kuài.
sentences.english: The stone car moved, and the speed was very fast.

sentences.chinese: 大明坐在车里，他感到很热。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng zuò zài chē lǐ, tā gǎn dào hěn rè.
sentences.english: Da Ming sat in the car, and he felt very hot.

sentences.chinese: 他想，在家里的时候，他爱打球。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, zài jiā lǐ de shí hòu, tā ài dǎ qiú.
sentences.english: He thought, when he was at home, he loved playing ball.

sentences.chinese: 打球是他的爱好，但他现在在这里冒险。
sentences.pinyin: Dǎ qiú shì tā de ài hào, dàn tā xiàn zài zài zhè lǐ mào xiǎn.
sentences.english: Playing ball was his hobby, but now he was here on an adventure.

sentences.chinese: 石车来到一个奇怪的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Shí chē lái dào yí gè qí guài de dì fāng.
sentences.english: The stone car arrived at a strange place.

sentences.chinese: 这里有很多大的树。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ yǒu hěn duō dà de shù.
sentences.english: There were many large trees here.

sentences.chinese: 大明走下车，他看见一个古老的房子。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng zǒu xià chē, tā kàn jiàn yí gè gǔ lǎo de fáng zi.
sentences.english: Da Ming stepped off the car and saw an ancient house.

sentences.chinese: 他走进房子，寻找地图。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu jìn fáng zi, xún zhǎo dì tú.
sentences.english: He walked into the house, searching for the map.

sentences.chinese: 他想找一个能帮他的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng zhǎo yí gè néng bāng tā de rén.
sentences.english: He wanted to find someone who could help him.

sentences.chinese: 他看到桌子上放着一本书。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe yì běn shū.
sentences.english: He saw a book placed on the table.

sentences.chinese: 这本书是日文的，他看不懂。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū shì Rì wén de, tā kàn bù dǒng.
sentences.english: This book was in Japanese, and he could not understand it.

sentences.chinese: 他突然看到一个老人，老人正在睡觉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tū rán kàn dào yí gè lǎo rén, lǎo rén zhèng zài shuì jiào.
sentences.english: Suddenly he saw an old man; the old man was sleeping.

sentences.chinese: 老人睡得很深，像是在生病。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén shuì de hěn shēn, xiàng shì zài shēng bìng.
sentences.english: The old man slept deeply, as if he were ill.

sentences.chinese: 大明走过去，轻轻地叫他。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng zǒu guò qù, qīng qīng de jiào tā.
sentences.english: Da Ming walked over and called him gently.

sentences.chinese: 老人醒了，他看起来很生气。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén xǐng le, tā kàn qǐ lái hěn shēng qì.
sentences.english: The old man woke up, and he looked very angry.

sentences.chinese: 老人大声说：“谁来这里？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén dà shēng shuō: “Shéi lái zhè lǐ?”
sentences.english: The old man said loudly, "Who comes here?"

sentences.chinese: 大明说：“对不起，我不知道这里有人。”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng shuō: “Duì bù qǐ, wǒ bù zhī dào zhè lǐ yǒu rén.”
sentences.english: Da Ming said, "I'm sorry, I didn't know there were people here."

sentences.chinese: 老人看着大明，他的眼神变了。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén kàn zhe Dà Míng, tā de yǎn shén biàn le.
sentences.english: The old man looked at Da Ming, and his expression changed.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你穿的衣服很奇怪。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ chuān de yī fu hěn qí guài.”
sentences.english: He said, "The clothes you are wearing are very strange."

sentences.chinese: 大明低头看，他穿的是现代的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng dī tóu kàn, tā chuān de shì xiàn dài de yī fu.
sentences.english: Da Ming looked down; he was wearing modern clothes.

sentences.chinese: 老人叹了一口气，他说他生病了。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén tàn le yì kǒu qì, tā shuō tā shēng bìng le.
sentences.english: The old man sighed and said he had fallen ill.

sentences.chinese: 大明问：“您需要看病吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng wèn: “Nín xū yào kàn bìng ma?”
sentences.english: Da Ming asked, "Do you need to see a doctor?"

sentences.chinese: 老人说：“我的病不需要医生，我只需要洗脸。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén shuō: “Wǒ de bìng bù xū yào yī shēng, wǒ zhǐ xū yào xǐ liǎn.”
sentences.english: The old man said, "My illness doesn't need a doctor; I only need to wash my face."

sentences.chinese: 大明帮老人洗脸，老人渐渐安静下来。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng bāng lǎo rén xǐ liǎn, lǎo rén jiàn jiàn ān jìng xià lái.
sentences.english: Da Ming helped the old man wash his face, and the old man gradually calmed down.

sentences.chinese: 老人开始唱一首歌，歌声很美。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén kāi shǐ chàng yì shǒu gē, gē shēng hěn měi.
sentences.english: The old man began to sing a song, and the singing was beautiful.

sentences.chinese: 老人说：“我来自比国，很多年前我来到了这里。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén shuō: “Wǒ lái zì Bǐ guó, hěn duō nián qián wǒ lái dào le zhè lǐ.”
sentences.english: The old man said, "I come from Belgium; many years ago I arrived here."

sentences.chinese: 大明很惊讶，他想知道这个地方有什么秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng hěn jīng yà, tā xiǎng zhī dào zhè gè dì fāng yǒu shén me mì mì.
sentences.english: Da Ming was very surprised; he wanted to know what secrets this place had.

sentences.chinese: 老人告诉他，深山里有一个巨大的宝藏。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén gào sù tā, shēn shān lǐ yǒu yí gè jù dà de bǎo zàng.
sentences.english: The old man told him that there was a huge treasure in the deep mountains.

sentences.chinese: 但要找到宝藏，大明必须用这本日文书。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn yào zhǎo dào bǎo zàng, Dà Míng bì xū yòng zhè běn Rì wén shū.
sentences.english: But to find the treasure, Da Ming must use this Japanese book.

sentences.chinese: 大明接过书，突然听到外面有巨大的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng jiē guò shū, tū rán tīng dào wài miàn yǒu jù dà de shēng yīn.
sentences.english: Da Ming took the book, and suddenly heard a huge sound outside.

sentences.chinese: 什么东西在靠近？
sentences.pinyin: Shén me dōng xi zài kào jìn?
sentences.english: What is approaching?

chapters.title_english: Chapter 4: The Trial of the Forest

sentences.chinese: 大明站在门口，心跳很快。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng zhàn zài mén kǒu, xīn tiào hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Da Ming stood at the doorway, his heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得外面的声音非常奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué de wài miàn de shēng yīn fēi cháng qí guài.
sentences.english: He felt that the sound outside was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 老人请大明跟着他走。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén qǐng Dà míng gēn zhe tā zǒu.
sentences.english: The old man asked Da Ming to follow him.

sentences.chinese: 他们走进深山的森林。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zǒu jìn shēn shān lǐ de sēn lín.
sentences.english: They walked into the forest of the deep mountains.

sentences.chinese: 森林里很黑，大明觉得有点害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Sēn lín lǐ hěn hēi, Dà míng jué de yǒu diǎn hài pà.
sentences.english: It was very dark in the forest, and Da Ming felt a bit scared.

sentences.chinese: 老人说：“这里是寻找宝藏的第一站。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén shuō: “Zhè lǐ shì xún zhǎo bǎo zàng de dì yī zhàn.”
sentences.english: The old man said, "This is the first station in the search for the treasure."

sentences.chinese: 大明问：“我们要在这里做什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng wèn: “Wǒ men yào zài zhè lǐ zuò shén me?”
sentences.english: Da Ming asked, "What do we need to do here?"

sentences.chinese: 老人告诉他，这里有一个特殊的考试。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén gào su tā, zhè lǐ yǒu yī gè tè shū de kǎo shì.
sentences.english: The old man told him that there was a special exam here.

sentences.chinese: 大明很惊讶，他没想到在山里还要考试。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng hěn jīng yà, tā méi xiǎng dào zài shān lǐ hái yào kǎo shì.
sentences.english: Da Ming was very surprised; he didn't expect there to be an exam in the mountains.

sentences.chinese: 老人给大明看书上的一个字。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén gěi Dà míng kàn shū shàng de yī gè zì.
sentences.english: The old man showed Da Ming a character in the book.

sentences.chinese: 老人说：“你要记住这个字，它是进门的钥匙。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén shuō: “Nǐ yào jì zhù zhè gè zì, tā shì jìn mén de yào shi.”
sentences.english: The old man said, "You must remember this character; it is the key to entering the gate."

sentences.chinese: 大明认真地记这个字，并把它记住。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng rèn zhēn de jì zhè gè zì, bìng bǎ tā jì zhù.
sentences.english: Da Ming carefully noted the character and committed it to memory.

sentences.chinese: 大明记得他在学校读书的时候，老师说过类似的字。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng jì de tā zài xué xiào dú shū de shí hou, lǎo shī shuō guò lèi sì de zì.
sentences.english: Da Ming remembered that when he was studying at school, the teacher had mentioned similar characters.

sentences.chinese: 老人请大明试着读出这个字。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén qǐng Dà míng shì zhe dú chū zhè gè zì.
sentences.english: The old man asked Da Ming to try reading this character.

sentences.chinese: 大明试了一次，读对了。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng shì le yī cì, dú duì le.
sentences.english: Da Ming tried once and read it correctly.

sentences.chinese: 老人笑着说：“你很聪明。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén xiào zhe shuō: “Nǐ hěn cōng míng.”
sentences.english: The old man said with a smile, "You are very smart."

sentences.chinese: 大明说：“谢谢您。”
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng shuō: “Xiè xie nín.”
sentences.english: Da Ming said, "Thank you."

sentences.chinese: 他们继续在森林里走路。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men jì xù zài sēn lín lǐ zǒu lù.
sentences.english: They continued walking in the forest.

sentences.chinese: 走了一段时间，大明觉得很累。
sentences.pinyin: Zǒu le yī duàn shí jiān, Dà míng jué de hěn lèi.
sentences.english: After walking for a while, Da Ming felt very tired.

sentences.chinese: 他想在树下休息，但老人说不能停。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng zài shù xià xiū xi, dàn lǎo rén shuō bù néng tíng.
sentences.english: He wanted to rest under a tree, but the old man said they couldn't stop.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个奇怪的人出现在他们面前。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, yī gè qí guài de rén chū xiàn zài tā men miàn qián.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a strange person appeared before them.

sentences.chinese: 大明认识这个人，他是之前的向导。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng rèn shi zhè gè rén, tā shì zhī qián de xiàng dǎo.
sentences.english: Da Ming recognized this person; he was the previous guide.

sentences.chinese: 他们终于见面了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zhōng yú jiàn miàn le.
sentences.english: They finally met each other.

sentences.chinese: 向导说话的声音很大，他说这里有危险。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo shuō huà de shēng yīn hěn dà, tā shuō zhè lǐ yǒu wēi xiǎn.
sentences.english: The guide's voice was very loud, and he said there was danger here.

sentences.chinese: 向导说：“快起来！不要在这里睡觉！”
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo shuō: “Kuài qǐ lái! Bù yào zài zhè lǐ shuì jiào!”
sentences.english: The guide said, "Get up quickly! Don't sleep here!"

sentences.chinese: 大明赶紧站起来。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng gǎn jǐn zhàn qǐ lái.
sentences.english: Da Ming quickly stood up.

sentences.chinese: 向导说他要送大明去一个安全的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo shuō tā yào sòng Dà míng qù yī gè ān quán de dì fang.
sentences.english: The guide said he wanted to send Da Ming to a safe place.

sentences.chinese: 大明跟在向导后面走。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng gēn zài xiàng dǎo hòu miàn zǒu.
sentences.english: Da Ming followed behind the guide.

sentences.chinese: 突然，向导停了下来，指着前面的大门。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, xiàng dǎo tíng le xià lái, zhǐ zhe qián miàn de dà mén.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the guide stopped and pointed to the large gate ahead.

sentences.chinese: 大门上有一个巨大的考字。
sentences.pinyin: Dà mén shàng yǒu yī gè jù dà de kǎo zì.
sentences.english: On the large gate was a giant character 'Kao' (test).

sentences.chinese: 大明想，这难道是另一个考验吗？
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng xiǎng, zhè nán dào shì lìng yī gè kǎo yàn ma?
sentences.english: Da Ming wondered, could this be another trial?

chapters.title_english: Chapter 5: The Riddle of the Ancient Gate

sentences.chinese: 大明看着大门上的那个字。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng kànzhe dàmén shàng de nàge zì.
sentences.english: Daming looked at the character on the great gate.

sentences.chinese: 向导说这个字在中文里很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo shuō zhège zì zài Zhōngwén lǐ hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.english: The guide said this character is very important in Chinese.

sentences.chinese: 大明想，他必须学习中文才能离开这里。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xiǎng, tā bìxū xuéxí Zhōngwén cáinéng líkāi zhèlǐ.
sentences.english: Daming thought he must learn Chinese to be able to leave this place.

sentences.chinese: 大门突然开口说话了，声音很大。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmén tūrán kāikǒu shuōhuà le, shēngyīn hěn dà.
sentences.english: The gate suddenly began to speak, its voice was very loud.

sentences.chinese: 它问大明：“你的名字是什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn Dàmíng: “Nǐ de míngzi shì shénme?”
sentences.english: It asked Daming, "What is your name?"

sentences.chinese: 大明回答说：“我叫大明。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng huídá shuō: “Wǒ jiào Dàmíng.”
sentences.english: Daming answered, "My name is Daming."

sentences.chinese: 大门说：“你要进入这里，必须回答我的问题。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmén shuō: “Nǐ yào jìnrù zhèlǐ, bìxū huídá wǒ de wèntí.”
sentences.english: The gate said, "To enter here, you must answer my questions."

sentences.chinese: 大门给大明一张古老的地图。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmén gěi Dàmíng yī zhāng gǔlǎo de dìtú.
sentences.english: The gate gave Daming an ancient map.

sentences.chinese: 大明从地图上看到很多奇怪的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng cóng dìtú shàng kàndào hěnduō qíguài de dìfāng.
sentences.english: Daming saw many strange places from the map.

sentences.chinese: 地图上写着北京，也写着中国。
sentences.pinyin: Dìtú shàng xiězhe Běijīng, yě xiězhe Zhōngguó.
sentences.english: Beijing was written on the map, and China was written too.

sentences.chinese: 大明想，他以前在外国学习外语。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xiǎng, tā yǐqián zài wàiguó xuéxí wàiyǔ.
sentences.english: Daming thought about how he used to study foreign languages in a foreign country.

sentences.chinese: 现在他在这里，像一个迷路的小朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài tā zài zhèlǐ, xiàng yīgè mílù de xiǎopéngyǒu.
sentences.english: Now he was here, like a lost little child.

sentences.chinese: 大门问：“谁在家里等你？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmén wèn: “Shéi zài jiālǐ děng nǐ?”
sentences.english: The gate asked, "Who is waiting for you at home?"

sentences.chinese: 大明想到了他的家。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xiǎngdào le tā de jiā.
sentences.english: Daming thought of his home.

sentences.chinese: 他想到了他的哥哥和姐姐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngdào le tā de gēge hé jiějie.
sentences.english: He thought of his older brother and older sister.

sentences.chinese: 他的哥哥像个医生，在医院工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de gēge xiàng gè yīshēng, zài yīyuàn gōngzuò.
sentences.english: His older brother was like a doctor, working in a hospital.

sentences.chinese: 他的姐姐在图书馆工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de jiějie zài túshūguǎn gōngzuò.
sentences.english: His older sister worked in a library.

sentences.chinese: 他想到了他的父母，以及他们的儿子和女儿。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngdào le tā de fùmǔ, yǐjí tāmen de érzi hé nǚ'ér.
sentences.english: He thought of his parents, as well as their son and daughter.

sentences.chinese: 他想到了他的妹妹，那个可爱的小孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngdào le tā de mèimei, nàge kě'ài de háizi.
sentences.english: He thought of his younger sister, that cute child.

sentences.chinese: 他甚至想到了他的女朋友，她现在一定很担心他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shènzhì xiǎngdào le tā de nǚpéngyǒu, tā xiànzài yīdìng hěn dānxīn tā.
sentences.english: He even thought of his girlfriend; she must be very worried about him now.

sentences.chinese: 大门问：“你认识这个女人吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmén wèn: “Nǐ rènshi zhège nǚrén ma?”
sentences.english: The gate asked, "Do you know this woman?"

sentences.chinese: 地图上出现了一个女人的画像。
sentences.pinyin: Dìtú shàng chūxiàn le yīgè nǚrén de huàxiàng.
sentences.english: A portrait of a woman appeared on the map.

sentences.chinese: 这个女人看起来像大明的姐。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège nǚrén kàn qǐlái xiàng Dàmíng de jiě.
sentences.english: This woman looked like Daming's sister.

sentences.chinese: 大门说：“这个女人是这里的守护者。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmén shuō: “Zhège nǚrén shì zhèlǐ de shǒuhùzhě.”
sentences.english: The gate said, "This woman is the guardian of this place."

sentences.chinese: 大明觉得这个家伙很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng juéde zhège jiāhuo hěn qíguài.
sentences.english: Daming felt this fellow was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 为了通过考验，大明必须用上声地读出地图上的字。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile tōngguò kǎoyàn, Dàmíng bìxū yòng shǎngshēng de dúchū dìtú shàng de zì.
sentences.english: To pass the test, Daming had to read the characters on the map using the third tone (shǎngshēng).

sentences.chinese: 大明很饿，他想起家里好吃的包子。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng hěn è, tā xiǎngqǐ jiālǐ hǎochī de bāozi.
sentences.english: Daming was very hungry; he remembered the delicious steamed buns at home.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉自己，只要通过这个考字，就能回家。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù zìjǐ, zhǐyào tōngguò zhège kǎo zì, jiù néng huíjiā.
sentences.english: He told himself that as long as he passed this 'test' character, he could go home.

sentences.chinese: 大明深呼吸，准备面对这个巨大的挑战。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng shēnhūxī, zhǔnbèi miànduì zhège jùdà de tiǎozhàn.
sentences.english: Daming took a deep breath, preparing to face this huge challenge.

sentences.chinese: 突然，地图上的字开始发光，一个黑影从门后走出来。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, dìtú shàng de zì kāishǐ fāguāng, yīgè hēiyǐng cóng mén hòu zǒu chūlái.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the characters on the map began to glow, and a dark shadow walked out from behind the door.

sentences.chinese: 黑影慢慢走近大明。
sentences.pinyin: Hēi yǐng màn màn zǒu jìn Dà Míng.
sentences.english: The shadow slowly approached Da Ming.

sentences.chinese: 他看起来像一个古老的工人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐ lái xiàng yī gè gǔ lǎo de gōng rén.
sentences.english: He looked like an ancient worker.

sentences.chinese: 他的衣服很旧，但眼睛在发光。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yī fu hěn jiù, dàn yǎn jīng zài fā guāng.
sentences.english: His clothes were very old, but his eyes were glowing.

sentences.chinese: 黑影笑了，声音很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Hēi yǐng xiào le, shēng yīn hěn qí guài.
sentences.english: The shadow smiled, and his voice was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 他对大明说：“请进，年轻人。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì Dà Míng shuō: “Qǐng jìn, nián qīng rén.”
sentences.english: He said to Da Ming, "Please come in, young man."

sentences.chinese: 大明走进门里，发现这里像一个巨大的房子。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng zǒu jìn mén lǐ, fā xiàn zhè lǐ xiàng yī gè jù dà de fáng zi.
sentences.english: Da Ming walked inside the door and found that this place was like a giant house.

sentences.chinese: 这里有楼下，也有很多房间。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ yǒu lóu xià, yě yǒu hěn duō fáng jiān.
sentences.english: There was a downstairs, and there were also many rooms.

sentences.chinese: 大明问他：“你是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng wèn tā: “Nǐ shì shuí?”
sentences.english: Da Ming asked him, "Who are you?"

sentences.chinese: 工人说：“我是这里的守护者，也是你的朋友。”
sentences.pinyin: Gōng rén shuō: “Wǒ shì zhè lǐ de shǒu hù zhě, yě shì nǐ de péng you.”
sentences.english: The worker said, "I am the guardian of this place, and also your friend."

sentences.chinese: 大明想起了他的弟弟，他最想念弟弟。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng xiǎng qǐ le tā de dì di, tā zuì xiǎng niàn dì di.
sentences.english: Da Ming thought of his younger brother; he missed his younger brother the most.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果弟弟在这里，一定会很害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rú guǒ dì di zài zhè lǐ, yī dìng huì hěn hài pà.
sentences.english: He thought that if his younger brother were here, he would definitely be very scared.

sentences.chinese: 房间里有很多奇怪的东西。
sentences.pinyin: Fáng jiān lǐ yǒu hěn duō qí guài de dōng xī.
sentences.english: There were many strange things in the room.

sentences.chinese: 有一台古老的电脑，上面写着汉语。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu yī tái gǔ lǎo de diàn nǎo, shàng miàn xiě zhe Hàn yǔ.
sentences.english: There was an ancient computer with Chinese written on it.

sentences.chinese: 大明在网上看到过这种机器，但这个不一样。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng zài wǎng shàng kàn guò zhè zhǒng jī qì, dàn zhè gè bù yī yàng.
sentences.english: Da Ming had seen this kind of machine online, but this one was different.

sentences.chinese: 桌子上有一些食物：米饭，面包和水果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī xiē shí wù: mǐ fàn, miàn bāo hé shuǐ guǒ.
sentences.english: There was some food on the table: cooked rice, bread, and fruit.

sentences.chinese: 还有一杯白色的牛奶。
sentences.pinyin: Hái yǒu yī bēi bái sè de niú nǎi.
sentences.english: There was also a glass of white cow's milk.

sentences.chinese: 大明很饿，他想吃米饭和面包。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng hěn è, tā xiǎng chī mǐ fàn hé miàn bāo.
sentences.english: Da Ming was very hungry; he wanted to eat the rice and bread.

sentences.chinese: 工人看着大明，突然问他：“你记得你的男朋友吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Gōng rén kàn zhe Dà Míng, tū rán wèn tā: “Nǐ jì dé nǐ de nán péng you ma?”
sentences.english: The worker looked at Da Ming and suddenly asked him, "Do you remember your boyfriend?"

sentences.chinese: 大明很惊讶，因为他没有男朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng hěn jīng yà, yīn wèi tā méi yǒu nán péng you.
sentences.english: Da Ming was very surprised because he didn't have a boyfriend.

sentences.chinese: 工人笑了起来，说这是一个玩笑。
sentences.pinyin: Gōng rén xiào le qǐ lái, shuō zhè shì yī gè wán xiào.
sentences.english: The worker started laughing and said it was a joke.

sentences.chinese: 他翻开书的第六页，指着上面的字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fān kāi shū de dì liù yè, zhǐ zhe shàng miàn de zì.
sentences.english: He flipped to the sixth page of the book and pointed to the characters on it.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“在这个世界，你可以像飞机一样飞。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zài zhè gè shì jiè, nǐ kě yǐ xiàng fēi jī yī yàng fēi.”
sentences.english: He said, "In this world, you can fly like an airplane."

sentences.chinese: 大明想起他在车上的时候，还没准备好面对这一切。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng xiǎng qǐ tā zài chē shàng de shí hou, hái méi zhǔn bèi hǎo miàn duì zhè yī qiè.
sentences.english: Da Ming remembered when he was in the car, he wasn't ready to face all this.

sentences.chinese: 现在他必须干很多困难的工作才能回家。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài tā bì xū gàn hěn duō kùn nan de gōng zuò cái néng huí jiā.
sentences.english: Now he must do a lot of difficult work to be able to go home.

sentences.chinese: 突然，地上的字再次发光，一个巨大的洞出现了。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, dì shàng de zì zài cì fā guāng, yī gè jù dà de dòng chū xiàn le.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the characters on the ground glowed again, and a giant hole appeared.

sentences.chinese: 大明看着地上的洞，心跳很快。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng kàn zhe dì shàng de dòng, xīn tiào hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Da Ming looked at the hole on the ground, his heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 他跳进了洞里，像一个球一样在空中滚动。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tiào jìn le dòng lǐ, xiàng yí gè qiú yí yàng zài kōng zhōng gǔn dòng.
sentences.english: He jumped into the hole, rolling in the air like a ball.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他看到了一个奇怪的地点。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, tā kàn dào le yí gè qí guài de dì diǎn.
sentences.english: Suddenly, he saw a strange place.

sentences.chinese: 这里像是一个巨大的商场，但没有一个人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ xiàng shì yí gè jù dà de shāng chǎng, dàn méi yǒu yí gè rén.
sentences.english: This place looked like a giant shopping mall, but there wasn't a single person.

sentences.chinese: 大明在路边看到一个商店，里面有很多发光的字。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng zài lù biān kàn dào yí gè shāng diàn, lǐ miàn yǒu hěn duō fā guāng de zì.
sentences.english: Da Ming saw a store by the road, inside were many glowing characters.

sentences.chinese: 他想起在自己的国家，商店里没有这样的字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ zài zì jǐ de guó jiā, shāng diàn lǐ méi yǒu zhè yàng de zì.
sentences.english: He remembered that in his own country, stores didn't have characters like these.

sentences.chinese: 他走近看，发现这些字在讲述一个女人的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu jìn kàn, fā xiàn zhè xiē zì zài jiǎng shù yí gè nǚ rén de gù shì.
sentences.english: He walked closer and discovered these characters were telling the story of a woman.

sentences.chinese: 这个女人是他的妈妈，或者说，像他的妈妈。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè nǚ rén shì tā de mā ma, huò zhě shuō, xiàng tā de mā ma.
sentences.english: This woman was his mother, or rather, looked like his mother.

sentences.chinese: 书上的字说，这个女人的儿子在这里等待。
sentences.pinyin: Shū shàng de zì shuō, zhè gè nǚ rén de ér zi zài zhè lǐ děng dài.
sentences.english: The characters in the book said this woman's son was waiting here.

sentences.chinese: 大明想，这个子是不是在说我？
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng xiǎng, zhè gè zǐ shì bú shì zài shuō wǒ?
sentences.english: Da Ming thought, is this 'son' referring to me?

sentences.chinese: 他突然听到一声巨大的号，像是一头怪兽在叫。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tū rán tīng dào yì shēng jù dà de hào, xiàng shì yì tóu guài shòu zài jiào.
sentences.english: Suddenly he heard a loud roar, like a monster screaming.

sentences.chinese: 他害怕地跑进一个房间，那里有一张床和一个桌子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hài pà de pǎo jìn yí gè fáng jiān, nà lǐ yǒu yì zhāng chuáng hé yí gè zhuō zi.
sentences.english: Terrified, he ran into a room where there was a bed and a table.

sentences.chinese: 桌子上面有一个杯子，杯子里有蓝色的水。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuō zi shàng miàn yǒu yí gè bēi zi, bēi zi lǐ yǒu lán sè de shuǐ.
sentences.english: On the table was a cup, and inside the cup was blue water.

sentences.chinese: 大明看到桌子上还有一个手机，但手机没有电。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng kàn dào zhuō zi shàng hái yǒu yí gè shǒu jī, dàn shǒu jī méi yǒu diàn.
sentences.english: Da Ming saw there was also a cell phone on the table, but the phone had no electricity.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试打开手机，想给他的爸发一条信息。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cháng shì dǎ kāi shǒu jī, xiǎng gěi tā de bà fā yì tiáo xìn xī.
sentences.english: He tried to turn on the phone, wanting to send a message to his dad.

sentences.chinese: 他想告诉爸爸，他现在在做什么事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng gào sù bà ba, tā xiàn zài zài zuò shén me shì.
sentences.english: He wanted to tell his father what matter he was dealing with now.

sentences.chinese: 他想起家里，妈妈在准备晚饭，爸爸在看电影。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ jiā lǐ, mā ma zài zhǔn bèi wǎn fàn, bà ba zài kàn diàn yǐng.
sentences.english: He thought of home, where mama was preparing dinner and papa was watching a movie.

sentences.chinese: 他突然想起，他现在没有机票，不能坐汽车回家。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tū rán xiǎng qǐ, tā xiàn zài méi yǒu jī piào, bù néng zuò qì chē huí jiā.
sentences.english: He suddenly remembered he had no air ticket now and couldn't take a car home.

sentences.chinese: 他低头看书，这本书的本原是这个世界的地图。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dī tóu kàn shū, zhè běn shū de běn yuán shì zhè gè shì jiè de dì tú.
sentences.english: He looked down at the book; the origin of this book was a map of this world.

sentences.chinese: 窗外，一个巨大的月亮在发光。
sentences.pinyin: Chuāng wài, yí gè jù dà de yuè liàng zài fā guāng.
sentences.english: Outside the window, a giant moon was glowing.

sentences.chinese: 大明觉得口渴，他想找洗手间洗洗脸。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng jué de kǒu kě, tā xiǎng zhǎo xǐ shǒu jiān xǐ xǐ liǎn.
sentences.english: Da Ming felt thirsty and wanted to find the washroom to wash his face.

sentences.chinese: 他走到洗手间，发现墙上有一个小点在闪烁。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu dào xǐ shǒu jiān, fā xiàn qiáng shàng yǒu yí gè xiǎo diǎn zài shǎn shuò.
sentences.english: He walked to the washroom and found a small dot flashing on the wall.

sentences.chinese: 那个点突然变成了一张机票，上面写着他的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè diǎn tū rán biàn chéng le yì zhāng jī piào, shàng miàn xiě zhe tā de míng zì.
sentences.english: That dot suddenly turned into an air ticket with his name written on it.

sentences.chinese: 大明很惊讶，他不知道这张票能带他去哪里。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng hěn jīng yà, tā bù zhī dào zhè zhāng piào néng dài tā qù nǎ lǐ.
sentences.english: Da Ming was very surprised; he didn't know where this ticket could take him.

sentences.chinese: 他听到外面又传来了声音，有人在叫他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīng dào wài miàn yòu chuán lái le shēng yīn, yǒu rén zài jiào tā.
sentences.english: He heard sounds from outside again; someone was calling him.

sentences.chinese: 大明拿起杯子，准备面对新的挑战。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng ná qǐ bēi zi, zhǔn bèi miàn duì xīn de tiǎo zhàn.
sentences.english: Da Ming picked up the cup, preparing to face a new challenge.

sentences.chinese: 谁在洞穴的城市里等着他？
sentences.pinyin: Shéi zài dòng xué de chéng shì lǐ děng zhe tā?
sentences.english: Who is waiting for him in the cavern city?

sentences.chinese: 大明拿着那张票，走出了洞穴的门口。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng názhe nà zhāng piào, zǒuchūle dòngxué de ménkǒu.
sentences.english: Daming held the ticket and walked out of the cave entrance.

sentences.chinese: 外面突然刮起了很大的风。
sentences.pinyin: Wàimiàn tūrán guāqǐle hěn dà de fēng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a strong wind blew outside.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一个奇怪的城市，那里像一个巨大的电影院。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào yīgè qíguài de chéngshì, nàlǐ xiàng yīgè jùdà de diànyǐngyuàn.
sentences.english: He saw a strange city that looked like a giant cinema.

sentences.chinese: 一个男人走过来，他的身体看起来很不舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè nánrén zǒu guòlái, tā de shēntǐ kàn qǐlái hěn bù shūfu.
sentences.english: A man walked over, and his body looked very uncomfortable.

sentences.chinese: 大明问：“请问，这里是哪里？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng wèn: “Qǐngwèn, zhèlǐ shì nǎlǐ?”
sentences.english: Daming asked, "Excuse me, where is this place?"

sentences.chinese: 那个男人像一个病人，说话的声音很小。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè nánrén xiàng yīgè bìngrén, shuōhuà de shēngyīn hěn xiǎo.
sentences.english: That man was like a sick person, and his voice was very low.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“这里是记忆之城，但回家的路很远。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zhèlǐ shì jìyì zhī chéng, dàn huíjiā de lù hěn yuǎn.”
sentences.english: He said, "This is the City of Memory, but the road home is very far."

sentences.chinese: 男人告诉大明，要回家必须去那个车站。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén gàosù Dàmíng, yào huíjiā bìxū qù nàgè chēzhàn.
sentences.english: The man told Daming that to go home, he must go to that station.

sentences.chinese: 大明觉得这个任务很难，但他没有放弃。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng juédé zhège rènwu hěn nán, dàn tā méiyǒu fàngqì.
sentences.english: Daming felt this task was very difficult, but he did not give up.

sentences.chinese: 他们走进一家饭店，大明想吃点饭。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒujìn yījiā fàndiàn, Dàmíng xiǎng chī diǎn fàn.
sentences.english: They walked into a restaurant, and Daming wanted to eat a meal.

sentences.chinese: 桌上有肉，有鸡蛋，还有很多好菜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuōshàng yǒu ròu, yǒu jīdàn, hái yǒu hěnduō hǎo cài.
sentences.english: On the table there was meat, eggs, and many good dishes.

sentences.chinese: 大明喝了一杯热茶，感觉舒服了很多。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng hēle yī bēi rè chá, gǎnjué shūfu le hěnduō.
sentences.english: Daming drank a cup of hot tea and felt much better.

sentences.chinese: 在饭店里，他看到很多行奇怪的字在墙上发光。
sentences.pinyin: Zài fàndiàn lǐ, tā kàndào hěnduō háng qíguài de zì zài qiángshàng fāguāng.
sentences.english: In the restaurant, he saw many rows of strange characters glowing on the wall.

sentences.chinese: 这些字像是在说某种古老的语言，或者是一种秘密的话。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē zì xiàng shì zài shuō mǒu zhǒng gǔlǎo de yǔyán, huòzhě shì yī zhǒng mìmì de huà.
sentences.english: These characters seemed to be speaking some kind of ancient language, or a kind of secret words.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他看到桌子上有一个旧的电视机。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, tā kàndào zhuōzi shàng yǒu yīgè jiù de diànshìjī.
sentences.english: Suddenly, he saw an old television set on the table.

sentences.chinese: 这个电视机没有电，但屏幕上出现了一个电话号码。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège diànshìjī méiyǒu diàn, dàn píngmù shàng chūxiànle yīgè diànhuà hàomǎ.
sentences.english: This television set had no power, but a phone number appeared on the screen.

sentences.chinese: 大明想起家里的电视，他很想念家人。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xiǎngqǐ jiālǐ de diànshì, tā hěn xiǎngniàn jiārén.
sentences.english: Daming thought of the TV at home; he missed his family very much.

sentences.chinese: 他打开钱包，发现里面没有钱，只有一张旧照片。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dǎkāi qiánbāo, fāxiàn lǐmiàn méiyǒu qián, zhǐyǒu yī zhāng jiù zhàopiàn.
sentences.english: He opened his wallet and found there was no money, only an old photo.

sentences.chinese: 这时，电视机突然说话了，声音很大。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, diànshìjī tūrán shuōhuà le, shēngyīn hěn dà.
sentences.english: At that moment, the television set suddenly spoke, and the voice was very loud.

sentences.chinese: 它说：“如果你想离开，就拨打这个电话。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng líkāi, jiù bōdǎ zhège diànhuà.”
sentences.english: It said, "If you want to leave, dial this phone number."

sentences.chinese: 大明拿起电话，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng náqǐ diànhuà, xīntiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Daming picked up the phone, his heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 电话那边传来了熟悉的声音，但声音很模糊。
sentences.pinyin: Diànhuà nàbiān chuánláile shúxī de shēngyīn, dàn shēngyīn hěn móhu.
sentences.english: A familiar voice came from the other end, but the voice was very blurry.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，地上的光突然消失了，一个黑影再次出现。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhèshí, dìshàng de guāng tūrán xiāoshī le, yīgè hēiyǐng zàicì chūxiàn.
sentences.english: Just then, the light on the ground suddenly disappeared, and a dark shadow appeared again.

sentences.chinese: 黑影走在光里，他的样子和大明一样。
sentences.pinyin: Hēiyǐng zǒu zài guāng lǐ, tā de yàngzi hé Dàmíng yīyàng.
sentences.english: The shadow walked in the light, and his appearance was the same as Da Ming's.

sentences.chinese: 大明觉得不对，这个黑影是谁？
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng juéde bùduì, zhège hēiyǐng shì shéi?
sentences.english: Da Ming felt something was wrong; who was this shadow?

sentences.chinese: 黑影说话了，他的声音非常大。
sentences.pinyin: Hēiyǐng shuōhuà le, tā de shēngyīn fēicháng dà.
sentences.english: The shadow spoke, and his voice was very loud.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“这里有很多知识，但你太快了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zhèlǐ yǒu hěnduō zhīshi, dàn nǐ tài kuài le.”
sentences.english: He said, "There is much knowledge here, but you are too fast."

sentences.chinese: 大明很认真地看着他，想明白这个意思。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng hěn rènzhēn de kànzhe tā, xiǎng míngbai zhège yìsi.
sentences.english: Da Ming looked at him very seriously, trying to understand the meaning.

sentences.chinese: 黑影指着桌子上的一本书，那本书好看，也很有名。
sentences.pinyin: Hēiyǐng zhǐzhe zhuōzi shàng de yī běn shū, nà běn shū hǎokàn, yě hěn yǒumíng.
sentences.english: The shadow pointed to a book on the table; that book was good-looking and also very famous.

sentences.chinese: 大明问：“这本书重要吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng wèn: “Zhè běn shū zhòngyào ma?”
sentences.english: Da Ming asked, "Is this book important?"

sentences.chinese: 黑影说：“是对的，这本书非常重要。”
sentences.pinyin: Hēiyǐng shuō: “Shì duì de, zhè běn shū fēicháng zhòngyào.”
sentences.english: The shadow said, "That is correct, this book is very important."

sentences.chinese: 大明拿起书，发现书页很干净。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng ná qǐ shū, fāxiàn shūyè hěn gānjìng.
sentences.english: Da Ming picked up the book and found the pages were very clean.

sentences.chinese: 书里写着：“真正的力量是知识。”
sentences.pinyin: Shū lǐ xiězhe: “Zhēnzhèng de lìliàng shì zhīshi.”
sentences.english: Inside the book it was written: "True power is knowledge."

sentences.chinese: 大明想，这真的很好。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xiǎng, zhè zhēn de hěn hǎo.
sentences.english: Da Ming thought this was really good.

sentences.chinese: 黑影突然笑了起来，他说：“你想回家，就得走对这一着。”
sentences.pinyin: Hēiyǐng tūrán xiào le qǐlái, tā shuō: “Nǐ xiǎng huíjiā, jiù děi zǒu duì zhè yī zhāo.”
sentences.english: The shadow suddenly started laughing and said, "If you want to go home, you must make the right move."

sentences.chinese: 大明问：“怎么走？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng wèn: “Zěnme zǒu?”
sentences.english: Da Ming asked, "How do I go?"

sentences.chinese: 黑影说：“你看，这里有三种水果。”
sentences.pinyin: Hēiyǐng shuō: “Nǐ kàn, zhèlǐ yǒu sān zhǒng shuǐguǒ.”
sentences.english: The shadow said, "Look, there are three kinds of fruit here."

sentences.chinese: 桌子上的水果看起来很好吃，但大明知道这是一个陷阱。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng de shuǐguǒ kàn qǐlái hěn hǎochī, dàn Dàmíng zhīdào zhè shì yī gè xiànjǐng.
sentences.english: The fruit on the table looked delicious, but Da Ming knew this was a trap.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这些水果太贵了，不是普通的食物。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde zhèxiē shuǐguǒ tài guì le, bù shì pǔtōng de shíwù.
sentences.english: He felt these fruits were too expensive, not ordinary food.

sentences.chinese: 大明明白了，这不是关于吃，而是关于选择。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng míngbai le, zhè bù shì guānyú chī, ér shì guānyú xuǎnzé.
sentences.english: Da Ming understood that this was not about eating, but about choosing.

sentences.chinese: 他马上告诉黑影：“我不需要好吃的东西，我只要回家。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā mǎshàng gàosù hēiyǐng: “Wǒ bù xūyào hǎochī de dōngxi, wǒ zhǐyào huíjiā.”
sentences.english: He immediately told the shadow, "I don't need tasty things, I only want to go home."

sentences.chinese: 黑影真惊讶，他没有想到大明这么聪明。
sentences.pinyin: Hēiyǐng zhēn jīngyà, tā méiyǒu xiǎngdào Dàmíng zhème cōngmíng.
sentences.english: The shadow was truly surprised; he didn't expect Da Ming to be so smart.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“好，你通过了这次考验。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Hǎo, nǐ tōngguò le zhè cì kǎoyàn.”
sentences.english: He said, "All right, you have passed this test."

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，房间里的光突然变了颜色。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, fángjiān lǐ de guāng tūrán biàn le yánsè.
sentences.english: But just then, the light in the room suddenly changed color.

sentences.chinese: 黑影的身影开始变得模糊。
sentences.pinyin: Hēiyǐng de shēnyǐng kāishǐ biàn de móhu.
sentences.english: The shadow's figure began to become blurry.

sentences.chinese: 大明大喊：“你快告诉我怎么走！”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng dà hǎn: “Nǐ kuài gàosù wǒ zěnme zǒu!”
sentences.english: Da Ming shouted, "Quickly tell me how to go!"

sentences.chinese: 黑影消失前说了一句话，声音很小。
sentences.pinyin: Hēiyǐng xiāoshī qián shuō le yī jù huà, shēngyīn hěn xiǎo.
sentences.english: Before disappearing, the shadow said a sentence in a very small voice.

sentences.chinese: 大明听不清楚，但门突然打开了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng tīng bù qīngchǔ, dàn mén tūrán dǎkāi le.
sentences.english: Da Ming couldn't hear clearly, but the door suddenly opened.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 10: Strangers of the Ancient City

sentences.chinese: 大明走进了门，发现这是一个巨大的广场。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng zǒujìn le mén, fāxiàn zhè shì yī gè jùdà de guǎngchǎng.
sentences.english: Daming walked through the door and found that it was a huge square.

sentences.chinese: 这里有很多奇怪的人，他们穿着古老的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ yǒu hěnduō qíguài de rén, tāmen chuānzhe gǔlǎo de yīfu.
sentences.english: There were many strange people here, and they were wearing ancient clothes.

sentences.chinese: 大明看到几个女人在说话，她们看起来很担心。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng kàndào jǐ gè nǚrén zài shuōhuà, tāmen kàn qǐlái hěn dānxīn.
sentences.english: Daming saw a few women talking; they looked very worried.

sentences.chinese: 一个男人走过来，他姓东，是大明的向导。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè nánrén zǒu guòlái, tā xìng Dōng, shì Dàmíng de xiàngdǎo.
sentences.english: A man walked over; his surname was Dong, and he was Daming's guide.

sentences.chinese: 东先生说：“你们终于来了！”
sentences.pinyin: Dōng xiānsheng shuō: “Nǐmen zhōngyú lái le!”
sentences.english: Mr. Dong said, "You all have finally arrived!"

sentences.chinese: 大明很惊讶，他问：“你们是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng hěn jīngyà, tā wèn: “Nǐmen shì shéi?”
sentences.english: Daming was very surprised and asked, "Who are you?"

sentences.chinese: 东先生指着广场上的那些人说：“这些人是这里的守护者。”
sentences.pinyin: Dōng xiānsheng zhǐzhe guǎngchǎng shàng de nàxiē rén shuō: “Zhèxiē rén shì zhèlǐ de shǒuhùzhě.”
sentences.english: Mr. Dong pointed to those people on the square and said, "These people are the guardians of this place."

sentences.chinese: 大明想起前天他在书里看到的汉字，觉得这里很熟悉。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xiǎngqǐ qiántiān tā zài shū lǐ kàndào de hànzì, juédé zhèlǐ hěn shúxī.
sentences.english: Daming remembered the Chinese characters he saw in the book the day before yesterday and felt that this place was very familiar.

sentences.chinese: 他记得上次在森林里，他也见到了类似的符号。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìdé shàngcì zài sēnlín lǐ, tā yě jiàndào le lèisì de fúhào.
sentences.english: He remembered that last time in the forest, he had also seen similar symbols.

sentences.chinese: 东先生带他走到一张小几旁边，上面有一本书。
sentences.pinyin: Dōng xiānsheng dài tā zǒu dào yī zhāng jǐ pángbiān, shàngmiàn yǒu yī běn shū.
sentences.english: Mr. Dong led him to a small table, on which there was a book.

sentences.chinese: 这本书叫《大学》，里面记录了古城的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū jiào «Dàxué», lǐmiàn jìlù le gǔchéng de mìmì.
sentences.english: This book was called "The Great Learning," and it recorded the secrets of the ancient city.

sentences.chinese: 大明看到书页被撕掉了一半，心里很不安。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng kàndào shūyè bèi sī diào le yībàn, xīnlǐ hěn bù'ān.
sentences.english: Daming saw that half of the pages had been torn out, and he felt uneasy.

sentences.chinese: 他问：“哪些页码不见了？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn: “Nǎxiē yèmǎ bùjiàn le?”
sentences.english: He asked, "Which page numbers are missing?"

sentences.chinese: 东先生叹了口气，说：“这很难解释。”
sentences.pinyin: Dōng xiānsheng tàn le kǒu qì, shuō: “Zhè hěn nán jiěshì.”
sentences.english: Mr. Dong sighed and said, "This is hard to explain."

sentences.chinese: 大明想起了他在现实世界里的一个网友，那个网友很擅长解谜。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xiǎngqǐ le tā zài xiànshí shìjiè lǐ de yī gè wǎngyǒu, nàge wǎngyǒu hěn shàncháng jiěmí.
sentences.english: Daming thought of an online friend in the real world; that online friend was very good at solving puzzles.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果能给网友发消息，也许能找到答案。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rúguǒ néng gěi wǎngyǒu fā xiāoxi, yěxǔ néng zhǎodào dá'àn.
sentences.english: He thought that if he could send a message to his online friend, he might find the answer.

sentences.chinese: 大明看着这些发光的石头，好奇地问：“那儿有什么吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng kànzhe zhèxiē fāguāng de shítou, hàoqí de wèn: “Nà'er yǒu shénme ma?”
sentences.english: Daming looked at these glowing stones and asked curiously, "Is there something there?"

sentences.chinese: 东先生告诉他，明天他们必须出发去寻找缺失的页码。
sentences.pinyin: Dōng xiānsheng gàosù tā, míngtiān tāmen bìxū chūfā qù xúnzhǎo quēshī de yèmǎ.
sentences.english: Mr. Dong told him that tomorrow they must set out to find the missing pages.

sentences.chinese: 此时，一群人走过来，大明不知道他们是敌人还是朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Cǐshí, yī qún rén zǒu guòlái, Dàmíng bù zhīdào tāmen shì dírén háishì péngyǒu.
sentences.english: At this moment, a group of people walked over, and Daming didn't know if they were enemies or friends.

sentences.chinese: 为了缓解紧张，东先生请大明吃一碗热的面条儿。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile huǎnjiě jǐnzhāng, Dōng xiānsheng qǐng Dàmíng chī yī wǎn rè de miàntiáo'er.
sentences.english: To ease the tension, Mr. Dong invited Daming to eat a bowl of hot noodles.

sentences.chinese: 大明自个儿吃得很开心，但心里的疑问越来越多。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng zìgě'er chī dé hěn kāixīn, dàn xīnlǐ de yíwèn yuè lái yuè duō.
sentences.english: Daming ate happily by himself, but the doubts in his heart grew more and more.

sentences.chinese: 谁在操纵这一切？
sentences.pinyin: Shéi zài cāozòng zhè yīqiè?
sentences.english: Who is manipulating all of this?

sentences.chinese: 突然，地上的影子再次移动，指向了远方的一座高塔。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, dìshàng de yǐngzi zàicì yídòng, zhǐxiàng le yuǎnfāng de yī zuò gāotǎ.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the shadow on the ground moved again, pointing toward a high tower in the distance.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 11: Secrets of the High Tower

sentences.chinese: 大明看着远方的高塔，心中充满了疑问。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng kànzhe yuǎnfāng de gāotǎ, xīnzhōng chōngmǎnle yíwèn.
sentences.english: Daming looked at the high tower in the distance, his heart full of questions.

sentences.chinese: 东先生看着大明，说：“我们要一起去那个塔。”
sentences.pinyin: Dōng xiānsheng kànzhe Dàmíng, shuō: “Wǒmen yào yīqǐ qù nàge tǎ.”
sentences.english: Mr. Dong looked at Daming and said, "We must go to that tower together."

sentences.chinese: 大明问：“那里有什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng wèn: “Nàlǐ yǒu shénme?”
sentences.english: Daming asked, "What is there?"

sentences.chinese: 东先生笑了笑，说：“那里有你需要的答案。”
sentences.pinyin: Dōng xiānsheng xiàole xiào, shuō: “Nàlǐ yǒu nǐ xūyào de dá'àn.”
sentences.english: Mr. Dong smiled and said, "There are the answers you need."

sentences.chinese: 他们走在路上，看到了一些奇怪的石头。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒu zài lùshàng, kàndàole yīxiē qíguài de shítou.
sentences.english: As they walked along the road, they saw some strange stones.

sentences.chinese: 大明发现这些石头上有数字。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng fāxiàn zhèxiē shítou shàng yǒu shùzì.
sentences.english: Daming discovered that there were numbers on these stones.

sentences.chinese: 第一块石头上写着一。
sentences.pinyin: Dì yī kuài shítou shàng xiězhe yī.
sentences.english: On the first stone, the number one was written.

sentences.chinese: 第二块石头上写着二。
sentences.pinyin: Dì èr kuài shítou shàng xiězhe èr.
sentences.english: On the second stone, the number two was written.

sentences.chinese: 大明想，这是不是一个谜题？
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xiǎng, zhè shì bùshì yīgè mítí?
sentences.english: Daming wondered if this was a puzzle.

sentences.chinese: 他继续看，发现了三，四，五，六。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìxù kàn, fāxiànle sān, sì, wǔ, liù.
sentences.english: He continued to look and found three, four, five, six.

sentences.chinese: 然后是七，八，九，十。
sentences.pinyin: Ránhòu shì qī, bā, jiǔ, shí.
sentences.english: Then came seven, eight, nine, ten.

sentences.chinese: 东先生说：“这些数字代表时间。”
sentences.pinyin: Dōng xiānsheng shuō: “Zhèxiē shùzì dàibiǎo shíjiān.”
sentences.english: Mr. Dong said, "These numbers represent time."

sentences.chinese: 大明问：“多少时间？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng wèn: “Duōshǎo shíjiān?”
sentences.english: Daming asked, "How much time?"

sentences.chinese: 东先生说：“我们需要在半个小时内到达塔下。”
sentences.pinyin: Dōng xiānsheng shuō: “Wǒmen xūyào zài bàn gè xiǎoshí nèi dàodá tǎ xià.”
sentences.english: Mr. Dong said, "We need to reach the bottom of the tower within half an hour."

sentences.chinese: 大明觉得时间不大，但路很长。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng juéde shíjiān bù dà, dàn lù hěn cháng.
sentences.english: Daming felt the time was not much, but the road was long.

sentences.chinese: 突然，大明听到身后有声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, Dàmíng tīngdào shēnhòu yǒu shēngyīn.
sentences.english: Suddenly, Daming heard a sound behind him.

sentences.chinese: 他回头看，发现有两个人在跟着他们。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huítóu kàn, fāxiàn yǒu liǎng gè rén zài gēnzhe tāmen.
sentences.english: He looked back and found that two people were following them.

sentences.chinese: 大明问东先生：“那是谁？是别人吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng wèn Dōng xiānsheng: “Nà shì shuí? Shì biérén ma?”
sentences.english: Daming asked Mr. Dong, "Who is that? Are they other people?"

sentences.chinese: 东先生低声说：“不要管别人，快走！”
sentences.pinyin: Dōng xiānsheng dīshēng shuō: “Bùyào guǎn biérén, kuài zǒu!”
sentences.english: Mr. Dong whispered, "Don't mind others, move quickly!"

sentences.chinese: 大明想知道那是些什么人，但东先生不让他回头。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xiǎng zhīdào nà shì xiē shénme rén, dàn Dōng xiānsheng bù ràng tā huítóu.
sentences.english: Daming wanted to know what kind of people they were, but Mr. Dong wouldn't let him look back.

sentences.chinese: 他们走到了一个分叉路口。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒudàole yīgè fēnchālùkǒu.
sentences.english: They arrived at a fork in the road.

sentences.chinese: 大明问：“我们走哪条路？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng wèn: “Wǒmen zǒu nǎ tiáo lù?”
sentences.english: Daming asked, "Which path do we take?"

sentences.chinese: 东先生看着地图说：“走左边那条，右边那条路坏了。”
sentences.pinyin: Dōng xiānsheng kànzhe dìtú shuō: “Zǒu zuǒbiān nà tiáo, yòubiān nà tiáo lù huàile.”
sentences.english: Mr. Dong looked at the map and said, "Take the one on the left; the road on the right is broken."

sentences.chinese: 大明问：“哪里坏了？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng wèn: “Nǎlǐ huàile?”
sentences.english: Daming asked, "Where is it broken?"

sentences.chinese: 东先生指着右边的断崖说：“那里不能走。”
sentences.pinyin: Dōng xiānsheng zhǐzhe yòubiān de duànyá shuō: “Nàlǐ bùnéng zǒu.”
sentences.english: Mr. Dong pointed to the cliff on the right and said, "You cannot go there."

sentences.chinese: 大明心想，如果走错了路，就再也找不到回家的方法了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xīnxiǎng, rúguǒ zǒu cuòle lù, jiù zài yě zhǎo bù dào huíjiā de fāngfǎ le.
sentences.english: Daming thought to himself that if he took the wrong path, he would never find the way home again.

sentences.chinese: 他问：“除了这个，还有别的路吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn: “Chúle zhège, hái yǒu bié de lù ma?”
sentences.english: He asked, "Besides this, is there any other path?"

sentences.chinese: 东先生说：“没有别的路了，我们先走。”
sentences.pinyin: Dōng xiānsheng shuō: “Méiyǒu bié de lù le, wǒmen xiān zǒu.”
sentences.english: Mr. Dong said, "There are no other paths, let's go first."

sentences.chinese: 他们快步走在林间，大明感觉心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen kuàibù zǒu zài línjiān, Dàmíng gǎnjué xīntiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: They walked quickly through the woods, and Daming felt his heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 突然，那两个陌生人追上了他们。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, nà liǎng gè mòshēng rén zhuī shàngle tāmen.
sentences.english: Suddenly, those two strangers caught up with them.

sentences.chinese: 其中一个人大喊：“再见，大明！”
sentences.pinyin: Qízhōng yīgè rén dàhǎn: “Zàijiàn, Dàmíng!”
sentences.english: One of them shouted, "Goodbye, Daming!"

sentences.chinese: 大明很惊讶，对方怎么知道他的名字？
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng hěn jīngyà, duìfāng zěnme zhīdào tā de míngzì?
sentences.english: Daming was very surprised; how did the other party know his name?

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，高塔的大门突然在他们面前打开了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, gāotǎ de dàmén tūrán zài tāmen miànqián dǎkāile.
sentences.english: At that moment, the great door of the high tower suddenly opened before them.

sentences.chinese: 门后是一片漆黑，大明不知道里面有什么在等着他。
sentences.pinyin: Mén hòu shì yīpiàn qīhēi, Dàmíng bù zhīdào lǐmiàn yǒu shénme zài děngzhe tā.
sentences.english: Behind the door was total darkness, and Daming did not know what was waiting for him inside.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十二章：黑暗中的声音

sentences.chinese: 大明走进高塔的大门，这里很黑。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng zǒujìn gāotǎ de dàmén, zhèlǐ hěn hēi.
sentences.english: Daming walked into the main gate of the high tower; it was very dark here.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这儿有一些奇怪的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde zhèr yǒu yīxiē qíguài de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: He felt there were some strange sounds here.

sentences.chinese: 他心想：“我怎么会来到这里？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā xīnxiǎng: “Wǒ zěnme huì láidào zhèlǐ?”
sentences.english: He thought to himself, "How did I come here?"

sentences.chinese: 我们必须小心，因为这里很危险。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū xiǎoxīn, yīnwèi zhèlǐ hěn wēixiǎn.
sentences.english: We must be careful because it is very dangerous here.

sentences.chinese: 大明想起他的爷爷，爷爷是一个老探险家。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xiǎngqǐ tā de yéye, yéye shì yīgè lǎo tànxiǎnjiā.
sentences.english: Daming thought of his grandfather; his grandfather was an old explorer.

sentences.chinese: 爷爷常常告诉他，冒险的时候不能害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Yéye chángcháng gàosù tā, màoxiǎn de shíhòu bùnéng hàipà.
sentences.english: Grandfather often told him that one must not be afraid during an adventure.

sentences.chinese: 大明的包里有一些小东西，但食物很少。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng de bāo lǐ yǒu yīxiē xiǎo dōngxī, dàn shíwù hěn shǎo.
sentences.english: There were some small things in Daming's bag, but food was scarce.

sentences.chinese: 他现在觉得很饿，肚子在叫。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiànzài juéde hěn è, dùzi zài jiào.
sentences.english: He feels very hungry now, and his stomach is growling.

sentences.chinese: 他看到前面有两条路，这是第二道考验。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào qiánmiàn yǒu liǎng tiáo lù, zhè shì dì-èr dào kǎoyàn.
sentences.english: He saw two paths ahead; this is the second test.

sentences.chinese: 有的路很宽，有的路很窄。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu de lù hěn kuān, yǒu de lù hěn zhǎi.
sentences.english: Some paths are wide, and some are narrow.

sentences.chinese: 有些路看起来很安全，有些路却很黑。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒuxiē lù kàn qǐlái hěn ānquán, yǒuxiē lù què hěn hēi.
sentences.english: Some paths look safe, while some are very dark.

sentences.chinese: 他想，我是走左边，还是走右边？
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, wǒ shì zǒu zuǒbiān, háishì zǒu yòubiān?
sentences.english: He wondered, should I go left, or go right?

sentences.chinese: 他想起了爷爷的书，书里写着：最后的一道门在最深的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ le yéye de shū, shū lǐ xiězhe: zuìhòu de yī dào mén zài zuì shēn de dìfāng.
sentences.english: He remembered his grandfather's book, which wrote: the final door is in the deepest place.

sentences.chinese: 大明走在黑暗中，有时他会听到有人在叫他的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng zǒu zài hēi'àn zhōng, yǒushí tā huì tīngdào yǒurén zài jiào tā de míngzì.
sentences.english: Daming walked in the darkness; sometimes he would hear someone calling his name.

sentences.chinese: 那个声音是不是刚才那两个陌生人的？
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè shēngyīn shì bù shì gāngcái nà liǎng gè mòshēng rén de?
sentences.english: Is that voice that of the two strangers from just now?

sentences.chinese: 他走到一个房间，那里有一面大镜子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒudào yīgè fángjiān, nàlǐ yǒu yī miàn dà jìngzi.
sentences.english: He walked into a room where there was a large mirror.

sentences.chinese: 镜子里的影子在重复他的动作，像是在重演他的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Jìngzi lǐ de yǐngzi zài chóngfù tā de dòngzuò, xiàng shì zài chóngyǎn tā de shēnghuó.
sentences.english: The shadow in the mirror repeated his movements, as if re-enacting his life.

sentences.chinese: 他突然想到，如果不能回家，明年他不能在学校读书了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán xiǎngdào, rúguǒ bùnéng huíjiā, míngnián tā bùnéng zài xuéxiào dúshū le.
sentences.english: He suddenly thought that if he couldn't go home, he wouldn't be able to study at school next year.

sentences.chinese: 他大喊：“我想要回家！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàhǎn: “Wǒ xiǎngyào huíjiā!”
sentences.english: He shouted, "I want to go home!"

sentences.chinese: 还有一个人在黑暗中笑了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Hái yǒu yīgè rén zài hēi'àn zhōng xiào le qǐlái.
sentences.english: There was still someone laughing in the darkness.

sentences.chinese: 那个笑声很奇怪，像是一个老人的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè xiàoshēng hěn qíguài, xiàng shì yīgè lǎorén de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: That laughter was very strange, sounding like an old man's voice.

sentences.chinese: 大明紧张地看着四周，突然，地上的光再次亮了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng jǐnzhāng de kànzhe sìzhōu, tūrán, dìshàng de guāng zàicì liàng le.
sentences.english: Daming looked around nervously; suddenly, the light on the ground lit up again.

sentences.chinese: 光亮指向了塔的顶端，但那里有一个巨大的黑影。
sentences.pinyin: Guāngliàng zhǐxiàng le tǎ de dǐngduān, dàn nàlǐ yǒu yīgè jùdà de hēiyǐng.
sentences.english: The light pointed to the top of the tower, but there was a huge dark shadow there.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十三章：守护者的名单

sentences.chinese: 大明看着塔顶的黑影，心跳很快。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng kànzhe tǎ dǐng de hēiyǐng, xīntiào hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Daming looked at the shadow atop the tower, his heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 那个黑影慢慢走下来，原来是一个老人。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge hēiyǐng mànman zǒu xiàlái, yuánlái shì yīgè lǎorén.
sentences.english: The shadow slowly walked down; it turned out to be an old man.

sentences.chinese: 老人说：“你好，大明，我叫三。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén shuō: “Nǐ hǎo, Dàmíng, wǒ jiào Sān.”
sentences.english: The old man said, "Hello, Daming, my name is San."

sentences.chinese: 大明很惊讶，这个人的名字这么奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng hěn jīngyà, zhège rén de míngzì zhème qíguài.
sentences.english: Daming was very surprised; this person's name was so strange.

sentences.chinese: 老人拿出一张古老的纸，上面写着很多名字。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén ná chū yī zhāng gǔlǎo de zhǐ, shàngmiàn xiězhe hěnduō míngzì.
sentences.english: The old man took out an ancient piece of paper with many names written on it.

sentences.chinese: 老人说：“这里有很多守护者，他们来自不同的地方。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén shuō: “Zhèlǐ yǒu hěnduō shǒuhùzhě, tāmen láizì bùtóng de dìfāng.”
sentences.english: The old man said, "There are many guardians here; they come from different places."

sentences.chinese: “比如，中先生和也先生，他们很久以前就在这里了。”
sentences.pinyin: “Bǐrú, Zhōng xiānshēng hé Yě xiānshēng, tāmen hěnjiǔ yǐqián jiù zài zhèlǐ le.”
sentences.english: "For example, Mr. Zhong and Mr. Ye have been here for a long time."

sentences.chinese: 大明看着纸，看到了元先生和关先生的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng kànzhe zhǐ, kàndàole Yuán xiānshēng hé Guān xiānshēng de míngzì.
sentences.english: Daming looked at the paper and saw the names of Mr. Yuan and Mr. Guan.

sentences.chinese: 他发现冷先生和别先生的名字在一起。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn Lěng xiānshēng hé Bié xiānshēng de míngzì zài yīqǐ.
sentences.english: He found that the names of Mr. Leng and Mr. Bie were together.

sentences.chinese: 包先生和南先生的名字在下面。
sentences.pinyin: Bāo xiānshēng hé Nán xiānshēng de míngzì zài xiàmiàn.
sentences.english: Mr. Bao and Mr. Nan's names were below.

sentences.chinese: 后先生和国先生的名字在中间。
sentences.pinyin: Hòu xiānshēng hé Guó xiānshēng de míngzì zài zhōngjiān.
sentences.english: Mr. Hou and Mr. Guo's names were in the middle.

sentences.chinese: 老人说：“坐先生和山先生是这里的最高领导。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén shuō: “Zuò xiānshēng hé Shān xiānshēng shì zhèlǐ de zuìgāo lǐngdǎo.”
sentences.english: The old man said, "Mr. Zuo and Mr. Shan are the highest leaders here."

sentences.chinese: 大明往左看，发现墙上有更多名字。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng wǎng zuǒ kàn, fāxiàn qiáng shàng yǒu gèng duō míngzì.
sentences.english: Daming looked to the left and found more names on the wall.

sentences.chinese: 左先生和常先生的名字在发光。
sentences.pinyin: Zuǒ xiānshēng hé Cháng xiānshēng de míngzì zài fāguāng.
sentences.english: Mr. Zuo and Mr. Chang's names were glowing.

sentences.chinese: 年先生和教先生的名字在闪烁。
sentences.pinyin: Nián xiānshēng hé Jiào xiānshēng de míngzì zài shǎnshuò.
sentences.english: Mr. Nian and Mr. Jiao's names were flickering.

sentences.chinese: 楼先生和毛先生的名字很小。
sentences.pinyin: Lóu xiānshēng hé Máo xiānshēng de míngzì hěn xiǎo.
sentences.english: Mr. Lou and Mr. Mao's names were very small.

sentences.chinese: 水先生和班先生的名字在最下面。
sentences.pinyin: Shuǐ xiānshēng hé Bān xiānshēng de míngzì zài zuì xiàmiàn.
sentences.english: Mr. Shui and Mr. Ban's names were at the very bottom.

sentences.chinese: 老人突然笑了，问大明：“你知道今天是几月几号吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén tūrán xiàole, wèn Dàmíng: “Nǐ zhīdào jīntiān shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào ma?”
sentences.english: The old man suddenly smiled and asked Daming, "Do you know what the date is today?"

sentences.chinese: 大明摇摇头，不知道。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng yáo yáotóu, bù zhīdào.
sentences.english: Daming shook his head, not knowing.

sentences.chinese: 老人说：“今天是我的生日，所以我想给你一个机会。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén shuō: “Jīntiān shì wǒ de shēngrì, suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng gěi nǐ yīgè jīhuì.”
sentences.english: The old man said, "Today is my birthday, so I want to give you a chance."

sentences.chinese: 他指着名单上的白先生和百先生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐzhe míngdān shàng de Bái xiānshēng hé Bǎi xiānshēng.
sentences.english: He pointed to Mr. Bai and Mr. Bai (Bai 100) on the list.

sentences.chinese: “能先生和花先生曾经在这里工作。”
sentences.pinyin: “Néng xiānshēng hé Huā xiānshēng céngjīng zài zhèlǐ gōngzuò.”
sentences.english: "Mr. Neng and Mr. Hua once worked here."

sentences.chinese: 大明看着路先生和车先生的名字，想起了之前的石车。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng kànzhe Lù xiānshēng hé Chē xiānshēng de míngzì, xiǎngqǐle zhīqián de shí chē.
sentences.english: Daming looked at the names of Mr. Lu and Mr. Che, remembering the stone carriage from before.

sentences.chinese: 过先生和还先生的名字在最后面。
sentences.pinyin: Guò xiānshēng hé Huán xiānshēng de míngzì zài zuì hòumiàn.
sentences.english: Mr. Guo and Mr. Huan's names were at the very back.

sentences.chinese: 那先生和都先生的名字在最顶端。
sentences.pinyin: Nà xiānshēng hé Dū xiānshēng de míngzì zài zuì dǐngduān.
sentences.english: Mr. Na and Mr. Du's names were at the very top.

sentences.chinese: 钱先生和错先生的名字被划掉了。
sentences.pinyin: Qián xiānshēng hé Cuò xiānshēng de míngzì bèi huà diào le.
sentences.english: Mr. Qian and Mr. Cuo's names had been crossed out.

sentences.chinese: 门先生和高先生的名字在发光。
sentences.pinyin: Mén xiānshēng hé Gāo xiānshēng de míngzì zài fāguāng.
sentences.english: Mr. Men and Mr. Gao's names were glowing.

sentences.chinese: 大明问：“这些人是谁？他们能帮我回家吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng wèn: “Zhèxiē rén shì shuí? Tāmen néng bāng wǒ huí jiā ma?”
sentences.english: Daming asked, "Who are these people? Can they help me go home?"

sentences.chinese: 三先生说：“他们是这个世界的钥匙。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng shuō: “Tāmen shì zhège shìjiè de yàoshi.”
sentences.english: Mr. San said, "They are the keys to this world."

sentences.chinese: 大明突然发现，这些名字其实是某种密码。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng tūrán fāxiàn, zhèxiē míngzì qíshí shì mǒu zhǒng mìmǎ.
sentences.english: Daming suddenly realized that these names were actually a kind of password.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试把名字连在一起，突然塔顶发出了巨大的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chángshì bǎ míngzì lián zài yīqǐ, tūrán tǎ dǐng fāchūle jùdà de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: He tried to connect the names together, and suddenly a huge sound erupted from the top of the tower.

sentences.chinese: 地面开始剧烈地抖动，一个巨大的石门在他们面前打开了。
sentences.pinyin: Dìmiàn kāishǐ jùliè de dǒudòng, yīgè jùdà de shímén zài tāmen miànqián dǎkāi le.
sentences.english: The ground began to shake violently, and a huge stone door opened in front of them.

sentences.chinese: 门后面是一条长长的走廊，尽头有一道强光。
sentences.pinyin: Mén hòumiàn shì yī tiáo chángcháng de zǒuláng, jìntóu yǒu yī dào qiángguāng.
sentences.english: Behind the door was a long corridor, with a strong light at the end.

sentences.chinese: 大明跑向那道光，但突然，一个巨大的影子挡在了他的面前。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng pǎo xiàng nà dào guāng, dàn tūrán, yīgè jùdà de yǐngzi dǎng zài le tā de miànqián.
sentences.english: Daming ran toward the light, but suddenly, a huge shadow blocked his path.

sentences.chinese: 那个影子比三先生大得多，而且看起来非常愤怒。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge yǐngzi bǐ Sān xiānshēng dà de duō, érqiě kàn qǐlái fēicháng fènnù.
sentences.english: That shadow was much larger than Mr. San, and it looked very angry.

sentences.chinese: 那个巨大的影子挡在大明的前边。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge jù dà de yǐng zi dǎng zài Dà Míng de qián bian.
sentences.english: That giant shadow stood in front of Da Ming.

sentences.chinese: 大明停了下来，他看着这个奇怪的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng tíng le xià lái, tā kàn zhe zhè ge qí guài de dì fāng.
sentences.english: Da Ming stopped and looked at this strange place.

sentences.chinese: 影子说话了，声音像来自国外一样陌生。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi shuō huà le, shēng yīn xiàng lái zì guó wài yī yàng mò shēng.
sentences.english: The shadow spoke, its voice sounding as foreign as if it came from abroad.

sentences.chinese: 影子说：“你想去外边吗？你必须找到正确的路。”
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi shuō: “Nǐ xiǎng qù wài bian ma? Nǐ bì xū zhǎo dào zhèng què de lù.”
sentences.english: The shadow said, "Do you want to go outside? You must find the correct path."

sentences.chinese: 大明看了一下地上，那里有一个巨大的地图。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng kàn le yī xià dì shang, nà lǐ yǒu yī gè jù dà de dì tú.
sentences.english: Da Ming looked at the ground, where there was a huge map.

sentences.chinese: 地图上写着：东边有火，西边有水。
sentences.pinyin: Dì tú shàng xiě zhe: dōng bian yǒu huǒ, xī bian yǒu shuǐ.
sentences.english: The map said: there is fire in the east, and water in the west.

sentences.chinese: 大明想，如果走东西方向，可能会很危险。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng xiǎng, rú guǒ zǒu dōng xī fāng xiàng, kě néng huì hěn wēi xiǎn.
sentences.english: Da Ming thought that if he traveled in an east-west direction, it might be very dangerous.

sentences.chinese: 他看向北边，那里是一道黑色的门。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng běi biān, nà lǐ shì yī dào hēi sè de mén.
sentences.english: He looked toward the north, where there was a black door.

sentences.chinese: 他看向南边，那里是一片白色的光。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng nán bian, nà lǐ shì yī piàn bái sè de guāng.
sentences.english: He looked toward the south, where there was a stretch of white light.

sentences.chinese: 影子指了指右边，说：“那边是死亡之路。”
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi zhǐ le zhǐ yòu bian, shuō: “nà bian shì sǐ wáng zhī lù.”
sentences.english: The shadow pointed to the right and said, "Over there is the road of death."

sentences.chinese: 大明看向左边，发现那里有一个小路口。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng kàn xiàng zuǒ bian, fā xiàn nà lǐ yǒu yī gè xiǎo lù kǒu.
sentences.english: Da Ming looked to the left and found a small intersection.

sentences.chinese: 他记得在回家的马路上，方向很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì dé zài huí jiā de mǎ lù shàng, fāng xiàng hěn zhòng yào.
sentences.english: He remembered that on the street going home, direction was very important.

sentences.chinese: 他现在身上只有那本神秘的古书。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàn zài shēn shang zhǐ yǒu nà běn shén mì de gǔ shū.
sentences.english: Right now, he only had that mysterious ancient book on his person.

sentences.chinese: 他一边走路，一边看书上的提示。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yī biān zǒu lù, yī biān kàn shū shàng de tí shì.
sentences.english: He walked while reading the tips in the book.

sentences.chinese: 书上说：不要看上边，要看下边。
sentences.pinyin: Shū shàng shuō: bù yào kàn shàng bian, yào kàn xià bian.
sentences.english: The book said: do not look above, look below.

sentences.chinese: 大明低下头，在脚旁边的石头上看到了一个字。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng dī xià tóu, zài jiǎo páng biān de shí tou shàng kàn dào le yī gè zì.
sentences.english: Da Ming lowered his head and saw a character on a stone beside his foot.

sentences.chinese: 那个字指向前，告诉他继续前进。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge zì zhǐ xiàng qián, gào sù tā jì xù qián jìn.
sentences.english: That character pointed forward, telling him to keep advancing.

sentences.chinese: 他走在长长的路上，感觉后边有东西在跟着他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu zài cháng cháng de lù shang, gǎn jué hòu bian yǒu dōng xī zài gēn zhe tā.
sentences.english: He walked on the long road, feeling that something was following him from behind.

sentences.chinese: 他快步走到一个分叉口，这里有四个方向。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kuài bù zǒu dào yī gè fēn chā kǒu, zhè lǐ yǒu sì gè fāng xiàng.
sentences.english: He walked quickly to a fork in the road, where there were four directions.

sentences.chinese: 右边的路通向一个阴暗的房间。
sentences.pinyin: Yòu bian de lù tōng xiàng yī gè yīn àn de fáng jiān.
sentences.english: The road on the right led to a dark room.

sentences.chinese: 左边的路通向一个巨大的花园。
sentences.pinyin: Zuǒ bian de lù tōng xiàng yī gè jù dà de huā yuán.
sentences.english: The road on the left led to a huge garden.

sentences.chinese: 他决定先去西边的花园看看。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué dìng xiān qù xī bian de huā yuán kàn kàn.
sentences.english: He decided to go to the garden in the west first.

sentences.chinese: 外面的风很大，吹在他身上很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Wài mian de fēng hěn dà, chuī zài tā shēn shang hěn lěng.
sentences.english: The wind outside was strong and felt cold on his body.

sentences.chinese: 他走到花园的中心，发现这边有一个古老的祭坛。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu dào huā yuán de zhōng xīn, fā xiàn zhè biān yǒu yī gè gǔ lǎo de jì tán.
sentences.english: He walked to the center of the garden and found an ancient altar here.

sentences.chinese: 祭坛的旁边放着一个金色的盒子。
sentences.pinyin: Jì tán de páng biān fàng zhe yī gè jīn sè de hé zi.
sentences.english: Beside the altar lay a golden box.

sentences.chinese: 大明打开盒子，里面是一把发光的钥匙。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng dǎ kāi hé zi, lǐ miàn shì yī bǎ fā guāng de yào shi.
sentences.english: Da Ming opened the box, and inside was a glowing key.

sentences.chinese: 突然，地面的石头开始移动，他被困在了中间。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, dì miàn de shí tou kāi shǐ yí dòng, tā bèi kùn zài le zhōng jiān.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the stones on the ground began to move, and he was trapped in the middle.

sentences.chinese: 一个声音在他耳边响起：“钥匙在手，但路在何方？”
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè shēng yīn zài tā ěr biān xiǎng qǐ: “yào shi zài shǒu, dàn lù zài hé fāng?”
sentences.english: A voice sounded in his ear: "The key is in hand, but where is the road?"

sentences.chinese: 大明惊恐地发现，所有的门都消失了。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng jīng kǒng de fā xiàn, suǒ yǒu de mén dōu xiāo shī le.
sentences.english: Da Ming discovered in horror that all the doors had disappeared.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十五章：迷宫中的新伙伴
chapters.title_english: Chapter 15: New Companions in the Maze

sentences.chinese: 大明看着四周，所有的门都消失了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng kànzhe sìzhōu, suǒyǒu de mén dōu xiāoshī le.
sentences.english: Daming looked around; all the doors had disappeared.

sentences.chinese: 他感到一点儿害怕，但手里拿着发光的钥匙。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎndào yī diǎn r hàipà, dàn shǒulǐ názhe fāguāng de yàoshi.
sentences.english: He felt a little bit scared, but he held the glowing key in his hand.

sentences.chinese: 突然，地面的石头地地地地响了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, dìmiàn de shítou dì dì dì dì xiǎng le qǐlái.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the stones on the ground began to rumble loudly.

sentences.chinese: 一个巨大的房子出现在他的面前。
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè jùdà de fángzi chūxiàn zài tā de miànqián.
sentences.english: A huge house appeared before him.

sentences.chinese: 这栋房子很新，像是一座白色的宫殿。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dòng fángzi hěn xīn, xiàng shì yī zuò báisè de gōngdiàn.
sentences.english: This house was very new, looking like a white palace.

sentences.chinese: 大明走进去，看到一个女孩儿在哭。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng zǒu jìnqù, kàndào yīgè nǚ hái r zài kū.
sentences.english: Daming walked inside and saw a girl crying.

sentences.chinese: 这个女孩儿看起来只有十岁。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège nǚ hái r kàn qǐlái zhǐyǒu shí suì.
sentences.english: This girl looked only ten years old.

sentences.chinese: 她身边有一个小孩儿，应该是她的弟弟。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shēnbiān yǒu yīgè xiǎo hái r, yīnggāi shì tā de dìdi.
sentences.english: Beside her was a child, who should be her younger brother.

sentences.chinese: 大明走过去，轻轻地问：“你们是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng zǒu guòqù, qīngqīng de wèn: “Nǐmen shì shéi?”
sentences.english: Daming walked over and asked softly, "Who are you?"

sentences.chinese: 女孩儿抬起头，看着大明，大声说：“救救我们！”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ hái r táiqǐ tóu, kànzhe Dàmíng, dàshēng shuō: “Jiùjiù wǒmen!”
sentences.english: The girl looked up at Daming and shouted, "Save us!"

sentences.chinese: 她说他们是这里的家人，但被黑影抓住了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō tāmen shì zhèlǐ de jiārén, dàn bèi hēiyǐng zhuāzhù le.
sentences.english: She said they were family members here, but had been captured by the dark shadow.

sentences.chinese: 女孩儿说：“我的奶奶和妹妹还在楼上。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ hái r shuō: “Wǒ de nǎinai hé mèimei hái zài lóushàng.”
sentences.english: The girl said, "My grandmother and younger sister are still upstairs."

sentences.chinese: 大明决定帮他们，因为他想回家。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng juédìng bāng tāmen, yīnwèi tā xiǎng huíjiā.
sentences.english: Daming decided to help them because he wanted to go home.

sentences.chinese: 他拿出一本子，在上面写下计划。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū yī běnzi, zài shàngmiàn xiě xià jìhuà.
sentences.english: He took out a notebook and wrote down a plan.

sentences.chinese: 那个小孩儿看着本子，觉得很新奇，说这里一点儿也不好玩儿。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge xiǎo hái r kànzhe běnzi, juédé hěn xīnqí, shuō zhèlǐ yī diǎn r yě bù hǎowán r.
sentences.english: The child looked at the notebook, found it novel, and said this place wasn't fun at all.

sentences.chinese: 大明对他们说：“别担心，我们一块儿走。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng duì tāmen shuō: “Bié dānxīn, wǒmen yī kuài r zǒu.”
sentences.english: Daming said to them, "Don't worry, let's go together."

sentences.chinese: 他们走出房子，看到地上有一块大石头。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒuchū fángzi, kàndào dìshàng yǒu yī kuài dà shítou.
sentences.english: They walked out of the house and saw a large piece of rock on the ground.

sentences.chinese: 石头上写着：“只有勇敢的人才能找到机场。”
sentences.pinyin: Shítou shàng xiězhe: “Zhǐyǒu yǒnggǎn de rén cáinéng zhǎodào jīchǎng.”
sentences.english: On the rock was written: "Only the brave can find the airport."

sentences.chinese: 大明很惊讶，在这个古老的迷宫里怎么会有机场？
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng hěn jīngyà, zài zhège gǔlǎo de mígōng lǐ zěnme huì yǒu jīchǎng?
sentences.english: Daming was surprised; how could there be an airport in this ancient maze?
