sentences.chinese: 他想了一下儿，觉得这可能是一个秘密的出口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng le yī xià r, juédé zhè kěnéng shì yīgè mìmì de chūkǒu.
sentences.english: He thought for a moment and felt this might be a secret exit.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个穿着长裙的小姐走过来。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, yīgè chuānzhe chángqún de xiǎojiě zǒu guòlái.
sentences.english: At that moment, a young lady wearing a long dress walked over.

sentences.chinese: 她手里拿着一个杯子，里面有蓝色的水。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shǒulǐ názhe yīgè bēizi, lǐmiàn yǒu lánsè de shuǐ.
sentences.english: In her hand, she held a cup containing blue water.

sentences.chinese: 小姐说：“喝一口水，你们会看到路。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎojiě shuō: “Hē yī kǒu shuǐ, nǐmen huì kàndào lù.”
sentences.english: The lady said, "Take a sip of water, and you will see the way."

sentences.chinese: 大明喝了水，突然发现自己的眼睛能看到隐形的门。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng hē le shuǐ, tūrán fāxiàn zìjǐ de yǎnjīng néng kàndào yǐnxíng de mén.
sentences.english: Daming drank the water and suddenly discovered his eyes could see invisible doors.

sentences.chinese: 他发现现在的路和之前的路差很多。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn xiànzài de lù hé zhīqián de lù chà hěnduō.
sentences.english: He found that the current path was very different from the previous one.

sentences.chinese: 大明牵着小孩儿的手，地地地地跑向那道光。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng qiānzhe xiǎo hái r de shǒu, dì dì dì dì pǎo xiàng nà dào guāng.
sentences.english: Daming held the child's hand and ran quickly toward the light.

sentences.chinese: 但就在他们快要到达时，楼上突然传来了巨大的笑声。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài tāmen kuài yào dàodá shí, lóushàng tūrán chuánlái le jùdà de xiàoshēng.
sentences.english: But just as they were about to arrive, a loud laugh suddenly came from upstairs.

sentences.chinese: 大明和小孩儿停了下来。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng hé xiǎoháir tíng le xià lái.
sentences.english: Da Ming and the child stopped.

sentences.chinese: 那个巨大的笑声在房间中间响起来。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge jùdà de xiàoshēng zài fángjiān zhōngjiān xiǎng qǐ lái.
sentences.english: The giant laughter echoed in the middle of the room.

sentences.chinese: 一个老人从阴影中走出来。
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè lǎorén cóng yīnyǐng zhōng zǒu chū lái.
sentences.english: An old man walked out from the shadows.

sentences.chinese: 这个老人看着大明，笑着说：“欢迎来到这里。”
sentences.pinyin: Zhège lǎorén kànzhe Dàmíng, xiàozhe shuō: “Huānyíng lái dào zhèlǐ.”
sentences.english: The old man looked at Da Ming and said with a smile, "Welcome here."

sentences.chinese: 大明很紧张，他问：“现在是什么时候？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng hěn jǐnzhāng, tā wèn: “Xiànzài shì shénme shíhou?”
sentences.english: Da Ming was very nervous and asked, "What time is it now?"

sentences.chinese: 老人说：“在这里，时间很奇怪。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén shuō: “Zài zhèlǐ, shíjiān hěn qíguài.”
sentences.english: The old man said, "Time is very strange here."

sentences.chinese: “今天可能是昨天，后天可能是明天。”
sentences.pinyin: “Jīntiān kěnéng shì zuótiān, hòutiān kěnéng shì míngtiān.”
sentences.english: "Today might be yesterday, and the day after tomorrow might be tomorrow."

sentences.chinese: 大明听了，觉得很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng tīng le, juéde hěn qíguài.
sentences.english: Da Ming heard this and felt it was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 他想起自己的爸爸，很想回家。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ de bàba, hěn xiǎng huí jiā.
sentences.english: He thought of his father and really wanted to go home.

sentences.chinese: 老人说：“你在这个迷宫里待了半天，但外面已经过了很多天。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén shuō: “Nǐ zài zhège mígōng lǐ dāile bàntiān, dàn wàimiàn yǐjīng guòle hěnduō tiān.”
sentences.english: The old man said, "You have been in this maze for a long time, but many days have passed outside."

sentences.chinese: 大明惊讶地问：“那是星期几？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng jīngyà de wèn: “Nà shì xīngqī jǐ?”
sentences.english: Da Ming asked in surprise, "What day of the week is it?"

sentences.chinese: 老人回答：“在这里没有星期，只有白天和晚上。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén huídá: “Zài zhèlǐ méiyǒu xīngqī, zhǐyǒu báitiān hé wǎnshang.”
sentences.english: The old man replied, "There are no weeks here, only daytime and nighttime."

sentences.chinese: 大明看着天空，发现这里的天是紫色的。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng kànzhe tiānkōng, fāxiàn zhèlǐ de tiān shì zǐsè de.
sentences.english: Da Ming looked at the sky and found that the sky here was purple.

sentences.chinese: 他记得早晨的时候，天空还是蓝色的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde zǎochén de shíhou, tiānkōng háishì lánsè de.
sentences.english: He remembered that in the morning, the sky was still blue.

sentences.chinese: 现在是中午，但光线很暗。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài shì zhōngwǔ, dàn guāngxiàn hěn àn.
sentences.english: Now it was noon, but the light was very dim.

sentences.chinese: 过了一会儿，光线突然变了，变成了下午的样子。
sentences.pinyin: Guòle yīhuìr, guāngxiàn tūrán biàn le, biàn chéng le xiàwǔ de yàngzi.
sentences.english: After a moment, the light suddenly changed, becoming like the afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 大明发现，在这间屋子之间，时间在快速移动。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng fāxiàn, zài zhè jiān wūzi zhījiān, shíjiān zài kuàisù yídòng.
sentences.english: Da Ming discovered that between these rooms, time was moving rapidly.

sentences.chinese: 他正在思考怎么离开，老人突然说话了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài sīkǎo zěnme líkāi, lǎorén tūrán shuōhuà le.
sentences.english: He was just thinking about how to leave when the old man suddenly spoke.

sentences.chinese: “你上次来的时候，没有看到那个门。”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ shàng cì lái de shíhou, méiyǒu kàndào nàge mén.”
sentences.english: "The last time you came, you didn't see that door."

sentences.chinese: 老人指着墙上的一个洞。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén zhǐzhe qiáng shàng de yīgè dòng.
sentences.english: The old man pointed to a hole in the wall.

sentences.chinese: 大明觉得很晚了，他很累，但看到门他很高兴。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng juéde hěn wǎn le, tā hěn lèi, dàn kàndào mén tā hěn gāoxìng.
sentences.english: Da Ming felt it was very late; he was exhausted, but he was happy to see the door.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，如果能通过这个门，他就能离家更近一步。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhīdào, rúguǒ néng tōngguò zhège mén, tā jiù néng lí jiā gèng jìn yībù.
sentences.english: He knew that if he could pass through this door, he could get one step closer to home.

sentences.chinese: 但就在他走近时，老人突然消失了，门也开始关闭。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài tā zǒu jìn shí, lǎorén tūrán xiāoshī le, mén yě kāishǐ guānbì.
sentences.english: But just as he approached, the old man suddenly disappeared, and the door began to close.

sentences.chinese: 大明快步跑过去，在门关闭之前跳了进去。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng kuàibù pǎo guòqù, zài mén guānbì zhīqián tiào le jìnqù.
sentences.english: Daming ran quickly and jumped inside before the door closed.

sentences.chinese: 他发现自己不在迷宫里，而是在一个巨大的学校里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn zìjǐ bù zài mǐgōng lǐ, ér shì zài yī gè jùdà de xuéxiào lǐ.
sentences.english: He found that he was no longer in the maze, but in a huge school.

sentences.chinese: 这里看起来像是一个奇怪的学院。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ kàn qǐlái xiàng shì yī gè qíguài de xuéyuàn.
sentences.english: This place looked like a strange college.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一座很高的教学楼，门上写着“知识之门”。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào yī zuò hěn gāo de jiàoxuélóu, mén shàng xiě zhe “zhīshi zhī mén”.
sentences.english: He saw a very tall teaching block, and on the door it said "Gate of Knowledge".

sentences.chinese: 大明想起他以前在小学的时候，老师告诉他学习很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xiǎngqǐ tā yǐqián zài xiǎoxué de shíhòu, lǎoshī gàosù tā xuéxí hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.english: Daming remembered when he was in elementary school, the teacher told him that learning was very important.

sentences.chinese: 他记得那时候他还是一个小学生，每天背课文。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde nà shíhòu tā háishì yī gè xiǎoxuéshēng, měitiān bèi kèwén.
sentences.english: He remembered that at that time he was still a primary school student, memorizing texts every day.

sentences.chinese: 现在，他看着周围，发现这里有很多学生。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài, tā kànzhe zhōuwéi, fāxiàn zhèlǐ yǒu hěnduō xuéshēng.
sentences.english: Now, looking around, he found there were many students here.

sentences.chinese: 有的男生在跑步，有的女生在说话。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu de nánshēng zài pǎobù, yǒu de nǚshēng zài shuōhuà.
sentences.english: Some boys were running, and some girls were talking.

sentences.chinese: 一个中学生走过来，背着一个蓝色的书包。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè zhōngxuéshēng zǒu guòlái, bēizhe yī gè lán sè de shūbāo.
sentences.english: A middle-school student walked over, carrying a blue schoolbag.

sentences.chinese: 那个中学生看着大明，问他：“你是哪个学校的？”
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè zhōngxuéshēng kànzhe Dàmíng, wèn tā: “Nǐ shì nǎ gè xuéxiào de?”
sentences.english: That middle-school student looked at Daming and asked, "Which school are you from?"

sentences.chinese: 大明很惊讶，他回答说：“我不是中学生，我只是想回家。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng hěn jīngyà, tā huídá shuō: “Wǒ bù shì zhōngxuéshēng, wǒ zhǐshì xiǎng huíjiā.”
sentences.english: Daming was surprised and replied, "I am not a middle-school student, I just want to go home."

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个大学生走过来，他看起来像个成熟的先生。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yī gè dàxuéshēng zǒu guòlái, tā kàn qǐlái xiàng gè chéngshú de xiānsheng.
sentences.english: At this moment, a university student walked over; he looked like a mature gentleman.

sentences.chinese: 这个大学生对大明说：“这里是学习的地方，每个学生都要上课。”
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dàxuéshēng duì Dàmíng shuō: “Zhèlǐ shì xuéxí de dìfāng, měi gè xuéshēng dōu yào shàngkè.”
sentences.english: This university student said to Daming, "This is a place for learning; every student must attend class."

sentences.chinese: 他指了指手中的课本，告诉大明必须读完这些字才能离开。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐ le zhǐ shǒuzhōng de kèběn, gàosù Dàmíng bìxū dú wán zhèxiē zì cáinéng líkāi.
sentences.english: He pointed to the textbook in his hand and told Daming he must read all these words to leave.

sentences.chinese: 大明发现这里的学生分很多等，等级越高，力量越大。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng fāxiàn zhèlǐ de xuéshēng fēn hěnduō děng, děngjí yuè gāo, lìliàng yuè dà.
sentences.english: Daming discovered that the students here were divided into many ranks; the higher the rank, the greater the power.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一个同学在认真地读课文，声音很大。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào yī gè tóngxué zài rènzhēn de dú kèwén, shēngyīn hěn dà.
sentences.english: He saw a classmate reading the text seriously, with a loud voice.

sentences.chinese: 大明想，这就像是在中学一样，必须努力学习。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xiǎng, zhè jiù xiàng shì zài zhōngxué yīyàng, bìxū nǔlì xuéxí.
sentences.english: Daming thought this was just like being in middle school, where one must study hard.

sentences.chinese: 他想起家乡的书店，那里有很多好书，但没有这样的魔法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ jiāxiāng de shūdiàn, nàlǐ yǒu hěnduō hǎo shū, dàn méiyǒu zhèyàng de mófǎ.
sentences.english: He thought of the bookstore in his hometown; there were many good books there, but none with such magic.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个老师走过来，严肃地看着大明。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yī gè lǎoshī zǒu guòlái, yánsù de kànzhe Dàmíng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a teacher walked over and looked at Daming sternly.

sentences.chinese: 老师说：“如果你想回家，你必须通过这个课的考验。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng huíjiā, nǐ bìxū tōngguò zhège kè de kǎoyàn.”
sentences.english: The teacher said, "If you want to go home, you must pass the trial of this course."

sentences.chinese: 大明紧张地接过课本，开始在教学楼里寻找答案。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng jǐnzhāng de jiēguò kèběn, kāishǐ zài jiàoxuélóu lǐ xúnzhǎo dá'àn.
sentences.english: Daming nervously took the textbook and began searching for answers in the teaching block.

sentences.chinese: 但就在他读到最后一页时，书本突然发光，地板开始震动。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài tā dú dào zuìhòu yī yè shí, shūběn tūrán fāguāng, dìbǎn kāishǐ zhèndòng.
sentences.english: But just as he read the last page, the book suddenly glowed, and the floor began to shake.

sentences.chinese: 地板的震动停止了，大明发现自己来到了一个奇怪的房间。
sentences.pinyin: Dì bāns hī zhāng: Shí jiān de mí wù
sentences.english: The shaking of the floor stopped, and Da Ming found himself in a strange room.

sentences.chinese: 这里的时间很奇怪，窗外一会儿是早上，一会儿是上午。
sentences.pinyin: Dì bǎn de zhèn dòng tíng zhǐ le, Dà Míng fā xiàn zì jǐ lái dào le yí gè qí guài de fáng jiān.
sentences.english: The time here was very strange; outside the window, it was early morning one moment, and late morning the next.

sentences.chinese: 他想起昨天在这里经历的恐怖，心跳很快。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de shí jiān hěn qí guài, chuāng wài yì huì r shì zǎo shang, yì huì r shì shàng wǔ.
sentences.english: He remembered the horror he experienced here yesterday, and his heart beat fast.

sentences.chinese: 他记得在那个星期天，或者说是那个星期日，他第一次进入这个迷宫。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ zuó tiān zài zhè lǐ jīng lì de kǒng bù, xīn tiào hěn kuài.
sentences.english: He remembered that on that Sunday, or rather that Sunday (Xingqiri), he entered this maze for the first time.

sentences.chinese: 他不能忘记老师说的考验，因为那是回到家乡的唯一方法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì dé zài nà gè Xīng qī tiān, huò zhě shuō shì nà gè Xīng qī rì, tā dì yī cì jìn rù zhè gè mí gōng.
sentences.english: He could not forget the trial the teacher spoke of, because that was the only way to return home.

sentences.chinese: 突然，窗外的天气变了，开始下雨。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù néng wàng jì lǎo shī shuō de kǎo yàn, yīn wèi nà shì huí dào jiā xiāng de wéi yī fāng fǎ.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the weather outside changed and it began to rain.

sentences.chinese: 大雨打在窗户上，发出巨大的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, chuāng wài de tiān qì biàn le, kāi shǐ xià yǔ.
sentences.english: Heavy rain hit the window, making a loud sound.

sentences.chinese: 大明觉得很渴，他想找点水喝。
sentences.pinyin: Dà yǔ dǎ zài chuāng hu shàng, fā chū jù dà de shēng yīn.
sentences.english: Da Ming felt very thirsty; he wanted to find some water to drink.

sentences.chinese: 他看到桌子上有一份早饭和一份午饭，但时间已经过去了几个小时。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng jué dé hěn kě, tā xiǎng zhǎo diǎn shuǐ hē.
sentences.english: He saw a breakfast and a lunch on the table, but several hours had already passed.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试拿起电话打电话，但电话没有声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào zhuō zi shàng yǒu yí fèn zǎo fàn hé yí fèn wǔ fàn, dàn shí jiān yǐ jīng guò qù le jǐ gè xiǎo shí.
sentences.english: He tried to pick up the phone to make a call, but the phone made no sound.

sentences.chinese: 他在日历上看到一个日期，那是他失踪的那一天。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cháng shì ná qǐ diàn huà dǎ diàn huà, dàn diàn huà méi yǒu shēng yīn.
sentences.english: He saw a date on the calendar; it was the day he disappeared.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个巨大的影子在房间里慢地移动。

sentences.chinese: 那个影子像一只巨大的鸟，在空中飞了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yí gè jù dà de yǐng zi zài fáng jiān lǐ màn de yí dòng.
sentences.english: That shadow was like a giant bird, flying up into the air.

sentences.chinese: 大明害怕极了，他开始在房间里跑，试图寻找出口。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè yǐng zi xiàng yì zhī jù dà de niǎo, zài kōng zhōng fēi le qǐ lái.
sentences.english: Da Ming was terrified; he began to run in the room, trying to find an exit.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他听到了一个声音，像是在对他微笑。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng hài pà jí le, tā kāi shǐ zài fáng jiān lǐ pǎo, shì tú xún zhǎo chū kǒu.
sentences.english: Suddenly, he heard a voice, as if it were smiling at him.

sentences.chinese: 那个声音说：“你看，那里有一辆火车。”
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, tā tīng dào le yí gè shēng yīn, xiàng shì zài duì tā wēi xiào.
sentences.english: The voice said: "Look, there is a train over there."

sentences.chinese: 大明看向窗外，雨停了，一辆金色的火车停在云端。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè shēng yīn shuō: “Nǐ kàn, nà lǐ yǒu yí liàng huǒ chē.”
sentences.english: Da Ming looked out the window; the rain had stopped, and a golden train was stopped in the clouds.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，这就是最后的机会。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng kàn xiàng chuāng wài, yǔ tíng le, yí liàng jīn sè de huǒ chē tíng zài yún duān.

sentences.chinese: 但他怎么才能登上那辆火车？

sentences.english: But how could he board that train?

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，房间的门再次关闭了，一个新的人影出现了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tā zěn me cái néng dēng shàng nà liàng huǒ chē?

sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, fáng jiān de mén zài cì guān bì le, yí gè xīn de rén yǐng chū xiàn le.

sentences.chinese: 那是一个高大的男人。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì yī gè gāo dà de nán rén.
sentences.english: It was a tall man.

sentences.chinese: 他对着大明微笑，说：“请进来。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì zhe dà míng wēi xiào, shuō: “Qǐng jìn lái.”
sentences.english: He smiled at Da Ming and said, "Please come in."

sentences.chinese: 大明走进房间，发现这里像是一个奇怪的吧。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng zǒu jìn fáng jiān, fā xiàn zhè lǐ xiàng shì yī gè qí guài de bā.
sentences.english: Da Ming walked into the room and found it looked like a strange bar.

sentences.chinese: 男人说：“你在这里已经待了半年了。”
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén shuō: “Nǐ zài zhè lǐ yǐ jīng dāi le bàn nián le.”
sentences.english: The man said, "You have already stayed here for half a year."

sentences.chinese: 大明很惊讶，他觉得自己才来了一天。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng hěn jīng yà, tā jué dé zì jǐ cái lái le yī tiān.
sentences.english: Da Ming was surprised; he felt he had only been here for one day.

sentences.chinese: 男人打开一个盒子，里面有十二张车票，刚好一打。
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén dǎ kāi yī gè hé zi, lǐ miàn yǒu shí èr zhāng chē piào, gāng hǎo yī dá.

sentences.chinese: “这些车票可以让你回家，”男人说。
sentences.pinyin: “Zhè xiē chē piào kě yǐ ràng nǐ huí jiā,” nán rén shuō.
sentences.english: "These tickets can let you go home," the man said.

sentences.chinese: 大明问：“我的车票呢？”
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng wèn: “Wǒ de chē piào ne?”
sentences.english: Da Ming asked, "And where is my ticket?"

sentences.chinese: 男人说：“有时候，回家需要通过最后的考验。”
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén shuō: “Yǒu shí hou, huí jiā xū yào tōng guò zuì hòu de kǎo yàn.”
sentences.english: The man said, "Sometimes, going home requires passing the final test."

sentences.chinese: 大明想起在教学楼里的日子，他每天都要等下课。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng xiǎng qǐ zài jiào xué lóu lǐ de rì zi, tā měi tiān dōu yào děng xià kè.

sentences.chinese: 他记得放学以后，他总是很累。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì dé fàng xué yǐ hòu, tā zǒng shì hěn lèi.
sentences.english: He remembered that after school was dismissed, he was always very tired.

sentences.chinese: 他在这个世界学习，不能请假，也不能放假。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài zhè gè shì jiè xué xí, bù néng qǐng jià, yě bù néng fàng jià.
sentences.english: He studied in this world; he could not request leave, nor could he have a holiday.

sentences.chinese: 男人说：“在这个世界，没有打车这种方便的事。”
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén shuō: “Zài zhè gè shì jiè, méi yǒu dǎ chē zhè zhǒng fāng biàn de shì.”
sentences.english: The man said, "In this world, there is no such convenient thing as taking a taxi."

sentences.chinese: 他告诉大明，这里的门票就是知识。

sentences.chinese: 大明突然想，如果他在家，现在应该在上网看电影。

sentences.chinese: 或者，他的父亲现在应该下班回家了。
sentences.pinyin: Huò zhě, tā de fù qīn xiàn zài yīng gāi xià bān huí jiā le.

sentences.chinese: 男人指着窗外的金色火车，说：“快开门吧！”

sentences.chinese: 大明赶紧打开门，风吹了进来。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng gǎn jǐn dǎ kāi mén, fēng chuī le jìn lái.

sentences.chinese: 他拿到了车票，准备上车。

sentences.chinese: 他知道，一旦下车，他就回到了自己的世界。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhī dào, yī dàn xià chē, tā jiù huí dào le zì jǐ de shì jiè.

sentences.chinese: 他快速关上门，跑向火车。

sentences.chinese: 这就是他期待已久的时刻。

sentences.chinese: 大明跑向火车，但一个老人挡在门前。

sentences.chinese: 大明礼貌地说：“您好，我想回家。”

sentences.chinese: 老人笑了，指着车厢里边说：“请坐，这里有你的位置。”

sentences.chinese: 大明走进车厢，看到一个奇怪的时钟。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng zǒu jìn chē xiāng, kàn dào yī gè qí guài de shí zhōng.

sentences.chinese: 时钟上的数字是零，它在慢慢转动。

sentences.chinese: 大明突然发现，他没看到之前那个黑影。

sentences.chinese: 大明深深呼吸，看向窗外。
