sentences.chinese: 我想起今天早上的天气很糟糕。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngqǐ jīntiān zǎoshang de tiānqì hěn zāogāo.
sentences.english: I remembered that the weather this early morning was terrible.

sentences.chinese: 雨一直在下，像是在掩盖什么秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ yīzhí zài xià, xiàng shì zài yǎngài shénme mìmì.
sentences.english: The rain kept falling, as if it were covering some secret.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，她一个小时前去了学校。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, tā yīgè xiǎoshí qián qùle xuéxiào.
sentences.english: He told me that she went to a school an hour ago.

sentences.chinese: 那个学校是一个很有名的中学。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge xuéxiào shì yīgè hěn yǒumíng de zhōngxué.
sentences.english: That school is a very famous middle school.

sentences.chinese: 我想知道那个日期的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zhīdào nàge rìqī de mìmì.
sentences.english: I wanted to know the secret of that date.

sentences.chinese: 地图上的日期是很多年前的。
sentences.pinyin: Dìtú shàng de rìqī shì hěnduō nián qián de.
sentences.english: The date on the map was from many years ago.

sentences.chinese: 我问他：“你为什么不直接去问她？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Nǐ wèishéme bù zhíjiē qù wèn tā?”
sentences.english: I asked him, "Why don't you just go ask her?"

sentences.chinese: 他低头看着桌子，那个小几上放着他的午饭。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dītóu kànzhe zhuōzi, nàge xiǎo jī shàng fàngzhe tā de wǔfàn.
sentences.english: He looked down at the table; his lunch was placed on that small table.

sentences.chinese: 他没有吃午饭，只是在听窗外的雨声。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu chī wǔfàn, zhǐshì zài tīng chuāngwài de yǔshēng.
sentences.english: He didn't eat lunch, he was just listening to the sound of the rain outside.

sentences.chinese: 他说，那个外国人的秘密就在那张地图里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, nàge wàiguó rén de mìmì jiù zài nà zhāng dìtú lǐ.
sentences.english: He said that the foreign person's secret was in that map.

sentences.chinese: 我突然意识到，他可能在撒谎。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tūrán yìshí dào, tā kěnéng zài sāhuǎng.
sentences.english: I suddenly realized that he might be lying.

sentences.chinese: 如果他真的在学习中文，为什么他的外语说得那么奇怪？
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ tā zhēn de zài xuéxí Zhōngwén, wèishéme tā de wàiyǔ shuō dé nàme qíguài?
sentences.english: If he were really studying Chinese, why was his foreign language spoken so strangely?

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，门外传来了敲门声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, mén wài chuánláile qiāomén shēng.
sentences.english: Just then, there was a knock at the door.

sentences.chinese: 敲门声很大，我感到很紧张。
sentences.pinyin: Qiāo mén shēng hěn dà, wǒ gǎndào hěn jǐn zhāng.
sentences.english: The knocking was loud, and I felt very nervous.

sentences.chinese: 我走过去开门，发现是一个我的朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǒu guò qù kāi mén, fā xiàn shì yī gè wǒ de péng you.
sentences.english: I walked over to open the door and found it was a friend of mine.

sentences.chinese: 他穿着一件黑色的衣服，看起来很疲惫。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chuān zhe yī jiàn hēi sè de yī fu, kàn qǐ lái hěn pí bèi.
sentences.english: He was wearing black clothes and looked very exhausted.

sentences.chinese: 他说他昨天在火车站看到了那个奇怪的男人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō tā zuó tiān zài huǒ chē zhàn kàn dào le nà gè qí guài de nán rén.
sentences.english: He said he saw that strange man at the train station yesterday.

sentences.chinese: 那个男人在车上拿着一本汉语课本。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè nán rén zài chē shàng ná zhe yī běn Hàn yǔ kè běn.
sentences.english: That man was holding a Chinese textbook on the vehicle.

sentences.chinese: 我的朋友说，那个男人在看课本的第十页。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de péng you shuō, nà gè nán rén zài kàn kè běn de dì shí yè.
sentences.english: My friend said the man was looking at page ten of the textbook.

sentences.chinese: 我请他进来，问他想喝什么。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ qǐng tā jìn lái, wèn tā xiǎng hē shén me.
sentences.english: I invited him in and asked him what he wanted to drink.

sentences.chinese: 他看起来很渴，我想给他一杯牛奶。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐ lái hěn kě, wǒ xiǎng gěi tā yī bēi niú nǎi.
sentences.english: He looked thirsty; I wanted to give him a glass of milk.

sentences.chinese: 但我发现桌子上只有一些水果和面包。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ fā xiàn zhuō zi shàng zhǐ yǒu yī xiē shuǐ guǒ hé miàn bāo.
sentences.english: But I noticed there were only some fruits and bread on the table.

sentences.chinese: 我记得今天早饭我只吃了米饭。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jì dé jīn tiān zǎo fàn wǒ zhǐ chī le mǐ fàn.
sentences.english: I remember that for breakfast today, I only ate rice.

sentences.chinese: 我的朋友坐在电脑前面，看着屏幕。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de péng you zuò zài diàn nǎo qián miàn, kàn zhe píng mù.
sentences.english: My friend sat in front of the computer, looking at the screen.

sentences.chinese: 他说他在网上找到了那个男人的照片。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō tā zài wǎng shàng zhǎo dào le nà gè nán rén de zhào piàn.
sentences.english: He said he found a photo of that man online.

sentences.chinese: 那个男人可能不是老师，但他假装在学习课文。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè nán rén kě néng bú shì lǎo shī, dàn tā jiǎ zhuāng zài xué xí kè wén.
sentences.english: That man might not be a teacher, but he pretended to be studying the text.

sentences.chinese: 我们看着电视机，电视上在说明天的天气。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men kàn zhe diàn shì jī, diàn shì shàng zài shuō míng tiān de tiān qì.
sentences.english: We watched the television; the TV was talking about tomorrow's weather.

sentences.chinese: 明天会下大雨，飞机不能起飞。
sentences.pinyin: Míng tiān huì xià dà yǔ, fēi jī bù néng qǐ fēi.
sentences.english: It will rain heavily tomorrow, and airplanes cannot take off.

sentences.chinese: 我的朋友告诉我，那个男人星期天会离开。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de péng you gào sù wǒ, nà gè nán rén xīng qī tiān huì lí kāi.
sentences.english: My friend told me that the man will leave on Sunday.

sentences.chinese: 他说星期日是那个男人的生日，他要走。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō xīng qī rì shì nà gè nán rén de shēng rì, tā yào zǒu.
sentences.english: He said Sunday is that man's birthday, and he is going to leave.

sentences.chinese: 我想知道他要去哪里，是不是要坐火车离开？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zhī dào tā yào qù nǎ lǐ, shì bú shì yào zuò huǒ chē lí kāi?
sentences.english: I wondered where he was going, was he leaving by train?

sentences.chinese: 我走到楼下，寻找那个男人掉落的东西。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǒu dào lóu xià, xún zhǎo nà gè nán rén diào luò de dōng xī.
sentences.english: I went downstairs to look for things the man might have dropped.

sentences.chinese: 我在地上的雨水里看到了一张小纸条。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zài dì shàng de yǔ shuǐ lǐ kàn dào le yī zhāng xiǎo zhǐ tiáo.
sentences.english: I saw a small slip of paper in the rain water on the ground.

sentences.chinese: 纸条上写着一个日期和时间。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐ tiáo shàng xiě zhe yī gè rì qī hé shí jiān.
sentences.english: The slip of paper had a date and time written on it.

sentences.chinese: 我突然想到，那个男人在撒谎的时候眼神很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tū rán xiǎng dào, nà gè nán rén zài sā huǎng de shí hou yǎn shén hěn qí guài.
sentences.english: I suddenly thought that the man's eyes were very strange when he was lying.

sentences.chinese: 如果他不是在学习，那么他在这里做什么？
sentences.pinyin: Rú guǒ tā bú shì zài xué xí, nà me tā zài zhè lǐ zuò shén me?
sentences.english: If he wasn't studying, then what was he doing here?

sentences.chinese: 我回到房间，发现那个男人的笔记本不见了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ huí dào fáng jiān, fā xiàn nà gè nán rén de bǐ jì běn bú jiàn le.
sentences.english: I returned to the room and found that the man's notebook was gone.

sentences.chinese: 谁拿走了笔记本？
sentences.pinyin: Shéi ná zǒu le bǐ jì běn?
sentences.english: Who took the notebook?

sentences.chinese: 门突然又被关上了。
sentences.pinyin: Mén tū rán yòu bèi guān shàng le.
sentences.english: The door was suddenly closed again.

sentences.chinese: 门关上了，我被关在房间里。
sentences.pinyin: Mén guān shàng le, wǒ bèi guān zài fáng jiān lǐ.
sentences.english: The door closed, and I was locked in the room.

sentences.chinese: 我想找那个笔记本，但它不在桌子上。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zhǎo nà gè bǐ jì běn, dàn tā bú zài zhuō zi shàng.
sentences.english: I wanted to find that notebook, but it wasn't on the table.

sentences.chinese: 谁把它拿走了？
sentences.pinyin: Shéi bǎ tā ná zǒu le?
sentences.english: Who took it?

sentences.chinese: 我想起那个男人来到这里的样子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐ nà gè nán rén lái dào zhè lǐ de yàng zi.
sentences.english: I remembered the way that man arrived here.

sentences.chinese: 他说他今天不去上班，他说他想去商场买书。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō tā jīn tiān bú qù shàng bān, tā shuō tā xiǎng qù shāng chǎng mǎi shū.
sentences.english: He said he wasn't going to work today; he said he wanted to go to the shopping mall to buy books.

sentences.chinese: 但是，他真的去商店买书了吗？
sentences.pinyin: Dàn shì, tā zhēn de qù shāng diàn mǎi shū le ma?
sentences.english: But did he really go to a store to buy books?

sentences.chinese: 他的动作很奇怪，像是在掩盖什么秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de dòng zuò hěn qí guài, xiàng shì zài yǎn gài shén me mì mì.
sentences.english: His movements were strange, as if he were covering up some secret.

sentences.chinese: 我走到窗边，看到他走出了门。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǒu dào chuāng biān, kàn dào tā zǒu chū le mén.
sentences.english: I walked to the window and saw him walking out the door.

sentences.chinese: 他很快打车离开了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hěn kuài dǎ chē lí kāi le.
sentences.english: He quickly took a taxi and left.

sentences.chinese: 我看到他上车的时候，手里拿着一个东西。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào tā shàng chē de shí hou, shǒu lǐ ná zhe yí gè dōng xi.
sentences.english: I saw that when he got into the car, he was holding something in his hand.

sentences.chinese: 那是他的笔记本吗？
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì tā de bǐ jì běn ma?
sentences.english: Was that his notebook?

sentences.chinese: 他在车里很忙，一直在打电话。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài chē lǐ hěn máng, yì zhí zài dǎ diàn huà.
sentences.english: He was very busy in the car, talking on the phone the whole time.

sentences.chinese: 他可能要去开会，或者去做他的秘密工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kě néng yào qù kāi huì, huò zhě qù zuò tā de mì mì gōng zuò.
sentences.english: He might be going to a meeting, or to do his secret work.

sentences.chinese: 我想知道他住在哪里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zhī dào tā zhù zài nǎ lǐ.
sentences.english: I wanted to know where he lived.

sentences.chinese: 我走出房间，决定去寻找他。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǒu chū fáng jiān, jué dìng qù xún zhǎo tā.
sentences.english: I walked out of the room, deciding to go search for him.

sentences.chinese: 我来到街上，看到很多人在吃饭。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ lái dào jiē shàng, kàn dào hěn duō rén zài chī fàn.
sentences.english: I arrived on the street and saw many people eating.

sentences.chinese: 这里的食物看起来很好吃，但我现在不喜欢吃饭。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de shí wù kàn qǐ lái hěn hǎo chī, dàn wǒ xiàn zài bù xǐ huan chī fàn.
sentences.english: The food here looked delicious, but I don't like eating right now.

sentences.chinese: 我必须得到那个笔记本，因为里面有真相。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bì xū dé dào nà gè bǐ jì běn, yīn wèi lǐ miàn yǒu zhēn xiàng.
sentences.english: I must obtain that notebook because the truth is inside.

sentences.chinese: 我走进一家书店，看到一本关于日文的书。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǒu jìn yì jiā shū diàn, kàn dào yì běn guān yú rì wén de shū.
sentences.english: I walked into a bookstore and saw a book about Japanese.

sentences.chinese: 我想，他是不是想回日本？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng, tā shì bú shì xiǎng huí rì běn?
sentences.english: I thought, does he want to go back to Japan?

sentences.chinese: 我在书的本页之间发现了一张纸。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zài shū de běn yè zhī jiān fā xiàn le yì zhāng zhǐ.
sentences.english: I discovered a piece of paper between the pages of the book.

sentences.chinese: 那是一张机票！
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì yì zhāng jī piào!
sentences.english: It was a plane ticket!

sentences.chinese: 机票上的日期是明天。
sentences.pinyin: Jī piào shàng de rì qī shì míng tiān.
sentences.english: The date on the ticket is tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 他打算在明天离开这里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dǎ suàn zài míng tiān lí kāi zhè lǐ.
sentences.english: He plans to leave here tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 我突然意识到，他下车的地方可能就在附近。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tū rán yì shí dào, tā xià chē de dì fang kě néng jiù zài fù jìn.
sentences.english: I suddenly realized that the place where he got off the car might be nearby.

sentences.chinese: 我快步走在街上，心里在想：他现在在吃晚饭吗？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kuài bù zǒu zài jiē shàng, xīn lǐ zài xiǎng: tā xiàn zài zài chī wǎn fàn ma?
sentences.english: I walked quickly on the street, thinking: is he eating dinner now?

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，我看到一个熟悉的身影在阴影中出现。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, wǒ kàn dào yí gè shú xī de shēn yǐng zài yīn yǐng zhōng chū lái.
sentences.english: Just then, I saw a familiar figure appear in the shadows.

sentences.chinese: 他正看着我。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhèng kàn zhe wǒ.
sentences.english: He was looking at me.

sentences.chinese: 那个男人站在一棵大树下面。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge nán rén zhàn zài yī kē dà shù xià miàn.
sentences.english: That man was standing under a large tree.

sentences.chinese: 他穿一件黑色的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chuān yī jiàn hēi sè de yī fu.
sentences.english: He was wearing black clothes.

sentences.chinese: 我慢慢走过去，我想看见他的脸。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ màn màn zǒu guò qù, wǒ xiǎng kàn jiàn tā de liǎn.
sentences.english: I slowly walked over; I wanted to see his face.

sentences.chinese: 他看见我以后，快步走开。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn jiàn wǒ yǐ hòu, kuài bù zǒu kāi.
sentences.english: After he saw me, he quickly walked away.

sentences.chinese: 他在走路的时候，手里拿着一张票。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài zǒu lù de shí hou, shǒu lǐ ná zhe yī zhāng piào.
sentences.english: While he was walking, he was holding a ticket in his hand.

sentences.chinese: 那是一张电影院的票。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì yī zhāng diàn yǐng yuàn de piào.
sentences.english: It was a ticket for the cinema.

sentences.chinese: 我跟着他走，直到一个车站。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gēn zhe tā zǒu, zhí dào yī gè chē zhàn.
sentences.english: I followed him until I reached a station.

sentences.chinese: 车站旁边有一辆白色的汽车。
sentences.pinyin: Chē zhàn páng biān yǒu yī liàng bái sè de qì chē.
sentences.english: Next to the station was a white car.

sentences.chinese: 他走进汽车，但我快步跑上前。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu jìn qì chē, dàn wǒ kuài bù pǎo shàng qián.
sentences.english: He got into the car, but I quickly ran forward.

sentences.chinese: 我对他大声说：“我想和你见面！”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ duì tā dà shēng shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng hé nǐ jiàn miàn!”
sentences.english: I said to him loudly, "I want to meet with you!"

sentences.chinese: 他停下来，看着我，眼神很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tíng xià lái, kàn zhe wǒ, yǎn shén hěn qí guài.
sentences.english: He stopped and looked at me; his gaze was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 他问我：“你为什么要找我？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn wǒ: “Nǐ wèi shén me yào zhǎo wǒ?”
sentences.english: He asked me, "Why do you want to find me?"

sentences.chinese: 他说他现在要去看病，不能说话。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō tā xiàn zài yào qù kàn bìng, bù néng shuō huà.
sentences.english: He said he had to go see a doctor now and couldn't speak.

sentences.chinese: 他给我一个杯子，杯子里有茶。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gěi wǒ yī gè bēi zi, bēi zi lǐ yǒu chá.
sentences.english: He gave me a cup, and there was tea in the cup.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“先喝茶，我们去那边说话。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Xiān hē chá, wǒ men qù nà biān shuō huà.”
sentences.english: He said, "Drink the tea first, and we will go over there to talk."

sentences.chinese: 我们走进一家小餐厅。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men zǒu jìn yī jiā xiǎo cān tīng.
sentences.english: We walked into a small restaurant.

sentences.chinese: 桌子上有很多肉和菜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuō zi shàng yǒu hěn duō ròu hé cài.
sentences.english: There was a lot of meat and vegetables on the table.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，他来自比利时，简称比。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ, tā lái zì Bǐ lǐ shí, jiǎn chēng Bǐ.
sentences.english: He told me that he comes from Belgium, abbreviated as 'Bi'.

sentences.chinese: 他说他在中国学习中文，明天有考试。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō tā zài Zhōng guó xué xí Zhōng wén, míng tiān yǒu kǎo shì.
sentences.english: He said he is studying Chinese in China and has an exam tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 他说他必须用这个时间复习，不能被干扰。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō tā bì xū yòng zhè ge shí jiān fù xí, bù néng bèi gān rǎo.
sentences.english: He said he must use this time to review and cannot be disturbed.

sentences.chinese: 我看着他，心里在想：他在说实话吗？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe tā, xīn lǐ zài xiǎng: tā zài shuō shí huà ma?
sentences.english: I looked at him and thought: is he telling the truth?

sentences.chinese: 他突然站起来，走向洗手间。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tū rán zhàn qǐ lái, zǒu xiàng xǐ shǒu jiān.
sentences.english: He suddenly stood up and walked toward the washroom.

sentences.chinese: 我试着看他的口袋，发现一个小的笔记本。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shì zhe kàn tā de kǒu dài, fā xiàn yī gè xiǎo de bǐ jì běn.
sentences.english: I tried to look in his pocket and found a small notebook.

sentences.chinese: 那是他之前丢失的那个笔记本！
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì tā zhī qián diū shī de nà ge bǐ jì běn!
sentences.english: That was the notebook he had lost before!

sentences.chinese: 我快要拿走它的时候，他突然回来了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kuài yào ná zǒu tā de shí hou, tā tū rán huí lái le.
sentences.english: Just as I was about to take it, he suddenly returned.

sentences.chinese: 他看着我，脸上的表情变了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe wǒ, liǎn shàng de biǎo qíng biàn le.
sentences.english: He looked at me, and the expression on his face changed.

sentences.chinese: 他低声说：“你考到了我的秘密。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dī shēng shuō: “Nǐ kǎo dào le wǒ de mì mì.”
sentences.english: He whispered, "You have hit upon my secret."

sentences.chinese: 他突然用力地抓住我的手，把我拉了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tū rán yòng lì de zhuā zhù wǒ de shǒu, bǎ wǒ lā le qǐ lái.
sentences.english: He suddenly gripped my hand with force and pulled me up.

sentences.chinese: 他用力地看着我，眼睛里有秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng lì de kàn zhe wǒ, yǎn jīng lǐ yǒu mì mì.
sentences.english: He looked at me forcefully, with secrets in his eyes.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你不用害怕，我只是想谈谈。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ bù yòng hài pà, wǒ zhǐ shì xiǎng tán tán.”
sentences.english: He said, "You don't need to be afraid, I just want to talk."

sentences.chinese: 我看着他，心里在想：他到底是谁？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe tā, xīn lǐ zài xiǎng: tā dào dǐ shì shuí?
sentences.english: I looked at him, thinking in my heart: who on earth is he?

sentences.chinese: 他把我拉到这里的一个小店里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ wǒ lā dào zhè lǐ de yī gè xiǎo diàn lǐ.
sentences.english: He pulled me into a small shop here.

sentences.chinese: 店里有很多人，他们都在说话。
sentences.pinyin: Diàn lǐ yǒu hěn duō rén, tā men dōu zài shuō huà.
sentences.english: There were many people in the shop; they were all talking.

sentences.chinese: 他指着桌子上的一些包子说：“你饿吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐ zhe zhuō zi shàng de yī xiē bāo zi shuō: “Nǐ è ma?”
sentences.english: He pointed to some baozi on the table and said, "Are you hungry?"

sentences.chinese: 我摇了摇头，我现在不想吃东西。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yáo le yáo tóu, wǒ xiàn zài bù xiǎng chī dōng xī.
sentences.english: I shook my head; I didn't want to eat anything right now.

sentences.chinese: 他低声说：“你最好听我的话。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dī shēng shuō: “Nǐ zuì hǎo tīng wǒ de huà.”
sentences.english: He whispered, "You had better listen to me."

sentences.chinese: 我问他：“你的名字是什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Nǐ de míng zi shì shén me?”
sentences.english: I asked him, "What is your name?"

sentences.chinese: 他笑了，但他的笑容很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiào le, dàn tā de xiào róng hěn qí guài.
sentences.english: He smiled, but his smile was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“名字是不有用的，在这个地方。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Míng zi shì bù yǒu yòng de, zài zhè gè dì fāng.”
sentences.english: He said, "Names are not useful in this place."

sentences.chinese: 我看到他从包里拿出一张照片。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào tā cóng bāo lǐ ná chū yī zhāng zhào piàn.
sentences.english: I saw him take a photo out from his bag.

sentences.chinese: 照片里有很多人，那些人看起来很严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhào piàn lǐ yǒu hěn duō rén, nà xiē rén kàn qǐ lái hěn yán sù.
sentences.english: There were many people in the photo; those people looked very serious.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“这些人是我在网上的网友。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zhè xiē rén shì wǒ zài wǎng shàng de wǎng yǒu.”
sentences.english: He said, "These people are my online friends."

sentences.chinese: 我问：“你们在做什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn: “Nǐ men zài zuò shén me?”
sentences.english: I asked, "What are you (plural) doing?"

sentences.chinese: 他看着我，语气变了，他说：“您知道这些秘密吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe wǒ, yǔ qì biàn le, tā shuō: “Nín zhī dào zhè xiē mì mì ma?”
sentences.english: He looked at me, his tone changed, and he said, "Do you (polite) know these secrets?"

sentences.chinese: 他突然用一种奇怪的语气说话，像是在练习上声。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tū rán yòng yī zhǒng qí guài de yǔ qì shuō huà, xiàng shì zài liàn xí shǎng shēng.
sentences.english: He suddenly spoke in a strange tone, as if he were practicing the third tone (shang sheng).

sentences.chinese: 他说：“有时候，真相就在这里。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Yǒu shí hou, zhēn xiàng jiù zài zhè lǐ.”
sentences.english: He said, "Sometimes, the truth is right here."

sentences.chinese: 我看着那些照片，发现其中一张照片在那个笔记本里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe nà xiē zhào piàn, fā xiàn qí zhōng yī zhāng zhào piàn zài nà gè bǐ jì běn lǐ.
sentences.english: I looked at those photos and found that one of them was in that notebook.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，他在这里等了一打人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ, tā zài zhè lǐ děng le yī dá rén.
sentences.english: He told me that he was waiting for a dozen people here.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“他们很快就到这儿了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Tā men hěn kuài jiù dào zhè r le.”
sentences.english: He said, "They will be here soon."

sentences.chinese: 我问：“那儿有什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn: “Nà r yǒu shén me?”
sentences.english: I asked, "What is over there?"

sentences.chinese: 他指了指门外，眼神很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐ le zhǐ mén wài, yǎn shén hěn lěng.
sentences.english: He pointed outside the door, his gaze cold.

sentences.chinese: 我说：“没关系，我可以走。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: “Méi guān xi, wǒ kě yǐ zǒu.”
sentences.english: I said, "It doesn't matter, I can leave."

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，门开了，一群陌生人走进了这里。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, mén kāi le, yī qún mò shēng rén zǒu jìn le zhè lǐ.
sentences.english: But just then, the door opened, and a group of strangers walked into this place.

sentences.chinese: 这些陌生人走进房间，气势很强。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē mòshēng rén zǒu jìn fángjiān, qìshì hěn qiáng.
sentences.english: These strangers entered the room with a strong presence.

sentences.chinese: 他们的领头人看着我，眼神很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen de lǐngtóu rén kànzhe wǒ, yǎnshén hěn qíguài.
sentences.english: Their leader looked at me with a strange look in his eyes.

sentences.chinese: 他手里拿着一张纸，上面写着很多名字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shǒulǐ názhe yì zhāng zhǐ, shàngmiàn xiězhe hěnduō míngzì.
sentences.english: He held a piece of paper in his hand, with many names written on it.

sentences.chinese: 我想看，但他很快把纸关在了文件夹里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng kàn, dàn tā hěn kuài bǎ zhǐ guān zàile wénjiàn jiá lǐ.
sentences.english: I wanted to see, but he quickly closed the paper in a folder.

sentences.chinese: 我发现这些名字都是姓氏。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ fāxiàn zhèxiē míngzì dōu shì xìngshì.
sentences.english: I discovered that these names were all surnames.

sentences.chinese: 名单上有三先生，还有东先生。
sentences.pinyin: Míngdān shàng yǒu Sān xiānsheng, hái yǒu Dōng xiānsheng.
sentences.english: On the list was Mr. San, and also Mr. Dong.

sentences.chinese: 接着是中先生，元先生，和关先生。
sentences.pinyin: Jiēzhe shì Zhōng xiānsheng, Yuán xiānsheng, hé Guān xiānsheng.
sentences.english: Then there were Mr. Zhong, Mr. Yuan, and Mr. Guan.

sentences.chinese: 南先生，山先生，常先生，年先生也在上面。
sentences.pinyin: Nán xiānsheng, Shān xiānsheng, Cháng xiānsheng, Nián xiānsheng yě zài shàngmiàn.
sentences.english: Mr. Nan, Mr. Shan, Mr. Chang, and Mr. Nian were also on it.

sentences.chinese: 新先生，班先生，能先生，花先生，还先生，那先生，钱先生也都在。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiānsheng, Bān xiānsheng, Néng xiānsheng, Huā xiānsheng, Huán xiānsheng, Nā xiānsheng, Qián xiānsheng yě dōu zài.
sentences.english: Mr. Xin, Mr. Ban, Mr. Neng, Mr. Hua, Mr. Huan, Mr. Na, and Mr. Qian were all there too.

sentences.chinese: 这些名字像是一个秘密的组织。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē míngzì xiàng shì yígè mìmì de zǔzhī.
sentences.english: These names seemed like a secret organization.

sentences.chinese: 领头人低声说：“这些人现在都不在家。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐngtóu rén dīshēng shuō: “Zhèxiē rén xiànzài dōu bù zài jiā.”
sentences.english: The leader whispered, "These people are not at home right now."

sentences.chinese: 我问：“他们是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn: “Tāmen shì shéi?”
sentences.english: I asked, "Who are they?"

sentences.chinese: 他冷笑一声，看着这个家伙。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lěngxiào yìshēng, kànzhe zhège jiāhuo.
sentences.english: He sneered and looked at this fellow.

sentences.chinese: 他指着那个男人说：“他是我的儿子。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐzhe nàge nánrén shuō: “Tā shì wǒ de ér zi.”
sentences.english: He pointed to that man and said, "He is my son."

sentences.chinese: 我很惊讶，因为那个男人看起来很年轻。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hěn jīngyà, yīnwèi nàge nánrén kàn qǐlái hěn niánqīng.
sentences.english: I was very surprised because that man looked very young.

sentences.chinese: 现在是正月初一，外面风很大。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài shì Zhēngyuè chūyī, wàimiàn fēng hěn dà.
sentences.english: It is now the first day of the first lunar month, and the wind is very strong outside.

sentences.chinese: 领头人说：“跟我们进屋，我们要谈谈。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐngtóu rén shuō: “Gēn wǒmen jìn wū, wǒmen yào tán tan.”
sentences.english: The leader said, "Follow us inside the house; we need to talk."

sentences.chinese: 我看着他，心里在想：这些姓氏之间有什么关系？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe tā, xīnlǐ zài xiǎng: zhèxiē xìngshì zhījiān yǒu shéme guānxì?
sentences.english: I looked at him and thought: what is the relationship between these surnames?

sentences.chinese: 为什么一个家庭会有这么多奇怪的联系？
sentences.pinyin: Wèishéme yígè jiātíng huì yǒu zhème duō qíguài de liánxì?
sentences.english: Why would one family have so many strange connections?

sentences.chinese: 我跟着他们走进深处，发现墙上有一张旧地图。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gēnzhe tāmen zǒu jìn shēnchù, fāxiàn qiáng shàng yǒu yì zhāng jiù dìtú.
sentences.english: I followed them deeper inside and found an old map on the wall.

sentences.chinese: 地图上标记了许多地方，其中一个红点就在我这里。
sentences.pinyin: Dìtú shàng biāojì le xǔduō dìfāng, qízhōng yígè hóngdiǎn jiù zài wǒ zhèlǐ.
sentences.english: The map marked many places, and one red dot was right here.

sentences.chinese: 突然，灯灭了，房间里一片漆黑。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, dēng miè le, fángjiān lǐ yípiàn chīhēi.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the lights went out, and the room became pitch black.

sentences.chinese: 我听到一个声音在我耳边低语：“快跑！”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tīngdào yígè shēngyīn zài wǒ ěrbiān dīyǔ: “Kuài pǎo!”
sentences.english: I heard a voice whisper in my ear: "Run!"

sentences.chinese: 我被那个声音吓到了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bèi nà ge shēng yīn xià dào le.
sentences.english: I was frightened by that voice.

sentences.chinese: 我不知道谁在说话。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhī dào shéi zài shuō huà.
sentences.english: I didn't know who was speaking.

sentences.chinese: 房间里非常黑，我什么也看不见。
sentences.pinyin: Fáng jiān lǐ fēi cháng hēi, wǒ shén me yě kàn bù jiàn.
sentences.english: The room was very dark; I couldn't see anything.

sentences.chinese: 我先听了一下，周围很安静。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiān tīng le yī xià, zhōu wéi hěn ā jìng.
sentences.english: I listened first, and the surroundings were very quiet.

sentences.chinese: 我慢慢站起来，感觉到身体很累。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ màn man zhàn qǐ lai, gǎn jué dào shēn tǐ hěn lèi.
sentences.english: I slowly stood up, feeling very tired.

sentences.chinese: 我想逃跑，但我不知道该往哪儿走。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng táo pǎo, dàn wǒ bù zhī dào gāi wǎng nǎ r zǒu.
sentences.english: I wanted to escape, but I didn't know where to go.

sentences.chinese: 突然，灯开了。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, dēng kāi le.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the lights came on.

sentences.chinese: 一个男人站在我面前，他的脸和之前的男人一样。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè nán rén zhàn zài wǒ miàn qián, tā de liǎn hé zhī qián de nán rén yī yàng.
sentences.english: A man was standing in front of me; his face was the same as the previous man's.

sentences.chinese: 他是谁？
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì shéi?
sentences.english: Who was he?

sentences.chinese: 他看着我，认真地说：“请记住，这里不安全。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe wǒ, rèn zhēn de shuō: “Qǐng jì zhù, zhè lǐ bù ā quán.”
sentences.english: He looked at me and said seriously, "Please remember, it is not safe here."

sentences.chinese: 他的衣服很干净，看起来像是一个有名的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yī fú hěn gān jìng, kàn qǐ lái xiàng shì yī gè yǒu míng de rén.
sentences.english: His clothes were very clean; he looked like a famous person.

sentences.chinese: 他对我笑了笑，但他的眼神不对。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì wǒ xiào le xiào, dàn tā de yǎn shén bù duì.
sentences.english: He smiled at me, but his expression was not right.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“我知道你在找那个笔记本。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ zhī dào nǐ zài zhǎo nà ge bǐ jì běn.”
sentences.english: He said, "I know you are looking for that notebook."

sentences.chinese: 我明白了，这个人知道很多秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ míng bai le, zhè gè rén zhī dào hěn duō mì mì.
sentences.english: I understood; this person knew many secrets.

sentences.chinese: 他说这个笔记本里有非常贵的知识。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō zhè běn bǐ jì běn lǐ yǒu fēi cháng guì de zhī shi.
sentences.english: He said that there was very precious knowledge in this notebook.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“这本笔记本的第一页写着北京。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zhè běn bǐ jì běn de dì yī yè xiě zhe Běi jīng.”
sentences.english: He said, "The first page of this notebook mentions Beijing."

sentences.chinese: 我好奇地问：“北京怎么了？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hào qí de wèn: “Běi jīng zěn me le?”
sentences.english: I asked curiously, "What happened to Beijing?"

sentences.chinese: 他回答说：“那里有我们要找的答案。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā huí dá shuō: “Nà lǐ yǒu wǒ men yào zhǎo de dá àn.”
sentences.english: He replied, "The answer we are looking for is there."

sentences.chinese: 我想知道他是不是在说实话。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zhī dào tā shì bù shì zài shuō shí huà.
sentences.english: I wanted to know if he was telling the truth.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，学习汉字需要很多时间。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ, xué xí hàn zì xū yào hěn duō shí jiān.
sentences.english: He told me that studying Chinese characters takes a lot of time.

sentences.chinese: 他问我：“你认识这些汉字吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn wǒ: “Nǐ rèn shi zhè xiē hàn zì ma?”
sentences.english: He asked me, "Do you recognize these characters?"

sentences.chinese: 我摇了摇头，因为我不明白这些复杂的字。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yáo le yáo tóu, yīn wèi wǒ bù míng bai zhè xiē fù zá de zì.
sentences.english: I shook my head because I didn't understand these complex characters.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“如果你认真学习，你就会知道真相。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Rú guǒ nǐ rèn zhēn xué xí, nǐ jiù huì zhī dào zhēn xiàng.”
sentences.english: He said, "If you study seriously, you will then know the truth."

sentences.chinese: 我问他：“你还是想帮我吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Nǐ hái shi xiǎng bāng wǒ ma?”
sentences.english: I asked him, "Do you still want to help me?"

sentences.chinese: 他点点头说：“对，我想帮你。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā diǎn diǎn tóu shuō: “Duì, wǒ xiǎng bāng nǐ.”
sentences.english: He nodded and said, "Correct, I want to help you."

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，先离开这个房间，再去找那个地图。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ, xiān lí kāi zhè gè fáng jiān, zài qù zhǎo nà ge dì tú.
sentences.english: He told me to leave this room first, and then go find that map.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“那个地图上的红点就是关键。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nà ge dì tú shàng de hóng diǎn jiù shì guān jiàn.”
sentences.english: He said, "The red dot on that map is exactly the key."

sentences.chinese: 我看着他，心里在想：他为什么这么好？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe tā, xīn lǐ zài xiǎng: tā wèi shén me zhè me hǎo?
sentences.english: I looked at him and thought: why is he so good?

sentences.chinese: 在这个危险的地方，谁会无缘无故地帮助我？
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè gè wēi xiǎn de dì fang, shéi huì wú yuán wú gù de bāng zhù wǒ?
sentences.english: In this dangerous place, who would help me for no reason?

sentences.chinese: 我突然听到门外有很多人在走。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tū rán tīng dào mén wài yǒu hěn duō rén zài zǒu.
sentences.english: I suddenly heard many people walking outside the door.

sentences.chinese: 他低声说：“快走，他们来了！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dī shēng shuō: “Kuài zǒu, tā men lái le!”
sentences.english: He whispered, "Go quickly, they are coming!"

sentences.chinese: 我们快步跑向门外。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen kuàibù pǎo xiàng mén wài.
sentences.english: We ran quickly out the door.

sentences.chinese: 我听到后面有六个人在走。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tīngdào hòumiàn yǒu liù gè rén zài zǒu.
sentences.english: I heard six people walking behind us.

sentences.chinese: 他低声对我说：“快，跟我走！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dīshēng duì wǒ shuō: “Kuài, gēn wǒ zǒu!”
sentences.english: He whispered to me, "Quick, follow me!"

sentences.chinese: 我们走了一会儿，进入了一个小巷子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zǒu le yī huì r, jìnrù le yī gè xiǎo xiàngzi.
sentences.english: We walked for a while and entered a small alley.

sentences.chinese: 这里太黑了，我看不清哪里有路。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ tài hēi le, wǒ kàn bù qīng nǎ lǐ yǒu lù.
sentences.english: It was too dark here; I couldn't see where there was a path.

sentences.chinese: 他突然停下来，拿出一张小纸条。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán tíng xiàlái, ná chū yī zhāng xiǎo zhǐtiáo.
sentences.english: He suddenly stopped and took out a small slip of paper.

sentences.chinese: 纸条上写着一些数字：四、五、六、七、八、九、十。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐtiáo shàng xiě zhe yī xiē shùzì: sì, wǔ, liù, qī, bā, jiǔ, shí.
sentences.english: Some numbers were written on the paper: four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.

sentences.chinese: 我问他：“这是什么意思？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Zhè shì shén me yìsi?”
sentences.english: I asked him, "What does this mean?"

sentences.chinese: 他看着我，眼神很严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe wǒ, yǎnshén hěn yánsù.
sentences.english: He looked at me with a very serious expression.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“这是一个代码，代表了不同的国家。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zhè shì yī gè dàimǎ, dàibiǎo le bù tóng de guó jiā.”
sentences.english: He said, "This is a code, representing different countries."

sentences.chinese: 我心里在想：这件奇怪的事到底是怎么回事？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xīnlǐ zài xiǎng: zhè jiàn qíguài de shì dàodǐ shì zěnme huí shì?
sentences.english: I thought to myself: what on earth is this strange matter about?

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，这些数字对应地图上的地点。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, zhè xiē shùzì duìyìng dìtú shàng de dì diǎn.
sentences.english: He told me that these numbers correspond to locations on the map.

sentences.chinese: 在这张地图上，有两处红点。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè zhāng dìtú shàng, yǒu liǎng chù hóng diǎn.
sentences.english: On this map, there are two red dots.

sentences.chinese: 其中一个红点就在这个城市。
sentences.pinyin: Qízhōng yī gè hóng diǎn jiù zài zhè gè chéngshì.
sentences.english: One of the red dots is right here in this city.

sentences.chinese: 我问他：“还有别的线索吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Hái yǒu bié de xiànsuǒ ma?”
sentences.english: I asked him, "Are there any other clues?"

sentences.chinese: 他点点头，说：“我们需要找到一个女人。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā diǎn diǎn tóu, shuō: “Wǒmen xūyào zhǎodào yī gè nǚ rén.”
sentences.english: He nodded and said, "We need to find a woman."

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，那个女人的名字在纸条的背面。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, nà gè nǚ rén de míngzì zài zhǐtiáo de bèimiàn.
sentences.english: He told me that the woman's name was on the back of the slip.

sentences.chinese: 我看了半天，才发现背面写着一个小数字：一。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn le bàn tiān, cái fāxiàn bèimiàn xiě zhe yī gè xiǎo shùzì: yī.
sentences.english: I looked for a long time before discovering a small number written on the back: one.

sentences.chinese: “一个数字怎么能代表一个人？”我疑惑地问。
sentences.pinyin: “Yī gè shùzì zěnme néng dàibiǎo yī gè rén?” wǒ húyì de wèn.
sentences.english: "How can one number represent a person?" I asked suspiciously.

sentences.chinese: 他回答说：“这个数字代表她是这个组织里的第一个成员。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā huídá shuō: “Zhè gè shùzì dàibiǎo tā shì zhè gè zǔzhī lǐ de dì yī gè chéngyuán.”
sentences.english: He answered, "This number represents that she is the first member of this organization."

sentences.chinese: 他问我：“你知道她现在在哪里吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn wǒ: “Nǐ zhīdào tā xiànzài zài nǎ lǐ ma?”
sentences.english: He asked me, "Do you know where she is now?"

sentences.chinese: 我摇了摇头，我说：“我不知道，我也不认识别人。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yáo le yáo tóu, wǒ shuō: “Wǒ bù zhīdào, wǒ yě bù rènshí bié ren.”
sentences.english: I shook my head and said, "I don't know, and I don't know anyone else."

sentences.chinese: 他叹了口气，说：“今天的时间不多了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā tàn le yī kǒu qì, shuō: “Jīntiān de shíjiān bù duō le.”
sentences.english: He sighed and said, "There isn't much time left today."

sentences.chinese: 我们需要在四天之内找到她。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào zài sì tiān zhī nèi zhǎodào tā.
sentences.english: We need to find her within four days.

sentences.chinese: 我想知道，这个组织里到底有多少人？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zhīdào, zhè gè zǔzhī lǐ dàodǐ yǒu duō shǎo rén?
sentences.english: I wanted to know, exactly how many people are in this organization?

sentences.chinese: 哪些人是好人，哪些人是坏人？
sentences.pinyin: Nǎ xiē rén shì hǎo rén, nǎ xiē rén shì huài rén?
sentences.english: Which ones are good people, and which ones are bad people?

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，巷子的入口处出现了一个身影。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, xiàngzi de rùkǒu chù chūxiàn le yī gè shēnyǐng.
sentences.english: Just then, a figure appeared at the entrance of the alley.

sentences.chinese: 那个身影正看着我们。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè shēnyǐng zhèng kàn zhe wǒmen.
sentences.english: That figure was watching us.

sentences.chinese: 那个男人站在巷子口，看着我们。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge nán rén zhàn zài xiàng zi kǒu, kàn zhe wǒ men.
sentences.english: That man stood at the entrance of the alley, looking at us.

sentences.chinese: 我感到很害怕，因为他看起来真冷漠。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gǎn dào hěn hài pà, yīn wèi tā kàn qǐ lái zhēn lěng mò.
sentences.english: I felt very scared because he looked truly cold.

sentences.chinese: 我们快步走开，离开那个地方。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men kuài bù zǒu kāi, lí kāi nà ge dì fang.
sentences.english: We walked away quickly, leaving that place.

sentences.chinese: 现在，我坐在房间里，心里在想：那个身影是谁？
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài, wǒ zuò zài fáng jiān lǐ, xīn lǐ zài xiǎng: nà ge shēn yǐng shì shuí?
sentences.english: Now, I am sitting in my room, thinking: who was that figure?

sentences.chinese: 桌子上有一些旧的信件。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī xiē jiù de xìn jiàn.
sentences.english: There are some old letters on the table.

sentences.chinese: 这些信件上的字很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiē xìn jiàn shàng de zì hěn qí guài.
sentences.english: The characters on these letters are very strange.

sentences.chinese: 有的字很大，有的字很小。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu de zì hěn dà, yǒu de zì hěn xiǎo.
sentences.english: Some characters are large, and some are small.

sentences.chinese: 我记得我的爸以前也收到过这样的信。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jì dé wǒ de bà yǐ qián yě shōu dào guò zhè yàng de xìn.
sentences.english: I remember my dad used to receive letters like this too.

sentences.chinese: 他常常告诉我，不要相信陌生人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cháng cháng gào sù wǒ, bù yào xiāng xìn mò shēng rén.
sentences.english: He often told me not to trust strangers.

sentences.chinese: 这时，我看到信封上写着“第二月”。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, wǒ kàn dào xìn fēng shàng xiě zhe “dì èr yuè”.
sentences.english: At this moment, I saw "Second Month" written on the envelope.

sentences.chinese: 这是什么意思？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì shén me yì si?
sentences.english: What does this mean?

sentences.chinese: 是不是在说二月份？
sentences.pinyin: Shì bù shì zài shuō èr yuè fèn?
sentences.english: Is it talking about February?

sentences.chinese: 还是在说第二个月的时间？
sentences.pinyin: Hái shì zài shuō dì èr gè yuè de shí jiān?
sentences.english: Or is it talking about the time of the second month?

sentences.chinese: 我想知道，她们到底在计划什么？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zhī dào, tā men dào dǐ zài jì huà shén me?
sentences.english: I want to know what they (females) are actually planning?

sentences.chinese: 这里的“她们”是指那个组织里的女人吗？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de “tā men” shì zhǐ nà ge zǔ zhī lǐ de nǚ rén ma?
sentences.english: Does "they" here refer to the women in that organization?

sentences.chinese: 有些线索很清楚，有些线索却很模糊。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu xiē xiàn suǒ hěn qīng chu, yǒu xiē xiàn suǒ què hěn mó hu.
sentences.english: Some clues are very clear, while some clues are very blurry.

sentences.chinese: 有时，我觉得自己离真相很近。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu shí, wǒ jué dé zì jǐ lí zhēn xiàng hěn jìn.
sentences.english: Sometimes, I feel I am very close to the truth.

sentences.chinese: 但最后，我总是发现自己被骗了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zuì hòu, wǒ zǒng shì fā xiàn zì jǐ bèi piàn le.
sentences.english: But in the end, I always find that I have been deceived.

sentences.chinese: 我看了看时钟，现在是十点。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn le kàn shí zhōng, xiàn zài shì shí diǎn.
sentences.english: I looked at the clock; it is ten o'clock now.

sentences.chinese: 时间不多了，我们必须快一点。
sentences.pinyin: Shí jiān bù duō le, wǒ men bì xū kuài yī diǎn.
sentences.english: Time is running out; we must be a bit faster.

sentences.chinese: 我尝试在电视上寻找相关的新闻。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ cháng shì zài diàn shì shàng xún zhǎo xiāng guān de xīn wén.
sentences.english: I tried to look for related news on the television.

sentences.chinese: 但我什么也没找到，电视里只有广告。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ shén me yě méi zhǎo dào, diàn shì lǐ zhǐ yǒu guǎng gào.
sentences.english: But I found nothing; there were only advertisements on the TV.

sentences.chinese: 我想起那个男人之前在电影院见过我。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐ nà ge nán rén zhī qián zài diàn yǐng yuàn jiàn guò wǒ.
sentences.english: I remembered that the man had seen me at the cinema before.

sentences.chinese: 他是不是一直在跟踪我？
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì bù shì yī zhí zài gēn zōng wǒ?
sentences.english: Has he been following me all along?

sentences.chinese: 怎么会这样？
sentences.pinyin: Zěn me huì zhè yàng?
sentences.english: How could this be?

sentences.chinese: 我拿起一个小球，在手里转动，努力思考。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ ná qǐ yī gè xiǎo qiú, zài shǒu lǐ zhuàn dòng, nǔ lì sī kǎo.
sentences.english: I picked up a small ball, rotating it in my hand, thinking hard.

sentences.chinese: 突然，我发现信纸的背面有一个红点。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, wǒ fā xiàn xìn zhǐ de bèi miàn yǒu yī gè hóng diǎn.
sentences.english: Suddenly, I discovered a red dot on the back of the letter paper.

sentences.chinese: 这个红点指向了一个新的地址。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge hóng diǎn zhǐ xiàng le yī gè xīn de dì zhǐ.
sentences.english: This red dot pointed to a new address.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十一章：北边的旧诊所
chapters.title_english: Chapter 11: The Old Clinic in the North

sentences.chinese: 我看着那个红点，觉得这个地址很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe nàge hóngdiǎn, juéde zhège dìzhǐ hěn qíguài.
sentences.english: I looked at the red dot and felt this address was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 它在城市的北边。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài chéngshì de běibiān.
sentences.english: It is in the north of the city.

sentences.chinese: 这里离我的家很远。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ lí wǒ de jiā hěn yuǎn.
sentences.english: This place is very far from my home.

sentences.chinese: 我拿起手机，发现电量只剩下零个百分点。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ náqǐ shǒujī, fāxiàn diànliàng zhǐ shèngxià líng gè bǎifēndiǎn.
sentences.english: I picked up my phone and found the battery was at zero percent.

sentences.chinese: 手机坏了，我不能打电话。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒujī huài le, wǒ bùnéng dǎ diànhuà.
sentences.english: The phone was broken; I couldn't make a call.

sentences.chinese: 我想起那个男人，他是不是生病了？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngqǐ nàge nánrén, tā shì bù shì shēngbìng le?
sentences.english: I thought of that man; was he sick?

sentences.chinese: 他之前说他没生病，但我觉得不对。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhīqián shuō tā méi shēngbìng, dàn wǒ juéde bùduì.
sentences.english: He said before that he wasn't sick, but I felt something was wrong.

sentences.chinese: 他看起来像一个病人，身体很差。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐlái xiàng yīgè bìngrén, shēntǐ hěn chà.
sentences.english: He looked like a patient, his health was very poor.

sentences.chinese: 我走在路上，天快黑了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǒu zài lùshàng, tiān kuài hēi le.
sentences.english: I walked on the road, and it was almost dark.

sentences.chinese: 我看到一个小的旧房子，门没关上。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàndào yīgè xiǎo de jiù fángzi, mén méi guānshàng.
sentences.english: I saw a small old house, the door was not closed.

sentences.chinese: 房子里没有灯，只有半个房间有光。
sentences.pinyin: Fángzi lǐ méiyǒu dēng, zhǐyǒu bàn gè fángjiān yǒu guāng.
sentences.english: There were no lights in the house, only half a room had light.

sentences.chinese: 我走进房子，看到一个男人在椅子上。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǒu jìn fángzi, kàndào yīgè nánrén zài yǐzi shàng.
sentences.english: I walked into the house and saw a man in a chair.

sentences.chinese: 他看着我，低声说：“对不起，我忘了时间。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe wǒ, dīshēng shuō: “Duìbuqǐ, wǒ wàngle shíjiān.”
sentences.english: He looked at me and said in a low voice, "I'm sorry, I forgot the time."

sentences.chinese: 他的声音很小，而且很累。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shēngyīn hěn xiǎo, érqiě hěn lèi.
sentences.english: His voice was very small and he sounded very tired.

sentences.chinese: 我问他：“你是谁？为什么在这里？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Nǐ shì shéi? Wèishéme zài zhèlǐ?”
sentences.english: I asked him, "Who are you? Why are you here?"

sentences.chinese: 他说：“我在这里照顾一个病人。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ zài zhèlǐ zhàogù yīgè bìngrén.”
sentences.english: He said, "I am here taking care of a patient."

sentences.chinese: 但我发现这里没有其他的人。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ fāxiàn zhèlǐ méiyǒu qítā de rén.
sentences.english: But I discovered there were no other people here.

sentences.chinese: 这里太安静了，少了很多生活的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ tài ānjìng le, shǎole hěnduō shēnghuó de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: It was too quiet here, lacking many sounds of life.

sentences.chinese: 我觉得这个地方不大，但是很阴森。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhège dìfāng bù dà, dànshì hěn yīnsēn.
sentences.english: I felt this place was not large, but very eerie.

sentences.chinese: 我想走，但门突然被关上了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zǒu, dàn mén tūrán bèi guānshàng le.
sentences.english: I wanted to leave, but the door was suddenly closed.

sentences.chinese: 我听到外面有二个人在说话。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tīngdào wàimiàn yǒu èr gè rén zài shuōhuà.
sentences.english: I heard two people talking outside.

sentences.chinese: 他们说：“快找，他一定在里面。”
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen shuō: “Kuài zhǎo, tā yīdìng zài lǐmiàn.”
sentences.english: They said, "Search quickly, he must be inside."

sentences.chinese: 寻找真相太难了。
sentences.pinyin: Xúnzhǎo zhēnxiàng tài nán le.
sentences.english: Searching for the truth is too difficult.

sentences.chinese: 我看向窗下，发现他们正走过来。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànxiàng chuāng xià, fāxiàn tāmen zhèng zǒu guòlái.
sentences.english: I looked down from the window and found they were walking over.

sentences.chinese: 没什么好害怕的，我必须面对他们。
sentences.pinyin: Méishénme hǎo hàipà de, wǒ bìxū miànduì tāmen.
sentences.english: There is nothing to be afraid of; I must face them.

sentences.chinese: 但我不知道，他们是谁。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ bù zhīdào, tāmen shì shéi.
sentences.english: But I don't know who they are.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十二章：旧诊所的秘密
chapters.title_english: Chapter 12: Secrets of the Old Clinic

sentences.chinese: 我快步走进旧诊所，那里很冷，但是我的心很热。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kuài bù zǒu jìn jiù zhěn suǒ, nà lǐ hěn lěng, dàn shì wǒ de xīn hěn rè.
sentences.english: I stepped quickly into the old clinic; it was very cold there, but my heart was racing (hot).

sentences.chinese: 我听到有人在说话，我停下来想一下儿。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tīng dào yǒu rén zài shuō huà, wǒ tíng xià lái xiǎng yī xià r.
sentences.english: I heard someone talking, so I stopped to think for a moment.

sentences.chinese: 一个女人走出来，她看着我，眼神很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè nǚ rén zǒu chū lái, tā kàn zhe wǒ, yǎn shén hěn qí guài.
sentences.english: A woman walked out; she looked at me with a very strange expression.

sentences.chinese: 她说：“你来这里干什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ lái zhè lǐ gàn shén me?”
sentences.english: She asked, "What are you doing here?"

sentences.chinese: 我告诉她，我想找一个男人，他可能在这里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gào su tā, wǒ xiǎng zhǎo yī gè nán rén, tā kě néng zài zhè lǐ.
sentences.english: I told her I was looking for a man who might be here.

sentences.chinese: 这个女人笑了，她说：“你在开玩笑吗？这里没有人。”
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè nǚ rén xiào le, tā shuō: “Nǐ zài kāi wán xiào ma? Zhè lǐ méi yǒu rén.”
sentences.english: The woman laughed and said, "Are you joking? There is no one here."

sentences.chinese: 她看起来很高兴，但我觉得她是在撒谎。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐ lái hěn gāo xìng, dàn wǒ jué de tā shì zài sā huǎng.
sentences.english: She seemed happy, but I felt she was lying.

sentences.chinese: 我看到桌子上有一个旧盒子，我慢慢地打开它。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī gè jiù hé zi, wǒ màn màn de dǎ kāi tā.
sentences.english: I saw an old box on the table and slowly opened it.

sentences.chinese: 盒子里有一张照片，照片上是一个小女孩和她的父亲。
sentences.pinyin: Hé zi lǐ yǒu yī zhāng zhào piàn, zhào piàn shàng shì yī gè xiǎo nǚ hái hé tā de fù qīn.
sentences.english: Inside the box was a photo of a little girl and her father.

sentences.chinese: 女人突然生气了，她大声说：“快把照片给我！”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ rén tū rán shēng qì le, tā dà shēng shuō: “Kuài bǎ zhào piàn gěi wǒ!”
sentences.english: The woman suddenly became angry and shouted, "Give me the photo quickly!"

sentences.chinese: 我后退了一步，问她：“这个女孩是你的女儿吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hòu tuì le yī bù, wèn tā: “Zhè gè nǚ hái shì nǐ de nǚ ér ma?”
sentences.english: I took a step back and asked her, "Is this girl your daughter?"

sentences.chinese: 她沉默了，然后低声说：“是的，她现在不在家里。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā chén mò le, rán hòu dī shēng shuō: “Shì de, tā xiàn zài bù zài jiā lǐ.”
sentences.english: She fell silent, then whispered, "Yes, she is not at home right now."

sentences.chinese: 她说她的女儿身体不好，不能出门玩儿。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō tā de nǚ ér shēn tǐ bù hǎo, bù néng chū mén wán r.
sentences.english: She said her daughter's health was poor and she couldn't go out to play.

sentences.chinese: 我想帮忙，于是我说：“我可以帮你们。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng bāng máng, yú shì wǒ shuō: “Wǒ kě yǐ bāng nǐ men.”
sentences.english: I wanted to help, so I said, "I can help you all."

sentences.chinese: 她看着我，语气变软了，说：“谢谢你。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe wǒ, yǔ qì biàn ruǎn le, shuō: “Xiè xiè nǐ.”
sentences.english: She looked at me, her tone softening, and said, "Thank you."

sentences.chinese: 我说：“不客气。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: “Bù kè qi.”
sentences.english: I said, "You're welcome."

sentences.chinese: 她告诉我，那个男人是她的男朋友，他现在应该下班了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su wǒ, nà gè nán rén shì tā de nán péng you, tā xiàn zài yīng gāi xià bān le.
sentences.english: She told me that the man was her boyfriend and he should have finished work by now.

sentences.chinese: 他说过，等他放假的时候，会带女儿来这里打球。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō guò, děng tā fàng jià de shí hou, huì dài nǚ ér lái zhè lǐ dǎ qiú.
sentences.english: He had said that when he had a holiday, he would bring their daughter here to play ball.

sentences.chinese: 但现在，那个男人不见了，这并不好玩儿。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiàn zài, nà gè nán rén bù jiàn le, zhè bìng bù hǎo wán r.
sentences.english: But now, the man had disappeared, which was not amusing at all.

sentences.chinese: 我问她：“你今天几点起床的？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Nǐ jīn tiān jǐ diǎn qǐ chuáng de?”
sentences.english: I asked her, "What time did you get up today?"

sentences.chinese: 她说：“我很早，但我没事儿，我一直在等他。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ hěn zǎo, dàn wǒ méi shì r, wǒ yī zhí zài děng tā.”
sentences.english: She said, "Very early, but I'm free, I've been waiting for him all along."

sentences.chinese: 我想起那个红点，突然想到了一招：我可以检查诊所的后门。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐ nà gè hóng diǎn, tū rán xiǎng dào le yī zhāo: wǒ kě yǐ jiǎn chá zhěn suǒ de hòu mén.
sentences.english: I remembered the red dot and suddenly thought of a trick: I could check the back door of the clinic.

sentences.chinese: 我问她：“他吃过饭了吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Tā chī guò fàn le ma?”
sentences.english: I asked her, "Has he eaten a meal yet?"

sentences.chinese: 她摇了摇头，眼神中充满了恐惧。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yáo le tóu, yǎn shén zhōng chōng mǎn le kǒng jù.
sentences.english: She shook her head, her eyes filled with fear.

sentences.chinese: 我走向后门，发现门后面有一个黑色的影子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǒu xiàng hòu mén, fā xiàn mén hòu miàn yǒu yī gè hēi sè de yǐng zi.
sentences.english: I walked toward the back door and discovered a black shadow behind the door.

sentences.chinese: 那个黑色的影子在后边快速移动。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge hēi sè de yǐng zi zài hòu bian kuài sù yí dòng.
sentences.english: That black shadow moved quickly behind me.

sentences.chinese: 我心跳很快，慢慢走到影子的旁边。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xīn tiào hěn kuài, màn màn zǒu dào yǐng zi de páng biān.
sentences.english: My heart beat fast, and I slowly walked to the side of the shadow.

sentences.chinese: 我看到地上有一个小东西。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào dì shang yǒu yí gè xiǎo dōng xī.
sentences.english: I saw a small object on the ground.

sentences.chinese: 那是一个旧的机票，上面写着机场的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì yí gè jiù de jī piào, shàng miàn xiě zhe jī chǎng de míng zi.
sentences.english: It was an old plane ticket with the name of an airport on it.

sentences.chinese: 这个机票是去国外的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge jī piào shì qù guó wài de.
sentences.english: This ticket was for going abroad.

sentences.chinese: 我一边看机票，一边思考这个秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yì biān kàn jī piào, yì biān sī kǎo zhè ge mì mì.
sentences.english: I looked at the ticket while thinking about this secret.

sentences.chinese: 现在是下午，阳光照在窗户上边。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài shì xià wǔ, yáng guāng zhào zài chuāng hu shàng bian.
sentences.english: It is now afternoon, and the sunlight is shining above the window.

sentences.chinese: 我想起中午的时候，我在东边看到过那个男人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐ zhōng wǔ de shí hou, wǒ zài dōng bian kàn guò nà ge nán rén.
sentences.english: I remembered that at noon, I had seen that man on the east side.

sentences.chinese: 他在北边走，然后向南边走。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài běi bian zǒu, rán hòu xiàng nán bian zǒu.
sentences.english: He walked north, and then walked south.

sentences.chinese: 他在这个地方做什么？
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài zhè ge dì fāng zuò shén me?
sentences.english: What is he doing in this place?

sentences.chinese: 我看向左边，看到一个旧桌子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn xiàng zuǒ bian, kàn dào yí gè jiù zhuō zi.
sentences.english: I looked to the left and saw an old table.

sentences.chinese: 我看向右边，看到一个旧椅子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn xiàng yòu bian, kàn dào yí gè jiù yǐ zi.
sentences.english: I looked to the right and saw an old chair.

sentences.chinese: 在桌子和椅子的中间，有一个小盒子。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhuō zi hé yǐ zi de zhōng jiān, yǒu yí gè xiǎo hé zi.
sentences.english: In the middle of the table and the chair, there was a small box.

sentences.chinese: 我伸手去拿，但右边突然出现了一只手。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shēn shǒu qù ná, dàn yòu bian tū rán chū xiàn le yì zhī shǒu.
sentences.english: I reached out to take it, but a hand suddenly appeared on the right side.

sentences.chinese: 那只手把我推向了前边。
sentences.pinyin: Nà zhī shǒu bǎ wǒ tuī xiàng le qián bian.
sentences.english: That hand pushed me forward.

sentences.chinese: 我跌在地上，看向前边。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ diē zài dì shang, kàn xiàng qián bian.
sentences.english: I fell on the ground and looked ahead.

sentences.chinese: 那个影子现在站在我的外边。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge yǐng zi xiàn zài zhàn zài wǒ de wài bian.
sentences.english: The shadow was now standing outside of me.

sentences.chinese: 他低声说：“你不能在这里。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dī shēng shuō: “Nǐ bù néng zài zhè lǐ.”
sentences.english: He whispered, "You cannot be here."

sentences.chinese: 我想问他关于机票的事情，但他很快走了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng wèn tā guān yú jī piào de shì qíng, dàn tā hěn kuài zǒu le.
sentences.english: I wanted to ask him about the ticket, but he left quickly.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“再见。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zài jiàn.”
sentences.english: He said, "Goodbye."

sentences.chinese: 他走到了外边，消失在阴影里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu dào le wài bian, xiāo shī zài yīn yǐng lǐ.
sentences.english: He walked outside and disappeared into the shadows.

sentences.chinese: 我看向下边，发现盒子在我的脚下。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn xiàng xià bian, fā xiàn hé zi zài wǒ de jiǎo xià.
sentences.english: I looked below and found the box beneath my feet.

sentences.chinese: 我打开盒子，发现里面有一张地图。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dǎ kāi hé zi, fā xiàn lǐ miàn yǒu yì zhāng dì tú.
sentences.english: I opened the box and found a map inside.

sentences.chinese: 地图上标明了这里的东边和西边。
sentences.pinyin: Dì tú shàng biāo míng le zhè lǐ de dōng bian hé xī bian.
sentences.english: The map marked the east and west sides of this place.

sentences.chinese: 我意识到，晚上这里会发生很重要的事情。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yì shí dào, wǎn shang zhè lǐ huì fā shēng hěn zhòng yào de shì qíng.
sentences.english: I realized that something very important would happen here tonight.

sentences.chinese: 如果现在太晚，我就不能找到他了。
sentences.pinyin: Rú guǒ xiàn zài tài wǎn, wǒ jiù bù néng zhǎo dào tā le.
sentences.english: If it is too late now, I will not be able to find him.

sentences.chinese: 我们必须一起找出这个秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men bì xū yì qǐ zhǎo chū zhè ge mì mì.
sentences.english: We must find this secret together.

sentences.chinese: 我看着地图，发现一个红点在西边。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe dìtú, fāxiàn yīgè hóngdiǎn zài xībiān.
sentences.english: I looked at the map and found a red dot in the west.

sentences.chinese: 这是一个很重要的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yīgè hěn zhòngyào de dìfāng.
sentences.english: This was a very important place.

sentences.chinese: 我问我的朋友：“我们现在去那边吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn wǒ de péngyǒu: “Wǒmen xiànzài qù nàbiān ma?”
sentences.english: I asked my friend, "Are we going over there now?"

sentences.chinese: 他点点头，说：“我们要快，因为白天的时间不多了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā diǎndiǎn tóu, shuō: “Wǒmen yào kuài, yīnwèi báitiān de shíjiān bù duō le.”
sentences.english: He nodded and said, "We must hurry, because there isn't much daytime left."

sentences.chinese: 我们走出旧诊所，走在马路上。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zǒuchū jiù zhěnsuǒ, zǒu zài mǎlù shàng.
sentences.english: We walked out of the old clinic and onto the street.

sentences.chinese: 在路口，我看到一个男生在看我。
sentences.pinyin: Zài lùkǒu, wǒ kàndào yīgè nánshēng zài kàn wǒ.
sentences.english: At the intersection, I saw a boy looking at me.

sentences.chinese: 他看起来像个小朋友，但他的眼神很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐlái xiàng gè xiǎopéngyǒu, dàn tā de yǎnshén hěn qíguài.
sentences.english: He looked like a child, but his gaze was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 他手里拿着一张车票，那是去西边的票。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shǒulǐ názhe yī zhāng chēpiào, nà shì qù xī biān de piào.
sentences.english: In his hand, he held a ticket; it was a ticket to the west.

sentences.chinese: 我走过去，发现他身上有一张小纸条。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǒu guòqù, fāxiàn tā shēnshang yǒu yī zhāng xiǎo zhǐtiáo.
sentences.english: I walked over and discovered he had a small note on his person.

sentences.chinese: 纸条上写着一个饭店的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐtiáo shàng xiězhe yīgè fàndiàn de míngzi.
sentences.english: The note had the name of a restaurant on it.

sentences.chinese: 我们走进那个饭店，发现里边没有人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zǒujìn nàgè fàndiàn, fāxiàn lǐbiān méiyǒu rén.
sentences.english: We entered that restaurant and found no one inside.

sentences.chinese: 我看到桌子上有一行字。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàndào zhuōzi shàng yǒu yī háng zì.
sentences.english: I saw a line of words on the table.

sentences.chinese: 那行字说：“秘密在楼上。”
sentences.pinyin: Nà háng zì shuō: “Mìmì zài lóushàng.”
sentences.english: The line said: "The secret is upstairs."

sentences.chinese: 我们快步走到楼上，进入一个房间。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen kuàibù zǒu dào lóushàng, jìnrù yīgè fángjiān.
sentences.english: We walked quickly upstairs and entered a room.

sentences.chinese: 在房间中间，有一个旧盒子。
sentences.pinyin: Zài fángjiān zhōngjiān, yǒu yīgè jiù hézi.
sentences.english: In the middle of the room, there was an old box.

sentences.chinese: 我打开盒子，发现里面有一个半年的日历。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dǎkāi hézi, fāxiàn lǐmiàn yǒu yīgè bànnián de rìlì.
sentences.english: I opened the box and found a calendar for half a year inside.

sentences.chinese: 日历上标明了很多次秘密会面的时间。
sentences.pinyin: Rìlì shàng biāomíng le hěnduō cì mìmì huìmiàn de shíjiān.
sentences.english: The calendar marked the times of many secret meetings.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，电突然灭了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, diàn tūrán miè le.
sentences.english: Just then, the electricity suddenly went out.

sentences.chinese: 房间里变得很黑，我听到有人在我的身边走动。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ biàn de hěn hēi, wǒ tīngdào yǒurén zài wǒ de shēnbiān zǒudòng.
sentences.english: The room became very dark, and I heard someone moving beside me.

sentences.chinese: 我意识到，有人正在看着我们。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yìshí dào, yǒurén zhèngzài kànzhe wǒmen.
sentences.english: I realized that someone was currently watching us.

sentences.chinese: 我看向窗外，看到路上有很多黑色的影子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn xiàng chuāngwài, kàndào lùshàng yǒu hěnduō hēisè de yǐngzi.
sentences.english: I looked out the window and saw many black shadows on the road.

sentences.chinese: 这个孩子是谁的儿子？
sentences.pinyin: Zhège háizi shì shuí de érzi?
sentences.english: Whose son is this child?

sentences.chinese: 他为什么在这里？
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèishéme zài zhèlǐ?
sentences.english: Why is he here?

sentences.chinese: 突然，门被用力关上了。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, mén bèi yònglì guān shàng le.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the door was slammed shut.

sentences.chinese: 门关上了，房间里很安静。
sentences.pinyin: Mén guān shàng le, fáng jiān lǐ hěn ānjìng.
sentences.english: The door closed, and the room became very quiet.

sentences.chinese: 我看着那个孩子，他看起来像个小学生。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe nà gè hái zi, tā kàn qǐ lái xiàng gè xiǎo xué shēng.
sentences.english: I looked at the child; he looked like a primary school student.

sentences.chinese: 他背着一个蓝色的书包。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bēi zhe yī gè lán sè de shū bāo.
sentences.english: He was carrying a blue schoolbag.

sentences.chinese: 我问他：“你是谁？你为什么在这个房子里？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Nǐ shì shuí? Nǐ wèi shén me zài zhè gè fáng zi lǐ?”
sentences.english: I asked him, "Who are you? Why are you in this house?"

sentences.chinese: 孩子没有说话，他看着我，眼神很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Hái zi méi yǒu shuō huà, tā kàn zhe wǒ, yǎn shén hěn qí guài.
sentences.english: The child didn't speak; he looked at me with a strange expression in his eyes.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，他是一个中学生，但他在学习一些秘密的东西。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ, tā shì yī gè zhōng xué shēng, dàn tā zài xué xí yī xiē mì mì de dōng xī.
sentences.english: He told me that he is a middle-school student, but he is studying some secret things.

sentences.chinese: 他说他不去小学，也不去普通的学院。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō tā bù qù xiǎo xué, yě bù qù pǔ tōng de xué yuàn.
sentences.english: He said he doesn't go to primary school, nor does he go to a normal college.

sentences.chinese: 他每天在一家大学读书，但那不是正常的大学。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zài yī jiā dà xué dú shū, dàn nà bù shì zhèng cháng de dà xué.
sentences.english: He studies at a university every day, but it is not a normal university.

sentences.chinese: 那个孩子说，他在那里学很多奇怪的课。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè hái zi shuō, tā zài nà lǐ xué hěn duō qí guài de kè.
sentences.english: The child said he learns many strange subjects there.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，他每天早上很早去上学。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ, tā měi tiān zǎo shang hěn zǎo qù shàng xué.
sentences.english: He told me that he goes to school very early every morning.

sentences.chinese: 他在教学楼的地下室上课。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài jiào xué lóu de dì xià shì shàng kè.
sentences.english: He attends class in the basement of the teaching block.

sentences.chinese: 他说，他的同学都不是普通的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, tā de tóng xué dōu bù shì pǔ tōng de rén.
sentences.english: He said his classmates are not ordinary people.

sentences.chinese: 其中有一个女生，她能听到墙壁后面的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Qí zhōng yǒu yī gè nǚ shēng, tā néng tīng dào qiáng bì hòu miàn de shēng yīn.
sentences.english: Among them is a girl who can hear sounds behind the walls.

sentences.chinese: 有一天，他在上课的时候，听到一个先生在说话。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu yī tiān, tā zài shàng kè de shí hou, tīng dào yī gè xiān sheng zài shuō huà.
sentences.english: One day, while in class, he heard a gentleman speaking.

sentences.chinese: 那个先生告诉他，这里的秘密在床下面。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè xiān sheng gào sù tā, zhè lǐ de mì mì zài chuáng xià miàn.
sentences.english: That gentleman told him that the secret here is under the bed.

sentences.chinese: 孩子说：“下课以后，我偷偷看了看。”
sentences.pinyin: Hái zi shuō: “Xià kè yǐ hòu, wǒ tōu tōu kàn le kàn.”
sentences.english: The child said, "After class, I took a secret look."

sentences.chinese: 他在床下面发现了一张听写纸。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài chuáng xià miàn fā xiàn le yī zhāng tīng xiě zhǐ.
sentences.english: He found a dictation paper under the bed.

sentences.chinese: 纸上写着很多奇怪的名字和地址。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐ shàng xiě zhe hěn duō qí guài de míng zi hé dì zhǐ.
sentences.english: The paper had many strange names and addresses written on it.

sentences.chinese: 孩子说，他现在很饿，想吃东西。
sentences.pinyin: Hái zi shuō, tā xiàn zài hěn è, xiǎng chī dōng xī.
sentences.english: The child said he is very hungry now and wants to eat something.

sentences.chinese: 我意识到，这个孩子可能是一个大学生在伪装。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yì shí dào, zhè gè hái zi kě néng shì yī gè dà xué shēng zài wěi zhuāng.
sentences.english: I realized that this child might be a university student in disguise.

sentences.chinese: 他不是真的小学生，而是一个聪明的大学生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù shì zhēn de xiǎo xué shēng, ér shì yī gè cōng míng de dà xué shēng.
sentences.english: He is not really a primary school student, but a clever university student.

sentences.chinese: 他等放学的时间，为了在这个城市寻找线索。
sentences.pinyin: Tā děng fàng xué de shí jiān, wèi le zài zhè gè chéng shì xún zhǎo xiàn suǒ.
sentences.english: He waits for the time students are dismissed from school to search for clues in this city.

sentences.chinese: 我看着他，突然发现他的书包里有一把钥匙。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe tā, tū rán fā xiàn tā de shū bāo lǐ yǒu yī bǎ yào shi.
sentences.english: I looked at him and suddenly discovered there was a key in his schoolbag.

sentences.chinese: 这把钥匙能打开那个黑色的盒子吗？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǎ yào shi néng dǎ kāi nà gè hēi sè de hé zi ma?
sentences.english: Can this key open that black box?

chapters.title_chinese: 第十六章：伪装者的秘密

sentences.chinese: 我看着那个孩子，他现在不想说话。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe nàge háizi, tā xiànzài bù xiǎng shuōhuà.
sentences.english: I looked at the child; he didn't want to speak right now.

sentences.chinese: 他拿出一个手机，很快地记了一些东西。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū yīgè shǒujī, hěn kuài de jìle yīxiē dōngxi.
sentences.english: He took out a cell phone and quickly noted some things down.

sentences.chinese: 我问他：“你是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Nǐ shì shéi?”
sentences.english: I asked him, "Who are you?"

sentences.chinese: 他没有回答我。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu huídá wǒ.
sentences.english: He did not answer me.

sentences.chinese: 他叫我跟着他，走回那个旧房子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiào wǒ gēnzhe tā, zǒu huí nàge jiù fángzi.
sentences.english: He called me to follow him and walk back to that old house.

sentences.chinese: 我们回去的时候，天气很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen huíqù de shíhou, tiānqì hěn lěng.
sentences.english: When we went back, the weather was very cold.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，他必须早一点找到那个黑盒子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, tā bìxū zǎo yīdiǎn zhǎodào nàge hēi hézi.
sentences.english: He told me that he must find that black box a bit earlier.

sentences.chinese: 他突然停下来，说他需要休息。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán tíng xiàlái, shuō tā xūyào xiūxi.
sentences.english: He suddenly stopped and said he needed to rest.

sentences.chinese: 他坐在椅子上，像是在睡觉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuò zài yǐzi shàng, xiàng shì zài shuìjiào.
sentences.english: He sat on the chair, appearing to be sleeping.

sentences.chinese: 但我知道，他没有在睡。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ zhīdào, tā méiyǒu zài shuì.
sentences.english: But I knew he was not asleep.

sentences.chinese: 他在听门外的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài tīng mén wài de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: He was listening to the sounds outside the door.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个女人在外面大声地号。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yīgè nǚrén zài wàimiàn dàshēng de háo.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a woman outside wailed loudly.

sentences.chinese: 那个声音很像在唱一首悲伤的歌。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge shēngyīn hěn xiàng zài chàng yī shǒu bēishāng de gē.
sentences.english: That sound was very much like singing a sad song.

sentences.chinese: 我想，那是谁在唱？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng, nà shì shéi zài chàng?
sentences.english: I wondered, who was singing?

sentences.chinese: 那个女人在叫：“我的孩子在哪里？”
sentences.pinyin: Nàge nǚrén zài jiào: “Wǒ de háizi zài nǎlǐ?”
sentences.english: The woman was shouting, "Where is my child?"

sentences.chinese: 她大声地说话，声音在走廊里回荡。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàshēng de shuōhuà, shēngyīn zài zǒuláng lǐ huídàng.
sentences.english: She spoke loudly, her voice echoing in the hallway.

sentences.chinese: 这个孩子突然站起来，看着手机。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège háizi tūrán zhàn qǐlái, kànzhe shǒujī.
sentences.english: The child suddenly stood up and looked at the phone.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“这是我的妈妈，不，是我的奶妈。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zhè shì wǒ de māma, bù, shì wǒ de nǎimā.”
sentences.english: He said, "This is my mother—no, my wet nurse."

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，这个女人的电话号码很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, zhège nǚrén de diànhuà hàomǎ hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.english: He told me that this woman's phone number was very important.

sentences.chinese: 他拿出一杯水，喝了一口，然后看着我。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū yī bēi shuǐ, hēle yī kǒu, ránhòu kànzhe wǒ.
sentences.english: He took out a glass of water, drank a sip, and then looked at me.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“谢谢你帮我，但现在你必须离开。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Xièxie nǐ bāng wǒ, dàn xiànzài nǐ bìxū líkāi.”
sentences.english: He said, "Thank you for helping me, but now you must leave."

sentences.chinese: 我想重复一次我的问题，但他说：“请重读这个地址。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chóngfù yīcì wǒ de wèntí, dàn tā shuō: “Qǐng chóng dú zhège dìzhǐ.”
sentences.english: I wanted to repeat my question once more, but he said, "Please read this address again."

sentences.chinese: 他指了指纸上的字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐle zhǐ zhǐ shàng de zì.
sentences.english: He pointed to the words on the paper.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，那个女人走回来了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, nàge nǚrén zǒu huíláile.
sentences.english: Just then, the woman came back.

sentences.chinese: 她看着我们，眼神里没有爱，只有秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe wǒmen, yǎnshén lǐ méiyǒu ài, zhǐyǒu mìmì.
sentences.english: She looked at us, and in her eyes there was no love, only secrets.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十七章：旧照片的秘密
chapters.title_english: Chapter 17: The Secret of the Old Photo

sentences.chinese: 那个女人看着我，她没有笑。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge nǚ rén kàn zhe wǒ, tā méi yǒu xiào.
sentences.english: That woman looked at me; she did not smile.

sentences.chinese: 她是一个很老的人，看起来像是一个老人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì yí gè hěn lǎo de rén, kàn qǐ lái xiàng shì yí gè lǎo rén.
sentences.english: She was a very old person, looking like an elderly woman.

sentences.chinese: 她拿出一张旧照片，放在桌子上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū yì zhāng jiù zhào piàn, fàng zài zhuō zi shàng.
sentences.english: She took out an old photo and placed it on the table.

sentences.chinese: 照片里有一个大房子，和一些奇怪的人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhào piàn lǐ yǒu yí gè dà fáng zi, hé yì xiē qí guài de rén.
sentences.english: In the photo, there was a big house and some strange people.

sentences.chinese: 她说：“这是我的家人。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zhè shì wǒ de jiā rén.”
sentences.english: She said, "These are my family members."

sentences.chinese: 照片里有一个爷爷和一个奶奶。
sentences.pinyin: Zhào piàn lǐ yǒu yí gè yé ye hé yí gè nǎi nai.
sentences.english: In the photo, there was a grandfather and a grandmother.

sentences.chinese: 还有一个男人，那是她的爸爸。
sentences.pinyin: Hái yǒu yí gè nán rén, nà shì tā de bà ba.
sentences.english: There was also a man; that was her father.

sentences.chinese: 她说，这个男人去年不见了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, zhè ge nán rén qù nián bù jiàn le.
sentences.english: She said this man disappeared last year.

sentences.chinese: 那个男人在去年新年的时候离开的。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge nán rén zài qù nián xīn nián de shí hou lí kāi de.
sentences.english: That man left during the New Year of last year.

sentences.chinese: 我想起上次在这里看到的东西。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐ shàng cì zài zhè lǐ kàn dào de dōng xi.
sentences.english: I remembered the things I saw here last time.

sentences.chinese: 那个女人说：“这个小姐也是我的家人。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zhè ge xiǎo jie yě shì wǒ de jiā rén.”
sentences.english: The woman said, "This young lady is also my family member."

sentences.chinese: 她指着照片里的一个年轻女孩。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐ zhe zhào piàn lǐ de yí gè nián qīng nǚ hái.
sentences.english: She pointed to a young girl in the photo.

sentences.chinese: 那个女孩看起来只有十八岁。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge nǚ hái kàn qǐ lái zhǐ yǒu shí bā suì.
sentences.english: That girl looked only eighteen years old.

sentences.chinese: 她说，那个女孩曾经是一个学生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, nà ge nǚ hái céng jīng shì yí gè xué sheng.
sentences.english: She said that girl used to be a student.

sentences.chinese: 她属于学生中的最高等。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shǔ yú xué sheng zhōng de zuì gāo děng.
sentences.english: She belonged to the highest rank of students.

sentences.chinese: 女人低声说：“她帮我干了很多工作。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ rén dī shēng shuō: “Tā bāng wǒ gàn le hěn duō gōng zuò.”
sentences.english: The woman whispered, "She helped me do a lot of work."

sentences.chinese: 我看着照片，突然发现一个细节。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe zhào piàn, tū rán fā xiàn yí gè xì jié.
sentences.english: I looked at the photo and suddenly noticed a detail.

sentences.chinese: 照片的角落里有一个钱包。
sentences.pinyin: Zhào piàn de jiǎo luò lǐ yǒu yí gè qián bāo.
sentences.english: In the corner of the photo, there was a wallet.

sentences.chinese: 那个钱包在车站的椅子上。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge qián bāo zài chē zhàn de yǐ zi shàng.
sentences.english: That wallet was on a chair at the station.

sentences.chinese: 我想起那个黑色的盒子，它可能在这个车站。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐ nà ge hēi sè de hé zi, tā kě néng zài zhè ge chē zhàn.
sentences.english: I thought of that black box; it might be at this station.

sentences.chinese: 我自个儿在心里想，这太奇怪了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zì gě r zài xīn lǐ xiǎng, zhè tài qí guài le.
sentences.english: I thought to myself, this is too strange.

sentences.chinese: 我想马上离开这里，去找那个车站。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎ shàng lí kāi zhè lǐ, qù zhǎo nà ge chē zhàn.
sentences.english: I wanted to leave here immediately and find that station.

sentences.chinese: 但那个女人突然抓住了我的手。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn nà ge nǚ rén tū rán zhuā zhù le wǒ de shǒu.
sentences.english: But that woman suddenly grabbed my hand.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 18: The Secret of the Station

sentences.chinese: 那个女人用力地抓住了我的手。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge nǚrén yònglì de zhuā zhù le wǒ de shǒu.
sentences.english: That woman gripped my hand tightly.

sentences.chinese: 她看着我，低声说：“我想给你介绍一个人。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe wǒ, dī shēng shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng gěi nǐ jièshào yī gè rén.”
sentences.english: She looked at me and whispered, "I want to introduce someone to you."

sentences.chinese: 我没有动，因为我还在想那个黑色的盒子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu dòng, yīnwèi wǒ hái zài xiǎng nàge hēisè de hézi.
sentences.english: I didn't move, because I was still thinking about that black box.

sentences.chinese: 她带我来到车站旁边的一个小吧。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dài wǒ lái dào chēzhàn pángbiān de yī gè xiǎo bā.
sentences.english: She took me to a small bar next to the station.

sentences.chinese: 这里很安静，只有几口大桌子。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ hěn ānjìng, zhǐyǒu jǐ kǒu dà zhuōzi.
sentences.english: It was very quiet here, with only a few large tables.

sentences.chinese: 她给我了一杯热茶，让我慢慢吃一块小蛋糕。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gěi wǒ le yī bēi rè chá, ràng wǒ mànman chī yī kuài xiǎo dàngāo.
sentences.english: She gave me a cup of hot tea and let me eat a piece of small cake.

sentences.chinese: 她说：“你爱找秘密，这是你的爱好吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ ài zhǎo mìmì, zhè shì nǐ de àihào ma?”
sentences.english: She said, "You love finding secrets, is this your hobby?"

sentences.chinese: 我看着她，想知道她为什么在这里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe tā, xiǎng zhīdào tā wèishéme zài zhèlǐ.
sentences.english: I looked at her, wanting to know why she was here.

sentences.chinese: 她拿出一个本子，那是之前消失的那个笔记本。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū yī gè běnzi, nà shì zhīqián xiāoshī de nàge bǐjìběn.
sentences.english: She took out a notebook; it was the notebook that had disappeared before.

sentences.chinese: 她告诉我，后天他们会在这里见面。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, hòutiān tāmen huì zài zhèlǐ jiànmiàn.
sentences.english: She told me that they would meet here the day after tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 她说：“我们要准备做一件很重要的事情。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒmen yào zhǔnbèi zuò yī jiàn hěn zhòngyào de shìqíng.”
sentences.english: She said, "We need to prepare to do something very important."

sentences.chinese: 我问她：“谁会来这里？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Shéi huì lái zhèlǐ?”
sentences.english: I asked her, "Who will come here?"

sentences.chinese: 她没有说话，只是地地道道地指了指窗外。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu shuōhuà, zhǐshì dì dì dào dào de zhǐ le zhǐ chuāng wài.
sentences.english: She didn't speak, she just pointed pointedly out the window.

sentences.chinese: 窗外有一个男人在洗手，他的样子并不好看。
sentences.pinyin: Chuāng wài yǒu yī gè nánrén zài xǐ shǒu, tā de yàngzi bìng bù hǎokàn.
sentences.english: Outside the window, a man was washing his hands; he didn't look good.

sentences.chinese: 他看起来很差，眼神里没有爱。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐlái hěn chà, yǎnshén lǐ méiyǒu ài.
sentences.english: He looked quite poor/shabby, and there was no love in his eyes.

sentences.chinese: 那个女人说：“他会分给你一些线索。”
sentences.pinyin: Nàge nǚrén shuō: “Tā huì fēn gěi nǐ yīxiē xiànsuǒ.”
sentences.english: The woman said, "He will divide some clues for you."

sentences.chinese: 我突然想上网查一下这个男人的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tūrán xiǎng shàngwǎng chá yīxià zhège nánrén de míngzì.
sentences.english: I suddenly wanted to go online to check this man's name.

sentences.chinese: 但我发现我的手机在那个钱包里。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ fāxiàn wǒ de shǒujī zài nàge qiánbāo lǐ.
sentences.english: But I discovered my phone was in that wallet.

sentences.chinese: 钱包现在在车站的椅子上呢。
sentences.pinyin: Qiánbāo xiànzài zài chēzhàn de yǐzi shàng ne.
sentences.english: The wallet is at the station on the chair, you know.

sentences.chinese: 我看着那个男人，想知道他是不是在等我。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe nàge nánrén, xiǎng zhīdào tā shì bù shì zài děng wǒ.
sentences.english: I looked at the man, wondering if he was waiting for me.

sentences.chinese: 他慢慢地走过来，打开了门。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mànman de zǒu guòlái, kāi dǎ le mén.
sentences.english: He slowly walked over and opened the door.

sentences.chinese: 他看着我，轻声说：“我来送你离开这里。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe wǒ, qīng shēng shuō: “Wǒ lái sòng nǐ líkāi zhèlǐ.”

books.description_chinese: 李明是一个热爱科学的学生。在未来的星际学院里，他遇到了一个奇怪的机器人和变色的天空。他要去哪里？
books.description_english: Li Ming is a student who loves science. At a futuristic Interstellar Academy, he encounters a mysterious robot and a shifting sky. Where is he being taken?

chapters.title_english: Chapter 1: The Secret of the Interstellar Academy

sentences.chinese: 在未来的星际学院，一个学生叫李明。
sentences.pinyin: Zài wèilái de xīngjì xuéyuàn, yīgè xuéshēng jiào Lǐ Míng.
sentences.english: In the future Interstellar Academy, there is a student called Li Ming.

sentences.chinese: 他非常喜欢学习科学。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fēicháng xǐhuan xuéxí kēxué.
sentences.english: He likes studying science very much.

sentences.chinese: 李明在学习的时候，喜欢喝一种蓝色的水。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zài xuéxí de shíhou, xǐhuan hē yīzhǒng lánsè de shuǐ.
sentences.english: While studying, Li Ming likes to drink a kind of blue water.

sentences.chinese: 他用这个水来帮助他记笔记。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng zhège shuǐ lái bāngzhù tā jì bǐjì.
sentences.english: He uses this water to help him take notes.

sentences.chinese: 今天是一个很重要的日子，因为他有一个很难的考试。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān shì yīgè hěn zhòngyào de rìzi, yīnwèi tā yǒu yīgè hěn nán de kǎoshì.
sentences.english: Today is a very important day because he has a very difficult exam.

sentences.chinese: 他必须记住所有的星图。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū jìzhù suǒyǒu de xīngtú.
sentences.english: He must remember all the star maps.

sentences.chinese: 他问老师：“请告诉我，这个考试难吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn lǎoshī: “Qǐng gàosù wǒ, zhège kǎoshì nán ma?”
sentences.english: He asked the teacher: "Please tell me, is this exam difficult?"

sentences.chinese: 老师回答说：“如果你学习认真，就不难。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī huídá shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ xuéxí rènzhēn, jiù bù nán.”
sentences.english: The teacher replied: "If you study seriously, it is not difficult."

sentences.chinese: 李明想试一试，所以他努力学习。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xiǎng shì yī shì, suǒyǐ tā nǔlì xuéxí.
sentences.english: Li Ming wanted to give it a try, so he studied hard.

sentences.chinese: 他学习的比其他学生都要快。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xuéxí de bǐ qítā xuéshēng dōu yào kuài.
sentences.english: He studied faster than the other students.

sentences.chinese: 他找了一个安静的地方，开始学习。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǎo le yīgè ānjìng de dìfang, kāishǐ xuéxí.
sentences.english: He looked for a quiet place and began to study.

sentences.chinese: 他在笔记本上记了很多东西。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài bǐjìběn shàng jì le hěnduō dōngxi.
sentences.english: He recorded many things in his notebook.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他听到一个奇怪的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, tā tīngdào yīgè qíguài de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: Suddenly, he heard a strange sound.

sentences.chinese: 那个声音在唱一首歌。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge shēngyīn zài chàng yī shǒu gē.
