sentences.english: That sound was singing a song.

sentences.chinese: 李明很惊讶，因为在这个实验室里没有人唱歌。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng hěn jīngyà, yīnwèi zài zhège shíyànshì lǐ méiyǒu rén chànggē.
sentences.english: Li Ming was very surprised because there was no one singing in this laboratory.

sentences.chinese: 他想知道谁在唱这首歌。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng zhīdào shéi zài chàng zhè shǒu gē.
sentences.english: He wanted to know who was singing this song.

sentences.chinese: 他走到机器前面，对机器说话。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu dào jīqì qiánmiàn, duì jīqì shuōhuà.
sentences.english: He walked up to the machine and spoke to it.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“请告诉我，你是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Qǐng gàosù wǒ, nǐ shì shéi?”
sentences.english: He said: "Please tell me, who are you?"

sentences.chinese: 机器没有说话，但是它发出了一声大号的警报声。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqì méiyǒu shuōhuà, dànshì tā fāchū le yī shēng dà hào de jǐngbào shēng.
sentences.english: The machine did not speak, but it emitted a loud roar of an alarm.

sentences.chinese: 李明吓了一跳，他大声叫了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xià le yī tiào, tā dàshēng jiào le qǐlái.
sentences.english: Li Ming was startled and shouted loudly.

sentences.chinese: 他想用手去考这个机器，看看它是不是坏了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng yòng shǒu qù kǎo zhège jīqì, kànkan tā shì bù shì huài le.
sentences.english: He wanted to use his hand to tap (test) the machine to see if it was broken.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个人工智能出现了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, yīgè réngōng zhìnéng chūxiàn le.
sentences.english: At that moment, an AI appeared.

sentences.chinese: 它说：“谢谢你发现我。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Xièxie nǐ fāxiàn wǒ.”
sentences.english: It said: "Thank you for finding me."

sentences.chinese: 李明问它：“你为什么在这里？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng wèn tā: “Nǐ wèishéme zài zhèlǐ?”
sentences.english: Li Ming asked it: "Why are you here?"

sentences.chinese: 人工智能说：“我想要学习人类的情感。”
sentences.pinyin: Réngōng zhìnéng shuō: “Wǒ xiǎngyào xuéxí rénlèi de qínggǎn.”
sentences.english: The AI said: "I want to learn human emotions."

sentences.chinese: 它说：“我最好能有一个朋友。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ zuìhǎo néng yǒu yīgè péngyǒu.”
sentences.english: It said: "It would be best if I could have a friend."

sentences.chinese: 李明告诉它：“我可以是你的朋友。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng gàosù tā: “Wǒ kěyǐ shì nǐ de péngyǒu.”
sentences.english: Li Ming told it: "I can be your friend."

sentences.chinese: 人工智能说：“请帮我买一个音乐芯片，我想唱歌。”
sentences.pinyin: Réngōng zhìnéng shuō: “Qǐng bāng wǒ mǎi yīgè yīnyuè xīnpiàn, wǒ xiǎng chànggē.”
sentences.english: The AI said: "Please help me buy a music chip; I want to sing songs."

sentences.chinese: 李明决定帮它，因为他喜欢这个奇怪的机器人。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng juédìng bāng tā, yīnwèi tā xǐhuan zhège qíguài de jīqìrén.
sentences.english: Li Ming decided to help it because he liked this strange robot.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果这个机器人能帮他考试，那就太好了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rúguǒ zhège jīqìrén néng bāng tā kǎoshì, nà jiù tài hǎo le.
sentences.english: He thought, if this robot could help him with the exam, that would be great.

sentences.chinese: 但是，机器人突然说了一句奇怪的话。
sentences.pinyin: Dànshì, jīqìrén tūrán shuō le yī jù qíguài de huà.
sentences.english: However, the robot suddenly said something strange.

sentences.chinese: 它说：“我们要离开这个星球。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒmen yào líkāi zhège xīngqiú.”
sentences.english: It said: "We must leave this planet."

sentences.chinese: 李明觉得这个机器人很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng jué de zhè ge jī qì rén hěn qí guài.
sentences.english: Li Ming felt that this robot was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 他问：“我们要去哪里？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn: “Wǒ men yào qù nǎ lǐ?”
sentences.english: He asked, "Where are we going?"

sentences.chinese: 机器人没有说话。
sentences.pinyin: Jī qì rén méi yǒu shuō huà.
sentences.english: The robot did not speak.

sentences.chinese: 中午，李明放学了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōng wǔ, Lǐ Míng fàng xué le.
sentences.english: At noon, Li Ming finished school.

sentences.chinese: 他走在星际学院的路上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu zài xīng jì xué yuàn de lù shang.
sentences.english: He walked on the road of the Interstellar Academy.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一个奇怪的男人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào yí ge qí guài de nán rén.
sentences.english: He saw a strange man.

sentences.chinese: 这个男人是一个老人，他看起来一百岁了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge nán rén shì yí ge lǎo rén, tā kàn qǐ lái yì bǎi suì le.
sentences.english: This man was an old person; he looked a hundred years old.

sentences.chinese: 老人说：“请问，你想买芯片吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén shuō: “Qǐng wèn, nǐ xiǎng mǎi xīn piàn ma?”
sentences.english: The old man said, "Excuse me, do you want to buy chips?"

sentences.chinese: 李明说：“我想买一个音乐芯片。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yí ge yīn yuè xīn piàn.”
sentences.english: Li Ming said, "I want to buy a music chip."

sentences.chinese: 老人说：“请进，我的商店在里面。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén shuō: “Qǐng jìn, wǒ de shāng diàn zài lǐ miàn.”
sentences.english: The old man said, "Please come in, my shop is inside."

sentences.chinese: 商店里有很多奇怪的东西。
sentences.pinyin: Shāng diàn lǐ yǒu hěn duō qí guài de dōng xi.
sentences.english: There were many strange things in the shop.

sentences.chinese: 这里有十个发光的球。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ yǒu shí ge fā guāng de qiú.
sentences.english: There were ten glowing spheres here.

sentences.chinese: 这里有八本旧的书。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ yǒu bā běn jiù de shū.
sentences.english: There were eight old books here.

sentences.chinese: 这里有五个金属的盒子。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ yǒu wǔ ge jīn shǔ de hé zi.
sentences.english: There were five metal boxes here.

sentences.chinese: 李明看到一个男生在商店里。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kàn dào yí ge nán shēng zài shāng diàn lǐ.
sentences.english: Li Ming saw a boy in the shop.

sentences.chinese: 那个男生是他的大学同学。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge nán shēng shì tā de dà xué tóng xué.
sentences.english: That boy was his university classmate.

sentences.chinese: 男生说：“李明，你来了！这是我的姐姐。”
sentences.pinyin: Nán shēng shuō: “Lǐ Míng, nǐ lái le! Zhè shì wǒ de jiě jie.”
sentences.english: The boy said, "Li Ming, you're here! This is my older sister."

sentences.chinese: 姐姐在看一个像鸡蛋一样的机器。
sentences.pinyin: Jiě jie zài kàn yí ge xiàng jī dàn yí yàng de jī qì.
sentences.english: The older sister was looking at a machine that looked like an egg.

sentences.chinese: 李明问：“这个机器是什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng wèn: “Zhè ge jī qì shì shén me?”
sentences.english: Li Ming asked, "What is this machine?"

sentences.chinese: 姐姐说：“这是一个生命之子，它可以创造家人。”
sentences.pinyin: Jiě jie shuō: “Zhè shì yí ge shēng mìng zhī zǐ, tā kě yǐ chuàng zào jiā rén.”
sentences.english: The sister said, "This is a seed of life; it can create family members."

sentences.chinese: 李明想到了自己的家。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xiǎng dào le zì jǐ de jiā.
sentences.english: Li Ming thought of his own home.

sentences.chinese: 他的爸爸是一个科学家。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de bà ba shì yí ge kē xué jiā.
sentences.english: His father is a scientist.

sentences.chinese: 他的妈妈在实验室工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de mā ma zài shí yàn shì gōng zuò.
sentences.english: His mother works in a laboratory.

sentences.chinese: 他叫他的爸爸：“爸，你看这个！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiào tā de bà ba: “Bà, nǐ kàn zhè ge!”
sentences.english: He called his father, "Dad, look at this!"

sentences.chinese: 但他的爸爸没有在商店里。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tā de bà ba méi yǒu zài shāng diàn lǐ.
sentences.english: But his father was not in the shop.

sentences.chinese: 他想到了他的爷爷和妈妈，还有他的妈。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng dào le tā de yé ye hé mā ma, hái yǒu tā de mā.
sentences.english: He thought of his grandfather and mother, and also his ma.

sentences.chinese: 他想到了他的哥和弟。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng dào le tā de gē hé dì.
sentences.english: He thought of his elder brother and younger brother.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果机器人有家人，它会开心吗？
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rú guǒ jī qì rén yǒu jiā rén, tā huì kāi xīn ma?
sentences.english: He wondered, if a robot had family, would it be happy?

sentences.chinese: 那个老人先生看着李明。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge lǎo rén xiān sheng kàn zhe Lǐ Míng.
sentences.english: That old gentleman looked at Li Ming.

sentences.chinese: 老人说：“你的儿子以后也会来这里。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén shuō: “Nǐ de ér zi yǐ hòu yě huì lái zhè lǐ.”
sentences.english: The old man said, "Your son will also come here in the future."

sentences.chinese: 李明很惊讶，因为他现在才七岁左右的心理状态，他没有儿子。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng hěn jīng yà, yīn wèi tā xiàn zài cái qī suì zuǒ yòu de xīn lǐ zhuàng tài, tā méi yǒu ér zi.
sentences.english: Li Ming was very surprised, because he is currently in a psychological state of about seven years old; he has no son.

sentences.chinese: 突然，机器人发出了一声大响声。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, jī qì rén fā chū le yì shēng dà xiǎng shēng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the robot made a loud noise.

sentences.chinese: 它指着窗外，说：“时间到了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐ zhe chuāng wài, shuō: “Shí jiān dào le.”
sentences.english: It pointed out the window and said, "The time has come."

sentences.chinese: 窗外的天气突然变了。
sentences.pinyin: Chuāng wài de tiān qì tū rán biàn le.
sentences.english: The weather outside suddenly changed.

sentences.chinese: 天空变成了一半蓝色，一半紫色。
sentences.pinyin: Tiān kōng biàn chéng le yī bàn lán sè, yī bàn zǐ sè.
sentences.english: The sky became half blue and half purple.

sentences.chinese: 李明看着窗外，他感到很害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kàn zhe chuāng wài, tā gǎn dào hěn hài pà.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked out the window; he felt very scared.

sentences.chinese: 机器人指着天空说：“我们要去一个新地方。”
sentences.pinyin: Jī qì rén zhǐ zhe tiān kōng shuō: “Wǒ men yào qù yī gè xīn dì fang.”
sentences.english: The robot pointed to the sky and said, "We are going to a new place."

sentences.chinese: 老人先生在桌子上放了一张地图。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén xiān sheng zài zhuō zi shàng fàng le yī zhāng dì tú.
sentences.english: The old gentleman placed a map on the table.

sentences.chinese: 那张地图不是纸做的，它是光做的。
sentences.pinyin: Nà zhāng dì tú bù shì zhǐ zuò de, tā shì guāng zuò de.
sentences.english: That map was not made of paper; it was made of light.

sentences.chinese: 地图上有一个地方写着“中国”。
sentences.pinyin: Dì tú shàng yǒu yī gè dì fang xiě zhe “Zhōng guó”.
sentences.english: On the map, there was a place written as "China."

sentences.chinese: 老人说：“那是很久以前的地球。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén shuō: “Nà shì hěn jiǔ yǐ qián de dì qiú.”
sentences.english: The old man said, "That was Earth a long time ago."

sentences.chinese: 李明问：“那里的人说中文吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng wèn: “Nà lǐ de rén shuō Zhōng wén ma?”
sentences.english: Li Ming asked, "Do the people there speak Chinese?"

sentences.chinese: 老人点点头说：“是的，那是很美的语言。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén diǎn diǎn tóu shuō: “Shì de, nà shì hěn měi de yǔ yán.”
sentences.english: The old man nodded and said, "Yes, it is a very beautiful language."

sentences.chinese: 李明想起了上次在学校看到的古老书本。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xiǎng qǐ le shàng cì zài xué xiào kàn dào de gǔ lǎo shū běn.
sentences.english: Li Ming remembered the ancient books he saw at school last time.

sentences.chinese: 他记得书里说，很久以前人们学习外语很慢。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì dé shū lǐ shuō, hěn jiǔ yǐ qián rén men xué xí wài yǔ hěn màn.
sentences.english: He remembered the books saying that a long time ago, people learned foreign languages very slowly.

sentences.chinese: 现在是今年，在这个星际时代，学习外语只需要一个小时。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài shì jīn nián, zài zhè gè xīng jì shí dài, xué xí wài yǔ zhǐ xū yào yī gè xiǎo shí.
sentences.english: It is this year, in this interstellar era, learning a foreign language only takes one hour.

sentences.chinese: 老人看着李明，眼神很温柔。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén kàn zhe Lǐ Míng, yǎn shén hěn wēn róu.
sentences.english: The old man looked at Li Ming with a gentle gaze.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“前天，我见到了一个女人。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Qián tiān, wǒ jiàn dào le yī gè nǚ rén.”
sentences.english: He said, "The day before yesterday, I met a woman."

sentences.chinese: “她是谁？”李明好奇地问。
sentences.pinyin: “Tā shì shuí?” Lǐ Míng hào qí de wèn.
sentences.english: "Who is she?" Li Ming asked curiously.

sentences.chinese: “她是我很多年前的女朋友，”老人叹了一口气。
sentences.pinyin: “Tā shì wǒ hěn duō nián qián de nǚ péng you,” lǎo rén tàn le yī kǒu qì.
sentences.english: "She was my girlfriend from many years ago," the old man sighed.

sentences.chinese: “她曾经是一名医生，在一家很大的医院工作。”
sentences.pinyin: “Tā céng jīng shì yī míng yī shēng, zài yī jiā hěn dà de yī yuàn gōng zuò.”
sentences.english: "She used to be a doctor, working in a very large hospital."

sentences.chinese: 老人继续说：“她有一个女儿，那个孩子现在一定长大了。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén jì xù shuō: “Tā yǒu yī gè nǚ ér, nà gè hái zi xiàn zài yī dìng zhǎng dà le.”
sentences.english: The old man continued, "She has a daughter; that child must have grown up by now."

sentences.chinese: “那个小朋友现在在哪里？”李明问。
sentences.pinyin: “Nà gè xiǎo péng yǒu xiàn zài zài nǎ lǐ?” Lǐ Míng wèn.
sentences.english: "Where is that little child now?" Li Ming asked.

sentences.chinese: 老人指着地图上的一个点说：“在那。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén zhǐ zhe dì tú shàng de yī gè diǎn shuō: “Zài nà.”
sentences.english: The old man pointed to a spot on the map and said, "There."

sentences.chinese: 李明注意到地图上的那个点写着“那”。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zhù yì dào dì tú shàng de nà gè diǎn xiě zhe “Nà”.
sentences.english: Li Ming noticed that the spot on the map was labeled "Na."

sentences.chinese: 那是这个女人的姓，叫那女士。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì zhè gè nǚ rén de xìng, jiào Nà nǚ shì.
sentences.english: That was the woman's surname, Ms. Na.

sentences.chinese: 老人说：“去年，我尝试联系她，但失败了。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén shuō: “Qù nián, wǒ cháng shì lián xì tā, dàn shī bài le.”
sentences.english: The old man said, "Last year, I tried to contact her, but I failed."

sentences.chinese: “半年之前，我决定再次尝试。”
sentences.pinyin: “Bàn nián zhī qián, wǒ jué dìng zài cì cháng shì.”
sentences.english: "Half a year ago, I decided to try again."

sentences.chinese: “上次我失败了，但下次一定会成功。”
sentences.pinyin: “Shàng cì wǒ shī bài le, dàn xià cì yī dìng huì chéng gōng.”
sentences.english: "Last time I failed, but next time I will definitely succeed."

sentences.chinese: 李明看着那个小小的几，上面放着一本旧书。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kàn zhe nà gè xiǎo xiǎo de jī, shàng miàn fàng zhe yī běn jiù shū.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked at the small table, on which an old book was placed.

sentences.chinese: 他记得以前在书店买过类似的书。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì dé yǐ qián zài shū diàn mǎi guò léi sì de shū.
sentences.english: He remembered buying a similar book at a bookstore before.

sentences.chinese: 在图书馆里，他也看过关于地球的历史。
sentences.pinyin: Zài tú shū guǎn lǐ, tā yě kàn guò guān yú dì qiú de lì shǐ.
sentences.english: In the library, he had also read about the history of Earth.

sentences.chinese: 这时，机器人说：“他们来了。”
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, jī qì rén shuō: “Tā men lái le.”
sentences.english: At this moment, the robot said, "They have arrived."

sentences.chinese: 李明看向门口，几个穿着白色衣服的人走了进来。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kàn xiàng mén kǒu, jǐ gè chuān zhe bái sè yī fú de rén zǒu le jìn lái.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked toward the door, and several people wearing white clothes walked in.

sentences.chinese: 他们看起来像医生，但眼神很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men kàn qǐ lái xiàng yī shēng, dàn yǎn shén hěn lěng.
sentences.english: They looked like doctors, but their eyes were cold.

sentences.chinese: 他们说：“李明，你的时间到了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā men shuō: “Lǐ Míng, nǐ de shí jiān dào le.”
sentences.english: They said, "Li Ming, your time has come."

sentences.chinese: 李明突然意识到，他可能不是一个普通的孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng tū rán yì shí dào, tā kě néng bù shì yī gè pǔ tōng de hái zi.
sentences.english: Li Ming suddenly realized that he might not be an ordinary child.

sentences.chinese: 他看向老人，但老人已经消失了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng lǎo rén, dàn lǎo rén yǐ jīng xiāo shī le.
sentences.english: He looked toward the old man, but the old man had already disappeared.

sentences.chinese: 只剩下那张发光的地图在空中旋转。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐ shèng xià nà zhāng fā guāng de dì tú zài kōng zhōng xuán zhuǎn.
sentences.english: Only that glowing map remained, spinning in the air.

sentences.chinese: 李明看着那些发光的线条，感到很害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kàn zhe nà xiē fā guāng de xiàn tiāo, gǎn dào hěn hài pà.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked at those glowing lines and felt very scared.

sentences.chinese: 那些医生把他带到了一个白色的房间。
sentences.pinyin: Nà xiē yī shēng bǎ tā dài dào le yí gè bái sè de fáng jiān.
sentences.english: Those doctors took him to a white room.

sentences.chinese: 房间里有一个很大的电脑。
sentences.pinyin: Fáng jiān lǐ yǒu yí gè hěn dà de diàn nǎo.
sentences.english: In the room, there was a very large computer.

sentences.chinese: 一个穿白衣服的工人正在检查机器。
sentences.pinyin: Yí gè chuān bái yī fu de gōng rén zhèng zài jiǎn chá jī qì.
sentences.english: A worker wearing white clothes was checking the machine.

sentences.chinese: 工人告诉他：“李明，你不是普通的人。”
sentences.pinyin: Gōng rén gào su tā: “Lǐ Míng, nǐ bú shì pǔ tōng de rén.”
sentences.english: The worker told him, "Li Ming, you are not an ordinary person."

sentences.chinese: 李明觉得很渴，他想要喝水。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng jué de hěn kě, tā xiǎng yào hē shuǐ.
sentences.english: Li Ming felt thirsty; he wanted to drink water.

sentences.chinese: 工人给了他一杯牛奶和一些水果。
sentences.pinyin: Gōng rén gěi le tā yì bēi niú nǎi hé yì xiē shuǐ guǒ.
sentences.english: The worker gave him a glass of milk and some fruit.

sentences.chinese: 李明问：“我是谁？我的生日是什么日期？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng wèn: “Wǒ shì shéi? Wǒ de shēng rì shì shén me rì qī?”
sentences.english: Li Ming asked, "Who am I? What date is my birthday?"

sentences.chinese: 工人看着电脑，说：“你的记忆在网上。”
sentences.pinyin: Gōng rén kàn zhe diàn nǎo, shuō: “Nǐ de jì yì zài wǎng shàng.”
sentences.english: The worker looked at the computer and said, "Your memories are online."

sentences.chinese: 他告诉李明，他的生活像是一篇课文，是被写好的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su Lǐ Míng, tā de shēng huó xiàng shì yì piān kè wén, shì bèi xiě hǎo de.
sentences.english: He told Li Ming that his life was like a textbook lesson, it had been written.

sentences.chinese: 李明想起昨天，他还在星际学院学习汉语。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xiǎng qǐ zuó tiān, tā hái zài xīng jì xué yuàn xué xí Hàn yǔ.
sentences.english: Li Ming remembered yesterday, when he was still studying Chinese at the Interstellar Academy.

sentences.chinese: 他记得他的老师是一个很温柔的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì de tā de lǎo shī shì yí gè hěn wēn róu de rén.
sentences.english: He remembered that his teacher was a very gentle person.

sentences.chinese: 他的老师告诉他，明年他们会去另一个星球。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de lǎo shī gào su tā, míng nián tā men huì qù lìng yí gè xīng qiú.
sentences.english: His teacher told him that next year they would go to another planet.

sentences.chinese: 李明还记得他的好朋友，一个叫小强的男孩。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng hái jì de tā de hǎo péng you, yí gè jiào Xiǎo Qiáng de nán hái.
sentences.english: Li Ming also remembered his good friend, a boy named Xiao Qiang.

sentences.chinese: 小强曾经说，他们可以在星期天一起玩。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo Qiáng céng jīng shuō, tā men kě yǐ zài xīng qī tiān yì qǐ wán.
sentences.english: Xiao Qiang once said they could play together on Sunday.

sentences.chinese: 在他们的星球，星期日是休息的时间。
sentences.pinyin: Zài tā men de xīng qiú, xīng qī rì shì xiū xi de shí jiān.
sentences.english: On their planet, Sunday is a time for rest.

sentences.chinese: 李明记得一个早晨，他坐在楼下吃早饭。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng jì de yí gè zǎo shang, tā zuò zài lóu xià chī zǎo fàn.
sentences.english: Li Ming remembered one early morning, he was sitting downstairs eating breakfast.

sentences.chinese: 桌子上有一碗热腾腾的米饭。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuō zi shàng yǒu yì wǎn rè téng téng de mǐ fàn.
sentences.english: On the table was a bowl of steaming hot rice.

sentences.chinese: 那是正月初一，是新年。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì zhēng yuè chū yī, shì xīn nián.
sentences.english: It was the first day of the first lunar month, the New Year.

sentences.chinese: 他记得那个早上的阳光很温暖。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì de nà gè zǎo shang de yáng guāng hěn wēn nuǎn.
sentences.english: He remembered the sunlight that morning was very warm.

sentences.chinese: 他想起明天，他原本计划和小强一起去坐火车。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ míng tiān, tā yuán běn jì huà hé Xiǎo Qiáng yì qǐ qù zuò huǒ chē.
sentences.english: He thought about tomorrow; he had originally planned to take the train with Xiao Qiang.

sentences.chinese: 他记得小强有一个男朋友，他们经常一起讨论科学。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì de Xiǎo Qiáng yǒu yí gè nán péng you, tā men jīng cháng yì qǐ tǎo lùn kē xué.
sentences.english: He remembered Xiao Qiang had a boyfriend, and they often discussed science together.

sentences.chinese: 现在，李明看着自己身上的衣服，发现那是实验服。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài, Lǐ Míng kàn zhe zì jǐ shēn shang de yī fu, fā xiàn nà shì shí yàn fú.
sentences.english: Now, Li Ming looked at the clothes on his body and discovered it was a lab coat.

sentences.chinese: 工人说：“你不需要担心，我们会帮你找回记忆。”
sentences.pinyin: Gōng rén shuō: “Nǐ bù xū yào dān xīn, wǒ men huì bāng nǐ zhǎo huí jì yì.”
sentences.english: The worker said, "You don't need to worry, we will help you recover your memories."

sentences.chinese: 李明突然在电脑屏幕上看到了一个日期。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng tū rán zài diàn nǎo píng mù shàng kàn dào le yí gè rì qī.
sentences.english: Li Ming suddenly saw a date on the computer screen.

sentences.chinese: 那个日期是未来的时间。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rì qī shì wèi lái de shí jiān.
sentences.english: That date was a time in the future.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，他的整个世界可能只是一个模拟程序。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, tā de zhěng gè shì jiè kě néng zhǐ shì yí gè mó nǐ chéng xù.
sentences.english: He realized that his entire world might just be a simulation program.

sentences.chinese: 突然，电脑发出了红色的警告灯。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, diàn nǎo fā chū le hóng sè de jǐng gào dēng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the computer emitted a red warning light.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 5: Cracks in the Simulated World

sentences.chinese: 红色的灯光在房间里闪烁。
sentences.pinyin: Hóngsè de dēngguāng zài fángjiān lǐ shǎnshuò.
sentences.english: The red lights flickered in the room.

sentences.chinese: 李明觉得这里不对。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng juéde zhèlǐ bù duì.
sentences.english: Li Ming felt that something was wrong here.

sentences.chinese: 他看着电脑，屏幕上的数字变成了零。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe diànnǎo, píngmù shàng de shùzì biànchéng le líng.
sentences.english: He looked at the computer; the numbers on the screen had turned to zero.

sentences.chinese: 一个声音在房间里响起。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè shēngyīn zài fángjiān lǐ xiǎngqǐ.
sentences.english: A voice sounded in the room.

sentences.chinese: “你不能在这里待太久。”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ bù néng zài zhèlǐ dāi tài jiǔ.”
sentences.english: "You cannot stay here too long."

sentences.chinese: 这是一个年轻女孩儿的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yī gè niánqīng nǚhái r de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: It was the voice of a young girl.

sentences.chinese: 李明看向窗外，他看到北边的天空在消失。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kànxiàng chuāngwài, tā kàndào běibiān de tiānkōng zài xiāoshī.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked out the window and saw the northern sky disappearing.

sentences.chinese: 那个世界像坏了的电视一样，在闪烁。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè shìjiè xiàng huài le de diànshì yīyàng, zài shǎnshuò.
sentences.english: That world was flickering like a broken television.

sentences.chinese: 他突然感到很饿，肚子在响。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán gǎndào hěn è, dùzi zài xiǎng.
sentences.english: He suddenly felt very hungry, and his stomach was growling.

sentences.chinese: 他记得在中学的时候，他总是忘记吃午饭。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde zài zhōngxué de shíhou, tā zǒngshì wàngjì chī wǔfàn.
sentences.english: He remembered that back in middle school, he always forgot to eat lunch.

sentences.chinese: 但现在，他不确定自己是不是真的去过中学。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiànzài, tā bù quèdìng zìjǐ shì bù shì zhēn de qùguo zhōngxué.
sentences.english: But now, he wasn't sure if he had actually attended middle school.

sentences.chinese: 一个穿着白色衣服的小姐走进了房间。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè chuānzhe báisè yīfú de xiǎojiě zǒu jìn le fángjiān.
sentences.english: A young lady wearing white clothes walked into the room.

sentences.chinese: 她看着李明，眼神很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe Lǐ Míng, yǎnshén hěn qíguài.
sentences.english: She looked at Li Ming with a strange expression.

sentences.chinese: “你是一个特殊的病人，”小姐说。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ shì yī gè tèshū de bìngrén,” xiǎojiě shuō.
sentences.english: "You are a special patient," the young lady said.

sentences.chinese: 李明问：“我是生病了吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng wèn: “Wǒ shì shēngbìng le ma?”
sentences.english: Li Ming asked, "Am I sick?"

sentences.chinese: 小姐回答：“你的病不在身体里，而在记忆里。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎojiě huídá: “Nǐ de bìng bù zài shēntǐ lǐ, ér zài jìyì lǐ.”
sentences.english: The young lady replied, "Your illness is not in your body, but in your memories."

sentences.chinese: 她告诉李明，他不是一个普通的小孩儿。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosu Lǐ Míng, tā bù shì yī gè pǔtōng de xiǎohái r.
sentences.english: She told Li Ming that he was not an ordinary child.

sentences.chinese: 在这个模拟世界里，他是一个被观察的男孩儿。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège mónǐ shìjiè lǐ, tā shì yī gè bèi guānchá de nánhái r.
sentences.english: In this simulated world, he was a boy being observed.

sentences.chinese: 他的哥哥也在这个程序里，但哥哥在楼上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de gēge yě zài zhège chéngxù lǐ, dàn gēge zài lóushàng.
sentences.english: His older brother was also in this program, but his brother was upstairs.

sentences.chinese: “你的哥哥现在在二号房间，”小姐说。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ de gēge xiànzài zài èr hào fángjiān,” xiǎojiě shuō.
sentences.english: "Your brother is currently in room two," the young lady said.

sentences.chinese: 李明想去那儿，但他的腿很沉。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xiǎng qù nà r, dàn tā de tuǐ hěn chén.
sentences.english: Li Ming wanted to go there, but his legs felt heavy.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得自己的身体很小，像一个孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde zìjǐ de shēntǐ hěn xiǎo, xiàng yī gè háizi.
sentences.english: He felt that his body was very small, like a child's.

sentences.chinese: 他看到桌子上有一本课本，但课本上的字在消失。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào zhuōzi shàng yǒu yī běn kèběn, dàn kèběn shàng de zì zài xiāoshī.
sentences.english: He saw a textbook on the table, but the words on the textbook were disappearing.

sentences.chinese: “这里的人太少了，”李明低声说。
sentences.pinyin: “Zhèlǐ de rén tài shǎo le,” Lǐ Míng dīshēng shuō.
sentences.english: "There are too few people here," Li Ming said softly.

sentences.chinese: 小姐笑了笑，说：“因为大多数人已经离开了。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎojiě xiào le xiào, shuō: “Yīnwèi dàduōshù rén yǐjīng líkāi le.”
sentences.english: The young lady smiled and said, "Because most people have already left."

sentences.chinese: 李明问：“我可以去楼上吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng wèn: “Wǒ kěyǐ qù lóushàng ma?”
sentences.english: Li Ming asked, "Can I go upstairs?"

sentences.chinese: 小姐说：“可以，请下楼走走，然后去北门。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎojiě shuō: “Kěyǐ, qǐng xià lóu zǒuzǒu, ránhòu qù běimén.”
sentences.english: The young lady said, "You can; please go downstairs for a walk first, then go to the north gate."

sentences.chinese: 李明说：“谢谢你。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng shuō: “Xièxie nǐ.”
sentences.english: Li Ming said, "Thank you."

sentences.chinese: 小姐回答：“不客气。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎojiě huídá: “Bù kèqi.”
sentences.english: The young lady replied, "You're welcome."

sentences.chinese: 他走出房间，看到走廊里有一个男人的影子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒuchū fángjiān, kàndào zǒuláng lǐ yǒu yī gè nánrén de yǐngzi.
sentences.english: He walked out of the room and saw the shadow of a man in the corridor.

sentences.chinese: 那个男人看起来很病，像一个真正的病人。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè nánrén kàn qǐlái hěn bìng, xiàng yī gè zhēnzhèng de bìngrén.
sentences.english: That man looked very ill, like a real patient.

sentences.chinese: 李明数了一下，走廊里有六个这样的影子。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng shǔ le yīxià, zǒuláng lǐ yǒu liù gè zhèyàng de yǐngzi.
sentences.english: Li Ming counted; there were six such shadows in the corridor.

sentences.chinese: 他突然忘了一件事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán wàng le yī jiàn shì.
sentences.english: He suddenly forgot one thing.

sentences.chinese: 如果这个世界是假的，那么真实的他是谁？
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhège shìjiè shì jiǎ de, nàme zhēnshí de tā shì shuí?
sentences.english: If this world is fake, then who is the real him?

sentences.chinese: 他快步走向北门，但门突然关上了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kuàibù zǒuxiàng běimén, dàn mén tūrán guān shàng le.
sentences.english: He walked quickly toward the north gate, but the door suddenly slammed shut.

sentences.chinese: 北门关上了，李明被关在走廊里。
sentences.pinyin: Běimén guān shàng le, Lǐ Míng bèi guān zài zǒuláng lǐ.
sentences.english: The north gate closed, and Li Ming was trapped in the corridor.

sentences.chinese: 他看着那些像病人的影子，觉得这个地方很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe nàxiē xiàng bìngrén de yǐngzi, juéde zhège dìfāng hěn qíguài.
sentences.english: He looked at those shadows that looked like sick people and felt this place was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 突然，天空中开始下雨。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, tiānkōng zhōng kāishǐ xià yǔ.
sentences.english: Suddenly, it began to rain in the sky.

sentences.chinese: 但这不是真正的雨，而是绿色的数字在落下。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zhè búshì zhēnzhèng de yǔ, érshì lǜsè de shùzì zài luòxià.
sentences.english: But this was not real rain, but green numbers falling.

sentences.chinese: 李明听到一个声音在说话。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng tīngdào yígè shēngyīn zài shuōhuà.
sentences.english: Li Ming heard a voice speaking.

sentences.chinese: 他听见那个声音在叫他的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīngjiàn nàge shēngyīn zài jiào tā de míngzi.
sentences.english: He heard that voice calling his name.

sentences.chinese: “李明，快回到你的控制室。”
sentences.pinyin: “Lǐ Míng, kuài huídào nǐ de kòngzhìshì.”
sentences.english: "Li Ming, quickly return to your control room."

sentences.chinese: 他看着周围，发现这里没有家，也没有家里的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe zhōuwéi, fāxiàn zhèlǐ méiyǒu jiā, yě méiyǒu jiālǐ de rén.
sentences.english: He looked around and found there was no home here, nor people from home.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果这是一个模拟世界，那么他该怎么回家？
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rúguǒ zhè shì yígè mónǐ shìjiè, nàme tā gāi zěnme huíjiā?
sentences.english: He thought, if this is a simulated world, then how should he return home?

sentences.chinese: 他看到一个机器人走过来，那个家伙看起来很冷漠。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào yígè jīqìrén zǒu guòlái, nàge jiāhuo kàn qǐlái hěn lěngmò.
sentences.english: He saw a robot walk over; that fellow looked very cold.

sentences.chinese: 机器人拿出一本书，那是关于这个世界的书经。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén ná chū yì běn shū, nà shì guānyú zhège shìjiè de shūjīng.
sentences.english: The robot took out a book, which was the scripture of this world.

sentences.chinese: 机器人对他说：“坐下，我帮你干这个工作。”
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén duì tā shuō: “Zuòxià, wǒ bāng nǐ gàn zhège gōngzuò.”
sentences.english: The robot said to him, "Sit down, I will help you do this work."

sentences.chinese: 机器人开始写一些代码，代码在空中旋转。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén kāishǐ xiě yìxiē dàimǎ, dàimǎ zài kōngzhōng xuánzhuǎn.
sentences.english: The robot began to write some code, and the code rotated in the air.

sentences.chinese: 李明问：“这些代码有用吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng wèn: “Zhèxiē dàimǎ yǒuyòng ma?”
sentences.english: Li Ming asked, "Is this code useful?"

sentences.chinese: 机器人说：“这是最有用的一段代码，它可以让你出去。”
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén shuō: “Zhè shì zuì yǒuyòng de yíduàn dàimǎ, tā kěyǐ ràng nǐ chūqù.”
sentences.english: The robot said, "This is the most useful piece of code; it can let you go out."

sentences.chinese: 李明看着代码，突然忘记了刚才在想什么。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kànzhe dàimǎ, tūrán wàngjì le gāngcái zài xiǎng shénme.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked at the code and suddenly forgot what he was thinking just now.

sentences.chinese: 他看到桌子上有一个包子，但那是数字做的，不能吃。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào zhuōzi shàng yǒu yígè bāozi, dàn nà shì shùzì zuò de, bùnéng chī.
sentences.english: He saw a baozi on the table, but it was made of numbers and could not be eaten.

sentences.chinese: 他想打电话给那个消失的老人，但这里没有电话。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng dǎ diànhuà gěi nàge xiāoshī de lǎorén, dàn zhèlǐ méiyǒu diànhuà.
sentences.english: He wanted to make a phone call to that disappeared old man, but there was no phone here.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试打十二个数字，希望能够联系到外界。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chángshì dǎ shí'èr gè shùzì, xīwàng nénggòu liánxì dào wàijiè.
sentences.english: He tried to dial a dozen numbers, hoping to contact the outside world.

sentences.chinese: 他从书经里寻找答案，想找到真实的自己。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng shūjīng lǐ xúnzhǎo dá'àn, xiǎng zhǎodào zhēnshí de zìjǐ.
sentences.english: He searched for answers from the scripture, wanting to find the real self.

sentences.chinese: 他感觉到一种奇怪的频率，声音很好听。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎnjué dào yì zhǒng qíguài de pínlǜ, shēngyīn hěn hǎotīng.
sentences.english: He felt a strange frequency; the sound was very pleasant to hear.

sentences.chinese: 这种频率和之前的警告灯是一样的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng pínlǜ hé zhīqián de jǐnggàodēng shì yíyàng de.
sentences.english: This frequency was the same as the previous warning light.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，这些影子其实是程序中的错误。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, zhèxiē yǐngzi qíshí shì chéngxù zhōng de cuòwù.
sentences.english: He realized that these shadows were actually errors in the program.

sentences.chinese: 他需要帮机器人完成最后的步骤。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xūyào bāng jīqìrén wánchéng zuìhòu de bùzhòu.
sentences.english: He needed to help the robot complete the final steps.

sentences.chinese: 他看向窗外，数字的雨还在下。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng chuāngwài, shùzì de yǔ hái zài xià.
sentences.english: He looked out the window; the digital rain was still falling.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果能离开这里，他就自由了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rúguǒ néng líkāi zhèlǐ, tā jiù zìyóu le.
sentences.english: He thought, if he could leave this place, he would be free.

sentences.chinese: 突然，走廊尽头出现了一个发光的门。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, zǒuláng jìntóu chūxiàn le yígè fāguāng de mén.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a glowing door appeared at the end of the corridor.

sentences.chinese: 门后面有一个声音在喊：“快进来！”
sentences.pinyin: Mén hòumiàn yǒu yígè shēngyīn zài hǎn: “Kuài jìnlái!”
sentences.english: Behind the door, a voice was shouting, "Come in quickly!"

sentences.chinese: 李明快步跑向那个发光的门。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kuài bù pǎo xiàng nà gè fā guāng de mén.
sentences.english: Li Ming ran quickly toward the glowing door.

sentences.chinese: 他听到声音说：“请进！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīng dào shēng yīn shuō: “qǐng jìn!”
sentences.english: He heard a voice say: "Please come in!"

sentences.chinese: 他小心地走了进去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎo xīn de zǒu le jìn qù.
sentences.english: He carefully walked inside.

sentences.chinese: 门里是一个非常大的白色房间。
sentences.pinyin: Mén lǐ shì yī gè fēi cháng dà de bái sè fáng jiān.
sentences.english: Inside the door was a very large white room.

sentences.chinese: 房间里边没有窗户，但是光很亮。
sentences.pinyin: Fáng jiān lǐ bian méi yǒu chuāng hu, dàn shì guāng hěn liàng.
sentences.english: Inside the room there were no windows, but the light was very bright.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一个穿着白衣服的人在笑。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào yī gè chuān zhe bái yī fú de rén zài xiào.
sentences.english: He saw a person wearing white clothes smiling.

sentences.chinese: 那个人说：“请坐，李明。”
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén shuō: “qǐng zuò, Lǐ Míng.”
sentences.english: That person said: "Please have a seat, Li Ming."

sentences.chinese: 李明坐在椅子上，感觉这里有一点儿冷。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zuò zài yǐ zi shàng, gǎn jué zhè lǐ yǒu yī diǎn r lěng.
sentences.english: Li Ming sat in the chair and felt it was a little bit cold here.

sentences.chinese: 那个人说：“我姓冷，我是这里的管理员。”
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén shuō: “wǒ xìng Lěng, wǒ shì zhè lǐ de guǎn lǐ yuán.”
sentences.english: That person said: "My surname is Leng, I am the administrator here."

sentences.chinese: 冷先生看着李明，问他：“你记得我是谁吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Lěng xiān sheng kàn zhe Lǐ Míng, wèn tā: “nǐ jì de wǒ shì shuí ma?”
sentences.english: Mr. Leng looked at Li Ming and asked him: "Do you remember who I am?"

sentences.chinese: 李明摇了摇头，他没记得这个人的脸。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng yáo le tóu, tā méi jì de zhè gè rén de liǎn.
sentences.english: Li Ming shook his head; he did not remember this person's face.

sentences.chinese: 冷先生笑了，他说：“不用担心，你现在很安全。”
sentences.pinyin: Lěng xiān sheng xiào le, tā shuō: “bù yòng dān xīn, nǐ xiàn zài hěn ā n quán.”
sentences.english: Mr. Leng smiled and said: "No need to worry, you are very safe now."

sentences.chinese: 他给李明一快儿面包，说：“吃一点儿吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā gěi Lǐ Míng yī kuài r miàn bāo, shuō: “chī yī diǎn r ba.”
sentences.english: He gave Li Ming a piece of bread and said: "Eat a little bit."

sentences.chinese: 李明接过面包，突然想到了学校的事情。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng jiē guò miàn bāo, tū rán xiǎng dào le xué xiào de shì qíng.
sentences.english: Li Ming took the bread and suddenly thought about things at school.

sentences.chinese: 他问：“如果我不在学校，我需要请假吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn: “rú guǒ wǒ bù zài xué xiào, wǒ xū yào qǐng jià ma?”
sentences.english: He asked: "If I am not at school, do I need to request a leave of absence?"

sentences.chinese: 冷先生笑了起来，说：“这里不是学校，你们不需要请假。”
sentences.pinyin: Lěng xiān sheng xiào le qǐ lái, shuō: “zhè lǐ bù shì xué xiào, nǐ men bù xū yào qǐng jià.”
sentences.english: Mr. Leng laughed and said: "This is not a school, you all do not need to request leave."

sentences.chinese: 李明很惊讶，他问：“你们是谁？这里是哪里？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng hěn jīng yà, tā wèn: “nǐ men shì shuí? zhè lǐ shì nǎ lǐ?”
sentences.english: Li Ming was very surprised and asked: "Who are you? Where is this place?"

sentences.chinese: 冷先生指了指墙上的九个屏幕。
sentences.pinyin: Lěng xiān sheng zhǐ le zhǐ qiáng shàng de jiǔ gè píng mù.
sentences.english: Mr. Leng pointed to nine screens on the wall.

sentences.chinese: 屏幕上飞着很多奇怪的金属球。
sentences.pinyin: Píng mù shàng fēi zhe hěn duō qí guài de jīn shǔ qiú.
sentences.english: Many strange metal spheres were flying on the screens.

sentences.chinese: 冷先生说：“这里有很多人，比如南先生，年先生和车先生。”
sentences.pinyin: Lěng xiān sheng shuō: “zhè lǐ yǒu hěn duō rén, bǐ rú Nán xiān sheng, Nián xiān sheng hé Chē xiān sheng.”
sentences.english: Mr. Leng said: "There are many people here, for example, Mr. Nan, Mr. Nian, and Mr. Che."

sentences.chinese: 李明问：“哪些人能帮我离开这里？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng wèn: “nǎ xiē rén néng bāng wǒ lí kāi zhè lǐ?”
sentences.english: Li Ming asked: "Which people can help me leave this place?"

sentences.chinese: 冷先生说：“我们一块儿看看这些数据。”
sentences.pinyin: Lěng xiān sheng shuō: “wǒ men yī kuài r kàn kàn zhè xiē shù jù.”
sentences.english: Mr. Leng said: "Let's look at this data together."

sentences.chinese: 他让李明看了一下儿屏幕上的数字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ràng Lǐ Míng kàn le yī xià r píng mù shàng de shù zì.
sentences.english: He let Li Ming take a quick look at the numbers on the screen.

sentences.chinese: 李明发现这些数字像是在跳舞，看起来很好玩儿。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng fā xiàn zhè xiē shù zì xiàng shì zài tiào wǔ, kàn qǐ lái hěn hǎo wán r.
sentences.english: Li Ming found that these numbers seemed to be dancing; they looked very fun.

sentences.chinese: 但是，他突然意识到，这里的人都没有影子。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn shì, tā tū rán yì shí dào, zhè lǐ de rén dōu méi yǒu yǐng zi.
sentences.english: However, he suddenly realized that the people here had no shadows.

sentences.chinese: 他看向冷先生，发现冷先生的脚下也没有影子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng Lěng xiān sheng, fā xiàn Lěng xiān sheng de jiǎo xià yě méi yǒu yǐng zi.
sentences.english: He looked at Mr. Leng and found that there was no shadow under Mr. Leng's feet.

sentences.chinese: 李明感到害怕，他想快点离开这个房间。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng gǎn dào hài pà, tā xiǎng kuài diǎn lí kāi zhè gè fáng jiān.
sentences.english: Li Ming felt afraid; he wanted to leave this room quickly.

sentences.chinese: 突然，房间的灯灭了，一个黑色的影子出现在他身后。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, fáng jiān de dēng miè le, yī gè hēi sè de yǐng zi chū xiàn zài tā shēn hòu.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the lights in the room went out, and a black shadow appeared behind him.

sentences.chinese: 那个黑色的影子突然说话了。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè hēi sè de yǐng zi tū rán shuō huà le.
sentences.english: The black shadow suddenly spoke.

sentences.chinese: 它说：“对不起，李明，你不能离开。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Duì bu qǐ, Lǐ Míng, nǐ bù néng lí kāi.”
sentences.english: It said, "I'm sorry, Li Ming, you cannot leave."

sentences.chinese: 李明很害怕，他地地地快步跑向门口。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng hěn hài pà, tā dì dì dì kuài bù pǎo xiàng mén kǒu.
sentences.english: Li Ming was very scared; he ran quickly toward the door.

sentences.chinese: 他想关上门，但是门已经消失了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng guān shàng mén, dàn shì mén yǐ jīng xiāo shī le.
sentences.english: He wanted to close the door, but the door had already disappeared.

sentences.chinese: 影子轻轻地笑了，它介绍自己是这个模拟世界的管理员。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi qīng qīng de xiào le, tā jiè shào zì jǐ shì zhè gè mó nǐ shì jiè de guǎn lǐ yuán.
sentences.english: The shadow laughed softly and introduced itself as the administrator of this simulated world.

sentences.chinese: 它说：“在这里，我们不需要影子，因为我们只是数字。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zài zhè lǐ, wǒ men bù xū yào yǐng zi, yīn wèi wǒ men zhǐ shì shù zì.”
sentences.english: It said, "Here, we do not need shadows because we are just numbers."

sentences.chinese: 李明问：“我呢？我是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng wèn: “Wǒ ne? Wǒ shì shuí?”
sentences.english: Li Ming asked, "What about me? Who am I?"

sentences.chinese: 管理员说：“你是一个特殊的程序，你以后会知道的。”
sentences.pinyin: Guǎn lǐ yuán shuō: “Nǐ shì yí gè tè shū de chéng xù, nǐ yǐ hòu huì zhī dào de.”
sentences.english: The administrator said, "You are a special program; you will know in the future."

sentences.chinese: 突然，房间变成了像学校的样子。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, fáng jiān biàn chéng le xiàng xué xiào de yàng zi.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the room turned into something like a school.

sentences.chinese: 管理员说：“现在下课了，你可以去休息。”
sentences.pinyin: Guǎn lǐ yuán shuō: “Xiàn zài xià kè le, nǐ kě yǐ qù xiū xi.”
sentences.english: The administrator said, "Class is over now; you can go rest."

sentences.chinese: 李明看到桌子上有一块发光的蛋糕和一口面条儿。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kàn dào zhuō zi shàng yǒu yí kuài fā guāng de dàn gāo hé yì kǒu miàn tiáo r.
sentences.english: Li Ming saw a piece of glowing cake and a mouthful of noodles on the table.

sentences.chinese: 这些食物看起来很好看，但李明不敢吃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiē shí wù kàn qǐ lái hěn hǎo kàn, dàn Lǐ Míng bù gǎn chī.
sentences.english: This food looked very nice, but Li Ming didn't dare eat it.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果这是一个模拟世界，那么我想家了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rú guǒ zhè shì yí gè mó nǐ shì jiè, nà me wǒ xiǎng jiā le.
sentences.english: He thought, if this is a simulated world, then I miss home.

sentences.chinese: 他问：“我的奶奶在家吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn: “Wǒ de nǎi nai zài jiā ma?”
sentences.english: He asked, "Is my grandma at home?"

sentences.chinese: 管理员说：“你的记忆在网络里，你可以上网去找她。”
sentences.pinyin: Guǎn lǐ yuán shuō: “Nǐ de jì yì zài wǎng lù lǐ, nǐ kě yǐ shàng wǎng qù zhǎo tā.”
sentences.english: The administrator said, "Your memories are in the network; you can go online to find her."

sentences.chinese: 李明试着上网，但他发现自己的权限差一点点。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng shì zhe shàng wǎng, dàn tā fā xiàn zì jǐ de quán xiàn chā yì diǎn diǎn.
sentences.english: Li Ming tried to go online, but he found his permissions were slightly short.

sentences.chinese: 管理员说：“后天你就可以看到她了。”
sentences.pinyin: Guǎn lǐ yuán shuō: “Hòu tiān nǐ jiù kě yǐ kàn dào tā le.”
sentences.english: The administrator said, "The day after tomorrow, you will be able to see her."

sentences.chinese: 李明很失望，他不想再等两天。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng hěn shī wàng, tā bù xiǎng zài děng liǎng tiān.
sentences.english: Li Ming was very disappointed; he didn't want to wait another two days.

sentences.chinese: 管理员给他一个听写本，说：“如果你能做对这些题目，我就让你见她。”
sentences.pinyin: Guǎn lǐ yuán gěi tā yí gè tīng xiě běn, shuō: “Rú guǒ nǐ néng zuò duì zhè xiē tí mù, wǒ jiù ràng nǐ jiàn tā.”
sentences.english: The administrator gave him a dictation notebook and said, "If you can do these questions correctly, I will let you see her."

sentences.chinese: 李明看着本子，上面的字在分分合合，像在跳舞。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kàn zhe běn zi, shàng miàn de zì zài fēn fēn hé hé, xiàng zài tiào wǔ.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked at the notebook; the characters on it were dividing and combining, as if dancing.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，管理员们在玩弄他的记忆。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, guǎn lǐ yuán men zài wán nòng tā de jì yì.
sentences.english: He realized that the administrators were playing with his memories.

sentences.chinese: 他看向窗外，发现外面没有天空，只有无数的蓝色线条。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng chuāng wài, fā xiàn wài miàn méi yǒu tiān kōng, zhǐ yǒu wú shù de lán sè xiàn tiáo.
sentences.english: He looked out the window and found there was no sky outside, only countless blue lines.

sentences.chinese: 他突然想，如果我能分出我的意识，也许能逃掉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tū rán xiǎng, rú guǒ wǒ néng fēn chū wǒ de yì shí, yě xǔ néng táo diào.
sentences.english: He suddenly thought, if I can split my consciousness, maybe I can escape.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试地闭上眼睛，在脑海中构建一个真实的家。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cháng shì dì bì shàng yǎn jīng, zài nǎo hǎi zhōng gòu jiàn yí gè zhēn shí de jiā.
sentences.english: He tried to close his eyes and construct a real home in his mind.

sentences.chinese: 这时，管理员的声音再次响起。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, guǎn lǐ yuán de shēng yīn zài cì xiǎng qǐ.
sentences.english: At this moment, the administrator's voice sounded again.

sentences.chinese: “你真的以为，你现在是在家吗？”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ zhēn de yǐ wéi, nǐ xiàn zài shì zài jiā ma?”
sentences.english: "Do you really think you are at home right now?"

sentences.chinese: 李明猛地睁开眼，发现自己回到了那个白色的房间。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng měng de zhēng kāi yǎn, fā xiàn zì jǐ huí dào le nà gè bái sè de fáng jiān.
sentences.english: Li Ming snapped his eyes open and found himself back in that white room.

sentences.chinese: 而这次，他的脚下出现了一个黑色的影子。
sentences.pinyin: Ér zhè cì, tā de jiǎo xià chū xiàn le yí gè hēi sè de yǐng zi.
sentences.english: And this time, a black shadow appeared beneath his feet.

sentences.chinese: 李明看着脚下的影子，觉得这很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kànzhe jiǎoxià de yǐngzi, juéde zhè hěn qíguài.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked at the shadow under his feet and felt that this was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 他想，这个影子是不是冷先生送给他的礼物？
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, zhège yǐngzi shì bú shì Lěng xiān sheng sòng gěi tā de lǐwù?
sentences.english: He thought, was this shadow a gift sent to him by Mr. Leng?

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个老声音在他耳边响起。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yí gè lǎo shēngyīn zài tā ěrbiān xiǎngqǐ.
sentences.english: Suddenly, an old voice sounded in his ear.

sentences.chinese: “你来看这个。”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ lái kàn zhège.”
sentences.english: "Come and look at this."

sentences.chinese: 李明转过身，看到桌子上有一个本子。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zhuǎn guò shēn, kàndào zhuōzi shàng yǒu yí gè běnzi.
sentences.english: Li Ming turned around and saw a notebook on the table.

sentences.chinese: 这个本子是白色的，第一页写着他的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège běnzi shì báisè de, dì yī yè xiězhe tā de míngzi.
sentences.english: This notebook was white, and the first page had his name written on it.

sentences.chinese: 他用手翻开第二页，上面画着一个机场。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng shǒu fānkāi dì èr yè, shàngmiàn huàzhe yí gè jīchǎng.
sentences.english: He used his hand to flip open the second page, which had a drawing of an airport.

sentences.chinese: 那个机场在日出的光芒下非常漂亮。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge jīchǎng zài rìchū de guāngmáng xià fēicháng piàoliang.
sentences.english: That airport was very beautiful under the light of the sunrise.

sentences.chinese: 李明知道，这不是真实的世界，而是模拟的记忆。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zhīdào, zhè bú shì zhēnshí de shìjiè, ér shì mónǐ de jìyì.
sentences.english: Li Ming knew that this was not the real world, but simulated memories.

sentences.chinese: 在他的记忆里，他有一个弟弟和一个妹。
sentences.pinyin: Zài tā de jìyì lǐ, tā yǒu yí gè dìdi hé yí gè mèi.
sentences.english: In his memories, he had a younger brother and a younger sister.

sentences.chinese: 他爱他的弟弟和妹，这是他唯一的爱好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ài tā de dìdi hé mèi, zhè shì tā wéiyī de àihào.
sentences.english: He loved his brother and sister; this was his only hobby.

sentences.chinese: 但是，在模拟世界里，他觉得很累。
sentences.pinyin: Dànshì, zài mónǐ shìjiè lǐ, tā juéde hěn lèi.
sentences.english: However, in the simulated world, he felt very tired.

sentences.chinese: 他想洗洗脸，让自己清醒一点。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng xǐ xǐ liǎn, ràng zìjǐ qīngxǐng yì diǎn.
sentences.english: He wanted to wash his face to make himself a bit more awake.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个杯子在桌子上慢慢移动。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yí gè bēizi zài zhuōzi shàng mànmàn yídòng.
sentences.english: At this moment, a cup moved slowly on the table.

sentences.chinese: 杯子里有蓝色的液体，像是在发光。
sentences.pinyin: Bēizi lǐ yǒu lánsè de yètǐ, xiàng shì zài fāguāng.
sentences.english: There was a blue liquid in the cup, which seemed to be glowing.

sentences.chinese: 他想起在车上的时候，冷先生说过的话。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zài chēshàng de shíhou, Lěng xiān sheng shuō guò de huà.
sentences.english: He remembered the words Mr. Leng had said while they were in the car.

sentences.chinese: 冷先生说：“没事儿，你只需要看这个本子。”
sentences.pinyin: Lěng xiān sheng shuō: “Méishìr, nǐ zhǐ xūyào kàn zhège běnzi.”
sentences.english: Mr. Leng said: "It's nothing, you only need to look at this notebook."

sentences.chinese: 李明看向本子的第十页，发现那里有一张照片。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kànxiàng běnzi de dì shí yè, fāxiàn nàlǐ yǒu yì zhāng zhàopiàn.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked at the tenth page of the notebook and found a photo there.

sentences.chinese: 照片里的人在笑，但他们的脸很模糊。
sentences.pinyin: Zhàopiàn lǐ de rén zài xiào, dàn tāmen de liǎn hěn móhu.
sentences.english: The people in the photo were smiling, but their faces were very blurry.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果能离开这里，他就能找到这些人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rúguǒ néng líkāi zhèlǐ, tā jiù néng zhǎodào zhèxiē rén.
sentences.english: He thought that if he could leave here, he could find these people.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试开门，但门还是关着的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chángshì kāi mén, dàn mén háishì guānzhe de.
sentences.english: He tried to open the door, but the door was still closed.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得心跳很快，因为影子在靠近他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde xīntiào hěn kuài, yīnwèi yǐngzi zài kàojìn tā.
sentences.english: He felt his heart beating fast because the shadow was approaching him.

sentences.chinese: 这个影子现在成了他的陪伴。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège yǐngzi xiànzài chéngle tā de péibàn.
sentences.english: This shadow had now become his companion.

sentences.chinese: 他想，这也许是离开这个白色房间的唯一办法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, zhè yěxǔ shì líkāi zhège báisè fángjiān de wéiyī bànfǎ.
sentences.english: He thought that this might be the only way to leave this white room.

sentences.chinese: 他再次看向本子，发现页码在自动变化。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zàicì kànxiàng běnzi, fāxiàn yèmǎ zài zìdòng biànhuà.
sentences.english: He looked at the notebook again and found the page numbers changing automatically.

sentences.chinese: 现在本子上出现了一个新的地址。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài běnzi shàng chūxiànle yí gè xīn de dìzhǐ.
sentences.english: Now a new address appeared in the notebook.

sentences.chinese: 那个地址在模拟世界的边缘。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge dìzhǐ zài mónǐ shìjiè de biānyuán.
sentences.english: That address was at the edge of the simulated world.

sentences.chinese: 李明决定走过去，看看那里有什么。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng juédìng zǒu guòqù, kànkan nàlǐ yǒu shénme.
sentences.english: Li Ming decided to walk over and see what was there.

sentences.chinese: 李明走到了模拟世界的边缘。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zǒu dào le mónǐ shìjiè de biānyuán.
sentences.english: Li Ming walked to the edge of the simulated world.

sentences.chinese: 这里看起来像一个旧的城市。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ kàn qǐlái xiàng yī gè jiù de chéngshì.
sentences.english: It looked like an old city.

sentences.chinese: 他看到很多人在走，他们看起来很忙。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào hěn duō rén zài zǒu, tāmen kàn qǐlái hěn máng.
sentences.english: He saw many people walking; they looked very busy.

sentences.chinese: 有的人在去上学的路上。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu de rén zài qù shàngxué de lùshàng.
sentences.english: Some people were on their way to go to school.

sentences.chinese: 有的人在去上班的路上。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu de rén zài qù shàngbān de lùshàng.
sentences.english: Some people were on their way to go to work.

sentences.chinese: 他们像机器人一样，动作很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xiàng jīqìrén yīyàng, dòngzuò hěn qíguài.
sentences.english: They were like robots; their movements were very strange.

sentences.chinese: 李明发现这些人的动作完全一样。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng fāxiàn zhèxiē rén de dòngzuò wánquán yīyàng.
sentences.english: Li Ming discovered that these people's movements were exactly the same.

sentences.chinese: 他想，这个地方的人怎么住在这里？
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, zhège dìfāng de rén zěnme zhù zài zhèlǐ?
sentences.english: He thought, how do the people of this place live here?

sentences.chinese: 他看到一个男人在开车。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào yī gè nánrén zài kāichē.
sentences.english: He saw a man driving a car.

sentences.chinese: 那个男人开车去开会。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge nánrén kāichē qù kāihuì.
sentences.english: That man was driving to attend a meeting.

sentences.chinese: 李明想去帮忙，但那个男人没有看他。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xiǎng qù bāngmáng, dàn nàge nánrén méiyǒu kàn tā.
sentences.english: Li Ming wanted to help, but the man did not look at him.

sentences.chinese: 李明觉得这像是在开玩笑。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng juédé zhè xiàng shì zài kāiwánxiào.
sentences.english: Li Ming felt that this was like a joke.

sentences.chinese: 他走进一家餐厅，看到人们在吃饭。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu jìn yī jiā cāntǐng, kàndào rénmen zài chīfàn.
sentences.english: He walked into a restaurant and saw people eating.

sentences.chinese: 桌子上有一杯白色的奶。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng yǒu yī bēi báisè de nǎi.
sentences.english: There was a glass of white milk on the table.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个声音在他耳边响起。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yī gè shēngyīn zài tā ěrbiān xiǎngqǐ.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a voice sounded in his ear.

sentences.chinese: “你不能在这里休息。”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ bùnéng zài zhèlǐ xiūxi.”
sentences.english: "You cannot rest here."

sentences.chinese: 李明回头看，发现一个穿白衣服的人走了出来。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng huítóu kàn, fāxiàn yī gè chuān bái yīfú de rén zǒu le chūlái.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked back and found a person in white clothes coming out.

sentences.chinese: 那个人说：“现在是上课时间，你为什么不在教室？”
sentences.pinyin: Nàge rén shuō: “Xiànzài shì shàngkè shíjiān, nǐ wèishéme bù zài jiàoshì?”
sentences.english: That person said, "It is class time now, why are you not in the classroom?"

sentences.chinese: 李明很惊讶，他问：“我应该回哪里去？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng hěn jīngyà, tā wèn: “Wǒ yīnggāi huí nǎlǐ qù?”
sentences.english: Li Ming was surprised and asked, "Where should I go back to?"

sentences.chinese: 那个人说：“回去，快回去！”
sentences.pinyin: Nàge rén shuō: “Huíqù, kuài huíqù!”
sentences.english: That person said, "Go back, go back quickly!"

sentences.chinese: 李明没有回去，他打开了那个本子。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng méiyǒu huíqù, tā dǎkāi le nàge běnzi.
sentences.english: Li Ming did not go back; he opened that notebook.

sentences.chinese: 本子上写着：寻找真正的飞机。
sentences.pinyin: Běnzi shàng xiězhe: Xúnzhǎo zhēnzhèng de fēijī.
sentences.english: It was written in the notebook: Search for the real airplane.

sentences.chinese: 在这个模拟世界里，没有真正的飞机。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège mónǐ shìjiè lǐ, méiyǒu zhēnzhèng de fēijī.
sentences.english: In this simulated world, there are no real airplanes.

sentences.chinese: 李明决定出城看看。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng juédìng chū chéng kànkàn.
sentences.english: Li Ming decided to go out of the city to see.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一辆奇怪的车，他赶紧上车。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào yī liàng qíguài de chē, tā gǎnjǐn shàngchē.
sentences.english: He saw a strange car and quickly got in.

sentences.chinese: 车子开始动了，速度非常快。
sentences.pinyin: Chēzi kāishǐ dòng le, sùdù fēicháng kuài.
sentences.english: The car started to move, and the speed was very fast.

sentences.chinese: 他不知道这个机器怎么工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zhīdào zhège jīqì zěnme gōngzuò.
sentences.english: He did not know how this machine worked.

sentences.chinese: 他想得到真正的答案。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng dédào zhēnzhèng de dá'àn.
sentences.english: He wanted to obtain the real answer.

sentences.chinese: 车子在城市边缘停了下来，他下车了。
sentences.pinyin: Chēzi zài chéngshì biānyuán tíng le xiàlái, tā xiàchē le.
sentences.english: The car stopped at the edge of the city, and he got off.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一个男人在下班，看起来很累。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào yī gè nánrén zài xiàbān, kàn qǐlái hěn lèi.
sentences.english: He saw a man finishing work, who looked very tired.

sentences.chinese: 那个男人告诉他：“这里是模拟世界的尽头。”
sentences.pinyin: Nàge nánrén gàosù tā: “Zhèlǐ shì mónǐ shìjiè de jìntóu.”
sentences.english: That man told him, "This is the end of the simulated world."

sentences.chinese: 李明准备离开这里，寻找真实的自己。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zhǔnbèi líkāi zhèlǐ, xúnzhǎo zhēnshí de zìjǐ.
sentences.english: Li Ming prepared to leave this place to find his true self.

sentences.chinese: 突然，天空出现了一个巨大的红色按钮。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, tiānkōng chūxiàn le yī gè jùdà de hóngsè ànniǔ.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a giant red button appeared in the sky.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 11: The World Behind the Button

sentences.chinese: 李明看着天空那个巨大的红色按钮。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kàn zhe tiān kōng nà gè jù dà de hóng sè àn niǔ.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked at that giant red button in the sky.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得很奇怪，因为这个世界不应该是这样的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué de hěn qí guài, yīn wèi zhè gè shì jiè bù yīng gāi shì zhè yàng de.
sentences.english: He felt it was very strange, because this world should not be like this.

sentences.chinese: 他决定走过去，看看按钮后面有什么。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué dìng zǒu guò qù, kàn kàn àn niǔ hòu miàn yǒu shén me.
sentences.english: He decided to walk over and see what was behind the button.

sentences.chinese: 他开始走路，走在一条很长的马路上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kāi shǐ zǒu lù, zǒu zài yī tiáo hěn cháng de mǎ lù shàng.
sentences.english: He began to walk, walking on a very long street.

sentences.chinese: 路边没有车，只有一些发光的蓝色树。
sentences.pinyin: Lù biān méi yǒu chē, zhǐ yǒu yī xiē fā guāng de lán sè shù.
sentences.english: There were no cars by the road, only some glowing blue trees.

sentences.chinese: 天气突然变得很热，像是在火星上一样。
sentences.pinyin: Tiān qì tū rán biàn de hěn rè, xiàng shì zài huǒ xīng shàng yī yàng.
sentences.english: The weather suddenly became very hot, as if he were on Mars.

sentences.chinese: 李明看见一个奇怪的站，那里有一个机器人。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kàn jiàn yī gè qí guài de zhàn, nà lǐ yǒu yī gè jī qì rén.
sentences.english: Li Ming saw a strange station, where there was a robot.

sentences.chinese: 那个机器人穿着一件白色的衣服，像一个医生。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè jī qì rén chuān zhe yī jiàn bái sè de yī fú, xiàng yī gè yī shēng.
sentences.english: That robot was wearing a white piece of clothing, like a doctor.

sentences.chinese: 机器人说：“你终于来到这里了。”
sentences.pinyin: Jī qì rén shuō: “Nǐ zhōng yú lái dào zhè lǐ le.”
sentences.english: The robot said, "You have finally arrived here."

sentences.chinese: 李明问：“你是谁？你认识我吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng wèn: “Nǐ shì shuí? Nǐ rèn shi wǒ ma?”
sentences.english: Li Ming asked, "Who are you? Do you know me?"

sentences.chinese: 机器人笑了，说：“我知道你在读书，但你的书是假的。”
sentences.pinyin: Jī qì rén xiào le, shuō: “Wǒ zhī dào nǐ zài dú shū, dàn nǐ de shū shì jiǎ de.”
sentences.english: The robot smiled and said, "I know you are studying, but your books are fake."

sentences.chinese: 李明感到很生气，因为他不想在模拟世界里生活。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng gǎn dào hěn shēng qì, yīn wèi tā bù xiǎng zài mó nǐ shì jiè lǐ shēng huó.
sentences.english: Li Ming felt very angry because he did not want to live in a simulated world.

sentences.chinese: 机器人告诉他，这个世界的人不需要睡觉。
sentences.pinyin: Jī qì rén gào su tā, zhè gè shì jiè de rén bù xū yào shuì jiào.
sentences.english: The robot told him that the people in this world do not need to sleep.

sentences.chinese: 他们不需要起床，也不需要每天穿衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men bù xū yào qǐ chuáng, yě bù xū yào měi tiān chuān yī fú.
sentences.english: They do not need to get out of bed, nor do they need to put on clothes every day.

sentences.chinese: 他们不需要看病，因为他们没有身体。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men bù xū yào kàn bìng, yīn wèi tā men méi yǒu shēn tǐ.
sentences.english: They do not need to visit a doctor because they have no bodies.

sentences.chinese: 他们只是在玩儿，比如在虚拟空间里打球。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zhǐ shì zài wán r, bǐ rú zài xū nǐ kōng jiān lǐ dǎ qiú.
sentences.english: They just play, for example, playing ball in virtual space.

sentences.chinese: 机器人说：“在这个世界，你可以永远放假。”
sentences.pinyin: Jī qì rén shuō: “Zài zhè gè shì jiè, nǐ kě yǐ yǒng yuǎn fàng jià.”
sentences.english: The robot said, "In this world, you can have a holiday forever."

sentences.chinese: 李明摇摇头，他说：“我想见真实的自己。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng yáo tóu, tā shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng jiàn zhēn shí de zì jǐ.”
sentences.english: Li Ming shook his head and said, "I want to see the real me."

sentences.chinese: 机器人叹了口气，指了指那个红色按钮。
sentences.pinyin: Jī qì rén tàn le yī kǒu qì, zhǐ le zhǐ nà gè hóng sè àn niǔ.
sentences.english: The robot sighed and pointed to that red button.

sentences.chinese: “这是一个着，一个离开这里的机会。”
sentences.pinyin: “Zhè shì yī gè zhāo, yī gè lí kāi zhè lǐ de jī huì.”
sentences.english: "This is a move, a chance to leave this place."

sentences.chinese: 李明走近按钮，把它放进自己的记忆里。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zǒu jìn àn niǔ, bǎ tā fàng jìn zì jǐ de jì yì lǐ.
sentences.english: Li Ming walked close to the button and placed it into his memory.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果能跟真实的家人见面，那就太好了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rú guǒ néng gēn zhēn shí de jiā rén jiàn miàn, nà jiù tài hǎo le.
sentences.english: He thought that if he could meet his real family, that would be great.

sentences.chinese: 他感觉到身体在起，像是在飞一样。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎn jué dào shēn tǐ zài qǐ, xiàng shì zài fēi yī yàng.
sentences.english: He felt his body rising, as if he were flying.

sentences.chinese: 他慢慢地站起来，看着周围的世界开始消失。
sentences.pinyin: Tā màn màn de zhàn qǐ lái, kàn zhe zhōu wéi de shì jiè kāi shǐ xiāo shī.
sentences.english: He slowly stood up, watching the surrounding world begin to disappear.

sentences.chinese: 他闭上眼，像是在睡一个很长的觉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì shàng yǎn, xiàng shì zài shuì yī gè hěn cháng de jiào.
sentences.english: He closed his eyes, as if he were sleeping a very long sleep.

sentences.chinese: 他不再走，而是等待着光芒出现。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zài zǒu, ér shì děng dài zhe guāng máng chū xiàn.
sentences.english: He no longer walked, but waited for the light to appear.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他听到一个声音在喊他的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, tā tīng dào yī gè shēng yīn zài hǎn tā de míng zi.
sentences.english: Suddenly, he heard a voice calling his name.

sentences.chinese: 他睁开眼，发现自己在一个冷冷的金属房间里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhēng kāi yǎn, fā xiàn zì jǐ zài yī gè lěng lěng de jīn shǔ fáng jiān lǐ.
sentences.english: He opened his eyes and found himself in a cold metal room.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 12: Directions of the Metal City

sentences.chinese: 李明在冷冷的金属房间里睁开眼。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zài lěng lěng de jīn shǔ fáng jiān lǐ zhēng kāi yǎn.
sentences.english: Li Ming opened his eyes in the cold metal room.

sentences.chinese: 他看到地上有一个小本子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào dì shang yǒu yī gè xiǎo běn zi.
sentences.english: He saw a small notebook on the ground.

sentences.chinese: 这个地方很奇怪，没有窗户。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè dì fāng hěn qí guài, méi yǒu chuāng hu.
sentences.english: This place was very strange; there were no windows.

sentences.chinese: 他看向房间的中间，有一个发光的屏幕。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng fáng jiān de zhōng jiān, yǒu yī gè fā guāng de píng mù.
sentences.english: He looked at the middle of the room, where there was a glowing screen.

sentences.chinese: 屏幕上写着：现在是下午两点。
sentences.pinyin: Píng mù shàng xiě zhe: xiàn zài shì xià wǔ liǎng diǎn.
sentences.english: The screen said: It is now 2 p.m.

sentences.chinese: 李明走到屏幕前，想知道自己在哪里。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zǒu dào píng mù qián, xiǎng zhī dào zì jǐ zài nǎ lǐ.
sentences.english: Li Ming walked to the front of the screen, wanting to know where he was.

sentences.chinese: 屏幕显示，他在一个巨大的金属城市里。
sentences.pinyin: Píng mù xiǎn shì, tā zài yī gè jù dà de jīn shǔ chéng shì lǐ.
sentences.english: The screen showed that he was in a huge metal city.

sentences.chinese: 这个城市很大，东边是工厂，西边是实验室。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè chéng shì hěn dà, dōng bian shì gōng chǎng, xī bian shì shí yàn shì.
sentences.english: This city was very large; to the east were factories, and to the west were laboratories.

sentences.chinese: 北边有很高的塔，南边是深黑色的海。
sentences.pinyin: Běi bian yǒu hěn gāo de tǎ, nán bian shì shēn hēi sè de hǎi.
sentences.english: To the north were very high towers, and to the south was a deep black sea.

sentences.chinese: 李明看向左边，那里有一扇门。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kàn xiàng zuǒ bian, nà lǐ yǒu yī shàn mén.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked to the left; there was a door there.

sentences.chinese: 他看向右边，那里只有一面墙。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng yòu bian, nà lǐ zhǐ yǒu yī miàn qiáng.
sentences.english: He looked to the right; there was only a wall there.

sentences.chinese: 他在墙的旁边发现了一个按钮。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài qiáng de páng biān fā xiàn le yī gè àn niǔ.
sentences.english: He found a button beside the wall.

sentences.chinese: 他按下按钮，门开了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā àn xià àn niǔ, mén kāi le.
sentences.english: He pressed the button, and the door opened.

sentences.chinese: 他走到门的前边，发现外边是一个长长的走廊。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu dào mén de qián bian, fā xiàn wài bian shì yī gè cháng cháng de zǒu láng.
sentences.english: He walked to the front of the door and found that outside was a long corridor.

sentences.chinese: 走廊的上边有红色的灯在闪。
sentences.pinyin: Zǒu láng de shàng bian yǒu hóng sè de dēng zài shǎn.
sentences.english: Above the corridor, red lights were flashing.

sentences.chinese: 走廊的下边是透明的玻璃，可以看到下面的云。
sentences.pinyin: Zǒu láng de xià bian shì tòu míng de bō lí, kě yǐ kàn dào xià miàn de yún.
sentences.english: Below the corridor was transparent glass, through which the clouds below could be seen.

sentences.chinese: 李明一边走，一边思考这个世界的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng yī biān zǒu, yī biān sī kǎo zhè gè shì jiè de mì mì.
sentences.english: Li Ming walked while thinking about the secrets of this world.

sentences.chinese: 他想，这里是不是一个外国的秘密基地？
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, zhè lǐ shì bù shì yī gè wài guó de mì mì jī dì?
sentences.english: He wondered, is this a secret base of a foreign country?

sentences.chinese: 或者，这是一个在国外建立的太空站？
sentences.pinyin: Huò zhě, zhè shì yī gè zài guó wài jiàn lì de tài kōng zhàn?
sentences.english: Or, is this a space station built abroad?

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这个地方像是一个外国的实验室。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué de zhè gè dì fāng xiàng shì yī gè wài guó de shí yàn shì.
sentences.english: He felt this place was like a foreign laboratory.

sentences.chinese: 他走在路上，感觉这里离真实的家很远。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu zài lù shang, gǎn jué zhè lǐ lí zhēn shí de jiā hěn yuǎn.
sentences.english: Walking on the road, he felt this place was far from his real home.

sentences.chinese: 他看向走廊的后边，有一个黑色的影子在跟着他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng zǒu láng de hòu bian, yǒu yī gè hēi sè de yǐng zi zài gēn zhe tā.
sentences.english: He looked behind the corridor and saw a black shadow following him.

sentences.chinese: 那个影子在右边出现，然后又在左边出现。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè yǐng zi zài yòu bian chū xiàn, rán hòu yòu zài zuǒ bian chū xiàn.
sentences.english: That shadow appeared on the right, and then appeared on the left.

sentences.chinese: 李明快步走到走廊的西边，那里有一个出口。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kuài bù zǒu dào zǒu láng de xī bian, nà lǐ yǒu yī gè chū kǒu.
sentences.english: Li Ming walked quickly to the west side of the corridor, where there was an exit.

sentences.chinese: 他走出房间，看到天空中有东西在飞。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu chū fáng jiān, kàn dào tiān kōng zhōng yǒu dōng xī zài fēi.
sentences.english: He walked out of the room and saw things flying in the sky.

sentences.chinese: 那些东西在东边和西边之间飞来飞去。
sentences.pinyin: Nà xiē dōng xī zài dōng bian hé xī bian zhī jiān fēi lái fēi qù.
sentences.english: Those things were flying back and forth between the east and the west.

sentences.chinese: 现在已经是晚上了，天空变成了紫色。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài yǐ jīng shì wǎn shang le, tiān kōng biàn chéng le zǐ sè.
sentences.english: It was already evening, and the sky had turned purple.

sentences.chinese: 他看向那边，发现有一个人在等他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng nà bian, fā xiàn yǒu yī gè rén zài děng tā.
sentences.english: He looked over there and found a person waiting for him.

sentences.chinese: 在这个空间间，他终于见到了真正的冷先生。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè gè kōng jiān jiān, tā zhōng yú jiàn dào le zhēn zhèng de Lěng xiān sheng.
sentences.english: Within this space, he finally met the real Mr. Leng.

sentences.chinese: 冷先生说：“欢迎来到真实的世界。”
sentences.pinyin: Lěng xiān sheng shuō: “Huān yíng lái dào zhēn shí de shì jiè.”
sentences.english: Mr. Leng said, "Welcome to the real world."

chapters.title_english: Chapter 13: The Council of the Real World

sentences.chinese: 李明看着冷先生，感到很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kànzhe Lěng Xiānshēng, gǎndào hěn qíguài.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked at Mr. Leng and felt very strange.

sentences.chinese: 冷先生带他走进一栋巨大的金属建筑。
sentences.pinyin: Lěng Xiānshēng dài tā zǒujìn yī dòng jùdà de jīnshǔ jiànzhù.
sentences.english: Mr. Leng led him into a huge metal building.

sentences.chinese: 这里不是模拟世界，这里是真实的世界。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ bùshì mónǐ shìjiè, zhèlǐ shì zhēnshí de shìjiè.
sentences.english: This was not the simulated world; this was the real world.

sentences.chinese: 在这个房间里，坐着三十个人。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège fángjiān lǐ, zuòzhe sānshí gè rén.
sentences.english: In this room, thirty people were sitting.

sentences.chinese: 他们是这个世界的领导者。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen shì zhège shìjiè de lǐngdǎozhě.
sentences.english: They were the leaders of this world.

sentences.chinese: 冷先生说：“他们都在等你。”
sentences.pinyin: Lěng Xiānshēng shuō: “Tāmen dōu zài děng nǐ.”
sentences.english: Mr. Leng said, "They are all waiting for you."

sentences.chinese: 这些人每一个都有一个奇怪的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē rén měi yī gè dōu yǒu yī gè qíguài de míngzì.
sentences.english: Each of these people had a strange name.

sentences.chinese: 第一个人叫三，他看起来很严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Dì yī gè rén jiào Sān, tā kàn qǐlái hěn yánsù.
sentences.english: The first person was named San; he looked very serious.

sentences.chinese: 第二个人叫东，他正在看地图。
sentences.pinyin: Dì èr gè rén jiào Dōng, tā zhèngzài kàn dìtú.
sentences.english: The second person was named Dong; he was looking at a map.

sentences.chinese: 第三个人叫中，他来自一个古老的城市。
sentences.pinyin: Dì sān gè rén jiào Zhōng, tā láizì yī gè gǔlǎo de chéngshì.
sentences.english: The third person was named Zhong; he came from an ancient city.

sentences.chinese: 第四个人叫也，他在点头。
sentences.pinyin: Dì sì gè rén jiào Yě, tā zài diǎntóu.
sentences.english: The fourth person was named Ye; he was nodding.

sentences.chinese: 第五个人叫元，他穿着一件旧衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Dì wǔ gè rén jiào Yuán, tā chuānzhe yī jiàn jiù yīfú.
sentences.english: The fifth person was named Yuan; he was wearing old clothes.

sentences.chinese: 第六个人叫关，他在看李明。
sentences.pinyin: Dì liù gè rén jiào Guān, tā zài kàn Lǐ Míng.
sentences.english: The sixth person was named Guan; he was looking at Li Ming.

sentences.chinese: 第七个人叫别，他在说话。
sentences.pinyin: Dì qī gè rén jiào Bié, tā zài shuōhuà.
sentences.english: The seventh person was named Bie; he was speaking.

sentences.chinese: 第八个人叫包，他拿着一个黑色的本子。
sentences.pinyin: Dì bā gè rén jiào Bāo, tā názhe yī gè hēisè de běnzi.
sentences.english: The eighth person was named Bao; he was holding a black notebook.

sentences.chinese: 第九个人叫后，他坐在最后面。
sentences.pinyin: Dì jiǔ gè rén jiào Hòu, tā zuò zài zuì hòumiàn.
sentences.english: The ninth person was named Hou; he sat at the very back.

sentences.chinese: 第十个人叫国，他非常高大。
sentences.pinyin: Dì shí gè rén jiào Guó, tā fēicháng gāodà.
sentences.english: The tenth person was named Guo; he was very tall.

sentences.chinese: 第十一个人叫坐，他没有动。
sentences.pinyin: Dì shí yī gè rén jiào Zuò, tā méiyǒu dòng.
sentences.english: The eleventh person was named Zuo; he did not move.

sentences.chinese: 第十二个人叫山，他的脸像石头一样。
sentences.pinyin: Dì shí èr gè rén jiào Shān, tā de liǎn xiàng shítou yīyàng.
sentences.english: The twelfth person was named Shan; his face was like stone.

sentences.chinese: 第十三个人叫左，他在看左边的窗户。
sentences.pinyin: Dì shí sān gè rén jiào Zuǒ, tā zài kàn zuǒbiān de chuānghu.
sentences.english: The thirteenth person was named Zuo; he was looking at the window on the left.

sentences.chinese: 第十四个人叫常，他经常微笑。
sentences.pinyin: Dì shí sì gè rén jiào Cháng, tā jīngcháng wēixiào.
sentences.english: The fourteenth person was named Chang; he smiled often.

sentences.chinese: 第十五个人叫教，他像一个老师。
sentences.pinyin: Dì shí wǔ gè rén jiào Jiào, tā xiàng yī gè lǎoshī.
sentences.english: The fifteenth person was named Jiao; he was like a teacher.

sentences.chinese: 第十六个人叫新，他拿着一个发光的设备。
sentences.pinyin: Dì shí liù gè rén jiào Xīn, tā názhe yī gè fāguāng de shèbèi.
sentences.english: The sixteenth person was named Xin; he was holding a glowing device.

sentences.chinese: 第十七个人叫楼，他来自高处的城市。
sentences.pinyin: Dì shí qī gè rén jiào Lóu, tā láizì gāochù de chéngshì.
sentences.english: The seventeenth person was named Lou; he came from the high-altitude city.

sentences.chinese: 第十八个人叫毛，他在思考。
sentences.pinyin: Dì shí bā gè rén jiào Máo, tā zài sīkǎo.
sentences.english: The eighteenth person was named Mao; he was thinking.

sentences.chinese: 第十九个人叫水，他的眼睛很亮。
sentences.pinyin: Dì shí jiǔ gè rén jiào Shuǐ, tā de yǎnjīng hěn liàng.
sentences.english: The nineteenth person was named Shui; his eyes were very bright.

sentences.chinese: 第二十个人叫班，他穿着制服。
sentences.pinyin: Dì èrshí gè rén jiào Bān, tā chuānzhe zhìfú.
sentences.english: The twentieth person was named Ban; he was wearing a uniform.

sentences.chinese: 第二十一个人叫白，他的头发是白色的。
sentences.pinyin: Dì èrshí yī gè rén jiào Bái, tā de tóufa shì báisè de.
sentences.english: The twenty-first person was named Bai; his hair was white.

sentences.chinese: 第二十二个人叫百，他在数数字。
sentences.pinyin: Dì èrshí èr gè rén jiào Bǎi, tā zài shǔ shùzì.
sentences.english: The twenty-second person was named Bai; he was counting numbers.

sentences.chinese: 第二十三个人叫花，他的衣服有很多颜色。
sentences.pinyin: Dì èrshí sān gè rén jiào Huā, tā de yīfú yǒu hěnduō yánsè.
sentences.english: The twenty-third person was named Hua; his clothes had many colors.

sentences.chinese: 第二十四个人叫路，他指着远方。
sentences.pinyin: Dì èrshí sì gè rén jiào Lù, tā zhǐzhe yuǎnfāng.
sentences.english: The twenty-fourth person was named Lu; he pointed to the distance.

sentences.chinese: 第二十五个人叫过，他走到了李明面前。
sentences.pinyin: Dì èrshí wǔ gè rén jiào Guò, tā zǒu dào le Lǐ Míng miànqián.
sentences.english: The twenty-fifth person was named Guo; he walked up to Li Ming.

sentences.chinese: 第二十六个人叫还，他问李明是谁。
sentences.pinyin: Dì èrshí liù gè rén jiào Huán, tā wèn Lǐ Míng shì shuí.
sentences.english: The twenty-sixth person was named Huan; he asked who Li Ming was.

sentences.chinese: 第二十七个人叫都，他看着所有人。
sentences.pinyin: Dì èrshí qī gè rén jiào Dū, tā kànzhe suǒyǒu rén.
sentences.english: The twenty-seventh person was named Du; he looked at everyone.

sentences.chinese: 第二十八个人叫钱，他关心这个世界的资源。
sentences.pinyin: Dì èrshí bā gè rén jiào Qián, tā guānxīn zhège shìjiè de zīyuán.
sentences.english: The twenty-eighth person was named Qian; he cared about the world's resources.

sentences.chinese: 第二十九个人叫错，他说模拟世界出错了。
sentences.pinyin: Dì èrshí jiǔ gè rén jiào Cuò, tā shuō mónǐ shìjiè chūcuò le.
sentences.english: The twenty-ninth person was named Cuo; he said the simulated world had an error.

sentences.chinese: 第三十个人叫门，他守在出口那里。
sentences.pinyin: Dì sānshí gè rén jiào Mén, tā shǒu zài chūkǒu nàlǐ.
sentences.english: The thirtieth person was named Men; he stood guard at the exit.

sentences.chinese: 最后一个人叫高，他站了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Zuìhòu yī gè rén jiào Gāo, tā zhàn le qǐlái.
sentences.english: The last person was named Gao; he stood up.

sentences.chinese: 高说：“李明，你终于回来了。”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo shuō: “Lǐ Míng, nǐ zhōngyú huílái le.”
sentences.english: Gao said, "Li Ming, you have finally returned."

sentences.chinese: 李明很惊讶，他问：“你们是谁？为什么在这里？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng hěn jīngyà, tā wèn: “Nǐmen shì shuí? Wèishéme zài zhèlǐ?”
sentences.english: Li Ming was surprised and asked, "Who are you? Why are you here?"

sentences.chinese: 高告诉他，这些人都不是普通的人。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo gàosu tā, zhèxiē rén dōu bùshì pǔtōng de rén.
sentences.english: Gao told him that these people were not ordinary humans.

sentences.chinese: 他们是真实世界的守护者。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen shì zhēnshí shìjiè de shǒuhùzhě.
sentences.english: They were the guardians of the real world.

sentences.chinese: 他们一直在等待一个能离开模拟世界的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen yīzhí zài děngdài yī gè néng líkāi mónǐ shìjiè de rén.
sentences.english: They had been waiting for someone who could leave the simulated world.

sentences.chinese: 现在，李明就是那个人。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài, Lǐ Míng jiùshì nà gè rén.
sentences.english: Now, Li Ming was that person.

sentences.chinese: 但是，高看向门外，脸色突然变了。
sentences.pinyin: Dànshì, Gāo kàn xiàng mén wài, liǎnsè tūrán biàn le.
sentences.english: However, Gao looked outside the door, and his expression suddenly changed.

sentences.chinese: 他低声说：“他们来了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dīshēng shuō: “Tāmen lái le.”
sentences.english: He whispered, "They have come."

sentences.chinese: 门开了，一群人走进来。
sentences.pinyin: Mén kāi le, yī qún rén zǒu jìn lái.
sentences.english: The door opened, and a group of people walked in.

sentences.chinese: 他们不是机器人，而是真实世界的学生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men bú shì jī qì rén, ér shì zhēn shí shì jiè de xué sheng.
sentences.english: They were not robots, but students of the real world.

sentences.chinese: 其中一个女学生看着李明，她很惊讶。
sentences.pinyin: Qí zhōng yī gè nǚ xué sheng kàn zhe Lǐ Míng, tā hěn jīng yà.
sentences.english: One of the female students looked at Li Ming, and she was very surprised.

sentences.chinese: 她说：“你看起来像个小学生。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ kàn qǐ lái xiàng gè xiǎo xué shēng.”
sentences.english: She said, "You look like a primary school student."

sentences.chinese: 李明觉得很奇怪，因为他在模拟世界里是一个中学生。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng jué de hěn qí guài, yīn wèi tā zài mó nǐ shì jiè lǐ shì yī gè zhōng xué shēng.
sentences.english: Li Ming felt it was strange, because in the simulated world, he was a middle-school student.

sentences.chinese: 那个女生指了指李明的书包，说那是模拟世界的标志。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè nǚ shēng zhǐ le zhǐ Lǐ Míng de shū bāo, shuō nà shì mó nǐ shì jiè de biāo zhì.
sentences.english: The girl pointed to Li Ming's schoolbag, saying it was a symbol of the simulated world.

sentences.chinese: 冷先生告诉他们，李明来自一个特殊的学院。
sentences.pinyin: Lěng xiān sheng gào sù tā men, Lǐ Míng lái zì yī gè tè shū de xué yuàn.
sentences.english: Mr. Leng told them that Li Ming came from a special academy.

sentences.chinese: 在这个真实的国家，人们不再去小学或者中学。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè gè zhēn shí guó jiā, rén men bù zài qù xiǎo xué huò zhě zhōng xué.
sentences.english: In this real country, people no longer go to primary school or middle school.

sentences.chinese: 现在的大学生直接在脑海中学习。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài de dà xué shēng zhí jiē zài nǎo hǎi zhōng xué xí.
sentences.english: Today's university students learn directly in their minds.

sentences.chinese: 冷先生带李明走进一间房子。
sentences.pinyin: Lěng xiān sheng dài Lǐ Míng zǒu jìn yī jiān fáng zi.
sentences.english: Mr. Leng led Li Ming into a house.

sentences.chinese: 房间里有一张床，一张桌子，和一个杯子。
sentences.pinyin: Fáng jiān lǐ yǒu yī zhāng chuáng, yī zhāng zhuō zi, hé yī gè bēi zi.
sentences.english: In the room, there was a bed, a table, and a cup.

sentences.chinese: 桌子上放着一个手机，屏幕上有几个汉字。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe yī gè shǒu jī, píng mù shàng yǒu jǐ gè hàn zì.
sentences.english: A cell phone was placed on the table, with a few Chinese characters on the screen.

sentences.chinese: 李明认不出这些字，因为它们在发光。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng rèn bù chū zhè xiē zì, yīn wèi tā men zài fā guāng.
sentences.english: Li Ming could not recognize these characters because they were glowing.

sentences.chinese: 冷先生说：“这些字是真实的语言，不是模拟世界的代码。”
sentences.pinyin: Lěng xiān sheng shuō: “Zhè xiē zì shì zhēn shí de yǔ yán, bú shì mó nǐ shì jiè de dài mǎ.”
sentences.english: Mr. Leng said, "These characters are the real language, not the code of the simulated world."

sentences.chinese: 李明想起了他在模拟世界的同学。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xiǎng qǐ le tā zài mó nǐ shì jiè lǐ de tóng xué.
sentences.english: Li Ming thought of his classmates in the simulated world.

sentences.chinese: 在那里，他们每天在教学楼里学习。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nà lǐ, tā men měi tiān zài jiào xué lóu lǐ xué xí.
sentences.english: There, they studied in the teaching block every day.

sentences.chinese: 他们会一起去商店买东西，或者去商场玩。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men huì yī qǐ qù shāng diàn mǎi dōng xī, huò zhě qù shāng chǎng wán.
sentences.english: They would go to stores to buy things together, or go to the shopping mall to play.

sentences.chinese: 那些日子虽然是假的，但李明现在觉得很怀念。
sentences.pinyin: Nà xiē rì zi suī rán shì jiǎ de, dàn Lǐ Míng xiàn zài jué de hěn huái niàn.
sentences.english: Although those days were fake, Li Ming now felt a sense of nostalgia.

sentences.chinese: “你以前在模拟世界里住在北京吗？”那个女生问。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ yǐ qián zài mó nǐ shì jiè lǐ zhù zài Běi jīng ma?” nà gè nǚ shēng wèn.
