sentences.english: "Did you live in Beijing in the simulated world before?" the girl asked.

sentences.chinese: 李明点头说：“是的，那里有很多汽车。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng diǎn tóu shuō: “Shì de, nà lǐ yǒu hěn duō qì chē.”
sentences.english: Li Ming nodded and said, "Yes, there were many cars there."

sentences.chinese: 冷先生给李明一份晚饭，食物味道非常好，很好吃。
sentences.pinyin: Lěng xiān sheng gěi Lǐ Míng yī fèn wǎn fàn, shí wù wèi dào fēi cháng hǎo, hěn hǎo chī.
sentences.english: Mr. Leng gave Li Ming a dinner; the food tasted very good, it was delicious.

sentences.chinese: 李明吃得很开心，他感到很高兴能来到这里。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng chī de hěn kāi xīn, tā gǎn dào hěn gāo xìng néng lái dào zhè lǐ.
sentences.english: Li Ming ate happily; he felt very glad to have come here.

sentences.chinese: 但冷先生的脸色突然变得严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn Lěng xiān sheng de liǎn sè tū rán biàn de yán sù.
sentences.english: But Mr. Leng's expression suddenly became serious.

sentences.chinese: 他拿出一张机票，放在桌子上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū yī zhāng jī piào, fàng zài zhuō zi shàng.
sentences.english: He took out an air ticket and placed it on the table.

sentences.chinese: “你必须快点离开这个房子，”冷先生说。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ bì xū kuài diǎn lí kāi zhè gè fáng zi,” Lěng xiān sheng shuō.
sentences.english: "You must leave this house quickly," Mr. Leng said.

sentences.chinese: “守护者们认为你太危险了。”
sentences.pinyin: “Shǒu hù zhě men rèn wéi nǐ tài wēi xiǎn le.”
sentences.english: "The Guardians believe you are too dangerous."

sentences.chinese: 李明看着机票，上面的目的地是一个他从未听过的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kàn zhe jī piào, shàng miàn de mù dì dì shì yī gè tā cóng wèi tīng guò de dì fāng.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked at the air ticket; the destination on it was a place he had never heard of.

sentences.chinese: 突然，房间外的走廊传来了沉重的脚步声。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, fáng jiān wài de zǒu láng chuán lái le chén zhòng de jiǎo bù shēng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, heavy footsteps echoed in the corridor outside the room.

sentences.chinese: 沉重的脚步声在门口停了下来。
sentences.pinyin: Chén zhòng de jiǎo bù shēng zài mén kǒu tíng le xià lái.
sentences.english: The heavy footsteps stopped at the doorway.

sentences.chinese: 冷先生低声说：“快走，去洗手间躲起来！”
sentences.pinyin: Lěng xiān sheng dī shēng shuō: “Kuài zǒu, qù xǐ shǒu jiān duǒ qǐ lái!”
sentences.english: Mr. Leng whispered, "Go quickly, hide in the washroom!"

sentences.chinese: 李明跑进洗手间，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng pǎo jìn xǐ shǒu jiān, xīn tiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Li Ming ran into the washroom, his heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 他看到墙上有一个发光的点。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào qiáng shàng yǒu yī gè fā guāng de diǎn.
sentences.english: He saw a glowing point on the wall.

sentences.chinese: 那个点像一个小球，在空中旋转。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè diǎn xiàng yī gè xiǎo qiú, zài kōng zhōng xuán zhuǎn.
sentences.english: That point was like a small sphere, rotating in the air.

sentences.chinese: 这是真实世界的电能信号。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì zhēn shí shì jiè de diàn néng xìn hào.
sentences.english: This was an electrical energy signal of the real world.

sentences.chinese: 冷先生在他耳边轻声说了一句话。
sentences.pinyin: Lěng xiān sheng zài tā ěr biān qīng shēng shuō le yī jù huà.
sentences.english: Mr. Leng whispered a sentence in his ear.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“这里的一切都像电影一样，但这是真的。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zhè lǐ de yī qiè dōu xiàng diàn yǐng yī yàng, dàn zhè shì zhēn de.”
sentences.english: He said, "Everything here is like a movie, but it is real."

sentences.chinese: 李明想起在模拟世界里，他经常在电影院看电影。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xiǎng qǐ zài mó nǐ shì jiè lǐ, tā jīng cháng zài diàn yǐng yuàn kàn diàn yǐng.
sentences.english: Li Ming remembered that in the simulated world, he often watched movies in the cinema.

sentences.chinese: 在那里，电视和电视机只是简单的机器。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nà lǐ, diàn shì hé diàn shì jī zhǐ shì jiǎn dān de jī qì.
sentences.english: There, televisions and TV sets were just simple machines.

sentences.chinese: 但在这里，电话可以传输人的知识。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zài zhè lǐ, diàn huà kě yǐ chuán shū rén de zhī shi.
sentences.english: But here, telephones can transmit human knowledge.

sentences.chinese: 冷先生给了他一张票。
sentences.pinyin: Lěng xiān sheng gěi le tā yī zhāng piào.
sentences.english: Mr. Leng gave him a ticket.

sentences.chinese: 这张票分很多等，最高等的人可以去远方。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng piào fēn hěn duō děng, zuì gāo děng de rén kě yǐ qù yuǎn fāng.
sentences.english: This ticket is divided into many classes; those of the highest class can go far away.

sentences.chinese: 冷先生还给了他一些肉和菜，还有一点茶。
sentences.pinyin: Lěng xiān sheng hái gěi le tā yī xiē ròu hé cài, hái yǒu yī diǎn chá.
sentences.english: Mr. Leng also gave him some meat and vegetables, and a bit of tea.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“吃点饭，你需要体力。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Chī diǎn fàn, nǐ xū yào tǐ lì.”
sentences.english: He said, "Eat some food, you need strength."

sentences.chinese: 李明看着这些食物，觉得很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kàn zhe zhè xiē shí wù, jué de hěn qí guài.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked at this food and felt it was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 他走出房间，看到走廊里有一行机器人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu chū fáng jiān, kàn dào zǒu láng lǐ yǒu yī háng jī qì rén.
sentences.english: He walked out of the room and saw a row of robots in the corridor.

sentences.chinese: 机器人像在上课一样，整齐地走着。
sentences.pinyin: Jī qì rén xiàng zài shàng kè yī yàng, zhěng qí de zǒu zhe.
sentences.english: The robots were walking orderly, as if they were in a class.

sentences.chinese: 李明快步走到路口，低头看自己的钱包。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kuài bù zǒu dào lù kǒu, dī tóu kàn zì jǐ de qián bāo.
sentences.english: Li Ming walked quickly to the intersection and looked down at his wallet.

sentences.chinese: 钱包里有一张车票。
sentences.pinyin: Qián bāo lǐ yǒu yī zhāng chē piào.
sentences.english: There was a train ticket in the wallet.

sentences.chinese: 他必须在十分钟内到达车站。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì xū zài shí fēn zhōng nèi dào dá chē zhàn.
sentences.english: He must reach the station within ten minutes.

sentences.chinese: 他跑向大门口，风很大，吹在他的脸上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pǎo xiàng dà mén kǒu, fēng hěn dà, chuī zài tā de liǎn shàng.
sentences.english: He ran toward the main gate; the wind was strong, blowing on his face.

sentences.chinese: 他路过一家饭店，那里的人在休息。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lù guò yī jiā fàn diàn, nà lǐ de rén zài xiū xī.
sentences.english: He passed a restaurant where people were resting.

sentences.chinese: 他发现自己还拿着一张门票，那是进入秘密基地的凭证。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn zì jǐ hái ná zhe yī zhāng mén piào, nà shì jìn rù mì mì jī dì de píng zhèng.
sentences.english: He discovered he was still holding an entrance ticket, which was the credential to enter the secret base.

sentences.chinese: 他突然听到电话响了，是冷先生在说话。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tū rán tīng dào diàn huà xiǎng le, shì Lěng xiān sheng zài shuō huà.
sentences.english: Suddenly he heard the phone ring; it was Mr. Leng speaking.

sentences.chinese: 冷先生说：“快跑，他们发现你了！”
sentences.pinyin: Lěng xiān sheng shuō: “Kuài pǎo, tā men fā xiàn nǐ le!”
sentences.english: Mr. Leng said, "Run quickly, they have found you!"

sentences.chinese: 李明回头看，守护者们已经到了。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng huí tóu kàn, shǒu hù zhě men yǐ jīng dào le.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked back, and the Guardians had already arrived.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 16: The Door to the Secret Base

sentences.chinese: 李明跑得很快，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng pǎo de hěn kuài, xīn tiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Li Ming ran very fast, his heart beating very fast.

sentences.chinese: 守护者们在后面，他们像机器一样快。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuhùzhě men zài hòumiàn, tāmen xiàng jīqì yīyàng kuài.
sentences.english: The Guardians were behind him, they were as fast as machines.

sentences.chinese: 李明想，我怎么才能离开这里？
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xiǎng, wǒ zěnme cáinéng líkāi zhèlǐ?
sentences.english: Li Ming thought, how can I leave this place?

sentences.chinese: 他跑进了一条小路，那里很干净，没有一个人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pǎo jìn le yī tiáo xiǎo lù, nàlǐ hěn gānjìng, méiyǒu yī gè rén.
sentences.english: He ran into a small alley; it was very clean, and there was not a single person.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一个不大的门，门上写着“秘密基地”。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào yī gè bù dà de mén, mén shàng xiě zhe “mìmì jīdì”.
sentences.english: He saw a not-too-large door, and on the door it said "Secret Base".

sentences.chinese: 他拿出那张门票，门打开了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū nà zhāng méntiào, mén dǎkāi le.
sentences.english: He took out that ticket, and the door opened.

sentences.chinese: 门里面有两个机器人，他们看着李明。
sentences.pinyin: Mén lǐmiàn yǒu liǎng gè jīqìrén, tāmen kànzhe Lǐ Míng.
sentences.english: Inside the door were two robots, they were looking at Li Ming.

sentences.chinese: 一个机器人问：“你是谁？你要干什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè jīqìrén wèn: “Nǐ shì shuí? Nǐ yào gàn shénme?”
sentences.english: One robot asked: "Who are you? What are you doing?"

sentences.chinese: 李明很害怕，他说：“我有一些事，冷先生让我来这里。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng hěn hàipà, tā shuō: “Wǒ yǒu yīxiē shì, Lěng xiānshēng ràng wǒ lái zhèlǐ.”
sentences.english: Li Ming was very scared, he said: "I have some matters, Mr. Leng told me to come here."

sentences.chinese: 机器人看了他半天，没有说话。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén kàn le tā bàn tiān, méiyǒu shuōhuà.
sentences.english: The robot looked at him for a long time without speaking.

sentences.chinese: 另一个机器人问：“你知道这里有多少秘密吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Lìng yī gè jīqìrén wèn: “Nǐ zhīdào zhèlǐ yǒu duōshǎo mìmì ma?”
sentences.english: Another robot asked: "Do you know how many secrets are here?"

sentences.chinese: 李明摇摇头，他说：“我不知道，但我需要帮助。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng yáo yáotóu, tā shuō: “Wǒ bù zhīdào, dàn wǒ xūyào bāngzhù.”
sentences.english: Li Ming shook his head and said: "I don't know, but I need help."

sentences.chinese: 机器人说：“先在这里等一会儿。”
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén shuō: “Xiān zài zhèlǐ děng yīhuìr.”
sentences.english: The robot said: "Wait here for a moment first."

sentences.chinese: 李明在房间里坐了半个小时。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zài fángjiān lǐ zuò le bàn gè xiǎoshí.
sentences.english: Li Ming sat in the room for half an hour.

sentences.chinese: 他发现这里的墙是白色的，像模拟世界一样。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn zhèlǐ de qiáng shì báisè de, xiàng mónǐ shìjiè yīyàng.
sentences.english: He found that the walls here were white, just like the simulated world.

sentences.chinese: 他想，真实的世界怎么也像模拟世界？
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, zhēnshí de shìjiè zěnme yě xiàng mónǐ shìjiè?
sentences.english: He thought, why does the real world also look like the simulated world?

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个声音在喊：“早！李明！”
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yī gè shēngyīn zài hǎn: “Zǎo! Lǐ Míng!”
sentences.english: At that moment, a voice shouted: "Morning! Li Ming!"

sentences.chinese: 他回头看，是一个年轻的女人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huítóu kàn, shì yī gè niánqīng de nǚrén.
sentences.english: He looked back; it was a young woman.

sentences.chinese: 她问他：“你从哪里来？你是怎么找到这里的？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn tā: “Nǐ cóng nǎlǐ lái? Nǐ shì zěnme zhǎodào zhèlǐ de?”
sentences.english: She asked him: "Where did you come from? How did you find this place?"

sentences.chinese: 李明告诉她他的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng gàosù tā tā de gùshì.
sentences.english: Li Ming told her his story.

sentences.chinese: 女人说：“很多别人都想找这里，但他们找不到。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚrén shuō: “Hěnduō biérén dōu xiǎng zhǎo zhèlǐ, dàn tāmen zhǎo bù dào.”
sentences.english: The woman said: "Many other people wanted to find this place, but they couldn't."

sentences.chinese: 李明问：“这里还有别的秘密吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng wèn: “Zhèlǐ hái yǒu bié de mìmì ma?”
sentences.english: Li Ming asked: "Are there other secrets here?"

sentences.chinese: 女人笑了，她说：“太多了，你现在不能知道。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚrén xiào le, tā shuō: “Tài duō le, nǐ xiànzài bùnéng zhīdào.”
sentences.english: The woman smiled and said: "Too many, you cannot know now."

sentences.chinese: 她看着门外，脸色突然变得不好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe mén wài, liǎnsè tūrán biàn de bù hǎo.
sentences.english: She looked outside the door, and her expression suddenly became bad.

sentences.chinese: 她说：“守护者们就在哪儿，他们快到了！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Shǒuhùzhě men jiù zài nǎ'er, tāmen kuài dào le!”
sentences.english: She said: "The Guardians are right there, they are arriving soon!"

sentences.chinese: 李明问：“我们现在去哪？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng wèn: “Wǒmen xiànzài qù nǎ?”
sentences.english: Li Ming asked: "Where do we go now?"

sentences.chinese: 女人说：“快跟我走，再见，旧的世界！”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚrén shuō: “Kuài gēn wǒ zǒu, zàijiàn, jiù de shìjiè!”
sentences.english: The woman said: "Follow me quickly, goodbye, old world!"

sentences.chinese: 她拉着李明跑向一个发光的通道。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lā zhe Lǐ Míng pǎo xiàng yī gè fāguāng de tōngdào.
sentences.english: She pulled Li Ming and ran toward a glowing passage.

sentences.chinese: 李明和女人跑进了发光的通道。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng hé nǚ rén pǎo jìn le fā guāng de tōng dào.
sentences.english: Li Ming and the woman ran into the glowing passage.

sentences.chinese: 通道里有一些奇怪的光，有些光是红色的，有些是蓝色的。
sentences.pinyin: Tōng dào lǐ yǒu yī xiē qí guài de guāng, yǒu xiē guāng shì hóng sè de, yǒu xiē shì lán sè de.
sentences.english: Inside the passage, there were some strange lights; some were red, and some were blue.

sentences.chinese: 女人停下来，认真地看着李明。
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ rén tíng xià lái, rèn zhēn de kàn zhe Lǐ Míng.
sentences.english: The woman stopped and looked at Li Ming earnestly.

sentences.chinese: 她说：“您现在明白了吗？这个世界非常危险。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nín xiàn zài míng bai le ma? Zhè ge shì jiè fēi cháng wēi xiǎn.”
sentences.english: She said, "Do you understand now? This world is very dangerous."

sentences.chinese: 李明问：“谁在追我们？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng wèn: “Shéi zài zhuī wǒ men?”
sentences.english: Li Ming asked, "Who is chasing us?"

sentences.chinese: 女人说：“守护者，他们在这个星系非常有有名。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ rén shuō: “Shǒu hù zhě, tā men zài zhè ge xīng xì fēi cháng yǒu míng.”
sentences.english: The woman said, "The Guardians; they are very famous in this galaxy."

sentences.chinese: 李明觉得这些话很难懂。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng jué de zhè xiē huà hěn nán dǒng.
sentences.english: Li Ming felt these words were hard to understand.

sentences.chinese: 他问：“我们是不是在逃跑？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn: “Wǒ men shì bù shì zài táo pǎo?”
sentences.english: He asked, "Are we escaping?"

sentences.chinese: 女人点头说：“是的，这是最后的机会。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ rén diǎn tóu shuō: “Shì de, zhè shì zuì hòu de jī huì.”
sentences.english: The woman nodded and said, "Yes, this is the final chance."

sentences.chinese: 她告诉李明，她以前是一个网友，在虚拟世界里认识他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su Lǐ Míng, tā yǐ qián shì yī gè wǎng yǒu, zài xū nǐ shì jiè lǐ rèn shi tā.
sentences.english: She told Li Ming that she used to be an online friend who knew him in the virtual world.

sentences.chinese: 她还说，在真实的月球基地，她有一个妹妹。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hái shuō, zài zhēn shí de yuè qiú jī dì, tā yǒu yī gè mèi mei.
sentences.english: She also said that in the real moon base, she has a younger sister.

sentences.chinese: 那个妹妹在四个月前失踪了。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè mèi mei zài sì gè yuè qián shī zōng le.
sentences.english: That younger sister disappeared four months ago.

sentences.chinese: 李明想，这件事非常重要。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xiǎng, zhè jiàn shì fēi cháng zhòng yào.
sentences.english: Li Ming thought that this matter was very important.

sentences.chinese: 通道的墙壁上有许多字，李明试着读这些字。
sentences.pinyin: Tōng dào de qiáng bì shàng yǒu xǔ duō zì, Lǐ Míng shì zhe dú zhè xiē zì.
sentences.english: There were many characters on the walls of the passage, and Li Ming tried to read them.

sentences.chinese: 他读到：“时间是贵重的，不要浪费。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dú dào: “Shí jiān shì guì zhòng de, bù yào làng fèi.”
sentences.english: He read: "Time is precious, do not waste it."

sentences.chinese: 这里的“贵”是指时间比钱更珍贵。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de “guì” shì zhǐ shí jiān bǐ qián gèng zhēn guì.
sentences.english: The word "expensive/precious" here meant that time is more precious than money.

sentences.chinese: 有时候，李明觉得这里像是一个梦。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu shí hou, Lǐ Míng jué de zhè lǐ xiàng shì yī gè mèng.
sentences.english: Sometimes, Li Ming felt that this place was like a dream.

sentences.chinese: 有时，他会想起在模拟世界里的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu shí, tā huì xiǎng qǐ zài mó nǐ shì jiè lǐ de shēng huó.
sentences.english: Now and then, he would think of his life in the simulated world.

sentences.chinese: 在那儿，他每天的生活很像一个星期，没有变化。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nà r, tā měi tiān de shēng huó hěn xiàng yī gè xīng qī, méi yǒu biàn huà.
sentences.english: There, his daily life was like a week, with no changes.

sentences.chinese: 现在已经是很晚了，他们必须快点走。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài yǐ jīng shì hěn wǎn le, tā men bì xū kuài diǎn zǒu.
sentences.english: It was already very late now, and they had to move quickly.

sentences.chinese: 有的通道是空的，有的通道有机器人在等他们。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu de tōng dào shì kōng de, yǒu de tōng dào yǒu jī qì rén zài děng tā men.
sentences.english: Some passages were empty, and some passages had robots waiting for them.

sentences.chinese: 李明问：“我们还是回金属之城吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng wèn: “Wǒ men hái shi huí jīn shǔ zhī chéng ma?”
sentences.english: Li Ming asked, "Are we still going back to the Metal City?"

sentences.chinese: 女人说：“不，那里已经不安全了，还有更多危险。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ rén shuō: “Bù, nà lǐ yǐ jīng bù ān quán le, hái yǒu gèng duō wēi xiǎn.”
sentences.english: The woman said, "No, it is no longer safe there, and there are even more dangers."

sentences.chinese: 李明感到有点害怕，但他说：“没什么，我可以的。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng gǎn dào yǒu diǎn hài pà, dàn tā shuō: “Méi shén me, wǒ kě yǐ de.”
sentences.english: Li Ming felt a bit scared, but he said, "It's nothing, I can do it."

sentences.chinese: 女人看着他，脸上露出了一丝听。
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ rén kàn zhe tā, liǎn shàng lù chū le yī sī tīng.
sentences.english: The woman looked at him, and a slight smile appeared on her face.

sentences.chinese: 她低声说：“你比我想象的要勇敢。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dī shēng shuō: “Nǐ bǐ wǒ xiǎng xiàng de yào yǒng gǎn.”
sentences.english: She whispered, "You are braver than I imagined."

sentences.chinese: 突然，通道的尽头出现了一个巨大的黑洞。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, tōng dào de jìn tóu chū xiàn le yī gè jù dà de hēi dòng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a giant black hole appeared at the end of the passage.

sentences.chinese: 黑洞在他们面前旋转，像一个巨大的眼睛。
sentences.pinyin: Hēi dòng zài tā men miàn qián xuán zhuǎn, xiàng yī gè jù dà de yǎn jīng.
sentences.english: The black hole swirled in front of them, like a giant eye.

sentences.chinese: 女人看着李明，轻声说：“跟我一起走吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ rén kàn zhe Lǐ Míng, qīng shēng shuō: “Gēn wǒ yī qǐ zǒu ba.”
sentences.english: The woman looked at Li Ming and whispered, "Come with me."

sentences.chinese: 李明看向那个黑洞，他知道那里是真实的家。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kàn xiàng nà gè hēi dòng, tā zhī dào nà lǐ shì zhēn shí de jiā.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked at the black hole; he knew that place was his true home.

sentences.chinese: 现在，时间不多了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài, shí jiān bù duō le.
sentences.english: Now, time was running out.

sentences.chinese: 那个女人叫能姐，她是这个世界的守护者。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè nǚ rén jiào Néng jiě, tā shì zhè gè shì jiè de shǒu hù zhě.
sentences.english: That woman was called Sister Neng; she was a guardian of this world.

sentences.chinese: 能姐说：“今天，我们要去一个特殊的地点。”
sentences.pinyin: Néng jiě shuō: “Jīn tiān, wǒ men yào qù yī gè tè shū de dì diǎn.”
sentences.english: Sister Neng said, "Today, we are going to a special location."

sentences.chinese: 李明问：“那里有什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng wèn: “Nà lǐ yǒu shén me?”
sentences.english: Li Ming asked, "What is there?"

sentences.chinese: 能姐回答：“那里有真正的天，有白天的阳光。”
sentences.pinyin: Néng jiě huí dá: “Nà lǐ yǒu zhēn zhèng de tiān, yǒu bái tiān de yáng guāng.”
sentences.english: Sister Neng answered, "There is a real sky there, with the sunlight of daytime."

sentences.chinese: 在模拟世界里，没有真正的白天，只有数字的光。
sentences.pinyin: Zài mó nǐ shì jiè lǐ, méi yǒu zhēn zhèng de bái tiān, zhǐ yǒu shù zì de guāng.
sentences.english: In the simulated world, there was no real daytime, only digital light.

sentences.chinese: 李明觉得身体很沉，他的身体正在发生变化。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng jué de shēn tǐ hěn chén, tā de shēn tǐ zhèng zài fā shēng biàn huà.
sentences.english: Li Ming felt his body was heavy; his body was undergoing a change.

sentences.chinese: 他发现身上有一道光，那是真实世界的标记。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn shēn shang yǒu yī dào guāng, nà shì zhēn shí shì jiè de biāo jì.
sentences.english: He discovered a light on his body, which was the mark of the real world.

sentences.chinese: 这时，远处传来了守护者们的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yuǎn chù chuán lái le shǒu hù zhě men de shēng yīn.
sentences.english: At this moment, the voices of the guardians came from the distance.

sentences.chinese: 她们正在靠近，速度很快。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zhèng zài kào jìn, sù dù hěn kuài.
sentences.english: They were approaching, and their speed was very fast.

sentences.chinese: 李明有些害怕，他跑得太慢了。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng yǒu xiē hài pà, tā pǎo de tài màn le.
sentences.english: Li Ming was a bit scared; he was running too slowly.

sentences.chinese: 能姐拉住他的手说：“没关系，我在这儿帮你。”
sentences.pinyin: Néng jiě lā zhù tā de shǒu shuō: “Méi guān xi, wǒ zài zhè r bāng nǐ.”
sentences.english: Sister Neng grabbed his hand and said, "It doesn't matter, I am here to help you."

sentences.chinese: 李明对她说：“谢谢你，能姐。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng duì tā shuō: “Xiè xiè nǐ, Néng jiě.”
sentences.english: Li Ming said to her, "Thank you, Sister Neng."

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，他不再是一个孤独的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, tā bù zài shì yī gè gū dú de rén.
sentences.english: He realized that he was no longer a lonely person.

sentences.chinese: 我们现在必须马上离开这里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men xiàn zài bì xū mǎ shàng lí kāi zhè lǐ.
sentences.english: We must leave this place immediately now.

sentences.chinese: 他在想，这个时刻对他来说真重要。

sentences.english: The sun was about to go down.

sentences.chinese: 我问朋友：我们还要走多少路？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn péng yǒu: Wǒ men hái yào zǒu duō shǎo lù?
sentences.english: I asked my friend: How much further do we have to walk?

sentences.chinese: 朋友说：我们还差七步就到了。
sentences.pinyin: Péng yǒu shuō: Wǒ men hái chà qī bù jiù dào le.
sentences.english: My friend said: We are only seven steps away.

sentences.chinese: 我们看到一个很小的洞。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men kàn dào yī gè hěn xiǎo de dòng.
sentences.english: We saw a very small hole.

sentences.chinese: 洞里有两本书，还有一些别的古物。
sentences.pinyin: Dòng lǐ yǒu liǎng běn shū, hái yǒu yī xiē bié de gǔ wù.
sentences.english: Inside the hole were two books and some other antiquities.

sentences.chinese: 我心跳很快，因为我知道这些书很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xīn tiào hěn kuài, yīn wèi wǒ zhī dào zhè xiē shū hěn zhòng yào.
sentences.english: My heart beat fast because I knew these books were very important.

sentences.chinese: 这时，远处传来一声巨大的号角声。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yuǎn chù chuán lái yī shēng jù dà de hào jiǎo shēng.
sentences.english: At that moment, a loud sound of a horn came from the distance.

sentences.chinese: 那是皇宫的信号，意味着有紧急的事情发生了。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì huáng gōng de xìn hào, yì wèi zhe yǒu jǐn jí de shì qíng fā shēng le.
sentences.english: That was a signal from the imperial palace, meaning an emergency had occurred.

sentences.chinese: 号角声在古城上空响了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Hàojiǎo shēng zài gǔchéng shàngkōng xiǎng le qǐlái.
sentences.english: The sound of the horn echoed across the sky of the ancient city.

sentences.chinese: 我有些害怕，但我的心跳得更快了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǒuxiē hàipà, dàn wǒ de xīntiào dé gèng kuài le.
sentences.english: I was somewhat afraid, but my heart beat even faster.

sentences.chinese: 在这个第二章的故事里，我必须保护这些书。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège dì èr zhāng de gùshì lǐ, wǒ bìxū bǎohù zhèxiē shū.
sentences.english: In the story of this second chapter, I must protect these books.

sentences.chinese: 这些书真的非常重要。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē shū zhēn de fēicháng zhòngyào.
sentences.english: These books are truly very important.

sentences.chinese: 我看到洞里有一些古老的地图，还有一些金色的笔。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàndào dòng lǐ yǒu yīxiē gǔlǎo de dìtú, hái yǒu yīxiē jīnsè de bǐ.
sentences.english: I saw some ancient maps in the hole, and also some golden brushes.

sentences.chinese: 有的地图是关于山的，有的地图是关于水的。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu de dìtú shì guānyú shān de, yǒu de dìtú shì guānyú shuǐ de.
sentences.english: Some maps were about mountains, and some maps were about water.

sentences.chinese: 我想知道这些地图是什么，但时间没有了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zhīdào zhèxiē dìtú shì shénme, dàn shíjiān méiyǒu le.
sentences.english: I wanted to know what these maps were, but time had run out.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个男人跑了过来。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, yīgè nánrén pǎo le guòlái.
sentences.english: Just then, a man ran over.

sentences.chinese: 他是一个年轻的男使者，穿着皇宫的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì yīgè niánqīng de nán shǐzhě, chuānzhe huánggōng de yīfú.
sentences.english: He was a young male messenger, wearing the clothes of the imperial palace.

sentences.chinese: 他跑得很快，呼吸很重。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pǎo dé hěn kuài, hūxī hěn zhòng.
sentences.english: He ran very fast, his breathing heavy.

sentences.chinese: 他看着我，问我：“你在这里做什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe wǒ, wèn wǒ: “Nǐ zài zhèlǐ zuò shénme?”
sentences.english: He looked at me and asked, "What are you doing here?"

sentences.chinese: 我紧张地看着他，不知道该说什么。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jǐnzhāng de kànzhe tā, bù zhīdào gāi shuō shénme.
sentences.english: I looked at him nervously, not knowing what to say.

sentences.chinese: 我想问他：“你是哪里的使者？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng wèn tā: “Nǐ shì nǎlǐ de shǐzhě?”
sentences.english: I wanted to ask him, "Which place are you a messenger from?"

sentences.chinese: 但他没有时间听我说话。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tā méiyǒu shíjiān tīng wǒ shuōhuà.
sentences.english: But he had no time to listen to me speak.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，皇宫里发生了一些奇怪的事情。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, huánggōng lǐ fāshēng le yīxiē qíguài de shìqíng.
sentences.english: He told me that some strange things had happened in the palace.

sentences.chinese: 有时，人们会听到地底的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒushí, rénmen huì tīngdào dìdǐ de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: Sometimes, people would hear sounds from underground.

sentences.chinese: 他问我有没有看到古老的书。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn wǒ yǒu méiyǒu kàndào gǔlǎo de shū.
sentences.english: He asked me if I had seen any ancient books.

sentences.chinese: 我看着手中的书，心想：这真是一个秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe shǒuzhōng de shū, xīn xiǎng: zhè zhēn shì yīgè mìmì.
sentences.english: I looked at the books in my hand and thought: this is truly a secret.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“没什么好害怕的，请跟我回到皇宫。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “méi shénme hǎo hàipà de, qǐng gēn wǒ huí dào huánggōng.”
sentences.english: He said, "It's nothing to be afraid of, please return to the palace with me."

sentences.chinese: 我的家人在城里的一个小房子里等我。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de jiārén zài chénglǐ de yīgè xiǎo fángzi lǐ děng wǒ.
sentences.english: My family members were waiting for me in a small house in the city.

sentences.chinese: 我想告诉他们这个发现，但使者说这是第一等的大事。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gàosù tāmen zhège fāxiàn, dàn shǐzhě shuō zhè shì dì yī děng de dàshì.
sentences.english: I wanted to tell them about this discovery, but the messenger said this was a first-class matter.

sentences.chinese: 他在纸上写了一个零，告诉我这是秘密代码的开始。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài zhǐ shàng xiě le yīgè líng, gàosù wǒ zhè shì mìmì dàimǎ de kāishǐ.
sentences.english: He wrote a zero on the paper and told me this was the start of the secret code.

sentences.chinese: 我决定跟着他走，因为我知道这会改变我的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ juédìng gēnzhe tā zǒu, yīnwèi wǒ zhīdào zhè huì gǎibiàn wǒ de shēnghuó.
sentences.english: I decided to follow him, because I knew this would change my life.

chapters.title_chinese: 第三章：皇宫的秘密之门
chapters.title_english: Chapter 3: The Secret Gate of the Imperial Palace

sentences.chinese: 我和使者走在去皇宫的路上。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hé shǐzhě zǒu zài qù huánggōng de lùshàng.
sentences.english: The messenger and I walked on the road to the imperial palace.

sentences.chinese: 天空突然变黑，开始下雨了。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānkōng tūrán biàn hēi, kāishǐ xià yǔ le.
sentences.english: The sky suddenly turned dark and it began to rain.

sentences.chinese: 使者给我一把伞，我说：“谢谢您。”
sentences.pinyin: Shǐzhě gěi wǒ yī bǎ sǎn, wǒ shuō: “Xièxiè nín.”
sentences.english: The messenger gave me an umbrella, and I said, "Thank you."

sentences.chinese: 他笑了笑，说：“不客气。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiào le xiào, shuō: “Bù kèqi.”
sentences.english: He smiled and said, "You're welcome."

sentences.chinese: 他说：“不用担心，我们会很快到达。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Bùyòng dānxīn, wǒmen huì hěn kuài dàodá.”
sentences.english: He said, "No need to worry, we will arrive very soon."

sentences.chinese: 我想起那些古老的书，它们现在在我的包里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngqǐ nàxiē gǔlǎo de shū, tāmen xiànzài zài wǒ de bāo lǐ.
sentences.english: I thought of those ancient books; they were now in my bag.

sentences.chinese: 我想在纸上写下我的想法，但雨太大了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zài zhǐ shàng xiě xià wǒ de xiǎngfǎ, dàn yǔ tài dà le.
sentences.english: I wanted to write my thoughts on paper, but the rain was too heavy.

sentences.chinese: 使者看到我不安，他轻轻地笑。
sentences.pinyin: Shǐzhě kàndào wǒ bù'ān, tā qīngqīng de xiào.
sentences.english: Seeing my unease, the messenger smiled gently.

sentences.chinese: 这时，我听到远处有声音。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, wǒ tīngdào yuǎnchù yǒu shēngyīn.
sentences.english: At that moment, I heard a sound in the distance.

sentences.chinese: 我听见有人在唱歌。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tīngjiàn yǒurén zài chànggē.
sentences.english: I heard someone singing a song.

sentences.chinese: 那个声音非常好听，像是在迎接我们。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge shēngyīn fēicháng hǎotīng, xiàng shì zài yíngjiē wǒmen.
sentences.english: That voice was very pleasant to hear, as if it were welcoming us.

sentences.chinese: 我记得父亲说过，皇宫的音乐能让人忘记烦恼。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jìde fùqīn shuōguò, huánggōng de yīnyuè néng ràng rén wàngjì fánnǎo.
sentences.english: I remembered my father saying that the music of the palace could make one forget their troubles.

sentences.chinese: 我不能忘记这个秘密代码，因为它是关键。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bùnéng wàngjì zhège mìmì dàimǎ, yīnwèi tā shì guānjiàn.
sentences.english: I must not forget this secret code, because it is the key.

sentences.chinese: 使者告诉我，他找到了打十二个士兵来保护我们。
sentences.pinyin: Shǐzhě gàosù wǒ, tā zhǎodào le dǎ shí'èr gè shìbīng lái bǎohù wǒmen.
sentences.english: The messenger told me he had found a dozen soldiers to protect us.

sentences.chinese: 虽然在这个时代没有电话，不能打电话，但信件很快。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán zài zhège shídài méiyǒu diànhuà, bùnéng dǎ diànhuà, dàn xìnjiàn hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Although there were no telephones in this era and one could not make a phone call, letters were fast.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，这些古书非常有用。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, zhèxiē gǔshū fēicháng yǒuyòng.
sentences.english: He told me that these ancient books were very useful.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“现在没事儿，我们可以慢慢走。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Xiànzài méishìr, wǒmen kěyǐ mànman zǒu.”
sentences.english: He said, "It's okay now, we can walk slowly."

sentences.chinese: 我不小心踩到了水坑，使者说：“没关系。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎoxīn cǎi dào le shuǐkēng, shǐzhě shuō: “Méiguānxì.”
sentences.english: I accidentally stepped into a puddle, and the messenger said, "It doesn't matter."

sentences.chinese: 当我看到巨大的红门时，我心跳加快了。
sentences.pinyin: Dāng wǒ kàndào jùdà de hóngmén shí, wǒ xīntiào jiākuài le.
sentences.english: When I saw the giant red gate, my heart beat faster.

sentences.chinese: 我记得那个零，那是进入宫殿的钥匙。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jìde nàge líng, nà shì jìnrù gōngdiàn de yàoshi.
sentences.english: I remembered that zero; it was the key to entering the palace.

sentences.chinese: 使者说我必须勇敢，他试图说服我前进。
sentences.pinyin: Shǐzhě shuō wǒ bìxū yǒnggǎn, tā shìtú shuōfú wǒ qiánjìn.
sentences.english: The messenger said I must be brave; he tried to persuade me to move forward.

sentences.chinese: 他读了一段古老的咒语，门缓缓打开了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dú le yī duàn gǔlǎo de zhòuyǔ, mén huǎnhuǎn dǎkāi le.
sentences.english: He read a passage of an ancient spell, and the gate slowly opened.

sentences.chinese: 一只金色的鸟从门后飞了出来，飞向天空。
sentences.pinyin: Yī zhī jīnsè de niǎo cóng mén hòu fēi le chūlái, fēi xiàng tiānkōng.
sentences.english: A golden bird flew out from behind the gate and flew toward the sky.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 4: Deep Within the Imperial Palace

sentences.chinese: 金色的鸟飞走了，使者对我笑了笑。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnsè de niǎo fēi zǒu le, shǐzhě duì wǒ xiào le xiào.
sentences.english: The golden bird flew away, and the messenger smiled at me.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“现在，请进。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Xiànzài, qǐng jìn.”
sentences.english: He said, "Now, please come in."

sentences.chinese: 我小心地走进了那个巨大的红门，我终于进去了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎoxīn de zǒu jìn le nàge jùdà de hóngmén, wǒ zhōngyú jìn qù le.
sentences.english: I carefully walked through the giant red gate; I had finally gone in.

sentences.chinese: 里边是一个非常漂亮的地方，到处都是金色的墙。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐbian shì yīgè fēicháng piàoliang de dìfāng, dàochù dōu shì jīnsè de qiáng.
sentences.english: Inside was a very beautiful place, with golden walls everywhere.

sentences.chinese: 使者带我走到了一个安静的房间。
sentences.pinyin: Shǐzhě dài wǒ zǒu dào le yīgè ānjìng de fángjiān.
sentences.english: The messenger led me to a quiet room.

sentences.chinese: 他对我很有礼貌地说：“您请坐。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì wǒ hěn yǒu lǐmào de shuō: “Nín qǐng zuò.”
sentences.english: He said to me very politely, "You (formal), please have a seat."

sentences.chinese: 我紧张地坐下，心跳依然很快。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jǐnzhāng de zuò xia, xīntiào yīrán hěn kuài.
sentences.english: I sat down nervously, my heart still beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 使者告诉我，这里的每个地方都需要门票，但我是特殊的。
sentences.pinyin: Shǐzhě gàosù wǒ, zhèlǐ de měi gè dìfāng dōu xūyào ménpiào, dàn wǒ shì tèshū de.
sentences.english: The messenger told me that every place here requires an entrance ticket, but I was special.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你不需要门票，因为你拥有那个秘密的零。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ bù xūyào ménpiào, yīnwèi nǐ yōngyǒu nàge mìmì de líng.”
sentences.english: He said, "You (informal) do not need a ticket, because you possess that secret zero."

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个老学者走了进来。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yīgè lǎo xuézhě zǒu le jìnlái.
sentences.english: At that moment, an old scholar walked in.

sentences.chinese: 他看着我说：“进来，孩子，这里是你休息的地方。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe wǒ shuō: “Jìnlái, háizi, zhèlǐ shì nǐ xiūxi de dìfāng.”
sentences.english: He looked at me and said, "Come in, child, this is the place for you to rest."

sentences.chinese: 老学者告诉我，我想回家的话，必须先请假。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo xuézhě gàosù wǒ, wǒ xiǎng huí jiā de huà, bìxū xiān qǐngjià.
sentences.english: The old scholar told me that if I wanted to go home, I must first request a leave of absence.

sentences.chinese: 他指了指楼下，说那里有一辆皇家的马车。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐ le zhǐ lóu xià, shuō nàlǐ yǒu yī liàng huángjiā de mǎchē.
sentences.english: He pointed downstairs and said there was an imperial carriage there.

sentences.chinese: 在古代，开车是指驾驶马车。
sentences.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, kāichē shì zhǐ jiàshǐ mǎchē.
sentences.english: In ancient times, "driving a car" referred to driving a carriage.

sentences.chinese: 使者递给我一张车票，虽然在宫殿里不需要，但这是出城的证明。
sentences.pinyin: Shǐzhě dì gěi wǒ yī zhāng chēpiào, suīrán zài gōngdiàn lǐ bù xūyào, dàn zhè shì chū chéng de zhèngmíng.
sentences.english: The messenger handed me a ticket; although not needed inside the palace, it was proof for leaving the city.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你现在可以上车了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ xiànzài kěyǐ shàng chē le.”
sentences.english: He said, "You can get in the carriage now."

sentences.chinese: 我走在车上，感受到了丝绸的柔软。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǒu zài chē shàng, gǎnshòu dào le sīchóu de róuruǎn.
sentences.english: I stepped onto the carriage and felt the softness of the silk.

sentences.chinese: 但在下车之前，老学者告诉我一个秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zài xià chē zhīqián, lǎo xuézhě gàosù wǒ yīgè mìmì.
sentences.english: But before getting off the carriage, the old scholar told me a secret.

sentences.chinese: 他低声说：“在睡觉之前，不要出去。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dī shēng shuō: “Zài shuìjiào zhīqián, bùyào chūqù.”
sentences.english: He whispered, "Before going to sleep, do not go out."

sentences.chinese: 我听到他的声音里有一个奇怪的上声，像是在警告我。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tīng dào tā de shēngyīn lǐ yǒu yīgè qíguài de shǎngshēng, xiàng shì zài jǐnggào wǒ.
sentences.english: I heard a strange rising tone (shǎngshēng) in his voice, as if he were warning me.

sentences.chinese: 我看着窗外，发现宫殿的门再次关闭了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe chuāngwài, fāxiàn gōngdiàn de mén zàicì guānbì le.
sentences.english: I looked out the window and found that the palace gates had closed once again.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 5: Day and Night in the Forbidden Palace

sentences.chinese: 现在，我住在皇宫的一个小房间里。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài, wǒ zhù zài huánggōng de yī gè xiǎo fángjiān lǐ.
sentences.english: Now, I am living in a small room in the imperial palace.

sentences.chinese: 这是一个很奇怪的地点。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yī gè hěn qíguài de dìdiǎn.
sentences.english: This is a very strange place.

sentences.chinese: 白天，这里很安静，只有风的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Báitiān, zhèlǐ hěn ānjìng, zhǐyǒu fēng de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: During the day, it is very quiet here, with only the sound of the wind.

sentences.chinese: 我看着天空，天是蓝色的。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe tiānkōng, tiān shì lán sè de.
sentences.english: I look at the sky; the sky is blue.

sentences.chinese: 中午，太阳在正中间，光线很强。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōngwǔ, tàiyáng zài zhèng zhōngjiān, guāngxiàn hěn qiáng.
sentences.english: At noon, the sun is right in the middle, and the light is very strong.

sentences.chinese: 我在这里坐了半天，思考老学者的警告。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zài zhèlǐ zuòle bàntiān, sīkǎo lǎo xuézhě de jǐnggào.
sentences.english: I sat here for a long time, thinking about the old scholar's warning.

sentences.chinese: 我想，今天我必须找到那个秘密代码的答案。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng, jīntiān wǒ bìxū zhǎodào nàgè mìmì dàimǎ de dá'àn.
sentences.english: I thought that today I must find the answer to that secret code.

sentences.chinese: 下午，使者回来了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàwǔ, shǐzhě huíláile.
sentences.english: In the afternoon, the messenger returned.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，我们要一起去见一个人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, wǒmen yào yīqǐ qù jiàn yī gè rén.
sentences.english: He told me that we were going to see someone together.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你先跟我走。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ xiān gēn wǒ zǒu.”
sentences.english: He said, "You follow me first."

sentences.chinese: 我们快快地走在宫殿的前面。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen kuài kuài de zǒu zài gōngdiàn de qiánmiàn.
sentences.english: We walked quickly in front of the palace.

sentences.chinese: 我看到地上有一些奇怪的点。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàndào dìshang yǒu yīxiē qíguài de diǎn.
sentences.english: I saw some strange dots on the ground.

sentences.chinese: 这些点像是一个地图。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē diǎn xiàng shì yī gè dìtú.
sentences.english: These dots looked like a map.

sentences.chinese: 这时候，我听到远处有很大的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shíhou, wǒ tīngdào yuǎnchù yǒu hěn dà de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: At that moment, I heard a loud sound in the distance.

sentences.chinese: 那是雷声，天空出现了电。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì léishēng, tiānkōng chūxiànle diàn.
sentences.english: It was thunder, and lightning appeared in the sky.

sentences.chinese: 在古代，人们害怕这种电，认为它是天的信号。
sentences.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, rénmen hàipà zhè zhǒng diàn, rènwéi tā shì tiān de xìnhào.
sentences.english: In ancient times, people feared this lightning, believing it was a signal from heaven.

sentences.chinese: 使者说，这个星期我们要完成很多工作。
sentences.pinyin: Shǐzhě shuō, zhège xīngqī wǒmen yào wánchéng hěnduō gōngzuò.
sentences.english: The messenger said that this week we have to complete a lot of work.

sentences.chinese: 他看着时间，说现在是三点。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe shíjiān, shuō xiànzài shì sān diǎn.
sentences.english: He looked at the time and said it was now three o'clock.

sentences.chinese: 我们正在走廊里走，他低声说话。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zhèngzài zǒuláng lǐ zǒu, tā dīshēng shuōhuà.
sentences.english: We were walking in the corridor, and he spoke in a low voice.

sentences.chinese: 他说，下一次我们要去更深的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, xià yī cì wǒmen yào qù gèng shēn de dìfāng.
sentences.english: He said that next time we would go to a deeper place.

sentences.chinese: 到了晚上，宫殿变得很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Dàole wǎnshang, gōngdiàn biàn de hěn lěng.
sentences.english: When evening came, the palace became very cold.

sentences.chinese: 我记得他说过，晚上不要出去。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jìdé tā shuōguò, wǎnshang bùyào chūqù.
sentences.english: I remembered him saying not to go out at night.

sentences.chinese: 但我还是在睡觉前，偷偷地看了看窗外。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ háishì zài shuìjiào qián, tōutōu de kànle kàn chuāngwài.
sentences.english: But still, before sleeping, I secretly looked out the window.

sentences.chinese: 那个时候，我看到一个黑色的身影在中间走过。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè shíhou, wǒ kàndào yī gè hēisè de shēnyǐng zài zhōngjiān zǒuguò.
sentences.english: At that time, I saw a black figure walking in the middle.

sentences.chinese: 我等了一会儿，但那个人不见了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ děngle yīhuìr, dàn nàgè rén bùjiànle.
sentences.english: I waited a moment, but the person disappeared.

sentences.chinese: 最后，我听到有人在门外说：“再见。”
sentences.pinyin: Zuìhòu, wǒ tīngdào yǒurén zài mén wài shuō: “Zàijiàn.”
sentences.english: Finally, I heard someone outside the door say, "Goodbye."

sentences.chinese: 我心中很不安，因为现在已经是很晚了，但我的门被打开了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xīnzhōng hěn bù'ān, yīnwèi xiànzài yǐjīng shì hěn wǎn le, dàn wǒ de mén bèi dǎkāile.
sentences.english: I felt very uneasy in my heart because it was already very late, but my door was opened.

sentences.chinese: 我的门被打开了，我非常害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de mén bèi dǎ kāi le, wǒ fēi cháng hài pà.
sentences.english: My door was opened, and I was very afraid.

sentences.chinese: 我看到一个男人站在门口。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào yí gè nán rén zhàn zài mén kǒu.
sentences.english: I saw a man standing at the doorway.

sentences.chinese: 他看着我，他的身体在发抖。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe wǒ, tā de shēn tǐ zài fā dǒu.
sentences.english: He looked at me, and his body was trembling.

sentences.chinese: 他低声问我：“你身上有那个秘密代码吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dī shēng wèn wǒ: “Nǐ shēn shang yǒu nà gè mì mì dài mǎ ma?”
sentences.english: He whispered to me, "Do you have that secret code on you?"

sentences.chinese: 我想起那个零，但我还是没有说话。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐ nà gè líng, dàn wǒ hái shi méi yǒu shuō huà.
sentences.english: I thought of that zero, but I still did not speak.

sentences.chinese: 他马上走出了房间。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mǎ shàng zǒu chū le fáng jiān.
sentences.english: He immediately walked out of the room.

sentences.chinese: 我悄悄地跟着他，走在阴暗的走廊间。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ qiāo qiāo de gēn zhe tā, zǒu zài yīn àn de zǒu láng jiān.
sentences.english: I quietly followed him, walking between the dark corridors.

sentences.chinese: 宫殿里的风很大，听起来像是在哭泣。
sentences.pinyin: Gōng diàn lǐ de fēng hěn dà, tīng qǐ lái xiàng shì zài kū qì.
sentences.english: The wind in the palace was strong, sounding as if it were weeping.

sentences.chinese: 我们走到了一个路口，他向右转了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men zǒu dào le yí gè lù kǒu, tā xiàng yòu zhuǎn le.
sentences.english: We came to an intersection, and he turned right.

sentences.chinese: 我想知道他要去那里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zhī dào tā yào qù nà li.
sentences.english: I wanted to know where he was going.

sentences.chinese: 他走得很快，我感觉他离我越来越远。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu de hěn kuài, wǒ gǎn jué tā lí wǒ yuè lái yuè yuǎn.
sentences.english: He walked very fast, and I felt he was getting further and further from me.

sentences.chinese: 他走在一条像马路一样宽的石路上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu zài yì tiáo xiàng mǎ lù yí yàng kuān de shí lù shang.
sentences.english: He walked on a stone road as wide as a street.

sentences.chinese: 路上的灯光很暗，我只能看到他的背影。
sentences.pinyin: Lù shang de dēng guāng hěn àn, wǒ zhǐ néng kàn dào tā de bèi yǐng.
sentences.english: The lights on the road were dim; I could only see his silhouette.

sentences.chinese: 他走过一行红色的柱子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu guò yì háng hóng sè de zhù zi.
sentences.english: He walked past a row of red pillars.

sentences.chinese: 他在一个大门前停了下来，那是皇宫的贸易行。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài yí gè dà mén qián tíng le xià lái, nà shì huáng gōng de mào yì háng.
sentences.english: He stopped in front of a large gate; it was the imperial trade firm.

sentences.chinese: 他对我喊道：“快过来！看看这些东西！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì wǒ hǎn dào: “Kuài guò lái! Kàn kàn zhè xiē dōng xī!”
sentences.english: He shouted to me, "Come quickly! Look at these things!"

sentences.chinese: 我走过去，看到桌上有几块奇怪的石头。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǒu guò qù, kàn dào zhuō shang yǒu jǐ kuài qí guài de shí tou.
sentences.english: I walked over and saw several strange pieces of stone on the table.

sentences.chinese: 他问我：“你知道哪些石头是真正的钥匙？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn wǒ: “Nǐ zhī dào nǎ xiē shí tou shì zhēn zhèng de yào shi?”
sentences.english: He asked me, "Which stones do you know are the real keys?"

sentences.chinese: 我张口想要说话，但我的心跳太快了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhāng kǒu xiǎng yào shuō huà, dàn wǒ de xīn tiào tài kuài le.
sentences.english: I opened my mouth to speak, but my heart was beating too fast.

sentences.chinese: 我想回去我的房间，回到安全的家里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng huí qu wǒ de fáng jiān, huí dào ān quán de jiā lǐ.
sentences.english: I wanted to go back to my room, back to the safety of my home.

sentences.chinese: 但我记得使者说，这是第一等的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ jì de shǐ zhě shuō, zhè shì dì yī děng de mì mì.
sentences.english: But I remembered the messenger said this was a first-class secret.

sentences.chinese: 我想，如果我现在离开，我就不能像学生一样放假了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng, rú guǒ wǒ xiàn zài lí kāi, wǒ jiù bù néng xiàng xué shēng yí yàng fàng jià le.
sentences.english: I thought, if I leave now, I won't be able to have a holiday like a student.

sentences.chinese: 我决定留下来，看看这个夜晚会发生什么。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jué dìng liú xià lái, kàn kàn zhè gè yè wǎn huì fā shēng shén me.
sentences.english: I decided to stay and see what would happen tonight.

sentences.chinese: 我站在冰冷的走廊里，心跳依然很快。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhàn zài bīng lěng de zǒu láng lǐ, xīn tiào yī rán hěn kuài.
sentences.english: I stood in the cold corridor, my heart still beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 我看着远处，那里有一个人正在工作。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe yuǎn chù, nà lǐ yǒu yī gè rén zhèng zài gōng zuò.
sentences.english: I looked into the distance, where someone was working.

sentences.chinese: 那是宫廷的守卫，他现在正在上班。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì gōng tíng de shǒu wèi, tā xiàn zài zhèng zài shàng bān.
sentences.english: That was the palace guard; he was currently on duty.

sentences.chinese: 他对我笑了笑，用低沉的声音介绍这个地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì wǒ xiào le xiào, yòng dī chén de shēng yīn jiè shào zhè gè dì fang.
sentences.english: He smiled at me and introduced this place in a low voice.

sentences.chinese: 他说这里是一个秘密的图书馆，很多学者在这里上课。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō zhè lǐ shì yī gè mì mì de tú shū guǎn, hěn duō xué zhě zài zhè lǐ shàng kè.
sentences.english: He said this was a secret library where many scholars attend classes.

sentences.chinese: 我问他，在这么古老的地方，人们会做什么？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā, zài zhè me gǔ lǎo de dì fang, rén men huì zuò shén me?
sentences.english: I asked him, in such an ancient place, what would people do?

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，这里的学者喜欢分门别类地研究古书。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ, zhè lǐ de xué zhě xǐ huan fēn mén bié lèi de yán jiū gǔ shū.
sentences.english: He told me that the scholars here like to categorize and study ancient books.

sentences.chinese: 我跟着他走到一个巨大的木门前。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gēn zhe tā zǒu dào yī gè jù dà de mù mén qián.
sentences.english: I followed him to a huge wooden door.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，在门打开之前，千万不要动。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ, zài mén dǎ kāi zhī qián, qiān wàn bù yào dòng.
sentences.english: He told me that before the door opens, I must not move.

sentences.chinese: 他的动作很慢，像是在举行某种仪式。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de dòng zuò hěn màn, xiàng shì zài jǔ xíng mǒu zhǒng yí shì.
sentences.english: His movements were slow, as if he were performing some kind of ritual.

sentences.chinese: 他用手打开了那扇沉重的门。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng shǒu dǎ kāi le nà shàn chén zhòng de mén.
sentences.english: He used his hand to open that heavy door.

sentences.chinese: 我走进房间，发现里面有很多奇怪的机器。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jìn shàng fáng jiān, fā xiàn lǐ miàn yǒu hěn duō qí guài de jī qì.
sentences.english: I entered the room and found many strange machines inside.

sentences.chinese: 他开玩笑说，这些机器像未来的机场一样复杂。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kāi wán xiào shuō, zhè xiē jī qì xiàng wèi lái de jī chǎng yī yàng fù zá.
sentences.english: He joked that these machines were as complex as a future airport.

sentences.chinese: 虽然在这个时代没有网络，但他提到一种古老的“上网”方式，就是通过书信连接世界。
sentences.pinyin: Suī rán zài zhè gè shí dài méi yǒu wǎng luò, dàn tā tí dào yī zhǒng gǔ lǎo de “shàng wǎng” fāng shì, jiù shì tōng guò shū xìn lián jiē shì jiè.
sentences.english: Although there was no internet in this era, he mentioned an ancient way of "going online," which was connecting the world through letters.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，这里的每个人都爱学习，这是他们共同的爱好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ, zhè lǐ de měi gè rén dōu ài xué xí, zhè shì tā men gòng tóng de ài hào.
sentences.english: He told me that everyone here loves learning; it is their common hobby.

sentences.chinese: 在这个房间里，每天都会开会讨论国家的大事。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè gè fáng jiān lǐ, měi tiān dōu huì kāi huì tǎo lùn guó jiā de dà shì.
sentences.english: In this room, meetings are held every day to discuss great national affairs.

sentences.chinese: 我看到桌子上有一盆水，有人在洗手。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī pén shuǐ, yǒu rén zài xǐ shǒu.
sentences.english: I saw a basin of water on the table, and someone was washing their hands.

sentences.chinese: 那个使者对我说：“如果你想在这里工作，你必须学会安静。”
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè shǐ zhě duì wǒ shuō: “Rú guǒ nǐ xiǎng zài zhè lǐ gōng zuò, nǐ bì xū xué huì ānjìng.”
sentences.english: The messenger said to me, "If you want to work here, you must learn to be quiet."

sentences.chinese: 我看着那些书，我想去读读看。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe nà xiē shū, wǒ xiǎng qù dú dú kàn.
sentences.english: I looked at those books and wanted to go read them.

sentences.chinese: 他送我到房间的窗边，让我看看外面的月亮。
sentences.pinyin: Tā sòng wǒ dào fáng jiān de chuāng biān, ràng wǒ kàn kàn wài miàn de yuè liàng.
sentences.english: He escorted me to the window of the room to let me see the moon outside.

sentences.chinese: 我站在那里，感觉到一种奇怪的力量在房间里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhàn zài nà lǐ, gǎn jué dào yī zhǒng qí guài de lì liàng zài fáng jiān lǐ.
sentences.english: I stood there, feeling a strange power in the room.

sentences.chinese: 突然，门外传来了急促的脚步声。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, mén wài chuán lái le jí cù de jiǎo bù shēng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, hurried footsteps sounded outside the door.

sentences.chinese: 有人在大喊：“快进！有紧急的消息！”
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu rén zài dà hǎn: “Kuài jìn! Yǒu jǐn jí de xiāo xī!”
sentences.english: Someone shouted, "Come in quickly! There is urgent news!"

sentences.chinese: 我心想，这个夜晚才刚刚开始。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xīn xiǎng, zhè gè yè wǎn cái gāng gāng kāi shǐ.
sentences.english: I thought to myself, this night has only just begun.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 8: Visitors of the Forbidden Palace

sentences.chinese: 那个喊叫的人进来了，他是一个穿着蓝色衣服的工人。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè hǎn jiào de rén jìn lái le, tā shì yī gè chuān zhe lán sè yī fú de gōng rén.
sentences.english: The shouting man entered; he was a worker wearing blue clothes.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，现在不是休息的时间，因为皇宫里发生了一件大事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ, xiàn zài bú shì xiū xí de shí jiān, yīn wèi huáng gōng lǐ fā shēng le yī jiàn dà shì.
sentences.english: He told me that now is not the time to rest, because something major has happened in the palace.

sentences.chinese: 他带我来到一个大房间，那里坐着一个严肃的女人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dài wǒ lái dào yī gè dà fáng jiān, nà lǐ zuò zhe yī gè yán sù de nǚ rén.
sentences.english: He led me to a large room where a serious woman was sitting.

sentences.chinese: 这个女人是皇宫里的一个医生，她刚刚从医院回来。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè nǚ rén shì huáng gōng lǐ de yī gè yī shēng, tā gāng gāng cóng yī yuàn huí lái.
sentences.english: This woman was a doctor in the palace, and she had just returned from the hospital.

sentences.chinese: 她看着我，轻声问我的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe wǒ, qīng shēng wèn wǒ de míng zi.
sentences.english: She looked at me and softly asked for my name.

sentences.chinese: 我告诉她我的名字，她点点头，说我需要帮她看一张地图。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gào sù tā wǒ de míng zi, tā diǎn diǎn tóu, shuō wǒ xū yào bāng tā kàn yī zhāng dì tú.
sentences.english: I told her my name, and she nodded, saying I needed to help her look at a map.

sentences.chinese: 这张地图非常古老，上面写着关于中国很多地方的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng dì tú fēi cháng gǔ lǎo, shàng miàn xiě zhe guān yú Zhōng guó hěn duō dì fāng de mì mì.
sentences.english: This map was very ancient, and on it were written secrets about many places in China.

sentences.chinese: 地图上的文字不是简单的中文，而是一种奇怪的外语。
sentences.pinyin: Dì tú shàng de wén zì bú shì jiǎn dān de Zhōng wén, ér shì yī zhǒng qí guài de wài yǔ.
sentences.english: The characters on the map were not simple Chinese, but a strange foreign language.

sentences.chinese: 医生告诉我，她的儿子和女儿都在学习这些文字。
sentences.pinyin: Yī shēng gào sù wǒ, tā de ér zi hé nǚ ér dōu zài xué xí zhè xiē wén zì.
sentences.english: The doctor told me that her son and daughter were both studying these characters.

sentences.chinese: 她说：“我的儿子在图书馆工作，他很聪明。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ de ér zi zài tú shū guǎn gōng zuò, tā hěn cōng míng.”
sentences.english: She said, "My son works in the library; he is very clever."

sentences.chinese: “我的女儿在书店帮忙，她也喜欢看古书。”
sentences.pinyin: “Wǒ de nǚ ér zài shū diàn bāng máng, tā yě xǐ huan kàn gǔ shū.”
sentences.english: "My daughter helps out at the bookstore; she also likes reading ancient books."

sentences.chinese: 这时，房间里走进来一个年轻的男人，他是医生的哥哥。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, fáng jiān lǐ zǒu jìn lái yī gè nián qīng de nán rén, tā shì yī shēng de gē ge.
sentences.english: At that moment, a young man walked into the room; he was the doctor's older brother.

sentences.chinese: 这个哥哥带着一个孩子，那个孩子是个可爱的小朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè gē ge dài zhe yī gè hái zi, nà gè hái zi shì gè kě ài de xiǎo péng yǒu.
sentences.english: This older brother brought a child, and that child was a cute little friend (young child).

sentences.chinese: 医生说，这个孩子是她的弟弟，也就是她的小妹。
sentences.pinyin: Yī shēng shuō, zhè gè hái zi shì tā de dì di, yě jiù shì tā de xiǎo mèi.
sentences.english: The doctor said this child was her younger brother, also her little sister (youngest sibling).

sentences.chinese: 虽然他是弟弟，但他在学习方面比哥哥快，而哥哥学习比较慢。
sentences.pinyin: Suī rán tā shì dì di, dàn tā zài xué xí fāng miàn bǐ gē ge kuài, ér gē ge xué xí bǐ jiào màn.
sentences.english: Although he was the younger brother, he was faster in learning than the older brother, while the older brother's learning was slower.

sentences.chinese: 医生还提到了她的姐姐，姐姐在宫外照顾一个生病的孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Yī shēng hái tí dào le tā de jiě jie, jiě jie zài gōng wài zhào gù yī gè shēng bìng de hái zi.
sentences.english: The doctor also mentioned her older sister, who was outside the palace caring for a sick child.

sentences.chinese: 她说她的姐姐有一个漂亮的女朋友，她们一起在研究古籍。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō tā de jiě jie yǒu yī gè piào liang de nǚ péng you, tā men yī qǐ zài yán jiū gǔ jí.
sentences.english: She said her older sister had a beautiful girlfriend, and they were studying ancient texts together.

sentences.chinese: 我看着他们，感觉这个家庭每个人都有自己的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe tā men, gǎn jué zhè gè jiā rén měi gè rén dōu yǒu zì jǐ de mì mì.
sentences.english: I looked at them and felt that everyone in this family had their own secrets.

sentences.chinese: 医生指着地图说，我们需要在上午找到那个秘密的地点。
sentences.pinyin: Yī shēng zhǐ zhe dì tú shuō, wǒ men xū yào zài shàng wǔ zhǎo dào nà gè mì mì de dì diǎn.
sentences.english: The doctor pointed to the map and said we needed to find that secret location in the morning.

sentences.chinese: 因为现在的天气很冷，我们不能在外面待太久。
sentences.pinyin: Yīn wèi xiàn zài de tiān qì hěn lěng, wǒ men bù néng zài wài miàn dài tài jiǔ.
sentences.english: Because the weather is very cold now, we cannot stay outside for too long.

sentences.chinese: 她问我：“你认识这个地方吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn wǒ: “Nǐ rèn shi zhè gè dì fāng ma?”
sentences.english: She asked me, "Do you recognize this place?"

sentences.chinese: 我仔细看，发现地图上有一个标记，像是一个小小的门。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǐ xì kàn, fā xiàn dì tú shàng yǒu yī gè biāo jì, xiàng shì yī gè xiǎo xiǎo de mén.
sentences.english: I looked closely and found a mark on the map, like a tiny door.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一名年轻的女子走进来，她是医生的妹妹。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yī míng nián qīng de nǚ zǐ zǒu jìn lái, tā shì yī shēng de mèi mei.
sentences.english: At that moment, a young woman walked in; she was the doctor's younger sister.

sentences.chinese: 这个妹妹对着我说：“哥，快来看这里！”
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè mèi mei duì zhe wǒ shuō: “Gē, kuài lái kàn zhè lǐ!”
sentences.english: This younger sister said to me, "Brother, come quickly and look at this!"

sentences.chinese: 她虽然叫我哥，但我们并不是真正的兄弟，这只是她对年长者的称呼。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suī rán jiào wǒ gē, dàn wǒ men bìng bú shì zhēn zhèng de xiōng dì, zhè zhǐ shì tā duì nián zhǎng zhě de chēng hu.
sentences.english: Although she called me brother, we were not actual brothers; this was just her way of addressing an elder.

sentences.chinese: 我们讨论了很久，直到午饭的时间到了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men tǎo lùn le hěn jiǔ, zhí dào wǔ fàn de shí jiān dào le.
sentences.english: We discussed for a long time until it was time for lunch.

sentences.chinese: 医生说：“先吃饭，然后我们再去寻找那个秘密。”
sentences.pinyin: Yī shēng shuō: “Xiān chī fàn, rán hòu wǒ men zài qù xún zhǎo nà gè mì mì.”
sentences.english: The doctor said, "Eat first, and then we will go search for that secret."

sentences.chinese: 就在我准备吃饭时，窗外突然传来一声尖叫。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài wǒ zhǔn bèi chī fàn shí, chuāng wài tū rán chuán lái yī shēng jiān jiào.
sentences.english: Just as I was preparing to eat, a scream suddenly came from outside the window.

sentences.chinese: 我看向窗外，发现一个黑影正迅速跑向禁宫的深处。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn xiàng chuāng wài, fā xiàn yī gè hēi yǐng zhèng xùn sù pǎo xiàng jìn gōng de shēn chù.
sentences.english: I looked out the window and saw a dark shadow running rapidly toward the depths of the forbidden palace.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 9: Visions of the Forbidden Palace

sentences.chinese: 我看着那个黑影消失，心中充满了不安。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe nà gè hēi yǐng xiāo shī, xīn zhōng chōng mǎn le bù ān.
sentences.english: I watched the dark shadow disappear, my heart filled with unease.

sentences.chinese: 医生告诉我，现在是正月，天气还很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Yī shēng gào sù wǒ, xiàn zài shì zhēng yuè, tiān qì hái hěn lěng.
sentences.english: The doctor told me that it is now the first lunar month, and the weather is still very cold.

sentences.chinese: 他叹了口气，说这个禁宫里有许多奇怪的东西。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tàn le yī kǒu qì, shuō zhè gè jìn gōng lǐ yǒu xǔ duō qí guài de dōng xī.
sentences.english: He sighed and said there are many strange things in this forbidden palace.

sentences.chinese: 他指着墙上的古画说，那些画像现在的电脑一样，记录了很多信息。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐ zhe qiáng shàng de gǔ huà shuō, nà xiē huà xiàng xiàn zài de diàn nǎo yī yàng, jì lù le hěn duō xìn xī.
sentences.english: He pointed to the ancient paintings on the wall and said those paintings are like today's computers, recording a lot of information.

sentences.chinese: 他说，古人想象过像飞机一样在天上飞，像火车一样在地上快跑。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, gǔ rén xiǎng xiàng guò xiàng fēi jī yī yàng zài tiān shàng fēi, xiàng huǒ chē yī yàng zài dì shàng kuài pǎo.
sentences.english: He said the ancients imagined flying in the sky like airplanes and running fast on the ground like trains.

sentences.chinese: 虽然我们没有电视机，但这些画就是我们的窗户。
sentences.pinyin: Suī rán wǒ men méi yǒu diàn shì jī, dàn zhè xiē huà jiù shì wǒ men de chuāng hu.
sentences.english: Although we have no television sets, these paintings are our windows.

sentences.chinese: 我问他，这些画是用汉语写的吗？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā, zhè xiē huà shì yòng Hàn yǔ xiě de ma?
sentences.english: I asked him, are these paintings written in Chinese?

sentences.chinese: 医生点头说，这是最古老的汉语，像课本里的课文一样重要。
sentences.pinyin: Yī shēng diǎn tóu shuō, zhè shì zuì gǔ lǎo de Hàn yǔ, xiàng kè běn lǐ de kè wén yī yàng zhòng yào.
sentences.english: The doctor nodded and said this is the most ancient Chinese, as important as the texts in textbooks.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，在这个宫殿里，人们不能在网上寻找答案。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ, zài zhè gè gōng diàn lǐ, rén men bù néng zài wǎng shàng xún zhǎo dá àn.
sentences.english: He told me that in this palace, people cannot search for answers online.

sentences.chinese: 突然，窗外下起了雨。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, chuāng wài xià qǐ le yǔ.
sentences.english: Suddenly, it started to rain outside.

sentences.chinese: 雨水打在窗户上，声音很大。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ shuǐ dǎ zài chuāng hu shàng, shēng yīn hěn dà.
sentences.english: The rain hit the window, and the sound was very loud.

sentences.chinese: 我感到很渴，医生给我了一杯牛奶和一些面包。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gǎn dào hěn kě, yī shēng gěi wǒ le yī bēi niú nǎi hé yī xiē miàn bāo.
sentences.english: I felt thirsty, and the doctor gave me a glass of milk and some bread.

sentences.chinese: 他还给了我一些红色的水果，说这是新年庆祝时吃的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hái gěi le wǒ yī xiē hóng sè de shuǐ guǒ, shuō zhè shì xīn nián qìng zhù shí chī de.
sentences.english: He also gave me some red fruits, saying they are eaten during New Year celebrations.

sentences.chinese: 我想起我的一个朋友，他今天过生日。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐ wǒ de yī gè péng you, tā jīn tiān guò shēng rì.
sentences.english: I thought of a friend of mine whose birthday is today.

sentences.chinese: 我希望他能穿上新衣服，在家里开心。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xī wàng tā néng chuān shàng xīn yī fu, zài jiā lǐ kāi xīn.
sentences.english: I hoped he could put on new clothes and be happy at home.

sentences.chinese: 医生问我，你有没有男朋友或者好朋友陪在你身边？
sentences.pinyin: Yī shēng wèn wǒ, nǐ yǒu méi yǒu nán péng you huò zhě hǎo péng you péi zài nǐ shēn biān?
sentences.english: The doctor asked me, do you have a boyfriend or a good friend by your side?

sentences.chinese: 我摇摇头，因为在这个秘密的地方，我只有他。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yáo yáo tóu, yīn wèi zài zhè gè mì mì de dì fāng, wǒ zhǐ yǒu tā.
sentences.english: I shook my head, because in this secret place, I only have him.

sentences.chinese: 我们谈话直到第二天早上。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men tán huà zhí dào dì èr tiān zǎo shang.
sentences.english: We talked until the next early morning.

sentences.chinese: 早饭准备好了，但我的心依然在跳。
sentences.pinyin: Zǎo fàn zhǔn bèi hǎo le, dàn wǒ de xīn yī rán zài tiào.
sentences.english: Breakfast was ready, but my heart was still racing.

sentences.chinese: 我突然发现，医生在看一本奇怪的书。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tū rán fā xiàn, yī shēng zài kàn yī běn qí guài de shū.
sentences.english: I suddenly discovered that the doctor was reading a strange book.

sentences.chinese: 那本书里写着那个黑影的名字，以及一个可怕的计划。
sentences.pinyin: Nà běn shū lǐ xiě zhe nà gè hēi yǐng de míng zi, yǐ jí yī gè kě pà de jì huà.
sentences.english: In that book was written the name of that dark shadow, as well as a terrifying plan.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十章：古书中的异世界
chapters.title_english: Chapter 10: The Other World in the Ancient Book

sentences.chinese: 医生把那本书放在桌子上。
sentences.pinyin: Yī shēng bǎ nà běn shū fàng zài zhuō zi shàng.
sentences.english: The doctor placed that book on the table.

sentences.chinese: 我看着书上的汉字，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe shū shàng de hàn zì, xīn tiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: I looked at the Chinese characters in the book, and my heart beat fast.

sentences.chinese: 这本书记录了一个奇怪的国家，那里的人不用马车，而用汽车。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū jì lù le yī gè qí guài de guó jiā, nà lǐ de rén bù yòng mǎ chē, ér yòng qì chē.
sentences.english: This book recorded a strange country where people did not use carriages, but cars.

sentences.chinese: 医生低声说：“这本书来自遥远的未来，那里有一个叫北京的大城市。”
sentences.pinyin: Yī shēng dī shēng shuō: “Zhè běn shū lái zì yáo yuǎn de wèi lái, nà lǐ yǒu yī gè jiào Běi jīng de dà chéng shì.”
sentences.english: The doctor whispered, "This book comes from the distant future, where there is a big city called Beijing."

sentences.chinese: 在那个世界里，人们在巨大的商场买东西，而不是在小商店。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nà gè shì jiè lǐ, rén men zài jù dà de shāng chǎng mǎi dōng xī, ér bù shì zài xiǎo shāng diàn.
sentences.english: In that world, people buy things in huge shopping malls, not in small shops.

sentences.chinese: 我问他：“那里的人怎么说话？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Nà lǐ de rén zěn me shuō huà?”
sentences.english: I asked him, "How do the people there speak?"

sentences.chinese: 医生指着书上的字说：“他们依然使用汉字，但生活完全不同。”
sentences.pinyin: Yī shēng zhǐ zhe shū shàng de zì shuō: “Tā men yī rán shǐ yòng hàn zì, dàn shēng huó wán quán bù tóng.”
sentences.english: The doctor pointed to the characters in the book and said, "They still use Chinese characters, but life is completely different."

sentences.chinese: 书中提到，人们拿着一个叫手机的小东西，可以像电影一样看到远方的人。
sentences.pinyin: Shū zhōng tí dào, rén men ná zhe yī gè jiào shǒu jī de xiǎo dōng xī, kě yǐ xiàng diàn yǐng yī yàng kàn dào yuǎn fāng de rén.
sentences.english: The book mentioned that people hold a small thing called a cell phone, which allows them to see people from afar like a movie.

sentences.chinese: 我感到很困惑，因为在我的时代，这种事情像做梦一样。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gǎn dào hěn kùn huò, yīn wèi zài wǒ de shí dài, zhè zhǒng shì qíng xiàng zuò mèng yī yàng.
sentences.english: I felt very confused, because in my era, such a thing was like a dream.

sentences.chinese: 医生拿起杯子喝了一口水，看着窗外的月亮。
sentences.pinyin: Yī shēng ná qǐ bēi zi hē le yī kǒu shuǐ, kàn zhe chuāng wài de yuè liang.
sentences.english: The doctor picked up the cup, took a sip of water, and looked at the moon outside the window.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“这个秘密比任何金子都贵。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zhè gè mì mì bǐ rèn hé jīn zi dōu guì.”
sentences.english: He said, "This secret is more precious than any gold."

sentences.chinese: 书里还写到，人们可以通过机票飞到日或比这些遥远的国度。
sentences.pinyin: Shū lǐ hái xiě dào, rén men kě yǐ tōng guò jī piào fēi dào Rì huò Bǐ zhè xiē yáo yuǎn de guó dù.
sentences.english: The book also wrote that people could fly to distant lands like Japan or Belgium via air tickets.

sentences.chinese: 我突然想到我的家，想到我的爸爸和妈妈。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tū rán xiǎng dào wǒ de jiā, xiǎng dào wǒ de bà ba hé mā ma.
sentences.english: I suddenly thought of my home, and thought of my father and mother.

sentences.chinese: 我的爸爸是一个严厉的人，我的妈妈则很温柔。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de bà ba shì yī gè yán lì de rén, wǒ de mā ma zé hěn wēn róu.
sentences.english: My father is a strict person, and my mother is very gentle.

sentences.chinese: 我想起我的小弟，他现在一定在院子里玩球。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐ wǒ de xiǎo dì, tā xiàn zài yī dìng zài yuàn zi lǐ wán qiú.
sentences.english: I thought of my younger brother; he must be playing with a ball in the courtyard right now.

sentences.chinese: 我心中有一个女孩子，她是一位聪明的小姐，经常教我读书。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xīn zhōng yǒu yī gè nǚ hái zi, tā shì yī wèi cōng míng de xiǎo jiě, jīng cháng jiào wǒ dú shū.
sentences.english: There is a girl in my heart, a clever young lady who often teaches me to read.

sentences.chinese: 我想告诉我的妈，告诉我的爸，这个世界即将改变。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gà o wǒ de mā, gà o wǒ de bà, zhè gè shì jiè jí jiāng gǎi biàn.
sentences.english: I want to tell my mom, tell my dad, that this world is about to change.

sentences.chinese: 医生看着我，像看着自己的孩子一样看着这个子。
sentences.pinyin: Yī shēng kàn zhe wǒ, xiàng kàn zhe zì jǐ de hái zi yī yàng kàn zhe zhè gè zǐ.
sentences.english: The doctor looked at me, looking at this child as if looking at his own son.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，今晚的晚饭后，我们要离开这里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gà o wǒ, jīn wǎn de wǎn fàn hòu, wǒ men yào lí kāi zhè lǐ.
sentences.english: He told me that after dinner tonight, we must leave this place.

sentences.chinese: 他拿出一张古老的纸，上面写着离开禁宫的路。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū yī zhāng gǔ lǎo de zhǐ, shàng miàn xiě zhe lí kāi jìn gōng de lù.
sentences.english: He took out an ancient piece of paper with the route to leave the Forbidden Palace written on it.

sentences.chinese: 我看着那些复杂的字，感到一种前所未有的恐惧。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe nà xiē fù zá de zì, gǎn dào yī zhǒng qián suǒ wèi yǒu de kǒng jù.
sentences.english: I looked at those complex characters and felt an unprecedented fear.

sentences.chinese: 如果这个未来是真的，那么我们现在的生活算什么？
sentences.pinyin: Rú guǒ zhè gè wèi lái shì zhēn de, nà me wǒ men xiàn zài de shēng huó suàn shén me?
sentences.english: If this future is real, then what does our current life count for?

sentences.chinese: 医生突然合上书，眼神变得严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Yī shēng tū rán hé shàng shū, yǎn shén biàn de yán sù.
sentences.english: The doctor suddenly closed the book, and his expression became serious.

sentences.chinese: 他低声说：“有人在门外。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dī shēng shuō: “Yǒu rén zài mén wài.”
sentences.english: He whispered, "Someone is outside the door."

sentences.chinese: 我看向门口，发现一个黑影再次出现。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn xiàng mén kǒu, fā xiàn yī gè hēi yǐng zài cì chū xiàn.
sentences.english: I looked toward the door and found that the dark shadow had appeared again.

sentences.chinese: 那个人手里拿着一样闪光的东西，看起来像书里描述的手机。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén shǒu lǐ ná zhe yī yàng shǎn guāng de dōng xī, kàn qǐ lái xiàng shū lǐ miáo shù de shǒu jī.
sentences.english: That person was holding something flashing in his hand, which looked like the cell phone described in the book.

sentences.chinese: 他对着我们冷冷地笑了，声音像冰一样冷。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì zhe wǒ men lěng lěng de xiào le, shēng yīn xiàng bīng yī yàng lěng.
sentences.english: He smiled coldly at us, his voice as cold as ice.

sentences.chinese: 那个男人看着我们，手里拿着那个发光的奇怪东西。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè nán rén kàn zhe wǒ men, shǒu lǐ ná zhe nà gè fā guāng de qí guài dōng xī.
sentences.english: That man looked at us, holding that strange glowing object in his hand.

sentences.chinese: 医生问他：“你是谁？你来这里干什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Yī shēng wèn tā: “Nǐ shì shuí? Nǐ lái zhè lǐ gàn shén me?”
sentences.english: The doctor asked him, "Who are you? What are you doing here?"

sentences.chinese: 那个男人没有说话，他指了指那个东西，说这像是一个电话。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè nán rén méi yǒu shuō huà, tā zhǐ le zhǐ nà gè dōng xī, shuō zhè xiàng shì yī gè diàn huà.
sentences.english: The man did not speak; he pointed to the object and said it was like a telephone.

sentences.chinese: 他说他来自一个很远的地方，那里有电视，还有像电影院一样的大房子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō tā lái zì yī gè hěn yuǎn de dì fāng, nà lǐ yǒu diàn shì, hái yǒu xiàng diàn yǐng yuàn yī yàng de dà fáng zi.
sentences.english: He said he came from a very far place, where there were televisions and large buildings like cinemas.

sentences.chinese: 我听不懂他的话，因为这些词在我们的时代不存在。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tīng bù dǒng tā de huà, yīn wèi zhè xiē cí zài wǒ men de shí dài bù cún zài.
sentences.english: I could not understand his words, because these terms did not exist in our era.

sentences.chinese: 医生皱起眉头，问他：“你从哪儿来的？”
sentences.pinyin: Yī shēng zhòu qǐ méi tóu, wèn tā: “Nǐ cóng nǎ r lái de?”
sentences.english: The doctor frowned and asked him, "Where did you come from?"

sentences.chinese: 男人叹了一口气，从他的钱包里拿出一张奇怪的票。
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén tàn le yī kǒu qì, cóng tā de qián bāo lǐ ná chū yī zhāng qí guài de piào.
sentences.english: The man sighed and took a strange ticket out of his wallet.

sentences.chinese: 他说他在一个叫车站的地方看到了一个门，然后就来到了这里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō tā zài yī gè jiào chē zhàn de dì fāng kàn dào le yī gè mén, rán hòu jiù lái dào le zhè lǐ.
sentences.english: He said he saw a door at a place called a station, and then he arrived here.

sentences.chinese: 医生看着他，觉得这个男人很奇怪，但他的眼神很老，像经历了很多事情。
sentences.pinyin: Yī shēng kàn zhe tā, jué de zhè gè nán rén hěn qí guài, dàn tā de yǎn shén hěn lǎo, xiàng jīng lì le hěn duō shì qíng.
sentences.english: The doctor looked at him and felt this man was strange, but his eyes were old, as if he had experienced many things.

sentences.chinese: 医生说：“你饿了吧？先去饭店吃顿饭。”
sentences.pinyin: Yī shēng shuō: “Nǐ è le ba? Xiān qù fàn diàn chī dùn fàn.”
sentences.english: The doctor said, "You must be hungry, right? Let's go to a restaurant and have a meal first."

sentences.chinese: 我们走进宫殿的一间小房，那里准备好了简单的菜。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men zǒu jìn gōng diàn de yī jiān xiǎo fáng, nà lǐ zhǔn bèi hǎo le jiǎn dān de cài.
sentences.english: We entered a small room in the palace where simple dishes were prepared.

sentences.chinese: 桌上有白色的米饭，还有一些肉和鸡蛋。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuō shàng yǒu bái sè de mǐ fàn, hái yǒu yī xiē ròu hé jī dàn.
sentences.english: On the table was white rice, as well as some meat and eggs.

sentences.chinese: 我给那个男人倒了一杯热茶。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gěi nà gè nán rén dào le yī bēi rè chá.
sentences.english: I poured a cup of hot tea for the man.

sentences.chinese: 这个男人看着这些食物，突然流下了眼泪。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè nán rén kàn zhe zhè xiē shí wù, tū rán liú xià le yǎn lèi.
sentences.english: Looking at this food, the man suddenly burst into tears.

sentences.chinese: 他说，在他的世界里，人们不再这样安静地吃米饭和肉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, zài tā de shì jiè lǐ, rén men bù zài zhè yàng ān jìng de chī mǐ fàn hé ròu.
sentences.english: He said that in his world, people no longer ate rice and meat so quietly.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我们，他失去了他的家，再也不能回家了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ men, tā shī qù le tā de jiā, zài yě bù néng huí jiā le.
sentences.english: He told us that he had lost his home and could never return home again.

sentences.chinese: 医生看着他，轻声说：“在这个大宫殿里，每个人都有秘密。”
sentences.pinyin: Yī shēng kàn zhe tā, qīng shēng shuō: “Zài zhè gè dà gōng diàn lǐ, měi gè rén dōu yǒu mì mì.”
sentences.english: The doctor looked at him and said softly, "In this great palace, everyone has secrets."

sentences.chinese: 突然，那个男人的闪光东西再次发出巨大的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, nà gè nán rén de shǎn guāng dōng xī zài cì fā chū jù dà de shēng yīn.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the man's glowing object made a loud noise again.

sentences.chinese: 他惊恐地看向窗外，发现禁宫的影子在移动。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīng kǒng de kàn xiàng chuāng wài, fā xiàn jìn gōng de yǐng zi zài yí dòng.
sentences.english: He looked out the window in terror and found that the shadows of the forbidden palace were moving.

sentences.chinese: 他低声说：“他们找到了我，快跑！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dī shēng shuō: “Tā men zhǎo dào le wǒ, kuài pǎo!”
sentences.english: He whispered, "They have found me, run!"

sentences.chinese: 我们惊恐地跑向禁宫的深处。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men jīng kǒng de pǎo xiàng jìn gōng de shēn chù.
sentences.english: We ran in terror toward the depths of the forbidden palace.

sentences.chinese: 那个男人停下来，看着我们说：“你们必须听我说。”
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè nán rén tíng xià lái, kàn zhe wǒ men shuō: “Nǐ men bì xū tīng wǒ shuō.”
sentences.english: The man stopped and looked at us, saying, "You must listen to me."

sentences.chinese: 他指着那个闪光的东西，说那是他从另一个世界带来的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐ zhe nà gè shǎn guāng de dōng xī, shuō nà shì tā cóng lìng yī gè shì jiè dài lái de.
sentences.english: He pointed to the flashing object and said it was brought from another world.

sentences.chinese: 他说，去年他来到了这里，但失去了回家的路。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, qù nián tā lái dào le zhè lǐ, dàn shī qù le huí jiā de lù.
sentences.english: He said that last year he came here, but lost the way home.

sentences.chinese: 在那儿，时间是不一样的。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nà r, shí jiān shì bù yī yàng de.
sentences.english: There, time is different.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，前天他看到了一个奇怪的日期。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ, qián tiān tā kàn dào le yī gè qí guài de rì qī.
sentences.english: He told me that the day before yesterday, he saw a strange date.

sentences.chinese: 那个日期写在古书的一页上。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rì qī xiě zài gǔ shū de yī xié shàng.
sentences.english: That date was written on a page of the ancient book.

sentences.chinese: 他说，去年到今年，他在这里住了半年。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, qù nián dào jīn nián, tā zài zhè lǐ zhù le bàn nián.
sentences.english: He said that from last year to this year, he had lived here for half a year.

sentences.chinese: 有时候，他会想起自己的家。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu shí hou, tā huì xiǎng qǐ zì jǐ de jiā.
sentences.english: Sometimes, he would think of his home.

sentences.chinese: 医生看着他，问他上次看到那些影子是什么时候。
sentences.pinyin: Yī shēng kàn zhe tā, wèn tā shàng cì kàn dào nà xiē yǐng zi shì shén me shí hou.
sentences.english: The doctor looked at him and asked when he last saw those shadows.

sentences.chinese: 男人低声说：“昨天，就在一个小时之前。”
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén dī shēng shuō: “Zuó tiān, jiù zài yī gè xiǎo shí zhī qián.”
sentences.english: The man whispered, "Yesterday, just one hour ago."

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，那些影子在寻找一个秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ, nà xiē yǐng zi zài xún zhǎo yī gè mì mì.
sentences.english: He told me that those shadows were searching for a secret.

sentences.chinese: 他指着房间里的一张小几，上面放着一些旧纸。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐ zhe fáng jiān lǐ de yī zhāng jǐ, shàng miàn fàng zhe yī xiē jiù zhǐ.
sentences.english: He pointed to a small table in the room, on which some old papers were placed.

sentences.chinese: “这些纸记录了所有人的秘密，”他说。
sentences.pinyin: “Zhè xiē zhǐ jì lù le suǒ yǒu rén de mì mì,” tā shuō.
sentences.english: "These papers record everyone's secrets," he said.

sentences.chinese: 我看到纸上写着：星期天，或者星期日，影子会最强。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào zhǐ shàng xiě zhe: Xīng qī tiān, huò zhě Xīng qī rì, yǐng zi huì zuì qiáng.
sentences.english: I saw written on the paper: Sunday, or Sunday, the shadows will be strongest.

sentences.chinese: 他看着我，眼神很悲伤，他说：“我自个儿已经等了太久。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe wǒ, yǎn shén hěn bēi shāng, tā shuō: “Wǒ zì gè r yǐ jīng děng le tài jiǔ.”
sentences.english: He looked at me with sad eyes and said, "I myself have waited too long."

sentences.chinese: 他说，明年他可能再也无法离开这儿。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, míng nián tā kě néng zài yě wú fǎ lí kāi zhè r.
sentences.english: He said that next year he might never be able to leave here.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，明天他们会再次进攻。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ, míng tiān tā men huì zài cì jìn gōng.
sentences.english: He told me that tomorrow they will attack again.

sentences.chinese: 他说，下次如果我能回家，我会告诉我的女儿。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, xià cì rú guǒ wǒ néng huí jiā, wǒ huì gào sù wǒ de nǚ ér.
sentences.english: He said that next time, if I can go home, I will tell my daughter.

sentences.chinese: 他想起了她，那个在远方等待他的女孩。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ le tā, nà gè zài yuǎn fāng děng dài tā de nǚ hái.
sentences.english: He thought of her, the girl waiting for him in the distance.

sentences.chinese: 现在，我们的时间只剩下了一半。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài, wǒ men de shí jiān zhǐ shèng xià le yī bàn.
sentences.english: Now, only half of our time remains.

sentences.chinese: 他看着我们说：“你们现在必须决定，是留下还是离开。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe wǒ men shuō: “Nǐ men xiàn zài bì xū jué dìng, shì liú xià hái shì lí kāi.”
sentences.english: He looked at us and said, "You must now decide whether to stay or leave."

sentences.chinese: 我们看着那些在窗外移动的黑影。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men kàn zhe nà xiē zài chuāng wài yí dòng de hēi yǐng.
sentences.english: We looked at those black shadows moving outside the window.

sentences.chinese: 他们越来越近，声音越来越大。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men yuè lái yuè jìn, shēng yīn yuè lái yuè dà.
sentences.english: They were getting closer and closer, their voices louder and louder.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个巨大的黑影撞破了门，把桌上的东西全部扫落在地。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, yī gè jù dà de hēi yǐng zhuàng pò le mén, bǎ zhuō shàng de dōng xī quán bù sǎo luò zài dì.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a huge black shadow crashed through the door, sweeping everything on the table to the ground.

sentences.chinese: 巨大的黑影把门撞开了，一切都不对。
sentences.pinyin: Jù dà de hēi yǐng bǎ mén zhuàng kāi le, yī qiè dōu bù duì.
sentences.english: The huge shadow smashed the door open; everything was wrong.

sentences.chinese: 医生大喊：“快跑！去北边的花园！”
sentences.pinyin: Yī shēng dà hǎn: “Kuài pǎo! Qù běi bian de huā yuán!”
sentences.english: The doctor shouted, "Run! Go to the northern garden!"

sentences.chinese: 我看着地上的本子，那是记录秘密代码的书。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe dì shàng de běn zi, nà shì jì lù mì mì dài mǎ de shū.
sentences.english: I looked at the notebook on the ground; it was the book recording the secret codes.

sentences.chinese: 我赶紧把它拿起来，因为我不能忘掉那些数字。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gǎn xìn bǎ tā ná qǐ lái, yīn wèi wǒ bù néng wàng diào nà xiē shù zì.
sentences.english: I quickly picked it up because I could not forget those numbers.

sentences.chinese: 黑影的声音很大，像是一声巨大的“吧”！
sentences.pinyin: Hēi yǐng de shēng yīn hěn dà, xiàng shì yī shēng jù dà de “ba”!
sentences.english: The shadow's voice was loud, like a giant "bang"!

sentences.chinese: 医生觉得这个情况很危险，他非常生气。
sentences.pinyin: Yī shēng jué de zhè ge qíng kuàng hěn wēi xiǎn, tā fēi cháng shēng qì.
sentences.english: The doctor felt that this situation was very dangerous, and he was very angry.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“对不起，我没能保护好这个地方。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Duì bu qǐ, wǒ méi néng bǎo hù hǎo zhè ge dì fang.”
sentences.english: He said, "I am sorry, I failed to protect this place."

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，这些黑影其实是生病的灵魂。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ, zhè xiē hēi yǐng qí shí shì shēng bìng de líng hún.
