sentences.english: He told me that these shadows were actually sick souls.

sentences.chinese: 他们得了一种奇怪的病，变成了可怕的病人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men dé le yī zhǒng qí guài de bìng, biàn chéng le kě pà de bìng rén.
sentences.english: They had contracted a strange disease and became terrifying patients.

sentences.chinese: 我想起我在学校的时候，下课后总是很开心。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐ wǒ zài xué xiào de shí hou, xià kè hòu zǒng shì hěn kāi xīn.
sentences.english: I remembered when I was at school, I was always happy after class.

sentences.chinese: 但现在，这里的气氛比最难的听写考试还要紧张。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiàn zài, zhè lǐ de qì fēn bǐ zuì nán de tīng xiě kǎo shì hái yào jǐn zhāng.
sentences.english: But now, the atmosphere here was even more tense than the most difficult dictation test.

sentences.chinese: 我感觉肚子很饿，但我现在不能吃东西。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gǎn jué dù zi hěn è, dàn wǒ xiàn zài bù néng chī dōng xi.
sentences.english: I felt my stomach was very hungry, but I couldn't eat anything now.

sentences.chinese: 医生说，如果被他们考到，我们就没机会了。
sentences.pinyin: Yī shēng shuō, rú guǒ bèi tā men kǎo dào, wǒ men jiù méi jī huì le.
sentences.english: The doctor said if we were hit by them, we would have no chance.

sentences.chinese: 他指着窗外说：“快，我们得像打车一样迅速离开这里！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐ zhe chuāng wài shuō: “Kuài, wǒ men děi xiàng dǎ chē yī yàng xùn sù lí kāi zhè lǐ!”
sentences.english: He pointed out the window and said, "Quick, we must leave here as fast as taking a taxi!"

sentences.chinese: 虽然在古代没有车，但他的意思是快跑。
sentences.pinyin: Suī rán zài gǔ dài méi yǒu chē, dàn tā de yì si shì kuài pǎo.
sentences.english: Although there were no cars in ancient times, he meant to run fast.

sentences.chinese: 我看到一个黑影试图关上花园的大门。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào yī gè hēi yǐng shì tú guān shàng huā yuán de dà mén.
sentences.english: I saw a shadow trying to close the main gate of the garden.

sentences.chinese: 我心想，如果我能像下班一样轻松离开就好了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xīn xiǎng, rú guǒ wǒ néng xiàng xià bān yī yàng qīng sōng lí kāi jiù hǎo le.
sentences.english: I thought to myself, if only I could leave as easily as getting off work.

sentences.chinese: 医生突然停下来，他看起来像生病了，脸色很差。
sentences.pinyin: Yī shēng tū rán tíng xià lái, tā kàn qǐ lái xiàng shēng bìng le, liǎn sè hěn chà.
sentences.english: The doctor suddenly stopped; he looked as if he had fallen ill, his complexion was poor.

sentences.chinese: 他低声说：“我二月的时候就感觉身体不对。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dī shēng shuō: “Wǒ èr yuè de shí hou jiù gǎn jué shēn tǐ bù duì.”
sentences.english: He whispered, "I felt something was wrong with my body back in February."

sentences.chinese: 他觉得自己的身体坏了，无法再走远。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué de zì jǐ de shēn tǐ huài le, wú fǎ zài zǒu yuǎn.
sentences.english: He felt that his body was broken and he could no longer walk far.

sentences.chinese: 我记得每天起床的时候，生活总是那么简单。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jì dé měi tiān qǐ chuáng de shí hou, shēng huó zǒng shì nà me jiǎn dān.
sentences.english: I remember when I got up every day, life was always so simple.

sentences.chinese: 但现在，逃跑变得如此困难。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiàn zài, táo pǎo biàn de rú cǐ kùn nan.
sentences.english: But now, escaping had become so difficult.

sentences.chinese: 医生看着我，眼神里充满了悲伤。
sentences.pinyin: Yī shēng kàn zhe wǒ, yǎn shén lǐ chōng mǎn le bēi shāng.
sentences.english: The doctor looked at me, his eyes full of sadness.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，花园的墙壁突然裂开了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, huā yuán de qiáng bì tū rán liè kāi le.
sentences.english: Just then, the walls of the garden suddenly cracked open.

sentences.chinese: 花园的墙壁裂开了，我突然看到一个奇怪的世界。
sentences.pinyin: Huāyuán de qiángbì liè kāi le, wǒ tūrán kàndào yīgè qíguài de shìjiè.
sentences.english: The garden walls cracked open, and I suddenly saw a strange world.

sentences.chinese: 那里有一座很大的学校，看起来像是一个古老的学院。
sentences.pinyin: Nàlǐ yǒu yī zuò hěn dà de xuéxiào, kàn qǐlái xiàng shì yīgè gǔlǎo de xuéyuàn.
sentences.english: There was a huge school there, which looked like an ancient academy.

sentences.chinese: 我看到很多学生在走廊里走。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàndào hěnduō xuésheng zài zǒuláng lǐ zǒu.
sentences.english: I saw many students walking in the corridor.

sentences.chinese: 有的男生在跑步，有的女生在说话。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu de nánshēng zài pǎobù, yǒu de nǚshēng zài shuōhuà.
sentences.english: Some boys were running, and some girls were talking.

sentences.chinese: 一个小学生背着书包，看起来很像我小时候。
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè xiǎoxuéshēng bēizhe shūbāo, kàn qǐlái hěn xiàng wǒ xiǎoshíhou.
sentences.english: An elementary school student was carrying a schoolbag, looking very much like I did when I was little.

sentences.chinese: 我想起我以前在小学读书的日子，那时候生活很开心。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngqǐ wǒ yǐqián zài xiǎoxué dúshū de rìzi, nà shíhou shēnghuó hěn kāixīn.
sentences.english: I remembered the days when I studied in primary school; life was very happy then.

sentences.chinese: 后来我进入了中学，成为了一个中学生。
sentences.pinyin: Hòulái wǒ jìnrù le zhōngxué, chéngwéi le yīgè zhōngxuésheng.
sentences.english: Later, I entered middle school and became a middle-school student.

sentences.chinese: 在中学的时候，我每天早起去上学。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhōngxué de shíhou, wǒ měitiān zǎoqǐ qù shàngxué.
sentences.english: During middle school, I woke up early every day to go to school.

sentences.chinese: 我的同学告诉我，我们要努力学习，将来去大学。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de tóngxué gàosù wǒ, wǒmen yào nǔlì xuéxí, jiānglái qù dàxué.
sentences.english: My classmates told me that we must study hard to go to university in the future.

sentences.chinese: 在那个时代，大学不仅是学校，也是一种伟大的学习方式。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nàge shídài, dàxué bùjǐn shì xuéxiào, yěshì yī zhǒng wěidà de xuéxí fāngshì.
sentences.english: In that era, 'The Great Learning' (Daxue) was not just a school, but also a great way of learning.

sentences.chinese: 我想成为一个大学生，像那些博学的先生一样。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chéngwéi yīgè dàxuéshēng, xiàng nàxiē bóxué de xiānsheng yīyàng.
sentences.english: I wanted to become a university student, like those learned gentlemen.

sentences.chinese: 我记得我的老师总是说，读书可以让人的心变得宽广。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jìde wǒ de lǎoshī zǒng shì shuō, dúshū kěyǐ ràng rén de xīn biàn de kuānguǎng.
sentences.english: I remember my teacher always saying that reading books can make one's heart broad.

sentences.chinese: 那个教学楼很高，像一座巨大的山。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge jiàoxuélóu hěn gāo, xiàng yī zuò jùdà de shān.
sentences.english: The teaching building was very tall, like a giant mountain.

sentences.chinese: 每天放学的时候，我们都会在门口等朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Měitiān fàngxué de shíhou, wǒmen dūhuì zài ménkǒu děng péngyǒu.
sentences.english: Every day after school was dismissed, we would wait for friends at the gate.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个老人走到了我面前。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yīgè lǎorén zǒu dào le wǒ miànqián.
sentences.english: Suddenly, an old man walked up to me.

sentences.chinese: 他看着我，眼神里有一种深沉的智慧。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe wǒ, yǎnshén lǐ yǒu yī zhǒng shēnchén de zhìhuì.
sentences.english: He looked at me, and there was a kind of deep wisdom in his eyes.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你不是这个世界的人，你是一个迷路的学生。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ bùshì zhège shìjiè de rén, nǐ shì yīgè mílù de xuésheng.”
sentences.english: He said, "You are not from this world; you are a lost student."

sentences.chinese: 我惊恐地问他：“你是谁？为什么我知道这里？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jīngkǒng de wèn tā: “Nǐ shì shéi? Wèishéme wǒ zhīdào zhèlǐ?”
sentences.english: I asked him in terror, "Who are you? Why do I know this place?"

sentences.chinese: 老人笑了，他说他在这个世界里有很多网友，虽然他们不在同一个地方，但心在一起。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén xiào le, tā shuō tā zài zhège shìjiè lǐ yǒu hěnduō wǎngyǒu, suīrán tāmen bù zài tóng yīgè dìfāng, dàn xīn zài yīqǐ.
sentences.english: The old man smiled and said he had many online friends in this world; although they were not in the same place, their hearts were together.

sentences.chinese: 在这个古老的时空里，这种连接就像是某种魔法。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège gǔlǎo de shíkōng lǐ, zhè zhǒng liánjiē jiù xiàng shì mǒu zhǒng mófǎ.
sentences.english: In this ancient space-time, this kind of connection was like some kind of magic.

sentences.chinese: 我突然意识到，这个幻象是医生为了救我而创造的记忆碎片。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tūrán yìshí dào, zhège huànxiàng shì yīshēng wèile jiù wǒ ér chuàngzào de jìyì suìpiàn.
sentences.english: I suddenly realized that this illusion was a fragment of memory created by the doctor to save me.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，裂缝中传来了那个黑影的冷笑声。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, lièfèng zhōng chuánlái le nàge hēiyǐng de lěngxiào shēng.
sentences.english: But just then, the cold laughter of that dark shadow echoed from the crack.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十五章：记忆中的温暖

sentences.chinese: 黑影的声音很冷，但我看着医生，发现他的眼睛里有光。
sentences.pinyin: Hēiyǐng de shēngyīn hěn lěng, dàn wǒ kànzhe yīshēng, fāxiàn tā de yǎnjīng lǐ yǒu guāng.
sentences.english: The shadow's voice was very cold, but looking at the doctor, I found light in his eyes.

sentences.chinese: 医生告诉我，为了逃离这里，我必须在记忆碎片中找到一个好地方。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng gàosù wǒ, wèile táolí zhèlǐ, wǒ bìxū zài jìyì suìpiàn zhōng zhǎodào yīgè hǎo dìfāng.
sentences.english: The doctor told me that in order to escape this place, I must find a good place within the memory fragments.

sentences.chinese: 我闭上眼睛，突然我想到了我的家。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bì shàng yǎnjīng, tūrán wǒ xiǎngdào le wǒ de jiā.
sentences.english: I closed my eyes, and suddenly I thought of my home.

sentences.chinese: 在那段记忆里，我的家非常干净，阳光照在木地板上。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nà duàn jìyì lǐ, wǒ de jiā fēicháng gānjìng, yángguāng zhào zài mù dìbǎn shàng.
sentences.english: In that memory, my home was very clean, with sunlight shining on the wooden floor.

sentences.chinese: 我看到我的奶奶在厨房里准备晚餐。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàndào wǒ de nǎinai zài chúfáng lǐ zhǔnbèi wǎncān.
sentences.english: I saw my grandmother preparing dinner in the kitchen.

sentences.chinese: 奶奶在做我最喜欢吃的面条，闻起来非常好吃。
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai zài zuò wǒ zuì xǐhuan chī de miàntiáo, wén qǐlái fēicháng hǎochī.
sentences.english: Grandmother was making the noodles I liked most; they smelled delicious.

sentences.chinese: 她叫我的名字，让我快点去吃饭。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiào wǒ de míngzì, ràng wǒ kuài diǎn qù chīfàn.
sentences.english: She called my name, telling me to hurry and eat.

sentences.chinese: 我记得我当时很忙，因为我想在家里学习写字。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jìde wǒ dāngshí hěn máng, yīnwèi wǒ xiǎng zài jiālǐ xuéxí xiězì.
sentences.english: I remember I was very busy then, because I wanted to study writing at home.

sentences.chinese: 我学习了很多古老的文字，这些文字对我来说像魔法一样。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xuéxí le hěnduō gǔlǎo de wénzì, zhèxiē wénzì duì wǒ lái shuō xiàng mófǎ yīyàng.
sentences.english: I studied many ancient characters; these characters were like magic to me.

sentences.chinese: 奶奶笑着对我说：“学习很重要，但现在要先喝牛奶。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai xiàozhe duì wǒ shuō: “Xuéxí hěn zhòngyào, dàn xiànzài yào xiān hē niúnǎi.”
sentences.english: Grandmother smiled and said to me, "Studying is important, but now you must drink your milk first."

sentences.chinese: 我记得那种奶的味道，温暖而甜美。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jìde nà zhǒng nǎi de wèidào, wēnnuǎn ér tiánměi.
sentences.english: I remember the taste of that milk, warm and sweet.

sentences.chinese: 在那段日子里，我每天都学很多新东西。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nà duàn rìzi lǐ, wǒ měitiān dōu xué hěnduō xīn dōngxī.
sentences.english: During those days, I learned many new things every day.

sentences.chinese: 我和朋友们在院子里打球，那是我们最快乐的时间。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyǒumen zài yuànzi lǐ dǎqiú, nà shì wǒmen zuì kuàilè de shíjiān.
sentences.english: My friends and I played ball in the courtyard; that was our happiest time.

sentences.chinese: 我看着记忆中的自己，觉得那个孩子长得很好看。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe jìyì zhōng de zìjǐ, juéde nàgè háizi zhǎng de hěn hǎokàn.
sentences.english: Looking at myself in the memory, I felt that child was very good-looking.

sentences.chinese: 突然，黑影的声音再次出现，他试图破坏这个幻象。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, hēiyǐng de shēngyīn zàicì chūxiàn, tā shìtú pòhuài zhège huànxiàng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the shadow's voice appeared again, attempting to destroy this illusion.

sentences.chinese: 他大声唱起了一首诡异的歌，声音像风一样在耳边响起。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàshēng chàng qǐ le yī shǒu guǐyì de gē, shēngyīn xiàng fēng yīyàng zài ěrbiān xiǎngqǐ.
sentences.english: He loudly sang an eerie song, the sound ringing in my ears like the wind.

sentences.chinese: 医生大喊：“不要听他！快回答我，你最想回到哪里？”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng dàhǎn: “Bùyào tīng tā! Kuài huídá wǒ, nǐ zuì xiǎng huí dào nǎlǐ?”
sentences.english: The doctor shouted, "Don't listen to him! Quickly answer me, where do you most want to return to?"

sentences.chinese: 我大声回答：“我想回到那个有奶奶的地方！”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dàshēng huídá: “Wǒ xiǎng huí dào nàgè yǒu nǎinai de dìfāng!”
sentences.english: I answered loudly, "I want to return to the place where my grandmother is!"

sentences.chinese: 黑影冷笑一声，说我在开玩笑，因为那个地方已经不存在了。
sentences.pinyin: Hēiyǐng lěngxiào yī shēng, shuō wǒ zài kāiwánxiào, yīnwèi nàgè dìfāng yǐjīng bù cúnzài le.
sentences.english: The shadow sneered, saying I was joking, because that place no longer existed.

sentences.chinese: 但我知道，只要我能得到这份记忆的力量，我就能生存。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ zhīdào, zhǐyào wǒ néng dédào zhè fèn jìyì de lìliàng, wǒ jiù néng shēngcún.
sentences.english: But I knew that as long as I could obtain the power of this memory, I could survive.

sentences.chinese: 我请求医生帮忙，帮我把这个幻象变成真正的门。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ qǐngqiú yīshēng bāngmáng, bāng wǒ bǎ zhège huànxiàng biànchéng zhēnzhèng de mén.
sentences.english: I asked the doctor for help, to help me turn this illusion into a real door.

sentences.chinese: 医生说：“好，但你必须勇敢地走出来。”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō: “Hǎo, dàn nǐ bìxū yǒnggǎn de zǒu chūlái.”
sentences.english: The doctor said, "All right, but you must bravely come out."

sentences.chinese: 我感觉到一股力量在体内产生，一个白色的出口出现在黑影面前。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gǎnjué dào yī gǔ lìliàng zài tǐnèi chǎnshēng, yīgè báisè de chūkǒu chūxiàn zài hēiyǐng miànqián.
sentences.english: I felt a power arise within my body, and a white exit appeared before the shadow.

sentences.chinese: 我想，在现实世界里，人们可以用钱买到很多东西，但买不到这种感情。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng, zài xiànshí shìjiè lǐ, rénmen kěyǐ yòng qián mǎi dào hěnduō dōngxī, dàn mǎi bù dào zhè zhǒng gǎnqíng.
sentences.english: I thought that in the real world, people can use money to buy many things, but they cannot buy this kind of emotion.

sentences.chinese: 我看着黑影，他现在看起来不再那么可怕，反而像个迷路的孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe hēiyǐng, tā xiànzài kàn qǐlái bù zài nàme kěpà, fǎn'ér xiàng gè mílù de háizi.
sentences.english: I looked at the shadow; he no longer seemed so scary, but rather like a lost child.

sentences.chinese: 我深吸一口气，准备走出这个时空的裂缝。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shēn xī yī kǒuqì, zhǔnbèi zǒu chū zhège shíkōng de lièfèng.
sentences.english: I took a deep breath, preparing to step out of this space-time rift.

sentences.chinese: 就在我踏出第一步时，我发现黑影的手里竟然拿着一样我熟悉的东西。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài wǒ tà chū dì yī bù shí, wǒ fāxiàn hēiyǐng de shǒulǐ jìngrán názhe yīyàng wǒ shúxī de dōngxī.
sentences.english: Just as I took the first step, I discovered that in the shadow's hand, he was actually holding something I recognized.

sentences.chinese: 我走近黑影，看见他手里拿着的是一本旧书。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǒu jìn hēiyǐng, kànjiàn tā shǒulǐ názhe de shì yī běn jiù shū.
sentences.english: I walked closer to the dark shadow and saw that he was holding an old book.

sentences.chinese: 那是我的书，我终于明白了一切。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì wǒ de shū, wǒ zhōngyú míngbai le yīqiè.
sentences.english: It was my book; I finally understood everything.

sentences.chinese: 黑影看着我，他的眼神不再冰冷，而是充满了悲伤。
sentences.pinyin: Hēiyǐng kànzhe wǒ, tā de yǎnshén bù zài bīnglěng, ér shì chōngmǎn le bēishāng.
sentences.english: The shadow looked at me, his gaze no longer cold, but filled with sadness.

sentences.chinese: 他低声说：“我一直在找你，为了告诉你这个秘密。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dīshēng shuō: “Wǒ yīzhí zài zhǎo nǐ, wèile gàosù nǐ zhège mìmì.”
sentences.english: He whispered, "I have been looking for you to tell you this secret."

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，他曾经是一个非常有名的学者。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, tā céngjīng shì yī gè fēicháng yǒu míng de xuézhě.
sentences.english: He told me that he was once a very famous scholar.

sentences.chinese: 他拥有很多古老的知识，但他在追求权力中迷失了方向。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǒngyǒu hěnduō gǔlǎo de zhīshi, dàn tā zài zhuīqiú quánlì zhōng míshī le fāngxiàng.
sentences.english: He possessed much ancient knowledge, but he lost his way in the pursuit of power.

sentences.chinese: 他把灵魂放进了这个时空的裂缝里，成了没有名字的影子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ línghún fàng jìn le zhège shíkōng de lièfèng lǐ, chéng le méiyǒu míngzi de yǐngzi.
sentences.english: He placed his soul into the rift of this space-time, becoming a shadow without a name.

sentences.chinese: 他现在穿一件破旧的黑衣服，看起来很可怜。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiànzài chuān yī jiàn pòjiù de hēi yīfu, kàn qǐlái hěn kělián.
sentences.english: He is now wearing old, ragged black clothes and looks very pitiful.

sentences.chinese: 他对我认真地说：“你最好离开这里，因为这里很危险。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì wǒ rènzhēn de shuō: “Nǐ zuìhǎo líkāi zhèlǐ, yīnwèi zhèlǐ hěn wēixiǎn.”
sentences.english: He said to me earnestly, "You had better leave this place, because it is very dangerous."

sentences.chinese: 我看着他，觉得他像一个需要看病的人，身体很虚弱。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe tā, juéde tā xiàng yī gè xūyào kànbìng de rén, shēntǐ hěn xūruò.
sentences.english: I looked at him and felt he was like someone who needed to see a doctor; his body was very weak.

sentences.chinese: 此时，我们来到了一棵巨大的古树下。
sentences.pinyin: Cǐshí, wǒmen láidào le yī kē jùdà de gǔshù xià.
sentences.english: At this moment, we arrived under a huge ancient tree.

sentences.chinese: 阳光照在树叶上，天气变得很热。
sentences.pinyin: Yángguāng zhào zài shùyè shàng, tiānqì biàn de hěn rè.
sentences.english: Sunlight shone on the leaves, and the weather became very hot.

sentences.chinese: 黑影突然唱起了一首古老的歌，声音很轻。
sentences.pinyin: Hēiyǐng tūrán chàng qǐ le yī shǒu gǔlǎo de gē, shēngyīn hěn qīng.
sentences.english: The shadow suddenly began to sing an ancient song, his voice very soft.

sentences.chinese: 他说，在很久以前，人们在这里玩儿，生活很单纯。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, zài hěnjiǔ yǐqián, rénmen zài zhèlǐ wánr, shēnghuó hěn dāncún.
sentences.english: He said that long ago, people played here, and life was very simple.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，要学会用心地感受世界，而不是只看书本。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, yào xuéhuì yòng xīn de gǎnshòu shìjiè, ér bùshì zhǐ kàn shūběn.
sentences.english: He told me that one must learn to use the heart to feel the world, rather than just looking at books.

sentences.chinese: 我想起在学校的时候，为了考试，我每天只知道读书。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngqǐ zài xuéxiào de shíhou, wèile kǎoshì, wǒ měitiān zhǐ zhīdào dúshū.
sentences.english: I remembered when I was at school, for the sake of exams, I only knew how to study every day.

sentences.chinese: 那时我没有时间去认识这个真实的世界。
sentences.pinyin: Nàshí wǒ méiyǒu shíjiān qù rènshi zhège zhēnshí de shìjiè.
sentences.english: At that time, I had no time to get to know this real world.

sentences.chinese: 黑影说：“我们终于见面了，虽然是以这种方式。”
sentences.pinyin: Hēiyǐng shuō: “Wǒmen zhōngyú jiànmiàn le, suīrán shì yǐ zhèzhǒng fāngshì.”
sentences.english: The shadow said, "We have finally met, although it is in this manner."

sentences.chinese: 我问他：“你怎么知道我会来到这里？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Nǐ zěnme zhīdào wǒ huì láidào zhèlǐ?”
sentences.english: I asked him, "How did you know I would come here?"

sentences.chinese: 他笑了，说这是一个古老的着法，是命运的安排。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiào le, shuō zhè shì yī gè gǔlǎo de zhāofǎ, shì mìngyùn de ānpái.
sentences.english: He smiled and said this was an ancient trick, an arrangement of fate.

sentences.chinese: 他给我看了一封信，信里写着我祖父的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gěi wǒ kàn le yī fēng xìn, xìn lǐ xiězhe wǒ zǔfù de míngzi.
sentences.english: He showed me a letter, and in the letter was my grandfather's name.

sentences.chinese: 我意识到，我必须认真听他的话，才能找到回家的路。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yìshí dào, wǒ bìxū rènzhēn tīng tā de huà, cáinéng zhǎodào huíjiā de lù.
sentences.english: I realized that I must listen to his words earnestly to find the way home.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你现在应该去睡一会儿，休息之后我们再见。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ xiànzài yīnggāi qù shuì yīhuìr, xiūxi zhīhòu wǒmen zàijiàn.”
sentences.english: He said, "You should go sleep for a while now; we shall meet again after you rest."

sentences.chinese: 我看着他慢慢消失在光芒中，心中有一种奇怪的感觉。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe tā mànmàn xiāoshī zài guāngmáng zhōng, xīnzhōng yǒu yī zhǒng qíguài de gǎnjué.
sentences.english: I watched him slowly disappear into the light, feeling a strange sensation in my heart.

sentences.chinese: 我知道，他是在保护我，给我指引方向。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào, tā shì zài bǎohù wǒ, gěi wǒ zhǐyǐn fāngxiàng.
sentences.english: I knew he was protecting me, giving me guidance.

sentences.chinese: 但就在我准备闭上眼睛时，我突然听到了一个熟悉的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài wǒ zhǔnbèi bì shàng yǎnjīng shí, wǒ tūrán tīngdào le yī gè shúxī de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: But just as I was preparing to close my eyes, I suddenly heard a familiar voice.

sentences.chinese: 那个声音在喊我的名字，而且听起来非常紧急。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge shēngyīn zài hǎn wǒ de míngzi, érqiě tīng qǐlái fēicháng jǐnjí.
sentences.english: That voice was calling my name, and it sounded very urgent.

sentences.chinese: 我猛地从床上起来。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ měng de cóng chuáng shàng qǐ lai.
sentences.english: I suddenly got up from the bed.

sentences.chinese: 那个熟悉的声音在我的耳边说话。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè shú xī de shēng yīn zài wǒ de ěr biān shuō huà.
sentences.english: That familiar voice was speaking in my ear.

sentences.chinese: 我睁开眼睛，发现我回到了家中的床边。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhēng kāi yǎn jīng, fā xiàn wǒ huí dào le jiā zhōng de chuáng biān.
sentences.english: I opened my eyes and found that I had returned to the side of my bed at home.

sentences.chinese: 我的奶奶正看着我，她的眼神很温柔。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de nǎi nai zhèng kàn zhe wǒ, tā de yǎn shén hěn wēn róu.
sentences.english: My grandmother was looking at me, her gaze very gentle.

sentences.chinese: 她说：“孩子，你终于回来了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Hái zi, nǐ zhōng yú huí lai le.”
sentences.english: She said, "Child, you have finally come back."

sentences.chinese: 我很高兴看到她，因为我太想她了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hěn gāo xìng kàn dào tā, yīn wèi wǒ tài xiǎng tā le.
sentences.english: I was very happy to see her because I missed her so much.

sentences.chinese: 奶奶给我了一杯热茶。
sentences.pinyin: Nǎi nai gěi wǒ le yī bēi rè chá.
sentences.english: Grandmother gave me a cup of hot tea.

sentences.chinese: 我接过杯子，对她说：“谢谢奶奶。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiē guò bēi zi, duì tā shuō: “Xiè xie nǎi nai.”
sentences.english: I took the cup and said to her, "Thank you, Grandma."

sentences.chinese: 奶奶告诉我，我刚才在做一个很长的梦。
sentences.pinyin: Nǎi nai gào sù wǒ, wǒ gāng cái zài zuò yī gè hěn cháng de mèng.
sentences.english: Grandmother told me that I had just been having a very long dream.

sentences.chinese: 她说：“你要记住，梦里的东西很重要。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ yào jì zhu, mèng lǐ de dōng xī hěn zhòng yào.”
sentences.english: She said, "You must remember, the things in the dream are very important."

sentences.chinese: 我想起梦中的黑影和那个医生。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐ mèng zhōng de hēi yǐng hé nà gè yī shēng.
sentences.english: I thought of the black shadow and the doctor in the dream.

sentences.chinese: 我想在纸上记下所有的细节。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zài zhǐ shàng jì xià suǒ yǒu de xì jié.
sentences.english: I wanted to record all the details on paper.

sentences.chinese: 奶奶看着我，问我发生了什么。
sentences.pinyin: Nǎi nai kàn zhe wǒ, wèn wǒ fā shēng le shén me.
sentences.english: Grandmother looked at me and asked me what had happened.

sentences.chinese: 我试着告诉她关于禁宫的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shì zhe gào sù tā guān yú jìn gōng de mì mì.
sentences.english: I tried to tell her about the secrets of the Forbidden Palace.

sentences.chinese: 奶奶低声说：“那些秘密太贵，普通人不能知道。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎi nai dī shēng shuō: “Nà xiē mì mì tài guì, pǔ tōng rén bù néng zhī dào.”
sentences.english: Grandmother whispered, "Those secrets are too precious; ordinary people cannot know them."

sentences.chinese: 这里的“贵”是指这些知识非常珍贵且危险。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de “guì” shì zhǐ zhè xiē zhī shi fēi cháng zhēn guì qiě wēi xiǎn.
sentences.english: Here, "precious" refers to the fact that this knowledge is very valuable and dangerous.

sentences.chinese: 我请奶奶告诉我更多关于这个家族的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ qǐng nǎi nai gào sù wǒ gèng duō guān yú zhè gè jiā zú de gù shì.
sentences.english: I asked my grandmother to tell me more about the story of this family.

sentences.chinese: 她请我跟她一起走。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qǐng wǒ gēn tā yī qǐ zǒu.
sentences.english: She invited me to go with her.

sentences.chinese: 我们开始在花园里走路。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men kāi shǐ zài huā yuán lǐ zǒu lù.
sentences.english: We began to walk in the garden.

sentences.chinese: 我问她：“请问，那个黑影是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Qǐng wèn, nà gè hēi yǐng shì shéi?”
sentences.english: I asked her, "Excuse me, who is that black shadow?"

sentences.chinese: 奶奶停下来，看着远方。
sentences.pinyin: Nǎi nai tíng xià lái, kàn zhe yuǎn fāng.
sentences.english: Grandmother stopped and looked into the distance.

sentences.chinese: 她没有说话，只是让我重新思考那个声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méi yǒu shuō huà, zhǐ shì ràng wǒ chóng xīn sī kǎo nà gè shēng yīn.
sentences.english: She did not speak, but only asked me to rethink that voice.

sentences.chinese: 她让我重读一遍家里的古书。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ràng wǒ chóng dú yī biàn jiā lǐ de gǔ shū.
sentences.english: She asked me to re-read the ancient books in the house once more.

sentences.chinese: 我问她：“那个秘密在哪里？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Nà gè mì mì zài nǎ lǐ?”
sentences.english: I asked her, "Where is that secret?"

sentences.chinese: 奶奶笑了，但她的笑容里有一丝忧虑。
sentences.pinyin: Nǎi nai xiào le, dàn tā de xiào róng lǐ yǒu yī sī yōu lǜ.
sentences.english: Grandmother smiled, but there was a hint of anxiety in her smile.

sentences.chinese: 突然，花园的门再次打开了。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, huā yuán de mén zài cì dǎ kāi le.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the garden gate opened once again.

sentences.chinese: 一个穿着古装的人走进来，手里拿着一本书。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè chuān zhe gǔ zhuāng de rén zǒu jìn lái, shǒu lǐ ná zhe yī běn shū.
sentences.english: A person dressed in ancient clothing walked in, holding a book in their hand.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 18: The Secret of the Ancient Book

sentences.chinese: 那个穿着古装的人走过来，手里拿了一本书。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge chuān zhe gǔ zhuāng de rén zǒu guò lái, shǒu lǐ ná le yī běn shū.
sentences.english: The person dressed in ancient clothes walked over, holding a book in his hand.

sentences.chinese: 他看着我，突然笑了一下儿。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe wǒ, tū rán xiào le yī xià r.
sentences.english: He looked at me and suddenly smiled for a moment.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你就是那个孩子，你今年多少岁？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ jiù shì nà ge hái zi, nǐ jīn nián duō shǎo suì?”
sentences.english: He said, "You are that child, how old are you this year?"

sentences.chinese: 我告诉他我的年龄，然后我们一块儿走进屋子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gào su tā wǒ de nián líng, rán hòu wǒ men yī kuài r zǒu jìn wū zi.
sentences.english: I told him my age, and then we went into the room together.

sentences.chinese: 屋子里很安静，这里有很多古老的书。
sentences.pinyin: Wū zi lǐ hěn ānjìng, zhè lǐ yǒu hěn duō gǔ lǎo de shū.
sentences.english: It was very quiet inside the room; there were many ancient books here.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，从很久以前，这里的书就是最重要的课。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su wǒ, cóng hěn jiǔ yǐ qián, zhè lǐ de shū jiù shì zuì zhòng yào de kè.
sentences.english: He told me that since a long time ago, the books here have been the most important lesson.

sentences.chinese: 他问我：“你能帮我干一件事情吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn wǒ: “Nǐ néng bāng wǒ gàn yī jiàn shì qíng ma?”
sentences.english: He asked me, "Can you help me do something?"

sentences.chinese: 我点点头，觉得这件事有点儿好玩儿。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ diǎn diǎn tóu, jué de zhè jiàn shì yǒu diǎn r hǎo wán r.
sentences.english: I nodded, thinking this matter was a bit fun.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个男孩儿和一个女孩儿跑了进来。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yī gè nán hái r hé yī gè nǚ hái r pǎo le jìn lái.
sentences.english: At this moment, a boy and a girl ran in.

sentences.chinese: 他们看起来像个小孩儿，在屋里跑来跑去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men kàn qǐ lái xiàng gè xiǎo hái r, zài wū lǐ pǎo lái pǎo qù.
sentences.english: They looked like small children, running back and forth in the room.

sentences.chinese: 那个男孩儿在楼上大喊，声音很大。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge nán hái r zài lóu shàng dà hǎn, shēng yīn hěn dà.
sentences.english: The boy shouted from upstairs, his voice very loud.

sentences.chinese: 那个女孩儿在书架里寻找一样东西。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge nǚ hái r zài shū jià lǐ xún zhǎo yī yàng dōng xī.
sentences.english: The girl was searching for something among the bookshelves.

sentences.chinese: 我看着他们，心想这像是一个奇怪的学校。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe tā men, xīn xiǎng zhè xiàng shì yī gè qí guài de xué xiào.
sentences.english: I looked at them and thought this was like a strange school.

sentences.chinese: 古装人说：“现在，我们先去洗手间洗洗手。”
sentences.pinyin: Gǔ zhuāng rén shuō: “Xiàn zài, wǒ men xiān qù xǐ shǒu jiān xǐ xǐ shǒu.”
sentences.english: The man in ancient clothes said, "Now, let's go to the washroom to wash our hands first."

sentences.chinese: 然后，他请我们去吃面条儿。
sentences.pinyin: Rán hòu, tā qǐng wǒ men qù chī miàn tiáo r.
sentences.english: Then, he invited us to eat noodles.

sentences.chinese: 我和那些孩子坐在桌子旁，吃着热腾腾的面条儿。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hé nà xiē hái zi zuò zài zhuō zi páng, chī zhe rè téng téng de miàn tiáo r.
sentences.english: Those children and I sat by the table, eating steaming hot noodles.

sentences.chinese: 在这个安静的下午，我感觉到了久违的温暖。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè ge ānjìng de xià wǔ, wǒ gǎn jué dào le jiǔ wéi de wēn nuǎn.
sentences.english: On this quiet afternoon, I felt a long-lost warmth.

sentences.chinese: 但突然，古装人停了下来，他的眼神变得严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tū rán, gǔ zhuāng rén tíng le xià lái, tā de yǎn shén biàn de yán sù.
sentences.english: But suddenly, the man in ancient clothes stopped, and his expression became serious.

sentences.chinese: 他低声说：“书里的秘密就在这里，但有人想拿走它。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dī shēng shuō: “Shū lǐ de mì mì jiù zài zhè lǐ, dàn yǒu rén xiǎng ná zǒu tā.”
sentences.english: He whispered, "The secret in the book is right here, but someone wants to take it away."

sentences.chinese: 我看向窗外，发现刚才那个黑影再次出现了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn xiàng chuāng wài, fā xiàn gāng cái nà ge hēi yǐng zài cì chū xiàn le.
sentences.english: I looked out the window and found that the dark shadow from before had appeared again.

sentences.chinese: 他正对着我们冷冷地笑。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhèng duì zhe wǒ men lěng lěng de xiào.
sentences.english: He was smiling coldly at us.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 19: The Threat of the Shadow

sentences.chinese: 黑影在窗外笑，他的眼睛里没有光。
sentences.pinyin: Hēiyǐng zài chuāngwài xiào, tā de yǎnjīng lǐ méiyǒu guāng.
sentences.english: The shadow laughed outside the window, there was no light in his eyes.

sentences.chinese: 那个古装人看着我，低声说：“我们不能在这里等了。”
sentences.pinyin: Nàge gǔzhuāng rén kànzhe wǒ, dīshēng shuō: “Wǒmen bùnéng zài zhèlǐ děng le.”
sentences.english: The man in ancient clothes looked at me and whispered, "We cannot wait here any longer."

sentences.chinese: 我想问：“谁在外面？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng wèn: “Shéi zài wàimiàn?”
sentences.english: I wanted to ask, "Who is outside?"

sentences.chinese: 但他的脸变得很严肃，他说：“这不再是一个安全的地方。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tā de liǎn biàndé hěn yánsù, tā shuō: “Zhè bù zài shì yígè ānquán de dìfāng.”
sentences.english: But his face became very serious, and he said, "This is no longer a safe place."

sentences.chinese: 我看向桌上的古书，书的封面有很多奇怪的图案。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànxiàng zhuōshàng de gǔshū, shū de fēngmiàn yǒu hěnduō qíguài de túàn.
sentences.english: I looked at the ancient book on the table; there were many strange patterns on the cover.

sentences.chinese: 医生走了过来，他的样子很累，因为他没睡觉。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng zǒu le guòlái, tā de yàngzi hěn lèi, yīnwèi tā méi shuìjiào.
sentences.english: The doctor walked over; he looked exhausted because he had not slept.

sentences.chinese: 他看着黑影，问古装人：“他怎么进来的？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe hēiyǐng, wèn gǔzhuāng rén: “Tā zěnme jìnlái de?”
sentences.english: He looked at the shadow and asked the man in ancient clothes, "How did he get in?"

sentences.chinese: 古装人回答：“他想拿走这本书，我们必须快点走。”
sentences.pinyin: Gǔzhuāng rén huídá: “Tā xiǎng názǒu zhè běn shū, wǒmen bìxū kuàidiǎn zǒu.”
sentences.english: The man in ancient clothes replied, "He wants to take this book; we must leave quickly."

sentences.chinese: 我想起我的爷爷，他以前告诉我，书里的秘密很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngqǐ wǒ de yéye, tā yǐqián gàosù wǒ, shū lǐ de mìmì hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.english: I thought of my grandfather; he once told me that the secrets in the book were very important.

sentences.chinese: 爷爷说，如果有人想偷走秘密，就必须勇敢地面对。
sentences.pinyin: Yéye shuō, rúguǒ yǒurén xiǎng tōu zǒu mìmì, jiù bìxū yǒnggǎn de miànduì.
sentences.english: Grandfather said if someone wants to steal the secret, one must face it bravely.

sentences.chinese: 我问：“我们要回哪里去？我们要回家吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn: “Wǒmen yào huí nǎlǐ qù? Wǒmen yào huíjiā ma?”
sentences.english: I asked, "Where are we going back to? Are we going home?"

sentences.chinese: 医生摇了摇头，说：“现在没法回那个家。”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng yáole yáotóu, shuō: “Xiànzài méifǎ huí nàge jiā.”
sentences.english: The doctor shook his head and said, "Right now there is no way to go back to that home."

sentences.chinese: 古装人说：“后天才是解决问题的日子，现在我们必须离开。”
sentences.pinyin: Gǔzhuāng rén shuō: “Hòutiān cáishì jiějué wèntí de rìzi, xiànzài wǒmen bìxū líkāi.”
sentences.english: The man in ancient clothes said, "The day after tomorrow is the day to solve the problem; now we must leave."

sentences.chinese: 我感到很不安，心跳很快，差一点就要叫出来了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gǎndào hěn bù'ān, xīntiào hěn kuài, chà yìdiǎn jiù yào jiào chūlái le.
sentences.english: I felt very uneasy, my heart beat fast, and I almost screamed.

sentences.chinese: 我想问：“那奶奶呢？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng wèn: “Nà nǎinai ne?”
sentences.english: I wanted to ask, "What about Grandma?"

sentences.chinese: 古装人说：“她在家等着我们，但我们现在不能回去。”
sentences.pinyin: Gǔzhuāng rén shuō: “Tā zàijiā děngzhe wǒmen, dàn wǒmen xiànzài bùnéng huíqù.”
sentences.english: The man in ancient clothes said, "She is at home waiting for us, but we cannot go back now."

sentences.chinese: 他们们看向我，眼神里有担心。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen kànxiàng wǒ, yǎnshén lǐ yǒu dānxīn.
sentences.english: They looked at me, there was worry in their eyes.

sentences.chinese: 我问：“这书里到底有什么吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn: “Zhè shū lǐ dàodǐ yǒu shéme ma?”
sentences.english: I asked, "Is there actually something in this book?"

sentences.chinese: 古装人没有回答，他直接拿起了书。
sentences.pinyin: Gǔzhuāng rén méiyǒu huídá, tā zhíjiē náqǐ le shū.
sentences.english: The man in ancient clothes did not answer; he simply picked up the book.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，窗户突然碎了，黑影跳了进来。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhèshí, chuānghù tūrán suì le, hēiyǐng tiào le jìnlái.
sentences.english: Just then, the window suddenly shattered, and the shadow jumped inside.

sentences.chinese: 他看着我们，冷冷地说：“书给我，否则你们谁也走不了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe wǒmen, lěng lěng de shuō: “Shū gěi wǒ, fǒuzé nǐmen shéi yě zǒu bù liǎo.”
sentences.english: He looked at us and said coldly, "Give me the book, otherwise none of you will be able to leave."

chapters.title_english: Chapter 20: The Labyrinth of the Forbidden Palace

sentences.chinese: 黑影跳进来的时候，我一边害怕，一边看着古装人。
sentences.pinyin: Hēiyǐng tiào jìnlái de shíhou, wǒ yībiān hàipà, yībiān kànzhe gǔzhuāng rén.
sentences.english: When the dark shadow jumped in, I was frightened on one hand, and watching the man in ancient clothes on the other.

sentences.chinese: 古装人突然大喊：“快跑！”
sentences.pinyin: Gǔzhuāng rén tūrán dàhǎn: “Kuài pǎo!”
sentences.english: The man in ancient clothes suddenly shouted, "Run quickly!"

sentences.chinese: 他拉着我的左边，我们迅速跑向门口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lāzhe wǒ de zuǒbiān, wǒmen xùnsù pǎo xiàng ménkǒu.
sentences.english: He pulled my left side, and we quickly ran toward the door.

sentences.chinese: 黑影在我们的后边，他的声音在房间里回荡。
sentences.pinyin: Hēiyǐng zài wǒmen de hòubiān, tā de shēngyīn zài fángjiān lǐ huídàng.
sentences.english: The dark shadow was behind us, his voice echoing in the room.

sentences.chinese: 我们跑到了一个很大的地方，这里像是一个迷宫。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen pǎo dàole yīgè hěn dà de dìfāng, zhèlǐ xiàng shì yīgè mígōng.
sentences.english: We ran to a very large place, which felt like a labyrinth.

sentences.chinese: 我看向前边，有很多条路。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn xiàng qiánbiān, yǒu hěnduō tiáo lù.
sentences.english: I looked ahead; there were many paths.

sentences.chinese: 古装人说：“我们要去东边，那里有出口。”
sentences.pinyin: Gǔzhuāng rén shuō: “Wǒmen yào qù dōngbiān, nàlǐ yǒu chūkǒu.”
sentences.english: The man in ancient clothes said, "We must go east; there is an exit there."

sentences.chinese: 我问他：“那南边和北边呢？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Nà nánbiān hé běibiān ne?”
sentences.english: I asked him, "What about the south and north sides?"

sentences.chinese: 他说：“南边是禁宫的深处，北边是高墙，我们不能去。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nánbiān shì jìngōng de shēnchù, běibiān shì gāoqiáng, wǒmen bùnéng qù.”
sentences.english: He said, "The south is the depths of the forbidden palace, and the north is a high wall; we cannot go there."

sentences.chinese: 我们向东走，走到了一个奇怪的房间。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàng dōng zǒu, zǒu dàole yīgè qíguài de fángjiān.
sentences.english: We walked east and arrived at a strange room.

sentences.chinese: 房间的右边有一扇小门，右边墙上挂着一张地图。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān de yòubiān yǒu yī shàn xiǎo mén, yòubiān qiáng shàng guàzhe yī zhāng dìtú.
sentences.english: On the right side of the room was a small door, and a map was hanging on the right wall.

sentences.chinese: 地图上写着，这个地方连接着西边的古道。
sentences.pinyin: Dìtú shàng xiězhe, zhège dìfāng liánjiēzhe xībiān de gǔdào.
sentences.english: The map stated that this place connected to the ancient road in the west.

sentences.chinese: 古装人指着地图说：“看，西边是回家的路。”
sentences.pinyin: Gǔzhuāng rén zhǐzhe dìtú shuō: “Kàn, xībiān shì huíjiā de lù.”
sentences.english: The man in ancient clothes pointed to the map and said, "Look, the west is the way home."

sentences.chinese: 他提到，很久以前，有一些来自外国的人带来了这本书。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tídào, hěnjiǔ yǐqián, yǒu yīxiē láizì wàiguó de rén dàiláile zhè běn shū.
sentences.english: He mentioned that long ago, some people from foreign countries brought this book.

sentences.chinese: 那些外国人在国外学习过古老的魔法。
sentences.pinyin: Nàxiē wàiguó rén zài guówài xuéxí guò gǔlǎo de mófǎ.
sentences.english: Those foreigners had studied ancient magic abroad.

sentences.chinese: 他低声说：“这本书里的东西，不属于这个世界。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dīshēng shuō: “Zhè běn shū lǐ de dōngxi, bù shǔyú zhège shìjiè.”
sentences.english: He whispered, "The things in this book do not belong to this world."

sentences.chinese: 这时，我听到外边有很大的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, wǒ tīngdào wàibiān yǒu hěn dà de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: At that moment, I heard a loud noise outside.

sentences.chinese: 黑影已经来到了外边，就在门旁边。
sentences.pinyin: Hēiyǐng yǐjīng láidào le wàibiān, jiù zài mén pángbiān.
sentences.english: The dark shadow had already arrived outside, right beside the door.

sentences.chinese: 我看向房间的上边，发现天花板在移动。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn xiàng fángjiān de shàngbiān, fāxiàn tiānhuāpán zài yídòng.
sentences.english: I looked at the top of the room and found the ceiling was moving.

sentences.chinese: 我看向下边，地板突然裂开了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn xiàng xiàbiān, dìbǎn tūrán liè kāile.
sentences.english: I looked below, and the floor suddenly cracked open.

sentences.chinese: 古装人指着那边说：“快跳到那边去！”
sentences.pinyin: Gǔzhuāng rén zhǐzhe nàbiān shuō: “Kuài tiào dào nàbiān qù!”
sentences.english: The man in ancient clothes pointed over there and said, "Jump over there quickly!"

sentences.chinese: 我看向这边，这边只有深深的洞。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn xiàng zhèbiān, zhèbiān zhǐyǒu shēnshēn de dòng.
sentences.english: I looked at this side; here there was only a deep hole.

sentences.chinese: 我只能看向西，向着西边的光芒跳过去。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐnéng kàn xiàng xī, xiàngzhe xībiān de guāngmáng tiào guòqù.
sentences.english: I could only look west and jump toward the light of the west side.

sentences.chinese: 我们终于跑到了宫殿的外面，但黑影依然在追我们。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zhōngyú pǎo dàole gōngdiàn de wàimiàn, dàn hēiyǐng yīrán zài zhuī wǒmen.
sentences.english: We finally ran to the outside of the palace, but the dark shadow was still chasing us.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十一章：最后的守护者

sentences.chinese: 我们跑在宫殿外的草地上，风很大。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen pǎo zài gōngdiàn wài de cǎodì shàng, fēng hěn dà.
sentences.english: We ran on the grass outside the palace, and the wind was strong.

sentences.chinese: 黑影在后面追，他的速度非常快。
sentences.pinyin: Hēiyǐng zài hòumiàn zhuī, tā de sùdù fēicháng kuài.
sentences.english: The shadow chased behind us, and his speed was very fast.

sentences.chinese: 古装人突然停下来，他看着远方的山脉。
sentences.pinyin: Gǔzhuāng rén tūrán tíng xiàlái, tā kànzhe yuǎnfāng de shānmài.
sentences.english: The man in ancient clothes suddenly stopped and looked at the distant mountains.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“这里有一个古老的村庄，那里有很多人可以帮我们。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zhèlǐ yǒu yīgè gǔlǎo de cūnzhuāng, nàlǐ yǒu hěnduō rén kěyǐ bāng wǒmen.”
sentences.english: He said, "There is an ancient village here, where many people can help us."

sentences.chinese: 我们跑进村庄，看到很多穿着元代衣服的人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen pǎo jìn cūnzhuāng, kàndào hěnduō chuānzhe Yuán dài yīfú de rén.
sentences.english: We ran into the village and saw many people wearing clothes from the Yuan dynasty.

sentences.chinese: 这里的人姓氏很奇怪，像是某种古老的密码。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de rén xìngshì hěn qíguài, xiàng shì mǒu zhǒng gǔlǎo de mìmǎ.
sentences.english: The surnames of the people here were very strange, like some kind of ancient code.

sentences.chinese: 村长姓三，他坐在大门前看着我们。
sentences.pinyin: Cūnzhǎng xìng Sān, tā zuò zài dàmén qián kànzhe wǒmen.
sentences.english: The village chief's surname was San; he sat in front of the main gate watching us.

sentences.chinese: 他的左手拿着一本书，右手拿着一盏灯。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de zuǒshǒu názhe yī běn shū, yòushǒu názhe yī zhǎn dēng.
sentences.english: In his left hand he held a book, and in his right hand he held a lamp.

sentences.chinese: 三村长说：“你们在逃避那个黑影，对吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān cūnzhǎng shuō: “Nǐmen zài táobì nàgè hēiyǐng, duì ma?”
sentences.english: Chief San said, "You are escaping from that shadow, right?"

sentences.chinese: 古装人点头，说：“我们需要找到守护书的委员会。”
sentences.pinyin: Gǔzhuāng rén diǎntóu, shuō: “Wǒmen xūyào zhǎodào shǒuhù shū de wěiyuánhuì.”
sentences.english: The man in ancient clothes nodded and said, "We need to find the committee that guards the book."

sentences.chinese: 三村长笑了，他指着村子里的不同方向。
sentences.pinyin: Sān cūnzhǎng xiàole, tā zhǐzhe cūnzǐ lǐ de bùtóng fāngxiàng.
sentences.english: Chief San smiled and pointed in different directions in the village.

sentences.chinese: “在这个村子里，每个家庭都负责一个秘密。”
sentences.pinyin: “Zài zhège cūnzǐ lǐ, měi gè jiātíng dōu fùzé yīgè mìmì.”
sentences.english: "In this village, every family is responsible for one secret."

sentences.chinese: “东先生在东边的屋子里，他知道关于时间的秘密。”
sentences.pinyin: “Dōng xiānshēng zài dōngbiān de wūzi lǐ, tā zhīdào guānyú shíjiān de mìmì.”
sentences.english: "Mr. Dong is in the house to the east; he knows the secret of time."

sentences.chinese: “中先生在村子中间，他精通中原的古法。”
sentences.pinyin: “Zhōng xiānshēng zài cūnzǐ zhōngjiān, tā jīngtōng Zhōngyuán de gǔfǎ.”
sentences.english: "Mr. Zhong is in the middle of the village; he is proficient in the ancient methods of the Central Plains."

sentences.chinese: “也先生和元先生在一起，他们研究古代的星象。”
sentences.pinyin: “Yě xiānshēng hé Yuán xiānshēng zài yīqǐ, tāmen yánjiū gǔdài de xīngxiàng.”
sentences.english: "Mr. Ye and Mr. Yuan are together; they study ancient astronomy."

sentences.chinese: “关先生和冷先生在水边，他们守护着入口。”
sentences.pinyin: “Guān xiānshēng hé Lěng xiānshēng zài shuǐbiān, tāmen shǒuhùzhe rùkǒu.”
sentences.english: "Mr. Guan and Mr. Leng are by the water; they guard the entrance."

sentences.chinese: “别先生和包先生在森林里，他们能听到风的声音。”
sentences.pinyin: “Bié xiānshēng hé Bāo xiānshēng zài sēnlín lǐ, tāmen néng tīngdào fēng de shēngyīn.”
sentences.english: "Mr. Bie and Mr. Bao are in the forest; they can hear the sound of the wind."

sentences.chinese: “南先生和后先生在南墙，他们负责警卫。”
sentences.pinyin: “Nán xiānshēng hé Hòu xiānshēng zài nánqiáng, tāmen fùzé jǐngwèi.”
sentences.english: "Mr. Nan and Mr. Hou are at the south wall; they are responsible for the guards."

sentences.chinese: “国先生和坐先生在书房，他们记录历史。”
sentences.pinyin: “Guó xiānshēng hé Zuò xiānshēng zài shūfáng, tāmen jìlù lìshǐ.”
sentences.english: "Mr. Guo and Mr. Zuo are in the study; they record history."

sentences.chinese: “山先生和左先生在山顶，他们观察敌人的动向。”
sentences.pinyin: “Shān xiānshēng hé Zuǒ xiānshēng zài shāndǐng, tāmen guānchá dírén de dòngxiàng.”
sentences.english: "Mr. Shan and Mr. Zuo are on the mountain top; they observe the enemy's movements."

sentences.chinese: “常先生和年先生在药店，他们能治好所有的伤。”
sentences.pinyin: “Cháng xiānshēng hé Nián xiānshēng zài yàodiàn, tāmen néng zhì hǎo suǒyǒu de shāng.”
sentences.english: "Mr. Chang and Mr. Nian are in the pharmacy; they can heal all wounds."

sentences.chinese: “教先生和新先生在学校，他们教我们如何阅读古书。”
sentences.pinyin: “Jiào xiānshēng hé Xīn xiānshēng zài xuéxiào, tāmen jiào wǒmen rúhé yuèdú gǔshū.”
sentences.english: "Mr. Jiao and Mr. Xin are in the school; they teach us how to read ancient books."

sentences.chinese: “楼先生和毛先生在塔楼，他们负责发号施令。”
sentences.pinyin: “Lóu xiānshēng hé Máo xiānshēng zài tǎlóu, tāmen fùzé fāhào shīlìng.”
sentences.english: "Mr. Lou and Mr. Mao are in the tower; they are responsible for issuing orders."

sentences.chinese: “水先生和班先生在河边，他们管理着运输。”
sentences.pinyin: “Shuǐ xiānshēng hé Bān xiānshēng zài hébiān, tāmen guǎnlǐzhe yùnshū.”
sentences.english: "Mr. Shui and Mr. Ban are by the river; they manage transportation."

sentences.chinese: “白先生和百先生在花园，他们种了很多奇怪的花。”
sentences.pinyin: “Bái xiānshēng hé Bǎi xiānshēng zài huāyuán, tāmen zhòngle hěnduō qíguài de huā.”
sentences.english: "Mr. Bai and Mr. Bai (Bai/Bai) are in the garden; they planted many strange flowers."

sentences.chinese: “能先生和花先生在作坊，他们制作秘密的钥匙。”
sentences.pinyin: “Néng xiānshēng hé Huā xiānshēng zài zuòfáng, tāmen zhìzuò mìmì de yàoshi.”
sentences.english: "Mr. Neng and Mr. Hua are in the workshop; they make secret keys."

sentences.chinese: “路先生和车先生在门口，他们负责接送客人。”
sentences.pinyin: “Lù xiānshēng hé Chē xiānshēng zài ménkǒu, tāmen fùzé jiēsòng kèrén.”
sentences.english: "Mr. Lu and Mr. Che are at the gate; they are responsible for receiving guests."

sentences.chinese: “过先生和还先生在厨房，他们准备着最后的晚餐。”
sentences.pinyin: “Guō xiānshēng hé Huán xiānshēng zài chúfáng, tāmen zhǔnbèizhe zuìhòu de wǎncān.”
sentences.english: "Mr. Guo (Guo/Guo) and Mr. Huan are in the kitchen; they are preparing the final dinner."

sentences.chinese: “那先生和都先生在仓库，他们保管着古老的钱币。”
sentences.pinyin: “Nā xiānshēng hé Dū xiānshēng zài cāngkù, tāmen bǎoguǎn zhe gǔlǎo de qiánbì.”
sentences.english: "Mr. Na and Mr. Du are in the warehouse; they keep ancient coins."

sentences.chinese: “钱先生和错先生在账房，他们计算着时间的代价。”
sentences.pinyin: “Qián xiānshēng hé Cuò xiānshēng zài zhàngfáng, tāmen jìsuànzhe shíjiān de dàijià.”
sentences.english: "Mr. Qian and Mr. Cuo are in the accounting office; they calculate the price of time."

sentences.chinese: “门先生和高先生在最高的地方，他们是最后的防线。”
sentences.pinyin: “Mén xiānshēng hé Gāo xiānshēng zài zuìgāo de dìfāng, tāmen shì zuìhòu de fángxiàn.”
sentences.english: "Mr. Men and Mr. Gao are at the highest point; they are the final line of defense."

sentences.chinese: 黑影终于追到了村口，他大喊：“把书给我！”
sentences.pinyin: Hēiyǐng zhōngyú zhuī dàole cūnkǒu, tā dà hǎn: “Bǎ shū gěi wǒ!”
sentences.english: The shadow finally caught up to the village entrance and shouted, "Give me the book!"

sentences.chinese: 这时，所有姓氏不同的人都站了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, suǒyǒu xìngshì bùtóng de rén dōu zhànle qǐlái.
sentences.english: At that moment, all the people with different surnames stood up.

sentences.chinese: 他们围成一个巨大的圆圈，挡在我们的面前。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen wéi chéng yīgè jùdà de yuánquān, dǎng zài wǒmen de miànqián.
sentences.english: They formed a giant circle, blocking the way in front of us.

sentences.chinese: 三村长低声说：“这个黑影其实是我们的一个错误。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān cūnzhǎng dīshēng shuō: “Zhège hēiyǐng qíshí shì wǒmen de yīgè cuòwù.”
sentences.english: Chief San said in a low voice, "This shadow is actually a mistake of ours."

sentences.chinese: 他看着我，眼神里充满了智慧。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe wǒ, yǎnshén lǐ chōngmǎnle zhìhuì.
sentences.english: He looked at me, his eyes full of wisdom.

sentences.chinese: “只有当你意识到书不是为了权力，而是为了爱，你才能赢。”
sentences.pinyin: “Zhǐyǒu dāng nǐ yìshí dào shū bùshì wèile quánlì, ér shì wèile ài, nǐ cáinéng yíng.”
sentences.english: "Only when you realize the book is not for power, but for love, can you win."

sentences.chinese: 我看着手中的书，突然感觉到一种温暖的力量。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe shǒuzhōng de shū, tūrán gǎnjué dào yī zhǒng wēnnuǎn de lìliàng.
sentences.english: I looked at the book in my hand and suddenly felt a warm power.

sentences.chinese: 我对着黑影大喊：“我不需要权力，我只要真相！”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ duìzhe hēiyǐng dà hǎn: “Wǒ bù xūyào quánlì, wǒ zhǐyào zhēnxiàng!”
sentences.english: I shouted at the shadow, "I don't need power; I only want the truth!"

sentences.chinese: 突然，一道强光从书里射出，黑影在光芒中消失了。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yī dào qiángguāng cóng shū lǐ shè chū, hēiyǐng zài guāngmáng zhōng xiāoshīle.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a strong light shot out from the book, and the shadow disappeared in the radiance.

sentences.chinese: 村庄恢复了安静，但三村长看着天空，脸色变得凝重。
sentences.pinyin: Cūnzhuāng huīfùle ānjìng, dàn Sān cūnzhǎng kànzhe tiānkōng, liǎnsè biànde níngzhòng.
sentences.english: The village returned to silence, but Chief San looked at the sky, his expression becoming solemn.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“战争结束了，但新的门即将开启。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zhànzhēng jiéshùle, dàn xīn de mén jíjiāng kāiqǐ.”
sentences.english: He said, "The war is over, but a new door is about to open."

sentences.chinese: 我看向远方，发现地平线上出现了一个巨大的金色影子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànxiàng yuǎnfāng, fāxiàn dìpíngxiàn shàng chūxiànle yīgè jùdà de jīnsè yǐngzi.
sentences.english: I looked into the distance and found a giant golden shadow appearing on the horizon.

word_usage.sentence: 在很久以前的大唐，有一座小城。

sentences.chinese: 大卫坐上出租车，然后快快地下车。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi zuò shàng chū zū chē, rán hòu kuài kuài de xià chē.
sentences.english: David took a taxi, and then quickly got off the car.

sentences.chinese: 他走进家门，大声说：“我回来了！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu jìn jiā mén, dà shēng shuō: “Wǒ huí lái le!”
sentences.english: He walked into the house door and said loudly, "I'm back!"

sentences.chinese: 但是，家里很安静。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn shì, jiā lǐ hěn ā jìng.
sentences.english: But, it was very quiet in the house.

sentences.chinese: 他看到他的爷爷在睡。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào tā de yé ye zài shuì.
sentences.english: He saw his grandfather sleeping.

sentences.chinese: 他的奶奶也在睡。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de nǎi nai yě zài shuì.
sentences.english: His grandmother was also sleeping.

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得不对。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi jué de bù duì.
sentences.english: David felt something was wrong.

sentences.chinese: 为什么家里的老人都在睡？
sentences.pinyin: Wèi shé me jiā lǐ de lǎo rén dōu zài shuì?
sentences.english: Why are the elderly people in the house all sleeping?

sentences.chinese: 他看到桌子上有很多药。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào zhuō zi shàng yǒu hěn duō yào.
sentences.english: He saw a lot of medicine on the table.

sentences.chinese: 他的家人生病了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de jiā rén shēng bìng le.
sentences.english: His family members had fallen ill.

sentences.chinese: 他的爷爷和奶奶现在是病人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yé ye hé nǎi nai xiàn zài shì bìng rén.
sentences.english: His grandfather and grandmother are now patients.

sentences.chinese: 大卫很担心，他说：“对不起，我不知道你们有病。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi hěn dān xīn, tā shuō: “Duì bu qǐ, wǒ bù zhī dào nǐ men yǒu bìng.”
sentences.english: David was very worried and said, "I'm sorry, I didn't know you were sick."

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个年轻的小姐走了进来。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yī gè nián qīng de xiǎo jie zǒu le jìn lái.
sentences.english: At this moment, a young lady walked in.

sentences.chinese: 她看起来很严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐ lái hěn yán sù.
sentences.english: She looked very serious.

sentences.chinese: 她说：“你是谁？为什么在我的房子里？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ shì shuí? Wèi shé me zài wǒ de fáng zi lǐ?”
sentences.english: She said, "Who are you? Why are you in my house?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫很惊讶，他觉得这个情况很坏。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi hěn jīng yà, tā jué de zhè gè qíng kuàng hěn huài.
sentences.english: David was very surprised; he felt this situation was bad.

sentences.chinese: 他发现自己进错了门！
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn zì jǐ jìn cuò le mén!
sentences.english: He discovered he had entered the wrong door!

sentences.chinese: 这不是他的家，这是一个医生的家。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù shì tā de jiā, zhè shì yī gè yī shēng de jiā.
sentences.english: This is not his home; this is a doctor's home.

sentences.chinese: 大卫想快快地离开，但是门关上了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎng kuài kuài de lí kāi, dàn shì mén guān shàng le.
sentences.english: David wanted to leave quickly, but the door was closed.

sentences.chinese: 他听到外面有人在喊：“下班了！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīng dào wài miàn yǒu rén zài hǎn: “Xià bān le!”
sentences.english: He heard someone shouting outside, "Work is over!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫发现自己被关在了一个陌生人的家。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi fā xiàn zì jǐ bèi guān zài le yī gè mò shēng rén de jiā.
sentences.english: David discovered he was locked in a stranger's house.

sentences.chinese: 他现在怎么办？
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàn zài zěn me bàn?
sentences.english: What should he do now?

sentences.chinese: 现在是下午三点。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài shì xiàwǔ sān diǎn.
sentences.english: It is now 3 p.m. in the afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 大卫在房间里走来走去。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi zài fángjiān lǐ zǒu lái zǒu qù.
sentences.english: David is walking back and forth in the room.

sentences.chinese: 他想：我中午没有吃饭，我现在很饿。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng: Wǒ zhōngwǔ méiyǒu chīfàn, wǒ xiànzài hěn è.
sentences.english: He thinks: I didn't eat lunch at noon, I am very hungry now.

sentences.chinese: 他看到桌子上有一个杯子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào zhuōzi shàng yǒu yīgè bēizi.
sentences.english: He sees a cup on the table.

sentences.chinese: 杯子里没有水。
sentences.pinyin: Bēizi lǐ méiyǒu shuǐ.
sentences.english: There is no water in the cup.

sentences.chinese: 他看到桌子上还有一些包子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào zhuōzi shàng hái yǒu yīxiē bāozi.
sentences.english: He sees some bao (steamed buns) on the table as well.

sentences.chinese: 大卫吃了一口包子。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi chīle yīkǒu bāozi.
sentences.english: David takes a bite of a bao.

sentences.chinese: “太好吃了！”大卫说。
sentences.pinyin: “Tài hǎochī le!” Dàwèi shuō.
sentences.english: "So delicious!" David says.

sentences.chinese: 他看到桌子上还有很多菜。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào zhuōzi shàng hái yǒu hěnduō cài.
sentences.english: He sees there are many dishes on the table.

sentences.chinese: 有肉，有米饭，还有鸡蛋。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu ròu, yǒu mǐfàn, hái yǒu jīdàn.
sentences.english: There is meat, cooked rice, and eggs.

sentences.chinese: 大卫想，这比饭店的饭更好吃。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎng, zhè bǐ fàndiàn de fàn gèng hǎochī.
sentences.english: David thinks this is even tastier than the food at a restaurant.

sentences.chinese: 他吃了很多肉和米饭。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chīle hěnduō ròu hé mǐfàn.
sentences.english: He eats a lot of meat and rice.

sentences.chinese: 但是，他突然想去洗手间。
sentences.pinyin: Dànshì, tā tūrán xiǎng qù xǐshǒujiān.
sentences.english: But, he suddenly wants to go to the washroom.

sentences.chinese: 他走进洗手间，但是门突然关上了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu jìn xǐshǒujiān, dànshì mén tūrán guānshàng le.
sentences.english: He goes into the washroom, but the door suddenly closes.

sentences.chinese: 大卫大喊：“救命！”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi dà hǎn: “Jiùmìng!”
sentences.english: David screams: "Help!"

sentences.chinese: 他听到外面有一个声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīngdào wàimiàn yǒu yīgè shēngyīn.
sentences.english: He hears a voice outside.

sentences.chinese: 那是这个医生的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì zhège yīshēng de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: That is the doctor's voice.

sentences.chinese: 医生说：“我的电视机在哪里？”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō: “Wǒ de diànshìjī zài nǎlǐ?”
sentences.english: The doctor says: "Where is my television set?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫在洗手间里听，心在飞。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi zài xǐshǒujiān lǐ tīng, xīn zài fēi.
sentences.english: David listens in the washroom, his heart is flying (beating wildly).

sentences.chinese: 他很害怕，因为现在很晚了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hěn hàipà, yīnwèi xiànzài hěn wǎn le.
sentences.english: He is very scared because it is already late.

sentences.chinese: 他想：我不能在晚上住在别人的床上面。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng: Wǒ bùnéng zài wǎnshang zhù zài biérén de chuáng shàngmiàn.
sentences.english: He thinks: I cannot sleep on someone else's bed in the evening.

sentences.chinese: 他想快快地出去，吃完晚饭就走。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng kuài kuài de chūqù, chī wán wǎnfàn jiù zǒu.
sentences.english: He wants to get out quickly, and leave after eating dinner.

sentences.chinese: 他看到地上有一块小石头。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào dìshàng yǒu yīkuài xiǎo shítou.
sentences.english: He sees a small piece of stone on the floor.

sentences.chinese: 他用石头敲门。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng shítou qiāo mén.
sentences.english: He uses the stone to knock on the door.

sentences.chinese: 医生走进了洗手间。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng zǒu jìn le xǐshǒujiān.
sentences.english: The doctor walks into the washroom.

sentences.chinese: 医生看着大卫，大卫看着医生。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng kànzhe Dàwèi, Dàwèi kànzhe yīshēng.
sentences.english: The doctor looks at David, and David looks at the doctor.

sentences.chinese: 医生问：“你是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng wèn: “Nǐ shì shuí?”
sentences.english: The doctor asks: "Who are you?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫在洗手间里，心跳非常快。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi zài xǐshǒujiān lǐ, xīntiào fēicháng kuài.
sentences.english: David was in the bathroom, his heart beating very fast.

sentences.chinese: 医生看着大卫，觉得他看起来很不认真。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng kànzhe Dàwèi, juéde tā kàn qǐlái hěn bù rènzhēn.
sentences.english: The doctor looked at David and felt he didn't look very serious.

sentences.chinese: 大卫马上说：“你好！我是大卫！”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi mǎshàng shuō: “Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ shì Dàwèi!”
sentences.english: David immediately said, "Hello! I am David!"

sentences.chinese: 医生很明白，他现在的表情太奇怪了。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng hěn míngbai, tā xiànzài de biǎoqíng tài qíguài le.
sentences.english: The doctor understood clearly that his current expression was too strange.

sentences.chinese: 医生问：“你是不是我的新助手？”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng wèn: “Nǐ shì bù shì wǒ de xīn zhùshǒu?”
sentences.english: The doctor asked, "Are you or are you not my new assistant?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫想，今天的事情真奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎng, jīntiān de shìqing zhēn qíguài.
sentences.english: David thought today's events were really strange.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这个家很干净，但是他并不在自己的家。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde zhège jiā hěn gānjìng, dànshì tā bìng bù zài zìjǐ de jiā.
sentences.english: He felt this house was very clean, but he was not in his own home.

sentences.chinese: 他小声说：“我不确定，但我现在很害怕。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎoshēng shuō: “Wǒ bù quèdìng, dàn wǒ xiànzài hěn hàipà.”
sentences.english: He said softly, "I'm not sure, but I am very scared right now."

sentences.chinese: 医生笑了，他说：“你说话的样子和我一样。”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng xiào le, tā shuō: “Nǐ shuōhuà de yàngzi hé wǒ yīyàng.”
sentences.english: The doctor smiled and said, "The way you speak is the same as me."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这个医生非常有名，可能是一个重要的人。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéde zhège yīshēng fēicháng yǒumíng, kěnéng shì yī gè zhòngyào de rén.
sentences.english: David felt this doctor was very famous, perhaps an important person.

sentences.chinese: 医生看着大卫的衣服，说：“你的衣服很贵。”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng kànzhe Dàwèi de yīfu, shuō: “Nǐ de yīfu hěn guì.”
sentences.english: The doctor looked at David's clothes and said, "Your clothes are very expensive."

sentences.chinese: 大卫想，这件衣服确实很贵，而且还是他最喜欢的。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎng, zhè jiàn yīfu quèshí hěn guì, érqiě háishì tā zuì xǐhuan de.
sentences.english: David thought this piece of clothing was indeed very expensive, and it was still his favorite.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉医生，他常常在外面走走，有时会迷路。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosu yīshēng, tā chángcháng zài wàimiàn zǒuzǒu, yǒushí huì mílù.
sentences.english: He told the doctor that he often walked around outside and sometimes got lost.

sentences.chinese: 医生认真地听着，但觉得大卫的话不对。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng rènzhēn de tīngzhe, dàn juéde Dàwèi de huà bù duì.
sentences.english: The doctor listened earnestly, but felt David's words were not right.

sentences.chinese: 医生问：“你真的在我的洗手间里做什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng wèn: “Nǐ zhēn de zài wǒ de xǐshǒujiān lǐ zuò shénme?”
sentences.english: The doctor asked, "What are you really doing in my bathroom?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫说：“我正在找我的手机！”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi shuō: “Wǒ zhèngzài zhǎo wǒ de shǒujī!”
sentences.english: David said, "I am currently looking for my phone!"

sentences.chinese: 医生说：“手机很重要，但是敲门不重要。”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō: “Shǒujī hěn zhòngyào, dànshì qiāomén bù zhòngyào.”
sentences.english: The doctor said, "A phone is very important, but knocking on the door is not important."

sentences.chinese: 大卫想起他刚才用石头敲门，觉得太不好意思了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎngqǐ tā gāngcái yòng shítou qiāomén, juéde tài bù hǎoyìsi le.
sentences.english: David remembered he had just knocked on the door with a stone and felt too embarrassed.

sentences.chinese: 医生说：“请你重说一遍，你是怎么进来的？”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō: “Qǐng nǐ chóng shuō yī biàn, nǐ shì zěnme jìnlái de?”
sentences.english: The doctor said, "Please repeat it once more, how did you get in?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫尝试解释，但医生还是不明白。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi chángshì jiěshì, dàn yīshēng háishì bù míngbai.
sentences.english: David tried to explain, but the doctor still didn't understand.

sentences.chinese: 还有一件事情，大卫发现医生的脸不大像他想象的那样。
sentences.pinyin: Hái yǒu yī jiàn shìqing, Dàwèi fāxiàn yīshēng de liǎn bù dà xiàng tā xiǎngxiàng de nàyàng.
sentences.english: There was one more thing; David noticed the doctor's face was not quite like he had imagined.

sentences.chinese: 医生说：“好，现在我们去客厅说话。”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō: “Hǎo, xiànzài wǒmen qù kètīng shuōhuà.”
sentences.english: The doctor said, "All right, now let's go to the living room to talk."

sentences.chinese: 大卫跟着医生走，心想：这真的太离谱了！
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi gēnzhe yīshēng zǒu, xīn xiǎng: zhè zhēn de tài lípǔ le!
sentences.english: David followed the doctor, thinking: this is truly too absurd!

sentences.chinese: 最后，医生停了下来，看着门外的一个人。
sentences.pinyin: Zuìhòu, yīshēng tíng le xiàlái, kànzhe mén wài de yī gè rén.
sentences.english: Finally, the doctor stopped and looked at a person outside the door.

sentences.chinese: 那个人喊道：“医生，你的双胞胎兄弟回来了！”
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén hǎndào: “Yīshēng, nǐ de shuāngbāotāi xiōngdì huílái le!”
sentences.english: That person shouted, "Doctor, your twin brother is back!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫愣住了，他看着那个新来的人。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi lèng zhù le, tā kànzhe nà gè xīn lái de rén.
sentences.english: David froze, looking at the newcomer.

sentences.chinese: 那个人的样子竟然和大卫一模一样！
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén de yàngzi jìngrán hé Dàwèi yīyàng!
sentences.english: That person's appearance was actually exactly the same as David's!

chapters.title_chinese: 第四章：谁才是真正的医生？
chapters.title_english: Chapter 4: Who is the Real Doctor?

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着那个像他一样的人，觉得这太奇怪了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe nàge xiàng tā yīyàng de rén, juéde zhè tài qíguài le.
sentences.english: David looked at the person who looked just like him and thought this was too strange.

sentences.chinese: 那个新来的人大喊：“爸爸！”
sentences.pinyin: Nàge xīn lái de rén dà hǎn: “Bàba!”
sentences.english: The newcomer shouted, "Dad!"

sentences.chinese: 医生愣住了，他说：“你是我的儿子？”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng lèngzhù le, tā shuō: “Nǐ shì wǒ de érzi?”
sentences.english: The doctor was stunned and said, "Are you my son?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫赶紧说：“不，我不是！我昨天才来到这里！”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi gǎnjǐn shuō: “Bù, wǒ bù shì! Wǒ zuótiān cái lái dào zhèlǐ!”
sentences.english: David quickly said, "No, I'm not! I only arrived here yesterday!"

sentences.chinese: 那个年轻人笑了，他看着大卫说：“你是谁？你为什么长得像我爸爸？”
sentences.pinyin: Nàge niánqīng rén xiào le, tā kànzhe Dàwèi shuō: “Nǐ shì shuí? Nǐ wèishéme zhǎng de xiàng wǒ bàba?”
sentences.english: The young man smiled and looked at David, saying, "Who are you? Why do you look like my father?"

sentences.chinese: 医生揉了揉眼睛，他觉得今天的天气太奇怪了。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng róu le róu yǎnjīng, tā juéde jīntiān de tiānqì tài qíguài le.
sentences.english: The doctor rubbed his eyes; he felt today's weather was too strange.

sentences.chinese: 他记得前天家里很安静，但现在却有两个大卫。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde qiántiān jiālǐ hěn ānjìng, dàn xiànzài què yǒu liǎng gè Dàwèi.
sentences.english: He remembered that the day before yesterday the house was very quiet, but now there were two Davids.

sentences.chinese: 医生问：“你什么时候来的？是坐火车来的，还是坐飞机来的？”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng wèn: “Nǐ shénme shíhòu lái de? Shì zuò huǒchē lái de, háishì zuò fēijī lái de?”
sentences.english: The doctor asked, "When did you come? Did you come by train, or by airplane?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫紧张地说：“我不知道日期，我只是在马路边走走。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi jǐnzhāng de shuō: “Wǒ bù zhīdào rìqī, wǒ zhǐshì zài mǎlù biān zǒuzǒu.”
sentences.english: David said nervously, "I don't know the date, I was just walking along the street."

sentences.chinese: 年轻人说：“没关系，现在是上午，我们可以一起吃午饭。”
sentences.pinyin: Niánqīng rén shuō: “Méiguānxì, xiànzài shì shàngwǔ, wǒmen kěyǐ yīqǐ chī wǔfàn.”
sentences.english: The young man said, "It's okay, it's morning now, we can have lunch together."

sentences.chinese: 大卫心想：这个家太乱了，我得赶紧离开。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xīn xiǎng: zhège jiā tài luàn le, wǒ děi gǎnjǐn líkāi.
sentences.english: David thought to himself: this house is too chaotic, I must leave quickly.

sentences.chinese: 医生看了看表，说：“我已经等了一个小时，我想喝牛奶。”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng kàn le kàn biǎo, shuō: “Wǒ yǐjīng děng le yī gè xiǎoshí, wǒ xiǎng hē niúnǎi.”
sentences.english: The doctor looked at his watch and said, "I have already waited for an hour, I want to drink some milk."

sentences.chinese: 年轻人跑进厨房，拿出了面包和一些水果。
sentences.pinyin: Niánqīng rén pǎo jìn chúfáng, ná chū le miànbāo hé yīxiē shuǐguǒ.
sentences.english: The young man ran into the kitchen and brought out some bread and some fruit.

sentences.chinese: 他笑着说：“爸爸，明天是星期天，也是你的生日！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàozhe shuō: “Bàba, míngtiān shì xīngqītiān, yěshì nǐ de shēngrì!”
sentences.english: He smiled and said, "Dad, tomorrow is Sunday, and it's also your birthday!"

sentences.chinese: 医生高兴地说：“对！星期日我们要去公园！”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng gāoxìng de shuō: “Duì! Xīngqīrì wǒmen yào qù gōngyuán!”
sentences.english: The doctor said happily, "Right! On Sunday we are going to the park!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫在旁边听着，觉得这一切像个笑话。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi zài pángbiān tīngzhe, juéde zhè yīqiè xiàng gè xiàohua.
sentences.english: David listened from the side, feeling that all of this was like a joke.

sentences.chinese: 他记得自己早上还没吃早饭，现在肚子很饿。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde zìjǐ zǎoshang hái méi chī zǎofàn, xiànzài dùzi hěn è.
sentences.english: He remembered he hadn't eaten breakfast this morning, and now his stomach was very hungry.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个工人走进来，他给医生送来了一个大盒子。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yī gè gōngrén zǒu jìnlái, tā gěi yīshēng sòng lái le yī gè dà hézi.
sentences.english: At that moment, a worker walked in and delivered a big box to the doctor.

sentences.chinese: 工人说：“医生，外面下雨了，快进来吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Gōngrén shuō: “Yīshēng, wàimiàn xià yǔ le, kuài jìnlái ba.”
sentences.english: The worker said, "Doctor, it's raining outside, come in quickly."

sentences.chinese: 大卫问工人：“请问现在是几点？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi wèn gōngrén: “Qǐngwèn xiànzài shì jǐ diǎn?”
sentences.english: David asked the worker, "Excuse me, what time is it now?"

sentences.chinese: 工人看了看大卫，又看了看医生，惊讶地说：“天哪，两个医生！”
sentences.pinyin: Gōngrén kàn le kàn Dàwèi, yòu kàn le kàn yīshēng, jīngyà de shuō: “Tiān nǎ, liǎng gè yīshēng!”
sentences.english: The worker looked at David, then looked at the doctor, and said in surprise, "My god, two doctors!"

sentences.chinese: 年轻人摆摆手说：“没事儿，他们只是长得像。”
sentences.pinyin: Niánqīng rén bǎibǎi shǒu shuō: “Méishì r, tāmen zhǐshì zhǎng de xiàng.”
sentences.english: The young man waved his hand and said, "It's nothing, they just look alike."

sentences.chinese: 医生看着大卫，突然严肃地说：“你不能走，直到我知道你是谁。”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng kànzhe Dàwèi, tūrán yánsù de shuō: “Nǐ bùnéng zǒu, zhídào wǒ zhīdào nǐ shì shuí.”
sentences.english: The doctor looked at David and suddenly said seriously, "You cannot leave until I know who you are."

sentences.chinese: 大卫绝望地想：我怎么会被关在这里？
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéwàng de xiǎng: wǒ zěnme huì bèi guān zài zhèlǐ?
sentences.english: David thought desperately: how could I be trapped here?

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，大卫的手机响了，电话那边传来一个熟悉的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, Dàwèi de shǒujī xiǎng le, diànhuà nàbiān chuán lái yī gè shúxī de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: Just then, David's phone rang, and a familiar voice came from the other end.

sentences.chinese: 大卫接了电话。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi jiē le diànhuà.
sentences.english: David answered the phone.

sentences.chinese: 电话里是一个女人的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Diànhuà lǐ shì yí gè nǚrén de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: Inside the phone was a woman's voice.

sentences.chinese: 她是他的姐姐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì tā de jiějie.
sentences.english: She was his older sister.

sentences.chinese: 姐姐高兴地大喊：“大卫！你在哪里呢？”
sentences.pinyin: Jiějie gāoxìng de dà hǎn: “Dàwèi! Nǐ zài nǎlǐ ne?”
sentences.english: His sister shouted happily, "David! Where are you?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫紧张地看着医生，小声地说：“我在一个奇怪的地方。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi jǐnzhāng de kànzhe yīshēng, xiǎo shēng de shuō: “Wǒ zài yí gè qíguài de dìfāng.”
sentences.english: David looked at the doctor nervously and said in a low voice, "I am in a strange place."

sentences.chinese: 医生走过来，想听听电话里的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng zǒu guòlái, xiǎng tīngtīng diànhuà lǐ de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: The doctor walked over, wanting to hear the voice on the phone.

sentences.chinese: 医生问：“谁在说话？”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng wèn: “Shéi zài shuōhuà?”
sentences.english: The doctor asked, "Who is speaking?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫赶紧说：“没什么，没什么！”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi gǎnjǐn shuō: “Méishénme, méishénme!”
sentences.english: David quickly said, "It's nothing, it's nothing!"

sentences.chinese: 但姐姐在电话里继续说：“你的弟弟在家里等你，他想让你帮他做听写。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiějie zài diànhuà lǐ jìxù shuō: “Nǐ de dìdi zài jiālǐ děng nǐ, tā xiǎng ràng nǐ bāng tā zuò tīngxiě.”
sentences.english: But his sister continued on the phone, "Your younger brother is waiting for you at home; he wants you to help him with dictation."

sentences.chinese: 大卫愣住了，他想：我的弟弟怎么会在这里？
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi lèng zhù le, tā xiǎng: Wǒ de dìdi zěnme huì zài zhèlǐ?
sentences.english: David was stunned; he thought: How could my younger brother be here?

sentences.chinese: 医生听到“弟弟”两个字，突然大笑起来。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tīng dào “dìdi” liǎng gè zì, tūrán dà xiào qǐlái.
sentences.english: The doctor heard the words "younger brother" and suddenly burst out laughing.

sentences.chinese: 医生说：“哈哈！你也有弟弟？我也有一个弟弟！”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō: “Hāhā! Nǐ yě yǒu dìdi? Wǒ yě yǒu yí gè dìdi!”
sentences.english: The doctor said, "Haha! You have a younger brother too? I also have a younger brother!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这太奇怪了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéde zhè tài qíguài le.
sentences.english: David felt this was too strange.

sentences.chinese: 他看着医生，发现这个医生的样子跟自己真的太像了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe yīshēng, fāxiàn zhè gè yīshēng de yàngzi gēn zìjǐ zhēnde tài xiàng le.
sentences.english: He looked at the doctor and found that this doctor's appearance was really too similar to his own.

sentences.chinese: 医生看着大卫，认真地说：“你这个样子，差一点就和我一模一样了。”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng kànzhe Dàwèi, rènzhēn de shuō: “Nǐ zhè gè yàngzi, chà yì diǎn jiù hé wǒ yì yàng yí yàng le.”
sentences.english: The doctor looked at David and said seriously, "Your appearance is almost exactly the same as mine."

sentences.chinese: 大卫问：“你是谁？你叫什么名字？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi wèn: “Nǐ shì shéi? Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?”
sentences.english: David asked, "Who are you? What is your name?"

sentences.chinese: 医生回答：“我姓那，你可以叫我老那。”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng huídá: “Wǒ xìng Nà, nǐ kěyǐ jiào wǒ Lǎo Nà.”
sentences.english: The doctor replied, "My surname is Na; you can call me Old Na."

sentences.chinese: 大卫惊讶地想：他姓那？我也姓那！
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi jīngyà de xiǎng: Tā xìng Nà? Wǒ yě xìng Nà!
sentences.english: David thought in surprise: His surname is Na? My surname is also Na!

sentences.chinese: 这时候，房间里的工人们在讨论这件事。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shíhou, fángjiān lǐ de gōngrén men zài tǎolùn zhè jiàn shì.
sentences.english: At this time, the workers in the room were discussing this matter.

sentences.chinese: 他们说：“这两个人长得这么多一样，太有趣了！”
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen shuō: “Zhè liǎng gè rén zhǎng de zhème duō yíyàng, tài yǒuqù le!”
sentences.english: They said, "These two people look so much alike, it's too interesting!"

sentences.chinese: 老那看着大卫，突然说：“既然我们姓一样，长得也像，那就这样吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo Nà kànzhe Dàwèi, tūrán shuō: “Jìrán wǒmen xìng yíyàng, zhǎng de yě xiàng, nà jiù zhèyàng ba.”
sentences.english: Old Na looked at David and suddenly said, "Since we have the same surname and look alike, let's just do this."

sentences.chinese: 大卫问：“这样是什么意思？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi wèn: “Zhèyàng shì shénme yìsi?”
sentences.english: David asked, "What does 'do this' mean?"

sentences.chinese: 老那说：“后天我有事不能来，你帮我工作一次，好吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo Nà shuō: “Hòutiān wǒ yǒu shì bù néng lái, nǐ bāng wǒ gōngzuò yí cì, hǎo ma?”
sentences.english: Old Na said, "The day after tomorrow I have something to do and cannot come; can you help me work for one time?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫惊呆了，他不能代替医生工作！
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi jīng dāi le, tā bù néng dàitì yīshēng gōngzuò!
sentences.english: David was stunned; he cannot work as a substitute for a doctor!

sentences.chinese: 大卫想再次解释，但老那已经走开了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎng zàicì jiěshì, dàn Lǎo Nà yǐjīng zǒu kāi le.
sentences.english: David wanted to explain again, but Old Na had already walked away.

sentences.chinese: 大卫绝望地想：我怎么变成了第两个医生？
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéwàng de xiǎng: Wǒ zěnme biànchéng le dì èr gè yīshēng?
sentences.english: David thought desperately: How did I become the second doctor?

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，大卫的手机又响了，这次是一个陌生号码。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shíhou, Dàwèi de shǒujī yòu xiǎng le, zhè cì shì yí gè mòshēng hàomǎ.
sentences.english: Just then, David's phone rang again; this time it was a strange number.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着手机，电话那头的人声音很大。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe shǒujī, diànhuà nàtóu de rén shēngyīn hěn dà.
sentences.english: David looked at his phone; the person on the other end of the line had a very loud voice.

sentences.chinese: 那个人说：“喂！你是那个新医生吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè rén shuō: “Wèi! Nǐ shì nàgè xīn yīshēng ma?”
sentences.english: That person said, "Hello! Are you the new doctor?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫想说“不是”，但他的嘴巴不能动。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎng shuō “bú shì”, dàn tā de zuǐba bùnéng dòng.
sentences.english: David wanted to say "no," but his mouth couldn't move.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个穿着白衣服的人走进了房间。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, yīgè chuānzhe bái yīfú de rén zǒujìnle fángjiān.
sentences.english: At that moment, a person wearing white clothes walked into the room.

sentences.chinese: 这个人的名字叫三，他是这里的经理。
sentences.pinyin: Zhègè rén de míngzì jiào Sān, tā shì zhèlǐ de jīnglǐ.
sentences.english: This person's name was San, and he was the manager here.

sentences.chinese: 三经理拿着一张长长的名单，看起来很严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Sān jīnglǐ názhe yī zhāng chángcháng de míngdān, kàn qǐlái hěn yánsù.
sentences.english: Manager San was holding a long list and looked very serious.

sentences.chinese: 三经理说：“医生，今天有很多病人要见你。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān jīnglǐ shuō: “Yīshēng, jīntiān yǒu hěnduō bìngrén yào jiàn nǐ.”
sentences.english: Manager San said, "Doctor, there are many patients who want to see you today."

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着名单，发现上面的名字非常奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe míngdān, fāxiàn shàngmiàn de míngzì fēicháng qíguài.
sentences.english: David looked at the list and found that the names on it were very strange.

sentences.chinese: 名单上的第一个人叫东先生。
sentences.pinyin: Míngdān shàng de dì-yī gè rén jiào Dōng xiānshēng.
sentences.english: The first person on the list was Mr. Dong.

sentences.chinese: 第二个人叫中先生。
sentences.pinyin: Dì-èr gè rén jiào Zhōng xiānshēng.
sentences.english: The second person was Mr. Zhong.

sentences.chinese: 第三个人叫也先生。
sentences.pinyin: Dì-sān gè rén jiào Yě xiānshēng.
sentences.english: The third person was Mr. Ye.

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这太奇怪了，他问：“这些人都是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéde zhè tài qíguài le, tā wèn: “Zhèxiē rén dōu shì shéi?”
sentences.english: David felt this was too strange and asked, "Who are these people?"

sentences.chinese: 三经理说：“他们是我们的老病人。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān jīnglǐ shuō: “Tāmen shì wǒmen de lǎo bìngrén.”
sentences.english: Manager San said, "They are our old patients."

sentences.chinese: 名单继续写着：元先生、关先生和冷先生。
sentences.pinyin: Míngdān jìxù xiězhe: Yuán xiānshēng, Guān xiānshēng hé Lěng xiānshēng.
sentences.english: The list continued: Mr. Yuan, Mr. Guan, and Mr. Leng.

sentences.chinese: 然后是别先生、包先生和南先生。
sentences.pinyin: Ránhòu shì Bié xiānshēng, Bāo xiānshēng hé Nán xiānshēng.
sentences.english: Then came Mr. Bie, Mr. Bao, and Mr. Nan.

sentences.chinese: 大卫心想：这些名字怎么像在读课本？
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xīn xiǎng: Zhèxiē míngzì zěnme xiàng zài dú kèběn?
sentences.english: David thought to himself: Why do these names sound like I'm reading a textbook?

sentences.chinese: 接着是后先生、国先生和坐先生。
sentences.pinyin: Jiēzhe shì Hòu xiānshēng, Guó xiānshēng hé Zuò xiānshēng.
sentences.english: Next were Mr. Hou, Mr. Guo, and Mr. Zuo.

sentences.chinese: 还有山先生、左先生和常先生。
sentences.pinyin: Hái yǒu Shān xiānshēng, Zuǒ xiānshēng hé Cháng xiānshēng.
sentences.english: Also Mr. Shan, Mr. Zuo, and Mr. Chang.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着三经理，三经理看着大卫。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe Sān jīnglǐ, Sān jīnglǐ kànzhe Dàwèi.
sentences.english: David looked at Manager San, and Manager San looked at David.

sentences.chinese: 三经理问：“你怎么了？你不认识年先生和教先生吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān jīnglǐ wèn: “Nǐ zěnme le? Nǐ bù rènshí Nián xiānshēng hé Jiào xiānshēng ma?”
sentences.english: Manager San asked, "What's wrong? Don't you know Mr. Nian and Mr. Jiao?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫摇摇头，他觉得自己的生活变成了一个笑话。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi yáoyáo tóu, tā juéde zìjǐ de shēnghuó biànchéngle yīgè xiàohua.
sentences.english: David shook his head; he felt his life had become a joke.

sentences.chinese: 名单上还有新先生、楼先生和毛先生。
sentences.pinyin: Míngdān shàng hái yǒu Xīn xiānshēng, Lóu xiānshēng hé Máo xiānshēng.
sentences.english: On the list were also Mr. Xin, Mr. Lou, and Mr. Mao.

sentences.chinese: 接着是水先生、班先生和白先生。
sentences.pinyin: Jiēzhe shì Shuǐ xiānshēng, Bān xiānshēng hé Bái xiānshēng.
sentences.english: Then Mr. Shui, Mr. Ban, and Mr. Bai.

sentences.chinese: 大卫发现名单后面还有百先生和能先生。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi fāxiàn míngdān hòumiàn hái yǒu Bǎi xiānshēng hé Néng xiānshēng.
sentences.english: David discovered that further down the list were Mr. Bai and Mr. Neng.

sentences.chinese: 然后是花先生、路先生和车先生。
sentences.pinyin: Ránhòu shì Huā xiānshēng, Lù xiānshēng hé Chē xiānshēng.
sentences.english: Then Mr. Hua, Mr. Lu, and Mr. Che.

sentences.chinese: 大卫绝望地想：这个医院是不是在开玩笑？
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéwàng de xiǎng: Zhègè yīyuàn shìbúshì zài kāiwánxiào?
sentences.english: David thought desperately: Is this hospital playing a joke?

sentences.chinese: 名单最后还有过先生、还先生和都先生。
sentences.pinyin: Míngdān zuìhòu hái yǒu Guò xiānshēng, Huán xiānshēng hé Dū xiānshēng.
sentences.english: At the end of the list were also Mr. Guo, Mr. Huan, and Mr. Du.

sentences.chinese: 最后三个是钱先生、错先生和门先生。
sentences.pinyin: Zuìhòu sān gè shì Qián xiānshēng, Cuò xiānshēng hé Mén xiānshēng.
sentences.english: The last three were Mr. Qian, Mr. Cuo, and Mr. Men.

sentences.chinese: 最下面写着一个高先生。
sentences.pinyin: Zuì xiàmiàn xiězhe yīgè Gāo xiānshēng.
sentences.english: At the very bottom was written a Mr. Gao.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着这张名单，突然觉得头很晕。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe zhè zhāng míngdān, tūrán juéde tóu hěn yūn.
sentences.english: David looked at this list and suddenly felt very dizzy.

sentences.chinese: 他想逃跑，但三经理挡在了门口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng táopǎo, dàn Sān jīnglǐ dǎng zàile ménkǒu.
sentences.english: He wanted to run away, but Manager San blocked the doorway.

sentences.chinese: 三经理说：“现在，请你去见第一个病人，东先生。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān jīnglǐ shuō: “Xiànzài, qǐng nǐ qù jiàn dì-yī gè bìngrén, Dōng xiānshēng.”
