sentences.english: Manager San said, "Now, please go see the first patient, Mr. Dong."

sentences.chinese: 大卫慢慢走向房间，他不知道会发生什么。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi mànmàn zǒuxiàng fángjiān, tā bù zhīdào huì fāshēng shénme.
sentences.english: David slowly walked toward the room, not knowing what would happen.

sentences.chinese: 就在他推开门的时候，他听到里面传来了巨大的尖叫声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tā tuīkāi mén de shíhòu, tā tīngdào lǐmiàn chuánláile jùdà de jiānjiào shēng.
sentences.english: Just as he pushed open the door, he heard a huge scream coming from inside.

sentences.chinese: 大卫推开门，看到一个大男人在尖叫。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi tuī kāi mén, kàndào yī gè dà nánrén zài jiānjiào.
sentences.english: David pushed open the door and saw a big man screaming.

sentences.chinese: 这个男人手里拿着一个大苹果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè nánrén shǒu lǐ názhe yī gè dà píngguǒ.
sentences.english: This man was holding a big apple in his hand.

sentences.chinese: 他看着大卫，大声问：“你是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe Dàwèi, dàshēng wèn: “Nǐ shì shuí?”
sentences.english: He looked at David and asked loudly, "Who are you?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫吓了一跳，他赶紧说：“您好！我是医生。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xià le yī tiào, tā gǎnjǐn shuō: “Nín hǎo! Wǒ shì yīshēng.”
sentences.english: David was startled and quickly said, "Hello (polite)! I am the doctor."

sentences.chinese: 那个男人停了下来，他看着大卫，突然笑了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè nánrén tíng le xiàlái, tā kànzhe Dàwèi, tūrán xiào le qǐlái.
sentences.english: The man stopped, looked at David, and suddenly started laughing.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你看起来像个外国人的样子。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ kàn qǐlái xiàng gè wàiguórén de yàngzi.”
sentences.english: He said, "You look like a foreigner."

sentences.chinese: 大卫尴尬地笑，心想：我确实是外国人的样子。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi gāngà de xiào, xīn xiǎng: Wǒ quèshí shì wàiguórén de yàngzi.
sentences.english: David laughed awkwardly, thinking: I indeed look like a foreigner.

sentences.chinese: 那个男人问：“你会说外语吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè nánrén wèn: “Nǐ huì shuō wàiyǔ ma?”
sentences.english: The man asked, "Do you speak a foreign language?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫回答：“我会说一点儿中文。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi huídá: “Wǒ huì shuō yīdiǎnr Zhōngwén.”
sentences.english: David replied, "I can speak a little bit of Chinese."

sentences.chinese: 男人大笑说：“太好了！我从北京来到这里。”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén dà xiào shuō: “Tài hǎo le! Wǒ cóng Běijīng lái dào zhèlǐ.”
sentences.english: The man laughed loudly and said, "Great! I came here from Beijing."

sentences.chinese: “我在这里住了三年，但我最讨厌这里的天气。”
sentences.pinyin: “Wǒ zài zhèlǐ zhù le sān nián, dàn wǒ zuì tǎoyàn zhèlǐ de tiānqì.”
sentences.english: "I have lived here for three years, but I hate the weather here the most."

sentences.chinese: 大卫想帮这个男人，但这个局面太难了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎng bāng zhè gè nánrén, dàn zhè gè júmiàn tài nán le.
sentences.english: David wanted to help this man, but this situation was too difficult.

sentences.chinese: 男人说：“我的小妹也在房间里，她很小，只有五岁。”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén shuō: “Wǒ de xiǎomèi yě zài fángjiān lǐ, tā hěn xiǎo, zhǐyǒu wǔ suì.”
sentences.english: The man said, "My younger sister is also in the room; she is very small, only five years old."

sentences.chinese: 大卫看到房间里有一个小女孩，她正在玩家具。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kàndào fángjiān lǐ yǒu yī gè xiǎo nǚhái, tā zhèngzài wán jiājù.
sentences.english: David saw a little girl in the room playing with the furniture.

sentences.chinese: 大卫问：“您想干什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi wèn: “Nín xiǎng gàn shénme?”
sentences.english: David asked, "What would you like to do?"

sentences.chinese: 男人说：“我想请你帮我拿那个苹果。”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ ná nà gè píngguǒ.”
sentences.english: The man said, "I would like to ask you to help me get that apple."

sentences.chinese: 大卫走过去，拿起了苹果，但苹果掉在了地上。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi zǒu guòqù, ná qǐ le píngguǒ, dàn píngguǒ diào zài le dìshàng.
sentences.english: David walked over and picked up the apple, but the apple fell on the floor.

sentences.chinese: 男人大喊：“我的苹果！”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén dà hǎn: “Wǒ de píngguǒ!”
sentences.english: The man shouted, "My apple!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫赶紧说：“没关系，没关系！我再拿一个。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi gǎnjǐn shuō: “Méiguānxi, méiguānxi! Wǒ zài ná yī gè.”
sentences.english: David quickly said, "It doesn't matter, it doesn't matter! I'll get another one."

sentences.chinese: 男人看着大卫，突然安静了一下儿。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén kànzhe Dàwèi, tūrán ānjìng le yīxiàr.
sentences.english: The man looked at David and suddenly became quiet for a moment.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你这个家伙，真的像个医生吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ zhè gè jiāhuo, zhēnde xiàng gè yīshēng ma?”
sentences.english: He said, "You fellow, do you really look like a doctor?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫紧张地看着他，觉得这里越来越奇怪了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi jǐnzhāng de kànzhe tā, juédé zhèlǐ yuè lái yuè qíguài le.
sentences.english: David looked at him nervously, feeling that this place was becoming stranger and stranger.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，三经理走进了房间。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, Sān Jīnglǐ zǒu jìn le fángjiān.
sentences.english: Just then, Manager San walked into the room.

sentences.chinese: 三经理看着大卫，眼神里充满了怀疑。
sentences.pinyin: Sān Jīnglǐ kànzhe Dàwèi, yǎnshén lǐ chōngmǎn le huáiyí.
sentences.english: Manager San looked at David, his eyes full of suspicion.

sentences.chinese: 三经理看着大卫，眼神里充满了怀疑。
sentences.pinyin: Sān jīng lǐ kàn zhe Dà wèi, yǎn shén lǐ chōng mǎn le huái yí.
sentences.english: Manager San looked at David, his eyes full of suspicion.

sentences.chinese: 他问：“医生，你为什么不动？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn: “Yī shēng, nǐ wèi shén me bú dòng?”
sentences.english: He asked, "Doctor, why aren't you moving?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫吓了一跳，他的动作很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi xià le yí tiào, tā de dòng zuò hěn qí guài.
sentences.english: David was startled, and his movement was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 他想回答，但是他不知道该说什么。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng huí dá, dàn shì tā bù zhī dào gāi shuō shén me.
sentences.english: He wanted to answer, but he didn't know what to say.

sentences.chinese: 三经理冷冷地说：“你现在在上班，请认真做你的工作。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān jīng lǐ lěng lěng de shuō: “Nǐ xiàn zài zài shàng bān, qǐng rèn zhēn zuò nǐ de gōng zuò.”
sentences.english: Manager San said coldly, "You are on duty now, please do your work seriously."

sentences.chinese: 东先生突然叫了起来：“我想回家！”
sentences.pinyin: Dōng xiān sheng tū rán jiào le qǐ lái: “Wǒ xiǎng huí jiā!”
sentences.english: Mr. Dong suddenly shouted, "I want to go home!"

sentences.chinese: 三经理对大卫说：“请你向东先生介绍一下你的治疗计划。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān jīng lǐ duì Dà wèi shuō: “Qǐng nǐ xiàng Dōng xiān sheng jiè shào yí xià nǐ de zhì liáo jì huà.”
sentences.english: Manager San said to David, "Please introduce your treatment plan to Mr. Dong."

sentences.chinese: 大卫紧张地看着东先生，他心想：我怎么会知道怎么做？
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi jǐn zhāng de kàn zhe Dōng xiān sheng, tā xīn xiǎng: Wǒ zěn me huì zhī dào zěn me zuò?
sentences.english: David looked at Mr. Dong nervously, thinking to himself: How would I know how to do this?

sentences.chinese: 他试着说：“您喜欢喝什么？水还是茶？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì zhe shuō: “Nín xǐ huan hē shén me? Shuǐ hái shì chá?”
sentences.english: He tried saying, "What do you like to drink? Water or tea?"

sentences.chinese: 东先生生气了，他大喊：“我不想喝水，我想回去！”
sentences.pinyin: Dōng xiān sheng shēng qì le, tā dà hǎn: “Wǒ bù xiǎng hē shuǐ, wǒ xiǎng huí qu!”
sentences.english: Mr. Dong got angry and yelled, "I don't want to drink water, I want to go back!"

sentences.chinese: 三经理皱起眉头，问大卫：“你准备怎么治疗他？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān jīng lǐ zhòu qǐ méi tóu, wèn Dà wèi: “Nǐ zhǔn bèi zěn me zhì liáo tā?”
sentences.english: Manager San frowned and asked David, "How do you prepare to treat him?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫突然想到一个主意，他决定假装在上课。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi tū rán xiǎng dào yí gè zhǔ yì, tā jué dìng jiǎ zhuāng zài shàng kè.
sentences.english: David suddenly had an idea; he decided to pretend he was teaching a class.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“东先生，我们现在来做一个简单的测试。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Dōng xiān sheng, wǒ men xiàn zài lái zuò yí gè jiǎn dān de cè shì.”
sentences.english: He said, "Mr. Dong, let's do a simple test now."

sentences.chinese: “首先，请您唱一首歌。”
sentences.pinyin: “Shǒu xiān, qǐng nín chàng yì shǒu gē.”
sentences.english: "First, please sing a song."

sentences.chinese: 东先生愣住了，他问：“为什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Dōng xiān sheng lèng zhù le, tā wèn: “Wèi shén me?”
sentences.english: Mr. Dong was stunned and asked, "Why?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫赶紧说：“我想看看您的声音能不能出来。”
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi gǎn jǐn shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng kàn kàn nín de shēng yīn néng bù néng chū lái.”
sentences.english: David quickly said, "I want to see if your voice can come out."

sentences.chinese: 东先生开始唱，声音非常难听。
sentences.pinyin: Dōng xiān sheng kāi shǐ chàng, shēng yīn fēi cháng nán tīng.
sentences.english: Mr. Dong started to sing, and the sound was very unpleasant.

sentences.chinese: 三经理看着大卫，觉得这个医生很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Sān jīng lǐ kàn zhe Dà wèi, jué de zhè gè yī shēng hěn qí guài.
sentences.english: Manager San looked at David and felt this doctor was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 三经理问：“你以前在哪里上学？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān jīng lǐ wèn: “Nǐ yǐ qián zài nǎ lǐ shàng xué?”
sentences.english: Manager San asked, "Where did you go to school before?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫胡乱地回答：“我在一个很远的地方上学。”
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi hú luàn de huí dá: “Wǒ zài yí gè hěn yuǎn de dì fang shàng xué.”
sentences.english: David answered randomly, "I went to school in a very far place."

sentences.chinese: 三经理又问：“你现在住在哪儿？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān jīng lǐ yòu wèn: “Nǐ xiàn zài zhù zài nǎ r?”
sentences.english: Manager San asked again, "Where do you live now?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫说：“我住在一个……很有趣的地方。”
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi shuō: “Wǒ zhù zài yí gè…… hěn yǒu qù de dì fang.”
sentences.english: David said, "I live in a... very interesting place."

sentences.chinese: 三经理怀疑地看着他，想上网查一下大卫的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Sān jīng lǐ huái yí de kàn zhe tā, xiǎng shàng wǎng chá yí xià Dà wèi de míng zi.
sentences.english: Manager San looked at him suspiciously and wanted to go online to check David's name.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，东先生突然跳了起来，想出房间去。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, Dōng xiān sheng tū rán tiào le qǐ lái, xiǎng chū fáng jiān qù.
sentences.english: Just then, Mr. Dong suddenly jumped up and wanted to go out of the room.

sentences.chinese: 大卫赶紧抓住他，大喊：“不能动！请分清楚这里是医院！”
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi gǎn jǐn zhuā zhù tā, dà hǎn: “Bù néng dòng! Qǐng fēn qīng chǔ zhè lǐ shì yī yuàn!”
sentences.english: David quickly grabbed him and shouted, "Don't move! Please distinguish that this is a hospital!"

sentences.chinese: 东先生终于安静了下来，但三经理的眼神更怀疑了。
sentences.pinyin: Dōng xiān sheng zhōng yú ān jìng le xià lái, dàn Sān jīng lǐ de yǎn shén gèng huái yí le.
sentences.english: Mr. Dong finally quieted down, but Manager San's look became even more suspicious.

sentences.chinese: 三经理告诉大卫：“等会儿你得跟我上车，我们要去见院长。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān jīng lǐ gào sù Dà wèi: “Děng huì r nǐ děi gēn wǒ shàng chē, wǒ men yào qù jiàn yuàn zhǎng.”
sentences.english: Manager San told David, "In a moment, you must get in the car with me; we are going to see the director."

sentences.chinese: 大卫绝望地想：我怎么还没能回来我的家？
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi jué wàng de xiǎng: Wǒ zěn me hái méi néng huí lái wǒ de jiā?
sentences.english: David thought desperately: How have I still not been able to return to my home?

sentences.chinese: 他看着窗外，发现一个和他长得一模一样的人正在走进来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe chuāng wài, fā xiàn yí gè hé tā zhǎng de yí mó yí yàng de rén zhèng zài zǒu jìn lái.
sentences.english: He looked out the window and noticed a person who looked exactly like him walking in.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着窗外，那个长得一样的人走进了房间。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe chuāngwài, nàge zhǎng de yīyàng de rén zǒu jìnle fángjiān.
sentences.english: David looked out the window, and the person who looked exactly like him walked into the room.

sentences.chinese: 三经理大喊：“你怎么在这里？你不是在打球吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān jīnglǐ dàhǎn: “Nǐ zěnme zài zhèlǐ? Nǐ bùshì zài dǎ qiú ma?”
sentences.english: Manager San shouted, "Why are you here? Weren't you playing ball?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫很想说：“我不是他！”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi hěn xiǎng shuō: “Wǒ bùshì tā!”
sentences.english: David really wanted to say, "I am not him!"

sentences.chinese: 但三经理看着大卫，笑着说：“你在开玩笑吧？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàn Sān jīnglǐ kànzhe Dàwèi, xiàozhe shuō: “Nǐ zài kāi wánxiào ba?”
sentences.english: But Manager San looked at David and said with a smile, "You're joking, right?"

sentences.chinese: 另一个“大卫”走过来，他的手在抖。
sentences.pinyin: Lìng yīgè “Dàwèi” zǒu guòlái, tā de shǒu zài dǒu.
sentences.english: Another "David" walked over, his hands shaking.

sentences.chinese: 他看着大卫，惊讶地说：“你怎么在这里？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe Dàwèi, jīngyà de shuō: “Nǐ zěnme zài zhèlǐ?”
sentences.english: He looked at David and said in surprise, "Why are you here?"

sentences.chinese: 三经理生气了，他大声说：“你们两个都给我闭嘴！”
sentences.pinyin: Sān jīnglǐ shēngqì le, tā dàshēng shuō: “Nǐmen liǎng gè dōu gěi wǒ bìzuǐ!”
sentences.english: Manager San got angry and said loudly, "Both of you shut up!"

sentences.chinese: 三经理说：“现在我们很忙，院长在开会。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān jīnglǐ shuō: “Xiànzài wǒmen hěn máng, yuànzhǎng zài kāihuì.”
sentences.english: Manager San said, "We are very busy right now, the dean is in a meeting."

sentences.chinese: 他告诉他们：“你们必须学习怎么在这个医院工作。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù tāmen: “Nǐmen bìxū xuéxí zěnme zài zhège yīyuàn gōngzuò.”
sentences.english: He told them, "You must learn how to work in this hospital."

sentences.chinese: 大卫想：我怎么要学习医生的工作？
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎng: Wǒ zěnme yào xuéxí yīshēng de gōngzuò?
sentences.english: David thought: How am I supposed to study the work of a doctor?

sentences.chinese: 三经理打开门，让他们来到院长办公室。
sentences.pinyin: Sān jīnglǐ dǎkāi mén, ràng tāmen láidào yuànzhǎng bàngōngshì.
sentences.english: Manager San opened the door and led them to the dean's office.

sentences.chinese: 办公室外面有一棵很大的树。
sentences.pinyin: Bàngōngshì wàimiàn yǒu yī kē hěn dà de shù.
sentences.english: There was a very large tree outside the office.

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得天气很热，他想洗个脸。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéde tiānqì hěn rè, tā xiǎng xǐ gè liǎn.
sentences.english: David felt the weather was very hot and wanted to wash his face.

sentences.chinese: 另一个“大卫”突然开始唱歌，唱了一首奇怪的歌。
sentences.pinyin: Lìng yīgè “Dàwèi” tūrán kāishǐ chànggē, chàngle yī shǒu qíguài de gē.
sentences.english: The other "David" suddenly started singing, singing a strange song.

sentences.chinese: 三经理看着他，说：“你的爱好真奇怪。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān jīnglǐ kànzhe tā, shuō: “Nǐ de àihào zhēn qíguài.”
sentences.english: Manager San looked at him and said, "Your hobby is really strange."

sentences.chinese: 大卫问：“你爱做什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi wèn: “Nǐ ài zuò shénme?”
sentences.english: David asked, "What do you love to do?"

sentences.chinese: 那个双胞胎说：“我爱玩儿，我不爱学习。”
sentences.pinyin: Nàge shuāngbāotāi shuō: “Wǒ ài wánr, wǒ bù ài xuéxí.”
sentences.english: The twin said, "I love to play, I don't love to study."

sentences.chinese: 三经理说：“别说话！我们要去得到院长的同意。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān jīnglǐ shuō: “Bié shuōhuà! Wǒmen yào qù dédào yuànzhǎng de tóngyì.”
sentences.english: Manager San said, "Stop talking! We need to get the dean's approval."

sentences.chinese: 他让大卫帮忙拿一个文件夹。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ràng Dàwèi bāngmáng ná yīgè wénjiànjiá.
sentences.english: He asked David to help carry a folder.

sentences.chinese: 大卫把文件夹放在桌子上。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi bǎ wénjiànjiá fàng zài zhuōzi shàng.
sentences.english: David put the folder on the table.

sentences.chinese: 三经理说：“院长很好看，但他也很凶。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān jīnglǐ shuō: “Yuànzhǎng hěn hǎokàn, dàn tā yě hěn xiōng.”
sentences.english: Manager San said, "The dean is good-looking, but he is also very fierce."

sentences.chinese: 大卫心想：如果我能打车回家就好了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xīn xiǎng: Rúguǒ wǒ néng dǎchē huí jiā jiù hǎole.
sentences.english: David thought to himself: If only I could take a taxi home.

sentences.chinese: 三经理开门走进去，大卫跟在后面。
sentences.pinyin: Sān jīnglǐ kāimén zǒu jìnqù, Dàwèi gēn zài hòumiàn.
sentences.english: Manager San opened the door and walked in, and David followed behind.

sentences.chinese: 他看到院长在喝一杯热奶。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào yuànzhǎng zài hē yī bēi rè nǎi.
sentences.english: He saw the dean drinking a glass of hot milk.

sentences.chinese: 院长看着两个大卫，愣住了。
sentences.pinyin: Yuànzhǎng kànzhe liǎng gè Dàwèi, lèng zhùle.
sentences.english: The dean looked at the two Davids and was stunned.

sentences.chinese: 院长问：“为什么这里有两个医生？”
sentences.pinyin: Yuànzhǎng wèn: “Wèishéme zhèlǐ yǒu liǎng gè yīshēng?”
sentences.english: The dean asked, "Why are there two doctors here?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫绝望地看着另一个自己，心想：这下麻烦大了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéwàng de kànzhe lìng yīgè zìjǐ, xīn xiǎng: Zhè xià máfan dàle.
sentences.english: David looked at the other version of himself in despair, thinking: Now I'm in big trouble.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十章：谁是真正的医生？
chapters.title_english: Chapter 10: Who is the Real Doctor?

sentences.chinese: 院长看着两个大卫，他的杯子还在手里着。
sentences.pinyin: Yuàn zhǎng kàn zhe liǎng gè Dà wèi, tā de bēi zi hái zài shǒu lǐ zhāo.
sentences.english: The Dean looked at the two Davids, his cup still in his hand.

sentences.chinese: 院长大声说：“你们两个，快站起来！”
sentences.pinyin: Yuàn zhǎng dà shēng shuō: “Nǐ men liǎng gè, kuài zhàn qǐ lái!”
sentences.english: The Dean shouted, "You two, stand up quickly!"

sentences.chinese: 两个大卫赶紧站了起来，像两个木头人一样站着。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng gè Dà wèi gǎn jǐn zhàn le qǐ lái, xiàng liǎng gè mù tou rén yī yàng zhàn zhe.
sentences.english: The two Davids quickly stood up, standing there like two pieces of wood.

sentences.chinese: 院长看着他们，觉得这件事太奇怪了。
sentences.pinyin: Yuàn zhǎng kàn zhe tā men, jué de zhè jiàn shì tài qí guài le.
sentences.english: The Dean looked at them and felt this matter was too strange.

sentences.chinese: 他想试一下，看看谁才是真正的医生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng shì yī xià, kàn kàn shuí cái shì zhēn zhèng de yī shēng.
sentences.english: He wanted to try a bit to see who the real doctor was.

sentences.chinese: 院长说：“真正的医生必须知道怎么看病。”
sentences.pinyin: Yuàn zhǎng shuō: “Zhēn zhèng de yī shēng bì xū zhī dào zěn me kàn bìng.”
sentences.english: The Dean said, "A real doctor must know how to treat patients."

sentences.chinese: 大卫很紧张，他不知道怎么说话。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi hěn jǐn zhāng, tā bù zhī dào zěn me shuō huà.
sentences.english: David was very nervous; he didn't know how to speak.

sentences.chinese: 另一个大卫很自信，他穿一件白衣服，看起来很专业。
sentences.pinyin: Lìng yī gè Dà wèi hěn zì xìn, tā chuān yī jiàn bái yī fú, kàn qǐ lái hěn zhuān yè.
sentences.english: The other David was very confident; he wore a white coat and looked very professional.

sentences.chinese: 院长问：“请告诉我，医生每天怎么工作？”
sentences.pinyin: Yuàn zhǎng wèn: “Qǐng gào sù wǒ, yī shēng měi tiān zěn me gōng zuò?”
sentences.english: The Dean asked, "Please tell me, how does a doctor work every day?"

sentences.chinese: 另一个大卫说：“医生要早起，早早起床。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìng yī gè Dà wèi shuō: “Yī shēng yào zǎo qǐ, zǎo zǎo qǐ chuáng.”
sentences.english: The other David said, "A doctor must rise early, getting out of bed very early."

sentences.chinese: 他继续说：“然后我就去医院，给很多病人看病。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì xù shuō: “Rán hòu wǒ jiù qù yī yuàn, gěi hěn duō bìng rén kàn bìng.”
sentences.english: He continued, "Then I go to the hospital to see many patients."

sentences.chinese: 大卫想：我也知道这些，因为我以前读书的时候看过书。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi xiǎng: Wǒ yě zhī dào zhè xiē, yīn wèi wǒ yǐ qián dú shū de shí hou kàn guò shū.
sentences.english: David thought: I know this too, because I read books when I was studying.

sentences.chinese: 院长看着大卫说：“你呢？你认识这里的病人吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Yuàn zhǎng kàn zhe Dà wèi shuō: “Nǐ ne? Nǐ rèn shi zhè lǐ de bìng rén ma?”
sentences.english: The Dean looked at David and said, "What about you? Do you recognize the patients here?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫愣住了，他没有记下任何病人的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi lèng zhù le, tā méi yǒu jì xià rèn hé bìng rén de míng zi.
sentences.english: David froze; he hadn't recorded any of the patients' names.

sentences.chinese: 他心想：我怎么能记住那些名字？我才刚来这里！
sentences.pinyin: Tā xīn xiǎng: Wǒ zěn me néng jì zhù nà xiē míng zi? Wǒ cái gāng lái zhè lǐ!
sentences.english: He thought: How could I remember those names? I just got here!

sentences.chinese: 院长突然说：“那么，我们要进行一次考试。”
sentences.pinyin: Yuàn zhǎng tū rán shuō: “Nà me, wǒ men yào jìn xíng yī cì kǎo shì.”
sentences.english: The Dean suddenly said, "In that case, we will have an exam."

sentences.chinese: 大卫惊恐地问：“考试？在这里考我？”
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi jīng kǒng de wèn: “Kǎo shì? Zài zhè lǐ kǎo wǒ?”
sentences.english: David asked in terror, "An exam? Testing me here?"

sentences.chinese: 院长点点头说：“是的，如果你能通过考试，你就可以走。”
sentences.pinyin: Yuàn zhǎng diǎn diǎn tóu shuō: “Shì de, rú guǒ nǐ néng tōng guò kǎo shì, nǐ jiù kě yǐ zǒu.”
sentences.english: The Dean nodded and said, "Yes, if you can pass the exam, you can leave."

sentences.chinese: 院长请他们两个坐下，给他们每人一张纸。
sentences.pinyin: Yuàn zhǎng qǐng tā men liǎng gè zuò xià, gěi tā men měi rén yī zhāng zhǐ.
sentences.english: The Dean asked them both to sit down and gave each of them a piece of paper.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着纸，发现上面没有字，只有一张睡觉的图片。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi kàn zhe zhǐ, fā xiàn shàng miàn méi yǒu zì, zhǐ yǒu yī zhāng shuì jiào de tú piàn.
sentences.english: David looked at the paper and found there were no words, only a picture of someone sleeping.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这是一个奇怪的着法，也许院长在开玩笑。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué de zhè shì yī gè qí guài de zhāo fǎ, yě xǔ yuàn zhǎng zài kāi wán xiào.
sentences.english: He felt this was a strange trick; perhaps the Dean was joking.

sentences.chinese: 大卫试着在纸上画了一个大大的笑脸。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi shì zhe zài zhǐ shàng huà le yī gè dà dà de xiào liǎn.
sentences.english: David tried to draw a big smiley face on the paper.

sentences.chinese: 院长看见这个笑脸，突然大笑起来。
sentences.pinyin: Yuàn zhǎng kàn jiàn zhè gè xiào liǎn, tū rán dà xiào qǐ lái.
sentences.english: The Dean saw this smiley face and suddenly burst out laughing.

sentences.chinese: 院长说：“太有趣了！你竟然敢在考试的时候画画！”
sentences.pinyin: Yuàn zhǎng shuō: “Tài yǒu qù le! Nǐ jìng rán gǎn zài kǎo shì de shí hou huà huà!”
sentences.english: The Dean said, "Too interesting! You actually dare to draw during an exam!"

sentences.chinese: 另一个大卫在认真地写字，他写了很多医学词汇。
sentences.pinyin: Lìng yī gè Dà wèi zài rèn zhēn de xiě zì, tā xiě le hěn duō yī xué cí huì.
sentences.english: The other David was writing seriously; he wrote many medical terms.

sentences.chinese: 院长看着那个认真的大卫，突然皱起了眉头。
sentences.pinyin: Yuàn zhǎng kàn zhe nà gè rèn zhēn de Dà wèi, tū rán zhòu qǐ le méi tóu.
sentences.english: The Dean looked at the serious David and suddenly frowned.

sentences.chinese: 院长说：“你写得太累了，看起来一点也不快乐。”
sentences.pinyin: Yuàn zhǎng shuō: “Nǐ xiě dé tài lèi le, kàn qǐ lái yī diǎn yě bù kuài lè.”
sentences.english: The Dean said, "You write too exhaustingly; you don't look happy at all."

sentences.chinese: 三经理在旁边小声说：“院长，我们不能一直这样走下去。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān jīng lǐ zài páng biān xiǎo shēng shuō: “Yuàn zhǎng, wǒ men bù néng yī zhí zhè yàng zǒu xià qù.”
sentences.english: Manager San whispered beside him, "Dean, we cannot keep going on like this."

sentences.chinese: 院长站起来，决定和他们见面谈谈。
sentences.pinyin: Yuàn zhǎng zhàn qǐ lái, jué dìng hé tā men jiàn miàn tán tan.
sentences.english: The Dean stood up and decided to meet with them to talk.

sentences.chinese: 他看着大卫说：“你虽然不认识病人，但你很有趣。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe Dà wèi shuō: “Nǐ suī rán bù rèn shi bìng rén, dàn nǐ hěn yǒu qù.”
sentences.english: He looked at David and said, "Although you don't know the patients, you are very interesting."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得走路回家的路现在变得很远。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi jué de zǒu lù huí jiā de lù xiàn zài biàn dé hěn yuǎn.
sentences.english: David felt the walk back home had now become very far.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，另一个大卫突然大喊一声，指着窗外。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, lìng yī gè Dà wèi tū rán dà hǎn yī shēng, zhǐ zhe chuāng wài.
sentences.english: Just then, the other David suddenly shouted and pointed out the window.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看见窗外又出现了一个长得一样的人！
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi kàn jiàn chuāng wài yòu chū xiàn le yī gè zhǎng dé yī yàng de rén!
sentences.english: David saw another person who looked exactly the same appear outside the window!

sentences.chinese: 院长惊呆了，他的热奶洒在了衣服上。
sentences.pinyin: Yuàn zhǎng jīng dāi le, tā de rè nǎi sǎ zài le yī fú shàng.
sentences.english: The Dean was stunned, and his hot milk spilled on his clothes.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十一章：三个大卫和奇怪的歌
chapters.title_english: Chapter 11: Three Davids and the Strange Song

sentences.chinese: 院长看着他的衣服，大喊：“我的天！”
sentences.pinyin: Yuàn zhǎng kàn zhe tā de yī fu, dà hǎn: “Wǒ de tiān!”
sentences.english: The dean looked at his clothes and shouted, "My goodness!"

sentences.chinese: 窗外现在开始下雨了。
sentences.pinyin: Chuāng wài xiàn zài kāi shǐ xià yǔ le.
sentences.english: It started to rain outside.

sentences.chinese: 三个长得一样的人站在那里，他们看起来都很困惑。
sentences.pinyin: Sān gè zhǎng de yī yàng de rén zhàn zài nà lǐ, tā men kàn qǐ lái dōu hěn kùn huò.
sentences.english: Three people who looked exactly the same were standing there; they all looked confused.

sentences.chinese: 院长对他们说：“你们三个，快进来！”
sentences.pinyin: Yuàn zhǎng duì tā men shuō: “Nǐ men sān gè, kuài jìn lái!”
sentences.english: The dean said to them, "You three, come in quickly!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫走进了房间，那里有一张很小的几。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi zǒu jìn le fáng jiān, nà lǐ yǒu yī zhāng hěn xiǎo de jǐ.
sentences.english: David walked into the room, where there was a very small side table.

sentences.chinese: 院长在几上面写了他的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Yuàn zhǎng zài jǐ shàng miàn xiě le tā de míng zi.
sentences.english: The dean wrote his name on the side table.

sentences.chinese: 他看着大卫说：“你是医生，还是在这个医院工作的医生？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe Dà wèi shuō: “Nǐ shì yī shēng, hái shì zài zhè gè yī yuàn gōng zuò de yī shēng?”
sentences.english: He looked at David and said, "Are you a doctor, or a doctor working in this hospital?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫想说他不是医生，但他突然听到窗外有声音。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi xiǎng shuō tā bù shì yī shēng, dàn tā tū rán tīng dào chuāng wài yǒu shēng yīn.
sentences.english: David wanted to say he wasn't a doctor, but he suddenly heard a sound outside the window.

sentences.chinese: 他听见一个人在唱歌。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīng jiàn yī gè rén zài chàng gē.
sentences.english: He heard someone singing a song.

sentences.chinese: 那个声音非常好听。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè shēng yīn fēi cháng hǎo tīng.
sentences.english: That voice was very pleasant to hear.

sentences.chinese: 一个女人走进了房间，她是院长的女儿。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè nǚ rén zǒu jìn le fáng jiān, tā shì yuàn zhǎng de nǚ ér.
sentences.english: A woman walked into the room; she was the dean's daughter.

sentences.chinese: 她看着三个大卫，惊讶地问：“爸爸，为什么这里有三个你？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe sān gè Dà wèi, jīng yà de wèn: “Bà ba, wèi shén me zhè lǐ yǒu sān gè nǐ?”
sentences.english: She looked at the three Davids and asked in surprise, "Dad, why are there three of you here?"

sentences.chinese: 院长尴尬地笑了，他说：“这不是我，这是大卫。”
sentences.pinyin: Yuàn zhǎng gān gà de xiào le, tā shuō: “Zhè bù shì wǒ, zhè shì Dà wèi.”
sentences.english: The dean smiled awkwardly and said, "This isn't me, this is David."

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个漂亮的女人走进来，她是大卫的女朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yī gè piào liang de nǚ rén zǒu jìn lái, tā shì Dà wèi de nǚ péng you.
sentences.english: At that moment, a beautiful woman walked in; she was David's girlfriend.

sentences.chinese: 她大喊：“大卫！你怎么还没回家？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dà hǎn: “Dà wèi! Nǐ zěn me hái méi huí jiā?”
sentences.english: She shouted, "David! Why haven't you returned home yet?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫终于看到了她，他觉得她像太阳一样。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi zhōng yú kàn dào le tā, tā jué de tā xiàng tài yáng yī yàng.
sentences.english: David finally saw her, and he felt she was like the sun.

sentences.chinese: 女朋友看着另外两个大卫，大声说：“你们是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ péng you kàn zhe lìng wài liǎng gè Dà wèi, dà shēng shuō: “Nǐ men shì shuí?”
sentences.english: The girlfriend looked at the other two Davids and asked loudly, "Who are you?"

sentences.chinese: 另一个大卫紧张地坐下，他忘记了怎么说话。
sentences.pinyin: Lìng yī gè Dà wèi jǐn zhāng de zuò xia, tā wàng jì le zěn me shuō huà.
sentences.english: Another David sat down nervously; he forgot how to speak.

sentences.chinese: 第三个大卫突然拿出一张地图。
sentences.pinyin: Dì sān gè Dà wèi tū rán ná chū yī zhāng dì tú.
sentences.english: The third David suddenly pulled out a map.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“我想回到我的家里，但我找不到路。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng huí dào wǒ de jiā lǐ, dàn wǒ zhǎo bù dào lù.”
sentences.english: He said, "I want to return to my home, but I can't find the way."

sentences.chinese: 院长觉得太奇怪了，他决定给警察打电话。
sentences.pinyin: Yuàn zhǎng jué de tài qí guài le, tā jué dìng gěi jǐng chá dǎ diàn huà.
sentences.english: The dean felt it was too strange and decided to call the police.

sentences.chinese: 他拿起电话，准备打电话求助。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná qǐ diàn huà, zhǔn bèi dǎ diàn huà qiú zhù.
sentences.english: He picked up the phone, preparing to make a phone call for help.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个送货员走进来，他带着一打鸡蛋。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yī gè sòng huò yuán zǒu jìn lái, tā dài zhe yī dá jī dàn.
sentences.english: Just then, a delivery man walked in, carrying a dozen eggs.

sentences.chinese: 送货员看着三个大卫，吓得把鸡蛋都掉了。
sentences.pinyin: Sòng huò yuán kàn zhe sān gè Dà wèi, xià de bǎ jī dàn dōu diào le.
sentences.english: The delivery man looked at the three Davids and was so scared that he dropped all the eggs.

sentences.chinese: 院长对大卫说：“你现在必须出去，在外面等我。”
sentences.pinyin: Yuàn zhǎng duì Dà wèi shuō: “Nǐ xiàn zài bì xū chū qù, zài wài miàn děng wǒ.”
sentences.english: The dean said to David, "You must go out now and wait for me outside."

sentences.chinese: 大卫走出医院，他想开车离开这里。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi zǒu chū yī yuàn, tā xiǎng kāi chē lí kāi zhè lǐ.
sentences.english: David walked out of the hospital; he wanted to drive a car to leave this place.

sentences.chinese: 但是，他突然发现自己的车钥匙不见了！
sentences.pinyin: Dàn shì, tā tū rán fā xiàn zì jǐ de chē yào shi bù jiàn le!
sentences.english: But suddenly, he discovered that his car keys were gone!

sentences.chinese: 大卫在车上找了很久，但是没有找到钥匙。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi zài chē shàng zhǎo le hěn jiǔ, dànshì méiyǒu zhǎo dào yàoshi.
sentences.english: David searched for a long time in the car, but he didn't find the keys.

sentences.chinese: 他想，也许钥匙在衣服里边。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, yěxǔ yàoshi zài yīfu lǐbian.
sentences.english: He thought maybe the keys were inside his clothes.

sentences.chinese: 他检查了所有的口袋，但那些口袋都是空的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiǎnchá le suǒyǒu de kǒudài, dàn nàxiē kǒudài dōu shì kōng de.
sentences.english: He checked all the pockets, but those pockets were all empty.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得很渴，想去买一瓶水。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde hěn kě, xiǎng qù mǎi yī píng shuǐ.
sentences.english: He felt thirsty and wanted to buy a bottle of water.

sentences.chinese: 大卫走回医院楼下，看到一个女人在哭。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi zǒu huí yīyuàn lóuxià, kàndào yīgè nǚrén zài kū.
sentences.english: David walked back downstairs to the hospital and saw a woman crying.

sentences.chinese: 那个女人看着大卫，大喊道：“我的男朋友！”
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè nǚrén kànzhe Dàwèi, dà hǎn dào: “Wǒ de nán péngyou!”
sentences.english: That woman looked at David and shouted, "My boyfriend!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫很惊讶，因为他不是她的男朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi hěn jīngyà, yīnwèi tā búshì tā de nán péngyou.
sentences.english: David was very surprised because he was not her boyfriend.

sentences.chinese: 他想，网上一定有关于这个女人的信息。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, wǎngshàng yīdìng yǒu guānyú zhègè nǚrén de xìnxī.
sentences.english: He thought there must be information about this woman online.

sentences.chinese: 但现在没时间看手机，他必须找到钥匙。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiànzài méi shíjiān kàn shǒujī, tā bìxū zhǎodào yàoshi.
sentences.english: But there was no time to look at the phone now; he had to find the keys.

sentences.chinese: 他记得刚才三个大卫在一起的时候，有人在跑。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde gāngcái sān gè Dàwèi zài yīqǐ de shíhou, yǒurén zài pǎo.
sentences.english: He remembered that when the three Davids were together just now, someone was running.

sentences.chinese: 大卫跑回医院，大喊：“请问，有人看到我的钥匙吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi pǎo huí yīyuàn, dà hǎn: “Qǐngwèn, yǒurén kàndào wǒ de yàoshi ma?”
sentences.english: David ran back to the hospital and shouted, "Excuse me, has anyone seen my keys?"

sentences.chinese: 三经理走过来，笑着说：“请进，进来谈谈。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān jīnglǐ zǒu guòlái, xiàozhe shuō: “Qǐng jìn, jìnlái tán tán.”
sentences.english: Manager San walked over and said with a smile, "Please come in, come in and talk."

sentences.chinese: 大卫走进办公室，三经理说：“请坐。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi zǒu jìn bàngōngshì, Sān jīnglǐ shuō: “Qǐng zuò.”
sentences.english: David walked into the office, and Manager San said, "Please have a seat."

sentences.chinese: 三经理看着大卫，试图说服他留在医院工作。
sentences.pinyin: Sān jīnglǐ kànzhe Dàwèi, shìtú shuōfú tā liú zài yīyuàn gōngzuò.
sentences.english: Manager San looked at David and tried to persuade him to stay and work at the hospital.

sentences.chinese: 三经理说：“你可以在这里工作，不用请假。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān jīnglǐ shuō: “Nǐ kěyǐ zài zhèlǐ gōngzuò, bùyòng qǐngjià.”
sentences.english: Manager San said, "You can work here, no need to request leave."

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着桌子上的这些东西：一张车票，一张门票，还有一本书。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe zhuōzi shàng de zhèxiē dōngxi: yī zhāng chēpiào, yī zhāng ménpiào, hái yǒu yī běn shū.
sentences.english: David looked at these things on the table: a bus ticket, a theater ticket, and a book.

sentences.chinese: 他翻开书的第一页，发现里面有一把钥匙！
sentences.pinyin: Tā fān kāi shū de dì yī yè, fāxiàn lǐmiàn yǒu yī bǎ yàoshi!
sentences.english: He flipped to the first page of the book and found a key inside!

sentences.chinese: 大卫大喊：“这儿！钥匙在这儿！”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi dà hǎn: “Zhèr! Yàoshi zài zhèr!”
sentences.english: David shouted, "Here! The keys are here!"

sentences.chinese: 他赶紧把钥匙拿走，觉得这本书非常有用。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎnjǐn bǎ yàoshi ná zǒu, juéde zhè běn shū fēicháng yǒuyòng.
sentences.english: He quickly took the keys and felt that this book was very useful.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个朋友走进来，看着大卫说：“你为什么在那儿？”
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yīgè péngyou zǒu jìnlái, kànzhe Dàwèi shuō: “Nǐ wèishéme zài nàr?”
sentences.english: At this moment, a friend walked in, looked at David and said, "Why are you over there?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫指着里边，说：“我刚才在这里找东西。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi zhǐzhe lǐbian, shuō: “Wǒ gāngcái zài zhèlǐ zhǎo dōngxi.”
sentences.english: David pointed inside and said, "I was looking for something here just now."

sentences.chinese: 他的朋友看着他，又看着窗外，惊讶地大喊。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de péngyou kànzhe tā, yòu kànzhe chuāngwài, jīngyà de dà hǎn.
sentences.english: His friend looked at him, then looked out the window, and shouted in surprise.

sentences.chinese: 窗外，另外两个大卫正试图进去医院。
sentences.pinyin: Chuāngwài, lìngwài liǎng gè Dàwèi zhèng shìtú jìnqù yīyuàn.
sentences.english: Outside the window, the other two Davids were trying to go into the hospital.

sentences.chinese: 大卫赶紧跑向车上，他不想再看到那些“自己”了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi gǎnjǐn pǎo xiàng chē shàng, tā bù xiǎng zài kàndào nàxiē “zìjǐ” le.
sentences.english: David quickly ran to the car; he didn't want to see those "selves" again.

sentences.chinese: 但他突然发现，他的车票不见了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tā tūrán fāxiàn, tā de chēpiào bùjiàn le.
sentences.english: But he suddenly discovered that his ticket was gone.

sentences.chinese: 这时，另一个大卫敲了敲车窗，笑着问：“你的票在我这儿吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, lìng yīgè Dàwèi qiāo le qiāo chē chuāng, xiàozhe wèn: “Nǐ de piào zài wǒ zhèr ma?”
sentences.english: At that moment, another David knocked on the car window and asked with a smile, "Is your ticket here with me?"

chapters.title_chinese: 第十三章：大卫的“学校”大冒险

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着那个拿着票的“自己”，感到非常绝望。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe nàge názhe piào de “zìjǐ”, gǎndào fēicháng juéwàng.
sentences.english: David looked at the "self" holding the ticket and felt completely desperate.

sentences.chinese: 那个大卫笑着说：“你想拿回票吗？跟我去那个学校吧！”
sentences.pinyin: Nàge Dàwèi xiàozhe shuō: “Nǐ xiǎng ná huí piào ma? Gēn wǒ qù nàge xuéxiào ba!”
sentences.english: That David smiled and said, "Do you want your ticket back? Follow me to that school!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫没有选择，只能跟着他走。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi méiyǒu xuǎnzé, zhǐnéng gēnzhe tā zǒu.
sentences.english: David had no choice but to follow him.

sentences.chinese: 他们来到了一所奇怪的学校。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen láidào le yī suǒ qíguài de xuéxiào.
sentences.english: They arrived at a strange school.

sentences.chinese: 这里有小学，也有中学。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ yǒu xiǎoxué, yěyǒu zhōngxué.
sentences.english: There was an elementary school and a middle school here.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看到很多小学生在跑，他们看起来像个调皮的小朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kàndào hěnduō xiǎoxuéshēng zài pǎo, tāmen kàn qǐlái xiàng gè tiáopí de xiǎo péngyǒu.
sentences.english: David saw many primary school students running; they looked like naughty children.

sentences.chinese: 一个中学生背着巨大的书包，差点撞到大卫。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè zhōngxuéshēng bēizhe jùdà de shūbāo, chàdiǎn zhuàng dào Dàwèi.
sentences.english: A middle-school student carrying a huge schoolbag almost bumped into David.

sentences.chinese: 大卫问：“这里是什么地方？是大学吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi wèn: “Zhèlǐ shì shénme dìfāng? Shì dàxué ma?”
sentences.english: David asked, "What place is this? Is it a university?"

sentences.chinese: 另一个大卫回答：“不，这是一个特殊的学院，专门教怎么变成医生。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìng yī gè Dàwèi huídá: “Bù, zhè shì yī gè tèshū de xuéyuàn, zhuānmén jiāo zěnme biànchéng yīshēng.”
sentences.english: The other David answered, "No, this is a special college, specifically teaching how to become a doctor."

sentences.chinese: 他们走进教学楼，里面非常安静。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒujìn jiàoxuélóu, lǐmiàn fēicháng ānjìng.
sentences.english: They walked into the teaching block; it was very quiet inside.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看到一个男生在用电脑，他看起来像个大学生。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kàndào yī gè nánshēng zài yòng diànnǎo, tā kàn qǐlái xiàng gè dàxuéshēng.
sentences.english: David saw a boy using a computer; he looked like a university student.

sentences.chinese: 一个女生在读课本，她的课文非常长。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè nǚshēng zài dú kèběn, tā de kèwén fēicháng cháng.
sentences.english: A girl was reading a textbook; her lesson text was very long.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个老师走过来，严肃地看着大卫。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, yī gè lǎoshī zǒu guòlái, yánsù de kànzhe Dàwèi.
sentences.english: At that moment, a teacher walked over and looked at David sternly.

sentences.chinese: 老师问：“你是哪个班的学生？你的课在哪个房间？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī wèn: “Nǐ shì nǎge bān de xuéshēng? Nǐ de kè zài nǎge fángjiān?”
sentences.english: The teacher asked, "Which class's student are you? Which room is your class in?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫紧张地说：“我不是学生，我是个先生！”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi jǐnzhāng de shuō: “Wǒ bùshì xuéshēng, wǒ shì gè xiānsheng!”
sentences.english: David said nervously, "I am not a student, I am a gentleman!"

sentences.chinese: 老师大笑起来，说：“在这里，每个人都要学习。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī dàxiào qǐlái, shuō: “Zài zhèlǐ, měi gèrén dōu yào xuéxí.”
sentences.english: The teacher burst out laughing and said, "Here, everyone must study."

sentences.chinese: 他带着大卫走进图书馆，那里有很多书。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàizhe Dàwèi zǒujìn túshūguǎn, nàlǐ yǒu hěnduō shū.
sentences.english: He led David into the library, where there were many books.

sentences.chinese: 大卫想：“如果我去书店买书，是不是就不用在这里学习了？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎng: “Rúguǒ wǒ qù shūdiàn mǎi shū, shì bù shì jiù bùyòng zài zhèlǐ xuéxí le?”
sentences.english: David thought, "If I go to the bookstore to buy books, would I not have to study here?"

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个同学跑过来，大喊：“放学了！放学了！”
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, yī gè tóngxué pǎo guòlái, dàhǎn: “Fàngxué le! Fàngxué le!”
sentences.english: Just then, a classmate ran over and shouted, "School is over! School is over!"

sentences.chinese: 所有的孩子都高兴地跑出了房间。
sentences.pinyin: Suǒyǒu de háizi dōu gāoxìng de pǎo chū le fángjiān.
sentences.english: All the children happily ran out of the room.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着那个拿着票的“自己”，突然发现他的书包里有东西。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe nàge názhe piào de “zìjǐ”, tūrán fāxiàn tā de shūbāo lǐ yǒu dōngxī.
sentences.english: David looked at the "self" holding the ticket and suddenly noticed there was something in his schoolbag.

sentences.chinese: 大卫赶紧打开书包，发现里面没有票，而是一本关于怎么做医生的课本。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi gǎnjǐn dǎkāi shūbāo, fāxiàn lǐmiàn méiyǒu piào, ér shì yī běn guānyú zěnme zuò yīshēng de kèběn.
sentences.english: David quickly opened the schoolbag and found there was no ticket, but a textbook about how to be a doctor.

sentences.chinese: 大卫绝望地大喊：“我的票在哪里！”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéwàng de dàhǎn: “Wǒ de piào zài nǎlǐ!”
sentences.english: David shouted desperately, "Where is my ticket!"

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，窗外出现了第四个大卫。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhèshí, chuāngwài chūxiàn le dì sì gè Dàwèi.
sentences.english: Right then, a fourth David appeared outside the window.

sentences.chinese: 第四个大卫手里拿着票，对着他眨了眨眼。
sentences.pinyin: Dì sì gè Dàwèi shǒu lǐ názhe piào, duìzhe tā zhǎ le zhǎ yǎn.
sentences.english: The fourth David was holding the ticket and winked at him.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十四章：大卫的方位大混乱

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着第四个大卫，觉得这个地方太奇怪了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe dì sì gè Dàwèi, juéde zhège dìfāng tài qíguài le.
sentences.english: David looked at the fourth David and felt this place was too strange.

sentences.chinese: 第四个大卫一边笑，一边把票放在车顶上边。
sentences.pinyin: Dì sì gè Dàwèi yībiān xiào, yībiān bǎ piào fàng zài chē dǐng shàngbian.
sentences.english: The fourth David laughed while placing the ticket on top of the car.

sentences.chinese: 大卫赶紧跳起来，但他的脚踩在了下边的一个东西上。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi gǎnjǐn tiào qǐlái, dàn tā de jiǎo cǎizàile xiàbian de yīgè dōngxī shàng.
sentences.english: David quickly jumped up, but his foot stepped on something below.

sentences.chinese: 他失去平衡，直接撞在了第四个大卫的旁边。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shīqù pínghéng, zhíjiē zhuàngzàile dì sì gè Dàwèi de pángbiān.
sentences.english: He lost his balance and crashed right next to the fourth David.

sentences.chinese: 第四个大卫指着东边说：“你的车在东边！”
sentences.pinyin: Dì sì gè Dàwèi zhǐzhe dōngbiān shuō: “Nǐ de chē zài dōngbiān!”
sentences.english: The fourth David pointed east and said, "Your car is to the east!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着中间的街道，感到非常困惑。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe zhōngjiān de jiēdào, gǎndào fēicháng kùnhuò.
sentences.english: David looked at the street in the middle and felt very confused.

sentences.chinese: 前边有一个路口，北边是医院，南边是公园。
sentences.pinyin: Qiánbian yǒu yīgè lùkǒu, běibiān shì yīyuàn, nánbiān shì gōngyuán.
sentences.english: There was an intersection in front; the hospital was to the north, and the park was to the south.

sentences.chinese: 大卫问：“我的车在哪个方向？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi wèn: “Wǒ de chē zài nǎge fāngxiàng?”
sentences.english: David asked, "Which direction is my car in?"

sentences.chinese: 第四个大卫指着右边，然后又指着左边。
sentences.pinyin: Dì sì gè Dàwèi zhǐzhe yòubiān, ránhòu yòu zhǐzhe zuǒbiān.
sentences.english: The fourth David pointed to the right, and then pointed to the left.

sentences.chinese: 他大喊：“在右边！不对，在左边！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàhǎn: “Zài yòubiān! Bùduì, zài zuǒbiān!”
sentences.english: He shouted, "On the right! No, on the left!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫绝望地看着右边，发现那里只有一棵树。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéwàng de kànzhe yòubiān, fāxiàn nàlǐ zhǐyǒu yī kē shù.
sentences.english: David looked desperately to the right and found there was only a tree.

sentences.chinese: 他看向后边，发现另外两个大卫正在跑过来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng hòubian, fāxiàn lìngwài liǎng gè Dàwèi zhèngzài pǎo guòlái.
sentences.english: He looked behind him and found the other two Davids were running over.

sentences.chinese: 一个大卫说：“我从国外回来，我记得车在西边！”
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè Dàwèi shuō: “Wǒ cóng guówài huílái, wǒ jìde chē zài xībiān!”
sentences.english: One David said, "I came back from abroad; I remember the car is to the west!"

sentences.chinese: 另一个大卫说：“不对，在西边那个地方有个商店。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìng yīgè Dàwèi shuō: “Bùduì, zài xībiān nàge dìfāng yǒu gè shāngdiàn.”
sentences.english: Another David said, "No, there is a shop in that place to the west."

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着外边的混乱，觉得自己的头要炸了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe wàibiān de hùnluàn, juéde zìjǐ de tóu yào zhà le.
sentences.english: David looked at the chaos outside and felt his head was about to explode.

sentences.chinese: 他大喊：“外边有四个我，谁才是真的？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàhǎn: “Wàibiān yǒu sì gè wǒ, shuí cáishì zhēn de?”
sentences.english: He shouted, "There are four of me outside, who is the real one?"

sentences.chinese: 现在，四个大卫站在路口，像一个奇怪的圆圈。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài, sì gè Dàwèi zhàn zài lùkǒu, xiàng yīgè qíguài de yuánquān.
sentences.english: Now, four Davids stood at the intersection, like a strange circle.

sentences.chinese: 一个在大卫的左边，一个在右边，两个在中间。
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè zài Dàwèi de zuǒbiān, yīgè zài yòu biān, liǎng gè zài zhōngjiān.
sentences.english: One was to David's left, one to the right, and two in the middle.

sentences.chinese: 大卫决定离开这边，往那边走走。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juédìng líkāi zhèbiān, wǎng nàbiān zǒu zǒu.
sentences.english: David decided to leave this side and walk toward that side.

sentences.chinese: 他走在路上，试图思考怎么回家。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu zài lùshàng, shìtú sīkǎo zěnme huí jiā.
sentences.english: He walked on the road, trying to think about how to get home.

sentences.chinese: 他记得他的家在城市的西边，靠近那个大公园。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde tā de jiā zài chéngshì de xībiān, kàojìn nàge dà gōngyuán.
sentences.english: He remembered his home was on the west side of the city, near that big park.

sentences.chinese: 他看向天空，发现太阳在西边落下。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng tiānkōng, fāxiàn tàiyáng zài xībiān luòxià.
sentences.english: He looked at the sky and found the sun setting in the west.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他发现一个大卫在他的后边悄悄走过来。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, tā fāxiàn yīgè Dàwèi zài tā de hòubian qiāoqiāo zǒu guòlái.
sentences.english: Suddenly, he noticed a David quietly walking up behind him.

sentences.chinese: 那个大卫在他耳边说：“你的票其实在我的口袋里。”
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè Dàwèi zài tā ěrbiān shuō: “Nǐ de piào qíshí zài wǒ de kǒudài lǐ.”
sentences.english: That David whispered in his ear, "Your ticket is actually in my pocket."

chapters.title_chinese: 第十五章：谁才是我的兄弟？

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着这个大卫，觉得他很二。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe zhège Dàwèi, juéde tā hěn èr.
sentences.english: David looked at this David and thought he was quite stupid.

sentences.chinese: 他大喊：“你干什么！快给我票！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàhǎn: “Nǐ gàn shénme! Kuài gěi wǒ piào!”
sentences.english: He shouted, "What are you doing! Give me the ticket quickly!"

sentences.chinese: 那个大卫笑着说：“你想知道票在哪里吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Nàge Dàwèi xiàozhe shuō: “Nǐ xiǎng zhīdào piào zài nǎlǐ ma?”
sentences.english: That David smiled and said, "Do you want to know where the ticket is?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫很生气，问他：“你怎么在这里？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi hěn shēngqì, wèn tā: “Nǐ zěnme zài zhèlǐ?”
sentences.english: David was very angry and asked him, "How are you here?"

sentences.chinese: 那个大卫指了指天空，说：“我知道你没票，所以我想给你一点帮助。”
sentences.pinyin: Nàge Dàwèi zhǐle zhǐ tiānkōng, shuō: “Wǒ zhīdào nǐ méi piào, suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng gěi nǐ yīdiǎn bāngzhù.”
sentences.english: That David pointed to the sky and said, "I know you don't have a ticket, so I want to give you some help."

sentences.chinese: 大卫问：“你是谁？你是我的哪个兄弟？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi wèn: “Nǐ shì shéi? Nǐ shì wǒ de nǎge xiōngdì?”
sentences.english: David asked, "Who are you? Which brother of mine are you?"

sentences.chinese: 那个大卫从口袋里拿出一本汉语书。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge Dàwèi cóng kǒudài lǐ ná chū yī běn Hànyǔ shū.
sentences.english: That David took a Chinese book out of his pocket.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你看，这本书告诉我，学习汉语很重要。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ kàn, zhè běn shū gàosù wǒ, xuéxí Hànyǔ hěn zhòngyào.”
sentences.english: He said, "Look, this book tells me that learning Chinese is very important."

sentences.chinese: 大卫愣住了，他问：“这跟我的票有什么关系？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi lèng zhù le, tā wèn: “Zhè gēn wǒ de piào yǒu shénme guānxì?”
sentences.english: David was stunned and asked, "What does this have to do with my ticket?"

sentences.chinese: 那个大卫说：“我是一个来自日比鲁的小孩儿，我喜欢读这些书。”
sentences.pinyin: Nàge Dàwèi shuō: “Wǒ shì yī gè láizì Rì Bǐ lǔ de xiǎoháir, wǒ xǐhuān dú zhèxiē shū.”
sentences.english: That David said, "I am a child from Ri-Bi-lu, and I like reading these books."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这个大卫太奇怪了，他问：“你到底在说什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéde zhège Dàwèi tài qíguài le, tā wèn: “Nǐ dàodǐ zài shuō shénme?”
sentences.english: David thought this David was too strange and asked, "What on earth are you talking about?"

sentences.chinese: 这时，旁边走过来一个女孩儿和一个妹妹。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, pángbiān zǒu guòlái yī gè nǚháir hé yī gè mèimei.
sentences.english: At this moment, a girl and a younger sister walked over.

sentences.chinese: 那个女孩儿看着大卫，问：“这些大卫里，哪些才是真正的医生？”
sentences.pinyin: Nàge nǚháir kànzhe Dàwèi, wèn: “Zhèxiē Dàwèi lǐ, nǎxiē cáishì zhēnzhèng de yīshēng?”
sentences.english: The girl looked at David and asked, "Among these Davids, which ones are the real doctors?"

sentences.chinese: 妹妹看着他们，笑了起来，像个可爱的小孩儿。
sentences.pinyin: Mèimei kànzhe tāmen, xiào le qǐlái, xiàng gè kě'ài de xiǎoháir.
sentences.english: The younger sister looked at them and laughed, like a cute child.

sentences.chinese: 大卫绝望地说：“我也不知道我在哪儿！”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéwàng de shuō: “Wǒ yě bù zhīdào wǒ zài nǎ'er!”
sentences.english: David said despairingly, "I don't even know where I am!"

sentences.chinese: 他想，我最好现在就离开这里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, wǒ zuìhǎo xiànzài jiù líkāi zhèlǐ.
sentences.english: He thought, I had better leave this place right now.

sentences.chinese: 他问那个女孩儿：“你知道我的家在哪里吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn nàge nǚháir: “Nǐ zhīdào wǒ de jiā zài nǎlǐ ma?”
sentences.english: He asked the girl, "Do you know where my home is?"

sentences.chinese: 女孩儿指了指方向，说：“在那边，但是你没有车。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚháir zhǐle zhǐ fāngxiàng, shuō: “Zài nàbiān, dànshì nǐ méiyǒu chē.”
sentences.english: The girl pointed in a direction and said, "Over there, but you don't have a car."

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着自己的口袋，里面只有零钱。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe zìjǐ de kǒudài, lǐmiàn zhǐyǒu língqián.
sentences.english: David looked into his pocket; there was only some loose change.

sentences.chinese: 他心想：我现在的钱是零，我怎么回家？
sentences.pinyin: Tā xīnxiǎng: Wǒ xiànzài de qián shì líng, wǒ zěnme huí jiā?
sentences.english: He thought: My money right now is zero, how can I go home?

sentences.chinese: 突然，另一个大卫走过来，像个大哥一样拍拍他的肩膀。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, lìng yī gè Dàwèi zǒu guòlái, xiàng gè dàgē yīyàng pāipāi tā de jiānbǎng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, another David walked over and patted his shoulder like an older brother.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“别担心，我可以给你开车。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Bié dānxīn, wǒ kěyǐ gěi nǐ kāichē.”
sentences.english: He said, "Don't worry, I can drive for you."

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着这五个长得一样的人，觉得世界太疯狂了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe zhè wǔ gè zhǎng de yīyàng de rén, juéde shìjiè tài fēngkuáng le.
sentences.english: David looked at these five people who looked exactly the same and felt the world was too crazy.

sentences.chinese: 他突然发现，那个大卫手里拿着一张奇怪的地图。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán fāxiàn, nàge Dàwèi shǒu lǐ názhe yī zhāng qíguài de dìtú.
sentences.english: He suddenly noticed that the David was holding a strange map.

sentences.chinese: 地图上写着：真正的票在医院的地下室里。
sentences.pinyin: Dìtú shàng xiězhe: Zhēnzhèng de piào zài yīyuàn de dìxiàshì lǐ.
sentences.english: The map read: The real ticket is in the hospital basement.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十六章：地下室的迷宫

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着地图，觉得这个地下室像个迷宫。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe dìtú, juéde zhège dìxiàshì xiàng gè mígōng.
sentences.english: David looked at the map and felt that this basement was like a maze.

sentences.chinese: 他跟另外四个大卫一块儿走进了地下室。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gēn lìngwài sì gè Dàwèi yīkuàir zǒu jìnle dìxiàshì.
sentences.english: He walked into the basement together with the other four Davids.

sentences.chinese: 走了一半，大卫发现这里太慢了，因为大家都长得一样，走来走去像在跳舞。
sentences.pinyin: Zǒule yībàn, Dàwèi fāxiàn zhèlǐ tài mànle, yīnwèi dàjiā dōu zhǎng de yīyàng, zǒu lái zǒu qù xiàng zài tiàowǔ.
sentences.english: Halfway through, David found that it was too slow here, because everyone looked the same, and walking back and forth was like dancing.

sentences.chinese: 一个大卫说：“你记得上次我们来这里吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè Dàwèi shuō: “Nǐ jìde shàngcì wǒmen lái zhèlǐ ma?”
sentences.english: One David said, "Do you remember last time we came here?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫愣住了：“上次？我没来过这里！”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi lèngzhùle: “Shàngcì? Wǒ méi láiguò zhèlǐ!”
sentences.english: David was stunned: "Last time? I have never been here!"

sentences.chinese: 另一个大卫笑了，他说：“去年我也没来过，但今年我来了三次。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìng yīgè Dàwèi xiàole, tā shuō: “Qùnián wǒ yě méi láiguò, dàn jīnnián wǒ láile sāncì.”
sentences.english: Another David smiled and said, "I didn't come here last year either, but this year I've been here three times."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这太好玩儿了，虽然他现在很害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéde zhè tài hǎowánr le, suīrán tā xiànzài hěn hàipà.
sentences.english: David thought this was very fun, although he was very scared right now.

sentences.chinese: 他们在这个地下室里找了半天，终于看到一个奇怪的门。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zài zhège dìxiàshì lǐ zhǎole bàntiān, zhōngyú kàndào yīgè qíguài de mén.
sentences.english: They searched in this basement for a long time and finally saw a strange door.

sentences.chinese: 门上写着：“明年见”。
sentences.pinyin: Mén shàng xiězhe: “Míngnián jiàn”.
sentences.english: On the door it said: "See you next year".

sentences.chinese: 大卫问：“为什么现在写明年？现在是正月初一吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi wèn: “Wèishéme xiànzài xiě míngnián? Xiànzài shì zhēngyuè chūyī ma?”
sentences.english: David asked, "Why does it say next year now? Is it the first day of the first lunar month?"

sentences.chinese: 那个像哥哥的大卫说：“有时候，这里的门会说话。”
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè xiàng gēge de Dàwèi shuō: “Yǒu shíhou, zhèlǐ de mén huì shuōhuà.”
sentences.english: The David who acted like an older brother said, "Sometimes, the doors here can talk."

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着他，心想：这个医生真的是我的哥哥吗？
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe tā, xīnxiǎng: Zhège yīshēng zhēn de shì wǒ de gēge ma?
sentences.english: David looked at him and thought: Is this doctor really my older brother?

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个穿着白衣服的男孩儿走过来。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, yīgè chuānzhe bái yīfú de nánháir zǒu guòlái.
sentences.english: At this moment, a boy wearing white clothes walked over.

sentences.chinese: 他手里拿着一碗面条儿，看起来很好吃。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shǒu lǐ názhe yī wǎn miàntiáor, kàn qǐlái hěn hǎochī.
sentences.english: He was holding a bowl of noodles, which looked delicious.

sentences.chinese: 男孩儿说：“你们找票吗？票在我的口袋里。”
sentences.pinyin: Nánháir shuō: “Nǐmen zhǎo piào ma? Piào zài wǒ de kǒudài lǐ.”
sentences.english: The boy said, "Are you looking for the ticket? The ticket is in my pocket."

sentences.chinese: 大卫赶紧说：“谢谢你！”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi gǎnjǐn shuō: “Xièxiè nǐ!”
sentences.english: David quickly said, "Thank you!"

sentences.chinese: 男孩儿笑着说：“不客气。”
sentences.pinyin: Nánháir xiàozhe shuō: “Bù kèqi.”
sentences.english: The boy smiled and said, "You're welcome."

sentences.chinese: 大卫问：“你在这里住了多久？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi wèn: “Nǐ zài zhèlǐ zhùle duōjiǔ?”
sentences.english: David asked, "How long have you lived here?"

sentences.chinese: 男孩儿说：“我在这里住了半年，我在这儿等我的姐和弟。”
sentences.pinyin: Nánháir shuō: “Wǒ zài zhèlǐ zhùle bànnián, wǒ zài zhèr děng wǒ de jiě hé dì.”
sentences.english: The boy said, "I have lived here for half a year; I am here waiting for my older sister and younger brother."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这个地下室越来越奇怪了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéde zhège dìxiàshì yuè lái yuè qíguài le.
sentences.english: David felt that this basement was becoming more and more strange.

sentences.chinese: 他想起去年新年的时候，他在中国旅游，也没见过这么奇怪的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ qùnián xīnnián de shíhou, tā zài Zhōngguó lǚyóu, yě méi jiànguò zhème qíguài de dìfāng.
sentences.english: He remembered that during the New Year last year, when he was traveling in China, he had never seen such a strange place.

sentences.chinese: 他想，下次他绝对不进地下室。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, xiàcì tā juéduì bù jìn dìxiàshì.
sentences.english: He thought that next time he would absolutely not enter a basement.

sentences.chinese: 他看了看表，现在是三点半。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànle kàn biǎo, xiànzài shì sān diǎn bàn.
sentences.english: He checked his watch; it was three thirty.

sentences.chinese: 他突然听到后面有人在喊他的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán tīngdào hòumiàn yǒurén zài hǎn tā de míngzi.
sentences.english: He suddenly heard someone calling his name from behind.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十七章：地下室的数字游戏

sentences.chinese: 大卫慢慢转过身，看到一个大卫在前面走。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi mànman zhuǎn guò shēn, kàndào yī gè Dàwèi zài qiánmiàn zǒu.
sentences.english: David slowly turned around and saw a David walking in front.

sentences.chinese: 那是第六个大卫，他手里拿着一些奇怪的纸。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì dì liù gè Dàwèi, tā shǒu lǐ názhe yīxiē qíguài de zhǐ.
sentences.english: That was the sixth David, and he was holding some strange papers.

sentences.chinese: 大卫问：“你在这里做什么事？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi wèn: “Nǐ zài zhèlǐ zuò shénme shì?”
sentences.english: David asked, "What matter are you dealing with here?"

sentences.chinese: 第六个大卫笑了，他说：“我们要一起玩一个游戏。”
sentences.pinyin: Dì liù gè Dàwèi xiàole, tā shuō: “Wǒmen yào yīqǐ wán yī gè yóuxì.”
sentences.english: The sixth David smiled and said, "We are going to play a game together."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这个地点太奇怪了，他想赶紧离开。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juédé zhège dìdiǎn tài qíguài le, tā xiǎng gǎnjǐn líkāi.
sentences.english: David felt this location was too strange and wanted to leave quickly.

sentences.chinese: 第六个大卫说：“先看地上，那里有很多数字。”
sentences.pinyin: Dì liù gè Dàwèi shuō: “Xiān kàn dìshang, nàlǐ yǒu hěnduō shùzì.”
sentences.english: The sixth David said, "First look on the ground, there are many numbers there."

sentences.chinese: 大卫低头看，地上写着一，二，三，四，五。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi dītóu kàn, dìshang xiězhe yī, èr, sān, sì, wǔ.
sentences.english: David looked down, and written on the ground were one, two, three, four, five.

sentences.chinese: 然后是六，七，八，九，十。
sentences.pinyin: Ránhòu shì liù, qī, bā, jiǔ, shí.
sentences.english: Then came six, seven, eight, nine, ten.

sentences.chinese: 大卫问：“这些数字是什么意思？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi wèn: “Zhèxiē shùzì shì shénme yìsi?”
sentences.english: David asked, "What do these numbers mean?"

sentences.chinese: 第六个大卫说：“如果你能猜对我的号，我就给你票。”
sentences.pinyin: Dì liù gè Dàwèi shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ néng cāiduì wǒ de hào, wǒ jiù gěi nǐ piào.”
sentences.english: The sixth David said, "If you can guess my number, I will give you the ticket."

sentences.chinese: 大卫想，这简直像是在另一个国家一样疯狂。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎng, zhè jiǎnzhí xiàng shì zài lìng yī gè guójiā yīyàng fēngkuáng.
sentences.english: David thought this was as crazy as being in another country.

sentences.chinese: 他问：“这里有多少个大卫？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn: “Zhèlǐ yǒu duōshǎo gè Dàwèi?”
sentences.english: He asked, "How many Davids are here?"

sentences.chinese: 第六个大卫回答：“现在有六个，但一会儿可能会有更多的人。”
sentences.pinyin: Dì liù gè Dàwèi huídá: “Xiànzài yǒu liù gè, dàn yīhuìr kěnéng huì yǒu gèng duō de rén.”
sentences.english: The sixth David answered, "There are six now, but in a moment there might be more people."

sentences.chinese: 大卫绝望了，他大喊一声：“我不要玩游戏，我要回家！”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéwàng le, tā dà hǎn yīshēng: “Wǒ bùyào wán yóuxì, wǒ yào huíjiā!”
sentences.english: David was desperate and shouted, "I don't want to play games, I want to go home!"

sentences.chinese: 这时，两个大卫从后面跑过来，他们手里拿着商店的购物袋。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, liǎng gè Dàwèi cóng hòumiàn pǎo guòlái, tāmen shǒu lǐ názhe shāngdiàn de gòuwù dài.
sentences.english: At that moment, two Davids ran over from behind, holding shopping bags from a store.

sentences.chinese: 其中一个大卫说：“你看，我们在商场买到了别的衣服！”
sentences.pinyin: Qízhōng yī gè Dàwèi shuō: “Nǐ kàn, wǒmen zài shāngchǎng mǎidào le bié de yīfú!”
sentences.english: One of the Davids said, "Look, we bought other clothes at the shopping mall!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着他们，觉得别人都比他聪明。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe tāmen, juédé biérén dōu bǐ tā cōngmíng.
sentences.english: David looked at them and felt that other people were smarter than him.

sentences.chinese: 他想，也许他应该去别的商店买个大脑。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, yěxǔ tā yīnggāi qù bié de shāngdiàn mǎi gè dànǎo.
sentences.english: He thought maybe he should go to another store and buy a brain.

sentences.chinese: 第六个大卫指着前面说：“票在那个盒子里。”
sentences.pinyin: Dì liù gè Dàwèi zhǐzhe qiánmiàn shuō: “Piào zài nàgè hézi lǐ.”
sentences.english: The sixth David pointed ahead and said, "The ticket is in that box."

sentences.chinese: 大卫跑过去，但盒子是空的。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi pǎo guòqù, dàn hézi shì kōng de.
sentences.english: David ran over, but the box was empty.

sentences.chinese: 他气得大叫，声音像是在号叫一样响亮。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qì de dà jiào, shēngyīn xiàng shì zài hào jiào yīyàng xiǎngliàng.
sentences.english: He was so angry that he screamed, his voice as loud as a roar.

sentences.chinese: 他对着第六个大卫说：“再见！我再也不想见到你们！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā duìzhe dì liù gè Dàwèi shuō: “Zàijiàn! Wǒ zài yě bù xiǎng jiàndào nǐmen!”
sentences.english: He said to the sixth David, "Goodbye! I never want to see you all again!"

sentences.chinese: 但就在他转身离开的时候，他发现天黑了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài tā zhuǎnshēn líkāi de shíhòu, tā fāxiàn tiān hēi le.
sentences.english: But just as he turned to leave, he noticed the sky had turned dark.

sentences.chinese: 他突然看到地下室的墙上写着：真正的票在七号房间。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán kàndào dìxiàshì de qiáng shàng xiězhe: Zhēnzhèng de piào zài qī hào fángjiān.
sentences.english: He suddenly saw written on the basement wall: The real ticket is in Room 7.

sentences.chinese: 大卫愣住了，他现在面对的是一个巨大的迷宫。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi lèng zhù le, tā xiànzài miànduì de shì yī gè jùdà de mígōng.
sentences.english: David was stunned; he was now facing a giant maze.

sentences.chinese: 他不知道在接下来的几天里，还会出现多少个自己。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zhīdào zài jiē xiàlái de jǐ tiān lǐ, hái huì chūxiàn duōshǎo gè zìjǐ.
sentences.english: He didn't know how many more versions of himself would appear in the coming days.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十八章：七号房间的秘密
chapters.title_english: Chapter 18: The Secret of Room Seven

sentences.chinese: 大卫快快地跑向七号房间。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kuài kuài de pǎo xiàng qī hào fángjiān.
sentences.english: David ran quickly toward Room Seven.

sentences.chinese: 他想：我必须快点找到那张票！
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng: wǒ bìxū kuài diǎn zhǎodào nà zhāng piào!
sentences.english: He thought: I must find that ticket quickly!

sentences.chinese: 当他打开门的时候，他看到了一个奇怪的场景。
sentences.pinyin: Dāng tā dǎkāi mén de shíhou, tā kàndào le yī gè qíguài de chǎngjǐng.
sentences.english: When he opened the door, he saw a strange scene.

sentences.chinese: 房间里有三个女人。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ yǒu sān gè nǚrén.
sentences.english: There were three women in the room.

sentences.chinese: 她们在看一本很大的书。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zài kàn yī běn hěn dà de shū.
sentences.english: They were looking at a very large book.

sentences.chinese: 其中一个是他的妈妈。
sentences.pinyin: Qízhōng yī gè shì tā de māma.
sentences.english: One of them was his mother.

sentences.chinese: 他的妈妈看着他，大声喊道：“我的儿子！你怎么在这里？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā de māma kànzhe tā, dàshēng hǎndào: “Wǒ de érzi! Nǐ zěnme zài zhèlǐ?”
sentences.english: His mother looked at him and shouted loudly, "My son! Why are you here?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫愣住了，他想：“我的妈，为什么妈妈在地下室？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi lèng zhù le, tā xiǎng: “Wǒ de mā, wèishéme māma zài dìxiàshì?”
sentences.english: David was stunned, thinking: "My goodness (my ma), why is mom in the basement?"

sentences.chinese: 另外两个女孩子在笑。
sentences.pinyin: Lìngwài liǎng gè nǚ háizi zài xiào.
sentences.english: Two other girls were laughing.

sentences.chinese: 有的在喝水，有的在看手机。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu de zài hē shuǐ, yǒu de zài kàn shǒujī.
sentences.english: Some were drinking water, and some were looking at their cell phones.

sentences.chinese: 大卫问：“你们是谁？你们在做什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi wèn: “Nǐmen shì shuí? Nǐmen zài zuò shénme?”
sentences.english: David asked, "Who are you? What are you doing?"

sentences.chinese: 一个女孩子说：“我们在学习汉字。”
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè nǚ háizi shuō: “Wǒmen zài xuéxí hànzì.”
sentences.english: One girl said, "We are studying Chinese characters."

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着桌子，那里有一些小小的字。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe zhuōzi, nàlǐ yǒu yīxiē xiǎo xiǎo de zì.
sentences.english: David looked at the table; there were some tiny characters there.

sentences.chinese: 这些汉字对他来说太难了，他完全看不懂这些字。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē hànzì duì tā lái shuō tài nán le, tā wánquán kàn bù dǒng zhèxiē zì.
sentences.english: These Chinese characters were too difficult for him; he couldn't understand these characters at all.

sentences.chinese: 这时候，他的爸爸也走进了房间。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shíhou, tā de bàba yě zǒu jìn le fángjiān.
sentences.english: At this moment, his father also walked into the room.

sentences.chinese: 他的爸爸拿着一个手机，看起来有些着急。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de bàba názhe yī gè shǒujī, kàn qǐlái yǒuxiē zhāojí.
sentences.english: His father was holding a cell phone and looked somewhat anxious.

sentences.chinese: 爸爸说：“大卫，现在是几点？我们没时间了！”
sentences.pinyin: Bàba shuō: “Dàwèi, xiànzài shì jǐ diǎn? Wǒmen méi shíjiān le!”
sentences.english: Dad said, "David, what time is it? We have no time!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫看了一眼表，现在是星期三，十月的一个早晨。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kàn le yīyǎn biǎo, xiànzài shì xīngqī sān, shíyuè de yī gè zǎo chén.
sentences.english: David glanced at his watch; it was Wednesday, an early morning in October.

sentences.chinese: 爸爸说：“快！你的机票在楼上，不在地下室！”
sentences.pinyin: Bàba shuō: “Kuài! Nǐ de jīpiào zài lóushàng, bù zài dìxiàshì!”
sentences.english: Dad said, "Quick! Your plane ticket is upstairs, not in the basement!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫大喊：“什么？那墙上的字是怎么回事？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi dà hǎn: “Shénme? Nà qiáng shàng de zì shì zěnme huí shì?”
sentences.english: David shouted, "What? Then what's with the characters on the wall?"

sentences.chinese: 爸爸笑了，说：“那是我的小儿子写的，他喜欢开玩笑。”
sentences.pinyin: Bàba xiào le, shuō: “Nà shì wǒ de xiǎo érzi xiě de, tā xǐhuān kāi wánxiào.”
sentences.english: Dad laughed and said, "That was written by my little son; he likes to play jokes."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这个家太疯狂了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéde zhège jiā tài fēngkuáng le.
sentences.english: David felt this family was too crazy.

sentences.chinese: 我们现在要去哪里？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiànzài yào qù nǎlǐ?
sentences.english: Where are we going now?

sentences.chinese: 爸爸指了指外面的汽车。
sentences.pinyin: Bàba zhǐ le zhǐ wàimiàn de qìchē.
sentences.english: Dad pointed to the car outside.

sentences.chinese: 大卫想，这一个月的经历简直像个笑话。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎng, zhè yī gè yuè de jīnglì jiǎnzhí xiàng gè xiàohua.
sentences.english: David thought the experiences of this past month were simply like a joke.

sentences.chinese: 他赶紧跑向楼上，希望能拿到机票离开这里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎnjǐn pǎo xiàng lóushàng, xīwàng néng nádào jīpiào líkāi zhèlǐ.
sentences.english: He hurried upstairs, hoping to get the plane ticket and leave this place.

sentences.chinese: 但就在他快要拿到票的时候，他听到楼下传来了另一个大卫的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài tā kuài yào nádào piào de shíhou, tā tīngdào lóuxià chuánlái le lìng yī gè Dàwèi de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: But just as he was about to get the ticket, he heard another David's voice coming from downstairs.

sentences.chinese: 那个声音在喊：“爸爸！我的票在哪里？”
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè shēngyīn zài hǎn: “Bàba! Wǒ de piào zài nǎlǐ?”
sentences.english: That voice was shouting, "Dad! Where is my ticket?"

chapters.title_chinese: 第十九章：最后的大混乱

sentences.chinese: 大卫在房间里停了下来，他的身体在发抖。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi zài fángjiān lǐ tíng le xiàlái, tā de shēntǐ zài fādǒu.
sentences.english: David stopped in the room, his body trembling.

sentences.chinese: 他看着手里那张票，心想：这终于结束了！
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe shǒulǐ nà zhāng piào, xīn xiǎng: zhè zhōngyú jiéshù le!
sentences.english: He looked at the ticket in his hand and thought: this is finally over!

sentences.chinese: 这时，他的电话响了，是一个网友打来的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, tā de diànhuà xiǎng le, shì yígè wǎngyǒu dǎ lái de.
sentences.english: At that moment, his phone rang; it was an online friend calling.

sentences.chinese: 网友在电话里说：“大卫，你在哪里？快来看电影！”
sentences.pinyin: Wǎngyǒu zài diànhuà lǐ shuō: “Dàwèi, nǐ zài nǎlǐ? Kuài lái kàn diànyǐng!”
sentences.english: The online friend said on the phone, "David, where are you? Come watch a movie quickly!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫大喊：“我现在没时间去电影院，我被五个我自己包围了！”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi dà hǎn: “Wǒ xiànzài méi shíjiān qù diànyǐngyuàn, wǒ bèi wǔ gè wǒ zìjǐ bāowéi le!”
sentences.english: David shouted, "I don't have time to go to the cinema right now, I'm surrounded by five of myself!"

sentences.chinese: 他走出房间，发现门口站着一个男人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒuchū fángjiān, fāxiàn ménkǒu zhànzhe yígè nánrén.
sentences.english: He walked out of the room and found a man standing at the doorway.

sentences.chinese: 那个男人手里拿着一个圆圆的球，像是在玩游戏。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè nánrén shǒulǐ názhe yígè yuányuán de qiú, xiàng shì zài wán yóuxì.
sentences.english: That man was holding a round ball in his hand, as if playing a game.

sentences.chinese: 男人笑着说：“你是第二个人发现这张票的吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén xiàozhe shuō: “Nǐ shì dì-èr gè fāxiàn zhè zhāng piào de ma?”
sentences.english: The man smiled and said, "Are you the second person to find this ticket?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫愣住了，他发现这个人的话非常奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi lèng zhù le, tā fāxiàn zhègè rén de huà fēicháng qíguài.
sentences.english: David froze; he found the man's words very strange.

sentences.chinese: 他想，这个人的知识一定有问题，怎么会在这里？
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, zhègè rén de zhīshi yídìng yǒu wèntí, zěnme huì zài zhèlǐ?
sentences.english: He thought, this person's knowledge must be problematic; why would he be here?

sentences.chinese: 大卫低头看，发现自己的钱包在身上，但里面没有钱。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi dītóu kàn, fāxiàn zìjǐ de qiánbāo zài shēnshang, dàn lǐmiàn méiyǒu qián.
sentences.english: David looked down and found his wallet on his person, but there was no money inside.

sentences.chinese: 他突然想起，他把钱给了那个喝茶的医生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán xiǎngqǐ, tā bǎ qián gěile nàgè hē chá de yīshēng.
sentences.english: He suddenly remembered that he gave the money to that tea-drinking doctor.

sentences.chinese: 他跑向窗边，窗外风很大，吹乱了他的头发。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pǎo xiàng chuāngbiān, chuāngwài fēng hěn dà, chuī luàn le tā de tóufa.
sentences.english: He ran to the window; the wind outside was strong, blowing his hair into a mess.

sentences.chinese: 他看着远方的车站，心想：那里才是我的救星。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe yuǎnfāng de chēzhàn, xīn xiǎng: nàlǐ cáishì wǒ de jiùxīng.
sentences.english: He looked at the distant station and thought: that place is my savior.

sentences.chinese: 他走出医院，在第一行车位看到了他的车。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒuchū yīyuàn, zài dì-yī háng chēwèi kàndào le tā de chē.
sentences.english: He walked out of the hospital and saw his car in the first row of parking spaces.

sentences.chinese: 他想起白天的时候，电视里在说这里的电有问题。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ báitiān de shíhou, diànshì lǐ zài shuō zhèlǐ de diàn yǒu wèntí.
sentences.english: He remembered that during the daytime, the TV was saying there were electricity problems here.

sentences.chinese: 果然，路灯突然灭了，一片漆黑。
sentences.pinyin: Guǒrán, lùdēng tūrán miè le, yípiàn chīhēi.
sentences.english: Sure enough, the streetlights suddenly went out, leaving everything in pitch black.

sentences.chinese: 大卫在黑暗中撞到了一个大卫，两人一起摔在地上。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi zài hēi'àn zhōng zhuàng dàole yígè Dàwèi, liǎng rén yìqǐ shuāi zài dìshàng.
sentences.english: David bumped into another David in the dark, and the two of them fell to the ground together.

sentences.chinese: 另一个大卫读了一个奇怪的句子，声音像是在唱歌。
sentences.pinyin: Lìng yígè Dàwèi dú le yígè qíguài de jùzi, shēngyīn xiàng shì zài chànggē.
sentences.english: Another David read a strange sentence, his voice sounding like he was singing.

sentences.chinese: 大卫赶紧说：“谢谢你帮我检查身体，但请你走开！”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi gǎnjǐn shuō: “Xièxie nǐ bāng wǒ jiǎnchá shēntǐ, dàn qǐng nǐ zǒukāi!”
sentences.english: David quickly said, "Thank you for checking my body, but please go away!"

sentences.chinese: 他发现自己和另一个大卫之间只有一间房的距离。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn zìjǐ hé lìng yígè Dàwèi zhījiān zhǐyǒu yì jiān fáng de jùlí.
sentences.english: He found that there was only the distance of one room between himself and the other David.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果我能像电影一样快进，我就能回家了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rúguǒ wǒ néng xiàng diànyǐng yíyàng kuàijìn, wǒ jiù néng huíjiā le.
sentences.english: He thought, if I could fast-forward like a movie, I could go home.

sentences.chinese: 他终于跑到了车站，大声地喊道：“我要回家！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhōngyú pǎodào le chēzhàn, dàshēng de hǎndào: “Wǒ yào huíjiā!”
sentences.english: He finally ran to the station and shouted loudly, "I want to go home!"

sentences.chinese: 这时候，所有的大卫都出现了，他们排成一排。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshíhou, suǒyǒu de Dàwèi dōu chūxiàn le, tāmen páichéng yì pái.
sentences.english: At this moment, all the Davids appeared, lining up in a row.

sentences.chinese: 他们一起说：“大卫，你的票其实在我们的钱包里。”
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen yìqǐ shuō: “Dàwèi, nǐ de piào qíshí zài wǒmen de qiánbāo lǐ.”
sentences.english: They said together, "David, your ticket is actually in our wallets."

sentences.chinese: 大卫绝望地看着天空，觉得这个世界太疯狂了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéwàng de kànzhe tiānkōng, juéde zhègè shìjiè tài fēngkuáng le.
sentences.english: David looked at the sky in despair, feeling that this world was too crazy.

sentences.chinese: 他闭上眼睛，希望这一切只是一个梦。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì shàng yǎnjīng, xīwàng zhè yíqiè zhǐshì yígè mèng.
sentences.english: He closed his eyes, hoping that all of this was just a dream.

books.description_chinese: 一个温暖的早晨，大明忘记买蛋糕了！他能找到手机并解决问题吗？用简单的词汇体验中国家庭的日常生活。

sentences.english: He taught Da Ming how to stir the milk and flour.

sentences.chinese: 大明发现，做蛋糕就像在做听写，需要很细心。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng fāxiàn, zuò dàngāo jiù xiàng zài zuò tīngxiě, xūyào hěn xìxīn.
sentences.english: Da Ming found that making a cake is like doing a dictation; it requires great care.

sentences.chinese: 两人一边做蛋糕，一边唱简单的歌。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng rén yībiān zuò dàngāo, yībiān chàng jiǎndān de gē.
sentences.english: While making the cake, the two of them sang simple songs.

sentences.chinese: 时间很快到了中午，他们准备吃饭。
sentences.pinyin: Shíjiān hěn kuài dào le zhōngwǔ, tāmen zhǔnbèi chīfàn.
sentences.english: Time quickly reached noon, and they prepared to have a meal.

sentences.chinese: 他们吃了一些水果，喝了新鲜的奶。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen chī le yīxiē shuǐguǒ, hē le xīnxiān de nǎi.
sentences.english: They ate some fruit and drank fresh milk.

sentences.chinese: 蛋糕在烤箱里，香味出来了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàngāo zài kǎoxiāng lǐ, xiāngwèi chūlái le.
sentences.english: The cake was in the oven, and the aroma came out.

sentences.chinese: 大明想，今天真是美好的一天。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xiǎng, jīntiān zhēnshì měihǎo de yītiān.
sentences.english: Da Ming thought today was truly a beautiful day.

sentences.chinese: 但突然，大明想起来一件事。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tūrán, Dàmíng xiǎngqǐ lái yī jiàn shì.
sentences.english: But suddenly, Da Ming remembered something.

sentences.chinese: 他回过头看，发现他的手机不见了！
sentences.pinyin: Tā huí guò tóu kàn, fāxiàn tā de shǒujī bù jiàn le!
sentences.english: He turned his head to look and found that his phone was gone!

sentences.chinese: 大明很惊讶，他的手机不见了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng hěn jīngyà, tā de shǒujī bùjiàn le.
sentences.english: Da Ming was very surprised; his phone was gone.

sentences.chinese: 他开始在房间里找手机。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kāishǐ zài fángjiān lǐ zhǎo shǒujī.
sentences.english: He started looking for the phone in the room.

sentences.chinese: 他想，手机在桌子上吗？
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, shǒujī zài zhuōzi shàng ma?
sentences.english: He thought, is the phone on the table?

sentences.chinese: 不在，桌子上只有一个小本子。
sentences.pinyin: Bù zài, zhuōzi shàng zhǐyǒu yī gè xiǎo běnzi.
sentences.english: No, there was only a small notebook on the table.

sentences.chinese: 大明很忙，他今天有很多工作。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng hěn máng, tā jīntiān yǒu hěnduō gōngzuò.
sentences.english: Da Ming was very busy; he had a lot of work today.

sentences.chinese: 他需要用手机给朋友打电话。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xūyào yòng shǒujī gěi péngyǒu dǎ diànhuà.
sentences.english: He needed to use the phone to call a friend.

sentences.chinese: 他走到厨房，看到他的朋友小王来到了这里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu dào chúfáng, kàndào tā de péngyǒu Xiǎo Wáng láidào le zhèlǐ.
sentences.english: He walked to the kitchen and saw his friend Xiao Wang had arrived.

sentences.chinese: 小王在洗手，因为他的手很脏。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng zài xǐshǒu, yīnwèi tā de shǒu hěn zāng.
sentences.english: Xiao Wang was washing his hands because his hands were dirty.

sentences.chinese: 大明问：“你在干什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng wèn: “Nǐ zài gàn shénme?”
sentences.english: Da Ming asked, "What are you doing?"

sentences.chinese: 小王笑着说：“我在洗手，准备吃蛋糕！”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng xiàozhe shuō: “Wǒ zài xǐshǒu, zhǔnbèi chī dàngāo!”
sentences.english: Xiao Wang smiled and said, "I'm washing my hands, getting ready to eat cake!"

sentences.chinese: 大明有些生气，他说：“我的手机不见了，你能帮忙吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng yǒuxiē shēngqì, tā shuō: “Wǒ de shǒujī bùjiàn le, nǐ néng bāngmáng ma?”
sentences.english: Da Ming was a bit angry and said, "My phone is missing, can you help?"

sentences.chinese: 小王说：“对不起，我没看到。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng shuō: “Duìbuqǐ, wǒ méi kàndào.”
sentences.english: Xiao Wang said, "I'm sorry, I didn't see it."

sentences.chinese: 大明想，小王是在开玩笑吗？
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xiǎng, Xiǎo Wáng shì zài kāi wánxiào ma?
sentences.english: Da Ming thought, is Xiao Wang joking?

sentences.chinese: 小王说：“我没有开玩笑，我真的不知道。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng shuō: “Wǒ méiyǒu kāi wánxiào, wǒ zhēnde bù zhīdào.”
sentences.english: Xiao Wang said, "I'm not joking, I really don't know."

sentences.chinese: 他们一起在客厅找手机。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen yīqǐ zài kètīng zhǎo shǒujī.
sentences.english: They looked for the phone in the living room together.

sentences.chinese: 大明看到沙发下面有一个黑色的东西。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng kàndào shāfā xiàmiàn yǒu yī gè hēisè de dōngxi.
sentences.english: Da Ming saw something black under the sofa.

sentences.chinese: 他把手机得到了，手机就在沙发下面！
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ shǒujī dédào le, shǒujī jiù zài shāfā xiàmiàn!
sentences.english: He got the phone; the phone was right under the sofa!

sentences.chinese: 大明发现他把手机放在了沙发下面。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng fāxiàn tā bǎ shǒujī fàng zài le shāfā xiàmiàn.
sentences.english: Da Ming discovered he had put the phone under the sofa.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“是我的错，我太忙了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Shì wǒ de cuò, wǒ tài máng le.”
sentences.english: He said, "It is my fault, I was too busy."

sentences.chinese: 小王笑了，他说：“没关系，我们快吃蛋糕吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng xiào le, tā shuō: “Méi guānxi, wǒmen kuài chī dàngāo ba.”
sentences.english: Xiao Wang laughed and said, "It's okay, let's eat the cake quickly."

sentences.chinese: 烤箱里的蛋糕很热，香味非常好。
sentences.pinyin: Kǎoxiāng lǐ de dàngāo hěn rè, xiāngwèi fēicháng hǎo.
sentences.english: The cake in the oven was hot, and the aroma was wonderful.

sentences.chinese: 他们坐下来，开始学习怎么分享蛋糕。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zuò xiàlái, kāishǐ xuéxí zěnme fēnxiǎng dàngāo.
sentences.english: They sat down and started learning how to share the cake.

sentences.chinese: 大明爱学习新东西，这是他的爱好。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng ài xuéxí xīn dōngxi, zhè shì tā de àihào.
sentences.english: Da Ming loves learning new things; this is his hobby.

sentences.chinese: 他爱读书，也爱学习怎么做菜。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ài dúshū, yě ài xuéxí zěnme zuò cài.
sentences.english: He loves reading and also loves learning how to cook.

sentences.chinese: 小王说：“你学习得很快。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng shuō: “Nǐ xuéde hěn kuài.”
sentences.english: Xiao Wang said, "You learn very quickly."

sentences.chinese: 大明说：“谢谢，我想以后学习更多。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng shuō: “Xièxiè, wǒ xiǎng yǐhòu xuéxí gèng duō.”
sentences.english: Da Ming said, "Thanks, I want to study more in the future."

sentences.chinese: 小王问：“你下午做什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng wèn: “Nǐ xiàwǔ zuò shénme?”
sentences.english: Xiao Wang asked, "What are you doing this afternoon?"

sentences.chinese: 大明说：“我得去开会，然后我想去打球。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng shuō: “Wǒ děi qù kāihuì, ránhòu wǒ xiǎng qù dǎqiú.”
sentences.english: Da Ming said, "I have to attend a meeting, and then I want to play ball."

sentences.chinese: 小王说：“我也爱打球，我们可以一起玩儿。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng shuō: “Wǒ yě ài dǎqiú, wǒmen kěyǐ yīqǐ wánr.”
sentences.english: Xiao Wang said, "I love playing ball too, we can hang out together."

sentences.chinese: 大明想，有朋友在一起真是太好了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xiǎng, yǒu péngyǒu zài yīqǐ zhēn shì tài hǎo le.
