sentences.english: Da Ming thought it was truly wonderful to be with friends.

sentences.chinese: 突然，大明的手机响了。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, Dàmíng de shǒujī xiǎng le.
sentences.english: Suddenly, Da Ming's phone rang.

sentences.chinese: 这是一个陌生人的电话。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yī gè mòshēng rén de diànhuà.
sentences.english: It was a call from a stranger.

sentences.chinese: 大明接了电话，对方的声音听起来像是有病。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng jiē le diànhuà, duìfāng de shēngyīn tīng qǐlái xiàng shì yǒu bìng.
sentences.english: Da Ming answered the phone; the other person's voice sounded like they were ill.

sentences.chinese: 那个声音说：“请问，你见过我的狗吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Nàge shēngyīn shuō: “Qǐngwèn, nǐ jiànguò wǒ de gǒu ma?”
sentences.english: That voice said, "Excuse me, have you seen my dog?"

sentences.chinese: 大明愣住了，他看向窗外的树下。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng lèng zhù le, tā kàn xiàng chuāngwài de shù xià.
sentences.english: Da Ming froze and looked under the tree outside the window.

sentences.chinese: 那里真的有一只小狗在看他。
sentences.pinyin: Nàlǐ zhēnde yǒu yī zhī xiǎo gǒu zài kàn tā.
sentences.english: There really was a little dog there looking at him.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 4: The Puppy Under the Tree

sentences.chinese: 大明站在窗前，看见一只白色的小狗。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng zhàn zài chuāng qián, kànjiàn yì zhī báisè de xiǎogǒu.
sentences.english: Daming stood by the window and saw a small white dog.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这只小狗很可爱，眼睛圆圆的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde zhè zhī xiǎogǒu hěn kě'ài, yǎnjīng yuán yuán de.
sentences.english: He felt that this little dog was very cute, with round eyes.

sentences.chinese: 他想起手机里的那个声音，对方在问他的狗。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ shǒujī lǐ de nàge shēngyīn, duìfāng zài wèn tā de gǒu.
sentences.english: He remembered the voice on the phone; the other person was asking about their dog.

sentences.chinese: 大明知道他必须帮这个陌生人。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng zhīdào tā bìxū bāng zhège mòshēng rén.
sentences.english: Daming knew he had to help this stranger.

sentences.chinese: 他快快地穿上外套，走出了家门。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kuài kuài de chuān shàng wàitào, zǒu chū le jiāmén.
sentences.english: He quickly put on his coat and walked out of the house.

sentences.chinese: 他在树下看见了小狗，小狗在说话一样地叫。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài shù xià kànjiàn le xiǎogǒu, xiǎogǒu zài shuōhuà yíyàng de jiào.
sentences.english: He saw the puppy under the tree; the puppy was barking as if it were speaking.

sentences.chinese: 大明请小狗跟他走。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng qǐng xiǎogǒu gēn tā zǒu.
sentences.english: Daming asked the puppy to go with him.

sentences.chinese: 小狗很聪明，它跟在大明身后，一起走路。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎogǒu hěn cōngmíng, tā gēn zài Dàmíng shēnhòu, yìqǐ zǒulù.
sentences.english: The puppy was very smart; it followed behind Daming, and they walked together.

sentences.chinese: 大明想，如果能记住对方的电话，就方便见面了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xiǎng, rúguǒ néng jìzhù duìfāng de diànhuà, jiù fāngbiàn jiànmiàn le.
sentences.english: Daming thought that if he could remember the other person's phone number, it would be convenient to meet.

sentences.chinese: 但他突然发现，他还没把电话号码记下来。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tā tūrán fāxiàn, tā hái méi bǎ diànhuà hàomǎ jì xiàlái.
sentences.english: But he suddenly realized he hadn't noted down the phone number yet.

sentences.chinese: 他试着回想，但很难记住那些数字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì zhe huíxiǎng, dàn hěn nán jìzhù nàxiē shùzì.
sentences.english: He tried to recall it, but it was hard to remember those numbers.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个男人走进了街道。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yí gè nánrén zǒu jìn le jiēdào.
sentences.english: At this moment, a man walked into the street.

sentences.chinese: 这个男人看起来很不舒服，好像需要去看病。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège nánrén kàn qǐlái hěn bù shūfu, hǎoxiàng xūyào qù kànbìng.
sentences.english: This man looked very uncomfortable, as if he needed to visit a doctor.

sentences.chinese: 大明走上前，跟这个男人见面。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng zǒu shàng qián, gēn zhège nánrén jiànmiàn.
sentences.english: Daming stepped forward and met this man.

sentences.chinese: 男人看见小狗，高兴地叫了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén kànjiàn xiǎogǒu, gāoxìng de jiào le qǐlái.
sentences.english: The man saw the puppy and cried out happily.

sentences.chinese: “谢谢你！我认识这只狗，它是我的宝贝！”男人说。
sentences.pinyin: “Xièxie nǐ! Wǒ rènshi zhè zhī gǒu, tā shì wǒ de bǎobèi!” nánrén shuō.
sentences.english: "Thank you! I know this dog; it is my baby!" the man said.

sentences.chinese: 大明笑着说：“不客气，我只是想给你的狗找主人。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xiào zhe shuō: “Bú kèqi, wǒ zhǐshì xiǎng gěi nǐ de gǒu zhǎo zhǔrén.”
sentences.english: Daming smiled and said, "You're welcome, I just wanted to find the owner for your dog."

sentences.chinese: 男人看着大明，问他是不是学生。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén kàn zhe Dàmíng, wèn tā shì bú shì xuésheng.
sentences.english: The man looked at Daming and asked if he was a student.

sentences.chinese: 大明点点头说：“是的，我在读书。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng diǎntóu shuō: “Shì de, wǒ zài dúshū.”
sentences.english: Daming nodded and said, "Yes, I am studying."

sentences.chinese: 男人问：“你最近有考试吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén wèn: “Nǐ zuìjìn yǒu kǎoshì ma?”
sentences.english: The man asked, "Do you have an exam recently?"

sentences.chinese: 大明说：“明天有一个重要的考试，我要努力学习。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng shuō: “Míngtiān yǒu yí gè zhòngyào de kǎoshì, wǒ yào nǔlì xuéxí.”
sentences.english: Daming said, "There is an important exam tomorrow, and I need to study hard."

sentences.chinese: 男人开玩笑说：“学习就像下棋，得想好每一步着法。”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén kāi wánxiào shuō: “Xuéxí jiù xiàng xiàqí, děi xiǎng hǎo měi yí bù zhāo fǎ.”
sentences.english: The man joked, "Studying is like playing chess; you have to think through every move."

sentences.chinese: 大明觉得这个男人很有趣。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng juéde zhège nánrén hěn yǒuqù.
sentences.english: Daming felt this man was very interesting.

sentences.chinese: 男人说：“你真好，请让我请你喝杯咖啡。”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén shuō: “Nǐ zhēn hǎo, qǐng ràng wǒ qǐng nǐ hē bēi kāfēi.”
sentences.english: The man said, "You are so kind, please let me treat you to a cup of coffee."

sentences.chinese: 大明想起他还没买蛋糕，时间快到了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xiǎngqǐ tā hái méi mǎi dàngāo, shíjiān kuài dào le.
sentences.english: Daming remembered he hadn't bought the cake yet, and time was running out.

sentences.chinese: 他突然站起来，想起了一件事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán zhàn qǐlái, xiǎngqǐ le yí jiàn shì.
sentences.english: He suddenly stood up and remembered something.

sentences.chinese: 他问男人：“请问，你见过我的手机吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn nánrén: “Qǐngwèn, nǐ jiàn guò wǒ de shǒujī ma?”
sentences.english: He asked the man, "Excuse me, have you seen my phone?"

sentences.chinese: 男人愣住了，他慢慢地从口袋里拿出一个手机。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén lèng zhù le, tā mànman de cóng kǒudài lǐ ná chū yí gè shǒujī.
sentences.english: The man froze, and slowly took a phone out of his pocket.

sentences.chinese: 男人说：“这个手机是你丢的吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén shuō: “Zhège shǒujī shì nǐ diū de ma?”
sentences.english: The man said, "Is this phone the one you lost?"

sentences.chinese: 大明看着手机，高兴地说：“是的，这是我的手机！”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng kàn zhe shǒu jī, gāo xìng de shuō: “Shì de, zhè shì wǒ de shǒu jī!”
sentences.english: Da Ming looked at the phone and said happily, "Yes, this is my phone!"

sentences.chinese: 他看向这个男人，男人穿着很正式，像是一位先生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng zhè ge nán rén, nán rén chuān zhe hěn zhèng shì, xiàng shì yī wèi xiān sheng.
sentences.english: He looked at the man; the man was dressed very formally, like a gentleman.

sentences.chinese: 男人笑了，他说：“我刚才在学校门口捡到了它。”
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén xiào le, tā shuō: “Wǒ gāng cái zài xué xiào mén kǒu jiǎn dào le tā.”
sentences.english: The man smiled and said, "I just picked it up at the school gate."

sentences.chinese: 大明看向远方，那里有一所很大的学校。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng kàn xiàng yuǎn fāng, nà lǐ yǒu yī suǒ hěn dà de xué xiào.
sentences.english: Da Ming looked into the distance, where there was a very large school.

sentences.chinese: 学校里有很多学生，他们正走在去教学楼的路上。
sentences.pinyin: Xué xiào lǐ yǒu hěn duō xué sheng, tā men zhèng zǒu zài qù jiào xué lóu de lù shàng.
sentences.english: There were many students in the school, walking toward the teaching block.

sentences.chinese: 大明看到很多小学生，他们背着可爱的小书包。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng kàn dào hěn duō xiǎo xué shēng, tā men bēi zhe kě ài de xiǎo shū bāo.
sentences.english: Da Ming saw many primary school students, carrying cute little schoolbags.

sentences.chinese: 一个小学生指着大明说：“你看，那个男生在笑。”
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè xiǎo xué shēng zhǐ zhe Dà Míng shuō: “Nǐ kàn, nà ge nán shēng zài xiào.”
sentences.english: A primary school student pointed at Da Ming and said, "Look, that boy is smiling."

sentences.chinese: 在他们旁边，还有一些中学生，他们看起来更成熟。
sentences.pinyin: Zài tā men páng biān, hái yǒu yī xiē zhōng xué shēng, tā men kàn qǐ lái gèng chéng shú.
sentences.english: Beside them, there were some middle-school students who looked more mature.

sentences.chinese: 一个中学生手里拿着一本厚厚的书，在认真地阅读。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè zhōng xué shēng shǒu lǐ ná zhe yī běn hòu hòu de shū, zài rèn zhēn de yuè dú.
sentences.english: A middle-school student was holding a thick book in his hand, reading intently.

sentences.chinese: 大明想起他自己以前在中学的时候，也是这样地爱读书。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng xiǎng qǐ tā zì jǐ yǐ qián zài zhōng xué de shí hou, yě shì zhè yàng de ài dú shū.
sentences.english: Da Ming remembered when he was in middle school, he also loved reading books like this.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一个女生在和她的同学说话。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào yī gè nǚ shēng zài hé tā de tóng xué shuō huà.
sentences.english: He saw a girl talking to her classmate.

sentences.chinese: 那个女生说：“今天的课太难了，我看不懂课文。”
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge nǚ shēng shuō: “Jīn tiān de kè tài nán le, wǒ kàn bù dǒng kè wén.”
sentences.english: The girl said, "Today's lesson is too difficult, I don't understand the text."

sentences.chinese: 她的同学回答：“是的，这个课本的内容真的很多。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā de tóng xué huí dá: “Shì de, zhè ge kè běn de nèi róng zhēn de hěn duō.”
sentences.english: Her classmate replied, "Yes, the content of this textbook is really a lot."

sentences.chinese: 大明想，现在的学生生活一定很辛苦。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng xiǎng, xiàn zài de xué sheng shēng huó yī dìng hěn xīn kǔ.
sentences.english: Da Ming thought that student life nowadays must be very hard.

sentences.chinese: 他注意到那个男人在看着一个大学的学生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhù yì dào nà ge nán rén zài kàn zhe yī gè dà xué de xué sheng.
sentences.english: He noticed the man looking at a university student.

sentences.chinese: 那个大学生来自市里的艺术学院，穿着很时尚。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge dà xué shēng lái zì shì lǐ de yì shù xué yuàn, chuān zhe hěn shí shàng.
sentences.english: That university student came from the city's art college and was dressed very fashionably.

sentences.chinese: 男人对大明说：“我以前也是一名大学生，我现在是这里的老师。”
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén duì Dà Míng shuō: “Wǒ yǐ qián yě shì yī míng dà xué shēng, wǒ xiàn zài shì zhè lǐ de lǎo shī.”
sentences.english: The man said to Da Ming, "I used to be a university student, and now I am a teacher here."

sentences.chinese: 大明愣住了，他问：“您教什么课？”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng lèng zhù le, tā wèn: “Nín jiāo shén me kè?”
sentences.english: Da Ming was stunned and asked, "What subject do you teach?"

sentences.chinese: 老师微笑着说：“我教很多不同等级的课，不管是小学还是大学。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo shī wēi xiào zhe shuō: “Wǒ jiāo hěn duō bù tóng děng jí de kè, bù guǎn shì xiǎo xué hái shì dà xué.”
sentences.english: The teacher smiled and said, "I teach classes of many different levels, whether it's primary school or university."

sentences.chinese: 大明觉得这个先生很亲切，他想多聊一会儿。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Míng jué de zhè ge xiān sheng hěn qīn qiè, tā xiǎng duō liáo yī huì r.
sentences.english: Da Ming felt this gentleman was very kind and wanted to chat a bit more.

sentences.chinese: 但突然，他想到了那个还没买的蛋糕。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tū rán, tā xiǎng dào le nà ge hái méi mǎi de dàn gāo.
sentences.english: But suddenly, he thought of the cake he hadn't bought yet.

sentences.chinese: 如果现在不去买，今天就不能庆祝了。
sentences.pinyin: Rú guǒ xiàn zài bù qù mǎi, jīn tiān jiù bù néng qìng zhù le.
sentences.english: If he didn't go buy it now, he wouldn't be able to celebrate today.

sentences.chinese: 他礼貌地道谢，准备离开，但老师突然叫住了他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lǐ mào de dào xiè, zhǔn bèi lí kāi, dàn lǎo shī tū rán jiào zhù le tā.
sentences.english: He thanked him politely and prepared to leave, but the teacher suddenly called out to him.

sentences.chinese: 老师笑着说：“大明，等一下。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī xiàozhe shuō: “Dàmíng, děng yīxià.”
sentences.english: The teacher smiled and said, "Daming, wait a moment."

sentences.chinese: 他从口袋里拿出一张白色的纸。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng kǒudài lǐ ná chū yī zhāng báisè de zhǐ.
sentences.english: He took a piece of white paper out of his pocket.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“这是我班上的学生名单。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zhè shì wǒ bān shàng de xuéshēng míngdān.”
sentences.english: He said, "This is the student list for my class."

sentences.chinese: 大明好奇地看了看那张纸。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng hàoqí de kànle kàn nà zhāng zhǐ.
sentences.english: Daming looked at the piece of paper curiously.

sentences.chinese: 这张纸上的名字非常奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhǐ shàng de míngzì fēicháng qíguài.
sentences.english: The names on this paper were very strange.

sentences.chinese: 名单上的第一个人姓三。
sentences.pinyin: Míngdān shàng de dì yī gè rén xìng Sān.
sentences.english: The first person on the list had the surname San.

sentences.chinese: 第二个人姓东。
sentences.pinyin: Dì èr gè rén xìng Dōng.
sentences.english: The second person had the surname Dong.

sentences.chinese: 第三个人姓中。
sentences.pinyin: Dì sān gè rén xìng Zhōng.
sentences.english: The third person had the surname Zhong.

sentences.chinese: 大明觉得这很奇怪，因为这些词通常不是姓氏。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng juédé zhè hěn qíguài, yīnwèi zhèxiē cí tōngcháng bùshì xìngshì.
sentences.english: Daming thought this was very strange because these words are usually not surnames.

sentences.chinese: 接下来的名字也一样。
sentences.pinyin: Jiē xiàlái de míngzì yě yīyàng.
sentences.english: The following names were the same.

sentences.chinese: 他看到了姓元的人，看到了姓关的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndàole xìng Yuán de rén, kàndàole xìng Guān de rén.
sentences.english: He saw a person with the surname Yuan and a person with the surname Guan.

sentences.chinese: 还有姓冷的人，和姓别的人。
sentences.pinyin: Hái yǒu xìng Lěng de rén, hé xìng Bié de rén.
sentences.english: There was also a person with the surname Leng and a person with the surname Bie.

sentences.chinese: 大明问：“老师，这些学生都是中国人吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng wèn: “Lǎoshī, zhèxiē xuéshēng dōu shì Zhōngguórén ma?”
sentences.english: Daming asked, "Teacher, are these students all Chinese?"

sentences.chinese: 老师点点头说：“是的，他们都来自不同的地方。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī diǎndiǎn tóu shuō: “Shì de, tāmen dōu láizì bùtóng de dìfāng.”
sentences.english: The teacher nodded and said, "Yes, they all come from different places."

sentences.chinese: 大明继续往下看，看到了姓包的人和姓南的人。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng jìxù wǎng xià kàn, kàndàole xìng Bāo de rén hé xìng Nán de rén.
sentences.english: Daming continued to look down and saw a person with the surname Bao and a person with the surname Nan.

sentences.chinese: 然后是姓后的人，和姓国的人。
sentences.pinyin: Ránhòu shì xìng Hòu de rén, hé xìng Guó de rén.
sentences.english: Then there was a person with the surname Hou and a person with the surname Guo.

sentences.chinese: 名单上竟然还有姓坐的人，和姓山的人。
sentences.pinyin: Míngdān shàng jìngrán hái yǒu xìng Zuò de rén, hé xìng Shān de rén.
sentences.english: Surprisingly, there were even people with the surnames Zuo and Shan on the list.

sentences.chinese: 大明觉得这个班级太有趣了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng juédé zhège bānjí tài yǒuqùle.
sentences.english: Daming thought this class was too interesting.

sentences.chinese: 他看到了姓左的人，和姓常的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndàole xìng Zuǒ de rén, hé xìng Cháng de rén.
sentences.english: He saw a person with the surname Zuo and a person with the surname Chang.

sentences.chinese: 还有姓年的人，和姓教的人。
sentences.pinyin: Hái yǒu xìng Nián de rén, hé xìng Jiào de rén.
sentences.english: There were also people with the surnames Nian and Jiao.

sentences.chinese: 大明问：“您的学生这么多吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng wèn: “Nín de xuéshēng zhème duō ma?”
sentences.english: Daming asked, "Do you have this many students?"

sentences.chinese: 老师笑着说：“是的，我的学生很多。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī xiàozhe shuō: “Shì de, wǒ de xuéshēng hěnduō.”
sentences.english: The teacher smiled and said, "Yes, I have many students."

sentences.chinese: 大明看到名单上还有姓楼的人，和姓毛的人。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng kàndào míngdān shàng hái yǒu xìng Lóu de rén, hé xìng Máo de rén.
sentences.english: Daming saw that there were also people with the surnames Lou and Mao on the list.

sentences.chinese: 接着是姓水的人，和姓班的人。
sentences.pinyin: Jiēzhe shì xìng Shuǐ de rén, hé xìng Bān de rén.
sentences.english: Next were people with the surnames Shui and Ban.

sentences.chinese: 大明发现名单上的姓氏真的很多。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng fāxiàn míngdān shàng de xìngshì zhēnde hěnduō.
sentences.english: Daming found that there were truly many surnames on the list.

sentences.chinese: 他看到了姓白的人，和姓百的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndàole xìng Bái de rén, hé xìng Bǎi de rén.
sentences.english: He saw a person with the surname Bai and a person with the surname Bai (Hundred).

sentences.chinese: 还有姓能的人，和姓花的人。
sentences.pinyin: Hái yǒu xìng Néng de rén, hé xìng Huā de rén.
sentences.english: There were also people with the surnames Neng and Hua.

sentences.chinese: 大明觉得老师是在开玩笑。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng juédé lǎoshī shì zài kāiwánxiào.
sentences.english: Daming thought the teacher was joking.

sentences.chinese: 他看到了姓路的人，和姓车的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndàole xìng Lù de rén, hé xìng Chē de rén.
sentences.english: He saw a person with the surname Lu and a person with the surname Che.

sentences.chinese: 还有姓过的人，和姓还的人。
sentences.pinyin: Hái yǒu xìng Guò de rén, hé xìng Huán de rén.
sentences.english: There were also people with the surnames Guo and Huan.

sentences.chinese: 名单快结束了，最后几个名字是姓那的人，和姓都的人。
sentences.pinyin: Míngdān kuài jiéshùle, zuìhòu jǐ gè míngzì shì xìng Nā de rén, hé xìng Dū de rén.
sentences.english: The list was almost over; the last few names were people with the surnames Na and Du.

sentences.chinese: 然后是姓钱的人，和姓错的人。
sentences.pinyin: Ránhòu shì xìng Qián de rén, hé xìng Cuò de rén.
sentences.english: Then there were people with the surnames Qian and Cuo.

sentences.chinese: 最后一个人姓门，而老师自己姓高。
sentences.pinyin: Zuìhòu yī gè rén xìng Mén, ér lǎoshī zìjǐ xìng Gāo.
sentences.english: The last person had the surname Men, and the teacher himself had the surname Gao.

sentences.chinese: 大明愣住了，他觉得这张名单绝对错了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng lèngzhùle, tā juédé zhè zhāng míngdān juéduì cuòle.
sentences.english: Daming was stunned; he felt this list was absolutely wrong.

sentences.chinese: 他想告诉老师，但此时他突然想起了蛋糕。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng gàosù lǎoshī, dàn cǐshí tā tūrán xiǎngqǐle dàngāo.
sentences.english: He wanted to tell the teacher, but at that moment, he suddenly remembered the cake.

sentences.chinese: 他赶紧说：“对不起，我必须走了！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎnjǐn shuō: “Duìbùqǐ, wǒ bìxū zǒule!”
sentences.english: He hurriedly said, "I'm sorry, I must go!"

sentences.chinese: 他跑出教室，但他在门口突然停了下来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pǎo chū jiàoshì, dàn tā zài ménkǒu tūrán tíngle xiàlái.
sentences.english: He ran out of the classroom, but he suddenly stopped at the door.

sentences.chinese: 他发现自己把手机又留在老师的桌子上了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn zìjǐ bǎ shǒujī yòu liú zài lǎoshī de zhuōzi shàngle.
sentences.english: He discovered that he had left his phone on the teacher's desk again.

sentences.chinese: 大明叹了一口气，他重新走回教室拿手机。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng tànle yī kǒuqì, tā chóngxīn zǒu huí jiàoshì ná shǒujī.
sentences.english: Da Ming sighed and walked back to the classroom to get his phone.

sentences.chinese: 现在是上午十点，他觉得今天太奇怪了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài shì shàngwǔ shí diǎn, tā juéde jīntiān tài qíguài le.
sentences.english: It was 10:00 in the morning, and he felt today was too strange.

sentences.chinese: 他走出学校，看到街道上的风很大。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒuchū xuéxiào, kàndào jiēdào shàng de fēng hěn dà.
sentences.english: He walked out of the school and saw that the wind on the street was very strong.

sentences.chinese: 天空的颜色变了，天气看起来不太好。
sentences.pinyin: Tīnkōng de yánsè biàn le, tiānqì kàn qǐlái bù tài hǎo.
sentences.english: The color of the sky changed; the weather looked not very good.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果下雨，买蛋糕就麻烦了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rúguǒ xià yǔ, mǎi dàngāo jiù máfan le.
sentences.english: He thought, if it rains, buying a cake will be troublesome.

sentences.chinese: 他走在路上，看到一个工人正在工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu zài lùshàng, kàndào yī gè gōngrén zhèngzài gōngzuò.
sentences.english: Walking on the road, he saw a worker working.

sentences.chinese: 那个工人对他笑了笑，说：“早！”
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè gōngrén duì tā xiàole xiào, shuō: “Zǎo!”
sentences.english: That worker smiled at him and said, "Morning!"

sentences.chinese: 大明也礼貌地回答：“早！”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng yě lǐmào de huídá: “Zǎo!”
sentences.english: Da Ming also politely replied, "Morning!"

sentences.chinese: 他想起今天早上他只喝了牛奶，没有吃早饭。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ jīntiān zǎoshang tā zhǐ hēle niúnǎi, méiyǒu chī zǎofàn.
sentences.english: He remembered that early this morning he only drank milk and didn't eat breakfast.

sentences.chinese: 现在他觉得有点渴，也觉得肚子很饿。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài tā juéde yǒudiǎn kě, yě juéde dùzi hěn è.
sentences.english: Now he felt a bit thirsty and also felt his stomach was very hungry.

sentences.chinese: 他走进一家小店，那里有面包和很多水果。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒujìn yī jiā xiǎo diàn, nàlǐ yǒu miànbāo hé hěnduō shuǐguǒ.
sentences.english: He walked into a small shop; there was bread and a lot of fruit there.

sentences.chinese: 他想买一些水果，但他的心还在想那个蛋糕。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng mǎi yīxiē shuǐguǒ, dàn tā de xīn hái zài xiǎng nà gè dàngāo.
sentences.english: He wanted to buy some fruit, but his mind was still thinking about that cake.

sentences.chinese: 他想起他的朋友来自西班牙，喜欢吃西方的甜点。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ tā de péngyǒu láizì Xībānyá, xǐhuān chī Xīfāng de tiándiǎn.
sentences.english: He remembered his friend came from Spain and liked to eat Western desserts.

sentences.chinese: 一个小时后，他终于找到了蛋糕店。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè xiǎoshí hòu, tā zhōngyú zhǎodàole dàngāodiàn.
sentences.english: An hour later, he finally found the cake shop.

sentences.chinese: 这时已经是中午了，街上的人很多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí yǐjīng shì zhōngwǔ le, jiē shàng de rén hěnduō.
sentences.english: By this time it was already noon, and there were many people on the street.

sentences.chinese: 人们在讨论关于火车和飞机的新闻。
sentences.pinyin: Rénmen zài tǎolùn guānyú huǒchē hé fēijī de xīnwén.
sentences.english: People were discussing news about trains and airplanes.

sentences.chinese: 大明走进店里，看到很多人在吃午饭。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng zǒujìn diàn lǐ, kàndào hěnduō rén zài chī wǔfàn.
sentences.english: Da Ming walked into the shop and saw many people eating lunch.

sentences.chinese: 有人在吃包子，有人在吃米饭。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒurén zài chī bāozi, yǒurén zài chī mǐfàn.
sentences.english: Some people were eating baozi, and some were eating rice.

sentences.chinese: 他想，简单的饭菜也是一种幸福。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, jiǎndān de fàncài yěshì yī zhǒng xìngfú.
sentences.english: He thought, simple meals are also a kind of happiness.

sentences.chinese: 他终于买到了漂亮的蛋糕，准备回家。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhōngyú mǎidàole piàoliang de dàngāo, zhǔnbèi huí jiā.
sentences.english: He finally bought the beautiful cake and prepared to go home.

sentences.chinese: 但突然，他听到手机响了，是一个不认识的号码。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tūrán, tā tīngdào shǒujī xiǎngle, shì yī gè bù rènshi de hàomǎ.
sentences.english: But suddenly, he heard the phone ring; it was a number he didn't recognize.

sentences.chinese: 大明站在路口，看着手中的蛋糕。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng zhàn zài lùkǒu, kànzhe shǒuzhōng de dàngāo.
sentences.english: Daming stood at the intersection, looking at the cake in his hand.

sentences.chinese: 他现在有点担心，因为这个电话号码很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiànzài yǒudiǎn dānxīn, yīnwèi zhège diànhuà hàomǎ hěn qíguài.
sentences.english: He was now a bit worried because this phone number was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 他接起电话，那边是一个女人的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiē qǐ diànhuà, nàbiān shì yīgè nǚrén de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: He answered the phone, and on the other end was a woman's voice.

sentences.chinese: 女人问他：“请问，你现在在哪个地方？”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚrén wèn tā: “Qǐngwèn, nǐ xiànzài zài nǎge dìfāng?”
sentences.english: The woman asked him, "Excuse me, where are you right now?"

sentences.chinese: 大明愣住了，他问：“你是谁？你在哪里？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng lèng zhù le, tā wèn: “Nǐ shì shuí? Nǐ zài nǎlǐ?”
sentences.english: Daming was stunned and asked, "Who are you? Where are you?"

sentences.chinese: 女人说：“我在你的前边，就在那个公园的右边。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚrén shuō: “Wǒ zài nǐ de qiánbian, jiù zài nàge gōngyuán de yòubiān.”
sentences.english: The woman said, "I am in front of you, right to the right side of that park."

sentences.chinese: 大明看向前边，看到一个穿着白色衣服的女人。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng kàn xiàng qiánbian, kàndào yīgè chuānzhe báisè yīfú de nǚrén.
sentences.english: Daming looked ahead and saw a woman wearing white clothes.

sentences.chinese: 她正在一边走，一边看着手机。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài yībiān zǒu, yībiān kànzhe shǒujī.
sentences.english: She was walking while looking at her phone.

sentences.chinese: 她走到了大明的旁边，笑着说：“你好。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu dào le Dàmíng de pángbiān, xiàozhe shuō: “Nǐ hǎo.”
sentences.english: She walked to Daming's side and said with a smile, "Hello."

sentences.chinese: 大明发现，她的眼睛和他的老师一样大。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng fāxiàn, tā de yǎnjīng hé tā de lǎoshī yīyàng dà.
sentences.english: Daming noticed that her eyes were as large as his teacher's.

sentences.chinese: 大明想，这个女人是不是从国外来的？
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xiǎng, zhège nǚrén shì bù shì cóng guówài lái de?
sentences.english: Daming wondered if this woman had come from abroad.

sentences.chinese: 因为她的衣服很特别，不像本地的人。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi tā de yīfú hěn tèbié, bù xiàng běndì de rén.
sentences.english: Because her clothes were very special, not like the local people.

sentences.chinese: 女人指着地上的一个小包说：“这是你的吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚrén zhǐzhe dìshàng de yīgè xiǎo bāo shuō: “Zhè shì nǐ de ma?”
sentences.english: The woman pointed to a small bag on the ground and said, "Is this yours?"

sentences.chinese: 大明低头看，发现包在她的左边，就在地上。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng dītóu kàn, fāxiàn bāo zài tā de zuǒbiān, jiù zài dìshàng.
sentences.english: Daming looked down and found the bag was to her left, right on the ground.

sentences.chinese: 他赶紧弯下腰，把包从下边捡了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎnjǐn wān xià yāo, bǎ bāo cóng xiàbiān jiǎn le qǐlái.
sentences.english: He quickly bent down and picked up the bag from below.

sentences.chinese: 他发现包的身上有一个小标签，写着他的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn bāo de shēnshàng yǒu yīgè xiǎo biāoqiān, xiězhe tā de míngzì.
sentences.english: He found a small label on the bag with his name written on it.

sentences.chinese: 他很惊讶，因为他今天没有带这个包。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hěn jīngyà, yīnwèi tā jīntiān méiyǒu dài zhège bāo.
sentences.english: He was very surprised because he hadn't brought this bag today.

sentences.chinese: 他问女人：“这个包怎么会在你那里？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn nǚrén: “Zhège bāo zěnme huì zài nǐ nàli?”
sentences.english: He asked the woman, "How did this bag end up with you there?"

sentences.chinese: 女人指了指北边，说：“我在北边的商店看到了它。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚrén zhǐ le zhǐ běibiān, shuō: “Wǒ zài běibiān de shāngdiàn kàndào le tā.”
sentences.english: The woman pointed north and said, "I saw it at a store in the north."

sentences.chinese: 大明想，那个商店在路口往东边走就到了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xiǎng, nàge shāngdiàn zài lùkǒu wǎng dōngbiān zǒu jiù dào le.
sentences.english: Daming thought that the store could be reached by walking east from the intersection.

sentences.chinese: 他问：“你怎么知道我的手机号码？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn: “Nǐ zěnme zhīdào wǒ de shǒujī hàomǎ?”
sentences.english: He asked, "How do you know my phone number?"

sentences.chinese: 女人笑着说：“因为你的手机刚才掉在了包的里面。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚrén xiàozhe shuō: “Yīnwèi nǐ de shǒujī gāngcái diào zài le bāo de lǐmiàn.”
sentences.english: The woman smiled and said, "Because your phone just fell inside the bag."

sentences.chinese: 大明想起刚才在教室里的事情，觉得身体有点累。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xiǎngqǐ gāngcái zài jiàoshì lǐ de shìqíng, juédé shēntǐ yǒudiǎn lèi.
sentences.english: Daming thought about what had happened in the classroom and felt his body was a bit tired.

sentences.chinese: 他想，今天发生的事情太多了，太奇怪了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, jīntiān fāshēng de shìqíng tài duō le, tài qíguài le.
sentences.english: He thought too many strange things had happened today.

sentences.chinese: 他看着外边的天空，现在已经是下午了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe wàibiān de tiānkōng, xiànzài yǐjīng shì xiàwǔ le.
sentences.english: He looked at the sky outside; it was already afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 他想马上回家，因为他还要准备庆祝活动。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng mǎshàng huíjiā, yīnwèi tā hái yào zhǔnbèi qìngzhù huódòng.
sentences.english: He wanted to go home immediately because he still had to prepare for the celebration.

sentences.chinese: 他问女人：“你住在南边吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn nǚrén: “Nǐ zhù zài nánbiān ma?”
sentences.english: He asked the woman, "Do you live in the south?"

sentences.chinese: 女人摇摇头说：“不，我住在西边。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚrén yáo yáotóu shuō: “Bù, wǒ zhù zài xībiān.”
sentences.english: The woman shook her head and said, "No, I live in the west."

sentences.chinese: 大明对这个女人感到很好奇。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng duì zhège nǚrén gǎndào hěn hàoqí.
sentences.english: Daming felt very curious about this woman.

sentences.chinese: 他想，这个世界有很多有趣的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, zhège shìjiè yǒu hěnduō yǒuqù de dìfāng.
sentences.english: He thought there are many interesting places in this world.

sentences.chinese: 他看着上边的小鸟，心情慢慢变好了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe shàngbiān de xiǎoniǎo, xīnqíng mànman biàn hǎo le.
sentences.english: He looked at the birds above, and his mood slowly improved.

sentences.chinese: 他想和这个新朋友一起走一段路。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng hé zhège xīn péngyǒu yīqǐ zǒu yīduàn lù.
sentences.english: He wanted to walk a piece of the way together with this new friend.

sentences.chinese: 他问：“你想去那边看那个漂亮的喷泉吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn: “Nǐ xiǎng qù nàbiān kàn nàge piàoliang de pēnfúan ma?”
sentences.english: He asked, "Do you want to go over there to see that beautiful fountain?"

sentences.chinese: 女人点点头，说：“好，我们一起去。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚrén diǎntóu, shuō: “Hǎo, wǒmen yīqǐ qù.”
sentences.english: The woman nodded and said, "Okay, let's go together."

sentences.chinese: 但就在他们走的时候，大明突然发现包里少了一样东西。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài tāmen zǒu de shíhòu, Dàmíng tūrán fāxiàn bāo lǐ shǎo le yīyàng dōngxī.
sentences.english: But just as they were walking, Daming suddenly discovered something was missing from the bag.

sentences.chinese: 大明突然停了下来。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng tūrán tíngle xiàlái.
sentences.english: Da Ming suddenly stopped.

sentences.chinese: 他赶紧打开包，发现钥匙不见了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎnjǐn dǎkāi bāo, fāxiàn yàoshi bùjiàn le.
sentences.english: He quickly opened his bag and found the keys were gone.

sentences.chinese: 他的心跳得很快，脸也变得很红。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de xīntiào de hěn kuài, liǎn yě biàn de hěn hóng.
sentences.english: His heart beat very fast, and his face turned very red.

sentences.chinese: 他想，这把钥匙非常重要。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, zhè bǎ yàoshi fēicháng zhòngyào.
sentences.english: He thought, this key is very important.

sentences.chinese: 如果没有钥匙，他就不能回家了。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu yàoshi, tā jiù bùnéng huíjiā le.
sentences.english: If there are no keys, he simply cannot go home.

sentences.chinese: 那个女人看着他，轻轻地问：“你怎么了？”
sentences.pinyin: Nàge nǚrén kànzhe tā, qīngqīng de wèn: “Nǐ zěnme le?”
sentences.english: The woman looked at him and asked softly, "What happened to you?"

sentences.chinese: 大明难过地说：“我的钥匙不见了。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng nánguò de shuō: “Wǒ de yàoshi bùjiàn le.”
sentences.english: Da Ming said sadly, "My keys are gone."

sentences.chinese: 他在包的中间找了半天，但是没有找到。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài bāo de zhōngjiān zhǎole bàntiān, dànshì méiyǒu zhǎodào.
sentences.english: He searched in the middle of the bag for a long time, but didn't find them.

sentences.chinese: 他想起来，白天他去过很多地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐlái, báitiān tā qùguò hěnduō dìfāng.
sentences.english: He remembered that during the daytime he had gone to many places.

sentences.chinese: 他去过学校，去过商店，还去过那个奇怪的先生的家。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qùguò xuéxiào, qùguò shāngdiàn, hái qùguò nàge qíguài de xiānsheng de jiā.
sentences.english: He had gone to school, to the store, and even to that strange gentleman's house.

sentences.chinese: 现在已经是下午了，太阳在后边慢慢落下。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài yǐjīng shì xiàwǔ le, tàiyáng zài hòubian mànmàn luòxià.
sentences.english: It was already afternoon, and the sun was slowly setting behind them.

sentences.chinese: 大明觉得很累，他坐在长椅上休息一会儿。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng juéde hěn lèi, tā zuò zài chángyǐ shàng xiūxi yīhuìr.
sentences.english: Da Ming felt very tired; he sat on the bench to rest for a moment.

sentences.chinese: 他想，也许钥匙在某个地方呢？
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, yěxǔ yàoshi zài mǒu gè dìfāng ne?
sentences.english: He wondered, maybe the keys are in some place?

sentences.chinese: 他看着周围，发现这里有很多人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe zhōuwéi, fāxiàn zhèlǐ yǒu hěnduō rén.
sentences.english: He looked around and found there were many people here.

sentences.chinese: 有些人在大声说话，有些人走得很慢。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒuxiē rén zài dàshēng shuōhuà, yǒuxiē rén zǒu de hěn màn.
sentences.english: Some people were speaking loudly, some were walking very slowly.

sentences.chinese: 他问自己：“我应该再去哪里找找？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn zìjǐ: “Wǒ yīnggāi zài qù nǎlǐ zhǎozhao?”
sentences.english: He asked himself, "Where should I go to look again?"

sentences.chinese: 他想到了楼上的那个小房间，那是他今天去的第一个地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngdàole lóushàng de nàge xiǎo fángjiān, nà shì tā jīntiān qù de dì-yī gè dìfāng.
sentences.english: He thought of that small room upstairs; that was the first place he went today.

sentences.chinese: 那是第一间房间，也是他最喜欢的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì dì-yī jiān fángjiān, yěshì tā zuì xǐhuan de dìfāng.
sentences.english: That was the first room, and also his favorite place.

sentences.chinese: 但现在回那里太远了，时间差了很多。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiànzài huí nàlǐ tài yuǎn le, shíjiān chā le hěnduō.
sentences.english: But returning there now was too far, and the time difference was too great.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果今天找不到，后天可能就更难找了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rúguǒ jīntiān zhǎo bù dào, hòutiān kěnéng jiù gèng nán zhǎo le.
sentences.english: He thought, if I can't find them today, it might be even harder the day after tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 他再次检查了包的每一个角落。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zàicì jiǎnchále bāo de měi yī gè jiǎoluò.
sentences.english: He checked every corner of the bag once more.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他看到包的底边有一个小缝。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, tā kàndào bāo de dǐbiān yǒu yī gè xiǎo fèng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, he saw a small gap at the bottom of the bag.

sentences.chinese: 他伸手去摸，摸到了一个冰冷的东西。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shēnshǒu qù mō, mō dàole yī gè bīnglěng de dōngxi.
sentences.english: He reached out to feel, and touched something cold.

sentences.chinese: 他慢慢地把它拿出来，发现正是那把钥匙！
sentences.pinyin: Tā mànmàn de bǎ tā ná chūlái, fāxiàn zhèngshì nà bǎ yàoshi!
sentences.english: He slowly pulled it out and found it was exactly that key!

sentences.chinese: 大明高兴地笑了，他觉得生活真是奇妙。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng gāoxìng de xiàole, tā juéde shēnghuó zhēnshì qímiào.
sentences.english: Da Ming smiled happily; he felt that life is truly wonderful.

sentences.chinese: 他站起来，对女人说：“我们现在去那个漂亮的喷泉吧！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhàn qǐlái, duì nǚrén shuō: “Wǒmen xiànzài qù nàge piàoliang de pēnxuán ba!”
sentences.english: He stood up and said to the woman, "Let's go to that beautiful fountain now!"

sentences.chinese: 他们一起走在温暖的阳光中间，心情非常好。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen yīqǐ zǒu zài wēnnuǎn de yángguāng zhōngjiān, xīnqíng fēicháng hǎo.
sentences.english: They walked together in the middle of the warm sunshine, feeling very good.

sentences.chinese: 大明和那个女人走在街上。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng hé nà gè nǚ rén zǒu zài jiē shàng.
sentences.english: Da Ming and the woman were walking on the street.

sentences.chinese: 她告诉大明，她来自中国。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Dà míng, tā láizì Zhōng guó.
sentences.english: She told Da Ming that she came from China.

sentences.chinese: 大明很惊讶，因为他今年想去中国旅游。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng hěn jīng yà, yīnwèi tā jīn nián xiǎng qù Zhōng guó lǚ yóu.
sentences.english: Da Ming was very surprised because he wanted to travel to China this year.

sentences.chinese: 他们走到了一个漂亮的书店门口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zǒu dào le yī gè piào liang de shū diàn mén kǒu.
sentences.english: They walked to the entrance of a beautiful bookstore.

sentences.chinese: 女人指着书店里的东西说：“你看，那里有很有意思的书。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ rén zhǐ zhe shū diàn lǐ de dōng xī shuō: “Nǐ kàn, nà lǐ yǒu hěn yǒu yì si de shū.”
sentences.english: The woman pointed to the things in the bookstore and said, "Look, there are very interesting books there."

sentences.chinese: 大明看了看，发现那里有一本很大的地图书。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng kàn le kàn, fā xiàn nà lǐ yǒu yī běn hěn dà de dì tú shū.
sentences.english: Da Ming looked and found there was a very large map book there.

sentences.chinese: 他问女人：“你们也喜欢看地图吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn nǚ rén: “Nǐ men yě xǐ huan kàn dì tú ma?”
sentences.english: He asked the woman, "Do you (plural) also like looking at maps?"

sentences.chinese: 女人笑了，她说：“是的，我们都喜欢。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ rén xiào le, tā shuō: “Shì de, wǒ men dōu xǐ huan.”
sentences.english: The woman smiled and said, "Yes, we all do."

sentences.chinese: 他们走进书店，里边很安静。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zǒu jìn shū diàn, lǐ bian hěn ā jìng.
sentences.english: They entered the bookstore; it was very quiet inside.

sentences.chinese: 女人在书架前停下来，翻开书的一页。
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ rén zài shū jià qián tíng xià lái, fān kāi shū de yī yè.
sentences.english: The woman stopped in front of a bookshelf and turned to a page of the book.

sentences.chinese: 她指着那儿说：“这里是我的家乡。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐ zhe nà r shuō: “Zhè lǐ shì wǒ de jiā xiāng.”
sentences.english: She pointed there and said, "This place is my hometown."

sentences.chinese: 大明看着那些漂亮的图片，觉得非常神奇。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng kàn zhe nà xiē piào liang de tú piàn, jué de fēi cháng shén qí.
sentences.english: Da Ming looked at those beautiful pictures and felt it was very magical.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个男人走过来，他对他们说：“你们好！”
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yī gè nán rén zǒu guò lái, tā duì tā men shuō: “Nǐ men hǎo!”
sentences.english: At this moment, a man walked over and said to them, "Hello!"

sentences.chinese: 男人说，他是这个书店的老板，他的店在医院对面。
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén shuō, tā shì zhè gè shū diàn de lǎo bǎn, tā de diàn zài yī yuàn duì miàn.
sentences.english: The man said he was the owner of this bookstore, and his shop was opposite the hospital.

sentences.chinese: 他热情地邀请大明和女人去他的工作室看看。
sentences.pinyin: Tā rè qíng de yāo qǐng Dà míng hé nǚ rén qù tā de gōng zuò shì kàn kàn.
sentences.english: He warmly invited Da Ming and the woman to visit his studio.

sentences.chinese: 工作室在书店的楼下。
sentences.pinyin: Gōng zuò shì zài shū diàn de lóu xià.
sentences.english: The studio was downstairs from the bookstore.

sentences.chinese: 男人开门说：“请进！”
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén kāi mén shuō: “Qǐng jìn!”
sentences.english: The man opened the door and said, "Please come in!"

sentences.chinese: 房间里很整洁，有一台先进的电脑。
sentences.pinyin: Fáng jiān lǐ hěn zhěng jié, yǒu yī tái xiān jìn de diàn nǎo.
sentences.english: The room was very tidy, and there was an advanced computer.

sentences.chinese: 男人说：“我在网上买了很多关于艺术的东西。”
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén shuō: “Wǒ zài wǎng shàng mǎi le hěn duō guān yú yì shù de dōng xī.”
sentences.english: The man said, "I bought many things related to art online."

sentences.chinese: 他指着墙上的几件艺术品说：“这些是我最喜欢的。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐ zhe qiáng shàng de jǐ jiàn yì shù pǐn shuō: “Zhè xiē shì wǒ zuì xǐ huan de.”
sentences.english: He pointed to a few artworks on the wall and said, "These are my favorites."

sentences.chinese: 大明看着那些艺术品，觉得这里像一个小型图书馆。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng kàn zhe nà xiē yì shù pǐn, jué de zhè r xiàng yī gè xiǎo xíng tú shū guǎn.
sentences.english: Da Ming looked at those artworks and felt this place was like a small library.

sentences.chinese: 男人请他们坐下，说：“请坐。”
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén qǐng tā men zuò xià, shuō: “Qǐng zuò.”
sentences.english: The man asked them to sit down and said, "Please have a seat."

sentences.chinese: 大明注意到男人穿着一件很特别的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng zhù yì dào nán rén chuān zhe yī jiàn hěn tè bié de yī fu.
sentences.english: Da Ming noticed the man was wearing a very special piece of clothing.

sentences.chinese: 男人说：“这件衣服是新年的时候买的。”
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén shuō: “Zhè jiàn yī fu shì xīn nián de shí hou mǎi de.”
sentences.english: The man said, "This clothing was bought during the New Year."

sentences.chinese: 大明觉得这个下午真是太奇妙了。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng jué de zhè gè xià wǔ zhēn shì tài qí miào le.
sentences.english: Da Ming felt this afternoon was truly wonderful.

sentences.chinese: 他看向那个女人，发现她正在认真地看一张旧照片。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng nà gè nǚ rén, fā xiàn tā zhèng zài rèn zhēn de kàn yī zhāng jiù zhào piàn.
sentences.english: He looked at the woman and found she was seriously looking at an old photo.

sentences.chinese: 大明走过去，问她：“那儿有什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng zǒu guò qù, wèn tā: “Nà r yǒu shén me?”
sentences.english: Da Ming walked over and asked her, "What is there?"

sentences.chinese: 女人没有说话，她的眼睛里有泪水。
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ rén méi yǒu shuō huà, tā de yǎn jīng lǐ yǒu lèi shuǐ.
sentences.english: The woman didn't speak; there were tears in her eyes.

sentences.chinese: 她慢慢地把照片递给大明，照片上的场景让他愣住了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā màn màn de bǎ zhào piàn dì gěi Dà míng, zhào piàn shàng de chǎng jǐng ràng tā lèng zhù le.
sentences.english: She slowly handed the photo to Da Ming, and the scene in the photo left him stunned.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十一章：旧照片的故事
chapters.title_english: Chapter 11: The Story of the Old Photo

sentences.chinese: 照片上的地方不大，但看起来很温暖。
sentences.pinyin: Zhàopiàn shàng de dìfāng bù dà, dàn kàn qǐlái hěn wēnnuǎn.
sentences.english: The place in the photo was not very large, but it looked very warm.

sentences.chinese: 大明仔细看，发现照片里有一个小饭店。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng zǐxì kàn, fāxiàn zhàopiàn lǐ yǒu yī gè xiǎo fàndiàn.
sentences.english: Daming looked closely and found there was a small restaurant in the photo.

sentences.chinese: 照片里有两个男孩子，他们正在开心地下棋。
sentences.pinyin: Zhàopiàn lǐ yǒu liǎng gè nán háizi, tāmen zhèngzài kāixīn de xiàqí.
sentences.english: There were two boys in the photo, and they were happily playing chess.

sentences.chinese: 那个女人轻声说：“这是我的哥哥和我的父亲。”
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè nǚrén qīngshēng shuō: “Zhè shì wǒ de gēge hé wǒ de fùqīn.”
sentences.english: The woman said softly, "This is my brother and my father."

sentences.chinese: 大明问：“你现在还认识他们吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng wèn: “Nǐ xiànzài hái rènshi tāmen ma?”
sentences.english: Daming asked, "Do you still know them now?"

sentences.chinese: 女人摇摇头，眼睛里还是有泪水。
sentences.pinyin: Nǚrén yáoyáo tóu, yǎnjīng lǐ háishì yǒu lèishuǐ.
sentences.english: The woman shook her head, and there were still tears in her eyes.

sentences.chinese: 她说：“我已经半年没有见到他们了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ yǐjīng bàn nián méiyǒu jiàn dào tāmen le.”
sentences.english: She said, "I haven't seen them for half a year."

sentences.chinese: 大明觉得心里有点不舒服，他想帮帮她。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng juéde xīnlǐ yǒudiǎn bù shūfu, tā xiǎng bāngbang tā.
sentences.english: Daming felt a bit uncomfortable in his heart; he wanted to help her.

sentences.chinese: 他注意到照片的右边一半被撕掉了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhùyì dào zhàopiàn de yòubiān yī bàn bèi sī diào le.
sentences.english: He noticed that half of the right side of the photo had been torn off.

sentences.chinese: 他想，这不对，照片应该是完整的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, zhè bù duì, zhàopiàn yīnggāi shì wánzhěng de.
sentences.english: He thought, this is not right; the photo should be complete.

sentences.chinese: 他问：“您知道另一半在哪里吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn: “Nín zhīdào lìng yī bàn zài nǎlǐ ma?”
sentences.english: He asked, "Do you know where the other half is?"

sentences.chinese: 女人说：“我忘了，我真的忘了。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚrén shuō: “Wǒ wàng le, wǒ zhēn de wàng le.”
sentences.english: The woman said, "I forgot, I really forgot."

sentences.chinese: 大明看着她，觉得她现在很伤心。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng kànzhe tā, juéde tā xiànzài hěn shāngxīn.
sentences.english: Daming looked at her and felt she was very sad right now.

sentences.chinese: 他想，生活有时候会有坏的事情发生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, shēnghuó yǒushíhou huì yǒu huài de shìqing fāshēng.
sentences.english: He thought that sometimes bad things happen in life.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉她：“没关系，我们可以一起去找。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosu tā: “Méi guānxi, wǒmen kěyǐ yīqǐ qù zhǎo.”
sentences.english: He told her, "It's okay, we can go look for it together."

sentences.chinese: 女人看着大明，慢慢地笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Nǚrén kànzhe Dàmíng, mànmàn de xiào le.
sentences.english: The woman looked at Daming and slowly smiled.

sentences.chinese: 她发现大明虽然年轻，但心肠很好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn Dàmíng suīrán niánqīng, dàn xīncháng hěn hǎo.
sentences.english: She found that although Daming was young, he had a very kind heart.

sentences.chinese: 大明看了看时间，现在是三点半。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng kànle kàn shíjiān, xiànzài shì sān diǎn bàn.
sentences.english: Daming checked the time; it was now three-thirty.

sentences.chinese: 他想起那个奇怪的手机号码，那是零点零二分打来的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ nàgè qíguài de shǒujī hàomǎ, nà shì líng diǎn líng èr fēn dǎ lái de.
sentences.english: He remembered that strange phone number; it had called at zero hours and zero two minutes.

sentences.chinese: 他没有忘记那个电话，因为那很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu wàngjì nàgè diànhuà, yīnwèi nà hěn qíguài.
sentences.english: He had not forgotten that call because it was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 他建议说：“我们先去吃饭，慢慢想办法。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiànyì shuō: “Wǒmen xiān qù chīfàn, mànmàn xiǎng bànfǎ.”
sentences.english: He suggested, "Let's eat first and think of a solution slowly."

sentences.chinese: 他们走进一家小店，点了一打饺子。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒujìn yī jiā xiǎo diàn, diǎnle yī dǎ jiǎozi.
sentences.english: They walked into a small shop and ordered a dozen dumplings.

sentences.chinese: 在这里，时间走得很慢，但心情变好了。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhèlǐ, shíjiān zǒu de hěn màn, dàn xīnqíng biàn hǎo le.
sentences.english: Here, time moved very slowly, but their mood improved.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，大明的手机突然又响了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, Dàmíng de shǒujī tūrán yòu xiǎng le.
sentences.english: But just then, Daming's phone suddenly rang again.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 12: Melodies of a Rainy Day

sentences.chinese: 大明看着手机，那个奇怪的号码再次打电话来了。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng kàn zhe shǒu jī, nà ge qí guài de hào mǎ zài cì dǎ diàn huà lái.
sentences.english: Daming looked at his phone; that strange number was calling again.

sentences.chinese: 他还没有忘记那个电话，因为那很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hái méi yǒu wàng jì nà ge diàn huà, yīn wèi nà hěn qí guài.
sentences.english: He had not forgotten that call because it was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 他看向身边的女人，她轻轻地说：“你接电话吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng shēn biān de nǚ rén, tā qīng qīng de shuō: “Nǐ jiē diàn huà ba.”
sentences.english: He looked at the woman beside him, and she softly said, "Answer the phone."

sentences.chinese: 大明接起电话，但对方没有说话，只有一段好听的歌声。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng jiē qǐ diàn huà, dàn duì fāng méi yǒu shuō huà, zhǐ yǒu yī duàn hǎo tīng de gē shēng.
sentences.english: Daming answered, but the other party didn't speak; there was only a pleasant song.

sentences.chinese: 他听见了一个人在唱歌，那首歌很温柔。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīng jiàn le yī gè rén zài chàng gē, nà shǒu gē hěn wēn róu.
sentences.english: He heard someone singing; the song was very gentle.

sentences.chinese: 他听到这个声音，突然记得起了一个老朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīng dào zhè ge shēng yīn, tū rán jì de qǐ le yī gè lǎo péng yǒu.
sentences.english: Hearing this voice, he suddenly remembered an old friend.

sentences.chinese: 他问对方：“你是谁？你为什么给我打电话？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn duì fāng: “Nǐ shì shuí? Nǐ wèi shén me gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà?”
sentences.english: He asked the other party, "Who are you? Why are you calling me?"

sentences.chinese: 对方还是没有说话，电话突然挂断了。
sentences.pinyin: Duì fāng hái shì méi yǒu shuō huà, diàn huà tū rán guà duàn le.
sentences.english: The other party still didn't speak, and the call suddenly disconnected.

sentences.chinese: 大明愣住了，他看着窗外，发现外面开始下雨了。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng lèng zhù le, tā kàn zhe chuāng wài, fā xiàn wài miàn kāi shǐ xià yǔ le.
sentences.english: Daming was stunned; he looked out the window and found it had started to rain.

sentences.chinese: 雨很大，他们不能现在出去。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ hěn dà, tā men bù néng xiàn zài chū qù.
sentences.english: The rain was heavy; they could not go out now.

sentences.chinese: 女人对他说：“我们先在这里休息一下吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ rén duì tā shuō: “Wǒ men xiān zài zhè lǐ xiū xi yī xià ba.”
sentences.english: The woman said to him, "Let's rest here for a while first."

sentences.chinese: 大明坐下，喝了一口热茶，心情慢慢平静下来。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng zuò xia, hē le yī kǒu rè chá, xīn qíng màn màn píng jìng xià lái.
sentences.english: Daming sat down, drank a sip of hot tea, and his mood slowly calmed down.

sentences.chinese: 他拿出纸和笔，想写一些东西记录这个奇怪的下午。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū zhǐ hé bǐ, xiǎng xiě yī xiē dōng xī jì lù zhè ge qí guài de xià wǔ.
sentences.english: He took out paper and a pen, wanting to write some things to record this strange afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果现在回家，可能会被雨淋湿。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rú guǒ xiàn zài huí jiā, kě néng huì bèi yǔ lín shī.
sentences.english: He thought that if he went home now, he might get soaked by the rain.

sentences.chinese: 他问女人：“你今天需要回去吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn nǚ rén: “Nǐ jīn tiān xū yào huí qu ma?”
sentences.english: He asked the woman, "Do you need to go back today?"

sentences.chinese: 女人摇摇头说：“我想在这里等雨停，然后才回家。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ rén yáo yáo tóu shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng zài zhè lǐ děng yǔ tíng, rán hòu cái huí jiā.”
sentences.english: The woman shook her head and said, "I want to wait for the rain to stop here, and then go home."

sentences.chinese: 大明看到窗外有一只小鸟，它在雨中飞向一个屋檐。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng kàn dào chuāng wài yǒu yī zhī xiǎo niǎo, tā zài yǔ zhōng fēi xiàng yī gè wū yán.
sentences.english: Daming saw a small bird outside the window, flying toward an eave in the rain.

sentences.chinese: 小鸟跑向干燥的地方，然后安静地睡在那里。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo niǎo pǎo xiàng gān zào de dì fāng, rán hòu ānjìng de shuì zài nà lǐ.
sentences.english: The little bird ran toward a dry place and then slept quietly there.

sentences.chinese: 大明想，动物睡觉的样子真简单。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng xiǎng, dòng wù shuì jiào de yàng zi zhēn jiǎn dān.
sentences.english: Daming thought the way animals sleep is truly simple.

sentences.chinese: 突然，店老板走过来，对大明说：“你们想多坐一会儿吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, diàn lǎo bǎn zǒu guò lái, duì dà míng shuō: “Nǐ men xiǎng duō zuò yī huì r ma?”
sentences.english: Suddenly, the shop owner walked over and said to Daming, "Would you like to sit for a while longer?"

sentences.chinese: 大明笑着说：“谢谢，我们想在这里多待一会儿。”
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng xiào zhe shuō: “Xiè xie, wǒ men xiǎng zài zhè lǐ duō dāi yī huì r.”
sentences.english: Daming smiled and said, "Thank you, we would like to stay here a bit longer."

sentences.chinese: 他想起自己明天放假，所以不用担心时间。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ zì jǐ míng tiān fàng jià, suǒ yǐ bù yòng dān xīn shí jiān.
sentences.english: He remembered that he had a holiday tomorrow, so he didn't need to worry about the time.

sentences.chinese: 但突然，大明想到了他的工作，他记得自己还没有给老板请假。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tū rán, dà míng xiǎng dào le tā de gōng zuò, tā jì de zì jǐ hái méi yǒu gěi lǎo bǎn qǐng jià.
sentences.english: But suddenly, Daming thought of his work; he remembered he hadn't requested leave from his boss.

sentences.chinese: 如果明天不能去工作，老板可能会生气。
sentences.pinyin: Rú guǒ míng tiān bù néng qù gōng zuò, lǎo bǎn kě néng huì shēng qì.
sentences.english: If he couldn't go to work tomorrow, the boss might be angry.

sentences.chinese: 他赶紧地在手机上给老板发信息，告诉他自己可能生病了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎn jǐn de zài shǒu jī shàng gěi lǎo bǎn fā xìn xī, gào su tā zì jǐ kě néng shēng bìng le.
sentences.english: He hurriedly sent a message to his boss on his phone, telling him he might be ill.

sentences.chinese: 虽然他没有生病，但他不想在雨天跑来跑去。
sentences.pinyin: Suī rán tā méi yǒu shēng bìng, dàn tā bù xiǎng zài yǔ tiān pǎo lái pǎo qù.
sentences.english: Although he wasn't ill, he didn't want to run around in the rain.

sentences.chinese: 女人看着他，轻声说：“你不用那么担心。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ rén kàn zhe tā, qīng shēng shuō: “Nǐ bù yòng nà me dān xīn.”
sentences.english: The woman looked at him and softly said, "You don't need to worry so much."

sentences.chinese: 大明笑了，他觉得这个雨天其实很安静。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng xiào le, tā jué de zhè ge yǔ tiān qí shí hěn ānjìng.
sentences.english: Daming smiled; he felt this rainy day was actually very peaceful.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个熟人走进了店里，大明喊道：“快进来！”
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yī gè shú rén zǒu jìn le diàn lǐ, dà míng hǎn dào: “Kuài jìn lái!”
sentences.english: At this moment, an acquaintance walked into the shop, and Daming shouted, "Come in quickly!"

sentences.chinese: 那个人看到大明，惊讶地走进去，坐在他们身边。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén kàn dào dà míng, jīng yà de zǒu jìn qù, zuò zài tā men shēn biān.
sentences.english: That person saw Daming, walked in with surprise, and sat beside them.

sentences.chinese: 大明终于找到了这个下午的答案，但那个电话是谁打的呢？
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng zhōng yú zhǎo dào le zhè ge xià wǔ de dá àn, dàn nà ge diàn huà shì shuí dǎ de ne?
sentences.english: Daming finally found the answer to this afternoon, but who made that phone call?

sentences.chinese: 走进店里的熟人叫王先生。
sentences.pinyin: Zǒu jìn diàn lǐ de shú rén jiào Wáng xiān sheng.
sentences.english: The acquaintance who walked into the shop was called Mr. Wang.

sentences.chinese: 大明记得上次见他是在去年。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng jì de shàng cì jiàn tā shì zài qù nián.
sentences.english: Da Ming remembered that the last time he saw him was last year.

sentences.chinese: 王先生看着大明，笑着说：“好久不见！”
sentences.pinyin: Wáng xiān sheng kàn zhe Dà míng, xiào zhe shuō: “Hǎo jiǔ bú jiàn!”
sentences.english: Mr. Wang looked at Da Ming and smiled, saying, "Long time no see!"

sentences.chinese: 大明问他：“请问，你为什么在这里？”
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng wèn tā: “Qǐng wèn, nǐ wèi shén me zài zhè lǐ?”
sentences.english: Da Ming asked him, "Excuse me, why are you here?"

sentences.chinese: 王先生说：“我前天回到了这个城市。”
sentences.pinyin: Wáng xiān sheng shuō: “Wǒ qián tiān huí dào le zhè ge chéng shì.”
sentences.english: Mr. Wang said, "I returned to this city the day before yesterday."

sentences.chinese: 他从包里打开一个笔记本，上面写着很多日期。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng bāo lǐ dǎ kāi yí gè bǐ jì běn, shàng miàn xiě zhe hěn duō rì qī.
sentences.english: He opened a notebook from his bag, which had many dates written on it.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“昨天我在这里走，突然想到了你。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zuó tiān wǒ zài zhè lǐ zǒu, tū rán xiǎng dào le nǐ.”
sentences.english: He said, "Yesterday I was walking here and suddenly thought of you."

sentences.chinese: 大明觉得很开心，但他的肚子突然响了，他觉得很饿。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng jué de hěn kāi xīn, dàn tā de dù zi tū rán xiǎng le, tā jué de hěn è.
sentences.english: Da Ming felt very happy, but his stomach suddenly growled; he felt very hungry.

sentences.chinese: 王先生说：“没事儿，我们一起吃饺子。”
sentences.pinyin: Wáng xiān sheng shuō: “Méi shì r, wǒ men yì qǐ chī jiǎo zi.”
sentences.english: Mr. Wang said, "It's no problem, let's eat dumplings together."

sentences.chinese: 他们开始聊天，谈到了过去的事情。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men kāi shǐ liáo tiān, tán dào le guò qù de shì qíng.
sentences.english: They began to chat, talking about things from the past.

sentences.chinese: 王先生说，他有时候会想起在这里的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng xiān sheng shuō, tā yǒu shí hou huì xiǎng qǐ zài zhè lǐ de shēng huó.
sentences.english: Mr. Wang said that sometimes he thinks back to his life here.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉大明，他明年想搬到日方公司工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su Dà míng, tā míng nián xiǎng bān dào rì fāng gōng sī gōng zuò.
sentences.english: He told Da Ming that next year he wants to move to a Japanese company for work.

sentences.chinese: 大明惊讶地问：“你想去日本吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng jīng yà de wèn: “Nǐ xiǎng qù Rì běn ma?”
sentences.english: Da Ming asked in surprise, "Do you want to go to Japan?"

sentences.chinese: 王先生点头说：“是的，我想去日方那里学习。”
sentences.pinyin: Wáng xiān sheng diǎn tóu shuō: “Shì de, wǒ xiǎng qù rì fāng nà lǐ xué xí.”
sentences.english: Mr. Wang nodded and said, "Yes, I want to go to the Japanese side to study."

sentences.chinese: 大明想，生活真是奇妙，每个人都有自己的计划。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng xiǎng, shēng huó zhēn shì qí miào, měi gè rén dōu yǒu zì jǐ de jì huà.
sentences.english: Da Ming thought that life is truly wonderful, and everyone has their own plans.

sentences.chinese: 他们聊到明天要去做什么，还约了下次见面。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men liáo dào míng tiān yào qù zuò shén me, hái yuē le xià cì jiàn miàn.
sentences.english: They talked about what to do tomorrow and arranged to meet next time.

sentences.chinese: 王先生说：“我们星期天见面吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Wáng xiān sheng shuō: “Wǒ men Xīng qī tiān jiàn miàn ba.”
sentences.english: Mr. Wang said, "Let's meet on Sunday."

sentences.chinese: 大明说：“好，星期日我没事儿，我们可以去公园。”
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng shuō: “Hǎo, Xīng qī rì wǒ méi shì r, wǒ men kě yǐ qù gōng yuán.”
sentences.english: Da Ming said, "Okay, I am free on Sunday; we can go to the park."

sentences.chinese: 时间很快就到了关上店门的时候。
sentences.pinyin: Shí jiān hěn kuài jiù dào le guān shàng diàn mén de shí hou.
sentences.english: Time passed quickly until it was time to close the shop door.

sentences.chinese: 王先生站起来，说：“我送你回家吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Wáng xiān sheng zhàn qǐ lái, shuō: “Wǒ sòng nǐ huí jiā ba.”
sentences.english: Mr. Wang stood up and said, "Let me see you home."

sentences.chinese: 大明笑着说：“不用了，我自己个儿走回家就行。”
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng xiào zhe shuō: “Bú yòng le, wǒ zì jǐ gè r zǒu huí jiā jiù xíng.”
sentences.english: Da Ming smiled and said, "No need, I can just walk home by myself."

sentences.chinese: 大明对王先生说：“再见！”
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng duì Wáng xiān sheng shuō: “Zài jiàn!”
sentences.english: Da Ming said to Mr. Wang, "Goodbye!"

sentences.chinese: 就在大明准备离开时，他突然想起了那个奇怪的电话。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài Dà míng zhǔn bèi lí kāi shí, tā tū rán xiǎng qǐ le nà gè qí guài de diàn huà.
sentences.english: Just as Da Ming was preparing to leave, he suddenly remembered that strange phone call.

sentences.chinese: 他看向手机，发现那个号码又发来了一条信息。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng shǒu jī, fā xiàn nà gè hào mǎ yòu fā lái le yì tiáo xìn xī.
sentences.english: He looked at his phone and found that the number had sent another message.

sentences.chinese: 大明站在马路上，看着手机上的信息。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng zhàn zài mǎlù shàng, kànzhe shǒujī shàng de xìnxī.
sentences.english: Daming stood on the road, looking at the message on his phone.

sentences.chinese: 信息说：“我在车站等你，我想告诉你一个秘密。”
sentences.pinyin: Xìnxī shuō: “Wǒ zài chēzhàn děng nǐ, wǒ xiǎng gàosù nǐ yīgè mìmì.”
sentences.english: The message said: "I am waiting for you at the station, I want to tell you a secret."

sentences.chinese: 大明觉得很奇怪，但他想知道是谁。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng juéde hěn qíguài, dàn tā xiǎng zhīdào shì shéi.
sentences.english: Daming felt it was very strange, but he wanted to know who it was.

sentences.chinese: 他决定打车去那个车站。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juédìng dǎchē qù nàgè chēzhàn.
sentences.english: He decided to take a taxi to that station.

sentences.chinese: 出租车司机开车很快，窗外的景色在快速移动。
sentences.pinyin: Chūzūchē sījī kāichē hěn kuài, chuāngwài de jǐngsè zài kuàisù yídòng.
sentences.english: The taxi driver drove very fast, and the scenery outside the window moved quickly.

sentences.chinese: 司机问他：“你去哪里？”
sentences.pinyin: Sījī wèn tā: “Nǐ qù nǎlǐ?”
sentences.english: The driver asked him: "Where are you going?"

sentences.chinese: 大明说：“我去市中心的车站。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng shuō: “Wǒ qù shì zhōngxīn de chēzhàn.”
sentences.english: Daming said: "I'm going to the downtown station."

sentences.chinese: 他在车上想，这个号码是不是和之前的照片有关？
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài chēshàng xiǎng, zhège hàomǎ shì bù shì hé zhīqián de zhàopiàn yǒuguān?
sentences.english: On the car, he wondered if this number was related to the previous photo.

sentences.chinese: 司机说：“到了，请下车。”
sentences.pinyin: Sījī shuō: “Dàole, qǐng xiàchē.”
sentences.english: The driver said: "We've arrived, please get off."

sentences.chinese: 大明下车后，在车站看到了一个新朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xiàchē hòu, zài chēzhàn kàndàole yīgè xīn péngyǒu.
sentences.english: After getting off, Daming saw a new friend at the station.

sentences.chinese: 那是一个叫新先生的人，他看起来很像一个老师。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì yīgè jiào Xīn xiānshēng de rén, tā kàn qǐlái hěn xiàng yīgè lǎoshī.
sentences.english: It was a person named Mr. Xin, who looked very much like a teacher.

sentences.chinese: 新先生说：“你好，大明！我刚下课，然后就来了。”
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiānshēng shuō: “Nǐ hǎo, Dàmíng! Wǒ gāng xiàkè, ránhòu jiù lái le.”
sentences.english: Mr. Xin said: "Hello, Daming! I just finished class, and then I came."

sentences.chinese: 大明惊讶地问：“你怎么知道我？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng jīngyà de wèn: “Nǐ zěnme zhīdào wǒ?”
sentences.english: Daming asked in surprise: "How do you know me?"

sentences.chinese: 新先生笑了，他说：“我是王先生的朋友，他比我年轻，但我比他知道更多。”
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiānshēng xiàole, tā shuō: “Wǒ shì Wáng xiānshēng de péngyǒu, tā bǐ wǒ niánqīng, dàn wǒ bǐ tā zhīdào gèng duō.”
sentences.english: Mr. Xin smiled and said: "I am Mr. Wang's friend; he is younger than me, but I know more than he does."

sentences.chinese: 新先生拿出一张车票和一张门票。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiānshēng ná chū yī zhāng chēpiào hé yī zhāng ménpiào.
sentences.english: Mr. Xin took out a vehicle ticket and an admission ticket.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“这是去北京的票，我想请你去北京看一个地方。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zhè shì qù Běijīng de piào, wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ qù Běijīng kàn yīgè dìfāng.”
sentences.english: He said: "These are tickets to Beijing; I want to invite you to go to Beijing to see a place."

sentences.chinese: 大明愣住了，他问：“为什么是我？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng lèng zhù le, tā wèn: “Wèishéme shì wǒ?”
sentences.english: Daming was stunned and asked: "Why me?"

sentences.chinese: 新先生说：“没什么，只是觉得你是个好人。”
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiānshēng shuō: “Méishénme, zhǐshì juéde nǐ shì gè hǎorén.”
sentences.english: Mr. Xin said: "It's nothing, I just feel that you are a good person."

sentences.chinese: 大明说：“谢谢你！”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng shuō: “Xièxiè nǐ!”
sentences.english: Daming said: "Thank you!"

sentences.chinese: 新先生说：“不客气。”
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiānshēng shuō: “Bù kèqi.”
sentences.english: Mr. Xin said: "You're welcome."

sentences.chinese: 大明想，他现在不用回家了，因为这个邀请太神奇了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xiǎng, tā xiànzài bùyòng huí jiā le, yīnwèi zhège yāoqǐng tài shénqí le.
sentences.english: Daming thought that he didn't need to go home now because this invitation was too magical.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，新先生的手机响了，他说：“我的同事下班了，他现在要来接我。”
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, Xīn xiānshēng de shǒujī xiǎng le, tā shuō: “Wǒ de tóngshì xiàbān le, tā xiànzài yào lái jiē wǒ.”
sentences.english: Just then, Mr. Xin's phone rang, and he said: "My colleague has finished work, and he is coming to pick me up now."

sentences.chinese: 新先生打开手机，把信息重读了一遍。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiānshēng kāi dǎ shǒujī, bǎ xìnxī chóng dú le yī biàn.
sentences.english: Mr. Xin opened his phone and read the message again.

sentences.chinese: 他突然脸色变得严肃，看向远方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán liǎnsè biàn de yánsù, kàn xiàng yuǎnfāng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, his expression became serious as he looked into the distance.

sentences.chinese: 大明问：“怎么了？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng wèn: “Zěnme le?”
sentences.english: Daming asked: "What's wrong?"

sentences.chinese: 新先生没有说话，只是指了指远处的一辆黑车。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiānshēng méiyǒu shuōhuà, zhǐshì zhǐ le zhǐ yuǎnchù de yī liàng hēichē.
sentences.english: Mr. Xin didn't speak, he just pointed to a black car in the distance.

sentences.chinese: 大明赶紧上车，但他在车上感觉到一种不安。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng gǎnjǐn shàngchē, dàn tā zài chēshàng gǎnjué dào yī zhǒng bù'ān.
sentences.english: Daming quickly got into the car, but inside the car, he felt a sense of unease.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十五章：黑车里的秘密
chapters.title_english: Chapter 15: Secrets in the Black Car

sentences.chinese: 黑车在街道上慢慢走。
sentences.pinyin: Hēichē zài jiēdào shàng mànman zǒu.
sentences.english: The black car drove slowly along the street.

sentences.chinese: 大明坐在车里，心里有一些不安。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng zuò zài chē lǐ, xīnlǐ yǒu yīxiē bù'ān.
sentences.english: Daming sat in the car, feeling some unease in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 他问新先生：“我们现在去哪？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn Xīn xiānsheng: “Wǒmen xiànzài qù nǎ?”
sentences.english: He asked Mr. Xin, "Where are we going now?"

sentences.chinese: 新先生没有说话，他看着窗外。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiānsheng méiyǒu shuōhuà, tā kànzhe chuāngwài.
sentences.english: Mr. Xin didn't speak; he looked out the window.

sentences.chinese: 大明看到窗外有一些人，有的在走路，有的在说话。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng kàndào chuāngwài yǒu yīxiē rén, yǒu de zài zǒulù, yǒu de zài shuōhuà.
sentences.english: Daming saw some people outside; some were walking, and some were talking.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这些别人看起来都很开心，但他的心情太复杂了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde zhèxiē biérén kàn qǐlái dōu hěn kāixīn, dàn tā de xīnqíng tài fùzá le.
sentences.english: He felt that these other people looked very happy, but his own mood was too complex.

sentences.chinese: 他想，生活怎么会突然变得这么奇怪？
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, shēnghuó zěnme huì tūrán biànde zhème qíguài?
sentences.english: He thought, how could life suddenly become so strange?

sentences.chinese: 车子开过一个十字路口，大明看到路边有六个红色的小房子。
sentences.pinyin: Chēzi kāiguò yīgè shízì lùkǒu, Dàmíng kàndào lùbiān yǒu liù gè hóngsè de xiǎo fángzi.
sentences.english: The car passed through an intersection, and Daming saw six small red houses by the road.

sentences.chinese: 然后，他看到了七个漂亮的小花坛。
sentences.pinyin: Ránhòu, tā kàndào le qī gè piàoliang de xiǎo huātán.
sentences.english: Then, he saw seven beautiful small flower beds.

sentences.chinese: 他又数了数，那边有八个孩子在玩，还有九个气球在天上飞。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòu shǔle shǔ, nàbiān yǒu bā gè háizi zài wán, hái yǒu jiǔ gè qìqiú zài tiānshàng fēi.
sentences.english: He counted again; there were eight children playing over there, and nine balloons flying in the sky.

sentences.chinese: 新先生突然开口了，他说：“你是不是在数数？”
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiānsheng tūrán kāikǒu le, tā shuō: “Nǐ shì bù shì zài shǔshù?”
sentences.english: Mr. Xin suddenly spoke and said, "Are you counting?"

sentences.chinese: 大明愣住了，他不好意思地说：“我只是在看。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng lèngzhù le, tā bù hǎoyìsi de shuō: “Wǒ zhǐshì zài kàn.”
sentences.english: Daming was stunned and said embarrassedly, "I'm just looking."

sentences.chinese: 新先生笑了，他说：“我常常这样，在不安的时候数数。”
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiānsheng xiào le, tā shuō: “Wǒ chángcháng zhèyàng, zài bù'ān de shíhòu shǔshù.”
sentences.english: Mr. Xin smiled and said, "I often do this, counting when I'm anxious."

sentences.chinese: 大明问：“您现在在想什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng wèn: “Nín xiànzài zài xiǎng shénme?”
sentences.english: Daming asked, "What are you thinking about right now?"

sentences.chinese: 新先生看着大明，眼神里有一些忧伤。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiānsheng kànzhe Dàmíng, yǎnshén lǐ yǒu yīxiē yōushāng.
sentences.english: Mr. Xin looked at Daming, with some sadness in his eyes.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“我想起了一些旧朋友，她们曾经在这里住过。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ xiǎngqǐ le yīxiē jiù péngyǒu, tāmen céngjīng zài zhèlǐ zhù guò.”
sentences.english: He said, "I thought of some old friends; they used to live here."

sentences.chinese: 大明好奇地问：“她们是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng hàoqí de wèn: “Tāmen shì shéi?”
sentences.english: Daming asked curiously, "Who are they?"

sentences.chinese: 新先生指了指路边的第二家书店，说：“在那里，我认识了很多人。”
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiānsheng zhǐle zhǐ lùbiān de dì èr jiā shūdiàn, shuō: “Zài nàlǐ, wǒ rènshi le hěnduō rén.”
sentences.english: Mr. Xin pointed to the second bookstore by the road and said, "There, I met many people."

sentences.chinese: 大明问：“在那儿有多少人？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng wèn: “Zài nà'er yǒu duōshǎo rén?”
sentences.english: Daming asked, "How many people were there?"

sentences.chinese: 新先生说：“大概十个人，我们常常一起读书。”
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiānsheng shuō: “Dàgài shí gè rén, wǒmen chángcháng yīqǐ dúshū.”
sentences.english: Mr. Xin said, "About ten people; we often read books together."

sentences.chinese: 大明想，原来新先生也有这样简单而美好的回忆。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xiǎng, yuánlái Xīn xiānsheng yěyǒu zhèyàng jiǎndān ér měihǎo de huíyì.
sentences.english: Daming thought that it turned out Mr. Xin also had such simple and beautiful memories.

sentences.chinese: 但这时，车子突然停了下来。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zhèshí, chēzi tūrán tíngle xiàlái.
sentences.english: But at this moment, the car suddenly came to a stop.

sentences.chinese: 新先生问大明：“你觉得哪些东西是最重要的？”
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiānsheng wèn Dàmíng: “Nǐ juéde nǎxiē dōngxi shì zuì zhòngyào de?”
sentences.english: Mr. Xin asked Daming, "Which things do you think are the most important?"

sentences.chinese: 大明想了想，说：“可能是家人，或者是一点点小幸福。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xiǎngle xiǎng, shuō: “Kěnéng shì jiārén, huòzhě shì yī diǎndiǎn xiǎo xìngfú.”
sentences.english: Daming thought for a while and said, "Maybe family, or a little bit of small happiness."

sentences.chinese: 新先生点点头，说：“没错，但有些事情我们必须面对。”
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiānsheng diǎndiǎn tóu, shuō: “Méicuò, dàn yǒuxiē shìqíng wǒmen bìxū miànduì.”
sentences.english: Mr. Xin nodded and said, "Correct, but there are some things we must face."

sentences.chinese: 他从口袋里拿出一张纸，上面写着四个数字：五、四、三、二。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng kǒudài lǐ ná chū yī zhāng zhǐ, shàngmiàn xiězhe sì gè shùzì: wǔ, sì, sān, èr.
sentences.english: He took a piece of paper from his pocket, on which four numbers were written: five, four, three, two.

sentences.chinese: 大明很奇怪，他问：“这是什么意思？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng hěn qíguài, tā wèn: “Zhè shì shénme yìsi?”
sentences.english: Daming was very puzzled and asked, "What does this mean?"

sentences.chinese: 新先生没有回答，他看向车外的一辆白色车。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiānsheng méiyǒu huídá, tā kàn xiàng chēwài de yī liàng báisè chē.
sentences.english: Mr. Xin didn't answer; he looked at a white car outside.

sentences.chinese: 白色车里坐着两个人，他们正盯着这辆黑车看。
sentences.pinyin: Báisè chē lǐ zuòzhe liǎng gè rén, tāmen zhèng dīngzhe zhè liàng hēichē kàn.
sentences.english: Two people were sitting in the white car, staring at this black car.

sentences.chinese: 大明感觉到，这可能不是一个简单的邀请。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng gǎnjué dào, zhè kěnéng bùshì yīgè jiǎndān de yāoqǐng.
sentences.english: Daming felt that this might not be a simple invitation.

sentences.chinese: 最后，新先生低声说：“准备好，我们要下车了。”
sentences.pinyin: Zuìhòu, Xīn xiānsheng dīshēng shuō: “Zhǔnbèi hǎo, wǒmen yào xiàchē le.”
sentences.english: Finally, Mr. Xin said in a low voice, "Get ready, we are getting out of the car."

sentences.chinese: 大明心跳得很快，他不知道接下来会发生什么。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xīntiào dé hěn kuài, tā bù zhīdào jiē xiàlái huì fāshēng shénme.
sentences.english: Daming's heart beat very fast; he didn't know what would happen next.

sentences.chinese: 大明和新先生走下了车。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng hé Xīn xiān sheng zǒu xià le chē.
sentences.english: Daming and Mr. Xin got out of the car.

sentences.chinese: 他们面前是一座漂亮的房子。
sentences.pinyin: Mén they miàn qián shì yī zuò piào liang de fáng zi.
sentences.english: In front of them was a beautiful house.

sentences.chinese: 新先生说：“我们进去看一下儿吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiān sheng shuō: “Wǒ men jìn qù yī xià r ba.”
sentences.english: Mr. Xin said, "Let's go in and take a look."

sentences.chinese: 房子里有很多老人。
sentences.pinyin: Fáng zi lǐ yǒu hěn duō lǎo rén.
sentences.english: There were many elderly people in the house.

sentences.chinese: 大明看到一个老王先生在喝一杯热茶。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng kàn dào yī gè Lǎo Wáng xiān sheng zài hē yī bēi rè chá.
sentences.english: Daming saw an Old Mr. Wang drinking a cup of hot tea.

sentences.chinese: 一个可爱的女孩儿在跑，一个男孩儿在笑。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè kě ài de nǚ hái r zài pǎo, yī gè nán hái r zài xiào.
sentences.english: A cute girl was running, and a boy was laughing.

sentences.chinese: 这里有很多小孩儿，他们在一起玩，觉得很好玩儿。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ yǒu hěn duō xiǎo hái r, tā men zài yī qǐ wán, jué de hěn hǎo wán r.
sentences.english: There were many children here; they were playing together and found it very fun.

sentences.chinese: 大明看到一个奶奶在厨房里做面条儿。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng kàn dào yī gè nǎi nai zài chú fáng lǐ zuò miàn tiáo r.
sentences.english: Daming saw a grandma making noodles in the kitchen.

sentences.chinese: 一个爷爷在看书，他看起来很高兴。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè yé ye zài kàn shū, tā kàn qǐ lái hěn gāo xìng.
sentences.english: A grandpa was reading a book; he looked very happy.

sentences.chinese: 大明问新先生：“这里是谁的家？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng wèn Xīn xiān sheng: “Zhè lǐ shì shéi de jiā?”
sentences.english: Daming asked Mr. Xin, "Whose home is this?"

sentences.chinese: 新先生说：“这是一个照顾老人的地方。”
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiān sheng shuō: “Zhè shì yī gè zhào gù lǎo rén de dì fang.”
sentences.english: Mr. Xin said, "This is a place for taking care of the elderly."

sentences.chinese: 大明觉得这里很温暖，一点儿也不不安。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng jué de zhè lǐ hěn wēn nuǎn, yī diǎn r yě bù bù ān.
sentences.english: Daming felt it was very warm here, not the least bit uneasy.

sentences.chinese: 他看到桌子上有一块蛋糕，那是他最喜欢的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī kuài dàn gāo, nà shì tā zuì xǐ huan de.
sentences.english: He saw a piece of cake on the table, which was his favorite.

sentences.chinese: 他拿了一块蛋糕，吃了一口，味道很好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná le yī kuài dàn gāo, chī le yī kǒu, wèi dào hěn hǎo.
sentences.english: He took a piece of cake, took a bite, and it tasted great.

sentences.chinese: 新先生说：“我们一块儿坐下来休息吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiān sheng shuō: “Wǒ men yī kuài r zuò xià lái xiū xi ba.”
sentences.english: Mr. Xin said, "Let's sit down and rest together."

sentences.chinese: 大明想，这里的生活很慢，很舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng xiǎng, zhè lǐ de shēng huó hěn màn, hěn shū fu.
sentences.english: Daming thought that life here was slow and comfortable.

sentences.chinese: 但突然，新先生的手机响了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tū rán, Xīn xiān sheng de shǒu jī xiǎng le.
sentences.english: But suddenly, Mr. Xin's phone rang.

sentences.chinese: 新先生看了一下儿手机，脸色变了。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiān sheng kàn le yī xià r shǒu jī, liǎn sè biàn le.
sentences.english: Mr. Xin glanced at the phone, and his expression changed.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“糟糕，我忘记去机场接人了！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zāo gāo, wǒ wàng jì qù jī chǎng jiē rén le!”
sentences.english: He said, "Oh no, I forgot to pick someone up from the airport!"

sentences.chinese: 大明愣住了，他看着新先生匆忙离开。
sentences.pinyin: Dàmíng lèng zhù le, tā kàn zhe Xīn xiān sheng cōng máng lí kāi.
sentences.english: Daming was stunned as he watched Mr. Xin leave in a hurry.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个老人走到大明身边，低声说了一句话。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yī gè lǎo rén zǒu dào Dàmíng shēn biān, dī shēng shuō le yī jù huà.
sentences.english: At that moment, an elderly person walked up to Daming and whispered something.

sentences.chinese: 老人低声说：“你好，请问你的名字是什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén dī shēng shuō: “Nǐ hǎo, qǐng wèn nǐ de míng zi shì shén me?”
sentences.english: The old man whispered, "Hello, may I ask what your name is?"

sentences.chinese: 大明愣住了，他看着这个老人。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng lèng zhù le, tā kàn zhe zhè ge lǎo rén.
sentences.english: Da Ming was stunned, looking at this old man.

sentences.chinese: 老人穿着一件很干净的衣服，看起来非常温和。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén chuān zhe yī jiàn hěn gān jìng de yī fú, kàn qǐ lái fēi cháng wēn hé.
sentences.english: The old man wore very clean clothes and looked very gentle.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“我是这里的主人，我在这里等一个外国朋友。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ shì zhè lǐ de zhǔ rén, wǒ zài zhè lǐ děng yī gè wài guó péng yǒu.”
sentences.english: He said, "I am the owner here, I am waiting for a foreign friend."

sentences.chinese: 大明说：“你好，我叫大明，我刚才和新先生在一起。”
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng shuō: “Nǐ hǎo, wǒ jiào Dà míng, wǒ gāng cái hé Xīn xiān sheng zài yī qǐ.”
sentences.english: Da Ming said, "Hello, my name is Da Ming, I was with Mr. Xin just now."

sentences.chinese: 老人笑了，他轻声地笑，眼神很认真。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén xiào le, tā qīng shēng de xiào, yǎn shén hěn rèn zhēn.
sentences.english: The old man smiled, he smiled softly, and his gaze was very earnest.

sentences.chinese: 老人说：“新先生是个好人，但他总是太忙了。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén shuō: “Xīn xiān sheng shì gè hǎo rén, dàn tā zǒng shì tài máng le.”
sentences.english: The old man said, "Mr. Xin is a good man, but he is always too busy."

sentences.chinese: 他请大明走进屋子，屋子里的家具很好看。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qǐng Dà míng zǒu jìn wū zi, wū zi lǐ de jiā jù hěn hǎo kàn.
sentences.english: He invited Da Ming into the house, and the furniture inside was very nice-looking.

sentences.chinese: 老人说：“请坐，你先喝杯茶，我们慢慢聊。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén shuō: “Qǐng zuò, nǐ xiān hē bēi chá, wǒ men màn màn liáo.”
sentences.english: The old man said, "Please sit, have some tea first, and we can chat slowly."

sentences.chinese: 大明坐在椅子上，觉得这里的气氛很舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng zuò zài yǐ zi shàng, jué de zhè lǐ de qì fēn hěn shū fú.
sentences.english: Da Ming sat on the chair and felt the atmosphere here was very comfortable.

sentences.chinese: 老人告诉大明，他以前在大学教汉语。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén gào sù Dà míng, tā yǐ qián zài dà xué jiāo Hàn yǔ.
sentences.english: The old man told Da Ming that he used to teach Chinese at a university.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“学习中文很有意思，虽然有些字很难，但非常有意义。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Xué xí Zhōng wén hěn yǒu yì si, suī rán yǒu xiē zì hěn nán, dàn fēi cháng yǒu yì yì.”
sentences.english: He said, "Learning Chinese is very interesting; although some characters are difficult, it is very meaningful."

sentences.chinese: 大明觉得很有趣，因为他也想学习外语。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng jué de hěn yǒu qù, yīn wèi tā yě xiǎng xué xí wài yǔ.
sentences.english: Da Ming found this very interesting because he also wanted to learn a foreign language.

sentences.chinese: 老人从桌子上拿出一本书，递给大明。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén cóng zhuō zi shàng ná chū yī běn shū, dì gěi Dà míng.
sentences.english: The old man took a book from the table and handed it to Da Ming.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“这本书很有用，如果你想学习，可以拿走。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zhè běn shū hěn yǒu yòng, rú guǒ nǐ xiǎng xué xí, kě yǐ ná zǒu.”
sentences.english: He said, "This book is very useful; if you want to learn, you can take it."

sentences.chinese: 大明接过书，发现这本书非常有名。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng jiē guò shū, fā xiàn zhè běn shū fēi cháng yǒu míng.
sentences.english: Da Ming took the book and found that this book was very famous.

sentences.chinese: 老人说：“学习语言最重要的是认真，不要怕出错。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén shuō: “Xué xí yǔ yán zuì zhòng yào de shì rèn zhēn, bù yào pà chū cuò.”
sentences.english: The old man said, "The most important thing in learning a language is to be conscientious; don't be afraid of making mistakes."

sentences.chinese: 大明点点头，他现在明白老人的意思了。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng diǎn diǎn tóu, tā xiàn zài míng bai lǎo rén de yì si le.
sentences.english: Da Ming nodded; he now understood the old man's meaning.

sentences.chinese: 老人问大明：“你今年多少岁了？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén wèn Dà míng: “Nǐ jīn nián duō shǎo suì le?”
sentences.english: The old man asked Da Ming, "How old are you this year?"

sentences.chinese: 大明回答了他的岁数，然后两人聊了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng huí dá le tā de suì shù, rán hòu liǎng rén liáo le qǐ lái.
sentences.english: Da Ming answered his age, and then the two of them started chatting.

sentences.chinese: 老人说：“在这个家里，最重要的事情就是安静地读书。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén shuō: “Zài zhè ge jiā lǐ, zuì zhòng yào de shì qíng shì jǐng jìng de dú shū.”
sentences.english: The old man said, "In this home, the most important thing is to read books quietly."

sentences.chinese: 大明看着窗外，想起之前那些奇怪的电话和相遇。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng kàn zhe chuāng wài, xiǎng qǐ zhī qián nà xiē qí guài de diàn huà hé xiāng yù.
sentences.english: Da Ming looked out the window, thinking of those strange phone calls and encounters before.

sentences.chinese: 他想，生活真的很有意思，每次都有新发现。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, shēng huó zhēn de hěn yǒu yì si, měi cì dōu yǒu xīn fā xiàn.
sentences.english: He thought that life is truly interesting, with new discoveries every time.

sentences.chinese: 老人突然问他：“你觉得学习中文还是学习英语更好？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén tū rán wèn tā: “Nǐ jué de xué xí Zhōng wén hái shi xué xí Yīng yǔ gèng hǎo?”
sentences.english: The old man suddenly asked him, "Do you think learning Chinese or learning English is better?"

sentences.chinese: 大明想了想，说：“我觉得中文更好，因为它很美。”
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng xiǎng le xiǎng, shuō: “Wǒ jué de Zhōng wén gèng hǎo, yīn wèi tā hěn měi.”
