sentences.english: Da Ming thought for a while and said, "I think Chinese is better because it is beautiful."

sentences.chinese: 老人听了很高兴，他给大明准备了一些点心。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén tīng le hěn gāo xìng, tā gěi Dà míng zhǔn bèi le yī xiē diǎn xīn.
sentences.english: The old man was very happy to hear this and prepared some snacks for Da Ming.

sentences.chinese: 大明吃了一口，觉得非常好吃。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng chī le yī kǒu, jué de fēi cháng hǎo chī.
sentences.english: Da Ming took a bite and found them very delicious.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“谢谢您，这些点心真的很好吃。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Xiè xie nín, zhè xiē diǎn xīn zhēn de hěn hǎo chī.”
sentences.english: He said, "Thank you, these snacks are really delicious."

sentences.chinese: 老人说：“这些点心不贵，但我花了很多时间做。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén shuō: “Zhè xiē diǎn xīn bù guì, dàn wǒ huā le hěn duō shí jiān zuò.”
sentences.english: The old man said, "These snacks are not expensive, but I spent a lot of time making them."

sentences.chinese: 大明觉得，这种简单的快乐才是最好的。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng jué de, zhè zhǒng jiǎn dān de kuài lè cái shì zuì hǎo de.
sentences.english: Da Ming felt that this kind of simple happiness was the best.

sentences.chinese: 这时，窗外突然响起了巨大的声音，像是在正月的雷声一样。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, chuāng wài tū rán xiǎng qǐ le jù dà de shēng yīn, xiàng shì zài zhēng yuè de léi shēng yī yàng.
sentences.english: At this moment, a loud sound suddenly echoed outside the window, like thunder in the first lunar month.

sentences.chinese: 大明赶紧看向门外，发现新先生回来了。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng gǎn jǐn kàn xiàng mén wài, fā xiàn Xīn xiān sheng huí lái le.
sentences.english: Da Ming quickly looked outside the door and found that Mr. Xin had returned.

sentences.chinese: 但新先生的脸上没有笑容，他看起来非常紧张。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn Xīn xiān sheng de liǎn shàng méi yǒu xiào róng, tā kàn qǐ lái fēi cháng jǐn zhāng.
sentences.english: But there was no smile on Mr. Xin's face; he looked very nervous.

sentences.chinese: 新先生走进房间，他的样子很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiān sheng zǒu jìn fáng jiān, tā de yàng zi hěn qí guài.
sentences.english: Mr. Xin walked into the room, and he looked very strange.

sentences.chinese: 大明问他：“发生什么事了？”
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng wèn tā: “fā shēng shén me shì le?”
sentences.english: Da Ming asked him, "What happened?"

sentences.chinese: 新先生没有说话，他快快地走到桌子旁边。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiān sheng méi yǒu shuō huà, tā kuài kuài de zǒu dào zhuō zi páng biān.
sentences.english: Mr. Xin didn't speak; he quickly walked to the side of the table.

sentences.chinese: 桌子上有一个杯子，里面有水。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuō zi shàng yǒu yí gè bēi zi, lǐ miàn yǒu shuǐ.
sentences.english: There was a cup on the table with water inside.

sentences.chinese: 新先生拿起手机，看着屏幕上的字。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiān sheng ná qǐ shǒu jī, kàn zhe píng mù shàng de zì.
sentences.english: Mr. Xin picked up his phone and looked at the characters on the screen.

sentences.chinese: 他低声说：“我忘记买机票了！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dī shēng shuō: “wǒ wàng jì mǎi jī piào le!”
sentences.english: He whispered, "I forgot to buy the plane ticket!"

sentences.chinese: 大明愣住了，他不知道这个时间为什么买机票。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng lèng zhù le, tā bù zhī dào zhè gè shí jiān wèi shén me mǎi jī piào.
sentences.english: Da Ming was stunned; he didn't understand why he was buying a plane ticket at this time.

sentences.chinese: 新先生说：“我有一个朋友从另一个国家来，他明天到。”
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiān sheng shuō: “wǒ yǒu yí gè péng you cóng lìng yí gè guó jiā lái, tā míng tiān dào.”
sentences.english: Mr. Xin said, "I have a friend coming from another country; he arrives tomorrow."

sentences.chinese: 大明想，这个地点离机场很远。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng xiǎng, zhè gè dì diǎn lí jī chǎng hěn yuǎn.
sentences.english: Da Ming thought that this location was very far from the airport.

sentences.chinese: 新先生在笔记本上写了一个号，那是他的电话号码。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiān sheng zài bǐ jì běn shàng xiě le yí gè hào, nà shì tā de diàn huà hào mǎ.
sentences.english: Mr. Xin wrote a number in the notebook; it was his phone number.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉大明：“这个星期我非常忙，我忘了日期。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su Dà míng: “zhè gè xīng qī wǒ fēi cháng máng, wǒ wàng le rì qī.”
sentences.english: He told Da Ming, "I have been very busy this week; I forgot the date."

sentences.chinese: 大明看着日历，现在是十月。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng kàn zhe rì lì, xiàn zài shì shí yuè.
sentences.english: Da Ming looked at the calendar; it was currently October.

sentences.chinese: 新先生说：“我得去商场，那里有很大的商店，可以买到票。”
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiān sheng shuō: “wǒ děi qù shāng chǎng, nà lǐ yǒu hěn dà de shāng diàn, kě yǐ mǎi dào piào.”
sentences.english: Mr. Xin said, "I must go to the shopping mall; there is a large store there where I can buy a ticket."

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，一个年轻的女孩子走进了房间。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, yí gè nián qīng de nǚ hái zi zǒu jìn le fáng jiān.
sentences.english: Just then, a young girl walked into the room.

sentences.chinese: 她看起来像是一个礼貌的小姐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐ lái xiàng shì yí gè lǐ mào de xiǎo jie.
sentences.english: She looked like a polite young lady.

sentences.chinese: 她对大明说：“你好，我是新先生的女儿。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì Dà míng shuō: “nǐ hǎo, wǒ shì Xīn xiān sheng de nǚ ér.”
sentences.english: She said to Da Ming, "Hello, I am Mr. Xin's daughter."

sentences.chinese: 她叫他的妈妈，大声喊道：“妈！妈妈！机票在这里！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiào tā de mā, dà shēng hǎn dào: “mā! mā ma! jī piào zài zhè lǐ!”
sentences.english: She called her mom, shouting loudly, "Mom! Mama! The plane ticket is here!"

sentences.chinese: 原来，他的妈妈帮他买好了机票。
sentences.pinyin: Yuán lái, tā de mā ma bāng tā mǎi hǎo le jī piào.
sentences.english: It turned out that his mother had helped him buy the ticket.

sentences.chinese: 新先生终于笑了，他觉得今天真是美好的一天。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiān sheng zhōng yú xiào le, tā jué de jīn tiān zhēn shì měi hǎo de yì tiān.
sentences.english: Mr. Xin finally smiled; he felt that today was truly a beautiful day.

sentences.chinese: 他看着大明说：“现在我们有时间吃晚饭了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe Dà míng shuō: “xiàn zài wǒ men yǒu shí jiān chī wǎn fàn le.”
sentences.english: He looked at Da Ming and said, "Now we have time to eat dinner."

sentences.chinese: 晚上，他们一起在家里吃晚饭。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎn shang, tā men yì qǐ zài jiā lǐ chī wǎn fàn.
sentences.english: In the evening, they ate dinner together at home.

sentences.chinese: 大明觉得这个家的人都很温暖。
sentences.pinyin: Dà míng jué de zhè gè jiā de rén dōu hěn wēn nuǎn.
sentences.english: Da Ming felt that the people in this house were all very warm.

sentences.chinese: 吃完饭，大明觉得有点累，他想去床上面休息。
sentences.pinyin: Chī wán fàn, Dà míng jué de yǒu diǎn lèi, tā xiǎng qù chuáng shàng miàn xiū xi.
sentences.english: After finishing dinner, Da Ming felt a bit tired and wanted to go rest on the bed.

books.title_english: The Magic Books of Cloud City
books.description_chinese: 林月走进了一所神奇的中学。在巨大的图书馆里，她发现了会飞的发光书。快来一起探索这个魔法世界！
books.description_english: Lin Yue enters a mysterious school in the City of Clouds. Inside a giant library, she discovers glowing books that can fly. Come explore this magical world!

sentences.chinese: 在云端之城，有一所神奇的中学。
sentences.pinyin: Zài yúnduān zhī chéng, yǒu yī suǒ shénqí de zhōngxué.
sentences.english: In the City of Clouds, there is a magical middle school.

sentences.chinese: 这里的学生都学习魔法。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de xuéshēng dōu xuéxí mófǎ.
sentences.english: The students here all study magic.

sentences.chinese: 林月是一个安静的女生。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè shì yī gè ānjìng de nǚshēng.
sentences.english: Lin Yue is a quiet girl.

sentences.chinese: 她爱看古老的魔法书。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ài kàn gǔlǎo de mófǎ shū.
sentences.english: She loves reading ancient magic books.

sentences.chinese: 林月有一个姐姐，叫林星。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè yǒu yī gè jiějie, jiào Lín Xīng.
sentences.english: Lin Yue has an older sister named Lin Xing.

sentences.chinese: 林星是一个漂亮的女人，也是学校的老师。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng shì yī gè piàoliang de nǚrén, yě shì xuéxiào de lǎoshī.
sentences.english: Lin Xing is a beautiful woman and also a teacher at the school.

sentences.chinese: 林星是林月的姐姐，她们一起住在魔法塔里。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng shì Lín Yuè de jiějie, tāmen yīqǐ zhù zài mófǎ tǎ lǐ.
sentences.english: Lin Xing is Lin Yue's older sister, and they live together in the magic tower.

sentences.chinese: 林月还有一个小妹妹，叫林小妹。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè hái yǒu yī gè xiǎo mèimei, jiào Lín Xiǎomèi.
sentences.english: Lin Yue also has a little younger sister named Lin Xiaomei.

sentences.chinese: 林小妹很可爱，她是林月最爱的妹。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎomèi hěn kě'ài, tā shì Lín Yuè zuì ài de mèi.
sentences.english: Lin Xiaomei is very cute; she is the younger sister Lin Yue loves most.

sentences.chinese: 今天，林月在家等林星回来。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān, Lín Yuè zài jiā děng Lín Xīng huílái.
sentences.english: Today, Lin Yue is at home waiting for Lin Xing to return.

sentences.chinese: 林星的女儿在另一个世界学习。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng de nǚ'ér zài lìng yī gè shìjiè xuéxí.
sentences.english: Lin Xing's daughter is studying in another world.

sentences.chinese: 一个神秘的小姐来到了林月的家。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè shénmì de xiǎojiě láidào le Lín Yuè de jiā.
sentences.english: A mysterious young lady came to Lin Yue's home.

sentences.chinese: 这个小姐穿着黑色的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè xiǎojiě chuānzhe hēisè de yīfú.
sentences.english: This young lady was wearing black clothes.

sentences.chinese: 她告诉林月，林月的力量只有一半。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Lín Yuè, Lín Yuè de lìliàng zhǐyǒu yībàn.
sentences.english: She told Lin Yue that Lin Yue's power is only half.

sentences.chinese: 另外半部分力量在深海的饭店里。
sentences.pinyin: Lìngwài bàn bùfèn lìliàng zài shēnhǎi de fàndiàn lǐ.
sentences.english: The other half of the power is in a restaurant in the deep sea.

sentences.chinese: 林月觉得很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè juédé hěn qíguài.
sentences.english: Lin Yue felt it was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 她拿了一杯水，思考这个问题。
sentences.pinyin: Tā nále yī bēi shuǐ, sīkǎo zhè gè wèntí.
sentences.english: She took a cup of water and thought about this problem.

sentences.chinese: 这时，林星回到了教学楼。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, Lín Xīng huídào le jiàoxuélóu.
sentences.english: At this moment, Lin Xing returned to the teaching block.

sentences.chinese: 林星对林月说：“快走，你的女朋友在等你。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng duì Lín Yuè shuō: “Kuài zǒu, nǐ de nǚpéngyǒu zài děng nǐ.”
sentences.english: Lin Xing said to Lin Yue, "Hurry, your girlfriend is waiting for you."

sentences.chinese: 林月脸红了，她想到了那个女孩。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè liǎnhóng le, tā xiǎngdào le nà gè nǚhái.
sentences.english: Lin Yue blushed; she thought of that girl.

sentences.chinese: 林星帮林月关上门。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng bāng Lín Yuè guānshàng mén.
sentences.english: Lin Xing helped Lin Yue close the door.

sentences.chinese: 她们走向那个充满魔法的森林。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒuxiàng nà gè chōngmǎn mófǎ de sēnlín.
sentences.english: They walked toward that forest full of magic.

sentences.chinese: 林月的冒险现在开始了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè de màoxiǎn xiànzài kāishǐ le.
sentences.english: Lin Yue's adventure begins now.

sentences.chinese: 林月走进了魔法森林。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè zǒu jìn le mó fǎ sēn lín.
sentences.english: Lin Yue walked into the magic forest.

sentences.chinese: 这里的大树很好看。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de dà shù hěn hǎo kàn.
sentences.english: The big trees here are very beautiful.

sentences.chinese: 林星在后边走地很慢。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng zài hòu bian zǒu de hěn màn.
sentences.english: Lin Xing was walking very slowly behind her.

sentences.chinese: 林月想找那个女孩。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè xiǎng zhǎo nà ge nǚ hái.
sentences.english: Lin Yue wanted to find that girl.

sentences.chinese: 她看到一块发光的石头。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào yī kuài fā guāng de shí tou.
sentences.english: She saw a glowing stone.

sentences.chinese: 石头在她的右边。
sentences.pinyin: Shí tou zài tā de yòu bian.
sentences.english: The stone was on her right side.

sentences.chinese: 林月用手动了那块石头。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè yòng shǒu dòng le nà kuài shí tou.
sentences.english: Lin Yue moved the stone with her hand.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个奇怪的小精灵出现了。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, yī gè qí guài de xiǎo jīng líng chū xiàn le.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a strange little sprite appeared.

sentences.chinese: 小精灵开口说话了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo jīng líng kāi kǒu shuō huà le.
sentences.english: The little sprite opened its mouth to speak.

sentences.chinese: “你好！我是这里的守护者。”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ shì zhè lǐ de shǒu hù zhě.”
sentences.english: "Hello! I am the guardian of this place."

sentences.chinese: 小精灵向林月介绍这个森林。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo jīng líng xiàng Lín Yuè jiè shào zhè ge sēn lín.
sentences.english: The little sprite introduced the forest to Lin Yue.

sentences.chinese: “这里的魔法很特别。”
sentences.pinyin: “Zhè lǐ de mó fǎ hěn tè bié.”
sentences.english: "The magic here is very special."

sentences.chinese: “你可以上网，但这里的网是魔法的网。”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ kě yǐ shàng wǎng, dàn zhè lǐ de wǎng shì mó fǎ de wǎng.”
sentences.english: "You can go online, but the 'web' here is a magic web."

sentences.chinese: 林月很惊讶，她想知道怎么做。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè hěn jīng yà, tā xiǎng zhī dào zěn me zuò.
sentences.english: Lin Yue was surprised; she wanted to know how to do it.

sentences.chinese: 小精灵说：“你必须准备好你的心。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo jīng líng shuō: “Nǐ bì xū zhǔn bèi hǎo nǐ de xīn.”
sentences.english: The little sprite said, "You must prepare your heart."

sentences.chinese: “我们可以分三个步骤学习。”
sentences.pinyin: “Wǒ men kě yǐ fēn sān gè bù zhòu xué xí.”
sentences.english: "We can divide the learning into three steps."

sentences.chinese: “首先，你要听写魔法的咒语。”
sentences.pinyin: “Shǒu xiān, nǐ yào tīng xiě mó fǎ de zhòu yǔ.”
sentences.english: "First, you must do a dictation of the magic spells."

sentences.chinese: 林月问：“那个女孩呢？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè wèn: “Nà ge nǚ hái ne?”
sentences.english: Lin Yue asked, "What about that girl?"

sentences.chinese: 小精灵笑了：“她会在后天到这里。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo jīng líng xiào le: “Tā huì zài hòu tiān dào zhè lǐ.”
sentences.english: The little sprite smiled, "She will arrive here the day after tomorrow."

sentences.chinese: “现在差一点时间，你就不能见她。”
sentences.pinyin: “Xiàn zài chà yī diǎn shí jiān, nǐ jiù bù néng jiàn tā.”
sentences.english: "Right now, it is short by a little bit of time, then you cannot see her."

sentences.chinese: 林月想吃一块魔法果实，因为她饿了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè xiǎng chī yī kuài mó fǎ guǒ shí, yīn wèi tā è le.
sentences.english: Lin Yue wanted to eat a piece of magic fruit because she was hungry.

sentences.chinese: 小精灵开心地给她一个果实。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo jīng líng kāi xīn de gěi tā yī gè guǒ shí.
sentences.english: The little sprite happily gave her a fruit.

sentences.chinese: “你会在这里学到很多东西。”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ huì zài zhè lǐ xué dào hěn duō dōng xī.”
sentences.english: "You will learn many things here."

sentences.chinese: 林月想，这里的世界真是太神奇了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè xiǎng, zhè lǐ de shì jiè zhēn shì tài shén qí le.
sentences.english: Lin Yue thought, the world here is truly too magical.

sentences.chinese: 她决定再学习一下魔法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué dìng zài xué xí yī xià mó fǎ.
sentences.english: She decided to study magic once more.

sentences.chinese: 小精灵说：“现在，我们要去那个大门。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo jīng líng shuō: “Xiàn zài, wǒ men yào qù nà ge dà mén.”
sentences.english: The little sprite said, "Now, we are going to that great gate."

sentences.chinese: 当她们走到大门前，门突然自己开了。
sentences.pinyin: Dāng tā men zǒu dào dà mén qián, mén tū rán zì jǐ kāi le.
sentences.english: When they reached the great gate, the door suddenly opened by itself.

sentences.chinese: 大门后面是一个巨大的图书馆。
sentences.pinyin: Dà mén hòu miàn shì yí gè jù dà de tú shū guǎn.
sentences.english: Behind the great gate was a giant library.

sentences.chinese: 林月看到很多发光的书在飞。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè kàn dào hěn duō fā guāng de shū zài fēi.
sentences.english: Lin Yue saw many glowing books flying.

sentences.chinese: 小精灵告诉她：“这里是魔法大学的图书馆。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo jīng líng gào sù tā: “Zhè lǐ shì mó fǎ dà xué de tú shū guǎn.”
sentences.english: The sprite told her: "This is the library of the Magic University."

sentences.chinese: 林月很喜欢这里，因为这里很神奇。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè hěn xǐ huan zhè lǐ, yīn wèi zhè lǐ hěn shén qí.
sentences.english: Lin Yue liked it here very much because it was very magical.

sentences.chinese: 她看到一个老法师在写一本很大的书。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào yí gè lǎo fǎ shī zài xiě yì běn hěn dà de shū.
sentences.english: She saw an old mage writing a very large book.

sentences.chinese: 老法师叫她过去，林月快快地走过去。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo fǎ shī jiào tā guò qù, Lín Yuè kuài kuài de zǒu guò qù.
sentences.english: The old mage called her over, and Lin Yue walked over quickly.

sentences.chinese: 老法师问她：“你想学习魔法吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo fǎ shī wèn tā: “Nǐ xiǎng xué xí mó fǎ ma?”
sentences.english: The old mage asked her: "Do you want to study magic?"

sentences.chinese: 林月回答：“我想学习，我想得到力量。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè huí dá: “Wǒ xiǎng xué xí, wǒ xiǎng dé dào lì liàng.”
sentences.english: Lin Yue replied: "I want to study, I want to obtain power."

sentences.chinese: 老法师笑了，他说：“学习魔法需要很多时间。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo fǎ shī xiào le, tā shuō: “Xué xí mó fǎ xū yào hěn duō shí jiān.”
sentences.english: The old mage smiled and said: "Studying magic takes a lot of time."

sentences.chinese: 他给林月一本旧书，说这本书很有用。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gěi Lín Yuè yì běn jiù shū, shuō zhè běn shū hěn yǒu yòng.
sentences.english: He gave Lin Yue an old book, saying this book was very useful.

sentences.chinese: 林月想买这本书，但小精灵说这里不用钱。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè xiǎng mǎi zhè běn shū, dàn xiǎo jīng líng shuō zhè lǐ bú yòng qián.
sentences.english: Lin Yue wanted to buy this book, but the sprite said money is not used here.

sentences.chinese: 林月开始学怎么用这本书。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè kāi shǐ xué zěn me yòng zhè běn shū.
sentences.english: Lin Yue began to learn how to use this book.

sentences.chinese: 突然，她听到一个好听的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, tā tīng dào yí gè hǎo tīng de shēng yīn.
sentences.english: Suddenly, she heard a pleasant sound.

sentences.chinese: 她听见有人在唱歌。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīng jiàn yǒu rén zài chàng gē.
sentences.english: She heard someone singing a song.

sentences.chinese: 她看向窗外，看到一只白色的龙在唱一首歌。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng chuāng wài, kàn dào yì zhī bái sè de lóng zài chàng yì shǒu gē.
sentences.english: She looked out the window and saw a white dragon singing a song.

sentences.chinese: 那首歌非常好听，林月觉得很开心。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shǒu gē fēi cháng hǎo tīng, Lín Yuè jué de hěn kāi xīn.
sentences.english: That song was very pleasant to hear, and Lin Yue felt very happy.

sentences.chinese: 龙在唱：“欢迎来到魔法的世界。”
sentences.pinyin: Lóng zài chàng: “Huān yíng lái dào mó fǎ de shì jiè.”
sentences.english: The dragon sang: "Welcome to the world of magic."

sentences.chinese: 林月问小精灵：“我可以帮龙帮忙吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè wèn xiǎo jīng líng: “Wǒ kě yǐ bāng lóng bāng máng ma?”
sentences.english: Lin Yue asked the sprite: "Can I help the dragon?"

sentences.chinese: 小精灵说：“你可以，但你得先喝这个。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo jīng líng shuō: “Nǐ kě yǐ, dàn nǐ děi xiān hē zhè ge.”
sentences.english: The sprite said: "You can, but you must drink this first."

sentences.chinese: 小精灵给林月一杯热奶。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo jīng líng gěi Lín Yuè yì bēi rè nǎi.
sentences.english: The sprite gave Lin Yue a glass of hot milk.

sentences.chinese: 林月喝了热奶，觉得身体很暖和。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè hē le rè nǎi, jué de shēn tǐ hěn nuǎn huo.
sentences.english: Lin Yue drank the hot milk and felt her body become warm.

sentences.chinese: 她想打电话告诉林星这个好消息，但这里没有电话。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng dǎ diàn huà gào sù Lín Xīng zhè ge hǎo xiāo xī, dàn zhè lǐ méi yǒu diàn huà.
sentences.english: She wanted to make a phone call to tell Lin Xing this good news, but there were no phones here.

sentences.chinese: 她决定在书上写信给林星。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué dìng zài shū shàng xiě xìn gěi Lín Xīng.
sentences.english: She decided to write a letter to Lin Xing in the book.

sentences.chinese: 她在这个图书馆找到了很多秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài zhè ge tú shū guǎn zhǎo dào le hěn duō mì mì.
sentences.english: She found many secrets in this library.

sentences.chinese: 她学习如何用歌来唤醒魔法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xué xí rú hé yòng gē lái huàn xǐng mó fǎ.
sentences.english: She studied how to use songs to awaken magic.

sentences.chinese: 林月发现，唱歌可以让她看到隐藏的门。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè fā xiàn, chàng gē kě yǐ ràng tā kàn dào yǐn cáng de mén.
sentences.english: Lin Yue discovered that singing songs could let her see hidden doors.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，书架后面传来了奇怪的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, shū jià hòu miàn chuán lái le qí guài de shēng yīn.
sentences.english: Just then, a strange sound came from behind the bookshelves.

sentences.chinese: 林月在书架后面看见了一个奇怪的人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè zài shū jià hòu miàn kàn jiàn le yī gè qí guài de rén.
sentences.english: Lin Yue saw a strange person behind the bookshelf.

sentences.chinese: 他穿一件黑色的长袍，像一个影子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chuān yī jiàn hēi sè de cháng páo, xiàng yī gè yǐng zi.
sentences.english: He wore a black robe, like a shadow.

sentences.chinese: 林月不知道他是谁，但他的眼睛在发光。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè bù zhī dào tā shì shuí, dàn tā de yǎn jīng zài fā guāng.
sentences.english: Lin Yue did not know who he was, but his eyes were glowing.

sentences.chinese: 他给林月看了一本书，书里写着古代的魔法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gěi Lín Yuè kàn le yī běn shū, shū lǐ xiě zhe gǔ dài de mó fǎ.
sentences.english: He showed a book to Lin Yue, which contained ancient magic.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你想学习魔法吗？你必须参加一个考试。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ xiǎng xué xí mó fǎ ma? Nǐ bì xū cān jiā yī gè kǎo shì.”
sentences.english: He said, "Do you want to learn magic? You must take an exam."

sentences.chinese: 林月很惊讶，她问：“什么样的考试？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè hěn jīng yà, tā wèn: “Shén me yàng de kǎo shì?”
sentences.english: Lin Yue was surprised and asked, "What kind of exam?"

sentences.chinese: 那个影子说话的声音很低，像风一样。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè yǐng zi shuō huà de shēng yīn hěn dī, xiàng fēng yī yàng.
sentences.english: The shadow's speaking voice was very low, like the wind.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你要试着用魔法打开这扇门。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ yào shì zhe yòng mó fǎ dǎ kāi zhè shàn mén.”
sentences.english: He said, "You must try to use magic to open this door."

sentences.chinese: 林月记得在之前的课文中看过这个魔法。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè jì de zài zhī qián de kè wén zhōng kàn guò zhè gè mó fǎ.
sentences.english: Lin Yue remembered seeing this magic in a previous text.

sentences.chinese: 她试着读起书上的文字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì zhe dú qǐ shū shàng de wén zì.
sentences.english: She tried to start reading the characters in the book.

sentences.chinese: 她慢慢地读书，试图记住每一个字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā màn màn de dú shū, shì tú jì zhù měi yī gè zì.
sentences.english: She read the book slowly, trying to memorize every character.

sentences.chinese: 她想，如果能通过考试，她就能认识更多的魔法生物。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rú guǒ néng tōng guò kǎo shì, tā jiù néng rèn shi gèng duō de mó fǎ shēng wù.
sentences.english: She thought that if she could pass the exam, she could get to know more magical creatures.

sentences.chinese: 影子请她站起来，走到门前。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi qǐng tā zhàn qǐ lái, zǒu dào mén qián.
sentences.english: The shadow asked her to stand up and walk to the door.

sentences.chinese: 林月起来后，感觉心跳很快。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè qǐ lái hòu, gǎn jué xīn tiào hěn kuài.
sentences.english: After Lin Yue stood up, she felt her heart beating very fast.

sentences.chinese: 她闭上眼睛，在心里记下魔法的咒语。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì shàng yǎn jīng, zài xīn lǐ jì xià mó fǎ de zhòu yǔ.
sentences.english: She closed her eyes and noted the magic spell in her heart.

sentences.chinese: 她必须记住这个咒语，不能忘记。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì xū jì zhù zhè gè zhòu yǔ, bù néng wàng jì.
sentences.english: She had to remember this spell and must not forget it.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个巨大的火球飞向她，像要考她的反应一样撞在地上。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, yī gè jù dà de huǒ qiú fēi xiàng tā, xiàng yào kǎo tā de fǎn yìng yī yàng zhuàng zài dì shàng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a huge fireball flew toward her, hitting the ground as if to test her reaction.

sentences.chinese: 林月大声说话，用歌声唤醒了光芒。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè dà shēng shuō huà, yòng gē shēng huàn xǐng le guāng máng.
sentences.english: Lin Yue spoke loudly, awakening the light with her singing.

sentences.chinese: 光芒照亮了房间，她看见门开了。
sentences.pinyin: Guāng máng zhào liàng le fáng jiān, tā kàn jiàn mén kāi le.
sentences.english: The light illuminated the room, and she saw the door open.

sentences.chinese: 影子很高兴，他笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi hěn gāo xìng, tā xiào le.
sentences.english: The shadow was very happy and smiled.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你通过了，现在我们可以见面了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ tōng guò le, xiàn zài wǒ mén kě yǐ jiàn miàn le.”
sentences.english: He said, "You passed; now we can meet."

sentences.chinese: 林月发现，这个影子其实是图书馆的守护者。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè fā xiàn, zhè gè yǐng zi qí shí shì tú shū guǎn de shǒu hù zhě.
sentences.english: Lin Yue discovered that this shadow was actually the guardian of the library.

sentences.chinese: 守护者告诉她，走出这座图书馆，就有一条通往龙之城的马路。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒu hù zhě gào sù tā, zǒu chū zhè zuò tú shū guǎn, jiù yǒu yī tiáo tōng wǎng lóng zhī chéng de mǎ lù.
sentences.english: The guardian told her that upon leaving this library, there was a road leading to the Dragon City.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，守护者突然变色了，他问林月：“你真的准备好离开这里了吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, shǒu hù zhě tū rán biàn sè le, tā wèn Lín Yuè: “Nǐ zhēn de zhǔn bèi hǎo lí kāi zhè lǐ le ma?”
sentences.english: But at that moment, the guardian suddenly changed color and asked Lin Yue, "Are you truly ready to leave this place?"

chapters.title_english: Chapter 5: The Road to the Dragon City

sentences.chinese: 林月看着守护者，她觉得是对的。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè kànzhe shǒuhùzhě, tā juéde shì duì de.
sentences.english: Lin Yue looked at the guardian and felt it was right.

sentences.chinese: 她说：“我准备好了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ zhǔnbèi hǎo le.”
sentences.english: She said, "I am ready."

sentences.chinese: 守护者笑了，他告诉林月今天是一个特别的日子。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuhùzhě xiào le, tā gàosù Lín Yuè jīntiān shì yī gè tèbié de rìzi.
sentences.english: The guardian smiled; he told Lin Yue that today was a special day.

sentences.chinese: 他给了林月一些魔法的东西。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gěi le Lín Yuè yīxiē mófǎ de dōngxī.
sentences.english: He gave Lin Yue some magical things.

sentences.chinese: 这些东西在地上发光。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxī zài dìshàng fāguāng.
sentences.english: These things were glowing on the ground.

sentences.chinese: 林月拿起来，感觉身体很轻。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè ná qǐlái, gǎnjué shēntǐ hěn qīng.
sentences.english: Lin Yue picked them up and felt her body become very light.

sentences.chinese: 守护者说：“现在，我们要一起走。”
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuhùzhě shuō: “Xiànzài, wǒmen yào yīqǐ zǒu.”
sentences.english: The guardian said, "Now, we shall go together."

sentences.chinese: 他们走到了图书馆的外边。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒu dào le túshūguǎn de wàibian.
sentences.english: They walked to the outside of the library.

sentences.chinese: 外边是一个很大的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Wàibian shì yī gè hěn dà de dìfāng.
sentences.english: The outside was a very large place.

sentences.chinese: 这里有两座大山，一座在东边，一座在西边。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ yǒu liǎng zuò dàshān, yī zuò zài dōngbian, yī zuò zài xībian.
sentences.english: There were two big mountains here, one in the east and one in the west.

sentences.chinese: 在两座山的中间，有一条长长的马路。
sentences.pinyin: Zài liǎng zuò shān de zhōngjiān, yǒu yī tiáo chángcháng de mǎlù.
sentences.english: In the middle of the two mountains, there was a long road.

sentences.chinese: 林月问：“龙之城在哪里？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè wèn: “Lóng zhī chéng zài nǎlǐ?”
sentences.english: Lin Yue asked, "Where is the Dragon City?"

sentences.chinese: 守护者指了指前边。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuhùzhě zhǐ le zhǐ qiánbian.
sentences.english: The guardian pointed ahead.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“龙之城在北边，但路很长。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Lóng zhī chéng zài běibian, dàn lù hěn cháng.”
sentences.english: He said, "The Dragon City is in the north, but the road is long."

sentences.chinese: 林月看了看天空，现在是中午。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè kàn le kàn tiānkōng, xiànzài shì zhōngwǔ.
sentences.english: Lin Yue looked at the sky; it was currently noon.

sentences.chinese: 她想，下午她应该能看到龙之城。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, xiàwǔ tā yīnggāi néng kàndào Lóng zhī chéng.
sentences.english: She thought that in the afternoon, she should be able to see the Dragon City.

sentences.chinese: 他们开始走，林月一边走一边想她的魔法。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen kāishǐ zǒu, Lín Yuè yībiān zǒu yībiān xiǎng tā de mófǎ.
sentences.english: They began to walk, and Lin Yue thought about her magic while she walked.

sentences.chinese: 她想知道这里有多少神奇的动物。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng zhīdào zhèlǐ yǒu duōshǎo shénqí de dòngwù.
sentences.english: She wanted to know how many magical animals were here.

sentences.chinese: 走了一会儿，林月看到右边有一棵大树。
sentences.pinyin: Zǒu le yīhuìr, Lín Yuè kàndào yòubian yǒu yī kē dà shù.
sentences.english: After walking for a while, Lin Yue saw a big tree on the right.

sentences.chinese: 树的上边有很多小鸟在唱歌。
sentences.pinyin: Shù de shàngbian yǒu hěnduō xiǎo niǎo zài chànggē.
sentences.english: Above the tree, many small birds were singing.

sentences.chinese: 树的下边有一朵蓝色的花。
sentences.pinyin: Shù de xiàbian yǒu yī duǒ lánsè de huā.
sentences.english: Below the tree, there was a blue flower.

sentences.chinese: 林月问：“这里是国外吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè wèn: “Zhèlǐ shì guówài ma?”
sentences.english: Lin Yue asked, "Is this abroad?"

sentences.chinese: 守护者说：“这里不是你认识的国外，这是魔法世界。”
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuhùzhě shuō: “Zhèlǐ bù shì nǐ rènshi de guówài, zhè shì mófǎ shìjiè.”
sentences.english: The guardian said, "This is not the 'abroad' you know; this is a magical world."

sentences.chinese: 他们向南边看，那里有白色的云。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xiàng nánbian kàn, nàlǐ yǒu báisè de yún.
sentences.english: They looked toward the south, where there were white clouds.

sentences.chinese: 他们在这条路上走了半天。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zài zhè tiáo lù shàng zǒu le bàntiān.
sentences.english: They walked on this road for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 林月突然停下来，问：“我的书在哪儿？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè tūrán tíng xiàlái, wèn: “Wǒ de shū zài nǎr?”
sentences.english: Lin Yue suddenly stopped and asked, "Where is my book?"

sentences.chinese: 她发现书掉在了路边。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn shū diào le zài lùbiān.
sentences.english: She discovered that her book had fallen by the side of the road.

sentences.chinese: 守护者看着她，轻轻地笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuhùzhě kànzhe tā, qīngqīng de xiào le.
sentences.english: The guardian looked at her and smiled softly.

sentences.chinese: 林月捡起她的魔法课本。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè jiǎn qǐ tā de mó fǎ kè běn.
sentences.english: Lin Yue picked up her magic textbook.

sentences.chinese: 守护者说：“现在，我们要快点走。”
sentences.pinyin: Shǒu hù zhě shuō: “Xiàn zài, wǒ men yào kuài diǎn zǒu.”
sentences.english: The Guardian said, "Now, we must walk faster."

sentences.chinese: 他们在路上走了一段时间。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zài lù shang zǒu le yī duàn shí jiān.
sentences.english: They walked on the road for a while.

sentences.chinese: 白天的阳光很亮，但是森林里有一些奇怪的雾。
sentences.pinyin: Bái tiān de yáng guāng hěn liàng, dàn shì sēn lín lǐ yǒu yī xiē qí guài de wù.
sentences.english: The daytime sunlight was bright, but there was some strange mist in the forest.

sentences.chinese: 林月发现，这里的雾有些冷。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè fā xiàn, zhè lǐ de wù yǒu xiē lěng.
sentences.english: Lin Yue discovered that the mist here was somewhat cold.

sentences.chinese: 她问守护者：“我们还要走多少个星期才能到龙之城？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn shǒu hù zhě: “Wǒ men hái yào zǒu duō shǎo gè xīng qī cái néng dào Lóng zhī Chéng?”
sentences.english: She asked the Guardian, "How many weeks do we still have to walk to reach the Dragon City?"

sentences.chinese: 守护者回答：“如果你用心学习，很快就能到。”
sentences.pinyin: Shǒu hù zhě huí dá: “Rú guǒ nǐ yòng xīn xué xí, hěn kuài jiù néng dào.”
sentences.english: The Guardian replied, "If you study diligently, you will arrive very soon."

sentences.chinese: 有时，雾会变成小动物的形状。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu shí, wù huì biàn chéng xiǎo dòng wù de xíng zhuàng.
sentences.english: Sometimes, the mist would turn into the shapes of small animals.

sentences.chinese: 有的雾像小猫，有的雾像小鸟。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu de wù xiàng xiǎo māo, yǒu de wù xiàng xiǎo niǎo.
sentences.english: Some of the mist looked like kittens, some looked like small birds.

sentences.chinese: 他们走到一个路口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zǒu dào yī gè lù kǒu.
sentences.english: They arrived at an intersection.

sentences.chinese: 左边是一座黑色的山。
sentences.pinyin: Zuǒ bian shì yī zuò hēi sè de shān.
sentences.english: To the left was a black mountain.

sentences.chinese: 右边是茂密的森林。
sentences.pinyin: Yòu bian shì mào mì de sēn lín.
sentences.english: To the right was a dense forest.

sentences.chinese: 在路口的旁边，有一个古老的石碑。
sentences.pinyin: Zài lù kǒu de páng biān, yǒu yī gè gǔ lǎo de shí bēi.
sentences.english: Beside the intersection, there was an ancient stone tablet.

sentences.chinese: 守护者告诉她，西边是禁忌之地，不能去那里。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒu hù zhě gào sù tā, xī biān shì jìn jì zhī dì, bù néng qù nà li.
sentences.english: The Guardian told her that the west was the forbidden land, and she could not go there.

sentences.chinese: 林月看了一下自己的身上，发现只有这本书。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè kàn le yī xià zì jǐ de shēn shang, fā xiàn zhǐ yǒu zhè běn shū.
sentences.english: Lin Yue looked at her body (what she had on her) and found she only had this book.

sentences.chinese: 她想：“我还有很多东西需要学习。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng: “Wǒ hái yǒu hěn duō dōng xī xū yào xué xí.”
sentences.english: She thought, "I still have many things that I need to learn."

sentences.chinese: 就在这个时候，天突然黑了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè gè shí hou, tiān tū rán hēi le.
sentences.english: Right at that moment, the sky suddenly turned dark.

sentences.chinese: 白天变成了晚上。
sentences.pinyin: Bái tiān biàn chéng le wǎn shang.
sentences.english: Daytime turned into night.

sentences.chinese: 守护者正在看天空，他的脸变得很严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒu hù zhě zhèng zài kàn tiān kōng, tā de liǎn biàn de hěn yán sù.
sentences.english: The Guardian was just looking at the sky, and his face became very solemn.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“在这段时间间，黑暗的力量会增强。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zài zhè duàn shí jiān jiān, hēi àn de lì liàng huì zēng qiáng.”
sentences.english: He said, "Within this period of time, the power of darkness will strengthen."

sentences.chinese: 林月看向这边，发现森林在发光。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè kàn xiàng zhè biān, fā xiàn sēn lín zài fā guāng.
sentences.english: Lin Yue looked toward this side and found the forest was glowing.

sentences.chinese: 她又看向那边，发现黑色的山在移动。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòu kàn xiàng nà bian, fā xiàn hēi sè de shān zài yí dòng.
sentences.english: She then looked toward that side and found the black mountain was moving.

sentences.chinese: 林月感到很害怕，但她紧紧抱着她的书。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè gǎn dào hěn hài pà, dàn tā jǐn jǐn bào zhe tā de shū.
sentences.english: Lin Yue felt very scared, but she hugged her book tightly.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个巨大的声音在他们中间响起。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, yī gè jù dà de shēng yīn zài tā men zhōng jiān xiǎng qǐ.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a giant voice rang out between them.

chapters.title_chinese: 第七章：古老的守护者会议
chapters.title_english: Chapter 7: The Council of Ancient Guardians

sentences.chinese: 那个巨大的声音来自一座发光的塔。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge jù dà de shēng yīn lái zì yī zuò fā guāng de tǎ.
sentences.english: That giant voice came from a glowing tower.

sentences.chinese: 林月看着塔，发现那里有很多奇怪的人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè kàn zhe tǎ, fā xiàn nà lǐ yǒu hěn duō qí guài de rén.
sentences.english: Lin Yue looked at the tower and found many strange people there.

sentences.chinese: 这些人都不是普通人，他们是古老的守护者。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiē rén dōu bù shì pǔ tōng rén, tā men shì gǔ lǎo de shǒu hù zhě.
sentences.english: These people were not ordinary; they were the Ancient Guardians.

sentences.chinese: 第一个守护者叫三，他穿着一件红色的长袍。
sentences.pinyin: Dì yī gè shǒu hù zhě jiào Sān, tā chuān zhe yī jiàn hóng sè de cháng páo.
sentences.english: The first guardian was named San, and he wore a red robe.

sentences.chinese: 第二个守护者叫东，他能控制风的方向。
sentences.pinyin: Dì èr gè shǒu hù zhě jiào Dōng, tā néng kòng zhì fēng de fāng xiàng.
sentences.english: The second guardian was named Dong, and he could control the direction of the wind.

sentences.chinese: 第三个守护者叫中，他来自一个遥远的东方国度。
sentences.pinyin: Dì sān gè shǒu hù zhě jiào Zhōng, tā lái zì yī gè yáo yuǎn de dōng fāng guó dù.
sentences.english: The third guardian was named Zhong, who came from a distant eastern land.

sentences.chinese: 林月问：“你们是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè wèn: “Nǐ men shì shuí?”
sentences.english: Lin Yue asked, "Who are you?"

sentences.chinese: 一个叫也的人走过来，笑着说：“我们是这里的老师。”
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè jiào Yě de rén zǒu guò lái, xiào zhe shuō: “Wǒ men shì zhè lǐ de lǎo shī.”
sentences.english: A person named Ye walked over, smiling and saying, "We are the teachers here.

sentences.chinese: 元守护者拿着一本金色的书，告诉林月关于未来的预言。
sentences.pinyin: Yuán shǒu hù zhě ná zhe yī běn jīn sè de shū, gào sù Lín Yuè guān yú wèi lái de yù yán.
sentences.english: Guardian Yuan held a golden book and told Lin Yue the prophecy of the future.

sentences.chinese: 关守护者站在大门旁边，他的眼睛像火一样亮。
sentences.pinyin: Guān shǒu hù zhě zhàn zài dà mén páng biān, tā de yǎn jīng xiàng huǒ yī yàng liàng.
sentences.english: Guardian Guan stood by the great gate, his eyes shining like fire.

sentences.chinese: 冷守护者走过来，周围的空气突然变得很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Lěng shǒu hù zhě zǒu guò lái, zhōu wéi de kōng qì tū rán biàn de hěn lěng.
sentences.english: Guardian Leng walked over, and the surrounding air suddenly became very cold.

sentences.chinese: 别守护者在低声说话，他在提醒林月不要害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Bié shǒu hù zhě zài dī shēng shuō huà, tā zài tí xǐng Lín Yuè bù yào hài pà.
sentences.english: Guardian Bie spoke in a low voice, reminding Lin Yue not to be afraid.

sentences.chinese: 包守护者带来了一个神奇的袋子，里面有很多魔法药水。
sentences.pinyin: Bāo shǒu hù zhě dài lái le yī gè shén qí de dài zi, lǐ miàn yǒu hěn duō mó fǎ yào shuǐ.
sentences.english: Guardian Bao brought a magical bag containing many magic potions.

sentences.chinese: 南守护者指向南方，那里是龙之城的位置。
sentences.pinyin: Nán shǒu hù zhě zhǐ xiàng nán fāng, nà lǐ shì lóng zhī chéng de wèi zhì.
sentences.english: Guardian Nan pointed south, where the Dragon City was located.

sentences.chinese: 后守护者在林月的身后，他默默地保护着她。
sentences.pinyin: Hòu shǒu hù zhě zài Lín Yuè de shēn hòu, tā mò mò de bǎo hù zhe tā.
sentences.english: Guardian Hou was behind Lin Yue, silently protecting her.

sentences.chinese: 国守护者说：“为了这个世界的和平，我们需要你的力量。”
sentences.pinyin: Guó shǒu hù zhě shuō: “Wèi le zhè ge shì jiè de hé píng, wǒ men xū yào nǐ de lì liàng.”
sentences.english: Guardian Guo said, "For the peace of this world, we need your power."

sentences.chinese: 坐守护者坐在一个巨大的石头上，看着林月。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò shǒu hù zhě zuò zài yī gè jù dà de shí tou shàng, kàn zhe Lín Yuè.
sentences.english: Guardian Zuo sat on a giant rock, watching Lin Yue.

sentences.chinese: 山守护者像一座山一样高大，他的声音像雷一样。
sentences.pinyin: Shān shǒu hù zhě xiàng yī zuò shān yī yàng gāo dà, tā de shēng yīn xiàng léi yī yàng.
sentences.english: Guardian Shan was as tall as a mountain, and his voice was like thunder.

sentences.chinese: 左守护者站在林月的左边，他拿着一把银色的剑。
sentences.pinyin: Zuǒ shǒu hù zhě zhàn zài Lín Yuè de zuǒ biān, tā ná zhe yī bǎ yín sè de jiàn.
sentences.english: Guardian Zuo (Left) stood to Lin Yue's left, holding a silver sword.

sentences.chinese: 常守护者说，这种黑暗的力量经常在夜晚出现。
sentences.pinyin: Cháng shǒu hù zhě shuō, zhè zhǒng hēi sè de lì liàng jīng cháng zài yè wǎn chū xiàn.
sentences.english: Guardian Chang said that this dark power often appears at night.

sentences.chinese: 年守护者已经活了许多年，他知道所有的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Nián shǒu hù zhě yǐ jīng huó le xǔ duō nián, tā zhī dào suǒ yǒu de mì mì.
sentences.english: Guardian Nian had lived for many years and knew all the secrets.

sentences.chinese: 教守护者开始教林月如何对抗黑色的山。
sentences.pinyin: Jiào shǒu hù zhě kāi shǐ jiào Lín Yuè rú hé duì kàng hēi sè de shān.
sentences.english: Guardian Jiao began to teach Lin Yue how to fight the black mountain.

sentences.chinese: 新守护者带来了一把新的魔法钥匙。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn shǒu hù zhě dài lái le yī bǎ xīn de mó fǎ yào shi.
sentences.english: Guardian Xin brought a new magical key.

sentences.chinese: 楼守护者住在高高的塔楼里，他能看到所有人的心。
sentences.pinyin: Lóu shǒu hù zhě zhù zài gāo gāo de tǎ lóu lǐ, tā néng kàn dào suǒ yǒu rén de xīn.
sentences.english: Guardian Lou lived in the high tower and could see everyone's heart.

sentences.chinese: 毛守护者穿着一件毛茸茸的白色衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Máo shǒu hù zhě chuān zhe yī jiàn máo róng róng de bái sè yī fu.
sentences.english: Guardian Mao wore a fluffy white garment.

sentences.chinese: 水守护者挥挥手，清澈的水在空中飞舞。
sentences.pinyin: Shuǐ shǒu hù zhě huī huī shǒu, qīng chè de shuǐ zài kōng zhōng fēi wǔ.
sentences.english: Guardian Shui waved a hand, and clear water danced in the air.

sentences.chinese: 班守护者说，林月现在是这个魔法班的学生。
sentences.pinyin: Bān shǒu hù zhě shuō, Lín Yuè xiàn zài shì zhè ge mó fǎ bān de xué shēng.
sentences.english: Guardian Ban said that Lin Yue was now a student of this magic class.

sentences.chinese: 白守护者穿着白色的衣服，看起来非常纯洁。
sentences.pinyin: Bái shǒu hù zhě chuān zhe bái sè de yī fu, kàn qǐ lái fēi cháng chún jié.
sentences.english: Guardian Bai wore white clothes and looked very pure.

sentences.chinese: 百守护者说，这里有上百种魔法可以学习。
sentences.pinyin: Bǎi shǒu hù zhě shuō, zhè lǐ yǒu shàng bǎi zhǒng mó fǎ kě yǐ xué xí.
sentences.english: Guardian Bai (Hundred) said there were hundreds of types of magic to learn.

sentences.chinese: 能守护者告诉她：“你能改变这个世界的命运。”
sentences.pinyin: Néng shǒu hù zhě gào sù tā: “Nǐ néng gǎi biàn zhè ge shì jiè de mìng yùn.”
sentences.english: Guardian Neng told her, "You can change the destiny of this world."

sentences.chinese: 花守护者在林月身边种下了发光的魔法花。
sentences.pinyin: Huā shǒu hù zhě zài Lín Yuè shēn biān zhòng xià le fā guāng de mó fǎ huā.
sentences.english: Guardian Hua planted glowing magic flowers around Lin Yue.

sentences.chinese: 路守护者指着前方，告诉她正确的路。
sentences.pinyin: Lù shǒu hù zhě zhǐ zhe qián fāng, gào sù tā zhèng què de lù.
sentences.english: Guardian Lu pointed forward, telling her the correct path.

sentences.chinese: 车守护者开着一辆飞行的魔法车，准备带她离开。
sentences.pinyin: Chē shǒu hù zhě kāi zhe yī liàng fēi xíng de mó fǎ chē, zhǔn bèi dài tā lí kāi.
sentences.english: Guardian Che drove a flying magic car, preparing to take her away.

sentences.chinese: 过守护者说：“我们要经过那座桥，才能到达目的地。”
sentences.pinyin: Guò shǒu hù zhě shuō: “Wǒ men yào jīng guò nà zuò qiáo, cái néng dào dá mù dì dì.”
sentences.english: Guardian Guo (Cross) said, "We must cross that bridge to reach the destination."

sentences.chinese: 还守护者问她：“你还记得你的目标吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Huán shǒu hù zhě wèn tā: “Nǐ hái jì dé nǐ de mù biāo ma?”
sentences.english: Guardian Huan asked her, "Do you still remember your goal?"

sentences.chinese: 那守护者指着远方的黑山，眼神很严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Nā shǒu hù zhě zhǐ zhe yuǎn fāng de hēi shān, yǎn shén hěn yán sù.
sentences.english: Guardian Na pointed to the distant black mountain with a serious look.

sentences.chinese: 都守护者说：“我们都愿意帮助你。”
sentences.pinyin: Dū shǒu hù zhě shuō: “Wǒ men dōu yuàn yì bāng zhù nǐ.”
sentences.english: Guardian Du said, "We are all willing to help you."

sentences.chinese: 钱守护者拿着金币，但他说魔法不需要钱。
sentences.pinyin: Qián shǒu hù zhě ná zhe jīn bì, dàn tā shuō mó fǎ bù xū yào qián.
sentences.english: Guardian Qian held gold coins, but he said magic does not require money.

sentences.chinese: 错守护者提醒她：“走错路会很危险。”
sentences.pinyin: Cuò shǒu hù zhě tí xǐng tā: “Zǒu cuò lù huì hěn wēi xiǎn.”
sentences.english: Guardian Cuo warned her, "Taking the wrong path will be dangerous."

sentences.chinese: 门守护者轻轻地打开了通往下一关的门。
sentences.pinyin: Mén shǒu hù zhě qīng qīng de dǎ kāi le tōng wǎng xià yī guān de mén.
sentences.english: Guardian Men gently opened the door to the next stage.

sentences.chinese: 高守护者站在最高的地方，看着远方的迷雾。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo shǒu hù zhě zhàn zài zuì gāo de dì fāng, kàn zhe yuǎn fāng de mí wù.
sentences.english: Guardian Gao stood at the highest point, looking at the distant mist.

sentences.chinese: 林月看着这些守护者，感到非常惊讶。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè kàn zhe zhè xiē shǒu hù zhě, gǎn dào fēi cháng jīng yà.
sentences.english: Lin Yue looked at these guardians and felt very surprised.

sentences.chinese: 她紧紧抱着她的书，准备面对接下来的挑战。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jǐn jǐn bào zhe tā de shū, zhǔn bèi miàn duì jiē xià lái de tiǎo zhàn.
sentences.english: She hugged her book tightly, preparing to face the challenges ahead.

sentences.chinese: 突然，远方的黑山发出了巨大的咆哮声。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, yuǎn fāng de hēi shān fā chū le jù dà de páo xiāo shēng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the distant black mountain let out a giant roar.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 8: Secrets of the Black Mountain

sentences.chinese: 黑山的咆哮声在空中回荡。
sentences.pinyin: Hēishān de páoxiào shēng zài kōngzhōng huídàng.
sentences.english: The roar of the Black Mountain echoed in the air.

sentences.chinese: 林月看着高守护者，问他：“我们要干什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè kànzhe Gāo Shǒuhùzhě, wèn tā: “Wǒmen yào gàn shénme?”
sentences.english: Lin Yue looked at the High Guardian and asked him, "What are we doing?"

sentences.chinese: 高守护者看着她，严肃地说：“我们需要走，现在就走。”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo Shǒuhùzhě kànzhe tā, yánsù de shuō: “Wǒmen xūyào zǒu, xiànzài jiù zǒu.”
sentences.english: The High Guardian looked at her and said seriously, "We need to go, go now."

sentences.chinese: 他们开始在黑色的土地上走路。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen kāishǐ zài hēisè de tǔdì shàng zǒulù.
sentences.english: They began to walk on the black land.

sentences.chinese: 这里的空气很奇怪，像是在下雨，但没有水。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de kōngqì hěn qíguài, xiàng shì zài xiàyǔ, dàn méiyǒu shuǐ.
sentences.english: The air here was strange, as if it were raining, but there was no water.

sentences.chinese: 林月想起她在学校上学的时候，生活很简单。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè xiǎngqǐ tā zài xuéxiào shàngxué de shíhou, shēnghuó hěn jiǎndān.
sentences.english: Lin Yue remembered when she attended school, life was very simple.

sentences.chinese: 那时她每天起床，然后去上课。
sentences.pinyin: Nàshí tā měitiān qǐchuáng, ránhòu qù shàngkè.
sentences.english: At that time, she got up every day and then went to class.

sentences.chinese: 等到下课，她就和朋友们一起玩儿。
sentences.pinyin: Děng dào xiàkè, tā jiù hé péngyǒumen yìqǐ wánr.
sentences.english: When class finished, she would play with her friends.

sentences.chinese: 现在，她不再是那个等放学的小学生了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài, tā bù zài shì nàge děng fàngxué de xiǎoxuéshēng le.
sentences.english: Now, she was no longer that primary student waiting for school to be dismissed.

sentences.chinese: 她现在是一个学习魔法的勇士。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiànzài shì yígè xuéxí mófǎ de yǒngshì.
sentences.english: She was now a warrior learning magic.

sentences.chinese: 高守护者告诉她，守护者的工作很辛苦。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo Shǒuhùzhě gàosù tā, shǒuhùzhě de gōngzuò hěn xīnkǔ.
sentences.english: The High Guardian told her that the guardians' work was very hard.

sentences.chinese: 他们必须上班，时刻保护这个世界。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen bìxū shàngbān, shíkè bǎohù zhège shìjiè.
sentences.english: They had to start work and protect this world at all times.

sentences.chinese: 他们不能随便休息，也不能随便睡觉。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen bùnéng suíbiàn xiūxi, yě bùnéng suíbiàn shuìjiào.
sentences.english: They could not rest casually, nor could they sleep casually.

sentences.chinese: 即使生病了，他们也要继续工作。
sentences.pinyin: Jíshǐ shēngbìng le, tāmen yě yào jìxù gōngzuò.
sentences.english: Even if they fell ill, they had to continue working.

sentences.chinese: 林月问：“如果守护者有病，谁来帮他们看病？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè wèn: “Rúguǒ shǒuhùzhě yǒu bìng, shéi lái bāng tāmen kànbìng?”
sentences.english: Lin Yue asked, "If a guardian has an illness, who helps them see a doctor?"

sentences.chinese: 高守护者笑了，说：“魔法可以治疗所有的病。”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo Shǒuhùzhě xiào le, shuō: “Mófǎ kěyǐ zhìliáo suǒyǒu de bìng.”
sentences.english: The High Guardian smiled and said, "Magic can cure all diseases."

sentences.chinese: 他们走到一座巨大的石树下面。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒu dào yí zuò jùdà de shíshù xiàmiàn.
sentences.english: They walked to the bottom of a giant stone tree.

sentences.chinese: 石树的动作很慢，它在轻轻地移动分支。
sentences.pinyin: Shíshù de dòngzuò hěn màn, tā zài qīngqīng de yídòng fēnzhī.
sentences.english: The movements of the stone tree were very slow, gently moving its branches.

sentences.chinese: “坐下吧，”高守护者说，“我们需要在这里休息一下。”
sentences.pinyin: “Zuòxia ba,” Gāo Shǒuhùzhě shuō, “wǒmen xūyào zài zhèlǐ xiūxi yíxià.”
sentences.english: "Sit down," the High Guardian said, "we need to rest here for a while."

sentences.chinese: 林月坐下，打开她的书，准备吃饭。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè zuòxia, dǎkāi tā de shū, zhǔnbèi chīfàn.
sentences.english: Lin Yue sat down, opened her book, and prepared to eat a meal.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个奇怪的小生物跑了过来。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yígè qíguài de xiǎo shēngwù pǎo le guòlái.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a strange little creature ran over.

sentences.chinese: 它像一个小球，林月想和它打球。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàng yígè xiǎo qiú, Lín Yuè xiǎng hé tā dǎqiú.
sentences.english: It looked like a small ball; Lin Yue wanted to play ball with it.

sentences.chinese: 但这个小生物很生气，它大声叫了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zhège xiǎo shēngwù hěn shēngqì, tā dàshēng jiào le qǐlái.
sentences.english: But this little creature was very angry; it let out a loud cry.

sentences.chinese: “它在开玩笑吗？”林月惊讶地问。
sentences.pinyin: “Tā zài kāiwánxiào ma?” Lín Yuè jīngyà de wèn.
sentences.english: "Is it joking?" Lin Yue asked in surprise.

sentences.chinese: 高守护者摇摇头说：“它在提醒我们，黑山的魔王要开会了。”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo Shǒuhùzhě yáoyáo tóu shuō: “Tā zài tíxǐng wǒmen, Hēishān de mówáng yào kāihuì le.”
sentences.english: The High Guardian shook his head and said, "It is reminding us that the Demon King of the Black Mountain is about to hold a meeting."

sentences.chinese: 魔王召集所有的影子，决定如何攻击龙之城。
sentences.pinyin: Mówáng zhāojí suǒyǒu de yǐngzi, juédìng rúhé gōngjī Lóngzhīchéng.
sentences.english: The Demon King summoned all the shadows to decide how to attack the Dragon City.

sentences.chinese: 林月想，如果她能开车，也许能快一点到达目的地。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè xiǎng, rúguǒ tā néng kāichē, yěxǔ néng kuài yìdiǎn dàodá mùdìdì.
sentences.english: Lin Yue thought that if she could drive a car, perhaps she could reach the destination faster.

sentences.chinese: 但在这个魔法世界，没有人开车，也没有人打车。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zài zhège mófǎ shìjiè, méiyǒu rén kāichē, yě méiyǒu rén dǎchē.
sentences.english: But in this magical world, no one drives cars, and no one takes a taxi.

sentences.chinese: 他们只能用脚走，或者骑上飞龙。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zhǐnéng yòng jiǎo zǒu, huòzhě qí shàng fēilóng.
sentences.english: They could only go on foot or ride a flying dragon.

sentences.chinese: “快把书放好，”高守护者提醒她。
sentences.pinyin: “Kuài bǎ shū fàng hǎo,” Gāo Shǒuhùzhě tíxǐng tā.
sentences.english: "Put your book away quickly," the High Guardian reminded her.

sentences.chinese: 林月把书放进包里，站起来准备出发。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè bǎ shū fàng jìn bāo lǐ, zhàn qǐlái zhǔnbèi chūfā.
sentences.english: Lin Yue put the book in her bag, stood up, and prepared to set off.

sentences.chinese: 她想，如果现在能放假，她一定想回家睡觉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rúguǒ xiànzài néng fàngjià, tā yídìng xiǎng huíjiā shuìjiào.
sentences.english: She thought that if she could have a holiday now, she would definitely want to go home to sleep.

sentences.chinese: 但她知道，她不能在这个时候睡。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tā zhīdào, tā bùnéng zài zhège shíhou shuì.
sentences.english: But she knew she could not sleep at this time.

sentences.chinese: 她必须面对黑山的挑战，救回她的朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū miànduì Hēishān de tiǎozhàn, jiù huí tā de péngyǒu.
sentences.english: She had to face the challenge of the Black Mountain and rescue her friends.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，黑山的顶端突然亮起了红光。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhèshí, Hēishān de dǐngduān tūrán liàngqǐ le hóngguāng.
sentences.english: Just then, a red light suddenly lit up at the peak of the Black Mountain.

sentences.chinese: 一个巨大的影子从山顶走下来，正朝着他们跑来。
sentences.pinyin: Yígè jùdà de yǐngzi cóng shāndǐng zǒu xiàlái, zhèng cháozhe tāmen pǎo lái.
sentences.english: A huge shadow walked down from the mountaintop and was running toward them.

sentences.chinese: 这个巨大的影子跑到了林月面前。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge jù dà de yǐng zi pǎo dào le Lín Yuè miàn qián.
sentences.english: The giant shadow ran up to Lin Yue.

sentences.chinese: 这并不是一个怪物，而是一个穿着古老衣服的男生。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bìng bú shì yí gè guài wù, ér shì yí gè chuān zhe gǔ lǎo yī fu de nán shēng.
sentences.english: This was not a monster, but a boy wearing ancient clothes.

sentences.chinese: 他看着林月，笑了，说：“你看起来像个学生。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe Lín Yuè, xiào le, shuō: “Nǐ kàn qǐ lái xiàng gè xué sheng.”
sentences.english: He looked at Lin Yue, smiled, and said, "You look like a student."

sentences.chinese: 林月很惊讶，因为他看起来像个中学生，但他的眼睛里有星辰。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè hěn jīng yà, yīn wèi tā kàn qǐ lái xiàng gè zhōng xué shēng, dàn tā de yǎn jīng lǐ yǒu xīng chén.
sentences.english: Lin Yue was surprised because he looked like a middle-school student, but there were stars in his eyes.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林月，他在这座山上住了半年了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su Lín Yuè, tā zài zhè zuò shān shàng zhù le bàn nián le.
sentences.english: He told Lin Yue that he had lived on this mountain for half a year.

sentences.chinese: 他原本是一个大学生，但因为一个魔法错误，他变成了一个影子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yuán běn shì yí gè dà xué shēng, dàn yīn wèi yí gè mó fǎ cuò wù, tā biàn chéng le yí gè yǐng zi.
sentences.english: He was originally a university student, but because of a magic mistake, he became a shadow.

sentences.chinese: 他现在像个小学生一样，必须重新学习魔法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàn zài xiàng gè xiǎo xué shēng yí yàng, bì xū chóng xīn xué xí mó fǎ.
sentences.english: He is now like a primary school student and must learn magic all over again.

sentences.chinese: 他指了指地上的一个旧书包，那是他唯一的财产。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐ le zhǐ dì shàng de yí gè jiù shū bāo, nà shì tā wéi yī de cái chǎn.
sentences.english: He pointed to an old schoolbag on the ground; it was his only possession.

sentences.chinese: “我的爱好是读书，”他说，“但我现在不能读我的书。”
sentences.pinyin: “Wǒ de ài hào shì dú shū,” tā shuō, “dàn wǒ xiàn zài bù néng dú wǒ de shū.”
sentences.english: "My hobby is reading," he said, "but I cannot read my books now."

sentences.chinese: 林月想起自己的同学，在学校里，大家也喜欢读书。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè xiǎng qǐ zì jǐ de tóng xué, zài xué xiào lǐ, dà jiā yě xǐ huan dú shū.
sentences.english: Lin Yue thought of her classmates; at school, everyone also liked reading.

sentences.chinese: 她想起在小学的时候，她也是一个爱学习的小朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ zài xiǎo xué de shí hou, tā yě shì yí gè ài xué xí de xiǎo péng yǒu.
sentences.english: She remembered when she was in elementary school, she was also a child who loved learning.

sentences.chinese: 这个男生说，他有一个弟弟，一个很可爱的孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge nán shēng shuō, tā yǒu yí gè dì di, yí gè hěn kě ài de hái zi.
sentences.english: The boy said he had a younger brother, a very cute child.

sentences.chinese: 他的弟弟还是个很小的子，像一颗种子一样在成长。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de dì di hái shì gè hěn xiǎo de zǐ, xiàng yì kē zhǒng zi yí yàng zài chéng zhǎng.
sentences.english: His younger brother was still a very small child (seed), growing like a seed.

sentences.chinese: 他想在新年之前变回人类，然后回家见他的奶奶。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng zài xīn nián zhī qián biàn huí rén lèi, rán hòu huí jiā jiàn tā de nǎi nai.
sentences.english: He wanted to turn back into a human before the New Year and then go home to see his grandma.

sentences.chinese: “我的父亲说，我是他的好儿子，”他伤心地说。
sentences.pinyin: “Wǒ de fù qīn shuō, wǒ shì tā de hǎo ér zi,” tā shāng xīn de shuō.
sentences.english: "My father said I am his good son," he said sadly.

sentences.chinese: 林月问他：“你在这里有男朋友或者朋友吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè wèn tā: “Nǐ zài zhè lǐ yǒu nán péng you huò zhě péng you ma?”
sentences.english: Lin Yue asked him, "Do you have a boyfriend or friends here?"

sentences.chinese: 他摇摇头，说：“没有，我在这里很孤独。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā yáo yáo tóu, shuō: “Méi yǒu, wǒ zài zhè lǐ hěn gū dú.”
sentences.english: He shook his head and said, "No, I am very lonely here."

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林月，这是他第一次见到能看到他的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su Lín Yuè, zhè shì tā dì yī cì jiàn dào néng kàn dào tā de rén.
sentences.english: He told Lin Yue that this was the first time he had seen someone who could see him.

sentences.chinese: 他看着林月手中的书，说：“这是第十本古书，它可以救我。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe Lín Yuè shǒu zhōng de shū, shuō: “Zhè shì dì shí běn gǔ shū, tā kě yǐ jiù wǒ.”
sentences.english: He looked at the book in Lin Yue's hand and said, "This is the tenth ancient book; it can save me."

sentences.chinese: 林月看着他，觉得这个像弟弟一样的男生很可怜。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè kàn zhe tā, jué de zhè ge xiàng dì di yí yàng de nán shēng hěn kě lián.
sentences.english: Lin Yue looked at him and felt that this boy, who was like a younger brother, was very pitiful.

sentences.chinese: 她决定帮他，因为她知道失去家人的感觉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué dìng bāng tā, yīn wèi tā zhī dào shī qù jiā rén de gǎn jué.
sentences.english: She decided to help him because she knew the feeling of losing family.

sentences.chinese: 突然，黑山再次震动，一个更大的影子出现了。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, hēi shān zài cì zhèn dòng, yí gè gèng dà de yǐng zi chū xiàn le.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the Black Mountain shook again, and an even larger shadow appeared.

sentences.chinese: 那个影子大声喊道：“谁在抢我的学生！”
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge yǐng zi dà shēng hǎn dào: “Shéi zài qiǎng wǒ de xué sheng!”
sentences.english: That shadow shouted loudly, "Who is stealing my student!"

sentences.chinese: 巨大的影子看着林月，发出了巨大的号叫。
sentences.pinyin: Jù dà de yǐng zi kàn zhe Lín Yuè, fā chū le jù dà de hào jiào.
sentences.english: The giant shadow looked at Lin Yue and let out a massive roar.

sentences.chinese: 他问：“你是谁？你怎么在这里？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn: “Nǐ shì shuí? Nǐ zěn me zài zhè lǐ?”
sentences.english: He asked, "Who are you? How are you here?"

sentences.chinese: 林月很害怕，但她看着那个像弟弟的男生。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè hěn hài pà, dàn tā kàn zhe nà ge xiàng dì di de nán shēng.
sentences.english: Lin Yue was very scared, but she looked at the boy who was like a younger brother.

sentences.chinese: 男生说：“我记得我曾经在那个学院学习。”
sentences.pinyin: Nán shēng shuō: “Wǒ jì dé wǒ céng jīng zài nà ge xué yuàn xué xí.”
sentences.english: The boy said, "I remember I once studied at that academy."

sentences.chinese: 林月问：“什么学院？那是哪一个国家？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè wèn: “Shén me xué yuàn? Nà shì nǎ yī gè guó jiā?”
sentences.english: Lin Yue asked, "What academy? Which country was that?"

sentences.chinese: 影子大声说：“这里没有国家，只有我的世界！”
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi dà shēng shuō: “Zhè lǐ méi yǒu guó jiā, zhǐ yǒu wǒ de shì jiè!”
sentences.english: The shadow shouted, "There are no countries here, only my world!"

sentences.chinese: 林月发现书上的字在发光。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè fā xiàn shū shàng de zì zài fā guāng.
sentences.english: Lin Yue discovered the characters on the book were glowing.

sentences.chinese: 书上有十个古老的符号。
sentences.pinyin: Shū shàng yǒu shí gè gǔ lǎo de fú hào.
sentences.english: There were ten ancient symbols on the book.

sentences.chinese: 其中一个字写着：“寻找丢失的记忆。”
sentences.pinyin: Qí zhōng yī gè zì xiě zhe: “Xún zhǎo diū shī de jì yì.”
sentences.english: One of the characters read: "Search for the lost memories."

sentences.chinese: 林月想知道，这件事怎么才能解决。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè xiǎng zhī dào, zhè jiàn shì zěn me cái néng jiě jué.
sentences.english: Lin Yue wanted to know how this matter could be resolved.

sentences.chinese: 她问影子：“哪些东西能让你开心？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn yǐng zi: “Nǎ xiē dōng xī néng ràng nǐ kāi xīn?”
sentences.english: She asked the shadow, "Which things can make you happy?"

sentences.chinese: 影子停了下来，他的声音变小了。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi tíng le xià lái, tā de shēng yīn biàn xiǎo le.
sentences.english: The shadow stopped, and his voice became softer.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“我想念我的妈妈。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng niàn wǒ de mā ma.”
sentences.english: He said, "I miss my mother."

sentences.chinese: 林月心中很酸，她说：“我也想我的妈。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè xīn zhōng hěn suān, tā shuō: “Wǒ yě xiǎng wǒ de mā.”
sentences.english: Lin Yue felt a pang in her heart and said, "I miss my mom too."

sentences.chinese: 影子低头看，他记得很久以前的一天。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi dī tóu kàn, tā jì dé hěn jiǔ yǐ qián de yī tiān.
sentences.english: The shadow looked down; he remembered a day from a long time ago.

sentences.chinese: 那时候，他住在个漂亮的房间里，有一张柔软的床。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shí hou, tā zhù zài gè piào liang de fáng jiān lǐ, yǒu yī zhāng róu ruǎn de chuáng.
sentences.english: At that time, he lived in a beautiful room with a soft bed.

sentences.chinese: 他的妈妈带他去商店买书。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de mā ma dài tā qù shāng diàn mǎi shū.
sentences.english: His mother took him to a store to buy books.

sentences.chinese: 那里不像现在的黑山，那里有很多热闹的商场。
sentences.pinyin: Nà lǐ bù xiàng xiàn zài de hēi shān, nà lǐ yǒu hěn duō rè nao de shāng chǎng.
sentences.english: It wasn't like the Black Mountain now; there were many bustling shopping malls there.

sentences.chinese: 影子记得，他有六个朋友，他们一起学习魔法。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi jì dé, tā yǒu liù gè péng you, tā men yī qǐ xué xí mó fǎ.
sentences.english: The shadow remembered he had six friends, and they studied magic together.

sentences.chinese: 第一天，他们学习火魔法。
sentences.pinyin: Dì yī tiān, tā men xué xí huǒ mó fǎ.
sentences.english: On the first day, they studied fire magic.

sentences.chinese: 第二天，他们学习水魔法。
sentences.pinyin: Dì èr tiān, tā men xué xí shuǐ mó fǎ.
sentences.english: On the second day, they studied water magic.

sentences.chinese: 第三天，他们学习风魔法。
sentences.pinyin: Dì sān tiān, tā men xué xí fēng mó fǎ.
sentences.english: On the third day, they studied wind magic.

sentences.chinese: 第四天，他们学习土魔法。
sentences.pinyin: Dì sì tiān, tā men xué xí tǔ mó fǎ.
sentences.english: On the fourth day, they studied earth magic.

sentences.chinese: 第五天，他们学习光魔法。
sentences.pinyin: Dì wǔ tiān, tā men xué xí guāng mó fǎ.
sentences.english: On the fifth day, they studied light magic.

sentences.chinese: 第六天，他们学习暗魔法。
sentences.pinyin: Dì liù tiān, tā men xué xí àn mó fǎ.
sentences.english: On the sixth day, they studied dark magic.

sentences.chinese: 第七天，他们学习时间魔法。
sentences.pinyin: Dì qī tiān, tā men xué xí shí jiān mó fǎ.
sentences.english: On the seventh day, they studied time magic.

sentences.chinese: 第八天，他们学习空间魔法。
sentences.pinyin: Dì bā tiān, tā men xué xí kōng jiān mó fǎ.
sentences.english: On the eighth day, they studied space magic.

sentences.chinese: 第九天，他们学习灵魂魔法。
sentences.pinyin: Dì jiǔ tiān, tā men xué xí líng hún mó fǎ.
sentences.english: On the ninth day, they studied soul magic.

sentences.chinese: 但在第十天，发生了一件可怕的事。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zài dì shí tiān, fā shēng le yī jiàn kě pà de shì.
sentences.english: But on the tenth day, a terrifying thing happened.

sentences.chinese: 一个黑色的洞打开了，把所有人都吸走了。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè hēi sè de dòng dǎ kāi le, bǎ suǒ yǒu rén dōu xī zǒu le.
sentences.english: A black hole opened and sucked everyone away.

sentences.chinese: 林月看着他，轻声说：“我们现在可以帮你。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè kàn zhe tā, qīng shēng shuō: “Wǒ men xiàn zài kě yǐ bāng nǐ.”
sentences.english: Lin Yue looked at him and said softly, "We can help you now."

sentences.chinese: 影子看着林月，又看着那个男生。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi kàn zhe Lín Yuè, yòu kàn zhe nà ge nán shēng.
sentences.english: The shadow looked at Lin Yue, and then at the boy.

sentences.chinese: 他问：“在这个地点，我怎么才能找回我的身体？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn: “Zài zhè ge dì diǎn, wǒ zěn me cái néng zhǎo huí wǒ de shēn tǐ?”
sentences.english: He asked, "At this location, how can I recover my body?"

sentences.chinese: 林月看向远方，发现除了黑山，还有别的山在移动。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè kàn xiàng yuǎn fāng, fā xiàn chú le hēi shān, hái yǒu bié de shān zài yí dòng.
sentences.english: Lin Yue looked into the distance and found that besides the Black Mountain, other mountains were moving.

sentences.chinese: 突然，天空变黑了，一个巨大的声音在他们头顶响起。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, tiān kōng biàn hēi le, yī gè jù dà de shēng yīn zài tā men tóu dǐng xiǎng qǐ.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the sky turned black, and a massive voice echoed above their heads.

sentences.chinese: 天空中的声音很大，像是在读一门古老的课。
sentences.pinyin: Tiān kōng zhōng de shēng yīn hěn dà, xiàng shì zài dú yī mén gǔ lǎo de kè.
sentences.english: The voice in the sky was very loud, as if it were reading an ancient lesson.

sentences.chinese: 林月看着天空，发现月亮变成了红色的球。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè kàn zhe tiān kōng, fā xiàn yuè liàng biàn chéng le hóng sè de qiú.
sentences.english: Lin Yue looked at the sky and found that the moon had turned into a red sphere.

sentences.chinese: 影子看着她，低声说：“我忘了我是谁，我的时间停在了很久以前。”
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi kàn zhe tā, dī shēng shuō: “Wǒ wàng le wǒ shì shéi, wǒ de shí jiān tíng zhài le hěn jiǔ yǐ qián.”
sentences.english: The shadow looked at her and whispered, "I forgot who I am; my time stopped a long time ago."

sentences.chinese: 林月想帮他，但她发现周围的环境突然变了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè xiǎng bāng tā, dàn tā fā xiàn zhōu wéi de huán jìng tū rán biàn le.
sentences.english: Lin Yue wanted to help him, but she found that the surrounding environment suddenly changed.

sentences.chinese: 他们不再在黑山，而是在一个奇怪的房间里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men bù zài zài hēi shān, ér shì zài yī gè qí guài de fáng jiān lǐ.
sentences.english: They were no longer at the Black Mountain, but in a strange room.

sentences.chinese: 房间里有一张桌子，桌子上有一个杯子和一盘肉菜。
sentences.pinyin: Fáng jiān lǐ yǒu yī zhāng zhuō zi, zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī gè bēi zi hé yī pán ròu cài.
sentences.english: In the room there was a table, and on the table was a cup and a plate of meat and vegetables.

sentences.chinese: 林月看到桌子上还有一个钱包，里面有一张电影票。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè kàn dào zhuō zi shàng hái yǒu yī gè qián bāo, lǐ miàn yǒu yī zhāng diàn yǐng piào.
sentences.english: Lin Yue saw there was also a wallet on the table, with a movie ticket inside.

sentences.chinese: 她拿起票，上面写着“电影院：记忆之门”。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná qǐ piào, shàng miàn xiě zhe “diàn yǐng yuàn: jì yì zhī mén”.
sentences.english: She picked up the ticket, which read "Cinema: Door of Memory."

sentences.chinese: 影子看着这些东西，突然说：“我想起了我的爸。”
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi kàn zhe zhè xiē dōng xī, tū rán shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng qǐ le wǒ de bà.”
sentences.english: The shadow looked at these things and suddenly said, "I remember my dad."

sentences.chinese: 他记得自己以前生活在一个有电视和电话的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì dé zì jǐ yǐ qián shēng huó zài yī gè yǒu diàn shì hé diàn huà de dì fāng.
sentences.english: He remembered that he used to live in a place with televisions and telephones.

sentences.chinese: 在那里的生活像电影一样，很快就过去了。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nà lǐ de shēng huó xiàng diàn yǐng yī yàng, hěn kuài jiù guò qù le.
sentences.english: Life there was like a movie, passing by very quickly.

sentences.chinese: 林月在桌子上发现了一本旧书，书的本源充满了魔法。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè zài zhuō zi shàng fā xiàn le yī běn jiù shū, shū de běn yuán chōng mǎn le mó fǎ.
sentences.english: Lin Yue found an old book on the table, the root of which was full of magic.

sentences.chinese: 她读了书中的话，发现这是一个寻找身体的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dú le shū zhōng de huà, fā xiàn zhè shì yī gè xún zhǎo shēn tǐ de mì mì.
sentences.english: She read the words in the book and discovered it was a secret to finding a body.

sentences.chinese: 影子说：“我记得这里有个洗手间，我的身体就在那里。”
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi shuō: “Wǒ jì dé zhè lǐ yǒu gè xǐ shǒu jiān, wǒ de shēn tǐ jiù zài nà lǐ.”
sentences.english: The shadow said, "I remember there is a restroom here; my body is in there."

sentences.chinese: 他们走向洗手间，但门被锁住了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zǒu xiàng xǐ shǒu jiān, dàn mén bèi suǒ zhù le.
sentences.english: They walked toward the restroom, but the door was locked.

sentences.chinese: 林月发现门上有一个小点，像是一个按钮。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè fā xiàn mén shàng yǒu yī gè xiǎo diǎn, xiàng shì yī gè àn niǔ.
sentences.english: Lin Yue found a small dot on the door, like a button.

sentences.chinese: 她按下那个点，门开了，但里面没有身体，只有一台老汽车。
sentences.pinyin: Tā àn xià nà gè diǎn, mén kāi le, dàn lǐ miàn méi yǒu shēn tǐ, zhǐ yǒu yī tái lǎo qì chē.
sentences.english: She pressed that dot, the door opened, but there was no body inside, only an old car.

sentences.chinese: 汽车停在房间中间，像是在等一个人。
sentences.pinyin: Qì chē tíng zài fáng jiān zhōng jiān, xiàng shì zài děng yī gè rén.
sentences.english: The car was parked in the middle of the room, as if waiting for someone.

sentences.chinese: 林月问：“我们怎么能开车去车站？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè wèn: “Wǒ men zěn me néng kāi chē qù chē zhàn?”
sentences.english: Lin Yue asked, "How can we drive to the station?"

sentences.chinese: 影子回答：“我们需要第二种魔法，那是最高等的力量。”
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi huí dá: “Wǒ men xū yào dì èr zhǒng mó fǎ, nà shì zuì gāo děng de lì liàng.”
sentences.english: The shadow replied, "We need a second kind of magic; that is the highest grade of power."

sentences.chinese: 突然，林月的手机响了，这是一个奇怪的电话。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, Lín Yuè de shǒu jī xiǎng le, zhè shì yī gè qí guài de diàn huà.
sentences.english: Suddenly, Lin Yue's cell phone rang; it was a strange phone call.

sentences.chinese: 电话里的人说：“快走！不要在这里喝茶！”
sentences.pinyin: Diàn huà lǐ de rén shuō: “Kuài zǒu! Bù yào zài zhè lǐ hē chá!”
sentences.english: The person on the phone said, "Leave quickly! Do not drink tea here!"

sentences.chinese: 林月看向桌子，发现茶杯里的茶在发光。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè kàn xiàng zhuō zi, fā xiàn chá bēi lǐ de chá zài fā guāng.
sentences.english: Lin Yue looked at the table and found the tea in the teacup was glowing.

sentences.chinese: 她看到房间里的东西排成了一行，指向远方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào fáng jiān lǐ de dōng xī pái chéng le yī háng, zhǐ xiàng yuǎn fāng.
sentences.english: She saw the things in the room lined up in a row, pointing toward the distance.

sentences.chinese: 她意识到这个房间是影子记忆的碎片。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào zhè gè fáng jiān shì yǐng zi jì yì de suì piàn.
sentences.english: She realized this room was a fragment of the shadow's memory.

sentences.chinese: 他们必须在时间结束前离开这个幻境。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men bì xū zài shí jiān jié shù qián lí kāi zhè gè huàn jìng.
sentences.english: They had to leave this illusion before time ran out.

sentences.chinese: 就在他们准备走的时候，汽车突然自己启动了，向着黑山冲去。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tā men zhǔn bèi zǒu de shí hòu, qì chē tū rán zì jǐ qǐ dòng le, xiàng zhe hēi shān chōng qù.
sentences.english: Just as they were preparing to leave, the car suddenly started on its own and rushed toward the Black Mountain.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十二章：飞行的车与古老的门
chapters.title_english: Chapter 12: The Flying Car and the Ancient Gate

sentences.chinese: 林月大声喊道：“快上车！”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè dà shēng hǎn dào: “Kuài shàng chē!”
sentences.english: Lin Yue shouted loudly, "Quick, get in the car!"

sentences.chinese: 她和影子赶紧上车，汽车像鸟一样飞在空中。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hé yǐng zi gǎn jǐn shàng chē, qì chē xiàng niǎo yī yàng fēi zài kōng zhōng.
sentences.english: She and the shadow quickly got in the car, and the car flew in the sky like a bird.

sentences.chinese: 他们飞向黑山，林月没有忘记她的魔法书。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men fēi xiàng hēi shān, Lín Yuè méi yǒu wàng jì tā de mó fǎ shū.
sentences.english: They flew toward the Black Mountain; Lin Yue did not forget her magic book.

sentences.chinese: 她打开书，发现里面有一张奇怪的票。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dǎ kāi shū, fā xiàn lǐ miàn yǒu yī zhāng qí guài de piào.
sentences.english: She opened the book and found a strange ticket inside.

sentences.chinese: 这张票看起来像机票，但上面写着“日之国”。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng piào kàn qǐ lái xiàng jī piào, dàn shàng miàn xiě zhe “Rì zhī guó”.
sentences.english: This ticket looked like an air ticket, but it said "Land of the Sun (Ri)".

sentences.chinese: 影子说：“我们需要这张票，才能进入黑山的中心。”
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi shuō: “Wǒ men xū yào zhè zhāng piào, cái néng jìn rù hēi shān de zhōng xīn.”
sentences.english: The shadow said, "We need this ticket to enter the center of the Black Mountain."

sentences.chinese: 汽车快速地来到一座巨大的石门前。
sentences.pinyin: Qì chē kuài sù de lái dào yī zuò jù dà de shí mén qián.
sentences.english: The car quickly arrived in front of a giant stone gate.

sentences.chinese: 林月问：“我们要怎么进去？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè wèn: “Wǒ men yào zěn me jìn qù?”
sentences.english: Lin Yue asked, "How do we go in?"

sentences.chinese: 影子回答：“我们需要一张门票，或者一张车票。”
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi huí dá: “Wǒ men xū yào yī zhāng mén piào, huò zhě yī zhāng chē piào.”
sentences.english: The shadow replied, "We need an admission ticket or a vehicle ticket."

sentences.chinese: 林月把书里的票拿出来，递给石门。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè bǎ shū lǐ de piào ná chū lái, dì gěi shí mén.
sentences.english: Lin Yue took the ticket out of the book and handed it to the stone gate.

sentences.chinese: 石门突然出声了，它说：“请进来。”
sentences.pinyin: Shí mén tū rán chū shēng le, tā shuō: “Qǐng jìn lái.”
sentences.english: The stone gate suddenly made a sound and said, "Please come in."

sentences.chinese: 林月和影子走进去，进入了一个发光的世界。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè hé yǐng zi zǒu jìn qù, jìn rù le yī gè fā guāng de shì jiè.
sentences.english: Lin Yue and the shadow went in, entering a glowing world.

sentences.chinese: 他们看到很多影子在里面走来走去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men kàn dào hěn duō yǐng zi zài lǐ miàn zǒu lái zǒu qù.
sentences.english: They saw many shadows walking back and forth inside.

sentences.chinese: 一个影子对他们说：“你们为什么不回家？”
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè yǐng zi duì tā men shuō: “Nǐ men wèi shén me bù huí jiā?”
sentences.english: A shadow said to them, "Why don't you go home?"

sentences.chinese: 林月说：“我必须帮我的朋友回来。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè shuō: “Wǒ bì xū bāng wǒ de péng yǒu huí lái.”
sentences.english: Lin Yue said, "I must help my friend come back."

sentences.chinese: 影子叹气说：“这里的人都忘记了怎么回去。”
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi tàn qì shuō: “Zhè lǐ de rén dōu wàng jì le zěn me huí qù.”
sentences.english: The shadow sighed and said, "The people here have all forgotten how to go back."

sentences.chinese: 林月看向远处，发现一个出口。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè kàn xiàng yuǎn chù, fā xiàn yī gè chū kǒu.
sentences.english: Lin Yue looked into the distance and found an exit.

sentences.chinese: 她对影子说：“我们快出去，那里有出路。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì yǐng zi shuō: “Wǒ men kuài chū qù, nà lǐ yǒu chū lù.”
sentences.english: She said to the shadow, "Let's go out quickly, there is a way out there."

sentences.chinese: 他们快步走出去，回到了黑山的边缘。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men kuài bù zǒu chū qù, huí dào le hēi shān de biān yuán.
sentences.english: They walked out quickly and returned to the edge of the Black Mountain.

sentences.chinese: 林月意识到，他们必须回到那个记忆的碎片里。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè yì shí dào, tā men bì xū huí dào nà gè jì yì de suì piàn lǐ.
sentences.english: Lin Yue realized that they must return to that fragment of memory.

sentences.chinese: 她决定再次回去寻找真相。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué dìng zài cì huí qù xún zhǎo zhēn xiàng.
sentences.english: She decided to go back once more to find the truth.

sentences.chinese: 就在他们准备下车的时候，天空突然变色了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tā men zhǔn bèi xià chē de shí hòu, tiān kōng tū rán biàn sè le.
sentences.english: Just as they were preparing to get out of the car, the sky suddenly changed color.

sentences.chinese: 一个巨大的声音在他们头顶响起：“谁敢来到这里！”
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè jù dà de shēng yīn zài tā men tóu dǐng xiǎng qǐ: “Shéi gǎn lái dào zhè lǐ!”
sentences.english: A giant voice rang out above their heads: "Who dares to come here!"

chapters.title_chinese: 第十三章：雷电之塔的知识
chapters.title_english: Chapter 13: Knowledge of the Lightning Tower

sentences.chinese: 天空的颜色现在非常奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Tiān kōng de yán sè xiàn zài fēi cháng qí guài.
sentences.english: The color of the sky is very strange now.

sentences.chinese: 巨大的声音在他们前方的云层中响起。
sentences.pinyin: Jù dà de shēng yīn zài tā men qián fāng de yún céng zhōng xiǎng qǐ.
sentences.english: A giant voice echoed in the clouds ahead of them.

sentences.chinese: 林月看着天空，发现那里有很多金色的电光。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè kàn zhe tiān kōng, fā xiàn nà lǐ yǒu hěn duō jīn sè de diàn guāng.
sentences.english: Lin Yue looked at the sky and found many golden flashes of lightning there.

sentences.chinese: 那些电光像火一样在空中跳舞。
sentences.pinyin: Nà xiē diàn guāng xiàng huǒ yī yàng zài kōng zhōng tiào wǔ.
sentences.english: Those flashes of lightning danced in the air just like fire.

sentences.chinese: 林月觉得这个声音太大了，她感到很害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè jué de zhè ge shēng yīn tài dà le, tā gǎn dào hěn hài pà.
sentences.english: Lin Yue felt the voice was too loud, and she felt very scared.

sentences.chinese: 但她知道，寻找真相是非常重要的。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tā zhī dào, xún zhǎo zhēn xiàng shì fēi cháng zhòng yào de.
sentences.english: But she knew that searching for the truth was extremely important.

sentences.chinese: 她跟在影子的后面，快步走向一座高塔。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gēn zài yǐng zi de hòu miàn, kuài bù zǒu xiàng yī zuò gāo tǎ.
sentences.english: She followed behind the shadow, walking quickly toward a high tower.

sentences.chinese: 这座塔很有名，人们叫它“雷电之塔”。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò tǎ hěn yǒu míng, rén men jiào tā “Léi diàn zhī tǎ”.
sentences.english: This tower is very famous; people call it the "Tower of Lightning."

sentences.chinese: 塔的外面很干净，没有一点灰尘。
sentences.pinyin: Tǎ de wài miàn hěn gān jìng, méi yǒu yī diǎn huī chén.
sentences.english: The outside of the tower was very clean, without a speck of dust.

sentences.chinese: 林月想，这里的魔法一定很贵，因为只有最高贵的人才能进入。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè xiǎng, zhè lǐ de mó fǎ yī dìng hěn guì, yīn wèi zhǐ yǒu zuì gāo guì de rén cái néng jìn rù.
sentences.english: Lin Yue thought the magic here must be precious, because only the most noble people could enter.

sentences.chinese: 她认真地看着塔门上的文字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā rèn zhēn de kàn zhe tǎ mén shàng de wén zì.
sentences.english: She seriously looked at the characters on the tower door.

sentences.chinese: 她明白这些文字是古老的知识。
sentences.pinyin: Tā míng bai zhè xiē wén zì shì gǔ lǎo de zhī shi.
sentences.english: She understood that these characters were ancient knowledge.

sentences.chinese: 影子告诉她：“我们必须先进入塔，才能找到答案。”
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi gào su tā: “Wǒ men bì xū xiān jìn rù tǎ, cái néng zhǎo dào dá àn.”
sentences.english: The shadow told her, "We must enter the tower first before we can find the answer."

sentences.chinese: 林月问：“现在是早晨还是晚上？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè wèn: “Xiàn zài shì zǎo chén hái shi wǎn shang?”
sentences.english: Lin Yue asked, "Is it morning or evening now?"

sentences.chinese: 影子回答：“在这里，时间没有早晚，只有魔法。”
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi huí dá: “Zài zhè lǐ, shí jiān méi yǒu zǎo wǎn, zhǐ yǒu mó fǎ.”
sentences.english: The shadow replied, "Here, there is no morning or evening, only magic."

sentences.chinese: 他们进入塔后，发现里面有一个小桌子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men jìn rù tǎ hòu, fā xiàn lǐ miàn yǒu yī ge xiǎo zhuō zi.
sentences.english: After they entered the tower, they found a small table inside.

sentences.chinese: 桌子上有一些好吃的水果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī xiē hǎo chī de shuǐ guǒ.
sentences.english: There were some delicious fruits on the table.

sentences.chinese: 林月常常在书里读到，魔法塔里的食物能给人力量。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè cháng cháng zài shū lǐ dú dào, mó fǎ tǎ lǐ de shí wù néng gěi rén lì liàng.
sentences.english: Lin Yue often read in books that food in magic towers could give people strength.

sentences.chinese: 她吃了一块水果，觉得真的很好吃。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chī le yī kuài shuǐ guǒ, jué de zhēn de hěn hǎo chī.
sentences.english: She ate a piece of fruit and felt it was truly delicious.

sentences.chinese: 影子看着她，说：“你现在感觉好多了吧？”
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi kàn zhe tā, shuō: “Nǐ xiàn zài gǎn jué hǎo duō le ba?”
sentences.english: The shadow looked at her and said, "You feel much better now, right?"

sentences.chinese: 林月点点头，但她还是感到有些不安。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè diǎn diǎn tóu, dàn tā hái shi gǎn dào yǒu xiē bù ān.
sentences.english: Lin Yue nodded, but she still felt somewhat uneasy.

sentences.chinese: 她说：“这里的魔法太难了，我不知道怎么使用。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zhè lǐ de mó fǎ tài nán le, wǒ bù zhī dào zěn me shǐ yòng.”
sentences.english: She said, "The magic here is too difficult; I don't know how to use it."

sentences.chinese: 影子笑了，他说：“学习魔法需要时间，不要太忙，要慢慢来。”
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi xiào le, tā shuō: “Xué xí mó fǎ xū yào shí jiān, bù yào tài máng, yào màn màn lái.”
sentences.english: The shadow smiled and said, "Learning magic takes time; don't be in too much of a hurry, take it slowly."

sentences.chinese: 突然，一阵强风吹进了房间。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, yī zhèn qiáng fēng chuī jìn le fáng jiān.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a strong wind blew into the room.

sentences.chinese: 风把书页翻得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Fēng bǎ shū yè fān de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: The wind flipped the pages of the book very quickly.

sentences.chinese: 林月发现最后的一页写着一个秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè fā xiàn zuì hòu de yī yè xiě zhe yī ge mì mì.
sentences.english: Lin Yue discovered a secret written on the final page.

sentences.chinese: 这个秘密关于黑山的身体。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge mì mì guān yú hēi shān de shēn tǐ.
sentences.english: This secret was about the body of the Black Mountain.

sentences.chinese: 林月意识到，找回身体的路还很远。
