sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè yì shí dào, zhǎo huí shēn tǐ de lù hái hěn yuǎn.
sentences.english: Lin Yue realized that the road to recovering the body was still far.

sentences.chinese: 她必须重复阅读这些文字，因为每一个字都很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì xū chóng fù yuè dú zhè xiē wén zì, yīn wèi měi yī gè zì dōu hěn zhòng yào.
sentences.english: She had to repeat the reading of these words because every single character was important.

sentences.chinese: 影子说：“如果你想成功，最好现在就开始练习。”
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi shuō: “Rú guǒ nǐ xiǎng chéng gōng, zuì hǎo xiàn zài jiù kāi shǐ liàn xí.”
sentences.english: The shadow said, "If you want to succeed, it's best to start practicing now."

sentences.chinese: 林月决定尝试一次新的魔法着法。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè jué dìng cháng shì yī cì xīn de mó fǎ zhāo fǎ.
sentences.english: Lin Yue decided to try a new magic move.

sentences.chinese: 她闭上眼睛，心中想着家人的样子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì shàng yǎn jīng, xīn zhōng xiǎng zhe jiā rén de yàng zi.
sentences.english: She closed her eyes and thought of her family's faces.

sentences.chinese: 真神奇！她的手中出现了一道光。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēn shén qí! Tā de shǒu zhōng chū xiàn le yī dào guāng.
sentences.english: Truly magical! A beam of light appeared in her hand.

sentences.chinese: 这道光和记忆碎片里的光一样亮。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào guāng hé jì yì suì piàn lǐ de guāng yī yàng liàng.
sentences.english: This light was as bright as the light in the memory fragments.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，塔顶突然发出了巨大的轰鸣声，一个黑色的影子马上冲了下来。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, tǎ dǐng tū rán fā chū le jù dà de hōng míng shēng, yī ge hēi sè de yǐng zi mǎ shàng chōng le xià lái.
sentences.english: Just then, a giant roar suddenly erupted from the top of the tower, and a black shadow immediately rushed down.

sentences.chinese: 那个黑色的影子冲到林月面前。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge hēi sè de yǐng zi chōng dào Lín Yuè miàn qián.
sentences.english: That black shadow rushed in front of Lin Yue.

sentences.chinese: 他是一个高大的男人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì yī gè gāo dà de nán rén.
sentences.english: He was a tall man.

sentences.chinese: 林月问：“你是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè wèn: “Nǐ shì shéi?”
sentences.english: Lin Yue asked, "Who are you?"

sentences.chinese: 他停下来，声音很低：“我的名字被忘记了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā tíng xià lái, shēng yīn hěn dī: “Wǒ de míng zi bèi wàng jì le.”
sentences.english: He stopped, his voice very low: "My name has been forgotten."

sentences.chinese: 他看着林月，说：“你让我想起我的家人。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe Lín Yuè, shuō: “Nǐ ràng wǒ xiǎng qǐ wǒ de jiā rén.”
sentences.english: He looked at Lin Yue and said, "You remind me of my family."

sentences.chinese: 突然，一道光把他们带到了一个奇怪的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, yī dào guāng bǎ tā men dài dào le yī gè qí guài de dì fang.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a beam of light took them to a strange place.

sentences.chinese: 那里有一座大房子。
sentences.pinyin: Nà lǐ yǒu yī zuò dà fáng zi.
sentences.english: There was a big house there.

sentences.chinese: 房子里面有很多古老的家具。
sentences.pinyin: Fáng zi lǐ miàn yǒu hěn duō gǔ lǎo de jiā jù.
sentences.english: Inside the house, there was a lot of ancient furniture.

sentences.chinese: 在这个房子里，林月看到了一个先生。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè ge fáng zi lǐ, Lín Yuè kàn dào le yī gè xiān sheng.
sentences.english: In this house, Lin Yue saw a gentleman.

sentences.chinese: 他看起来像一个病人，身体很弱。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐ lái xiàng yī gè bìng rén, shēn tǐ hěn ruò.
sentences.english: He looked like a sick person, his body was very weak.

sentences.chinese: 林月问：“这位先生是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè wèn: “Zhè wèi xiān sheng shì shéi?”
sentences.english: Lin Yue asked, "Who is this gentleman?"

sentences.chinese: 影子说：“他是我的哥哥，一个很伟大的哥。”
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi shuō: “Tā shì wǒ de gē ge, yī gè hěn wěi dà de gē.”
sentences.english: The shadow said, "He is my older brother, a very great brother."

sentences.chinese: 这个哥哥已经很多岁了，他住在楼上。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge gē ge yǐ jīng hěn duō suì le, tā zhù zài lóu shàng.
sentences.english: This older brother was already many years old; he lived upstairs.

sentences.chinese: 林月走上楼，看到他在看一些奇怪的汉字。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè zǒu shàng lóu, kàn dào tā zài kàn yī xiē qí guài de hàn zì.
sentences.english: Lin Yue walked upstairs and saw him looking at some strange Chinese characters.

sentences.chinese: 这些汉字在发光，像魔法一样。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiē hàn zì zài fā guāng, xiàng mó fǎ yī yàng.
sentences.english: These characters were glowing, just like magic.

sentences.chinese: 哥哥看着林月，笑着说：“你不是这里的人。”
sentences.pinyin: Gē ge kàn zhe Lín Yuè, xiào zhe shuō: “Nǐ bù shì zhè lǐ de rén.”
sentences.english: The older brother looked at Lin Yue and said with a smile, "You are not a person from here."

sentences.chinese: “这里只有我们，没有别人。”
sentences.pinyin: “Zhè lǐ zhǐ yǒu wǒ men, méi yǒu bié ren.”
sentences.english: "There are only us here, no other people."

sentences.chinese: 林月想起了她的家，想起了温暖的晚饭。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè xiǎng qǐ le tā de jiā, xiǎng qǐ le wēn nuǎn de wǎn fàn.
sentences.english: Lin Yue thought of her home, and thought of warm dinner.

sentences.chinese: 她记得家里的饭很好吃，尤其是鸡蛋。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì dé jiā lǐ de fàn hěn hǎo chī, yóu qí shì jī dàn.
sentences.english: She remembered the meals at home were delicious, especially the eggs.

sentences.chinese: 她对哥哥说：“我想帮你们找回身体。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì gē ge shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng bāng nǐ men zhǎo huí shēn tǐ.”
sentences.english: She said to the brother, "I want to help you all find back your bodies."

sentences.chinese: 这时候，影子们突然看向窗外。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí hou, yǐng zi men tū rán kàn xiàng chuāng wài.
sentences.english: At this moment, the shadows suddenly looked out the window.

sentences.chinese: 一个像网友一样奇怪的生物在窗户外面喊道：“快走！”
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè xiàng wǎng yǒu yī yàng qí guài de shēng wù zài chuāng hu wài miàn hǎn dào: “Kuài zǒu!”
sentences.english: A strange creature, like an online friend, shouted from outside the window: "Leave quickly!"

sentences.chinese: 林月感到心跳很快，因为房子开始震动。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè gǎn dào xīn tiào hěn kuài, yīn wèi fáng zi kāi shǐ zhèn dòng.
sentences.english: Lin Yue felt her heart beating fast because the house began to shake.

sentences.chinese: 房子震动得非常厉害，林月和影子们赶紧跑了出去。
sentences.pinyin: Fáng zi zhèn dòng de fēi cháng lì hai, Lín Yuè hé yǐng zi men gǎn jǐn pǎo le chū qu.
sentences.english: The house shook violently, and Lin Yue and the shadows hurried out.

sentences.chinese: 他们发现自己来到一个奇怪的地方，这里看起来像一个巨大的城市。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men fā xiàn zì jǐ lái dào yí gè qí guài de dì fang, zhè lǐ kàn qǐ lái xiàng yí gè jù dà de chéng shì.
sentences.english: They found themselves in a strange place that looked like a giant city.

sentences.chinese: 虽然现在是早上，但天空没有太阳，只有灰色的雨在落下。
sentences.pinyin: Suī rán xiàn zài shì zǎo shang, dàn tiān kōng méi yǒu tài yáng, zhǐ yǒu huī sè de yǔ zài luò xià.
sentences.english: Although it was early morning, there was no sun in the sky, only grey rain falling.

sentences.chinese: 林月看着周围，这里的天气非常奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè kàn zhe zhōu wéi, zhè lǐ de tiān qì fēi cháng qí guài.
sentences.english: Lin Yue looked around; the weather here was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 一个穿着蓝色衣服的工人走过来，他的动作很慢。
sentences.pinyin: Yí gè chuān zhe lán sè yī fu de gōng rén zǒu guò lái, tā de dòng zuò hěn màn.
sentences.english: A worker wearing blue clothes walked over, his movements very slow.

sentences.chinese: 工人告诉她：“这里是幻象之城，这里的东西都是从你们的记忆里来的。”
sentences.pinyin: Gōng rén gào su tā: “Zhè lǐ shì huàn xiàng zhī chéng, zhè lǐ de dōng xi dōu shì cóng nǐ men de jì yì lǐ lái de.”
sentences.english: The worker told her, "This is the City of Illusions; everything here comes from your memories."

sentences.chinese: 林月看到路边有一家书店，书店里有很多写着中文的书。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè kàn dào lù biān yǒu yì jiā shū diàn, shū diàn lǐ yǒu hěn duō xiě zhe Zhōng wén de shū.
sentences.english: Lin Yue saw a bookstore by the road, and inside the bookstore were many books written in Chinese.

sentences.chinese: 她想起在那个外国的梦里，她学习过汉语和外语。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ zài nà gè wài guó de mèng lǐ, tā xué xí guò Hàn yǔ hé wài yǔ.
sentences.english: She remembered that in a foreign dream, she had studied Mandarin and foreign languages.

sentences.chinese: 她走进书店，发现了一张古老的地图。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu jìn shū diàn, fā xiàn le yì zhāng gǔ lǎo de dì tú.
sentences.english: She walked into the bookstore and discovered an ancient map.

sentences.chinese: 地图上写着：从这里出发，可以去北京，也可以去中国其他地方。
sentences.pinyin: Dì tú shàng xiě zhe: Cóng zhè lǐ chū fā, kě yǐ qù Běi jīng, yě kě yǐ qù Zhōng guó qí tā dì fang.
sentences.english: The map said: Starting from here, you can go to Beijing, or other places in China.

sentences.chinese: 她好奇地问：“这里有电脑或者电视机吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā hào qí de wèn: “Zhè lǐ yǒu diàn nǎo huò zhě diàn shì jī ma?”
sentences.english: She asked curiously, "Are there computers or television sets here?"

sentences.chinese: 工人笑了笑说：“这里没有，但你可以通过网上看到真实的世界。”
sentences.pinyin: Gōng rén xiào le xiào shuō: “Zhè lǐ méi yǒu, dàn nǐ kě yǐ tōng guò wǎng shàng kàn dào zhēn shí de shì jiè.”
sentences.english: The worker smiled and said, "There are none here, but you can see the real world online."

sentences.chinese: 林月感到很渴，她想喝牛奶或者吃一些水果。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè gǎn dào hěn kě, tā xiǎng hē niú nǎi huò zhě chī yì xiē shuǐ guǒ.
sentences.english: Lin Yue felt very thirsty; she wanted to drink cow's milk or eat some fruit.

sentences.chinese: 她想起早上的早饭只有面包，现在她很想吃米饭。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ zǎo shang de zǎo fàn zhǐ yǒu miàn bāo, xiàn zài tā hěn xiǎng chī mǐ fàn.
sentences.english: She remembered that for breakfast this morning she only had bread, and now she really wanted to eat rice.

sentences.chinese: 她看向地图的另一边，那里有一个很大的医院。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng dì tú de lìng yì biān, nà lǐ yǒu yí gè hěn dà de yī yuàn.
sentences.english: She looked at the other side of the map, where there was a very large hospital.

sentences.chinese: 她记得那里有一位医生，可以帮影子们找回身体。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì de nà lǐ yǒu yí wèi yī shēng, kě yǐ bāng yǐng zi men zhǎo huí shēn tǐ.
sentences.english: She remembered there was a doctor there who could help the shadows recover their bodies.

sentences.chinese: 她决定在午饭之前去那个医院看看。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué dìng zài wǔ fàn zhī qián qù nà gè yī yuàn kàn kàn.
sentences.english: She decided to visit that hospital before lunch.

sentences.chinese: 为了快速到达，她看到远处有一辆飞行的火车。
sentences.pinyin: Wèi le kuài sù dào dá, tā kàn dào yuǎn chù yǒu yí liàng fēi xíng de huǒ chē.
sentences.english: To arrive quickly, she saw a flying train in the distance.

sentences.chinese: 火车像飞机一样在空中飞快地移动。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒ chē xiàng fēi jī yí yàng zài kōng zhōng fēi kuài de yí dòng.
sentences.english: The train moved swiftly through the air like an airplane.

sentences.chinese: 林月走在车上，看着窗外的风景，感觉像是在逛一个巨大的图书馆。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè zǒu zài chē shàng, kàn zhe chuāng wài de fēng jǐng, gǎn jué xiàng shì zài guàng yí gè jù dà de tú shū guǎn.
sentences.english: Lin Yue walked on the train, looking at the scenery outside the window, feeling as if she were visiting a giant library.

sentences.chinese: 她想起以前在学校学习中文的日子，那时候生活很简单。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ yǐ qián zài xué xiào xué xí Zhōng wén de rì zi, nà shí hou shēng huó hěn jiǎn dān.
sentences.english: She thought back to the days of studying Chinese at school; life was very simple then.

sentences.chinese: 突然，火车停了下来，一个巨大的影子挡在了路中间。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, huǒ chē tíng le xià lái, yí gè jù dà de yǐng zi dǎng zài le lù zhōng jiān.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the train came to a stop, and a giant shadow blocked the middle of the road.

sentences.chinese: 那个影子大声喊道：“你们不能去医院！”
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè yǐng zi dà shēng hǎn dào: “Nǐ men bù néng qù yī yuàn!”
sentences.english: The shadow shouted loudly, "You cannot go to the hospital!"

sentences.chinese: 林月紧紧抱着她的地图，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè jǐn jǐn bào zhe tā de dì tú, xīn tiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Lin Yue hugged her map tightly, her heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 她知道，如果不能在上午离开这里，他们会被困在幻象中。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhī dào, rú guǒ bù néng zài shàng wǔ lí kāi zhè lǐ, tā men huì bèi kùn zài huàn xiàng zhōng.
sentences.english: She knew that if they couldn't leave here by the morning, they would be trapped in the illusion.

sentences.chinese: 影子们开始发抖，因为这个巨大的影子拥有强大的力量。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi men kāi shǐ fā dǒu, yīn wèi zhè gè jù dà de yǐng zi yōng yǒu qiáng dà de lì liàng.
sentences.english: The shadows began to tremble because this giant shadow possessed great power.

sentences.chinese: 林月看着那个影子，突然发现他的眼睛里有泪水。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè kàn zhe nà gè yǐng zi, tū rán fā xiàn tā de yǎn jīng lǐ yǒu lèi shuǐ.
sentences.english: Lin Yue looked at the shadow and suddenly noticed tears in its eyes.

sentences.chinese: 这个影子竟然也是一个迷路的人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè yǐng zi jìng rán yě shì yí gè mí lù de rén.
sentences.english: This shadow was actually a lost person as well.

sentences.chinese: 林月尝试用温暖的声音说话，希望能说服他。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè cháng shì yòng wēn nuǎn de shēng yīn shuō huà, xī wàng néng shuō fú tā.
sentences.english: Lin Yue tried to speak in a warm voice, hoping to persuade him.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，天空中突然出现了一个巨大的黑洞。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, tiān kōng zhōng tū rán chū xiàn le yí gè jù dà de hēi dòng.
sentences.english: But just then, a giant black hole suddenly appeared in the sky.

sentences.chinese: 黑洞开始吞噬周围的一切，包括那辆火车。
sentences.pinyin: Hēi dòng kāi shǐ tūn shì zhōu wéi de yí qiè, bāo kuò nà liàng huǒ chē.
sentences.english: The black hole began to swallow everything around it, including the train.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 16: The End of the Black Hole

sentences.chinese: 火车在黑洞中向下掉。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒchē zài hēidòng zhōng xiàng xià diào.
sentences.english: The train fell downwards into the black hole.

sentences.chinese: 林月觉得这里不对。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè juéde zhèlǐ bùduì.
sentences.english: Lin Yue felt that something was wrong here.

sentences.chinese: 她看到那个影子在哭。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào nàge yǐngzi zài kū.
sentences.english: She saw that the shadow was crying.

sentences.chinese: 他看起来很累，也很饿。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐlái hěn lèi, yě hěn è.
sentences.english: He looked very tired and very hungry.

sentences.chinese: 林月对他大喊：“不要害怕！”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè duì tā dà hǎn: “Bùyào hàipà!”
sentences.english: Lin Yue shouted to him, "Do not be afraid!"

sentences.chinese: 但黑洞的力量很大，把一切都弄坏了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn hēidòng de lìliàng hěn dà, bǎ yīqiè dōu nòng huài le.
sentences.english: But the power of the black hole was great, and it broke everything.

sentences.chinese: 影子说：“对不起，我忘了怎么回家。”
sentences.pinyin: Yǐngzi shuō: “Duìbuqǐ, wǒ wàngle zěnme huí jiā.”
sentences.english: The shadow said, "I'm sorry, I forgot how to go home."

sentences.chinese: 林月说：“没关系，我帮你找。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè shuō: “Méi guānxi, wǒ bāng nǐ zhǎo.”
sentences.english: Lin Yue said, "It's okay, I will help you look for it."

sentences.chinese: 他们掉到了一个奇怪的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen diào dàole yīgè qíguài de dìfāng.
sentences.english: They fell into a strange place.

sentences.chinese: 这里像是一个古老的机场，但没有飞机。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ xiàng shì yīgè gǔlǎo de jīchǎng, dàn méiyǒu fēijī.
sentences.english: It looked like an ancient airport, but there were no airplanes.

sentences.chinese: 林月看到两个男孩子在北边走。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè kàndào liǎng gè nán háizi zài běibiān zǒu.
sentences.english: Lin Yue saw two boys walking in the north.

sentences.chinese: 他们手里拿着二个发光的球。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen shǒu lǐ názhe èr gè fāguāng de qiú.
sentences.english: They held two glowing spheres in their hands.

sentences.chinese: 这些球比星星还要小，但光很强。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē qiú bǐ xīngxīng hái yào xiǎo, dàn guāng hěn qiáng.
sentences.english: These spheres were smaller than stars, but the light was strong.

sentences.chinese: 林月看向西边，发现那里有一座金色的门。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè kàn xiàng xībiān, fāxiàn nàlǐ yǒu yī zuò jīnsè de mén.
sentences.english: Lin Yue looked to the west and found a golden gate there.

sentences.chinese: 她觉得这里的魔法非常少。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde zhèlǐ de mófǎ fēicháng shǎo.
sentences.english: She felt that the magic here was very scarce.

sentences.chinese: 她想，如果忘掉回家路，那就太糟糕了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rúguǒ wàngdiào huí jiā lù, nà jiù tài zāogāo le.
sentences.english: She thought that it would be terrible to forget the way home.

sentences.chinese: 她对影子说：“我们要快点走。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì yǐngzi shuō: “Wǒmen yào kuài diǎn zǒu.”
sentences.english: She said to the shadow, "We need to move quickly."

sentences.chinese: 影子点头，他的声音在上声调中颤抖。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐngzi diǎntóu, tā de shēngyīn zài shǎngshēngdiào zhōng chàndǒu.
sentences.english: The shadow nodded, his voice trembling in the rising tone.

sentences.chinese: 林月决定送他回到真正的世界。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè juédìng sòng tā huí dào zhēnzhèng de shìjiè.
sentences.english: Lin Yue decided to send him back to the real world.

sentences.chinese: 但突然，金色的门关上了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tūrán, jīnsè de mén guān shàng le.
sentences.english: But suddenly, the golden gate closed.

sentences.chinese: 一个巨大的声音说：“谁想进来？”
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè jùdà de shēngyīn shuō: “Shéi xiǎng jìnlái?”
sentences.english: A giant voice said, "Who wants to come in?"

sentences.chinese: 林月发现，门后面有一个巨大的眼睛在看着她。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè fāxiàn, mén hòumiàn yǒu yīgè jùdà de yǎnjīng zài kànzhe tā.
sentences.english: Lin Yue discovered that there was a giant eye behind the door watching her.

sentences.chinese: 巨大的眼睛看着林月，声音像雷一样。
sentences.pinyin: Jù dà de yǎn jīng kàn zhe Lín Yuè, shēng yīn xiàng léi yī yàng.
sentences.english: The giant eye looked at Lin Yue, its voice like thunder.

sentences.chinese: 它问：“你是不是想找回你的家？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn: “Nǐ shì bù shì xiǎng zhǎo huí nǐ de jiā?”
sentences.english: It asked, "Are you trying to find your way home?"

sentences.chinese: 林月害怕，但她看着身边的影子，轻声说：“是的。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè hài pà, dàn tā kàn zhe shēn biān de yǐng zi, qīng shēng shuō: “Shì de.”
sentences.english: Lin Yue was afraid, but she looked at the shadow beside her and whispered, "Yes."

sentences.chinese: 眼睛突然闭上了，门慢慢开了。
sentences.pinyin: Yǎn jīng tū rán bì shàng le, mén màn màn kāi le.
sentences.english: The eye suddenly closed, and the door slowly opened.

sentences.chinese: 门口站着一个老先生，他看起来像林月的爷爷。
sentences.pinyin: Mén kǒu zhàn zhe yī gè lǎo xiān sheng, tā kàn qǐ lái xiàng Lín Yuè de yé ye.
sentences.english: At the doorway stood an old gentleman who looked like Lin Yue's grandfather.

sentences.chinese: 他穿着一件古老的衣服，手里拿着一个奇怪的钟。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chuān zhe yī jiàn gǔ lǎo de yī fu, shǒu lǐ ná zhe yī gè qí guài de zhōng.
sentences.english: He wore ancient clothes and held a strange clock in his hand.

sentences.chinese: 钟上的数字是零，这意味着时间在这里停止了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōng shàng de shù zì shì líng, zhè yì wèi zhe shí jiān zài zhè lǐ tíng zhǐ le.
sentences.english: The number on the clock was zero, meaning time had stopped here.

sentences.chinese: 老先生微笑说：“欢迎来到时间的学校。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo xiān sheng wēi xiào shuō: “Huān yíng lái dào shí jiān de xué xiào.”
sentences.english: The old gentleman smiled and said, "Welcome to the School of Time."

sentences.chinese: 林月惊讶地问：“您是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè jīng yà de wèn: “Nín shì shuí?”
sentences.english: Lin Yue asked in surprise, "Who are you?"

sentences.chinese: 老先生说：“我是这里的守护者，老王。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo xiān sheng shuō: “Wǒ shì zhè lǐ de shǒu hù zhě, Lǎo Wáng.”
sentences.english: The old gentleman said, "I am the guardian here, Old Wang."

sentences.chinese: 林月礼貌地说：“谢谢您帮我。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè lǐ mào de shuō: “Xiè xie nín bāng wǒ.”
sentences.english: Lin Yue said politely, "Thank you for helping me."

sentences.chinese: 老王摆摆手说：“不客气，没关系。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo Wáng bǎi bǎi shǒu shuō: “Bù kè qi, méi guān xi”)
sentences.english: Old Wang waved his hand and said, "You're welcome, it doesn't matter."

sentences.chinese: 他看到林月很饿，从口袋里拿出一个发光的包子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào Lín Yuè hěn è, cóng kǒu dài lǐ ná chū yī gè fā guāng de bāo zi.
sentences.english: He saw that Lin Yue was very hungry and took a glowing baozi from his pocket.

sentences.chinese: “这个包子有魔法，能给你力量，”老王说。
sentences.pinyin: “Zhè ge bāo zi yǒu mó fǎ, néng gěi nǐ lì liàng,” Lǎo Wáng shuō.
sentences.english: "This baozi has magic; it can give you strength," Old Wang said.

sentences.chinese: 林月吃完后觉得身体很暖，她说：“我没觉得累了。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè chī wán hòu jué de shēn tǐ hěn nuǎn, tā shuō: “Wǒ méi jué de lèi le.”
sentences.english: After eating, Lin Yue felt her body become warm, and she said, "I don't feel tired anymore."

sentences.chinese: 老王问：“你现在觉得身体不大舒服吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo Wáng wèn: “Nǐ xiàn zài jué de shēn tǐ bù dà shū fu ma?”
sentences.english: Old Wang asked, "Do you feel not very comfortable right now?"

sentences.chinese: 林月回答：“没什么，我现在没事儿。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè huí dá: “Méi shén me, wǒ xiàn zài méi shì r.”
sentences.english: Lin Yue replied, "It's nothing, I'm fine now."

sentences.chinese: 老王看着天空，说：“现在是正月的第一个早晨。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo Wáng kàn zhe tiān kōng, shuō: “Xiàn zài shì zhèng yuè de dì yī gè zǎo chen.”
sentences.english: Old Wang looked at the sky and said, "It is now the first morning of the first lunar month."

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林月，不用担心，只要通过这个门，就能回家。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su Lín Yuè, bù yòng dān xīn, zhǐ yào tōng guò zhè ge mén, jiù néng huí jiā.
sentences.english: He told Lin Yue not to worry; as long as she passed through this door, she could go home.

sentences.chinese: 林月看向影子，影子说：“我没有家了，但我有你这个朋友。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè kàn xiàng yǐng zi, yǐng zi shuō: “Wǒ méi yǒu jiā le, dàn wǒ yǒu nǐ zhè ge péng you.”
sentences.english: Lin Yue looked at the shadow, and the shadow said, "I have no home, but I have you as a friend."

sentences.chinese: 林月笑了，她说：“我们一起走吧！”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè xiào le, tā shuō: “Wǒ men yī qǐ zǒu ba!”
sentences.english: Lin Yue smiled and said, "Let's go together!"

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，老王突然变色了，他的眼睛变成了红色。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, Lǎo Wáng tū rán biàn sè le, tā de yǎn jīng biàn chéng le hóng sè.
sentences.english: But just then, Old Wang suddenly changed color, and his eyes turned red.

sentences.chinese: 他低声说：“再见，小女孩。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dī shēng shuō: “Zài jiàn, xiǎo nǚ hái.”
sentences.english: He whispered, "Goodbye, little girl."

sentences.chinese: 然后，他把林月推向了一个深不见底的黑洞。
sentences.pinyin: Ran hòu, tā bǎ Lín Yuè tuī xiàng le yī gè shēn bù jiàn dǐ de hēi dòng.
sentences.english: Then, he pushed Lin Yue toward a bottomless black hole.

sentences.chinese: 林月在黑洞里边飞了很久。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè zài hēi dòng lǐ bian fēi le hěn jiǔ.
sentences.english: Lin Yue flew inside the black hole for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 她感到害怕，因为这里没有光。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎndào hàipà, yīnwèi zhè lǐ méiyǒu guāng.
sentences.english: She felt afraid because there was no light here.

sentences.chinese: 突然，她掉进了一个奇怪的房间。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, tā diào jìn le yí gè qí guài de fáng jiān.
sentences.english: Suddenly, she fell into a strange room.

sentences.chinese: 房间里有一张小几，上面放着一张纸。
sentences.pinyin: Fáng jiān lǐ yǒu yì zhāng xiǎo jī, shàng miàn fàng zhe yì zhāng zhǐ.
sentences.english: In the room, there was a small table with a piece of paper on it.

sentences.chinese: 纸上写着一个日期，那是她的生日。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐ shàng xiě zhe yí gè rì qī, nà shì tā de shēng rì.
sentences.english: The paper had a date on it; it was her birthday.

sentences.chinese: 林月很惊讶，她想：“我怎么在这儿？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè hěn jīng yà, tā xiǎng: “Wǒ zěn me zài zhè r?”
sentences.english: Lin Yue was surprised and thought, "How am I here?"

sentences.chinese: 这时候，一个声音说：“请进，年轻的法师。”
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí hou, yí gè shēng yīn shuō: “Qǐng jìn, nián qīng de fǎ shī.”
sentences.english: At that moment, a voice said, "Please come in, young mage."

sentences.chinese: 林月看向门口，那里站着一个老法师。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè kàn xiàng mén kǒu, nà lǐ zhàn zhe yí gè lǎo fǎ shī.
sentences.english: Lin Yue looked toward the door, where an old mage was standing.

sentences.chinese: 老法师说：“请坐，我想和你说话。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo fǎ shī shuō: “Qǐng zuò, wǒ xiǎng hé nǐ shuō huà.”
sentences.english: The old mage said, "Please have a seat, I want to talk to you."

sentences.chinese: 林月坐下来，问：“请问，您是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè zuò xià lái, wèn: “Qǐng wèn, nín shì shuí?”
sentences.english: Lin Yue sat down and asked, "Excuse me, who are you?"

sentences.chinese: 老法师笑了，他的笑容像听一样温和。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo fǎ shī xiào le, tā de xiào róng xiàng tīng yī yàng wēn hé.
sentences.english: The old mage smiled, and his smile was as gentle as a 'ting' (archaic smile).

sentences.chinese: 他说：“我是时间的守护者，我在这里等了你很多小时。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ shì shí jiān de shǒu hù zhě, wǒ zài zhè lǐ děng le nǐ hěn duō xiǎo shí.”
sentences.english: He said, "I am the Guardian of Time; I have waited for you here for many hours."

sentences.chinese: 他看着林月说：“去年，你还只是一个普通女孩。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe Lín Yuè shuō: “Qù nián, nǐ hái zhǐ shì yí gè pǔ tōng nǚ hái.”
sentences.english: He looked at Lin Yue and said, "Last year, you were still just an ordinary girl."

sentences.chinese: “前天，你面对了黑山；昨天，你进入了黑洞。”
sentences.pinyin: “Qián tiān, nǐ miàn duì le hēi shān; zuó tiān, nǐ jìn rù le hēi dòng.”
sentences.english: "The day before yesterday, you faced the Black Mountain; yesterday, you entered the black hole."

sentences.chinese: “今年，是你觉醒魔法的一年。”
sentences.pinyin: “Jīn nián, shì nǐ jué xǐng mó fǎ de yì nián.”
sentences.english: "This year is the year of your magic awakening."

sentences.chinese: 林月想起了她的朋友，那个影子。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè xiǎng qǐ le tā de péng you, nà gè yǐng zi.
sentences.english: Lin Yue thought of her friend, the shadow.

sentences.chinese: 她问：“我的朋友在哪儿？他还在那儿吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn: “Wǒ de péng you zài nǎ r? Tā hái zài nà r ma?”
sentences.english: She asked, "Where is my friend? Is he still there?"

sentences.chinese: 老法师指了指楼下，说：“他在楼下等着你。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo fǎ shī zhǐ le zhǐ lóu xià, shuō: “Tā zài lóu xià děng zhe nǐ.”
sentences.english: The old mage pointed downstairs and said, "He is downstairs waiting for you."

sentences.chinese: 林月想起上次和影子的对话，心中感到温暖。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè xiǎng qǐ shàng cì hé yǐng zi de đối huà, xīn zhōng gǎndào wēn nuǎn.
sentences.english: Lin Yue remembered the conversation with the shadow last time and felt warmth in her heart.

sentences.chinese: 影子曾经说，他没有家里，但现在他有了朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi céng jīng shuō, tā méiyǒu jiā lǐ, dàn xiàn zài tā yǒu le péng you.
sentences.english: The shadow had once said he had no home, but now he had a friend.

sentences.chinese: 老法师说：“有时候，时间会欺骗我们。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo fǎ shī shuō: “Yǒu shí hou, shí jiān huì qī piàn wǒ men.”
sentences.english: The old mage said, "Sometimes, time deceives us."

sentences.chinese: “那些旧的记忆和这些新的力量在打架。”
sentences.pinyin: “Nà xiē jiù de jì yì hé zhè xiē xīn de lì liàng zài dǎ jià.”
sentences.english: "Those old memories and these new powers are fighting."

sentences.chinese: 他拿出一个打大小的魔法球，球里有很多光。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū yí gè dǎ dà xiǎo de mó fǎ qiú, qiú lǐ yǒu hěn duō guāng.
sentences.english: He took out a magic orb the size of a dozen, filled with much light.

sentences.chinese: “在这个球里，你可以看到明天，甚至明年。”
sentences.pinyin: “Zài zhè gè qiú lǐ, nǐ kě yǐ kàn dào míng tiān, shèn zhì míng nián.”
sentences.english: "Inside this orb, you can see tomorrow, and even next year."

sentences.chinese: 林月问：“我能看到下次见面的时候吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè wèn: “Wǒ néng kàn dào xià cì jiàn miàn de shí hou ma?”
sentences.english: Lin Yue asked, "Can I see the next time we meet?"

sentences.chinese: 老法师点头说：“你可以，但你必须先学会控制魔法。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo fǎ shī diǎn tóu shuō: “Nǐ kě yǐ, dàn nǐ bì xū xiān xué huì kòng zhì mó fǎ.”
sentences.english: The old mage nodded and said, "You can, but you must first learn to control magic."

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林月，在这个世界，星期天和星期日是不一样的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su Lín Yuè, zài zhè gè shì jiè, Xīng qī tiān hé Xīng qī rì shì bù yī yàng de.
sentences.english: He told Lin Yue that in this world, Sunday (Xingqitian) and Sunday (Xingqiri) are different.

sentences.chinese: “在我们的世界，星期天是休息，星期日是战斗。”
sentences.pinyin: “Zài wǒ men de shì jiè, Xīng qī tiān shì xiū xi, Xīng qī rì shì zhàn dòu.”
sentences.english: "In our world, Sunday (Xingqitian) is for rest, and Sunday (Xingqiri) is for battle."

sentences.chinese: 林月想回家，她问：“我需要请假才能离开这里吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè xiǎng huí jiā, tā wèn: “Wǒ xū yào qǐng jià cái néng lí kāi zhè lǐ ma?”
sentences.english: Lin Yue wanted to go home and asked, "Do I need to request a leave of absence to leave this place?"

sentences.chinese: 老法师大笑，说：“你们不需要请假，只需要勇气。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo fǎ shī dà xiào, shuō: “Nǐ men bù xū yào qǐng jià, zhǐ xū yào yǒng qì.”
sentences.english: The old mage laughed loudly and said, "You all do not need to request leave, you only need courage."

sentences.chinese: 他看着林月，自个儿轻轻地说：“你和他们不一样。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe Lín Yuè, zì gè ěr qīng qīng de shuō: “Nǐ hé tā men bù yī yàng.”
sentences.english: He looked at Lin Yue and said softly to himself, "You are different from them."

sentences.chinese: 林月站起来，准备走向楼下。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè zhàn qǐ lái, zhǔn bèi zǒu xiàng lóu xià.
sentences.english: Lin Yue stood up, preparing to go downstairs.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，房间的墙壁突然开始移动。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí hou, fáng jiān de qiáng bì tū rán kāi shǐ yí dòng.
sentences.english: But just then, the walls of the room suddenly began to move.

sentences.chinese: 一个巨大的时钟出现在她面前，指针在疯狂地旋转。
sentences.pinyin: Yí gè jù dà de shí zhōng chū xiàn zài tā miàn qián, zhǐ zhēn zài fēng kuáng de xuán zhuǎn.
sentences.english: A giant clock appeared before her, its hands spinning frantically.

sentences.chinese: 时钟的指针突然停了一下儿。
sentences.pinyin: Shízhōng de zhǐzhēn tūrán tíng le yī xià r.
sentences.english: The clock hands suddenly stopped for a moment.

sentences.chinese: 林月发现自己不在迷宫里，而是在一个白色的房间里。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè fāxiàn zìjǐ bù zài mígōng lǐ, ér shì zài yī gè báisè de fángjiān lǐ.
sentences.english: Lin Yue discovered she was no longer in the maze, but in a white room.

sentences.chinese: 这里很安静，像一个巨大的梦。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ hěn ānjìng, xiàng yī gè jùdà de mèng.
sentences.english: It was very quiet here, like a giant dream.

sentences.chinese: 她看到一个老人坐在桌子旁边。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào yī gè lǎo rén zuò zài zhuōzi pángbiān.
sentences.english: She saw an old man sitting beside a table.

sentences.chinese: 那个老人看着她，轻轻地笑了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè lǎo rén kànzhe tā, qīngqīng de xiào le qǐlái.
sentences.english: The old man looked at her and smiled softly.

sentences.chinese: 他手里拿了一个旧本子，那是时间的记录书。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shǒu lǐ ná le yī gè jiù běn zi, nà shì shíjiān de jìlù shū.
sentences.english: In his hand, he held an old notebook; it was the record book of time.

sentences.chinese: 老人说：“这个女孩儿终于来了。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén shuō: “Zhè gè nǚ hái r zhōngyú lái le.”
sentences.english: The old man said, "This girl has finally arrived."

sentences.chinese: 林月走过去，看到本子里的最后一页写着她的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè zǒu guòqù, kàndào běn zi lǐ de zuìhòu yī xié xiě zhe tā de míngzì.
sentences.english: Lin Yue walked over and saw that her name was written on the last page of the notebook.

sentences.chinese: 她感到心跳快了一点儿，因为她知道这是最后的挑战。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎndào xīntiào kuài le yī diǎn r, yīnwèi tā zhīdào zhè shì zuìhòu de tiǎozhàn.
sentences.english: She felt her heart beat a little faster because she knew this was the final challenge.

sentences.chinese: 房间里还有一个小男孩儿，他看起来像个普通的小孩儿。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ hái yǒu yī gè xiǎo nán hái r, tā kàn qǐlái xiàng gè pǔtōng de xiǎo hái r.
sentences.english: In the room, there was also a little boy who looked like an ordinary child.

sentences.chinese: 男孩儿在玩一个发光的球，他说：“这里很好玩儿！”
sentences.pinyin: Nán hái r zài wán yī gè fāguāng de qiú, tā shuō: “Zhè lǐ hěn hǎo wán r!”
sentences.english: The boy was playing with a glowing ball and said, "It's very fun here!"

sentences.chinese: 林月问：“你是谁？你的爸爸在哪里？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè wèn: “Nǐ shì shuí? Nǐ de bà ba zài nǎ lǐ?”
sentences.english: Lin Yue asked, "Who are you? Where is your father?"

sentences.chinese: 男孩儿说：“我是时间的影子，我在这里帮老人干活。”
sentences.pinyin: Nán hái r shuō: “Wǒ shì shíjiān de yǐngzi, wǒ zài zhè lǐ bāng lǎo rén gàn huó.”
sentences.english: The boy said, "I am the shadow of time; I am here helping the old man work."

sentences.chinese: 老人告诉林月，她必须和这个男孩儿一块儿打开最后的大门。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén gàosù Lín Yuè, tā bìxū hé zhè gè nán hái r yī kuài r dǎkāi zuìhòu de dàmén.
sentences.english: The old man told Lin Yue that she must open the final gate together with this boy.

sentences.chinese: 林月记得从森林开始的所有冒险，她想回家了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Yuè jìdé cóng sēnlín kāishǐ de suǒyǒu màoxiǎn, tā xiǎng huí jiā le.
sentences.english: Lin Yue remembered all the adventures starting from the forest; she wanted to go home.

sentences.chinese: 她想起家里爸爸做的面条儿，那是她最喜欢的东西。

sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, wǒ tīng dào chuāng wài yǒu rén zài jiào wǒ de míng zi.
sentences.english: Suddenly, I heard someone calling my name outside the window.

sentences.chinese: 那是我的朋友李明，他大声地号叫，好像很着急。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì wǒ de péng you Lǐ Míng, tā dà shēng de hào jiào, hǎo xiàng hěn zháo jí.
sentences.english: That was my friend Li Ming; he was shouting loudly, seeming very anxious.

sentences.chinese: 我听见他在喊：“大卫！快出来！”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tīng jiàn tā zài hǎn: “Dà wèi! Kuài chū lái!”
sentences.english: I heard him yelling, "David! Come out quickly!"

sentences.chinese: 我也听到了一种奇怪的声音，像是在唱歌。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yě tīng dào le yì zhǒng qí guài de shēng yīn, xiàng shì zài chàng gē.
sentences.english: I also heard a strange sound, like someone singing.

sentences.chinese: 李明喜欢唱很多中国的老歌。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xǐ huan chàng hěn duō Zhōng guó de lǎo gē.
sentences.english: Li Ming likes to sing many old Chinese songs.

sentences.chinese: 他说这些歌很好听，能让人开心。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō zhè xiē gē hěn hǎo tīng, néng ràng rén kāi xīn.
sentences.english: He said these songs are pleasant to hear and can make people happy.

sentences.chinese: 我赶紧打开门，对他说：“请进！”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gǎn jǐn dǎ kāi mén, duì tā shuō: “Qǐng jìn!”
sentences.english: I quickly opened the door and said to him, "Please come in!"

sentences.chinese: 李明跑进房间，气喘吁吁。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng pǎo jìn fáng jiān, qì chuǎn xū xū.
sentences.english: Li Ming ran into the room, panting for breath.

sentences.chinese: 他对我说：“请坐，我想告诉你一件事。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì wǒ shuō: “Qǐng zuò, wǒ xiǎng gào su nǐ yì jiàn shì.”
sentences.english: He said to me, "Please have a seat, I want to tell you something."

sentences.chinese: 我坐下，看着他，他看起来有点累。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuò xia, kàn zhe tā, tā kàn qǐ lái yǒu diǎn lèi.
sentences.english: I sat down and looked at him; he looked a bit tired.

sentences.chinese: 李明说他开车来找我，但路上遇到了麻烦。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng shuō tā kāi chē lái zhǎo wǒ, dàn lù shàng yù dào le má fan.
sentences.english: Li Ming said he drove a car to find me, but encountered trouble on the road.

sentences.chinese: 他忘记了带地图，在街上绕了很久才找到我的家。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wàng jì le dài dì tú, zài jiē shàng rào le hěn jiǔ cái zhǎo dào wǒ de jiā.
sentences.english: He forgot to bring a map and wandered the streets for a long time before finding my home.

sentences.chinese: 他现在非常渴，想喝一杯水。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàn zài fēi cháng kě, xiǎng hē yì bēi shuǐ.
sentences.english: He is very thirsty now and wants to drink a glass of water.

sentences.chinese: 我给他水，他告诉我他想带我去一个秘密的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gěi tā shuǐ, tā gào su wǒ tā xiǎng dài wǒ qù yí gè mì mì de dì fang.
sentences.english: I gave him water, and he told me he wanted to take me to a secret place.

sentences.chinese: 但是，李明突然咳嗽起来，好像生病了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn shì, Lǐ Míng tū rán ké sou qǐ lái, hǎo xiàng shēng bìng le.
sentences.english: But suddenly, Li Ming started coughing, as if he had fallen ill.

sentences.chinese: 我想打电话给医生，但他说没关系。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng dǎ diàn huà gěi yī shēng, dàn tā shuō méi guān xi.
sentences.english: I wanted to make a phone call to a doctor, but he said it was okay.

sentences.chinese: 他记得他在山上的朋友可以帮我们。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì de tā zài shān shàng de péng you kě yǐ bāng wǒ men.
sentences.english: He remembered that his friend in the mountains could help us.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，我们要飞往一个遥远的小镇。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su wǒ, wǒ men yào fēi wǎng yí gè yáo yuǎn de xiǎo zhèn.
sentences.english: He told me that we would fly to a distant small town.

sentences.chinese: 我看着窗外，看到一只小鸟在雨中飞翔。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe chuāng wài, kàn dào yì zhī xiǎo niǎo zài yǔ zhōng fēi xiáng.
sentences.english: I looked out the window and saw a small bird flying in the rain.

sentences.chinese: 李明说，他需要向公司请假一周才能出发。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng shuō, tā xū yào xiàng gōng sī qǐng jià yì zhōu cái néng chū fā.
sentences.english: Li Ming said he needed to request a week's leave from his company before departing.

sentences.chinese: 我想起我还没准备好，但我决定跟他走。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐ wǒ hái méi zhǔn bèi hǎo, dàn wǒ jué dìng gēn tā zǒu.
sentences.english: I remembered that I wasn't ready yet, but I decided to go with him.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“我们现在就走吧！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ men xiàn zài jiù zǒu ba!”
sentences.english: He said, "Let's go now!"

sentences.chinese: 我回到房间，拿上我的背包。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ huí dào fáng jiān, ná shàng wǒ de bēi bāo.
sentences.english: I returned to my room and grabbed my backpack.

sentences.chinese: 我不想回家，我想去探索世界。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng huí jiā, wǒ xiǎng qù tàn suǒ shì jiè.
sentences.english: I didn't want to return home; I wanted to explore the world.

sentences.chinese: 我们走出了门，走进雨中。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men zǒu chū le mén, zǒu jìn yǔ zhōng.
sentences.english: We walked out the door and into the rain.

sentences.chinese: 这时，我听到远处传来了一声巨大的号角声。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, wǒ tīng dào yuǎn chù chuán lái le yì shēng jù dà de hào jiǎo shēng.
sentences.english: At that moment, I heard a loud horn sound coming from the distance.

sentences.chinese: 那是旅程的开始，还是某种警告？
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì lǚ chéng de kāi shǐ, hái shì mǒu zhǒng jǐng gào?
sentences.english: Was that the start of the journey, or some kind of warning?

sentences.chinese: 雨还在下，但我心中的火在燃烧。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ hái zài xià, dàn wǒ xīn zhōng de huǒ zài rán shāo.
sentences.english: The rain was still falling, but the fire in my heart was burning.

sentences.chinese: 我看着窗外，想起去年在家里度过的安静日子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe chuāng wài, xiǎng qǐ qù nián zài jiā lǐ dù guò de ānjìng rì zi.
sentences.english: I looked out the window and thought of the quiet days I spent at home last year.

sentences.chinese: 去年，我只是一个在房间里看书的学生。
sentences.pinyin: Qù nián, wǒ zhǐ shì yí gè zài fáng jiān lǐ kàn shū de xué sheng.
sentences.english: Last year, I was just a student reading books in my room.

sentences.chinese: 但今年，我想去看看这个世界。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jīn nián, wǒ xiǎng qù kàn kan zhè gè shì jiè.
sentences.english: But this year, I want to see the world.

sentences.chinese: 我想去中国，去那个神秘的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù Zhōng guó, qù nà gè shén mì de dì fang.
sentences.english: I want to go to China, to that mysterious place.

sentences.chinese: 我记得前天我在图书馆看到的一本书。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jì de qián tiān wǒ zài tú shū guǎn kàn dào de yì běn shū.
sentences.english: I remember a book I saw in the library the day before yesterday.

sentences.chinese: 那本书告诉我，北京是一个伟大的城市。
sentences.pinyin: Nà běn shū gào sù wǒ, Běi jīng shì yí gè wěi dà de chéng shì.
sentences.english: That book told me that Beijing is a great city.

sentences.chinese: 我想学习中文，因为我想听懂当地人的话。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xué xí Zhōng wén, yīn wèi wǒ xiǎng tīng dǒng dāng dì rén de huà.
sentences.english: I want to learn Chinese because I want to understand the local people.

sentences.chinese: 外语对我来说像是一把钥匙，可以打开新的大门。
sentences.pinyin: Wài yǔ duì wǒ lái shuō xiàng shì yì bǎ yào shi, kě yǐ dǎ kāi xīn de dà mén.
sentences.english: A foreign language is like a key to me, capable of opening new doors.

sentences.chinese: 我走到桌边，桌上放着一张旧地图。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǒu dào zhuō biān, zhuō shàng fàng zhe yì zhāng jiù dì tú.
sentences.english: I walked to the table, where an old map was lying.

sentences.chinese: 我用手指在地图上慢慢地移动。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yòng shǒu zhǐ zài dì tú shàng màn màn de yí dòng.
sentences.english: I moved my finger slowly across the map.

sentences.chinese: 我记得上次去书店的时候，买了一本旅行指南。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jì de shàng cì qù shū diàn de shí hou, mǎi le yì běn lǚ xíng zhǐ nán.
sentences.english: I remember the last time I went to the bookstore, I bought a travel guide.

sentences.chinese: 下次，我一定要买一本更好的字典。
sentences.pinyin: Xià cì, wǒ yí dìng yào mǎi yì běn gèng hǎo de zì diǎn.
sentences.english: Next time, I must buy a better dictionary.

sentences.chinese: 我突然想起，我得给那个奇怪的家伙发个信息。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tū rán xiǎng qǐ, wǒ děi gěi nà gè qí guài de jiā huo fā gè xìn xī.
sentences.english: I suddenly remembered that I had to send a message to that strange fellow.

sentences.chinese: 那个家伙在上午给我打过电话，声音很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè jiā huo zài shàng wǔ gěi wǒ dǎ guò diàn huà, shēng yīn hěn qí guài.
sentences.english: That fellow had called me in the morning, and his voice was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 他说话的声音有一种奇怪的上声调，像在唱歌。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō huà de shēng yīn yǒu yì zhǒng qí guài de shǎng shēng diào, xiàng zài chàng gē.
sentences.english: His speaking voice had a strange rising tone, as if he were singing.

sentences.chinese: 我看了看表，现在是上午十点。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn le kàn biǎo, xiàn zài shì shàng wǔ shí diǎn.
sentences.english: I checked my watch; it was ten in the morning.

sentences.chinese: 我得在两个小时内准备好所有的东西。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ děi zài liǎng gè xiǎo shí nèi zhǔn bèi hǎo suǒ yǒu de dōng xi.
sentences.english: I had to prepare everything within two hours.

sentences.chinese: 我从书架上拿下一打笔记本，准备记录旅程。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ cóng shū jià shàng ná xià yì dá bǐ jì běn, zhǔn bèi jì lù lǚ chéng.
sentences.english: I took a dozen notebooks from the bookshelf, preparing to record the journey.

sentences.chinese: 我走到一个小几旁边，上面放着我的午饭。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǒu dào yí gè xiǎo jī páng biān, shàng miàn fàng zhe wǒ de wǔ fàn.
sentences.english: I walked to a small table, where my lunch was placed.

sentences.chinese: 那是几个热腾腾的包子，味道很香。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì jǐ gè rè téng téng de bāo zi, wèi dào hěn xiāng.
sentences.english: Those were a few steaming hot baozi, smelling very fragrant.

sentences.chinese: 我想起上次生病去医院的时候，医生说我的身体很好。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐ shàng cì shēng bìng qù yī yuàn de shí hou, yī shēng shuō wǒ de shēn tǐ hěn hǎo.
sentences.english: I remembered the last time I was sick and went to the hospital, the doctor said my health was very good.

sentences.chinese: 我现在感觉很有力气，准备好出发了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiàn zài gǎn jué hěn yǒu lì qi, zhǔn bèi hǎo chū fā le.
sentences.english: I feel very energetic now and am ready to set off.

sentences.chinese: 虽然现在的天气很糟糕，但我的心很坚定。
sentences.pinyin: Suī rán xiàn zài de tiān qì hěn zāo gāo, dàn wǒ de xīn hěn jiān dìng.
sentences.english: Although the weather is terrible now, my heart is firm.

sentences.chinese: 我把所有的东西装进背包，离开这个小房间。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ suǒ yǒu de dōng xi zhuāng jìn bēi bāo, lí kāi zhè gè xiǎo fáng jiān.
sentences.english: I packed everything into my backpack and left this small room.

sentences.chinese: 我走出大门，再次看向远方。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǒu chū dà mén, zài cì kàn xiàng yuǎn fāng.
sentences.english: I walked out the main door and looked toward the distance once more.

sentences.chinese: 号角声再次响起，但这次我没有害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Hào jiǎo shēng zài cì xiǎng qǐ, dàn zhè cì wǒ méi yǒu hài pà.
sentences.english: The horn sounded again, but this time I was not afraid.

sentences.chinese: 在街道的尽头，一个穿着雨衣的人在对我挥手。
sentences.pinyin: Zài jiē dào de jìn tóu, yí gè chuān zhe yǔ yī de rén zài duì wǒ huī shǒu.
sentences.english: At the end of the street, a person wearing a raincoat was waving to me.

sentences.chinese: 他手里拿着一样像家俱一样大的奇怪东西。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shǒu lǐ ná zhe yí yàng xiàng jiā jù yí yàng dà de qí guài dōng xi.
sentences.english: In his hand, he held a strange object as large as a piece of furniture.

sentences.chinese: 他到底是谁？他为什么在等我？
sentences.pinyin: Tā dào dǐ shì shuí? Tā wèi shén me zài děng wǒ?
sentences.english: Who on earth is he? Why is he waiting for me?

sentences.chinese: 我慢慢走过去，那个穿着黄色衣服的人在笑。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ màn man zǒu guò qù, nà gè chuān zhe huáng sè yī fu de rén zài xiào.
sentences.english: I slowly walked over, and the person wearing yellow clothes was smiling.

sentences.chinese: 他看起来很友好，手里拿着一个巨大的旧课本。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐ lái hěn yǒu hǎo, shǒu lǐ ná zhe yī gè jù dà de jiù kè běn.
sentences.english: He looked very friendly, holding a huge old textbook in his hand.

sentences.chinese: “请问，你是谁？”我问他。
sentences.pinyin: “Qǐng wèn, nǐ shì shuí?” wǒ wèn tā.
sentences.english: "Excuse me, who are you?" I asked him.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，他叫王老师，是一个教汉语的老师。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ, tā jiào Wáng lǎo shī, shì yī gè jiāo Hàn yǔ de lǎo shī.
sentences.english: He told me his name is Teacher Wang, a teacher of the Chinese language.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，昨天他在这里等我，但雨太大了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ, zuó tiān tā zài zhè lǐ děng wǒ, dàn yǔ tài dà le.
sentences.english: He told me that yesterday he was waiting for me here, but the rain was too heavy.

sentences.chinese: 今天已经是星期天了，也就是星期日。
sentences.pinyin: Jīn tiān yǐ jīng shì Xīng qī tiān le, yě jiù shì Xīng qī rì.
sentences.english: Today is already Sunday, which is also Sunday.

sentences.chinese: 他看着手中的日期，告诉我一个秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe shǒu zhōng de rì qī, gào sù wǒ yī gè mì mì.
sentences.english: He looked at the date in his hand and told me a secret.

sentences.chinese: 他说，现在正是一个特殊的季节，接近新年。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, xiàn zài zhèng shì yī gè tè shū de jì jié, jiē jìn xīn nián.
sentences.english: He said that right now is a special season, approaching the New Year.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，明年他会带我去更多美丽的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ, míng nián tā huì dài wǒ qù gèng duō měi lì de dì fang.
sentences.english: He told me that next year he would take me to more beautiful places.

sentences.chinese: 他邀请我跟他一起去楼下的一家小店。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yāo qǐng wǒ gēn tā yī qǐ qù lóu xià de yī jiā xiǎo diàn.
sentences.english: He invited me to go downstairs with him to a small shop.

sentences.chinese: 我们在店里吃了早饭，有热腾腾的米饭和新鲜的水果。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men zài diàn lǐ chī le zǎo fàn, yǒu rè téng téng de mǐ fàn hé xīn xiān de shuǐ guǒ.
sentences.english: We ate breakfast in the shop, with steaming rice and fresh fruit.

sentences.chinese: 我还喝了一杯白色的牛奶。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hái hē le yī bēi bái sè de niú nǎi.
sentences.english: I also drank a glass of white cow's milk.

sentences.chinese: 王老师说，旅行中最有用的东西不是电脑，而是好奇心。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng lǎo shī shuō, lǚ xíng zhōng zuì yǒu yòng de dōng xī bú shì diàn nǎo, ér shì hào qí xīn.
sentences.english: Teacher Wang said that the most useful thing during travel is not a computer, but curiosity.

sentences.chinese: 他把那个巨大的课本打开，指着上面的课文。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ nà gè jù dà de kè běn dǎ kāi, zhǐ zhe shàng miàn de kè wén.
sentences.english: He opened that huge textbook and pointed to the text inside.

sentences.chinese: 他说，这本书记录了所有去往远方的火车路线。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, zhè běn shū jì lù le suǒ yǒu qù wǎng yuǎn fāng de huǒ chē lù xiàn.
sentences.english: He said this book recorded all the train routes to far-off places.

sentences.chinese: 他从衣服的口袋里拿出一张车票，递给我。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng yī fu de kǒu dài lǐ ná chū yī zhāng chē piào, dì gěi wǒ.
sentences.english: He took a ticket out of his clothes pocket and handed it to me.

sentences.chinese: “明天我们就要出发了，”他神秘地说道。
sentences.pinyin: “Míng tiān wǒ men jiù yào chū fā le,” tā mì mì de shuō dào.
sentences.english: "Tomorrow we will set off," he said mysteriously.

sentences.chinese: 我看着车票，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe chē piào, xīn tiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: I looked at the ticket, my heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 我们走出小店，看到远处有一辆红色的火车。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men zǒu chū xiǎo diàn, kàn dào yuǎn chù yǒu yī liàng hóng sè de huǒ chē.
sentences.english: We walked out of the small shop and saw a red train in the distance.

sentences.chinese: 王老师说，我们要快点进去，不然就没座位了。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng lǎo shī shuō, wǒ men yào kuài diǎn jìn qù, bù rán jiù méi zuò wèi le.
sentences.english: Teacher Wang said we must go in quickly, otherwise there would be no seats.

sentences.chinese: 在车上，我们开始讨论接下来的旅程。
sentences.pinyin: Zài chē shàng, wǒ men kāi shǐ tǎo lùn jiē xià lái de lǚ chéng.
sentences.english: On the train, we began to discuss the upcoming journey.

sentences.chinese: 我想知道，这次旅行会带我去哪里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zhī dào, zhè cì lǚ xíng huì dài wǒ qù nǎ lǐ.
sentences.english: I wanted to know where this trip would take me.

sentences.chinese: 我问他，我们什么时候回来？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā, wǒ men shén me shí hòu huí lái?
sentences.english: I asked him, when will we come back?

sentences.chinese: 他笑了笑，说这取决于我们的发现。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiào le xiào, shuō zhè qǔ jué yú wǒ men de fā xiàn.
sentences.english: He smiled and said it depends on our discoveries.

sentences.chinese: 雨渐渐停了，阳光照在铁轨上。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔ jiàn jiàn tíng le, yáng guāng zhào zài tiě guǐ shàng.
sentences.english: The rain gradually stopped, and sunlight shone on the tracks.

sentences.chinese: 我意识到，我的生活在这一刻改变了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yì shí dào, wǒ de shēng huó zài zhè yī kè gǎi biàn le.
sentences.english: I realized that my life changed at this moment.

sentences.chinese: 我们要去的地方，在地图的尽头。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men yào qù de dì fang, zài dì tú de jìn tóu.
sentences.english: The place we are going is at the end of the map.

sentences.chinese: 我们沿着铁轨走，来到一个小车站。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yánzhe tiěguǐ zǒu, lái dào yī gè xiǎo chēzhàn.
sentences.english: We walked along the tracks and arrived at a small station.

sentences.chinese: 我的向导说，这里的人来自中国的中部。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de xiàngdǎo shuō, zhèlǐ de rén láizì Zhōngguó de zhōngbù.
sentences.english: My guide said that the people here come from the central part of China.

sentences.chinese: 车站里有很多奇怪的人，他们都在等待。
sentences.pinyin: Chēzhàn lǐ yǒu hěnduō qíguài de rén, tāmen dōu zài děngdài.
sentences.english: There were many strange people in the station; they were all waiting.

sentences.chinese: 有一个人姓元，他看起来很严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu yī gè rén xìng Yuán, tā kàn qǐlái hěn yánsù.
sentences.english: There was a person surnamed Yuan who looked very serious.

sentences.chinese: 旁边的人姓关，他正在读一本书。
sentences.pinyin: Pángbiān de rén xìng Guān, tā zhèngzài dú yī běn shū.
sentences.english: The person next to him was surnamed Guan, and he was reading a book.

sentences.chinese: 我还看到了姓包的人和姓后的人在说话。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hái kàn dào xìng Bāo de rén hé xìng Hòu de rén zài shuōhuà.
sentences.english: I also saw people surnamed Bao and Hou talking.

sentences.chinese: 他们讨论着这个国家，姓国的人在点头。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen tǎolùnzhe zhège guójiā, xìng Guó de rén zài diǎntóu.
sentences.english: They were discussing this country, and the person surnamed Guo was nodding.

sentences.chinese: 一个姓坐的人在椅子上休息，他的朋友姓左。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè xìng Zuò de rén zài yǐzi shàng xiūxí, tā de péngyǒu xìng Zuǒ.
sentences.english: A person surnamed Zuo was resting on a chair, and his friend was surnamed Zuo (Left).

sentences.chinese: 一个姓教的人在给一个小孩儿讲故事。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè xìng Jiào de rén zài gěi yī gè xiǎo hái r jiǎng gùshì.
sentences.english: A person surnamed Jiao was telling a story to a child.

sentences.chinese: 那个小孩儿觉得这个故事很好玩儿。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè xiǎo hái r juédé zhège gùshì hěn hǎo wán r.
sentences.english: That child thought the story was very fun.

sentences.chinese: 楼上，一个姓楼的人在看风景。
sentences.pinyin: Lóushàng, yī gè xìng Lóu de rén zài kàn fēngjǐng.
sentences.english: Upstairs, a person surnamed Lou was looking at the scenery.

sentences.chinese: 一个姓毛的人在喝茶，而姓水的人在写字。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè xìng Máo de rén zài hē chá, ér xìng Shuǐ de rén zài xiězì.
sentences.english: A person surnamed Mao was drinking tea, while a person surnamed Shui was writing.

sentences.chinese: 花园里，姓花的人在看花，姓路的人在走路。
sentences.pinyin: Huāyuán lǐ, xìng Huā de rén zài kàn huā, xìng Lù de rén zài zǒulù.
sentences.english: In the garden, the person surnamed Hua was looking at flowers, and the person surnamed Lu was walking.

sentences.chinese: 一个姓过的人对我笑了笑，姓还的人在挥手。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè xìng Guō de rén duì wǒ xiào le xiào, xìng Huán de rén zài huīshǒu.
sentences.english: A person surnamed Guo smiled at me, and the person surnamed Huan was waving.

sentences.chinese: 我问路，一个姓错的人告诉我方向。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn lù, yī gè xìng Cuò de rén gàosù wǒ fāngxiàng.
sentences.english: I asked for directions, and a person surnamed Cuo told me the way.

sentences.chinese: 一个姓高的人指了指远方。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè xìng Gāo de rén zhǐ le zhǐ yuǎnfāng.
sentences.english: A person surnamed Gao pointed toward the distance.

sentences.chinese: 我想买一些食物，看到桌子上有一块儿面包。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yīxiē shíwù, kàn dào zhuōzi shàng yǒu yī kuài r miànbāo.
sentences.english: I wanted to buy some food and saw a piece of bread on the table.

sentences.chinese: 这些面包看起来很新鲜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē miànbāo kàn qǐlái hěn xīnxiān.
sentences.english: These breads looked very fresh.

sentences.chinese: 我不小心弄掉了面包，我对向导说对不起。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎoxīn nòng diào le miànbāo, wǒ duì xiàngdǎo shuō duìbùqǐ.
sentences.english: I accidentally dropped the bread and said sorry to the guide.

sentences.chinese: 他笑着说没关系。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàozhe shuō méi guān xi.
sentences.english: He smiled and said it didn't matter.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个年轻人走过来，他是我的哥哥。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yī gè niánqīng rén zǒu guòlái, tā shì wǒ de gēge.
sentences.english: At that moment, a young man walked over; he was my older brother.

sentences.chinese: 他们开始一起聊天，讨论未来的旅程。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen kāishǐ yīqǐ liáotiān, tǎolùn wèilái de lǚchéng.
sentences.english: They started chatting together, discussing the future journey.

sentences.chinese: 我看着这些有趣的人，感到很神奇。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe zhèxiē yǒuqù de rén, gǎndào hěn shénqí.
sentences.english: I looked at these interesting people and felt it was magical.

sentences.chinese: 我们准备坐上火车，前往地图的尽头。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zhǔnbèi zuò shàng huǒchē, qiánwǎng dìtú de jìntóu.
sentences.english: We prepared to board the train to the end of the map.

sentences.chinese: 但火车门突然关上了，我的包还在外面。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn huǒchē mén tūrán guān shàng le, wǒ de bāo hái zài wàimiàn.
sentences.english: But the train door suddenly closed, and my bag was still outside.

sentences.chinese: 我们该怎么办？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen gāi zěnme bàn?
sentences.english: What should we do?

sentences.chinese: 火车门关了，我的包在外面。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒchē mén guān le, wǒ de bāo zài wàimiàn.
sentences.english: The train door closed, and my bag was outside.

sentences.chinese: 我有点儿害怕，但是我的新朋友们在帮我。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī diǎn r hàipà, dànshì wǒ de xīn péngyǒumen zài bāng wǒ.
sentences.english: I was a little bit scared, but my new friends were helping me.

sentences.chinese: 一个大男人走过来，他说：“没关系，我可以帮你。”
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè dà nánrén zǒu guòlái, tā shuō: “Méiguānxì, wǒ kěyǐ bāng nǐ.”
sentences.english: A big man walked over and said, "It's okay, I can help you."

sentences.chinese: 他叫三先生，他是一个很有名的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiào Sān xiānshēng, tā shì yīgè hěn yǒumíng de rén.
sentences.english: His name is Mr. San, and he is a very famous person.

sentences.chinese: 他身边站着一个年轻的弟弟，叫东先生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shēnbiān zhànzhe yīgè niánqīng de dìdi, jiào Dōng xiānshēng.
sentences.english: Standing beside him was a young brother, Mr. Dong.

sentences.chinese: 他们两个都想帮我把包拿回来。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen liǎng gè dōu xiǎng bāng wǒ bǎ bāo ná huílái.
sentences.english: Both of them wanted to help me get my bag back.

sentences.chinese: 这时，车厢里走进来很多奇怪的人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, chēxiāng lǐ zǒu jìn lái hěnduō qíguài de rén.
sentences.english: At this moment, many strange people walked into the carriage.

sentences.chinese: 这里有也先生，有冷先生，还有别先生。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ yǒu Yě xiānshēng, yǒu Lěng xiānshēng, hái yǒu Bié xiānshēng.
sentences.english: There was Mr. Ye, Mr. Leng, and also Mr. Bie.

sentences.chinese: 他们看起来像是一个团队，但他们不是同一个班的学生。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen kàn qǐlái xiàng shì yīgè tuánduì, dàn tāmen bùshì tóng yīgè bān de xuéshēng.
sentences.english: They looked like a team, but they weren't students from the same class.

sentences.chinese: 南先生在看书，山先生在睡觉。
sentences.pinyin: Nán xiānshēng zài kàn shū, Shān xiānshēng zài shuìjiào.
sentences.english: Mr. Nan was reading a book, and Mr. Shan was sleeping.

sentences.chinese: 常先生和年先生在讨论地图上的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Cháng xiānshēng hé Nián xiānshēng zài tǎolùn dìtú shàng de mìmì.
sentences.english: Mr. Chang and Mr. Nian were discussing the secrets on the map.

sentences.chinese: 班先生在喝水，白先生在写字。
sentences.pinyin: Bān xiānshēng zài hē shuǐ, Bái xiānshēng zài xiězì.
sentences.english: Mr. Ban was drinking water, and Mr. Bai was writing.

sentences.chinese: 百先生拿着很多钱，他看起来很富有。
sentences.pinyin: Bǎi xiānshēng názhe hěnduō qián, tā kàn qǐlái hěn fùyǒu.
sentences.english: Mr. Bai (Bai) was holding a lot of money; he looked very wealthy.

sentences.chinese: 能先生和车先生在讨论火车的速度。
sentences.pinyin: Néng xiānshēng hé Chē xiānshēng zài tǎolùn huǒchē de sùdù.
sentences.english: Mr. Neng and Mr. Che were discussing the speed of the train.

sentences.chinese: 那个人，叫那先生，他在看窗外。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén, jiào Nā xiānshēng, tā zài kàn chuāngwài.
sentences.english: That person, named Mr. Na, was looking out the window.

sentences.chinese: 都先生说：“我们应该让火车停下来。”
sentences.pinyin: Dū xiānshēng shuō: “Wǒmen yīnggāi ràng huǒchē tíng xiàlái.”
sentences.english: Mr. Du said, "We should make the train stop."

sentences.chinese: 我看到我的包就在门外面。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàndào wǒ de bāo jiù zài mén wàimiàn.
sentences.english: I saw my bag right outside the door.

sentences.chinese: 我没有钱给他们，但我很感谢他们。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu qián gěi tāmen, dàn wǒ hěn gǎnxiè tāmen.
sentences.english: I had no money to give them, but I was very grateful to them.

sentences.chinese: 我的小妹在家里等着我，我必须带回那个包。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de xiǎomèi zài jiālǐ děngzhe wǒ, wǒ bìxū dài huí nàgè bāo.
sentences.english: My little sister is waiting for me at home; I must bring that bag back.

sentences.chinese: 我走进车厢的中间，看着这些有趣的人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǒu jìn chēxiāng de zhōngjiān, kànzhe zhèxiē yǒuqù de rén.
sentences.english: I walked into the middle of the carriage, looking at these interesting people.

sentences.chinese: 我想问他们：“你们是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng wèn tāmen: “Nǐmen shì shuí?”
sentences.english: I wanted to ask them, "Who are you?"

sentences.chinese: 但此时，火车突然启动了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn cǐshí, huǒchē tūrán qǐdòng le.
sentences.english: But at this moment, the train suddenly started moving.

sentences.chinese: 我的包在铁轨上慢慢地离开了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de bāo zài tiěguǐ shàng mànmàn de líkāi le.
sentences.english: My bag slowly left me on the tracks.

sentences.chinese: 我感到一点儿难过，但三先生笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gǎndào yī diǎn r nánguò, dàn Sān xiānshēng xiào le.
sentences.english: I felt a little sad, but Mr. San smiled.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“别担心，我们去买面条儿吃吧！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Bié dānxīn, wǒmen qù mǎi miàntiáo r chī ba!”
sentences.english: He said, "Don't worry, let's go buy some noodles to eat!"

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，车窗外出现了一个巨大的影子。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, chēchuāng wài chūxiàn le yīgè jùdà de yǐngzi.
sentences.english: Just then, a giant shadow appeared outside the train window.

sentences.chinese: 我看着窗外，那个巨大的影子在火车的右边。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe chuāngwài, nàge jùdà de yǐngzi zài huǒchē de yòubiān.
sentences.english: I looked out the window; that giant shadow was on the right side of the train.

sentences.chinese: 三先生一边喝茶，一边对我笑。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng yībiān hē chá, yībiān duì wǒ xiào.
sentences.english: Mr. San was drinking tea while smiling at me.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“看，前边有一个小男孩儿。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Kàn, qiánbian yǒu yīgè xiǎo nánháir.”
sentences.english: He said, "Look, there is a little boy in front."

sentences.chinese: 那个男孩儿很小，他是三先生的弟弟。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge nánháir hěn xiǎo, tā shì Sān xiānshēng de dìdi.
sentences.english: That boy was very small; he is Mr. San's younger brother.

sentences.chinese: 弟弟手里拿着一本书，那是关于国外的地方的书。
sentences.pinyin: Dìdi shǒulǐ názhe yī běn shū, nà shì guānyú guówài de dìfāng de shū.
sentences.english: The younger brother was holding a book, a book about places abroad.

sentences.chinese: 他在书的最后一页画了一个奇怪的地图。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài shū de zuìhòu yī yè huàle yīgè qíguài de dìtú.
sentences.english: On the last page of the book, he drew a strange map.

sentences.chinese: 地图上，北边是大山，南边是大海。
sentences.pinyin: Dìtú shàng, běibiān shì dàshān, nánbiān shì dàhǎi.
sentences.english: On the map, there were big mountains in the north and a vast sea in the south.

sentences.chinese: 东边有很多树，西边有很多水。
sentences.pinyin: Dōngbian yǒu hěnduō shù, xībiān yǒu hěnduō shuǐ.
sentences.english: There were many trees in the east and a lot of water in the west.

sentences.chinese: 三先生说：“我们现在向北走，去一个外国的地方。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng shuō: “Wǒmen xiànzài xiàng běi zǒu, qù yīgè wàiguó de dìfāng.”
sentences.english: Mr. San said, "We are now heading north to a foreign place."

sentences.chinese: 在这个地方，人们说不同的语言，生活很新奇。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège dìfāng, rénmen shuō bùtóng de yǔyán, shēnghuó hěn xīnqí.
sentences.english: In this place, people speak different languages, and life is very novel.

sentences.chinese: 我的左边坐着一个男人，他来自西边的国家。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de zuǒbiān zuòzhe yīgè nánrén, tā láizì xībiān de guójiā.
sentences.english: To my left sat a man who came from a country in the west.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，他以前在国外工作，现在想回家。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, tā yǐqián zài guówài gōngzuò, xiànzài xiǎng huíjiā.
sentences.english: He told me he used to work abroad and now wants to go home.

sentences.chinese: 他的右边是一个女人，她在帮弟弟拿书。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yòubiān shì yīgè nǚrén, tā zài bāng dìdi ná shū.
sentences.english: To his right was a woman who was helping the younger brother take the book.

sentences.chinese: 他们在这个小小的空间里，干着不同的事情。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zài zhège xiǎo xiǎo de kōngjiān lǐ, gànzhe bùtóng de shìqíng.
sentences.english: In this small space, they were doing different things.

sentences.chinese: 外边开始下雪了，白色的雪覆盖了大地。
sentences.pinyin: Wàibiān kāishǐ xià xuě le, báisè de xuě fùgàile dàdì.
sentences.english: It started to snow outside; white snow covered the earth.

sentences.chinese: 火车在雪地里前进，后边留下了长长的痕迹。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒchē zài xuědì lǐ qiánjìn, hòubiān liúxiàle chángcháng de hénjī.
sentences.english: The train moved forward through the snow, leaving long tracks behind.

sentences.chinese: 我看着窗外，突然发现那个巨大的影子又回来了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe chuāngwài, tūrán fāxiàn nàge jùdà de yǐngzi yòu huíláile.
sentences.english: I looked out the window and suddenly discovered that the giant shadow had returned.

sentences.chinese: 它比火车还要大，正对着我们走来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǐ huǒchē hái yào dà, zhèng duìzhe wǒmen zǒu lái.
sentences.english: It was even bigger than the train, walking straight toward us.

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着它，轻轻地说：“它在送我们去终点。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng kànzhe tā, qīngqīng de shuō: “Tā zài sòng wǒmen qù zhōngdiǎn.”
sentences.english: Mr. San looked at it and said softly, "It is seeing us off to the destination."

sentences.chinese: 我感到害怕，但三先生和那个男人都在笑。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gǎndào hàipà, dàn Sān xiānshēng hé nàge nánrén dōu zài xiào.
sentences.english: I felt scared, but Mr. San and that man were both laughing.

sentences.chinese: 我们在这个奇怪的旅程中，遇到了来自世界各地的朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zài zhège qíguài de lǚchéng zhōng, yùdàole láizì shìjiè gèdì de péngyǒu.
sentences.english: In this strange journey, we met friends from all over the world.

sentences.chinese: 但那个影子到底是什么？
sentences.pinyin: Dàn nàge yǐngzi dàodǐ shì shénme?
sentences.english: But what on earth is that shadow?

sentences.chinese: 它为什么要跟着我们？
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèishéme yào gēnzhe wǒmen?
sentences.english: Why does it want to follow us?

sentences.chinese: 火车突然剧烈地摇晃了一下。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒchē tūrán jùliè de yáohuàngle yīxià.
sentences.english: The train suddenly shook violently.

sentences.chinese: 我们是不是走错了方向？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen shì bù shì zǒu cuòle fāngxiàng?
sentences.english: Did we go in the wrong direction?

chapters.title_chinese: 第七章：车厢里的新朋友
chapters.title_english: Chapter 7: New Friends in the Carriage

sentences.chinese: 火车终于停了下来，这是一个奇怪的车站。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒchē zhōngyú tíng le xiàlái, zhè shì yígè qíguài de chēzhàn.
sentences.english: The train finally came to a stop; it was a strange station.

sentences.chinese: 三先生说：“没关系，这不是什么大事。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng shuō: “Méi guānxì, zhè bú shì shénme dà shì.”
sentences.english: Mr. San said, "It's okay, this isn't a big matter."

sentences.chinese: 车厢里来了很多人。
sentences.pinyin: Chēxiāng lǐ lái le hěn duō rén.
sentences.english: Many people entered the carriage.

sentences.chinese: 其中有一个年轻的女人，她看起来很温柔。
sentences.pinyin: Qízhōng yǒu yígè niánqīng de nǚrén, tā kàn qǐlái hěn wēnróu.
sentences.english: Among them was a young woman who seemed very gentle.

sentences.chinese: 她问我：“你好，你的名字是什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn wǒ: “Nǐ hǎo, nǐ de míngzi shì shénme?”
sentences.english: She asked me, "Hello, what is your name?"

sentences.chinese: 我告诉她我的名字，她笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gàosù tā wǒ de míngzi, tā xiào le.
sentences.english: I told her my name, and she smiled.

sentences.chinese: 她告诉我，她来自一个很远的国家。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, tā láizì yígè hěn yuǎn de guójiā.
sentences.english: She told me she came from a very distant country.

sentences.chinese: 她在这个国家旅行已经三天了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài zhège guójiā lǚxíng yǐjīng sān tiān le.
sentences.english: She has been traveling in this country for three days.

sentences.chinese: 这个女人是个小姐，她看起来只有二十岁。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège nǚrén shì gè xiǎojiě, tā kàn qǐlái zhǐyǒu èrshí suì.
sentences.english: This woman is a young lady; she looks only twenty years old.

sentences.chinese: 她手里拿着一个杯子，里面有热的牛奶。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shǒulǐ názhe yígè bēizi, lǐmiàn yǒu rè de niúnǎi.
sentences.english: She was holding a cup in her hand, with hot milk inside.

sentences.chinese: 她说：“我想我的妈妈也会喜欢这里的。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng wǒ de māma yě huì xǐhuan zhèlǐ de.”
sentences.english: She said, "I think my mother would like it here too."

sentences.chinese: 她提到她的妈妈和家里的孩子，一个可爱的儿子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tí dào tā de māma hé jiālǐ de háizi, yígè kě'ài de érzi.
sentences.english: She mentioned her mother and the child at home, a cute son.

sentences.chinese: 她向我展示了一张照片，照片里有一个小孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàng wǒ zhǎnshì le yì zhāng zhàopiàn, zhàopiàn lǐ yǒu yígè xiǎo háizi.
sentences.english: She showed me a photo, and there was a small child in the photo.

sentences.chinese: 照片上的字很小，但我能看懂。
sentences.pinyin: Zhàopiàn shàng de zì hěn xiǎo, dàn wǒ néng kàndǒng.
sentences.english: The characters on the photo were very small, but I could understand them.

sentences.chinese: 她告诉我，她以前在大的商场工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, tā yǐqián zài dà de shāngchǎng gōngzuò.
sentences.english: She told me that she used to work in a large shopping mall.

sentences.chinese: 现在，她想去很多小的商店看看。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài, tā xiǎng qù hěn duō xiǎo de shāngdiàn kànkan.
sentences.english: Now, she wants to visit many small shops.

sentences.chinese: 她从包里拿出一本厚厚的书。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng bāo lǐ ná chū yì běn hòuhòu de shū.
sentences.english: She took a thick book out of her bag.

sentences.chinese: 书里记录了她去过的每一个地方。
sentences.pinyin: Shū lǐ jìlù le tā qù guò de měi yígè dìfāng.
sentences.english: The book recorded every place she had visited.

sentences.chinese: 她还拿出了她的手机，给我看日历。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hái ná chū le tā de shǒujī, gěi wǒ kàn rìlì.
sentences.english: She also took out her mobile phone and showed me the calendar.

sentences.chinese: 她说：“这个星期，我要去日本。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zhège xīngqī, wǒ yào qù Rìběn.”
sentences.english: She said, "This week, I am going to Japan."

sentences.chinese: 她向我展示了一张机票。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàng wǒ zhǎnshì le yì zhāng jīpiào.
sentences.english: She showed me an air ticket.

sentences.chinese: 现在已经是早晨了，阳光很亮。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài yǐjīng shì zǎochén le, yángguāng hěn liàng.
sentences.english: It is already morning now, and the sunlight is bright.

sentences.chinese: 但我想起昨晚的事情，心里还是有点不安。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ xiǎngqǐ zuówǎn de shìqing, xīnlǐ háishì yǒudiǎn bù'ān.
sentences.english: But I thought about last night, and my heart was still a bit uneasy.

sentences.chinese: 昨晚，我在狭小的床上面睡不着。
sentences.pinyin: Zuówǎn, wǒ zài xiǎoxiǎo de chuáng shàngmiàn shuì bù zháo.
sentences.english: Last night, I couldn't sleep on the small bed.

sentences.chinese: 那天晚上，那个巨大的影子就在窗外。
sentences.pinyin: Nà tiān wǎnshang, nàge jùdà de yǐngzi jiù zài chuāngwài.
sentences.english: That night, that huge shadow was right outside the window.

sentences.chinese: 我们一起吃了晚饭，聊了很多关于月亮的话题。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ chī le wǎnfàn, liáo le hěn duō guānyú yuèliàng de huàtí.
sentences.english: We had dinner together and talked a lot about the moon.

sentences.chinese: 时间过得很快，现在已经是晚上的前奏，也就是黄昏。
sentences.pinyin: Shíjiān guò de hěn kuài, xiànzài yǐjīng shì wǎnshang de qiánzòu, yě jiùshì huánghūn.
sentences.english: Time passed quickly, and it is now the prelude to the evening, which is dusk.

sentences.chinese: 但那个影子并没有消失，它还在火车的后面。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn nàge yǐngzi bìng méiyǒu xiāoshī, tā hái zài huǒchē de hòumiàn.
sentences.english: But that shadow has not disappeared; it is still behind the train.

sentences.chinese: 它在等我们，还是在保护我们？
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài děng wǒmen, háishì zài bǎohù wǒmen?
sentences.english: Is it waiting for us, or is it protecting us?

sentences.chinese: 火车停了，我们到了一个奇怪的车站。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒchē tíng le, wǒmen dào le yí gè qíguài de chēzhàn.
sentences.english: The train stopped, and we arrived at a strange station.

sentences.chinese: 外面的风很大，吹在脸上很凉快。
sentences.pinyin: Wàimiàn de fēng hěn dà, chuī zài liǎn shàng hěn liángkuai.
sentences.english: The wind outside was strong, blowing coolly against my face.

sentences.chinese: 三先生说：“我们下车看看吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng shuō: “Wǒmen xià chē kànkan ba.”
sentences.english: Mr. San said, "Let's get off the train and take a look."

sentences.chinese: 我看着窗外，那个巨大的影子不见了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe chuāngwài, nàgè jùdà de yǐngzi bú jiàn le.
sentences.english: I looked out the window; the giant shadow was gone.

sentences.chinese: 车站里有一个男人，他看起来像个病人，脸色很白。
sentences.pinyin: Chēzhàn lǐ yǒu yí gè nánrén, tā kàn qǐlái xiàng gè bìngrén, liǎnsè hěn bái.
sentences.english: Inside the station was a man; he looked like a sick person, his face very pale.

sentences.chinese: 他坐在一个木头桌子后面，看着我们。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuò zài yí gè mùtou zhuōzi hòumiàn, kànzhe wǒmen.
sentences.english: He was sitting behind a wooden table, watching us.

sentences.chinese: 桌子上有一本旧书，上面写着很多复杂的汉字。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng yǒu yì běn jiù shū, shàngmiàn xiězhe hěnduō fùzá de hànzì.
sentences.english: On the table was an old book, with many complex Chinese characters written on it.

sentences.chinese: 我问他：“请问，这里是哪里？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Qǐngwèn, zhèlǐ shì nǎlǐ?”
sentences.english: I asked him, "Excuse me, where is this place?"

sentences.chinese: 那个男人没有说话，他指了指远方。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè nánrén méiyǒu shuōhuà, tā zhǐ le zhǐ yuǎnfāng.
sentences.english: The man didn't speak; he pointed toward the distance.

sentences.chinese: 那里有一辆红色的汽车，在路边等候。
sentences.pinyin: Nàlǐ yǒu yí liàng hóngsè de qìchē, zài lùbiān děnghòu.
sentences.english: There was a red car there, waiting by the roadside.

sentences.chinese: 三先生走过去，对那个男人说：“谢谢你。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng zǒu guòqù, duì nàgè nánrén shuō: “Xièxie nǐ.”
sentences.english: Mr. San walked over and said to the man, "Thank you."

sentences.chinese: 男人从桌子下面拿出一张票，给了我。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén cóng zhuōzi xiàmiàn ná chū yì zhāng piào, gěi le wǒ.
sentences.english: The man took a ticket from under the table and gave it to me.

sentences.chinese: 我打开钱包，发现我的钱还在，但票很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dǎkāi qiánbāo, fāxiàn wǒ de qián hái zài, dàn piào hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.english: I opened my wallet and found my money was still there, but the ticket was important.

sentences.chinese: 三先生说：“我们得快点，现在是下午五点。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng shuō: “Wǒmen děi kuài diǎn, xiànzài shì xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn.”
sentences.english: Mr. San said, "We have to hurry, it's five o'clock in the afternoon."

sentences.chinese: 他想给我打个电话，但这里没有电。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng gěi wǒ dǎ gè diànhuà, dàn zhèlǐ méiyǒu diàn.
sentences.english: He wanted to make a phone call for me, but there was no electricity here.

sentences.chinese: 没有电，这里的电视机和电视就不能用。
sentences.pinyin: Méiyǒu diàn, zhèlǐ de diànshìjī hé diànshì jiù bùnéng yòng.
sentences.english: Without electricity, the television sets and TVs here could not be used.

sentences.chinese: 我想起家里的爸爸，他经常在电视上看电影。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngqǐ jiālǐ de bàba, tā jīngcháng zài diànshì shàng kàn diànyǐng.
sentences.english: I thought of my father at home, who often watches movies on TV.

sentences.chinese: 如果我们在电影院看电影，就不用在火车上担心影子了。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ wǒmen zài diànyǐngyuàn kàn diànyǐng, jiù búyòng zài huǒchē shàng dānxīn yǐngzi le.
sentences.english: If we were watching a movie in a cinema, we wouldn't have to worry about the shadow on the train.

sentences.chinese: 三先生问我：“你想喝茶吗？还是想吃肉？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng wèn wǒ: “Nǐ xiǎng hē chá ma? Háishì xiǎng chī ròu?”
sentences.english: Mr. San asked me, "Would you like to drink tea? Or would you like to eat meat?"

sentences.chinese: 他指着旁边的一排菜，每一行菜都看起来很好吃。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐzhe pángbiān de yì pái cài, měi yì háng cài dōu kàn qǐlái hěn hǎochī.
sentences.english: He pointed to a row of dishes nearby; every row of food looked delicious.

sentences.chinese: 我告诉他：“我想去洗手间。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gàosù tā: “Wǒ xiǎng qù xǐshǒujiān.”
sentences.english: I told him, "I want to go to the washroom."

sentences.chinese: 在洗手间里，我看到一个圆圆的球在地上滚。
sentences.pinyin: Zài xǐshǒujiān lǐ, wǒ kàndào yí gè yuán yuán de qiú zài dìshàng gǔn.
sentences.english: In the washroom, I saw a round ball rolling on the floor.

sentences.chinese: 那个球像一个小地球，上面有很多颜色。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè qiú xiàng yí gè xiǎo dìqiú, shàngmiàn yǒu hěnduō yánsè.
sentences.english: That ball was like a small globe, with many colors on it.

sentences.chinese: 三先生在门外对我喊话：“快出来，我们要走了！”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng zài mén wài duì wǒ hǎnhuà: “Kuài chūlái, wǒmen yào zǒu le!”
sentences.english: Mr. San shouted to me from outside the door, "Come out quickly, we're leaving!"

sentences.chinese: 我走出洗手间，看到那个男人在对我笑。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǒu chū xǐshǒujiān, kàndào nàgè nánrén zài duì wǒ xiào.
sentences.english: I walked out of the washroom and saw the man smiling at me.

sentences.chinese: 他像我的爸一样，眼神很温柔。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàng wǒ de bà yíyàng, yǎnshén hěn wēnróu.
sentences.english: He was like my dad, with a very gentle look in his eyes.

sentences.chinese: 但当我们走向汽车时，我突然听到远处传来了巨大的雷声。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn dāng wǒmen zǒuxiàng qìchē shí, wǒ tūrán tīngdào yuǎnchù chuánlái le jùdà de léishēng.
sentences.english: But as we walked toward the car, I suddenly heard a massive clap of thunder from the distance.

sentences.chinese: 雷声很大，天空变成了灰色。
sentences.pinyin: Léishēng hěn dà, tiānkōng biànchéngle huīsè.
sentences.english: The thunder was loud, and the sky turned grey.

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着我，他的表情不大了。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng kànzhe wǒ, tā de biǎoqíng bù dà le.
sentences.english: Mr. San looked at me, his expression not very [calm].

sentences.chinese: 他说：“这里的天气不对，我们必须快走。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zhèlǐ de tiānqì bù duì, wǒmen bìxū kuài zǒu.”
sentences.english: He said, "The weather here is not right; we must leave quickly."

sentences.chinese: 我看到路边有两辆汽车，一辆是红色的，一辆是蓝色的。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàndào lùbiān yǒu liǎng liàng qìchē, yī liàng shì hóngsè de, yī liàng shì lánsè de.
sentences.english: I saw two cars by the road, one red and one blue.

sentences.chinese: 三先生说：“我们先坐红色的车。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng shuō: “Wǒmen xiān zuò hóngsè de chē.”
sentences.english: Mr. San said, "Let's take the red car first."

sentences.chinese: 我问他：“为什么不坐蓝色的车吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Wèishéme bù zuò lánsè de chē ma?”
sentences.english: I asked him, "Why not take the blue car?"

sentences.chinese: 他笑了笑，指着蓝色的车说：“那辆车坏了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàole xiào, zhǐzhe lánsè de chē shuō: “Nà liàng chē huài le.”
sentences.english: He smiled and pointed to the blue car, saying, "That car is broken."

sentences.chinese: 我看向那辆车，发现它的轮子只有一半在地上。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn xiàng nà liàng chē, fāxiàn tā de lúnzi zhǐyǒu yī bàn zài dìshàng.
sentences.english: I looked at the car and found that only half of its wheel was on the ground.

sentences.chinese: 车里坐着一些奇怪的人，他们在看我们。
sentences.pinyin: Chē lǐ zuòzhe yīxiē qíguài de rén, tāmen zài kàn wǒmen.
sentences.english: Some strange people were sitting in the car, watching us.

sentences.chinese: 三先生说：“不要看别人，快上车！”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng shuō: “Bùyào kàn biérén, kuài shàng chē!”
sentences.english: Mr. San said, "Don't look at other people, get in the car quickly!"

sentences.chinese: 我们坐进车里，车内有四个座位。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zuò jìn chē lǐ, chē nèi yǒu sì gè zuòwèi.
sentences.english: We sat in the car; there were four seats inside.

sentences.chinese: 我坐在后面，看着窗外，心里想：这里是什么地方？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuò zài hòumiàn, kànzhe chuāngwài, xīnlǐ xiǎng: Zhèlǐ shì shénme dìfāng?
sentences.english: I sat in the back, looking out the window, thinking: What place is this?

sentences.chinese: 三先生开始数路边的树，他数到五，然后是六。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng kāishǐ shǔ lùbiān de shù, tā shǔ dào wǔ, ránhòu shì liù.
sentences.english: Mr. San began counting the trees by the road; he counted to five, then six.

sentences.chinese: 接着是七，八，九，最后是十。
sentences.pinyin: Jiēzhe shì qī, bā, jiǔ, zuìhòu shì shí.
sentences.english: Then seven, eight, nine, and finally ten.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“这里的树很有意思，每十棵树就有一棵是金色的。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zhèlǐ de shù hěn yǒu yìsi, měi shí kē shù jiù yǒu yī kē shì jīnsè de.”
sentences.english: He said, "The trees here are very interesting; for every ten trees, one is golden."

sentences.chinese: 我好奇地问：“除了金色的，还有别的颜色吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hàoqí dì wèn: “Chúle jīnsè de, hái yǒu bié de yánsè ma?”
sentences.english: I asked curiously, "Besides gold, are there other colors?"

sentences.chinese: 三先生说：“有，但那是另外的故事。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng shuō: “Yǒu, dàn nà shì lìngwài de gùshì.”
sentences.english: Mr. San said, "There are, but that is another story."

sentences.chinese: 我看着窗外，感觉时间过得很快，像过了半年一样长。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe chuāngwài, gǎnjué shíjiān guò dé hěn kuài, xiàng guòle bàn nián yīyàng cháng.
sentences.english: I looked out the window and felt time passing very quickly, as if half a year had passed.

sentences.chinese: 此时，车速突然变快了，我们像在飞一样。
sentences.pinyin: Cǐshí, chēsù tūrán biàn kuài le, wǒmen xiàng zài fēi yīyàng.
sentences.english: At this moment, the car speed suddenly increased; we were like we were flying.

sentences.chinese: 三先生说：“我们现在要经过四个村庄。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng shuō: “Wǒmen xiànzài yào jīngguò sì gè cūnzhuāng.”
sentences.english: Mr. San said, "We are now going to pass through four villages."

sentences.chinese: 我问：“哪些村庄最有名？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn: “Nǎxiē cūnzhuāng zuì yǒumíng?”
sentences.english: I asked, "Which villages are the most famous?"

sentences.chinese: 他回答：“二号村和四号村，那里有很多古老的房子。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā huídá: “Èr hào cūn hé sì hào cūn, nàlǐ yǒu hěnduō gǔlǎo de fángzi.”
sentences.english: He answered, "Village Number Two and Village Number Four; there are many ancient houses there."

sentences.chinese: 我看到路边有很多小石子，大约有两百多个。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàndào lùbiān yǒu hěnduō xiǎo shízǐ, dàyuē yǒu liǎng bǎi duō gè.
sentences.english: I saw many pebbles by the road, about two hundred odd.

sentences.chinese: 三先生突然停下车，看向后视镜。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng tūrán tíng xià chē, kàn xiàng hòushìjìng.
sentences.english: Mr. San suddenly stopped the car and looked in the rearview mirror.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“不对，那个影子又回来了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Bù duì, nàgè yǐngzi yòu huíláile.”
sentences.english: He said, "Something is wrong; that shadow has come back again."

sentences.chinese: 那个巨大的影子在雨中奔跑，速度比我们快一倍。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè jùdà de yǐngzi zài yǔzhōng bēnpǎo, sùdù bǐ wǒmen kuài yī bèi.
