sentences.english: The huge shadow was running in the rain, its speed twice as fast as ours.

sentences.chinese: 它离我们只有半公里了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lí wǒmen zhǐyǒu bàn gōnglǐ le.
sentences.english: It was only half a kilometer away from us.

sentences.chinese: 三先生紧张地看着我，低声说：“快，帮我数数，它现在有几个头？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng jǐnzhāng dì kànzhe wǒ, dīshēng shuō: “Kuài, bāng wǒ shǔshǔ, tā xiànzài yǒu jǐ gè tóu?”
sentences.english: Mr. San looked at me nervously and whispered, "Quick, help me count, how many heads does it have now?"

sentences.chinese: 我睁大眼睛看去，发现那个影子正在分裂成两个。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhēng dà yǎnjīng kàn qù, fāxiàn nàgè yǐngzi zhèngzài fēnliè chéng liǎng gè.
sentences.english: I widened my eyes and looked, only to find that the shadow was splitting into two.

sentences.chinese: 我看着那个影子，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe nàge yǐngzi, xīntiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: I looked at that shadow, my heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 它现在有两个头，而且速度很快。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiànzài yǒu liǎng gè tóu, érqiě sùdù hěn kuài.
sentences.english: It now had two heads, and its speed was very fast.

sentences.chinese: 三先生大声说：“快跑！我们最好现在就离开这里！”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānsheng dàshēng shuō: “Kuài pǎo! Wǒmen zuìhǎo xiànzài jiù líkāi zhèlǐ!”
sentences.english: Mr. San shouted, "Run! We had better leave here right now!"

sentences.chinese: 我们跑向一个小房子，那里有一些旧椅子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen pǎo xiàng yī gè xiǎo fángzi, nàlǐ yǒu yīxiē jiù yǐzi.
sentences.english: We ran toward a small house, where there were some old chairs.

sentences.chinese: 我问他：“那个影子到底是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Nàge yǐngzi dàodǐ shì shéi?”
sentences.english: I asked him, "Who exactly is that shadow?"

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着我，眼神有些奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānsheng kànzhe wǒ, yǎnshén yǒuxiē qíguài.
sentences.english: Mr. San looked at me, his expression somewhat strange.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“在这个地方，有些东西常常在雨中出现。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zài zhège dìfāng, yǒuxiē dōngxi chángcháng zài yǔzhōng chūxiàn.”
sentences.english: He said, "In this place, some things frequently appear in the rain."

sentences.chinese: 有时候，它们是朋友；有时，它们是危险。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒushíhou, tāmen shì péngyou; yǒushí, tāmen shì wēixiǎn.
sentences.english: Sometimes they are friends; sometimes they are dangers.

sentences.chinese: 有的影子在寻找家，有的影子在寻找路。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒude yǐngzi zài xúnzhǎo jiā, yǒude yǐngzi zài xúnzhǎo lù.
sentences.english: Some shadows are looking for home, some shadows are looking for a path.

sentences.chinese: 三先生指着远方，那里有一架巨大的飞机。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānsheng zhǐzhe yuǎnfāng, nàlǐ yǒu yī jià jùdà de fēijī.
sentences.english: Mr. San pointed to the distance, where there was a huge airplane.

sentences.chinese: “你看那些飞机，它们不能飞，因为这里没有天空。”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ kàn nàxiē fēijī, tāmen bùnéng fēi, yīnwèi zhèlǐ méiyǒu tiānkōng.”
sentences.english: "Look at those airplanes, they cannot fly because there is no sky here."

sentences.chinese: 我感到很奇怪，怎么会这样？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gǎndào hěn qíguài, zěnme huì zhèyàng?
sentences.english: I felt it was very strange, how could it be like this?

sentences.chinese: 三先生给我一张地图，地图上有第二条路。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānsheng gěi wǒ yī zhāng dìtú, dìtú shàng yǒu dì-èr tiáo lù.
sentences.english: Mr. San gave me a map, and on the map there was a second path.

sentences.chinese: 他轻声说：“读这张地图，它会告诉我们怎么走。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā qīngshēng shuō: “Dú zhè zhāng dìtú, tā huì gàosù wǒmen zěnme zǒu.”
sentences.english: He said softly, "Read this map, it will tell us how to go."

sentences.chinese: 我读着地图，发现路很少，而且路很重，意思是很难走。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dúzhe dìtú, fāxiàn lù hěn shǎo, érqiě lù hěn zhòng, yìsi shì hěn nán zǒu.
sentences.english: I read the map and found that paths were few, and the path was 'heavy,' meaning it was hard to travel.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个年轻的男孩子跑过来，他看起来像个妹妹的哥哥。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, yī gè niánqīng de nán háizi pǎo guòlái, tā kàn qǐlái xiàng gè mèimei de gēge.
sentences.english: Just then, a young boy ran over; he looked like a younger sister's older brother.

sentences.chinese: 他礼貌地对三先生说：“您好，三先生，您在找谁？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā lǐmào de duì Sān xiānsheng shuō: “Nín hǎo, Sān xiānsheng, nín zài zhǎo shéi?”
sentences.english: He politely said to Mr. San, "Hello, Mr. San, who are you looking for?"

sentences.chinese: 三先生笑着说：“我在找一个能帮我数数的人。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānsheng xiàozhe shuō: “Wǒ zài zhǎo yī gè néng bāng wǒ shǔshǔ de rén.”
sentences.english: Mr. San smiled and said, "I am looking for someone who can help me count."

sentences.chinese: 那个男孩看着我，问我：“你叫什么名字？”
sentences.pinyin: Nàge nánhái kànzhe wǒ, wèn wǒ: “Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?”
sentences.english: The boy looked at me and asked, "What is your name?"

sentences.chinese: 我告诉他我的名字，他对我笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gàosù tā wǒ de míngzi, tā duì wǒ xiàole.
sentences.english: I told him my name, and he smiled at me.

sentences.chinese: 三先生说：“现在我们得重新决定方向。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānsheng shuō: “Xiànzài wǒmen děi chóngxīn juédìng fāngxiàng.”
sentences.english: Mr. San said, "Now we must decide the direction again."

sentences.chinese: 他想出了一个好着，让我们沿着地图走。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng chūle yī gè hǎo zhāo, ràng wǒmen yánzhe dìtú zǒu.
sentences.english: He came up with a good trick, letting us follow the map.

sentences.chinese: 我们现在还不知道前方有多少危险。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiànzài hái bù zhīdào qiánfāng yǒu duōshǎo wēixiǎn.
sentences.english: We still don't know how much danger lies ahead.

sentences.chinese: 但我们必须一起走，因为一个人太小，力量太少。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒmen bìxū yīqǐ zǒu, yīnwèi yī gè rén tài xiǎo, lìliàng tài shǎo.
sentences.english: But we must go together, because one person is too small and the strength is too little.

sentences.chinese: 还有一个人在后面看着我们，那是谁？
sentences.pinyin: Hái yǒu yī gè rén zài hòumiàn kànzhe wǒmen, nà shì shéi?
sentences.english: There is still someone watching us from behind, who is it?

sentences.chinese: 那个影子再次分裂了，这次变成了三个头。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge yǐngzi zàicì fēnliè le, zhècì biànchéng le sān gè tóu.
sentences.english: The shadow split again, and this time it became three heads.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十一章：迷雾中的小镇
chapters.title_english: Chapter 11: The Town in the Mist

sentences.chinese: 三个头的影子在后面走，我们快步跑进了一个小镇。
sentences.pinyin: Sān gè tóu de yǐng zi zài hòu mian zǒu, wǒ men kuài bù pǎo jìn le yī gè xiǎo zhèn.
sentences.english: The three-headed shadow followed behind as we ran quickly into a small town.

sentences.chinese: 这里有一个很旧的学校，看起来像是一个中学。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ yǒu yī gè hěn jiù de xué xiào, kàn qǐ lái xiàng shì yī gè zhōng xué.
sentences.english: There was a very old school here, which looked like a middle school.

sentences.chinese: 在学校里，我看到一个女人在哭。
sentences.pinyin: Zài xué xiào lǐ, wǒ kàn dào yī gè nǚ rén zài kū.
sentences.english: Inside the school, I saw a woman crying.

sentences.chinese: 她身边有一个小孩子，是一个可爱的小朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shēn biān yǒu yī gè xiǎo hái zi, shì yī gè kě ài de xiǎo péng yǒu.
sentences.english: Beside her was a small child, a cute little kid.

sentences.chinese: 那个女人告诉我，她的儿子生病了。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè nǚ rén gào sù wǒ, tā de ér zi shēng bìng le.
sentences.english: The woman told me that her son was sick.

sentences.chinese: 她现在在找一个医生，因为她的儿子今天过生日。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàn zài zài zhǎo yī gè yī shēng, yīn wèi tā de ér zi jīn tiān guò shēng rì.
sentences.english: She was currently looking for a doctor because today was her son's birthday.

sentences.chinese: 一个穿着工作服的工人走过来，对她说：“别担心。”
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè chuān zhe gōng zuò fú de gōng rén zǒu guò lái, duì tā shuō: “Bié dān xīn.”
sentences.english: A worker wearing a uniform walked over and said to her, "Don't worry."

sentences.chinese: 这个工人是她的朋友，他知道这里有一个好医生。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè gōng rén shì tā de péng you, tā zhī dào zhè lǐ yǒu yī gè hǎo yī shēng.
sentences.english: This worker was her friend; he knew there was a good doctor here.

sentences.chinese: 医生住在楼上，就在那个红色的房子里。
sentences.pinyin: Yī shēng zhù zài lóu shàng, jiù zài nà gè hóng sè de fáng zi lǐ.
sentences.english: The doctor lived upstairs, right inside that red house.

sentences.chinese: 我帮她拿了一下儿包，她对我说了谢谢。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bāng tā ná le yī xià r bāo, tā duì wǒ shuō le xiè xie.
sentences.english: I helped her carry her bag for a moment, and she thanked me.

sentences.chinese: 我笑着说：“不客气。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiào zhe shuō: “Bù kè qi.”
sentences.english: I smiled and said, "You're welcome."

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个年轻的男人跑过来，他是那个女人的男朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yī gè nián qīng de nán rén pǎo guò lái, tā shì nà gè nǚ rén de nán péng you.
sentences.english: Just then, a young man ran over; he was the woman's boyfriend.

sentences.chinese: 他带着他的女儿，一个活泼的小女孩。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dài zhe tā de nǚ ér, yī gè huó pō de xiǎo nǚ hái.
sentences.english: He brought his daughter, a lively little girl.

sentences.chinese: 这个男人以前是这里的老师，现在在大学工作。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè nán rén yǐ qián shì zhè lǐ de lǎo shī, xiàn zài zài dà xué gōng zuò.
sentences.english: This man used to be a teacher here and now works at a university.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，他在网上认识了一个网友，那个网友说这里有秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ, tā zài wǎng shàng rèn shi le yī gè wǎng yǒu, nà gè wǎng yǒu shuō zhè lǐ yǒu mì mì.
sentences.english: He told me that he met an online friend on the internet, and that online friend said there were secrets here.

sentences.chinese: 他现在想给他的女朋友买一份特别的生日礼物。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàn zài xiǎng gěi tā de nǚ péng you mǎi yī fèn tè bié de shēng rì lǐ wù.
sentences.english: He now wanted to buy a special birthday gift for his girlfriend.

sentences.chinese: 我看着他，问他：“你觉得这个影子是什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe tā, wèn tā: “Nǐ jué de zhè gè yǐng zi shì shén me?”
sentences.english: I looked at him and asked, "What do you think this shadow is?"

sentences.chinese: 他看着远处，突然站了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe yuǎn chù, tū rán zhàn le qǐ lái.
sentences.english: He looked into the distance and suddenly stood up.

sentences.chinese: 他的大姐也走到了我们身边，看着那个影子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de dà jiě yě zǒu dào le wǒ men shēn biān, kàn zhe nà gè yǐng zi.
sentences.english: His older sister also walked up to us, watching the shadow.

sentences.chinese: 在这个安静的小镇里，每个人看起来都很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè gè ān jìng de xiǎo zhèn lǐ, měi gè rén kàn qǐ lái dōu hěn qí guài.
sentences.english: In this quiet town, everyone seemed very strange.

sentences.chinese: 我们决定一起去吃顿饭，然后讨论怎么离开这里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men jué dìng yī qǐ qù chī dùn fàn, rán hòu tǎo lùn zěn me lí kāi zhè lǐ.
sentences.english: We decided to go have a meal together and then discuss how to leave this place.

sentences.chinese: 但就在我们准备吃饭的时候，那个三头影子突然出现在了窗户外面。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài wǒ men zhǔn bèi chī fàn de shí hou, nà gè sān tóu yǐng zi tū rán chū xiàn zài le chuāng hu wài mian.
sentences.english: But just as we were preparing to eat, the three-headed shadow suddenly appeared outside the window.

sentences.chinese: 它在看着我们，眼神里没有愤怒，只有悲伤。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài kàn zhe wǒ men, yǎn shén lǐ méi yǒu fèn nù, zhǐ yǒu bēi shāng.
sentences.english: It was looking at us, and in its eyes there was no anger, only sadness.

sentences.chinese: 它是不是在寻找它丢失的家人？
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì bú shì zài xún zhǎo tā diū shī de jiā rén?
sentences.english: Was it searching for its lost family?

sentences.chinese: 三先生低声说，地图上的下一个标记就在这个镇子的中心。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng dī shēng shuō, dì tú shàng de xià yī gè biāo jì jiù zài zhè gè zhèn zi de zhōng xīn.
sentences.english: Mr. San whispered that the next marker on the map was right in the center of this town.

sentences.chinese: 但中心的地方，现在被浓雾覆盖了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zhōng xīn de dì fang, xiàn zài bèi nóng wù fù gài le.
sentences.english: But the center of the town was now covered in thick mist.

sentences.chinese: 三头影子在窗外看着我们，它的眼神很悲伤。
sentences.pinyin: Sān tóu yǐng zi zài chuāng wài kàn zhe wǒ men, tā de yǎn shén hěn bēi shāng.
sentences.english: The three-headed shadow looked at us from outside the window, its eyes full of sadness.

sentences.chinese: 三先生说，我们现在不能在饭店里呆着。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng shuō, wǒ men xiàn zài bù néng zài fàn diàn lǐ dāi zhe.
sentences.english: Mr. San said that we cannot stay in the hotel now.

sentences.chinese: 他看着窗外，低声说：“它在等我们。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe chuāng wài, dī shēng shuō: “Tā zài děng wǒ men.”
sentences.english: He looked out the window and whispered, "It is waiting for us."

sentences.chinese: 今天，这个小镇被浓雾覆盖了。
sentences.pinyin: Jīn tiān, zhè ge xiǎo zhèn bèi nóng wù fù gài le.
sentences.english: Today, this small town is covered in thick fog.

sentences.chinese: 我们走出房门，感觉雾气就在我们中间。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men zǒu chū fáng mén, gǎn jué wù qì jiù zài wǒ men zhōng jiān.
sentences.english: We walked out of the room and felt the mist right between us.

sentences.chinese: 现在是中午，但天空看起来像黑夜。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài shì zhōng wǔ, dàn tiān kōng kàn qǐ lái xiàng hēi yè.
sentences.english: It is noon now, but the sky looks like nighttime.

sentences.chinese: 三先生问我：“你觉得它是在寻找家人，还是在保护我们？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng wèn wǒ: “Nǐ jué de tā shì zài xún zhǎo jiā rén, hái shi zài bǎo hù wǒ men?”
sentences.english: Mr. San asked me, "Do you think it is searching for family, or is it protecting us?"

sentences.chinese: 我没说话，因为我正在想那个奇怪的地图。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ méi shuō huà, yīn wèi wǒ zhèng zài xiǎng nà ge qí guài de dì tú.
sentences.english: I didn't speak because I was just thinking about that strange map.

sentences.chinese: 我们走在街道上，走了一会儿，雾突然变大了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men zǒu zài jiē dào shàng, zǒu le yī huì r, wù tū rán biàn dà le.
sentences.english: We walked on the street, and after a while, the fog suddenly grew thicker.

sentences.chinese: 我们在这里走了一半天，却没看到镇中心。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men zài zhè lǐ zǒu le bàn tiān, què méi kàn dào zhèn zhōng xīn.
sentences.english: We walked here for half the day, yet we didn't see the town center.

sentences.chinese: 三先生停下来，看着我，问我：“你在干什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng tíng xià lái, kàn zhe wǒ, wèn wǒ: “Nǐ zài gàn shén me?”
sentences.english: Mr. San stopped, looked at me, and asked, "What are you doing?"

sentences.chinese: 我说我感觉身体有点儿冷。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō wǒ gǎn jué shēn tǐ yǒu diǎnr lěng.
sentences.english: I said I felt my body was a bit cold.

sentences.chinese: 他摸了摸自己的身上，拿出一件大外套给我。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mō le mō zì jǐ de shēn shang, ná chū yī jiàn dà wài tào gěi wǒ.
sentences.english: He felt on his person and took out a large coat for me.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你要照顾好身体，因为我们的时间不多了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ yào zhào gù hǎo shēn tǐ, yīn wèi wǒ men de shí jiān bù duō le.”
sentences.english: He said, "You must take care of your health, because our time is running out."

sentences.chinese: 我们继续往前走，走到了一个巨大的石门前面。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men jì xù wǎng qián zǒu, zǒu dào le yī gè jù dà de shí mén qián miàn.
sentences.english: We continued forward and arrived in front of a huge stone gate.

sentences.chinese: 石门中间有一个小窗口，那里有一个卖门票的人。
sentences.pinyin: Shí mén zhōng jiān yǒu yī gè xiǎo chuāng kǒu, nà lǐ yǒu yī gè mài mén piào de rén.
sentences.english: In the middle of the stone gate, there was a small window where a ticket seller stood.

sentences.chinese: 三先生买了两张门票，对我说：“这次我们要小心。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng mǎi le liǎng zhāng mén piào, duì wǒ shuō: “Zhè cì wǒ men yào xiǎo xīn.”
sentences.english: Mr. San bought two tickets and said to me, "This time we must be careful."

sentences.chinese: 我们一起走进了石门，里面是一个古老的公园。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men yī qǐ zǒu jìn le shí mén, lǐ miàn shì yī gè gǔ lǎo de gōng yuán.
sentences.english: Together we entered the stone gate; inside was an ancient park.

sentences.chinese: 在白天，这里应该是很美的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Zài bái tiān, zhè lǐ yīng gāi shì hěn měi de dì fang.
sentences.english: During the daytime, this should be a very beautiful place.

sentences.chinese: 但现在，这里只有安静和迷雾。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiàn zài, zhè lǐ zhǐ yǒu ān jìng hé mí wù.
sentences.english: But now, there is only silence and mist here.

sentences.chinese: 我们走在公园的中间，突然听到了一声巨大的叫声。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men zǒu zài gōng yuán de zhōng jiān, tū rán tīng dào le yī shēng jù dà de jiào shēng.
sentences.english: As we walked in the middle of the park, we suddenly heard a loud shout.

sentences.chinese: 那个三头影子马上就出现在了我们的面前。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge sān tóu yǐng zi mǎ shàng jiù chū xiàn zài le wǒ men de miàn qián.
sentences.english: The three-headed shadow immediately appeared before us.

sentences.chinese: 它看着我们，然后指了指远方的一棵大树。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe wǒ men, rán hòu zhǐ le zhǐ yuǎn fāng de yī kē dà shù.
sentences.english: It looked at us, then pointed toward a large tree in the distance.

sentences.chinese: 我记得在之前的一次旅行中，我也见过类似的标志。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jì de zài zhī qián de yī cì lǚ xíng zhōng, wǒ yě jiàn guò lèi sì de biāo zhì.
sentences.english: I remember that in a previous trip, I had seen a similar sign.

sentences.chinese: 这时，太阳终于出来了，现在已经是下午了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, tài yáng zhōng yú chū lái le, xiàn zài yǐ jīng shì xià wǔ le.
sentences.english: At this moment, the sun finally came out; it was already afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 我突然想起，我今天早上起床的时候，地图上出现了一个新标记。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tū rán xiǎng qǐ, wǒ jīn tiān zǎo shang qǐ chuáng de shí hou, dì tú shàng chū xiàn le yī gè xīn biāo jì.
sentences.english: I suddenly remembered that when I got up this morning, a new mark appeared on the map.

sentences.chinese: 那个标记就在那棵大树的下面。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge biāo jì jiù zài nà kē dà shù de xià miàn.
sentences.english: That mark was exactly under that large tree.

sentences.chinese: 但就在我们走向大树的时候，一个陌生的人挡在了我们中间。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài wǒ men zǒu xiàng dà shù de shí hou, yī gè mò shēng de rén dǎng zài le wǒ men zhōng jiān.
sentences.english: But just as we walked toward the tree, a stranger blocked the way between us.

sentences.chinese: 他看着我们，眼神很冷，问我们是谁。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe wǒ men, yǎn shén hěn lěng, wèn wǒ men shì shuí.
sentences.english: He looked at us with cold eyes and asked who we were.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 13: The Academy in the Mist

sentences.chinese: 那个陌生的人看着我们，眼神很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge mòshēng de rén kànzhe wǒmen, yǎnshén hěn lěng.
sentences.english: The stranger looked at us with a cold gaze.

sentences.chinese: 三先生走上前去，礼貌地问他：“请问，这里是哪里？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānsheng zǒu shàngqián qù, lǐmào de wèn tā: “Qǐngwèn, zhèlǐ shì nǎlǐ?”
sentences.english: Mr. San stepped forward and politely asked him, "Excuse me, where is this place?"

sentences.chinese: 那个人指了指雾中的一座大建筑，说那是当地的学院。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge rén zhǐle zhǐ wùzhōng de yī zuò dà jiànzhù, shuō nà shì dāngdì de xuéyuàn.
sentences.english: The man pointed to a large building in the mist and said it was the local academy.

sentences.chinese: 我们走近一看，那是一座巨大的教学楼。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zǒu jìn yī kàn, nà shì yī zuò jùdà de jiàoxuélóu.
sentences.english: We walked closer and saw it was a massive teaching block.

sentences.chinese: 奇怪的是，虽然现在是下午，但这里看起来像是在放学时间。
sentences.pinyin: Qíguài de shì, suīrán xiànzài shì xiàwǔ, dàn zhèlǐ kàn qǐlái xiàng shì zài fàngxué shíjiān.
sentences.english: Strangely, although it was now afternoon, it looked like the time when school lets out.

sentences.chinese: 很多学生在楼前走，有小学生，也有中学生。
sentences.pinyin: Hěnduō xuésheng zài lóu qián zǒu, yǒu xiǎoxuésheng, yěyǒu zhōngxuéshēng.
sentences.english: Many students were walking in front of the building; there were primary school students and middle-school students.

sentences.chinese: 一个背着书包的男生跑过来，他看起来很匆忙。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè bēizhe shūbāo de nánshēng pǎo guòlái, tā kàn qǐlái hěn cōngmáng.
sentences.english: A boy carrying a schoolbag ran over; he looked very hurried.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，这里的学生每天都要学习很多奇怪的知识。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, zhèlǐ de xuésheng měitiān dōu yào xuéxí hěnduō qíguài de zhīshì.
sentences.english: He told me that the students here have to study many strange pieces of knowledge every day.

sentences.chinese: 三先生对我说：“你看，那个女生在读书，她的书很厚。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānsheng duì wǒ shuō: “Nǐ kàn, nàge nǚshēng zài dúshū, tā de shū hěn hòu.”
sentences.english: Mr. San said to me, "Look, that girl is reading; her book is very thick."

sentences.chinese: 我看到那个女生在读一本关于地图的书，那看起来像是一本古老的书经。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàndào nàge nǚshēng zài dú yī běn guānyú dìtú de shū, nà kàn qǐlái xiàng shì yī běn gǔlǎo de shū.
sentences.english: I saw the girl reading a book about maps; it looked like an ancient scripture.

sentences.chinese: 我问三先生：“这里的人每天怎么上学？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn Sān xiānsheng: “Zhèlǐ de rén měitiān zěnme shàngxué?”
sentences.english: I asked Mr. San, "How do the people here go to school every day?"

sentences.chinese: 三先生回答说，他们不需要坐车，只需要在雾中行走。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānsheng huídá shuō, tāmen bù xūyào zuò chē, zhǐ xūyào zài wùzhōng xíngzǒu.
sentences.english: Mr. San replied that they don't need to take a car; they only need to walk through the mist.

sentences.chinese: 我们走进教学楼，看到很多教室里正在上课。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zǒu jìn jiàoxuélóu, kàndào hěnduō jiàoshì lǐ zhèngzài shàngkè.
sentences.english: We entered the teaching block and saw that classes were in session in many classrooms.

sentences.chinese: 一个大学生走过来，他是我在旅途中遇到的第一个大学生。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè dàxuéshēng zǒu guòlái, tā shì wǒ zài lǚtú zhōng yùdào de dì yī gè dàxuéshēng.
sentences.english: A university student walked over; he was the first university student I had met on my journey.

sentences.chinese: 他说，他们现在正在学一种古老的语言。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, tāmen xiànzài zhèngzài xué yī zhǒng gǔlǎo de yǔyán.
sentences.english: He said they were currently learning an ancient language.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，每个学生都有一个本子，用来记录听写的内容。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, měi gè xuésheng dōu yǒu yī gè běnzi, yòng lái jìlù tīngxiě de nèiróng.
sentences.english: He told me that every student has a notebook used to record dictation content.

sentences.chinese: 在这个学院里，听写是非常重要的一课。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège xuéyuàn lǐ, tīngxiě shì fēicháng zhòngyào de yī kè.
sentences.english: In this academy, dictation is a very important lesson.

sentences.chinese: 那个大学生说：“我们现在快要下课了，你可以进来看看。”
sentences.pinyin: Nàge dàxuéshēng shuō: “Wǒmen xiànzài kuàiyào xiàkè le, nǐ kěyǐ jìnlái kànkan.”
sentences.english: The university student said, "We are about to finish class now; you can come in and take a look."

sentences.chinese: 我看到教室里坐着很多同学，他们都在认真地学习。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàndào jiàoshì lǐ zuòzhe hěnduō tóngxué, tāmen dōu zài rènzhēn de xuéxí.
sentences.english: I saw many classmates sitting in the classroom, all studying diligently.

sentences.chinese: 三先生笑了，他说他以前也像个小学生一样，对世界充满好奇。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānsheng xiàole, tā shuō tā yǐqián yě xiàng gè xiǎoxuésheng yīyàng, duì shìjiè chōngmǎn hàoqí.
sentences.english: Mr. San smiled and said that he used to be like a primary school student, full of curiosity about the world.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，读书不仅是为了知识，更是为了寻找自我。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, dúshū bùjǐn shì wèile zhīshì, gèng shì wèile xúnzhǎo zìwǒ.
sentences.english: He told me that reading is not only for knowledge but also for finding oneself.

sentences.chinese: 突然，我的肚子响了，我感到非常饿。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, wǒ de dùzi xiǎngle, wǒ gǎndào fēicháng è.
sentences.english: Suddenly, my stomach growled; I felt very hungry.

sentences.chinese: 三先生拿出一个面包给我，笑着说：“学习之前，先填饱肚子。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānsheng ná chū yī gè miànbāo gěi wǒ, xiàozhe shuō: “Xuéxí zhīqián, xiān tián bǎo dùzi.”
sentences.english: Mr. San took out a piece of bread for me and said with a smile, "Before studying, fill your stomach first."

sentences.chinese: 我们决定在学院里等一等，看看能不能找到地图上的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen juédìng zài xuéyuàn lǐ děng yī děng, kànkàn néng bù néng zhǎodào dìtú shàng de mìmì.
sentences.english: We decided to wait a bit in the academy to see if we could find the secret on the map.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，那个冷漠的陌生人再次出现了，他手里拿着一张名单。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, nàge lěngmò de mòshēng rén zàicì chūxiànle, tā shǒu lǐ názhe yī zhāng míngdān.
sentences.english: But just then, that cold stranger appeared again, holding a list in his hand.

sentences.chinese: 他盯着我，低声说：“你不在这个等级的名单上。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dīngzhe wǒ, dīshēng shuō: “Nǐ bù zài zhège děngjí de míngdān shàng.”
sentences.english: He stared at me and whispered, "You are not on the list for this grade."

sentences.chinese: 我看着那个陌生人，心里觉得很不安。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe nàge mòshēng rén, xīnlǐ juéde hěn bù'ān.
sentences.english: I looked at the stranger, feeling uneasy in my heart.

sentences.chinese: 三先生在我的旁边，他轻轻地拍了拍我的肩膀。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng zài wǒ de pángbiān, tā qīngqīng de pāile pāi wǒ de jiānbǎng.
sentences.english: Mr. San was by my side, gently patting my shoulder.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“没关系，我们在这里可以找到答案。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Méiguānxì, wǒmen zài zhèlǐ kěyǐ zhǎodào dá'àn.”
sentences.english: He said, "It's okay, we can find the answer here."

sentences.chinese: 陌生人冷冷地指了指门口，示意我们离开。
sentences.pinyin: Mòshēng rén lěnglěng de zhǐle zhǐ ménkǒu, shìyì wǒmen líkāi.
sentences.english: The stranger coldly pointed to the doorway, signaling us to leave.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我们，这个地点不对，我们不能在里边待太久。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒmen, zhège dìdiǎn bùduì, wǒmen bùnéng zài lǐbiān dài tài jiǔ.
sentences.english: He told us that this location was incorrect and we could not stay inside for too long.

sentences.chinese: 我低头看，发现地上有一张旧地图。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dītóu kàn, fāxiàn dìshàng yǒu yī zhāng jiù dìtú.
sentences.english: I looked down and found an old map on the ground.

sentences.chinese: 地图上写着，秘密在东边和西边之间，也就是东西方向的中心。
sentences.pinyin: Dìtú shàng xiězhe, mìmì zài dōngbiān hé xībiān zhījiān, yě jiùshì dōngxī fāngxiàng de zhōngxīn.
sentences.english: The map stated that the secret was between the east and west, that is, the center of the east-west direction.

sentences.chinese: 三先生拿起地图，看着上边的小字，若有所思。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng ná qǐ dìtú, kànzhe shàngbian de xiǎo zì, ruò yǒu suǒ sī.
sentences.english: Mr. San picked up the map, looking at the small characters on the top, lost in thought.

sentences.chinese: 他指着地图下方，说：“看，秘密在地下，在我们的下边。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐzhe dìtú xiàfāng, shuō: “Kàn, mìmì zài dìxià, zài wǒmen de xiàbian.”
sentences.english: He pointed to the bottom of the map and said, "Look, the secret is underground, below us."

sentences.chinese: 为了找到那个地方，我们必须走出学院的大门。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile zhǎodào nàge dìfāng, wǒmen bìxū zǒuchū xuéyuàn de dàmén.
sentences.english: To find that place, we had to walk out of the academy's main gate.

sentences.chinese: 我们走在马路上，风很大，感觉很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zǒu zài mǎlù shàng, fēng hěn dà, gǎnjué hěn lěng.
sentences.english: We walked on the street; the wind was strong, and it felt very cold.

sentences.chinese: 路口有一个奇怪的标志，指向前方。
sentences.pinyin: Lùkǒu yǒu yīgè qíguài de biāozhì, zhǐxiàng qiánfāng.
sentences.english: At the intersection, there was a strange sign pointing forward.

sentences.chinese: 三先生问我：“你觉得去哪儿比较快？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng wèn wǒ: “Nǐ juéde qù nǎr bǐjiào kuài?”
sentences.english: Mr. San asked me, "Where do you think is the faster way to go?"

sentences.chinese: 我回答说：“我不知道去哪里，这里的路太复杂了。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ huídá shuō: “Wǒ bù zhīdào qù nǎlǐ, zhèlǐ de lù tài fùzá le.”
sentences.english: I replied, "I don't know where to go; the roads here are too complicated."

sentences.chinese: 我们走在路上，周围没有人，只有浓雾。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zǒu zài lùshàng, zhōuwéi méiyǒu rén, zhǐyǒu nóngwù.
sentences.english: We walked on the road; there was no one around, only thick fog.

sentences.chinese: 我问三先生：“我们要怎么走？哪条路才是正确的？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn Sān xiānshēng: “Wǒmen yào zěnme zǒu? Nǎ tiáo lù cáishì zhèngquè de?”
sentences.english: I asked Mr. San, "How should we go? Which road is the correct one?"

sentences.chinese: 三先生笑了，他说：“寻找秘密总是很难的，但这就是旅行的乐趣。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng xiàole, tā shuō: “Xúnzhǎo mìmì zǒngshì hěn nán de, dàn zhè jiùshì lǚxíng de lèqù.”
sentences.english: Mr. San smiled and said, "Searching for secrets is always difficult, but that is the joy of travel."

sentences.chinese: 这时，我看到那边有一个小房子。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, wǒ kàndào nàbiān yǒu yīgè xiǎo fángzi.
sentences.english: At that moment, I saw a small house over there.

sentences.chinese: 三先生说：“我们去那边看看吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng shuō: “Wǒmen qù nàbiān kànkan ba.”
sentences.english: Mr. San said, "Let's go over there and take a look."

sentences.chinese: 我们走到房子前，看到一个老人在门口等我们。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zǒu dào fángzi qián, kàndào yīgè lǎorén zài ménkǒu děng wǒmen.
sentences.english: We walked to the front of the house and saw an old man waiting for us at the doorway.

sentences.chinese: 老人看着我，显得很高兴，他对我点头微笑。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén kànzhe wǒ, xiǎnde hěn gāoxìng, tā duì wǒ diǎntóu wēixiào.
sentences.english: The old man looked at me and seemed very happy; he nodded and smiled at me.

sentences.chinese: 他指了指这儿，又指了指这边，像是在引导我们。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐle zhǐ zhèr, yòu zhǐle zhǐ zhèbiān, xiàng shì zài yǐndǎo wǒmen.
sentences.english: He pointed here and then pointed this way, as if he were guiding us.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你们在找那个秘密吗？它就在那儿。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐmen zài zhǎo nàge mìmì ma? Tā jiù zài nàr.”
sentences.english: He said, "Are you looking for that secret? It is right there."

sentences.chinese: 他指向远方的一个山谷，那里被云雾覆盖。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐxiàng yuǎnfāng de yīgè shāngǔ, nàlǐ bèi yúnwù fùgài.
sentences.english: He pointed toward a valley in the distance, which was covered in mist.

sentences.chinese: 我对着老人说：“谢谢您，再见！”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ duìzhe lǎorén shuō: “Xièxiè nín, zàijiàn!”
sentences.english: I said to the old man, "Thank you, goodbye!"

sentences.chinese: 我们向那儿走去，但突然，那个冷漠的陌生人再次出现在我们身后。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàng nàr zǒu qù, dàn tūrán, nàge lěngmò de mòshēng rén zàicì chūxiàn zài wǒmen shēnhòu.
sentences.english: We walked toward there, but suddenly, the cold stranger appeared behind us once again.

sentences.chinese: 他低声说：“你们还是没能逃掉。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dīshēng shuō: “Nǐmen háishì méinéng táodiào.”
sentences.english: He whispered, "You still haven't managed to escape."

chapters.title_chinese: 第十五章：山谷中的秘密

sentences.chinese: 那个陌生人的声音很冷，但我并不害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge mò shēng rén de shēng yīn hěn lěng, dàn wǒ bìng bù hài pà.
sentences.english: The stranger's voice was very cold, but I was not afraid.

sentences.chinese: 三先生快步走到我面前，看着那个陌生人。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kuài bù zǒu dào wǒ miàn qián, kàn zhe nà ge mò shēng rén.
sentences.english: Mr. San quickly stepped in front of me and looked at the stranger.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“我们是不是在找同一个东西？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ men shì bù shì zài zhǎo tóng yī gè dōng xi?”
sentences.english: He asked, "Are we looking for the same thing?"

sentences.chinese: 陌生人没有说话，只是指了指远方的山谷。
sentences.pinyin: Mò shēng rén méi yǒu shuō huà, zhǐ shì zhǐ le zhǐ yuǎn fāng de shān gǔ.
sentences.english: The stranger didn't speak, he just pointed toward the distant valley.

sentences.chinese: 那里的风景非常好看，云雾在山间流动。
sentences.pinyin: Nà lǐ de fēng jǐng fēi cháng hǎo kàn, yún wù zài shān jiān liú dòng.
sentences.english: The scenery there was very beautiful, with clouds and mist flowing between the mountains.

sentences.chinese: 我们走在山路上，突然下起了一场小雨。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men zǒu zài shān lù shàng, tū rán xià qǐ le yī chǎng xiǎo yǔ.
sentences.english: As we walked on the mountain road, a light rain suddenly began to fall.

sentences.chinese: 三先生说：“没事儿，这雨很快就会停。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng shuō: “Méi shì r, zhè yǔ hěn kuài jiù huì tíng.”
sentences.english: Mr. San said, "It's no problem, this rain will stop very quickly."

sentences.chinese: 走了一会儿，我们看到一个干净的小房子。
sentences.pinyin: Zǒu le yī huì r, wǒ men kàn dào yī gè gān jìng de xiǎo fáng zi.
sentences.english: After walking for a while, we saw a clean little house.

sentences.chinese: 房子里坐着一个年轻的女孩儿，她看起来像我的姐姐。
sentences.pinyin: Fáng zi lǐ zuò zhe yī gè nián qīng de nǚ hái r, tā kàn qǐ lái xiàng wǒ de jiě jie.
sentences.english: A young girl was sitting in the house; she looked like my older sister.

sentences.chinese: 她很认真地在看一本书，书里有很多知识。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hěn rèn zhēn de zài kàn yī běn shū, shū lǐ yǒu hěn duō zhī shi.
sentences.english: She was reading a book very seriously; there was a lot of knowledge in the book.

sentences.chinese: 她抬头看着我们，笑着说：“你们终于来了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā tái tóu kàn zhe wǒ men, xiào zhe shuō: “Nǐ men zhōng yú lái le.”
sentences.english: She looked up at us and said with a smile, "You all have finally arrived."

sentences.chinese: 她请我们坐下来，给我们准备了简单的晚餐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qǐng wǒ men zuò xià lái, gěi wǒ men zhǔn bèi le jiǎn dān de wǎn cān.
sentences.english: She invited us to sit down and prepared a simple dinner for us.

sentences.chinese: 晚餐有热腾腾的鸡蛋和面条儿。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎn cān yǒu rè téng téng de jī dàn hé miàn tiáo r.
sentences.english: The dinner had steaming hot eggs and noodles.

sentences.chinese: 我尝了一口，觉得真的很好吃。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ cháng le yī kǒu, jué de zhēn de hěn hǎo chī.
sentences.english: I took a bite and felt it was really delicious.

sentences.chinese: 三先生问她：“这里的秘密是不是很重要？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng wèn tā: “Zhè lǐ de mì mì shì bù shì hěn zhòng yào?”
sentences.english: Mr. San asked her, "Is the secret here very important?"

sentences.chinese: 女孩儿点头说：“是的，这个秘密非常重要。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ hái r diǎn tóu shuō: “Shì de, zhè ge mì mì fēi cháng zhòng yào.”
sentences.english: The girl nodded and said, "Yes, this secret is extremely important."

sentences.chinese: 她说这个秘密关于一个有名的古老家族。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō zhè ge mì mì guān yú yī gè yǒu míng de gǔ lǎo jiā zú.
sentences.english: She said the secret concerned a famous ancient family.

sentences.chinese: 那个家族的人认为知识比钱更贵。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge jiā zú de rén rèn wéi zhī shi bǐ qián gèng guì.
sentences.english: The people of that family believed that knowledge was more precious than money.

sentences.chinese: 我听了以后，终于明白了她的意思。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tīng le yǐ hòu, zhōng yú míng bai le tā de yì si.
sentences.english: After listening, I finally understood her meaning.

sentences.chinese: 这个地方太安静了，让人觉得真舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge dì fang tài ānjìng le, ràng rén jué de zhēn shū fu.
sentences.english: This place was too quiet, making one feel truly comfortable.

sentences.chinese: 陌生人也坐了下来，他的眼神不再那么冷。
sentences.pinyin: Mò shēng rén yě zuò le xià lái, tā de yǎn shén bù zài nà me lěng.
sentences.english: The stranger also sat down, and his gaze was no longer so cold.

sentences.chinese: 他看着我，轻声说：“你是一个好孩子。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe wǒ, qīng shēng shuō: “Nǐ shì yī gè hǎo hái zi.”
sentences.english: He looked at me and said softly, "You are a good child."

sentences.chinese: 我们在这里聊了很久，直到月亮升起来。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men zài zhè lǐ liáo le hěn jiǔ, zhí dào yuè liàng shēng qǐ lái.
sentences.english: We chatted here for a long time until the moon rose.

sentences.chinese: 最后，女孩儿拿出一把金色的钥匙。
sentences.pinyin: Zuì hòu, nǚ hái r ná chū yī bǎ jīn sè de yào shi.
sentences.english: Finally, the girl took out a golden key.

sentences.chinese: 她告诉我，真正的秘密就在山谷的尽头。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su wǒ, zhēn zhèng de mì mì jiù zài shān gǔ de jìn tóu.
sentences.english: She told me that the real secret was at the end of the valley.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，窗外突然传来了巨大的撞击声。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, chuāng wài tū rán chuán lái le jù dà de zhuàng jī shēng.
sentences.english: But just then, a huge crashing sound suddenly came from outside the window.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十六章：山谷中的老房子
chapters.title_english: Chapter 16: The Old House in the Valley

sentences.chinese: 巨大的撞击声让我们地惊跳了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Jù dà de zhuàng jī shēng ràng wǒ men dì jīng tiào le qǐ lái.
sentences.english: The huge crashing sound made us jump up in shock.

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着窗外，低声说：“没什么，可能只是风。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kàn zhe chuāng wài, dī shēng shuō: “méi shén me, kě néng zhǐ shì fēng.”
sentences.english: Mr. San looked out the window and said softly, "It's nothing, it might just be the wind."

sentences.chinese: 但我看到窗外有一个老人，他正看着我们。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ kàn dào chuāng wài yǒu yī gè lǎo rén, tā zhèng kàn zhe wǒ men.
sentences.english: But I saw an old man outside the window, and he was looking at us.

sentences.chinese: 那个老人穿着一件旧衣服，手里拿着一块面包。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè lǎo rén chuān zhe yī jiàn jiù yī fú, shǒu lǐ ná zhe yī kuài miàn bāo.
sentences.english: That old man was wearing old clothes and holding a piece of bread in his hand.

sentences.chinese: 他张开口，对着我们大喊：“快进来！这里不安全！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhāng kāi kǒu, duì zhe wǒ men dà hǎn: “kuài jìn lái! zhè lǐ bù ān quán!”
sentences.english: He opened his mouth and shouted at us, "Come in quickly! It is not safe here!"

sentences.chinese: 我们跟在他后面，走进了一个奇怪的房子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men gēn zài tā hòu miàn, zǒu jìn le yī gè qí guài de fáng zi.
sentences.english: We followed behind him and walked into a strange house.

sentences.chinese: 这房子很小，但里面很温暖。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fáng zi hěn xiǎo, dàn lǐ miàn hěn wēn nuǎn.
sentences.english: This house was very small, but it was very warm inside.

sentences.chinese: 房子里有爷爷和奶奶，还有她们的家人。
sentences.pinyin: Fáng zi lǐ yǒu yé ye hé nǎi nai, hái yǒu tā men de jiā rén.
sentences.english: In the house were a grandfather and a grandmother, and their family members.

sentences.chinese: 奶奶给我们每人一杯热茶，爷爷笑着说：“欢迎来到山谷。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎi nai gěi wǒ men měi rén yī bēi rè chá, yé ye xiào zhe shuō: “huān yíng lái dào shān gǔ.”
sentences.english: Grandmother gave each of us a cup of hot tea, and Grandfather smiled and said, "Welcome to the valley."

sentences.chinese: 三先生问：“我们在这里住多久呢？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng wèn: “wǒ men zài zhè lǐ zhù duō jiǔ ne?”
sentences.english: Mr. San asked, "How long will we stay here?"

sentences.chinese: 爷爷说：“你们可以住到后天，然后去机场离开。”
sentences.pinyin: Yé ye shuō: “nǐ men kě yǐ zhù dào hòu tiān, rán hòu qù jī chǎng lí kāi.”
sentences.english: Grandfather said, "You can stay until the day after tomorrow, and then go to the airport to leave."

sentences.chinese: 我看着这个家，觉得这里像是在家一样舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe zhè gè jiā, jué de zhè lǐ xiàng shì zài jiā yī yàng shū fú.
sentences.english: I looked at this home and felt that it was as comfortable as being at home.

sentences.chinese: 三先生对我说：“这里的生活和城市差很多。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng duì wǒ shuō: “zhè lǐ de shēng huó hé chéng shì chā hěn duō.”
sentences.english: Mr. San said to me, "Life here is very different from the city."

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个年轻的哥哥走过来，他是这里的第零号向导。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yī gè nián qīng de gē ge zǒu guò lái, tā shì zhè lǐ de dì líng hào xiàng dǎo.
sentences.english: At this moment, a young elder brother walked over; he was the zero-number guide here.

sentences.chinese: 老哥告诉我，金色的钥匙可以打开山谷的门。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo gē gào sù wǒ, jīn sè de yào shi kě yǐ dǎ kāi shān gǔ de mén.
sentences.english: Old Brother told me that the golden key could open the gate of the valley.

sentences.chinese: 我问他：“那个冷漠的陌生人会来这里吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “nà gè lěng mò de mò shēng rén huì lái zhè lǐ ma?”
sentences.english: I asked him, "Will that cold stranger come here?"

sentences.chinese: 他地平静地回答：“不用担心，他进不来。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dì píng jìng dì huí dá: “bù yòng dān xīn, tā jìn bù lái.”
sentences.english: He answered calmly, "No need to worry, he cannot get in."

sentences.chinese: 我看着窗外，想起之前的旅程，心中感到很平静。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe chuāng wài, xiǎng qǐ zhī qián de lǚ chéng, xīn zhōng gǎn dào hěn píng jìng.
sentences.english: I looked out the window, thought of the previous journey, and felt very peaceful in my heart.

sentences.chinese: 但突然，我听到房子外面传来了“吧”的一声巨响。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tū rán, wǒ tīng dào fáng zi wài miàn chuán lái le “bā” de yī shēng jù xiǎng.
sentences.english: But suddenly, I heard a loud "bang" from outside the house.

sentences.chinese: 门被撞开了，那个冷漠的陌生人站在门口。
sentences.pinyin: Mén bèi zhuàng kāi le, nà gè lěng mò de mò shēng rén zhàn zài mén kǒu.
sentences.english: The door was crashed open, and that cold stranger was standing in the doorway.

sentences.chinese: 他看着金色的钥匙，眼神变得非常可怕。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe jīn sè de yào shi, yǎn shén biàn de fēi cháng kě pà.
sentences.english: He looked at the golden key, and his gaze became very terrifying.

sentences.chinese: 他低声说：“钥匙现在必须给我。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dī shēng shuō: “yào shi xiàn zài bì xū gěi wǒ.”
sentences.english: He said in a low voice, "The key must be given to me now."

sentences.chinese: 我们看向彼此，我知道，真正的挑战才刚刚开始。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men kàn xiàng bǐ cǐ, wǒ zhī dào, zhēn zhèng de tiǎo zhàn cái gāng gāng kāi shǐ.
sentences.english: We looked at each other, and I knew that the real challenge had just begun.

sentences.chinese: 陌生人走进了房间，他的动作很快，像一只黑色的鸟。
sentences.pinyin: Mò shēng rén zǒu jìn le fáng jiān, tā de dòng zuò hěn kuài, xiàng yī zhī hēi sè de niǎo.
sentences.english: The stranger entered the room; his movements were fast, like a black bird.

sentences.chinese: 三先生赶紧把金色的钥匙关在口袋里，然后告诉我们：“快走！”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng gǎn jǐn bǎ jīn sè de yào shi guān zài kǒu dài lǐ, rán hòu gào sù wǒ men: “Kuài zǒu!”
sentences.english: Mr. San quickly closed the golden key in his pocket and then told us: "Go quickly!"

sentences.chinese: 我们不能在这里休息，必须马上离开这个可怕的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men bù néng zài zhè lǐ xiū xi, bì xū mǎ shàng lí kāi zhè ge kě pà de dì fang.
sentences.english: We couldn't rest here; we had to leave this terrifying place immediately.

sentences.chinese: 陌生人看着我，冷冷地说：“你们想去哪里？这里没有人会帮你们。”
sentences.pinyin: Mò shēng rén kàn zhe wǒ, lěng lěng de shuō: “Nǐ men xiǎng qù nǎ lǐ? Zhè lǐ méi yǒu rén huì bāng nǐ men.”
sentences.english: The stranger looked at me and said coldly: "Where do you want to go? No one here will help you."

sentences.chinese: 他想把我们分开放，这样他更容易拿到钥匙。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng bǎ wǒ men fēn fàng, zhè yàng tā gèng róng yì ná dào yào shi.
sentences.english: He wanted to separate us, so it would be easier for him to get the key.

sentences.chinese: 三先生突然大喊一声，把陌生人的注意力吸引了过去。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng tū rán dà hǎn yī shēng, bǎ mò shēng rén de zhù yì lì xī yǐn le guò qù.
sentences.english: Mr. San suddenly let out a loud shout, drawing the stranger's attention away.

sentences.chinese: 趁这个机会，我们赶紧跑出房子，跑到了外面的小路上。
sentences.pinyin: Chèn zhè ge jī huì, wǒ men gǎn jǐn pǎo chū fáng zi, pǎo dào le wài miàn de xiǎo lù shàng.
sentences.english: Taking this opportunity, we quickly ran out of the house and onto the small road outside.

sentences.chinese: 我们看到远处有一辆旧汽车，三先生说：“快上车！”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men kàn dào yuǎn chù yǒu yī liàng jiù qì chē, Sān xiān sheng shuō: “Kuài shàng chē!”
sentences.english: We saw an old car in the distance; Mr. San said: "Get in the car quickly!"

sentences.chinese: 我们迅速上车，三先生发动了引擎，汽车终于动了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men xùn sù shàng chē, Sān xiān sheng fā dòng le yǐn qíng, qì chē zhōng yú dòng le qǐ lái.
sentences.english: We quickly got in the car, Mr. San started the engine, and the car finally began to move.

sentences.chinese: 在车里，我问三先生，那个陌生人到底在做什么工作。
sentences.pinyin: Zài chē lǐ, wǒ wèn Sān xiān sheng, nà ge mò shēng rén dào dǐ zài zuò shén me gōng zuò.
sentences.english: In the car, I asked Mr. San what kind of work that stranger actually did.

sentences.chinese: 三先生叹了一口气，向我介绍这个人的身份。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng tàn le yī kǒu qì, xiàng wǒ jiè shào zhè ge rén de shēn fèn.
sentences.english: Mr. San sighed and introduced the man's identity to me.

sentences.chinese: 他说，那个陌生人以前在学院上班，负责管理所有的秘密钥匙。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, nà ge mò shēng rén yǐ qián zài xué yuàn shàng bān, fù zé guǎn lǐ suǒ yǒu de mì mì yào shi.
sentences.english: He said the stranger used to work at the academy, responsible for managing all the secret keys.

sentences.chinese: 他每天早早上班，等到晚上下班后，才会偷偷寻找丢失的宝藏。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎo zǎo shàng bān, děng dào wǎn shàng xià bān hòu, cái huì tōu tōu xún zhǎo diū shī de bǎo zàng.
sentences.english: He would go to work early every day, and only after finishing work in the evening would he secretly search for lost treasures.

sentences.chinese: 三先生说，那个男人不喜欢任何人，他只喜欢权力。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng shuō, nà ge nán rén bù xǐ huan rèn hé rén, tā zhǐ xǐ huan quán lì.
sentences.english: Mr. San said the man didn't like anyone; he only liked power.

sentences.chinese: 我想上网查查这个人的名字，但这里没有信号，我没法上网。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng shàng wǎng chá chá zhè ge rén de míng zi, dàn zhè lǐ méi yǒu xìn hào, wǒ méi fǎ shàng wǎng.
sentences.english: I wanted to go online to check the man's name, but there was no signal here; I couldn't get online.

sentences.chinese: 我们开了一会儿车，到了一个安静的小村庄。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men kāi le yī huì r chē, dào le yī gè ā jìng de xiǎo cūn zhuāng.
sentences.english: We drove for a while and arrived at a quiet little village.

sentences.chinese: 三先生说，我们可以在这里住一个晚上，准备明天的计划。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng shuō, wǒ men kě yǐ zài zhè lǐ zhù yī gè wǎn shàng, zhǔn bèi míng tiān de jì huà.
sentences.english: Mr. San said we could stay here for one night to prepare for tomorrow's plan.

sentences.chinese: 他带我们去一家小店吃饭，我们买了热腾腾的面条儿吃。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dài wǒ men qù yī jiā xiǎo diàn chī fàn, wǒ men mǎi le rè téng téng de miàn tiáo r chī.
sentences.english: He took us to a small shop to have a meal; we bought steaming hot noodles to eat.

sentences.chinese: 吃完饭，三先生说：“我们需要休息，明天一早我们就回去。”
sentences.pinyin: Chī wán fàn, Sān xiān sheng shuō: “Wǒ men xū yào xiū xi, míng tiān yī zǎo wǒ men jiù huí qu.”
sentences.english: After eating, Mr. San said: "We need to rest; we will go back early tomorrow morning."

sentences.chinese: 我问他：“回去哪里？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Huí qu nǎ lǐ?”
sentences.english: I asked him: "Go back where?"

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着远方，低声说：“回到那个地图的起点，把钥匙还给它。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kàn zhe yuǎn fāng, dī shēng shuō: “Huí dào nà ge dì tú de qǐ diǎn, bǎ yào shi huán gěi tā.”
sentences.english: Mr. San looked into the distance and said softly: "Return to the starting point of the map and return the key to it."

sentences.chinese: 就在我们准备下车的时候，我突然看到路边停着一辆黑色的车。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài wǒ men zhǔn bèi xià chē de shí hou, wǒ tū rán kàn dào lù biān tíng zhe yī liàng hēi sè de chē.
sentences.english: Just as we were preparing to get out of the car, I suddenly saw a black car parked by the road.

sentences.chinese: 那个陌生人竟然跟来了，他已经到了村口。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge mò shēng rén jìng rán gēn lái le, tā yǐ jīng dào le cūn kǒu.
sentences.english: The stranger had actually followed us; he had already reached the village entrance.

sentences.chinese: 三先生紧张地告诉我：“千万不要让他发现我们回来了。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng jǐn zhāng de gào sù wǒ: “Qiān wàn bù yào ràng tā fā xiàn wǒ men huí lái le.”
sentences.english: Mr. San nervously told me: "Whatever you do, don't let him discover that we have come back."

sentences.chinese: 我们赶紧关上车窗，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men gǎn jǐn guān shàng chē chuāng, xīn tiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: We quickly closed the car windows, our hearts beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 这时，我发现车后座有一个奇怪的小盒子，那是谁留在那里的？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, wǒ fā xiàn chē hòu zuò yǒu yī gè qí guài de xiǎo hé zi, nà shì shuí liú zài nà lǐ de?
sentences.english: At that moment, I noticed a strange small box on the back seat; who left it there?

sentences.chinese: 我慢慢地把盒子拿出来，发现里面有一张旧照片。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ màn màn de bǎ hé zi ná chū lái, fā xiàn lǐ miàn yǒu yī zhāng jiù zhào piàn.
sentences.english: I slowly brought the box out and found an old photograph inside.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十八章：照片中的秘密
chapters.title_english: Chapter 18: The Secret in the Photograph

sentences.chinese: 我拿着照片，手在抖。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ ná zhe zhàopiàn, shǒu zài dǒu.
sentences.english: I held the photo, and my hand was shaking.

sentences.chinese: 照片里有一个人在一棵大树下面。
sentences.pinyin: Zhàopiàn lǐ yǒu yī gè rén zài yī kē dà shù xiàmiàn.
sentences.english: There was a person under a big tree in the photo.

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着照片，想起了很多事情。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng kàn zhe zhàopiàn, xiǎng qǐ le hěn duō shìqíng.
sentences.english: Mr. San looked at the photo and remembered many things.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“这是我的一个好朋友，他的爱好是洗照片。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zhè shì wǒ de yī gè hǎo péngyǒu, tā de àihào shì xǐ zhàopiàn.”
sentences.english: He said, "This is a good friend of mine; his hobby is developing photos."

sentences.chinese: 我问他：“这个人的工作是什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Zhè gè rén de gōngzuò shì shénme?”
sentences.english: I asked him, "What is this person's job?"

sentences.chinese: 三先生没有马上回答，他看着窗外。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng méiyǒu mǎshàng huídá, tā kàn zhe chuāngwài.
sentences.english: Mr. San did not answer immediately; he looked out the window.

sentences.chinese: 那个陌生人还在村口，他正在找我们。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè mòshēng rén hái zài cūn kǒu, tā zhèngzài zhǎo wǒmen.
sentences.english: That stranger was still at the village entrance, looking for us.

sentences.chinese: 三先生低声说：“对不起，我忘了告诉你，他以前是个警察。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng dī shēng shuō: “Duìbuqǐ, wǒ wàng le gàosù nǐ, tā yǐqián shì gè jǐngchá.”
sentences.english: Mr. San whispered, "I'm sorry, I forgot to tell you, he used to be a policeman."

sentences.chinese: 我们现在很忙，必须快点离开这里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiànzài hěn máng, bìxū kuài diǎn líkāi zhèlǐ.
sentences.english: We are very busy now and must leave this place quickly.

sentences.chinese: 我问三先生：“我们要打车走吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn Sān xiānshēng: “Wǒmen yào dǎchē zǒu ma?”
sentences.english: I asked Mr. San, "Should we take a taxi to leave?"

sentences.chinese: 三先生笑了，说：“他在开玩笑，他其实并不想抓我们。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng xiào le, shuō: “Tā zài kāi wánxiào, tā qíshí bìng bù xiǎng zhuā wǒmen.”
sentences.english: Mr. San smiled and said, "He is joking; he doesn't actually want to catch us."

sentences.chinese: 但我不想冒险，我赶紧打开那个小盒子。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ bù xiǎng màoxiǎn, wǒ gǎnjǐn dǎkāi nà gè xiǎo hézi.
sentences.english: But I didn't want to take a risk, so I quickly opened the small box.

sentences.chinese: 盒子里有一张纸，上面写着一个时间。
sentences.pinyin: Hézi lǐ yǒu yī zhāng zhǐ, shàngmiàn xiě zhe yī gè shíjiān.
sentences.english: There was a piece of paper in the box with a time written on it.

sentences.chinese: 三先生说：“看来他要在这里开会，我们得在他来之前离开。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng shuō: “Kàn lái tā yào zài zhèlǐ kāihuì, wǒmen děi zài tā lái zhīqián líkāi.”
sentences.english: Mr. San said, "It seems he is going to hold a meeting here; we must leave before he arrives."

sentences.chinese: 我发现照片背面写着：‘我爱这个地方’。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ fāxiàn zhàopiàn bèimiàn xiě zhe: ‘Wǒ ài zhège dìfāng’.
sentences.english: I noticed on the back of the photo it said: 'I love this place'.

sentences.chinese: 这里的天气很热，我感觉很不舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de tiānqì hěn rè, wǒ gǎnjué hěn bù shūfu.
sentences.english: The weather here is very hot, and I feel very uncomfortable.

sentences.chinese: 三先生说：“如果你能帮忙，我们可以更快地得到答案。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ néng bāngmáng, wǒmen kěyǐ gèng kuài de dédào dá'àn.”
sentences.english: Mr. San said, "If you can help, we can get the answer faster."

sentences.chinese: 他让我把照片放在一个秘密的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ràng wǒ bǎ zhàopiàn fàng zài yī gè mìmì de dìfāng.
sentences.english: He asked me to put the photo in a secret place.

sentences.chinese: 我想，如果现在能放假，我就不用担心这些奇怪的人了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng, rúguǒ xiànzài néng fàngjià, wǒ jiù bùyòng dānxīn zhèxiē qíguài de rén le.
sentences.english: I thought that if I could have a holiday now, I wouldn't have to worry about these strange people.

sentences.chinese: 我记得在之前的学院里，有人在打球，那时候的生活很简单。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jìdé zài zhīqián de xuéyuàn lǐ, yǒurén zài dǎqiú, nà shíhou de shēnghuó hěn jiǎndān.
sentences.english: I remember in the previous academy, some people were playing ball; life was very simple then.

sentences.chinese: 我们慢慢来到村子的后门。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen mànman láidào cūnzi de hòumén.
sentences.english: We slowly arrived at the back door of the village.

sentences.chinese: 三先生开起车，快速地离开了村庄。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiānshēng kāi qǐ chē, kuàisù de líkāi le cūnzhuāng.
sentences.english: Mr. San started the car and quickly left the village.

sentences.chinese: 我们终于逃离了那个陌生人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zhōngyú táolí le nà gè mòshēng rén.
sentences.english: We finally escaped from that stranger.

sentences.chinese: 但三先生突然停了下来，他看着前方，脸色很苍白。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn Sān xiānshēng tūrán tíng le xiàlái, tā kàn zhe qiánfāng, liǎnsè hěn cāngbái.
sentences.english: But Mr. San suddenly stopped; he looked ahead, his face very pale.

sentences.chinese: 他轻声说：“你看，那里有什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā qīngshēng shuō: “Nǐ kàn, nàlǐ yǒu shénme?”
sentences.english: He whispered, "Look, what is over there?"

sentences.chinese: 我看向前方，发现地图上的最后一个标记就在那里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn xiàng qiánfāng, fāxiàn dìtú shàng de zuìhòu yī gè biāojì jiù zài nàlǐ.
sentences.english: I looked ahead and found that the last mark on the map was right there.

sentences.chinese: 但标记的旁边，站着一个我们从未见过的人。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn biāojì de pángbiān, zhàn zhe yī gè wǒmen cóngwèi jiànguò de rén.
sentences.english: But beside the mark stood a person we had never seen before.

sentences.chinese: 那个人静静地站在那里。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge rén jìng jìng de zhàn zài nà lǐ.
sentences.english: That person stood there quietly.

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着他，突然觉得很累。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kàn zhe tā, tū rán jué de hěn lèi.
sentences.english: Mr. San looked at him and suddenly felt very tired.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“我们走吧，我们走路去见他。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ men zǒu ba, wǒ men zǒu lù qù jiàn tā.”
sentences.english: He said, "Let's go, let's walk to meet him."

sentences.chinese: 我看见那个人穿着一件旧衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn jiàn nà ge rén chuān zhe yī jiàn jiù yī fu.
sentences.english: I saw that the person was wearing old clothes.

sentences.chinese: 他看着我们，没有说话。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe wǒ men, méi yǒu shuō huà.
sentences.english: He looked at us without speaking.

sentences.chinese: 三先生请他说话，但那个人只是笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng qǐng tā shuō huà, dàn nà ge rén zhǐ shì xiào le.
sentences.english: Mr. San asked him to speak, but the person only smiled.

sentences.chinese: 我突然知道他是谁了，他就是照片里的人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tū rán zhī dào tā shì shuí le, tā jiù shì zhào piàn lǐ de rén.
sentences.english: I suddenly knew who he was; he was the person in the photo.

sentences.chinese: 我们终于见面了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men zhōng yú jiàn miàn le.
sentences.english: We finally met face-to-face.

sentences.chinese: 三先生问他：“你认识我们吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng wèn tā: “Nǐ rèn shi wǒ men ma?”
sentences.english: Mr. San asked him, "Do you know us?"

sentences.chinese: 那个人点头说：“我认识你们，我一直在等你们。”
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge rén diǎn tóu shuō: “Wǒ rèn shi nǐ men, wǒ yī zhí zài děng nǐ men.”
sentences.english: The person nodded and said, "I know you; I have been waiting for you."

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我们，这个地方是一个特殊的站。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su wǒ men, zhè ge dì fang shì yī gè tè shū de zhàn.
sentences.english: He told us that this place is a special station.

sentences.chinese: 在这里，人们不用考试，只需要用心地生活。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè lǐ, rén men bù yòng kǎo shì, zhǐ xū yào yòng xīn de shēng huó.
sentences.english: Here, people don't have to take exams; they only need to live with heart.

sentences.chinese: 他说，很多人在这里玩儿，忘记了回家的路。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, hěn duō rén zài zhè lǐ wán r, wàng jì le huí jiā de lù.
sentences.english: He said many people hang out here and forget the way home.

sentences.chinese: 有些人生病了，他们在这里看病，慢慢好起来。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu xiē rén shēng bìng le, tā men zài zhè lǐ kàn bìng, màn màn hǎo qǐ lái.
sentences.english: Some people fell ill; they see a doctor here and slowly get better.

sentences.chinese: 他照顾他们，看他们睡觉，直到他们醒来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhào gù tā men, kàn tā men shuì jiào, zhí dào tā men xǐng lái.
sentences.english: He looks after them, watches them sleep, until they wake up.

sentences.chinese: 我问他：“为什么你要在这里等我们？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Wèi shén me nǐ yào zài zhè lǐ děng wǒ men?”
sentences.english: I asked him, "Why did you want to wait for us here?"

sentences.chinese: 他轻声说：“因为你们必须记住地图上的秘密。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā qīng shēng shuō: “Yīn wèi nǐ men bì xū jì zhù dì tú shàng de mì mì.”
sentences.english: He said softly, "Because you must remember the secret on the map."

sentences.chinese: 我试着想，但我想不起来。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shì zhe xiǎng, dàn wǒ xiǎng bù qǐ lái.
sentences.english: I tried to think, but I couldn't remember.

sentences.chinese: 三先生有些生气，因为他觉得我们走太久了。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng yǒu xiē shēng qì, yīn wèi tā jué de wǒ men zǒu tài jiǔ le.
sentences.english: Mr. San was a bit angry because he felt we had been walking for too long.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“我不想在这里睡觉，我要回家。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ bù xiǎng zài zhè lǐ shuì jiào, wǒ yào huí jiā.”
sentences.english: He said, "I don't want to sleep here; I want to go home."

sentences.chinese: 那个人说：“回家之前，你们要先考一个简单的考题。”
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge rén shuō: “Huí jiā zhī qián, nǐ men yào xiān kǎo yī gè jiǎn dān de kǎo tí.”
sentences.english: The person said, "Before going home, you must first answer a simple test question."

sentences.chinese: 这是一个关于记忆的考试。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yī gè guān yú jì yì de kǎo shì.
sentences.english: This was an exam about memory.

sentences.chinese: 他让我们记下这里的风景，然后记住那个金色的钥匙。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ràng wǒ men jì xià zhè lǐ de fēng jǐng, rán hòu jì zhù nà ge jīn sè de yào shi.
sentences.english: He asked us to record the scenery here and then remember that golden key.

sentences.chinese: 我闭上眼睛，在心里记录这一切。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bì shàng yǎn jing, zài xīn lǐ jì lù zhè yī qiè.
sentences.english: I closed my eyes and recorded everything in my heart.

sentences.chinese: 现在，我们准备离开这个奇怪的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài, wǒ men zhǔn bèi lí kāi zhè ge qí guài de dì fang.
sentences.english: Now, we are preparing to leave this strange place.

sentences.chinese: 但就在我们走的时候，那个人突然叫住了我。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài wǒ men zǒu de shí hou, nà ge rén tū rán jiào zhù le wǒ.
sentences.english: But just as we were leaving, the person suddenly called out to me.

sentences.english: I did not answer him.

sentences.chinese: 我问他：“你要什么帮忙？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Nǐ yào shénme bāngmáng?”
sentences.english: I asked him, "What help do you need?"

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，他知道我过去在学校的事情。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, tā zhīdào wǒ guòqù zài xuéxiào de shìqíng.
sentences.english: He told me that he knew about my past at school.

sentences.chinese: 他说，记得你上学的时候吗？
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, jìde nǐ shàngxué de shíhou ma?
sentences.english: He said, "Do you remember when you went to school?"

sentences.chinese: 记得你上课的时候，在笔记本上写的东西吗？
sentences.pinyin: Jìde nǐ shàngkè de shíhou, zài bǐjìběn shàng xiě de dōngxi ma?
sentences.english: "Remember the things you wrote in your notebook when you attended class?"

sentences.chinese: 他突然唱起了一首歌，声音很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán chàng qǐ le yī shǒu gē, shēngyīn hěn qíguài.
sentences.english: He suddenly started to sing a song, his voice very strange.

sentences.chinese: 我感到很害怕，我想要出去。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gǎndào hěn hàipà, wǒ xiǎngyào chūqù.
sentences.english: I felt very afraid; I wanted to go out.

sentences.chinese: 但我发现门被锁住了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ fāxiàn mén bèi suǒ zhù le.
sentences.english: But I discovered the door was locked.

sentences.chinese: 我必须买一个机会逃走，但我现在没有任何东西。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bìxū mǎi yī gè jīhuì táozǒu, dàn wǒ xiànzài méiyǒu rènhé dōngxi.
sentences.english: I must buy a chance to escape, but I have nothing right now.

sentences.chinese: 他对我笑了，他说：“现在，游戏开始了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì wǒ xiào le, tā shuō: “Xiànzài, yóuxì kāishǐ le.”
sentences.english: He smiled at me and said, "Now, the game begins."

sentences.chinese: 那个男人还在唱他的歌。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge nán rén hái zài chàng tā de gē.
sentences.english: That man was still singing his song.

sentences.chinese: 他的声音很冷，但房间里很热。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shēng yīn hěn lěng, dàn fáng jiān lǐ hěn rè.
sentences.english: His voice was cold, but the room was hot.

sentences.chinese: 他看着我，像在看一个病。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe wǒ, xiàng zài kàn yī gè bìng.
sentences.english: He looked at me as if he were looking at a disease.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“我知道你认识我。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ zhī dào nǐ rèn shi wǒ.”
sentences.english: He said, "I know you recognize me."

sentences.chinese: 我不认识他，但我很害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bù rèn shi tā, dàn wǒ hěn hài pà.
sentences.english: I didn't recognize him, but I was very afraid.

sentences.chinese: 他穿一件黑色的衣服，站在门那里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chuān yī jiàn hēi sè de yī fu, zhàn zài mén nà lǐ.
sentences.english: He wore black clothes and stood there by the door.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你想玩儿吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ xiǎng wán r ma?”
sentences.english: He said, "Do you want to play?"

sentences.chinese: 他拿出一个球，开始在房间里打球。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū yī gè qiú, kāi shǐ zài fáng jiān lǐ dǎ qiú.
sentences.english: He took out a ball and started playing ball in the room.

sentences.chinese: 球在墙上撞，声音很大。
sentences.pinyin: Qiú zài qiáng shàng zhuàng, shēng yīn hěn dà.
sentences.english: The ball hit the wall, and the sound was very loud.

sentences.chinese: 他突然生气了，大声说：“你为什么不说话？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā tū rán shēng qì le, dà shēng shuō: “Nǐ wèi shén me bù shuō huà?”
sentences.english: Suddenly he got angry and shouted, "Why aren't you speaking?"

sentences.chinese: 他走过来，要把我的手机拿走。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu guò lái, yào bǎ wǒ de shǒu jī ná zǒu.
sentences.english: He walked over and wanted to take my phone away.

sentences.chinese: 我用手挡住，但我不能赢他。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yòng shǒu dǎng zhù, dàn wǒ bù néng yíng tā.
sentences.english: I used my hand to block him, but I couldn't beat him.

sentences.chinese: 他把我的手机放在桌子上，然后打开了它。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ wǒ de shǒu jī fàng zài zhuō zi shàng, rán hòu dǎ kāi le tā.
sentences.english: He put my phone on the table and then opened it.

sentences.chinese: 他看着我的照片，笑着说：“你有很多朋友。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe wǒ de zhào piàn, xiào zhe shuō: “Nǐ yǒu hěn duō péng you.”
sentences.english: He looked at my photos and said with a smile, "You have many friends."

sentences.chinese: 他说，他想给我的朋友打电话。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, tā xiǎng gěi wǒ de péng you dǎ diàn huà.
sentences.english: He said he wanted to make a phone call to my friends.

sentences.chinese: 我大声说：“请不要这样做！”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dà shēng shuō: “Qǐng bù yào zhè yàng zuò!”
sentences.english: I shouted, "Please don't do that!"

sentences.chinese: 他说：“如果你想见你的朋友，你必须通过我的考试。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Rú guǒ nǐ xiǎng jiàn nǐ de péng you, nǐ bì xū tōng guò wǒ de kǎo shì.”
sentences.english: He said, "If you want to see your friends, you must pass my exam."

sentences.chinese: 他说这个考试很简单，只要我能找出一个东西。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō zhè ge kǎo shì hěn jiǎn dān, zhǐ yào wǒ néng zhǎo chū yī gè dōng xi.
sentences.english: He said this exam was very simple, as long as I could find one thing.

sentences.chinese: 他让我找一个钥匙。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ràng wǒ zhǎo yī gè yào shi.
sentences.english: He told me to find a key.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你最好快一点。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ zuì hǎo kuài yī diǎn.”
sentences.english: He said, "You had better be quick."

sentences.chinese: 我开始在房间里找，我看见了一棵小树。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kāi shǐ zài fáng jiān lǐ zhǎo, wǒ kàn jiàn le yī kē xiǎo shù.
sentences.english: I started looking in the room, and I saw a small tree.

sentences.chinese: 树在花盆里，在窗户旁边。
sentences.pinyin: Shù zài huā pén lǐ, zài chuāng hu páng biān.
sentences.english: The tree was in a flower pot, next to the window.

sentences.chinese: 我走到树那里，在土里看见了钥匙。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ lái dào shù nà lǐ, zài tǔ lǐ kàn jiàn le yào shi.
sentences.english: I arrived at the tree and saw the key in the soil.

sentences.chinese: 我拿到了钥匙，我想要快点离开这里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ ná dào le yào shi, wǒ xiǎng yào kuài diǎn lí kāi zhè lǐ.
sentences.english: I got the key; I wanted to leave this place quickly.

sentences.chinese: 我想去车站，然后打车回家。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù chē zhàn, rán hòu dǎ chē huí jiā.
sentences.english: I wanted to go to the station and then take a taxi home.

sentences.chinese: 我想去医院看病，因为我的心跳太快了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù yī yuàn kàn bìng, yīn wèi wǒ de xīn tiào tài kuài le.
sentences.english: I wanted to go to the hospital to see a doctor because my heart was beating too fast.

sentences.chinese: 我打开门，跑了出去。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dǎ kāi mén, pǎo le chū qù.
sentences.english: I opened the door and ran out.

sentences.chinese: 但我突然看见，门外站着另外两个人。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ tū rán kàn jiàn, mén wài zhàn zhe lìng wài liǎng gè rén.
sentences.english: But suddenly I saw two other people standing outside the door.

sentences.chinese: 我看着他们，我的心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe tāmen, wǒ de xīntiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: I looked at them, my heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 他们是谁？
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen shì shéi?
sentences.english: Who are they?

sentences.chinese: 一个男人说话了，他的声音很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè nánrén shuō huà le, tā de shēngyīn hěn lěng.
sentences.english: A man spoke, his voice was very cold.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“请你走过来。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Qǐng nǐ zǒu guòlái.”
sentences.english: He said, "Please come over here."

sentences.chinese: 我不想走，我想跑。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng zǒu, wǒ xiǎng pǎo.
sentences.english: I didn't want to go; I wanted to run.

sentences.chinese: 我试着往后走，但我不能走远。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shìzhe wǎng hòu zǒu, dàn wǒ bùnéng zǒu yuǎn.
sentences.english: I tried to move backward, but I couldn't go far.

sentences.chinese: 这两个人看起来很危险。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng gè rén kàn qǐlái hěn wēixiǎn.
sentences.english: These two people looked very dangerous.

sentences.chinese: 一个人的名字叫包，另一个人叫冷。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè rén de míngzì jiào Bāo, lìng yī gè rén jiào Lěng.
sentences.english: One person's name was Bao, and the other was Leng.

sentences.chinese: 他们看着我，一点也不高兴。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen kànzhe wǒ, yīdiǎn yě bù gāoxìng.
sentences.english: They looked at me, not happy at all.

sentences.chinese: 我想问他们：“你们想要什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng wèn tāmen: “Nǐmen xiǎng yào shénme?”
sentences.english: I wanted to ask them, "What do you want?"

sentences.chinese: 但我的嘴不能说话。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ de zuǐ bùnéng shuō huà.
sentences.english: But my mouth could not speak.

sentences.chinese: 我记得我在书上读书的时候，看过这种危险的情况。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jìde wǒ zài shū shàng dú shū de shíhòu, kànguò zhè zhǒng wēixiǎn de qíngkuàng.
sentences.english: I remember when I was reading books, I had seen this kind of dangerous situation.

sentences.chinese: 我必须记住那个秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bìxū jì zhù nàgè mìmì.
sentences.english: I must remember that secret.

sentences.chinese: 我记在我的心里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jì zài wǒ de xīnlǐ.
sentences.english: I recorded it in my heart.

sentences.chinese: 他们对我大声说：“走！快走！”
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen duì wǒ dà shēng shuō: “Zǒu! Kuài zǒu!”
sentences.english: They shouted at me, "Go! Move fast!"

sentences.chinese: 我开始快速地走路。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kāishǐ kuàisù de zǒulù.
sentences.english: I started walking quickly.

sentences.chinese: 我走在黑色的街道上。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǒu zài hēisè de jiēdào shàng.
sentences.english: I walked on the black streets.

sentences.chinese: 这里很冷，我感觉很饿，但我不敢停下来。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ hěn lěng, wǒ gǎnjué hěn è, dàn wǒ bù gǎn tíng xiàlái.
sentences.english: It was very cold here, I felt very hungry, but I didn't dare to stop.

sentences.chinese: 我想知道他们要去哪里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zhīdào tāmen yào qù nǎlǐ.
sentences.english: I wanted to know where they were going.

sentences.chinese: 他们说：“我们要去见水先生。”
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen shuō: “Wǒmen yào qù jiàn Shuǐ xiānsheng.”
sentences.english: They said, "We are going to see Mr. Shui."

sentences.chinese: 水先生是谁？
sentences.pinyin: Shuǐ xiānsheng shì shéi?
sentences.english: Who is Mr. Shui?

sentences.chinese: 他们说：“我们要一块儿去。”
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen shuō: “Wǒmen yào yīkuàir qù.”
sentences.english: They said, "We are going together."

sentences.chinese: 我问他们：“我能回家吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tāmen: “Wǒ néng huí jiā ma?”
sentences.english: I asked them, "Can I go home?"

sentences.chinese: 他们笑了，说这个问题太难了。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xiào le, shuō zhège wèntí tài nán le.
sentences.english: They laughed and said this question was too difficult.

sentences.chinese: 我突然想起，我今天早上起床的时候，生活还很正常。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tūrán xiǎngqǐ, wǒ jīntiān zǎoshàng qǐ chuáng de shíhòu, shēnghuó hái hěn zhèngcháng.
sentences.english: I suddenly remembered that when I got up this morning, life was still normal.

sentences.chinese: 我从床上起来，以为这只是普通的一天。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ cóng chuáng shàng qǐ lái, yǐwéi zhè zhǐshì pǔtōng de yī tiān.
sentences.english: I rose from the bed, thinking it was just an ordinary day.

sentences.chinese: 现在，我必须学习怎么生存。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài, wǒ bìxū xuéxí zěnme shēngcún.
sentences.english: Now, I must learn how to survive.

sentences.chinese: 他们说：“你会说中文吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen shuō: “Nǐ huì shuō Zhōngwén ma?”
sentences.english: They asked, "Do you speak Chinese?"

sentences.chinese: 我说：“会。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: “Huì.”
sentences.english: I said, "Yes."

sentences.chinese: 他们说：“谢谢。”
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen shuō: “Xièxie.”
sentences.english: They said, "Thank you."

sentences.chinese: 但我知道，这不是真正的谢谢。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ zhīdào, zhè bùshì zhēnzhèng de xièxie.
sentences.english: But I knew this wasn't a real thank you.

sentences.chinese: 他们们在计划什么？
sentences.pinyin: Tāmenmen zài jìhuà shénme?
sentences.english: What are they planning?

sentences.chinese: 我看着前面的路，那里没有人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe qiánmiàn de lù, nàlǐ méiyǒu rén.
sentences.english: I looked at the road ahead; there was no one there.

sentences.chinese: 我必须逃走。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bìxū táo zǒu.
sentences.english: I must escape.

sentences.chinese: 我跑在黑暗的街道上。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ pǎo zài hēi àn de jiē dào shàng.
sentences.english: I ran on the dark streets.

sentences.chinese: 现在是星期天，但街道上很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài shì Xīng qī tiān, dàn jiē dào shàng hěn lěng.
sentences.english: It is Sunday now, but the streets are very cold.

sentences.chinese: 今天的天气很不好，下雨了。
sentences.pinyin: Jīn tiān de tiān qì hěn bù hǎo, xià yǔ le.
sentences.english: The weather today is very bad; it is raining.

sentences.chinese: 我想起我的名字，但我现在不记得我的名字了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐ wǒ de míng zi, dàn wǒ xiàn zài bù jì dé wǒ de míng zi le.
sentences.english: I thought of my name, but I cannot remember my name now.

sentences.chinese: 我看到一个女人在跑。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào yí gè nǚ rén zài pǎo.
sentences.english: I saw a woman running.

sentences.chinese: 她看着我，她的眼睛里有恐惧。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe wǒ, tā de yǎn jīng lǐ yǒu kǒng jù.
sentences.english: She looked at me, and there was fear in her eyes.

sentences.chinese: 她告诉我，那些人不是工人，他们是危险的家伙。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ, nà xiē rén bú shì gōng rén, tā men shì wēi xiǎn de jiā huo.
sentences.english: She told me those people are not workers; they are dangerous fellows.

sentences.chinese: 她说话的时候用了一种外语，但我能听懂。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō huà de shí hou yòng le yì zhǒng wài yǔ, dàn wǒ néng tīng dǒng.
sentences.english: She spoke in a foreign language, but I could understand.

sentences.chinese: 她说她有一个儿子和一个女儿，他们都在家里等她。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō tā yǒu yí gè ér zi hé yí gè nǚ ér, tā men dōu zài jiā lǐ děng tā.
sentences.english: She said she has a son and a daughter, and they are both at home waiting for her.

sentences.chinese: 她有一个小孩子，一个可爱的小朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǒu yí gè xiǎo hái zi, yí gè kě ài de xiǎo péng yǒu.
sentences.english: She has a small child, a cute little friend.

sentences.chinese: 她说她的女朋友也在寻找她。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō tā de nǚ péng you yě zài xún zhǎo tā.
sentences.english: She said her girlfriend is also looking for her.

sentences.chinese: 我们一起跑向一个学校。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men yì qǐ pǎo xiàng yí gè xué xiào.
sentences.english: We ran together toward a school.

sentences.chinese: 那是我的中学，我很多年前在这里学习。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì wǒ de zhōng xué, wǒ hěn duō nián qián zài zhè lǐ xué xí.
sentences.english: That was my middle school; I studied here many years ago.

sentences.chinese: 我们跑进学校的图书馆。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men pǎo jìn xué xiào de tú shū guǎn.
sentences.english: We ran into the school library.

sentences.chinese: 这里很安静，有很多书。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ hěn ān jìng, yǒu hěn duō shū.
sentences.english: It is very quiet here, with many books.

sentences.chinese: 我看到一张地图，那是中国的地图。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào yì zhāng dì tú, nà shì Zhōng guó de dì tú.
sentences.english: I saw a map, it was a map of China.

sentences.chinese: 我需要这张地图来逃走。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xū yào zhè zhāng dì tú lái táo zǒu.
sentences.english: I need this map to escape.

sentences.chinese: 我想去医院找一个医生。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù yī yuàn zhǎo yí gè yī shēng.
sentences.english: I want to go to the hospital to find a doctor.

sentences.chinese: 我记得上次去医院的日期，那是三月十日。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jì dé shàng cì qù yī yuàn de rì qī, nà shì sān yuè shí rì.
sentences.english: I remember the date of my last visit to the hospital; it was March 10th.

sentences.chinese: 那时我还没忘记怎么吃早饭和午饭。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shí wǒ hái méi wàng jì zěn me chī zǎo fàn hé wǔ fàn.
sentences.english: At that time, I hadn't forgotten how to eat breakfast and lunch.

sentences.chinese: 现在我已经跑了一个小时了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài wǒ yǐ jīng pǎo le yí gè xiǎo shí le.
sentences.english: Now I have already been running for an hour.

sentences.chinese: 我们在图书馆的角落里发现了一家书店的小摊位。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men zài tú shū guǎn de jiǎo luò lǐ fā xiàn le yì jiā shū diàn de xiǎo tān wèi.
sentences.english: In a corner of the library, we found a small bookstore stall.

sentences.chinese: 那里有打十二本书，全部关于秘密代码。
sentences.pinyin: Nà lǐ yǒu dá shí èr běn shū, quán bù guān yú mì mì dài mǎ.
sentences.english: There were a dozen books there, all about secret codes.

sentences.chinese: 我想起我的家，我想回家。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐ wǒ de jiā, wǒ xiǎng huí jiā.
sentences.english: I thought of my home; I want to go home.

sentences.chinese: 但突然，门开了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tū rán, mén kāi le.
sentences.english: But suddenly, the door opened.

sentences.chinese: 那些人来了。
sentences.pinyin: Nà xiē rén lái le.
sentences.english: Those people have arrived.

sentences.chinese: 他们看着我们，笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men kàn zhe wǒ men, xiào le.
sentences.english: They looked at us and smiled.

sentences.chinese: 那些人走近了，他们的脸很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Nà xiē rén zǒu jìn le, tā men de liǎn hěn lěng.
sentences.english: Those people approached, their faces were cold.

sentences.chinese: 我想跑，但我的腿在抖。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng pǎo, dàn wǒ de tuǐ zài dǒu.
sentences.english: I wanted to run, but my legs were shaking.

sentences.chinese: 我想起今天是星期日，我本应该在家里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐ jīn tiān shì xīng qī rì, wǒ běn yīng gāi zài jiā lǐ.
sentences.english: I remembered today is Sunday, I should have been at home.

sentences.chinese: 我看到桌子上有一台旧电脑。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī tái jiù diàn nǎo.
sentences.english: I saw an old computer on the table.

sentences.chinese: 也许这个电脑有用。
sentences.pinyin: Yě xǔ zhè ge diàn nǎo yǒu yòng.
sentences.english: Maybe this computer is useful.

sentences.chinese: 我快步走过去，打开它。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kuài bù zǒu guò qù, dǎ kāi tā.
sentences.english: I walked over quickly and turned it on.

sentences.chinese: 屏幕上有很多汉字，我看不懂。
sentences.pinyin: Píng mù shàng yǒu hěn duō hàn zì, wǒ kàn bù dǒng.
sentences.english: There were many Chinese characters on the screen; I couldn't understand them.

sentences.chinese: 我记得我的老师教过我这些。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jì dé wǒ de lǎo shī jiào guò wǒ zhè xiē.
sentences.english: I remembered my teacher had taught me these.

sentences.chinese: 他在大学的时候告诉我，秘密就在课文里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài dà xué de shí hòu gàosù wǒ, mì mì jiù zài kè wén lǐ.
sentences.english: He told me when he was at university that the secret was in the text.

sentences.chinese: 我翻开一本课本，看到第十页。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ fān kāi yī běn kè běn, kàn dào dì shí yè.
sentences.english: I flipped open a textbook and saw page ten.

sentences.chinese: 那里写着一个名字：车先生。
sentences.pinyin: Nà lǐ xiě zhe yī gè míng zì: Chē xiān sheng.
sentences.english: There was a name written there: Mr. Che.

sentences.chinese: 车先生是谁呢？
sentences.pinyin: Chē xiān sheng shì shuí ne?
sentences.english: Who is Mr. Che?

sentences.chinese: 我突然感到很渴，我的喉咙在痛。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tū rán gǎn dào hěn kě, wǒ de hóu lóng zài tòng.
sentences.english: I suddenly felt very thirsty; my throat was hurting.

sentences.chinese: 桌上有牛奶和面包，还有一些水果。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuō shàng yǒu niú nǎi hé miàn bāo, hái yǒu yī xiē shuǐ guǒ.
sentences.english: On the table there was milk and bread, and some fruit.

sentences.chinese: 我没有时间吃米饭或者包子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ méi yǒu shí jiān chī mǐ fàn huò zhě bāo zi.
sentences.english: I didn't have time to eat rice or baozi.

sentences.chinese: 我随便拿了一件衣服穿上，因为外面在下雨。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ suí biàn ná le yī jiàn yī fu chuān shàng, yīn wèi wài miàn zài xià yǔ.
sentences.english: I randomly put on a piece of clothing because it was raining outside.

sentences.chinese: 我想给我的朋友打电话。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gěi wǒ de péng you dǎ diàn huà.
sentences.english: I wanted to call my friend.

sentences.chinese: 我的男朋友也在网上找我，但他找不到我。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de nán péng you yě zài wǎng shàng zhǎo wǒ, dàn tā zhǎo bù dào wǒ.
sentences.english: My boyfriend was also looking for me online, but he couldn't find me.

sentences.chinese: 我想起我的生日快到了，但我现在不能回家。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐ wǒ de shēng rì kuài dào le, dàn wǒ xiàn zài bù néng huí jiā.
sentences.english: I remembered my birthday was coming soon, but I cannot go home now.

sentences.chinese: 我看到一张机票，那是飞机的票。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào yī zhāng jī piào, nà shì fēi jī de piào.
sentences.english: I saw a plane ticket; it was a ticket for an airplane.

sentences.chinese: 我还看到一张火车的票。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hái kàn dào yī zhāng huǒ chē de piào.
sentences.english: I also saw a train ticket.

sentences.chinese: 我必须离开这个地方。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bì xū lí kāi zhè ge dì fang.
sentences.english: I must leave this place.

sentences.chinese: 我看着那些人，他们离我越来越近。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe nà xiē rén, tā men lí wǒ yuè lái yuè jìn.
sentences.english: I looked at those people; they were getting closer and closer to me.

sentences.chinese: 他们想拿走那个电脑。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men xiǎng ná zǒu nà ge diàn nǎo.
sentences.english: They wanted to take that computer.

sentences.chinese: 我抓起那个课本，冲向门外。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhuā qǐ nà ge kè běn, chōng xiàng mén wài.
sentences.english: I grabbed that textbook and rushed out the door.

sentences.chinese: 我抱着电脑和课本，跑在黑夜里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bàozhe diànnǎo hé kèběn, pǎo zài hēiyè lǐ.
sentences.english: I held the computer and the textbook, running in the dark night.

sentences.chinese: 我的书包很重，但里面有重要的东西。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de shūbāo hěn zhòng, dàn lǐmiàn yǒu zhòngyào de dōngxī.
sentences.english: My schoolbag was heavy, but there were important things inside.

sentences.chinese: 我想起我不是一个大学生，我只是一个普通学生。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngqǐ wǒ bùshì yīgè dàxuéshēng, wǒ zhǐshì yīgè pǔtōng xuésheng.
sentences.english: I remembered that I am not a university student; I am just an ordinary student.

sentences.chinese: 我曾经在那个学院学习，但现在这里太危险了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ céngjīng zài nàgè xuéyuàn xuéxí, dàn xiànzài zhèlǐ tài wēixiǎn le.
sentences.english: I once studied at that college, but now it is too dangerous here.

sentences.chinese: 我跑向火车站，那是离开这个国家的唯一地点。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ pǎo xiàng huǒchēzhàn, nà shì líkāi zhège guójiā de wéiyī dìdiǎn.
sentences.english: I ran toward the train station; it was the only location to leave this country.

sentences.chinese: 路边有一个商店，店里没有人。
sentences.pinyin: Lùbiān yǒu yīgè shāngdiàn, diàn lǐ méiyǒu rén.
sentences.english: There was a store by the road, and there was no one in the store.

sentences.chinese: 我走进商店，看到一个中年先生在看书。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǒu jìn shāngdiàn, kàndào yīgè zhōngnián xiānsheng zài kànshū.
sentences.english: I walked into the store and saw a middle-aged gentleman reading a book.

sentences.chinese: 他看着我，眼神很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe wǒ, yǎnshén hěn qíguài.
sentences.english: He looked at me, his gaze very strange.

sentences.chinese: 他问我：“孩子，你发生了什么事？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn wǒ: “Háizi, nǐ fāshēngle shénme shì?”
sentences.english: He asked me, "Child, what matter has happened?"

sentences.chinese: 我不敢说话，因为我看到窗外有很多人在找我。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bù gǎn shuōhuà, yīnwèi wǒ kàndào chuāngwài yǒu hěnduō rén zài zhǎo wǒ.
sentences.english: I didn't dare to speak because I saw many people looking for me outside the window.

sentences.chinese: 其中一个男人大声地号叫，声音很可怕。
