sentences.pinyin: Qízhōng yīgè nánrén dàshēng de háojiào, shēngyīn hěn kěpà.
sentences.english: One of the men cried out loudly; the sound was terrifying.

sentences.chinese: 我看到一个女孩儿在哭，她看起来像个中学生。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàndào yīgè nǚháir zài kū, tā kàn qǐlái xiàng gè zhōngxuéshēng.
sentences.english: I saw a girl crying; she looked like a middle-school student.

sentences.chinese: 她的旁边有一个女生，可能是一个大学生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de pángbiān yǒu yīgè nǚshēng, kěnéng shì yīgè dàxuéshēng.
sentences.english: Beside her was a female student, possibly a university student.

sentences.chinese: 她们看着我，眼神里有恐惧。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen kànzhe wǒ, yǎnshén lǐ yǒu kǒngjù.
sentences.english: They looked at me, and there was fear in their eyes.

sentences.chinese: 我突然想起我的家人，我想念我的妈妈。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tūrán xiǎngqǐ wǒ de jiārén, wǒ xiǎngniàn wǒ de māma.
sentences.english: I suddenly thought of my family; I missed my mother.

sentences.chinese: 我记得妈妈常说，要保护好我的妹妹。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jìde māma cháng shuō, yào bǎohù hǎo wǒ de mèimei.
sentences.english: I remember Mom often said to protect my younger sister.

sentences.chinese: 我像个小学生一样害怕，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiàng gè xiǎoxuéshēng yīyàng hàipà, xīntiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: I was as scared as a primary school student, my heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 我记得我在小学的时候，老师教我怎么看字。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jìde wǒ zài xiǎoxué de shíhou, lǎoshī jiào wǒ zěnme kàn zì.
sentences.english: I remember when I was in elementary school, the teacher taught me how to read characters.

sentences.chinese: 现在，我看着火车的票上的字，那是我的希望。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài, wǒ kànzhe huǒchē de piào shàng de zì, nà shì wǒ de xīwàng.
sentences.english: Now, I look at the characters on the train ticket; that is my hope.

sentences.chinese: 我跑出商店，来到一个巨大的商场前面。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ pǎo chū shāngdiàn, lái dào yīgè jùdà de shāngchǎng qiánmiàn.
sentences.english: I ran out of the store and came in front of a huge shopping mall.

sentences.chinese: 一个年轻的小姐在商场门口等我。
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè niánqīng de xiǎojiě zài shāngchǎng ménkǒu děng wǒ.
sentences.english: A young lady was waiting for me at the mall entrance.

sentences.chinese: 她对我低声说：“快走，你的同学在后面。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì wǒ dīshēng shuō: “Kuài zǒu, nǐ de tóngxué zài hòumiàn.”
sentences.english: She whispered to me, "Go quickly, your classmate is behind you."

sentences.chinese: 我回头看，那些人离我越来越近。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ huítóu kàn, nàxiē rén lí wǒ yuè lái yuè jìn.
sentences.english: I looked back, and those people were getting closer and closer.

sentences.chinese: 那个女人在喊：“抓住那个孩子！”
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè nǚrén zài hǎn: “Zhuā zhù nàgè zǐ!”
sentences.english: That woman shouted, "Catch that child!"

sentences.chinese: 我不知道那个女是谁，但她很凶。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào nàgè nǚ shì shéi, dàn tā hěn xiōng.
sentences.english: I don't know who that woman is, but she is very fierce.

sentences.chinese: 我跑向火车，这就是我生存的唯一机会。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ pǎo xiàng huǒchē, zhè jiùshì wǒ shēngcún de wéiyī jīhuì.
sentences.english: I ran toward the train; this is my only chance of survival.

sentences.chinese: 但突然，一个人的手抓住了我的肩膀。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tūrán, yīgè rén de shǒu zhuā zhùle wǒ de jiānbǎng.
sentences.english: But suddenly, a person's hand grabbed my shoulder.

sentences.chinese: 一个强壮的男人抓住了我。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè qiáng zhuàng de nán rén zhuā zhù le wǒ.
sentences.english: A strong man grabbed me.

sentences.chinese: 他的手像冰一样冷。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shǒu xiàng bīng yī yàng lěng.
sentences.english: His hand was as cold as ice.

sentences.chinese: 我用力挣脱，跑向车站的洗手间。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yòng lì zhèng tuō, pǎo xiàng chē zhàn de xǐ shǒu jiān.
sentences.english: I struggled hard and ran toward the station's restroom.

sentences.chinese: 我躲在洗手间里，心跳很快。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ duǒ zài xǐ shǒu jiān lǐ, xīn tiào hěn kuài.
sentences.english: I hid in the restroom, my heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 我看着手机，没有信号。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe shǒu jī, méi yǒu xìn hào.
sentences.english: I looked at my cell phone; there was no signal.

sentences.chinese: 我记得一个星期前，我的爸爸告诉我，不要相信陌生人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jì dé yī gè xīng qī qián, wǒ de bà ba gào sù wǒ, bù yào xiāng xìn mò shēng rén.
sentences.english: I remember a week ago, my father told me not to trust strangers.

sentences.chinese: 我的爸爸是一个医生，他经常照顾病人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de bà ba shì yī gè yī shēng, tā jīng cháng zhào gù bìng rén.
sentences.english: My father is a doctor; he often takes care of patients.

sentences.chinese: 我那时才十岁，但我现在必须像个大人一样勇敢。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ nà shí cái shí suì, dàn wǒ xiàn zài bì xū xiàng gè dà rén yī yàng yǒng gǎn.
sentences.english: I was only ten years old then, but now I must be as brave as an adult.

sentences.chinese: 我看着洗手间里的镜子，我只是一个瘦小的男孩儿。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe xǐ shǒu jiān lǐ de jìng zi, wǒ zhǐ shì yī gè shòu xiǎo de nán hái r.
sentences.english: I looked in the restroom mirror; I am just a thin little boy.

sentences.chinese: 一个男生在外面喊，他说：“他在里面！”
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè nán shēng zài wài miàn hǎn, tā shuō: “Tā zài lǐ miàn!”
sentences.english: A schoolboy shouted outside, saying, "He's in here!"

sentences.chinese: 我听到了很多人的脚步声。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tīng dào le hěn duō rén de jiǎo bù shēng.
sentences.english: I heard the footsteps of many people.

sentences.chinese: 我看到桌子上有一个杯子，我把它推倒在地。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī gè bēi zi, wǒ bǎ tā tuī dǎo zài dì.
sentences.english: I saw a cup on the table and pushed it to the floor.

sentences.chinese: 杯子碎了，声音很大。
sentences.pinyin: Bēi zi suì le, shēng yīn hěn dà.
sentences.english: The cup broke, and the sound was loud.

sentences.chinese: 趁他们惊讶的时候，我冲出门，跑向路边的一辆汽车。
sentences.pinyin: Chèn tā men jīng yà de shí hou, wǒ chōng chū mén, pǎo xiàng lù biān de yī liàng qì chē.
sentences.english: While they were surprised, I rushed out the door and ran toward a car by the roadside.

sentences.chinese: 汽车在快速行驶，我不知道要去哪里。
sentences.pinyin: Qì chē zài kuài sù xíng shǐ, wǒ bù zhī dào yào qù nǎ lǐ.
sentences.english: The car was moving fast; I didn't know where it was going.

sentences.chinese: 车里有一个小孩儿，他抱着一个球。
sentences.pinyin: Chē lǐ yǒu yī gè xiǎo hái r, tā bào zhe yī gè qiú.
sentences.english: There was a child in the car, holding a ball.

sentences.chinese: 他看着我，眼神很害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe wǒ, yǎn shén hěn hài pà.
sentences.english: He looked at me with fear in his eyes.

sentences.chinese: 他问我：“你也是被他们抓来的吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn wǒ: “Nǐ yě shì bèi tā men zhuā lái de ma?”
sentences.english: He asked me, "Were you captured by them too?"

sentences.chinese: 我没有说话，我只想到我手里那本重要的课本。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ méi yǒu shuō huà, wǒ zhǐ xiǎng dào wǒ shǒu lǐ nà běn zhòng yào de kè běn.
sentences.english: I didn't speak; I only thought about that important textbook in my hand.

sentences.chinese: 我想起那个课本里有我的机票，那是离开这里的唯一机会。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐ nà gè kè běn lǐ yǒu wǒ de jī piào, nà shì lí kāi zhè lǐ de wéi yī jī huì.
sentences.english: I remembered that there was an air ticket in that book, the only chance to leave this place.

sentences.chinese: 车子停在了一栋巨大的建筑前面，那是学校的教学楼。
sentences.pinyin: Chē zi tíng zài le yī dòng jù dà de jiàn zhù qián miàn, nà shì xué xiào de jiào xué lóu.
sentences.english: The car stopped in front of a huge building, which was the school's teaching block.

sentences.chinese: 现在是晚上十点，月亮很亮。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài shì wǎn shàng shí diǎn, yuè liàng hěn liàng.
sentences.english: It was ten o'clock at night, and the moon was very bright.

sentences.chinese: 教学楼里没有电，到处都是黑暗。
sentences.pinyin: Jiào xué lóu lǐ méi yǒu diàn, dào chù dōu shì hēi àn.
sentences.english: There was no electricity in the teaching block; it was dark everywhere.

sentences.chinese: 我们走进一个房间，那里有一张床和一台电视。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men zǒu jìn yī gè fáng jiān, nà lǐ yǒu yī zhāng chuáng hé yī tái diàn shì.
sentences.english: We walked into a room where there was a bed and a television.

sentences.chinese: 电视没有开，但墙上有一个电话。
sentences.pinyin: Diàn shì méi yǒu kāi, dàn qiáng shàng yǒu yī gè diàn huà.
sentences.english: The TV was not on, but there was a telephone on the wall.

sentences.chinese: 我想打电话给我的爸，但我害怕对方在听。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng dǎ diàn huà gěi wǒ de bà, dàn wǒ hài pà duì fāng zài tīng.
sentences.english: I wanted to call my dad, but I was afraid the other side was listening.

sentences.chinese: 我想起以前在电影院看电影，电影里的主角总能逃走。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐ yǐ qián zài diàn yǐng yuàn kàn diàn yǐng, diàn yǐng lǐ de zhǔ jué zǒng néng táo zǒu.
sentences.english: I remembered watching movies in the cinema before; the protagonists in movies always manage to escape.

sentences.chinese: 但我现在不在电影院，我在一个真实的噩梦里。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ xiàn zài bù zài diàn yǐng yuàn, wǒ zài yī gè zhēn shí de è mèng lǐ.
sentences.english: But I am not in a cinema now; I am in a real nightmare.

sentences.chinese: 我们还没吃晚饭，肚子很饿，但恐惧比饥饿更可怕。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men hái méi chī wǎn fàn, dù zi hěn è, dàn kǒng jù bǐ jī è gèng kě pà.
sentences.english: We hadn't eaten dinner yet, and our stomachs were hungry, but fear was more terrible than hunger.

sentences.chinese: 突然，门开了，那个凶狠的女人站在门口。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, mén kāi le, nà gè xiōng hěn de nǚ rén zhàn zài mén kǒu.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the door opened, and that fierce woman stood at the entrance.

sentences.chinese: 她看着我们，冷冷地说：“游戏还没有结束。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe wǒ men, lěng lěng de shuō: “Yóu xì hái méi yǒu jié shù.”
sentences.english: She looked at us and said coldly, "The game is not over yet."

sentences.chinese: 那个女人走进门口，她的脸很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè nǚ rén zǒu jìn mén kǒu, tā de liǎn hěn lěng.
sentences.english: The woman walked into the doorway, her face very cold.

sentences.chinese: 她看着我，说了一些奇怪的话。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe wǒ, shuō le yī xiē qí guài de huà.
sentences.english: She looked at me and said some strange words.

sentences.chinese: 她说：“你们得吃饭了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ men děi chī fàn le.”
sentences.english: She said, "You must eat now."

sentences.chinese: 她指了指桌子，那里有肉和鸡蛋。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐ le zhǐ zhuō zi, nà lǐ yǒu ròu hé jī dàn.
sentences.english: She pointed to the table, where there was meat and eggs.

sentences.chinese: 还有一些绿色的菜，和一碗面条儿。
sentences.pinyin: Hái yǒu yī xiē lǜ sè de cài, hé yī wǎn miàn tiáo r.
sentences.english: There were also some green vegetables and a bowl of noodles.

sentences.chinese: 我看着这些食物，但我不敢吃。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe zhè xiē shí wù, dàn wǒ bù gǎn chī.
sentences.english: I looked at this food, but I didn't dare eat it.

sentences.chinese: 我想起我的网友告诉我，这个女人很危险。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐ wǒ de wǎng yǒu gào sù wǒ, zhè gè nǚ rén hěn wī xiǎn.
sentences.english: I remembered my online friend telling me that this woman is very dangerous.

sentences.chinese: 我的网友在北京，他懂很多关于这个游戏的知识。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de wǎng yǒu zài Běi jīng, tā dǒng hěn duō guān yú zhè gè yóu xì de zhī shi.
sentences.english: My online friend is in Beijing; he knows a lot of knowledge about this game.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，这个游戏像是一门残酷的课。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ, zhè gè yóu xì xiàng shì yī mén cán kù de kè.
sentences.english: He told me that this game is like a cruel course.

sentences.chinese: 我想逃走，但我没有钱，我的钱包不见了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng táo zǒu, dàn wǒ méi yǒu qián, wǒ de qián bāo bù jiàn le.
sentences.english: I wanted to escape, but I had no money; my wallet was gone.

sentences.chinese: 我想，我的票是不是也在钱包里？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng, wǒ de piào shì bù shì yě zài qián bāo lǐ?
sentences.english: I wondered, was my ticket also in the wallet?

sentences.chinese: 没有票，我不能去车站离开这里。
sentences.pinyin: Méi yǒu piào, wǒ bù néng qù chē zhàn lí kāi zhè lǐ.
sentences.english: Without a ticket, I cannot go to the station to leave this place.

sentences.chinese: 那个女人端来一杯茶，放在我面前。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè nǚ rén duān lái yī bēi chá, fàng zài wǒ miàn qián.
sentences.english: The woman brought a cup of tea and placed it in front of me.

sentences.chinese: 她问我：“你读过我的书吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn wǒ: “Nǐ dú guò wǒ de shū ma?”
sentences.english: She asked me, "Have you read my book?"

sentences.chinese: 我不知道她在说什么，我只能低头看桌子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhī dào tā zài shuō shén me, wǒ zhǐ néng dī tóu kàn zhuō zi.
sentences.english: I didn't know what she was talking about; I could only lower my head and look at the table.

sentences.chinese: 桌上的盘子排成一行，像是在等待什么。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuō shàng de pán zi pái chéng yī háng, xiàng shì zài děng dài shén me.
sentences.english: The plates on the table were arranged in a row, as if waiting for something.

sentences.chinese: 她冷冷地说：“在这个房间里，只有两种等级的人：猎人和猎物。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā lěng lěng de shuō: “Zài zhè gè fáng jiān lǐ, zhǐ yǒu liǎng zhǒng děng jí de rén: liè rén hé liè wù.”
sentences.english: She said coldly, "In this room, there are only two ranks of people: hunters and prey."

sentences.chinese: 我问她：“你是哪个人？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Nǐ shì nǎ gè rén?”
sentences.english: I asked her, "Which one are you?"

sentences.chinese: 她笑了，笑声像冬天的风一样冷。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiào le, xiào shēng xiàng dōng tiān de fēng yī yàng lěng.
sentences.english: She laughed, and her laughter was as cold as the winter wind.

sentences.chinese: 她告诉我，她的名字叫那，而她的助手叫山。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ, tā de míng zi jiào Nā, ér tā de zhù shǒu jiào Shān.
sentences.english: She told me her name was Na, and her assistant was named Shan.

sentences.chinese: 那和山，这两个名字让我感到害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Nā hé Shān, zhè liǎng gè míng zi ràng wǒ gǎn dào hài pà.
sentences.english: Na and Shan—these two names made me feel afraid.

sentences.chinese: 她突然问我：“你会说汉语吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā tū rán wèn wǒ: “Nǐ huì shuō Hàn yǔ ma?”
sentences.english: She suddenly asked me, "Can you speak Chinese?"

sentences.chinese: 我点点头，但我现在太害怕了，不能说话。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ diǎn diǎn tóu, dàn wǒ xiàn zài tài hài pà le, bù néng shuō huà.
sentences.english: I nodded, but I was too scared now to speak.

sentences.chinese: 她告诉我，门外的马路现在很危险。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ, mén wài de mǎ lù xiàn zài hěn wī xiǎn.
sentences.english: She told me the road outside the door is very dangerous right now.

sentences.chinese: 她指着窗外的一家饭店，说那里有很多人，但没有人能救我。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐ zhe chuāng wài de yī jiā fàn diàn, shuō nà lǐ yǒu hěn duō rén, dàn méi yǒu rén néng jiù wǒ.
sentences.english: She pointed to a restaurant outside the window and said there are many people there, but no one can save me.

sentences.chinese: 突然，她拿出一把刀，轻轻地放在我的面条儿旁边。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, tā ná chū yī bǎ dāo, qīng qīng de fàng zài wǒ de miàn tiáo r páng biān.
sentences.english: Suddenly, she took out a knife and gently placed it next to my noodles.

sentences.chinese: 她看着我的眼睛，轻声说：“现在，真正的晚餐开始了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe wǒ de yǎn jīng, qīng shēng shuō: “Xiàn zài, zhēn zhèng de wǎn cān kāi shǐ le.”
sentences.english: She looked into my eyes and whispered, "Now, the real dinner begins."

sentences.chinese: 我看着那把刀，心跳得非常快。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe nà bǎ dāo, xīntiào de fēicháng kuài.
sentences.english: I looked at that knife, my heart beating very fast.

sentences.chinese: 那个女人笑了，她看着我的眼睛说：“你现在只有一分钟时间。”
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè nǚrén xiàole, tā kànzhe wǒ de yǎnjīng shuō: “Nǐ xiànzài zhǐyǒu yī fēnzhōng shíjiān.”
sentences.english: That woman smiled, she looked into my eyes and said, "You only have one minute now."

sentences.chinese: 我看着桌子，那里有一些奇怪的纸。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe zhuōzi, nàlǐ yǒu yīxiē qíguài de zhǐ.
sentences.english: I looked at the table; there were some strange pieces of paper there.

sentences.chinese: 纸上写着很多数字：四，五，六，七，八，九。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐ shàng xiězhe hěnduō shùzì: sì, wǔ, liù, qī, bā, jiǔ.
sentences.english: Many numbers were written on the paper: four, five, six, seven, eight, nine.

sentences.chinese: 最后是一个大大的十。
sentences.pinyin: Zuìhòu shì yīgè dàdà de shí.
sentences.english: Finally, there was a big ten.

sentences.chinese: 我不知道这些数字是什么意思。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào zhèxiē shùzì shì shénme yìsi.
sentences.english: I didn't know what these numbers meant.

sentences.chinese: 她告诉我，这些数字代表我们生存的机会。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, zhèxiē shùzì dàibiǎo wǒmen shēngcún de jīhuì.
sentences.english: She told me that these numbers represent our chances of survival.

sentences.chinese: 有些数字是陷阱，有的数字是出口。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒuxiē shùzì shì xiànjǐng, yǒude shùzì shì chūkǒu.
sentences.english: Some numbers are traps, and some are exits.

sentences.chinese: 我问她：“为什么你要这样做？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Wèishéme nǐ yào zhèyàng zuò?”
sentences.english: I asked her, "Why are you doing this?"

sentences.chinese: 她没有说话，只是看着我。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu shuōhuà, zhǐshì kànzhe wǒ.
sentences.english: She didn't speak, she just looked at me.

sentences.chinese: 我发现房间里还有两把椅子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ fāxiàn fángjiān lǐ hái yǒu liǎng bǎ yǐzi.
sentences.english: I discovered there were still two chairs in the room.

sentences.chinese: 一个人坐在第一把椅子上，另一个人坐在第二把椅子上。
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè rén zuò zài dì-yī bǎ yǐzi shàng, lìng yīgè rén zuò zài dì-èr bǎ yǐzi shàng.
sentences.english: One person sat on the first chair, and another person sat on the second chair.

sentences.chinese: 但现在，这里只有我一个人。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiànzài, zhèlǐ zhǐyǒu wǒ yīgè rén.
sentences.english: But now, I am the only person here.

sentences.chinese: 我常常在想，我是谁，我为什么在这里？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng zài xiǎng, wǒ shì shuí, wǒ wèishéme zài zhèlǐ?
sentences.english: I often wonder, who am I, and why am I here?

sentences.chinese: 这里的空气有些冷，我觉得最可怕的是安静。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de kōngqì yǒuxiē lěng, wǒ juédé zuì kěpà de shì ānjìng.
sentences.english: The air here is somewhat cold; I feel the most terrifying thing is the silence.

sentences.chinese: 那个女人说：“如果你能猜对多少个数字，我就让你走。”
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè nǚrén shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ néng cāiduì duōshǎo gè shùzì, wǒ jiù ràng nǐ zǒu.”
sentences.english: The woman said, "If you can guess how many numbers correctly, I will let you go."

sentences.chinese: 我看着她，我想逃走，但我还是不能动。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe tā, wǒ xiǎng táozǒu, dàn wǒ háishì bùnéng dòng.
sentences.english: I looked at her; I wanted to escape, but I still couldn't move.

sentences.chinese: 我想找别的办法，但这里没有别的门。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zhǎo bié de bànfǎ, dàn zhèlǐ méiyǒu bié de mén.
sentences.english: I wanted to find some other way, but there were no other doors here.

sentences.chinese: 有时我想大喊，但我的声音出不来。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒushí wǒ xiǎng dàhǎn, dàn wǒ de shēngyīn chū bù lái.
sentences.english: Sometimes I want to scream, but my voice won't come out.

sentences.chinese: 我看到墙上有一个钟，现在是六点四分。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàndào qiáng shàng yǒu yīgè zhōng, xiànzài shì liù diǎn sì fēn.
sentences.english: I saw a clock on the wall; it is now 6:04.

sentences.chinese: 从六点四分到七点，我必须找到答案。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng liù diǎn sì fēn dào qī diǎn, wǒ bìxū zhǎodào dá'àn.
sentences.english: From 6:04 until 7 o'clock, I must find the answer.

sentences.chinese: 她们在门外等着，我能听到她们说话的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zài mén wài děngzhe, wǒ néng tīngdào tāmen shuōhuà de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: They are waiting outside the door; I can hear the sound of them talking.

sentences.chinese: 她们常常在笑，那笑声让我害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen chángcháng zài xiào, nà xiàoshēng ràng wǒ hàipà.
sentences.english: They often laugh, and that laughter scares me.

sentences.chinese: 我想知道她们在计划什么，还有谁在外面？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zhīdào tāmen zài jìhuà shénme, hái yǒu shuí zài wàimiàn?
sentences.english: I want to know what they are planning, and who else is outside?

sentences.chinese: 我尝试重新思考，我想重读那些数字。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ chángshì chóngxīn sīkǎo, wǒ xiǎng chóng dú nàxiē shùzì.
sentences.english: I tried to rethink; I wanted to re-read those numbers.

sentences.chinese: 我发现这些数字之间有一些秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ fāxiàn zhèxiē shùzì zhījiān yǒu yīxiē mìmì.
sentences.english: I discovered there are some secrets between these numbers.

sentences.chinese: 我想对她说：“再见”，然后永远离开这里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng duì tā shuō: “Zàijiàn”, ránhòu yǒngyuǎn líkāi zhèlǐ.
sentences.english: I want to say "Goodbye" to her and then leave this place forever.

sentences.chinese: 但我知道，如果我错了，我可能再也看不到明天的太阳。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ zhīdào, rúguǒ wǒ cuòle, wǒ kěnéng zài yě kànbudào míngtiān de tàiyáng.
sentences.english: But I know that if I am wrong, I might never see tomorrow's sun again.

sentences.chinese: 我看着那把刀，它离我的手只有四厘米。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe nà bǎ dāo, tā lí wǒ de shǒu zhǐyǒu sì límǐ.
sentences.english: I looked at that knife; it was only four centimeters from my hand.

sentences.chinese: 我必须在十秒钟之内做决定。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bìxū zài shí miǎozhōng zhī nèi zuò juédìng.
sentences.english: I must make a decision within ten seconds.

sentences.chinese: 突然，那个女人站了起来，她对我轻声说：“时间到了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, nàgè nǚrén zhànle qǐlái, tā duì wǒ qīngshēng shuō: “Shíjiān dàole.”
sentences.english: Suddenly, the woman stood up and whispered to me, "Time is up."

sentences.chinese: 我看着那把刀，心跳得非常快。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe nà bǎ dāo, xīntiào de fēicháng kuài.
sentences.english: I looked at the knife, my heart beating very fast.

sentences.chinese: 那个女人在笑，她看着我，像在看一个玩具。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge nǚrén zài xiào, tā kànzhe wǒ, xiàng zài kàn yīgè wánjù.
sentences.english: That woman was laughing, looking at me as if I were a toy.

sentences.chinese: 我突然想到，上次我见到她的时候，她还没有这么凶。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tūrán xiǎngdào, shàngcì wǒ jiàn dào tā de shíhou, tā hái méiyǒu zhème xiōng.
sentences.english: I suddenly remembered that last time I saw her, she wasn't this fierce.

sentences.chinese: 我想起去年，那是一个寒冷的冬天。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngqǐ qùnián, nà shì yīgè hánlěng de dōngtiān.
sentences.english: I thought of last year; it was a cold winter.

sentences.chinese: 去年新年的时候，我在这里见过她。
sentences.pinyin: Qùnián xīnnián de shíhou, wǒ zài zhèlǐ jiànguò tā.
sentences.english: During the New Year last year, I had seen her here.

sentences.chinese: 那时候，她对我很好，像我的姐姐一样。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shíhou, tā duì wǒ hěn hǎo, xiàng wǒ de jiějie yīyàng.
sentences.english: At that time, she was very good to me, like my older sister.

sentences.chinese: 她曾说她是我的姐姐，但我不知道这是真的吗？
sentences.pinyin: Tā céng shuō tā shì wǒ de jiějie, dàn wǒ bù zhīdào zhè shì zhēn de ma?
sentences.english: She once said she was my older sister, but I don't know if that's true.

sentences.chinese: 我的哥哥和弟弟也在这里，但他们现在在哪里？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de gēge hé dìdi yě zài zhèlǐ, dàn tāmen xiànzài zài nǎlǐ?
sentences.english: My older brother and younger brother were also here, but where are they now?

sentences.chinese: 我想起我的哥哥，他总是保护我。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngqǐ wǒ de gēge, tā zǒngshì bǎohù wǒ.
sentences.english: I thought of my older brother; he always protected me.

sentences.chinese: 我想起我的弟弟，他很小，很可爱。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngqǐ wǒ de dìdi, tā hěn xiǎo, hěn kě'ài.
sentences.english: I thought of my younger brother; he was very small and cute.

sentences.chinese: 我还记得一个女孩，她是我的妹，我的小妹。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hái jìde yīgè nǚhái, tā shì wǒ de mèi, wǒ de xiǎo mèi.
sentences.english: I also remember a girl; she is my younger sister, my little sister.

sentences.chinese: 我的姐，也就是那个女人，曾经告诉过我一个秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de jiě, yě jiùshì nàge nǚrén, céngjīng gàosùguò wǒ yīgè mìmì.
sentences.english: My sister—that woman—once told me a secret.

sentences.chinese: 她说，半年之前，我们全家都失踪了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, bànnián zhīqián, wǒmen quánjiā dōu shīzōng le.
sentences.english: She said that half a year ago, our whole family disappeared.

sentences.chinese: 前天，我在一个旧本子上看到了这些名字。
sentences.pinyin: Qiántiān, wǒ zài yīgè jiù běnzi shàng kàndàole zhèxiē míngzì.
sentences.english: The day before yesterday, I saw these names in an old notebook.

sentences.chinese: 这些名字让我想起了很多事情。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē míngzì ràng wǒ xiǎngqǐle hěnduō shìqing.
sentences.english: These names reminded me of many things.

sentences.chinese: 有时候，我想逃走，但这里是唯一的线索。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒushíhou, wǒ xiǎng táozǒu, dàn zhèlǐ shì wéiyī de xiànsuǒ.
sentences.english: Sometimes I want to escape, but this place is the only clue.

sentences.chinese: 我看着桌子上的东西，那里有一半的面条儿。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe zhuōzi shàng de dōngxi, nàlǐ yǒu yībàn de miàntiáor.
sentences.english: I looked at the things on the table; there was half of the noodles there.

sentences.chinese: 我看着那个小几，上面放着一张旧照片。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe nàge xiǎo jǐ, shàngmiàn fàngzhe yī zhāng jiù zhàopiàn.
sentences.english: I looked at that small table; there was an old photo on it.

sentences.chinese: 照片上的我们在一起，那是去年上午拍的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhàopiàn shàng de wǒmen zài yīqǐ, nà shì qùnián shàngwǔ pāi de.
sentences.english: We were together in the photo; it was taken one morning last year.

sentences.chinese: 现在是今年，但我感觉时间停止了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài shì jīnnián, dàn wǒ gǎnjué shíjiān tíngzhǐ le.
sentences.english: Now it is this year, but I feel like time has stopped.

sentences.chinese: 昨天，我试图寻找出口，但那些门都锁住了。
sentences.pinyin: Zuótiān, wǒ shìtú xúnzhǎo chūkǒu, dàn nàxiē mén dōu suǒzhù le.
sentences.english: Yesterday, I tried to find an exit, but those doors were all locked.

sentences.chinese: 早上，我听见外面有人的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Zǎoshang, wǒ tīngjiàn wàimiàn yǒu rén de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: In the early morning, I heard voices outside.

sentences.chinese: 他们在说话，声音很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zài shuōhuà, shēngyīn hěn lěng.
sentences.english: They were talking; their voices were cold.

sentences.chinese: 我想，下次我必须在他们发现我之前离开。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng, xiàcì wǒ bìxū zài tāmen fāxiàn wǒ zhīqián líkāi.
sentences.english: I thought that next time I must leave before they find me.

sentences.chinese: 我想，明天我一定要逃到那儿，逃到那个安全的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng, míngtiān wǒ yīdìng yào táo dào nà'r, táo dào nàge ānquán de dìfang.
sentences.english: I thought that tomorrow I must escape to there, to that safe place.

sentences.chinese: 明年，我希望我能自由。
sentences.pinyin: Míngnián, wǒ xīwàng wǒ néng zìyóu.
sentences.english: Next year, I hope I can be free.

sentences.chinese: 现在正是一月，天气非常冷。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài zhèng shì yīyuè, tiānqì fēicháng lěng.
sentences.english: It is currently the first month (January), and the weather is very cold.

sentences.chinese: 我看着这里的墙壁，发现那儿有一个小洞。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe zhèlǐ de qiángbì, fāxiàn nà'r yǒu yīgè xiǎo dòng.
sentences.english: I looked at the walls here and found a small hole there.

sentences.chinese: 我把手伸进那个洞里，摸到了一个冰冷的金属东西。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ shǒu shēn jìn nàge dòng lǐ, mō dào le yīgè bīnglěng de jīnshǔ dōngxi.
sentences.english: I put my hand into that hole and touched a cold metal object.

sentences.chinese: 那个女人突然大喊一声：“你找到了！”
sentences.pinyin: Nàge nǚrén tūrán dàhǎn yīshēng: “Nǐ zhǎodào le!”
sentences.english: The woman suddenly shouted, "You found it!"

sentences.chinese: 我快速地把手从洞里拿了出来。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kuàisù de bǎ shǒu cóng dòng lǐ ná le chūlái.
sentences.english: I quickly took my hand out of the hole.

sentences.chinese: 我看到那是一个金属钥匙，只有三块钱那么小。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàndào nà shì yī gè jīnshǔ yàoshi, zhǐyǒu sān kuài qián nàme xiǎo.
sentences.english: I saw that it was a metal key, as small as a three-yuan coin.

sentences.chinese: 那个女人走过来，她的脸很凶。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè nǚrén zǒu guòlái, tā de liǎn hěn xiōng.
sentences.english: The woman walked over, her face fierce.

sentences.chinese: 她看着我，冷冷地说：“你觉得这很好玩儿吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe wǒ, lěnglěng de shuō: “Nǐ juéde zhè hěn hǎowánr ma?”
sentences.english: She looked at me and said coldly, "Do you think this is fun?"

sentences.chinese: 我害怕地看着她，心跳很快。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hàipà de kànzhe tā, xīntiào hěn kuài.
sentences.english: I looked at her fearfully, my heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 我想，我必须离开这个房子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng, wǒ bìxū líkāi zhège fángzi.
sentences.english: I thought, I must leave this house.

sentences.chinese: 那个女人突然关上门，房间里没有光了。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè nǚrén tūrán guānshàng mén, fángjiān lǐ méiyǒu guāng le.
sentences.english: The woman suddenly closed the door, and there was no more light in the room.

sentences.chinese: 她对我介绍这个钥匙的作用。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì wǒ jièshào zhège yàoshi de zuòyòng.
sentences.english: She introduced the function of this key to me.

sentences.chinese: 她说：“这个钥匙能开那个大门。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zhège yàoshi néng kāi nàgè dà mén.”
sentences.english: She said, "This key can open that big door."

sentences.chinese: 但我知道，她不会给我机会走掉。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ zhīdào, tā búhuì gěi wǒ jīhuì zǒu diào.
sentences.english: But I knew she would not give me a chance to leave.

sentences.chinese: 她拿出一张纸，像在学校做听写一样，让我写我的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū yī zhāng zhǐ, xiàng zài xuéxiào zuò tīngxiě yīyàng, ràng wǒ xiě wǒ de míngzì.
sentences.english: She took out a piece of paper and, like doing a dictation in school, told me to write my name.

sentences.chinese: 她说：“如果你写错了，我就让你吃苦头。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ xiě cuò le, wǒ jiù ràng nǐ chī kǔtou.”
sentences.english: She said, "If you write it wrong, I will make you suffer."

sentences.chinese: 我张开口，想说话，但声音出不来。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhāngkāi kǒu, xiǎng shuōhuà, dàn shēngyīn chū bù lái.
sentences.english: I opened my mouth, wanting to speak, but no sound came out.

sentences.chinese: 我想起我的奶奶，她总是告诉我要有勇气。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngqǐ wǒ de nǎinai, tā zǒngshì gàosù wǒ yào yǒu yǒngqì.
sentences.english: I thought of my grandmother, who always told me to be brave.

sentences.chinese: 我突然想上网，看看这个地方在地图上的哪里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tūrán xiǎng shàngwǎng, kànkan zhège dìfāng zài dìtú shàng de nǎlǐ.
sentences.english: I suddenly wanted to go online to see where this place was on the map.

sentences.chinese: 但我没有电脑，也没有手机。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ méiyǒu diànnǎo, yě méiyǒu shǒujī.
sentences.english: But I had no computer and no phone.

sentences.chinese: 那个女人笑了，她说：“在这里，你不能上网。”
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè nǚrén xiào le, tā shuō: “Zài zhèlǐ, nǐ bùnéng shàngwǎng.”
sentences.english: The woman laughed and said, "Here, you cannot go online."

sentences.chinese: 她告诉我，后天她会把我交给另外一个人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, hòutiān tā huì bǎ wǒ jiāo gěi lìngwài yī gè rén.
sentences.english: She told me that the day after tomorrow, she would hand me over to another person.

sentences.chinese: 现在差十分钟到午夜，时间快没了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài chà shí fēnzhōng dào wǔyè, shíjiān kuài méi le.
sentences.english: It is now ten minutes to midnight; time is almost up.

sentences.chinese: 她对我大喊：“快写！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì wǒ dàhǎn: “Kuài xiě!”
sentences.english: She shouted at me, "Write quickly!"

sentences.chinese: 我低头看着纸，突然想到一个办法。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dītóu kànzhe zhǐ, tūrán xiǎngdào yī gè bànfǎ.
sentences.english: I looked down at the paper and suddenly thought of a way.

sentences.chinese: 我假装害怕，轻声说：“对不起，我不能写。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiǎzhuāng hàipà, qīngshēng shuō: “Duìbuqǐ, wǒ bùnéng xiě.”
sentences.english: I pretended to be afraid and said softly, "I'm sorry, I cannot write."

sentences.chinese: 她生气地走过来，我趁机跑向窗户。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shēngqì de zǒu guòlái, wǒ chènjī pǎo xiàng chuānghu.
sentences.english: She walked over angrily, and I took the chance to run toward the window.

sentences.chinese: 我听到她大喊：“你以为下课了就可以走吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tīngdào tā dàhǎn: “Nǐ yǐwéi xiàkè le jiù kěyǐ zǒu ma?”
sentences.english: I heard her scream, "Do you think you can just leave because class is over?"

sentences.chinese: 我跳出窗外，落在泥地里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tiào chū chuāngwài, luò zài ní dì lǐ.
sentences.english: I jumped out of the window and landed in the mud.

sentences.chinese: 我快步跑到大街上，看到一家酒吧。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kuàibù pǎo dào dàjiē shàng, kàndào yī jiā jiǔbā.
sentences.english: I walked quickly to the main street and saw a bar.

sentences.chinese: 我跑进吧里，希望那里有人能救我。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ pǎo jìn bā lǐ, xīwàng nàlǐ yǒu rén néng jiù wǒ.
sentences.english: I ran into the bar, hoping someone there could save me.

sentences.chinese: 但当我回头看时，那个女人已经在门外看着我了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn dāng wǒ huítóu kàn shí, nàgè nǚrén yǐjīng zài mén wài kànzhe wǒ le.
sentences.english: But when I looked back, the woman was already outside the door watching me.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十二章：酒吧里的陌生人

sentences.chinese: 我看着门外的女人，觉得这里很不安全。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe mén wài de nǚrén, juéde zhèlǐ hěn bù ānquán.
sentences.english: I looked at the woman outside the door and felt that this place was very unsafe.

sentences.chinese: 我快步走到吧台，手里拿着一个杯子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kuàibù zǒu dào bātái, shǒu lǐ názhe yígè bēizi.
sentences.english: I walked quickly to the bar counter, holding a glass in my hand.

sentences.chinese: 我想洗洗手，因为我的手在发抖。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xǐ xǐ shǒu, yīnwèi wǒ de shǒu zài fādǒu.
sentences.english: I wanted to wash my hands because my hands were shaking.

sentences.chinese: 酒吧里有一个老人，他看着我，眼神很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǔbā lǐ yǒu yígè lǎorén, tā kànzhe wǒ, yǎnshén hěn qíguài.
sentences.english: There was an old man in the bar; he looked at me with a strange expression.

sentences.chinese: 这个老人是我的爷爷的朋友吗？
sentences.pinyin: Zhège lǎorén shì wǒ de yéye de péngyǒu ma?
sentences.english: Was this old man a friend of my grandfather?

sentences.chinese: 他不说话，只是看着我，好像在想什么。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù shuōhuà, zhǐshì kànzhe wǒ, hǎoxiàng zài xiǎng shénme.
sentences.english: He didn't speak, he just looked at me as if he were thinking about something.

sentences.chinese: 我觉得很累，因为我已经跑了很久。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ juéde hěn lèi, yīnwèi wǒ yǐjīng pǎole hěn jiǔ.
sentences.english: I felt very tired because I had been running for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 突然，三个男人走了过来。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, sān gè nánrén zǒu le guòlái.
sentences.english: Suddenly, three men walked over.

sentences.chinese: 他们看着我，问：“你们在干什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen kànzhe wǒ, wèn: “Nǐmen zài gàn shénme?”
sentences.english: They looked at me and asked, "What are you all doing?"

sentences.chinese: 我害怕地看着他们，不知道这些人是谁。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hàipà de kànzhe tāmen, bù zhīdào zhèxiē rén shì shéi.
sentences.english: I looked at them fearfully, not knowing who these people were.

sentences.chinese: 其中一个人说，他的名字叫老南。
sentences.pinyin: Qízhōng yígè rén shuō, tā de míngzi jiào Lǎo Nán.
sentences.english: One of them said his name was Old Nan.

sentences.chinese: 另一个人叫别先生，最后一个人姓班。
sentences.pinyin: Lìng yígè rén jiào Bié xiānsheng, zuìhòu yígè rén xìng Bān.
sentences.english: Another was Mr. Bie, and the last one's surname was Ban.

sentences.chinese: 我问他们：“你们是哪些人？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tāmen: “Nǐmen shì nǎxiē rén?”
sentences.english: I asked them, "Which people are you?"

sentences.chinese: 老南冷冷地说：“我们是来送你离开这里的。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo Nán lěnglěng de shuō: “Wǒmen shì lái sòng nǐ líkāi zhèlǐ de.”
sentences.english: Old Nan said coldly, "We are here to send you away from here."

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，他们可以送我去机场。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, tāmen kěyǐ sòng wǒ qù jīchǎng.
sentences.english: He told me they could take me to the airport.

sentences.chinese: 但我不知道他们是否爱我，或者他们有别的目的。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ bù zhīdào tāmen shìfǒu ài wǒ, huòzhě tāmen yǒu bié de mùdì.
sentences.english: But I didn't know if they loved me, or if they had other motives.

sentences.chinese: 我对他们说：“我不喜欢这种爱好，我只想逃走。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ duì tāmen shuō: “Wǒ bù xǐhuan zhèzhǒng àihào, wǒ zhǐ xiǎng táozǒu.”
sentences.english: I said to them, "I don't like this kind of hobby; I just want to escape."

sentences.chinese: 这三个人的表情很严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè sān gè rén de biǎoqíng hěn yánsù.
sentences.english: The expressions of these three men were very serious.

sentences.chinese: 他们说，这是第十二次尝试救我。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen shuō, zhè shì dì shí'èr cì chángshì jiù wǒ.
sentences.english: They said this was the twelfth time they had tried to save me.

sentences.chinese: 但我记得，那个女人还在门外。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ jìde, nàge nǚrén hái zài mén wài.
sentences.english: But I remembered that the woman was still outside the door.

sentences.chinese: 她看着酒吧的窗户，笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe jiǔbā de chuānghu, xiào le.
sentences.english: She looked at the bar window and smiled.

sentences.chinese: 她对我喊道：“你以为这些人能救你吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì wǒ hǎndào: “Nǐ yǐwéi zhèxiē rén néng jiù nǐ ma?”
sentences.english: She shouted to me, "Do you think these people can save you?"

sentences.chinese: 我看着老南，他握住了我的手。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe Lǎo Nán, tā wòzhù le wǒ de shǒu.
sentences.english: I looked at Old Nan, and he gripped my hand.

sentences.chinese: 突然，酒吧的灯灭了。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, jiǔbā de dēng miè le.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the lights in the bar went out.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十三章：黑暗中的名单
chapters.title_english: Chapter 13: The List in the Dark

sentences.chinese: 酒吧里现在很黑。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǔbā lǐ xiànzài hěn hēi.
sentences.english: The bar is very dark now.

sentences.chinese: 老南在我耳边轻声说：“快走！”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo Nán zài wǒ ěrbiān qīngshēng shuō: “Kuài zǒu!”
sentences.english: Lao Nan whispered in my ear, "Go quickly!"

sentences.chinese: 我们跑向后门，但那里站着一个高个子男人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen pǎo xiàng hòumén, dàn nàlǐ zhànzhe yīgè gāo gèzi nánrén.
sentences.english: We ran toward the back door, but a tall man was standing there.

sentences.chinese: 这个男人叫高先生，他是那个女人的帮手。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège nánrén jiào Gāo xiānshēng, tā shì nàgè nǚrén de bāngshǒu.
sentences.english: This man is called Mr. Gao; he is the woman's assistant.

sentences.chinese: 老南突然从口袋里拿出一张纸。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo Nán tūrán cóng kǒudài lǐ ná chū yī zhāng zhǐ.
sentences.english: Lao Nan suddenly took a piece of paper from his pocket.

sentences.chinese: 这张纸上写了很多人的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhǐ shàng xiěle hěnduō rén de míngzì.
sentences.english: Many people's names were written on this paper.

sentences.chinese: 这些名字很奇怪，看起来像是一个名单。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē míngzì hěn qíguài, kàn qǐlái xiàng shì yīgè míngdān.
sentences.english: These names were very strange; it looked like a list.

sentences.chinese: 名单上有三先生和东先生。
sentences.pinyin: Míngdān shàng yǒu Sān xiānshēng hé Dōng xiānshēng.
sentences.english: On the list were Mr. San and Mr. Dong.

sentences.chinese: 还有中先生、也先生和元先生。
sentences.pinyin: Hái yǒu Zhōng xiānshēng, Yě xiānshēng hé Yuán xiānshēng.
sentences.english: There were also Mr. Zhong, Mr. Ye, and Mr. Yuan.

sentences.chinese: 关先生和后先生也在上面。
sentences.pinyin: Guān xiānshēng hé Hòu xiānshēng yě zài shàngmiàn.
sentences.english: Mr. Guan and Mr. Hou were also on it.

sentences.chinese: 国先生、坐先生和左先生紧接着出现。
sentences.pinyin: Guó xiānshēng, Zuò xiānshēng hé Zuǒ xiānshēng jǐnjiē chūxiàn.
sentences.english: Mr. Guo, Mr. Zuo, and Mr. Zuo appeared next.

sentences.chinese: 常先生、年先生和教先生的名字在中间。
sentences.pinyin: Cháng xiānshēng, Nián xiānshēng hé Jiào xiānshēng de míngzì zài zhōngjiān.
sentences.english: Mr. Chang, Mr. Nian, and Mr. Jiao's names were in the middle.

sentences.chinese: 楼先生、毛先生和花先生在下面。
sentences.pinyin: Lóu xiānshēng, Máo xiānshēng hé Huā xiānshēng zài xiàmiàn.
sentences.english: Mr. Lou, Mr. Mao, and Mr. Hua were at the bottom.

sentences.chinese: 路先生、过先生和还先生的名字被圈了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Lù xiānshēng, Guō xiānshēng hé Huán xiānshēng de míngzì bèi quānle qǐlái.
sentences.english: Mr. Lu, Mr. Guo, and Mr. Huan's names were circled.

sentences.chinese: 都先生、钱先生和错先生的名字被划掉了。
sentences.pinyin: Dū xiānshēng, Qián xiānshēng hé Cuò xiānshēng de míngzì bèi huà diào le.
sentences.english: Mr. Du, Mr. Qian, and Mr. Cuo's names were crossed out.

sentences.chinese: 最后一个人是门先生。
sentences.pinyin: Zuìhòu yīgè rén shì Mén xiānshēng.
sentences.english: The last person was Mr. Men.

sentences.chinese: 老南低声说：“这些人都是这个游戏的参与者。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo Nán dīshēng shuō: “Zhèxiē rén dōu shì zhège yóuxì de cānyùzhě.”
sentences.english: Lao Nan said in a low voice, "These people are all participants in this game."

sentences.chinese: 高先生看着这张纸，突然大喊：“把名单给我！”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiānshēng kànzhe zhè zhāng zhǐ, tūrán dàhǎn: “Bǎ míngdān gěi wǒ!”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao looked at the paper and suddenly shouted, "Give me the list!"

sentences.chinese: 他冲向我们，速度非常快。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chōng xiàng wǒmen, sùdù fēicháng kuài.
sentences.english: He rushed toward us, his speed was very fast.

sentences.chinese: 我感到非常害怕，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gǎndào fēicháng hàipà, xīntiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: I felt very afraid, and my heart beat very fast.

sentences.chinese: 我们必须在黑暗中找到出口。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū zài hēiyàn zhōng zhǎodào chūkǒu.
sentences.english: We had to find the exit in the darkness.

sentences.chinese: 但高先生已经堵住了唯一的路。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn Gāo xiānshēng yǐjīng dǔzhùle wéiyī de lù.
sentences.english: But Mr. Gao had already blocked the only path.

sentences.chinese: 他冷冷地说：“你们逃不掉的。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā lěnglěng de shuō: “Nǐmen táo bù diào de.”
sentences.english: He said coldly, "You cannot escape."

sentences.chinese: 突然，酒吧的灯亮了，但老南不见了。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, jiǔbā de dēng liàngle, dàn Lǎo Nán bùjiàn le.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the bar lights turned on, but Lao Nan was gone.

sentences.chinese: 我看着高先生，他站在那里，脸很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe Gāo xiān sheng, tā zhàn zài nà lǐ, liǎn hěn lěng.
sentences.english: I looked at Mr. Gao; he was standing there, his face very cold.

sentences.chinese: 老南没有在这里，我感到一点儿害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo Nán méi yǒu zài zhè lǐ, wǒ gǎndào yī diǎn r hàipà.
sentences.english: Old Nan was not here, and I felt a little bit afraid.

sentences.chinese: 我问高先生：“老南怎么不见了？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn Gāo xiān sheng: “Lǎo Nán zěn me bù jiàn le?”
sentences.english: I asked Mr. Gao, "How did Old Nan disappear?"

sentences.chinese: 高先生笑了，他说：“他现在没关系。”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng xiào le, tā shuō: “Tā xiàn zài méi guān xi.”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao smiled and said, "He is fine now."

sentences.chinese: 这句话不对，我觉得非常不对。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jù huà bù duì, wǒ jué dé fēi cháng bù duì.
sentences.english: That sentence was wrong; I felt it was very wrong.

sentences.chinese: 我看到桌子上有一个小杯子，里面只有半杯水。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī gè xiǎo bēi zi, lǐ miàn zhǐ yǒu bàn bēi shuǐ.
sentences.english: I saw a small cup on the table, with only half a cup of water inside.

sentences.chinese: 我的心跳很快，但我不能慢。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de xīn tiào hěn kuài, dàn wǒ bù néng màn.
sentences.english: My heart was beating fast, but I could not be slow.

sentences.chinese: 我突然看到一个男的走进来，他姓白。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tū rán kàn dào yī gè nán de zǒu jìn lái, tā xìng Bái.
sentences.english: I suddenly saw a man walk in; his surname was Bai.

sentences.chinese: 白先生看着我，他说：“你不用担心。”
sentences.pinyin: Bái xiān sheng kàn zhe wǒ, tā shuō: “Nǐ bù yòng dān xīn.”
sentences.english: Mr. Bai looked at me and said, "You don't need to worry."

sentences.chinese: 我想说：“谢谢你。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng shuō: “Xiè xie nǐ.”
sentences.english: I wanted to say, "Thank you."

sentences.chinese: 他冷冷地说：“不客气。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā lěng lěng de shuō: “Bù kè qi.”
sentences.english: He said coldly, "You're welcome."

sentences.chinese: 他的声音不大，但是让我觉得很坏。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shēng yīn bù dà, dàn shì ràng wǒ jué dé hěn huài.
sentences.english: His voice was not loud, but it made me feel something was bad.

sentences.chinese: 我问他：“是不是老南在你的房间？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Shì bù shì Lǎo Nán zài nǐ de fáng jiān?”
sentences.english: I asked him, "Is Old Nan in your room?"

sentences.chinese: 白先生说：“没什么，他没事儿。”
sentences.pinyin: Bái xiān sheng shuō: “Méi shén me, tā méi shì r.”
sentences.english: Mr. Bai said, "It's nothing, he is okay."

sentences.chinese: 我不相信他，因为这里没有老南的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiāng xìn tā, yīn wèi zhè lǐ méi yǒu Lǎo Nán de shēng yīn.
sentences.english: I didn't believe him because there was no sound of Old Nan here.

sentences.chinese: 我看到白先生的手里有一个零的小本子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào Bái xiān sheng de shǒu lǐ yǒu yī gè líng de xiǎo běn zi.
sentences.english: I saw a small notebook in Mr. Bai's hand with a zero on it.

sentences.chinese: 那个本子上写着二个名字。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè běn zi shàng xiě zhe èr gè míng zi.
sentences.english: Two names were written in that notebook.

sentences.chinese: 一个是我，另一个是我的弟弟。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè shì wǒ, lìng yī gè shì wǒ de dì di.
sentences.english: One was me, and the other was my younger brother.

sentences.chinese: 我的弟弟不在这里，他怎么会在这里的名字里？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de dì di bù zài zhè lǐ, tā zěn me huì zài zhè lǐ de míng zi lǐ?
sentences.english: My younger brother is not here; how could he be among the names here?

sentences.chinese: 这里的人太少了，只有我们三个。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de rén tài shǎo le, zhǐ yǒu wǒ men sān gè.
sentences.english: There were too few people here, only the three of us.

sentences.chinese: 我没看到出口，门被锁住了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ méi kàn dào chū kǒu, mén bèi suǒ zhù le.
sentences.english: I didn't see an exit; the door was locked.

sentences.chinese: 我尝试推门，但门坏了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ cháng shì tuī mén, dàn mén huài le.
sentences.english: I tried to push the door, but the door was broken.

sentences.chinese: 我看着白先生，他对我笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe Bái xiān sheng, tā duì wǒ xiào le.
sentences.english: I looked at Mr. Bai, and he smiled at me.

sentences.chinese: 他轻声说：“游戏才刚刚开始。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā qīng shēng shuō: “Yóu xì cái gāng gāng kāi shǐ.”
sentences.english: He whispered, "The game has only just begun."

sentences.chinese: 白先生一边看着我，一边在手里玩着那把冰冷的钥匙。
sentences.pinyin: Bái xiān sheng yī biān kàn zhe wǒ, yī biān zài shǒu lǐ wán zhe nà bǎ bīng lěng de yào shi.
sentences.english: Mr. Bai was looking at me while playing with that ice-cold key in his hand.

sentences.chinese: 我的心在跳，我觉得这个地方太危险了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de xīn zài tiào, wǒ jué de zhè ge dì fāng tài wēi xiǎn le.
sentences.english: My heart was racing; I felt this place was too dangerous.

sentences.chinese: 我想逃到外边，但门还是打不开。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng táo dào wài bian, dàn mén hái shì dǎ bù kāi.
sentences.english: I wanted to escape outside, but the door still wouldn't open.

sentences.chinese: 白先生指着房间的东边，那里有一面大墙。
sentences.pinyin: Bái xiān sheng zhǐ zhe fáng jiān de dōng bian, nà lǐ yǒu yī miàn dà qiáng.
sentences.english: Mr. Bai pointed to the east side of the room, where there was a large wall.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你看看上边，那里有东西。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ kàn kan shàng bian, nà lǐ yǒu dōng xī.”
sentences.english: He said, "Look above, there is something there."

sentences.chinese: 我抬头看，上边有一个很小的窗户。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tái tóu kàn, shàng bian yǒu yī gè hěn xiǎo de chuāng hu.
sentences.english: I looked up, and there was a very small window above.

sentences.chinese: 窗户外面是黑色的夜，现在已经很晚了。
sentences.pinyin: Chuāng hu wài mian shì hēi sè de yè, xiàn zài yǐ jīng hěn wǎn le.
sentences.english: Outside the window was the black night; it was already very late.

sentences.chinese: 我想，如果我能去国外，我就安全了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng, rú guǒ wǒ néng qù guó wài, wǒ jiù ān quán le.
sentences.english: I thought if I could go abroad, I would be safe.

sentences.chinese: 但在那个外国的地方，我没有朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zài nà ge wài guó de dì fāng, wǒ méi yǒu péng you.
sentences.english: But in that foreign place, I have no friends.

sentences.chinese: 我看向左边，那里只有一张旧椅子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn xiàng zuǒ bian, nà lǐ zhǐ yǒu yī zhāng jiù yǐ zi.
sentences.english: I looked to the left, where there was only an old chair.

sentences.chinese: 我看向右边，右边是一扇关上的门。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn xiàng yòu bian, yòu bian shì yī shàn guān shàng de mén.
sentences.english: I looked to the right; to the right was a closed door.

sentences.chinese: 我尝试拿那个椅子，想把它推到窗户下边。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ cháng shì ná nà ge yǐ zi, xiǎng bǎ tā tuī dào chuāng hu xià bian.
sentences.english: I tried to take that chair, wanting to push it under the window.

sentences.chinese: 白先生在后边对我大喊：“你不能走！”
sentences.pinyin: Bái xiān sheng zài hòu bian duì wǒ dà hǎn: “Nǐ bù néng zǒu!”
sentences.english: Mr. Bai shouted at me from behind, "You cannot leave!"

sentences.chinese: 我惊恐地回头，发现他离我非常近。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jīng kǒng de huí tóu, fā xiàn tā lí wǒ fēi cháng jìn.
sentences.english: I turned around in terror and found he was very close to me.

sentences.chinese: 他想帮我，还是想杀我？
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng bāng wǒ, hái shì xiǎng shā wǒ?
sentences.english: Did he want to help me, or did he want to kill me?

sentences.chinese: 我不知道他想干什么。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhī dào tā xiǎng gàn shén me.
sentences.english: I didn't know what he wanted to do.

sentences.chinese: 我迅速跑向北边，试图寻找另一个出口。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xùn sù pǎo xiàng běi bian, shì tú xún zhǎo lìng yī gè chū kǒu.
sentences.english: I quickly ran toward the north, trying to find another exit.

sentences.chinese: 但北边的墙壁很冷，没有任何门。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn běi bian de qiáng bì hěn lěng, méi yǒu rèn hé mén.
sentences.english: But the north wall was cold, and there was no door at all.

sentences.chinese: 我跑向南边，那里有一扇小窗户。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ pǎo xiàng nán bian, nà lǐ yǒu yī shàn xiǎo chuāng hu.
sentences.english: I ran toward the south, where there was a small window.

sentences.chinese: 我看向窗外，西边是一座高山，西边的风很大。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn xiàng chuāng wài, xī bian shì yī zuò gāo shān, xī bian de fēng hěn dà.
sentences.english: I looked outside; to the west was a high mountain, and the wind in the west was strong.

sentences.chinese: 在这个方向，西边的森林很远，我跑不到那里。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè ge fāng xiàng, xī bian de sēn lín hěn yuǎn, wǒ pǎo bù dào nà lǐ.
sentences.english: In this direction, the forest to the west was far away; I couldn't run there.

sentences.chinese: 我看向前边，前边是一个深坑。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn xiàng qián bian, qián bian shì yī gè shēn kēng.
sentences.english: I looked ahead; in front of me was a deep pit.

sentences.chinese: 我低头看，下边是黑色的水。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dī tóu kàn, xià bian shì hēi sè de shuǐ.
sentences.english: I looked down; below was black water.

sentences.chinese: 我站在坑的旁边，感觉自己快要死了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhàn zài kēng de páng biān, gǎn jué zì jǐ kuài yào sǐ le.
sentences.english: I stood beside the pit, feeling like I was about to die.

sentences.chinese: 白先生走到这边，冷冷地看着我。
sentences.pinyin: Bái xiān sheng zǒu dào zhè biān, lěng lěng de kàn zhe wǒ.
sentences.english: Mr. Bai walked to this side, looking at me coldly.

sentences.chinese: 他指着那边，那边站着那个凶狠的女人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐ zhe nà bian, nà bian zhàn zhe nà ge xiōng hěn de nǚ rén.
sentences.english: He pointed over there, where that fierce woman was standing.

sentences.chinese: 她和白先生一起看着我，笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hé Bái xiān sheng yī qǐ kàn zhe wǒ, xiào le.
sentences.english: She and Mr. Bai looked at me together and smiled.

sentences.chinese: 我被他们堵在了这个狭小的空间里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bèi tā men dǔ zài le zhè ge xiá xiǎo de kōng jiān lǐ.
sentences.english: I was blocked by them in this tiny space.

sentences.chinese: 突然，女人从口袋里拿出一张地图，上面写着我的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, nǚ rén cóng kǒu dài lǐ ná chū yī zhāng dì tú, shàng miàn xiě zhe wǒ de míng zi.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the woman took a map out of her pocket, and my name was written on it.

sentences.chinese: 我看着那张地图，上面写着我的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe nà zhāng dìtú, shàngmiàn xiězhe wǒ de míngzì.
sentences.english: I looked at the map; my name was written on it.

sentences.chinese: 白先生冷冷地说：“你记得这个地方吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Bái xiānsheng lěnglěng de shuō: “Nǐ jìde zhège dìfāng ma?”
sentences.english: Mr. Bai said coldly, "Do you remember this place?"

sentences.chinese: 我想起来了，那是北边的一个小房子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐlái le, nà shì běibiān de yī gè xiǎo fángzi.
sentences.english: I remembered; it was a small house in the north.

sentences.chinese: 我听到外面在下雨，雨声很大。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tīngdào wàimiàn zài xiàyǔ, yǔshēng hěn dà.
sentences.english: I heard it was raining outside, and the sound of the rain was very loud.

sentences.chinese: 那个女人对我笑，她说：“你现在不能回家。”
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè nǚrén duì wǒ xiào, tā shuō: “Nǐ xiànzài bùnéng huíjiā.”
sentences.english: The woman smiled at me and said, "You cannot go home now."

sentences.chinese: 她让我坐下，她想让我写一些东西。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ràng wǒ zuòxià, tā xiǎng ràng wǒ xiě yīxiē dōngxī.
sentences.english: She told me to sit down; she wanted me to write some things.

sentences.chinese: 我不想写，我想出去。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng xiě, wǒ xiǎng chūqù.
sentences.english: I didn't want to write; I wanted to go out.

sentences.chinese: 我想回到那个安全的地方，我想回去找老南。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng huídào nà gè ānquán de dìfāng, wǒ xiǎng huíqù zhǎo Lǎo Nán.
sentences.english: I wanted to return to that safe place; I wanted to go back to find Lao Nan.

sentences.chinese: 但我忘记了，老南不见了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ wàngle, Lǎo Nán bùjiàn le.
sentences.english: But I forgot that Lao Nan had disappeared.

sentences.chinese: 我不能忘记老南，我必须找到他。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bùnéng wàngjì Lǎo Nán, wǒ bìxū zhǎodào tā.
sentences.english: I cannot forget Lao Nan; I must find him.

sentences.chinese: 白先生说：“现在是下班时间，人们都在开车回家。”
sentences.pinyin: Bái xiānsheng shuō: “Xiànzài shì xiàbān shíjiān, rénmen dōu zài kāichē huíjiā.”
sentences.english: Mr. Bai said, "It is now time to get off work; people are all driving home."

sentences.chinese: 他看着窗外，看到很多车在走。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe chuāngwài, kàndào hěnduō chē zài zǒu.
sentences.english: He looked out the window and saw many cars passing by.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“如果现在是放假，或者学生们放学，这里会有更多人。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Rúguǒ xiànzài shì fàngjià, huòzhě xuéshēngmen fàngxué, zhèlǐ huì yǒu gèng duō rén.”
sentences.english: He said, "If it were a holiday now, or if students were being dismissed from school, there would be more people here."

sentences.chinese: 但现在这里只有我们三个。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiànzài zhèlǐ zhǐyǒu wǒmen sān gè.
sentences.english: But now there are only the three of us here.

sentences.chinese: 我突然听到一个声音，有人在唱歌。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tūrán tīngdào yī gè shēngyīn, yǒurén zài chànggē.
sentences.english: Suddenly, I heard a sound; someone was singing a song.

sentences.chinese: 那个声音很奇怪，像是一个生病的人在唱歌。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè shēngyīn hěn qíguài, xiàng shì yī gè shēngbìng de rén zài chànggē.
sentences.english: That voice was very strange, like a sick person singing.

sentences.chinese: 我听见那个声音越来越近。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tīngjiàn nà gè shēngyīn yuè lái yuè jìn.
sentences.english: I heard the voice getting closer and closer.

sentences.chinese: 我感到很害怕，我的心跳很快，我不能睡觉。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gǎndào hěn hàipà, wǒ de xīntiào hěn kuài, wǒ bùnéng shuìjiào.
sentences.english: I felt very afraid; my heart was beating fast, and I couldn't sleep.

sentences.chinese: 我不能在这里睡，因为我不能休息。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bùnéng zài zhèlǐ shuì, yīnwèi wǒ bùnéng xiūxi.
sentences.english: I couldn't sleep here because I couldn't rest.

sentences.chinese: 我记得地图上有一个红色的点。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jìde dìtú shàng yǒu yī gè hóngsè de diǎn.
sentences.english: I remembered there was a red dot on the map.

sentences.chinese: 我突然跑向那个女人，想拿走地图。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tūrán pǎo xiàng nà gè nǚrén, xiǎng názǒu dìtú.
sentences.english: I suddenly ran toward the woman, wanting to take the map.

sentences.chinese: 我像一只鸟一样飞快地跑过去。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiàng yī zhī niǎo yīyàng fēikuài de pǎo guòqù.
sentences.english: I ran over as fast as a bird flies.

sentences.chinese: 她大喊一声，把我推倒在地上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dà hǎn yī shēng, bǎ wǒ tuīdǎo zài dìshàng.
sentences.english: She let out a loud scream and pushed me to the ground.

sentences.chinese: 她冷冷地说：“你以为你能逃走吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā lěnglěng de shuō: “Nǐ yǐwéi nǐ néng táozǒu ma?”
sentences.english: She said coldly, "Do you think you can escape?"

sentences.chinese: 她指着门外，说：“你现在下车，就永远不能回来。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐzhe ménwài, shuō: “Nǐ xiànzài xiàchē, jiù yǒngyuǎn bùnéng huílái.”
sentences.english: She pointed outside the door and said, "If you get out of the car now, you can never come back."

sentences.chinese: 我看着她，我想知道她为什么这么凶。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe tā, wǒ xiǎng zhīdào tā wèishéme zhème xiōng.
sentences.english: I looked at her, wondering why she was so fierce.

sentences.chinese: 我尝试再次跑出去，但白先生挡住了我。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ chángshì zàicì pǎo chūqù, dàn Bái xiānsheng dǎngzhù le wǒ.
sentences.english: I tried to run out again, but Mr. Bai blocked me.

sentences.chinese: 他对我说：“游戏还没结束，你必须留在这里。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì wǒ shuō: “Yóuxì hái méi jiéshù, nǐ bìxū liú zài zhèlǐ.”
sentences.english: He said to me, "The game is not over yet; you must stay here."

sentences.chinese: 我看着窗外的雨，感到绝望。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe chuāngwài de yǔ, gǎndào juéwàng.
sentences.english: I looked at the rain outside the window and felt despair.

sentences.chinese: 突然，地图上的红色点开始发光。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, dìtú shàng de hóngsè diǎn kāishǐ fāguāng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the red dot on the map began to glow.

sentences.chinese: 红色点在发光，它像一个眼睛看着我。
sentences.pinyin: Hóng sè diǎn zài fā guāng, tā xiàng yī gè yǎn jīng kàn zhe wǒ.
sentences.english: The red dot was glowing; it was like an eye watching me.

sentences.chinese: 我看着地图，地图中间有一个小路口。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe dì tú, dì tú zhōng jiān yǒu yī gè xiǎo lù kǒu.
sentences.english: I looked at the map; there was a small intersection in the middle of the map.

sentences.chinese: 现在，我必须离开这里。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài, wǒ bì xū lí kāi zhè lǐ.
sentences.english: Now, I must leave this place.

sentences.chinese: 白先生正在看着我，他的眼睛很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Bái xiān sheng zhèng zài kàn zhe wǒ, tā de yǎn jīng hěn lěng.
sentences.english: Mr. Bai was watching me, his eyes were very cold.

sentences.chinese: 他对我笑了，那个笑容跟死神一样。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì wǒ xiào le, nà gè xiào róng gēn sǐ shén yī yàng.
sentences.english: He smiled at me, and that smile was just like the Grim Reaper.

sentences.chinese: 我先看了一下窗外，现在是下午，但天很黑。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiān kàn le yī xià chuāng wài, xiàn zài shì xià wǔ, dàn tiān hěn hēi.
sentences.english: I first looked out the window; it was afternoon now, but the sky was very dark.

sentences.chinese: 我记得今天中午，我在这里见到了那个女人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jì dé jīn tiān zhōng wǔ, wǒ zài zhè lǐ jiàn dào le nà gè nǚ rén.
sentences.english: I remember that today at noon, I met that woman here.

sentences.chinese: 从中午到下午，我已经在这里待了半天。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng zhōng wǔ dào xià wǔ, wǒ yǐ jīng zài zhè lǐ dāi le bàn tiān.
sentences.english: From noon to afternoon, I had already stayed here for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 我的身体在发抖，我觉得很不舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de shēn tǐ zài fā dǒu, wǒ jué dé hěn bù shū fú.
sentences.english: My body was shaking; I felt very uncomfortable.

sentences.chinese: 我看着地上，那里有一把小钥匙。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe dì shang, nà lǐ yǒu yī bǎ xiǎo yào shi.
sentences.english: I looked at the ground; there was a small key there.

sentences.chinese: 我快步走过去，把钥匙拿在身上。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kuài bù zǒu guò qù, bǎ yào shi ná zài shēn shang.
sentences.english: I walked quickly over and kept the key on my person.

sentences.chinese: 我不能在这里等，因为时间不多了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bù néng zài zhè lǐ děng, yīn wèi shí jiān bù duō le.
sentences.english: I cannot wait here because time is running out.

sentences.chinese: 我必须在晚上之前离开这个房间。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bì xū zài wǎn shang zhī qián lí kāi zhè gè fáng jiān.
sentences.english: I must leave this room before evening.

sentences.chinese: 我想起白先生说，白天这里很安全，但那是谎言。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐ Bái xiān sheng shuō, bái tiān zhè lǐ hěn ān quán, dàn nà shì huǎng yán.
sentences.english: I recalled Mr. Bai saying that it is safe here during the day, but that was a lie.

sentences.chinese: 我尝试从两个人的中间进到门外。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ cháng shì cóng liǎng gè rén de zhōng jiān jìn dào mén wài.
sentences.english: I tried to move between the two people and go outside the door.

sentences.chinese: 我跑向门前，心跳得非常快。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ pǎo xiàng mén qián, xīn tiào dé fēi cháng kuài.
sentences.english: I ran toward the front of the door, my heart beating very fast.

sentences.chinese: 这一次，我不能再失败。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè yī cì, wǒ bù néng zài shī bài.
sentences.english: This time, I cannot fail again.

sentences.chinese: 我跑到了路口，发现这里有很多人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ pǎo dào le lù kǒu, fā xiàn zhè lǐ yǒu hěn duō rén.
sentences.english: I ran to the intersection and found that there were many people here.

sentences.chinese: 但我发现，这些人的脸都一样，没有眼睛。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ fā xiàn, zhè xiē rén de liǎn dōu yī yàng, méi yǒu yǎn jīng.
sentences.english: But I discovered that these people's faces were all the same; they had no eyes.

sentences.chinese: 我害怕地看着他们，他们正一起向我走来。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hài pà de kàn zhe tā men, tā men zhèng yī qǐ xiàng wǒ zǒu lái.
sentences.english: I looked at them in fear as they walked toward me together.

sentences.chinese: 我跑在路上，感觉有人在跟在我后面。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ pǎo zài lù shang, gǎn jué yǒu rén zài gēn zài wǒ hòu miàn.
sentences.english: I ran on the road, feeling someone following closely behind me.

sentences.chinese: 我突然想到，那个女人的国籍是日日，她来自日本。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tū rán xiǎng dào, nà gè nǚ rén de guó jí shì Rì, tā lái zì Rì běn.
sentences.english: I suddenly thought that the woman's nationality was Japanese; she came from Japan.

sentences.chinese: 而且，白先生可能来自比，也就是比利时。
sentences.pinyin: Ér qiě, Bái xiān sheng kě néng lái zì Bǐ, yě jiù shì Bǐ lì shí.
sentences.english: And Mr. Bai might be from Belgium.

sentences.chinese: 他们为什么要把我关在这一间小房子里？
sentences.pinyin: Tā men wèi shén me yào bǎ wǒ guān zài zhè yī jiān xiǎo fáng zi lǐ?
sentences.english: Why did they lock me in this small room?

sentences.chinese: 我跑了一会儿，终于看到了一道光。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ pǎo le yī huì r, zhōng yú kàn dào le yī dào guāng.
sentences.english: I ran for a while and finally saw a light.

sentences.chinese: 那是我想去的那个地方。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì wǒ xiǎng qù de nà gè dì fang.
sentences.english: That was the place I wanted to go.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这个时候，一个黑色的影子出现在我面前。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè gè shí hou, yī gè hēi sè de yǐng zi chū xiàn zài wǒ miàn qián.
sentences.english: But right at this moment, a black shadow appeared in front of me.

sentences.chinese: 那是老南吗？还是另一个陷阱？
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì Lǎo Nán ma? Hái shì lìng yī gè xiàn jǐng?
sentences.english: Was that Lao Nan? Or another trap?

sentences.chinese: 他对我做了一个手势，像是在说：“快走！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì wǒ zuò le yī gè shǒu shì, xiàng shì zài shuō: “Kuài zǒu!”
sentences.english: He made a gesture to me, as if saying, "Go quickly!"

sentences.chinese: 我看着他，不知道该不该相信他。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe tā, bù zhī dào gāi bù gāi xiāng xìn tā.
sentences.english: I looked at him, not knowing if I should believe him.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他大喊一声：“快走，他们来了！”
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, tā dà hǎn yī shēng: “Kuài zǒu, tā men lái le!”
sentences.english: Suddenly, he shouted, "Go quickly, they are coming!"

sentences.chinese: 我看着那个黑色的影子，那是老南。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe nàge hēisè de yǐngzi, nà shì Lǎo Nán.
sentences.english: I looked at that black shadow; it was Lao Nan.

sentences.chinese: 他对我大喊：“快走！快上车！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì wǒ dà hǎn: “Kuài zǒu! Kuài shàng chē!”
sentences.english: He shouted at me: "Go quickly! Get in the car!"

sentences.chinese: 我赶紧跑过去，跳上车。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gǎnjǐn pǎo guòqù, tiào shàng chē.
sentences.english: I hurried over and jumped into the car.

sentences.chinese: 车上有一个人，他姓新。
sentences.pinyin: Chē shàng yǒu yīgè rén, tā xìng Xīn.
sentences.english: There was a person in the car; his surname was Xin.

sentences.chinese: 新先生看着我，他的笑很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiānshēng kànzhe wǒ, tā de xiào hěn qíguài.
sentences.english: Mr. Xin looked at me; his smile was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你终于来了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ zhōngyú lái le.”
sentences.english: He said, "You've finally arrived."

sentences.chinese: 我问他：“老南在哪里？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Lǎo Nán zài nǎlǐ?”
sentences.english: I asked him, "Where is Lao Nan?"

sentences.chinese: 新先生没有说话，他只是指了指前方。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiānshēng méiyǒu shuōhuà, tā zhǐshì zhǐ le zhǐ qiánfāng.
sentences.english: Mr. Xin didn't speak; he just pointed ahead.

sentences.chinese: 我们来到一个很大的房子前面。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen láidào yīgè hěn dà de fángzi qiánmiàn.
sentences.english: We arrived in front of a very large building.

sentences.chinese: 这里像是一个电影院，门口在卖门票。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ xiàng shì yīgè diànyǐngyuàn, ménkǒu zài mài ménpiào.
sentences.english: It looked like a cinema; they were selling tickets at the door.

sentences.chinese: 新先生对我说：“我们必须进去。”
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiānshēng duì wǒ shuō: “Wǒmen bìxū jìnqù.”
sentences.english: Mr. Xin said to me, "We must go in."

sentences.chinese: 我们走进了房子里边。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zǒu jìn le fángzi lǐbian.
sentences.english: We walked inside the building.

sentences.chinese: 楼下没有人，只有一台旧的电视机在响。
sentences.pinyin: Lóuxià méiyǒu rén, zhǐyǒu yī tái jiù de diànshìjī zài xiǎng.
sentences.english: There was no one downstairs, only an old television set making noise.

sentences.chinese: 电视机的声音不好听，像是在哭。
sentences.pinyin: Diànshìjī de shēngyīn bù hǎotīng, xiàng shì zài kū.
sentences.english: The sound of the television was not pleasant to hear; it sounded like crying.

sentences.chinese: 我听到楼上有声音，有人在喊我的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tīngdào lóushàng yǒu shēngyīn, yǒurén zài hǎn wǒ de míngzi.
sentences.english: I heard a sound upstairs; someone was calling my name.

sentences.chinese: 新先生对我说：“请问，您听到声音了吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiānshēng duì wǒ shuō: “Qǐngwèn, nín tīngdào shēngyīn le ma?”
sentences.english: Mr. Xin said to me, "Excuse me, have you heard the sound?"

sentences.chinese: 我点头说：“听到了。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ diǎntóu shuō: “Tīngdào le.”
sentences.english: I nodded and said, "I heard it."

sentences.chinese: 他对我轻声说：“快，跟我来。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì wǒ qīngshēng shuō: “Kuài, gēn wǒ lái.”
sentences.english: He whispered to me, "Quick, follow me."

sentences.chinese: 我们跑上楼，来到一个房间门口。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen pǎo shàng lóu, láidào yīgè fángjiān ménkǒu.
sentences.english: We ran upstairs and came to the door of a room.

sentences.chinese: 新先生推开门说：“请进。”
sentences.pinyin: Xīn xiānshēng tuīkāi mén shuō: “Qǐng jìn.”
sentences.english: Mr. Xin pushed open the door and said, "Please come in."

sentences.chinese: 我走进房间，看到百先生坐在椅子上。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǒu jìn fángjiān, kàndào Bǎi xiānshēng zuò zài yǐzi shàng.
sentences.english: I entered the room and saw Mr. Bai sitting in a chair.

sentences.chinese: 百先生冷冷地说：“请坐。”
sentences.pinyin: Bǎi xiānshēng lěnglěng de shuō: “Qǐng zuò.”
sentences.english: Mr. Bai said coldly, "Please have a seat."

sentences.chinese: 他看着我，像是在看一个死人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe wǒ, xiàng shì zài kàn yīgè sǐrén.
sentences.english: He looked at me as if he were looking at a dead person.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你不能请假，你必须参加最后的游戏。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ bùnéng qǐngjià, nǐ bìxū cānjiā zuìhòu de yóuxì.”
sentences.english: He said, "You cannot request leave; you must participate in the final game."

sentences.chinese: 我突然想打电话给警察，但我的手机不见了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tūrán xiǎng dǎ diànhuà gěi jǐngchá, dàn wǒ de shǒujī bùjiàn le.
sentences.english: I suddenly wanted to make a phone call to the police, but my phone was gone.

sentences.chinese: 这时，我看到桌子上有一张车票。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, wǒ kàndào zhuōzi shàng yǒu yī zhāng chēpiào.
sentences.english: At that moment, I saw a ticket on the table.

sentences.chinese: 那是离开这里的唯一机会。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì líkāi zhèlǐ de wéiyī jīhuì.
sentences.english: That was the only chance to leave this place.

sentences.chinese: 但我听到门外有很多人在走过来。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ tīngdào ménwài yǒu hěnduō rén zài zǒu guòlái.
sentences.english: But I heard many people walking toward the door.

sentences.chinese: 他们就在门外，就在这个房间的外面。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen jiù zài ménwài, jiù zài zhège fángjiān de wàimiàn.
sentences.english: They were right outside the door, right outside this room.

sentences.chinese: 百先生笑了，他说：“游戏快结束了。”
sentences.pinyin: Bǎi xiānshēng xiào le, tā shuō: “Yóuxì kuài jiéshù le.”
sentences.english: Mr. Bai smiled and said, "The game is almost over."

sentences.chinese: 我快步走到桌子旁边，抓住了那张车票。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kuài bù zǒu dào zhuō zi páng biān, zhuā zhù le nà zhāng chē piào.
sentences.english: I quickly walked to the table and grabbed the ticket.

sentences.chinese: 这张票非常重要，因为它是离开这里的唯一机会。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng piào fēi cháng zhòng yào, yīn wèi tā shì lí kāi zhè lǐ de wéi yī jī huì.
sentences.english: This ticket is extremely important because it is the only chance to leave this place.

sentences.chinese: 但我看到桌子上还有一个本子。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ kàn dào zhuō zi shàng hái yǒu yī gè běn zi.
sentences.english: But I saw there was also a notebook on the table.

sentences.chinese: 那个本子很干净，上面写着很多名字。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè běn zi hěn gān jìng, shàng miàn xiě zhe hěn duō míng zi.
sentences.english: That notebook was very clean, and many names were written on it.

sentences.chinese: 我认真地看着，发现一个名字叫能先生。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ rèn zhēn de kàn zhe, fā xiàn yī gè míng zi jiào Néng xiān sheng.
sentences.english: I looked seriously and found a name called Mr. Neng.

sentences.chinese: 能先生是一个有名的人，但现在他不见了。
sentences.pinyin: Néng xiān sheng shì yī gè yǒu míng de rén, dàn xiàn zài tā bù jiàn le.
sentences.english: Mr. Neng is a famous person, but now he is gone.

sentences.chinese: 我真的不明白，为什么这些人要对我做这些事。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhēn de bù míng bai, wèi shén me zhè xiē rén yào duì wǒ zuò zhè xiē shì.
sentences.english: I really don't understand why these people would do these things to me.

sentences.chinese: 门外的声音越来越大，太可怕了。
sentences.pinyin: Mén wài de shēng yīn yuè lái yuè dà, tài kě pà le.
sentences.english: The noise outside the door grew louder and louder; it was too terrifying.

sentences.chinese: 我马上听到有人在喊：“他在哪儿？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ mǎ shàng tīng dào yǒu rén zài hǎn: “Tā zài nǎ r?”
sentences.english: I immediately heard someone shouting, "Where is he?"

sentences.chinese: 我心跳很快，我必须快点跑。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xīn tiào hěn kuài, wǒ bì xū kuài diǎn pǎo.

sentences.english: Mr. Shan and Mr. Zuo are laughing.

sentences.chinese: 常先生和年先生在说话。
sentences.pinyin: Cháng xiān sheng hé Nián xiān sheng zài shuō huà.
sentences.english: Mr. Chang and Mr. Nian are talking.

sentences.chinese: 教先生和楼先生在写字。
sentences.pinyin: Jiào xiān sheng hé Lóu xiān sheng zài xiě zì.
sentences.english: Mr. Jiao and Mr. Lou are writing.

sentences.chinese: 毛先生和水先生在看窗外。
sentences.pinyin: Máo xiān sheng hé Shuǐ xiān sheng zài kàn chuāng wài.
sentences.english: Mr. Mao and Mr. Shui are looking out the window.

sentences.chinese: 班先生和白先生在听音乐。
sentences.pinyin: Bān xiān sheng hé Bái xiān sheng zài tīng yīn yuè.
sentences.english: Mr. Ban and Mr. Bai are listening to music.

sentences.chinese: 百先生和能先生在喝咖啡。
sentences.pinyin: Bǎi xiān sheng hé Néng xiān sheng zài hē kā fēi.
sentences.english: Mr. Bai (Hundred) and Mr. Neng are drinking coffee.

sentences.chinese: 花先生和路先生在看报纸。
sentences.pinyin: Huā xiān sheng hé Lù xiān sheng zài kàn bào zhǐ.
sentences.english: Mr. Hua and Mr. Lu are reading newspapers.

sentences.chinese: 车先生和过先生在讨论天气。
sentences.pinyin: Chē xiān sheng hé Guò xiān sheng zài tǎo lùn tiān qì.
sentences.english: Mr. Che and Mr. Guo (Pass) are discussing the weather.

sentences.chinese: 还先生和那先生在看地图。
sentences.pinyin: Huán xiān sheng hé Nā xiān sheng zài kàn dì tú.
sentences.english: Mr. Huan and Mr. Na are looking at a map.

sentences.chinese: 都先生和钱先生在数钱。
sentences.pinyin: Dū xiān sheng hé Qián xiān sheng zài shǔ qián.
sentences.english: Mr. Du and Mr. Qian are counting money.

sentences.chinese: 错先生和门先生在门口说话。
sentences.pinyin: Cuò xiān sheng hé Mén xiān sheng zài mén kǒu shuō huà.
sentences.english: Mr. Cuo and Mr. Men are talking at the door.

sentences.chinese: 高先生是这个咖啡馆的新客人。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng shì zhè gè kā fēi guǎn de xīn kè rén.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao is a new guest at this coffee shop.

sentences.chinese: 高先生长得很帅，眼睛很大。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng zhǎng de hěn shuài, yǎn jīng hěn dà.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao is very handsome with big eyes.

sentences.chinese: 他走进门，看到三先生在微笑。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu jìn mén, kàn dào Sān xiān sheng zài wēi xiào.
sentences.english: He walked through the door and saw Mr. San smiling.

sentences.chinese: 高先生觉得这里很温暖。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng jué de zhè lǐ hěn wēn nuǎn.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao felt it was very warm here.

sentences.chinese: 但是，他发现自己丢了钱包。
sentences.pinyin: Dan shì, tā fā xiàn zì jǐ diū le qián bāo.
sentences.english: However, he discovered that he had lost his wallet.

sentences.chinese: 他没有钱买咖啡。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méi yǒu qián mǎi kā fēi.
sentences.english: He had no money to buy coffee.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得很尴尬，脸红了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué de hěn gān gà, liǎn hóng le.
sentences.english: He felt very embarrassed, and his face turned red.

sentences.chinese: 三先生看到了，走过来对他说话。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kàn dào le, zǒu guò lái duì tā shuō huà.
sentences.english: Mr. San saw this and walked over to speak to him.

sentences.chinese: 三先生说：“没关系，今天我请你。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng shuō: “Méi guān xi, jīn tiān wǒ qǐng nǐ.”
sentences.english: Mr. San said, "It's okay, I'll treat you today."

sentences.chinese: 高先生很惊讶，他没有见过这么好的人。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng hěn jīng yà, tā méi yǒu jiàn guò zhè me hǎo de rén.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao was very surprised; he had never met such a kind person.

sentences.chinese: 他们开始聊天，发现彼此有很多共同点。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men kāi shǐ liáo tiān, fā xiàn bǐ cǐ hěn duō gòng tóng diǎn.
sentences.english: They began to chat and found they had many things in common.

sentences.chinese: 窗外下起了大雨，他们无法离开。
sentences.pinyin: Chuāng wài xià qǐ le dà yǔ, tā men wú fǎ lí kāi.
sentences.english: It started to rain heavily outside, and they could not leave.

sentences.chinese: 在这个小小的空间里，一种奇妙的感觉开始了。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè gè xiǎo xiǎo de kōng jiān lǐ, yī zhǒng qí miào de gǎn jué kāi shǐ le.
sentences.english: In this small space, a wonderful feeling began.

sentences.chinese: 高先生看着三先生，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng kàn zhe Sān xiān sheng, xīn tiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao looked at Mr. San, and his heart beat fast.

sentences.chinese: 他不知道这个下午会改变他的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zhī dào zhè gè xià wǔ huì gǎi biàn tā de shēng huó.
sentences.english: He didn't know that this afternoon would change his life.

sentences.chinese: 突然，三先生接了一个电话，脸色变了。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, Sān xiān sheng jiē le yī gè diàn huà, liǎn sè biàn le.
sentences.english: Suddenly, Mr. San answered a phone call, and his expression changed.

sentences.chinese: 三先生挂了电话，他的脸很沉重。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng guà le diàn huà, tā de liǎn hěn chóng zhòng.
sentences.english: Mr. San hung up the phone, his face was very heavy.

sentences.chinese: 高先生觉得他很不安。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng jué de tā hěn bù ān.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao felt that he was very uneasy.

sentences.chinese: 窗外还在下雨，雨很大。
sentences.pinyin: Chuāng wài hái zài xià yǔ, yǔ hěn dà.
sentences.english: It was still raining outside, and the rain was heavy.

sentences.chinese: 三先生说：“对不起，我必须现在回去。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng shuō: “Duì bù qǐ, wǒ bì xū xiàn zài huí qu.”
sentences.english: Mr. San said, "I'm sorry, I must go back now."

sentences.chinese: 高先生问：“你要去哪里？”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng wèn: “Nǐ yào qù nǎ lǐ?”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao asked, "Where are you going?"

sentences.chinese: 三先生说：“我的朋友生病了，他住在这个城市的车站附近。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng shuō: “Wǒ de péng you shēng bìng le, tā zhù zài zhè ge chéng shì de chē zhàn fù jìn.”
sentences.english: Mr. San said, "My friend has fallen ill, he lives near the station of this city."

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这个病很严重。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué de zhè ge bìng hěn yán zhòng.
sentences.english: He felt that this illness was very serious.

sentences.chinese: 高先生说：“我可以陪你走。”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng shuō: “Wǒ kě yǐ péi nǐ zǒu.”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao said, "I can walk with you."

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着他，记得高先生是一个好人。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kàn zhe tā, jì de Gāo xiān sheng shì yī gè hǎo rén.
sentences.english: Mr. San looked at him, remembering that Mr. Gao was a good person.

sentences.chinese: 他们走出咖啡店，来到街上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zǒu chū kā fēi diàn, lái dào jiē shàng.
sentences.english: They walked out of the coffee shop and arrived on the street.

sentences.chinese: 因为雨太大，他们不能走路，只能坐车。
sentences.pinyin: Yīn wèi yǔ tài dà, tā men bù néng zǒu lù, zhǐ néng zuò chē.
sentences.english: Because the rain was too heavy, they could not walk on foot, they could only take a car.

sentences.chinese: 三先生在车站等车，他站得很久。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng zài chē zhàn děng chē, tā zhàn de hěn jiǔ.
sentences.english: Mr. San waited for the car at the station, he stood for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 车来了，他们坐上了车。
sentences.pinyin: Chē lái le, tā men zuò shàng le chē.
sentences.english: The car came, and they got on.

sentences.chinese: 在车上，三先生很安静，像是在记一些事情。
sentences.pinyin: Zài chē shàng, Sān xiān sheng hěn ān jìng, xiàng shì zài jì yī xiē shì qing.
sentences.english: In the car, Mr. San was very quiet, as if he were recording some things.

sentences.chinese: 高先生想问，但他忘记了怎么开口。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng xiǎng wèn, dàn tā wàng jì le zěn me kāi kǒu.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao wanted to ask, but he forgot how to start.

sentences.chinese: 他不想让三先生忘记这个下午的相遇。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎng ràng Sān xiān sheng wàng jì zhè ge xià wǔ de xiāng yù.
sentences.english: He didn't want Mr. San to forget this afternoon's meeting.

sentences.chinese: 三先生突然说：“我下班后通常直接回家。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng tū rán shuō: “Wǒ xià bān hòu tōng cháng zhí jiē huí jiā.”
sentences.english: Mr. San suddenly said, "I usually go home directly after finishing work."

sentences.chinese: “今天我没有休息，因为我心不在焉。”
sentences.pinyin: “Jīn tiān wǒ méi yǒu xiū xi, yīn wèi wǒ xīn bù zài yān.”
sentences.english: "I didn't have a rest today because my mind was elsewhere."

sentences.chinese: 高先生笑了，觉得三先生很可爱。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng xiào le, jué de Sān xiān sheng hěn kě ài.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao smiled, thinking Mr. San was very cute.

sentences.chinese: 车到了车站，他们下车了。
sentences.pinyin: Chē dào le chē zhàn, tā men xià chē le.
sentences.english: The car arrived at the station, and they got off.

sentences.chinese: 三先生跑向一个小房子。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng pǎo xiàng yī gè xiǎo fáng zi.
sentences.english: Mr. San ran toward a small house.

sentences.chinese: 高先生跟着他走，心中有一种奇怪的感觉。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng gēn zhe tā zǒu, xīn zhōng yǒu yī zhǒng qí guài de gǎn jué.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao followed him, feeling a strange sensation in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 三先生回到房子里，对高先生说：“请坐下。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng huí dào fáng zi lǐ, duì Gāo xiān sheng shuō: “Qǐng zuò xia.”
sentences.english: Mr. San returned to the house and said to Mr. Gao, "Please sit down."

sentences.chinese: 房间里很安静，只有少少的光。
sentences.pinyin: Fáng jiān lǐ hěn ān jìng, zhǐ yǒu shǎo shǎo de guāng.
sentences.english: The room was very quiet, with only a little light.

sentences.chinese: 三先生说：“我的朋友来自日本，他现在不能睡觉。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng shuō: “Wǒ de péng you lái zì Rì běn, tā xiàn zài bù néng shuì jiào.”
sentences.english: Mr. San said, "My friend is from Japan, he cannot sleep right now."

sentences.chinese: “他需要有人陪他，直到医生回来。”
sentences.pinyin: “Tā xū yào yǒu rén péi tā, zhí dào yī shēng huí lái.”
sentences.english: "He needs someone to accompany him until the doctor comes back."

sentences.chinese: 高先生看着三先生，觉得他很温柔。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng kàn zhe Sān xiān sheng, jué de tā hěn wēn róu.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao looked at Mr. San and felt that he was very gentle.

sentences.chinese: 三先生说：“谢谢你来这里。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng shuō: “Xiè xie nǐ lái zhè lǐ.”
sentences.english: Mr. San said, "Thank you for coming here."

sentences.chinese: 高先生想，他希望这次相遇不是一次性的，而是会重演。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng xiǎng, tā xī wàng zhè cì xiāng yù bú shì yī cì xìng de, ér shì huì chóng yǎn.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao thought that he hoped this meeting was not a one-time thing, but would repeat.

sentences.chinese: 他不想忘记这个人的眼睛。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎng wàng zhè ge rén de yǎn jing.
sentences.english: He didn't want to forget this person's eyes.

sentences.chinese: 突然，房间里的电话又响了，三先生再次脸色大变。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, fáng jiān lǐ de diàn huà yòu xiǎng le, Sān xiān sheng zài cì liǎn sè dà biàn.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the phone in the room rang again, and Mr. San's expression changed drastically once more.

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着电话，脸色很不好。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kàn zhe diàn huà, liǎn sè hěn bù hǎo.
sentences.english: Mr. San looked at the phone, his expression very poor.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉高先生，他必须现在去车站。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su gāo xiān sheng, tā bì xū xiàn zài qù chē zhàn.
sentences.english: He told Mr. Gao that he must go to the station right now.

sentences.chinese: 他的家人在北京，现在有急事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de jiā rén zài Běi jīng, xiàn zài yǒu jí shì.
sentences.english: His family is in Beijing, and there is an emergency now.

sentences.chinese: 三先生在桌子上找到了他的钱包。
