sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng zài zhuō zi shàng zhǎo dào le tā de qián bāo.
sentences.english: Mr. San found his wallet on the table.

sentences.chinese: 他快步走到门口，看着外面的马路。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kuài bù zǒu dào mén kǒu, kàn zhe wài miàn de mǎ lù.
sentences.english: He walked quickly to the doorway and looked at the road outside.

sentences.chinese: 路口有很多汽车，天气还是很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Lù kǒu yǒu hěn duō qì chē, tiān qì hái shì hěn lěng.
sentences.english: There were many cars at the intersection, and the weather was still very cold.

sentences.chinese: 高先生觉得很担心，他想帮三先生。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng jué de hěn dān xīn, tā xiǎng bāng sān xiān sheng.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao felt very worried; he wanted to help Mr. San.

sentences.chinese: 三先生说：“对不起，我得快点走。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng shuō: “Duì bù qǐ, wǒ děi kuài diǎn zǒu.”
sentences.english: Mr. San said, "I'm sorry, I have to leave quickly."

sentences.chinese: 他拿出一张车票，那是去北京的票。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū yī zhāng chē piào, nà shì qù Běi jīng de piào.
sentences.english: He took out a train ticket; it was the ticket to Beijing.

sentences.chinese: 高先生问：“你住在什么样的房子里？”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng wèn: “Nǐ zhù zài shén me yàng de fáng zi lǐ?”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao asked, "What kind of house do you live in?"

sentences.chinese: 三先生笑了笑，说他小时候住在小学旁边的房子里。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng xiào le xiào, shuō tā xiǎo shí hou zhù zài xiǎo xué páng biān de fáng zi lǐ.
sentences.english: Mr. San smiled and said that when he was little, he lived in a house next to an elementary school.

sentences.chinese: 那时他经常在教学楼前面玩球。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shí tā jīng cháng zài jiào xué lóu qián miàn wán qiú.
sentences.english: At that time, he often played ball in front of the teaching building.

sentences.chinese: 现在，三先生必须离开这个城市。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài, sān xiān sheng bì xū lí kāi zhè ge chéng shì.
sentences.english: Now, Mr. San must leave this city.

sentences.chinese: 高先生想，他想在三先生走之前一起吃晚饭。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng xiǎng, tā xiǎng zài sān xiān sheng zǒu zhī qián yī qǐ chī wǎn fàn.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao thought he wanted to have dinner together before Mr. San left.

sentences.chinese: 但三先生没有时间，他必须去买机票。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn sān xiān sheng méi yǒu shí jiān, tā bì xū qù mǎi jī piào.
sentences.english: But Mr. San had no time; he had to go buy a plane ticket.

sentences.chinese: 他们走出房间，经过了一个小的商店。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zǒu chū fáng jiān, jīng guò le yī gè xiǎo de shāng diàn.
sentences.english: They walked out of the room and passed a small store.

sentences.chinese: 商店旁边是一个很大的商场。
sentences.pinyin: Shāng diàn páng biān shì yī gè hěn dà de shāng chǎng.
sentences.english: Next to the store was a very large shopping mall.

sentences.chinese: 三先生突然停下来，问高先生：“这里有书店吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng tū rán tíng xià lái, wèn gāo xiān sheng: “Zhè lǐ yǒu shū diàn ma?”
sentences.english: Mr. San suddenly stopped and asked Mr. Gao, "Is there a bookstore here?"

sentences.chinese: 高先生指了指前面的地点。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng zhǐ le zhǐ qián miàn de dì diǎn.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao pointed to the location ahead.

sentences.chinese: 三先生在书店买了一本书，想送给高先生。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng zài shū diàn mǎi le yī běn shū, xiǎng sòng gěi gāo xiān sheng.
sentences.english: Mr. San bought a book at the bookstore, wanting to give it to Mr. Gao.

sentences.chinese: 他把书放在高先生手中，轻声说：“下次见。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ shū fàng zài gāo xiān sheng shǒu zhōng, qīng shēng shuō: “Xià cì jiàn.”
sentences.english: He placed the book in Mr. Gao's hand and said softly, "See you next time."

sentences.chinese: 三先生走进了洗手间洗了把脸，让自己冷静下来。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng zǒu jìn le xǐ shǒu jiān xǐ le bǎ liǎn, ràng zì jǐ lěng jìng xià lái.
sentences.english: Mr. San went into the washroom to wash his face to calm himself down.

sentences.chinese: 他走出洗手间，看着手中的门票。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu chū xǐ shǒu jiān, kàn zhe shǒu zhōng de mén piào.
sentences.english: He walked out of the washroom and looked at the ticket in his hand.

sentences.chinese: 那是明天去电影院的门票，他原本想邀请高先生。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì míng tiān qù diàn yǐng yuàn de mén piào, tā yuán běn xiǎng yāo qǐng gāo xiān sheng.
sentences.english: It was a ticket for the cinema tomorrow; he had originally wanted to invite Mr. Gao.

sentences.chinese: 三先生想，他家里只有一台旧电脑和一台电视机。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng xiǎng, tā jiā lǐ zhǐ yǒu yī tái jiù diàn nǎo hé yī tái diàn shì jī.
sentences.english: Mr. San thought that at home, he only had an old computer and a television set.

sentences.chinese: 他并不喜欢那些东西，他更喜欢和高先生在一起。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìng bù xǐ huan nà xiē dōng xi, tā gèng xǐ huan hé gāo xiān sheng zài yī qǐ.
sentences.english: He didn't like those things; he preferred being with Mr. Gao.

sentences.chinese: 三先生走向车站，在候车大厅的第三行坐下。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng zǒu xiàng chē zhàn, zài hòu chē dà tīng de dì sān háng zuò xià.
sentences.english: Mr. San walked toward the station and sat down in the third row of the waiting hall.

sentences.chinese: 他看着窗外，心想这个城市的每一个路口都有高先生的身影。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe chuāng wài, xīn xiǎng zhè ge chéng shì de měi yī gè lù kǒu dōu yǒu gāo xiān sheng de shēn yǐng.
sentences.english: He looked out the window, thinking that every intersection in this city had Mr. Gao's silhouette.

sentences.chinese: 突然，三先生发现他弄丢了去北京的票。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, sān xiān sheng fā xiàn tā nòng diū le qù Běi jīng de piào.
sentences.english: Suddenly, Mr. San discovered he had lost the ticket to Beijing.

sentences.chinese: 他惊慌地在座位周围寻找，但票不见了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīng huāng de zài zuò wèi zhōu wéi xún zhǎo, dàn piào bù jiàn le.
sentences.english: He searched around the seat in a panic, but the ticket was gone.

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着空空的口袋，心里很慌。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kàn zhe kōng kōng de kǒu dài, xīn lǐ hěn huāng.
sentences.english: Mr. San looked at his empty pocket, feeling panicked.

sentences.chinese: 他没有票了，不能去北京。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méi yǒu piào le, bù néng qù Běi jīng.
sentences.english: He didn't have the ticket anymore; he couldn't go to Beijing.

sentences.chinese: 他想，这次的运气真的不大。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, zhè cì de yùn qi zhēn de bù dà.
sentences.english: He thought his luck this time was not very good.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他的手机响了，是高先生打来的。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, tā de shǒu jī xiǎng le, shì Gāo xiān sheng dǎ lái de.
sentences.english: Suddenly, his phone rang; it was Mr. Gao calling.

sentences.chinese: 三先生赶紧接电话，声音有点累。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng gǎn jǐn jiē diàn huà, shēng yīn yǒu diǎn lèi.
sentences.english: Mr. San quickly answered the phone, his voice sounding a bit tired.

sentences.chinese: “你是不是在车站？”高先生问。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ shì bù shì zài chē zhàn?” Gāo xiān sheng wèn.
sentences.english: "Are you at the station?" Mr. Gao asked.

sentences.chinese: 三先生说：“是的，我没找到我的票。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng shuō: “Shì de, wǒ méi zhǎo dào wǒ de piào.”
sentences.english: Mr. San said, "Yes, I haven't found my ticket."

sentences.chinese: 高先生笑了，声音像风一样温暖。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng xiào le, shēng yīn xiàng fēng yī yàng wēn nuǎn.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao smiled, his voice warm like the wind.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“没事儿，我刚才在座位上边看到了你的票。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Méi shì r, wǒ gāng cái zài zuò wèi shàng bian kàn dào le nǐ de piào.”
sentences.english: He said, "It's okay, I just saw your ticket on the seat above."

sentences.chinese: 三先生惊讶地问：“你怎么在这里？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng jīng yà de wèn: “Nǐ zěn me zài zhè lǐ?”
sentences.english: Mr. San asked in surprise, "How are you here?"

sentences.chinese: 高先生说：“我想再见你一次。”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng zài jiàn nǐ yī cì.”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao said, "I wanted to see you once more."

sentences.chinese: 三先生的心跳得很快，像零点钟的闹钟一样响。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng de xīn tiào de hěn kuài, xiàng líng diǎn zhōng de nào zhōng yī yàng xiǎng.
sentences.english: Mr. San's heart beat fast, ringing like an alarm clock at zero o'clock.

sentences.chinese: 高先生接着说：“我妹妹也在车站，她能帮你。”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng jiē zhe shuō: “Wǒ mèi mei yě zài chē zhàn, tā néng bāng nǐ.”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao continued, "My younger sister is also at the station; she can help you."

sentences.chinese: 三先生觉得没什么比这更开心了。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng jué de méi shén me bǐ zhè gèng kāi xīn le.
sentences.english: Mr. San felt that nothing was happier than this.

sentences.chinese: 高先生说：“你等我，我这就过来。”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng shuō: “Nǐ děng wǒ, wǒ jiù guò lái.”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao said, "Wait for me, I'll come over right now."

sentences.chinese: 三先生站了起来，看着门口。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng zhàn le qǐ lái, kàn zhe mén kǒu.
sentences.english: Mr. San stood up and looked toward the entrance.

sentences.chinese: 他想，后天他是不是可以和高先生一起吃饭？
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, hòu tiān tā shì bù shì kě yǐ hé Gāo xiān sheng yī qǐ chī fàn?
sentences.english: He wondered if he could have dinner with Mr. Gao the day after tomorrow?

sentences.chinese: 但现在，他只想看到那个人的眼睛。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiàn zài, tā zhǐ xiǎng kàn dào nà gè rén de yǎn jīng.
sentences.english: But right now, he only wanted to see that person's eyes.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个年轻的女孩走过来，手里拿着一张票。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, yī gè nián qīng de nǚ hái zǒu guò lái, shǒu lǐ ná zhe yī zhāng piào.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a young girl walked over, holding a ticket in her hand.

sentences.chinese: 女孩笑着说：“这是你的票。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ hái xiào zhe shuō: “Zhè shì nǐ de piào.”
sentences.english: The girl said with a smile, "This is your ticket."

sentences.chinese: 三先生接过票，对她说：“谢谢你。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng jiē guò piào, duì tā shuō: “Xiè xie nǐ.”
sentences.english: Mr. San took the ticket and said to her, "Thank you."

sentences.chinese: 女孩说：“不客气。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ hái shuō: “Bù kè qi.”
sentences.english: The girl said, "You're welcome."

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着票，现在是下午四点半。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kàn zhe piào, xiàn zài shì xià wǔ sì diǎn bàn.
sentences.english: Mr. San looked at the ticket; it was now four thirty in the afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 他想，他得在六点之前离开这里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, tā děi zài liù diǎn zhī qián lí kāi zhè lǐ.
sentences.english: He thought he had to leave this place before six o'clock.

sentences.chinese: 这时，高先生走进了房间。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, Gāo xiān sheng zǒu jìn le fáng jiān.
sentences.english: At that moment, Mr. Gao walked into the room.

sentences.chinese: 他看着三先生，笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe Sān xiān sheng, xiào le.
sentences.english: He looked at Mr. San and smiled.

sentences.chinese: 高先生说：“你们认识吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng shuō: “Nǐ men rèn shi ma?”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao asked, "Do you (plural) know each other?"

sentences.chinese: 三先生说：“不，她帮了我。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng shuō: “Bù, tā bāng le wǒ.”
sentences.english: Mr. San said, "No, she helped me."

sentences.chinese: 高先生对女孩点点头，然后看着三先生。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng duì nǚ hái diǎn diǎn tóu, rán hòu kàn zhe Sān xiān sheng.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao nodded to the girl and then looked at Mr. San.

sentences.chinese: 三先生觉得，自己的心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng jué de, zì jǐ de xīn tiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Mr. San felt his heart beating very fast.

sentences.chinese: 他想，他想和高先生多说几个字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, tā xiǎng hé Gāo xiān sheng duō shuō jǐ gè zì.
sentences.english: He thought he wanted to say a few more words to Mr. Gao.

sentences.chinese: 三先生说：“我想请你吃饭，下个星期二怎么样？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ chī fàn, xià gè xīng qī èr zěn me yàng?”
sentences.english: Mr. San said, "I would like to invite you to dinner; how about next Tuesday?"

sentences.chinese: 高先生想了想，说：“好，那我们约在七号。”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng xiǎng le xiǎng, shuō: “Hǎo, nà wǒ men yuē zài qī hào.”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao thought for a moment and said, "Okay, let's set it for the 7th."

sentences.chinese: 三先生很高兴，他想，从现在到七号还有八天。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng hěn gāo xìng, tā xiǎng, cóng xiàn zài dào qī hào hái yǒu bā tiān.
sentences.english: Mr. San was very happy; he thought there were eight days from now until the 7th.

sentences.chinese: 他计算着时间：五天，六天，七天，八天。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì suàn zhe shí jiān: wǔ tiān, liù tiān, qī tiān, bā tiān.
sentences.english: He counted the time: five days, six days, seven days, eight days.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这段时间太长了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué de zhè duàn shí jiān tài cháng le.
sentences.english: He felt this period of time was too long.

sentences.chinese: 他想，每天起床的时候，第一件事就是想高先生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, měi tiān qǐ chuáng de shí hou, dì yī jiàn shì jiù shì xiǎng Gāo xiān sheng.
sentences.english: He thought that every day when he got out of bed, the first thing would be thinking of Mr. Gao.

sentences.chinese: 他想，第二件事就是看日历。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, dì èr jiàn shì jiù shì kàn rì lì.
sentences.english: He thought the second thing would be looking at the calendar.

sentences.chinese: 他想，九点、十点，他都在想那个人的眼睛。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, jiǔ diǎn, shí diǎn, tā dōu zài xiǎng nà gè rén de yǎn jing.
sentences.english: He thought that at nine o'clock, ten o'clock, he was always thinking of that person's eyes.

sentences.chinese: 三先生想起他以前有一个网友，那个网友告诉他，爱情就是等待。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng xiǎng qǐ tā yǐ qián yǒu yī gè wǎng yǒu, nà gè wǎng yǒu gào su tā, ài qíng jiù shì děng dài.
sentences.english: Mr. San remembered he once had an online friend, and that online friend told him that love is waiting.

sentences.chinese: 现在他明白了，这种感觉是对的。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài tā míng bai le, zhè zhǒng gǎn jué shì duì de.
sentences.english: Now he understood that this feeling was right.

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着高先生，轻声说：“对不起，我刚才太紧张了。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kàn zhe Gāo xiān sheng, qīng shēng shuō: “Duì bù qǐ, wǒ gāng cái tài jǐn zhāng le.”
sentences.english: Mr. San looked at Mr. Gao and said softly, "I'm sorry, I was too nervous just now."

sentences.chinese: 高先生温柔地说：“没关系。”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng wēn róu de shuō: “Méi guān xi.”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao said gently, "It doesn't matter."

sentences.chinese: 两人的目光在空气中相遇，像一个小秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng rén de mù guāng zài kōng qì zhōng xiāng yù, xiàng yī gè xiǎo mì mì.
sentences.english: The gaze of the two people met in the air, like a small secret.

sentences.chinese: 三先生突然想起，他还没告诉高先生他的电话号码。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng tū rán xiǎng qǐ, tā hái méi gào su Gāo xiān sheng tā de diàn huà hào mǎ.
sentences.english: Mr. San suddenly remembered that he hadn't told Mr. Gao his phone number yet.

sentences.chinese: 他正要开口，手机突然响了，是一个陌生号码。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhèng yào kāi kǒu, shǒu jī tū rán xiǎng le, shì yī gè mò shēng hào mǎ.
sentences.english: Just as he was about to speak, the phone suddenly rang; it was a strange number.

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着手机，那个陌生号码让他很紧张。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kàn zhe shǒu jī, nà gè mò shēng hào mǎ ràng tā hěn jǐn zhāng.
sentences.english: Mr. San looked at the phone; that strange number made him very nervous.

sentences.chinese: 高先生笑了，他觉得三先生的样子很可爱。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng xiào le, tā jué de Sān xiān sheng de yàng zi hěn kě ài.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao smiled, feeling that Mr. San's manner was very cute.

sentences.chinese: 三先生终于说：“我想让你认识我的生活。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng zhōng yú shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng ràng nǐ rèn shi wǒ de shēng huó.”
sentences.english: Mr. San finally said, "I want you to get to know my life."

sentences.chinese: 他带着高先生走到了一个有名的学院门口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dài zhe Gāo xiān sheng zǒu dào le yí gè yǒu míng de xué yuàn mén kǒu.
sentences.english: He led Mr. Gao to the entrance of a famous college.

sentences.chinese: 这里是三先生以前上学的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ shì Sān xiān sheng yǐ qián shàng xué de dì fang.
sentences.english: This was the place where Mr. San used to go to school.

sentences.chinese: 三先生说：“我以前是一个大学生。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng shuō: “Wǒ yǐ qián shì yí gè dà xué shēng.”
sentences.english: Mr. San said, "I used to be a university student."

sentences.chinese: 高先生看着周围，这里的空气很干净。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng kàn zhe zhōu wéi, zhè lǐ de kōng qì hěn gān jìng.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao looked around; the air here was very clean.

sentences.chinese: 三先生指着一个男生说：“他是我以前的同学。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng zhǐ zhe yí gè nán shēng shuō: “Tā shì wǒ yǐ qián de tóng xué.”
sentences.english: Mr. San pointed to a boy and said, "He was my former classmate."

sentences.chinese: 那个男生手里拿着一个书包，里面有很多书。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè nán shēng shǒu lǐ ná zhe yí gè shū bāo, lǐ miàn yǒu hěn duō shū.
sentences.english: That boy was holding a schoolbag with many books inside.

sentences.chinese: 三先生告诉高先生，他在大学学习很多知识。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng gào su Gāo xiān sheng, tā zài dà xué xué xí hěn duō zhī shi.
sentences.english: Mr. San told Mr. Gao that he studied a lot of knowledge at the university.

sentences.chinese: 他记得那时候他每天认真地读书。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì de nà shí hou tā měi tiān rèn zhēn de dú shū.
sentences.english: He remembered that he read books earnestly every day back then.

sentences.chinese: 他每天早起上课，从不迟到。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎo qǐ shàng kè, cóng bù chí dào.
sentences.english: He went to class early every day and was never late.

sentences.chinese: 三先生拿出一个旧的本子，那是他的学习笔记。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng ná chū yí gè jiù de běn zi, nà shì tā de xué xí bǐ jì.
sentences.english: Mr. San took out an old notebook; it was his study notes.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“在这个本子里，我记住了很多重要的课。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zài zhè gè běn zi lǐ, wǒ jì zhù le hěn duō zhòng yào de kè.”
sentences.english: He said, "In this notebook, I remembered many important lessons."

sentences.chinese: 高先生看着本子，明白三先生是一个很认真的人。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng kàn zhe běn zi, míng bai Sān xiān sheng shì yí gè hěn rèn zhēn de rén.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao looked at the notebook and understood that Mr. San was a very conscientious person.

sentences.chinese: 三先生说：“在学院里，男生和女生一起学习。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng shuō: “Zài xué yuàn lǐ, nán shēng hé nǚ shēng yì qǐ xué xí.”
sentences.english: Mr. San said, "In the college, boys and girls study together."

sentences.chinese: 他记得那个时候，很多女生都觉得他很安静。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì de nà gè shí hou, hěn duō nǚ shēng dōu jué de tā hěn ān jìng.
sentences.english: He remembered that at that time, many girls thought he was very quiet.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“学习对我来说很重要。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Xué xí duì wǒ lái shuō hěn zhòng yào.”
sentences.english: He said, "Learning is very important to me."

sentences.chinese: 高先生问：“你最喜欢学什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng wèn: “Nǐ zuì xǐ huan xué shén me?”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao asked, "What do you like to learn most?"

sentences.chinese: 三先生微笑说：“我喜欢学习关于爱的东西。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng wēi xiào shuō: “Wǒ xǐ huan xué xí guān yú ài de dōng xi.”
sentences.english: Mr. San smiled and said, "I like learning things about love."

sentences.chinese: 突然，一阵风吹过，吹乱了高先生的头发。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, yí zhèn fēng chuī guò, chuī luàn le Gāo xiān sheng de tóu fa.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a gust of wind blew by, messing up Mr. Gao's hair.

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着他，觉得这个时刻比任何贵的东西都要珍贵。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kàn zhe tā, jué de zhè gè shí kè bǐ rèn hé guì de dōng xi dōu yào zhēn guì.
sentences.english: Mr. San looked at him, feeling that this moment was more precious than any expensive thing.

sentences.chinese: 高先生看着三先生，觉得他像一个纯洁的学生。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng kàn zhe Sān xiān sheng, jué de tā xiàng yí gè chún jié de xué sheng.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao looked at Mr. San, feeling that he was like a pure student.

sentences.chinese: 他们走在校园的小路上，聊着过去的事情。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zǒu zài xiào yuán de xiǎo lù shàng, liáo zhe guò qù de shì qing.
sentences.english: They walked on the small paths of the campus, chatting about the past.

sentences.chinese: 三先生想起他以前在宿舍的床边读书的夜晚。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng xiǎng qǐ tā yǐ qián zài sù shè de chuáng biān dú shū de yè wǎn.
sentences.english: Mr. San thought of the nights he spent reading by his bed in the dormitory.

sentences.chinese: 他想，现在的感觉比那时候好很多。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, xiàn zài de gǎn jué bǐ nà shí hou hǎo hěn duō.
sentences.english: He thought that the current feeling was much better than back then.

sentences.chinese: 他希望高先生能记住今天这个下午。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xī wàng Gāo xiān sheng néng jì zhù jīn tiān zhè gè xià wǔ.
sentences.english: He hoped Mr. Gao could remember this afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，三先生的手机再次响了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, Sān xiān sheng de shǒu jī zài cì xiǎng le.
sentences.english: Just then, Mr. San's phone rang again.

sentences.chinese: 这一次，电话那头传来一个急促的声音，三先生的脸色突然变得苍白。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè yí cì, diàn huà nà tóu chuán lái yí gè jí cù de shēng yīn, Sān xiān sheng de liǎn sè tū rán biàn de cāng bái.
sentences.english: This time, an urgent voice came from the other end of the phone, and Mr. San's face suddenly turned pale.

sentences.chinese: 三先生听完电话，感觉非常不对。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng tīng wán diàn huà, gǎn jué fēi cháng bù duì.
sentences.english: After finishing the phone call, Mr. San felt something was very wrong.

sentences.chinese: 他看着高先生，心里很不舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe Gāo xiān sheng, xīn lǐ hěn bù shū fu.
sentences.english: He looked at Mr. Gao, feeling very uncomfortable in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 电话里的声音说，他在国外的朋友出事了。
sentences.pinyin: Diàn huà lǐ de shēng yīn shuō, tā zài guó wài de péng you chū shì le.
sentences.english: The voice on the phone said that his friend abroad had encountered trouble.

sentences.chinese: 那个朋友在一个外国的地方工作，说的是外语。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge péng you zài yī gè wài guó de dì fāng gōng zuò, shuō de shì wài yǔ.
sentences.english: That friend worked in a foreign place and spoke a foreign language.

sentences.chinese: 三先生想，这件事太坏了。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng xiǎng, zhè jiàn shì tài huài le.
sentences.english: Mr. San thought, this matter was too bad.

sentences.chinese: 他现在必须先离开这个地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàn zài bì xū xiān lí kāi zhè ge dì fāng.
sentences.english: He must leave this place first now.

sentences.chinese: 他低头看，手机掉在地上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dī tóu kàn, shǒu jī diào zài dì shang.
sentences.english: He looked down and saw his phone had fallen on the ground.

sentences.chinese: 他赶紧把手机拿起来，发现电量不多了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎn jǐn bǎ shǒu jī ná qǐ lái, fā xiàn diàn liàng bù duō le.
sentences.english: He quickly picked up the phone and found the battery power was not much.

sentences.chinese: 他看着高先生，想说点别的，但是不知道说什么。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe Gāo xiān sheng, xiǎng shuō diǎn bié de, dàn shì bù zhī dào shuō shén me.
sentences.english: He looked at Mr. Gao and wanted to say something else, but didn't know what to say.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“对不起，我现在要去机场。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Duì bù qǐ, wǒ xiàn zài yào qù jī chǎng.”
sentences.english: He said, "I'm sorry, I have to go to the airport now."

sentences.chinese: 机场离这里非常远。
sentences.pinyin: Jī chǎng lí zhè lǐ fēi cháng yuǎn.
sentences.english: The airport was very far from here.

sentences.chinese: 高先生看着他，觉得三先生的样子很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng kàn zhe tā, jué de Sān xiān sheng de yàng zi hěn qí guài.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao looked at him and felt Mr. San's appearance was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 高先生问：“你还是想走吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng wèn: “Nǐ hái shi xiǎng zǒu ma?”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao asked, "Do you still want to leave?"

sentences.chinese: 三先生点头说：“是的，我必须走。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng diǎn tóu shuō: “Shì de, wǒ bì xū zǒu.”
sentences.english: Mr. San nodded and said, "Yes, I must leave."

sentences.chinese: 他想，也许以后他还会去国外，在那个地方找他的朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, yě xǔ yǐ hòu tā hái huì qù guó wài, zài nà ge dì fāng zhǎo tā de péng you.
sentences.english: He thought that perhaps in the future he would go abroad again to find his friend in that place.

sentences.chinese: 他不想让别人知道这个秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎng ràng bié ren zhī dào zhè ge mì mì.
sentences.english: He didn't want other people to know this secret.

sentences.chinese: 他想，现在是下午，但如果太晚，晚上就不好走。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, xiàn zài shì xià wǔ, dàn rú guǒ tài wǎn, wǎn shang jiù bù hǎo zǒu.
sentences.english: He thought it was afternoon now, but if it got too late, it would be hard to travel in the evening.

sentences.chinese: 他看着高先生，心里想：我还是非常喜欢他的眼睛。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe Gāo xiān sheng, xīn lǐ xiǎng: Wǒ hái shi fēi cháng xǐ huan tā de yǎn jīng.
sentences.english: He looked at Mr. Gao and thought: I still really like his eyes.

sentences.chinese: 他想告诉高先生，他还有很多话想说。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng gào su Gāo xiān sheng, tā hái yǒu hěn duō huà xiǎng shuō.
sentences.english: He wanted to tell Mr. Gao that he still had many things he wanted to say.

sentences.chinese: 但是时间不多了，他必须在二十分钟内出发。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn shì shí jiān bù duō le, tā bì xū zài èr shí fēn zhōng nèi chū fā.
sentences.english: But there wasn't much time; he had to set off within twenty minutes.

sentences.chinese: 他走到高先生面前，轻轻地说：“再见。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu dào Gāo xiān sheng miàn qián, qīng qīng de shuō: “Zài jiàn.”
sentences.english: He walked in front of Mr. Gao and said softly, "Goodbye."

sentences.chinese: 高先生看着他走出门外。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng kàn zhe tā zǒu chū mén wài.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao watched him walk out the door.

sentences.chinese: 三先生走在路的前面，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng zǒu zài lù de qián miàn, xīn tiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Mr. San walked ahead on the road, his heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 他最后回头看了一眼高先生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuì hòu huí tóu kàn le yī yǎn Gāo xiān sheng.
sentences.english: Finally, he looked back at Mr. Gao one last time.

sentences.chinese: 他不知道，这次再见是不是真的再见。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zhī dào, zhè cì zài jiàn shì bù shì zhēn de zài jiàn.
sentences.english: He didn't know if this goodbye was a real goodbye.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他的手机屏幕黑了，完全没电了。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, tā de shǒu jī píng mù hēi le, wán quán méi diàn le.
sentences.english: Suddenly, his phone screen went black; it was completely out of power.

sentences.chinese: 三先生走在街上，心很乱。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng zǒu zài jiē shàng, xīn hěn luàn.
sentences.english: Mr. San walked on the street, his mind in turmoil.

sentences.chinese: 他的手机没电了，他不能打电话给高先生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shǒu jī méi diàn le, tā bù néng dǎ diàn huà gěi Gāo xiān sheng.
sentences.english: His phone was out of power, and he couldn't call Mr. Gao.

sentences.chinese: 他记得前天的时候，天气很好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì de qián tiān de shí hou, tiān qì hěn hǎo.
sentences.english: He remembered that the weather was very good the day before yesterday.

sentences.chinese: 但现在，天空阴沉沉的。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiàn zài, tiān kōng yīn chén chén de.
sentences.english: But now, the sky was gloomy.

sentences.chinese: 他突然想起，他的哥哥在医院工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tū rán xiǎng qǐ, tā de gē ge zài yī yuàn gōng zuò.
sentences.english: He suddenly remembered that his older brother works in a hospital.

sentences.chinese: 他的哥哥是一个很有名的医生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de gē ge shì yī gè hěn yǒu míng de yī shēng.
sentences.english: His older brother is a very famous doctor.

sentences.chinese: 三先生快步走向那家大医院。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kuài bù zǒu xiàng nà jiā dà yī yuàn.
sentences.english: Mr. San walked quickly toward that large hospital.

sentences.chinese: 在医院的走廊里，他看到一个女人。
sentences.pinyin: Zài yī yuàn de zǒu láng lǐ, tā kàn dào yī gè nǚ rén.
sentences.english: In the hospital corridor, he saw a woman.

sentences.chinese: 她看起来很伤心，手里拿着一张地图。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐ lái hěn shāng xīn, shǒu lǐ ná zhe yī zhāng dì tú.
sentences.english: She looked very sad, holding a map in her hand.

sentences.chinese: 她问三先生：“请问，图书馆在哪里？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn Sān xiān sheng: “Qǐng wèn, tú shū guǎn zài nǎ lǐ?”
sentences.english: She asked Mr. San, "Excuse me, where is the library?"

sentences.chinese: 三先生告诉她，图书馆在医院的另一半区域。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng gào su tā, tú shū guǎn zài yī yuàn de lìng yī bàn qū yù.
sentences.english: Mr. San told her that the library was in the other half of the hospital area.

sentences.chinese: 这个女人告诉三先生，她是来找她的女儿的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè nǚ rén gào su Sān xiān sheng, tā shì lái zhǎo tā de nǚ ér de.
sentences.english: This woman told Mr. San that she had come to find her daughter.

sentences.chinese: 她的女儿今年在学习中文。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de nǚ ér jīn nián zài xué xí Zhōng wén.
sentences.english: Her daughter is studying Chinese this year.

sentences.chinese: 她去年在中国学习了半年。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qù nián zài Zhōng guó xué xí le bàn nián.
sentences.english: She studied in China for half a year last year.

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着她，觉得她像自己的姐姐一样温柔。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kàn zhe tā, jué de tā xiàng zì jǐ de jiě jie yī yàng wēn róu.
sentences.english: Mr. San looked at her and felt she was as gentle as his own older sister.

sentences.chinese: 他轻声说：“没关系，姐姐，我陪你去。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā qīng shēng shuō: “Méi guān xi, jiě, wǒ péi nǐ qù.”
sentences.english: He said softly, "It's okay, sister, I will go with you."

sentences.chinese: 那个女人笑了，她的笑容很美。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè nǚ rén xiào le, tā de xiào róng hěn měi.
sentences.english: The woman smiled, and her smile was beautiful.

sentences.chinese: 三先生想，上次见到高先生的时候，心跳也像现在这样快。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng xiǎng, shàng cì jiàn dào Gāo xiān sheng de shí hou, xīn tiào yě xiàng xiàn zài zhè yàng kuài.
sentences.english: Mr. San thought that last time he saw Mr. Gao, his heart beat as fast as it does now.

sentences.chinese: 他希望下次能快点见到高先生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xī wàng xià cì néng kuài diǎn jiàn dào Gāo xiān sheng.
sentences.english: He hoped he could see Mr. Gao again sooner next time.

sentences.chinese: 他在医院的小几上放下了自己的包。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài yī yuàn de xiǎo jǐ shàng fàng xià le zì jǐ de bāo.
sentences.english: He placed his bag on a small table in the hospital.

sentences.chinese: 他想起高先生是不是在等他吃午饭？
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ Gāo xiān sheng shì bù shì zài děng tā chī wǔ fàn?
sentences.english: He wondered if Mr. Gao was waiting for him to have lunch?

sentences.chinese: 三先生突然想起，他的好哥们说高先生有个妹妹。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng tū rán xiǎng qǐ, tā de hǎo gē men shuō Gāo xiān sheng yǒu gè mèi mei.
sentences.english: Mr. San suddenly remembered his good buddy saying Mr. Gao had a younger sister.

sentences.chinese: 那个妹妹很像一个可爱的小妹。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè mèi mei hěn xiàng yī gè kě ài de xiǎo mèi.
sentences.english: That younger sister was like a cute little sister.

sentences.chinese: 三先生还想知道，高先生有没有女朋友？
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng hái xiǎng zhī dào, Gāo xiān sheng yǒu méi yǒu nǚ péng you?
sentences.english: Mr. San also wanted to know if Mr. Gao had a girlfriend.

sentences.chinese: 他心想，如果高先生有女儿或儿子，那他一定是个好爸爸。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xīn xiǎng, rú guǒ Gāo xiān sheng yǒu nǚ ér huò ér zi, nà tā yī dìng shì gè hǎo bà ba.
sentences.english: He thought to himself, if Mr. Gao had a daughter or a son, he must be a good father.

sentences.chinese: 三先生静静地听着周围的声音，心里充满了不安。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng jìng jìng de tīng zhe zhōu wéi de shēng yīn, xīn lǐ chōng mǎn le bù ān.
sentences.english: Mr. San listened quietly to the sounds around him, his heart filled with anxiety.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个护士跑过来，喊了他的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, yī gè hù shi pǎo guò lái, hǎn le tā de míng zì.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a nurse ran over and called his name.

sentences.chinese: 护士告诉三先生，他的姐姐在房间里。
sentences.pinyin: Hù shi gào su sān xiān sheng, tā de jiě jie zài fáng jiān lǐ.
sentences.english: The nurse told Mr. San that his older sister was in the room.

sentences.chinese: 三先生快步走进去，但他的心跳很慢。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kuài bù zǒu jìn qù, dàn tā de xīn tiào hěn màn.
sentences.english: Mr. San walked in quickly, but his heartbeat was slow.

sentences.chinese: 他的姐姐在照顾一个孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de jiě jie zài zhào gù yī gè hái zi.
sentences.english: His older sister was taking care of a child.

sentences.chinese: 这个小朋友在笑，看起来很开心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè xiǎo péng yǒu zài xiào, kàn qǐ lái hěn kāi xīn.
sentences.english: This little child was laughing and looked very happy.

sentences.chinese: 三先生问：“这个孩子是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng wèn: “Zhè gè hái zi shì shéi?”
sentences.english: Mr. San asked, "Who is this child?"

sentences.chinese: 姐姐说：“他是我的弟弟，他之前在学校受伤了。”
sentences.pinyin: Jiě jie shuō: “Tā shì wǒ de dì di, tā zhī qián zài xué xiào shòu shāng le.”
sentences.english: His sister said, "He is my younger brother; he was injured at school before."

sentences.chinese: 三先生想起昨天，他还在想高先生的事。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng xiǎng qǐ zuó tiān, tā hái zài xiǎng gāo xiān sheng de shì.
sentences.english: Mr. San thought about yesterday, when he was still thinking about Mr. Gao.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得高先生是一个很好的朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué de gāo xiān sheng shì yī gè hěn hǎo de péng you.
sentences.english: He felt that Mr. Gao was a very good friend.

sentences.chinese: 现在是早上，房间里有早饭和很多水果。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài shì zǎo shang, fáng jiān lǐ yǒu zǎo fàn hé hěn duō shuǐ guǒ.
sentences.english: It was early morning, and there was breakfast and a lot of fruit in the room.

sentences.chinese: 三先生觉得很渴，他喝了一杯水。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng jué de hěn kě, tā hē le yī bēi shuǐ.
sentences.english: Mr. San felt thirsty, so he drank a glass of water.

sentences.chinese: 护士说，这个孩子需要休息几个小时。
sentences.pinyin: Hù shi shuō, zhè gè hái zi xū yào xiū xi jǐ gè xiǎo shí.
sentences.english: The nurse said the child needed to rest for a few hours.

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着日历，今天的日期是星期天。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kàn zhe rì lì, jīn tiān de rì qī shì xīng qī tiān.
sentences.english: Mr. San looked at the calendar; today's date was Sunday.

sentences.chinese: 他想，星期日应该是安静的一天。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, xīng qī rì yīng gāi shì ān jìng de yī tiān.
sentences.english: He thought Sunday should be a quiet day.

sentences.chinese: 他想起他以前是一个工人，每天工作很辛苦。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ tā yǐ qián shì yī gè gōng rén, měi tiān gōng zuò hěn xīn kǔ.
sentences.english: He remembered that he used to be a worker, working very hard every day.

sentences.chinese: 现在，他想学习汉语，因为这很有用。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài, tā xiǎng xué xí hàn yǔ, yīn wèi zhè hěn yǒu yòng.
sentences.english: Now, he wants to study Chinese because it is very useful.

sentences.chinese: 他想明年能和高先生一起去北京。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng míng nián néng hé gāo xiān sheng yī qǐ qù běi jīng.
sentences.english: He hopes that next year he can go to Beijing with Mr. Gao.

sentences.chinese: 他记得高先生说过，他喜欢坐火车旅行。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì de gāo xiān sheng shuō guò, tā xǐ huan zuò huǒ chē lǚ xíng.
sentences.english: He remembered Mr. Gao saying that he liked traveling by train.

sentences.chinese: 三先生想，明天他可以给高先生打电话吗？
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng xiǎng, míng tiān tā kě yǐ gěi gāo xiān sheng dǎ diàn huà ma?
sentences.english: Mr. San wondered, can he call Mr. Gao tomorrow?

sentences.chinese: 他想告诉高先生，他在家里照顾家人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng gào su gāo xiān sheng, tā zài jiā lǐ zhào gù jiā rén.
sentences.english: He wanted to tell Mr. Gao that he was at home taking care of his family.

sentences.chinese: 他希望新年的时候，他们能在一起。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xī wàng xīn nián de shí hou, tā men néng zài yī qǐ.
sentences.english: He hoped that during the New Year, they could be together.

sentences.chinese: 现在正是一月，天气很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài zhèng shì yī yuè, tiān qì hěn lěng.
sentences.english: Right now it is the first month of the year, and the weather is very cold.

sentences.chinese: 三先生走到楼下，看着外面的天空。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng zǒu dào lóu xià, kàn zhe wài miàn de tiān kōng.
sentences.english: Mr. San walked downstairs and looked at the sky outside.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果明年能再次见到高先生，那就太好了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rú guǒ míng nián néng zài cì jiàn dào gāo xiān sheng, nà jiù tài hǎo le.
sentences.english: He thought it would be wonderful if he could see Mr. Gao again next year.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他的手机响了，是一个陌生号码。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, tā de shǒu jī xiǎng le, shì yī gè mò shēng hào mǎ.
sentences.english: Suddenly, his phone rang; it was an unknown number.

sentences.chinese: 他紧张地接起电话。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jǐn zhāng de jiē qǐ diàn huà.
sentences.english: He nervously answered the phone.

sentences.chinese: 电话那头传来了高先生的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Diàn huà nà tóu chuán lái le gāo xiān sheng de shēng yīn.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao's voice came from the other end of the line.

sentences.chinese: 高先生问他：“你在哪里？”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng wèn tā: “Nǐ zài nǎ lǐ?”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao asked him, "Where are you?"

sentences.chinese: 三先生听到电话里高先生的声音，立刻站了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng tīng dào diàn huà lǐ Gāo xiān sheng de shēng yīn, lì kè zhàn le qǐ lai.
sentences.english: Hearing Mr. Gao's voice on the phone, Mr. San immediately stood up.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉高先生，他在医院里边。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su Gāo xiān sheng, tā zài yī yuàn lǐ bian.
sentences.english: He told Mr. Gao that he was inside the hospital.

sentences.chinese: 高先生的声音很温柔，他说：“您在那儿等我。”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng de shēng yīn hěn wēn róu, tā shuō: “Nín zài nàr děng wǒ.”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao's voice was very gentle; he said, "Please wait for me there."

sentences.chinese: 三先生的心跳得很快，他想起了他们第一次见面的那个雨天。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng de xīn tiào de hěn kuài, tā xiǎng qǐ le tā men dì yī cì jiàn miàn de nèi gè yǔ tiān.
sentences.english: Mr. San's heart beat fast, and he remembered the rainy day they first met.

sentences.chinese: 那时候，高先生穿着一件漂亮的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shí hou, Gāo xiān sheng chuān zhe yī jiàn piào liang de yī fu.
sentences.english: At that time, Mr. Gao was wearing a beautiful piece of clothing.

sentences.chinese: 三先生在网上查了高先生的名字，发现他是一位大学老师。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng zài wǎng shàng chá le Gāo xiān sheng de míng zi, fā xiàn tā shì yī wèi dà xué lǎo shī.
sentences.english: Mr. San looked up Mr. Gao's name online and discovered he was a university teacher.

sentences.chinese: 高先生在电话里说，他现在在车上，很快就到。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng zài diàn huà lǐ shuō, tā xiàn zài zài chē shàng, hěn kuài jiù dào.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao said on the phone that he was in the car and would arrive soon.

sentences.chinese: 三先生觉得很紧张，他走到窗边，看到外面出了一些小太阳。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng jué de hěn jǐn zhāng, tā zǒu dào chuāng biān, kàn dào wài miàn chū le yī xiē xiǎo tài yáng.
sentences.english: Mr. San felt very nervous; he walked to the window and saw a bit of sun coming out.

sentences.chinese: 他想，今天是不是高先生的生日？
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, jīn tiān shì bù shì Gāo xiān sheng de shēng rì?
sentences.english: He wondered if today was Mr. Gao's birthday.

sentences.chinese: 他希望能给高先生买一些好吃的，比如面包和肉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xī wàng néng gěi Gāo xiān sheng mǎi yī xiē hǎo chī de, bǐ rú miàn bāo hé ròu.
sentences.english: He hoped he could buy some delicious things for Mr. Gao, such as bread and meat.

sentences.chinese: 三先生在桌子上看到一本课本，那是他学习汉语用的。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng zài zhuō zi shàng kàn dào yī běn kè běn, nà shì tā xué xí hàn yǔ yòng de.
sentences.english: Mr. San saw a textbook on the table, which he used for studying Chinese.

sentences.chinese: 他翻开课本的一页，看着上面的课文，试图让自己平静下来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fān kāi kè běn de yī yè, kàn zhe shàng miàn de kè wén, shì tú ràng zì jǐ píng jìng xià lái.
sentences.english: He flipped to a page of the textbook and looked at the text, trying to calm himself down.

sentences.chinese: 他突然想到，高先生是不是有男朋友了？
sentences.pinyin: Tā tū rán xiǎng dào, Gāo xiān sheng shì bù shì yǒu nán péng you le?
sentences.english: He suddenly wondered if Mr. Gao already had a boyfriend.

sentences.chinese: 这个想法让他感到难过，他低头喝了一杯冷牛奶。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè xiǎng fǎ ràng tā gǎn dào nán guò, tā dī tóu hē le yī bēi lěng niú nǎi.
sentences.english: This thought made him feel sad, and he looked down and drank a glass of cold milk.

sentences.chinese: 他记得高先生说过，他很喜欢坐飞机去不同的城市。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì dé Gāo xiān sheng shuō guò, tā hěn xǐ huan zuò fēi jī qù bù tóng de chéng shì.
sentences.english: He remembered Mr. Gao saying that he loved taking airplanes to different cities.

sentences.chinese: 三先生在心里默默地说，他想和高先生一起去旅行。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng zài xīn lǐ mò mò de shuō, tā xiǎng hé Gāo xiān sheng yī qǐ qù lǚ xíng.
sentences.english: Mr. San said silently in his heart that he wanted to travel with Mr. Gao.

sentences.chinese: 终于，医院的大门打开了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōng yú, yī yuàn de dà mén dǎ kāi le.
sentences.english: Finally, the main door of the hospital opened.

sentences.chinese: 高先生走进了房间，眼神里充满了担心。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng zǒu jìn le fáng jiān, yǎn shén lǐ chōng mǎn le dān xīn.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao walked into the room, his eyes full of worry.

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着他，突然发现高先生手里拿着一个熟悉的小盒子。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kàn zhe tā, tū rán fā xiàn Gāo xiān sheng shǒu lǐ ná zhe yī gè shú xī de xiǎo hé zi.
sentences.english: Mr. San looked at him and suddenly noticed Mr. Gao was holding a familiar small box in his hand.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 11: The Secret of the Box

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着那个盒子，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kàn zhe nà ge hé zi, xīn tiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Mr. San looked at the box, his heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 高先生走过来，轻轻地打开盒子。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng zǒu guò lái, qīng qīng de dǎ kāi hé zi.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao walked over and gently opened the box.

sentences.chinese: 三先生看到里面有一张漂亮的纸。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kàn dào lǐ miàn yǒu yì zhāng piào liang de zhǐ.
sentences.english: Mr. San saw a beautiful piece of paper inside.

sentences.chinese: 那是高先生写的信。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì Gāo xiān sheng xiě de xìn.
sentences.english: It was a letter written by Mr. Gao.

sentences.chinese: 高先生告诉他，他一直在找三先生。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng gào sù tā, tā yì zhí zài zhǎo Sān xiān sheng.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao told him that he had been looking for Mr. San.

sentences.chinese: 三先生很惊讶，他问：“你在开玩笑吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng hěn jīng yà, tā wèn: “Nǐ zài kāi wán xiào ma?”
sentences.english: Mr. San was very surprised and asked, "Are you joking?"

sentences.chinese: 高先生笑了，他说：“我没有开玩笑。”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng xiào le, tā shuō: “Wǒ méi yǒu kāi wán xiào.”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao smiled and said, "I am not joking."

sentences.chinese: 高先生说，他在北京买了很多礼物送给三先生。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng shuō, tā zài Běi jīng mǎi le hěn duō lǐ wù sòng gěi Sān xiān sheng.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao said he had bought many gifts in Beijing for Mr. San.

sentences.chinese: 他买了一打精美的笔记本，想让三先生在上面写字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mǎi le yì dá jīng měi de bǐ jì běn, xiǎng ràng Sān xiān sheng zài shàng miàn xiě zì.
sentences.english: He bought a dozen exquisite notebooks, wanting Mr. San to write in them.

sentences.chinese: 三先生听到这些话，心里觉得很温暖。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng tīng dào zhè xiē huà, xīn lǐ jué de hěn wēn nuǎn.
sentences.english: Hearing these words, Mr. San felt warmth in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 高先生说，他想带三先生出去玩儿。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng shuō, tā xiǎng dài Sān xiān sheng chū qù wán r.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao said he wanted to take Mr. San out to have fun.

sentences.chinese: 他想开车带三先生去公园打球。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng kāi chē dài Sān xiān sheng qù gōng yuán dǎ qiú.
sentences.english: He wanted to drive Mr. San to the park to play ball.

sentences.chinese: 三先生听见高先生的声音，觉得非常好听。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng tīng jiàn Gāo xiān sheng de shēng yīn, jué de fēi cháng hǎo tīng.
sentences.english: Mr. San heard Mr. Gao's voice and thought it sounded wonderful.

sentences.chinese: 他想，高先生唱歌一定也很好听。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, Gāo xiān sheng chàng gē yí dìng yě hěn hǎo tīng.
sentences.english: He thought Mr. Gao's singing must also be wonderful.

sentences.chinese: 高先生问：“你想听我唱歌吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng wèn: “Nǐ xiǎng tīng wǒ chàng gē ma?”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao asked, "Do you want to hear me sing?"

sentences.chinese: 三先生点头说：“我想听你唱一首歌。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng diǎn tóu shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng tīng nǐ chàng yì shǒu gē.”
sentences.english: Mr. San nodded and said, "I want to hear you sing a song."

sentences.chinese: 高先生轻轻地唱了起来，那首歌很温柔。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng qīng qīng de chàng le qǐ lái, nà shǒu gē hěn wēn róu.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao began to sing softly; the song was very gentle.

sentences.chinese: 三先生觉得，他终于得到了他想要的爱。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng jué de, tā zhōng yú dé dào le tā xiǎng yào de ài.
sentences.english: Mr. San felt that he had finally obtained the love he wanted.

sentences.chinese: 突然，高先生的手机响了，他需要打电话给公司。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, Gāo xiān sheng de shǒu jī xiǎng le, tā xū yào dǎ diàn huà gěi gōng sī.
sentences.english: Suddenly, Mr. Gao's phone rang; he needed to make a call to the company.

sentences.chinese: 他说他明天要开会，不能迟到。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō tā míng tiān yào kāi huì, bù néng chí dào.
sentences.english: He said he had a meeting tomorrow and couldn't be late.

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着他，觉得时间过得太快了。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kàn zhe tā, jué de shí jiān guò de tài kuài le.
sentences.english: Mr. San looked at him, feeling that time was passing too quickly.

sentences.chinese: 高先生把信放在三先生的手里。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng bǎ xìn fàng zài Sān xiān sheng de shǒu lǐ.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao placed the letter in Mr. San's hand.

sentences.chinese: 他叫三先生快点准备，因为他要打车离开医院。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiào Sān xiān sheng kuài diǎn zhǔn bèi, yīn wèi tā yào dǎ chē lí kāi yī yuàn.
sentences.english: He called for Mr. San to get ready quickly because he had to take a taxi to leave the hospital.

sentences.chinese: 三先生帮他找手机，终于找到了。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng bāng tā zhǎo shǒu jī, zhōng yú zhǎo dào le.
sentences.english: Mr. San helped him look for his phone and finally found it.

sentences.chinese: 高先生说：“下次我开车来接你，我们一起上车去旅行。”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng shuō: “Xià cì wǒ kāi chē lái jiē nǐ, wǒ men yì qǐ shàng chē qù lǚ xíng.”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao said, "Next time I will drive to pick you up, and we will get in the car together to travel."

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着高先生离开的背影，心中充满了期待。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kàn zhe Gāo xiān sheng lí kāi de bèi yǐng, xīn zhōng chōng mǎn le qī dài.
sentences.english: Mr. San looked at Mr. Gao's departing figure, his heart full of anticipation.

sentences.chinese: 但是，当他再次打开那封信时，他看到了一个奇怪的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn shì, dāng tā zài cì dǎ kāi nà fēng xìn shí, tā kàn dào le yí gè qí guài de míng zi.
sentences.english: However, when he opened the letter again, he saw a strange name.

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着信上的名字，心跳很快。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kàn zhe xìn shàng de míng zi, xīn tiào hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Mr. San looked at the name on the letter, his heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 他在路上走得很慢，一直在想那个名字是谁。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài lù shang zǒu de hěn màn, yī zhí zài xiǎng nà gè míng zi shì shuí.
sentences.english: He walked slowly on the road, constantly wondering who that name belonged to.

sentences.chinese: 他想起高先生是一个温柔的男人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ Gāo xiān sheng shì yī gè wēn róu de nán rén.
sentences.english: He remembered that Mr. Gao was a gentle man.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他看见一个办公室，门开着。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, tā kàn jiàn yī gè bàn gōng shì, mén kāi zhe.
sentences.english: Suddenly, he saw an office with the door open.

sentences.chinese: 他走进去，看见一个医生在说话。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu jìn qù, kàn jiàn yī gè yī shēng zài shuō huà.
sentences.english: He went inside and saw a doctor speaking.

sentences.chinese: 三先生问医生：“请问，高先生在里面吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng wèn yī shēng: “Qǐng wèn, Gāo xiān sheng zài lǐ miàn ma?”
sentences.english: Mr. San asked the doctor, "Excuse me, is Mr. Gao inside?"

sentences.chinese: 医生说：“请进，请坐。”
sentences.pinyin: Yī shēng shuō: “Qǐng jìn, qǐng zuò.”
sentences.english: The doctor said, "Please come in, please have a seat."

sentences.chinese: 三先生走进房间，看到高先生在看病。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng zǒu jìn fáng jiān, kàn dào Gāo xiān sheng zài kàn bìng.
sentences.english: Mr. San entered the room and saw Mr. Gao visiting the doctor.

sentences.chinese: 高先生看见三先生，很惊讶。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng kàn jiàn Sān xiān sheng, hěn jīng yà.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao saw Mr. San and was very surprised.

sentences.chinese: 高先生说：“你怎么来了？你不是要考试吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng shuō: “Nǐ zěn me lái le? Nǐ bù shì yào kǎo shì ma?”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao said, "Why are you here? Aren't you supposed to take an exam?"

sentences.chinese: 三先生说：“我请假了，我想见你。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng shuō: “Wǒ qǐng jià le, wǒ xiǎng jiàn nǐ.”
sentences.english: Mr. San said, "I requested leave; I wanted to see you."

sentences.chinese: 高先生笑了，请三先生喝茶。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng xiào le, qǐng Sān xiān sheng hē chá.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao smiled and invited Mr. San to drink tea.

sentences.chinese: 他们坐在那里，安静地说话。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zuò zài nà lǐ, ān jìng de shuō huà.
sentences.english: They sat there, talking quietly.

sentences.chinese: 三先生问：“信上的那个名字是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng wèn: “Xìn shàng de nà gè míng zi shì shuí?”
sentences.english: Mr. San asked, "Who is the name on the letter?"

sentences.chinese: 高先生沉默了，他看着窗外飞的小鸟。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng chén mò le, tā kàn zhe chuāng wài fēi de xiǎo niǎo.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao fell silent, watching the small birds flying outside the window.

sentences.chinese: 他不想现在就见面说这件事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎng xiàn zài jiù jiàn miàn shuō zhè jiàn shì.
sentences.english: He didn't want to meet and talk about this matter right now.

sentences.chinese: 三先生想，高先生是不是在隐藏什么秘密？
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng xiǎng, Gāo xiān sheng shì bù shì zài yǐn cáng shén me mì mì?
sentences.english: Mr. San wondered if Mr. Gao was hiding some secret.

sentences.chinese: 这时，门外有人喊：“医生，请进来一下！”
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, mén wài yǒu rén hǎn: “Yī shēng, qǐng jìn lái yī xià!”
sentences.english: At that moment, someone shouted from outside the door, "Doctor, please come in for a moment!"

sentences.chinese: 高先生站起来，眼神里有一丝悲伤。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng zhàn qǐ lái, yǎn shén lǐ yǒu yī sī bēi shāng.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao stood up, a hint of sadness in his eyes.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十三章：旧照片的故事
chapters.title_english: Chapter 13: The Story of Old Photos

sentences.chinese: 高先生走出去了一会儿。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng zǒu chū qù le yī huì r.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao stepped out for a moment.

sentences.chinese: 三先生一个人在房间里，心里很不安。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng yī gè rén zài fáng jiān lǐ, xīn lǐ hěn bù ān.
sentences.english: Mr. San was alone in the room, feeling very uneasy.

sentences.chinese: 他看着桌子中间的一张旧照片。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe zhuō zi zhōng jiān de yī zhāng jiù zhào piàn.
sentences.english: He looked at an old photo in the middle of the table.

sentences.chinese: 照片里的男人很年轻，眼神很温柔。
sentences.pinyin: Zhào piàn lǐ de nán rén hěn nián qīng, yǎn shén hěn wēn róu.
sentences.english: The man in the photo was very young, with gentle eyes.

sentences.chinese: 三先生想，这个男人是谁？
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng xiǎng, zhè gè nán rén shì shéi?
sentences.english: Mr. San wondered, who is this man?

sentences.chinese: 他想起自己还是小学生的时候，也很喜欢看书。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ zì jǐ hái shì xiǎo xué shēng de shí hou, yě hěn xǐ huān kàn shū.
sentences.english: He remembered when he was still a primary school student, he also loved reading books.

sentences.chinese: 后来他在中学读书，成了一个中学生。
sentences.pinyin: Hòu lái tā zài zhōng xué dú shū, chéng le yī gè zhōng xué shēng.
sentences.english: Later, he studied in middle school and became a middle-school student.

sentences.chinese: 那时候，他在白天总是很努力学习。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shí hou, tā zài bái tiān zǒng shì hěn nǔ lì xué xí.
sentences.english: At that time, he always studied hard during the day.

sentences.chinese: 中午的时候，他会和同学一起在操场走走。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōng wǔ de shí hou, tā huì hé tóng xué yī qǐ zài cāo chǎng zǒu zǒu.
sentences.english: At noon, he would take walks on the playground with his classmates.

sentences.chinese: 放学以后，他会去书店看新书。
sentences.pinyin: Fàng xué yǐ hòu, tā huì qù shū diàn kàn xīn shū.
sentences.english: After school was dismissed, he would go to the bookstore to look at new books.

sentences.chinese: 时间过得很快，他现在已经长大了。
sentences.pinyin: Shí jiān guò de hěn kuài, tā xiàn zài yǐ jīng zhǎng dà le.
sentences.english: Time passed quickly, and he has grown up now.

sentences.chinese: 但这张照片让他想了半天。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zhè zhāng zhào piàn ràng tā xiǎng le bàn tiān.
sentences.english: But this photo made him think for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 突然，门开了，高先生回来了。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, mén kāi le, Gāo xiān sheng huí lái le.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the door opened, and Mr. Gao returned.

sentences.chinese: 高先生正在看三先生，他的脸上有一丝微笑。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng zhèng zài kàn Sān xiān sheng, tā de liǎn shàng yǒu yī sī wēi xiào.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao was looking at Mr. San, with a slight smile on his face.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“这是我的老师，姓新。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zhè shì wǒ de lǎo shī, xìng Xīn.”
sentences.english: He said, "This was my teacher, surnamed Xin."

sentences.chinese: 三先生觉得，这个新老师和高先生很像。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng jué de, zhè gè Xīn lǎo shī hé Gāo xiān sheng hěn xiàng.
sentences.english: Mr. San felt that this Teacher Xin looked very much like Mr. Gao.

sentences.chinese: 高先生说：“下午我们一起去吃饭吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng shuō: “Xià wǔ wǒ men yī qǐ qù chī fàn ba.”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao said, "Let's go eat together this afternoon."

sentences.chinese: 三先生问：“去哪里吃？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng wèn: “Qù nǎ lǐ chī?”
sentences.english: Mr. San asked, "Where shall we eat?"

sentences.chinese: 高先生说：“我知道一家店，那里的菜很好吃。”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng shuō: “Wǒ zhī dào yī jiā diàn, nà lǐ de cài hěn hǎo chī.”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao said, "I know a place where the dishes are delicious."

sentences.chinese: 三先生摸了摸身上，发现他没有带钱。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng mō le mō shēn shang, fā xiàn tā méi yǒu dài qián.
sentences.english: Mr. San felt around on his person and found he hadn't brought any money.

sentences.chinese: 在这个安静的房间间，两人的心靠得更近了。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè gè ān jìng de fáng jiān jiān, liǎng rén de xīn kào de gèng jìn le.
sentences.english: Within this quiet room, the hearts of the two grew closer.

sentences.chinese: 但高先生的眼神里，依然藏着一个秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn Gāo xiān sheng de yǎn shén lǐ, yī rán cáng zhe yī gè mì mì.
sentences.english: But in Mr. Gao's eyes, a secret was still hidden.

sentences.chinese: 高先生笑了，他说：“没关系，我来做主。”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng xiào le, tā shuō: “Méi guān xi #-} xi, wǒ lái zuò zhǔ.”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao smiled and said, "It doesn't matter, I'll take charge."

sentences.chinese: 他轻轻地关上了房间的门。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qīng qīng de guān shàng le fáng jiān de mén.
sentences.english: He gently closed the door of the room.

sentences.chinese: 他想带三先生去一个特别的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng dài Sān xiān sheng qù yī gè tè bié de dì fang.
sentences.english: He wanted to take Mr. San to a special place.

sentences.chinese: 他们走到了街角的一家小店。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zǒu dào le jiē jiǎo de yī jiā xiǎo diàn.
sentences.english: They walked to a small shop on the street corner.

sentences.chinese: 这家店很小，像一个温馨的吧。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn hěn xiǎo, xiàng yī gè wēn xīn de ba.
sentences.english: This shop was very small, like a cozy bar.

sentences.chinese: 高先生向三先生介绍这家店：“这是我奶奶开的店。”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng xiàng Sān xiān sheng jiè shào zhè jiā diàn: “Zhè shì wǒ nǎi nai kāi de diàn.”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao introduced the shop to Mr. San: "This is a shop opened by my grandmother."

sentences.chinese: 三先生觉得很惊讶，他想，原来高先生的家人也这么温柔。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng jué de hěn jīng yà, tā xiǎng, yuán lái Gāo xiān sheng de jiā rén yě zhè me wēn róu.
sentences.english: Mr. San felt very surprised; he thought that Mr. Gao's family was also this gentle.

sentences.chinese: 店里的人们都在忙着准备晚餐。
sentences.pinyin: Diàn lǐ de rén men dōu zài máng zhe zhǔn bèi wǎn cān.
sentences.english: The people in the shop were all busy preparing dinner.

sentences.chinese: 三先生看到桌上有热腾腾的包子。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kàn dào zhuō shàng yǒu rè téng téng de bāo zi.
sentences.english: Mr. San saw steaming hot baozi on the table.

sentences.chinese: 他吃了一口，觉得味道非常好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chī le yī kǒu, jué de wèi dào fēi cháng hǎo.
sentences.english: He took a bite and felt the taste was excellent.

sentences.chinese: 高先生问：“你喜欢吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng wèn: “Nǐ xǐ huān ma?”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao asked, "Do you like it?"

sentences.chinese: 三先生点点头，笑着说：“我很喜欢。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng diǎn diǎn tóu, xiào zhe shuō: “Wǒ hěn xǐ huān.”
sentences.english: Mr. San nodded and said with a smile, "I like it very much."

sentences.chinese: 这时，高先生想起了他的工作。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, Gāo xiān sheng xiǎng qǐ le tā de gōng zuò.
sentences.english: At this moment, Mr. Gao thought of his work.

sentences.chinese: 他是一个老师，现在还没到下课的时间。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì yī gè lǎo shī, xiàn zài hái méi dào xià kè de shí jiān.
sentences.english: He is a teacher, and it wasn't time to finish class yet.

sentences.chinese: 他拿出手机上网，看看学生的作业。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū shǒu jī shàng wǎng, kàn kàn xué shēng de zuò yè.
sentences.english: He took out his phone to go online and check the students' homework.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉三先生，他今天有一次听写测试。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su Sān xiān sheng, tā jīn tiān yǒu yī cì tīng xiě cè shì.
sentences.english: He told Mr. San that he had a dictation test today.

sentences.chinese: 三先生好奇地问：“你的学生会做这些题吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng hào qí de wèn: “Nǐ de xué shēng huì zuò zhè xiē tí ma?”
sentences.english: Mr. San asked curiously, "Will your students be able to do these problems?"

sentences.chinese: 高先生说：“他们很聪明，但还是差一点点。”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng shuō: “Tā men hěn cōng míng, dàn hái shì chā yī diǎn diǎn.”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao said, "They are very smart, but they are still a little short."

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着高先生认真的样子，心里觉得很甜。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kàn zhe Gāo xiān sheng rèn zhēn de yàng zi, xīn lǐ jué de hěn tián.
sentences.english: Looking at Mr. Gao's serious expression, Mr. San felt a sweetness in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果能一直这样在一起就好了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rú guǒ néng yī zhí zhè yàng zài yī qǐ jiù hǎo le.
sentences.english: He thought it would be wonderful if they could stay together like this forever.

sentences.chinese: 突然，三先生想起了一件事，他低声说：“对不起，我真的没有钱。”
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, Sān xiān sheng xiǎng qǐ le yī jiàn shì, tā dī shēng shuō: “Duì bu qǐ, wǒ zhēn de méi yǒu qián.”
sentences.english: Suddenly, Mr. San remembered something and said softly, "I'm sorry, I really have no money."

sentences.chinese: 高先生看着他，眼神里没有生气，只有温柔。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng kàn zhe tā, yǎn shén lǐ méi yǒu shēng qì, zhǐ yǒu wēn róu.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao looked at him; there was no anger in his eyes, only tenderness.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“在这儿，钱不重要，重要的是我们在一起。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zài zhèr, qián bù zhòng yào, zhòng yào de shì wǒ men zài yī qǐ.”
sentences.english: He said, "Here, money isn't important; what's important is that we are together."

sentences.chinese: 他们分了一盘水果，安静地聊天。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men fēn le yī pán shuǐ guǒ, ān jìng de liáo tiān.
sentences.english: They shared a plate of fruit and chatted quietly.

sentences.chinese: 三先生问：“你现在在家有谁呢？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng wèn: “Nǐ xiàn zài zài jiā yǒu shéi ne?”
sentences.english: Mr. San asked, "Who do you have at home now?"

sentences.chinese: 高先生沉默了一会儿，没有立刻回答。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng chén mò le yī huì r, méi yǒu lì kè huí dá.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao was silent for a while and did not answer immediately.

sentences.chinese: 他看着窗外，身体微微地动了一下。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe chuāng wài, shēn tǐ wēi wēi de dòng le yī xià.
sentences.english: He looked out the window, and his body moved slightly.

sentences.chinese: 三先生发现，高先生又在想那个秘密了。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng fā xiàn, Gāo xiān sheng yòu zài xiǎng nà gè mì mì le.
sentences.english: Mr. San noticed that Mr. Gao was thinking about that secret again.

sentences.chinese: 此时，高先生的手机响了，是一个陌生的电话。
sentences.pinyin: Cǐ shí, Gāo xiān sheng de shǒu jī xiǎng le, shì yī gè mò shēng de diàn huà.
sentences.english: Just then, Mr. Gao's phone rang; it was a call from a stranger.

sentences.chinese: 高先生接起电话，脸色突然变了。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng jiē qǐ diàn huà, liǎn sè tū rán biàn le.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao answered the phone, and his expression suddenly changed.

sentences.chinese: 高先生挂了电话，他的手在微微发抖。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng guà le diàn huà, tā de shǒu zài wēi wēi fā dǒu.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao hung up the phone, and his hand was shaking slightly.

sentences.chinese: 三先生问他：“发生了什么事？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng wèn tā: “Fā shēng le shén me shì?”
sentences.english: Mr. San asked him, "What happened?"

sentences.chinese: 高先生说：“是一个老朋友在找我。”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng shuō: “Shì yī gè lǎo péng you zài zhǎo wǒ.”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao said, "It is an old friend looking for me."

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着他，心想：这一定是那个秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kàn zhe tā, xīn xiǎng: zhè yī dìng shì nà gè mì mì.
sentences.english: Mr. San looked at him and thought: this must be that secret.

sentences.chinese: 他走过去，递给高先生一杯热水。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu guò qù, dì gěi Gāo xiān sheng yī bēi rè shuǐ.
sentences.english: He walked over and handed Mr. Gao a cup of hot water.

sentences.chinese: 高先生接过水，低声说：“谢谢你。”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng jiē guò shuǐ, dī shēng shuō: “Xiè xie nǐ.”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao took the water and said softly, "Thank you."

sentences.chinese: 三先生温和地说：“不用客气。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng wēn hé de shuō: “Bù yòng kè qi.”
sentences.english: Mr. San said gently, "You're welcome."

sentences.chinese: 他们坐在窗边，一边喝水，一边沉默。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zuò zài chuāng biān, yī biān hē shuǐ, yī biān chén mò.
sentences.english: They sat by the window, drinking water on one hand and remaining silent on the other.

sentences.chinese: 三先生想知道高先生的爱好，想让他开心一点。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng xiǎng zhī dào Gāo xiān sheng de ài hào, xiǎng ràng tā kāi xīn yī diǎn.
sentences.english: Mr. San wanted to know Mr. Gao's hobbies, wanting to make him a little happier.

sentences.chinese: 他问：“你爱做什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn: “Nǐ ài zuò shén me?”
sentences.english: He asked, "What do you love to do?"

sentences.chinese: 高先生笑了，但眼神里有悲伤。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng xiào le, dàn yǎn shén lǐ yǒu bēi shāng.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao smiled, but there was sadness in his eyes.

sentences.chinese: 他指向楼上，说：“我的一个老朋友住在那里。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐ xiàng lóu shàng, shuō: “Wǒ de yī gè lǎo péng you zhù zài nà lǐ.”
sentences.english: He pointed upstairs and said, "An old friend of mine lives there."

sentences.chinese: 三先生好奇地问：“他是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng hào qí de wèn: “Tā shì shuí?”
sentences.english: Mr. San asked curiously, "Who is he?"

sentences.chinese: 高先生说：“他是一个病人，身体不好。”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng shuō: “Tā shì yī gè bìng rén, shēn tǐ bù hǎo.”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao said, "He is a patient, and his health is not good."

sentences.chinese: 三先生想，这个老人一定是高先生生命中很重要的人。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng xiǎng, zhè gè lǎo rén yī dìng shì Gāo xiān sheng shēng mìng zhōng hěn zhòng yào de rén.
sentences.english: Mr. San thought that this old man must be a very important person in Mr. Gao's life.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个护士走了出来，对着他们说话。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yī gè hù shi zǒu le chū lái, duì zhe tā men shuō huà.
sentences.english: At this moment, a nurse came out and spoke to them.

sentences.chinese: 护士说：“高先生，请跟我来，那个病人想见你。”
sentences.pinyin: Hù shi shuō: “Gāo xiān sheng, qǐng gēn wǒ lái, nà gè bìng rén xiǎng jiàn nǐ.”
sentences.english: The nurse said, "Mr. Gao, please come with me, that patient wants to see you."

sentences.chinese: 三先生站起来，想陪他一起去。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng zhàn qǐ lái, xiǎng péi tā yī qǐ qù.
sentences.english: Mr. San stood up, wanting to accompany him.

sentences.chinese: 高先生轻轻地握住三先生的手，低声说了一些话。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng qīng qīng de wò zhù Sān xiān sheng de shǒu, dī shēng shuō le yī xiē huà.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao gently held Mr. San's hand and whispered a few words.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“这次我一个人去，你在这里等我。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zhè cì wǒ yī gè rén qù, nǐ zài zhè lǐ děng wǒ.”
sentences.english: He said, "I will go alone this time, you wait for me here."

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着高先生离开，心里充满了不安。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kàn zhe Gāo xiān sheng lí kāi, xīn lǐ chōng mǎn le bù ān.
sentences.english: Mr. San watched Mr. Gao leave, his heart filled with unease.

sentences.chinese: 这是他们相遇以来的第十五天，秘密终于要出来了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì tā men xiāng yù yǐ lái de dì shí wǔ tiān, mì mì zhōng yú yào chū lái le.
sentences.english: This was the fifteenth day since they met, and the secret was finally about to come out.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十六章：旧照片里的秘密

sentences.chinese: 高先生走后，三先生一个人在这里等待。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng zǒu hòu, Sān xiān sheng yī gè rén zài zhè lǐ děng dài.
sentences.english: After Mr. Gao left, Mr. San waited here alone.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得心里有一点儿不安。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué de xīn lǐ yǒu yī diǎn r bù ān.
sentences.english: He felt a little bit uneasy in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 他走到房间里，看到桌子上有一个旧盒子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu dào fáng jiān lǐ, kàn dào zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī gè jiù hé zi.
sentences.english: He walked into the room and saw an old box on the table.

sentences.chinese: 他拿起来看了一下儿，里面有很多照片。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná qǐ lái kàn le yī xià r, lǐ miàn yǒu hěn duō zhào piàn.
sentences.english: He picked it up and took a look; there were many photos inside.

sentences.chinese: 照片里有一个小男孩儿和一个小女孩儿。
sentences.pinyin: Zhào piàn lǐ yǒu yī gè xiǎo nán hái r hé yī gè xiǎo nǚ hái r.
sentences.english: In the photos, there was a little boy and a little girl.

sentences.chinese: 他们看起来只有五六岁。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men kàn qǐ lái zhǐ yǒu wǔ liù suì.
sentences.english: They looked to be only five or six years old.

sentences.chinese: 这个男孩儿和高先生很像，笑得很开心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè nán hái r hé Gāo xiān sheng hěn xiàng, xiào de hěn kāi xīn.
sentences.english: This boy looked a lot like Mr. Gao and was smiling happily.

sentences.chinese: 三先生想，这两个小孩儿是谁？
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng xiǎng, zhè liǎng gè xiǎo hái r shì shuí?
sentences.english: Mr. San wondered, who are these two children?

sentences.chinese: 他发现照片是从很多年前拍的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn zhào piàn shì cóng hěn duō nián qián pāi de.
sentences.english: He discovered the photos were taken from many years ago.

sentences.chinese: 他记得高先生说过，他最喜欢他的家人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì de Gāo xiān sheng shuō guò, tā zuì xǐ huan tā de jiā rén.
sentences.english: He remembered Mr. Gao saying that he loved his family the most.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个年轻的女孩儿走进来帮他干活。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yī gè nián qīng de nǚ hái r zǒu jìn lái bāng tā gàn huó.
sentences.english: At this moment, a young girl came in to help him with the work.

sentences.chinese: 她看到照片，轻声说：“这是高先生小时候的照片。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào zhào piàn, qīng shēng shuō: “Zhè shì Gāo xiān sheng xiǎo shí hou de zhào piàn.”
sentences.english: She saw the photos and said softly, "These are photos of Mr. Gao when he was little."

sentences.chinese: 三先生问：“他们在一起好玩儿吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng wèn: “Tā men zài yī qǐ hǎo wán r ma?”
sentences.english: Mr. San asked, "Was it fun for them to be together?"

sentences.chinese: 女孩儿点点头，说：“他们以前总是一块儿玩。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ hái r diǎn diǎn tóu, shuō: “Tā men yǐ qián zǒng shì yī kuài r wán.”
sentences.english: The girl nodded and said, "They always used to play together."

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着照片，突然想吃面条儿了。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kàn zhe zhào piàn, tū rán xiǎng chī miàn tiáo r le.
sentences.english: Looking at the photos, Mr. San suddenly wanted to eat noodles.

sentences.chinese: 他想给高先生做面条儿和鸡蛋。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng gěi Gāo xiān sheng zuò miàn tiáo r hé jī dàn.
sentences.english: He wanted to make noodles and eggs for Mr. Gao.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果高先生回来，他们可以一起吃晚餐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rú guǒ Gāo xiān sheng huí lái, tā men kě yǐ yī qǐ chī wǎn cān.
sentences.english: He thought that if Mr. Gao returned, they could have dinner together.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，他发现照片后面写着一个名字。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, tā fā xiàn zhào piàn hòu miàn xiě zhe yī gè míng zi.
sentences.english: But just then, he noticed a name written on the back of a photo.

sentences.chinese: 那个名字，他曾经在第十二章的信里看过。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè míng zi, tā céng jīng zài dì shí èr zhāng de xìn lǐ kàn guò.
sentences.english: That name was one he had seen before in the letter from Chapter 12.

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着照片上的汉字，心里很乱。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kàn zhe zhào piàn shàng de hàn zì, xīn lǐ hěn luàn.
sentences.english: Mr. San looked at the Chinese characters on the photo, his mind in turmoil.

sentences.chinese: 他想知道这个名字是谁。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng zhī dào zhè ge míng zi shì shéi.
sentences.english: He wanted to know who this name belonged to.

sentences.chinese: 他把照片放在桌子上，在照片下边发现了一张小纸条。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhào piàn fàng zài zhuō zi shàng, zài zhào piàn xià bian fā xiàn le yī zhāng xiǎo zhǐ tiáo.
sentences.english: He placed the photo on the table and found a small slip of paper underneath the photo.

sentences.chinese: 纸条上写着一个地址。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐ tiáo shàng xiě zhe yī gè dì zhǐ.
sentences.english: An address was written on the slip.

sentences.chinese: 三先生走出房间，来到外边。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng zǒu chū fáng jiān, lái dào wài bian.
sentences.english: Mr. San walked out of the room and went outside.

sentences.chinese: 他看着地图，想知道高先生在哪儿。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe dì tú, xiǎng zhī dào Gāo xiān sheng zài nǎ r.
sentences.english: He looked at the map, wanting to know where Mr. Gao was.

sentences.chinese: 地图的东边是一个公园，南边是一所学校。
sentences.pinyin: Dì tú de dōng bian shì yī gè gōng yuán, nán bian shì yī suǒ xué xiào.
sentences.english: To the east of the map was a park, and to the south was a school.

sentences.chinese: 北边是一个很大的医院，而西边是一个小咖啡店。
sentences.pinyin: Běi biān shì yī gè hěn dà de yī yuàn, ér xī biān shì yī gè xiǎo kā fēi diàn.
sentences.english: To the north was a very large hospital, and to the west was a small coffee shop.

sentences.chinese: 他记得高先生说过，他喜欢西方的艺术。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì de Gāo xiān sheng shuō guò, tā xǐ huan xī fāng de yì shù.
sentences.english: He remembered Mr. Gao saying that he liked Western art.

sentences.chinese: 他向西边走，看到前边有一个人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàng xī biān zǒu, kàn dào qián bian yǒu yī gè rén.
sentences.english: He walked toward the west and saw a person in front of him.

sentences.chinese: 三先生走过去，礼貌地说：“请问，高先生在您旁边吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng zǒu guò qù, lǐ mào de shuō: “Qǐng wèn, Gāo xiān sheng zài nín páng biān ma?”
sentences.english: Mr. San walked over and said politely, "Excuse me, is Mr. Gao beside you?"

sentences.chinese: 那个人摇了摇头，指了指右边。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén yáo le yáo tóu, zhǐ le zhǐ yòu biān.
sentences.english: The person shook their head and pointed to the right.

sentences.chinese: 三先生看向右边，发现那里有一个旧书店。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kàn xiàng yòu biān, fā xiàn nà lǐ yǒu yī gè jiù shū diàn.
sentences.english: Mr. San looked to the right and found an old bookstore there.

sentences.chinese: 书店的左边是一棵大树，右边是一扇红色的门。
sentences.pinyin: Shū diàn de zuǒ bian shì yī kē dà shù, yòu biān shì yī shàn hóng sè de mén.
sentences.english: To the left of the bookstore was a big tree, and to the right was a red door.

sentences.chinese: 他走进书店，看到很多东西，有书，有照片。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu jìn shū diàn, kàn dào hěn duō dōng xī, yǒu shū, yǒu zhào piàn.
sentences.english: He entered the bookstore and saw many things—books and photos.

sentences.chinese: 他在书架的后边看到了一个熟悉的身影。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài shū jià de hòu bian kàn dào le yī gè shú xī de shēn yǐng.
sentences.english: Behind the bookshelves, he saw a familiar figure.

sentences.chinese: 那是高先生，他正静静地站着。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì Gāo xiān sheng, tā zhèng jìng jìng de zhàn zhe.
sentences.english: It was Mr. Gao, standing there quietly.

sentences.chinese: 三先生心跳得很快，他慢慢走近他。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng xīn tiào de hěn kuài, tā màn màn zǒu jìn tā.
sentences.english: Mr. San's heart beat fast as he slowly approached him.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十八章：书店里的真相
chapters.title_english: Chapter 18: The Truth in the Bookstore

sentences.chinese: 三先生走近高先生，他的心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng zǒu jìn Gāo xiān sheng, tā de xīn tiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Mr. San approached Mr. Gao, his heart beating very fast.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你在这里干什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ zài zhè lǐ gàn shén me?”
sentences.english: He said, "What are you doing here?"

sentences.chinese: 高先生转过身，看着他，眼神里有一些悲伤。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng zhuǎn guò shēn, kàn zhe tā, yǎn shén lǐ yǒu yī xiē bēi shāng.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao turned around and looked at him, there was some sadness in his eyes.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“我在这里想一些旧的事情。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ zài zhè lǐ xiǎng yī xiē jiù de shì qing.”
sentences.english: He said, "I am here thinking about some old things."

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着周围，这儿有很多书，那边有一些照片。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kàn zhe zhōu wéi, zhè r yǒu hěn duō shū, nà bian yǒu yī xiē zhào piàn.
sentences.english: Mr. San looked around; there were many books here, and there were some photos over there.

sentences.chinese: 他问：“这些照片是谁的？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn: “Zhè xiē zhào piàn shì shéi de?”
sentences.english: He asked, "Whose are these photos?"

sentences.chinese: 高先生低头看那些照片，轻声说：“她们是我以前的朋友。”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng dī tóu kàn nà xiē zhào piàn, qīng shēng shuō: “Tā men shì wǒ yǐ qián de péng you.”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao looked down at those photos and said softly, "They were my friends from before."

sentences.chinese: 三先生感到有些奇怪，因为高先生常常一个人生活。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng gǎn dào yǒu xiē qí guài, yīn wèi Gāo xiān sheng cháng cháng yī gè rén shēng huó.
sentences.english: Mr. San felt somewhat strange because Mr. Gao often lived alone.

sentences.chinese: 他问：“她们现在在哪里？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn: “Tā men xiàn zài zài nǎ lǐ?”
sentences.english: He asked, "Where are they now?"

sentences.chinese: 高先生指了指窗外的那里，那个远方。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng zhǐ le zhǐ chuāng wài de nà li, nà gè yuǎn fāng.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao pointed to that place outside the window, to that distant land.

sentences.chinese: 三先生想，高先生真的有这么多秘密吗？
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng xiǎng, Gāo xiān sheng zhēn de yǒu zhè me duō mì mì ma?
sentences.english: Mr. San wondered, does Mr. Gao really have so many secrets?

sentences.chinese: 他问：“这些秘密多少能告诉我？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn: “Zhè xiē mì mì duō shǎo néng gà o sù wǒ?”
sentences.english: He asked, "How much of these secrets can you tell me?"

sentences.chinese: 高先生沉默了，有时候他不知道怎么开口。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng chén mò le, yǒu shí hou tā bù zhī dào zěn me kāi kǒu.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao fell silent; sometimes he didn't know how to start speaking.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“我们一起坐下吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ men yī qǐ zuò xià ba.”
sentences.english: He said, "Let's sit down together."

sentences.chinese: 他们坐在书店的这边，阳光照在他们身上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zuò zài shū diàn de zhè biān, yáng guāng zhào zài tā men shēn shang.
sentences.english: They sat on this side of the bookstore, the sunlight shining on them.

sentences.chinese: 三先生问：“哪一个照片是你最喜欢的？”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng wèn: “Nǎ yī gè zhào piàn shì nǐ zuì xǐ huan de?”
sentences.english: Mr. San asked, "Which photo is your favorite?"

sentences.chinese: 高先生指了指几张，说：“哪些照片记录了我的过去。”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng zhǐ le zhǐ jǐ zhāng, shuō: “Nǎ xiē zhào piàn jì lù le wǒ de guò qù.”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao pointed to a few and said, "Those photos recorded my past."

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着他，觉得他真是一个复杂的人。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kàn zhe tā, jué de tā zhēn shì yī gè fù zá de rén.
sentences.english: Mr. San looked at him and felt he was truly a complex person.

sentences.chinese: 他想，有的秘密是为了保护别人，有的秘密是为了忘记。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, yǒu de mì mì shì wèi le bǎo hù bié rén, yǒu de mì mì shì wèi le wàng jì.
sentences.english: He thought, some secrets are to protect others, and some secrets are to forget.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“我今天想知道真相。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ jīn tiān xiǎng zhī dào zhēn xiàng.”
sentences.english: He said, "I want to know the truth today."

sentences.chinese: 高先生看着三先生的眼睛，突然笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng kàn zhe Sān xiān sheng de yǎn jīng, tū rán xiào le.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao looked into Mr. San's eyes and suddenly smiled.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你为什么这么关心我？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ wèi shén me zhè me guān xīn wǒ?”
sentences.english: He said, "Why do you care about me so much?"

sentences.chinese: 三先生回答：“因为我们现在在一起。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng huí dá: “Yīn wèi wǒ men xiàn zài zài yī qǐ.”
sentences.english: Mr. San replied, "Because we are together now."

sentences.chinese: 有时，一个眼神比很多话更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu shí, yī gè yǎn shén bǐ hěn duō huà gèng zhòng yào.
sentences.english: Sometimes, a glance is more important than many words.

sentences.chinese: 高先生说：“其实，那儿有一个盒子，里面有答案。”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng shuō: “Qí shí, nà r yǒu yī gè hé zi, lǐ miàn yǒu dá àn.”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao said, "Actually, there is a box there, and the answer is inside."

sentences.chinese: 三先生马上站起来，走向那个角落。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng mǎ shàng zhàn qǐ lái, zǒu xiàng nà gè jiǎo luò.
sentences.english: Mr. San immediately stood up and walked toward that corner.

sentences.chinese: 他看到那里有一个小盒子，和第十章那个很像。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào nà li yǒu yī gè xiǎo hé zi, hé dì shí zhāng nà gè hěn xiàng.
sentences.english: He saw a small box there, very similar to the one in Chapter 10.

sentences.chinese: 他问：“这个盒子怎么打开？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn: “Zhè gè hé zi zěn me dǎ kāi?”
sentences.english: He asked, "How do I open this box?"

sentences.chinese: 高先生走过来，轻轻地握住他的手。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng zǒu guò lái, qīng qīng de wò zhù tā de shǒu.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao walked over and gently held his hand.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“现在，我可以告诉你了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Xiàn zài, wǒ kě yǐ gà o sù nǐ le.”
sentences.english: He said, "Now, I can tell you."

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，书店的门突然开了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, shū diàn de mén tū rán kāi le.
sentences.english: Just then, the bookstore door suddenly opened.

sentences.chinese: 一个女人走进来，看着他们，大声喊了高先生的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè nǚ rén zǒu jìn lái, kàn zhe tā men, dà shēng hǎn le Gāo xiān sheng de míng zi.
sentences.english: A woman walked in, looked at them, and called Mr. Gao's name loudly.

sentences.chinese: 三先生愣住了，他不知道这个女人是谁。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng lèng zhù le, tā bù zhī dào zhè gè nǚ rén shì shéi.
sentences.english: Mr. San was stunned; he didn't know who this woman was.

sentences.chinese: 这个女人看着高先生，眼神很复杂。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège nǚrén kànzhe Gāo xiān sheng, yǎnshén hěn fùzá.
sentences.english: This woman looked at Mr. Gao, her expression very complex.

sentences.chinese: 三先生看着这个女人，他觉得她很漂亮。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng kànzhe zhège nǚrén, tā juéde tā hěn piàoliang.
sentences.english: Mr. San looked at this woman; he thought she was very beautiful.

sentences.chinese: 高先生轻轻地说：“她是我的一位老朋友。”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng qīngqīng de shuō: “Tā shì wǒ de yī wèi lǎo péngyou.”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao said softly, "She is an old friend of mine."

sentences.chinese: 这个女人笑着说：“我不是朋友，我是他的前妻。”
sentences.pinyin: Zhège nǚrén xiàozhe shuō: “Wǒ bù shì péngyou, wǒ shì tā de qián qī.”
sentences.english: The woman smiled and said, "I am not a friend, I am his ex-wife."

sentences.chinese: 三先生愣住了，他觉得这是一件很严重的事。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng lèng zhù le, tā juéde zhè shì yī jiàn hěn yánzhòng de shì.
sentences.english: Mr. San was stunned; he felt this was a very serious matter.

sentences.chinese: 高先生看着三先生，他的眼神里有悲伤。
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng kànzhe Sān xiān sheng, tā de yǎnshén lǐ yǒu bēishāng.
sentences.english: Mr. Gao looked at Mr. San, and there was sadness in his eyes.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“她的名字叫林小姐。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Tā de míngzi jiào Lín xiǎojiě.”
sentences.english: He said, "Her name is Miss Lin."

sentences.chinese: 林小姐看着三先生，问他：“你是谁？”
