sentences.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě kànzhe Sān xiān sheng, wèn tā: “Nǐ shì shuí?”
sentences.english: Miss Lin looked at Mr. San and asked him, "Who are you?"

sentences.chinese: 高先生说：“他是我现在最重要的人。”
sentences.pinyin: Gāo xiān sheng shuō: “Tā shì wǒ xiànzài zuì zhòngyào de rén.”
sentences.english: Mr. Gao said, "He is the most important person to me now."

sentences.chinese: 林小姐叹了一口气，她说：“我从另一个国家回来了。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě tàn le yī kǒu qì, tā shuō: “Wǒ cóng lìng yī gè guójiā huílái le.”
sentences.english: Miss Lin sighed and said, "I have come back from another country."

sentences.chinese: 她说她离开过很多年，那是很多个大天之前的事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō tā líkāi guò hěnduō nián, nà shì hěnduō gè dà tiān zhīqián de shì.
sentences.english: She said she had been gone for many years, something from many big days ago.

sentences.chinese: 林小姐说，她以前和高先生住在同一个家。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě shuō, tā yǐqián hé Gāo xiān sheng zhù zài tóng yī gè jiā.
sentences.english: Miss Lin said she used to live in the same home with Mr. Gao.

sentences.chinese: 她记得那个家里的旧家具，还有那个蓝色的杯子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde nàge jiā lǐ de jiù jiājù, hái yǒu nàge lánsè de bēizi.
sentences.english: She remembered the old furniture in that home, and that blue cup.

sentences.chinese: 她还记得高先生的爸爸，一个很温柔的爸爸。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hái jìde Gāo xiān sheng de bàba, yī gè hěn wēnróu de bàba.
sentences.english: She also remembered Mr. Gao's father, a very gentle father.

sentences.chinese: 她记得高先生的妈妈，那个爱笑的妈妈。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde Gāo xiān sheng de māma, nàge ài xiào de māma.
sentences.english: She remembered Mr. Gao's mother, that mother who loved to smile.

sentences.chinese: 她记得高先生的爷爷，爷爷经常给她讲故事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde Gāo xiān sheng de yéye, yéye jīngcháng gěi tā jiǎng gùshì.
sentences.english: She remembered Mr. Gao's grandfather; grandfather often told her stories.

sentences.chinese: 林小姐说，她离开是因为一个误会。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě shuō, tā líkāi shì yīnwèi yī gè wùhuì.
sentences.english: Miss Lin said she left because of a misunderstanding.

sentences.chinese: 她看着三先生，问他：“你认识高先生多久了？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe Sān xiān sheng, wèn tā: “Nǐ rènshi Gāo xiān sheng duōjiǔ le?”
sentences.english: She looked at Mr. San and asked him, "How long have you known Mr. Gao?"

sentences.chinese: 三先生想了想，说：“我们认识一个月了。”
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng xiǎng le xiǎng, shuō: “Wǒmen rènshi yī gè yuè le.”
sentences.english: Mr. San thought for a moment and said, "We have known each other for a month."

sentences.chinese: 林小姐笑了，她说：“这个星期你一定很开心。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě xiào le, tā shuō: “Zhège xīngqī nǐ yīdìng hěn kāixīn.”
sentences.english: Miss Lin smiled and said, "You must have been very happy this week."

sentences.chinese: 三先生低头看着自己的手机，他不知道该说什么。
sentences.pinyin: Sān xiān sheng dītóu kànzhe zìjǐ de shǒujī, tā bù zhīdào gāi shuō shénme.
sentences.english: Mr. San looked down at his cell phone, not knowing what to say.

sentences.chinese: 他想起以前在电视里看到的爱情故事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ yǐqián zài diànshì lǐ kàndào de àiqíng gùshì.
sentences.english: He thought of the love stories he had seen on television before.

books.title_english: Lin Feng and the Lost Treasure
books.description_chinese: 勇敢的少年林风发现了一个奇怪的信号。他将与好朋友大强一起出发，寻找远方失踪的宝藏。他们能成功吗？
books.description_english: Brave young Lin Feng has discovered a mysterious signal. Alongside his friend Da Qiang, he embarks on a journey to find a long-lost treasure. Will they succeed in their quest?

sentences.chinese: 在远方的一座小镇上，住着一个勇敢的少年。
sentences.pinyin: Zài yuǎn fāng de yī zuò xiǎo zhèn shàng, zhù zhe yī gè yǒng gǎn de shào nián.
sentences.english: In a distant small town, there lived a brave youth.

sentences.chinese: 他姓林，大家都叫他林风。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xìng Lín, dà jiā dōu jiào tā Lín Fēng.
sentences.english: His surname is Lin, and everyone calls him Lin Feng.

sentences.chinese: 林风是一个好奇的学生，他想为世界寻找失踪的宝藏。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng shì yī gè hào qí de xué shēng, tā xiǎng wéi shì jiè xún zhǎo shī zōng de bǎo zàng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng is a curious student who wants to act as a seeker of the world's lost treasures.

sentences.chinese: 有一天，小镇举行了一个特别的集会。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu yī tiān, xiǎo zhèn jǔ xíng le yī gè tè bié de jí huì.
sentences.english: One day, the town held a special assembly.

sentences.chinese: 很多年轻人参加了这个集会，想听讲关于古老文明的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō nián qīng rén cān jiā le zhè gè jí huì, xiǎng tīng jiǎng guān yú gǔ lǎo wén míng de gù shì.
sentences.english: Many young people participated in this assembly, wanting to listen to a talk about ancient civilizations.

sentences.chinese: 林风在集会上举手，问教授关于“金山”的问题。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zài jí huì shàng jǔ shǒu, wèn jiào shòu guān yú “jīn shān” de wèn tí.
sentences.english: Lin Feng raised his hand at the assembly and asked the professor a question about the "Golden Mountain."

sentences.chinese: 教授告诉他，金山叫作“永恒之巅”。
sentences.pinyin: Jiào shòu gào sù tā, jīn shān jiào zuò “yǒng héng zhī diān”.
sentences.english: The professor told him that the Golden Mountain is called the "Peak of Eternity."

sentences.chinese: 林风听说那里有很多神奇的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng tīng shuō nà lǐ yǒu hěn duō shén qí de mì mì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng had heard that there were many magical secrets there.

sentences.chinese: 集会结束后，教授发给每个学生一张小纸条。
sentences.pinyin: Jí huì jié shù hòu, jiào shòu fā gěi měi gè xué shēng yī zhāng xiǎo zhǐ tiáo.
sentences.english: After the assembly ended, the professor sent out a small slip of paper to each student.

sentences.chinese: 林风取回自己的纸条，发现上面有一个秘密的入口。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng qǔ huí zì jǐ de zhǐ tiáo, fā xiàn shàng miàn yǒu yī gè mì mì de rù kǒu.
sentences.english: Lin Feng retrieved his slip and discovered a secret entrance on it.

sentences.chinese: 他决定去寻找这个入口，但需要一个伙伴。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué dìng qù xún zhǎo zhè gè rù kǒu, dàn xū yào yī gè huǒ bàn.
sentences.english: He decided to search for this entrance, but he needed a partner.

sentences.chinese: 他想交朋友，于是找到了他的好朋友大强。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng jiāo péng you, yú shì zhǎo dào le tā de hǎo péng you Dà Qiáng.
sentences.english: He wanted to make friends, so he found his good friend Da Qiang.

sentences.chinese: 大强养了一只聪明的大狗，叫作“雷电”。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng yǎng le yī zhī cōng míng de dà gǒu, jiào zuò “Léi Diàn”.
sentences.english: Da Qiang raises a smart big dog called "Thunder."

sentences.chinese: 林风和大强商量怎么去金山。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hé Dà Qiáng shāng liang zěn me qù jīn shān.
sentences.english: Lin Feng and Da Qiang discussed how to get to the Golden Mountain.

sentences.chinese: 他们决定使用一辆旧吉普车。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men jué dìng shǐ yòng yī liàng jiù jí pǔ chē.
sentences.english: They decided to use an old jeep.

sentences.chinese: 在出发前，他们必须先给车加油。
sentences.pinyin: Zài chū fā qián, tā men bì xū xiān gěi chē jiā yóu.
sentences.english: Before departing, they had to refuel the car first.

sentences.chinese: 车子在小镇的出口停了下来。
sentences.pinyin: Chē zi zài xiǎo zhèn de chū kǒu tíng le xià lái.
sentences.english: The car stopped at the exit of the small town.

sentences.chinese: 大强说：“我们得快点，不然就没时间午睡了。”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng shuō: “Wǒ men děi kuài diǎn, bù rán jiù méi shí jiān wǔ shuì le.”
sentences.english: Da Qiang said, "We have to hurry, otherwise there won't be time for a nap."

sentences.chinese: 林风笑了，他说：“现在不是午睡的时候！”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiào le, tā shuō: “Xiàn zài bú shì wǔ shuì de shí hou!”
sentences.english: Lin Feng laughed and said, "Now is not the time for a nap!"

sentences.chinese: 他们开车进入了深山，路上的风在吹。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men kāi chē jìn rù le shēn shān, lù shàng de fēng zài chuī.
sentences.english: They drove into the deep mountains, and the wind was blowing on the road.

sentences.chinese: 突然，车子停了，因为发动机出了问题。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, chē zi tíng le, yīn wèi fā dòng jī chū le wèn tí.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the car stopped because there was a problem with the engine.

sentences.chinese: 林风尝试停车，然后检查机器。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng cháng shì tíng chē, rán hòu jiǎn chá jī qì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng tried to pull over and then checked the machine.

sentences.chinese: 他借了一个工具箱，尝试用一种新的做法来修理。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiè le yī gè gōng jù xiāng, cháng shì yòng yī zhǒng xīn de zuò fǎ lái xiū lǐ.
sentences.english: He borrowed a toolbox and tried to repair it using a new method.

sentences.chinese: 虽然很难，但林风最终取得了成功，车子重新启动了。
sentences.pinyin: Suī rán hěn nán, dàn Lín Fēng zuì zhōng qǔ dé le chéng gōng, chē zi chóng xīn qǐ dòng le.
sentences.english: Although it was difficult, Lin Feng eventually obtained success, and the car restarted.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个奇怪的黑衣人出现了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yī gè qí guài de hēi yī rén chū xiàn le.
sentences.english: At that moment, a strange man in black appeared.

sentences.chinese: 黑衣人喊道：“把地图交给我！”
sentences.pinyin: Hēi yī rén hǎn dào: “Bǎ dì tú jiāo gěi wǒ!”
sentences.english: The man in black shouted, "Hand over the map to me!"

sentences.chinese: 林风赶紧把地图交给大强的背包里，藏在了一套厚衣服下面。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎn jǐn bǎ dì tú jiāo gěi Dà Qiáng de bēi bāo lǐ, cáng zài le yī tào hòu yī fú xià miàn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng quickly handed the map over into Da Qiang's backpack, hiding it under a set of thick clothes.

sentences.chinese: 黑衣人和他们分开，消失在森林里。
sentences.pinyin: Hēi yī rén hé tā men fēn kāi, xiāo shī zài sēn lín lǐ.
sentences.english: The man in black separated from them and disappeared into the forest.

sentences.chinese: 林风看了一眼表，现在是三点一刻。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn le yī yǎn biǎo, xiàn zài shì sān diǎn yī kè.
sentences.english: Lin Feng glanced at his watch; it was a quarter past three.

sentences.chinese: 他们必须在太阳下山前找到真正的入口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men bì xū zài tài yáng xià shān qián zhǎo dào zhēn zhèng de rù kǒu.
sentences.english: They must find the real entrance before the sun sets.

sentences.chinese: 大强说：“我饿了，我们能不能先做饭？”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng shuō: “Wǒ è le, wǒ men néng bù néng xiān zuò fàn?”
sentences.english: Da Qiang said, "I'm hungry, can we cook a meal first?"

sentences.chinese: 林风看着远方的山峰，心里充满了紧张和兴奋。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn zhe yuǎn fāng de shān fēng, xīn lǐ chōng mǎn le jǐn zhāng hé xīng fèn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the distant peaks, his heart full of tension and excitement.

sentences.chinese: 他们真的能找到宝藏吗？
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zhēn de néng zhǎo dào bǎo zàng ma?
sentences.english: Could they really find the treasure?

sentences.chinese: 林风看着大强，笑了笑。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn zhe Dà Qiáng, xiào le xiào.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at Da Qiang and smiled.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“我们先做饭，然后马上出发。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ men xiān zuò fàn, rán hòu mǎ shàng chū fā.”
sentences.english: He said, "Let's cook first, then we set off immediately."

sentences.chinese: 他们拿出了一些面包和水。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men ná chū le yī xiē miàn bāo hé shuǐ.
sentences.english: They took out some bread and water.

sentences.chinese: 大强拿起水杯，开心地说：“为了宝藏，干杯！”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng ná qǐ shuǐ bēi, kāi xīn de shuō: “Wèi le bǎo zàng, gān bēi!”
sentences.english: Da Qiang picked up his water cup and said happily, "To the treasure, cheers!"

sentences.chinese: 林风想起他大学时在山区的实习经历。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎng qǐ tā dà xué shí zài shān qū de shí xí jīng lì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng recalled his internship experience in the mountains during college.

sentences.chinese: 那时候，他学习如何在这个危险的地方生存。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shí hou, tā xué xí rú hé zài zhè ge wēi xiǎn de dì fāng shēng cún.
sentences.english: At that time, he learned how to survive in this dangerous place.

sentences.chinese: 他想起在那次实习中，一位老向导给过他的帮助。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ zài nà cì shí xí zhōng, yī wèi lǎo xiàng dǎo gěi guò tā de bāng zhù.
sentences.english: He remembered the help a veteran guide had given him during that internship.

sentences.chinese: 向导曾提到，这里的地图不能只看表面。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo céng tí dào, zhè lǐ de dì tú bù néng zhǐ kàn biǎo miàn.
sentences.english: The guide once mentioned that the maps here cannot be taken only at face value.

sentences.chinese: 林风拿出打印好的地图，认真地看着。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng ná chū dǎ yìn hǎo de dì tú, rèn zhēn de kàn zhe.
sentences.english: Lin Feng took out the printed map and looked at it seriously.

sentences.chinese: 他打算找出地图上隐藏的真正入口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dǎ suàn zhǎo chū dì tú shàng yǐn cáng de zhēn zhèng rù kǒu.
sentences.english: He planned to find the true hidden entrance on the map.

sentences.chinese: 他想到，地图上的线条可能需要改变方向。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng dào, dì tú shàng de xiàn tiāo kě néng xū yào gǎi biàn fāng xiàng.
sentences.english: He thought that the lines on the map might need to change direction.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试在纸上改了几次线。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cháng shì zài zhǐ shàng gǎi le jǐ cì xiàn.
sentences.english: He tried changing the lines on the paper a few times.

sentences.chinese: 接着，他得出一个结论：入口在东边的山谷。
sentences.pinyin: Jiē zhe, tā dé chū yī gè jié lùn: rù kǒu zài dōng biān de shān gǔ.
sentences.english: Then, he arrived at a conclusion: the entrance was in the eastern valley.

sentences.chinese: 林风突然想起，他在报纸的广告上看到过这个山谷。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng tū rán xiǎng qǐ, tā zài bào zhǐ de guǎng gào shàng kàn dào guò zhè ge shān gǔ.
sentences.english: Lin Feng suddenly remembered seeing this valley in a newspaper advertisement.

sentences.chinese: 那个广告说这里有古老的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge guǎng gào shuō zhè lǐ yǒu gǔ lǎo de mì mì.
sentences.english: That ad said there were ancient secrets here.

sentences.chinese: 大强看着林风，提出了一个问题。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng kàn zhe Lín Fēng, tí chū le yī gè wèn tí.
sentences.english: Da Qiang looked at Lin Feng and raised a question.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“我们现在该怎么走？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ men xiàn zài gāi zěn me zǒu?”
sentences.english: He said, "How should we go now?"

sentences.chinese: 林风和大强开始了一段简单的对话。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hé Dà Qiáng kāi shǐ le yī duàn jiǎn dān de duì huà.
sentences.english: Lin Feng and Da Qiang began a simple conversation.

sentences.chinese: 林风说：“接下来，我们需要换一套衣服。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng shuō: “Jiē xià lái, wǒ men xū yào huàn yī tào yī fú.”
sentences.english: Lin Feng said, "Next, we need to change our clothes."

sentences.chinese: 他们换上了适合爬山的衣服，然后放下背包。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men huàn shàng le shì hé pá shān de yī fú, rán hòu fàng xià bèi bāo.
sentences.english: They changed into clothes suitable for climbing and then put down their backpacks.

sentences.chinese: 林风拿出了他的电子指南针，按下按钮开机。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng ná chū le tā de diàn zǐ zhǐ nán zhēn, àn xià àn niǔ kāi jī.
sentences.english: Lin Feng took out his electronic compass and pressed the button to boot it up.

sentences.chinese: 指南针带来了一个准确的方向。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐ nán zhēn dài lái le yī gè zhǔn què de fāng xiàng.
sentences.english: The compass brought an accurate direction.

sentences.chinese: 大强看着指南针，感叹道：“太神奇了！”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng kàn zhe zhǐ nán zhēn, gǎn tàn dào: “Tài shén qí le!”
sentences.english: Da Qiang looked at the compass and exclaimed, "Amazing!"

sentences.chinese: 林风被大强的热情感动了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng bèi Dà Qiáng de rè qíng gǎn dòng le.
sentences.english: Lin Feng was touched by Da Qiang's enthusiasm.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉大强，如果他们拿到宝藏，收入会变得很高。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su Dà Qiáng, rú guǒ tā men ná dào bǎo zàng, shōu rù huì biàn de hěn gāo.
sentences.english: He told Da Qiang that if they obtained the treasure, their income would become very high.

sentences.chinese: 大强听到这个，眼睛亮了，他立刻接受了这个想法。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng tīng dào zhè ge, yǎn jīng liàng le, tā lì kè jiē shòu le zhè ge xiǎng fǎ.
sentences.english: Hearing this, Da Qiang's eyes lit up, and he immediately accepted this idea.

sentences.chinese: 他们开始在森林中行走，树木排成了一行行的墙。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men kāi shǐ zài sēn lín zhōng xíng zǒu, shù mù pái chéng le yī háng háng de qiáng.
sentences.english: They began walking in the forest, where the trees were arranged in rows like walls.

sentences.chinese: 林风拉着大强，快速地走在前面。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng lā zhe Dà Qiáng, kuài sù de zǒu zài qián miàn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng pulled Da Qiang and walked quickly in front.

sentences.chinese: 突然，林风的手机收到了一个奇怪的信号。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, Lín Fēng de shǒu jī shōu dào le yī gè qí guài de xìn hào.
sentences.english: Suddenly, Lin Feng's phone received a strange signal.

sentences.chinese: 他接通了电话，但对面只有风的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiē tōng le diàn huà, dàn duì miàn zhǐ yǒu fēng de shēng yīn.
sentences.english: He answered the phone, but there was only the sound of wind on the other side.

sentences.chinese: 林风意识到，这次冒险改变了他的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yì shí dào, zhè cì mào xiǎn gǎi biàn le tā de shēng huó.
sentences.english: Lin Feng realized that this adventure had changed his life.

sentences.chinese: 他们终于在山谷的尽头发现了一扇巨大的石门。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zhōng yú zài shān gǔ de jìn tóu fā xiàn le yī shàn jù dà de shí mén.
sentences.english: They finally discovered a huge stone door at the end of the valley.

sentences.chinese: 但石门上有一个奇怪的锁，他们需要一个钥匙才能进去。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn shí mén shàng yǒu yī gè qí guài de suǒ, tā men xū yào yī gè yào shi cái néng jìn qù.
sentences.english: But there was a strange lock on the stone door; they needed a key to get in.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 3: The Mystery of the Stone Door

sentences.chinese: 林风看着手机上的奇怪信号，心里很紧张。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe shǒujī shàng de qíguài xìnhào, xīnlǐ hěn jǐnzhāng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the strange signal on his phone, feeling very nervous.

sentences.chinese: 他想，这个信号可能来自一个很远的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, zhège xìnhào kěnéng láizì yīgè hěn yuǎn de dìfāng.
sentences.english: He thought this signal might come from a very far place.

sentences.chinese: 大强走过来，好奇地看着林风。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng zǒu guòlái, hàoqí de kànzhe Lín Fēng.
sentences.english: Da Qiang came over, looking at Lin Feng curiously.

sentences.chinese: “我们要怎么进入这扇大门？”大强问道。
sentences.pinyin: “Wǒmen yào zěnme jìnrù zhè shàn dàmén?” Dà Qiáng wèn dào.
sentences.english: "How are we going to enter this great door?" Da Qiang asked.

sentences.chinese: 林风看着门上的锁，那里有一幅古老的画。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe mén shàng de suǒ, nàlǐ yǒu yī fú gǔlǎo de huà.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the lock on the door, where there was an ancient painting.

sentences.chinese: 画上有一个人正在爬一座很高的山。
sentences.pinyin: Huà shàng yǒu yīgè rén zhèngzài pá yī zuò hěn gāo de shān.
sentences.english: In the painting, a person was climbing a very high mountain.

sentences.chinese: 林风记得他的老师曾经教学过关于古代锁的方法。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jìdé tā de lǎoshī céngjīng jiāoxué guò guānyú gǔdài suǒ de fāngfǎ.
sentences.english: Lin Feng remembered that his teacher had once taught methods regarding ancient locks.

sentences.chinese: 老师说，要打开这样的锁，必须数清楚画上的星星。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō, yào dǎkāi zhèyàng de suǒ, bìxū shǔ qīngchǔ huà shàng de xīngxīng.
sentences.english: The teacher said that to open such a lock, one must count the stars in the painting clearly.

sentences.chinese: 林风开始数画上的星星：一，二，三……
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kāishǐ shǔ huà shàng de xīngxīng: yī, èr, sān……
sentences.english: Lin Feng began to count the stars in the painting: one, two, three...

sentences.chinese: 他发现星星的数量像是在练习某种特殊的数学。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn xīngxīng de shùliàng xiàng shì zài liànxí mǒu zhǒng tèshū de shùxué.
sentences.english: He discovered that the number of stars seemed to be practicing some kind of special mathematics.

sentences.chinese: “这像是一个练习题，”林风对大强讲。
sentences.pinyin: “Zhè xiàng shì yīgè liànxítí,” Lín Fēng duì Dà Qiáng jiǎng.
sentences.english: "This is like an exercise problem," Lin Feng told Da Qiang.

sentences.chinese: 大强听了，觉得这是一个笑话。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng tīngle, juédé zhè shì yīgè xiàohua.
sentences.english: Da Qiang heard this and thought it was a joke.

sentences.chinese: “你觉得我们在山里做数学练习？”大强笑了起来。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ juédé wǒmen zài shān lǐ zuò shùxué liànxí?” Dà Qiáng xiào le qǐlái.
sentences.english: "You think we are doing math exercises in the mountains?" Da Qiang started laughing.

sentences.chinese: 林风没有理他，而是认真地讨论这个谜题。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng méiyǒu lǐ tā, ér shì rènzhēn de tǎolùn zhège mítí.
sentences.english: Lin Feng ignored him and seriously discussed this puzzle.

sentences.chinese: 他请求大强帮他一起看那些细节。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qǐngqiú Dà Qiáng bāng tā yīqǐ kàn nàxiē xìjié.
sentences.english: He requested Da Qiang to help him look at those details.

sentences.chinese: 大强虽然在笑，但还是决定帮忙。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng suīrán zài xiào, dàn háishì juédìng bāngmáng.
sentences.english: Although Da Qiang was laughing, he still decided to help.

sentences.chinese: 他们发现，如果重复画上的动作，门可能会开。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen fāxiàn, rúguǒ chóngfù huà shàng de dòngzuò, mén kěnéng huì kāi.
sentences.english: They discovered that if they repeated the actions in the painting, the door might open.

sentences.chinese: 林风尝试让大强在门前走三个圈。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng chángshì ràng Dà Qiáng zài mén qián zǒu sān gè quān.
sentences.english: Lin Feng tried to let Da Qiang walk three circles in front of the door.

sentences.chinese: 大强走完后，林风发现门上的水开始流了下来。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng zǒu wán hòu, Lín Fēng fāxiàn mén shàng de shuǐ kāishǐ liú le xiàlái.
sentences.english: After Da Qiang finished walking, Lin Feng found that water began to flow down the door.

sentences.chinese: 水流在石头上画出了一条线，像是在欢迎他们进入。
sentences.pinyin: Shuǐliú zài shítou shàng huà chū le yī tiáo xiàn, xiàng shì zài huānyíng tāmen jìnrù.
sentences.english: The flowing water drew a line on the stone, as if welcoming them to enter.

sentences.chinese: 林风突然想起，他曾经租过一本关于古文明的书。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng tūrán xiǎngqǐ, tā céngjīng zū guò yī běn guānyú gǔ wénmíng de shū.
sentences.english: Lin Feng suddenly remembered that he had once rented a book about ancient civilizations.

sentences.chinese: 书里提到，这种门是送给勇敢探索者的礼物。
sentences.pinyin: Shū lǐ tídào, zhè zhǒng mén shì sònggěi yǒnggǎn tànsuǒ zhě de lǐwù.
sentences.english: The book mentioned that this kind of door is a gift given to brave explorers.

sentences.chinese: 他们需要选一个正确的方向推门。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xūyào xuǎn yīgè zhèngquè de fāngxiàng tuī mén.
sentences.english: They needed to choose the correct direction to push the door.

sentences.chinese: 林风在心里算了一下时间，现在是中午。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zài xīnlǐ suàn le yīxià shíjiān, xiànzài shì zhōngwǔ.
sentences.english: Lin Feng calculated the time in his head; it was now noon.

sentences.chinese: 他通知大强，现在就是最好的机会。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tōngzhī Dà Qiáng, xiànzài jiùshì zuì hǎo de jīhuì.
sentences.english: He notified Da Qiang that now was the best opportunity.

sentences.chinese: 大强说：“如果我们能进去，我愿意请客吃大餐！”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng shuō: “Rúguǒ wǒmen néng jìnqù, wǒ yuànyì qǐngkè chī dàcān!”
sentences.english: Da Qiang said, "If we can get in, I'm willing to treat everyone to a big feast!"

sentences.chinese: 林风笑了，他觉得这次冒险让他学会了怎么面对困难。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiào le, tā juédé zhè cì màoxiǎn ràng tā xuéhuì le zěnme miànduì kùnnán.
sentences.english: Lin Feng smiled; he felt this adventure had taught him how to face difficulties.

sentences.chinese: 他想起在城市里生活的时候，每天只想洗澡和睡觉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zài chéngshì lǐ shēnghuó de shíhou, měitiān zhǐ xiǎng xǐzǎo hé shuìjiào.
sentences.english: He thought about when he lived in the city, wanting only to bathe and sleep every day.

sentences.chinese: 但现在，他感觉生命在这一刻真正地生了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiànzài, tā gǎnjué shēngmìng zài zhè yīkè zhēnzhèng de shēng le qǐlái.
sentences.english: But now, he felt that life truly came alive at this moment.

sentences.chinese: 他拿出相机，对着石门照相，想留下这个时刻。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū xiàngjī, duìzhe shímén zhàoxiàng, xiǎng liúxià zhège shíkè.
sentences.english: He took out his camera, took a photo of the stone door, wanting to leave behind this moment.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，手机再次响了，是一个紧急的通知。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, shǒujī zàicì xiǎng le, shì yīgè jǐnjí de tōngzhī.
sentences.english: Just then, the phone rang again; it was an emergency notice.

sentences.chinese: 声音在讲话，虽然很模糊，但听起来像是在求救。
sentences.pinyin: Shēngyīn zài jiǎnghuà, suīrán hěn móhu, dàn tīng qǐlái xiàng shì zài qiújiù.
sentences.english: A voice was speaking, although it was blurry, it sounded like a plea for help.

sentences.chinese: 林风和大强对视了一眼，决定立刻进入石门。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hé Dà Qiáng duìshì le yīyǎn, juédìng lìkè jìnrù shímén.
sentences.english: Lin Feng and Da Qiang looked at each other and decided to enter the stone door immediately.

sentences.chinese: 就在他们进入的一瞬间，远处传来一声巨大的响声，像是有什么东西起飞了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tāmen jìnrù de yī shùnjiān, yuǎnchù chuán lái yī shēng jùdà de xiǎngshēng, xiàng shì yǒu shéme dōngxī qǐfēi le.
sentences.english: The moment they entered, a huge sound came from the distance, as if something had taken off.

sentences.chinese: 他们回头看，但石门已经关上了，他们被留在了一个完全陌生的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen huítóu kàn, dàn shímén yǐjīng guān shàng le, tāmen bèi liú zài le yīgè wánquán mòshēng de dìfāng.
sentences.english: They looked back, but the stone door had already closed; they were left in a completely strange place.

sentences.chinese: 石门关了，林风和大强现在在黑暗的里头。
sentences.pinyin: Shímén guān le, Lín Fēng hé Dà Qiáng xiànzài zài hēi'àn de lǐtou.
sentences.english: The stone door closed, and Lin Feng and Da Qiang were now inside the darkness.

sentences.chinese: 他们点亮手电筒，发现这里到处都是奇怪的石头。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen diǎnliàng shǒudiàntǒng, fāxiàn zhèlǐ dào chù dōu shì qíguài de shítou.
sentences.english: They turned on their flashlights and found that there were strange stones everywhere.

sentences.chinese: 林风是一个勇敢的青年，他决定一直向前走。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng shì yīgè yǒnggǎn de qīngnián, tā juédìng yīzhí xiàng qián zǒu.
sentences.english: Lin Feng is a brave youth, and he decided to keep walking straight forward.

sentences.chinese: 大强十分紧张，他老是问：“我们要走多久？”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng shífēn jǐnzhāng, tā lǎoshì wèn: “Wǒmen yào zǒu duōjiǔ?”
sentences.english: Da Qiang was very nervous; he kept asking, "How long do we have to walk?"

sentences.chinese: 林风看着地图说，这个迷宫的长度非常长。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe dìtú shuō, zhège mígōng de chángdù fēicháng cháng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the map and said the length of this labyrinth was very long.

sentences.chinese: 他们发现墙上写着：这里的宝藏是全国最著名的。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen fāxiàn qiáng shàng xiězhe: zhèlǐ de bǎozàng shì quánguó zuì zhùmíng de.
sentences.english: They noticed writing on the wall: the treasure here is the most famous in the whole nation.

sentences.chinese: 林风心想，如果能找到它，他全家都会过上好日子。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xīnxiǎng, rúguǒ néng zhǎodào tā, tā quánjiā dōu huì guò shàng hǎo rìzi.
sentences.english: Lin Feng thought that if they could find it, his whole family would live a good life.

sentences.chinese: 大强突然摔了一跤，全身都脏了。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng tūrán shuāile yī jiāo, quánshēn dōu zāng le.
sentences.english: Da Qiang suddenly tripped and his whole body got dirty.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这次冒险太危险，想永远留在家里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde zhè cì màoxiǎn tài wēixiǎn, xiǎng yǒngyuǎn liú zài jiālǐ.
sentences.english: He felt this adventure was too dangerous and wanted to stay at home forever.

sentences.chinese: 但林风告诉他，所有伟大的发现都需要勇气。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn Lín Fēng gàosù tā, suǒyǒu wěidà de fāxiàn dōu xūyào yǒngqì.
sentences.english: But Lin Feng told him that all great discoveries require courage.

sentences.chinese: 他们走了一会儿，发现路口一共分成了三条路。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒu le yīhuìr, fāxiàn lùkǒu yīgòng fēnchéng le sān tiáo lù.
sentences.english: After walking for a while, they found that the path split into three ways altogether.

sentences.chinese: 林风觉得这里的空气完全不同，感觉很新鲜。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng juéde zhèlǐ de kōngqì wánquán bùtóng, gǎnjué hěn xīnxiān.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt the air here was completely different; it felt very fresh.

sentences.chinese: 他想起爷爷说过，他在一生中见过最神奇的地方就是这里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ yéye shuōguò, tā zài yīshēng zhōng jiànguò zuì shénqí de dìfāng jiùshì zhèlǐ.
sentences.english: He remembered his grandfather saying that the most magical place he had seen in his life was here.

sentences.chinese: 爷爷说这里全年都有水，而且有一种神奇的药水可以治病。
sentences.pinyin: Yéye shuō zhèlǐ quánnián dōu yǒu shuǐ, érqiě yǒu yī zhǒng shénqí de yàoshuǐ kěyǐ zhìbìng.
sentences.english: Grandfather said there is water here all year long, and there is a kind of magical medicinal liquid that can cure diseases.

sentences.chinese: 林风对大强说：“大家不要害怕，我们全部都要一起出去。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng duì Dà Qiáng shuō: “Dàjiā bùyào hàipà, wǒmen quánbù dōu yào yīqǐ chūqù.”
sentences.english: Lin Feng said to Da Qiang, "Everyone, don't be afraid, we all must get out together."

sentences.chinese: 他提醒大强，在迷宫里随时都要小心地上的陷阱。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tíxǐng Dà Qiáng, zài mígōng lǐ suíshí dōu yào xiǎoxīn dìshàng de xiànjǐng.
sentences.english: He reminded Da Qiang to be careful of traps on the ground at any time in the labyrinth.

sentences.chinese: 如果全体成员都能保持冷静，他们一定能成功。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ quántǐ chéngyuán dōu néng bǎochí lěngjìng, tāmen yīdìng néng chénggōng.
sentences.english: If the entire group can stay calm, they will surely succeed.

sentences.chinese: 他们决定选择中间那条路，因为那里有光。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen juédìng xuǎnzé zhōngjiān nà tiáo lù, yīnwèi nàlǐ yǒu guāng.
sentences.english: They decided to choose the middle path because there was light there.

sentences.chinese: 就在他们走进去时，地上的石头突然开始移动。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tāmen zǒu jìnqù shí, dìshàng de shítou tūrán kāishǐ yídòng.
sentences.english: Just as they walked in, the stones on the ground suddenly began to move.

sentences.chinese: 一个巨大的阴影在他们面前出现，挡住了所有的路。
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè jùdà de yīnyǐng zài tāmen miànqián chūxiàn, dǎngzhù le suǒyǒu de lù.
sentences.english: A huge shadow appeared in front of them, blocking all the paths.

sentences.chinese: 这个阴影在说话，声音像雷一样大。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège yīnyǐng zài shuōhuà, shēngyīn xiàng léi yīyàng dà.
sentences.english: This shadow began to speak, its voice as loud as thunder.

sentences.chinese: 那个巨大的阴影看着他们，声音低沉。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge jù dà de yīn yǐng kàn zhe tā men, shēng yīn dī chén.
sentences.english: The giant shadow looked at them, its voice deep.

sentences.chinese: “你们想平安离开这里吗？”阴影问。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ men xiǎng píng ān lí kāi zhè lǐ ma?” yīn yǐng wèn.
sentences.english: "Do you want to leave this place safe and sound?" the shadow asked.

sentences.chinese: 林风很紧张，但他告诉大强：“放心，我会保护你。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hěn jǐn zhāng, dàn tā gào su dà Qiáng: “fàng xīn, wǒ huì bǎo hù nǐ.”
sentences.english: Lin Feng was nervous, but he told Da Qiang, "Rest assured, I will protect you."

sentences.chinese: 阴影笑了，他说他叫海先生。
sentences.pinyin: Yīn yǐng xiào le, tā shuō tā jiào Hǎi xiān sheng.
sentences.english: The shadow smiled and said his name was Mr. Hai.

sentences.chinese: 海先生穿着一件蓝色的长袍，看起来并不像坏人。
sentences.pinyin: Yīn yǐng chuān zhe yī jiàn lán sè de cháng páo, kàn qǐ lái bìng bù xiàng huài rén.
sentences.english: Mr. Hai wore a blue robe and did not look like a bad person.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“如果你能给我一件有用的东西，我就让你们顺利通过。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Rú guǒ nǐ néng gěi wǒ yī jiàn yǒu yòng de dōng xi, wǒ jiù ràng nǐ men shùn lì tōng guò.”
sentences.english: He said, "If you can give me something useful, I will let you pass smoothly."

sentences.chinese: 大强在口袋里找了很久，最后拿出了一张银行卡。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng zài kǒu dài lǐ zhǎo le hěn jiǔ, zuì hòu ná chū le yī zhāng yín háng kǎ.
sentences.english: Da Qiang searched his pocket for a long time and finally took out a bank card.

sentences.chinese: “这对我来说很便宜，但对你可能很有用，”大强说。
sentences.pinyin: “Zhè duì wǒ lái shuō hěn biàn yi, dàn duì nǐ kě néng hěn yǒu yòng,” dà Qiáng shuō.
sentences.english: "This is cheap for me, but it might be very useful for you," Da Qiang said.

sentences.chinese: 海先生接过卡，像在看一个奇怪的顾客一样看着大强。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi xiān sheng jiē guò kǎ, xiàng zài kàn yī gè qí guài de gù kè yī yàng kàn zhe dà Qiáng.
sentences.english: Mr. Hai took the card and looked at Da Qiang as if he were a strange customer.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这张卡不错，于是决定给他们一些好处。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué de zhè zhāng kǎ bù cuò, yú shì jué dìng gěi tā men yī xiē hǎo chǔ.
sentences.english: He felt the card was not bad, so he decided to give them some benefits.

sentences.chinese: “你们是好人，我可以帮你们，”海先生说。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ men shì hǎo rén, wǒ kě yǐ bāng nǐ men,” Hǎi xiān sheng shuō.
sentences.english: "You are good people, I can help you," Mr. Hai said.

sentences.chinese: 不一会儿，阴影在面前变出了一扇门。
sentences.pinyin: Bù yī huǐ r, yīn yǐng zài miàn qián biàn chū le yī shàn mén.
sentences.english: In a short while, the shadow conjured a door in front of them.

sentences.chinese: 门后是一个凉快的地方，空气非常舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Mén hòu shì yī gè liáng kuai de dì fang, kōng qì fēi cháng shū fu.
sentences.english: Behind the door was a pleasantly cool place, and the air was very comfortable.

sentences.chinese: 林风觉得挺好，因为这里不再那么压抑了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jué de tǐng hǎo, yīn wèi zhè lǐ bù zài nà me yā yì le.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt it was very good because it was no longer so oppressive here.

sentences.chinese: 他很高兴他们能平安地走出那个迷宫。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hěn gāo xìng tā men néng píng ān de zǒu chū nà ge mí gōng.
sentences.english: He was glad they could safely leave that maze.

sentences.chinese: 大强也很开心，他大声说：“太好了！我们终于成功了！”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng yě hěn kāi xīn, tā dà shēng shuō: “Tài hǎo le! Wǒ men zhōng yú chéng gōng le!”
sentences.english: Da Qiang was also very happy, shouting, "Great! We finally succeeded!"

sentences.chinese: 他们走进新区域，心情变得非常快乐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zǒu jìn xīn qū yù, xīn qíng biàn de fēi cháng kuài lè.
sentences.english: They walked into the new area, and their mood became very joyful.

sentences.chinese: 海先生在后面喊道：“喂！记得以后要小心！”
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi xiān sheng zài hòu miàn hǎn dào: “Wéi! Jì de yǐ hòu yào xiǎo xīn!”
sentences.english: Mr. Hai shouted from behind, "Hello! Remember to be careful in the future!"

sentences.chinese: 林风回头对他挥挥手，开玩笑说：“祝你一路顺风！”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng huí tóu duì tā huī huī shǒu, kāi wán xiào shuō: “Zhù nǐ yī lù shùn fēng!”
sentences.english: Lin Feng turned back and waved to him, joking, "I wish you a pleasant journey!"

sentences.chinese: 大强也笑着说：“祝你一路平安！”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng yě xiào zhe shuō: “Zhù nǐ yī lù píng ān!”
sentences.english: Da Qiang also smiled and said, "Bon voyage!"

sentences.chinese: 他们走得很远，直到天黑，林风对大强说：“晚安，明天我们继续。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zǒu de hěn yuǎn, zhí dào tiān hēi, Lín Fēng duì dà Qiáng shuō: “Wǎn ān, míng tiān wǒ men jì xù.”
sentences.english: They walked a long way until it got dark, and Lin Feng said to Da Qiang, "Good night, we continue tomorrow."

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，他们发现前面的路突然消失了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, tā men fā xiàn qián miàn de lù tū rán xiāo shī le.
sentences.english: But just then, they discovered that the road ahead had suddenly disappeared.

chapters.title_chinese: 第六章：消失的路与黑暗之谷
chapters.title_english: Chapter 6: The Vanishing Path and the Valley of Darkness

sentences.chinese: 林风和大强站在原地，看着前面的路突然消失了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hé Dà Qiáng zhàn zài yuán dì, kàn zhe qián miàn de lù tū rán xiāo shī le.
sentences.english: Lin Feng and Da Qiang stood where they were, watching the road ahead suddenly vanish.

sentences.chinese: 这是一个非常可怕的难题。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yí gè fēi cháng kě pà de nán tí.
sentences.english: This was a very frightening difficult problem.

sentences.chinese: 林风尝试用手机看地图，但是手机突然卡了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng cháng shì yòng shǒu jī kàn dì tú, dàn shì shǒu jī tū rán kǎ le.
sentences.english: Lin Feng tried to use his phone to look at the map, but the phone suddenly lagged.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试重启，但手机最后直接关机了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cháng shì chóng qǐ, dàn shǒu jī zuì hòu zhí jiē guān jī le.
sentences.english: He tried to restart it, but the phone eventually just shut down.

sentences.chinese: 大强觉得很难过，他小声说：“我们是不是被困在这里了？”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng jué de hěn nán guò, tā xiǎo shēng shuō: “Wǒ men shì bú shì bèi kùn zài zhè lǐ le?”
sentences.english: Da Qiang felt very sad; he whispered, "Are we trapped here?"

sentences.chinese: 林风看着周围漆黑的环境，心里感到很不安。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn zhe zhōu wéi chì hēi de huán jìng, xīn lǐ gǎn dào hěn bù ān.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the pitch-black environment around them and felt uneasy in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 这里的空气很冷，而且光线很低。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de kōng qì hěn lěng, ér qiě guāng xiàn hěn dī.
sentences.english: The air here was very cold, and the light was very low.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他们听到远处传来一些难听的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, tā men tīng dào yuǎn chù chuán lái yì xiē nán tīng de shēng yīn.
sentences.english: Suddenly, they heard some unpleasant sounds coming from the distance.

sentences.chinese: 那声音像是有什么东西在哭，听起来非常难受。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shēng yīn xiàng shì yǒu shén me dōng xī zài kū, tīng qǐ lái fēi cháng nán shòu.
sentences.english: That sound was like something was crying; it sounded very distressing.

sentences.chinese: 大强害怕得想哭，他说：“这里一定有坏人！”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng hài pà de xiǎng kū, tā shuō: “Zhè lǐ yí dìng yǒu huài rén!”
sentences.english: Da Qiang was so scared he wanted to cry, saying, "There must be bad people here!"

sentences.chinese: 林风告诉他：“不要害怕，我们要一起面对。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gào su tā: “Bú yào hài pà, wǒ men yào yì qǐ miàn duì.”
sentences.english: Lin Feng told him, "Don't be afraid, we must face this together."

sentences.chinese: 他们往前走，发现路变得很短，而且非常难看，到处是碎石。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men wǎng qián zǒu, fā xiàn lù biàn de hěn duǎn, ér qiě fēi cháng nán kàn, dào chù shì suì shí.
sentences.english: They walked forward and found the path had become very short and very ugly, with crushed stones everywhere.

sentences.chinese: 大强不小心踩到了石头，脚突然很疼。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng bù xiǎo xīn cǎi dào le shí tou, jiǎo tū rán hěn téng.
sentences.english: Da Qiang accidentally stepped on a rock, and his foot suddenly hurt a lot.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得身体很不舒服，心情也很不满。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué de shēn tǐ hěn bù shū fu, xīn qíng yě hěn bù mǎn.
sentences.english: He felt physically unwell and was very dissatisfied with the situation.

sentences.chinese: 林风说：“我们只能慢慢走，这样可以省力气。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng shuō: “Wǒ men zhǐ néng màn màn zǒu, zhè yàng kě yǐ shěng lì qi.”
sentences.english: Lin Feng said, "We can only walk slowly; this way we can save energy."

sentences.chinese: 大强低着头说：“不好意思，我走得太慢了。”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng dī zhe tóu shuō: “Bù hǎo yì si, wǒ zǒu de tài màn le.”
sentences.english: Da Qiang lowered his head and said, "I'm sorry, I'm walking too slowly."

sentences.chinese: 林风笑了笑：“没关系，现在的路不如之前的路好走。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiào le xiào: “Méi guān xi, xiàn zài de lù bù rú zhī qián de lù hǎo zǒu.”
sentences.english: Lin Feng smiled, "It's okay, the current road is not as good to walk as the previous one."

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，他们看到前方有一堵巨大的石墙。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, tā men kàn dào qián fāng yǒu yì dǔ jù dà de shí qiáng.
sentences.english: Just then, they saw a huge stone wall ahead.

sentences.chinese: 林风用力推石墙，但石墙一点也不动。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yòng lì tuī shí qiáng, dàn shí qiáng yì diǎn yě bú dòng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng pushed the stone wall with all his might, but the wall didn't move at all.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“不行，我们不能从这里过去。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Bù xíng, wǒ men bù néng cóng zhè lǐ guò qù.”
sentences.english: He said, "It won't do, we cannot pass through here."

sentences.chinese: 突然，旁边的地面开始倒塌，一块大石头掉了下来。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, páng biān de dì miàn kāi shǐ dǎo tā, yí kuài dà shí tou diào le xià lái.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the ground beside them began to collapse, and a large rock fell down.

sentences.chinese: 他们赶紧跳开，差点掉进深渊。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men gǎn jǐn tiào kāi, chà diǎn diào jìn shēn yuān.
sentences.english: They quickly jumped away, almost falling into the abyss.

sentences.chinese: 林风发现这个地方有很多坏处，最危险的就是地基不稳。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng fā xiàn zhè gè dì fang yǒu hěn duō huài chu, zuì wēi xiǎn de jiù shì dì jī bù wěn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng discovered that this place had many harms; the most dangerous was the unstable foundation.

sentences.chinese: 在大山的阴影里，他们看到一只奇怪的黑猫在看着他们。
sentences.pinyin: Zài dà shān de yīn yǐng lǐ, tā men kàn dào yì zhī qí guài de hēi māo zài kàn zhe tā men.
sentences.english: In the shadow of the great mountain, they saw a strange black cat watching them.

sentences.chinese: 这只猫像是在指路，又像是在嘲笑他们。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī māo xiàng shì zài zhǐ lù, yòu xiàng shì zài cháo xiào tā men.
sentences.english: This cat seemed to be showing the way, or perhaps it was mocking them.

sentences.chinese: 林风想，在这个地方，只有少数的人能找到正确的出口。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎng, zài zhè gè dì fang, zhǐ yǒu shǎo shù de rén néng zhǎo dào zhèng què de chū kǒu.
sentences.english: Lin Feng thought that in this place, only a small number of people could find the correct exit.

sentences.chinese: 他想起了海先生的话，如果有人想把地图卖给坏人，那么宝藏就永远消失了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ le Hǎi xiān sheng de huà, rú guǒ yǒu rén xiǎng bǎ dì tú mài gěi huài rén, nà me bǎo zàng jiù yǒng yuǎn xiāo shī le.
sentences.english: He remembered Mr. Hai's words: if someone wanted to sell the map to bad people, the treasure would vanish forever.

sentences.chinese: 他们必须在天亮前找到出路，否则情况会变得更糟糕。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men bì xū zài tiān liàng qián zhǎo dào chū lù, fǒu zé qíng kuàng huì biàn de gèng zāo gāo.
sentences.english: They had to find a way out before dawn, otherwise the situation would become even worse.

sentences.chinese: 林风看着黑猫，决定跟着它走入深谷。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn zhe hēi māo, jué dìng gēn zhe tā zǒu rù shēn gǔ.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the black cat and decided to follow it into the deep valley.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 7: The Trial of the Deep Valley

sentences.chinese: 黑猫带着林风和大强往深谷的底部走去。
sentences.pinyin: Hēi māo dàizhe Lín Fēng hé Dà Qiáng wǎng shēn gǔ de dǐ bù zǒu qù.
sentences.english: The black cat led Lin Feng and Da Qiang towards the bottom of the deep valley.

sentences.chinese: 林风感到这里的空气变得很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎndào zhèlǐ de kōng qì biàn de hěn lěng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt that the air here had become very cold.

sentences.chinese: 大强很关心林风，他问：“你觉得这里安全吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng hěn guān xīn Lín Fēng, tā wèn: “Nǐ jué de zhèlǐ ān quán ma?”
sentences.english: Da Qiang cared about Lin Feng and asked, "Do you think it's safe here?"

sentences.chinese: 林风回答说，他们必须小心，因为这里看起来像是一个陷阱。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng huí dá shuō, tā men bì xū xiǎo xīn, yīn wèi zhèlǐ kàn qǐ lái xiàng shì yī gè xiàn jǐng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng replied that they must be careful, because this place looked like a trap.

sentences.chinese: 突然，黑猫停了下来，面前出现了一扇发光的门。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, hēi māo tíng le xià lái, miàn qián chū xiàn le yī shàn fā guāng de mén.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the black cat stopped, and a glowing door appeared in front of them.

sentences.chinese: 门上写着一段文字，像是一篇古老的作文。
sentences.pinyin: Mén shàng xiě zhe yī duàn wén zì, xiàng shì yī piān gǔ lǎo de zuò wén.
sentences.english: On the door was a piece of text, resembling an ancient essay.

sentences.chinese: 林风发现，这段文字的作用是测试进入者的智慧。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng fā xiàn, zhè duàn wén zì de zuò yòng shì cè shì jìn rù zhě de zhì huì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng discovered that the purpose of this text was to test the wisdom of those entering.

sentences.chinese: 他想起以前老师的教育，学习必须准确，不能随便猜测。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ yǐ qián lǎo shī de jiào yù, xué xí bì xū zhǔn què, bù néng suí biàn cāi cè.
sentences.english: He remembered his teacher's education: studying must be accurate; one cannot simply guess.

sentences.chinese: 他开始复习地图上的符号，试图懂得这段文字的意思。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kāi shǐ fù xí dì tú shàng de fú hào, shì tú dǒng de zhè duàn wén zì de yì si.
sentences.english: He began to review the symbols on the map, trying to comprehend the meaning of this text.

sentences.chinese: 大强看着林风说：“你懂这些字吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng kàn zhe Lín Fēng shuō: “Nǐ dǒng zhè xiē zì ma?”
sentences.english: Da Qiang looked at Lin Feng and asked, "Do you understand these characters?"

sentences.chinese: 林风点头说：“我想我可以办到。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng diǎn tóu shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng wǒ kě yǐ bàn dào.”
sentences.english: Lin Feng nodded and said, "I think I can manage it."

sentences.chinese: 他读到，只有愿意帮助他人的人，才能完成这个挑战。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dú dào, zhǐ yǒu yuàn yì bāng zhù tā rén de rén, cái néng wán chéng zhè gè tiǎo zhàn.
sentences.english: He read that only those willing to help others could complete this challenge.

sentences.chinese: 林风想起海先生给他的信，信里说真正的宝藏是勇气。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎng qǐ Hǎi xiān sheng gěi tā de xìn, xìn lǐ shuō zhēn zhèng de bǎo zàng shì yǒng qì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng remembered the letter Mr. Hai had given him, which said the real treasure is courage.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，只有成为一个勇敢的人，才能实现这个目标。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, zhǐ yǒu chéng wéi yī gè yǒng gǎn de rén, cái néng shí xiàn zhè gè mù biāo.
sentences.english: He realized that only by becoming a brave person could he achieve this goal.

sentences.chinese: 如果他们能做到这一点，他们就能通过这扇门。
sentences.pinyin: Rú guǒ tā men néng zuò dào zhè yī diǎn, tā men jiù néng tōng guò zhè shàn mén.
sentences.english: If they could accomplish this, they would be able to pass through this door.

sentences.chinese: 但这里的路并不方便，到处都是尖锐的石头。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zhè lǐ de lù bìng bù fāng biàn, dào chù dōu shì jiān ruì de shí tou.
sentences.english: But the road here was not convenient; there were sharp rocks everywhere.

sentences.chinese: 林风觉得自己的体力已经不够了，他快要走不动了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jué de zì jǐ de tǐ lì yǐ jīng bù gòu le, tā kuài yào zǒu bù dòng le.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt that his physical strength was no longer enough; he was about to be unable to walk.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉大强：“我们应该在这里休息一下。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su Dà Qiáng: “Wǒ men yīng gāi zài zhè lǐ xiū xi yī xià.”
sentences.english: He told Da Qiang, "We should take a break here."

sentences.chinese: 大强说：“不行，我们快要天亮前离开这里，否则情况会变糟糕。”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng shuō: “Bù xíng, wǒ men kuài yào tiān liàng qián lí kāi zhè lǐ, fǒu zé qíng kuàng huì biàn zāo gāo.”
sentences.english: Da Qiang said, "No, we are about to leave here before dawn, otherwise the situation will become worse."

sentences.chinese: 林风知道，这里的环境会影响他们的速度。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhī dào, zhè lǐ de huán jìng huì yǐng xiǎng tā men de sù dù.
sentences.english: Lin Feng knew that the environment here would influence their speed.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果他是一个大人，他可能会处理得更好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rú guǒ tā shì yī gè dà ren, tā kě néng huì chǔ lǐ de gèng hǎo.
sentences.english: He thought that if he were an adult, he might handle it better.

sentences.chinese: 他希望自己的能力能够提高，这样就能保护大强。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xī wàng zì jǐ de néng lì néng gòu tí gāo, zhè yàng jiù néng bǎo hù Dà Qiáng.
sentences.english: He hoped his abilities could improve so that he could protect Da Qiang.

sentences.chinese: 黑猫突然跳到门上，门上的文字变成了金色的光。
sentences.pinyin: Hēi māo tū rán tiào dào mén shàng, mén shàng de wén zì biàn chéng le jīn sè de guāng.
sentences.english: The black cat suddenly jumped onto the door, and the text on the door turned into golden light.

sentences.chinese: 林风发现，只要两人手牵手，就能找到合适的方式打开门。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng fā xiàn, zhǐ yào liǎng rén shǒu qiān shǒu, jiù néng zhǎo dào hé shì de fāng shì dǎ kāi mén.
sentences.english: Lin Feng discovered that as long as the two held hands, they could find a suitable way to open the door.

sentences.chinese: 他们尝试了一下，门终于缓缓地打开了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men cháng shì le yī xià, mén zhōng yú huǎn huǎn de dǎ kāi le.
sentences.english: They tried it, and the door finally opened slowly.

sentences.chinese: 他们花了一段时间度过了这个危险的区域。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men huā le yī duàn shí jiān dù guò le zhè gè wēi xiǎn de qū yù.
sentences.english: They spent some time passing through this dangerous area.

sentences.chinese: 当他们走进门的一瞬间，任务终于完成了。
sentences.pinyin: Dāng tā men zǒu jìn mén de yī shùn jiān, rèn wu zhōng yú wán chéng le.
sentences.english: The moment they stepped through the door, the task was finally finished.

sentences.chinese: 林风感到非常兴奋，因为他们终于走出了深谷。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎndào fēi cháng xīng fèn, yīn wèi tā men zhōng yú zǒu chū le shēn gǔ.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt very excited because they had finally left the deep valley.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，他们看到前方出现了一个巨大的城市。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, tā men kàn dào qián fāng chū xiàn le yī gè jù dà de chéng shì.
sentences.english: But just then, they saw a huge city appear ahead.

sentences.chinese: 这个城市看起来像是由纯金变成的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè chéng shì kàn qǐ lái xiàng shì yóu chún jīn biàn chéng de.
sentences.english: This city looked as if it had turned into pure gold.

sentences.chinese: 林风心中想，这就是他们寻找的地方吗？
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xīn zhōng xiǎng, zhè jiù shì tā men xún zhǎo de dì fang ma?
sentences.english: Lin Feng thought to himself, is this the place they were looking for?

sentences.chinese: 然而，城市的入口处站着一个巨大的石像，挡住了他们的路。
sentences.pinyin: Rán ér, chéng shì de rù kǒu chù zhàn zhe yī gè jù dà de shí xiàng, dǎng zhù le tā men de lù.
sentences.english: However, a giant stone statue stood at the entrance of the city, blocking their way.

chapters.title_chinese: 第八章：黄金之城的考验
chapters.title_english: Chapter 8: The Trials of the Golden City

sentences.chinese: 林风和大强站在巨大的石像面前。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hé Dà Qiáng zhàn zài jù dà de shí xiàng miàn qián.
sentences.english: Lin Feng and Da Qiang stood in front of the giant stone statue.

sentences.chinese: 石像的眼睛在发光，它要求他们必须通过一个测试才能进入城市。
sentences.pinyin: Shí xiàng de yǎn jīng zài fā guāng, tā yāo qiú tā men bì xū tōng guò yí gè cè shì cái néng jìn rù chéng shì.
sentences.english: The statue's eyes were glowing; it required them to pass a test before they could enter the city.

sentences.chinese: 林风认为这个测试可能和他们的地图有关。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng rèn wéi zhè gè cè shì kě néng hé tā men de dì tú yǒu guān.
sentences.english: Lin Feng thought this test might be related to their map.

sentences.chinese: 石像说话了，它的声音非常清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Shí xiàng shuō huà le, tā de shēng yīn fēi cháng qīng chu.
sentences.english: The statue spoke, and its voice was very clear.

sentences.chinese: 它说，只有懂得照顾他人的人，才能在这里生活。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, zhǐ yǒu dǒng dé zhào gù tā rén de rén, cái néng zài zhè lǐ shēng huó.
sentences.english: It said that only those who know how to take care of others can live here.

sentences.chinese: 大强觉得这个要求很简单，因为他一直照顾林风。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng jué dé zhè gè yāo qiú hěn jiǎn dān, yīn wèi tā yì zhí zhào gù Lín Fēng.
sentences.english: Da Qiang felt this requirement was very simple because he had always taken care of Lin Feng.

sentences.chinese: 石像要求他们进行一次检查，看看他们的心是否正确。
sentences.pinyin: Shí xiàng yāo qiú tā men jìn xíng yí cì jiǎn chá, kàn kàn tā men de xīn shì fǒu zhèng què.
sentences.english: The statue requested they conduct an inspection to see if their hearts were correct.

sentences.chinese: 它让林风检查地图上的每一个细节。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ràng Lín Fēng jiǎn chá dì tú shàng de měi yí gè xì jié.
sentences.english: It asked Lin Feng to examine every detail on the map.

sentences.chinese: 林风发现，地图是由许多小碎片组成的。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng fā xiàn, dì tú shì yóu xǔ duō xiǎo suì piàn zǔ chéng de.
sentences.english: Lin Feng discovered that the map was composed of many small fragments.

sentences.chinese: 这些碎片经过正确的排列，才能说明进入城市的路径。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiē suì piàn jīng guò zhèng què de pái liè, cái néng shuō míng jìn rù chéng shì de lù jìng.
sentences.english: These fragments, after correct arrangement, could explain the path into the city.

sentences.chinese: 林风认真地工作，直到他相信自己找到了正确的答案。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng rèn zhēn de gōng zuò, zhí dào tā xiāng xìn zì jǐ zhǎo dào le zhèng què de dá àn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng worked diligently until he believed he had found the correct answer.

sentences.chinese: 他把碎片放在石像的手心，这等于给了石像一把钥匙。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ suì piàn fàng zài shí xiàng de shǒu xīn, zhè děng yú gěi le shí xiàng yì bǎ yào shi.
sentences.english: He placed the fragments in the statue's palm, which was equivalent to giving the statue a key.

sentences.chinese: 石像看着碎片，非常满意地笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Shí xiàng kàn zhe suì piàn, fēi cháng mǎn yì de xiào le.
sentences.english: The statue looked at the fragments and smiled with great satisfaction.

sentences.chinese: 它答应让他们进入黄金之城。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dā ying ràng tā men jìn rù huáng jīn zhī chéng.
sentences.english: It promised to let them enter the Golden City.

sentences.chinese: 进入城市后，他们发现这里的建筑装满了亮晶晶的宝石。
sentences.pinyin: Jìn rù chéng shì hòu, tā men fā xiàn zhè lǐ de jiàn zhù zhuāng mǎn le liàng jīng jīng de bǎo shí.
sentences.english: After entering the city, they found that the buildings here were adorned with sparkling gems.

sentences.chinese: 这里的美超过了林风的所有想象。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de měi chāo guò le Lín Fēng de suǒ yǒu xiǎng xiàng.
sentences.english: The beauty here surpassed all of Lin Feng's imaginations.

sentences.chinese: 他们走在金色的街道上，这里的人们非常重视礼貌。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zǒu zài jīn sè de jiē dào shàng, zhè lǐ de rén men fēi cháng zhòng shì lǐ mào.
sentences.english: They walked on the golden streets, where the people attached great importance to politeness.

sentences.chinese: 林风发现自己对这个地方并不熟，所以他走得很慢。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng fā xiàn zì jǐ duì zhè gè dì fang bìng bù shú, suǒ yǐ tā zǒu dé hěn màn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng found that he was not familiar with this place, so he walked very slowly.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果能够在这里住一段时间，生活一定会很精彩。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rú guǒ néng gòu zài zhè lǐ zhù yí duàn shí jiān, shēng huó yí dìng huì hěn jīng cǎi.
sentences.english: He thought that if he could live here for a while, life would certainly be wonderful.

sentences.chinese: 他们走了一会儿，肚子饿了，于是找了一家餐厅。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zǒu le yí huì r, dù zi è le, yú shì zhǎo le yì jiā cān tīng.
sentences.english: They walked for a while and became hungry, so they found a restaurant.

sentences.chinese: 大强吃了很多当地的食物，直到吃饱为止。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng chī le hěn duō dāng dì de shí wù, zhí dào chī bǎo wéi zhǐ.
sentences.english: Da Qiang ate a lot of local food until he was full.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林风，这里的食物味道很棒，而且和他的口味很称。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su Lín Fēng, zhè lǐ de shí wù wèi dào hěn bàng, ér qiě hé tā de kǒu wèi hěn chèn.
sentences.english: He told Lin Feng that the food here tasted great and fit his taste perfectly.

sentences.chinese: 他们等到太阳快落山时，才发现城市中心有一座巨大的塔。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men děng dào tài yáng kuài luò shān shí, cái fā xiàn chéng shì zhōng xīn yǒu yí zuò jù dà de tǎ.
sentences.english: They waited until the sun was about to set before they discovered a giant tower in the center of the city.

sentences.chinese: 这座塔通过一条秘密的通道与地底迷宫相通。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò tǎ tōng guò yì tiáo mì mì de tōng dào yǔ dì dǐ mí gōng xiāng tōng.
sentences.english: This tower connects to the underground maze through a secret passage.

sentences.chinese: 林风意识到，真正的宝藏一定在塔的最顶端。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yì shí dào, zhēn zhèng de bǎo zàng yí dìng zài tǎ de zuì dǐng duān.
sentences.english: Lin Feng realized that the true treasure must be at the very top of the tower.

chapters.title_chinese: 第九章：黄金之城的奇怪街道
chapters.title_english: Chapter 9: The Strange Streets of the Golden City

sentences.chinese: 林风和大强站在巨大的塔下面，看着周围的景象。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hé Dà Qiáng zhàn zài jù dà de tǎ xià miàn, kàn zhe zhōu wéi de jǐng xiàng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng and Da Qiang stood beneath the giant tower, looking at the surrounding scenery.

sentences.chinese: 这座黄金之城非常奇怪，它看起来像是一个现代城市。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò huáng jīn zhī chéng fēi cháng qí guài, tā kàn qǐ lái xiàng shì yī gè xiàn dài chéng shì.
sentences.english: This Golden City was very strange; it looked like a modern city.

sentences.chinese: 他们看到一条宽阔的公路，上面没有一个人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men kàn dào yī tiáo kuān kuò de gōng lù, shàng miàn méi yǒu yī gè rén.
sentences.english: They saw a wide highway with not a single person on it.

sentences.chinese: 路边停着很多奇怪的车辆，但都没有司机。
sentences.pinyin: Lù biān tíng zhe hěn duō qí guài de chē liàng, dàn dōu méi yǒu sī jī.
sentences.english: Many strange vehicles were parked by the roadside, but none had drivers.

sentences.chinese: 大强指着一个地方说：“你看，那里有一个停车场！”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng zhǐ zhe yī gè dì fāng shuō: “Nǐ kàn, nà lǐ yǒu yī gè tíng chē chǎng!”
sentences.english: Da Qiang pointed to a place and said, "Look, there is a parking lot there!"

sentences.chinese: 停车场旁边是一个巨大的体育馆，还有一个很大的球场。
sentences.pinyin: Tíng chē chǎng páng biān shì yī gè jù dà de tǐ yù guǎn, hái yǒu yī gè hěn dà de qiú chǎng.
sentences.english: Next to the parking lot was a huge gymnasium and a very large sports ground.

sentences.chinese: 林风觉得这里不像古代城市，反而像一个巨大的办公室区域。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jué de zhè lǐ bù xiàng gǔ dài chéng shì, fǎn ér xiàng yī gè jù dà de bàn gōng shì qū yù.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt that this didn't look like an ancient city, but rather like a massive office area.

sentences.chinese: 他们走在道路上，试图寻找进入塔的正确方向。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zǒu zài dào lù shàng, shì tú xún zhǎo jìn rù tǎ de zhèng què fāng xiàng.
sentences.english: They walked along the road, trying to find the correct direction to enter the tower.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他们看到一个穿着制服的人在广场上走来走去。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, tā men kàn dào yī gè chuān zhe zhì fú de rén zài guǎng chǎng shàng zǒu lái zǒu qù.
sentences.english: Suddenly, they saw a person in uniform walking back and forth in the public square.

sentences.chinese: 林风决定过去问路。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jué dìng guò qù wèn lù.
sentences.english: Lin Feng decided to go over and ask for directions.

sentences.chinese: 那个人的态度非常友好，他告诉他们这座城市是由一个古老的网站控制的。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén de tài dù fēi cháng yǒu hǎo, tā gào sù tā men zhè zuò chéng shì shì yóu yī gè gǔ lǎo de wǎng zhàn kòng zhì de.
sentences.english: The person's attitude was very friendly; he told them that this city was controlled by an ancient website.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林风：“如果你想去塔顶，不能走这条道。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù Lín Fēng: “Rú guǒ nǐ xiǎng qù tǎ dǐng, bù néng zǒu zhè tiáo dào.”
sentences.english: He told Lin Feng, "If you want to go to the top of the tower, you cannot take this path."

sentences.chinese: 他指向一个狭小的弄，说那里有一条秘密的小路。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐ xiàng yī gè xiá xiǎo de lòng, shuō nà lǐ yǒu yī tiáo mì mì de xiǎo lù.
sentences.english: He pointed toward a narrow alley, saying there was a secret path there.

sentences.chinese: 林风和大强走进那个弄，发现那里有一座漂亮的院子。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hé Dà Qiáng zǒu jìn nà gè lòng, fā xiàn nà lǐ yǒu yī zuò piào liang de yuàn zi.
sentences.english: Lin Feng and Da Qiang entered that alley and found a beautiful courtyard.

sentences.chinese: 院子里的草地非常绿，像一块绿色的地毯。
sentences.pinyin: Yuàn zi lǐ de cǎo dì fēi cháng lǜ, xiàng yī kuài lǜ sè de dì tǎn.
sentences.english: The grass in the courtyard was very green, like a green carpet.

sentences.chinese: 在院子深处，有一座古老的店，看起来像是一家酒店。
sentences.pinyin: Zài yuàn zi shēn chù, yǒu yī zuò gǔ lǎo de diàn, kàn qǐ lái xiàng shì yī jiā jiǔ diàn.
sentences.english: Deep in the courtyard, there was an old shop that looked like a hotel.

sentences.chinese: 林风在店里发现了一辆旧的自行车。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zài diàn lǐ fā xiàn le yī liàng jiù de zì xíng chē.
sentences.english: Lin Feng found an old bicycle inside the shop.

sentences.chinese: 他想起在现代城市里，人们会骑自行车或坐公交车。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ zài xiàn dài chéng shì lǐ, rén men huì qí zì xíng chē huò zuò gōng jiāo chē.
sentences.english: He remembered that in modern cities, people ride bicycles or take the bus.

sentences.chinese: 在这个奇怪的地方，甚至还有像地铁一样的地下通道。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè gè qí guài de dì fāng, shèn zhì hái yǒu xiàng dì tiě yī yàng de dì xià tōng dào.
sentences.english: In this strange place, there were even underground passages like a subway.

sentences.chinese: 大强开玩笑说：“如果这里有出租车，我就能快点到塔顶了。”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng kāi wán xiào shuō: “Rú guǒ zhè lǐ yǒu chū zū chē, wǒ jiù néng kuài diǎn dào tǎ dǐng le.”
sentences.english: Da Qiang joked, "If there were taxis here, I could get to the top of the tower faster."

sentences.chinese: 他们走出这个院，发现自己来到了城市的另一边。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zǒu chū zhè gè yuàn, fā xiàn zì jǐ lái dào le chéng shì de lìng yī biān.
sentences.english: They walked out of this courtyard and found themselves on the other side of the city.

sentences.chinese: 这里有很多像学校一样的院子，但里面空无一人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ yǒu hěn duō xiàng xué xiào yī yàng de yuàn zi, dàn lǐ miàn kōng wú yī rén.
sentences.english: There were many courtyards here that looked like schools, but they were empty.

sentences.chinese: 林风看着手中的地图，意识到这座城市的结构是一个巨大的迷宫。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn zhe shǒu zhōng de dì tú, yì shí dào zhè zuò chéng shì de jié gòu shì yī gè jù dà de mí gōng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the map in his hand and realized the structure of this city was a giant maze.

sentences.chinese: 他们必须在太阳完全落下之前，找到进入塔底的入口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men bì xū zài tài yáng wán quán luò xià zhī qián, zhǎo dào jìn rù tǎ dǐ de rù kǒu.
sentences.english: They had to find the entrance to the base of the tower before the sun fully set.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，他们听到塔顶传来了一声巨大的钟声，整个城市开始震动。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, tā men tīng dào tǎ dǐng chuán lái le yī shēng jù dà de zhōng shēng, zhěng gè chéng shì kāi shǐ zhèn dòng.
sentences.english: Just then, they heard a loud bell ring from the top of the tower, and the entire city began to shake.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十章：幻影之城的秘密
chapters.title_english: Chapter 10: Secrets of the Phantom City

sentences.chinese: 震动停止后，林风和大强发现眼前的街道变了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèndòng tíngzhǐ hòu, Lín Fēng hé Dà Qiáng fāxiàn yǎnqián de jiēdào biàn le.
sentences.english: After the shaking stopped, Lin Feng and Da Qiang found that the streets before them had changed.

sentences.chinese: 这条街看起来像是一个现代城市，但这里没有一个人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiē kàn qǐlái xiàng shì yí gè xiàndài chéngshì, dàn zhèlǐ méiyǒu yí gè rén.
sentences.english: This street looked like a modern city, but there was not a single person here.

sentences.chinese: 林风看到路边停着一辆公共汽车，但它已经很旧了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàndào lùbiān tíngzhe yí liàng gōnggòng qìchē, dàn tā yǐjīng hěn jiù le.
sentences.english: Lin Feng saw a bus parked by the road, but it was already very old.

sentences.chinese: 他们走过一个巨大的体育场，那里安静得可怕。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒu guò yí gè jùdà de tǐyùchǎng, nàlǐ ānjìng de kěpà.
sentences.english: They walked past a huge stadium, where it was terrifyingly quiet.

sentences.chinese: 大强指着远处说：“看，那里像是一个公园！”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng zhǐzhe yuǎnchù shuō: “Kàn, nàlǐ xiàng shì yí gè gōngyuán!”
sentences.english: Da Qiang pointed into the distance and said, "Look, that looks like a park!"

sentences.chinese: 他们跑过去，发现那里有一个美丽的花园，中间有一个蓝色的湖。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen pǎo guòqù, fāxiàn nàlǐ yǒu yí gè měilì de huāyuán, zhōngjiān yǒu yí gè lánsè de hú.
sentences.english: They ran over and found a beautiful garden there, with a blue lake in the middle.

sentences.chinese: 林风觉得这个地方不像地球上的任何地方。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng juéde zhège dìfāng bú xiàng dìqiú shàng de rènhé dìfāng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt that this place was not like anywhere on Earth.

sentences.chinese: 这里的植物在发光，像是大自然在和他们说话。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de zhíwù zài fāguāng, xiàng shì dàzìrán zài hé tāmen shuōhuà.
sentences.english: The plants here were glowing, as if nature was speaking to them.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一只奇怪的狗跑向他们，它看起来不像普通的动物。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yì zhī qíguài de gǒu pǎo xiàng tāmen, tā kàn qǐlái bú xiàng pǔtōng de dòngwù.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a strange dog ran toward them; it didn't look like a normal animal.

sentences.chinese: 林风记得在书上看过，这种生物叫离，是一种古老的传说之兽。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jìde zài shū shàng kànguò, zhè zhǒng shēngwù jiào lí, shì yì zhǒng gǔlǎo de chuánshuō zhī shòu.
sentences.english: Lin Feng remembered reading in a book that this creature is called a Li, an ancient legendary beast.

sentences.chinese: 他们跟着这只离走，经过了一个像动物园一样的地方，里面关着很多奇怪的生物。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen gēnzhe zhè zhī lí zǒu, jīngguò le yí gè xiàng dòngwùyuán yíyàng de dìfāng, lǐmiàn guānzhe hěnduō qíguài de shēngwù.
sentences.english: Following this Li, they passed a place like a zoo, where many strange creatures were kept.

sentences.chinese: 林风看着它们，感到非常好奇。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe tāmen, gǎndào fēicháng hàoqí.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at them, feeling very curious.

sentences.chinese: 接着，他们来到一个像校园的地方，里面有一个教室。
sentences.pinyin: Jiēzhe, tāmen láidào yí gè xiàng xiàoyuán de dìfāng, lǐmiàn yǒu yí gè jiàoshì.
sentences.english: Next, they arrived at a place like a campus, where there was a classroom.

sentences.chinese: 教室的黑板上写着：“欢迎来到幻影之城”。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshì de hēibǎn shàng xiězhe: “Huānyíng láidào Huànyǐng zhī Chéng”.
sentences.english: On the blackboard of the classroom, it was written: "Welcome to the Phantom City".

sentences.chinese: 大强肚子饿了，他看到路边有一家饭馆。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng dùzi è le, tā kàndào lùbiān yǒu yì jiā fànguǎn.
sentences.english: Da Qiang was hungry, and he saw a restaurant by the road.

sentences.chinese: 他走进去，拿起菜单，但上面的字一直在变。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu jìnqù, náqǐ càidān, dàn shàngmiàn de zì yìzhí zài biàn.
sentences.english: He walked in and picked up the menu, but the characters on it kept changing.

sentences.chinese: 林风开玩笑说：“这里的菜比过年的时候还丰富。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kāiwánxiào shuō: “Zhèlǐ de cài bǐ guònián de shíhòu hái fēngfù.”
sentences.english: Lin Feng joked, "The food here is even more abundant than during the New Year."

sentences.chinese: 大强笑了：“我想念春节，想念家里的热饺子。”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng xiào le: “Wǒ xiǎngniàn Chūnjié, xiǎngniàn jiālǐ de rè jiǎozi.”
sentences.english: Da Qiang laughed, "I miss the Spring Festival, I miss the hot dumplings at home."

sentences.chinese: 他们走出饭馆，发现前面有一个奇怪的地铁站入口。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒuchū fànguǎn, fāxiàn qiánmiàn yǒu yí gè qíguài de dìtiězhàn rùkǒu.
sentences.english: They walked out of the restaurant and found a strange subway station entrance ahead.

sentences.chinese: 林风抬头看，月亮已经升起来了，光芒照在巨大的石门上。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng táitóu kàn, yuèliang yǐjīng shēng qǐlái le, guāngmáng zhào zài jùdà de shímén shàng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked up; the moon had already risen, and its light shone on the giant stone door.

sentences.chinese: 这个石门像是一扇大门，通往塔的底部。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shímén xiàng shì yí shàn dàmén, tōngwǎng tǎ de dǐbù.
sentences.english: This stone door was like a great gate leading to the bottom of the tower.

sentences.chinese: 他们意识到，这个城市是用记忆组成的迷宫。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen yìshí dào, zhège chéngshì shì yòng jìyì zǔchéng de mǐgōng.
sentences.english: They realized that this city was a maze made of memories.

sentences.chinese: 就在他们准备进入地铁站时，地底突然传来了巨大的咆哮声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tāmen zhǔnbèi jìnrù dìtiězhàn shí, dìdǐ tūrán chuánlái le jùdà de páoxào shēng.
sentences.english: Just as they were preparing to enter the subway station, a huge roar suddenly came from underground.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十一章：地底的记忆之声

sentences.chinese: 地底传来的声音非常大声。
sentences.pinyin: Dì dǐ chuán lái de shēng yīn fēi cháng dà shēng.
sentences.english: The sound coming from underground was very loud.

sentences.chinese: 林风和大强站在地铁站的中心，感到非常害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hé Dà Qiáng zhàn zài dì tiě zhàn de zhōng xīn, gǎn dào fēi cháng hài pà.
sentences.english: Lin Feng and Da Qiang stood in the center of the subway station, feeling very afraid.

sentences.chinese: 那个咆哮的声音听起来像是一头巨大的野兽，嘴里发出奇怪的响声。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè páo xiào de shēng yīn tīng qǐ lái xiàng shì yī tóu jù dà de yě shòu, zuǐ lǐ fā chū qí guài de xiǎng shēng.
sentences.english: That roaring sound sounded like a huge beast, making strange noises from its mouth.

sentences.chinese: 林风想起在学校时，体育老师说过，面对危险要保持健康的心态。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎng qǐ zài xué xiào shí, tǐ yù lǎo shī shuō guò, miàn duì wēi xiǎn yào bǎo chí jiàn kāng de xīn tài.
sentences.english: Lin Feng remembered that back in school, the PE teacher said that one must maintain a healthy mindset when facing danger.

sentences.chinese: 但现在的情况很不公平，因为他们没有武器。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiàn zài de qíng kuàng hěn bù gōng píng, yīn wèi tā men méi yǒu wǔ qì.
sentences.english: But the current situation was very unfair because they had no weapons.

sentences.chinese: 大强穿着一件厚厚的大衣，他紧紧地抓着大衣的领口。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng chuān zhe yī jiàn hòu hòu de dà yī, tā jǐn jǐn de zhuā zhe dà yī de lǐng kǒu.
sentences.english: Da Qiang was wearing a thick overcoat, and he gripped the collar of the overcoat tightly.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个奇怪的人出现在他们面前。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, yī gè qí guài de rén chū xiàn zài tā men miàn qián.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a strange person appeared before them.

sentences.chinese: 这个人的个子很高，看起来像是一个古老的商人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè rén de gè zi hěn gāo, kàn qǐ lái xiàng shì yī gè gǔ lǎo de shāng rén.
sentences.english: This person was very tall and looked like an ancient merchant.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉他们，这里曾经是一个巨大的公司，管理着整个城市的记忆。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù tā men, zhè lǐ céng jīng shì yī gè jù dà de gōng sī, guǎn lǐ zhe zhěng gè chéng shì de jì yì.
sentences.english: He told them that this place was once a huge company that managed the memories of the entire city.

sentences.chinese: 这个商人说，这里的记忆像是一个个例子，记录着人们的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè shāng rén shuō, zhè lǐ de jì yì xiàng shì yī gè gè lì zi, jì lù zhe rén men de shēng huó.
sentences.english: The merchant said that the memories here were like examples, recording people's lives.

sentences.chinese: 他向林风展示了一张图片，图片里是一个蔚蓝色的大海。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàng Lín Fēng zhǎn shì le yī zhāng tú piàn, tú piàn lǐ shì yī gè wèi lán sè de dà hǎi.
sentences.english: He showed Lin Feng a picture; in the picture was a deep blue ocean.

sentences.chinese: “这就是这个城市的原貌，”商人低声说。
sentences.pinyin: “Zhè jiù shì zhè gè chéng shì de yuán mào,” shāng rén dī shēng shuō.
sentences.english: "This is the original appearance of this city," the merchant said in a low voice.

sentences.chinese: 林风好奇地问：“谁是这里的主人？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hào qí de wèn: “Shéi shì zhè lǐ de zhǔ rén?”
sentences.english: Lin Feng asked curiously, "Who is the master of this place?"

sentences.chinese: 商人回答说，这里的主要原因是因为人们忘记了回家的路。
sentences.pinyin: Shāng rén huí dá shuō, zhè lǐ de zhǔ yào yuán yīn shì yīn wèi rén men wàng jì le huí jiā de lù.
sentences.english: The merchant replied that the main reason was because people forgot the way home.

sentences.chinese: 在这个城市里，人口很多，但每个人都失去了记忆。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè gè chéng shì lǐ, rén kǒu hěn duō, dàn měi gè rén dōu shī qù le jì yì.
sentences.english: In this city, the population was large, but everyone had lost their memories.

sentences.chinese: 他们习惯了在这里生活，忘记了外面的世界。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men xí guàn le zài zhè lǐ shēng huó, wàng jì le wài miàn de shì jiè.
sentences.english: They became accustomed to living here and forgot the outside world.

sentences.chinese: 商人提到，他曾经有很多同事，但现在只剩下他一个人。
sentences.pinyin: Shāng rén tí dào, tā céng jīng yǒu hěn duō tóng shì, dàn xiàn zài zhǐ shèng xià tā yī gè rén.
sentences.english: The merchant mentioned that he once had many colleagues, but now only he remained.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林风，在这个迷宫里，最重要的事情是找到记忆的碎片。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù Lín Fēng, zài zhè gè mí gōng lǐ, zuì zhòng yào de shì qing shì zhǎo dào jì yì de suì piàn.
sentences.english: He told Lin Feng that in this maze, the most important matter was to find the fragments of memory.

sentences.chinese: 林风觉得这个商人虽然奇怪，但其实很可爱。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jué de zhè gè shāng rén suī rán qí guài, dàn qí shí hěn kě ài.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt that although this merchant was strange, he was actually quite adorable.

sentences.chinese: 商人说，今天正好是这座城市建立一百周年的日子。
sentences.pinyin: Shāng rén shuō, jīn tiān zhèng hǎo shì zhè zuò chéng shì jiàn lì yī bǎi zhōu nián de rì zi.
sentences.english: The merchant said that today happened to be the hundredth anniversary of the city's founding.

sentences.chinese: 他问林风：“你还记得你的作业吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn Lín Fēng: “Nǐ hái jì dé nǐ de zuò yè ma?”
sentences.english: He asked Lin Feng, "Do you still remember your homework?"

sentences.chinese: 林风很惊讶，在这个冒险的地方，商人竟然提到作业。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hěn jīng yà, zài zhè gè mào xiǎn de dì fāng, shāng rén jìng rán tí dào zuò yè.
sentences.english: Lin Feng was very surprised that in this place of adventure, the merchant actually mentioned homework.

sentences.chinese: 商人笑了，他说：“记忆就像考试的分数，越完整，你越强大。”
sentences.pinyin: Shāng rén xiào le, tā shuō: “Jì yì jiù xiàng kǎo shì de fēn shù, yuè wán zhěng, nǐ yuè qiáng dà.”
sentences.english: The merchant smiled and said, "Memory is like exam grades; the more complete it is, the stronger you are."

sentences.chinese: 林风意识到，这里的信息隐藏在这些奇怪的对话中。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yì shí dào, zhè lǐ de xìn xī yǐn cáng zài zhè xiē qí guài de đối huà zhōng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng realized that the information here was hidden in these strange conversations.

sentences.chinese: 他们想起刚才在饭馆吃的中餐，那是他们在这个城市吃的第一顿正餐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men xiǎng qǐ gāng cái zài fàn guǎn chī de zhōng cān, nà shì tā men zài zhè gè chéng shì chī de dì yī dùn zhèng cān.
sentences.english: They thought about the Chinese meal they had just eaten at the restaurant; it was the first formal meal they had in this city.

sentences.chinese: 大强说：“我更喜欢午餐，因为那时候太阳还在。”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng shuō: “Wǒ gèng xǐ huān wǔ cān, yīn wèi nà shí hòu tài yáng hái zài.”
sentences.english: Da Qiang said, "I prefer lunch, because the sun was still out then."

sentences.chinese: 现在已经是半夜了，地底的黑暗让一切变得神秘。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài yǐ jīng shì bàn yè le, dì dǐ de hēi àn ràng yī qiè biàn dé shén mì.
sentences.english: It was already midnight now, and the underground darkness made everything mysterious.

sentences.chinese: 他们讨论着地底生物的大小，猜测那头野兽到底有多大。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men tǎo lùn zhe dì dǐ shēng wù de dà xiǎo, cāi cè nà tóu yě shòu dào dǐ yǒu duō dà.
sentences.english: They discussed the size of the underground creatures, guessing how big that beast actually was.

sentences.chinese: 林风刚准备走进去，地上的石头又开始震动。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gāng zhǔn bèi zǒu jìn qù, dì shàng de shí tou yòu kāi shǐ zhèn dòng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng had just prepared to walk in when the stones on the ground began to shake again.

sentences.chinese: 一个巨大的阴影再次出现，挡住了他们的去路。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè jù dà de yīn yǐng zài cì chū xiàn, dǎng zhù le tā men de qù lù.
sentences.english: A huge shadow appeared once more, blocking their path.

sentences.chinese: 阴影大声地问：“你们是谁？为什么要来这里？”
sentences.pinyin: Yīn yǐng dà shēng de wèn: “Nǐ men shì shéi? Wèi shén me yào lái zhè lǐ?”
sentences.english: The shadow asked loudly, "Who are you? Why do you want to come here?"

sentences.chinese: 林风看着商人，商人对他眨了眨眼，示意他勇敢回答。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn zhe shāng rén, shāng rén duì tā zhǎ le zhǎ yǎn, shì yì tā yǒng gǎn huí dá.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the merchant, and the merchant winked at him, signaling him to answer bravely.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 12: The Judgment of the Shadow

sentences.chinese: 林风站在巨大的阴影面前，心里非常紧张。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhàn zài jù dà de yīn yǐng miàn qián, xīn lǐ fēi cháng jǐn zhāng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng stood before the giant shadow, feeling very nervous in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 他想起在学校的时候，校长经常告诉他们要勇敢。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ zài xué xiào de shí hòu, xiào zhǎng jīng cháng gào sù tā men yào yǒng gǎn.
sentences.english: He remembered when he was at school, the principal often told them to be brave.

sentences.chinese: 那个阴影的声音像雷一样，但它现在看着林风，像是在看一个普通的小少年。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè yīn yǐng de shēng yīn xiàng léi yī yàng, dàn tā xiàn zài kàn zhe Lín Fēng, xiàng shì zài kàn yī gè pǔ tōng de xiǎo shào nián.
sentences.english: The shadow's voice was like thunder, but it was now looking at Lin Feng as if looking at an ordinary young youth.

sentences.chinese: 阴影问：“在这个地方，没有平等，只有力量，你们凭什么进来？”
sentences.pinyin: Yīn yǐng wèn: “Zài zhè gè dì fāng, méi yǒu píng děng, zhǐ yǒu lì liàng, nǐ men píng shén me jìn lái?”
sentences.english: The shadow asked, "In this place, there is no equality, only power; on what basis do you enter?"

sentences.chinese: 商人走上前，用一种很正常的声音说话。
sentences.pinyin: Shāng rén zǒu shàng qián, yòng yī zhǒng hěn zhèng cháng de shēng yīn shuō huà.
sentences.english: The merchant stepped forward and spoke in a very normal voice.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“我们不是来抢东西的，我们只是这里的客人。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ men bù shì lái qiǎng dōng xī de, wǒ men zhǐ shì zhè lǐ de kè rén.”
sentences.english: He said, "We didn't come to steal things; we are just guests here."

sentences.chinese: 阴影冷笑了一声，它觉得商人的意思是在骗它。
sentences.pinyin: Yīn yǐng lěng xiào le yī shēng, tā jué dé shāng rén de yì si shì zài piàn tā.
sentences.english: The shadow sneered; it felt the merchant's meaning was to deceive it.

sentences.chinese: 它说：“在我的记忆之城里，所有的实际情况都写在石碑上，没有人能骗我。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zài wǒ de jì yì zhī chéng lǐ, suǒ yǒu de shí jì qíng kuàng dōu xiě zài shí bēi shàng, méi yǒu rén néng piàn wǒ.”
sentences.english: It said, "In my City of Memories, all the actual situations are written on the stone tablets; no one can fool me."

sentences.chinese: 林风看着周围，发现石碑上有很多奇怪的数字。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn zhe zhōu wéi, fā xiàn shí bēi shàng yǒu hěn duō qí guài de shù zì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked around and found many strange numbers on the tablets.

sentences.chinese: 这些数字看起来像是一条长长的密码。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiē shù zì kàn qǐ lái xiàng shì yī tiáo cháng cháng de mì mǎ.
sentences.english: These numbers looked like a long strip of password.

sentences.chinese: 林风突然想到，这像是在学校学期考试时遇到的数学题。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng tū rán xiǎng dào, zhè xiàng shì zài xué qī kǎo shì shí yù dào de shù xué tí.
sentences.english: Lin Feng suddenly thought that this was like a math problem he encountered during the semester exams at school.

sentences.chinese: 他记得在报纸上看过一个关于解密的小说，里面提到过一种特殊的方法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì dé zài bào zhǐ shàng kàn guò yī gè guān yú jiě mì de xiǎo shuō, lǐ miàn tí dào guò yī zhǒng tè shū de fāng fǎ.
sentences.english: He remembered reading a novel about decryption in a newspaper, which mentioned a special method.

sentences.chinese: 他急忙对商人说：“我想我有办法能通过这个考验！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā jí máng duì shāng rén shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng wǒ yǒu bàn fǎ néng tōng guò zhè gè kǎo yàn!”
sentences.english: He hurriedly said to the merchant, "I think I have a way to pass this test!"

sentences.chinese: 商人有些惊讶，他问林风有什么意见。
sentences.pinyin: Shāng rén yǒu xiē jīng yà, tā wèn Lín Fēng yǒu shén me yì jiàn.
sentences.english: The merchant was somewhat surprised and asked Lin Feng what his opinion was.

sentences.chinese: 林风说：“如果我们将这些数字重新排列，也许能找到安全的出口。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng shuō: “Rú guǒ wǒ men jiāng zhè xiē shù zì chóng xīn pái liè, yě xǔ néng zhǎo dào ān quán de chū kǒu.”
sentences.english: Lin Feng said, "If we rearrange these numbers, perhaps we can find a safe exit."

sentences.chinese: 阴影对他很感兴趣，因为它很久没有遇到这么有意思的人了。
sentences.pinyin: Yīn yǐng duì tā hěn gǎn xìng qù, yīn wèi tā hěn jiǔ méi yǒu yù dào zhè me yǒu yì si de rén le.
sentences.english: The shadow was very interested in him because it hadn't met such an interesting person in a long time.

sentences.chinese: 它说：“如果你能解开这个谜题，我就给你们一个机会。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Rú guǒ nǐ néng jiě kāi zhè gè mí tí, wǒ jiù gěi nǐ men yī gè jī huì.”
sentences.english: It said, "If you can solve this puzzle, I will give you a chance."

sentences.chinese: 林风开始思考，他想起自己的家庭，想起父母对他成绩的期望。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kāi shǐ sī kǎo, tā xiǎng qǐ zì jǐ de jiā tíng, xiǎng qǐ fù mǔ duì tā chéng jì de qī wàng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng began to think; he thought of his family and his parents' expectations for his grades.

sentences.chinese: 他不能在这里失败，他必须像影片里的英雄明星一样勇敢。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù néng zài zhè lǐ shī bài, tā bì xū xiàng yǐng piàn lǐ de yīng xióng míng xīng yī yàng yǒng gǎn.
sentences.english: He could not fail here; he had to be as brave as the hero stars in movies.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，远处传来一声巨大的钟声，“当”的一声，震动了整个地底。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, yuǎn chù chuán lái yī shēng jù dà de zhōng shēng, “dāng” de yī shēng, zhèn dòng le zhěng gè dì dǐ.
sentences.english: Just then, a loud bell rang in the distance, a "dong" sound that shook the entire underground.

sentences.chinese: 林风意识到时间不多了，他不能再浪费时间。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yì shí dào shí jiān bù duō le, tā bù néng zài làng fèi shí jiān.
sentences.english: Lin Feng realized time was running out; he could not waste any more time.

sentences.chinese: 他快速地在地上写下数字，试图找到正确的答案。
