sentences.pinyin: Tā kuài sù de zài dì shàng xiě xià shù zì, shì tú zhǎo dào zhèng què de dá àn.
sentences.english: He quickly wrote the numbers on the ground, attempting to find the correct answer.

sentences.chinese: 阴影看着他，轻声说：“如果你成功了，我可以请你们吃一顿丰盛的晚餐。”
sentences.pinyin: Yīn yǐng kàn zhe tā, qīng shēng shuō: “Rú guǒ nǐ chéng gōng le, wǒ kě yǐ qǐng nǐ men chī yī dùn fēng shèng de wǎn cān.”
sentences.english: The shadow looked at him and said softly, "If you succeed, I can invite you to a sumptuous dinner."

sentences.chinese: 林风笑了，他想：“这比在市中心吃快餐要有意思得多！”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiào le, tā xiǎng: “Zhè bǐ zài shì zhōng xīn chī kuài cān yào yǒu yì si de duō!”
sentences.english: Lin Feng smiled and thought, "This is much more interesting than eating fast food in the city center!"

sentences.chinese: 他腰间系着一条皮带，上面挂着他的地图，他紧紧地抓着它。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yāo jiān xì zhe yī tiáo pí dài, shàng miàn guà zhe tā de dì tú, tā jǐn jǐn de zhuā zhe tā.
sentences.english: He had a leather belt tied around his waist with his map hanging from it, and he gripped it tightly.

sentences.chinese: 经过激烈的计算，林风终于找到了那个隐藏的开关。
sentences.pinyin: Jīng guò jī liè de jì suàn, Lín Fēng zhōng yú zhǎo dào le nà gè yǐn cáng de kāi guān.
sentences.english: After intense calculations, Lin Feng finally found the hidden switch.

sentences.chinese: 他大声说：“这就是答案！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dà shēng shuō: “Zhè jiù shì dá àn!”
sentences.english: He shouted, "This is the answer!"

sentences.chinese: 阴影沉默了一会儿，然后竟然低下了头。
sentences.pinyin: Yīn yǐng chén mò le yī huì r, rán hòu jìng rán dī xià le tóu.
sentences.english: The shadow was silent for a while, then actually bowed its head.

sentences.chinese: 它说：“感谢你们的诚实和聪明，现在你们可以前进。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Gǎn xiè nǐ men de chéng shí hé cōng míng, xiàn zài nǐ men kě yǐ qián jìn.”
sentences.english: It said, "Thank you for your honesty and intelligence; now you may proceed."

sentences.chinese: 林风和大强互相看了看，他们终于感到安全了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hé Dà Qiáng hù xiāng kàn le kàn, tā men zhōng yú gǎn dào ān quán le.
sentences.english: Lin Feng and Da Qiang looked at each other; they finally felt safe.

sentences.chinese: 但就在他们准备离开时，阴影突然变了样子。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài tā men zhǔn bèi lí kāi shí, yīn yǐng tū rán biàn le yàng zi.
sentences.english: But just as they were preparing to leave, the shadow suddenly changed its appearance.

sentences.chinese: 它变成了一个穿着优雅衣服的太太，眼神中闪过一丝诡异的光芒。
sentences.pinyin: Tā biàn chéng le yī gè chuān zhe yōu yǎ yī fú de tài tai, yǎn shén zhōng shǎn guò yī sī guǐ yì de guāng máng.
sentences.english: It turned into a lady wearing elegant clothes, with a flicker of eerie light in her eyes.

sentences.chinese: 她微笑着说：“不过，真正的考验现在才开始。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wēi xiào zhe shuō: “Bù guò, zhēn zhèng de kǎo yàn xiàn zài cái kāi shǐ.”
sentences.english: She smiled and said, "However, the real test is only just beginning."

chapters.title_chinese: 第十三章：记忆之屋的陷阱
chapters.title_english: Chapter 13: The Trap of the House of Memories

sentences.chinese: 那个优雅的太太挥了挥手，周围的环境突然变了。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge yōuyǎ de tàitai huīle huī shǒu, zhōuwéi de huánjìng tūrán biànle.
sentences.english: The elegant lady waved her hand, and the surrounding environment suddenly changed.

sentences.chinese: 他们现在站在一个奇怪的房间里，这里看起来像是一个现代的家。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xiànzài zhàn zài yīgè qíguài de fángjiān lǐ, zhèlǐ kàn qǐlái xiàng shì yīgè xiàndài de jiā.
sentences.english: They were now standing in a strange room that looked like a modern home.

sentences.chinese: 房间里有一台洗衣机，但它在不停地转，里面没有衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ yǒu yī tái xǐyījī, dàn tā zài bùtíng de zhuàn, lǐmiàn méiyǒu yīfú.
sentences.english: There was a washing machine in the room, but it was spinning non-stop with no clothes inside.

sentences.chinese: 墙上挂着很多漂亮的画儿，每一幅都像是在讲述一个故事。
sentences.pinyin: Qiáng shàng guàzhe hěnduō piàoliang de huàr, měi yī fú dōu xiàng shì zài jiǎngshù yīgè gùshì.
sentences.english: Many beautiful paintings hung on the walls, each seeming to tell a story.

sentences.chinese: 林风发现这里的空气很奇怪，有一种淡淡的油味。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng fāxiàn zhèlǐ de kōngqì hěn qíguài, yǒu yī zhǒng dàndàn de yóuwèi.
sentences.english: Lin Feng noticed that the air here was strange, with a faint smell of oil.

sentences.chinese: 那个太太热情地对他们说：“欢迎来到记忆之屋。”
sentences.pinyin: Nàge tàitai rèqíng de duì tāmen shuō: “Huānyíng láidào jìyì zhī wū.”
sentences.english: The lady enthusiastically said to them, "Welcome to the House of Memories."

sentences.chinese: 她指着桌子上的一瓶酒和一些礼物，示意他们坐下。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐzhe zhuōzi shàng de yī píng jiǔ hé yīxiē lǐwù, shìyì tāmen zuò xià.
sentences.english: She pointed to a bottle of wine and some gifts on the table, signaling them to sit down.

sentences.chinese: 林风注意到桌上还有一张旧照片，照片里是一个年轻的男人和一个女人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhùyì dào zhuō shàng hái yǒu yī zhāng jiù zhàopiàn, zhàopiàn lǐ shì yīgè niánqīng de nánrén hé yīgè nǚrén.
sentences.english: Lin Feng noticed there was also an old photograph on the table, showing a young man and a woman.

sentences.chinese: 太太微笑着说：“这是我的爱情故事，你们想听吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tàitai wēixiào zhe shuō: “Zhè shì wǒ de àiqíng gùshì, nǐmen xiǎng tīng ma?”
sentences.english: The lady smiled and said, "This is my romance story, do you want to hear it?"

sentences.chinese: 大强觉得这个地方太奇怪了，他想直接离开。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng juéde zhège dìfāng tài qíguài le, tā xiǎng zhíjiē líkāi.
sentences.english: Da Qiang felt this place was too strange and wanted to leave directly.

sentences.chinese: 他低声对林风说：“我们的目的是找到宝藏，不是听故事。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dīshēng duì Lín Fēng shuō: “Wǒmen de mùdì shì zhǎodào bǎozàng, bùshì tīng gùshì.”
sentences.english: He whispered to Lin Feng, "Our purpose is to find the treasure, not to listen to stories."

sentences.chinese: 林风看着房间里的灯，灯光在闪烁，像是在发出某种信号。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe fángjiān lǐ de dēng, dēngguāng zài shǎnshuò, xiàng shì zài fāchū mǒu zhǒng xìnhào.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the lamps in the room; the lights were flickering as if sending some kind of signal.

sentences.chinese: 太太突然拿出一支笔，在桌子的一片纸上写了几个字。
sentences.pinyin: Tàitai tūrán ná chū yī zhī bǐ, zài zhuōzi de yī piàn zhǐ shàng xiěle jǐ gè zì.
sentences.english: The lady suddenly took out a pen and wrote a few words on a sheet of paper on the table.

sentences.chinese: 她告诉他们，这里是一个科学实验的部分，用来测试人的行为。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù tāmen, zhèlǐ shì yīgè kēxué shíyàn de bùfen, yòng lái cèshì rén de xíngwéi.
sentences.english: She told them that this was part of a scientific experiment used to test human behavior.

sentences.chinese: 她说：“在这里，你们可以拥有绝对的自由。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zài zhèlǐ, nǐmen kěyǐ yōngyǒu juéduì de zìyóu.”
sentences.english: She said, "Here, you can have absolute freedom."

sentences.chinese: 但林风发现，这个房间其实是一个巨大的网，他们被困住了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn Lín Fēng fāxiàn, zhège fángjiān qíshí shì yīgè jùdà de wǎng, tāmen bèi kùn zhù le.
sentences.english: But Lin Feng discovered that this room was actually a giant net, and they were trapped.

sentences.chinese: 他想起自己在学校时，班长经常说，面对困难要讲道理。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ zài xuéxiào shí, bānzhǎng jīngcháng shuō, miàn duì kùnnán yào jiǎng dàolǐ.
sentences.english: He remembered when he was in school, the class monitor often said that one must reason when facing difficulties.

sentences.chinese: 他仔细观察，发现房间的墙壁上有一个像网球一样大的洞。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǐxì guānchá, fāxiàn fángjiān de qiángbì shàng yǒu yīgè xiàng wǎngqiú yīyàng dà de dòng.
sentences.english: He observed carefully and found a hole on the wall of the room about the size of a tennis ball.

sentences.chinese: 太太看着他们，眼神变得冷漠，像是一个严格的经理。
sentences.pinyin: Tàitai kànzhe tāmen, yǎnshén biàn de lěngmò, xiàng shì yīgè yángé de jīnglǐ.
sentences.english: The lady looked at them, her eyes turning cold, like a strict manager.

sentences.chinese: 她说：“你们的计划太简单了，在这个等级的考验面前，你们太弱了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐmen de jìhuà tài jiǎndān le, zài zhège jíbié de kǎoyàn miànqián, nǐmen tài ruò le.”
sentences.english: She said, "Your plan is too simple; before a test of this level, you are too weak."

sentences.chinese: 突然，林风的手机收到了一条短信，那是来自外界的神秘提示。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, Lín Fēng de shǒujī shōudào le yī tiáo duǎnxìn, nà shì láizì wàijiè de shénmì tíshì.
sentences.english: Suddenly, Lin Feng's phone received a text message, a mysterious hint from the outside world.

sentences.chinese: 短信说：“不要相信这里的节日气氛，这只是一个假节目。”
sentences.pinyin: Duǎnxìn shuō: “Bùyào xiāngxìn zhèlǐ de jiérì qìfēn, zhè zhǐshì yīgè jiǎ jiémù.”
sentences.english: The text said, "Do not believe the holiday atmosphere here; this is just a fake program."

sentences.chinese: 林风意识到，这个太太想用美好的理想来诱惑他们，让他们忘记离开。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yìshí dào, zhège tàitai xiǎng yòng měihǎo de lǐxiǎng lái yòuhuò tāmen, ràng tāmen wàngjì líkāi.
sentences.english: Lin Feng realized that this lady wanted to use beautiful ideals to tempt them and make them forget to leave.

sentences.chinese: 他大声说：“我们不需要你的礼物，我们要去塔顶！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàshēng shuō: “Wǒmen bù xūyào nǐ de lǐwù, wǒmen yào qù tǎ dǐng!”
sentences.english: He shouted, "We don't need your gifts, we are going to the top of the tower!"

sentences.chinese: 太太冷笑一声，房间里的气压突然升高，让他们感到呼吸困难。
sentences.pinyin: Tàitai lěngxiào yī shēng, fángjiān lǐ de qìyā tūrán shēnggāo, ràng tāmen gǎndào hūxī kùnnán.
sentences.english: The lady sneered, and the air pressure in the room suddenly rose, making it difficult for them to breathe.

sentences.chinese: 她挥手之间，房间里的所有东西开始飞舞。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huī shǒu zhī jiān, fángjiān lǐ de suǒyǒu dōngxī kāishǐ fēiwǔ.
sentences.english: With a wave of her hand, everything in the room began to fly around.

sentences.chinese: 林风和大强紧紧握住对方的手，试图寻找出口。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hé Dà Qiáng jǐnjǐn wò zhù duìfāng de shǒu, shìtú xúnzhǎo chūkǒu.
sentences.english: Lin Feng and Da Qiang gripped each other's hands tightly, trying to find an exit.

sentences.chinese: 他们发现那台洗衣机其实是一个开关，可以打开通往下一层的门。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen fāxiàn nà tái xǐyījī qíshí shì yīgè kāiguān, kěyǐ dǎkāi tōng wǎng xià yī céng de mén.
sentences.english: They discovered that the washing machine was actually a switch that could open the door to the next level.

sentences.chinese: 就在他们冲向洗衣机时，太太的声音在耳边响起。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tāmen chōng xiàng xǐyījī shí, tàitai de shēngyīn zài ěrbiān xiǎngqǐ.
sentences.english: Just as they rushed toward the washing machine, the lady's voice rang in their ears.

sentences.chinese: “你们以为这就结束了吗？”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐmen yǐwéi zhè jiù jiéshù le ma?”
sentences.english: "Did you think this was the end?"

sentences.chinese: 突然，地上的地板裂开了，一个巨大的黑洞出现在他们脚下。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, dìshàng de dìbǎn liè kāi le, yīgè jùdà de hēidòng chūxiàn zài tāmen jiǎoxià.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the floor split open, and a giant black hole appeared beneath their feet.

sentences.chinese: 他们两人一起掉进了深不见底的黑暗之中。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen liǎng rén yīqǐ diào jìn le shēn bùjiàn dǐ de hēiyàn zhī zhōng.
sentences.english: The two of them fell together into the bottomless darkness.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十四章：时间之屋的迷局
chapters.title_english: Chapter 14: The Puzzle of the House of Time

sentences.chinese: 林风和大强在黑暗中掉了很多时间，最后落在了另一个房间里。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hé Dà Qiáng zài hēi'àn zhōng diào le hěn duō shíjiān, zuìhòu luò zài le lìng yī gè fángjiān lǐ.
sentences.english: Lin Feng and Da Qiang fell through the darkness for a long time and finally landed in another room.

sentences.chinese: 这个房间很奇怪，墙上挂满了世界各地的地图。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè fángjiān hěn qíguài, qiáng shàng guà mǎn le shìjiè gè dì de dìtú.
sentences.english: This room was very strange, with maps of all over the world hanging on the walls.

sentences.chinese: 林风看到地图上标着东北、东南和西北的方向。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàndào dìtú shàng biāo zhe dōngběi, dōngnán hé xīběi de fāngxiàng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng saw the directions for the Northeast, Southeast, and Northwest marked on the map.

sentences.chinese: 大强看着墙上的字，说：“这些字我看不懂，是英文还是英语？”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng kànzhe qiáng shàng de zì, shuō: “Zhèxiē zì wǒ kàn bù dǒng, shì Yīngwén háishì Yīngyǔ?”
sentences.english: Da Qiang looked at the characters on the wall and said, "I can't understand these characters, is it English writing or the English language?"

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个穿着奇怪衣服的人出现了，他姓周，叫周先生。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yī gè chuānzhe qíguài yīfu de rén chūxiàn le, tā xìng Zhōu, jiào Zhōu xiān sheng.
sentences.english: At that moment, a man wearing strange clothes appeared; his surname was Zhou, and he was called Mr. Zhou.

sentences.chinese: 周先生笑着说：“欢迎来到时间之屋，这里记录了所有人的记忆。”
sentences.pinyin: Zhōu xiān sheng xiàozhe shuō: “Huānyíng lái dào shíjiān zhī wū, zhèlǐ jìlù le suǒyǒu rén de jìyì.”
sentences.english: Mr. Zhou smiled and said, "Welcome to the House of Time, where the memories of everyone are recorded."

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林风，前年这里曾经举办过一个盛大的晚会。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Lín Fēng, qiánnián zhèlǐ céngjīng jǔbàn guò yī gè shèngdà de wǎnhuì.
sentences.english: He told Lin Feng that a grand evening party had been held here the year before last.

sentences.chinese: 那个晚会邀请了来自加、克等很多国家的人。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè wǎnhuì yāoqǐng le lái zì Jiā, Kè děng hěn duō guójiā de rén.
sentences.english: That party invited people from many countries, including Canada and Croatia.

sentences.chinese: 甚至还有满族的人在这里分享他们的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Shènzhì hái yǒu Mǎn zú de rén zài zhèlǐ fēnxiǎng tāmen de gùshì.
sentences.english: There were even Manchu people here sharing their stories.

sentences.chinese: 周先生问他们：“你们现在有空儿吗？我想问你们一个问题。”
sentences.pinyin: Zhōu xiān sheng wèn tāmen: “Nǐmen xiànzài yǒukòngr ma? Wǒ xiǎng wèn nǐmen yī gè wèntí.”
sentences.english: Mr. Zhou asked them, "Are you available now? I want to ask you a question."

sentences.chinese: 林风紧张地问：“什么问题？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jǐnzhāng de wèn: “Shénme wèntí?”
sentences.english: Lin Feng asked nervously, "What question?"

sentences.chinese: 周先生说：“如果你们能告诉我一个好笑的笑话儿的话，我就让你们离开。”
sentences.pinyin: Zhōu xiān sheng shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐmen néng gàosù wǒ yī gè hǎoxiào de xiàohuar de huà, wǒ jiù ràng nǐmen líkāi.”
sentences.english: Mr. Zhou said, "If you can tell me a funny joke, I will let you leave."

sentences.chinese: 大强想了想，讲了一个关于饺子的笑话儿，逗得周先生大笑。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng xiǎng le xiǎng, jiǎng le yī gè guānyú jiǎozi de xiàohuar, dòu de Zhōu xiān sheng dà xiào.
sentences.english: Da Qiang thought for a moment and told a joke about dumplings, which made Mr. Zhou laugh out loud.

sentences.chinese: 周先生满意地拍拍手，说：“你们很有趣，就像上周我见到的那些旅行者一样。”
sentences.pinyin: Zhōu xiān sheng mǎnyì de pāipāi shǒu, shuō: “Nǐmen hěn yǒuqù, jiù xiàng shàngzhōu wǒ jiàndào de nàxiē lǚxíngzhě yīyàng.”
sentences.english: Mr. Zhou clapped his hands with satisfaction and said, "You are very interesting, just like the travelers I met last week."

sentences.chinese: 他接着说：“下周这里会变得非常危险，你们必须在周末之前离开。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiēzhe shuō: “Xiàzhōu zhèlǐ huì biàn de fēicháng wēixiǎn, nǐmen bìxū zài zhōumò zhīqián líkāi.”
sentences.english: He continued, "Next week it will become very dangerous here; you must leave before the weekend."

sentences.chinese: 林风想起这次冒险就像一个漫长的假期，但现在他只想回家。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎngqǐ zhè cì màoxiǎn jiù xiàng yī gè màncháng de jiàqī, dàn xiànzài tā zhǐ xiǎng huí jiā.
sentences.english: Lin Feng thought that this adventure was like a long vacation, but now he just wanted to go home.

sentences.chinese: 周先生指了指房门，说：“门在那边，但你们需要找到正确的钥匙。”
sentences.pinyin: Zhōu xiān sheng zhǐ le zhǐ fángmén, shuō: “Mén zài nàbiān, dàn nǐmen xūyào zhǎodào zhèngquè de yàoshi.”
sentences.english: Mr. Zhou pointed to the door and said, "The door is over there, but you need to find the correct key."

sentences.chinese: 林风和大强快步走过去，却发现门上没有锁，而是一个复杂的机关。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hé Dà Qiáng kuàibù zǒu guòqù, què fāxiàn mén shàng méiyǒu suǒ, ér shì yī gè fùzá de jīguān.
sentences.english: Lin Feng and Da Qiang walked over quickly, only to find that there was no lock on the door, but a complex mechanism.

sentences.chinese: 就在他们尝试打开门时，房间突然开始剧烈地旋转起来。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tāmen chángshì dǎkāi mén shí, fángjiān tūrán kāishǐ jùliè de xuánzhuǎn qǐlái.
sentences.english: Just as they tried to open the door, the room suddenly began to rotate violently.

sentences.chinese: 他们意识到，真正的挑战才刚刚开始。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen yìshí dào, zhēnzhèng de tiǎozhàn cái gānggāng kāishǐ.
sentences.english: They realized that the real challenge had only just begun.

sentences.chinese: 房间旋转得很快，林风和大强觉得头很晕。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān xuánzhuǎn de hěn kuài, Lín Fēng hé Dà Qiáng juéde tóu hěn yùn.
sentences.english: The room spun very quickly, and Lin Feng and Da Qiang felt very dizzy.

sentences.chinese: 突然，旋转停止了，他们发现自己站在一个奇怪的广场上。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, xuánzhuǎn tíngzhǐ le, tāmen fāxiàn zìjǐ zhàn zài yígè qíguài de guǎngchǎng shàng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the spinning stopped, and they found themselves standing in a strange plaza.

sentences.chinese: 这里的天空是多云的，但奇怪的是，广场被分成了四个部分。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de tiānkōng shì duōyún de, dàn qíguài de shì, guǎngchǎng bèi fēnchéng le sì gè bùfèn.
sentences.english: The sky here was cloudy, but strangely, the plaza was divided into four parts.

sentences.chinese: 第一部分是春天，到处都是绿色的花。
sentences.pinyin: Dì yī bùfèn shì chūntiān, dàochù dōu shì lǜsè de huā.
sentences.english: The first part was spring, with green flowers everywhere.

sentences.chinese: 第二部分是夏天，太阳很大，温度很高。
sentences.pinyin: Dì èr bùfèn shì xiàtiān, tàiyáng hěn dà, wēndù hěn gāo.
sentences.english: The second part was summer, with a big sun and a high temperature.

sentences.chinese: 第三部分是秋天，树叶变成了黄色。
sentences.pinyin: Dì sān bùfèn shì qiūtiān, shùyè biànchéng le huángsè.
sentences.english: The third part was autumn, and the leaves had turned yellow.

sentences.chinese: 第四部分是冬天，地上在下雪，气温是零下十度。
sentences.pinyin: Dì sì bùfèn shì dōngtiān, dìshàng zài xiàxuě, qìwēn shì língxià shí dù.
sentences.english: The fourth part was winter, it was snowing on the ground, and the air temperature was ten degrees below zero.

sentences.chinese: 林风看着四周，发现这里的住房非常高级，像是一座白色的宫殿。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe sìzhōu, fāxiàn zhèlǐ de zhùfáng fēicháng gāojí, xiàng shì yí zuò báisè de gōngdiàn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked around and found that the housing here was very high-grade, like a white palace.

sentences.chinese: 一个穿着长袍的人走过来，他说这里的语言很特别，但林风能听懂。
sentences.pinyin: Yígè chuānzhe chángpáo de rén zǒu guòlái, tā shuō zhèlǐ de yǔyán hěn tèbié, dàn Lín Fēng néng tīngdǒng.
sentences.english: A man wearing a robe walked over and said that the language here was very special, but Lin Feng could understand it.

sentences.chinese: 那个男人说：“你们必须通过季节的考验，才能离开这里。”
sentences.pinyin: Nàge nánrén shuō: “Nǐmen bìxū tōngguò jìjié de kǎoyàn, cáinéng líkāi zhèlǐ.”
sentences.english: The man said, "You must pass the trial of the seasons to leave this place."

sentences.chinese: 他给了大强一袋食物，里面有西餐和一些水果。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gěile Dà Qiáng yí dài shíwù, lǐmiàn yǒu xīcān hé yìxiē shuǐguǒ.
sentences.english: He gave Da Qiang a bag of food, which contained Western food and some fruit.

sentences.chinese: 大强看了一下，说：“这袋食物有五公斤，也就是十斤，太重了！”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng kànle yíxià, shuō: “Zhè dài shíwù yǒu wǔ gōngjīn, yě jiùshì shí jīn, tài zhòng le!”
sentences.english: Da Qiang took a look and said, "This bag of food is five kilograms, which is ten catties, it's too heavy!"

sentences.chinese: 林风提醒他，在科学课上，五公斤也叫五千克。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng tíxǐng tā, zài kēxué kè shàng, wǔ gōngjīn yě jiào wǔ qiānkè.
sentences.english: Lin Feng reminded him that in science class, five kilograms is also called five thousand grams (kilograms).

sentences.chinese: 男人告诉他们，他们必须在十分钟之内，走完这个广场。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén gàosù tāmen, tāmen bìxū zài shí fēnzhōng zhīnèi, zǒu wán zhège guǎngchǎng.
sentences.english: The man told them that they must walk across this plaza within ten minutes.

sentences.chinese: 这个广场很大，大约有一公里长。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège guǎngchǎng hěn dà, dàyuē yǒu yì gōnglǐ cháng.
sentences.english: This plaza was very large, about one kilometer long.

sentences.chinese: 林风想，这比他们平时吃早餐的时间还要短。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎng, zhè bǐ tāmen píngshí chī zǎocān de shíjiān hái yào duǎn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng thought this was even shorter than the time they usually spent eating breakfast.

sentences.chinese: 男人问他们：“你们知道现在是哪个月份吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén wèn tāmen: “Nǐmen zhīdào xiànzài shì nǎge yuèfèn ma?”
sentences.english: The man asked them, "Do you know which month it is now?"

sentences.chinese: 林风回答说：“在这里，时间没有意义，因为四季都在一起。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng huídá shuō: “Zài zhèlǐ, shíjiān méiyǒu yìyì, yīnwèi sìjì dōu zài yìqǐ.”
sentences.english: Lin Feng replied, "Here, time has no meaning because the four seasons are all together."

sentences.chinese: 男人笑了，他说：“正确，只有理解温度的人才能找到钥匙。”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén xiào le, tā shuō: “Zhèngquè, zhǐyǒu lǐjiě wēndù de rén cáinéng zhǎodào yàoshi.”
sentences.english: The man smiled and said, "Correct, only those who understand temperature can find the key."

sentences.chinese: 林风发现，当他走进冬天区域时，他的身体变得很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng fāxiàn, dāng tā zǒu jìn dōngtiān qūyù shí, tā de shēntǐ biàn de hěn lěng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng discovered that when he walked into the winter area, his body became very cold.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，钥匙就在那个最冷的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, yàoshi jiù zài nàge zuì lěng de dìfāng.
sentences.english: He realized the key was in the coldest place.

sentences.chinese: 就在林风伸手去拿钥匙时，地上的雪突然变成了巨大的冰墙，把他们分开了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài Lín Fēng shēnshǒu qù ná yàoshi shí, dìshàng de xuě tūrán biànchéng le jùdà de bīngqiáng, bǎ tāmen fēnkāi le.
sentences.english: Just as Lin Feng reached out to take the key, the snow on the ground suddenly turned into a giant ice wall, separating them.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十六章：冰墙后的秘密
chapters.title_english: Chapter 16: Secrets Behind the Ice Wall

sentences.chinese: 林风看着面前白色的冰墙，心里很着急。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe miànqián báisè de bīngqiáng, xīnlǐ hěn zhāojí.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the white ice wall in front of him, feeling very anxious.

sentences.chinese: 大强在墙那边大喊：“林风，你没事吧？我们现在怎么办？”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng zài qiáng nàbiān dàhǎn: “Lín Fēng, nǐ méishì ba? Wǒmen xiànzài zěnme bàn?”
sentences.english: Da Qiang shouted from the other side of the wall: "Lin Feng, are you okay? What should we do now?"

sentences.chinese: 林风尝试敲击冰墙，结果墙壁像镜子一样，照出了他的脸。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng chángshì qiāojī bīngqiáng, jiéguǒ qiángbì xiàng jìngzi yīyàng, zhào chūle tā de liǎn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng tried to knock on the ice wall, but as a result, the wall was like a mirror, reflecting his face.

sentences.chinese: 突然，冰墙上出现了一封信，林风伸手就收到了它。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, bīngqiáng shàng chūxiànle yī fēng xìn, Lín Fēng shēnshǒu jiù shōudào le tā.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a letter appeared on the ice wall, and Lin Feng reached out and received it.

sentences.chinese: 他接到这封信后，发现信上写着一个关于时间之屋的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiēdào zhè fēng xìn hòu, fāxiàn xìn shàng xiězhe yīgè guānyú shíjiān zhī wū de mìmì.
sentences.english: After receiving this letter, he found a secret about the House of Time written on it.

sentences.chinese: 信里说，这个地方是由一个出生在北方的老人创造的。
sentences.pinyin: Xìn lǐ shuō, zhège dìfāng shì yóu yīgè chūshēng zài běifāng de lǎorén chuàngzào de.
sentences.english: The letter said that this place was created by an old man born in the north.

sentences.chinese: 那个老人从小在西南地区长大，后来去了很多外地工作。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè lǎorén xiǎocóng zài xīnán dìqū zhǎngdà, hòulái qùle hěnduō wàidì gōngzuò.
sentences.english: That old man grew up in the southwest region and later went to many other parts of the country to work.

sentences.chinese: 他曾经在城市里出租过很多奇怪的房子，用来存放记忆。
sentences.pinyin: Tā céngjīng zài chéngshì lǐ chūzū guò hěnduō qíguài de fángzi, yòng lái cúnfàng jìyì.
sentences.english: He once rented out many strange houses in the city to store memories.

sentences.chinese: 林风在信中见到了一张旧照片，照片里有一辆黑色的车。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zài xìn zhòng jiàndào le yī zhāng jiù zhàopiàn, zhàopiàn lǐ yǒu yī liàng hēisè de chē.
sentences.english: Lin Feng saw an old photo in the letter, and there was a black car in the photo.

sentences.chinese: 照片旁边有一只白色的小鸟，看起来很安静。
sentences.pinyin: Zhàopiàn pángbiān yǒu yī zhǐ báisè de xiǎoniǎo, kàn qǐlái hěn ānjìng.
sentences.english: Beside the photo was a small white bird, which looked very peaceful.

sentences.chinese: 林风想起自己以前见过这种鸟，它们能引导人们走出迷宫。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ yǐqián jiànguò zhè zhǒng niǎo, tāmen néng yǐndǎo rénmen zǒuchū mígōng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng remembered that he had seen this kind of bird before; they can lead people out of the maze.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个声音在冰墙后面响起：“站住！不要乱动！”
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, yīgè shēngyīn zài bīngqiáng hòumiàn xiǎngqǐ: “Zhànzhù! Bùyào luàn dòng!”
sentences.english: At this moment, a voice sounded from behind the ice wall: "Stop! Do not move!"

sentences.chinese: 林风惊讶地走进一个隐藏的门，发现里面有一个小队伍在排队。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jīngyà de zǒujìn yīgè yǐncáng de mén, fāxiàn lǐmiàn yǒu yīgè xiǎo duìwǔ zài páiduì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng entered a hidden door in surprise and found a small group of people lining up inside.

sentences.chinese: 这个队伍的人都穿着奇怪的衣服，好像在等待被送到另一个世界。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège duìwǔ de rén dōu chuānzhe qíguài de yīfú, hǎoxiàng zài děngdài bèi sòngdào lìng yīgè shìjiè.
sentences.english: The people in this group were all wearing strange clothes, as if waiting to be delivered to another world.

sentences.chinese: 领头的人看着林风，慢慢地点头，示意他加入这个队。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐngtóu de rén kànzhe Lín Fēng, mànmàn de diǎntóu, shìyì tā jiārù zhège duì.
sentences.english: The leader looked at Lin Feng and slowly nodded, signaling him to join this team.

sentences.chinese: 林风意识到，这不仅仅是一个考验，而是一个巨大的记忆车站。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yìshí dào, zhè bùjǐnjǐn shì yīgè kǎoyàn, ér shì yīgè jùdà de jìyì chēzhàn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng realized that this was not just a test, but a huge memory station.

sentences.chinese: 他看向大强，但冰墙依然挡在他们之间。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng Dà Qiáng, dàn bīngqiáng yīrán dǎng zài tāmen zhījiān.
sentences.english: He looked toward Da Qiang, but the ice wall still stood between them.

sentences.chinese: 突然，冰墙开始剧烈地抖动，一个巨大的阴影再次出现。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, bīngqiáng kāishǐ jùliè de dǒudòng, yīgè jùdà de yīnyǐng zàicì chūxiàn.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the ice wall began to shake violently, and a giant shadow appeared again.

sentences.chinese: 这个阴影告诉他，如果想要救大强，必须找到那辆黑色的车。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège yīnyǐng gàosù tā, rúguǒ xiǎngyào jiù Dà Qiáng, bìxū zhǎodào nà liàng hēisè de chē.
sentences.english: This shadow told him that if he wanted to save Da Qiang, he must find that black car.

sentences.chinese: 林风看着周围，意识到自己进入了一个更深层的陷阱。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe zhōuwéi, yìshí dào zìjǐ jìnrùle yīgè gèng shēncéng de xiànjǐng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked around and realized he had entered a deeper layer of the trap.

sentences.chinese: 他必须在时间结束前，找到离开这里的唯一方法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū zài shíjiān jiéshù qián, zhǎodào líkāi zhèlǐ de wéiyī fāngfǎ.
sentences.english: He must find the only way to leave this place before time runs out.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十七章：黑色的车与记忆之门
chapters.title_english: Chapter 17: The Black Car and the Gate of Memory

sentences.chinese: 林风站在冰墙前，心里非常着急。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhàn zài bīng qiáng qián, xīn lǐ fēi cháng zháo jí.
sentences.english: Lin Feng stood before the ice wall, feeling very anxious.

sentences.chinese: 他大声问那个阴影：“为什么你要分开我们？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dà shēng wèn nà gè yīn yǐng: “Wèi shén me nǐ yào fēn kāi wǒ men?”
sentences.english: He asked the shadow loudly, "Why do you want to separate us?"

sentences.chinese: 阴影没有回答，只指了指远方的一座奇怪房子。
sentences.pinyin: Yīn yǐng méi yǒu huí dá, zhǐ zhǐ le zhǐ yuǎn fāng de yī zuò qí guài fáng zi.
sentences.english: The shadow did not answer, only pointing toward a strange house in the distance.

sentences.chinese: 林风走过去，发现那是一座灰色的房子，看起来很一般。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zǒu guò qù, fā xiàn nà shì yī zuò huī sè de fáng zi, kàn qǐ lái hěn yī bān.
sentences.english: Lin Feng walked over and found it was a gray house that looked quite ordinary.

sentences.chinese: 但是，房子的门前停着一辆黑色的车。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn shì, fáng zi de mén qián tíng zhe yī liàng hēi sè de chē.
sentences.english: However, a black car was parked in front of the house.

sentences.chinese: 这辆车看起来很旧，不但颜色深，而且上面有很多灰尘。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē kàn qǐ lái hěn jiù, bù dàn yán sè shēn, ér qiě shàng miàn yǒu hěn duō huī chén.
sentences.english: This car looked very old; not only was the color dark, but there was also a lot of dust on it.

sentences.chinese: 林风想，这一定就是阴影说的那辆车。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎng, zhè yī dìng jiù shì yīn yǐng shuō de nà liàng chē.
sentences.english: Lin Feng thought, this must be the car the shadow was talking about.

sentences.chinese: 他刚刚走到车边，就听到车里传来了声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gāng gāng zǒu dào chē biān, jiù tīng dào chē lǐ chuán lái le shēng yīn.
sentences.english: He had just walked to the side of the car when he heard a voice coming from inside.

sentences.chinese: 那是大强的声音，但听起来有点奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì Dà Qiáng de shēng yīn, dàn tīng qǐ lái yǒu diǎn qí guài.
sentences.english: It was Da Qiang's voice, but it sounded a bit strange.

sentences.chinese: 大强在车里喊：“林风！快进来！这里有一部分地图！”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng zài chē lǐ hǎn: “Lín Fēng! Kuài jìn lái! Zhè lǐ yǒu yī bù fen dì tú!”
sentences.english: Da Qiang shouted from inside the car, "Lin Feng! Come in quickly! There is a part of the map here!"

sentences.chinese: 林风赶紧打开车门，发现大强原来就在车里，但他的身体被一种奇怪的力量固定住了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎn jǐn dǎ kāi chē mén, fā xiàn Dà Qiáng yuán lái jiù zài chē lǐ, dàn tā de shēn tǐ bèi yī zhǒng qí guài de lì liàng gù dìng zhù le.
sentences.english: Lin Feng hurried to open the car door and discovered that Da Qiang was originally inside the car, but his body was fixed by a strange force.

sentences.chinese: 大强说：“刚才我在这里看到了很多东西，例如一些古老的书和钥匙。”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng shuō: “Gāng cái wǒ zài zhè lǐ kàn dào le hěn duō dōng xī, lì rú yī xiē gǔ lǎo de shū hé yào shi.”
sentences.english: Da Qiang said, "Just now I saw many things here, for example, some ancient books and keys."

sentences.chinese: 林风问：“这些东西是什么样的？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng wèn: “Zhè xiē dōng xī shì shén me yàng de?”
sentences.english: Lin Feng asked, "What kind of things are they?"

sentences.chinese: 大强回答：“它们很不同，有的像金子，有的像石头。”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng huí dá: “Tā men hěn bù tóng, yǒu de xiàng jīn zi, yǒu de xiàng shí tou.”
sentences.english: Da Qiang replied, "They are very different; some are like gold, some are like stone."

sentences.chinese: 林风尝试拉大强出来，但大强动不了，只是一点点地在移动。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng cháng shì lā Dà Qiáng chū lái, dàn Dà Qiáng dòng bù liǎo, zhǐ shì yī diǎn diǎn de zài yí dòng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng tried to pull Da Qiang out, but Da Qiang couldn't move, only moving a little bit.

sentences.chinese: 林风意识到，这辆车不一定是救人的工具，也许是一个新的陷阱。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yì shí dào, zhè liàng chē bù yī dìng shì jiù rén de gōng jù, yě xǔ shì yī gè xīn de xiàn jǐng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng realized that this car was not necessarily a tool for saving people; perhaps it was a new trap.

sentences.chinese: 他看了看车内，发现除了大强以外，还有不少奇怪的按钮。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn le kàn chē nèi, fā xiàn chú le Dà Qiáng yǐ wài, hái yǒu bù shǎo qí guài de àn niǔ.
sentences.english: He looked inside the car and found that apart from Da Qiang, there were quite a few strange buttons.

sentences.chinese: 这些按钮被分成了两组：上面写着“十级以上”和“十级以下”。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiē àn niǔ bèi fēn chéng le liǎng zǔ: shàng miàn xiě zhe “shí jí yǐ shàng” hé “shí jí yǐ xià”.
sentences.english: These buttons were divided into two groups: the top one said "Level 10 or above" and the other "Level 10 or below."

sentences.chinese: 林风从小就喜欢研究机器，他知道只要按下正确的按钮，就能打开锁。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng cóng xiǎo jiù xǐ huan yán jiū jī qì, tā zhī dào zhǐ yào àn xià zhèng què de àn niǔ, jiù néng dǎ kāi suǒ.
sentences.english: Lin Feng had liked studying machines since childhood, and he knew that as long as he pressed the correct button, he could open the lock.

sentences.chinese: 他想，在以前的冒险中，他学到了很多知识。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, zài yǐ qián de mào xiǎn zhōng, tā xué dào le hěn duō zhī shi.
sentences.english: He thought that in previous adventures, he had learned a lot of knowledge.

sentences.chinese: 他决定尝试按下那个“十级以下”的按钮。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué dìng cháng shì àn xià nà gè “shí jí yǐ xià” de àn niǔ.
sentences.english: He decided to try pressing the "Level 10 or below" button.

sentences.chinese: 不久，车内突然响起了巨大的声音，冰墙开始慢慢融化。
sentences.pinyin: Bù jiǔ, chē nèi tū rán xiǎng qǐ le jù dà de shēng yīn, bīng qiáng kāi shǐ màn màn róng huà.
sentences.english: Before long, a loud sound suddenly rang out inside the car, and the ice wall began to melt slowly.

sentences.chinese: 林风发现，他不仅救了大强，而且打开了一扇新的门。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng fā xiàn, tā bù jǐn jiù le Dà Qiáng, ér qiě dǎ kāi le yī shàn xīn de mén.
sentences.english: Lin Feng found that he had not only saved Da Qiang but also opened a new door.

sentences.chinese: 门后面是一个巨大的房间，其中有一个发光的圆圈。
sentences.pinyin: Mén hòu miàn shì yī gè jù dà de fáng jiān, qí zhōng yǒu yī gè fā guāng de yuán quān.
sentences.english: Behind the door was a huge room, among which was a glowing circle.

sentences.chinese: 这个圆圈代表着今后的方向，但林风不太确定该怎么走。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè yuán quān dài biǎo zhe jīn hòu de fāng xiàng, dàn Lín Fēng bù tài què dìng gāi zěn me zǒu.
sentences.english: This circle represented the direction for the future, but Lin Feng was not too sure how to go.

sentences.chinese: 除了这个圆圈，其他地方都是黑暗的。
sentences.pinyin: Chú le zhè gè yuán quān, qí tā dì fāng dōu shì hēi àn de.
sentences.english: Apart from this circle, other places were all dark.

sentences.chinese: 他记得以前听过，在这种地方，普通的人只能看到黑暗。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì de yǐ qián tīng guò, zài zhè zhǒng dì fāng, pǔ tōng de rén zhǐ néng kàn dào hēi àn.
sentences.english: He remembered hearing before that in this kind of place, ordinary people can only see darkness.

sentences.chinese: 但林风和大强不是一般的人，他们是勇敢的探险家。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn Lín Fēng hé Dà Qiáng bù shì yī bān de rén, tā men shì yǒng gǎn de tàn xiǎn jiā.
sentences.english: But Lin Feng and Da Qiang were not ordinary people; they were brave explorers.

sentences.chinese: 他看着大强说：“以后我们一定要小心。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe Dà Qiáng shuō: “Yǐ hòu wǒ men yī dìng yào xiǎo xīn.”
sentences.english: He looked at Da Qiang and said, "In the future, we must be careful."

sentences.chinese: 大强又笑了，这次他的声音恢复了正常。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng yòu xiào le, zhè cì tā de shēng yīn huī fù le zhèng cháng.
sentences.english: Da Qiang smiled again, and this time his voice returned to normal.

sentences.chinese: 他们走出车子，向着那个圆圈走去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zǒu chū chē zi, xiàng zhe nà gè yuán quān zǒu qù.
sentences.english: They stepped out of the car and walked toward the circle.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，圆圈突然变色，一个巨大的声音在房间里响起：
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, yuán quān tū rán biàn sè, yī gè jù dà de shēng yīn zài fáng jiān lǐ xiǎng qǐ:
sentences.english: Just then, the circle suddenly changed color, and a huge voice rang out in the room:

sentences.chinese: “欢迎来到记忆的终点，但你们准备好面对真相了吗？”
sentences.pinyin: “Huān yíng lái dào jì yì de zhōng diǎn, dàn nǐ men zhǔn bèi hǎo miàn duì zhēn xiàng le ma?”
sentences.english: "Welcome to the end of memory, but are you ready to face the truth?"

sentences.chinese: 圆圈的光芒变得非常亮，林风和大强被吸进了光里。
sentences.pinyin: Yuán quān de guāng máng biàn de fēi cháng liàng, Lín Fēng hé Dà Qiáng bèi xī jìn le guāng lǐ.
sentences.english: The light of the circle became very bright, and Lin Feng and Da Qiang were sucked into the light.

sentences.chinese: 他们发现自己站在一个奇怪的房间里，这里有很多旧照片。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men fā xiàn zì jǐ zhàn zài yí gè qí guài de fáng jiān lǐ, zhè lǐ yǒu hěn duō jiù zhào piàn.
sentences.english: They found themselves standing in a strange room with many old photographs.

sentences.chinese: 林风看到一张照片，那是他小时候的样子。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn dào yì zhāng zhào piàn, nà shì tā xiǎo shí hou de yàng zi.
sentences.english: Lin Feng saw a photo; it was him as a child.

sentences.chinese: 他惊讶地喊道：“啊！这是我！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīng yà de hǎn dào: “ā! Zhè shì wǒ!”
sentences.english: He shouted in surprise, "Ah! This is me!"

sentences.chinese: 大强也看到了同样的照片，但照片里的是大强。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng yě kàn dào le tóng yàng de zhào piàn, dàn zhào piàn lǐ de shì Dà Qiáng.
sentences.english: Da Qiang also saw the same photo, but the one in the photo was Da Qiang.

sentences.chinese: 林风觉得这里好像是一个记忆博物馆。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jué de zhè lǐ hǎo xiàng shì yí gè jì yì bó wù guǎn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt as if this place was a museum of memories.

sentences.chinese: 因为照片很多，大部分照片都记录了他们的过去。
sentences.pinyin: Yīn wèi zhào piàn hěn duō, dà bù fen zhào piàn dōu jì lù le tā men de guò qù.
sentences.english: Because there were so many photos, the majority of them recorded their past.

sentences.chinese: 林风看着照片想，我小时候多么开心啊。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn zhe zhào piàn xiǎng, wǒ xiǎo shí hou duō me kāi xīn ā.
sentences.english: Looking at the photos, Lin Feng thought, how happy I was in my childhood.

sentences.chinese: 可是，这些照片为什么会在这里？
sentences.pinyin: Kě shì, zhè xiē zhào piàn wèi shén me huì zài zhè lǐ?
sentences.english: But why are these photos here?

sentences.chinese: 当时，房间里忽然响起了一个声音。
sentences.pinyin: Dāng shí, fáng jiān lǐ hū rán xiǎng qǐ le yí gè shēng yīn.
sentences.english: At that time, a voice suddenly sounded in the room.

sentences.chinese: 那个声音说：“你们已经走了好久，现在可以面对真相了。”
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè shēng yīn shuō: “Nǐ men yǐ jīng zǒu le hǎo jiǔ, xiàn zài kě yǐ miàn duì zhēn xiàng le.”
sentences.english: The voice said, "You have already walked for quite a while; now you can face the truth."

sentences.chinese: 声音说，这个地方记录了大量关于这个世界的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Shēng yīn shuō, zhè gè dì fang jì lù le dà liàng guān yú zhè gè shì jiè de mì mì.
sentences.english: The voice said that this place recorded a large quantity of secrets about this world.

sentences.chinese: 多数人来到这里后都会忘记自己是谁，所以他们必须小心。
sentences.pinyin: Duō shù rén lái dào zhè lǐ hòu dōu huì wàng jì zì jǐ shì shuí, suǒ yǐ tā men bì xū xiǎo xīn.
sentences.english: Most people forget who they are after coming here, so they must be careful.

sentences.chinese: 林风问：“我们该怎样离开这里？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng wèn: “Wǒ men gāi zěn yàng lí kāi zhè lǐ?”
sentences.english: Lin Feng asked, "How should we leave this place?"

sentences.chinese: 声音回答：“或者你们可以尝试找回丢失的记忆，或者寻找出口。”
sentences.pinyin: Shēng yīn huí dá: “Huò zhě nǐ men kě yǐ cháng shì zhǎo huí diū shī de jì yì, huò zhě xún zhǎo chū kǒu.”
sentences.english: The voice replied, "Perhaps you can try to recover lost memories, or look for the exit."

sentences.chinese: 林风意识到，这个声音可能在故意考验他们。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yì shí dào, zhè gè shēng yīn kě néng zài gù yì kǎo yàn tā men.
sentences.english: Lin Feng realized that this voice might be deliberately testing them.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这个房间实在太奇怪了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué de zhè gè fáng jiān shí zài tài qí guài le.
sentences.english: He felt that this room was really too strange.

sentences.chinese: 他想起平常的生活，在那时他从没想过会经历这些冒险。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ píng cháng de shēng huó, zài nà shí tā cóng méi xiǎng guò huì jīng lì zhè xiē mào xiǎn.
sentences.english: He thought of his ordinary life; at that time, he never imagined he would experience these adventures.

sentences.chinese: 后来，他发现房间的墙壁开始移动，两个门同时出现了。
sentences.pinyin: Hòu lái, tā fā xiàn fáng jiān de qiáng bì kāi shǐ yí dòng, liǎng gè mén tóng shí chū xiàn le.
sentences.english: Later, he discovered the walls of the room began to move, and two doors appeared simultaneously.

sentences.chinese: 一个门通往过去，另一个门通往未来。
sentences.pinyin: Yí gè mén tōng wǎng guò qù, lìng yí gè mén tōng wǎng wèi lái.
sentences.english: One door led to the past, and the other led to the future.

sentences.chinese: 林风想，如果选错了门，我们可能永远不能回家。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎng, rú guǒ xuǎn cuò le mén, wǒ men kě néng yǒng yuǎn bù néng huí jiā.
sentences.english: Lin Feng thought, if we choose the wrong door, we might never be able to go home.

sentences.chinese: 他问大强：“你觉得怎么样？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn Dà Qiáng: “Nǐ jué de zěn me yàng?”
sentences.english: He asked Da Qiang, "What do you think?"

sentences.chinese: 大强看着两个门，说：“这两个门看起来差不多。”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng kàn zhe liǎng gè mén, shuō: “Zhè liǎng gè mén kàn qǐ lái chà bu duō.”
sentences.english: Da Qiang looked at the two doors and said, "These two doors look almost the same."

sentences.chinese: 他们在这里站了多久？林风已经不记得了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zài zhè lǐ zhàn le duō jiǔ? Lín Fēng yǐ jīng bù jì de le.
sentences.english: How long had they been standing here? Lin Feng already couldn't remember.

sentences.chinese: 但他们知道，这里的压力大大增加了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tā men zhī dào, zhè lǐ de yā lì dà dà zēng jiā le.
sentences.english: But they knew the pressure here had greatly increased.

sentences.chinese: 他们看到好多碎片在空中飞舞，像是在告诉他们某些事情。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men kàn dào hǎo duō suì piàn zài kōng zhōng fēi wǔ, xiàng shì zài gào su tā men mǒu xiē shì qing.
sentences.english: They saw many fragments flying in the air, as if telling them something.

sentences.chinese: 这些碎片或像玻璃，或像冰块。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiē suì piàn huò xiàng bō lí, huò xiàng bīng kuài.
sentences.english: These fragments were either like glass or like ice.

sentences.chinese: 林风觉得，无论选择哪个门，他们都必须一起面对。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jué de, wú lùn xuǎn zé nǎ gè mén, tā men dōu bì xū yì qǐ miàn duì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt that no matter which door they chose, they had to face it together.

sentences.chinese: 所以，他们决定一起走进那个通往未来的门。
sentences.pinyin: Suǒ yǐ, tā men jué dìng yì qǐ zǒu jìn nà gè tōng wǎng wèi lái de mén.
sentences.english: Therefore, they decided to walk into the door leading to the future together.

sentences.chinese: 就在他们迈步的一瞬间，地上的照片突然全部消失了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tā men mài bù de yì shùn jiān, dì shàng de zhào piàn tū rán quán bù xiāo shī le.
sentences.english: The moment they stepped forward, the photos on the ground suddenly all disappeared.

sentences.chinese: 一个巨大的黑影在门后等着他们，眼神冰冷。
sentences.pinyin: Yí gè jù dà de hēi yǐng zài mén hòu děng zhe tā men, yǎn shén bīng lěng.
sentences.english: A huge dark shadow was waiting for them behind the door, its eyes cold.

sentences.chinese: 林风心中一惊：难道真相就是这个怪物吗？
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xīn zhōng yì jīng: nán dào zhēn xiàng jiù shì zhè gè guài wù ma?
sentences.english: Lin Feng was startled: could the truth be this monster?

chapters.title_english: Chapter 19: The Secret of the Shadow

sentences.chinese: 林风和大强站在那个巨大的黑影面前，心里有一点儿害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hé Dà Qiáng zhàn zài nà gè jù dà de hēi yǐng miàn qián, xīn lǐ yǒu yī diǎn r hài pà.
sentences.english: Lin Feng and Da Qiang stood before the giant shadow, feeling a bit scared.

sentences.chinese: 这个黑影看上去有点儿像林风自己，但是它没有脸。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè hēi yǐng kàn shàng qù yǒu diǎn r xiàng Lín Fēng zì jǐ, dàn shì tā méi yǒu liǎn.
sentences.english: This shadow looked slightly like Lin Feng himself, but it had no face.

sentences.chinese: 黑影开口说话了，声音低沉且奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Hēi yǐng kāi kǒu shuō huà le, shēng yīn dī chén qiě qí guài.
sentences.english: The shadow began to speak, its voice deep and strange.

sentences.chinese: 它说：“欢迎来到这里，你们最近经历了很多事情。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Huān yíng lái dào zhè lǐ, nǐ men zuì jìn jīng lì le hěn duō shì qíng.”
sentences.english: It said, "Welcome here, you have experienced many things recently."

sentences.chinese: 林风感到身体在发抖，但他知道现在该勇敢一点。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎn dào shēn tǐ zài fā dǒu, dàn tā zhī dào xiàn zài gāi yǒng gǎn yī diǎn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt his body trembling, but he knew he should be a bit braver now.

sentences.chinese: 黑影告诉他们，这里正是所有记忆交汇的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Hēi yǐng gào sù tā men, zhè lǐ zhèng shì suǒ yǒu jì yì jiāo huì de dì fāng.
sentences.english: The shadow told them that this place is precisely where all memories converge.

sentences.chinese: 这里的规则很简单，比如你必须诚实，比如你不能逃跑。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de guī zé hěn jiǎn dān, bǐ rú nǐ bì xū chéng shí, bǐ rú nǐ bù néng táo pǎo.
sentences.english: The rules here are simple, for example, you must be honest, for example, you cannot run away.

sentences.chinese: 比如说，如果你说谎，你会被永远留在黑暗中。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐ rú shuō, rú guǒ nǐ shuō huǎng, nǐ huì bèi yǒng yuǎn liú zài hēi àn zhōng.
sentences.english: For instance, if you lie, you will be left in the darkness forever.

sentences.chinese: 黑影说，在过去，这里住着一个真正强大的人。
sentences.pinyin: Hēi yǐng shuō, zài guò qù, zhè lǐ zhù zhe yī gè zhēn zhèng qiáng dà de rén.
sentences.english: The shadow said that in the past, a truly powerful person lived here.

sentences.chinese: 那个人拥有许多秘密，而且他想把这些秘密交给勇敢的人。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén yōng yǒu xǔ duō mì mì, ér qiě tā xiǎng bǎ zhè xiē mì mì jiāo gěi yǒng gǎn de rén.
sentences.english: That person possessed many secrets, and moreover, he wanted to pass these secrets to brave people.

sentences.chinese: 林风看着黑影，发现它的动作和自己的动作完全相同。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn zhe hēi yǐng, fā xiàn tā de dòng zuò hé zì jǐ de dòng zuò wán quán xiāng tóng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the shadow and found that its movements were identical to his own.

sentences.chinese: 虽然这很奇怪，但林风觉得这个黑影并不想伤害他们。
sentences.pinyin: Suī rán zhè hěn qí guài, dàn Lín Fēng jué de zhè gè hēi yǐng bìng bù xiǎng shāng hài tā men.
sentences.english: Although this was strange, Lin Feng felt that this shadow did not want to hurt them.

sentences.chinese: 他试着向黑影走近，感觉距离越来越近。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì zhe xiàng hēi yǐng zǒu jìn, gǎn jué jù lí yuè lái yuè jìn.
sentences.english: He tried to move closer to the shadow, feeling the distance getting closer and closer.

sentences.chinese: 这时，大强在他身边小声地说：“林风，小心点。”
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, Dà Qiáng zài tā shēn biān xiǎo shēng de shuō: “Lín Fēng, xiǎo xīn diǎn.”
sentences.english: At this time, Da Qiang whispered beside him, "Lin Feng, be careful."

sentences.chinese: 这时候，黑影突然伸出手，指向地上的一个圆圈。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí hòu, hēi yǐng tū rán shēn chū shǒu, zhǐ xiàng dì shàng de yī gè yuán quān.
sentences.english: At this moment, the shadow suddenly reached out and pointed to a circle on the ground.

sentences.chinese: 林风想，如果这样走下去，我们可能就找到了真相。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎng, rú guǒ zhè yàng zǒu xià qù, wǒ men kě néng jiù zhǎo dào le zhēn xiàng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng thought, if we continue this way, we might find the truth.

sentences.chinese: 那么，我们为什么会来到这个奇怪的地方呢？
sentences.pinyin: Nà me, wǒ men wèi shé me huì lái dào zhè gè qí guài de dì fāng ne?
sentences.english: Then, why did we come to this strange place?

sentences.chinese: 林风想起了那会儿在森林里看到的地图。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎng qǐ le nà huì r zài sēn lín lǐ kàn dào de dì tú.
sentences.english: Lin Feng remembered the map he saw in the forest at that time.

sentences.chinese: 那时，他还没有意识到这次冒险会这么危险。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shí, tā hái méi yǒu yì shí dào zhè cì mào xiǎn huì zhè me wēi xiǎn.
sentences.english: Then, he had not realized that this adventure would be so dangerous.

sentences.chinese: 那时候，他以为只要找到宝藏就成功了。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shí hou, tā yǐ wéi zhǐ yào zhǎo dào bǎo zàng jiù chéng gōng le.
sentences.english: At that time, he thought that as long as he found the treasure, he would succeed.

sentences.chinese: 但现在他明白，那样想太简单了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiàn zài tā míng bái, nà yàng xiǎng tài jiǎn dān le.
sentences.english: But now he understands that thinking that way was too simple.

sentences.chinese: 黑影说：“你们可以随便选择一个方向走，但只有一条路是对的。”
sentences.pinyin: Hēi yǐng shuō: “Nǐ men kě yǐ suí biàn xuǎn zé yī gè fāng xiàng zǒu, dàn zhǐ yǒu yī tiáo lù shì duì de.”
sentences.english: The shadow said, "You may choose any direction to walk as you please, but only one path is correct."

sentences.chinese: 林风看着眼前的三扇门，正好是三种不同的颜色。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn zhe yǎn qián de sān shàn mén, zhèng hǎo shì sān zhǒng bù tóng de yán sè.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the three doors in front of him, which happened to be three different colors.

sentences.chinese: 他决定重新思考一下海先生给他的建议。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué dìng chóng xīn sī kǎo yī xià Hǎi xiān sheng gěi tā de jiàn yì.
sentences.english: He decided to rethink the advice Mr. Hai had given him.

sentences.chinese: 然后，他闭上眼睛，用心地听周围的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Rán hòu, tā bì shàng yǎn jīng, yòng xīn de tīng zhōu wéi de shēng yīn.
sentences.english: Then, he closed his eyes and listened carefully to the sounds around him.

sentences.chinese: 他突然意识到，这个黑影其实就是他内心恐惧的影子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tū rán yì shí dào, zhè gè hēi yǐng qí shí jiù shì tā nèi xīn kǒng jù de yǐng zi.
sentences.english: He suddenly realized that this shadow was actually the shadow of his own inner fear.

sentences.chinese: 他不再害怕，大声对黑影说：“我知道你是谁了！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zài hài pà, dà shēng duì hēi yǐng shuō: “Wǒ zhī dào nǐ shì shuí le!”
sentences.english: He was no longer afraid and said loudly to the shadow, "I know who you are!"

sentences.chinese: 黑影听到这句话后，身体开始慢慢变透明。
sentences.pinyin: Hēi yǐng tīng dào zhè jù huà hòu, shēn tǐ kāi shǐ màn man biàn tòu míng.
sentences.english: After hearing these words, the shadow's body began to slowly become transparent.

sentences.chinese: 就在黑影消失的一瞬间，三扇门突然全部打开了，里面传来了巨大的吼叫声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài hēi yǐng xiāo shī de yī shùn jiān, sān shàn mén tū rán quán bù dǎ kāi le, lǐ miàn chuán lái le jù dà de hǒu jiào shēng.
sentences.english: The moment the shadow disappeared, the three doors suddenly all opened, and a huge roar came from inside.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十章：吼叫之门与古老的考验
chapters.title_english: Chapter 20: The Gates of Roaring and the Ancient Trial

sentences.chinese: 三扇门打开了，巨大的吼叫声在房间里响了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Sān shàn mén dǎ kāi le, jù dà de hǒu jiào shēng zài fáng jiān lǐ xiǎng le qǐ lái.
sentences.english: The three doors opened, and a giant roaring sound echoed through the room.

sentences.chinese: 林风和大强赶紧跑向墙边，试图寻找掩护。
sentences.pinyin: Lín fēng hé dà qiáng gǎn jǐn pǎo xiàng qiáng biān, shì tú xún zhǎo yǎn hù.
sentences.english: Lin Feng and Da Qiang quickly ran toward the wall, trying to find cover.

sentences.chinese: 大强紧张地说：“咱得快点跑，不然就被抓住了！”
sentences.pinyin: Dà qiáng jǐn zhāng de shuō: “Zán děi kuài diǎn pǎo, bù rán jiù bèi zhuā zhù le!”
sentences.english: Da Qiang said nervously, "We have to run fast, otherwise we'll be caught!"

sentences.chinese: 林风看着门后，发现那里不是怪物，而是一片巨大的草地。
sentences.pinyin: Lín fēng kàn zhe mén hòu, fā xiàn nà lǐ bú shì guài wù, ér shì yī piàn jù dà de cǎo dì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked behind the door and found that it wasn't a monster, but a vast grassland.

sentences.chinese: 草地上停着一艘古老的船，船上放着一个奇怪的碗。
sentences.pinyin: Cǎo dì shàng tíng zhe yī sōu gǔ lǎo de chuán, chuán shàng fàng zhe yī gè qí guài de wǎn.
sentences.english: A primitive boat was stopped on the grass, and a strange bowl was placed on the boat.

sentences.chinese: 碗里装着一种绿色的药，旁边还有一张黄色的纸。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎn lǐ zhuāng zhe yī zhǒng lǜ sè de yào, páng biān hái yǒu yī zhāng huáng sè de zhǐ.
sentences.english: Inside the bowl was a type of green medicine, and there was also a yellow piece of paper beside it.

sentences.chinese: 纸上写着一个词，林风读了三遍才明白它的意思。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐ shàng xiě zhe yī gè cí, Lín fēng dú le sān biàn cái míng bái tā de yì si.
sentences.english: A word was written on the paper; Lin Feng read it three times before understanding its meaning.

sentences.chinese: 他发现这张纸上写着：“只有勇敢的人才能占据这里。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn zhè zhāng zhǐ shàng xiě zhe: “Zhǐ yǒu yǒng gǎn de rén cái néng zhàn jù zhè lǐ.”
sentences.english: He discovered that the paper said: "Only the brave can occupy this place."

sentences.chinese: 林风记得海先生早就告诉过他，这里的考验需要勇气。
sentences.pinyin: Lín fēng jì dé hǎi xiān sheng zǎo jiù gào sù guò tā, zhè lǐ de kǎo yàn xū yào yǒng qì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng remembered that Mr. Hai had already told him that the trials here required courage.

sentences.chinese: 他举起手中的地图，大声读出纸上的每一句指令。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jǔ qǐ shǒu zhōng de dì tú, dà shēng dú chū zhǐ shàng de měi yī jù zhǐ lǐng.
sentences.english: He raised the map in his hand and read every sentence of the instructions on the paper aloud.

sentences.chinese: 突然，地上的石头开始移动，像是在玩一个假的游戏。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, dì shàng de shí tou kāi shǐ yí dòng, xiàng shì zài wán yī gè jiǎ de yóu xì.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the stones on the ground began to move, as if playing a fake game.

sentences.chinese: 一个声音说：“如果你能背起这个沉重的宝箱，我就让你离开。”
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè shēng yīn shuō: “Rú guǒ nǐ néng bēi qǐ zhè gè chén zhòng de bǎo xiāng, wǒ jiù ràng nǐ lí kāi.”
sentences.english: A voice said, "If you can carry this heavy treasure chest on your back, I will let you leave."

sentences.chinese: 林风尝试去碰那个宝箱，但它重得像有一万斤一样。
sentences.pinyin: Lín fēng cháng shì qù pèng nà gè bǎo xiāng, dàn tā zhòng de xiàng yǒu yī wàn jīn yī yàng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng tried to touch the treasure chest, but it was as heavy as ten thousand catties.

sentences.chinese: 大强在旁边大喊：“别担心，我来帮你提这个箱子！”
sentences.pinyin: Dà qiáng zài páng biān dà hǎn: “Bié dān xīn, wǒ lái bāng nǐ tí zhè gè xiāng zi!”
sentences.english: Da Qiang shouted from the side, "Don't worry, I'll help you carry this box!"

sentences.chinese: 他们两人一起努力，终于把宝箱搬到了船上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men liǎng rén yī qǐ nǔ lì, zhōng yú bǎ bǎo xiāng bān dào le chuán shàng.
sentences.english: The two of them worked together and finally moved the treasure chest onto the boat.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，天色突然变暗，像是在深沉的夜色之中。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, tiān sè tū rán biàn àn, xiàng shì zài shēn chén de yè sè zhī zhōng.
sentences.english: Just then, the sky suddenly turned dark, as if in the deep colors of the night.

sentences.chinese: 林风发现宝箱里没有金子，而是一个像蛋一样圆的晶体。
sentences.pinyin: Lín fēng fā xiàn bǎo xiāng lǐ méi yǒu jīn zi, ér shì yī gè xiàng dàn yī yàng yuán de jīng tǐ.
sentences.english: Lin Feng found that there was no gold in the treasure chest, but a crystal as round as an egg.

sentences.chinese: 这个晶体散发出光芒，照亮了他们留下的所有脚印。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè jīng tǐ sàn fā chū guāng máng, zhào liàng le tā men liú xià de suǒ yǒu jiǎo yìn.
sentences.english: This crystal emitted light, illuminating all the footprints they had left behind.

sentences.chinese: 他们意识到，这个晶体才是打开最后之门的钥匙。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men yì shí dào, zhè gè jīng tǐ cái shì dǎ kāi zuì hòu zhī mén de yào shi.
sentences.english: They realized that this crystal was the key to opening the final door.

sentences.chinese: 但就在他们准备起航时，船底突然传来了奇怪的撞击声。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài tā men zhǔn bèi qǐ háng shí, chuán dǐ tū rán chuán lái le qí guài de zhuàng jī shēng.
sentences.english: But just as they were preparing to set sail, a strange bumping sound came from the bottom of the boat.

sentences.chinese: 有什么东西在水下盯着他们，而且它看起来非常饥饿。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu shén me dōng xī zài shuǐ xià dīng zhe tā men, ér qiě tā kàn qǐ lái fēi cháng jī è.
sentences.english: Something was staring at them under the water, and it looked very hungry.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十一章：水下之城的记忆
chapters.title_english: Chapter 21: Memories of the Underwater City

sentences.chinese: 船底的撞击声越来越大，林风和大强非常害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Chuán dǐ de zhuàng jī shēng yuè lái yuè dà, Lín Fēng hé Dà Qiáng fēi cháng hài pà.
sentences.english: The banging sound at the bottom of the boat grew louder, and Lin Feng and Da Qiang were very scared.

sentences.chinese: 他们突然被一股巨大的力量拉进了水底，进入了一个奇怪的城市。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men tū rán bèi yī gǔ jù dà de lì liàng lā jìn le shuǐ dǐ, jìn rù le yī gè qí guài de chéng shì.
sentences.english: They were suddenly pulled underwater by a huge force, entering a strange city.

sentences.chinese: 这里的人们看起来很奇怪，他们穿着像在教室里一样正式的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de rén men kàn qǐ lái hěn qí guài, tā men chuān zhe xiàng zài jiào shì lǐ yī yàng zhèng shì de yī fú.
sentences.english: The people here looked strange; they wore formal clothes as if they were in a classroom.

sentences.chinese: 林风发现这里有一个巨大的图书馆，里面坐着很多中年的人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng fā xiàn zhè lǐ yǒu yī gè jù dà de tú shū guǎn, lǐ miàn zuò zhe hěn duō zhōng nián de rén.
sentences.english: Lin Feng found a huge library here, where many middle-aged people were sitting.

sentences.chinese: 一个年轻的教师走过来，他对林风说：“欢迎来到记忆之城。”
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè nián qīng de jiào shī zǒu guò lái, tā duì Lín Fēng shuō: “Huān yíng lái dào jì yì zhī chéng.”
sentences.english: A young teacher walked over and said to Lin Feng, "Welcome to the City of Memory."

sentences.chinese: 他的中文说得非常流利，像是一个国际专家。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de Zhōng wén shuō de fēi cháng liú lì, xiàng shì yī gè guó jì zhuān jiā.
sentences.english: His Chinese was very fluent, like that of an international expert.

sentences.chinese: 林风注意到，这里的大多数人都在读一本厚书。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhù yì dào, zhè lǐ de dà duō shù rén dōu zài dú yī běn hòu shū.
sentences.english: Lin Feng noticed that the majority of people here were reading a thick book.

sentences.chinese: 那本书是一个著名的作家写的，讲述了亿万年前的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Nà běn shū shì yī gè zhù míng de zuò jiā xiě de, jiǎng shù le yì wàn nián qián de gù shì.
sentences.english: That book was written by a famous author and told a story from hundreds of millions of years ago.

sentences.chinese: 教师告诉他们，这里曾是一个中级文明的中心，现在只有几千个人留在这里。
sentences.pinyin: Jiào shī gào sù tā men, zhè lǐ céng shì yī gè zhōng jí wén míng de zhōng xīn, xiàn zài zhǐ yǒu jǐ qiān gè rén liú zài zhè lǐ.
sentences.english: The teacher told them that this place was once the center of a middle-level civilization, and now only a few thousand people remain here.

sentences.chinese: 林风看到周围的椅子和座位都是用透明的晶体做的。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn dào zhōu wéi de yǐ zi hé zuò wèi dōu shì yòng tòu míng de jīng tǐ zuò de.
sentences.english: Lin Feng saw that the chairs and seats around them were all made of transparent crystals.

sentences.chinese: 在大厅的墙上，写着一个很长的句子，那是这个城市的法律。
sentences.pinyin: Zài dà tīng de qiáng shàng, xiě zhe yī gè hěn cháng de jù zi, nà shì zhè gè chéng shì de fǎ lǜ.
sentences.english: On the wall of the hall, a very long sentence was written; it was the law of this city.

sentences.chinese: “这里不需要信用卡，也不需要护照，”教师微笑着说。
sentences.pinyin: “Zhè lǐ bù xū yào xìn yòng kǎ, yě bù xū yào hù zhào,” jiào shī wēi xiào zhe shuō.
sentences.english: "Credit cards are not needed here, nor are passports," the teacher said with a smile.

sentences.chinese: 林风看了看自己的手表，发现时间停止了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn le kàn zì jǐ de shǒu biǎo, fā xiàn shí jiān tíng zhǐ le.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at his wristwatch and found that time had stopped.

sentences.chinese: 他看到桌子上有一个塑料瓶子和一碗方便面，看起来很像他在中小学时吃的东西。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī gè sù liào píng zi hé yī wǎn fāng biàn miàn, kàn qǐ lái hěn xiàng tā zài zhōng xiǎo xué shí chī de dōng xī.
sentences.english: He saw a plastic bottle and a bowl of instant noodles on the table, which looked very much like the things he ate in middle and elementary school.

sentences.chinese: 这时，大强在旁边发现了一个排球和一双球鞋。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, Dà Qiáng zài páng biān fā xiàn le yī gè pái qiú hé yī shuāng qiú xié.
sentences.english: At this moment, Da Qiang discovered a volleyball and a pair of athletic shoes nearby.

sentences.chinese: 大强兴奋地说：“这里竟然有球队！我可以加入他们吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng xìng fèn de shuō: “Zhè lǐ jìng rán yǒu qiú duì! Wǒ kě yǐ jiā rù tā men ma?”
sentences.english: Da Qiang said excitedly, "There's actually a sports team here! Can I join them?"

sentences.chinese: 教师摇了摇头，说这里的运动已经不再常用了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiào shī yáo le yáo tóu, shuō zhè lǐ de yùn dòng yǐ jīng bù zài cháng yòng le.
sentences.english: The teacher shook his head and said that sports here were no longer in common usage.

sentences.chinese: 突然，城市里响起了巨大的新闻广播，声音在整个河底回荡。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, chéng shì lǐ xiǎng qǐ le jù dà de xīn wén guǎng bō, shēng yīn zài zhěng gè hé dǐ huí dàng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a loud news broadcast sounded in the city, the voice echoing throughout the riverbed.

sentences.chinese: 广播里说，现在的人数正在减少，只有少数小组能生存下去。
sentences.pinyin: Guǎng bō lǐ shuō, xiàn zài de rén shù zhèng zài jiǎn shǎo, zhǐ yǒu shǎo shù xiǎo zǔ néng shēng cún xià qù.
sentences.english: The broadcast said that the number of people was decreasing, and only a few groups could survive.

sentences.chinese: 林风突然想起，他曾经在新闻里听说过这个城市的市长。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng tū rán xiǎng qǐ, tā céng jīng zài xīn wén lǐ tīng shuō guò zhè gè chéng shì de shì zhǎng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng suddenly remembered that he had once heard about the mayor of this city in the news.

sentences.chinese: 传说市长拥有一个能发送特殊信号的装置，可以打开最后的大门。
sentences.pinyin: Chuán shuō shì zhǎng yōng yǒu yī gè néng fā sòng tè shū xìn hào de zhuāng zhì, kě yǐ dǎ kāi zuì hòu de dà mén.
sentences.english: Legend has it that the mayor possesses a device that can send a special signal to open the final gate.

sentences.chinese: 林风紧紧握着那个晶体，意识到它就是那个信号的来源。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jǐn jǐn wò zhe nà gè jīng tǐ, yì shí dào tā jiù shì nà gè xìn hào de lái yuán.
sentences.english: Lin Feng gripped the crystal tightly, realizing it was the source of that signal.

sentences.chinese: 它散发出的光芒让周围的所有人都看向了他们。
sentences.pinyin: Tā sàn fā chū de guāng máng ràng zhōu wéi de suǒ yǒu rén dōu kàn xiàng le tā men.
sentences.english: The light it emitted made everyone around them look toward them.

sentences.chinese: 教师的眼神变了，他不再那么友好，而是变得很严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Jiào shī de yǎn shén biàn le, tā bù zài nà me yǒu hǎo, ér shì biàn de hěn yán sù.
sentences.english: The teacher's expression changed; he was no longer so friendly but became very serious.

sentences.chinese: “把晶体给我！”教师大声喊道，声音像雷一样。
sentences.pinyin: “Bǎ jīng tǐ gěi wǒ!” jiào shī dà shēng hǎn dào, shēng yīn xiàng léi yī yàng.
sentences.english: "Give me the crystal!" the teacher shouted loudly, his voice like thunder.

sentences.chinese: 林风和大强赶紧跑了起来，他们的球鞋在晶体地面上发出响声。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hé Dà Qiáng gǎn jǐn pǎo le qǐ lái, tā men de qiú xié zài jīng tǐ dì miàn shàng fā chū xiǎng shēng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng and Da Qiang quickly started running, their athletic shoes making noise on the crystal floor.

sentences.chinese: 他们跑过一个像教室一样的房间，里面摆满了古老的书籍。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men pǎo guò yī gè xiàng jiào shì yī yàng de fáng jiān, lǐ miàn bǎi mǎn le gǔ lǎo de shū jí.
sentences.english: They ran through a room that looked like a classroom, filled with ancient books.

sentences.chinese: 他们必须在被抓住之前，找到那个能发送信号的机器。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men bì xū zài bèi zhuā zhù zhī qián, zhǎo dào nà gè néng fā sòng xìn hào de jī qì.
sentences.english: They had to find the machine that could send the signal before they were caught.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，水底的压力突然增加，四周的墙壁开始裂开。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, shuǐ dǐ de yā lì tū rán zēng jiā, sì zhōu de qiáng bì kāi shǐ liè kāi.
sentences.english: But just then, the underwater pressure suddenly increased, and the surrounding walls began to crack.

sentences.chinese: 巨大的水流涌进来，把他们推向了一个更深的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Jù dà de shuǐ liú yǒng jìn lái, bǎ tā men tuī xiàng le yī gè gèng shēn de dì fāng.
sentences.english: A huge current of water rushed in, pushing them to a deeper place.

sentences.chinese: 林风在水中看到一个巨大的阴影，比之前的怪物还要大。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zài shuǐ zhōng kàn dào yī gè jù dà de yīn yǐng, bǐ zhī qián de guài wù hái yào dà.
sentences.english: Lin Feng saw a huge shadow in the water, even larger than the previous monster.

sentences.chinese: 那个阴影睁开了眼睛，盯着手中的晶体。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè yīn yǐng zhēng kāi le yǎn jīng, dīng zhe shǒu zhōng de jīng tǐ.
sentences.english: That shadow opened its eyes, staring at the crystal in his hand.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十二章：记忆之海的幻象
chapters.title_english: Chapter 22: Illusions of the Memory Sea

sentences.chinese: 林风感到水流非常快，他的腿在水中拼命地动。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎndào shuǐliú fēicháng kuài, tā de tuǐ zài shuǐzhōng pīnmìng de dòng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt the current was very fast, and his legs were moving desperately in the water.

sentences.chinese: 巨大的阴影睁开了眼睛，那是深海的守护者。
sentences.pinyin: Jùdà de yīnyǐng zhēngkāile yǎnjing, nà shì shēnhǎi de shǒuhùzhě.
sentences.english: The giant shadow opened its eyes; it was the guardian of the deep sea.

sentences.chinese: 突然，周围的水变色了，变成了深绿色。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, zhōuwéi de shuǐ biànsè le, biànchéngle shēnlǜsè.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the surrounding water changed color, turning a deep green.

sentences.chinese: 林风发现自己不再在水下，而是在一个奇怪的房间里。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng fāxiàn zìjǐ bù zài shuǐxià, ér shì zài yīgè qíguài de fángjiān lǐ.
sentences.english: Lin Feng found that he was no longer underwater, but in a strange room.

sentences.chinese: 这个房间像是一个古老的课堂，墙上挂着很多画。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān xiàng shì yīgè gǔlǎo de kètáng, qiángshàng guàzhe hěnduō huà.
sentences.english: This room was like an ancient classroom, with many paintings hanging on the walls.

sentences.chinese: 一个画家正在画一张巨大的地图，地图上标着西方的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè huàjiā zhèngzài huà yī zhāng jùdà de dìtú, dìtú shàng biāozhe Xīfāng de dìfāng.
sentences.english: A painter was drawing a huge map, marking places in the West.

sentences.chinese: 旁边站着一个科学家，他正在研究一些奇怪的药店药方。
sentences.pinyin: Pángbiān zhànzhe yīgè kēxuéjiā, tā zhèngzài yánjiū yīxiē qíguài de yàodiàn yàofāng.
sentences.english: A scientist stood beside him, researching some strange pharmacy prescriptions.

sentences.chinese: 大强在房间的另一边，他正拿着一对筷子在吃东西。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng zài fángjiān de lìng yībiān, tā zhèng názhe yī duì kuàizi zài chī dōngxī.
sentences.english: Da Qiang was on the other side of the room, holding a pair of chopsticks and eating.

sentences.chinese: 他看到林风，大声喊道：“快看！这里像是一个银行，到处是金子！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào Lín Fēng, dàshēng hǎndào: “Kuài kàn! Zhèlǐ xiàng shì yīgè yínháng, dàochù shì jīnzi!”
sentences.english: He saw Lin Feng and shouted, "Look! This place is like a bank, there is gold everywhere!"

sentences.chinese: 但林风发现这些金子其实是黑色的石头。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn Lín Fēng fāxiàn zhèxiē jīnzi qíshí shì hēisè de shítou.
sentences.english: But Lin Feng discovered that this gold was actually black stones.

sentences.chinese: 一个穿着红色衣服的人走过来，他看起来像是一个队长。
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè chuānzhe hóngsè yīfú de rén zǒu guòlái, tā kànqǐlái xiàng shì yīgè duìzhǎng.
sentences.english: A person wearing red clothes walked over; he looked like a captain.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“欢迎来到记忆之海，我是这里的组长。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Huānyíng lái dào jìyì zhī hǎi, wǒ shì zhèlǐ de zǔzhǎng.”
sentences.english: He said, "Welcome to the Sea of Memory, I am the group leader here."

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林风，要离开这里，必须听懂一种特殊的音乐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Lín Fēng, yào líkāi zhèlǐ, bìxū tīngdǒng yī zhǒng tèshū de yīnyuè.
sentences.english: He told Lin Feng that to leave this place, he must understand a special kind of music.

sentences.chinese: 这种音乐像是一场巨大的音乐会，声音在房间里回荡。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yīnyuè xiàng shì yī chǎng jùdà de yīnyuèhuì, shēngyīn zài fángjiān lǐ huídàng.
sentences.english: This music was like a huge concert, with the sound echoing in the room.

sentences.chinese: 林风注意到，音乐的每一个音节都像是一个密码。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhùyì dào, yīnyuè de měi yīgè yīnjié dōu xiàng shì yīgè mìmǎ.
sentences.english: Lin Feng noticed that every syllable of the music was like a password.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，房间开始震动，地板变成了一个巨大的篮球。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, fángjiān kāishǐ zhèndòng, dìbǎn biànchéngle yīgè jùdà de lánqiú.
sentences.english: Just then, the room began to shake, and the floor turned into a giant basketball.

sentences.chinese: 林风失去了平衡，一只鞋掉在了地上。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng shīqùle pínghéng, yī zhī xié diào zàile dìshàng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng lost his balance, and a shoe fell to the ground.

sentences.chinese: 他看到地板上突然出现了一只奇怪的鸡，它在不停地叫。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào dìbǎn shàng tūrán chūxiànle yī zhī qíguài de jī, tā zài bùtíng de jiào.
sentences.english: He saw a strange chicken suddenly appear on the floor, clucking incessantly.

sentences.chinese: 在这个关键的节骨眼上，林风想起了手中的晶体。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège guānjiàn de jiégǔyǎn shàng, Lín Fēng xiǎngqǐle shǒuzhōng de jīngtǐ.
sentences.english: At this critical juncture, Lin Feng remembered the crystal in his hand.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，这一切都是幻象，是为了测试他的勇气。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, zhè yīqiè dōu shì huànxiàng, shì wèile cèshì tā de yǒngqì.
sentences.english: He realized that all of this was an illusion, meant to test his courage.

sentences.chinese: 他大声喊道：“这不是真的！我们要找的是信号机器！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàshēng hǎndào: “Zhè bùshì zhēn de! Wǒmen yào zhǎo de shì xìnhào jīqì!”
sentences.english: He shouted loudly, "This is not real! We are looking for the signal machine!"

sentences.chinese: 随着他的喊声，绿色的光芒爆发，房间开始破碎。
sentences.pinyin: Suízhe tā de hǎnshēng, lǜsè de guāngmáng bàofā, fángjiān kāishǐ pòsuì.
sentences.english: With his shout, a green light erupted, and the room began to shatter.

sentences.chinese: 但当光芒消失时，他发现大强不见了，只剩下一只黑色的鞋留在原地。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn dāng guāngmáng xiāoshī shí, tā fāxiàn Dà Qiáng bùjiànle, zhǐ shèng xià yī zhī hēisè de xié liú zài yuándì.
sentences.english: But when the light disappeared, he found that Da Qiang was gone, with only a black shoe left behind.

sentences.chinese: 林风看着地上的黑鞋，心里非常着急。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe dìshàng de hēi xié, xīnlǐ fēicháng zháojí.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the black shoe on the ground, feeling very anxious.

sentences.chinese: 他突然发现面前出现了一面巨大的白色墙壁。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán fāxiàn miànqián chūxiànle yī miàn jùdà de báisè qiángbì.
sentences.english: He suddenly discovered a huge white wall appearing in front of him.

sentences.chinese: 墙壁上写着一个很长的名单。
sentences.pinyin: Qiángbì shàng xiězhe yīgè hěn cháng de míngdān.
sentences.english: A very long list of names was written on the wall.

sentences.chinese: 林风仔细地查这个名单，想看看大强在不在上面。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zǐxì de zhá zhège míngdān, xiǎng kànkàn Dà Qiáng zài bù zài shàngmiàn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng carefully checked this list, wanting to see if Da Qiang was on it.

sentences.chinese: 他发现这面墙记录了所有进入过这座城市的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn zhè miàn qiáng jìlùle suǒyǒu jìnrùguò zhè zuò chéngshì de rén.
sentences.english: He discovered that this wall recorded everyone who had ever entered this city.

sentences.chinese: 名单上的名字很奇怪，很多是单字。
sentences.pinyin: Míngdān shàng de míngzì hěn qíguài, hěnduō shì dānzì.
sentences.english: The names on the list were very strange; many were single characters.

sentences.chinese: 他看到了全先生的名字，还有向先生的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndàole Quán xiānshēng de míngzì, hái yǒu Xiàng xiānshēng de míngzì.
sentences.english: He saw Mr. Quan's name, and also Mr. Xiang's name.

sentences.chinese: 接着，他看到了封先生和平先生的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Jiēzhe, tā kàndàole Fēng xiānshēng hé Píng xiānshēng de míngzì.
sentences.english: Next, he saw the names of Mr. Feng and Mr. Ping.

sentences.chinese: 林风继续往下看，发现了怕先生和成先生。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jìxù wǎng xià kàn, fāxiànle Pà xiānshēng hé Chéng xiānshēng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng continued to look down and found Mr. Pa and Mr. Cheng.

sentences.chinese: 他想，这些名字的人都去哪里了？
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, zhèxiē míngzì de rén dōu qù nǎlǐ le?
sentences.english: He wondered, where did the people with these names go?

sentences.chinese: 他看到了查先生和段先生，还有米先生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndàole Zhā xiānshēng hé Duàn xiānshēng, hái yǒu Mǐ xiānshēng.
sentences.english: He saw Mr. Zha and Mr. Duan, as well as Mr. Mi.

sentences.chinese: 墙上的字突然变了颜色，变成了红色。
sentences.pinyin: Qiáng shàng de zì tūrán biànle yánsè, biànchéngle hóngsè.
sentences.english: The characters on the wall suddenly changed color, turning red.

sentences.chinese: 红先生的名字在发光，像是在告诉林风什么。
sentences.pinyin: Hóng xiānshēng de míngzì zài fāguāng, xiàng shì zài gàosù Lín Fēng shénme.
sentences.english: Mr. Hong's name was glowing, as if telling Lin Feng something.

sentences.chinese: 随后，组先生和蓝先生的名字也亮了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Suíhòu, Zǔ xiānshēng hé Lán xiānshēng de míngzì yě liàngle qǐlái.
sentences.english: Subsequently, the names of Mr. Zu and Mr. Lan also lit up.

sentences.chinese: 角先生和闻先生的名字在闪烁，像是在跳舞。
sentences.pinyin: Jué xiānshēng hé Wén xiānshēng de míngzì zài shǎnshuò, xiàng shì zài tiàowǔ.
sentences.english: Mr. Jue's and Mr. Wen's names were flickering, as if they were dancing.

sentences.chinese: 林风注意到阴先生和雪先生的名字在一起。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhùyì dào Yīn xiānshēng hé Xuě xiānshēng de míngzì zài yīqǐ.
sentences.english: Lin Feng noticed that Mr. Yin's and Mr. Xue's names were together.

sentences.chinese: 题先生和鱼先生的名字在最下面。
sentences.pinyin: Tí xiānshēng hé Yú xiānshēng de míngzì zài zuì xiàmiàn.
sentences.english: Mr. Ti's and Mr. Yu's names were at the very bottom.

sentences.chinese: 最后，他看到了黄先生的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Zuìhòu, tā kàndàole Huáng xiānshēng de míngzì.
sentences.english: Finally, he saw Mr. Huang's name.

sentences.chinese: 黄先生的名字旁边有一个黄色的圆圈。
sentences.pinyin: Huáng xiānshēng de míngzì pángbiān yǒu yīgè huángsè de yuánquān.
sentences.english: Beside Mr. Huang's name, there was a yellow circle.

sentences.chinese: 这个黄色的小圆圈突然变成了一个按钮。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège huángsè de xiǎo yuánquān tūrán biànchéngle yīgè ànniǔ.
sentences.english: This small yellow circle suddenly turned into a button.

sentences.chinese: 林风勇敢地按下了那个按钮，墙壁突然打开了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yǒnggǎn de ànxiàle nàgè ànniǔ, qiángbì tūrán dǎkāile.
sentences.english: Lin Feng bravely pressed that button, and the wall suddenly opened.

sentences.chinese: 他看到了大强，但大强正被一个巨大的怪物抓着。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndàole Dà Qiáng, dàn Dà Qiáng zhèng bèi yīgè jùdà de guàiwù zhuāzhe.
sentences.english: He saw Da Qiang, but Da Qiang was being held by a huge monster.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十四章：怪物的秘密与记忆之镜
chapters.title_english: Chapter 24: The Monster's Secret and the Mirror of Memory

sentences.chinese: 林风看着面前的怪物，心中充满了愤怒。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn zhe miàn qián de guài wù, xīn zhōng chōng mǎn le fèn nù.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the monster in front of him, his heart filled with anger.

sentences.chinese: 那个怪物很大，它的颜色是深紫色的，样子很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè guài wù hěn dà, tā de yán sè shì shēn zǐ sè de, yàng zi hěn qí guài.
sentences.english: The monster was huge, its color was deep purple, and its appearance was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 大强被怪物抓在手里，脸上的表情很害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng bèi guài wù zhuā zài shǒu lǐ, liǎn shàng de biǎo qíng hěn hài pà.
sentences.english: Da Qiang was grabbed in the monster's hand, the expression on his face was very frightened.

sentences.chinese: 林风大声喊道：“放开他！”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng dà shēng hǎn dào: “Fàng kāi tā!”
sentences.english: Lin Feng shouted loudly, "Let him go!"

sentences.chinese: 怪物转过头，用一只巨大的眼盯着林风。
sentences.pinyin: Guài wù zhuǎn guò tóu, yòng yī zhī jù dà de yǎn dīng zhe Lín Fēng.
sentences.english: The monster turned its head and stared at Lin Feng with one giant eye.

sentences.chinese: 怪物的头发很长，像黑色的海草一样，遮住了它的脸。
sentences.pinyin: Guài wù de tóu fa hěn cháng, xiàng hēi sè de hǎi cǎo yī yàng, zhē zhù le tā de liǎn.
sentences.english: The monster's hair was very long, like black seaweed, covering its face.

sentences.chinese: 林风注意到，怪物的态度并不凶狠，反而看起来很悲伤。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhù yì dào, guài wù de tài du态度 bìng bù xiōng hěn, ér fǎn ér kàn qǐ lái hěn bēi shāng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng noticed that the monster's attitude was not fierce, but instead seemed very sad.

sentences.chinese: 在怪物的对面，有一座巨大的镜子。
sentences.pinyin: Zài guài wù de duì miàn, yǒu yī zuò jù dà de jìng zi.
sentences.english: Opposite the monster, there was a huge mirror.

sentences.chinese: 镜子里显示的是一个海边的场景，那里有蓝色的水和白色的沙子。
sentences.pinyin: Jìng zi lǐ xiǎn shì de shì yī gè hǎi biān de chǎng jǐng, nà lǐ yǒu lán sè de shuǐ hé bái sè de shā zi.
sentences.english: The mirror showed a seaside scene, with blue water and white sand.

sentences.chinese: 林风突然想到，这个怪物可能不是坏人，而是一个失去记忆的人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng tū rán xiǎng dào, zhè gè guài wù kě néng bú shì huài rén, ér shì yī gè shī qù jì yì de rén.
sentences.english: Lin Feng suddenly thought that this monster might not be a bad person, but someone who had lost their memory.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试从不同的角度去看这个问题。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cháng shì cóng bù tóng de jiǎo dù qù kàn zhè gè wèn tí.
sentences.english: He tried to look at this problem from different angles.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得，如果能改变看待怪物的观点，也许能救出大强。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué de, rú guǒ néng gǎi biàn kàn dài guài wù de guān diǎn, yě xǔ néng jiù chū Dà Qiáng.
sentences.english: He felt that if he could change his viewpoint regarding the monster, he might be able to save Da Qiang.

sentences.chinese: 林风走到怪物身边，轻声说：“你记得那个海边吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zǒu dào guài wù shēn biān, qīng shēng shuō: “Nǐ jì de nà gè hǎi biān ma?”
sentences.english: Lin Feng walked to the monster's side and said softly, "Do you remember that seaside?"

sentences.chinese: 怪物停了下来，它看向林风的眼神变了。
sentences.pinyin: Guài wù tíng le xià lái, tā kàn xiàng Lín Fēng de yǎn shén biàn le.
sentences.english: The monster stopped, and the look in its eyes toward Lin Feng changed.

sentences.chinese: 它慢慢地把大强放在地上，让大强靠在墙边。
sentences.pinyin: Tā màn màn de bǎ Dà Qiáng fàng zài dì shàng, ràng Dà Qiáng kào zài qiáng biān.
sentences.english: It slowly placed Da Qiang on the ground, letting Da Qiang lean against the wall.

sentences.chinese: 林风发现，怪物的一个方面像极了他在照片里见过的黄先生。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng fā xiàn, guài wù de yī gè fāng miàn xiàng jí le tā zài zhào piàn lǐ jiàn guò de Huáng xiān sheng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng discovered that one aspect of the monster looked exactly like Mr. Huang, whom he had seen in photos.

sentences.chinese: 黄先生以前是家里的家长，是一个很严肃的人。
sentences.pinyin: Huáng xiān sheng yǐ qián shì jiā lǐ de jiā zhǎng, shì yī gè hěn yán sù de rén.
sentences.english: Mr. Huang used to be the head of the household, a very serious man.

sentences.chinese: 林风记得黄先生总是挺起胸膛走路，非常有精神。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jì de Huáng xiān sheng zǒng shì tǐng qǐ xiōng táng zǒu lù, fēi cháng yǒu jīng shén.
sentences.english: Lin Feng remembered that Mr. Huang always walked with his chest held straight, full of energy.

sentences.chinese: 这时候，大强走过来，表露出担心的样子。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí hòu, Dà Qiáng zǒu guò lái, biǎo lù chū dān xīn de yàng zi.
sentences.english: At this moment, Da Qiang walked over, showing a worried appearance.

sentences.chinese: 大强说：“林风，你对这个怪物的看法是对的，它在哭。”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng shuō: “Lín Fēng, nǐ duì zhè gè guài wù de kàn fǎ shì duì de, tā zài kū.”
sentences.english: Da Qiang said, "Lin Feng, your view of this monster is correct; it is crying."

sentences.chinese: 林风看着怪物，心中觉得很奇怪，因为怪物的心情似乎在波动。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn zhe guài wù, xīn zhōng jué de hěn qí guài, yīn wèi guài wù de xīn qíng sì hū zài bō dòng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the monster and felt strange in his heart, because the monster's mood seemed to be fluctuating.

sentences.chinese: 他想起黄先生的爱人曾经说过，黄先生最喜欢在海边思考问题。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ Huáng xiān sheng de ài ren céng jīng shuō guò, Huáng xiān sheng zuì xǐ huan zài hǎi biān sī kǎo wèn tí.
sentences.english: He remembered that Mr. Huang's spouse had once said that Mr. Huang loved to think about problems by the sea.

sentences.chinese: 林风意识到，这个地方的每一位守护者其实都是记忆的碎片。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yì shí dào, zhè gè dì fāng de měi yī wèi shǒu hù zhě qí shí dōu shì jì yì de suì piàn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng realized that every guardian in this place was actually a fragment of memory.

sentences.chinese: 他碰到了一个发光的按钮，就在镜子的边上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pèng dào le yī gè fā guāng de àn niǔ, jiù zài jìng zi de biān shàng.
sentences.english: He came across a glowing button, right on the edge of the mirror.

sentences.chinese: 他没想到在这里会碰见一个能唤醒记忆的机关。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méi xiǎng dào zài zhè lǐ huì pèng jiàn yī gè néng huàn xǐng jì yì de jī guān.
sentences.english: He didn't expect to run into a mechanism that could awaken memories here.

sentences.chinese: 他看着镜子的表面，发现自己的脸在镜子里变了颜色。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe jìng zi de biǎo miàn, fā xiàn zì jǐ de liǎn zài jìng zi lǐ biàn le yán sè.
sentences.english: He looked at the surface of the mirror and found that his face changed color in the reflection.

sentences.chinese: 他必须面对这个真相，才能打开最后的大门。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì xū miàn duì zhè gè zhēn xiàng, cái néng dǎ kāi zuì hòu de dà mén.
sentences.english: He had to face this truth to open the final gate.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，镜子突然裂开了，一个更可怕的声音在他们面前响起。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, jìng zi tū rán liè kāi le, yī gè gèng kě pà de shēng yīn zài tā men miàn qián xiǎng qǐ.
