sentences.english: But just then, the mirror suddenly cracked, and an even more terrifying voice sounded in front of them.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十五章：记忆的碎片与幻象之城
chapters.title_english: Chapter 25: Fragments of Memory and the City of Illusions

sentences.chinese: 那个可怕的声音在房间里响起，镜子碎成了很多片。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge kěpà de shēngyīn zài fángjiān lǐ xiǎngqǐ, jìngzi suì chéngle hěnduō piàn.
sentences.english: That terrifying voice rang out in the room, and the mirror shattered into many pieces.

sentences.chinese: 林风看到碎片里出现了一个奇怪的城市，那里有很多行人走在路上。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàndào suìpiàn lǐ chūxiànle yīgè qíguài de chéngshì, nàlǐ yǒu hěnduō xíngrén zǒu zài lùshàng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng saw a strange city appear in the fragments, with many pedestrians walking on the roads.

sentences.chinese: 他发现自己进入了一个幻象，这个幻象是他过去生活的记忆。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn zìjǐ jìnrùle yīgè huànxiàng, zhège huànxiàng shì tā guòqù shēnghuó de jìyì.
sentences.english: He discovered he had entered an illusion, and this illusion was a memory of his past life.

sentences.chinese: 在记忆里，他曾经是一个留学生，在国外学习中文。
sentences.pinyin: Zài jìyì lǐ, tā céngjīng shì yīgè liúxuéshēng, zài guówài xuéxí Zhōngwén.
sentences.english: In his memory, he was once an international student studying Chinese abroad.

sentences.chinese: 他记得那时候他经常骑车去学校，那是他最喜欢的运动。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde nà shíhòu tā jīngcháng qíchē qù xuéxiào, nà shì tā zuì xǐhuān de yùndòng.
sentences.english: He remembered that back then he often rode a bike to school; that was his favorite sport.

sentences.chinese: 他还会骑一匹白色的马在草原上奔跑，感觉非常自由。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hái huì qí yī pǐ báisè de mǎ zài cǎoyuán shàng bēnpǎo, gǎnjué fēicháng zìyóu.
sentences.english: He would also ride a white horse galloping across the grasslands, feeling very free.

sentences.chinese: 那时候，他经常和朋友一起去爬山，探索那些没有人的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shíhòu, tā jīngcháng hé péngyǒu yīqǐ qù páshān, tànsuǒ nàxiē méiyǒu rén de dìfāng.
sentences.english: At that time, he often went mountain climbing with friends, exploring places where no one lived.

sentences.chinese: 有一天，他决定出门去远方旅行，想要看看这个世界。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu yītiān, tā juédìng chūmén qù yuǎnfāng lǚxíng, xiǎng yào kàn kàn zhège shìjiè.
sentences.english: One day, he decided to go out and travel to far-off lands, wanting to see the world.

sentences.chinese: 他像一个真正的旅客，背着包走过一条又一条陌生的街道。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàng yīgè zhēnzhèng de lǚkè, bēizhe bāo zǒuguò yītiáo yòu yītiáo mòshēng de jiēdào.
sentences.english: Like a true traveler, he walked past street after street of unfamiliar roads with a backpack.

sentences.chinese: 他参观了很多古老的博物馆，学习不同国家的文化。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cānguānle hěnduō gǔlǎo de bówùguǎn, xuéxí bùtóng guójiā de wénhuà.
sentences.english: He visited many ancient museums, learning about the cultures of different countries.

sentences.chinese: 他甚至在当地打工，为了赚更多钱去旅游。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shènzhì zài dāngdì dǎgōng, wèile zhuàn gèng duō qián qù lǚyóu.
sentences.english: He even worked a temporary job locally to earn more money for tourism.

sentences.chinese: 但这次旅行并不顺利，他生了一场大病，不得不住院治疗。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zhè cì lǚxíng bìng bù shùnlì, tā shēngle yī chǎng dà bìng, bùdébù zhùyuàn zhìliáo.
sentences.english: But this trip was not smooth; he fell seriously ill and had to be hospitalized for treatment.

sentences.chinese: 在医院里，他看着窗外，想念自己的家乡。
sentences.pinyin: Zài yīyuàn lǐ, tā kànzhe chuāngwài, xiǎngniàn zìjǐ de jiāxiāng.
sentences.english: In the hospital, he looked out the window, missing his hometown.

sentences.chinese: 直到有一天，医生告诉他可以出院了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhídào yǒu yītiān, yīshēng gàosù tā kěyǐ chūyuànle.
sentences.english: Until one day, the doctor told him he could be discharged from the hospital.

sentences.chinese: 他很高兴地离开医院，准备立刻回国。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hěn gāoxìng de líkāi yīyuàn, zhǔnbèi lìkè huíguó.
sentences.english: He happily left the hospital and prepared to return to his home country immediately.

sentences.chinese: 他记得在机场，很多游客在等飞机，每个人都想快点回家休假。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde zài jīchǎng, hěnduō yóukè zài děng fēijī, měi gèrén dōu xiǎng kuài diǎn huí jiā xiūjià.
sentences.english: He remembered at the airport, many tourists were waiting for planes, and everyone wanted to go home for vacation as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 但突然，幻象变了，那个可怕的声音再次响起：“这些记忆没有用！”
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tūrán, huànxiàng biànle, nàge kěpà de shēngyīn zàicì xiǎngqǐ: “Zhèxiē jìyì méiyǒu yòng!”
sentences.english: But suddenly, the illusion changed, and that terrifying voice rang out again: "These memories are useless!"

sentences.chinese: 林风意识到，这个幻象是通过某种特殊的交通方式将他的记忆连接在一起的。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yìshí dào, zhège huànxiàng shì tōngguò mǒu zhǒng tèshū de jiāotōng fāngshì jiāng tā de jìyì liánjiē zài yīqǐ de.
sentences.english: Lin Feng realized that this illusion connected his memories through some kind of special transportation method.

sentences.chinese: 他必须迅速行动，否则他将被永远留在这些碎片里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū xùnsù xíngdòng, fǒuzé tā jiāng bèi yǒngyuǎn liú zài zhèxiē suìpiàn lǐ.
sentences.english: He had to act quickly, otherwise, he would be trapped in these fragments forever.

sentences.chinese: 他大声对那个声音喊道：“走开！我不需要这些旧记忆！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàshēng duì nàge shēngyīn hǎn dào: “Zǒukāi! Wǒ bù xūyào zhèxiē jiù jìyì!”
sentences.english: He shouted loudly at the voice: "Go away! I don't need these old memories!"

sentences.chinese: 他开始在碎片之间快速运动，寻找离开这里的出口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kāishǐ zài suìpiàn zhī jiān kuàisù yùndòng, xúnzhǎo líkāi zhèlǐ de chūkǒu.
sentences.english: He began to move rapidly between the fragments, searching for the exit to leave this place.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一个发光的门，那是他这次冒险出发的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào yīgè fāguāng de mén, nà shì tā zhè cì màoxiǎn chūfā de dìfāng.
sentences.english: He saw a glowing door; it was the place where he had set off on this adventure.

sentences.chinese: 他必须出国，离开这个充满幻象的维度，回到大强身边。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū chūguó, líkāi zhège chōngmǎn huànxiàng de wéidù, huí dào Dà Qiáng shēnbiān.
sentences.english: He had to go abroad, leave this dimension full of illusions, and return to Da Qiang's side.

sentences.chinese: 他看到大强在远处被怪物抓着，身体无法活动。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào Dà Qiáng zài yuǎnchù bèi guàiwù zhuāzhe, shēntǐ wúfǎ huódòng.
sentences.english: He saw Da Qiang being held by the monster in the distance, unable to move his body.

sentences.chinese: 林风猛地跳向那个门，试图打破这个巨大的记忆陷阱。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng měng de tiào xiàng nàge mén, shìtú dǎpò zhège jùdà de jìyì xiànjǐng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng leaped violently toward the door, attempting to break this massive memory trap.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十六章：记忆的碎片与最后的希望
chapters.title_english: Chapter 26: Fragments of Memory and the Final Hope

sentences.chinese: 林风猛地跳向那个发光的门，感觉整个世界都在旋转。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng měng de tiào xiàng nà gè fā guāng de mén, gǎn jué zhěng gè shì jiè dōu zài xuán zhuǎn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng jumped violently toward the glowing door, feeling the entire world spinning.

sentences.chinese: 他终于打破了记忆陷阱，掉落在了一个奇怪的房间里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhōng yú dǎ pò le jì yì xiàn jǐng, diào luò zài le yī gè qí guài de fáng jiān lǐ.
sentences.english: He finally broke the memory trap and fell into a strange room.

sentences.chinese: 这里看起来像是一个古老的单位，墙上贴着很多旧的晚报。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ kàn qǐ lái xiàng shì yī gè gǔ lǎo de dān wèi, qiáng shàng tiē zhe hěn duō jiù de wǎn bào.
sentences.english: It looked like an old work unit, with many old evening newspapers pasted on the walls.

sentences.chinese: 林风发现，这里的空气有一种奇怪的味道，像是一本旧字典的味道。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng fā xiàn, zhè lǐ de kōng qì yǒu yī zhǒng qí guài de wèi dao, xiàng shì yī běn jiù zì diǎn de wèi dao.
sentences.english: Lin Feng noticed that the air here had a strange smell, like the smell of an old dictionary.

sentences.chinese: 他看到大强被锁在房间的第三层，一个巨大的怪物在盯着他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào Dà Qiáng bèi suǒ zài fáng jiān de dì sān céng, yī gè jù dà de guài wù zài dīng zhe tā.
sentences.english: He saw Da Qiang locked on the third floor of the room, with a giant monster staring at him.

sentences.chinese: 那个怪物说话的声音很奇怪，它在云：
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè guài wù shuō huà de shēng yīn hěn qí guài, tā zài yún:
sentences.english: The monster's voice was very strange; it said:

sentences.chinese: “如果你想救他，必须完成这一场考验。”
sentences.pinyin: “Rú guǒ nǐ xiǎng jiù tā, bì xū wán chéng zhè yī cháng kǎo yàn.”
sentences.english: "If you want to save him, you must complete this trial."

sentences.chinese: 林风以为这只是另一个幻象，但大强的恐惧是真的。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yǐ wéi zhè zhǐ shì lìng yī gè huàn xiàng, dàn Dà Qiáng de kǒng jù shì zhēn de.
sentences.english: Lin Feng thought this was just another illusion, but Da Qiang's fear was real.

sentences.chinese: 大强大声喊道：“快点儿！林风，快救我！”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng dà shēng hǎn dào: “Kuài diǎn r! Lín Fēng, kuài jiù wǒ!”
sentences.english: Da Qiang shouted loudly, "Hurry up! Lin Feng, save me quickly!"

sentences.chinese: 林风看着周围，发现桌子上有一份奇怪的报告。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn zhe zhōu wéi, fā xiàn zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī fèn qí guài de bào gào.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked around and found a strange report on the table.

sentences.chinese: 报告的名称是《关于记忆之城的秘密研究》。
sentences.pinyin: Bào gào de míng chēng shì 《Guān yú jì yì zhī chéng de mì mì yán jiū》.
sentences.english: The name of the report was "Secret Research on the City of Memory."

sentences.chinese: 报告里提到，这里的怪物受到了某种力量的影响，身体发生了变异。
sentences.pinyin: Bào gào lǐ tí dào, zhè lǐ de guài wù shòu dào le mǒu zhǒng lì liàng de yǐng xiǎng, shēn tǐ fā shēng le biàn yì.
sentences.english: The report mentioned that the monsters here had been affected by a certain power and their bodies had mutated.

sentences.chinese: 它不再是一个普通的人，而变成了一个没有名字的名怪物。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zài shì yī gè pǔ tōng de rén, ér biàn chéng le yī gè méi yǒu míng zì de míng guài wù.
sentences.english: It was no longer an ordinary person but had become a nameless monster.

sentences.chinese: 林风意识到，他必须找到一个办法来打败它。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yì shí dào, tā bì xū zhǎo dào yī gè bàn fǎ lái dǎ bài tā.
sentences.english: Lin Feng realized he had to find a way to defeat it.

sentences.chinese: 他想起自己曾经在学校学习过一些中医的知识，知道如何寻找身体的弱点。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ zì jǐ céng jīng zài xué xiào xué xí guò yī xiē zhōng yī de zhī shi, zhī dào rú hé xún zhǎo shēn tǐ de ruò diǎn.
sentences.english: He remembered that he had studied some traditional Chinese medicine at school and knew how to find weaknesses in the body.

sentences.chinese: 虽然他现在只是一个高中年级的学生，但他非常有信心。
sentences.pinyin: Suī rán tā xiàn zài zhǐ shì yī gè gāo zhōng nián jí de xué shēng, dàn tā fēi cháng yǒu xìn xīn.
sentences.english: Although he was currently just a high school grade student, he was very confident.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉自己：“只要努力，我一定能救出大强。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù zì jǐ: “Zhǐ yào nǔ lì, wǒ yī dìng néng jiù chū Dà Qiáng.”
sentences.english: He told himself, "As long as I work hard, I can definitely save Da Qiang."

sentences.chinese: 林风看着怪物，产生了一个大胆的想法。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn zhe guài wù, chǎn shēng le yī gè dà dǎn de xiǎng fǎ.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the monster and came up with a bold idea.

sentences.chinese: 他发现怪物的脚下有一个小圆圈，那是它的能量单位。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn guài wù de jiǎo xià yǒu yī gè xiǎo yuán quān, nà shì tā de néng liàng dān wèi.
sentences.english: He discovered a small circle under the monster's foot, which was its energy unit.

sentences.chinese: 他大声用普通话喊道：“嘿！你看这里！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dà shēng yòng pǔ tōng huà hǎn dào: “Hēi! Nǐ kàn zhè lǐ!”
sentences.english: He shouted loudly in Mandarin, "Hey! Look here!"

sentences.chinese: 怪物被吸引了，林风迅速地跑过去，用所有的力气撞向那个圆圈。
sentences.pinyin: Guài wù bèi xī yǐn le, Lín Fēng xùn sù de pǎo guò qù, yòng suǒ yǒu de lì qì zhuàng xiàng nà gè yuán quān.
sentences.english: The monster was attracted; Lin Feng quickly ran over and crashed into the circle with all his strength.

sentences.chinese: 这件简单的事情竟然起作用了，怪物发出一声惨叫，身体开始变小。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn jiǎn dān de shì qing jìng rán qǐ zuò yòng le, guài wù fā chū yī shēng cǎn jiào, shēn tǐ kāi shǐ biàn xiǎo.
sentences.english: This simple matter actually worked; the monster let out a miserable scream and its body began to shrink.

sentences.chinese: 林风感觉自己像是一个真正的才，终于找到了解决问题的关键。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎn jué zì jǐ xiàng shì yī gè zhēn zhèng de cái, zhōng yú zhǎo dào le jiě jué wèn tí de guān jiàn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt like he was a real talent, finally finding the key to solving the problem.

sentences.chinese: 他赶紧跑向大强，帮他打开了锁链。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎn kuài pǎo xiàng Dà Qiáng, bāng tā dǎ kāi le suǒ liàn.
sentences.english: He hurried toward Da Qiang and helped him unlock the chains.

sentences.chinese: 大强笑着说：“咱们终于在一起了！这真是件好事！”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng xiào zhe shuō: “Zán men zhōng yú zài yī qǐ le! Zhè zhēn shì jiàn hǎo shì!”
sentences.english: Da Qiang smiled and said, "We are finally together! This is truly a good thing!"

sentences.chinese: 林风开玩笑地说：“你刚才的样子，像是在等外卖一样着急。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kāi wán xiào de shuō: “Nǐ gāng cái de yàng zi, xiàng shì zài děng wài mài yī yàng zhāo jí.”
sentences.english: Lin Feng joked, "The way you looked just now was as anxious as if you were waiting for takeout."

sentences.chinese: 大强不好意思地笑了，两人赶紧离开这个危险的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng bù hǎo yì si de xiào le, liǎng rén gǎn kuài lí kāi zhè gè wēi xiǎn de dì fang.
sentences.english: Da Qiang smiled shyly, and the two of them quickly left this dangerous place.

sentences.chinese: 在离开之前，林风看到墙上的日历，上面写着开学的时间。
sentences.pinyin: Zài lí kāi zhī qián, Lín Fēng kàn dào qiáng shàng de rì lì, shàng miàn xiě zhe kāi xué de shí jiān.
sentences.english: Before leaving, Lin Feng saw the calendar on the wall, which had the date for the start of the school term.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，如果不能快点儿离开，他将错过回家的机会。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, rú guǒ bù néng kuài diǎn r lí kāi, tā jiāng cuò guò huí jiā de jī huì.
sentences.english: He realized that if he couldn't leave quickly, he would miss the chance to go home.

sentences.chinese: 他们跑向出口，但出口的门突然变了颜色，变得更红了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men pǎo xiàng chū kǒu, dàn chū kǒu de mén tū rán biàn le yán sè, biàn de gèng hóng le.
sentences.english: They ran toward the exit, but the exit door suddenly changed color, becoming even redder.

sentences.chinese: 门后传来了更巨大的吼叫声，一个更大的阴影出现了。
sentences.pinyin: Mén hòu chuán lái le gèng jù dà de hǒu jiào shēng, yī gè gèng dà de yīn yǐng chū xiàn le.
sentences.english: A louder roar came from behind the door, and an even larger shadow appeared.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十七章：最后的迷宫与记忆之门
chapters.title_english: Chapter 27: The Final Labyrinth and the Gate of Memory

sentences.chinese: 巨大的阴影挡在门前，它的特点是身体像黑色的烟一样。
sentences.pinyin: Jù dà de yīn yǐng dǎng zài mén qián, tā de tè diǎn shì shēn tǐ xiàng hēi sè de yān yī yàng.
sentences.english: A huge shadow stood before the door, its characteristic was that its body was like black smoke.

sentences.chinese: 林风意识到，离开这里的条件是必须解开墙上的谜题。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yì shí dào, lí kāi zhè lǐ de tiáo jiàn shì bì xū jiě kāi qiáng shàng de mí tí.
sentences.english: Lin Feng realized that the condition for leaving this place was to solve the puzzle on the wall.

sentences.chinese: 墙上写着一篇很长的文章，里面有很多生词。
sentences.pinyin: Qiáng shàng xiě zhe yī piān hěn cháng de wén zhāng, lǐ miàn yǒu hěn duō shēng cí.
sentences.english: There was a long piece of writing on the wall, and it contained many new words.

sentences.chinese: 大强看着那些词语，觉得非常头疼。
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng kàn zhe nà xiē cí yǔ, jué de fēi cháng tóu téng.
sentences.english: Da Qiang looked at those terms and felt a huge headache.

sentences.chinese: 林风拿出一个笔记本，开始快速记录这些奇怪的文字。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng ná chū yī gè bǐ jì běn, kāi shǐ kuài sù jì lù zhè xiē qí guài de wén zì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng took out a notebook and began to quickly record these strange characters.

sentences.chinese: 他经常在高中学习的时候，用这种方法记笔记。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīng cháng zài gāo zhōng xué xí de shí hòu, yòng zhè zhǒng fāng fǎ jì bǐ jì.
sentences.english: He often used this method to take notes when studying in senior high school.

sentences.chinese: 林风发现，这些文字的读音和他们平时听到的完全不同。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng fā xiàn, zhè xiē wén zì de dú yīn hé tā men píng shí tīng dào de wán quán bù tóng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng discovered that the pronunciation of these characters was completely different from what they usually heard.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试用随身携带的词典去查找，但这里没有网络，词典没有用。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cháng shì yòng suí shēn xié dài de cí diǎn qù chá zhǎo, dàn zhè lǐ méi yǒu wǎng luò, cí diǎn méi yǒu yòng.
sentences.english: He tried to use the dictionary he carried with him to search, but there was no network here, so the dictionary was useless.

sentences.chinese: “我的中文水平不够高，看不懂这些！”大强大喊道。
sentences.pinyin: “Wǒ de Zhōng wén shuǐ píng bù gòu gāo, kàn bù dǒng zhè xiē!” Dà Qiáng dà hǎn dào.
sentences.english: "My Chinese level is not high enough, I can't understand these!" Da Qiang shouted.

sentences.chinese: 这时，林风发现阴影的脚下有一台古老的计算机。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, Lín Fēng fā xiàn yīn yǐng de jiǎo xià yǒu yī tái gǔ lǎo de jì suàn jī.
sentences.english: At this moment, Lin Feng noticed an ancient computer beneath the shadow's feet.

sentences.chinese: 这台计算机看起来像是一个科幻电影里的东西，非常特别。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tái jì suàn jī kàn qǐ lái xiàng shì yī gè kē huàn diàn yǐng lǐ de dōng xī, fēi cháng tè bié.
sentences.english: This computer looked like something from a science fiction movie, very special.

sentences.chinese: 林风尝试操作它，发现这像是一个巨大的考试系统，他现在就像一个考生。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng cháng shì cāo zuò tā, fā xiàn zhè xiàng shì yī gè jù dà de kǎo shì xì tǒng, tā xiàn zài jiù xiàng yī gè kǎo shēng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng tried to operate it and found that it was like a huge exam system; he was now like an exam candidate.

sentences.chinese: 屏幕上出现了一个人的照片，那是这座记忆之城的院长。
sentences.pinyin: Píng mù shàng chū xiàn le yī gè rén de zhào piàn, nà shì zhè zuò jì yì zhī chéng de yuàn zhǎng.
sentences.english: A photo of a person appeared on the screen; it was the president of this Memory City.

sentences.chinese: 院长在照片里看起来已经进入了老年，眼神很温柔。
sentences.pinyin: Yuàn zhǎng zài zhào piàn lǐ kàn qǐ lái yǐ jīng jìn rù le lǎo nián, yǎn shén hěn wēn róu.
sentences.english: The president looked as if he had entered old age in the photo, with very gentle eyes.

sentences.chinese: 他曾是一位著名的西医，研究过人体内部的脏器和健康。
sentences.pinyin: Tā céng shì yī wèi zhù míng de xī yī, yán jiū guò rén tǐ nèi bù de zàng qì hé jiàn kāng.
sentences.english: He had been a famous Western doctor who studied the internal organs and health of the human body.

sentences.chinese: 他曾在笔记中写到，真正的力量不在于身体，而在于记忆。
sentences.pinyin: Tā céng zài bǐ jì zhōng xiě dào, zhēn zhèng de lì liàng bù zài yú shēn tǐ, ér zài yú jì yì.
sentences.english: He had written in his notes that true strength lies not in the body, but in memory.

sentences.chinese: 林风记得，院长曾经说过，现在流行用机器记录记忆，但那是错误的。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jì dé, yuàn zhǎng céng jīng shuō guò, xiàn zài liú xíng yòng jī qì jì lù jì yì, dàn nà shì cuò wù de.
sentences.english: Lin Feng remembered that the president had once said that it is popular to use machines to record memories now, but that is wrong.

sentences.chinese: 为了治疗病人，院长经常给他们开药片，但药片不能治愈灵魂。
sentences.pinyin: Wèi le zhì liáo bìng rén, yuàn zhǎng jīng cháng gěi tā men kāi yào piàn, dàn yào piàn bù néng zhì yù líng hún.
sentences.english: To treat patients, the president often prescribed pills, but pills cannot heal the soul.

sentences.chinese: 林风突然想起，他曾经在超市见过一个像院长一样的老朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng tū rán xiǎng qǐ, tā céng jīng zài chāo shì jiàn guò yī gè xiàng yuàn zhǎng yī yàng de lǎo péng you.
sentences.english: Lin Feng suddenly remembered that he had once seen an old friend in the supermarket who was just like the president.

sentences.chinese: 那个老朋友告诉他，要重点关注记忆中的细节。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè lǎo péng you gào sù tā, yào zhòng diǎn guān zhù jì yì zhōng de xì jié.
sentences.english: That old friend told him to focus on the details in the memory.

sentences.chinese: 林风赶紧拿起相机，拍下了计算机屏幕上的所有线索。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎn jǐn ná qǐ xiàng jī, pāi xià le jì suàn jī píng mù shàng de suǒ yǒu xiàn suǒ.
sentences.english: Lin Feng quickly picked up his camera and took photos of all the clues on the computer screen.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，这个谜题的答案就在他拍的照片里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, zhè gè mí tí de dá àn jiù zài tā pāi de zhào piàn lǐ.
sentences.english: He realized that the answer to this puzzle was in the photos he took.

sentences.chinese: 他快速地分析，终于找到了打开大门的正确代码。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kuài sù de fēn xī, zhōng yú zhǎo dào le dǎ kāi dà mén de zhèng què dài mǎ.
sentences.english: He analyzed them quickly and finally found the correct code to open the big door.

sentences.chinese: 随着一声巨响，红色的门慢慢打开了，外面出现了光芒。
sentences.pinyin: Suí zhe yī shēng jù xiǎng, hóng sè de mén màn màn dǎ kāi le, wài miàn chū xiàn le guāng máng.
sentences.english: With a loud bang, the red door slowly opened, and light appeared outside.

sentences.chinese: 但就在他们准备跑出去时，阴影突然发出了巨大的吼叫。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài tā men zhǔn bèi pǎo chū qù shí, yīn yǐng tū rán fā chū le jù dà de hǒu jiào.
sentences.english: But just as they were preparing to run out, the shadow suddenly let out a huge roar.

sentences.chinese: 它不再是烟雾，而变成了一个巨大的怪物，挡住了唯一的路。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zài shì yān wù, ér biàn chéng le yī gè jù dà de guài wù, dǎng zhù le wéi yī de lù.
sentences.english: It was no longer mist, but had turned into a giant monster, blocking the only path.

sentences.chinese: 林风和大强对视了一眼，他们知道，最后的战斗开始了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hé Dà Qiáng duì shì le yī yǎn, tā men zhī dào, zuì hòu de zhàn dǒu kāi shǐ le.
sentences.english: Lin Feng and Da Qiang looked at each other; they knew the final battle had begun.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十八章：最后的曙光

sentences.chinese: 巨大的怪物发出了黑色的光芒，周围变得非常阴暗。
sentences.pinyin: Jù dà de guài wù fā chū le hēi sè de guāng máng, zhōu wéi biàn de fēi cháng yīn àn.
sentences.english: The giant monster emitted a black light, and the surroundings became very dark.

sentences.chinese: 林风想起他平时在学校读过的冒险故事，告诉自己不能害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎng qǐ tā píng shí zài xué xiào dú guò de mào xiǎn gù shì, gào sù zì jǐ bù néng hài pà.
sentences.english: Lin Feng remembered the adventure stories he ordinarily read at school and told himself not to be afraid.

sentences.chinese: 大强大声喊道：“林风，快看那个怪物的眼睛！”
sentences.pinyin: Dà Qiáng dà shēng hǎn dào: “Lín Fēng, kuài kàn nà gè guài wù de yǎn jīng!”
sentences.english: Da Qiang shouted loudly, "Lin Feng, look at that monster's eyes!"

sentences.chinese: 怪物的眼睛是绿色的，而且在不停地闪烁。
sentences.pinyin: Guài wù de yǎn jīng shì lǜ sè de, ér qiě zài bù tíng de shǎn shuò.
sentences.english: The monster's eyes were green and flashing constantly.

sentences.chinese: 林风发现，这个怪物的身体其实很轻，像烟一样。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng fā xiàn, zhè gè guài wù de shēn tǐ qí shí hěn qīng, xiàng yān yī yàng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng discovered that the monster's body was actually very light, like smoke.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，只要光线足够亮，怪物就会消失。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, zhǐ yào guāng xiàn zú gòu liàng, guài wù jiù huì xiāo shī.
sentences.english: He realized that as long as the light was bright enough, the monster would disappear.

sentences.chinese: 他想起了很多日子以来，他们一起克服的困难。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ le hěn duō rì zi yǐ lái, tā men yī qǐ kè fú de kùn nan.
sentences.english: He thought about the difficulties they had overcome together over many days.

sentences.chinese: 他突然看到大门外，东方的天空开始变色。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tū rán kàn dào dà mén wài, Dōng fāng de tiān kōng kāi shǐ biàn sè.
sentences.english: Suddenly, he saw the sky in the East beginning to change color outside the gate.

sentences.chinese: 现在是早晨，太阳正在慢慢升起。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài shì zǎo chén, tài yáng zhèng zài màn màn shēng qǐ.
sentences.english: It was early morning, and the sun was slowly rising.

sentences.chinese: 天上的光芒穿过大门，照在了怪物的身上。
sentences.pinyin: Tiān shàng de guāng máng chuān guò dà mén, zhào zài le guài wù de shēn shang.
sentences.english: The light from the heavens passed through the gate and shone on the monster.

sentences.chinese: 怪物发出了痛苦的叫声，身体开始变得透明。
sentences.pinyin: Guài wù fā chū le tòng kǔ de jiào shēng, shēn tǐ kāi shǐ biàn de tòu míng.
sentences.english: The monster let out a cry of pain, and its body began to become transparent.

sentences.chinese: 林风和大强用力地冲向出口，越跑越快。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hé Dà Qiáng yòng lì de chōng xiàng chū kǒu, yuè pǎo yuè kuài.
sentences.english: Lin Feng and Da Qiang rushed toward the exit with all their might, running faster and faster.

sentences.chinese: 他们终于跑出了迷宫，来到了一个安静的山顶上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zhōng yú pǎo chū le mí gōng, lái dào le yī gè ān jìng de shān dǐng shàng.
sentences.english: They finally ran out of the maze and arrived at a quiet mountain top.

sentences.chinese: 这里的空气很凉，让他们感觉非常舒服。

sentences.chinese: 这时，时钟响了，时间已经很晚了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, shízhōng xiǎng le, shíjiān yǐjīng hěn wǎn le.
sentences.english: At this moment, the clock sounds; it is already very late.

sentences.chinese: 林明走出房子，对自己说了一声：“晚安”。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng zǒu chū fángzi, duì zìjǐ shuō le yī shēng: “Wǎn'ān”.
sentences.english: Lin Ming walks out of the house and says to himself, "Good night".

sentences.chinese: 但他不知道，这把钥匙将带他进入一个巨大的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tā bù zhīdào, zhè bǎ yàoshi jiāng dài tā jìnrù yīgè jùdà de mìmì.
sentences.english: But he does not know that this key will lead him into a huge secret.

sentences.chinese: 第二天早上，林明觉得身体很不舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Dì èr tiān zǎoshang, Lín Míng juéde shēntǐ hěn bù shūfu.
sentences.english: The next morning, Lin Ming felt very uncomfortable.

sentences.chinese: 他想，昨晚的事情太奇怪了，他永远不会忘记那把钥匙。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, zuó wǎn de shìqing tài qíguài le, tā yǒngyuǎn bú huì wàngjì nà bǎ yàoshi.
sentences.english: He thought the events of last night were too strange; he would never forget that key.

sentences.chinese: 他决定直接去问他的邻居，平先生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juédìng zhíjiē qù wèn tā de línjū, Píng xiānsheng.
sentences.english: He decided to go directly to ask his neighbor, Mr. Ping.

sentences.chinese: 平先生是一个热情的人，他经常在门口和顾客说话。
sentences.pinyin: Píng xiānsheng shì yí gè rèqíng de rén, tā jīngcháng zài ménkǒu hé gùkè shuōhuà.
sentences.english: Mr. Ping is a cordial person who frequently talks to customers at the door.

sentences.chinese: 平先生开了一家漂亮的小店，那里有很多相同的东西。
sentences.pinyin: Píng xiānsheng kāi le yì jiā piàoliang de xiǎo diàn, nàlǐ yǒu hěnduō xiāngtóng de dōngxi.
sentences.english: Mr. Ping runs a beautiful little shop, where there are many identical things.

sentences.chinese: 林明走到店门口，看到平先生正在停车。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng zǒu dào diàn ménkǒu, kàndào Píng xiānsheng zhèngzài tíngchē.
sentences.english: Lin Ming walked to the shop entrance and saw Mr. Ping parking his car.

sentences.chinese: “平先生，您好！”林明大声说。
sentences.pinyin: “Píng xiānsheng, nín hǎo!” Lín Míng dàshēng shuō.
sentences.english: "Hello, Mr. Ping!" Lin Ming said loudly.

sentences.chinese: 平先生笑着说：“林明，你来得正好，快进来休息。”
sentences.pinyin: Píng xiānsheng xiàozhe shuō: “Lín Míng, nǐ lái de zhènghǎo, kuài jìnlái xiūxi.”
sentences.english: Mr. Ping said with a smile, "Lin Ming, you've come at just the right time, come in and rest."

sentences.chinese: 林明走进店里，看到一个红色的盒子在桌子上。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng zǒu jìn diàn lǐ, kàndào yí gè hóngsè de hézi zài zhuōzi shàng.
sentences.english: Lin Ming entered the shop and saw a red box on the table.

sentences.chinese: 虽然这个盒子很轻，可是它看起来很有秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán zhège hézi hěn qīng, kěshì tā kàn qǐlái hěn yǒu mìmì.
sentences.english: Although this box was light, it seemed to hold many secrets.

sentences.chinese: 林明问平先生关于那把钥匙的事。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng wèn Píng xiānsheng guānyú nà bǎ yàoshi de shì.
sentences.english: Lin Ming asked Mr. Ping about the key.

sentences.chinese: 平先生说得非常流利，但是林明听不清楚他说什么。
sentences.pinyin: Píng xiānsheng shuō de fēicháng liúlì, dànshì Lín Míng tīng bù qīngchu tā shuō shénme.
sentences.english: Mr. Ping spoke very fluently, but Lin Ming could not hear clearly what he was saying.

sentences.chinese: 平先生说他认识一个团队，那个队的人知道很多秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Píng xiānsheng shuō tā rènshi yí gè tuánduì, nà gè duì de rén zhīdào hěnduō mìmì.
sentences.english: Mr. Ping said he knew a team, and the people in that group knew many secrets.

sentences.chinese: 林明觉得平先生的话没有道理，他认为平先生在故意隐藏东西。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng juéde Píng xiānsheng de huà méiyǒu dàolǐ, tā rènwéi Píng xiānsheng zài gùyì yǐncáng dōngxi.
sentences.english: Lin Ming felt that Mr. Ping's words made no sense; he thought Mr. Ping was deliberately hiding something.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果能自由地进入那个房间，事情会很顺利。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rúguǒ néng zìyóu de jìn rù nà gè fángjiān, shìqing huì hěn shùnlì.
sentences.english: He thought that if he could freely enter that room, things would go smoothly.

sentences.chinese: 平先生问他是否满意现在的答案。
sentences.pinyin: Píng xiānsheng wèn tā shìfǒu mǎnyì xiànzài de dá'àn.
sentences.english: Mr. Ping asked him if he was satisfied with the current answer.

sentences.chinese: 林明摇了摇头，因为他和平先生并不熟。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng yáo le yáo tóu, yīnwèi tā hé Píng xiānsheng bìng bù shú.
sentences.english: Lin Ming shook his head because he was not familiar with Mr. Ping.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一群顾客走进店里，排成了一个队。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yì qún gùkè zǒu jìn diàn lǐ, pái chéng le yí gè duì.
sentences.english: At that moment, a group of customers entered the shop and formed a line.

sentences.chinese: 林明在人群中看到了一个奇怪的人，那个人在看他。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng zài rénqún zhòng kàndào le yí gè qíguài de rén, nà gè rén zài kàn tā.
sentences.english: Lin Ming saw a strange person in the crowd, and that person was looking at him.

sentences.chinese: 他突然想起，昨晚的钥匙和这个人的衣服颜色相同。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán xiǎngqǐ, zuó wǎn de yàoshi hé zhège rén de yīfu yánsè xiāngtóng.
sentences.english: He suddenly remembered that the key from last night was the same color as this person's clothes.

sentences.chinese: 林明觉得肚子很饱，但他现在非常紧张。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng juéde dùzi hěn bǎo, dàn tā xiànzài fēicháng jǐnzhāng.
sentences.english: Lin Ming felt full in his stomach, but he was very nervous now.

sentences.chinese: 他想清楚地知道，谁在跟踪他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qīngchu de zhīdào, shéi zài gēnzōng tā.
sentences.english: He wanted to know clearly who was following him.

sentences.chinese: 他悄悄地离开了商店，走在安静的街道上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qiāoqiāo de líkāi le shāngdiàn, zǒu zài ānjìng de jiēdào shàng.
sentences.english: He quietly left the shop and walked on the quiet street.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他发现地上有一张红色的纸条。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, tā fāxiàn dìshàng yǒu yì zhāng hóngsè de zhǐtiáo.
sentences.english: Suddenly, he discovered a red piece of paper on the ground.

chapters.title_chinese: 第三章：红色的纸条和奇怪的线索
chapters.title_english: Chapter 3: The Red Note and Strange Clues

sentences.chinese: 林明低头看那张红色的纸条。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng dī tóu kàn nà zhāng hóng sè de zhǐ tiáo.
sentences.english: Lin Ming looked down at the red note.

sentences.chinese: 纸条上写着一个蓝色的数字和一些英文。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐ tiáo shàng xiě zhe yí gè lán sè de shù zì hé yì xiē Yīng wén.
sentences.english: On the note was written a blue number and some English text.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这个语言很奇怪，不像普通的英语。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué de zhè gè yǔ yán hěn qí guài, bú xiàng pǔ tōng de Yīng yǔ.
sentences.english: He felt this language was strange, not like ordinary English.

sentences.chinese: 他看了看自己的手表，现在是晚上八点。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn le kàn zì jǐ de shǒu biǎo, xiàn zài shì wǎn shàng bā diǎn.
sentences.english: He looked at his wristwatch; it was now eight o'clock in the evening.

sentences.chinese: 天空是多云的，没有星星。
sentences.pinyin: Tīān kōng shì duō yún de, méi yǒu xīng xīng.
sentences.english: The sky was cloudy, with no stars.

sentences.chinese: 夜晚的气温很低，温度让林明觉得很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Yè wǎn de qì wēn hěn dī, wēn dù ràng Lín Míng jué de hěn lěng.
sentences.english: The night air temperature was very low, and the temperature made Lin Ming feel very cold.

sentences.chinese: 他想起昨晚在银行看到的那个人，那个人穿着黑色的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ zuó wǎn zài yín háng kàn dào de nà gè rén, nà gè rén chuān zhe hēi sè de yī fú.
sentences.english: He remembered the person he saw at the bank last night; that person was wearing black clothes.

sentences.chinese: 林明决定去附近的一家饭馆坐坐，想清楚这件事。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng jué dìng qù fù jìn de yì jiā fàn guǎn zuò zuò, xiǎng qīng chǔ zhè jiàn shì.
sentences.english: Lin Ming decided to sit in a nearby restaurant to think clearly about this matter.

sentences.chinese: 这家饭馆很大，里面有西餐，也有中国菜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā fàn guǎn hěn dà, lǐ miàn yǒu xī cān, yě yǒu Zhōng guó cài.
sentences.english: This restaurant was very large, serving Western food as well as Chinese dishes.

sentences.chinese: 他拿过一份菜单，上面写着很多不同的食物。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná guò yí fèn cài dān, shàng miàn xiě zhe hěn duō bù tóng de shí wù.
sentences.english: He took a menu, which listed many different types of food.

sentences.chinese: 他点了一碗方便面，因为他想快点吃完。
sentences.pinyin: Tā diǎn le yì wǎn fāng biàn miàn, yīn wèi tā xiǎng kuài diǎn chī wán.
sentences.english: He ordered a bowl of instant noodles because he wanted to finish eating quickly.

sentences.chinese: 服务员给他带来了一双筷子和一个绿色的瓶子。
sentences.pinyin: Fú wù yuán gěi tā dài lái le yì shuāng kuài zi hé yí gè lǜ sè de píng zi.
sentences.english: The waiter brought him a pair of chopsticks and a green bottle.

sentences.chinese: 林明看着自己的脸在玻璃窗里，他看起来很紧张。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng kàn zhe zì jǐ de liǎn zài bō lí chuāng lǐ, tā kàn qǐ lái hěn jǐn zhāng.
sentences.english: Lin Ming looked at his face in the glass window; he looked very nervous.

sentences.chinese: 他想起他的朋友是一个满族人，懂很多关于历史的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ tā de péng you shì yí gè Mǎn zú rén, dǒng hěn duō guān yú lì shǐ de mì mì.
sentences.english: He remembered that his friend is Manchu and knows many secrets about history.

sentences.chinese: 林明在桌子上发现了一张信用卡和一本护照。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng zài zhuō zi shàng fā xiàn le yì zhāng xìn yòng kǎ hé yì běn hù zhào.
sentences.english: Lin Ming discovered a credit card and a passport on the table.

sentences.chinese: 这些东西不是他的，它们就在桌子的蓝色布下面。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiē dōng xī bú shì tā de, tā men jiù zài zhuō zi de lán sè bù xià miàn.
sentences.english: These things were not his; they were under the blue cloth of the table.

sentences.chinese: 护照上写着一个国际名字，看起来像是一个外国人的。
sentences.pinyin: Hù zhào shàng xiě zhe yí gè guó jì míng zi, kàn qǐ lái xiàng shì yí gè wài guó rén de.
sentences.english: The passport had an international name on it, appearing to belong to a foreigner.

sentences.chinese: 他想，这个人的行李大概有几公斤，或者说几个千克那么重。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, zhè gè rén de xíng lǐ dà gài yǒu jǐ gōng jīn, huò zhě shuō jǐ gè qiān kè nà me zhòng.
sentences.english: He thought the person's luggage probably weighed a few kilograms, or rather, a few thousand grams (kg).

sentences.chinese: 他想起在市场买水果时，人们习惯用斤来计算重量。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ zài shì chǎng mǎi shuǐ guǒ shí, rén men xí guàn yòng jīn lái jì suàn zhòng liàng.
sentences.english: He remembered when buying fruit at the market, people are used to using 'jin' (catty) to calculate weight.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他的手机响了，是一个奇怪的信号。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, tā de shǒu jī xiǎng le, shì yí gè qí guài de xìn hào.
sentences.english: Suddenly, his phone rang; it was a strange signal.

sentences.chinese: 手机屏幕上出现了一行字，像是黑板上的白色粉笔字。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒu jī píng mù shàng chū xiàn le yì háng zì, xiàng shì hēi bǎn shàng de bái sè fěn bǐ zì.
sentences.english: A line of text appeared on the phone screen, like white chalk on a blackboard.

sentences.chinese: 文字说：“大门后面有秘密”。
sentences.pinyin: Wén zì shuō: “Dà mén hòu miàn yǒu mì mì”.
sentences.english: The text said: "There is a secret behind the Great Door (Da Men)".

sentences.chinese: 林明想，这难道是指那个叫“大门”的美国摇滚乐队？
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎng, zhè nán dào shì zhǐ nà gè jiào “Dà mén” de Měi guó yáo gǔn yuè duì?
sentences.english: Lin Ming wondered if this referred to the American rock band called "The Doors".

sentences.chinese: 不对，这可能是一个地方的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Bú duì, zhè kě néng shì yí gè dì fang de míng zi.
sentences.english: No, this might be the name of a place.

sentences.chinese: 他想起这个月份是十月，是很多秘密开始出现的时候。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ zhè gè yuè fèn shì shí yuè, shì hěn duō mì mì kāi shǐ chū xiàn de shí hou.
sentences.english: He remembered that this month is October, a time when many secrets begin to emerge.

sentences.chinese: 他想离开这里，回到大自然中去思考。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng lí kāi zhè lǐ, huí dào dà zì rán zhōng qù sī kǎo.
sentences.english: He wanted to leave this place and go back into nature to think.

sentences.chinese: 他记得早餐时，报纸上说这个城市有奇怪的失踪案。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì de zǎo cān shí, bào zhǐ shàng shuō zhè gè chéng shì yǒu qí guài de shī zōng àn.
sentences.english: He remembered during breakfast, the newspaper said there were strange disappearance cases in this city.

sentences.chinese: 他把信用卡和护照放进兜里，悄悄走出了饭馆。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ xìn yòng kǎ hé hù zhào fàng jìn dōu lǐ, qiāo qiāo zǒu chū le fàn guǎn.
sentences.english: He put the credit card and passport in his pocket and quietly walked out of the restaurant.

sentences.chinese: 他走在街上，发现一个黑色的影子在跟踪他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu zài jiē shàng, fā xiàn yí gè hēi sè de yǐng zi zài gēn zōng tā.
sentences.english: As he walked on the street, he noticed a black shadow following him.

sentences.chinese: 那个影子很高，动作很快。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè yǐng zi hěn gāo, dòng zuò hěn kuài.
sentences.english: That shadow was very tall and moved very quickly.

sentences.chinese: 林明突然停了下来，回头看去。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng tū rán tíng le xià lái, huí tóu kàn qù.
sentences.english: Lin Ming suddenly stopped and looked back.

sentences.chinese: 但街道上没有人，只有风在吹。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiē dào shàng méi yǒu rén, zhǐ yǒu fēng zài chuī.
sentences.english: But there was no one on the street, only the wind blowing.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，他听到身后有一个声音在叫他的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, tā tīng dào shēn hòu yǒu yí gè shēng yīn zài jiào tā de míng zi.
sentences.english: Just then, he heard a voice behind him calling his name.

sentences.chinese: 林明听到声音，心跳很快。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng tīng dào shēngyīn, xīntiào hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Lin Ming heard the voice, and his heart beat fast.

sentences.chinese: 他往声音的方向看去，发现是一个年轻人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wǎng shēngyīn de fāngxiàng kàn qù, fāxiàn shì yígè niánqīng rén.
sentences.english: He looked towards the direction of the voice and found a young man.

sentences.chinese: 那个年轻人笑着说：“你好，林明，我想和你交朋友。”
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè niánqīng rén xiàozhe shuō: “Nǐ hǎo, Lín Míng, wǒ xiǎng hé nǐ jiāo péngyou.”
sentences.english: The young man smiled and said, "Hello, Lin Ming, I want to make friends with you."

sentences.chinese: 林明很奇怪，因为他不认识这个人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng hěn qíguài, yīnwèi tā bù rènshi zhège rén.
sentences.english: Lin Ming was very strange because he didn't know this person.

sentences.chinese: 年轻人告诉他，他叫王强，现在在一家公司实习。
sentences.pinyin: Niánqīng rén gàosù tā, tā jiào Wáng Qiáng, xiànzài zài yìjiā gōngsī shíxí.
sentences.english: The young man told him his name was Wang Qiang, and he was currently interning at a company.

sentences.chinese: 王强说，他发现林明在找一些东西，他想帮林明找出答案。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng shuō, tā fāxiàn Lín Míng zài zhǎo yìxiē dōngxi, tā xiǎng bāng Lín Míng zhǎo chū dá'àn.
sentences.english: Wang Qiang said he noticed Lin Ming was looking for something and wanted to help Lin Ming find the answer.

sentences.chinese: 林明想知道王强是怎么知道他的名字的。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎng zhīdào Wáng Qiáng shì zěnme zhīdào tā de míngzi de.
sentences.english: Lin Ming wanted to know how Wang Qiang knew his name.

sentences.chinese: 王强从口袋里拿出一张纸，那是林明以前写的一篇作文。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng cóng kǒudài lǐ ná chū yì zhāng zhǐ, nà shì Lín Míng yǐqián xiě de yì piān zuòwén.
sentences.english: Wang Qiang took a piece of paper from his pocket; it was an essay Lin Ming had written before.

sentences.chinese: 林明很吃惊，他记得那篇作文在家里，怎么会出现在这里？
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng hěn chījīng, tā jìde nà piān zuòwén zài jiālǐ, zěnme huì chūxiàn zài zhèlǐ?
sentences.english: Lin Ming was shocked; he remembered that essay was at home, how could it appear here?

sentences.chinese: 王强解释说，他通过一种特殊的做法，得到了这张纸。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng jiěshì shuō, tā tōngguò yì zhǒng tèshū de zuòfǎ, dédàole zhè zhāng zhǐ.
sentences.english: Wang Qiang explained that he obtained this paper through a special method.

sentences.chinese: 林明问他有什么办法可以把钥匙找回来。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng wèn tā yǒu shénme bànfǎ kěyǐ bǎ yàoshi zhǎo huílái.
sentences.english: Lin Ming asked him if there was any way to get the key back.

sentences.chinese: 王强说，这需要一个计划，他们需要商量一下。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng shuō, zhè xūyào yígè jìhuà, tāmen xūyào shāngliang yíxià.
sentences.english: Wang Qiang said this required a plan, and they needed to discuss it.

sentences.chinese: 王强告诉林明，明天学校要举行一个活动。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng gàosù Lín Míng, míngtiān xuéxiào yào jǔxíng yígè huódòng.
sentences.english: Wang Qiang told Lin Ming that the school was going to hold an activity tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 很多学生会参加，大家会去参观学校的旧图书馆。
sentences.pinyin: Hěnduō xuéshēng huì cānjiā, dàjiā huì qù cānguān xuéxiào de jiù túshūguǎn.
sentences.english: Many students would participate, and everyone would visit the school's old library.

sentences.chinese: 旧图书馆的入口在学校的最北边，那里的交通很不方便。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù túshūguǎn de rùkǒu zài xuéxiào de zuì běibiān, nàlǐ de jiāotōng hěn bù fāngbiàn.
sentences.english: The entrance to the old library is at the northernmost part of the school, where transportation is very inconvenient.

sentences.chinese: 王强说，如果林明能努力观察，就能实现他的目标。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng shuō, rúguǒ Lín Míng néng nǔlì guānchá, jiù néng shíxiàn tā de mùbiāo.
sentences.english: Wang Qiang said that if Lin Ming could observe hard, he could realize his goal.

sentences.chinese: 林明想，这个神秘的对话对他有很大的影响。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎng, zhège shénmì de duìhuà duì tā yǒu hěn dà de yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.english: Lin Ming thought that this mysterious conversation had a great influence on him.

sentences.chinese: 他问王强：“你为什么帮我？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn Wáng Qiáng: “Nǐ wèishénme bāng wǒ?”
sentences.english: He asked Wang Qiang, "Why are you helping me?"

sentences.chinese: 王强说，他小时候也丢失过重要的东西，所以他懂得这种感觉。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng shuō, tā xiǎoshíhòu yě diūshī guò zhòngyào de dōngxi, suǒyǐ tā dǒngde zhè zhǒng gǎnjué.
sentences.english: Wang Qiang said he had also lost something important when he was a child, so he understood this feeling.

sentences.chinese: 林明被王强的话感动了，他开始相信这个陌生人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng bèi Wáng Qiáng de huà gǎndòng le, tā kāishǐ xiāngxìn zhège mòshēng rén.
sentences.english: Lin Ming was moved by Wang Qiang's words and began to trust this stranger.

sentences.chinese: 王强说，他们必须在活动开始前完成所有的准备工作。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng shuō, tāmen bìxū zài huódòng kāishǐ qián wánchéng suǒyǒu de zhǔnbèi gōngzuò.
sentences.english: Wang Qiang said they must complete all the preparatory work before the activity began.

sentences.chinese: 林明想到了一个问题，他问王强：“我们需要复习之前的线索吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎngdàole yígè wèntí, tā wèn Wáng Qiáng: “Wǒmen xūyào fùxí zhīqián de xiànsuǒ ma?”
sentences.english: Lin Ming thought of a question and asked Wang Qiang, "Do we need to review the previous clues?"

sentences.chinese: 王强点头说：“是的，我们需要把所有的线索看完，才能得出正确的结论。”
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng diǎntóu shuō: “Shì de, wǒmen xūyào bǎ suǒyǒu de xiànsuǒ kàn wán, cáinéng déchū zhèngquè de jié lùn.”
sentences.english: Wang Qiang nodded and said, "Yes, we need to finish looking at all the clues before we can arrive at the correct conclusion."

sentences.chinese: 林明想，只要能做到这一点，他就能找到秘密的门。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎng, zhǐyào néng zuòdào zhè yì diǎn, tā jiù néng zhǎodào mìmì de mén.
sentences.english: Lin Ming thought that as long as he could achieve this, he could find the secret door.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，风又吹了起来，把周围的树叶吹得乱飞。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, fēng yòu chuī le qǐlái, bǎ zhōuwéi de shùyè chuī de luàn fēi.
sentences.english: Just then, the wind blew again, blowing the surrounding leaves wildly.

sentences.chinese: 王强提醒林明，他们不能在这里太久，因为时间就要到了。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng tíxǐng Lín Míng, tāmen bùnéng zài zhèlǐ tài jiǔ, yīnwèi shíjiān jiùyào dàole.
sentences.english: Wang Qiang reminded Lin Ming that they couldn't stay here too long because the time was about to arrive.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林明，在图书馆里，他们需要像听讲一样仔细听每一个声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Lín Míng, zài túshūguǎn lǐ, tāmen xūyào xiàng tīngjiǎng yíyàng zǐxì tīng měi yígè shēngyīn.
sentences.english: He told Lin Ming that in the library, they needed to listen to every sound carefully, just like attending a lecture.

sentences.chinese: 因为声音在那个安静的地方会有很大的作用。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi shēngyīn zài nàgè ānjìng de dìfāng huì yǒu hěn dà de zuòyòng.
sentences.english: Because sound has a great effect in that quiet place.

sentences.chinese: 林明想，他必须弄懂这个秘密到底是什么。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎng, tā bìxū nòng dǒng zhège mìmì dàodǐ shì shénme.
sentences.english: Lin Ming thought he must understand what this secret actually was.

sentences.chinese: 两人决定一起走，往图书馆的方向走去。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng rén juédìng yìqǐ zǒu, wǎng túshūguǎn de fāngxiàng zǒu qù.
sentences.english: The two decided to walk together towards the library.

sentences.chinese: 但林明没有注意到，在他们身后，那个黑色的影子又出现了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn Lín Míng méiyǒu zhùyì dào, zài tāmen shēnhòu, nàgè hēisè de yǐngzi yòu chūxiàn le.
sentences.english: But Lin Ming didn't notice that behind them, that black shadow had appeared again.

sentences.chinese: 那个影子在看着他们，似乎在计划着什么可怕的事情。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè yǐngzi zài kànzhe tāmen, sìhū zài jìhuàzhe shénme kěpà de shìqíng.
sentences.english: The shadow was watching them, seemingly planning something terrible.

sentences.chinese: 林明和他的新朋友快步走在路上。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng hé tā de xīn péngyǒu kuàibù zǒu zài lùshàng.
sentences.english: Lin Ming and his new friend walked quickly along the road.

sentences.chinese: 他们走过一个安静的小公园，快步走向图书馆。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒu guò yīgè ānjìng de xiǎo gōngyuán, kuàibù zǒuxiàng túshūguǎn.
sentences.english: They walked past a quiet small park, heading quickly toward the library.

sentences.chinese: 他们不想让那个黑色的影子超过他们。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen bù xiǎng ràng nàgè hēisè de yǐngzi chāo guò tāmen.
sentences.english: They didn't want that black shadow to surpass them.

sentences.chinese: 林明觉得心跳很快，像是在做剧烈的运动。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng juédé xīntiào hěn kuài, xiàng shì zài zuò jùliè de yùndòng.
sentences.english: Lin Ming felt his heart beating fast, as if he were doing strenuous exercise.

sentences.chinese: 他们走进图书馆的大门，进入了这个安静的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒu jìn túshūguǎn de dàmén, jìn rù le zhège ānjìng de dìfāng.
sentences.english: They entered the main door of the library, entering this quiet place.

sentences.chinese: 图书馆里有很多排书架，看起来非常整齐。
sentences.pinyin: Túshūguǎn lǐ yǒu hěnduō pái shūjià, kàn qǐlái fēicháng zhěngqí.
sentences.english: There were many rows of bookshelves in the library, looking very neat.

sentences.chinese: 林明靠在书架旁边，低声地和朋友讨论这件事。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng kào zài shūjià pángbiān, dīshēng de hé péngyǒu tǎolùn zhè jiàn shì.
sentences.english: Lin Ming leaned against the bookshelf, discussing the matter in a low voice with his friend.

sentences.chinese: 他讲起那把消失的钥匙和红色的纸条。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiǎng qǐ nà bǎ xiāoshī de yàoshi hé hóngsè de zhǐtiáo.
sentences.english: He spoke about the disappeared key and the red note.

sentences.chinese: 他的朋友认真听他的讲话，并帮他分析情况。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de péngyǒu rènzhēn tīng tā de jiǎnghuà, bìng bāng tā fēnxī qíngkuàng.
sentences.english: His friend listened carefully to his speech and helped him analyze the situation.

sentences.chinese: 接着，他们决定进行一次详细的检查。
sentences.pinyin: Jiēzhe, tāmen juédìng jìn xíng yī cì xiángxì de jiǎnchá.
sentences.english: Then, they decided to conduct a detailed inspection.

sentences.chinese: 他们需要检查每一个书架，看看有没有奇怪的东西。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xūyào jiǎnchá měi yīgè shūjià, kàn kàn yǒu méiyǒu qíguài de dōngxi.
sentences.english: They needed to examine every bookshelf to see if there was anything strange.

sentences.chinese: 林明想起他以前练习过怎么寻找隐藏的线索。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎngqǐ tā yǐqián liànxí guò zěnme xúnzhǎo yǐncáng de xiànsuǒ.
sentences.english: Lin Ming remembered that he had practiced how to find hidden clues before.

sentences.chinese: 他每天练写字的时候，习惯观察很多小细节。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měitiān liàn xiězì de shíhou, xíguàn guānchá hěnduō xiǎo xìjié.
sentences.english: Every day when he practiced writing, he made a habit of observing many small details.

sentences.chinese: 这种练习让他现在变得很细心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng liànxí ràng tā xiànzài biàn de hěn xìxīn.
sentences.english: This kind of practice made him very meticulous now.

sentences.chinese: 在走廊里，他们碰到一个穿着黑色衣服的人。
sentences.pinyin: Zài lángláng lǐ, tāmen pèng dào yīgè chuānzhe hēisè yīfu de rén.
sentences.english: In the corridor, they came across a person wearing black clothes.

sentences.chinese: 那个人看起来很奇怪，动作很慢，不像在正常的活动。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè rén kàn qǐlái hěn qíguài, dòngzuò hěn màn, bù xiàng zài zhèngcháng de huódòng.
sentences.english: That person looked very strange, moving slowly, not like normal activity.

sentences.chinese: 林明担心又碰见了那个黑色的影子。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng dānxīn yòu pèng jiàn le nàgè hēisè de yǐngzi.
sentences.english: Lin Ming worried that he had run into that black shadow again.

sentences.chinese: 他们小心地经过那个人，尽量不发出声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xiǎoxīn de jīngguò nàgè rén, jǐnliàng bù fāchū shēngyīn.
sentences.english: They carefully passed by that person, trying not to make a sound.

sentences.chinese: 这时，林明发现墙上有一条细小的水流在向下流。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, Lín Míng fāxiàn qiáng shàng yǒu yī tiáo xìxiǎo de shuǐliú zài xiàng xià liú.
sentences.english: At this moment, Lin Ming noticed a thin stream of water flowing down the wall.

sentences.chinese: 水流通过一个小孔，流向了地板下面的某个地方。
sentences.pinyin: Shuǐliú tōngguò yīgè xiǎo kǒng, liú xiàng le dìbǎn xiàmiàn de mǒu gè dìfāng.
sentences.english: The water flowed through a small hole, flowing toward some place beneath the floor.

sentences.chinese: 林明意识到这里可能有一个秘密的通道。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng yìshí dào zhèlǐ kěnéng yǒu yīgè mìmì de tōngdào.
sentences.english: Lin Ming realized there might be a secret passage here.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试拉开书架旁边的门，但门被锁住了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chángshì lā kāi shūjià pángbiān de mén, dàn mén bèi suǒ zhù le.
sentences.english: He tried to pull open the door next to the bookshelf, but the door was locked.

sentences.chinese: 他必须思考接下来的行动，不能太鲁莽。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū sīkǎo jiē xiàlái de xíngdòng, bùnéng tài lǔmǎng.
sentences.english: He had to think about the next action; he couldn't be too reckless.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果能通向地下的房间，就能找到答案。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rúguǒ néng tōng xiàng dìxià de fángjiān, jiù néng zhǎodào dá'àn.
sentences.english: He thought that if he could get through to the underground room, he could find the answer.

sentences.chinese: 他开始重点观察门上的锁，试图找到打开它的方法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kāishǐ zhòngdiǎn guānchá mén shàng de suǒ, shìtú zhǎodào dǎkāi tā de fāngfǎ.
sentences.english: He began to focus his observation on the lock on the door, trying to find a way to open it.

sentences.chinese: 突然，那个黑色的影子从他们身后走了过来。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, nàgè hēisè de yǐngzi cóng tāmen shēnhòu zǒu le guò lái.
sentences.english: Suddenly, that black shadow walked over from behind them.

sentences.chinese: 那个黑色的影子站在林明身后，全身被黑衣服覆盖。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè hēi sè de yǐng zi zhàn zài Lín Míng shēn hòu, quán shēn bèi hēi yī fú fù gài.
sentences.english: The black shadow stood behind Lin Ming, his whole body covered in black clothes.

sentences.chinese: 林明十分惊讶，他慢慢地转过身。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng shí fēn jīng yà, tā màn màn de zhuǎn guò shēn.
sentences.english: Lin Ming was very surprised; he slowly turned around.

sentences.chinese: 影子用大声的声音说：“不要进入那个房间！”
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi yòng dà shēng de shēng yīn shuō: “Bù yào jìn rù nà gè fáng jiān!”
sentences.english: The shadow said in a loud voice, "Do not enter that room!"

sentences.chinese: 林明觉得这个声音多么奇怪，像是在哭，又像是在笑。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng jué dé zhè gè shēng yīn duō me qí guài, xiàng shì zài kū, yòu xiàng shì zài xiào.
sentences.english: Lin Ming felt this voice was so strange, as if it were crying, yet as if it were laughing.

sentences.chinese: 影子说，他在这座图书馆工作了一生，知道这里所有的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi shuō, tā zài zhè zuò tú shū guǎn gōng zuò le yī shēng, zhī dào zhè lǐ suǒ yǒu de mì mì.
sentences.english: The shadow said he had worked in this library all his life and knew all the secrets here.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林明，这个地下房间的秘密影响了全国很多重要的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù Lín Míng, zhè gè dì xià fáng jiān de mì mì yǐng xiǎng le quán guó hěn duō zhòng yào de rén.
sentences.english: He told Lin Ming that the secret of this underground room affected many important people nationwide.

sentences.chinese: 影子说，大多数人认为这里只有书，但大部分时间，这里是存放秘密的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi shuō, dà duō shù rén rèn wéi zhè lǐ zhǐ yǒu shū, dàn dà bù fen shí jiān, zhè lǐ shì cún fàng mì mì de dì fāng.
sentences.english: The shadow said the majority of people think there are only books here, but for the greater part of the time, this is a place for storing secrets.

sentences.chinese: 林明看着影子，发现对方的脸完全被遮住了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng kàn zhe yǐng zi, fā xiàn duì fāng de liǎn wán quán bèi zhē zhù le.
sentences.english: Lin Ming looked at the shadow and found that the other party's face was completely covered.

sentences.chinese: 影子说，他之前照顾过这里的全体员工，现在他必须保护这个秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi shuō, tā zhī qián zhào gù guò zhè lǐ de quán tǐ yuán gōng, xiàn zài tā bì xū bǎo hù zhè gè mì mì.
sentences.english: The shadow said he had previously looked after the entire staff here, and now he must protect this secret.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林明，许多年前，一个全家都失踪的秘密就在这里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù Lín Míng, xǔ duō nián qián, yī gè quán jiā dōu shī zōng de mì mì jiù zài zhè lǐ.
sentences.english: He told Lin Ming that many years ago, a secret about a whole family disappearing was right here.

sentences.chinese: 那个秘密太长，需要很多时间才能讲完。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè mì mì tài cháng, xū yào hěn duō shí jiān cái néng jiǎng wán.
sentences.english: That secret was too long; it would take a lot of time to finish telling it.

sentences.chinese: 林明问：“为什么你要告诉我这些？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng wèn: “Wèi shé me nǐ yào gào sù wǒ zhè xiē?”
sentences.english: Lin Ming asked, "Why are you telling me these things?"

sentences.chinese: 影子说，现在有大量的人在寻找那把钥匙，他们并不友好。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi shuō, xiàn zài yǒu dà liàng de rén zài xún zhǎo nà bǎ yào shi, tā men bìng bù yǒu hǎo.
sentences.english: The shadow said that currently, a great amount of people are searching for that key, and they are not friendly.

sentences.chinese: 这些寻找钥匙的人中，多数都是为了钱。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiē xún zhǎo yào shi de rén zhōng, duō shù dōu shì wèi le qián.
sentences.english: Among those searching for the key, most are doing it for money.

sentences.chinese: 林明发现，书架后面有好多奇怪的符号。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng fā xiàn, shū jià hòu miàn yǒu hǎo duō qí guài de fú hào.
sentences.english: Lin Ming discovered there were quite a lot of strange symbols behind the bookshelf.

sentences.chinese: 他数了数，符号一共二十个。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shǔ le shǔ, fú hào yī gòng èr shí gè.
sentences.english: He counted them; there were twenty symbols altogether.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，这些符号大大增加了寻找答案的难度。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, zhè xiē fú hào dà dà zēng jiā le xún zhǎo dá àn de nán dù.
sentences.english: He realized that these symbols greatly increased the difficulty of finding the answer.

sentences.chinese: 林明想，他现在掌握的信息还不够，不能随便开门。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎng, tā xiàn zài zhǎng wò de xìn xī hái bù gòu, bù néng suí biàn kāi mén.
sentences.english: Lin Ming thought that the information he currently possessed was not enough; he couldn't just open the door carelessly.

sentences.chinese: 他看到桌子上有很多旧报纸，那是全年记录的奇怪事件。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào zhuō zi shàng yǒu hěn duō jiù bào zhǐ, nà shì quán nián jì lù de qí guài shì jiàn.
sentences.english: He saw many old newspapers on the table, which were records of strange events for the whole year.

sentences.chinese: 不少报纸上都提到了一个失踪的箱子。
sentences.pinyin: Bù shǎo bào zhǐ shàng dōu tí dào le yī gè shī zōng de xiāng zi.
sentences.english: Not a few newspapers mentioned a missing box.

sentences.chinese: 所有的人都以为箱子丢了，但影子说箱子就在地下。
sentences.pinyin: Suǒ yǒu de rén dōu yǐ wéi xiāng zi diū le, dàn yǐng zi shuō xiāng zi jiù zài dì xià.
sentences.english: Everyone thought the box was lost, but the shadow said the box was underground.

sentences.chinese: 大家在图书馆里安静地读书，没人知道这里发生了什么。
sentences.pinyin: Dà jiā zài tú shū guǎn lǐ ān jìng de dú shū, méi rén zhī dào zhè lǐ fā shēng le shén me.
sentences.english: Everyone in the library was reading quietly; no one knew what was happening here.

sentences.chinese: 林明感到这么紧张，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng gǎn dào zhè me jǐn zhāng, xīn tiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Lin Ming felt so nervous that his heart beat very fast.

sentences.chinese: 他决定把全部的注意力放在那个锁上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué dìng bǎ quán bù de zhù yì lì fàng zài nà gè suǒ shàng.
sentences.english: He decided to put all of his attention on that lock.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，影子突然消失了，只留下一张新的纸条。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, yǐng zi tū rán xiāo shī le, zhǐ liú xià yī zhāng xīn de zhǐ tiáo.
sentences.english: Just then, the shadow suddenly disappeared, leaving behind only a new note.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 7: The Strange Map of Clues

sentences.chinese: 林明拿起了那张新的纸条。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng ná qǐ le nà zhāng xīn de zhǐ tiáo.
sentences.english: Lin Ming picked up the new note.

sentences.chinese: 纸条上没有字，只有一张地图。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐ tiáo shàng méi yǒu zì, zhǐ yǒu yī zhāng dì tú.
sentences.english: There were no words on the note, only a map.

sentences.chinese: 地图上画了很多地方。
sentences.pinyin: Dì tú shàng huà le hěn duō dì fāng.
sentences.english: The map drew many places.

sentences.chinese: 首先，地图上有一个中小学。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒu xiān, dì tú shàng yǒu yī gè zhōng xiǎo xué.
sentences.english: First, there was a middle and elementary school on the map.

sentences.chinese: 林明记得那里有很多旧的教室。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng jì dé nà lǐ yǒu hěn duō jiù de jiào shì.
sentences.english: Lin Ming remembered there were many old classrooms there.

sentences.chinese: 在那里，他曾经认识一位很有名的教师。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nà lǐ, tā céng jīng rèn shí yī wèi hěn yǒu míng de jiào shī.
sentences.english: There, he had once known a very famous teacher.

sentences.chinese: 地图的第二个标记是一个体育场。
sentences.pinyin: Dì tú de dì èr gè biāo jì shì yī gè tǐ yù chǎng.
sentences.english: The second marker on the map was a stadium.

sentences.chinese: 那里是很多球队练习的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Nà lǐ shì hěn duō qiú duì liàn xí de dì fāng.
sentences.english: That was a place where many sports teams practiced.

sentences.chinese: 林明看着自己的球鞋，想起他在那里丢失过东西。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng kàn zhe zì jǐ de qiú xié, xiǎng qǐ tā zài nà lǐ diū shī guò dōng xī.
sentences.english: Lin Ming looked at his athletic shoes and remembered he had lost something there.

sentences.chinese: 第三个标记是一个公园，公园旁边有一条小河和一个美丽的湖。
sentences.pinyin: Dì tú de dì sān gè biāo jì shì yī gè gōng yuán, gōng yuán páng biān yǒu yī tiáo xiǎo hé hé yī gè měi lì de hú.
sentences.english: The third marker was a park, and next to the park was a small river and a beautiful lake.

sentences.chinese: 在湖边，经常可以看到很多小狗在跑。
sentences.pinyin: Zài hú biān, jīng cháng kě yǐ kàn dào hěn duō xiǎo gǒu zài pǎo.
sentences.english: By the lake, one could often see many small dogs running.

sentences.chinese: 这些动物让公园变得很有生气。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiē dòng wù ràng gōng yuán biàn dé hěn yǒu shēng qì.
sentences.english: These animals made the park very lively.

sentences.chinese: 地图上还画了一个动物园，距离这里有五公里。
sentences.pinyin: Dì tú shàng hái huà le yī gè dòng wù yuán, jù lí zhè lǐ yǒu wǔ gōng lǐ.
sentences.english: The map also drew a zoo, five kilometers from here.

sentences.chinese: 林明想，如果他坐公共汽车去，会很快。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎng, rú guǒ tā zuò gōng gòng qì chē qù, huì hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Lin Ming thought if he took the bus, it would be very fast.

sentences.chinese: 或者他可以走去最近的地铁站。
sentences.pinyin: Huò zhě tā kě yǐ zǒu qù zuì jìn de dì tiě zhàn.
sentences.english: Or he could walk to the nearest subway station.

sentences.chinese: 地图的中心是一个住房区，那里住着一个著名的作家。
sentences.pinyin: Dì tú de zhōng xīn shì yī gè zhù fáng qū, nà lǐ zhù zhe yī gè zhù míng de zuò jiā.
sentences.english: The center of the map was a housing area, where a famous author lived.

sentences.chinese: 这个作家在春节的时候，经常举办盛大的晚会。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè zuò jiā zài chūn jié de shí hòu, jīng cháng jǔ bàn shèng dà de wǎn huì.
sentences.english: This author often held grand evening parties during the Spring Festival.

sentences.chinese: 林明记得，那个作家曾经写过关于一个科学家的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng jì dé, nà gè zuò jiā céng jīng xiě guò guān yú yī gè kē xué jiā de gù shì.
sentences.english: Lin Ming remembered that the author had once written a story about a scientist.

sentences.chinese: 那个科学家在春天发现了一个巨大的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè kē xué jiā zài chūn tiān fā xiàn le yī gè jù dà de mì mì.
sentences.english: That scientist discovered a huge secret in the spring.

sentences.chinese: 林明在椅子上坐了下来，思考这个地图的意义。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng zài yǐ zi shàng zuò le xià lái, sī kǎo zhè gè dì tú de yì yì.
sentences.english: Lin Ming sat down on a chair, thinking about the meaning of this map.

sentences.chinese: 他发现地图上写着“友好”两个字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn dì tú shàng xiě zhe “yǒu hǎo” liǎng gè zì.
sentences.english: He discovered the words "Youhao" (Friendly) were written on the map.

sentences.chinese: 这可能是一个地名，也可能是一个暗示。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kě néng shì yī gè dì míng, yě kě néng shì yī gè àn shì.
sentences.english: This could be a place name, or it could be a hint.

sentences.chinese: 他想起日报上的新闻，说市长最近在关注这个区域。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ rì bào shàng de xīn wén, shuō shì zhǎng zuì jìn zài guān zhù zhè gè qū yù.
sentences.english: He recalled news in the daily newspaper saying the mayor had been paying attention to this area recently.

sentences.chinese: 林明决定组成一个小组，和朋友一起寻找答案。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng jué dìng zǔ chéng yī gè xiǎo zǔ, hé péng yǒu yī qǐ xún zhǎo dá àn.
sentences.english: Lin Ming decided to form a small group and look for the answer with friends.

sentences.chinese: 他想起一个画家朋友，那个画家很擅长观察细节。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ yī gè huà jiā péng yǒu, nà gè huà jiā hěn shàn cháng guān chá xì jié.
sentences.english: He thought of a painter friend, who was very good at observing details.

sentences.chinese: 他们约在学校的校园里见面。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men yuē zài xué xiào de xiào yuán lǐ jiàn miàn.
sentences.english: They agreed to meet on the school campus.

sentences.chinese: 在校园里，他们找到了一个空座位。
sentences.pinyin: Zài xiào yuán lǐ, tā men zhǎo dào le yī gè kōng zuò wèi.
sentences.english: On the campus, they found an empty seat.

sentences.chinese: 林明告诉朋友：“你看，这里还画了一个排球。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng gào sù péng yǒu: “Nǐ kàn, zhè lǐ hái huà le yī gè pái qiú.”
sentences.english: Lin Ming told his friend, "Look, there is also a volleyball drawn here."

sentences.chinese: 这太奇怪了，为什么地图上会有排球？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tài qí guài le, wèi shén me dì tú shàng huì yǒu pái qiú?
sentences.english: This was too strange; why would there be a volleyball on the map?

sentences.chinese: 林明突然意识到，这些地方在地图上连接起来，像一个字母。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng tū rán yì shí dào, zhè xiē dì fāng zài dì tú shàng lián jiē qǐ lái, xiàng yī gè zì mǔ.
sentences.english: Lin Ming suddenly realized that these places connected on the map looked like a letter.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，林明发现地图背面有一行小字。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, Lín Míng fā xiàn dì tú bèi miàn yǒu yī háng xiǎo zì.
sentences.english: Just then, Lin Ming discovered a line of small words on the back of the map.

sentences.chinese: 小字写着：真正的箱子不在地下，而是在一个你最不想去的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo zì xiě zhe: Zhēn zhèng de xiāng zi bù zài dì xià, ér shì zài yī gè nǐ zuì bù xiǎng qù de dì fāng.
sentences.english: The small words said: The real box is not underground, but in a place you least want to go.

sentences.chinese: 林明感到背后的汗水在流，他突然听到门外传来了沉重的脚步声。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng gǎn dào bèi hòu de hàn shuǐ zài liú, tā tū rán tīng dào mén wài chuán lái le chén zhòng de jiǎo bù shēng.
sentences.english: Lin Ming felt sweat flowing down his back, and he suddenly heard heavy footsteps coming from outside the door.

sentences.chinese: 沉重的脚步声越来越近，林明感到非常害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Chén zhòng de jiǎo bù shēng yuè lái yuè jìn, Lín Míng gǎn dào fēi cháng hài pà.
sentences.english: The heavy footsteps grew closer, and Lin Ming felt very scared.

sentences.chinese: 他快步走到门边，发现一个穿着黑色鞋子的人站在那里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kuài bù zǒu dào mén biān, fā xiàn yī gè chuān zhe hēi sè xié zi de rén zhàn zài nà lǐ.
sentences.english: He walked quickly to the door and found a person wearing black shoes standing there.

sentences.chinese: 那个人看起来像是一个组长，表情很严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén kàn qǐ lái xiàng shì yī gè zǔ zhǎng, biǎo qíng hěn yán sù.
sentences.english: That person looked like a group leader, with a very serious expression.

sentences.chinese: 林明想跑，但他的腿在发抖，不能快速移动。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎng pǎo, dàn tā de tuǐ zài fā dǒu, bù néng kuài sù yí dòng.
sentences.english: Lin Ming wanted to run, but his legs were shaking and he couldn't move quickly.

sentences.chinese: 那个人突然说话了，声音很奇怪，每个音节都很慢。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén tū rán shuō huà le, shēng yīn hěn qí guài, měi gè yīn jié dōu hěn màn.
sentences.english: The person suddenly spoke, his voice was strange, and every syllable was very slow.

sentences.chinese: 他问林明：“你在这个地方找什么样的人？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn Lín Míng: “Nǐ zài zhè gè dì fāng zhǎo shén me yàng de rén?”
sentences.english: He asked Lin Ming, "What kind of person are you looking for in this place?"

sentences.chinese: 林明没有回答，他赶紧把手机关机，然后悄悄地离开了房间。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng méi yǒu huí dá, tā gǎn jǐn bǎ shǒu jī guān jī, rán hòu qiāo qiāo de lí kāi le fáng jiān.
sentences.english: Lin Ming didn't answer; he quickly turned off his phone and then quietly left the room.

sentences.chinese: 他走在安静的街上，看到路边停着一辆黑色的车。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu zài ā jìng de jiē shàng, kàn dào lù biān tíng zhe yī liàng hēi sè de chē.
sentences.english: He walked on the quiet street and saw a black car parked by the roadside.

sentences.chinese: 街道上的车辆很少，这让他感到不安。
sentences.pinyin: Jiē dào shàng de chē liàng hěn shǎo, zhè ràng tā gǎn dào bù ān.
sentences.english: There were very few vehicles on the street, which made him feel uneasy.

sentences.chinese: 他记得地图上提到的那个地方，是在学校的西北方向。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì dé dì tú shàng tí dào de nà gè dì fāng, shì zài xué xiào de xī běi fāng xiàng.
sentences.english: He remembered the place mentioned on the map, which was in the northwest direction of the school.

sentences.chinese: 那里有一个旧的花园，花园旁边是一家药店。
sentences.pinyin: Nà lǐ yǒu yī gè jiù de huā yuán, huā yuán páng biān shì yī jiā yào diàn.
sentences.english: There was an old garden there, and next to the garden was a pharmacy.

sentences.chinese: 林明想起他的老师周老师曾经说过，这个花园里有秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎng qǐ tā de lǎo shī Zhōu lǎo shī céng jīng shuō guò, zhè gè huā yuán lǐ yǒu mì mì.
sentences.english: Lin Ming remembered that his teacher, Mr. Zhou, had once said there were secrets in this garden.

sentences.chinese: 他突然想到，也许真正的箱子就在那个方向。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tū rán xiǎng dào, yě xǔ zhēn zhèng de xiāng zi jiù zài nà gè fāng xiàng.
sentences.english: He suddenly thought that perhaps the real box was in that direction.

sentences.chinese: 但现在他没有信心，因为他不知道那个黑影是谁。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiàn zài tā méi yǒu xìn xīn, yīn wèi tā bù zhī dào nà gè hēi yǐng shì shuí.
sentences.english: But now he had no confidence because he didn't know who that black shadow was.

sentences.chinese: 他想起一个姓阴的人，那个人以前在课堂上经常提到东北的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ yī gè xìng Yīn de rén, nà gè rén yǐ qián zài kè táng shàng jīng cháng tí dào dōng běi de gù shì.
sentences.english: He thought of a person surnamed Yin, who often mentioned stories about Northeast China in the classroom.

sentences.chinese: 那个人的声音像音乐一样，但内容却让人害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén de shēng yīn xiàng yīn yuè yī yàng, dàn nèi róng què ràng rén hài pà.
sentences.english: That person's voice was like music, but the content was frightening.

sentences.chinese: 阴先生曾经邀请林明去参加一场音乐会，但林明拒绝了。
sentences.pinyin: Yīn xiān sheng céng jīng yāo qǐng Lín Míng qù cān jiā yī chǎng yīn yuè huì, dàn Lín Míng jù jué le.
sentences.english: Mr. Yin had once invited Lin Ming to attend a concert, but Lin Ming refused.

sentences.chinese: 林明现在在想，那个黑影的衣服颜色是不是和阴先生的一样？
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiàn zài zài xiǎng, nà gè hēi yǐng de yī fú yán sè shì bù shì hé Yīn xiān sheng de yī yàng?
sentences.english: Lin Ming was now wondering if the color of the black shadow's clothes was the same as Mr. Yin's.

sentences.chinese: 他决定重新开机，尝试给周老师发消息。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué dìng chóng xīn kāi jī, cháng shì gěi Zhōu lǎo shī fā xiāo xī.
sentences.english: He decided to turn the phone back on and try to send a message to Mr. Zhou.

sentences.chinese: 手机屏幕亮了，正是这个时候，他收到了一条陌生信息。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒu jī píng mù liàng le, zhèng shì zhè gè shí hòu, tā shōu dào le yī tiáo mò shēng xìn xī.
sentences.english: The phone screen lit up, and precisely at that moment, he received a strange message.

sentences.chinese: 信息上写着：“不要去西北的花园，那里很危险。”
sentences.pinyin: Xìn xī shàng xiě zhe: “Bù yào qù xī běi de huā yuán, nà lǐ hěn wēi xiǎn.”
sentences.english: The message read: "Do not go to the northwest garden, it is very dangerous."

sentences.chinese: 林明低头看，发现地上有一个篮球，那是谁留下的？
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng dī tóu kàn, fā xiàn dì shàng yǒu yī gè lán qiú, nà shì shuí liú xià de?
sentences.english: Lin Ming looked down and found a basketball on the ground; who left that there?

sentences.chinese: 他抬头看去，发现那个黑色的影子再次出现在药店门口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tái tóu kàn qù, fā xiàn nà gè hēi sè de yǐng zi zài cì chū xiàn zài yào diàn mén kǒu.
sentences.english: He looked up and saw the black shadow appear again at the entrance of the pharmacy.

sentences.chinese: 那个影子对着他笑了，然后慢慢地走向他。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè yǐng zi duì zhe tā xiào le, rán hòu màn màn de zǒu xiàng tā.
sentences.english: The shadow smiled at him and then slowly walked towards him.

chapters.title_chinese: 第九章：药店里的陌生人
chapters.title_english: Chapter 9: The Stranger in the Pharmacy

sentences.chinese: 林明看着那个黑色的影子，心跳得非常快。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng kànzhe nàge hēisè de yǐngzi, xīntiào de fēicháng kuài.
sentences.english: Lin Ming looked at the black shadow, his heart beating very fast.

sentences.chinese: 那个人的个子很高，穿着一件黑色的长大衣。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge rén de gèzi hěn gāo, chuānzhe yī jiàn hēisè de cháng dàyī.
sentences.english: That person's stature was very tall, wearing a long black overcoat.

sentences.chinese: 影子慢慢走到林明面前，低头看着他。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐngzi mànman zǒu dào Lín Míng miànqián, dītóu kànzhe tā.
sentences.english: The shadow slowly walked in front of Lin Ming, looking down at him.

sentences.chinese: 林明注意到，这个人的头戴着一顶奇怪的帽子。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng zhùyì dào, zhège rén de tóu dàizhe yī dǐng qíguài de màozi.
sentences.english: Lin Ming noticed that this person's head was wearing a strange hat.

sentences.chinese: 对方开口说话了，声音听起来像是一个中年男人。
sentences.pinyin: Duìfāng kāikǒu shuōhuà le, shēngyīn tīng qǐlái xiàng shì yīgè zhōngnián nánrén.
sentences.english: The other person began to speak, and the voice sounded like a middle-aged man.

sentences.chinese: “你是不是在找那个箱子？”男人问。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ shì bù shì zài zhǎo nàge xiāngzi?” nánrén wèn.
sentences.english: "Are you looking for that box?" the man asked.

sentences.chinese: 林明很惊讶，因为这个陌生人知道他在做什么。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng hěn jīngyà, yīnwèi zhège mòshēng rén zhīdào tā zài zuò shénme.
sentences.english: Lin Ming was surprised because this stranger knew what he was doing.

sentences.chinese: 男人告诉他，他以前是一名高中老师，现在是一家公司的经理。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén gàosù tā, tā yǐqián shì yī míng gāozhōng lǎoshī, xiànzài shì yī jiā gōngsī de jīnglǐ.
sentences.english: The man told him that he used to be a senior high school teacher and is now a manager of a company.

sentences.chinese: 他提到，在学校的时候，他是那个年级的班长，成绩非常好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tí dào, zài xuéxiào de shíhòu, tā shì nàge niánjí de bānzhǎng, chéngjī fēicháng hǎo.
sentences.english: He mentioned that when he was in school, he was the class monitor of that grade, and his grades were very good.

sentences.chinese: 他的水平很高，在那个学期拿到了最高的分数。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shuǐpíng hěn gāo, zài nàge xuéqī ná dào le zuìgāo de fēnshù.
sentences.english: His level was very high, and he got the highest score in that semester.

sentences.chinese: 男人说，他以前在高级科室工作，是一个中级职员。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén shuō, tā yǐqián zài gāojí kēshì gōngzuò, shì yīgè zhōngjí zhíyuán.
sentences.english: The man said he used to work in an advanced department and was a middle-level employee.

sentences.chinese: “我见过很多大人，但像你这么好奇的人不多。”男人笑了。
sentences.pinyin: “Wǒ jiànguò hěnduō dàren, dàn xiàng nǐ zhème hàoqí de rén bù duō.” nánrén xiào le.
sentences.english: "I have seen many adults, but not many people as curious as you," the man smiled.

sentences.chinese: 林明问他为什么在这里，男人指了指药店。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng wèn tā wèishéme zài zhèlǐ, nánrén zhǐ le zhǐ yàodiàn.
sentences.english: Lin Ming asked him why he was here, and the man pointed to the pharmacy.

sentences.chinese: 这家药店很特别，它有两层，上面是西医诊所，下面是中医药店。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā yàodiàn hěn tèbié, tā yǒu liǎng céng, shàngmiàn shì xīyī zhěnsuǒ, xiàmiàn shì zhōngyī yàodiàn.
sentences.english: This pharmacy was very special; it had two floors, with a Western medicine clinic on top and a traditional Chinese medicine pharmacy below.

sentences.chinese: 药店的院长是一个进入老年的人，非常有经验。
sentences.pinyin: Yàodiàn de yuànzhǎng shì yīgè jìnrù lǎonián de rén, fēicháng yǒu jīngyàn.
sentences.english: The head of the pharmacy was a person in old age, very experienced.

sentences.chinese: 男人说，他的主要工作是帮院长管理这里的药材。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén shuō, tā de zhǔyào gōngzuò shì bāng yuànzhǎng guǎnlǐ zhèlǐ de yàocái.
sentences.english: The man said his main job was to help the director manage the medicinal materials here.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林明，这里的规矩是，只有级数以上的人才能进入地下室。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Lín Míng, zhèlǐ de guīju shì, zhǐyǒu jí shù yǐshàng de rén cáinéng jìnrù dìxiàshì.
sentences.english: He told Lin Ming that the rule here is that only people of a certain rank or higher can enter the basement.

sentences.chinese: 林明想起了那个篮球，问男人是不是他骑车路过时留下的。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎngqǐ le nàge lánqiú, wèn nánrén shì bù shì tā qíchē lùguò shí liú xià de.
sentences.english: Lin Ming thought of the basketball and asked the man if he had left it while riding by.

sentences.chinese: 男人摇了摇头，说他没有骑车，也没有当过什么运动队的队长。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén yáo le yáotóu, shuō tā méiyǒu qíchē, yě méiyǒu dāng guò shénme yùndòng duì de duìzhǎng.
sentences.english: The man shook his head, saying he hadn't ridden a bike, nor had he ever been a captain of any sports team.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个穿着白大褂的人走了出来，他是这里的院长。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yīgè chuānzhe bái dàguà de rén zǒu le chūlái, tā shì zhèlǐ de yuànzhǎng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a person wearing a white coat walked out; he was the director here.

sentences.chinese: 院长看着林明，眼神很严肃，像是在看一个没开学的孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Yuànzhǎng kànzhe Lín Míng, yǎnshén hěn yánsù, xiàng shì zài kàn yīgè méi kāixué de háizi.
sentences.english: The director looked at Lin Ming with a serious expression, as if looking at a child who hadn't started school yet.

sentences.chinese: 他问林明：“你是谁的孩子？你的家长在哪里？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn Lín Míng: “Nǐ shì shéi de háizi? Nǐ de jiāzhǎng zài nǎlǐ?”
sentences.english: He asked Lin Ming, "Whose child are you? Where is your parent?"

sentences.chinese: 林明不知道怎么回答，因为他现在是一个人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng bù zhīdào zěnme huídá, yīnwèi tā xiànzài shì yīgè rén.
sentences.english: Lin Ming didn't know how to answer because he was alone right now.

sentences.chinese: 院长告诉他，这里不是玩游戏的地方，即使你是校长的学生也不行。
sentences.pinyin: Yuànzhǎng gàosù tā, zhèlǐ bù shì wán yóuxì de dìfāng, jíshǐ nǐ shì xiàozhǎng de xuéshēng yě bùxíng.
sentences.english: The director told him that this was not a place for playing games, even if he was the principal's student.

sentences.chinese: 林明感觉到气氛变得很奇怪，这个药店里隐藏着某种秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng gǎnjué dào qìfēn biàn de hěn qíguài, zhège yàodiàn lǐ yǐncáng zhe mǒu zhǒng mìmì.
sentences.english: Lin Ming felt the atmosphere become very strange; there was some kind of secret hidden in this pharmacy.

sentences.chinese: 他发现院长的桌子上有一张照片，照片里的人穿着高级的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn yuànzhǎng de zhuōzi shàng yǒu yī zhāng zhàopiàn, zhàopiàn lǐ de rén chuānzhe gāojí de yīfú.
sentences.english: He noticed a photo on the director's desk, and the person in the photo was wearing high-grade clothes.

sentences.chinese: 照片背后的字写着：秘密在西北花园的第三层地底。
sentences.pinyin: Zhàopiàn bèihòu de zì xiě zhe: Mìmì zài xīběi huāyuán de dì sān céng dìdǐ.
sentences.english: The words on the back of the photo read: The secret is in the third layer of the northwest garden underground.

sentences.chinese: 林明突然想起手机里的信息：“不要去西北的花园，那里很危险。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng tūrán xiǎngqǐ shǒujī lǐ de xìnxī: “Bùyào qù xīběi de huāyuán, nàlǐ hěn wēixiǎn.”
sentences.english: Lin Ming suddenly remembered the message on his phone: "Do not go to the northwest garden, it is very dangerous."

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，药店的灯突然灭了，黑暗中传来了沉重的脚步声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, yàodiàn de dēng tūrán miè le, hēiàn zhōng chuán lái le chénzhòng de jiǎobù shēng.
sentences.english: Just then, the lights in the pharmacy suddenly went out, and heavy footsteps were heard in the darkness.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 10: The Letter in the Dark

sentences.chinese: 黑暗中，沉重的脚步声越来越近。
sentences.pinyin: Hēi àn zhōng, chén zhòng de jiǎo bù shēng yuè lái yuè jìn.
sentences.english: In the darkness, the heavy footsteps were getting closer and closer.

sentences.chinese: 林明赶紧拿出手机，想照亮周围的环境。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng gǎn jǐn ná chū shǒu jī, xiǎng zhào liàng zhōu wéi de huán jìng.
sentences.english: Lin Ming quickly took out his phone, wanting to light up the surrounding environment.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他的手机接到了一个陌生电话。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, tā de shǒu jī jiē dào le yī gè mò shēng diàn huà.
sentences.english: Suddenly, his phone received a call from a stranger.

sentences.chinese: 他接电话后，对方没有说话，只发出了奇怪的笑声。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiē diàn huà hòu, duì fāng méi yǒu shuō huà, zhǐ fā chū le qí guài de xiào shēng.
sentences.english: After he answered the phone, the other party didn't speak, only emitted a strange laugh.

sentences.chinese: 林明感到这次危险带来了巨大的压力。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng gǎn dào zhè cì wēi xiǎn dài lái le jù dà de yā lì.
sentences.english: Lin Ming felt that this danger brought huge pressure.

sentences.chinese: 他记得院长曾经说过，这个药店的收入全部用来做研究。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì dé yuàn zhǎng céng jīng shuō guò, zhè gè yào diàn de shōu rù quán bù yòng lái zuò yán jiū.
sentences.english: He remembered the dean once said that all the income of this pharmacy was used for research.

sentences.chinese: 但林明不接受这个简单的解释。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn Lín Míng bù jiē shòu zhè gè jiǎn dān de jiě shì.
sentences.english: But Lin Ming did not accept this simple explanation.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得药店里隐藏着来自很多年前的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué dé yào diàn lǐ yǐn cáng zhe lái zì hěn duō nián qián de mì mì.
sentences.english: He felt that the pharmacy hid secrets coming from many years ago.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，一个黑色的影子出现在他面前。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, yī gè hēi sè de yǐng zi chū xiàn zài tā miàn qián.
sentences.english: Just then, a black shadow appeared in front of him.

sentences.chinese: 那个影子没有说话，只是把一个信封交给了他。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè yǐng zi méi yǒu shuō huà, zhǐ shì bǎ yī gè xìn fēng jiāo gěi le tā.
sentences.english: The shadow didn't speak, but simply handed an envelope over to him.

sentences.chinese: 林明接过信封，发现里面有一封旧信。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng jiē guò xìn fēng, fā xiàn lǐ miàn yǒu yī fēng jiù xìn.
sentences.english: Lin Ming took the envelope and found an old letter inside.

sentences.chinese: 信里写着一个人的出生日期和出生地。
sentences.pinyin: Xìn lǐ xiě zhe yī gè rén de chū shēng rì qī hé chū shēng dì.
sentences.english: The letter wrote a person's birth date and place of birth.

sentences.chinese: 这个人在很多年前出生在一个很穷的小村庄。
