sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè rén zài hěn duō nián qián chū shēng zài yī gè hěn qióng de xiǎo cūn zhuāng.
sentences.english: This person was born in a very poor small village many years ago.

sentences.chinese: 信中提到，这个人长大后取得了很多成就，受到了很多人的尊敬。
sentences.pinyin: Xìn zhōng tí dào, zhè gè rén zhǎng dà hòu qǔ dé le hěn duō chéng jiù, shòu dào le hěn duō rén de zūn jìng.
sentences.english: The letter mentioned that after this person grew up, he acquired many achievements and received respect from many people.

sentences.chinese: 但结果，他却在寻找一个丢失的礼物。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiē guǒ, tā què zài xún zhǎo yī gè diū shī de lǐ wù.
sentences.english: But as a result, he was searching for a lost gift.

sentences.chinese: 这个礼物是他的父亲送给他的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè lǐ wù shì tā de fù qīn sòng gěi tā de.
sentences.english: This gift was given to him by his father.

sentences.chinese: 林明想，如果能拿到这个礼物，就能得到真相。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎng, rú guǒ néng ná dào zhè gè lǐ wù, jiù néng dé dào zhēn xiàng.
sentences.english: Lin Ming thought that if he could get this gift, he could obtain the truth.

sentences.chinese: 他把信交给自己的好朋友，请他帮忙分析。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ xìn jiāo gěi zì jǐ de hǎo péng yǒu, qǐng tā bāng máng fēn xī.
sentences.english: He handed the letter over to his good friend, asking him to help analyze it.

sentences.chinese: 朋友说，这封信应该是被秘密送到这里的。
sentences.pinyin: Péng yǒu shuō, zhè fēng xìn yīng gāi shì bèi mì mì sòng dào zhè lǐ de.
sentences.english: The friend said that this letter should have been secretly delivered here.

sentences.chinese: 林明决定去取回那个被藏起来的礼物。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng jué dìng qù qǔ huí nà gè bèi cáng qǐ lái de lǐ wù.
sentences.english: Lin Ming decided to go and retrieve the gift that had been hidden.

sentences.chinese: 他想知道这个礼物是谁交给谁的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng zhī dào zhè gè lǐ wù shì shuí jiāo gěi shuí de.
sentences.english: He wanted to know who handed this gift to whom.

sentences.chinese: 他收到了一封新的信息，信息来自一个未知的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shōu dào le yī fēng xīn de xìn xī, xìn xī lái zì yī gè wèi zhī de rén.
sentences.english: He received a new message, and the message came from an unknown person.

sentences.chinese: 信息说：“你已经得到了第一块碎片。”
sentences.pinyin: Xìn xī shuō: “Nǐ yǐ jīng dé dào le dì yī kuài suì piàn.”
sentences.english: The message said: "You have already obtained the first fragment."

sentences.chinese: 接下来，林明必须去西北花园。
sentences.pinyin: Jiē xià lái, Lín Míng bì xū qù xī běi huā yuán.
sentences.english: Next, Lin Ming must go to the Northwest Garden.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，那里会有更多关于这个秘密的线索。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhī dào, nà lǐ huì yǒu gèng duō guān yú zhè gè mì mì de xiàn suǒ.
sentences.english: He knew that there would be more clues about this secret there.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十一章：西北花园的阴影
chapters.title_english: Chapter 11: Shadows of the Northwest Garden

sentences.chinese: 林明站在西北花园的门口，感到一点点害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng zhàn zài xī běi huā yuán de mén kǒu, gǎn dào yī diǎn diǎn hài pà.
sentences.english: Lin Ming stood at the entrance of the Northwest Garden, feeling a little bit afraid.

sentences.chinese: 他记得上周的时候，这里还是绿色的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì dé shàng zhōu de shí hòu, zhè lǐ hái shì lǜ sè de.
sentences.english: He remembered that last week, this place was still green.

sentences.chinese: 但现在是冬天，天气很冷，马上就要下雪了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiàn zài shì dōng tiān, tiān qì hěn lěng, mǎ shàng jiù yào xià xuě le.
sentences.english: But now it is winter, the weather is very cold, and it is about to snow.

sentences.chinese: 他想起前年夏天，他在这里见过一个年轻的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ qián nián xià tiān, tā zài zhè lǐ jiàn guò yī gè nián qīng de rén.
sentences.english: He recalled the summer of the year before last, when he had seen a young person here.

sentences.chinese: 那个人头发很长，看起来像个艺术家。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén tóu fa hěn cháng, kàn qǐ lái xiàng gè yì shù jiā.
sentences.english: That person had very long hair and looked like an artist.

sentences.chinese: 林明看着手机上的地图，西北花园在城市的东南方向，这里很安静。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng kàn zhe shǒu jī shàng de dì tú, xī běi huā yuán zài chéng shì de dōng nán fāng xiàng, zhè lǐ hěn ān jìng.
sentences.english: Lin Ming looked at the map on his phone; the Northwest Garden was in the southeast direction of the city, and it was very quiet.

sentences.chinese: 花园里到处都是枯萎的花，它们在风中摇摆。
sentences.pinyin: Huā yuán lǐ dào chù dōu shì kū wěi de huā, tā men zài fēng zhōng yáo bǎi.
sentences.english: Everywhere in the garden were withered flowers, and they were swaying in the wind.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一个旧的牌子，上面写着这里以前是出租给人们做研究的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào yī gè jiù de pái zi, shàng miàn xiě zhe zhè lǐ yǐ qián shì chū zū gěi rén men zuò yán jiū de dì fang.
sentences.english: He saw an old sign that said this place was previously rented to people for research.

sentences.chinese: 牌子上的句子很奇怪，像是一种常用代码。
sentences.pinyin: Pái zi shàng de jù zi hěn qí guài, xiàng shì yī zhǒng cháng yòng dài mǎ.
sentences.english: The sentence on the sign was very strange, like a commonly used code.

sentences.chinese: 林明想，如果这里有亿万块钱的秘密，为什么没有人发现？
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎng, rú guǒ zhè lǐ yǒu yì wàn kuài qián de mì mì, wèi shén me méi yǒu rén fā xiàn?
sentences.english: Lin Ming thought, if there were secrets worth hundreds of millions here, why had no one discovered them?

sentences.chinese: 他突然想起，上周周末他听过一个故事，说这里曾有几千个人排队寻找宝藏。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tū rán xiǎng qǐ, shàng zhōu zhōu mò tā tīng guò yī gè gù shi, shuō zhè lǐ céng yǒu jǐ qiān gè rén pái duì xún zhǎo bǎo zàng.
sentences.english: He suddenly remembered a story he heard last weekend, saying that thousands of people once lined up here searching for treasure.

sentences.chinese: 但现在，这里的人数几乎是零。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiàn zài, zhè lǐ de rén shù jī hū shì líng.
sentences.english: But now, the number of people here was almost zero.

sentences.chinese: 他拿出手机，突然电话响了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū shǒu jī, tū rán diàn huà xiǎng le.
sentences.english: He took out his phone, and suddenly it rang.

sentences.chinese: “喂？”林明紧张地问。
sentences.pinyin: “Wéi?” Lín Míng jǐn zhāng de wèn.
sentences.english: "Hello?" Lin Ming asked nervously.

sentences.chinese: 电话那边是一个低沉的声音，说：“你已经迟到了十分钟。”
sentences.pinyin: Diàn huà nà biān shì yī gè dī chén de shēng yīn, shuō: “Nǐ yǐ jīng chí dào le shí fēn zhōng.”
sentences.english: The voice on the other end was deep and said, "You are already ten minutes late."

sentences.chinese: 林明感到心跳加快，他不知道这个神秘的人是谁。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng gǎn dào xīn tiào jiā kuài, tā bù zhī dào zhè gè shén mì de rén shì shuí.
sentences.english: Lin Ming felt his heart race; he didn't know who this mysterious person was.

sentences.chinese: 对方说，下周他会给出更多的线索，但现在他必须找到那个箱子。
sentences.pinyin: Duì fāng shuō, xià zhōu tā huì gěi chū gèng duō de xiàn suǒ, dàn xiàn zài tā bì xū zhǎo dào nà gè xiāng zi.
sentences.english: The other party said that next week he would provide more clues, but for now, he must find that box.

sentences.chinese: 林明看着周围，发现一个奇怪的黑色盒子，它就在树下。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng kàn zhe zhōu wéi, fā xiàn yī gè qí guài de hēi sè hé zi, tā jiù zài shù xià.
sentences.english: Lin Ming looked around and found a strange black box; it was right under a tree.

sentences.chinese: 他走过去，发现盒子很便宜，看起来像个普通的塑料盒。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu guò qù, fā xiàn hé zi hěn pián yi, kàn qǐ lái xiàng gè pǔ tōng de sù liào hé.
sentences.english: He walked over and found the box was cheap, looking like an ordinary plastic box.

sentences.chinese: 但盒子上面写着一个数字：一万。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn hé zi shàng miàn xiě zhe yī gè shù zì: yī wàn.
sentences.english: But on the box was written a number: ten thousand.

sentences.chinese: 林明想，这个数字代表什么？
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎng, zhè gè shù zì dài biǎo shén me?
sentences.english: Lin Ming wondered, what does this number represent?

sentences.chinese: 他尝试打开盒子，但锁很紧，他担心会把它弄假，或者弄坏它。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cháng shì dǎ kāi hé zi, dàn suǒ hěn jǐn, tā dān xīn huì bǎ tā nòng jiǎ, huò zhě nòng huài tā.
sentences.english: He tried to open the box, but the lock was tight; he worried he might make it fake (break it/tamper with it) or ruin it.

sentences.chinese: 他心想：如果打不开，我该怎么办？
sentences.pinyin: Tā xīn xiǎng: rú guǒ dǎ bù kāi, wǒ gāi zěn me bàn?
sentences.english: He thought to himself: if I can't open it, what should I do?

sentences.chinese: 他想起地球上有很多类似的秘密，但这个最让他紧张。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ dì qiú shàng yǒu hěn duō lèi sì de mì mì, dàn zhè gè zuì ràng tā jǐn zhāng.
sentences.english: He thought about how there are many similar secrets on Earth, but this one made him the most nervous.

sentences.chinese: 他试着提了一下盒子，发现里面有东西在动。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì zhe tí le yī xià hé zi, fā xiàn lǐ miàn yǒu dōng xi zài dòng.
sentences.english: He tried to lift the box and found something moving inside.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这个发现挺好，因为这证明线索是真的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué dé zhè gè fā xiàn tǐng hǎo, yīn wèi zhè zhèng míng xiàn suǒ shì zhēn de.
sentences.english: He felt this discovery was very good, because it proved the clue was real.

sentences.chinese: 他小心地打开盒子，发现里面是一张旧照片和一张纸条。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎo xīn de dǎ kāi hé zi, fā xiàn lǐ miàn shì yī zhāng jiù zhào piàn hé yī zhāng zhǐ tiáo.
sentences.english: He carefully opened the box and found an old photo and a slip of paper inside.

sentences.chinese: 纸条上写着：“碎片就在你的脚下。”
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐ tiáo shàng xiě zhe: “Suì piàn jiù zài nǐ de jiǎo xià.”
sentences.english: The paper said: "The fragment is right beneath your feet."

sentences.chinese: 林明低头看去，发现地上的泥土被挖开了一点点。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng dī tóu kàn qù, fā xiàn dì shàng de ní tǔ bèi wā kāi le yī diǎn diǎn.
sentences.english: Lin Ming looked down and found the soil on the ground had been dug up a little bit.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，那个黑色的影子再次出现在他的身后。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, nà gè hēi sè de yǐng zi zài cì chū xiàn zài tā de shēn hòu.
sentences.english: Just then, that black shadow appeared behind him once again.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十二章：西南院的秘密
chapters.title_english: Chapter 12: The Secret of the Southwest Courtyard

sentences.chinese: 林明感到背后的冷风吹在身上，就像冬天的温度在零下一样。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng gǎndào bèihòu de lěngfēng chuī zài shēnshang, jiù xiàng dōngtiān de wēndù zài língxià yīyàng.
sentences.english: Lin Ming felt the cold wind blowing on his back, just as if the winter temperature were below zero.

sentences.chinese: 他慢慢地转过身，眼睛看着那个黑色的影子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mànmàn de zhuǎn guò shēn, yǎnjing kànzhe nàge hēisè de yǐngzi.
sentences.english: He slowly turned around, his eyes looking at the black shadow.

sentences.chinese: 那个影子不再走近，而是停在月亮的光下面。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge yǐngzi bù zài zǒujìn, érshì tíng zài yuèliang de guāng xiàmiàn.
sentences.english: The shadow no longer approached but stopped under the light of the moon.

sentences.chinese: 影子开口说话了，他的声音很奇怪，像是在讲一个古老的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐngzi kāikǒu shuōhuà le, tā de shēngyīn hěn qíguài, xiàng shì zài jiǎng yīgè gǔlǎo de gùshì.
sentences.english: The shadow began to speak; his voice was strange, as if he were telling an old story.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“林明，你终于来到了这里。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Lín Míng, nǐ zhōngyú láidào le zhèlǐ.”
sentences.english: He said, "Lin Ming, you have finally arrived here."

sentences.chinese: 林明问他：“你是谁？你为什么老是跟着我？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng wèn tā: “Nǐ shì shuí? Nǐ wèishéme lǎoshì gēnzhe wǒ?”
sentences.english: Lin Ming asked him, "Who are you? Why are you always following me?"

sentences.chinese: 影子笑了，他说：“我叫海，一个在秘密中长大的人。”
sentences.pinyin: Yǐngzi xiào le, tā shuō: “Wǒ jiào Hǎi, yīgè zài mìmì zhōng zhǎngdà de rén.”
sentences.english: The shadow smiled and said, "My name is Hai, a person who grew up amidst secrets."

sentences.chinese: 海告诉林明，这个秘密关于两个家族，一个姓海，一个姓鱼。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi gàosù Lín Míng, zhège mìmì guānyú liǎng gè jiāzú, yīgè xìng Hǎi, yīgè xìng Yú.
sentences.english: Hai told Lin Ming that this secret concerned two families, one surnamed Hai and one surnamed Yu.

sentences.chinese: 林明认为这是一个很复杂的难题，因为他之前没见过这些人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng rènwéi zhè shì yīgè hěn fùzá de nántí, yīnwèi tā zhīqián méi jiànguò zhèxiē rén.
sentences.english: Lin Ming believed this was a very complex difficult problem because he had not seen these people before.

sentences.chinese: 海说：“如果你有空儿的话，我可以告诉你更多。”
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ yǒukòngr de huà, wǒ kěyǐ gàosù nǐ gèng duō.”
sentences.english: Hai said, "If you are available, I can tell you more."

sentences.chinese: 林明点头，想知道真相。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng diǎntóu, xiǎng zhīdào zhēnxiàng.
sentences.english: Lin Ming nodded, wanting to know the truth.

sentences.chinese: 海指了指花园的西南方向，那里有一个破旧的小院。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi zhǐ le zhǐ huāyuán de xīnán fāngxiàng, nàlǐ yǒu yīgè pòjiù de xiǎo yuàn.
sentences.english: Hai pointed toward the southwest of the garden, where there was a dilapidated small courtyard.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“比如说，你可以看看那个院子里的旧井。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Bǐrúshuō, nǐ kěyǐ kànkan nàge yuànzi lǐ de jiù jǐng.”
sentences.english: He said, "For example, you could look at the old well in that courtyard."

sentences.chinese: 林明记得，在秋天的时候，这里的景色很美，但现在看起来很可怕。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng jìde, zài qiūtiān de shíhou, zhèlǐ de jǐngsè hěn měi, dàn xiànzài kàn qǐlái hěn kěpà.
sentences.english: Lin Ming remembered that in autumn, the scenery here was beautiful, but now it looked terrifying.

sentences.chinese: 海继续说：“很多年前，我们在过年的时候发现了一个秘密。”
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi jìxù shuō: “Hěnduō nián qián, wǒmen zài guònián de shíhou fāxiàn le yīgè mìmì.”
sentences.english: Hai continued, "Many years ago, we discovered a secret during the Chinese New Year."

sentences.chinese: 林明觉得海在讲一个笑话儿，因为这太奇怪了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng juéde Hǎi zài jiǎng yīgè xiàohuar, yīnwèi zhè tài qíguài le.
sentences.english: Lin Ming felt that Hai was telling a joke because this was too strange.

sentences.chinese: 但随着海的讲述，林明发现情况越来越危险。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn suízhe Hǎi de jiǎngshù, Lín Míng fāxiàn qíngkuàng yuèláiyuè wēixiǎn.
sentences.english: But as Hai narrated, Lin Ming found the situation becoming more and more dangerous.

sentences.chinese: 这时，海突然问他：“你觉得现在的情况怎么样？”
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, Hǎi tūrán wèn tā: “Nǐ juéde xiànzài de qíngkuàng zěnmeyàng?”
sentences.english: At this moment, Hai suddenly asked him, "How do you think the current situation is?"

sentences.chinese: 林明还没回答，就听到院子后面传来了沉重的脚步声。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng hái méi huídá, jiù tīngdào yuànzi hòumiàn chuánlái le chénzhòng de jiǎobùshēng.
sentences.english: Before Lin Ming could answer, he heard heavy footsteps coming from behind the courtyard.

sentences.chinese: 那个声音在关键的节骨眼上出现了，打断了他们的对话。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge shēngyīn zài guānjiàn de jiégǔyǎn shàng chūxiàn le, dǎduàn le tāmen de duìhuà.
sentences.english: That sound appeared at the critical juncture, interrupting their conversation.

sentences.chinese: 林明在阴影中突然见到一个人影，那个人拿着一把巨大的剪刀。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng zài yīnyǐng zhōng tūrán jiàndào yīgè rényǐng, nàge rén názhe yī bǎ jùdà de jiǎndāo.
sentences.english: Lin Ming suddenly saw a figure in the shadows; that person was holding a pair of huge scissors.

sentences.chinese: 那个人看向林明，眼神冷酷，像是在寻找丢失的东西。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge rén kànxiàng Lín Míng, yǎnshén lěngkù, xiàng shì zài xúnzhǎo diūshī de dōngxi.
sentences.english: The person looked at Lin Ming with a cold gaze, as if searching for something lost.

sentences.chinese: 林明意识到，海可能不是在帮助他，而是在引导他进入陷阱。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng yìshí dào, Hǎi kěnéng bùshì zài bāngzhù tā, ér shì zài yǐndǎo tā jìnrù xiànjǐng.
sentences.english: Lin Ming realized that Hai might not be helping him, but leading him into a trap.

sentences.chinese: 那个人影慢慢走近，林明发现他的衣服上写着一个奇怪的符号。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge rényǐng mànmàn zǒujìn, Lín Míng fāxiàn tā de yīfu shàng xiězhe yīgè qíguài de fúhào.
sentences.english: The figure slowly approached, and Lin Ming noticed a strange symbol written on his clothes.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十三章：奇怪的符号与深夜的追逐
chapters.title_english: Chapter 13: Strange Symbols and the Midnight Chase

sentences.chinese: 林明看着那个人衣服上的符号，心中感到非常害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng kànzhe nàge rén yīfú shàng de fúhào, xīnzhōng gǎndào fēicháng hàipà.
sentences.english: Lin Ming looked at the symbol on the man's clothes and felt very afraid in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 那个符号像是一部分破碎的地图。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge fúhào xiàng shì yī bùfen pòsuì de dìtú.
sentences.english: That symbol looked like a portion of a broken map.

sentences.chinese: 他想知道这个符号的主人是谁。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng zhīdào zhège fúhào de zhǔrén shì shéi.
sentences.english: He wanted to know who the owner of this symbol was.

sentences.chinese: 这件衣服看起来很旧，像是在北方的地方穿的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfú kàn qǐlái hěn jiù, xiàng shì zài běifāng de dìfāng chuān de.
sentences.english: This item of clothing looked very old, as if it were worn in the north.

sentences.chinese: 现在已经是半夜了，周围非常安静。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài yǐjīng shì bànyè le, zhōuwéi fēicháng ānjìng.
sentences.english: It was already midnight, and the surroundings were very quiet.

sentences.chinese: 林明记得，海曾经在单位工作，但那个单位的名称很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng jìdé, Hǎi céngjīng zài dānwèi gōngzuò, dàn nàge dānwèi de míngchēng hěn qíguài.
sentences.english: Lin Ming remembered that Hai once worked at a unit, but the name of that unit was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 海告诉他，他以前住在南方，那里天气很热。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi gàosù tā, tā yǐqián zhù zài nánfāng, nàlǐ tiānqì hěn rè.
sentences.english: Hai told him that he used to live in the south, where the weather was very hot.

sentences.chinese: 在那名陌生人面前，林明突然觉得咱们必须快点离开这里。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nà míng mòshēng rén miànqián, Lín Míng tūrán juédé zánmen bìxū kuài diǎn líkāi zhèlǐ.
sentences.english: In front of that one stranger, Lin Ming suddenly felt that we must leave this place quickly.

sentences.chinese: 这场危险的相遇让林明无法思考。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cháng wēixiǎn de xiāngyù ràng Lín Míng wúfǎ sīkǎo.
sentences.english: This dangerous encounter left Lin Ming unable to think.

sentences.chinese: 他看到对面有一家店，店里正在准备外卖。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào duìmiàn yǒu yījiā diàn, diàn lǐ zhèngzài zhǔnbèi wàimài.
sentences.english: He saw a shop opposite, and the shop was preparing takeout.

sentences.chinese: 很多外地的人喜欢来这里旅游。
sentences.pinyin: Hěnduō wàidì de rén xǐhuān lái zhèlǐ lǚyóu.
sentences.english: Many people from other places like to come here for travel.

sentences.chinese: 林明想起过一位太太，她是海的爱人，但她已经失踪很多日子了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎngqǐ guò yī wèi tàitai, tā shì Hǎi de àirén, dàn tā yǐjīng shīzōng hěnduō rìzi le.
sentences.english: Lin Ming remembered a lady, she was Hai's spouse, but she had been missing for many days.

sentences.chinese: 林明希望那个陌生人是个好人，但对方手中的剪刀告诉他不是。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xīwàng nàge mòshēng rén shì gè hǎorén, dàn duìfāng shǒuzhōng de jiǎndāo gàosù tā bùshì.
sentences.english: Lin Ming hoped that the stranger was a good person, but the scissors in the other's hand told him otherwise.

sentences.chinese: 他快步走向街道，对面有一家超市，那里有很多行人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kuàibù zǒuxiàng jiēdào, duìmiàn yǒu yījiā chāoshì, nàlǐ yǒu hěnduō xíngrén.
sentences.english: He walked quickly toward the street, and there was a supermarket opposite with many pedestrians.

sentences.chinese: 在心中，林明知道自己需要一个有才的人来帮助他。
sentences.pinyin: Zài xīnzhōng, Lín Míng zhīdào zìjǐ xūyào yīgè yǒu cái de rén lái bāngzhù tā.
sentences.english: In his heart, Lin Ming knew he needed a capable person to help him.

sentences.chinese: 天空中有几颗星星，但云很快遮住了它们。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānkōng zhōng yǒu jǐ kē xīngxing, dàn yún hěn kuài zhēzhù le tāmen.
sentences.english: There were a few stars in the sky, but clouds quickly covered them.

sentences.chinese: 他记得在昨天的晚报上看到过一个新闻，说这里流行一种奇怪的疾病。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìdé zài zuótiān de wǎnbào shàng kàndào guò yīgè xīnwén, shuō zhèlǐ liúxíng yī zhǒng qíguài de jíbìng.
sentences.english: He remembered seeing a news report in yesterday's evening newspaper saying that a strange disease was spreading here.

sentences.chinese: 陌生人开始说话，他说的是非常标准的普通话。
sentences.pinyin: Mòshēng rén kāishǐ shuōhuà, tā shuō de shì fēicháng biāozhǔn de pǔtōnghuà.
sentences.english: The stranger began to speak, and he spoke in very standard Mandarin.

sentences.chinese: 林明听到有人在后面喊他。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng tīngdào yǒurén zài hòumiàn hǎn tā.
sentences.english: Lin Ming heard someone shouting him from behind.

sentences.chinese: 在这种危险的条件下，他不能停下来。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhèzhǒng wēixiǎn de tiáojiàn xià, tā bùnéng tíng xiàlái.
sentences.english: Under these dangerous conditions, he could not stop.

sentences.chinese: 现在这种神秘的符号在很多游客之间流行起来了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài zhèzhǒng shénmì de fúhào zài hěnduō yóukè zhījiān liúxíng qǐlái le.
sentences.english: Nowadays, this kind of mysterious symbol has become popular among many tourists.

sentences.chinese: 海曾经提到过，他认识一名留学生，那是他的老朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi céngjīng tídào guò, tā rènshí yī míng liúxuéshēng, nà shì tā de lǎo péngyǒu.
sentences.english: Hai had once mentioned that he knew an exchange student, who was an old friend of his.

sentences.chinese: 这个留学生曾经是一名考生，准备去西方留学。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège liúxuéshēng céngjīng shì yī míng kǎoshēng, zhǔnbèi qù xīfāng liúxué.
sentences.english: This exchange student had once been an exam candidate preparing to study in the West.

sentences.chinese: 林明低头看，发现自己的脚在发抖。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng dītóu kàn, fāxiàn zìjǐ de jiǎo zài fǎdòu.
sentences.english: Lin Ming looked down and found his feet were shaking.

sentences.chinese: 他看到路边有一个表，时间在慢慢走。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào lùbiān yǒu yīgè biǎo, shíjiān zài mànmàn zǒu.
sentences.english: He saw a clock on the roadside, and time was moving slowly.

sentences.chinese: 他试图想起一个能描述这个符号的词语，但想不起来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shìtú xiǎngqǐ yīgè néng miáoshù zhège fúhào de cíyǔ, dàn xiǎng bù qǐlái.
sentences.english: He tried to think of a term that could describe this symbol, but he couldn't remember one.

sentences.chinese: 陌生人突然说：“如果你能帮我，我可以请客，带你去最好的酒店。”
sentences.pinyin: Mòshēng rén tūrán shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ néng bāng wǒ, wǒ kěyǐ qǐngkè, dài nǐ qù zuì hǎo de jiǔdiàn.”
sentences.english: The stranger suddenly said, "If you can help me, I can treat you and take you to the best hotel."

sentences.chinese: 林明知道，那个酒店里可能有酒，但现在不是喝酒的时候。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng zhīdào, nàge jiǔdiàn lǐ kěnéng yǒu jiǔ, dàn xiànzài bùshì hējiǔ de shíhòu.
sentences.english: Lin Ming knew that there might be liquor in that hotel, but now was not the time for drinking.

sentences.chinese: 他迅速跑向超市，试图在人群中消失。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xùnsù pǎo xiàng chāoshì, shìtú zài rénqún zhōng xiāoshī.
sentences.english: He quickly ran toward the supermarket, attempting to disappear into the crowd.

sentences.chinese: 他想起海说过，这个秘密涉及一个巨大的组织。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ Hǎi shuō guò, zhège mìmì shèjí yīgè jùdà de zǔzhī.
sentences.english: He remembered Hai saying that this secret involved a huge organization.

sentences.chinese: 那个组织在北方和南方都有人。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge zǔzhī zài běifāng hé nánfāng dōu yǒu rén.
sentences.english: That organization had people in both the north and the south.

sentences.chinese: 林明现在只想要安全。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiànzài zhǐ xiǎng yào ānquán.
sentences.english: Lin Ming only wanted safety now.

sentences.chinese: 他再次回头看，那个拿着剪刀的人还在跟着他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zàicì huítóu kàn, nàge názhe jiǎndāo de rén hái zài gēnzhe tā.
sentences.english: He looked back again, and the man holding the scissors was still following him.

sentences.chinese: 那个人的眼神依然冷酷，像是在寻找丢失的碎片。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge rén de yǎnshén yīrán lěngkù, xiàng shì zài xúnzhǎo diūshī de suìpiàn.
sentences.english: That man's gaze was still cold, as if he were searching for the lost fragment.

sentences.chinese: 林明意识到，海引导他来到这里，可能真的就是一个陷阱。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng yìshí dào, Hǎi yǐndǎo tā lái dào zhèlǐ, kěnéng zhēn de jiùshì yīgè xiànjǐng.
sentences.english: Lin Ming realized that Hai guiding him here might truly be a trap.

sentences.chinese: 他必须在被抓住之前找到答案。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū zài bèi zhuā zhú zhīqián zhǎodào dá'àn.
sentences.english: He had to find the answer before being caught.

sentences.chinese: 他跑进了一条小巷，那里非常黑暗。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pǎo jìn le yī tiáo xiǎoxiàng, nàlǐ fēicháng hēi'àn.
sentences.english: He ran into a small alley, which was very dark.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他听到身后传来了沉重的脚步声。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, tā tīngdào shēnhòu chuánlái le chénzhòng de jiǎobù shēng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, he heard heavy footsteps coming from behind him.

sentences.chinese: 他感觉到一个冰冷的东西碰到了他的后背。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎnjué dào yīgè bīnglěng de dōngxī pèng dào le tā de hòubèi.
sentences.english: He felt something cold touch his back.

sentences.chinese: 林明闭上眼睛，心跳得飞快。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng bì shàng yǎnjīng, xīntiào dé fēikuài.
sentences.english: Lin Ming closed his eyes, his heart beating wildly.

sentences.chinese: 林明突然睁开眼睛，发现那个冰冷的东西是一封信。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng tū rán zhēng kāi yǎn jīng, fā xiàn nà gè bīng lěng de dōng xī shì yī fēng xìn.
sentences.english: Lin Ming suddenly opened his eyes and discovered that the cold object was a letter.

sentences.chinese: 他迅速跑到一个安静的院子里面。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xùn sù pǎo dào yī gè ānjìng de yuàn zi lǐ miàn.
sentences.english: He quickly ran into a quiet courtyard.

sentences.chinese: 这里的空气特别凉，让他冷静了下来。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de kōng qì tè bié liáng, ràng tā lěng jìng le xià lái.
sentences.english: The air here was particularly cool, which helped him calm down.

sentences.chinese: 他打开信，发现里面有一张名单。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dǎ kāi xìn, fā xiàn lǐ miàn yǒu yī zhāng míng dān.
sentences.english: He opened the letter and found a list inside.

sentences.chinese: 这张名单上写了很多人的姓名。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng míng dān shàng xiě le hěn duō rén de xìng míng.
sentences.english: This list had many people's full names written on it.

sentences.chinese: 这些名字看起来像是一个秘密组织的成员。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiē míng zi kàn qǐ lái xiàng shì yī gè mì mì zǔ zhī de chéng yuán.
sentences.english: These names looked like members of a secret organization.

sentences.chinese: 名单的第一行写着：东方先生。
sentences.pinyin: Míng dān de dì yī háng xiě zhe: Dōng fāng xiān sheng.
sentences.english: The first line of the list read: Mr. Dongfang.

sentences.chinese: 接着是全先生、加先生和向先生。
sentences.pinyin: Jiē zhe shì Quán xiān sheng, Jiā xiān sheng hé Xiàng xiān sheng.
sentences.english: Following that were Mr. Quan, Mr. Jia, and Mr. Xiang.

sentences.chinese: 然后是封先生、成先生和查先生。
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu shì Fēng xiān sheng, Chéng xiān sheng hé Zhā xiān sheng.
sentences.english: Then there were Mr. Feng, Mr. Cheng, and Mr. Zha.

sentences.chinese: 林明继续看，还有段先生、红先生和组先生。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng jì xù kàn, hái yǒu Duàn xiān sheng, Hóng xiān sheng hé Zǔ xiān sheng.
sentences.english: Lin Ming continued reading; there were also Mr. Duan, Mr. Hong, and Mr. Zu.

sentences.chinese: 名单的最后一部分有蓝先生、角先生、闻先生、题先生和黄先生。
sentences.pinyin: Míng dān de zuì hòu yī bù fèn yǒu Lán xiān sheng, Jué xiān sheng, Wén xiān sheng, Tí xiān sheng hé Huáng xiān sheng.
sentences.english: The final part of the list had Mr. Lan, Mr. Jue, Mr. Wen, Mr. Ti, and Mr. Huang.

sentences.chinese: 林明实在太惊讶了，这些名字他以前听过。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng shí zài tài jīng yà le, zhè xiē míng zi tā yǐ qián tīng guò.
sentences.english: Lin Ming was really too surprised; he had heard these names before.

sentences.chinese: 他想知道这些人怎样会出现在这里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng zhī dào zhè xiē rén zěn yàng huì chū xiàn zài zhè lǐ.
sentences.english: He wanted to know how these people could appear here.

sentences.chinese: 这样奇怪的名单一定有某种特殊的意义。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè yàng qí guài de míng dān yī dìng yǒu mǒu zhǒng tè shū de yì yì.
sentences.english: Such a strange list must have some special meaning.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他听到院子外面传来了鸡的叫声。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, tā tīng dào yuàn zi wài miàn chuán lái le jī de jiào shēng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, he heard the sound of a chicken calling from outside the courtyard.

sentences.chinese: 这是一个很奇怪的时间，因为现在是深夜。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yī gè hěn qí guài de shí jiān, yīn wèi xiàn zài shì shēn yè.
sentences.english: This was a very strange time, because it was now midnight.

sentences.chinese: 林明意识到，有人在用这种方式提醒他。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng yì shí dào, yǒu rén zài yòng zhè zhǒng fāng shì tí xǐng tā.
sentences.english: Lin Ming realized that someone was using this method to alert him.

sentences.chinese: 他低头看信的背面，发现那里有一个小的符号。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dī tóu kàn xìn de bèi miàn, fā xiàn nà lǐ yǒu yī gè xiǎo de fú hào.
sentences.english: He looked down at the back of the letter and found a small symbol there.

sentences.chinese: 这个符号和那个黑色影子衣服上的符号一模一样。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè fú hào hé nà gè hēi sè yǐng zi yī fú shàng de fú hào yī mó yī yàng.
sentences.english: This symbol was exactly the same as the symbol on the black shadow's clothes.

sentences.chinese: 林明感觉到危险再次靠近了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng gǎn jué dào wēi xiǎn zài cì kào jìn le.
sentences.english: Lin Ming felt danger approaching once again.

sentences.chinese: 他听到墙后面有人在低声说话。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīng dào qiáng hòu miàn yǒu rén zài dī shēng shuō huà.
sentences.english: He heard someone speaking in a low voice behind the wall.

sentences.chinese: 他屏住呼吸，慢慢地向墙边走去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǐng zhù hū xī, màn màn de xiàng qiáng biān zǒu qù.
sentences.english: He held his breath and slowly walked toward the wall.

sentences.chinese: 就在他准备听清楚的时候，一只手突然抓住了他的肩膀。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tā zhǔn bèi tīng qīng chǔ de shí hòu, yī zhī shǒu tū rán zhuā zhù le tā de jiān bǎng.
sentences.english: Just as he was preparing to hear clearly, a hand suddenly grabbed his shoulder.

sentences.chinese: 林明吓了一跳，他快点儿回头看。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xià le yī tiào, tā kuài diǎn r huí tóu kàn.
sentences.english: Lin Ming was startled and quickly looked back.

sentences.chinese: 抓住他的是海，海的脸挺严肃的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuā zhù tā de shì Hǎi, Hǎi de liǎn tǐng yán sù de.
sentences.english: The person who grabbed him was Hai, and Hai's face was quite serious.

sentences.chinese: 海低声说：“快走，这里不安全。”
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi dī shēng shuō: “Kuài zǒu, zhè lǐ bù ān quán.”
sentences.english: Hai whispered, "Move quickly, it's not safe here."

sentences.chinese: 他们跑到一个安静的房间里，此时是早晨三点一刻。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men pǎo dào yī gè ānjìng de fáng jiān lǐ, cǐ shí shì zǎo chén sān diǎn yī kè.
sentences.english: They ran into a quiet room; it was 3:15 in the early morning.

sentences.chinese: 房间里有一股奇怪的味道，像是一种药水的感觉。
sentences.pinyin: Fáng jiān lǐ yǒu yī gǔ qí guài de wèi dao, xiàng shì yī zhǒng yào shuǐ de gǎn jué.
sentences.english: There was a strange smell in the room, a sensation like some kind of medicinal liquid.

sentences.chinese: 林明发现桌子上有一份秘密文件和一本旧字典。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng fā xiàn zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī fèn mì mì wén jiàn hé yī běn jiù zì diǎn.
sentences.english: Lin Ming discovered a secret document and an old character dictionary on the table.

sentences.chinese: 文件里有一篇关于克罗地亚和越南的报告，上面写着“克”和“越”两个字。
sentences.pinyin: Wén jiàn lǐ yǒu yī piān guān yú Kè luó dì yà hé Yuè nán de bào gào, shàng miàn xiě zhe “Kè” hé “Yuè” liǎng gè zì.
sentences.english: In the document, there was a report about Croatia and Vietnam, with the characters 'Ke' and 'Yue' written on it.

sentences.chinese: 林明看到文件旁边还有一本词典，他在寻找一些生词的读音。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng kàn dào wén jiàn páng biān hái yǒu yī běn cí diǎn, tā zài xún zhǎo yī xiē shēng cí de dú yīn.
sentences.english: Lin Ming saw a dictionary next to the document; he was looking for the pronunciation of some new words.

sentences.chinese: 海告诉他，一个来自黑龙江的人在这里干活儿，那个人留下了很多笔记。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi gào sù tā, yī gè lái zì Hēi lóng jiāng de rén zài zhè lǐ gàn huó r, nà gè rén liú xià le hěn duō bǐ jì.
sentences.english: Hai told him that a person from Heilongjiang worked here, and that person had left many notes.

sentences.chinese: 笔记里有一张黄色的画，画的是一个太阳。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐ jì lǐ yǒu yī zhāng huáng sè de huà, huà de shì yī gè tài yang.
sentences.english: In the notes, there was a yellow painting of a sun.

sentences.chinese: 林明用笔在纸上画了一个圈，他觉得这是一个重要的线索。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng yòng bǐ zài zhǐ shàng huà le yī gè quān, tā jué de zhè shì yī gè zhòng yào de xiàn suǒ.
sentences.english: Lin Ming used a pen to draw a circle on the paper; he felt this was an important clue.

sentences.chinese: 他拿起相机，对着那张画拍了一张照片。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná qǐ xiàng jī, duì zhe nà zhāng huà pāi le yī zhāng zhào piàn.
sentences.english: He picked up the camera and took a photo of the painting.

sentences.chinese: 海说：“这不是好事，那个黑色的影子可能在找这个。”
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi shuō: “Zhè bú shì hǎo shì, nà gè hēi sè de yǐng zi kě néng zài zhǎo zhè gè.”
sentences.english: Hai said, "This is not a good thing; that black shadow might be looking for this."

sentences.chinese: 林明注意到笔记里提到了一些药片，似乎是为了治疗某种病。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng zhù yì dào bǐ jì lǐ tí dào le yī xiē yào piàn, sì hū shì wèi le zhì liáo mǒu zhǒng bìng.
sentences.english: Lin Ming noticed that the notes mentioned some tablets, seemingly to treat some kind of illness.

sentences.chinese: 他仔细看，发现笔记的一页被撕掉了，只剩下一个小小的眼孔。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǐ xì kàn, fā xiàn bǐ jì de yī yè bèi sī diào le, zhǐ shèng xià yī gè xiǎo xiǎo de yǎn kǒng.
sentences.english: He looked closely and found that a page of the notes had been torn out, leaving only a small hole.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果能找到丢失的那一页，事情会更清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rú guǒ néng zhǎo dào diū shī de nà yī yè, shì qíng huì gèng qīng chǔ.
sentences.english: He thought that if he could find the missing page, things would be clearer.

sentences.chinese: 海突然肚子饿了，他说他想吃饺子。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi tū rán dù zi è le, tā shuō tā xiǎng chī jiǎo zi.
sentences.english: Hai suddenly got hungry and said he wanted to eat dumplings.

sentences.chinese: 林明觉得现在不是吃饭的时间，但海坚持要走。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng jué de xiàn zài bú shì chī fàn de shí jiān, dàn Hǎi jiān chí yào zǒu.
sentences.english: Lin Ming felt it wasn't the time to eat, but Hai insisted on leaving.

sentences.chinese: 他们走出房间，阳光开始出现，太阳升起来了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zǒu chū fáng jiān, yáng guāng kāi shǐ chū xiàn, tài yang shēng qǐ lái le.
sentences.english: They walked out of the room; sunlight began to appear, and the sun rose.

sentences.chinese: 林明看着相机里的照片，思考着那个符号的意义。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng kàn zhe xiàng jī lǐ de zhào piàn, sī kǎo zhe nà gè fú hào de yì yì.
sentences.english: Lin Ming looked at the photos in the camera, pondering the meaning of the symbol.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，这个秘密比他想象的要复杂得多。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, zhè gè mì mì bǐ tā xiǎng xiàng de yào fù zá dé duō.
sentences.english: He realized that this secret was much more complex than he had imagined.

sentences.chinese: 就在他们准备离开时，林明在地上发现了一个奇怪的笔盖。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tā men zhǔn bèi lí kāi shí, Lín Míng zài dì shàng fā xiàn le yī gè qí guài de bǐ gài.
sentences.english: Just as they were preparing to leave, Lin Ming found a strange pen cap on the ground.

sentences.chinese: 这个笔盖的颜色是深蓝色的，但上面有黄色的痕迹。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè bǐ gài de yán sè shì shēn lán sè de, dàn shàng miàn yǒu huáng sè de hén jì.
sentences.english: The cap was dark blue, but it had yellow marks on it.

sentences.chinese: 他记得之前在药店见过类似的颜色。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì dé zhī qián zài yào diàn jiàn guò lèi sì de yán sè.
sentences.english: He remembered seeing a similar color at the pharmacy before.

sentences.chinese: 突然，走廊里传来了沉重的脚步声。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, zǒu láng lǐ chuán lái le chén zhòng de jiǎo bù shēng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, heavy footsteps echoed in the corridor.

sentences.chinese: 那个黑色的影子再次出现了，而且这次他手里拿着一把钥匙。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè hēi sè de yǐng zi zài cì chū xiàn le, ér qiě zhè cì tā shǒu lǐ ná zhe yī bǎ yào shi.
sentences.english: The black shadow appeared again, and this time he was holding a key.

sentences.chinese: 影子对着林明冷冷地笑了，然后指向了那个房间。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi duì zhe Lín Míng lěng lěng de xiào le, rán hòu zhǐ xiàng le nà gè fáng jiān.
sentences.english: The shadow smiled coldly at Lin Ming and then pointed toward the room.

sentences.chinese: 林明感觉心跳得很快，他知道自己陷入了更大的陷阱。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng gǎn jué xīn tiào dé hěn kuài, tā zhī dào zì jǐ xiàn rù le gèng dà de xiàn jǐng.
sentences.english: Lin Ming felt his heart beating fast; he knew he had fallen into an even bigger trap.

sentences.chinese: 海拉住他，低声说：“快跑！”
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi lā zhù tā, dī shēng shuō: “Kuài pǎo!”
sentences.english: Hai pulled him and whispered, "Run!"

chapters.title_chinese: 第十六章：旧房间的秘密
chapters.title_english: Chapter 16: Secrets of the Old Room

sentences.chinese: 林明和海在走廊里快跑。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng hé Hǎi zài zǒuláng lǐ kuài pǎo.
sentences.english: Lin Ming and Hai ran quickly in the corridor.

sentences.chinese: 他们刚刚逃离那个黑色的影子。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen gānggāng táolí nàge hēisè de yǐngzi.
sentences.english: They had just escaped from that black shadow.

sentences.chinese: 刚才的情况太可怕了，林明觉得心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Gāngcái de qíngkuàng tài kěpà le, Lín Míng juéde xīntiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: The situation just now was too terrifying; Lin Ming felt his heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 他们跑进了一个旧房间，门关上了。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen pǎo jìn le yī gè jiù fángjiān, mén guān shàng le.
sentences.english: They ran into an old room, and the door closed.

sentences.chinese: 林明看着这个房间，觉得这里一般，没有什么特别的。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng kànzhe zhège fángjiān, juéde zhèlǐ yībān, méiyǒu shéme tèbié de.
sentences.english: Lin Ming looked at the room and felt it was ordinary, with nothing special.

sentences.chinese: 但是海说：“这里以前是一个办公室。”
sentences.pinyin: Dànshì Hǎi shuō: “Zhèlǐ yǐqián shì yī gè bàngōngshì.”
sentences.english: But Hai said, "This used to be an office."

sentences.chinese: 林明在桌子上发现了一些旧文件。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng zài zhuōzi shàng fāxiàn le yīxiē jiù wénjiàn.
sentences.english: Lin Ming found some old documents on the table.

sentences.chinese: 文件里写着一些名字，其中有一个名字是林明的父亲。
sentences.pinyin: Wénjiàn lǐ xiězhe yīxiē míngzì, qízhōng yǒu yī gè míngzì shì Lín Míng de fùqīn.
sentences.english: There were some names in the documents, among which one name was Lin Ming's father.

sentences.chinese: 林明从小就想知道父亲的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng cóngxiǎo jiù xiǎng zhīdào fùqīn de mìmì.
sentences.english: Lin Ming had wanted to know his father's secrets from childhood.

sentences.chinese: 他小时候经常问母亲关于父亲的事情，但母亲不说话。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎoshíhou jīngcháng wèn mǔqīn guānyú fùqīn de shìqíng, dàn mǔqīn bù shuōhuà.
sentences.english: In his childhood, he often asked his mother about his father, but his mother didn't speak.

sentences.chinese: 林明想，也许父亲在这个房间工作过。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎng, yěxǔ fùqīn zài zhège fángjiān gōngzuò guò.
sentences.english: Lin Ming thought, perhaps his father had worked in this room.

sentences.chinese: 他看到文件下面有一些数字，例如：102、205、309。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào wénjiàn xiàmiàn yǒu yīxiē shùzì, lìrú: 102, 205, 309.
sentences.english: He saw some numbers below the documents, for example: 102, 205, 309.

sentences.chinese: 这些数字以下的部分被撕掉了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē shùzì yǐxià de bùfèn bèi sī diào le.
sentences.english: The part below these numbers had been torn off.

sentences.chinese: 林明忽然想到，这些数字可能是一个密码。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng hūrán xiǎngdào, zhèxiē shùzì kěnéng shì yī gè mìmǎ.
sentences.english: Lin Ming suddenly thought that these numbers might be a password.

sentences.chinese: 他记得小时候在书里看过类似的密码。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde xiǎoshíhou zài shū lǐ kànguò lèisì de mìmǎ.
sentences.english: He remembered seeing similar passwords in books when he was a child.

sentences.chinese: 如果这个密码正确，他们就可以打开那个箱子。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhège mìmǎ zhèngquè, tāmen jiù kěyǐ dǎkāi nàge xiāngzi.
sentences.english: If this password is correct, they can open that box.

sentences.chinese: 海看着窗外，夜里很黑，看不清外面。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi kànzhe chuāngwài, yèlǐ hěn hēi, kàn bù qīng wàimiàn.
sentences.english: Hai looked out the window; it was very dark at night, and she couldn't see outside clearly.

sentences.chinese: 她担心那个影子会回来，因为那个影子好像在寻找他们。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dānxīn nàge yǐngzi huì huílái, yīnwèi nàge yǐngzi hǎoxiàng zài xúnzhǎo tāmen.
sentences.english: She worried the shadow would return because the shadow seemed to be looking for them.

sentences.chinese: 林明想，如果他们能在这里待好久，也许能找到更多线索。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎng, rúguǒ tāmen néng zài zhèlǐ dāi hǎojiǔ, yěxǔ néng zhǎodào gèng duō xiànsuǒ.
sentences.english: Lin Ming thought that if they could stay here for quite a while, maybe they could find more clues.

sentences.chinese: 但他们不能待太久，因为影子快要找到他们了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tāmen bùnéng dāi tài jiǔ, yīnwèi yǐngzi kuàiyào zhǎodào tāmen le.
sentences.english: But they couldn't stay too long because the shadow was about to find them.

sentences.chinese: 海低声说：“我们在这里待了多久了？”
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi dīshēng shuō: “Wǒmen zài zhèlǐ dāi le duōjiǔ le?”
sentences.english: Hai whispered, "How long have we been here?"

sentences.chinese: 林明看了一下表，差不多五分钟了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng kàn le yīxià biǎo, chàbuduō wǔ fēnzhōng le.
sentences.english: Lin Ming checked his watch; it had been almost five minutes.

sentences.chinese: 他想起平时父亲总是告诉他，要细心观察。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ píngshí fùqīn zǒngshì gàosù tā, yào xìxīn guānchá.
sentences.english: He remembered that ordinarily his father always told him to observe carefully.

sentences.chinese: 当时他不懂，但现在他明白了。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngshí tā bù dǒng, dàn xiànzài tā míngbái le.
sentences.english: At that time he didn't understand, but now he understands.

sentences.chinese: 原来，这个房间是父亲留给他的线索。
sentences.pinyin: Yuánlái, zhège fángjiān shì fùqīn liú gěi tā de xiànsuǒ.
sentences.english: Originally, this room was a clue left for him by his father.

sentences.chinese: 不久，林明在墙角发现了一张旧照片。
sentences.pinyin: Bùjiǔ, Lín Míng zài qiángjiǎo fāxiàn le yī zhāng jiù zhàopiàn.
sentences.english: Before long, Lin Ming found an old photo in the corner of the wall.

sentences.chinese: 照片里有两个人，一个是他的父亲，另一个或者是一个陌生人，或者是一个朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Zhàopiàn lǐ yǒu liǎng gè rén, yī gè shì tā de fùqīn, lìng yī gè huòzhě shì yī gè mòshēng rén, huòzhě shì yī gè péngyǒu.
sentences.english: There were two people in the photo, one was his father, and the other was either a stranger or a friend.

sentences.chinese: 林明看着照片，心中感叹：“啊！原来是这样！”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng kànzhe zhàopiàn, xīnzhōng gǎntàn: “Ā! Yuánlái shì zhèyàng!”
sentences.english: Lin Ming looked at the photo and sighed in his heart, "Ah! So that's how it is!"

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，今后他必须更加小心，因为秘密越来越大了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, jīnhòu tā bìxū gèngjiā xiǎoxīn, yīnwèi mìmì yuè lái yuè dà le.
sentences.english: He realized that henceforth he must be more careful, because the secret was becoming larger and larger.

sentences.chinese: 他不知道对方是想帮他，或想害他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zhīdào duìfāng shì xiǎng bāng tā, huò xiǎng hài tā.
sentences.english: He didn't know if the other party wanted to help him or harm him.

sentences.chinese: 后来，他发现照片背后写着一行字：真相在地下室。
sentences.pinyin: Hòulái, tā fāxiàn zhàopiàn bèihòu xiězhe yī háng zì: Zhēnxiàng zài dìxiàshì.
sentences.english: Afterwards, he found a line of text written on the back of the photo: The truth is in the basement.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，他们同时听到了门外传来了沉重的脚步声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, tāmen tóngshí tīngdào le ménwài chuánlái le chénzhòng de jiǎobùshēng.
sentences.english: Just then, they simultaneously heard heavy footsteps coming from outside the door.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十七章：地下室的秘密

sentences.chinese: 脚步声越来越近，林明感到有点儿害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǎobù shēng yuè lái yuè jìn, Lín Míng gǎndào yǒudiǎnr hàipà.
sentences.english: The footsteps were getting closer, and Lin Ming felt a bit scared.

sentences.chinese: 他看向身边，海的脸色也很紧张。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng shēnbiān, Hǎi de liǎnsè yě hěn jǐnzhāng.
sentences.english: He looked at his side; Hai's expression was also very tense.

sentences.chinese: 他们现在就在地下室的门面前。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xiànzài jiù zài dìxiàshì de mén miànqián.
sentences.english: They were now right in front of the basement door.

sentences.chinese: 林明想起最近发生的奇怪事情，比如那个黑色的影子。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎngqǐ zuìjìn fāshēng de qíguài shìqíng, bǐrú nàge hēisè de yǐngzi.
sentences.english: Lin Ming thought of the strange things that had happened recently, such as that black shadow.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得对方早就知道了他的计划。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde duìfāng zǎojiù zhīdàole tā de jìhuà.
sentences.english: He felt that the other party had already known his plan long ago.

sentences.chinese: 所以，他现在必须非常小心。
sentences.pinyin: Suǒyǐ, tā xiànzài bìxū fēicháng xiǎoxīn.
sentences.english: Therefore, he must be very careful now.

sentences.chinese: 那会儿，地下室里非常安静，只有冷风在吹。
sentences.pinyin: Nà huìr, dìxiàshì lǐ fēicháng ānjìng, zhǐyǒu lěng fēng zài chuī.
sentences.english: At that time, it was very quiet in the basement, with only a cold wind blowing.

sentences.chinese: 林明记得过去这里是一个旧仓库。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng jìde guòqù zhèlǐ shì yīgè jiù cāngkù.
sentences.english: Lin Ming remembered that in the past, this place was an old warehouse.

sentences.chinese: 那时，他的爷爷经常来这里工作。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shí, tā de yéye jīngcháng lái zhèlǐ gōngzuò.
sentences.english: Then, his grandfather often came here to work.

sentences.chinese: 那时候，这里还没有这么多秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shíhou, zhèlǐ hái méiyǒu zhème duō mìmì.
sentences.english: At that time, there weren't so many secrets here.

sentences.chinese: 这时，海低声说：“我们该进去了。”
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, Hǎi dīshēng shuō: “Wǒmen gāi jìnqù le.”
sentences.english: At this moment, Hai whispered, "We should go in."

sentences.chinese: 这时候，林明发现门锁有一点儿破了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shíhou, Lín Míng fāxiàn mén suǒ yǒu yīdiǎnr pò le.
sentences.english: At this moment, Lin Ming discovered that the door lock was a bit broken.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试随便转动一下钥匙，正好门开了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chángshì suíbiàn zhuàndòng yīxià yàoshi, zhènghǎo mén kāi le.
sentences.english: He tried turning the key randomly, and the door opened just in time.

sentences.chinese: 然后，他慢慢地走进了黑暗的房间。
sentences.pinyin: Ránhòu, tā mànmàn de zǒu jìn le hēi'àn de fángjiān.
sentences.english: Then, he slowly walked into the dark room.

sentences.chinese: 他感觉这里有点儿冷，像是在下雪一样。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎnjué zhèlǐ yǒudiǎnr lěng, xiàng shì zài xià xuě yīyàng.
sentences.english: He felt it was a bit cold here, as if it were snowing.

sentences.chinese: 他突然想起一个叫雪的人，那是他爷爷以前的朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán xiǎngqǐ yīgè jiào Xuě de rén, nà shì tā yéye yǐqián de péngyǒu.
sentences.english: He suddenly thought of a person named Xue; that was a friend of his grandfather's from before.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果雪先生在，一定会告诉他真相。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rúguǒ Xuě xiānshēng zài, yīdìng huì gàosù tā zhēnxiàng.
sentences.english: He thought that if Mr. Xue were here, he would surely tell him the truth.

sentences.chinese: 林明告诉自己，不能在这里放弃。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng gàosù zìjǐ, bùnéng zài zhèlǐ fàngqì.
sentences.english: Lin Ming told himself that he could not give up here.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，危险随时可能出现。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhīdào, wēixiǎn suíshí kěnéng chūxiàn.
sentences.english: He knew that danger could appear at any time.

sentences.chinese: 那么，真相到底在哪里？
sentences.pinyin: Nàme, zhēnxiàng dàodǐ zài nǎlǐ?
sentences.english: So, where exactly is the truth?

sentences.chinese: 他看向房间的角落，发现了一个旧箱子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng fángjiān de jiǎoluò, fāxiàn le yīgè jiù xiāngzi.
sentences.english: He looked toward the corner of the room and found an old box.

sentences.chinese: 他走过去，发现箱子上有一个奇怪的符号。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu guòqù, fāxiàn xiāngzi shàng yǒu yīgè qíguài de fúhào.
sentences.english: He walked over and found a strange symbol on the box.

sentences.chinese: 就在他准备打开箱子时，身后突然传来了笑声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tā zhǔnbèi dǎkāi xiāngzi shí, shēnhòu tūrán chuánlái le xiàoshēng.
sentences.english: Just as he was preparing to open the box, laughter suddenly came from behind him.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十八章：地下的秘密对话

sentences.chinese: 林明听到笑声，身体突然抖了一下。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng tīng dào xiào shēng, shēn tǐ tū rán dǒu le yī xià.
sentences.english: Lin Ming heard the laughter, and his body suddenly shuddered.

sentences.chinese: 他慢慢转过身，看到一个叫怕先生的人站在那里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā màn màn zhuǎn guò shēn, kàn dào yī gè jiào Pà xiān sheng de rén zhàn zài nà lǐ.
sentences.english: He slowly turned around and saw a man named Mr. Pa standing there.

sentences.chinese: 怕先生看着他，手里举着一盏旧灯。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dī shēng shuō: “Zán liǎng zài zhè lǐ jiàn miàn de jī huì bù duō.”
sentences.english: Mr. Pa looked at him, holding an old lamp in his hand.

sentences.chinese: 他低声说：“咱俩在这里见面的机会不多。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng hěn jǐn zhāng, tā bù gǎn xiāng xìn zhè gè rén de chū xiàn.
sentences.english: He said in a low voice, "There aren't many chances for us to meet here."

sentences.chinese: 林明很紧张，他不敢相信这个人的出现。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào Pà xiān sheng de bèi hòu, qiáng shàng huà zhe yī gè qí guài de chuán de tú àn.
sentences.english: Lin Ming was very nervous; he couldn't believe this person had appeared.

sentences.chinese: 他看到怕先生的背后，墙上画着一个奇怪的船的图案。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè tú àn zhàn le qiáng miàn hěn dà yī bù fèn, kàn qǐ lái hěn kě pà.
sentences.english: He saw behind Mr. Pa, on the wall, there was a strange drawing of a boat.

sentences.chinese: 这个图案占了墙面很大一部分，看起来很可怕。
sentences.pinyin: Pà xiān sheng zǒu dào zhuō zi páng, zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī gè pò wǎn hé yī xiē gān cǎo.
sentences.english: This pattern occupied a large part of the wall and looked terrifying.

sentences.chinese: 怕先生走到桌子旁，桌子上有一个破碗和一些干草。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng zhù yì dào, wǎn páng biān fàng zhe yī xiē qí guài de yào.
sentences.english: Mr. Pa walked to the table, where there was a broken bowl and some dry grass.

sentences.chinese: 林明注意到，碗旁边放着一些奇怪的药。
sentences.pinyin: Pà xiān sheng shuō: “Nǐ shì yī gè cōng míng de qīng shào nián, nǐ yīng gāi zhī dào zhēn xiàng.”
sentences.english: Lin Ming noticed that some strange medicine was placed next to the bowl.

sentences.chinese: 怕先生说：“你是一个聪明的青少年，你应该知道真相。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng wèn tā: “Zhēn xiàng dào dǐ shì shén me?”
sentences.english: Mr. Pa said, "You are a clever teenager; you should know the truth."

sentences.chinese: 林明问他：“真相到底是什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Pà xiān sheng zhǐ zhe yī zhāng jiù zhǐ, shàng miàn xiě zhe yī jù huà.
sentences.english: Lin Ming asked him, "What exactly is the truth?"

sentences.chinese: 怕先生指着一张旧纸，上面写着一句话。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng bǎ nà jù huà dú le yī biàn, dàn tā kàn bù dǒng shàng miàn de cí.
sentences.english: Mr. Pa pointed to an old piece of paper with a sentence written on it.

sentences.chinese: 林明把那句话读了一遍，但他看不懂上面的词。
sentences.pinyin: Pà xiān sheng lěng lěng de xiào, shuō: “Nà yàng de wèn tí, nǐ xiàn zài bù xū yào zhī dào.”
sentences.english: Lin Ming read that sentence once, but he couldn't understand the words on it.

sentences.chinese: 怕先生冷冷地笑，说：“那样的问题，你现在不需要知道。”
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, Lín Míng gǎn jué dào yǒu rén pèng le tā de jiān bǎng.
sentences.english: Mr. Pa laughed coldly and said, "That kind of question is something you don't need to know right now."

sentences.chinese: 突然，林明感觉到有人碰了他的肩膀。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huí tóu kàn, què fā xiàn shēn hòu zhǐ yǒu yī zhǐ hēi sè de niǎo zài fēi.
sentences.english: Suddenly, Lin Ming felt someone touch his shoulder.

sentences.chinese: 他回头看，却发现身后只有一只黑色的鸟在飞。
sentences.pinyin: Zài dì xià shì de zhè gè shēn yè, yī qiè dōu xiǎn de hěn qí guài.
sentences.english: He looked back, only to find a black bird flying behind him.

sentences.chinese: 在地下室的这个深夜，一切都显得很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Pà xiān sheng gào sù tā, zhè lǐ céng jīng liú zhe yī gè guān yú dàn de mì mì.
sentences.english: In the deep night of this basement, everything seemed very strange.

sentences.chinese: 怕先生告诉他，这里曾经留着一个关于蛋的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō zhè gè mì mì lí zhēn zhèng de bǎo zàng hěn jìn.
sentences.english: Mr. Pa told him that a secret about an egg had once been left here.

sentences.chinese: 他说这个秘密离真正的宝藏很近。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎng, zhè gè rén de huà zhēn de kě yǐ xiāng xìn ma?
sentences.english: He said this secret was very close to the real treasure.

sentences.chinese: 林明想，这个人的话真的可以相信吗？
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎn jué zhè gè dì xià shì xiàng shì yī gè jù dà de xiàn jǐng.
sentences.english: Lin Ming wondered, can the words of this person really be believed?

sentences.chinese: 他感觉这个地下室像是一个巨大的陷阱。
sentences.pinyin: Pà xiān sheng zài cì xiào le qǐ lái, shēng yīn zài fáng jiān lǐ huí dàng.
sentences.english: He felt that this basement was like a giant trap.

sentences.chinese: 怕先生再次笑了起来，声音在房间里回荡。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tū rán shuō: “Kuài kàn, xiāng zi dǎ kāi le!”
sentences.english: Mr. Pa laughed again, his voice echoing in the room.

sentences.chinese: 他突然说：“快看，箱子打开了！”
sentences.english: He suddenly said, "Look quickly, the box has opened!"

chapters.title_chinese: 第十九章：箱子里的秘密照片
chapters.title_english: Chapter 19: The Secret Photo in the Box

sentences.chinese: 林明看着箱子，里面没有金子，只有一些旧照片和一张纸。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng kànzhe xiāngzi, lǐmiàn méiyǒu jīnzi, zhǐyǒu yīxiē jiù zhàopiàn hé yī zhāng zhǐ.
sentences.english: Lin Ming looked at the box; there was no gold inside, only some old photos and a piece of paper.

sentences.chinese: 他拿出一张照片，照片里是一个年轻的青年。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū yī zhāng zhàopiàn, zhàopiàn lǐ shì yī gè niánqīng de qīngnián.
sentences.english: He took out a photo, and in the photo was a young youth.

sentences.chinese: 那个青年在爬山，背景是一座很高的大山。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè qīngnián zài páshān, bèijǐng shì yī zuò hěn gāo de dàshān.
sentences.english: That youth was climbing a mountain, with a very high mountain in the background.

sentences.chinese: 林明发现这个青年在照片里对着镜头笑，像是在照相的时候很开心。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng fāxiàn zhège qīngnián zài zhàopiàn lǐ duìzhe jìngtóu xiào, xiàng shì zài zhàoxiàng de shíhòu hěn kāixīn.
sentences.english: Lin Ming noticed that the youth was smiling at the camera in the photo, as if he were very happy while taking the photograph.

sentences.chinese: 纸上写着：这个青年曾经出国去旅行，在国外打工很多年。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐ shàng xiězhe: Zhège qīngnián céngjīng chūguó qù lǚxíng, zài guówài dǎgōng hěnduō nián.
sentences.english: The paper read: This youth once went abroad to travel and worked a temporary job abroad for many years.

sentences.chinese: 后来，他回国了，但身体不好，必须住院治疗。
sentences.pinyin: Hòulái, tā huíguó le, dàn shēntǐ bù hǎo, bìxū zhùyuàn zhìliáo.
sentences.english: Later, he returned to his home country, but his health was poor, and he had to be hospitalized for treatment.

sentences.chinese: 直到他出院的那天，他才决定把真正的秘密藏在这里。
sentences.pinyin: Zhídào tā chūyuàn de nà tiān, tā cái juédìng bǎ zhēnzhèng de mìmì cáng zài zhèlǐ.
sentences.english: It wasn't until the day he left the hospital that he decided to hide the true secret here.

sentences.chinese: 林明意识到，这个秘密是关于这个人的生活，而怕先生非常重视这些照片。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng yìshí dào, zhège mìmì shì guānyú zhège rén de shēnghuó, ér Pà Xiānshēng fēicháng zhòngshì zhèxiē zhàopiàn.
sentences.english: Lin Ming realized that this secret was about this person's life, and Mr. Pa valued these photos very much.

sentences.chinese: 突然，怕先生大喊一声：“站住！把照片给我！”
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, Pà Xiānshēng dà hǎn yī shēng: “Zhànzhù! Bǎ zhàopiàn gěi wǒ!”
sentences.english: Suddenly, Mr. Pa shouted, "Stop! Give me the photos!"

sentences.chinese: 林明感到很害怕，他迅速地爬起来，向地下室的出口跑去。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng gǎndào hěn hàipà, tā xùnsù de pá qǐlái, xiàng dìxiàshì de chūkǒu pǎo qù.
sentences.english: Lin Ming felt very scared; he quickly crawled up and ran toward the exit of the basement.

sentences.chinese: 他想离开这个可怕的地方，尽快出门离开这座房子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng líkāi zhège kěpà de dìfāng, jǐnkuài chūmén líkāi zhè zuò fángzi.
sentences.english: He wanted to leave this terrifying place and go out of the house as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 在跑的过程中，他想起那个青年在纸条里写道，他最喜欢骑车去森林问路。
sentences.pinyin: Zài pǎo de guòchéng zhōng, tā xiǎngqǐ nàgè qīngnián zài zhǐtiáo lǐ xiězhe, tā zuì xǐhuān qíchē qù sēnlín wènlù.
sentences.english: While running, he remembered that the youth wrote in the note that he loved riding a bike to the forest to ask for directions.

sentences.chinese: 他突然想到，真正的宝藏可能不在地下室，而是在那个青年出发去旅行的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán xiǎngdào, zhēnzhèng de bǎozàng kěnéng bù zài dìxiàshì, ér shì zài nàgè qīngnián chūfā qù lǚxíng de dìfāng.
sentences.english: He suddenly thought that the real treasure might not be in the basement, but in the place where that youth set off for his journey.

sentences.chinese: 他记得纸条最后写着：“祝你一路平安，一路顺风。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìdé zhǐtiáo zuìhòu xiězhe: “Zhù nǐ yīlù píng'ān, yīlù shùnfēng.”
sentences.english: He remembered the note ended with: "Wishing you a pleasant journey and a smooth trip."

sentences.chinese: 这看起来像是一句简单的祝福，但林明觉得这是一个隐藏的线索。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kàn qǐlái xiàng shì yī jù jiǎndān de zhùfú, dàn Lín Míng juéde zhè shì yī gè yǐncáng de xiànsuǒ.
sentences.english: This seemed like a simple blessing, but Lin Ming felt it was a hidden clue.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果那个青年在休假期间去了某个地方，那里一定有答案。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rúguǒ nàgè qīngnián zài xiūjià qījiān qùle mǒu gè dìfāng, nàlǐ yīdìng yǒu dá'àn.
sentences.english: He thought if that youth had gone to a certain place during his vacation, there must be an answer there.

sentences.chinese: 就在林明快要跑到门口时，他听到窗外传来了飞机的声音，飞机正在起飞。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài Lín Míng kuài yào pǎo dào ménkǒu shí, tā tīngdào chuāngwài chuánláile fēijī de shēngyīn, fēijī zhèngzài qǐfēi.
sentences.english: Just as Lin Ming was about to reach the door, he heard the sound of a plane outside; a plane was taking off.

sentences.chinese: 他回头看，怕先生的脸变得很可怕，正慢慢走过来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huítóu kàn, Pà Xiānshēng de liǎn biàn de hěn kěpà, zhèng mànmàn zǒu guòlái.
sentences.english: He looked back, and Mr. Pa's face had become terrifying as he slowly walked over.

sentences.chinese: 林明在心中大喊：我必须找到那个地方！
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng zài xīnzhōng dà hǎn: Wǒ bìxū zhǎodào nàgè dìfāng!
sentences.english: Lin Ming shouted in his heart: I must find that place!

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，地下室的门突然被锁上了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, dìxiàshì de mén tūrán bèi suǒ shàng le.
sentences.english: But at that moment, the basement door was suddenly locked.

sentences.chinese: 林明被关在了黑暗中，而怕先生在门外轻轻地笑了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng bèi guān zài le hēi'àn zhōng, ér Pà Xiānshēng zài mén wài qīngqīng de xiào le qǐlái.
sentences.english: Lin Ming was trapped in the darkness, and Mr. Pa began to laugh softly outside the door.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十章：黑暗中的挣扎

sentences.chinese: 地下室里很黑，林明感到非常难受。
sentences.pinyin: Dìxiàshì lǐ hěn hēi, Lín Míng gǎndào fēicháng nánshòu.
sentences.english: It was very dark in the basement, and Lin Ming felt extremely uncomfortable.

sentences.chinese: 他试图推门，但是门锁住了，不行。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shìtú tuī mén, dànshì mén suǒzhù le, bù xíng.
sentences.english: He tried to push the door, but the door was locked; it wouldn't work.

sentences.chinese: 他听到门外怕先生在说一些难听的话。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīngdào ménwài Pà Xiānsheng zài shuō yīxiē nántīng de huà.
sentences.english: He heard Mr. Pa saying some unpleasant things outside the door.

sentences.chinese: 怕先生在笑，他说林明现在的样子很难看。
sentences.pinyin: Pà Xiānsheng zài xiào, tā shuō Lín Míng xiànzài de yàngzi hěn nánkàn.
sentences.english: Mr. Pa was laughing, saying that Lin Ming looked unsightly right now.

sentences.chinese: 林明觉得这根本不是一个笑话，他感到很难过。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng juéde zhè gēnběn búshì yīgè xiàohua, tā gǎndào hěn nánguò.
sentences.english: Lin Ming felt this was not a joke at all; he felt very sad.

sentences.chinese: 他低头看，发现地上有一只白色的小猫。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dītóu kàn, fāxiàn dìshàng yǒu yī zhǐ báisè de xiǎomāo.
sentences.english: He lowered his head and found a small white cat on the floor.

sentences.chinese: 猫在小声地叫，似乎在告诉他这里有秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Māo zài xiǎoshēng de jiào, sìhū zài gàosù tā zhèlǐ yǒu mìmì.
sentences.english: The cat was meowing in a low voice, as if telling him there was a secret here.

sentences.chinese: 不一会儿，林明在墙角发现了一个绿色的盒子。
sentences.pinyin: Bù yīhuǐr, Lín Míng zài qiángjiǎo fāxiàn le yīgè lǜsè de hézi.
sentences.english: After a short while, Lin Ming found a green box in the corner.

sentences.chinese: 盒子很短，但是里面留下了很重要的一张纸条。
sentences.pinyin: Hézi hěn duǎn, dànshì lǐmiàn liúxià le hěn zhòngyào de yī zhāng zhǐtiáo.
sentences.english: The box was short, but inside it left behind a very important note.

sentences.chinese: 纸条上写着：坏人会把秘密卖掉。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐtiáo shàng xiězhe: huàirén huì bǎ mìmì màidiào.
sentences.english: The note said: Bad people will sell the secret.

sentences.chinese: 林明意识到，怕先生就是一个坏人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng yìshí dào, Pà Xiānsheng jiùshì yīgè huàirén.
sentences.english: Lin Ming realized that Mr. Pa was a bad person.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果现在能走开，就太好了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rúguǒ xiànzài néng zǒukāi, jiù tài hǎo le.
sentences.english: He thought that if he could leave now, it would be great.

sentences.chinese: 但这里的空间太小，他只能在黑暗中等待。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zhèlǐ de kōngjiān tài xiǎo, tā zhǐnéng zài hēi'àn zhòng děngdài.
sentences.english: But the space here was too small; he could only wait in the darkness.

sentences.chinese: 他想起今天是个阴天，外面一定很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ jīntiān shì gè yīntiān, wàimiàn yīdìng hěn lěng.
sentences.english: He remembered that today was a cloudy day; it must be very cold outside.

sentences.chinese: 他感到肚子很疼，可能是因为太紧张了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎndào dùzi hěn téng, kěnéng shì yīnwèi tài jǐnzhāng le.
sentences.english: He felt his stomach hurt, possibly because he was too nervous.

sentences.chinese: 他想起海，他们现在被分开了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ Hǎi, tāmen xiànzài bèi fēnkāi le.
sentences.english: He thought of Hai; they were now separated.

sentences.chinese: 他担心海会不会在午睡时被抓走。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dānxīn Hǎi huì bú huì zài wǔshuì shí bèi zhuāzǒu.
sentences.english: He worried whether Hai would be captured during a nap.

sentences.chinese: 他想，在这种情况下，省时间是最重要的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, zài zhèzhǒng qíngkuàng xià, shěng shíjiān shì zuì zhòngyào de.
sentences.english: He thought that in this situation, saving time was the most important thing.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试用身体撞门，但是力量不够。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chángshì yòng shēntǐ zhuàng mén, dànshì lìliàng bù gòu.
sentences.english: He tried to ram the door with his body, but the strength was not enough.

sentences.chinese: 他突然听到一个巨大的声音，像是有什么东西倒了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán tīngdào yīgè jùdà de shēngyīn, xiàng shì yǒu shéme dōngxi dǎo le.
sentences.english: He suddenly heard a loud noise, as if something had fallen.

sentences.chinese: 他感到很害怕，甚至想哭。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎndào hěn hàipà, shènzhì xiǎng kū.
sentences.english: He felt terrified, even wanting to cry.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，留在地下室会有很多坏处。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhīdào, liú zài dìxiàshì huì yǒu hěnduō huàichu.
sentences.english: He knew that staying in the basement would have many disadvantages.

sentences.chinese: 他小声对自己说：“不要放弃。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎoshēng duì zìjǐ shuō: “Bùyào fàngqì.”
sentences.english: He whispered to himself: "Don't give up."

sentences.chinese: 他发现少数几个窗户很高，他跳不上去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn shǎoshù jǐ gè chuānghu hěn gāo, tā tiào bù shàngqù.
sentences.english: He noticed a small number of windows were very high; he couldn't jump up to them.

sentences.chinese: 他试图把手伸向窗户，但手掉在了地上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shìtú bǎ shǒu shēn xiàng chuānghu, dàn shǒu diào zài le dìshàng.
sentences.english: He tried to reach his hand toward the window, but his hand dropped to the floor.

sentences.chinese: 他不好意思地笑了笑，觉得自己很笨。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù hǎo yì si de xiào le xiào, juéde zìjǐ hěn bèn.
sentences.english: He smiled embarrassedly, feeling that he was very stupid.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得现在的处境不如之前在图书馆的时候。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde xiànzài de chǔjìng bùrú zhīqián zài túshūguǎn de shíhou.
sentences.english: He felt his current situation was not as good as when he was in the library.

sentences.chinese: 他对怕先生的行为感到非常不满。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì Pà Xiānsheng de xíngwéi gǎndào fēicháng bùmǎn.
sentences.english: He felt very dissatisfied with Mr. Pa's behavior.

sentences.chinese: 他大声喊道：“走开！你这个可怕的人！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàshēng hǎndào: “Zǒukāi! Nǐ zhège kěpà de rén!”
sentences.english: He shouted loudly: "Go away! You terrifying person!"

sentences.chinese: 怕先生在外面冷冷地说：“在这里，没有人能救你。”
sentences.pinyin: Pà Xiānsheng zài wàimiàn lěng lěng de shuō: “Zài zhèlǐ, méiyǒu rén néng jiù nǐ.”
sentences.english: Mr. Pa said coldly from outside: "In here, no one can save you."

sentences.chinese: 林明放下手中的盒子，开始仔细观察墙壁。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng fàngxià shǒuzhòng de hézi, kāishǐ zǐxì guānchá qiángbì.
sentences.english: Lin Ming put down the box in his hand and began to observe the walls carefully.

sentences.chinese: 他发现墙上有一个奇怪的符号，像是一把钥匙。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn qiáng shàng yǒu yīgè qíguài de fúhào, xiàng shì yī bǎ yàoshi.
sentences.english: He found a strange symbol on the wall, looking like a key.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，他听到门外传来了另一个人的脚步声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhèshí, tā tīngdào ménwài chuánlái le lìng yīgè rén de jiǎobùshēng.
sentences.english: Just then, he heard the footsteps of another person outside the door.

sentences.chinese: 那声音不像怕先生，而像是一个朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shēngyīn bù xiàng Pà Xiānsheng, ér xiàng shì yīgè péngyǒu.
sentences.english: That voice didn't sound like Mr. Pa, but rather like a friend.

sentences.chinese: 林明的心跳得飞快，他不知道对方是谁。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng de xīntiào de fēikuài, tā bù zhīdào duìfāng shì shéi.
sentences.english: Lin Ming's heart beat rapidly; he didn't know who it was.

sentences.chinese: 突然，地下室的灯亮了，一个熟悉的身影出现在门口。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, dìxiàshì de dēng liàng le, yīgè shúxī de shēnyǐng chūxiàn zài ménkǒu.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the basement lights turned on, and a familiar figure appeared at the door.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十一章：旧照片的真相
chapters.title_english: Chapter 21: The Truth of the Old Photograph

sentences.chinese: 出现在门口的人是林明的大学同学，王强。
sentences.pinyin: Chū xiàn zài mén kǒu de rén shì Lín Míng de dà xué tóng xué, Wáng Qiáng.
sentences.english: The person appearing at the door was Lin Ming's college classmate, Wang Qiang.

sentences.chinese: 王强的声音很温柔，他说他一直在找林明。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng de shēng yīn hěn wēn róu, tā shuō tā yī zhí zài zhǎo Lín Míng.
sentences.english: Wang Qiang's voice was gentle, and he said he had been looking for Lin Ming.

sentences.chinese: 林明很惊讶，因为他以为王强在一家大公司工作。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng hěn jīng yà, yīn wèi tā yǐ wéi Wáng Qiáng zài yī jiā dà gōng sī gōng zuò.
sentences.english: Lin Ming was surprised because he thought Wang Qiang worked at a large company.

sentences.chinese: 王强告诉林明，这是一个关于一个商人家庭的秘密事情。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng gào sù Lín Míng, zhè shì yī gè guān yú yī gè shāng rén jiā tíng de mì mì shì qing.
sentences.english: Wang Qiang told Lin Ming that this was a secret matter regarding a businessman's family.

sentences.chinese: 他给林明看了一张图片，图片上是一个很大的房子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gěi Lín Míng kàn le yī zhāng tú piàn, tú piàn shàng shì yī gè hěn dà de fáng zi.
sentences.english: He showed Lin Ming a picture; the picture was of a very large house.

sentences.chinese: 这个房子的中心有一个奇怪的符号，就像地下室墙上的那个。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè fáng zi de zhōng xīn yǒu yī gè qí guài de fú hào, jiù xiàng dì xià shì qiáng shàng de nà gè.
sentences.english: At the center of this house was a strange symbol, just like the one on the basement wall.

sentences.chinese: 王强说，这个符号是这个家庭的习惯，代表着某种权力。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng shuō, zhè gè fú hào shì zhè gè jiā tíng de xí guàn, dài biǎo zhe mǒu zhǒng quán lì.
sentences.english: Wang Qiang said this symbol was a habit of this family, representing a kind of power.

sentences.chinese: 林明问，为什么这个秘密现在才出现？
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng wèn, wèi shé me zhè gè mì mì xiàn zài cái chū xiàn?
sentences.english: Lin Ming asked, why is this secret appearing only now?

sentences.chinese: 王强解释说，今年是那个商人去世十周年。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng jiě shì shuō, jīn nián shì nà gè shāng rén qù shì shí zhōu nián.
sentences.english: Wang Qiang explained that this year is the tenth anniversary of that businessman's death.

sentences.chinese: 很多以前的同事开始寻找这个秘密的原因。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō yǐ qián de tóng shì kāi shǐ xún zhǎo zhè gè mì mì de yuán yīn.
sentences.english: Many former colleagues began searching for the reason behind this secret.

sentences.chinese: 王强说，他之前在市中心的一个办公室工作，发现了这个秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng shuō, tā zhī qián zài shì zhōng xīn de yī gè bàn gōng shì gōng zuò, fā xiàn le zhè gè mì mì.
sentences.english: Wang Qiang said he previously worked in an office in the city center and discovered this secret.

sentences.chinese: 他给林明举了一个例子，说有些人在寻找这个符号后就消失了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gěi Lín Míng jǔ le yī gè lì zi, shuō yǒu xiē rén zài xún zhǎo zhè gè fú hào hòu jiù xiāo shī le.
sentences.english: He gave Lin Ming an example, saying some people disappeared after searching for this symbol.

sentences.chinese: 林明想起之前的信息，觉得这一切像是一本悬疑小说。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎng qǐ zhī qián de xìn xī, jué de zhè yī qiè xiàng shì yī běn xuán yí xiǎo shuō.
sentences.english: Lin Ming thought of the previous messages and felt all this was like a mystery novel.

sentences.chinese: 王强告诉他，真正的线索在城市的体育中心附近。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng gào sù tā, zhēn zhèng de xiàn suǒ zài chéng shì de tǐ yù zhōng xīn fù jìn.
sentences.english: Wang Qiang told him the real clue was near the city's sports center.

sentences.chinese: 他们决定离开地下室，先去吃午餐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men jué dìng lí kāi dì xià shì, xiān qù chī wǔ cān.
sentences.english: They decided to leave the basement and go have lunch first.

sentences.chinese: 他们去了一家中餐馆，点了一些简单的中餐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men qù le yī jiā zhōng cān guǎn, diǎn le yī xiē jiǎn dān de zhōng cān.
sentences.english: They went to a Chinese restaurant and ordered some simple Chinese food.

sentences.chinese: 在吃饭时，王强说他注意到这个城市的人口在增加，但秘密依然隐藏在阴影里。
sentences.pinyin: Zài chī fàn shí, Wáng Qiáng shuō tā zhù yì dào zhè gè chéng shì de rén kǒu zài zēng jiā, dàn mì mì yī rán yǐn cáng zài yīn yǐng lǐ.
sentences.english: While eating, Wang Qiang said he noticed the city's population was increasing, but the secret remained hidden in the shadows.

sentences.chinese: 他问林明，你觉得这个符号的大小意味着什么？
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn Lín Míng, nǐ jué de zhè gè fú hào de dà xiǎo yì wèi zhe shén me?
sentences.english: He asked Lin Ming, what do you think the size of this symbol means?

sentences.chinese: 林明看着窗外，窗外是一条繁忙的公路。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng kàn zhe chuāng wài, chuāng wài shì yī tiáo fán máng de gōng lù.
sentences.english: Lin Ming looked out the window; outside was a busy highway.

sentences.chinese: 公路边有很多出租车和公交车在跑。
sentences.pinyin: Gōng lù biān yǒu hěn duō chū zū chē hé gōng jiāo chē zài pǎo.
sentences.english: There were many taxis and public buses running by the side of the highway.

sentences.chinese: 王强说，如果我们想快点到达，可以坐地铁，或者找一个司机开车。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng shuō, rú guǒ wǒ men xiǎng kuài diǎn dào dá, kě yǐ zuò dì tiě, huò zhě zhǎo yī gè sī jī kāi chē.
sentences.english: Wang Qiang said if they wanted to arrive faster, they could take the subway or find a driver to drive.

sentences.chinese: 林明想起了自己的作业，他之前在研究城市规划，记得那个位置。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎng qǐ le zì jǐ de zuò yè, tā zhī qián zài yán jiū chéng shì guī huà, jì dé nà gè wèi zhì.
sentences.english: Lin Ming remembered his assignment; he had been studying urban planning and remembered that location.

sentences.chinese: 那个位置在体育馆后面的停车场旁边。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè wèi zhì zài tǐ yù guǎn hòu miàn de tíng chē chǎng páng biān.
sentences.english: That location was next to the parking lot behind the gymnasium.

sentences.chinese: 王强看着林明的嘴，发现林明在思考。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng kàn zhe Lín Míng de zuǐ, fā xiàn Lín Míng zài sī kǎo.
sentences.english: Wang Qiang looked at Lin Ming's mouth and noticed Lin Ming was thinking.

sentences.chinese: 他低声说，那里曾经接待过很多重要的客人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dī shēng shuō, nà lǐ céng jīng jiē dài guò hěn duō zhòng yào de kè rén.
sentences.english: He whispered that the place had once hosted many important guests.

sentences.chinese: 林明问，你为什么要帮我？
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng wèn, nǐ wèi shé me yào bāng wǒ?
sentences.english: Lin Ming asked, why are you helping me?

sentences.chinese: 王强笑了笑，说他不想让这个秘密被怕先生拿走。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng xiào le xiào, shuō tā bù xiǎng ràng zhè gè mì mì bèi Pà xiān sheng ná zǒu.
sentences.english: Wang Qiang smiled and said he didn't want this secret to be taken by Mr. Pa.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林明，那个秘密和大海有关，可能在海边的某个地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù Lín Míng, nà gè mì mì hé dà hǎi yǒu guān, kě néng zài hǎi biān de mǒu gè dì fāng.
sentences.english: He told Lin Ming that the secret was related to the sea and might be somewhere by the coast.

sentences.chinese: 林明感到很紧张，但他也觉得王强是值得信任的。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng gǎn dào hěn jǐn zhāng, dàn tā yě jué de Wáng Qiáng shì zhí de xìn rèn de.
sentences.english: Lin Ming felt very nervous, but he also felt Wang Qiang was trustworthy.

sentences.chinese: 他们走出餐厅，走在风中，向那个神秘的位置走去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zǒu chū cān tīng, zǒu zài fēng zhōng, xiàng nà gè shén mì de wèi zhì zǒu qù.
sentences.english: They left the restaurant and walked in the wind toward that mysterious location.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，林明的手机响了，是一条来自未知号码的信息。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, Lín Míng de shǒu jī xiǎng le, shì yī tiáo lái zì wèi zhī hào mǎ de xìn xī.
sentences.english: Just then, Lin Ming's phone rang; it was a message from an unknown number.

sentences.chinese: 信息上写着：“不要相信任何出现在你面前的人。”
sentences.pinyin: Xìn xī shàng xiě zhe: “Bù yào xiāng xìn rèn hé chū xiàn zài nǐ miàn qián de rén.”
sentences.english: The message read: "Do not trust anyone who appears before you."

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十二章：海边的秘密数字
chapters.title_english: Chapter 22: Secret Numbers by the Sea

sentences.chinese: 林明看着手机上的信息，心里感到非常不安。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng kànzhe shǒujī shàng de xìnxī, xīnlǐ gǎndào fēicháng bù'ān.
sentences.english: Lin Ming looked at the message on his phone, feeling very uneasy in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 他看向旁边的王强，对方的样子看起来很平静。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànxiàng pángbiān de Wáng Qiáng, duìfāng de yàngzi kàn qǐlái hěn píngjìng.
sentences.english: He looked at Wang Qiang beside him; the other man's appearance seemed very calm.

sentences.chinese: 王强说：“我们快走吧，机会不多了。”
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng shuō: “Wǒmen kuài zǒu ba, jīhuì bù duō le.”
sentences.english: Wang Qiang said, "Let's go quickly, there isn't much opportunity left."

sentences.chinese: 他们离开餐厅，走在城市的街道上，这里是市中心最热闹的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen líkāi cāntǐng, zǒu zài chéngshì de jiēdào shàng, zhèlǐ shì shì zhōngxīn zuì rènao de dìfāng.
sentences.english: They left the restaurant and walked on the city streets; this was the busiest part of the city center.

sentences.chinese: 他们穿过一个很大的广场，那里有一座古老的雕像。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen chuānguò yīgè hěn dà de guǎngchǎng, nàlǐ yǒu yī zuò gǔlǎo de diāoxiàng.
sentences.english: They crossed a large public square, where there was an ancient statue.

sentences.chinese: 随后，他们走进了一条狭窄的弄堂，这里的空气中有一股奇怪的油烟气。
sentences.pinyin: Suíhòu, tāmen zǒujìn le yī tiáo xiázhǎi de lòngtáng, zhèlǐ de kōngqì zhōng yǒu yī gǔ qíguài de yóuyān qì.
sentences.english: Afterwards, they entered a narrow alley; there was a strange smell of cooking oil in the air.

sentences.chinese: 林明想起以前看过的一个关于秘密的影片，电影里的主角也遇到了类似的情况。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎngqǐ yǐqián kànguò de yīgè guānyú mìmì de yǐngpiàn, diànyǐng lǐ de zhǔjué yě yùdào le lèisì de qíngkuàng.
sentences.english: Lin Ming remembered a movie about secrets he had seen before; the protagonist in the film had encountered a similar situation.

sentences.chinese: 现在的林明心情很复杂，他不知道该相信谁。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài de Lín Míng xīnqíng hěn fùzá, tā bù zhīdào gāi xiāngxìn shéi.
sentences.english: Lin Ming's mood was very complex now; he didn't know who to trust.

sentences.chinese: 王强走在前面，他的态度很奇怪，总是低着头不说话。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng zǒu zài qiánmiàn, tā de tàidù hěn qíguài, zǒngshì dīzhe tóu bù shuōhuà.
sentences.english: Wang Qiang walked in front; his attitude was strange, always keeping his head down and not speaking.

sentences.chinese: 林明想，这种行为是什么意思？
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎng, zhè zhǒng xíngwéi shì shénme yìsi?
sentences.english: Lin Ming wondered, what was the meaning of this behavior?

sentences.chinese: 他想给王强一些意见，但又怕对方生气。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng gěi Wáng Qiáng yīxiē yìjiàn, dàn yòu pà duìfāng shēngqì.
sentences.english: He wanted to give Wang Qiang some suggestions, but he was afraid the other person would get angry.

sentences.chinese: 突然，林明在路边的垃圾桶里发现了一份旧报纸。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, Lín Míng zài lùbiān de lājītǒng lǐ fāxiàn le yī fèn jiù bàozhǐ.
sentences.english: Suddenly, Lin Ming found an old newspaper in a trash can by the road.

sentences.chinese: 报纸上有一条新闻，照片里是一个著名的明星。
sentences.pinyin: Bàozhǐ shàng yǒu yī tiáo xīnwén, zhàopiàn lǐ shì yīgè zhùmíng de míngxīng.
sentences.english: There was a news item in the newspaper; the photograph showed a famous celebrity.

sentences.chinese: 在照片的旁边，有人用红笔写了一些数字。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhàopiàn de pángbiān, yǒurén yòng hóngbǐ xiě le yīxiē shùzì.
sentences.english: Beside the photograph, someone had written some numbers in red pen.

sentences.chinese: 林明意识到，这些数字可能就是寻找真相的方法。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng yìshí dào, zhèxiē shùzì kěnéng jiùshì xúnzhǎo zhēnxiàng de fāngfǎ.
sentences.english: Lin Ming realized that these numbers might be the method for finding the truth.

sentences.chinese: 他仔细观察数字的方向，发现它们指向海边。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǐxì guānchá shùzì de fāngxiàng, fāxiàn tāmen zhǐxiàng hǎibiān.
sentences.english: He carefully observed the direction of the numbers and found they pointed toward the seaside.

sentences.chinese: 王强注意到林明停了下来，问他怎么了。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng zhùyì dào Lín Míng tíng le xiàlái, wèn tā zěnme le.
sentences.english: Wang Qiang noticed Lin Ming had stopped and asked him what was wrong.

sentences.chinese: 林明在很多方面都开始怀疑王强，但他决定暂时保密。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng zài hěnduō fāngmiàn dōu kāishǐ huáiyí Wáng Qiáng, dàn tā juédìng zànshí bǎomì.
sentences.english: Lin Ming began to suspect Wang Qiang in many aspects, but he decided to keep it secret for now.

sentences.chinese: 此时，街道上有很多拿着地图的旅客，他们在这里旅游。
sentences.pinyin: Cǐshí, jiēdào shàng yǒu hěnduō názhe dìtú de lǚkè, tāmen zài zhèlǐ lǚyóu.
sentences.english: At this time, there were many travelers holding maps on the street; they were touring here.

sentences.chinese: 林明想起自己的少年时代，那时候他最喜欢在海边跑步。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ de shàonián shídài, nà shíhòu tā zuì xǐhuān zài hǎibiān pǎobù.
sentences.english: Lin Ming thought back to his youth; back then, he loved running by the seaside the most.

sentences.chinese: 他们决定先在一家快餐店简单地吃点东西，作为他们的晚餐。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen juédìng xiān zài yī jiā kuàicān diàn jiǎndān de chī diǎn dōngxī, zuòwéi tāmen de wǎncān.
sentences.english: They decided to eat something simple at a fast food restaurant first as their dinner.

sentences.chinese: 在快餐店里，林明看到一个女人的皮带上挂着一个奇怪的钥匙扣。
sentences.pinyin: Zài kuàicān diàn lǐ, Lín Míng kàndào yīgè nǚrén de dàidài shàng guàzhe yīgè qíguài de yàoshi kòu.
sentences.english: In the fast food restaurant, Lin Ming saw a strange keychain hanging from a woman's belt.

sentences.chinese: 那个钥匙扣的样子和林明之前发现的符号一模一样。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge yàoshi kòu de yàngzi hé Lín Míng zhīqián fāxiàn de fúhào yīmúyīyàng.
sentences.english: The appearance of that keychain was exactly the same as the symbol Lin Ming had found before.

sentences.chinese: 林明的心里跳得很快，他觉得这是一个重要的线索。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng de xīnlǐ tiào dé hěn kuài, tā juédé zhè shì yīgè zhòngyào de xiànsuǒ.
sentences.english: Lin Ming's heart beat very fast; he felt this was an important clue.

sentences.chinese: 他想起那个符号可能和一段古老的爱情故事有关。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ nàge fúhào kěnéng hé yīduàn gǔlǎo de àiqíng gùshì yǒuguān.
sentences.english: He thought that the symbol might be related to an ancient love story.

sentences.chinese: 走出快餐店后，他们来到了一间旧洗衣房。
sentences.pinyin: Zǒuchū kuàicān diàn hòu, tāmen lái dào le yī jiān jiù xǐyī fáng.
sentences.english: After leaving the fast food restaurant, they arrived at an old laundry room.

sentences.chinese: 洗衣房里有一台巨大的洗衣机正在转动，发出很大的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Xǐyī fáng lǐ yǒu yī tái jùdà de xǐyījī zhèngzài zhuàndòng, fāchū hěn dà de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: In the laundry room, a huge washing machine was rotating, making a loud noise.

sentences.chinese: 房间里的灯忽明忽暗，气氛变得非常紧张。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ de dēng hū míng hū àn, qìfēn biàn dé fēicháng jǐnzhāng.
sentences.english: The lights in the room flickered, and the atmosphere became very tense.

sentences.chinese: 林明悄悄地拿出之前的照片，对比报纸上的数字。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng qiāoqiāo de ná chū zhīqián de zhàopiàn, duìbǐ bàozhǐ shàng de shùzì.
