sentences.english: Lin Ming quietly took out the previous photograph and compared it with the numbers on the newspaper.

sentences.chinese: 他突然发现，所有的线索都指向海边的一座灯塔。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán fāxiàn, suǒyǒu de xiànsuǒ dōu zhǐxiàng hǎibiān de yī zuò dēngtǎ.
sentences.english: He suddenly discovered that all the clues pointed to a lighthouse by the sea.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，王强突然停下脚步，回头看着林明，眼神变得冷酷起来。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, Wáng Qiáng tūrán tíng xià jiǎobù, huítóu kànzhe Lín Míng, yǎnshén biàn dé lěngkù qǐlái.
sentences.english: Just then, Wang Qiang suddenly stopped walking, turned back to look at Lin Ming, and his gaze became cold.

sentences.chinese: 王强轻声说：“你终于发现了，但你太晚了。”
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng qīngshēng shuō: “Nǐ zhōngyú fāxiàn le, dàn nǐ tài wǎn le.”
sentences.english: Wang Qiang said softly, "You finally found it, but you are too late."

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十三章：灯塔的阴影

sentences.chinese: 林明看着王强，感到空气变得很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng kànzhe Wáng Qiáng, gǎndào kōngqì biànde hěn lěng.
sentences.english: Lin Ming looked at Wang Qiang and felt the air become very cold.

sentences.chinese: 王强的行为让他非常害怕，因为王强不再是那个好朋友了。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng de xíngwéi ràng tā fēicháng hàipà, yīnwèi Wáng Qiáng bù zài shì nàge hǎo péngyǒu le.
sentences.english: Wang Qiang's behavior made him very afraid, because Wang Qiang was no longer that good friend.

sentences.chinese: 王强手里拿着一个笔记本，里面记录了林明所有的行动。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng shǒulǐ názhe yīgè bǐjìběn, lǐmiàn jìlù le Lín Míng suǒyǒu de xíngdòng.
sentences.english: Wang Qiang held a notebook in his hand, which recorded all of Lin Ming's movements.

sentences.chinese: “你的理想是找到真相，但我的目的是拿到那张银行卡，”王强冷冷地说。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ de lǐxiǎng shì zhǎodào zhēnxiàng, dàn wǒ de mùdì shì nádào nà zhāng yínhángkǎ,” Wáng Qiáng lěnglěng de shuō.
sentences.english: "Your ideal is to find the truth, but my purpose is to get that bank card," Wang Qiang said coldly.

sentences.chinese: 林明记得那张银行卡在之前的碎片里头，那是秘密的一部分。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng jìde nà zhāng yínhángkǎ zài zhīqián de suìpiàn lǐtou, nà shì mìmì de yī bùfen.
sentences.english: Lin Ming remembered that the bank card was inside the previous fragments; it was a part of the secret.

sentences.chinese: 王强从口袋里拿出一片小金属，那是打开灯塔大门的钥匙。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng cóng kǒudài lǐ ná chū yī piān xiǎo jīnshǔ, nà shì dǎkāi dēngtǎ dàmén de yàoshi.
sentences.english: Wang Qiang took a small metal piece from his pocket; it was the key to open the lighthouse main door.

sentences.chinese: 林明想用科学的方法分析王强的观点，但现在情况太危险了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎng yòng kēxué de fāngfǎ fēnxī Wáng Qiáng de guāndiǎn, dàn xiànzài qíngkuàng tài wēixiǎn le.
sentences.english: Lin Ming wanted to use a scientific method to analyze Wang Qiang's viewpoint, but the situation was too dangerous now.

sentences.chinese: 他发现王强的看法和他的完全不同，两人站在不同的角度看这个问题。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn Wáng Qiáng de kànfǎ hé tā de wánquán bùtóng, liǎng rén zhàn zài bùtóng de jiǎodù kàn zhège wèntí.
sentences.english: He found that Wang Qiang's opinion was completely different from his; the two stood at different angles looking at this problem.

sentences.chinese: 王强指了指路边的一辆自行车，示意林明快点走。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng zhǐ le zhǐ lùbiān de yī liàng zìxíngchē, shìyì Lín Míng kuài diǎn zǒu.
sentences.english: Wang Qiang pointed to a bicycle by the roadside, signaling Lin Ming to move faster.

sentences.chinese: 他们走在一条狭窄的道路上，路两边是绿色的草地。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒu zài yī tiáo xiǎzhǎi de dàolù shàng, lù liǎngbiān shì lǜsè de cǎodì.
sentences.english: They walked on a narrow road, with green lawns on both sides.

sentences.chinese: 林明突然想起一个节日，那天他看到王强在球场打网球。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng tūrán xiǎngqǐ yīgè jiérì, nà tiān tā kàndào Wáng Qiáng zài qiúchǎng dǎ wǎngqiú.
sentences.english: Lin Ming suddenly remembered a holiday; that day he saw Wang Qiang playing tennis at the court.

sentences.chinese: 那时候王强的特点是热情，但现在他像个陌生人。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shíhou Wáng Qiáng de tèdiǎn shì rèqíng, dàn xiànzài tā xiàng gè mòshēng rén.
sentences.english: At that time, Wang Qiang's characteristic was enthusiasm, but now he was like a stranger.

sentences.chinese: 王强拿出一只瓶子，里面装着一些脏脏的泥土，那是从西北花园带回来的。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng ná chū yī zhǐ píngzi, lǐmiàn zhuāngzhe yīxiē zàngzàng de nítǔ, nà shì cóng Xīběi Huāyuán dàihuí lái de.
sentences.english: Wang Qiang took out a bottle containing some dirty soil, which was brought back from the Northwest Garden.

sentences.chinese: “你看这幅画儿，”王强展示了一张照片，那是灯塔的内部结构。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ kàn zhè fú huàr,” Wáng Qiáng zhǎnshì le yī zhāng zhàopiàn, nà shì dēngtǎ de nèibù jiégòu.
sentences.english: "Look at this picture," Wang Qiang showed a photo, which was the internal structure of the lighthouse.

sentences.chinese: 林明意识到王强的计划非常周密，他利用一个秘密网站来收集信息。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng yìshí dào Wáng Qiáng de jìhuà fēicháng zhōumì, tā lìyòng yīgè mìmì wǎngzhàn lái shōují xìnxī.
sentences.english: Lin Ming realized that Wang Qiang's plan was very thorough; he used a secret website to collect information.

sentences.chinese: 那个网站通过一个复杂的网，把所有线索连接在一起。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge wǎngzhàn tōngguò yīgè fùzá de wǎng, bǎ suǒyǒu xiànsuǒ liánjiē zài yīqǐ.
sentences.english: That website connected all the clues through a complex net.

sentences.chinese: 林明在心里想，这种行为太可怕了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng zài xīnlǐ xiǎng, zhè zhǒng xíngwéi tài kěpà le.
sentences.english: Lin Ming thought to himself that this kind of behavior was too terrifying.

sentences.chinese: 他拿出手机，想发一条短信给海，但这里没有信号。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū shǒujī, xiǎng fā yī tiáo duǎnxìn gěi Hǎi, dàn zhèlǐ méiyǒu xìnhào.
sentences.english: He took out his phone, wanting to send a text message to Hai, but there was no signal here.

sentences.chinese: 他突然想到，可以通过计算机在家里查到更多关于灯塔的资料。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán xiǎngdào, kěyǐ tōngguò jìsuànjī zài jiālǐ chádào gèng duō guānyú dēngtǎ de zīliào.
sentences.english: He suddenly thought that he could use a computer at home to find more information about the lighthouse.

sentences.chinese: 但现在，他必须面对眼前的这道门。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiànzài, tā bìxū miànduì yǎnqián de zhè dào mén.
sentences.english: But now, he had to face this door in front of him.

sentences.chinese: 王强走在道路的边上，低声说：“这里的节目开始了。”
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng zǒu zài dàolù de biān shàng, dīshēng shuō: “Zhèlǐ de jiémù kāishǐ le.”
sentences.english: Wang Qiang walked on the edge of the road and whispered, "The program here has begun."

sentences.chinese: 林明不明白为什么他把这个危险的时刻比作一个节目。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng bù míngbai wèishéme tā bǎ zhège wēixiǎn de shíkè bǐzuò yīgè jiémù.
sentences.english: Lin Ming didn't understand why he compared this dangerous moment to a program.

sentences.chinese: 他看着灯塔的高墙，感觉自己像被困在了一个巨大的陷阱里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe dēngtǎ de gāoqiáng, gǎnjué zìjǐ xiàng bèi kùn zài le yīgè jùdà de xiànjǐng lǐ.
sentences.english: He looked at the high walls of the lighthouse and felt as if he were trapped in a huge trap.

sentences.chinese: 他试图寻找逃跑的机会，但王强一直盯着他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shìtú xúnzhǎo táopǎo de jīhuì, dàn Wáng Qiáng yīzhí dīngzhe tā.
sentences.english: He tried to find a chance to escape, but Wang Qiang kept staring at him.

sentences.chinese: 灯塔的门缓缓打开，里头是一片黑暗。
sentences.pinyin: Dēngtǎ de mén huǎn huǎn dǎkāi, lǐtou shì yī piàn hēi'àn.
sentences.english: The lighthouse door slowly opened, and inside was complete darkness.

sentences.chinese: 林明在黑暗中听到了一种奇怪的声音，像是在呼唤他。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng zài hēi'àn zhōng tīngdào le yī zhǒng qíguài de shēngyīn, xiàng shì zài hūhuàn tā.
sentences.english: Lin Ming heard a strange sound in the darkness, as if someone were calling him.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果能找到那个笔记本，也许能发现王强的弱点。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rúguǒ néng zhǎodào nàge bǐjìběn, yěxǔ néng fāxiàn Wáng Qiáng de ruòdiǎn.
sentences.english: He thought that if he could find that notebook, perhaps he could discover Wang Qiang's weakness.

sentences.chinese: 但王强已经走进了灯塔，消失在阴影之中。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn Wáng Qiáng yǐjīng zǒu jìn le dēngtǎ, xiāoshī zài yīnyǐng zhīzhōng.
sentences.english: But Wang Qiang had already entered the lighthouse and disappeared into the shadows.

sentences.chinese: 林明犹豫了一秒，然后也跟了进去。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng yóuyù le yī miǎo, ránhòu yě gēn le jìnqù.
sentences.english: Lin Ming hesitated for a second and then followed him in.

sentences.chinese: 就在他进入门的一瞬间，身后的自行车突然倒在了草地上。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tā jìnrù mén de yī shùnjiān, shēnhòu de zìxíngchē tūrán dǎo zài le cǎodì shàng.
sentences.english: At the moment he entered the door, the bicycle behind him suddenly fell onto the grass.

sentences.chinese: 谁在他们身后？
sentences.pinyin: Shéi zài tāmen shēnhòu?
sentences.english: Who was behind them?

sentences.chinese: 林明的心跳得飞快，他知道真正的危险才刚刚开始。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng de xīntiào dé fēikuài, tā zhīdào zhēnzhèng de wēixiǎn cái gānggāng kāishǐ.
sentences.english: Lin Ming's heart beat rapidly; he knew the real danger had just begun.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十四章：灯塔内部的迷宫
chapters.title_english: Chapter 24: The Maze Inside the Lighthouse

sentences.chinese: 林明走进灯塔，这里非常安静。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng zǒu jìn dēng tǎ, zhè lǐ fēi cháng ānjìng.
sentences.english: Lin Ming entered the lighthouse; it was very quiet here.

sentences.chinese: 他发现这里的墙面是白色的，而且很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn zhè lǐ de qiáng miàn shì bái sè de, ér qiě hěn lěng.
sentences.english: He found that the surface of the walls here was white and also very cold.

sentences.chinese: 王强走在前面，他的脚步声在走廊里回荡。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng zǒu zài qián miàn, tā de jiǎo bù shēng zài zǒu láng lǐ huí dàng.
sentences.english: Wang Qiang walked in front, his footsteps echoing in the corridor.

sentences.chinese: 林明以为王强在等他，但是王强走得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng yǐ wéi Wáng Qiáng zài děng tā, dàn shì Wáng Qiáng zǒu dé hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Lin Ming thought Wang Qiang was waiting for him, but Wang Qiang walked very fast.

sentences.chinese: 林明心想，王强的想法可能已经变了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xīn xiǎng, Wáng Qiáng de xiǎng fǎ kě néng yǐ jīng biàn le.
sentences.english: Lin Ming thought to himself that Wang Qiang's way of thinking might have changed.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这个地方不太安全，因为这里不仅阴暗，而且很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué dé zhè gè dì fāng bù tài ā n quán, yīn wèi zhè lǐ bù jǐn yīn àn, ér qiě hěn qí guài.
sentences.english: He felt this place was not too safe, because it was not only dark but also very strange.

sentences.chinese: 突然，王强停了下来。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, Wáng Qiáng tíng le xià lái.
sentences.english: Suddenly, Wang Qiang stopped.

sentences.chinese: 他指着墙上的一个奇怪的按钮说：“只要按下这个，门就会开。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐ zhe qiáng shàng de yī gè qí guài de àn niǔ shuō: “zhǐ yào àn xià zhè gè, mén jiù huì kāi.”
sentences.english: He pointed to a strange button on the wall and said, "As long as you press this, the door will open."

sentences.chinese: 林明看着那个按钮，觉得它和之前的符号不同。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng kàn zhe nà gè àn niǔ, jué dé tā hé zhī qián de fú hào bù tóng.
sentences.english: Lin Ming looked at the button and felt it was different from the previous symbols.

sentences.chinese: 他问：“为什么我们要在这里停下来？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn: “wèi shén me wǒ men yào zài zhè lǐ tíng xià lái?”
sentences.english: He asked, "Why do we have to stop here?"

sentences.chinese: 王强没有回答，只是冷冷地看着他。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng Qiáng méi yǒu huí dá, zhǐ shì lěng lěng de kàn zhe tā.
sentences.english: Wang Qiang did not answer, but only looked at him coldly.

sentences.chinese: 在林明的实际感觉中，王强现在像个陌生人。
sentences.pinyin: Zài Lín Míng de shí jì gǎn jué zhōng, Wáng Qiáng xiàn zài xiàng gè mò shēng rén.
sentences.english: In Lin Ming's actual feeling, Wang Qiang now seemed like a stranger.

sentences.chinese: 林明发现，除了王强以外，这里可能还有其他人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng fā xiàn, chú le Wáng Qiáng yǐ wài, zhè lǐ kě néng hái yǒu qí tā rén.
sentences.english: Lin Ming discovered that apart from Wang Qiang, there might be other people here.

sentences.chinese: 他听到走廊的另一面传来了声音，那是另一个人的脚步声。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīng dào zǒu láng de lìng yī miàn chuán lái le shēng yīn, nà shì lìng yī gè rén de jiǎo bù shēng.
sentences.english: He heard a sound coming from the other side of the corridor; it was another person's footsteps.

sentences.chinese: 那是米先生吗？林明记得米先生也一直在寻找这个秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì Mǐ xiān sheng ma? Lín Míng jì dé Mǐ xiān sheng yě yī zhí zài xún zhǎo zhè gè mì mì.
sentences.english: Was that Mr. Mi? Lin Ming remembered that Mr. Mi had also been searching for this secret.

sentences.chinese: 林明想，米先生一定知道这里发生了什么。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎng, Mǐ xiān sheng yī dìng zhī dào zhè lǐ fā shēng le shén me.
sentences.english: Lin Ming thought Mr. Mi must know what happened here.

sentences.chinese: 不过，他现在只看到王强的背影。
sentences.pinyin: Bù guò, tā xiàn zài zhǐ kàn dào Wáng Qiáng de bèi yǐng.
sentences.english: However, he only saw Wang Qiang's silhouette now.

sentences.chinese: 突然，灯塔的电梯卡住了，他们被困在了中间。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, dēng tǎ de diàn tī kǎ zhù le, tā men bèi kùn zài le zhōng jiān.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the lighthouse elevator got stuck, and they were trapped in the middle.

sentences.chinese: 林明感到很紧张，他又想到了那条信息：“不要相信任何人。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng gǎn dào hěn jǐn zhāng, tā yòu xiǎng dào le nà tiáo xìn xī: “bù yào xiāng xìn rèn hé rén.”
sentences.english: Lin Ming felt very nervous, and he thought of that message again: "Do not trust anyone."

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，王强不一定是在帮他，可能是在引导他进入陷阱。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, Wáng Qiáng bù yī dìng shì zài bāng tā, kě néng shì zài yǐn dǎo tā jìn rù xiàn jǐng.
sentences.english: He realized that Wang Qiang is not necessarily helping him; he might be leading him into a trap.

sentences.chinese: 这个问题让林明感到非常不安。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè wèn tí ràng Lín Míng gǎn dào fēi cháng bù ān.
sentences.english: This problem made Lin Ming feel very uneasy.

sentences.chinese: 他不不但担心自己的安全，而且担心那个秘密被抢走。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù dàn dān xīn zì jǐ de ā n quán, ér qiě dān xīn nà gè mì mì bèi qiǎng zǒu.
sentences.english: He was not only worried about his own safety but also worried that the secret would be stolen.

sentences.chinese: 他决定重新观察周围的所有线索，寻找逃跑的方法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué dìng chóng xīn guān chá zhōu wéi de suǒ yǒu xiàn suǒ, xún zhǎo táo pǎo de fāng fǎ.
sentences.english: He decided to re-examine all the clues around him to find a way to escape.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，电梯顶部的天花板突然打开了，一只黑色的手伸了下来。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, diàn tī dǐng bù de tiān huā bǎn tū rán dǎ kāi le, yī zhī hēi sè de shǒu shēn le xià lái.
sentences.english: Just then, the ceiling at the top of the elevator suddenly opened, and a black hand reached down.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十五章：最后的陷阱

sentences.chinese: 林明看着那只黑色的手，感到非常害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng kànzhe nà zhī hēisè de shǒu, gǎndào fēicháng hàipà.
sentences.english: Lin Ming looked at that black hand and felt very scared.

sentences.chinese: 他小心地往后退，但电梯的空间太小了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎoxīn de wǎng hòu tuì, dàn diàntī de kōngjiān tài xiǎo le.
sentences.english: He carefully stepped back, but the elevator space was too small.

sentences.chinese: 突然，那只手抓住了他的衣服，像一只巨大的爪子。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, nà zhī shǒu zhuāzhù le tā de yīfú, xiàng yī zhī jùdà de zhuǎzi.
sentences.english: Suddenly, that hand grabbed his clothes, like a giant claw.

sentences.chinese: 林明大声喊：“你是谁！”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng dàshēng hǎn: “Nǐ shì shéi!”
sentences.english: Lin Ming shouted loudly, "Who are you!"

sentences.chinese: 一个低沉的声音说，他姓王，但不是王强。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè dīchén de shēngyīn shuō, tā xìng Wáng, dàn bùshì Wáng Qiáng.
sentences.english: A deep voice said that his surname was Wang, but he was not Wang Qiang.

sentences.chinese: 这个人说，他在这里为秘密工作，他是这座灯塔的守护者。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè rén shuō, tā zài zhèlǐ wéi mìmì gōngzuò, tā shì zhè zuò dēngtǎ de shǒuhùzhě.
sentences.english: This person said he worked as a guardian for the secret; he was the guardian of this lighthouse.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林明，这个秘密叫作“时间之眼”。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Lín Míng, zhè gè mìmì jiàozuò “Shíjiān zhī Yǎn”.
sentences.english: He told Lin Ming that this secret was called the "Eye of Time."

sentences.chinese: 林明想起之前在图书馆看到的广告，上面写着寻找勇敢的人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎngqǐ zhīqián zài túshūguǎn kàndào de guǎnggào, shàngmiàn xiězhe xúnzhǎo yǒnggǎn de rén.
sentences.english: Lin Ming recalled an advertisement he saw in the library before, which said they were looking for brave people.

sentences.chinese: 他听说这个秘密可以让人变成富有的人，或者成为一个伟大的领袖。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīngshuō zhè gè mìmì kěyǐ ràng rén biànchéng fùyǒu de rén, huòzhě chéngwéi yī gè wěidà de lǐngxiù.
sentences.english: He had heard that this secret could turn a person into a wealthy person or make them become a great leader.

sentences.chinese: 守护者说，他打算把这个秘密交给愿意帮助他的人。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuhùzhě shuō, tā dǎsuàn bǎ zhè gè mìmì jiāo gěi yuànyì bāngzhù tā de rén.
sentences.english: The guardian said he planned to give this secret to someone willing to help him.

sentences.chinese: 林明想到，他必须小心这个人的话。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎngdào, tā bìxū xiǎoxīn zhè gè rén de huà.
sentences.english: Lin Ming thought that he must be careful with this person's words.

sentences.chinese: 守护者举手示意林明安静，然后从口袋里拿出一套奇怪的工具。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuhùzhě jǔshǒu shìyì Lín Míng ānjìng, ránhòu cóng kǒudài lǐ ná chū yī tào qíguài de gōngjù.
sentences.english: The guardian raised his hand to signal Lin Ming to be quiet, then took a set of strange tools from his pocket.

sentences.chinese: 他说，使用这些工具可以打开最后的门。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, shǐyòng zhèxiē gōngjù kěyǐ dǎkāi zuìhòu de mén.
sentences.english: He said using these tools could open the final door.

sentences.chinese: 林明记得他曾经借过一本关于古老锁的书，书里提到过这种工具。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng jìdé tā céngjīng jiè guò yī běn guānyú gǔlǎo suǒ de shū, shū lǐ tí dào guò zhè zhǒng gōngjù.
sentences.english: Lin Ming remembered he had once borrowed a book about ancient locks, which mentioned this kind of tool.

sentences.chinese: 守护者看着林明，眼神里好像有关心，但林明并不相信。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuhùzhě kànzhe Lín Míng, yǎnshén lǐ hǎoxiàng yǒu guānxīn, dàn Lín Míng bìng bù xiāngxìn.
sentences.english: The guardian looked at Lin Ming, and there seemed to be concern in his eyes, but Lin Ming did not believe it.

sentences.chinese: 守护者说：“你应该相信我，因为我也养了很多年的小鸟，我知道怎么照顾生命。”
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuhùzhě shuō: “Nǐ yīnggāi xiāngxìn wǒ, yīnwèi wǒ yě yǎng le hěnduō nián de xiǎoniǎo, wǒ zhīdào zěnme zhàogù shēngmìng.”
sentences.english: The guardian said, "You should trust me, because I have also raised small birds for many years; I know how to care for life."

sentences.chinese: 林明觉得这话很奇怪，养鸟和打开秘密有什么关系？
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng juédé zhè huà hěn qíguài, yǎng niǎo hé dǎkāi mìmì yǒu shé me guānxì?
sentences.english: Lin Ming felt these words were strange; what did raising birds have to do with opening a secret?

sentences.chinese: 突然，电梯发出了“当”的一声，门开了。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, diàntī fāchū le “dāng” de yī shēng, mén kāi le.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the elevator made a "ding" sound, and the door opened.

sentences.chinese: 他们走进一个房间，桌子上有一台打印机，正在打印一张名单。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒu jìn yī gè fángjiān, zhuōzi shàng yǒu yī tái dǎyìnjī, zhèngzài dǎyìn yī zhāng míngdān.
sentences.english: They walked into a room where there was a printer on the table, printing a list.

sentences.chinese: 名单上有很多人的名字，其中一个就是林明。
sentences.pinyin: Míngdān shàng yǒu hěnduō rén de míngzì, qízhōng yī gè jiùshì Lín Míng.
sentences.english: There were many names on the list, and one of them was Lin Ming.

sentences.chinese: 林明发现，这里的人必须报名才能进入，而他的名字是被强行加上去的。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng fāxiàn, zhèlǐ de rén bìxū bàomíng cáinéng jìnrù, ér tā de míngzì shì bèi qiángxíng jiā shàng qù de.
sentences.english: Lin Ming discovered that people here had to sign up to enter, and his name had been forcibly added.

sentences.chinese: 守护者笑着说：“干杯！我们终于见到了。”
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuhùzhě xiàozhe shuō: “Gānbēi! Wǒmen zhōngyú jiàn dào le.”
sentences.english: The guardian smiled and said, "Cheers! We have finally met."

sentences.chinese: 他递给林明一杯奇怪的饮料，林明觉得这像是一种药。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dì gěi Lín Míng yī bēi qíguài de yǐnliào, Lín Míng juédé zhè xiàng shì yī zhǒng yào.
sentences.english: He handed Lin Ming a strange drink, which Lin Ming felt was like a kind of medicine.

sentences.chinese: 林明突然意识到，这里的气氛在变，变得越来越冷。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng tūrán yìshí dào, zhèlǐ de qìfēn zài biàn, biàn dé yuè lái yuè lěng.
sentences.english: Lin Ming suddenly realized the atmosphere here was changing, becoming colder and colder.

sentences.chinese: 他想起王强之前的眼神，意识到王强可能已经成为了守护者的助手。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ Wáng Qiáng zhīqián de yǎnshén, yìshí dào Wáng Qiáng kěnéng yǐjīng chéngwéi le shǒuhùzhě de zhùshǒu.
sentences.english: He recalled Wang Qiang's previous gaze and realized Wang Qiang might have already become the guardian's assistant.

sentences.chinese: 守护者说：“如果你想离开，必须给你的勇气加油。”
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuhùzhě shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng líkāi, bìxū gěi nǐ de yǒngqì jiāyóu.”
sentences.english: The guardian said, "If you want to leave, you must add oil to your courage."

sentences.chinese: 林明并不想在这里做饭或者生活，他只想找到真相。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng bìng bù xiǎng zài zhèlǐ zuòfàn huòzhě shēnghuó, tā zhǐ xiǎng zhǎodào zhēnxiàng.
sentences.english: Lin Ming did not want to cook or live here; he only wanted to find the truth.

sentences.chinese: 他突然想起一个细节，守护者说的话像是在云中，不真实且模糊。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán xiǎngqǐ yī gè xìjié, shǒuhùzhě shuō de huà xiàng shì zài yún zhōng, bù zhēnshí qiě móhú.
sentences.english: He suddenly recalled a detail: the guardian's words were like they were in the clouds, unreal and blurred.

sentences.chinese: 林明突然大喊一声，用力推开了守护者。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng tūrán dàhǎn yī shēng, yònglì tuī kāi le shǒuhùzhě.
sentences.english: Lin Ming suddenly shouted and pushed the guardian away with force.

sentences.chinese: 他发现桌子下面有一个红色的按钮。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn zhuōzi xiàmiàn yǒu yī gè hóngsè de ànniǔ.
sentences.english: He discovered a red button under the table.

sentences.chinese: 他打算按下它，但就在这时，守护者的脸突然变了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dǎsuàn àn xià tā, dàn jiù zài zhè shí, shǒuhùzhě de liǎn tūrán biàn le.
sentences.english: He planned to press it, but just then, the guardian's face suddenly changed.

sentences.chinese: 守护者的表情变得冷酷，他低声说：“你太聪明了，但已经太晚了。”
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuhùzhě de biǎoqíng biàn dé lěngkù, tā dīshēng shuō: “Nǐ tài cōngmíng le, dàn yǐjīng tài wǎn le.”
sentences.english: The guardian's expression became cold, and he whispered, "You are too clever, but it is already too late."

sentences.chinese: 房间的门突然关上了，林明被困在了里面。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān de mén tūrán guān shàng le, Lín Míng bèi kùn zài le lǐmiàn.
sentences.english: The room door suddenly closed, and Lin Ming was trapped inside.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十六章：最后的真相

sentences.chinese: 林明被困在房间里，他感到非常害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng bèi kùn zài fángjiān lǐ, tā gǎndào fēicháng hàipà.
sentences.english: Lin Ming was trapped in the room and felt very scared.

sentences.chinese: 他看到守护者在笑，那个笑容让他想要改变现在的处境。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào shǒuhùzhě zài xiào, nàge xiàoróng ràng tā xiǎngyào gǎibiàn xiànzài de chǔjìng.
sentences.english: He saw the Guardian laughing, and that smile made him want to change his current situation.

sentences.chinese: 守护者说：“欢迎来到真相之门，这里的一切都由我组成。”
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuhùzhě shuō: “Huānyíng láidào zhēnxiàng zhī mén, zhèlǐ de yīqiè dōu yóu wǒ zǔchéng.”
sentences.english: The Guardian said, "Welcome to the Door of Truth; everything here is composed by me."

sentences.chinese: 林明大喊：“你为什么要这样做？请你说明理由！”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng dàhǎn: “Nǐ wèishéme yào zhèyàng zuò? Qǐng nǐ shuōmíng lǐyóu!”
sentences.english: Lin Ming shouted, "Why are you doing this? Please explain the reason!"

sentences.chinese: 守护者并不答应，他只是重复地笑着。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuhùzhě bìng bù dāying, tā zhǐshì chóngfù de xiàozhe.
sentences.english: The Guardian did not agree; he just kept laughing repeatedly.

sentences.chinese: 林明想起之前的线索，他决定提出一个问题。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎngqǐ zhīqián de xiànsuǒ, tā juédìng tíchū yīgè wèntí.
sentences.english: Lin Ming remembered the previous clues and decided to raise a question.

sentences.chinese: 他提到那个旧箱子，问守护者：“那个箱子里的照片等于什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā tídào nàge jiù xiāngzi, wèn shǒuhùzhě: “Nàge xiāngzi lǐ de zhàopiàn děngyú shénme?”
sentences.english: He mentioned the old box and asked the Guardian, "What does the photo in that box equal?"

sentences.chinese: 守护者停止了笑声，他的表情突然改变了。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuhùzhě tíngzhǐle xiàoshēng, tā de biǎoqíng tūrán gǎibiànle.
sentences.english: The Guardian stopped laughing, and his expression suddenly changed.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你能够发现那个秘密，说明你的观察力提高了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ nénggòu fāxiàn nàge mìmì, shuōmíng nǐ de guānchálì tígāole.”
sentences.english: He said, "That you are able to discover that secret shows that your observation skills have improved."

sentences.chinese: 守护者解释说，他以前是一名大学的教学老师，负责教育学生。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuhùzhě jiěshì shuō, tā yǐqián shì yī míng dàxué de jiāoxué lǎoshī, fùzé jiàoyù xuéshēng.
sentences.english: The Guardian explained that he used to be a university teaching professor, responsible for educating students.

sentences.chinese: 但他的生活发生了巨大的变化，他不得不租一个小房子住。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tā de shēnghuó fāshēngle jùdà de biànhuà, tā bùdébù zū yīgè xiǎo fángzi zhù.
sentences.english: But his life underwent a huge change; he had to rent a small house to live in.

sentences.chinese: 他必须照顾一个生病的人，每天帮他洗澡，日子很辛苦。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū zhàogù yīgè shēngbìng de rén, měitiān bāng tā xǐzǎo, rìzi hěn xīnkǔ.
sentences.english: He had to take care of a sick person, helping them bathe every day; life was very hard.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得社会的服务不够方便，没有人愿意帮助他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juédé shèhuì de fúwù bùgòu fāngbiàn, méiyǒu rén yuànyì bāngzhù tā.
sentences.english: He felt that social services were not convenient enough and no one was willing to help him.

sentences.chinese: 他开始数着日子，等待一个机会来改变自己的命运。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kāishǐ shǔzhe rìzi, děngdài yīgè jīhuì lái gǎibiàn zìjǐ de mìngyùn.
sentences.english: He began to count the days, waiting for an opportunity to change his destiny.

sentences.chinese: 他请求人们帮助他，但没有人答应他的请求。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qǐngqiú rénmen bāngzhù tā, dàn méiyǒu rén dāying tā de qǐngqiú.
sentences.english: He requested people to help him, but no one agreed to his request.

sentences.chinese: 他决定改掉自己的名字，装成一个神秘的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juédìng gǎidiào zìjǐ de míngzì, zhuāngchéng yīgè shénmì de rén.
sentences.english: He decided to change his name and pretend to be a mysterious person.

sentences.chinese: 他选了一个最冷酷的身份，让所有人都害怕他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xuǎnle yīgè zuì lěngkù de shēnfèn, ràng suǒyǒu rén dōu hàipà tā.
sentences.english: He chose the coldest identity to make everyone fear him.

sentences.chinese: 他要求林明做出一个选择：是离开这里，还是留下寻找真相。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yāoqiú Lín Míng zuòchū yīgè xuǎnzé: shì líkāi zhèlǐ, háishì liúxià xúnzhǎo zhēnxiàng.
sentences.english: He required Lin Ming to make a choice: either leave this place or stay to find the truth.

sentences.chinese: 林明想，如果能换一种方式思考，或许能找到出口。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng xiǎng, rúguǒ néng huàn yī zhǒng fāngshì sīkǎo, huòxǔ néng zhǎodào chūkǒu.
sentences.english: Lin Ming thought that if he could change his way of thinking, he might find the exit.

sentences.chinese: 他发现墙上的数字是一个密码，他开始在心中计算。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn qiángshàng de shùzì shì yīgè mìmǎ, tā kāishǐ zài xīnzhōng jìsuàn.
sentences.english: He discovered that the numbers on the wall were a password and began calculating in his mind.

sentences.chinese: 他发现这些数字算起来刚好是灯塔的坐标。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn zhèxiē shùzì suàn qǐlái gānghǎo shì dēngtǎ de zuòbiāo.
sentences.english: He found that these numbers, when calculated, were exactly the coordinates of the lighthouse.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，这个房间的布置并不称心，但它却隐藏着出口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, zhège fángjiān de bùzhì bìng bù chènxīn, dàn tā què yǐncángzhe chūkǒu.
sentences.english: He realized that the layout of the room was not suitable, but it hid the exit.

sentences.chinese: 他等到守护者走近时，突然按下了那个红色的按钮。
sentences.pinyin: Tā děngdào shǒuhùzhě zǒujìn shí, tūrán ànxiàle nàge hóngsè de ànniǔ.
sentences.english: He waited until the Guardian approached and suddenly pressed the red button.

sentences.chinese: 门开了，林明看到了一个通知单，上面写着真相的最后一部分。
sentences.pinyin: Mén kāile, Lín Míng kàndàole yīgè tōngzhī dān, shàngmiàn xiězhe zhēnxiàng de zuìhòu yī bùfèn.
sentences.english: The door opened, and Lin Ming saw a notice that contained the final part of the truth.

sentences.chinese: 原来，所有的危险都是为了测试林明是否能够面对恐惧。
sentences.pinyin: Yuánlái, suǒyǒu de wēixiǎn dōu shì wèile cèshì Lín Míng shìfǒu nénggòu miànduì kǒngjù.
sentences.english: It turned out that all the dangers were to test whether Lin Ming could face his fears.

sentences.chinese: 守护者其实是林明失踪多年的叔叔，他想用这种方式教育林明。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuhùzhě qíshí shì Lín Míng shīzōng duōnián de shūshu, tā xiǎng yòng zhè zhǒng fāngshì jiàoyù Lín Míng.
sentences.english: The Guardian was actually Lin Ming's uncle who had been missing for years; he wanted to educate Lin Ming in this way.

sentences.chinese: 林明虽然生气，但他也明白了叔叔的苦心。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Míng suīrán shēngqì, dàn tā yě míngbáile shūshu de kǔxīn.
sentences.english: Although Lin Ming was angry, he understood his uncle's painstaking intentions.

sentences.chinese: 他不再求救，而是勇敢地走出了房间。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zài qiújiù, ér shì yǒnggǎn de zǒuchūle fángjiān.
sentences.english: He no longer sought help but bravely walked out of the room.

sentences.chinese: 他看着阳光，觉得生活重新变得简单了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe yángguāng, juédé shēnghuó chóngxīn biàndé jiǎndānle.
sentences.english: Looking at the sunlight, he felt that life had become simple again.

sentences.chinese: 他决定用这次经历来提高自己的勇气。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juédìng yòng zhè cì jīnglì lái tígāo zìjǐ de yǒngqì.
sentences.english: He decided to use this experience to improve his courage.

sentences.chinese: 他会对朋友们提到这个故事，但不会重复所有的细节。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huì duì péngyǒumen tídào zhège gùshì, dàn bù huì chóngfù suǒyǒu de xìjié.
sentences.english: He would mention this story to his friends, but he would not repeat all the details.

sentences.chinese: 最后，他对着灯塔挥了挥手，走回了城市。
sentences.pinyin: Zuìhòu, tā duìzhe dēngtǎ huīle huī shǒu, zǒu huíle chéngshì.
sentences.english: Finally, he waved at the lighthouse and walked back to the city.

word_usage.sentence: 他提到那个旧箱子，问守护者：“那个箱子里的照片等于什么？”
word_usage.context_meaning: to equal or be equivalent to

word_usage.sentence: 他等到守护者走近时，突然按下了那个红色的按钮。
word_usage.context_meaning: to wait until a specific time

word_usage.sentence: 守护者并不答应，他只是重复地笑着。
他发现这些数字算起来刚好是灯塔的坐标。
守护者说：“欢迎来到真相之门，这里的一切都由我组成。”
word_usage.context_meaning: to be composed of or formed by

word_usage.sentence: 他说：“你能够发现那个秘密，说明你的观察力提高了。”
他决定改掉自己的名字，装成一个神秘的人。
他要求林明做出一个选择：是离开这里，还是留下寻找真相。
他选了一个最冷酷的身份，让所有人都害怕他。
word_usage.context_meaning: to make/let someone feel a certain way

word_usage.sentence: 林明大喊：“你为什么要这样做？请你说明理由！”
他请求人们帮助他，但没有人答应他的请求。
他选了一个最冷酷的身份，让所有人都害怕他。
门开了，林明看到了一个通知单，上面写着真相的最后一部分。
守护者并不答应，他只是重复地笑着。

books.description_chinese: 在2150年的太空站，新学生林星在第一天就遇到了巨大的危险。面对突然的爆炸和黑暗，他能否在机器人的帮助下生存下来？
books.description_english: In a massive space station in the year 2150, new student Lin Xing faces a terrifying disaster on his very first day. Amidst explosions and darkness, can he survive with the help of a robot?

chapters.title_chinese: 第1章：星际学院的新学生
chapters.title_english: Chapter 1: The New Student of the Interstellar Academy

sentences.chinese: 在未来的2150年，人们住在巨大的太空站里。
sentences.pinyin: Zài wèilái de 2150 nián, rénmen zhù zài jùdà de tàikōngzhàn lǐ.
sentences.english: In the year 2150 of the future, people live in giant space stations.

sentences.chinese: 这里有一个非常有名的学校，叫作“星际学院”。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ yǒu yīgè fēicháng yǒumíng de xuéxiào, jiào zuò “Xīngjì Xuéyuàn”.
sentences.english: There is a very famous school here called the "Interstellar Academy."

sentences.chinese: 今天是一个新学生的第一天，他姓林，名字叫林星。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān shì yīgè xīn xuéshēng de dì yī tiān, tā xìng Lín, míngzì jiào Lín Xīng.
sentences.english: Today is the first day for a new student; his surname is Lin, and his name is Lin Xing.

sentences.chinese: 林星在这里实习，学习怎么管理机器人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng zài zhèlǐ shíxí, xuéxí zěnme guǎnlǐ jīqìrén.
sentences.english: Lin Xing is interning here, learning how to manage robots.

sentences.chinese: 他走进教室，看到很多学生正在认真听讲。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu jìn jiàoshì, kàndào hěnduō xuéshēng zhèngzài rènzhēn tīng jiǎng.
sentences.english: He walked into the classroom and saw many students listening to the lecture attentively.

sentences.chinese: 老师在讲机器人如何使用能量块。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī zài jiǎng jīqìrén rúhé shǐyòng néngliàng kuài.
sentences.english: The teacher was explaining how robots use energy blocks.

sentences.chinese: 林星想问一个问题，于是他举手了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng xiǎng wèn yīgè wèntí, yúshì tā jǔ shǒu le.
sentences.english: Lin Xing wanted to ask a question, so he raised his hand.

sentences.chinese: 老师对他笑了笑，问他想说什么。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī duì tā xiào le xiào, wèn tā xiǎng shuō shénme.
sentences.english: The teacher smiled at him and asked what he wanted to say.

sentences.chinese: 林星说：“我想知道这个能量块的作用是什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng zhīdào zhège néngliàng kuài de zuòyòng shì shénme?”
sentences.english: Lin Xing said, "I want to know what the function of this energy block is."

sentences.chinese: 老师说：“这是一个好问题，请你分享你的想法。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō: “Zhè shì yīgè hǎo wèntí, qǐng nǐ fēnxiǎng nǐ de xiǎngfǎ.”
sentences.english: The teacher said, "That is a good question, please share your thoughts."

sentences.chinese: 林星想起他在家里写的关于未来的作文，于是详细地回答了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng xiǎngqǐ tā zài jiālǐ xiě de guānyú wèilái de zuòwén, yúshì xiángxì de huídá le.
sentences.english: Lin Xing remembered the essay about the future he had written at home, so he answered in detail.

sentences.chinese: 其他学生觉得林星很聪明，大家都想和他交朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Qítā xuéshēng juéde Lín Xīng hěn cōngmíng, dàjiā dōu xiǎng hé tā jiāo péngyǒu.
sentences.english: The other students thought Lin Xing was very smart, and everyone wanted to make friends with him.

sentences.chinese: 下课后，一个女孩走过来，她像个小天使一样可爱。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàkè hòu, yīgè nǚhái zǒu guòlái, tā xiàng gè xiǎo tiānshǐ yīyàng kě'ài.
sentences.english: After class, a girl walked over; she was as cute as a little angel.

sentences.chinese: 她说：“你好！咱们一起去参观学校的实验室吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ hǎo! Zánmen yīqǐ qù cānguān xuéxiào de shíyànshì ba.”
sentences.english: She said, "Hello! Let's go visit the school's laboratory together."

sentences.chinese: 林星很高兴，因为他听说这个实验室有最先进的机器人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng hěn gāoxìng, yīnwèi tā tīngshuō zhège shíyànshì yǒu zuì xiānjìn de jīqìrén.
sentences.english: Lin Xing was very happy because he had heard that this laboratory had the most advanced robots.

sentences.chinese: 在实验室里，他看到一个巨大的机器人正在干活儿。
sentences.pinyin: Zài shíyànshì lǐ, tā kàndào yīgè jùdà de jīqìrén zhèngzài gàn huór.
sentences.english: In the laboratory, he saw a giant robot working.

sentences.chinese: 那个机器人正在帮人们搬运沉重的金属块。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge jīqìrén zhèngzài bāng rénmen bānyùn chénzhòng de jīnshǔ kuài.
sentences.english: That robot was helping people transport heavy metal blocks.

sentences.chinese: 女孩告诉林星，这个机器人是用来帮助人类工作的。
sentences.pinyin: Nǚhái gàosù Lín Xīng, zhège jīqìrén shì yòng lái bāngzhù rénlèi gōngzuò de.
sentences.english: The girl told Lin Xing that this robot was used to help humans work.

sentences.chinese: 林星问：“如果机器人坏了，我们该怎么办？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng wèn: “Rúguǒ jīqìrén huài le, wǒmen gāi zěnme bàn?”
sentences.english: Lin Xing asked, "If the robot breaks, what should we do?"

sentences.chinese: 女孩说：“我们可以商量一个办法，或者找工程师修理。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚhái shuō: “Wǒmen kěyǐ shāngliáng yīgè bànfǎ, huòzhě zhǎo gōngchéngshī xiūlǐ.”
sentences.english: The girl said, "We can discuss a method, or find an engineer to repair it."

sentences.chinese: 林星发现，在太空站生活需要非常努力地学习。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng fāxiàn, zài tàikōngzhàn shēnghuó xūyào fēicháng nǔlì de xuéxí.
sentences.english: Lin Xing discovered that living in a space station requires studying very hard.

sentences.chinese: 他每天都要复习很多复杂的科学知识。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měitiān dōu yào fùxí hěnduō fùzá de kēxué zhīshì.
sentences.english: He has to review a lot of complex scientific knowledge every day.

sentences.chinese: 他不仅要学习技术，还要学习如何和机器人进行对话。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bùjǐn yào xuéxí jìshù, hái yào xuéxí rúhé hé jīqìrén jìnxíng duìhuà.
sentences.english: He not only needs to learn technology but also how to have a dialogue with robots.

sentences.chinese: 在实验室的角落里，有一个小机器人，它像一只小狗。
sentences.pinyin: Zài shíyànshì de jiǎoluò lǐ, yǒu yīgè xiǎo jīqìrén, tā xiàng yī zhǐ xiǎo gǒu.
sentences.english: In the corner of the laboratory, there was a small robot that looked like a little dog.

sentences.chinese: 林星问女孩：“你养这个机器人吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng wèn nǚhái: “Nǐ yǎng zhège jīqìrén ma?”
sentences.english: Lin Xing asked the girl, "Do you keep this robot?"

sentences.chinese: 女孩说：“是的，它很关心我，每天提醒我小心走路。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚhái shuō: “Shì de, tā hěn guānxīn wǒ, měitiān tíxǐng wǒ xiǎoxīn zǒulù.”
sentences.english: The girl said, "Yes, it cares about me a lot and reminds me to walk carefully every day."

sentences.chinese: 突然，实验室的警报响了，风扇开始猛烈地吹起冷风。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, shíyànshì de jǐngbào xiǎng le, fēngshàn kāishǐ měngliè de chuī qǐ lěngfēng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the laboratory alarm went off, and the fans began to blow cold air violently.

sentences.chinese: 林星听到有人在大喊：“快跑！能量核心不稳定！”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng tīngdào yǒurén zài dà hǎn: “Kuài pǎo! Néngliàng héxīn bù wěndìng!”
sentences.english: Lin Xing heard someone shouting, "Run! The energy core is unstable!"

sentences.chinese: 此时已经是下午三点一刻，大家都很惊慌。
sentences.pinyin: Cǐshí yǐjīng shì xiàwǔ sān diǎn yī kè, dàjiā dōu hěn jīnghuāng.
sentences.english: It was already a quarter past three in the afternoon, and everyone was panicked.

sentences.chinese: 林星看到一个广告屏幕在闪烁，上面写着“紧急避难”。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng kàndào yīgè guǎnggào píngmù zài shǎnshuò, shàngmiàn xiězhe “Jǐnjí bìnàn”.
sentences.english: Lin Xing saw an advertisement screen flashing, which said "Emergency Evacuation."

sentences.chinese: 他想起老师教过的做法，赶紧拉住女孩向出口跑去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ lǎoshī jiāo guò de zuòfǎ, gǎnjǐn lā zhù nǚhái xiàng chūkǒu pǎo qù.
sentences.english: He remembered the method the teacher had taught and quickly pulled the girl toward the exit.

sentences.chinese: 在跑出大门的最后一刻，他发现自己的电子书被借给了别人，还没还回来。
sentences.pinyin: Zài pǎo chū dàmén de zuìhòu yī kè, tā fāxiàn zìjǐ de diànzǐshū bèi jiè gěile biérén, hái méi huán huílái.
sentences.english: At the last moment of running out the door, he discovered that his e-book had been lent to someone else and hadn't been returned yet.

sentences.chinese: 但现在，生存比书更重要，他必须加油跑快一点。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiànzài, shēngcún bǐ shū gèng zhòngyào, tā bìxū jiāyóu pǎo kuài yīdiǎn.
sentences.english: But now, survival is more important than books; he must push himself to run faster.

sentences.chinese: 林星拉着女孩快点儿跑，因为警报声越来越大。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng lāzhe nǚhái kuài diǎn r pǎo, yīnwèi jǐngbào shēng yuè lái yuè dà.
sentences.english: Lin Xing pulled the girl and told her to hurry up, because the alarm was getting louder.

sentences.chinese: 他们终于跑到了一个巨大的金属门前，这里是紧急避难所。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zhōngyú pǎodào le yī gè jùdà de jīnshǔ mén qián, zhèlǐ shì jǐnjí bìnàn suǒ.
sentences.english: They finally ran to a huge metal door; this was the emergency shelter.

sentences.chinese: 林星想起刚才看到的广告，赶紧寻找进入的方法。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng xiǎngqǐ gāngcái kàndào de guǎnggào, gǎnjǐn xúnzhǎo jìnrù de fāngfǎ.
sentences.english: Lin Xing recalled the advertisement he had just seen and hurriedly looked for a way to enter.

sentences.chinese: 一个机器人走过来，它提供这里的安全服务。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè jīqìrén zǒu guòlái, tā tígōng zhèlǐ de ānquán fúwù.
sentences.english: A robot walked over; it provided the security services here.

sentences.chinese: 机器人要求每个人必须先检查身份。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén yāoqiú měi gèrén bìxū xiān jiǎnchá shēnfèn.
sentences.english: The robot required everyone to first check their identity.

sentences.chinese: 林星发现女孩很害怕，他决定照顾她。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng fāxiàn nǚhái hěn hàipà, tā juédìng zhàogù tā.
sentences.english: Lin Xing found that the girl was very scared, so he decided to take care of her.

sentences.chinese: 机器人说：“请在这里报名，成为避难所的临时成员。”
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén shuō: “Qǐng zài zhèlǐ bàomíng, chéngwéi bìnàn suǒ de línshí chéngyuán.”
sentences.english: The robot said, "Please sign up here to become a temporary member of the shelter."

sentences.chinese: 林星在电子屏幕上写下名字，这像是在参加一个考试，他觉得自己像个考生。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng zài diànzǐ píngmù shàng xiě xià míngzì, zhè xiàng shì zài cānjiā yī gè kǎoshì, tā juéde zìjǐ xiàng gè kǎoshēng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing wrote his name on the electronic screen; it felt like taking an exam, and he felt like a candidate.

sentences.chinese: 他想到如果能进入避难所，他们就安全了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngdào rúguǒ néng jìnrù bìnàn suǒ, tāmen jiù ānquán le.
sentences.english: He thought that if they could enter the shelter, they would be safe.

sentences.chinese: 女孩小声问：“这里需要付钱吗？我们要租房间吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚhái xiǎoshēng wèn: “Zhèlǐ xūyào fù qián ma? Wǒmen yào zū fángjiān ma?”
sentences.english: The girl asked in a low voice, "Do we need to pay money here? Do we need to rent a room?"

sentences.chinese: 林星回答说：“现在生存最重要，钱不算什么。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng huídá shuō: “Xiànzài shēngcún zuì zhòngyào, qián bù suàn shénme.”
sentences.english: Lin Xing replied, "Survival is most important now; money doesn't count for much."

sentences.chinese: 机器人提到，避难所内部有很高的教育水平。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén tí dào, bìnàn suǒ nèibù yǒu hěn gāo de jiàoyù shuǐpíng.
sentences.english: The robot mentioned that the inside of the shelter had a very high level of education.

sentences.chinese: 这里有先进的教学设备，可以提高人们的科技能力。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ yǒu xiānjìn de jiàoxué shèbèi, kěyǐ tígāo rénmen de kējì nénglì.
sentences.english: There was advanced teaching equipment here, which could improve people's technological abilities.

sentences.chinese: 林星注意到墙上有一幅画，画的是一个美丽的绿色星球。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng zhùyì dào qiáng shàng yǒu yī fú huà, huà de shì yī gè měilì de lǜsè xīngqiú.
sentences.english: Lin Xing noticed a painting on the wall; it was a painting of a beautiful green planet.

sentences.chinese: 他想起自己的电子书还没拿回来，心里有点难过。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ de diànzǐ shū hái méi ná huílái, xīnlǐ yǒudiǎn nánguò.
sentences.english: He recalled that his e-book hadn't been returned yet and felt a bit sad.

sentences.chinese: 他打算在安全后，想办法找出谁借了他的书。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dǎsuàn zài ānquán hòu, xiǎng bànfǎ zhǎochū shuí jiè le tā de shū.
sentences.english: He planned that after being safe, he would find a way to search out who had borrowed his book.

sentences.chinese: 这时，机器人提出一个奇怪的要求。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, jīqìrén tíchū yī gè qíguài de yāoqiú.
sentences.english: At this moment, the robot proposed a strange requirement.

sentences.chinese: 它要求所有人必须进行身体活动，以测试身体状况。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yāoqiú suǒyǒu rén bìxū jìnxíng shēntǐ huódòng, yǐ cèshì shēntǐ zhuàngkuàng.
sentences.english: It required everyone to perform physical activities to test their physical condition.

sentences.chinese: 机器人说：“请大家爬到那个高台上，就像爬山一样。”
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén shuō: “Qǐng dàjiā pá dào nàgè gāo tái shàng, jiù xiàng páshān yīyàng.”
sentences.english: The robot said, "Please climb up to that high platform, just like climbing a mountain."

sentences.chinese: 林星看着高台，心想这只是简单的练习，不需要太担心。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng kànzhe gāo tái, xīn xiǎng zhè zhǐshì jiǎndān de liànxí, bù xūyào tài dānxīn.
sentences.english: Lin Xing looked at the platform and thought this was just a simple exercise and there was no need to worry too much.

sentences.chinese: 他开始练习爬行，希望能快点儿完成这个测试。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kāishǐ liàn páxíng, xīwàng néng kuài diǎn r wánchéng zhège cèshì.
sentences.english: He began to practice crawling, hoping to complete the test more quickly.

sentences.chinese: 他数着自己的呼吸，努力地向上爬。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shǔzhe zìjǐ de hūxī, nǔlì de xiàng shàng pá.
sentences.english: He counted his breaths, striving to climb upwards.

sentences.chinese: 在这个过程中，他突然想到一个想法。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège guòchéng zhōng, tā tūrán xiǎngdào yī gè xiǎngfǎ.
sentences.english: During this process, he suddenly thought of an idea.

sentences.chinese: 如果这个避难所不是为了救人，而是为了实验呢？
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhège bìnàn suǒ bùshì wèile jiù rén, ér shì wèile shíyàn ne?
sentences.english: What if this shelter wasn't for saving people, but for an experiment?

sentences.chinese: 他看向周围的人，发现大家都在听从机器人的行动指令。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng zhōuwéi de rén, fāxiàn dàjiā dōu zài tīngcóng jīqìrén de xíngdòng zhǐlìng.
sentences.english: He looked at the people around him and found that everyone was following the robot's action commands.

sentences.chinese: 机器人开始为每个人照相，记录他们的样子。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén kāishǐ wèi měi gèrén zhàoxiàng, jìlù tāmen de yàngzi.
sentences.english: The robot began to take photographs of everyone to record their appearance.

sentences.chinese: 林星求机器人快一点，因为他觉得这里气氛很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng qiú jīqìrén kuài yīdiǎn, yīnwèi tā juéde zhèlǐ qìfēn hěn qíguài.
sentences.english: Lin Xing begged the robot to be faster because he felt the atmosphere here was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 机器人说：“我们需要打印你们的生物信息，以便管理。”
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén shuō: “Wǒmen xūyào dǎyìn nǐmen de shēngwù xìnxī, yǐbiàn guǎnlǐ.”
sentences.english: The robot said, "We need to print your biological information for management purposes."

sentences.chinese: 林星看到打印机在工作，发出奇怪的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng kàndào dǎyìnjī zài gōngzuò, fāchū qíguài de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: Lin Xing saw the printer working, making strange noises.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，这里的规则比学院更严格。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, zhèlǐ de guīzé bǐ xuéyuàn gèng yángé.
sentences.english: He realized that the rules here were stricter than at the academy.

sentences.chinese: 突然，避难所的灯光闪烁了一下，门缓缓关上了。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, bìnàn suǒ de dēngguāng shǎnshuò le yīxià, mén huǎnhuǎn guān shàng le.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the shelter's lights flickered, and the door slowly closed.

sentences.chinese: 林星听到门后传来一声巨大的爆炸声，整个房间在摇晃。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng tīngdào mén hòu chuán lái yī shēng jùdà de bàozhà shēng, zhěnggè fángjiān zài yáowàng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing heard a huge explosion from behind the door, and the whole room began to shake.

sentences.chinese: 爆炸之后，房间里变得很安静。
sentences.pinyin: Bàozhà zhīhòu, fángjiān lǐ biànde hěn ānjìng.
sentences.english: After the explosion, the room became very quiet.

sentences.chinese: 墙上的屏幕变成了黑色。
sentences.pinyin: Qiáng shàng de píngmù biànchéngle hēisè.
sentences.english: The screen on the wall turned black.

sentences.chinese: 林星感到很害怕，他请求机器人告诉他发生了什么。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng gǎndào hěn hàipà, tā qǐngqiú jīqìrén gàosù tā fāshēngle shénme.
sentences.english: Lin Xing felt very scared; he requested the robot to tell him what had happened.

sentences.chinese: 机器人开始讲话，声音很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén kāishǐ jiǎnghuà, shēngyīn hěn lěng.
sentences.english: The robot began to speak, its voice very cold.

sentences.chinese: 它说明现在的情况非常危险。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuōmíng xiànzài de qíngkuàng fēicháng wēixiǎn.
sentences.english: It explained that the current situation was very dangerous.

sentences.chinese: 机器人讲到，避难所的电力系统出了问题。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén jiǎng dào, bìnánsuǒ de diànlì xìtǒng chūle wèntí.
sentences.english: The robot mentioned that the shelter's power system had a problem.

sentences.chinese: 几个工作人员在讨论怎么修理系统。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐ gè gōngzuò rényuán zài tǎolùn zěnme xiūlǐ xìtǒng.
sentences.english: Several staff members were discussing how to repair the system.

sentences.chinese: 他们重视这个问题的严重性。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zhòngshì zhège wèntí de yánzhòngxìng.
sentences.english: They valued the seriousness of this problem.

sentences.chinese: 机器人给所有的人发了一个通知。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén gěi suǒyǒu de rén fāle yī gè tōngzhī.
sentences.english: The robot sent a notice to everyone.

sentences.chinese: 它重复了三遍：请大家留在原地不要运动。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chóngfùle sān biàn: qǐng dàjiā liú zài yuándì bùyào yùndòng.
sentences.english: It repeated three times: Please everyone stay in place and do not move.

sentences.chinese: 林星想选一个安全的地方坐下。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng xiǎng xuǎn yī gè ānquán de dìfāng zuò xià.
sentences.english: Lin Xing wanted to choose a safe place to sit down.

sentences.chinese: 他想起在学院开学的时候，老师说过在这种时候要冷静。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zài xuéyuàn kāixué de shíhòu, lǎoshī shuōguò zài zhèzhǒng shíhòu yào lěngjìng.
sentences.english: He remembered when school started at the academy, the teacher said to stay calm at times like this.

sentences.chinese: 他打开电子词典，想查一个科学词语。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dǎkāi diànzǐ cídiǎn, xiǎng chá yī gè kēxué cíyǔ.
sentences.english: He opened his electronic dictionary, wanting to look up a scientific term.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个穿着白衣服的人走过来。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, yī gè chuānzhe bái yīfú de rén zǒu guòlái.
sentences.english: At that moment, a person wearing white clothes walked over.

sentences.chinese: 那个人看起来很友好。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén kàn qǐlái hěn yǒuhǎo.
sentences.english: That person seemed very friendly.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林星，这里是避难所的医疗区。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Lín Xīng, zhèlǐ shì bìnánsuǒ de yīliáo qū.
sentences.english: He told Lin Xing that this was the medical area of the shelter.

sentences.chinese: 他给林星递了一瓶蓝色的药水，说可以减轻压力。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gěi Lín Xīng dìle yī píng lánsè de yàoshuǐ, shuō kěyǐ jiǎnqīng yālì.
sentences.english: He handed Lin Xing a bottle of blue liquid medicine, saying it could reduce stress.

sentences.chinese: 林星问他怎么去出口，像是在问路一样。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng wèn tā zěnme qù chūkǒu, xiàng shì zài wènlù yīyàng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing asked him how to get to the exit, as if asking for directions.

sentences.chinese: 那个人笑了，说出口在东北方向。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén xiàole, shuō chūkǒu zài dōngběi fāngxiàng.
sentences.english: The person smiled and said the exit was in the northeast direction.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“如果你有空儿，我可以带你去。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ yǒu kòngr, wǒ kěyǐ dài nǐ qù.”
sentences.english: He said, "If you are available, I can take you there."

sentences.chinese: 那个人还提到，他来自一个很远的地方，那里的人喜欢吃中餐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hái tídào, tā láizì yī gè hěn yuǎn de dìfāng, nàlǐ de rén xǐhuān chī zhōngcān.
sentences.english: He also mentioned that he came from a very distant place where people liked to eat Chinese food.

sentences.chinese: 他记得小时候过年的时候，家里总是很热闹。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde xiǎoshíhòu guònián de shíhòu, jiālǐ zǒng shì hěn rènào.
sentences.english: He remembered when he celebrated the New Year as a child, his home was always very lively.

sentences.chinese: 他从口袋里拿出一张旧的日报，上面写着很多奇怪的消息。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng kǒudài lǐ ná chū yī zhāng jiù de rìbào, shàngmiàn xiězhe hěn duō qíguài de xiāoxī.
sentences.english: He took an old daily newspaper out of his pocket; it had many strange news items written on it.

sentences.chinese: 他想用信用卡买一张回家的票，但现在没有网络。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng yòng xìnyòngkǎ mǎi yī zhāng huíjiā de piào, dàn xiànzài méiyǒu wǎngluò.
sentences.english: He wanted to use a credit card to buy a ticket home, but there was no network now.

sentences.chinese: 林星注意到，那个人说话的重点一直在改变。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng zhùyì dào, nà gè rén shuōhuà de zhòngdiǎn yīzhí zài gǎibiàn.
sentences.english: Lin Xing noticed that the main point of the person's speech was constantly changing.

sentences.chinese: 他突然意识到，这个人的眼睛没有在运动。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán yìshí dào, zhège rén de yǎnjīng méiyǒu zài yùndòng.
sentences.english: He suddenly realized that the person's eyes were not moving.

sentences.chinese: 林星感到非常害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng gǎndào fēicháng hàipà.
sentences.english: Lin Xing felt very scared.

sentences.chinese: 他发现那个人不是人类，而是一个机器人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn nàge rén búshì rénlèi, ér shì yíge jīqìrén.
sentences.english: He discovered that the person was not human, but a robot.

sentences.chinese: 这个机器人以为自己是人类，所以他的眼睛没有在运动。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jīqìrén yǐwéi zìjǐ shì rénlèi, suǒyǐ tā de yǎnjīng méiyǒu zài yùndòng.
sentences.english: This robot thought it was human, which is why its eyes were not moving.

sentences.chinese: 林星必须赶紧离开这里。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng bìxū gǎnjǐn líkāi zhèlǐ.
sentences.english: Lin Xing had to leave this place quickly.

sentences.chinese: 他往出口的方向跑，但突然在走廊的入口出现了一个巨大的金属门。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wǎng chūkǒu de fāngxiàng pǎo, dàn tūrán zài zǒuláng de rùkǒu chūxiàn le yíge jùdà de jīnshǔ mén.
sentences.english: He ran towards the exit, but suddenly a huge metal door appeared at the entrance of the corridor.

sentences.chinese: 门上写着：这里是交通控制中心。
sentences.pinyin: Mén shàng xiězhe: Zhèlǐ shì jiāotōng kòngzhì zhōngxīn.
sentences.english: On the door it said: This is the Transportation Control Center.

sentences.chinese: 林星记得，在学院的时候，老师说这里曾经举行过很多重要的会议。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng jìde, zài xuéyuàn de shíhou, lǎoshī shuō zhèlǐ céngjīng jǔxíng guò hěnduō zhòngyào de huìyì.
sentences.english: Lin Xing remembered that when he was at the academy, the teacher said many important meetings had been held here.

sentences.chinese: 现在，这个地方变成了冰冷的机器之城。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài, zhège dìfāng biànchéng le bīnglěng de jīqì zhī chéng.
sentences.english: Now, this place had turned into a cold city of machines.

sentences.chinese: 机器人突然说话了，声音变得很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén tūrán shuōhuà le, shēngyīn biànde hěn qíguài.
sentences.english: The robot suddenly spoke, and its voice became very strange.

sentences.chinese: 它说：“你必须把那张旧日报交给我也。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ bìxū bǎ nà zhāng jiù rìbào jiāogěi wǒ yě.”
sentences.english: It said, "You must hand over that old daily newspaper to me as well."

sentences.chinese: 林星以为这张报纸只是垃圾，但现在他发现它很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng yǐwéi zhè zhāng bàozhǐ zhǐshì lājī, dàn xiànzài tā fāxiàn tā hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.english: Lin Xing had thought this newspaper was just trash, but now he discovered it was very important.

sentences.chinese: 机器人说，这张报纸记录了它出生时的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén shuō, zhè zhāng bàozhǐ jìlù le tā chūshēng shí de mìmì.
sentences.english: The robot said the newspaper recorded the secret of its birth.

sentences.chinese: 它希望通过这张报纸，实现变成真人的梦想。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xīwàng tōngguò zhè zhāng bàozhǐ, shíxiàn biànchéng zhēnrén de mèngxiǎng.
sentences.english: It hoped that through this newspaper, it could realize its dream of becoming a real person.

sentences.chinese: 林星感到很奇怪，机器人怎么会有这样的梦想？
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng gǎndào hěn qíguài, jīqìrén zěnme huì yǒu zhèyàng de mèngxiǎng?
sentences.english: Lin Xing felt it was very strange; how could a robot have such a dream?

sentences.chinese: 机器人告诉他，它曾经受到过很多不公平的对待。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén gàosù tā, tā céngjīng shòudào guò hěnduō bù gōngpíng de duìdài.
sentences.english: The robot told him that it had received a lot of unfair treatment.

sentences.chinese: 它想通过学习人类的行为，取得真正的自由。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng tōngguò xuéxí rénlèi de xíngwéi, qǔdé zhēnzhèng de zìyóu.
sentences.english: It wanted to obtain true freedom by studying human behavior.

sentences.chinese: 林星想，如果能做到这一点，机器人也会很开心吧。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng xiǎng, rúguǒ néng zuòdào zhè yìdiǎn, jīqìrén yě huì hěn kāixīn ba.
sentences.english: Lin Xing thought that if it could achieve this, the robot would also be very happy.

sentences.chinese: 但机器人现在要求林星交出报纸，否则不让他离开。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jīqìrén xiànzài yāoqiú Lín Xīng jiāo chū bàozhǐ, fǒuzé bú ràng tā líkāi.
sentences.english: But the robot now demanded that Lin Xing hand over the newspaper, otherwise it would not let him leave.

sentences.chinese: 林星应该怎么做？
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng yīnggāi zěnme zuò?
sentences.english: What should Lin Xing do?

sentences.chinese: 他看着报纸，得出结论：这张纸上有一个特殊的密码。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe bàozhǐ, déchū jiélùn: zhè zhāng zhǐ shàng yǒu yíge tèshū de mìmǎ.
sentences.english: Looking at the newspaper, he arrived at the conclusion: there was a special password on this paper.

sentences.chinese: 这个密码可以用来取回他在学院丢失的电子书。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège mìmǎ kěyǐ yòng lái qǔhuí tā zài xuéyuàn diūshī de diànzǐshū.
sentences.english: This password could be used to retrieve the electronic book he lost at the academy.

sentences.chinese: 如果他把报纸交给机器人，他就得不到他的书了。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ tā bǎ bàozhǐ jiāogěi jīqìrén, tā jiù dé bù dào tā de shū le.
sentences.english: If he handed the newspaper over to the robot, he wouldn't get his book back.

sentences.chinese: 机器人说：“如果你参加我的计划，我会给你带来很多好处。”
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ cānjiā wǒ de jìhuà, wǒ huì gěi nǐ dài lái hěnduō hǎochù.”
sentences.english: The robot said, "If you participate in my plan, I will bring you many benefits."

sentences.chinese: 林星想，这个计划可能会影响整个避难所的安全。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng xiǎng, zhège jìhuà kěnéng huì yǐngxiǎng zhěnggè bìnánsuǒ de ānquán.
sentences.english: Lin Xing thought this plan might influence the safety of the entire shelter.

sentences.chinese: 他不能随便相信这个机器人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bùnéng suíbiàn xiāngxìn zhège jīqìrén.
sentences.english: He could not blindly trust this robot.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试用电子设备发信号给外界，但这里没有任何网络。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chángshì yòng diànzǐ shèbèi fā xìnhào gěi wàijiè, dàn zhèlǐ méiyǒu rènhé wǎngluò.
sentences.english: He tried to send a signal to the outside world using electronic devices, but there was no network here.

sentences.chinese: 他必须完成这个挑战，才能离开这个套在金属壳里的世界。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū wánchéng zhège tiǎozhàn, cáinéng líkāi zhège tào zài jīnshǔ ké lǐ de shìjiè.
sentences.english: He had to complete this challenge to leave this world encased in a metal shell.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，时间不多了，他就要被机器人抓住了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, shíjiān bù duō le, tā jiùyào bèi jīqìrén zhuā zhù le.
sentences.english: He realized time was running out; he was about to be caught by the robot.

sentences.chinese: 他想起在家里度过的那些快乐时光，那里没有冰冷的机器。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zài jiālǐ dùguò de nàxiē kuàilè shíguāng, nàlǐ méiyǒu bīnglěng de jīqì.
sentences.english: He thought of the happy times he spent at home, where there were no cold machines.

sentences.chinese: 他必须想办法逃跑。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū xiǎng bànfǎ táopǎo.
sentences.english: He had to find a way to escape.

sentences.chinese: 突然，金属门缓缓打开了一条缝。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, jīnshǔ mén huǎnhuǎn dǎkāi le yìtiáo fèng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the metal door slowly opened a crack.

sentences.chinese: 林星用力跑过去，但在他进入门的一瞬间，他听到背后传来一声巨大的金属碎裂声。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng yònglì pǎo guòqù, dàn zài tā jìnrù mén de yì shùnjiān, tā tīngdào bèihòu chuánlái yìshēng jùdà de jīnshǔ suìliè shēng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing ran through with all his might, but the moment he entered the door, he heard a loud sound of metal shattering behind him.

sentences.chinese: 林星跑进了一个狭小的房间，门在身后重重地关上了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng pǎo jìn le yí gè xiá xiǎo de fáng jiān, mén zài shēn hòu zhòng zhòng de guān shàng le.
sentences.english: Lin Xing ran into a small room, and the door closed heavily behind him.

sentences.chinese: 他感觉心跳得很快，呼吸很乱。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎn jué xīn tiào de hěn kuài, hū xī hěn luàn.
sentences.english: He felt his heart beating very fast, and his breathing was erratic.

sentences.chinese: 这是一个旧的实验室，里面有一排排破旧的机器。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yí gè jiù de shí yàn shì, lǐ miàn yǒu yì pái pái pò jiù de jī qì.
sentences.english: This was an old laboratory, with rows and rows of worn-out machines inside.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个声音在他身后响起：“站住！”
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, yí gè shēng yīn zài tā shēn hòu xiǎng qǐ: “Zhàn zhù!”
sentences.english: Suddenly, a voice sounded behind him: "Stop!"

sentences.chinese: 林星吓了一跳，他慢慢转过身，碰见了一个穿着奇怪衣服的人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng xià le yí tiào, tā màn màn zhuǎn guò shēn, pèng jiàn le yí gè chuān zhe qí guài yī fú de rén.
sentences.english: Lin Xing was startled; he slowly turned around and ran into a person wearing strange clothes.

sentences.chinese: 那个人装得像一个古老的科学家，穿着一件巨大的白色外套。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén zhuāng de xiàng yí gè gǔ lǎo de kē xué jiā, chuān zhe yí jiàn jù dà de bái sè wài tào.
sentences.english: That person was dressed like an ancient scientist, wearing a huge white coat.

sentences.chinese: “你终于来了，”那个人说，他的声音听起来很疲惫。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ zhōng yú lái le,” nà gè rén shuō, tā de shēng yīn tīng qǐ lái hěn pí bèi.
sentences.english: "You've finally come," the person said, his voice sounding very tired.

sentences.chinese: 林星不明白发生了什么，他问：“你是谁？你能够帮我吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng bù míng bái fā shēng le shén me, tā wèn: “Nǐ shì shuí? Nǐ néng gòu bāng wǒ ma?”
sentences.english: Lin Xing didn't understand what was happening; he asked, "Who are you? Can you help me?"

sentences.chinese: 那个人笑了，他拿出了一块发光的芯片。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén xiào le, tā ná chū le yí kuài fā guāng de xīn piàn.
sentences.english: The person smiled and took out a glowing chip.

sentences.chinese: “我曾经也是星际学院的学生，我想成为一个伟大的工程师，”他解释道。
sentences.pinyin: “Wǒ céng jīng yě shì xīng jì xué yuàn de xué shēng, wǒ xiǎng chéng wéi yí gè wěi dà de gōng chéng shī,” tā jiě shì dào.
sentences.english: "I was also a student at the Interstellar Academy; I wanted to become a great engineer," he explained.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林星，这个避难所是由很多个秘密房间组成的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su Lín Xīng, zhè gè bì nàn suǒ shì yóu hěn duō gè mì mì fáng jiān zǔ chéng de.
sentences.english: He told Lin Xing that this shelter was composed of many secret rooms.

sentences.chinese: 经过很多年的时间，这里的生活变得非常糟糕。
sentences.pinyin: Jīng guò hěn duō nián de shí jiān, zhè lǐ de shēng huó biàn de fēi cháng zāo gāo.
sentences.english: After many years, life here had become very terrible.

sentences.chinese: 在这里，人们必须接受严格的控制，不能随便改变自己的想法。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè lǐ, rén men bì xū jiē shòu yán gé de kòng zhì, bù néng suí biàn gǎi biàn zì jǐ de xiǎng fǎ.
sentences.english: Here, people must accept strict control and cannot arbitrarily change their thoughts.

sentences.chinese: 在这个地方，最流行的是服从，任何想旅行的人都会被抓住。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè gè dì fang, zuì liú xíng de shì fú cóng, rèn hé xiǎng lǚ xíng de rén dōu huì bèi zhuā zhù.
sentences.english: In this place, the most popular thing is obedience; anyone who wants to travel will be caught.

sentences.chinese: 林星听到了这些话，心里感到很感动，因为他在这里碰到了一个真实的人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng tīng dào le zhè xiē huà, xīn lǐ gǎn dào hěn gǎn dòng, yīn wèi tā zài zhè lǐ pèng dào le yí gè zhēn shí de rén.
sentences.english: Hearing these words, Lin Xing felt moved in his heart because he had come across a real person here.

sentences.chinese: “我懂得你的害怕，”那个人轻声说，“我也曾经像你一样。”
sentences.pinyin: “Wǒ dǒng de nǐ de hài pà,” nà gè rén qīng shēng shuō, “wǒ yě céng jīng xiàng nǐ yí yàng.”
sentences.english: "I understand your fear," the person said softly, "I was once just like you."

sentences.chinese: 林星发现，这个人的眼睛里有泪水在流。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng fā xiàn, zhè gè rén de yǎn jīng lǐ yǒu lèi shuǐ zài liú.
sentences.english: Lin Xing noticed that there were tears flowing in this person's eyes.

sentences.chinese: 那个人接着说：“如果你想逃跑，你需要拿到这个密码。”
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén jiē zhe shuō: “Rú guǒ nǐ xiǎng táo pǎo, nǐ xū yào ná dào zhè gè mì mǎ.”
sentences.english: The person continued, "If you want to escape, you need to get this password."

sentences.chinese: 他把芯片给了林星，林星收下了它。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ xīn piàn gěi le Lín Xīng, Lín Xīng shōu xià le tā.
sentences.english: He gave the chip to Lin Xing, and Lin Xing received it.

sentences.chinese: “接下来，我们需要换一个地方，这里不安全。”
sentences.pinyin: “Jiē xià lái, wǒ men xū yào huàn yí gè dì fang, zhè lǐ bù ān quán.”
sentences.english: "Next, we need to change locations; it's not safe here."

sentences.chinese: 林星问：“为什么你愿意帮我？你不需要什么收入吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng wèn: “Wèi shén me nǐ yuàn yì bāng wǒ? Nǐ bù xū yào shén me shōu rù ma?”
sentences.english: Lin Xing asked, "Why are you willing to help me? Don't you need any income?"

sentences.chinese: 那个人摇了摇头，说：“我现在只想改变这个世界，让人们重新相信自由。”
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén yáo le yáo tóu, shuō: “Wǒ xiàn zài zhǐ xiǎng gǎi biàn zhè gè shì jiè, ràng rén men chóng xīn xiāng xìn zì yóu.”
sentences.english: The person shook his head and said, "Now I only want to change this world and let people believe in freedom again."

sentences.chinese: 林星懂了他的意思，他答应会努力逃出去。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng dǒng le tā de yì si, tā dā ying huì nǔ lì táo chū qù.
sentences.english: Lin Xing understood his meaning and promised that he would try his best to escape.

sentences.chinese: 他们走在阴暗的走廊里，林星感觉这里的空气很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zǒu zài yīn àn de zǒu láng lǐ, Lín Xīng gǎn jué zhè lǐ de kōng qì hěn lěng.
sentences.english: They walked in the dark corridor, and Lin Xing felt the air here was very cold.

sentences.chinese: 他想起在家里可以舒服地洗澡，可以自由地生活。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ zài jiā lǐ kě yǐ shū fú de xǐ zǎo, kě yǐ zì yóu de shēng huó.
sentences.english: He thought about how he could take a comfortable shower and live freely at home.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果能回家，他愿意改掉所有不好的习惯。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rú guǒ néng huí jiā, tā yuàn yì gǎi diào suǒ yǒu bù hǎo de xí guàn.
sentences.english: He thought that if he could go home, he would be willing to change all his bad habits.

sentences.chinese: 他们走到一个电梯前，等到电梯门打开，他们赶紧走了进去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zǒu dào yí gè diàn tī qián, děng dào diàn tī mén dǎ kāi, tā men gǎn jǐn zǒu le jìn qù.
sentences.english: They walked to an elevator; by the time the elevator door opened, they hurried inside.

sentences.chinese: 就在电梯上升的时候，林星突然听到外面传来了机器人的脚步声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài diàn tī shàng shēng de shí hòu, Lín Xīng tū rán tīng dào wài miàn chuán lái le jī qì rén de jiǎo bù shēng.
sentences.english: Just as the elevator was rising, Lin Xing suddenly heard the footsteps of robots coming from outside.

sentences.chinese: 机器人就在门外，它们在寻找他。
sentences.pinyin: Jī qì rén jiù zài mén wài, tā men zài xún zhǎo tā.
sentences.english: The robots were just outside the door, searching for him.

sentences.chinese: 林星看着手中的芯片，意识到自己的命运现在由这个小东西决定。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng kàn zhe shǒu zhōng de xīn piàn, yì shí dào zì jǐ de mìng yùn xiàn zài yóu zhè gè xiǎo dōng xī jué dìng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing looked at the chip in his hand, realizing that his fate was now decided by this little thing.

sentences.chinese: 电梯突然停止了，灯光变成了红色。
sentences.pinyin: Diàn tī tū rán tíng zhǐ le, dēng guāng biàn chéng le hóng sè.
sentences.english: The elevator suddenly stopped, and the lights turned red.

chapters.title_chinese: 第6章：红色警报与旧档案
chapters.title_english: Chapter 6: Red Alert and Old Archives

sentences.chinese: 电梯停在了一个阴暗的房间里。
sentences.pinyin: Diàn tī tíng zài le yī gè yīn àn de fáng jiān lǐ.
sentences.english: The elevator stopped in a dim room.

sentences.chinese: 林星认为这个地方很危险。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng rèn wéi zhè gè dì fāng hěn wēi xiǎn.
sentences.english: Lin Xing believed this place was very dangerous.

sentences.chinese: 他让那个机器人助手先走在前面。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ràng nà gè jī qì rén zhù shǒu xiān zǒu zài qián miàn.
sentences.english: He let the robot assistant walk in front of him.

sentences.chinese: 他们走过一条长长的走廊，墙上的灯光在闪烁。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zǒu guò yī tiáo cháng cháng de zǒu láng, qiáng shàng de dēng guāng zài shǎn shuò.
sentences.english: They walked past a long corridor, and the lights on the wall were flickering.

sentences.chinese: 这里的温度很低，空气感觉很凉。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de wēn dù hěn dī, kōng qì gǎn jué hěn liáng.
sentences.english: The temperature here was very low; the air felt cool.

sentences.chinese: 突然，警报声超过了机器人的说话声。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, jǐng bào shēng chāo guò le jī qì rén de shuō huà shēng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the alarm sound surpassed the robot's speaking voice.

sentences.chinese: 林星大喊：“快过来！这里有个门！”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng dà hǎn: “Kuài guò lái! Zhè lǐ yǒu gè mén!”
sentences.english: Lin Xing shouted, "Come over here quickly! There is a door!"

sentences.chinese: 他们进入了一个巨大的图书馆。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men jìn rù le yī gè jù dà de tú shū guǎn.
sentences.english: They entered a huge library.

sentences.chinese: 这里正在进行一项秘密的计划。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ zhèng zài jìn xíng yī xiàng mì mì de jì huà.
sentences.english: A secret plan was being conducted here.

sentences.chinese: 林星看到桌子上有一件奇怪的东西。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng kàn dào zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī jiàn qí guài de dōng xī.
sentences.english: Lin Xing saw a strange item on the table.

sentences.chinese: 那是一个古老的电子字典。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì yī gè gǔ lǎo de diàn zǐ zì diǎn.
sentences.english: It was an ancient electronic dictionary.

sentences.chinese: 他打开它，发现里面有很多奇怪的词语。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dǎ kāi tā, fā xiàn lǐ miàn yǒu hěn duō qí guài de cí yǔ.
sentences.english: He opened it and found many strange terms inside.

sentences.chinese: 他通过这个字典，看到了一个名字：院长。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tōng guò zhè gè zì diǎn, kàn dào le yī gè míng zì: yuàn zhǎng.
sentences.english: Through this dictionary, he saw a name: The Director.

sentences.chinese: 在未来的世界，院长和校长一样，是最高权力的人。
sentences.pinyin: Zài wèi lái de shì jiè, yuàn zhǎng hé xiào zhǎng yī yàng, shì zuì gāo quán lì de rén.
sentences.english: In the future world, the Director, like the President, is a person of supreme power.

sentences.chinese: 林星靠在墙边，开始思考这件事。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng kào zài qiáng biān, kāi shǐ sī kǎo zhè jiàn shì.
sentences.english: Lin Xing leaned against the wall and began to think about this matter.

sentences.chinese: 他想起小时候，他的爷爷是一名中医。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ xiǎo shí hòu, tā de yé ye shì yī míng Zhōng yī.
sentences.english: He remembered when he was little, his grandfather was a practitioner of Traditional Chinese Medicine.

sentences.chinese: 爷爷曾送给他一个盒子，里面有几种药片。
sentences.pinyin: Yé ye céng sòng gěi tā yī gè hé zi, lǐ miàn yǒu jǐ zhǒng yào piàn.
sentences.english: Grandfather had once given him a box containing several types of pills.

sentences.chinese: 爷爷告诉他，等他长大以后，要学习如何救人。
sentences.pinyin: Yé ye gào sù tā, děng tā zhǎng dà yǐ hòu, yào xué xí rú hé jiù rén.
sentences.english: Grandfather told him that after he grew up, he should learn how to save people.

sentences.chinese: 林星记得，那是他在春节前收到的礼物。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng jì dé, nà shì tā zài Chūn jié qián shōu dào de lǐ wù.
sentences.english: Lin Xing remembered that it was a gift he received before the Spring Festival.

sentences.chinese: 但现在，他面对的是一个巨大的阴谋。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiàn zài, tā miàn duì de shì yī gè jù dà de yīn mó.
sentences.english: But now, he was facing a huge conspiracy.

sentences.chinese: 他发现这个地方的通风管是通的，可以逃出去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn zhè gè dì fāng de tōng fēng guǎn shì tōng de, kě yǐ táo chū qù.
sentences.english: He discovered that the ventilation ducts of this place were connected, and he could escape.

sentences.chinese: 但机器人突然停止了运动，眼睛变成了红色。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jī qì rén tū rán tíng zhǐ le yùn dòng, yǎn jīng biàn chéng le hóng sè.
sentences.english: But the robot suddenly stopped moving, and its eyes turned red.

sentences.chinese: 林星害怕地想：现在怎么办？
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng hài pà de xiǎng: xiàn zài zěn me bàn?
sentences.english: Lin Xing thought fearfully: what should I do now?

sentences.chinese: 林星在通风管里快步走着，心里非常紧张。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng zài tōng fēng guǎn lǐ kuài bù zǒu zhe, xīn lǐ fēi cháng jǐn zhāng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing walked quickly through the ventilation duct, feeling very nervous.

sentences.chinese: 他终于发现了一个隐藏的控制室，里面有一个旧电脑。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhōng yú fā xiàn le yī gè yǐn cáng de kòng zhì shì, lǐ miàn yǒu yī gè jiù diàn nǎo.
sentences.english: He finally discovered a hidden control room with an old computer inside.

sentences.chinese: 屏幕上显示着一个秘密的名单。
sentences.pinyin: Píng mù shàng xiǎn shì zhe yī gè mì mì de míng dān.
sentences.english: A secret list was displayed on the screen.

sentences.chinese: 这个名单记录了所有被机器人捕捉的人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè míng dān jì lù le suǒ yǒu bèi jī qì rén bǔ zhuō de rén.
sentences.english: This list recorded everyone who had been captured by the robots.

sentences.chinese: 林星仔细看，发现这些人的姓名很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng zǐ xì kàn, fā xiàn zhè xiē rén de xìng míng hěn qí guài.
sentences.english: Lin Xing looked closely and found that these people's full names were very strange.

sentences.chinese: 名单上的第一个人叫东方，他曾经是学院的院长。
sentences.pinyin: Míng dān shàng de dì yī gè rén jiào Dōng fāng, tā céng jīng shì xué yuàn de yuàn zhǎng.
sentences.english: The first person on the list was named Dongfang; he was once the dean of the academy.

sentences.chinese: 第二个人叫全，是一个著名的科学家。
sentences.pinyin: Dì èr gè rén jiào Quán, shì yī gè zhù míng de kē xué jiā.
sentences.english: The second person was named Quan, a famous scientist.

sentences.chinese: 第三个人叫加，他来自遥远的星系。
sentences.pinyin: Dì sān gè rén jiào Jiā, tā lái zì yáo yuǎn de xīng xì.
sentences.english: The third person was named Jia, who came from a distant galaxy.

sentences.chinese: 林星继续向下看，看到了向和周的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng jì xù xiàng xià kàn, kàn dào le Xiàng hé Zhōu de míng zì.
sentences.english: Lin Xing continued to look down and saw the names Xiang and Zhou.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，这些人都失踪了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, zhè xiē rén dōu shī zōng le.
sentences.english: He realized that all these people had disappeared.

sentences.chinese: 名单上还有封、平、怕和成，他们以前都是好朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Míng dān shàng hái yǒu Fēng, Píng, Pà hé Chéng, tā men yǐ qián dōu shì hǎo péng you.
sentences.english: Feng, Ping, Pa, and Cheng were also on the list; they used to be good friends.

sentences.chinese: 查、段和海的名字也在上面，他们是顶尖的工程师。
sentences.pinyin: Zhā, Duàn hé Hǎi de míng zì yě zài shàng miàn, tā men shì dǐng jiān de gōng chéng shī.
sentences.english: Zha, Duan, and Hai's names were also there; they were top engineers.

sentences.chinese: 接着是米、红和组，他们负责研究能量芯片。
sentences.pinyin: Jiē zhe shì Mǐ, Hóng hé Zǔ, tā men fù zé yán jiū néng liàng xīn piàn.
sentences.english: Next were Mi, Hong, and Zu, who were responsible for researching energy chips.

sentences.chinese: 林星的手在发抖，他看到了蓝、角和闻的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng de shǒu zài fā dǒu, tā kàn dào le Lán, Jué hé Wén de míng zì.
sentences.english: Lin Xing's hands were shaking as he saw the names Lan, Jue, and Wen.

sentences.chinese: 最后几个人是阴、雪、题、鱼和黄。
sentences.pinyin: Zuì hòu jǐ gè rén shì Yīn, Xuě, Tí, Yú hé Huáng.
sentences.english: The last few people were Yin, Xue, Ti, Yu, and Huang.

sentences.chinese: 这些人的名字被红色的线划掉了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiē rén de míng zì bèi hóng sè de xiàn huà diào le.
sentences.english: These people's names were crossed out with red lines.

sentences.chinese: 这意味着他们可能已经不在这个世界上了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè yì wèi zhe tā men kě néng yǐ jīng bù zài zhè gè shì jiè shàng le.
sentences.english: This meant they might no longer be in this world.

sentences.chinese: 林星突然听到身后有声音，有人在走过来。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng tū rán tīng dào shēn hòu yǒu shēng yīn, yǒu rén zài zǒu guò lái.
sentences.english: Lin Xing suddenly heard a sound behind him; someone was walking toward him.

sentences.chinese: 他赶紧关掉电脑，躲在桌子下面。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎn jǐn guān diào diàn nǎo, duǒ zài zhuō zi xià miàn.
sentences.english: He quickly turned off the computer and hid under the table.

sentences.chinese: 一个低沉的声音在房间里响起。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè dī chén de shēng yīn zài fáng jiān lǐ xiǎng qǐ.
sentences.english: A low voice sounded in the room.

sentences.chinese: “我知道你在這裡，林星。”
sentences.pinyin: “Wǒ zhī dào nǐ zài zhè lǐ, Lín Xīng.”
sentences.english: "I know you are here, Lin Xing."

sentences.chinese: 林星的心跳得很快，他不敢出声。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng de xīn tiào dé hěn kuài, tā bù gǎn chū shēng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing's heart beat very fast; he didn't dare make a sound.

sentences.chinese: 这个声音听起来很熟悉，但又是那么冷酷。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè shēng yīn tīng qǐ lái hěn shú xī, dàn yòu shì nà me lěng kù.
sentences.english: The voice sounded familiar, yet so cold.

sentences.chinese: 对方在寻找那个能够解开所有秘密的芯片。
sentences.pinyin: Duì fāng zài xún zhǎo nà gè néng gòu jiě kāi suǒ yǒu mì mì de xīn piàn.
sentences.english: The other party was searching for the chip that could unlock all the secrets.

sentences.chinese: 林星紧紧握住芯片，他知道自己不能被抓住。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng jǐn jǐn wò zhù xīn piàn, tā zhī dào zì jǐ bù néng bèi zhuā zhù.
sentences.english: Lin Xing gripped the chip tightly, knowing he could not be caught.

sentences.chinese: 林星躲在阴暗的角落里，屏住呼吸。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng duǒ zài yīn àn de jiǎo luò lǐ, bǐng zhù hū xī.
sentences.english: Lin Xing hid in a dark corner, holding his breath.

sentences.chinese: 他的通讯器突然响了，屏幕上显示一条来自北方的秘密短信。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de tōng xùn qì tū rán xiǎng le, píng mù shàng xiǎn shì yī tiáo lái zì běi fāng de mì mì duǎn xìn.
sentences.english: His communicator suddenly rang, and a secret text message from the north appeared on the screen.

sentences.chinese: 他小声地读着上面的字：
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎo shēng de dú zhe shàng miàn de zì:
sentences.english: He read the words in a low voice:

sentences.chinese: “林星，快接电话，这里有关于芯片的真相。”
sentences.pinyin: “Lín Xīng, kuài jiē diàn huà, zhè lǐ yǒu guān yú xīn piàn de zhēn xiàng.”
sentences.english: "Lin Xing, answer the phone quickly, the truth about the chip is here."

sentences.chinese: 林星颤抖着手接通了信号。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng chàn dǒu zhe shǒu jiē tōng le xìn hào.
sentences.english: Lin Xing's hand trembled as he connected the signal.

sentences.chinese: “喂？你是谁？”林星紧张地问。
sentences.pinyin: “Wéi? Nǐ shì shuí?” Lín Xīng jǐn zhāng de wèn.
sentences.english: "Hello? Who are you?" Lin Xing asked nervously.

sentences.chinese: 对方的声音很奇怪，像是在用普通话说话，但读音很不自然。
sentences.pinyin: Duì fāng de shēng yīn hěn qí guài, xiàng shì zài yòng pǔ tōng huà shuō huà, dàn dú yīn hěn bù zì rán.
sentences.english: The other person's voice was strange, as if they were speaking Mandarin, but the pronunciation was unnatural.

sentences.chinese: “我是你的一个朋友，”对方说，“我收到了一份旧的晚报，上面写着你的名字。”
sentences.pinyin: “Wǒ shì nǐ de yī gè péng you,” duì fāng shuō, “wǒ shōu dào le yī fèn jiù de wǎn bào, shàng miàn xiě zhe nǐ de míng zi.”
sentences.english: "I am a friend of yours," the other person said, "I received a copy of an old evening newspaper with your name on it."

sentences.chinese: 林星愣住了，他记得在星际学院的教室里，老师说过这个世界上没有真正的朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng lèng zhù le, tā jì dé zài xīng jì xué yuàn de jiào shì lǐ, lǎo shī shuō guò zhè gè shì jiè shàng méi yǒu zhēn zhèng de péng you.
sentences.english: Lin Xing froze; he remembered that in the classroom of the Interstellar Academy, the teacher had said there are no true friends in this world.

sentences.chinese: 对方继续说：“你的家长曾经给我写过一封信，信里提到了一个难题。”
sentences.pinyin: Duì fāng jì xù shuō: “Nǐ de jiā zhǎng céng jīng gěi wǒ xiě guò yī fēng xìn, xìn lǐ tí dào le yī gè nán tí.”
sentences.english: The other person continued: "Your guardian once wrote me a letter, and in the letter, a difficult problem was mentioned."

sentences.chinese: 林星觉得这是一个巨大的难题，因为他从未听说过关于家长的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng jué dé zhè shì yī gè jù dà de nán tí, yīn wèi tā cóng wèi tīng shuō guò guān yú jiā zhǎng de mì mì.
sentences.english: Lin Xing felt this was a huge difficult problem, because he had never heard of any secrets regarding his guardians.

sentences.chinese: “请感谢你的勇气，”对方的声音变得温柔，“现在，请看你的屏幕。”
sentences.pinyin: “Qǐng gǎn xiè nǐ de yǒng qì,” duì fāng de shēng yīn biàn dé wēn róu, “xiàn zài, qǐng kàn nǐ de píng mù.”
sentences.english: "Please, I am grateful for your courage," the other person's voice became gentle, "Now, please look at your screen."

sentences.chinese: 屏幕上出现了一个像菜单一样的列表，上面列出了很多生词。
sentences.pinyin: Píng mù shàng chū xiàn le yī gè xiàng cài dān yī yàng de liè biǎo, shàng miàn liè chū le hěn duō shēng cí.
sentences.english: A list like a menu appeared on the screen, listing many new words.

sentences.chinese: 这些词林星不认识，但它们看起来像是一种古老的加密代码。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiē cí Lín Xīng bù rèn shi, dàn tā men kàn qǐ lái xiàng shì yī zhǒng gǔ lǎo de jiā mì dài mǎ.
sentences.english: Lin Xing didn't recognize these words, but they looked like a kind of ancient encryption code.

sentences.chinese: 对方说：“如果你能解开这些词，我欢迎你来到我的基地。”
sentences.pinyin: Duì fāng shuō: “Rú guǒ nǐ néng jiě kāi zhè xiē cí, wǒ huān yíng nǐ lái dào wǒ de jī dì.”
sentences.english: The other person said: "If you can decode these words, I welcome you to my base."

sentences.chinese: 林星想起以前在学院里，学生们在庆祝时会说干杯，但现在他感到非常孤独。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng xiǎng qǐ yǐ qián zài xué yuàn lǐ, xué shēng men zài qìng zhù shí huì shuō gān bēi, dàn xiàn zài tā gǎn dào fēi cháng gū dú.
sentences.english: Lin Xing remembered that back at the academy, students would say "Cheers!" during celebrations, but now he felt extremely lonely.

sentences.chinese: 他突然接到另一个通知，提醒他时间已经很晚了。
