sentences.pinyin: Tā tū rán jiē dào lìng yī gè tōng zhī, tí xǐng tā shí jiān yǐ jīng hěn wǎn le.
sentences.english: He suddenly received another notification reminding him that it was already very late.

sentences.chinese: 他轻声对自己说了一句：“晚安，世界。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā qīng shēng duì zì jǐ shuō le yī jù: “Wǎn ān, shì jiè.”
sentences.english: He whispered to himself: "Good night, world."

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，走廊里传来了沉重的脚步声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, zǒu láng lǐ chuán lái le chén zhòng de jiǎo bù shēng.
sentences.english: Just then, heavy footsteps echoed in the corridor.

sentences.chinese: 那个冷酷的声音再次响起：“林星，我知道你在那里。”
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè lěng kù de shēng yīn zài cì xiǎng qǐ: “Lín Xīng, wǒ zhī dào nǐ zài nà lǐ.”
sentences.english: That cold voice rang out again: "Lin Xing, I know you are there."

sentences.chinese: 林星看着屏幕上的代码，意识到这是唯一的希望。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng kàn zhe píng mù shàng de dài mǎ, yì shí dào zhè shì wéi yī de xī wàng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing looked at the code on the screen, realizing this was the only hope.

sentences.chinese: 但此时，一个巨大的金属影子已经挡住了门口的光。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn cǐ shí, yī gè jù dà de jīn shǔ yǐng zi yǐ jīng dǎng zhù le mén kǒu de guāng.
sentences.english: But at that moment, a huge metal shadow had already blocked the light at the door.

sentences.chinese: 那个巨大的金属影子是高级机器人，它的眼睛闪着红光。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge jùdà de jīnshǔ yǐngzi shì gāojí jīqìrén, tā de yǎnjīng shǎnzhe hóngguāng.
sentences.english: That giant metal shadow was an advanced robot, its eyes flashing with red light.

sentences.chinese: 林星赶紧打开他的笔记本，手指在键盘上飞快地跳动。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng gǎnjǐn dǎkāi tā de bǐjìběn, shǒuzhǐ zài jiànpán shàng fēikuài de tiàodòng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing quickly opened his laptop, his fingers dancing rapidly across the keyboard.

sentences.chinese: 他记得在高中最后一学期的课堂上，老师讲过这种加密方式。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìdé zài gāozhōng zuìhòu yī xuéqī de kètáng shàng, lǎoshī jiǎngguò zhè zhǒng jiāmì fāngshì.
sentences.english: He remembered that in the classroom of his final semester of high school, the teacher had taught this type of encryption.

sentences.chinese: 那是关于数字和逻辑的课，属于计算机科的最难部分。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì guānyú shùzì hé luójí de kè, shǔyú jìsuànjī kē de zuì nán bùfèn.
sentences.english: It was a lesson about numbers and logic, the most difficult part of the computer science division.

sentences.chinese: 林星看着屏幕，发现这组代码需要一个特定的分数才能解锁。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng kànzhe píngmù, fāxiàn zhè zǔ dàimǎ xūyào yīgè tèdìng de fēnshù cáinéng jiěsuǒ.
sentences.english: Lin Xing looked at the screen and found that this set of code required a specific score to unlock.

sentences.chinese: 这个分数必须在中级水平以上，否则系统会立即报警。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fēnshù bìxū zài zhōngjí shuǐpíng yǐshàng, fǒuzé xìtǒng huì lìjí bàojǐng.
sentences.english: This score had to be at the middle level or higher, otherwise the system would immediately trigger an alarm.

sentences.chinese: 他想起自己在学院的成绩单，他的数学分数一直很高。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ zài xuéyuàn de chéngjì dān, tā de shùxué fēnshù yīzhí hěn gāo.
sentences.english: He thought of his transcript at the academy; his math scores had always been very high.

sentences.chinese: 在那个先进的单位里，只有年级前十名的青年才能接触这些资料。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nàge xiānjìn de dānwèi lǐ, zhǐyǒu niánjí qián shí míng de qīngnián cáinéng jiēchù zhèxiē zīliào.
sentences.english: In that advanced unit, only the top ten youths of the grade could access these materials.

sentences.chinese: 他输入了一串复杂的数字，心跳得非常快。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shūrùle yī chuàn fùzá de shùzì, xīntiào de fēicháng kuài.
sentences.english: He entered a string of complex numbers, his heart beating very fast.

sentences.chinese: 突然，屏幕上出现了一张旧照片，是一个大人的样子。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, píngmù shàng chūxiànle yī zhāng jiù zhàopiàn, shì yīgè dàrén de yàngzi.
sentences.english: Suddenly, an old photo appeared on the screen, showing the image of an adult.

sentences.chinese: 照片里的男人站在西北的沙漠中，背景是深蓝色的天空。
sentences.pinyin: Zhàopiàn lǐ de nánrén zhàn zài xīběi de shāmò zhōng, bèijǐng shì shēnlán sè de tiānkōng.
sentences.english: The man in the photo was standing in the Northwest desert, with a deep blue sky in the background.

sentences.chinese: 天上的星星非常亮，像是一颗颗发光的珍珠。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānshàng de xīngxing fēicháng liàng, xiàng shì yī kē kē fāguāng de zhēnzhū.
sentences.english: The stars in the sky were very bright, like glowing pearls.

sentences.chinese: 林星意识到，这个男人可能就是他失踪的父亲。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng yìshí dào, zhège nánrén kěnéng jiùshì tā shīzōng de fùqīn.
sentences.english: Lin Xing realized that this man might be his missing father.

sentences.chinese: 照片下方写着：“等级：高级研究员”。
sentences.pinyin: Zhàopiàn xiàfāng xiězhe: “Děngjí: gāojí yánjiūyuán”.
sentences.english: Below the photo it read: "Rank: Advanced Researcher".

sentences.chinese: 他发现这个秘密被分成了很多层，每一层都需要不同的密钥。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn zhège mìmì bèi fēnchéngle hěnduō céng, měi yī céng dōu xūyào bùtóng de mìyuè.
sentences.english: He discovered that this secret was divided into many layers, and each layer required a different key.

sentences.chinese: 目前他只解开了第一级，但这已经足够让他看到隐藏的坐标。
sentences.pinyin: Mùqián tā zhǐ jiěkāile dì yī jí, dàn zhè yǐjīng zúgòu ràng tā kàndào yǐncáng de zuòbiāo.
sentences.english: Currently, he had only unlocked the first level, but this was already enough for him to see the hidden coordinates.

sentences.chinese: 他想起以前在课堂上学习的知识，这些坐标指向一个遥远的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ yǐqián zài kètáng shàng xuéxí de zhīshí, zhèxiē zuòbiāo zhǐxiàng yīgè yáoyuǎn de dìfāng.
sentences.english: He recalled the knowledge he had learned in the classroom; these coordinates pointed to a distant place.

sentences.chinese: 他必须在机器人冲进来之前，把这些信息全部复制到计算机里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū zài jīqìrén chōng jìnlái zhīqián, bǎ zhèxiē xìnxī quánbù fùzhì dào jìsuànjī lǐ.
sentences.english: He had to copy all this information into the computer before the robot rushed in.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，一个冰冷的声音在房间里响起。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, yīgè bīnglěng de shēngyīn zài fángjiān lǐ xiǎngqǐ.
sentences.english: But at that moment, a cold voice rang out in the room.

sentences.chinese: “林星，你的水平还不够，你无法打开最后一层。”
sentences.pinyin: “Lín Xīng, nǐ de shuǐpíng hái bùgòu, nǐ wúfǎ dǎkāi zuìhòu yī céng.”
sentences.english: "Lin Xing, your level is not high enough; you cannot open the final layer."

sentences.chinese: 林星回头看去，那个巨大的机器人已经站在他身后，手臂变成了锋利的刀。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng huítóu kàn qù, nàge jùdà de jīqìrén yǐjīng zhàn zài tā shēnhòu, shǒubì biànchéngle fēnglì de dāo.
sentences.english: Lin Xing looked back, and the giant robot was already standing behind him, its arm having turned into a sharp blade.

sentences.chinese: 它在寻找那个能改变世界的单位数值，而那个数值就在林星的脑海中。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài xúnzhǎo nàge néng gǎibiàn shìjiè de dānwèi shùzhí, ér nàge shùzhí jiù zài Lín Xīng de nǎohǎi zhōng.
sentences.english: It was searching for the unit value that could change the world, and that value was inside Lin Xing's mind.

sentences.chinese: 巨大的机器人就站在林星面前。
sentences.pinyin: jù dà de jī qì rén jiù zhàn zài lín xīng miàn qián.
sentences.english: The giant robot stood right in front of Lin Xing.

sentences.chinese: 它的刀刃在灯光下闪着冷光。
sentences.pinyin: tā de dāo rèn zài dēng guāng xià shǎn zhe lěng guāng.
sentences.english: Its blade flashed with a cold light under the lamps.

sentences.chinese: 林星忽然想起了很多事情。
sentences.pinyin: lín xīng hū rán xiǎng qǐ le hěn duō shì qíng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing suddenly remembered many things.

sentences.chinese: 他从小就对计算机感兴趣。
sentences.pinyin: tā cóng xiǎo jiù duì jì suàn jī gǎn xìng qù.
sentences.english: He had been interested in computers since childhood.

sentences.chinese: 小时候，他经常在旧书店找关于星际旅行的书。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo shí hou, tā jīng cháng zài jiù shū diàn zhǎo guān yú xīng jì lǚ xíng de shū.
sentences.english: As a child, he often looked for books about interstellar travel in old bookstores.

sentences.chinese: 那个少年在书里看到了一个自由的世界。
sentences.pinyin: nà gè shào nián zài shū lǐ kàn dào le yí gè zì yóu de shì jiè.
sentences.english: That youth saw a free world in those books.

sentences.chinese: 在前年，他进入了星际学院学习。
sentences.pinyin: zài qián nián, tā jìn rù le xīng jì xué yuàn xué xí.
sentences.english: The year before last, he entered the Interstellar Academy to study.

sentences.chinese: 以前，他觉得生活很简单，但现在一切都变了。
sentences.pinyin: yǐ qián, tā jué de shēng huó hěn jiǎn dān, dàn xiàn zài yí qiè dōu biàn le.
sentences.english: Previously, he thought life was simple, but now everything had changed.

sentences.chinese: 刚才，机器人的声音让他感到害怕。
sentences.pinyin: gāng cái, jī qì rén de shēng yīn ràng tā gǎn dào hài pà.
sentences.english: Just now, the robot's voice made him feel afraid.

sentences.chinese: 但这时，他意识到自己身边有一个秘密开关。
sentences.pinyin: dàn zhè shí, tā yì shí dào zì jǐ shēn biān yǒu yí gè mì mì kāi guān.
sentences.english: But at this moment, he realized there was a secret switch by his side.

sentences.chinese: 这时候，他决定尝试一次。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí hou, tā jué dìng cháng shì yí cì.
sentences.english: At this moment, he decided to try it once.

sentences.chinese: 他快速按下开关，然后身体向后跳去。
sentences.pinyin: tā kuài sù àn xià kāi guān, rán hòu shēn tǐ xiàng hòu tiào qù.
sentences.english: He quickly pressed the switch, and then jumped backward.

sentences.chinese: 机器人的动作停止了，它似乎在重新启动。
sentences.pinyin: jī qì rén de dòng zuò tíng zhǐ le, tā sì hū zài chóng xīn qǐ dòng.
sentences.english: The robot's movements stopped; it seemed to be rebooting.

sentences.chinese: 林星看着对面那个冰冷的机器，心跳很快。
sentences.pinyin: lín xīng kàn zhe duì miàn nà gè bīng lěng de jī qì, xīn tiào hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Lin Xing looked at the cold machine opposite him, his heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 他想起半夜里听到的奇怪信号。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng qǐ bàn yè lǐ tīng dào de qí guài xìn hào.
sentences.english: He remembered the strange signal he heard at midnight.

sentences.chinese: 那时，他以为那是机器人的错误。
sentences.pinyin: nà shí, tā yǐ wéi nà shì jī qì rén de cuò wù.
sentences.english: At that time, he thought it was a robot error.

sentences.chinese: 在那会儿，他还没有意识到这个世界的真相。
sentences.pinyin: zài nà huì r, tā hái méi yǒu yì shí dào zhè gè shì jiè de zhēn xiàng.
sentences.english: Back then, he had not yet realized the truth of this world.

sentences.chinese: 原来，这个机器人是他父亲以前设计的。
sentences.pinyin: yuán lái, zhè gè jī qì rén shì tā fù qīn yǐ qián shè jì de.
sentences.english: Originally, this robot was designed by his father.

sentences.chinese: 那时候，他的父亲是这个实验室的负责人。
sentences.pinyin: nà shí hou, tā de fù qīn shì zhè gè shí yàn shì de fù zé rén.
sentences.english: At that time, his father was the head of this laboratory.

sentences.chinese: 其中一个秘密就是，机器人可以通过特定的数值被控制。
sentences.pinyin: qí zhōng yí gè mì mì jiù shì, jī qì rén kě yǐ tōng guò tè dìng de shù zhí bèi kòng zhì.
sentences.english: One of the secrets was that robots could be controlled through specific numerical values.

sentences.chinese: 在过去，这种技术被认为是不安全的。
sentences.pinyin: zài guò qù, zhè zhǒng jì shù bèi rèn wéi shì bù ān quán de.
sentences.english: In the past, this technology was considered unsafe.

sentences.chinese: 林星记得，在很多年以前，父亲告诉他今后要保护好这个秘密。
sentences.pinyin: lín xīng jì de, zài hěn duō nián yǐ qián, fù qīn gào su tā jīn hòu yào bǎo hù hǎo zhè gè mì mì.
sentences.english: Lin Xing remembered that many years ago, his father told him to protect this secret in the future.

sentences.chinese: 当时，林星太小，没有完全明白。
sentences.pinyin: dāng shí, lín xīng tài xiǎo, méi yǒu wán quán míng bai.
sentences.english: At that time, Lin Xing was too young to fully understand.

sentences.chinese: 但最近，他发现这个秘密变得更重要了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn zuì jìn, tā fā xiàn zhè gè mì mì biàn de gèng zhòng yào le.
sentences.english: But recently, he found that this secret had become even more important.

sentences.chinese: 他已经不再是那个弱小的孩子。
sentences.pinyin: tā yǐ jīng bú zài shì nà gè ruò xiǎo de hái zi.
sentences.english: He was already no longer that weak child.

sentences.chinese: 他想起一个早晨，父亲在夜里工作了一整晚后，给了他一个芯片。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng qǐ yí gè zǎo chén, fù qīn zài yè lǐ gōng zuò le yì zhěng wǎn hòu, gěi le tā yí gè xīn piàn.
sentences.english: He remembered one early morning, after his father had worked all night, he gave him a chip.

sentences.chinese: 后来，父亲失踪了，芯片成了他唯一的线索。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái, fù qīn shī zōng le, xīn piàn chéng le tā wéi yī de xiàn suǒ.
sentences.english: Later, his father disappeared, and the chip became his only clue.

sentences.chinese: 机器人又开始运动了，而且速度更快。
sentences.pinyin: jī qì rén yòu kāi shǐ yùn dòng le, ér qiě sù dù gèng kuài.
sentences.english: The robot started moving again, and its speed was even faster.

sentences.chinese: 它快要触碰到林星的衣服了。
sentences.pinyin: tā kuài yào chù pèng dào lín xīng de yī fu le.
sentences.english: It was about to touch Lin Xing's clothes.

sentences.chinese: 林星刚刚想起来，那个数值就在他的记忆深处。
sentences.pinyin: lín xīng gāng gang xiǎng qǐ lái, nà gè shù zhí jiù zài tā de jì yì shēn chù.
sentences.english: Lin Xing had just remembered that the numerical value was deep in his memory.

sentences.chinese: 他闭上眼睛，尝试在脑海中搜索那个数字。
sentences.pinyin: tā bì shàng yǎn jīng, cháng shì zài nǎo hǎi zhōng sōu suǒ nà gè shù zì.
sentences.english: He closed his eyes and tried to search for that number in his mind.

sentences.chinese: 不久，他找到了那个数值：0.112。
sentences.pinyin: bù jiǔ, tā zhǎo dào le nà gè shù zhí: líng diǎn yī yī èr.
sentences.english: Before long, he found the value: 0.112.

sentences.chinese: 他大声喊出了这个数字，同时将芯片插入了计算机。
sentences.pinyin: tā dà shēng hǎn chū le zhè gè shù zì, tóng shí jiāng xīn piàn chā rù le jì suàn jī.
sentences.english: He shouted this number loudly, while simultaneously inserting the chip into the computer.

sentences.chinese: 其他所有的灯光突然变成了绿色。
sentences.pinyin: qí tā suǒ yǒu de dēng guāng tū rán biàn chéng le lǜ sè.
sentences.english: All other lights suddenly turned green.

sentences.chinese: 机器人停在了距离他很近的地方。
sentences.pinyin: jī qì rén tíng zài le jù lí tā hěn jìn de dì fang.
sentences.english: The robot stopped at a place very near to him.

sentences.chinese: 它慢慢地低下了头，不再攻击他。
sentences.pinyin: tā màn màn de dī xià le tóu, bú zài gōng jī tā.
sentences.english: It slowly lowered its head and stopped attacking him.

sentences.chinese: 林星喘着气，看着屏幕上出现的旧档案。
sentences.pinyin: lín xīng chuǎn zhe qì, kàn zhe píng mù shàng chū xiàn de jiù dàng àn.
sentences.english: Lin Xing gasped for breath, looking at the old archives appearing on the screen.

sentences.chinese: 档案的第一页写着：欢迎回来，我的孩子。
sentences.pinyin: dàng àn de dì yī yè xiě zhe: huān yíng huí lái, wǒ de hái zi.
sentences.english: The first page of the archive read: Welcome back, my child.

sentences.chinese: 林星看着屏幕上的文字，心中感到非常难过。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng kànzhe píngmù shàng de wénzì, xīnzhōng gǎndào fēicháng nánguò.
sentences.english: Lin Xing looked at the text on the screen and felt very sad in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 那个巨大的机器人依然低着头，像是在等待他的反应。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè jùdà de jīqìrén yīrán dīzhe tóu, xiàng shì zài děngdài tā de fǎnyìng.
sentences.english: The giant robot still lowered its head, as if waiting for his reaction.

sentences.chinese: 不一会儿，屏幕上出现了一段旧视频。
sentences.pinyin: Bù yīhuǐr, píngmù shàng chūxiànle yīduàn jiù shìpín.
sentences.english: After a short while, an old video appeared on the screen.

sentences.chinese: 视频里的男人穿着白色的衣服，笑容很温暖。
sentences.pinyin: Shìpín lǐ de nánrén chuānzhe báisè de yīfú, xiàoróng hěn wēnnuǎn.
sentences.english: The man in the video wore white clothes and had a warm smile.

sentences.chinese: 那个男人在说话，但声音有点难听，像是被损坏的机器在发声。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè nánrén zài shuōhuà, dàn shēngyīn yǒudiǎn nántīng, xiàng shì bèi sǔnhuài de jīqì zài fāshēng.
sentences.english: The man was speaking, but the voice was a bit unpleasant, sounding like a damaged machine.

sentences.chinese: “林星，如果你看到这个，说明你已经找到了这里。”
sentences.pinyin: “Lín Xīng, rúguǒ nǐ kàndào zhège, shuōmíng nǐ yǐjīng zhǎodàole zhèlǐ.”
sentences.english: "Lin Xing, if you are seeing this, it means you have found this place."

sentences.chinese: 林星感到呼吸困难，胸口有点疼。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng gǎndào hūxī kùnnán, xiōngkǒu yǒudiǎn téng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing felt it was difficult to breathe, and his chest hurt a bit.

sentences.chinese: 他想起小时候，父亲总是告诉他，这个世界的少数人拥有改变未来的能力。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ xiǎoshíhòu, fùqīn zǒng shì gàosù tā, zhège shìjiè de shǎoshù rén yōngyǒu gǎibiàn wèilái de nénglì.
sentences.english: He remembered when he was a child, his father always told him that a small number of people in this world have the ability to change the future.

sentences.chinese: 但现在的林星觉得，自己的能力远远不够。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiànzài de Lín Xīng juéde, zìjǐ de nénglì yuǎnyuǎn bùgòu.
sentences.english: But now Lin Xing felt that his own ability was far from enough.

sentences.chinese: 他看着视频，突然发现视频的背景是黄色的墙壁，那是他记忆中家的颜色。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe shìpín, tūrán fāxiàn shìpín de bèijǐng shì huángsè de qiángbì, nà shì tā jìyì zhōng jiā de yánsè.
sentences.english: Looking at the video, he suddenly noticed the background was a yellow wall, the color of home in his memory.

sentences.chinese: 他想起父亲曾说，他们必须分开，为了保护这个芯片。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ fùqīn céng shuō, tāmen bìxū fēnkāi, wèile bǎohù zhège xīnpiàn.
sentences.english: He remembered his father once saying they had to separate to protect this chip.

sentences.chinese: 那个芯片不能卖给任何人，因为它会被坏人利用。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè xīnpiàn bùnéng mài gěi rènhé rén, yīnwèi tā huì bèi huàirén lìyòng.
sentences.english: The chip could not be sold to anyone because it would be used by bad people.

sentences.chinese: 林星想起那些坏人带来的坏处，心中充满了不满。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng xiǎngqǐ nàxiē huàirén dàilái de huàichu, xīnzhōng chōngmǎnle bùmǎn.
sentences.english: Lin Xing thought of the harm brought by those villains, and his heart was filled with discontent.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这个世界太可怕了，他忍不住想哭。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde zhège shìjiè tài kěpàle, tā rèn bùzhù xiǎng kū.
sentences.english: He felt this world was too terrifying and couldn't help wanting to cry.

sentences.chinese: 视频中的父亲继续说道：“不要害怕，孩子。”
sentences.pinyin: Shìpín zhōng de fùqīn jìxù shuōdào: “Bùyào hàipà, háizi.”
sentences.english: The father in the video continued, "Don't be afraid, child."

sentences.chinese: “虽然现在的生活可能很难受，但你必须坚强。”
sentences.pinyin: “Suīrán xiànzài de shēnghuó kěnéng hěn nánshòu, dàn nǐ bìxū jiānqiáng.”
sentences.english: "Although life now may be difficult to bear, you must be strong."

sentences.chinese: 林星看着屏幕，突然发现视频开始卡住了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng kànzhe píngmù, tūrán fāxiàn shìpín kāishǐ kǎzhùle.
sentences.english: Lin Xing looked at the screen and suddenly found the video started to lag.

sentences.chinese: 他试着推了一下屏幕，但没有反应。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shìzhe tuīle yīxià píngmù, dàn méiyǒu fǎnyìng.
sentences.english: He tried to push the screen, but there was no reaction.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，这里的电力不足，系统运行太慢。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, zhèlǐ de diànlì bùzú, xìtǒng yùnxíng tài màn.
sentences.english: He realized the power here was insufficient, and the system was running too slowly.

sentences.chinese: 他只能等待视频重新加载。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐnéng děngdài shìpín chóngxīn jiāzài.
sentences.english: He could only wait for the video to reload.

sentences.chinese: 这时，机器人突然开口说话了，声音低沉且难看。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, jīqìrén tūrán kāikǒu shuōhuàle, shēngyīn dīchén qiě nánkàn.
sentences.english: At this moment, the robot suddenly spoke, its voice deep and ugly.

sentences.chinese: “你觉得这像个笑话吗？”机器人问。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ juéde zhè xiàng gè xiàohua ma?” jīqìrén wèn.
sentences.english: "Do you think this is a joke?" the robot asked.

sentences.chinese: 林星吓了一跳，赶紧放下手中的芯片。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng xiàle yī tiào, gǎnjǐn fàngxià shǒuzhōng de xīnpiàn.
sentences.english: Lin Xing was startled and quickly put down the chip in his hand.

sentences.chinese: 他不好意思地看着机器人，低声说：“对不起。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù hǎoyìsi de kànzhe jīqìrén, dīshēng shuō: “Duìbùqǐ.”
sentences.english: Feeling embarrassed, he looked at the robot and said in a low voice, "I'm sorry."

sentences.chinese: 机器人冷冷地说：“你的水平在等级十以下，你无法理解这里的真相。”
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén lěnglěng de shuō: “Nǐ de shuǐpíng zài děngjí shí yǐxià, nǐ wúfǎ lǐjiě zhèlǐ de zhēnxiàng.”
sentences.english: The robot said coldly, "Your level is below level ten; you cannot understand the truth here."

sentences.chinese: “如果你想省时间，就快点走。”
sentences.pinyin: “Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng shěng shíjiān, jiù kuài diǎn zǒu.”
sentences.english: "If you want to save time, leave quickly."

sentences.chinese: 林星觉得机器人的话太难听了，他感到很愤怒。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng juéde jīqìrén de huà tài nántīngle, tā gǎndào hěn fènnù.
sentences.english: Lin Xing felt the robot's words were too coarse, and he felt very angry.

sentences.chinese: 他想说：“我不走！”，但在这个巨大的金属生物面前，他觉得自己不如一只小猫。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng shuō: “Wǒ bù zǒu!”, dàn zài zhège jùdà de jīnshǔ shēngwù miànqián, tā juéde zìjǐ bùrú yī zhī xiǎo māo.
sentences.english: He wanted to say, "I'm not leaving!", but in front of this giant metal creature, he felt he was not as good as a little cat.

sentences.chinese: 他看着周围，发现这里的墙壁上涂着绿色的线条，像是某种古老的地图。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe zhōuwéi, fāxiàn zhèlǐ de qiángbì shàng túzhe lǜsè de xiàntiáo, xiàng shì mǒu zhǒng gǔlǎo de dìtú.
sentences.english: He looked around and found green lines painted on the walls, like some kind of ancient map.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个巨大的金属架子倒在了地上，发出巨大的响声。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yīgè jùdà de jīnshǔ jiàzi dǎozàile dìshàng, fāchū jùdà de xiǎngshēng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a huge metal rack collapsed to the ground, making a loud noise.

sentences.chinese: 林星被吓得掉了一跤，身体撞在了墙上。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng bèi xià de diàole yī jiē, shēntǐ zhuàng zàile qiáng shàng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing was so scared that he fell over, his body hitting the wall.

sentences.chinese: 他想起在学院的时候，午睡时间是最安静的，而现在这里只有危险。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zài xuéyuàn de shíhòu, wǔshuì shíjiān shì zuì ānjìng de, ér xiànzài zhèlǐ zhǐyǒu wēixiǎn.
sentences.english: He remembered that at the academy, nap time was the quietest, while now there was only danger here.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，如果他现在离开，就再也没有机会留下寻找真相。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, rúguǒ tā xiànzài líkāi, jiù zài yě méiyǒu jīhuì liúxià xúnzhǎo zhēnxiàng.
sentences.english: He realized that if he left now, he would never have the chance to stay and find the truth.

sentences.chinese: “不行，我必须留下来，”林星在心里对自己说。
sentences.pinyin: “Bùxíng, wǒ bìxū liú xiàlái,” Lín Xīng zài xīn lǐ duì zìjǐ shuō.
sentences.english: "No, I must stay," Lin Xing said to himself in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，屏幕上的视频突然恢复了，父亲的脸再次出现。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, píngmù shàng de shìpín tūrán huīfùle, fùqīn de liǎn zàicì chūxiàn.
sentences.english: Just then, the video on the screen suddenly recovered, and his father's face appeared again.

sentences.chinese: 但这次，父亲的表情变得非常严肃，他指着屏幕下方的一个红色按钮。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zhè cì, fùqīn de biǎoqíng biàndé fēicháng yánsù, tā zhǐzhe píngmù xiàfāng de yīgè hóngsè ànniǔ.
sentences.english: But this time, his father's expression became very serious, and he pointed to a red button at the bottom of the screen.

sentences.chinese: “快按下去！否则他们会发现你！”
sentences.pinyin: “Kuài àn xiàqù! Fǒuzé tāmen huì fāxiàn nǐ!”
sentences.english: "Press it quickly! Otherwise, they will find you!"

sentences.chinese: 林星还没来得及反应，大门外传来了沉重的脚步声。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng hái méi láidejí fǎnyìng, dàmén wài chuánláile chénzhòng de jiǎobù shēng.
sentences.english: Before Lin Xing could react, heavy footsteps sounded from outside the door.

sentences.chinese: 林星看着那个红色的按钮，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng kànzhe nàge hóngsè de ànniǔ, xīntiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Lin Xing looked at that red button, his heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 他知道如果现在按下它，他可能就再也见不到父亲的影像了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhīdào rúguǒ xiànzài ànxià tā, tā kěnéng jiù zài yě jiàn bù dào fùqīn de yǐngxiàng le.
sentences.english: He knew if he pressed it now, he might never see his father's image again.

sentences.chinese: 可是，门外的脚步声越来越近，那个巨大的机器人一定就在门后。
sentences.pinyin: Kěshì, mén wài de jiǎobù shēng yuè lái yuè jìn, nàge jùdà de jīqìrén yīdìng jiù zài mén hòu.
sentences.english: But the footsteps outside were getting closer; that giant robot must surely be behind the door.

sentences.chinese: 林星觉得这个情况实在太危险了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng juéde zhège qíngkuàng shízài tài wēixiǎn le.
sentences.english: Lin Xing felt this situation was truly too dangerous.

sentences.chinese: 他问父亲：“为什么我要按这个按钮？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn fùqīn: “Wèishéme wǒ yào àn zhège ànniǔ?”
sentences.english: He asked his father, "Why do I have to press this button?"

sentences.chinese: 父亲在屏幕里大声说：“因为这是唯一的办法！只要你按下它，你就可以进入秘密通道！”
sentences.pinyin: Fùqīn zài píngmù lǐ dàshēng shuō: “Yīnwèi zhè shì wéiyī de bànfǎ! Zhǐyào nǐ ànxià tā, nǐ jiù kěyǐ jìnrù mìmì tōngdào!”
sentences.english: His father said loudly on the screen, "Because this is the only way! As long as you press it, you can enter the secret passage!"

sentences.chinese: 林星犹豫了，他觉得这个按钮的样子很奇怪，不知道它是什么样的功能。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng yóuyù le, tā juéde zhège ànniǔ de yàngzi hěn qíguài, bù zhīdào tā shì shénme yàng de gōngnéng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing hesitated; he felt the appearance of this button was very strange and didn't know what kind of function it had.

sentences.chinese: 在他看来，一般的按钮不会这么红，而且它好像在发光。
sentences.pinyin: Zài tā kàn lái, yībān de ànniǔ bù huì zhème hóng, érqiě tā hǎoxiàng zài fāguāng.
sentences.english: In his view, ordinary buttons wouldn't be this red, and it seemed to be glowing.

sentences.chinese: 他想，也许按下它之后，他不但能逃跑，还能找到更多关于芯片的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, yěxǔ ànxià tā zhīhòu, tā bùdàn néng táopǎo, hái néng zhǎodào gèng duō guānyú xīnpiàn de mìmì.
sentences.english: He thought that perhaps after pressing it, he could not only escape but also find more secrets about the chip.

sentences.chinese: 但在这个房间以外的地方，还有很多机器人正在寻找他。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zài zhège fángjiān yǐwài de dìfāng, hái yǒu hěnduō jīqìrén zhèngzài xúnzhǎo tā.
sentences.english: But in places other than this room, there were many robots searching for him.

sentences.chinese: 他不太确定自己能否成功，因为他只是一个学生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù tài quèdìng zìjǐ néng fǒu chénggōng, yīnwèi tā zhǐ shì yīgè xuéshēng.
sentences.english: He wasn't too sure if he could succeed because he was only a student.

sentences.chinese: 不过，他知道自己不能在这里等死。
sentences.pinyin: Bùguò, tā zhīdào zìjǐ bùnéng zài zhèlǐ děng sǐ.
sentences.english: However, he knew he couldn't just wait for death here.

sentences.chinese: 他心想，如果我不走，我可能差不多三分钟后就会被抓住。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xīnxiǎng, rúguǒ wǒ bù zǒu, wǒ kěnéng chàbuduō sān fēnzhōng hòu jiù huì bèi zhuā zhù.
sentences.english: He thought to himself, if I don't leave, I will probably be caught in about three minutes.

sentences.chinese: 他看着屏幕，父亲的脸显得多么焦虑啊！
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe píngmù, fùqīn de liǎn xiǎnde duōme jiāolǜ ā!
sentences.english: He looked at the screen; how anxious his father's face looked!

sentences.chinese: 林星想知道，他需要等待多久才能完全信任这个影像？
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng xiǎng zhīdào, tā xūyào děngdài duōjiǔ cáinéng wánquán xìnrèn zhège yǐngxiàng?
sentences.english: Lin Xing wanted to know how long he needed to wait before he could fully trust this image?

sentences.chinese: 他已经好久没有见过家人了，这种感觉让他有点难过。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng hǎojiǔ méiyǒu jiànguò jiārén le, zhè zhǒng gǎnjué ràng tā yǒudiǎn nánguò.
sentences.english: It had been quite a while since he had seen his family, and this feeling made him a bit sad.

sentences.chinese: 他想问父亲，接下来的路怎么样，应该怎样走才能安全？
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng wèn fùqīn, jiē xiàlái de lù zěnmeyàng, yīnggāi zěnyàng zǒu cáinéng ānquán?
sentences.english: He wanted to ask his father how the road ahead was and how he should go to be safe.

sentences.chinese: 父亲回答道：“不一定每个人都能走通这条路，但你一定可以。”
sentences.pinyin: Fùqīn huídá dào: “Bù yīdìng měi gè rén dōu néng zǒu tōng zhè tiáo lù, dàn nǐ yīdìng kěyǐ.”
sentences.english: His father replied, "It's not necessarily the case that everyone can make it through this path, but you certainly can."

sentences.chinese: 林星觉得父亲的话和之前的档案里的语气同样严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng juéde fùqīn de huà hé zhīqián de dàng'àn lǐ de yǔqì tóngyàng yánsù.
sentences.english: Lin Xing felt his father's words were equally serious as the tone in the previous archives.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，在这种时刻，他不能只考虑自己的害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, zài zhè zhǒng shíkè, tā bùnéng zhǐ kǎolǜ zìjǐ de hàipà.
sentences.english: He realized that at such a moment, he couldn't only consider his own fear.

sentences.chinese: 例如，他可以选择战斗，或选择逃跑。
sentences.pinyin: Lìrú, tā kěyǐ xuǎnzé zhàndòu, huò xuǎnzé táopǎo.
sentences.english: For example, he could choose to fight, or choose to flee.

sentences.chinese: 但是，他现在没有武器，战斗是不可能的。
sentences.pinyin: Dànshì, tā xiànzài méiyǒu wǔqì, zhàndòu shì bù kěnéng de.
sentences.english: But he had no weapons now; fighting was impossible.

sentences.chinese: 他感觉到身体有一点点发抖，但他的眼神变得坚定。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎnjué dào shēntǐ yǒu yīdiǎndiǎn fādǒu, dàn tā de yǎnshén biànde jiāndìng.
sentences.english: He felt his body shaking a little bit, but his gaze became determined.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，在这种极端的环境下，普通的计划是不起作用的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, zài zhè zhǒng jíduān de huánjìng xià, pǔtōng de jìhuà shì bù qǐ zuòyòng de.
sentences.english: He realized that in such an extreme environment, ordinary plans would not work.

sentences.chinese: 他再次看向那个按钮，心想：不管结果怎么样，我必须尝试。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zàicì kàn xiàng nàge ànniǔ, xīnxiǎng: Bùguǎn jiéguǒ zěnmeyàng, wǒ bìxū chángshì.
sentences.english: He looked at the button again and thought: No matter how the result is, I must try.

sentences.chinese: 他伸出手，手指轻轻地触碰到了冰冷的金属表面。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shēn chū shǒu, shǒuzhǐ qīngqīng de chùpèng dào lěngcì de jīnshǔ biǎomiàn.
sentences.english: He reached out his hand, and his fingers gently touched the cold metal surface.

sentences.chinese: 就在他准备按下按钮的一瞬间，大门突然被巨大的力量撞开了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tā zhǔnbèi ànxià ànniǔ de yī shùnjiān, dàmén tūrán bèi jùdà de lìliàng zhuàng kāi le.
sentences.english: Just as he was about to press the button, the door was suddenly smashed open by a huge force.

sentences.chinese: 一个红色的眼睛在黑暗中闪烁，那是之前那个机器人的样子。
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè hóngsè de yǎnjīng zài hēi'àn zhōng shǎnshuò, nà shì zhīqián nàge jīqìrén de yàngzi.
sentences.english: A red eye flickered in the darkness; it was the appearance of that robot from before.

sentences.chinese: 机器人发出了低沉的声音：“林星，把芯片给我。”
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén fāchū le dīchén de shēngyīn: “Lín Xīng, bǎ xīnpiàn gěi wǒ.”
sentences.english: The robot made a low sound: "Lin Xing, give me the chip."

sentences.chinese: 林星看着机器人，又看着按钮，他必须在这一秒做出决定。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng kànzhe jīqìrén, yòu kànzhe ànniǔ, tā bìxū zài zhè yī miǎo zuòchū juédìng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing looked at the robot, then at the button; he had to make a decision in this second.

sentences.chinese: 他猛地按下了那个红色的按钮。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měng de ànxià le nàge hóngsè de ànniǔ.
sentences.english: He slammed down on that red button.

sentences.chinese: 红色按钮被按下后，房间里的灯光突然消失了。
sentences.pinyin: Hóngsè ànniǔ bèi ànxià hòu, fángjiān lǐ de dēngguāng tūrán xiāoshī le.
sentences.english: After the red button was pressed, the lights in the room suddenly disappeared.

sentences.chinese: 林星觉得有一点儿害怕，因为周围变得非常安静。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng juéde yǒu yī diǎnr hàipà, yīnwèi zhōuwéi biàn de fēicháng ānjìng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing felt a bit scared because the surroundings became very quiet.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一面巨大的电子墙在他面前出现。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yī miàn jùdà de diànzǐ qiáng zài tā miànqián chūxiàn.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a huge electronic wall appeared in front of him.

sentences.chinese: 墙上的文字说：欢迎进入记忆空间。
sentences.pinyin: Qiáng shàng de wénzì shuō: Huānyíng jìnrù jìyì kōngjiān.
sentences.english: The text on the wall said: Welcome to the Memory Space.

sentences.chinese: 林星发现，这里的颜色和他在学院看到的完全相同。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng fāxiàn, zhèlǐ de yánsè hé tā zài xuéyuàn kàn dào de wánquán xiāngtóng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing discovered that the colors here were exactly the same as what he saw at the academy.

sentences.chinese: 虽然这里很美，但他也感到有点儿奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán zhèlǐ hěn měi, dàn tā yě gǎndào yǒudiǎnr qíguài.
sentences.english: Although it was beautiful here, he also felt slightly strange.

sentences.chinese: 一个声音在他耳边响起：“你选择了这个按钮，所以你现在看到了真相。”
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè shēngyīn zài tā ěrbiān xiǎngqǐ: “Nǐ xuǎnzé le zhège ànniǔ, suǒyǐ nǐ xiànzài kàn dào le zhēnxiàng.”
sentences.english: A voice sounded in his ear: "You chose this button, so now you see the truth."

sentences.chinese: 这个声音正是他父亲的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shēngyīn zhèngshì tā fùqīn de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: This voice was precisely his father's voice.

sentences.chinese: 林星问：“这里是什么地方？是我在做梦，或者我在虚拟世界里？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng wèn: “Zhèlǐ shì shénme dìfāng? Shì wǒ zài zuòmèng, huòzhě wǒ zài xūnǐ shìjiè lǐ?”
sentences.english: Lin Xing asked: "What place is this? Am I dreaming, or am I in a virtual world?"

sentences.chinese: 父亲回答：“如果你能找到相同的代码的话，你就能离开。”
sentences.pinyin: Fùqīn huídá: “Rúguǒ nǐ néng zhǎodào xiāngtóng de dàimǎ de huà, nǐ jiù néng líkāi.”
sentences.english: His father replied: "If you can find the identical code, you will be able to leave."

sentences.chinese: “比如，你可以找找那些蓝色的数字。”
sentences.pinyin: “Bǐrú, nǐ kěyǐ zhǎozhao nàxiē lánsè de shùzì.”
sentences.english: "For example, you can look for those blue numbers."

sentences.chinese: “比如说，数字‘7’可能是关键。”
sentences.pinyin: “Bǐrú shuō, shùzì ‘qī’ kěnéng shì guānjiàn.”
sentences.english: "For instance, the number '7' might be the key."

sentences.chinese: 林星看着屏幕，发现这里的逻辑很奇怪，一个数字可能等于两个不同的意思。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng kànzhe píngmù, fāxiàn zhèlǐ de luójí hěn qíguài, yīgè shùzì kěnéng děngyú liǎng gè bùtóng de yìsi.
sentences.english: Lin Xing looked at the screen and found the logic here very strange; one number could equal two different meanings.

sentences.chinese: 而且，这些数字在屏幕上越来越快地移动。
sentences.pinyin: Érqiě, zhèxiē shùzì zài píngmù shàng yuè lái yuè kuài de yídòng.
sentences.english: Moreover, these numbers were moving faster and faster on the screen.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，有人故意设计了这个迷宫来测试他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, yǒurén gùyì shèjì le zhège mǐgōng lái cèshì tā.
sentences.english: He realized that someone had deliberately designed this maze to test him.

sentences.chinese: 他想：“我该怎么才能在这种环境下找到答案？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng: “Wǒ gāi zěnme cáinéng zài zhè zhǒng huánjìng xià zhǎodào dá'àn?”
sentences.english: He thought: "How should I find the answer in this kind of environment?"

sentences.chinese: 他发现，如果他这样移动，数字就会停止。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn, rúguǒ tā zhèyàng yídòng, shùzì jiù huì tíngzhǐ.
sentences.english: He found that if he moved this way, the numbers would stop.

sentences.chinese: 但如果他那样移动，数字就会消失。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn rúguǒ tā nàyàng yídòng, shùzì jiù huì xiāoshī.
sentences.english: But if he moved that way, the numbers would disappear.

sentences.chinese: 他不能这么快地做出决定，因为每一步都很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bùnéng zhème kuài de zuòchū juédìng, yīnwèi měi yī bù dōu hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.english: He couldn't make a decision so quickly because every step was very important.

sentences.chinese: 他想起在古老的书中读到，越是简单的事情，往往越复杂。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zài gǔlǎo de shū zhōng dú dào, yuè shì jiǎndān de shìqíng, wǎngwǎng yuè fùzá.
sentences.english: He remembered reading in ancient books that the simpler a thing is, the more complex it often is.

sentences.chinese: 他突然发现，屏幕的左面有一个小小的开关，正好在代码的下方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán fāxiàn, píngmù de zuǒmiàn yǒu yīgè xiǎo xiǎo de kāiguān, zhènghǎo zài dàimǎ de xiàfāng.
sentences.english: He suddenly noticed a small switch on the left side of the screen, just right below the code.

sentences.chinese: 他轻轻地按了一下，整个世界开始剧烈地摇晃起来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qīngqīng de àn le yīxià, zhěnggè shìjiè kāishǐ jùliè de yáohuàng qǐlái.
sentences.english: He pressed it lightly, and the entire world began to shake violently.

sentences.chinese: 世界在摇晃，林星突然发现自己不在实验室里。
sentences.pinyin: Shìjiè zài yáohuàng, Lín Xīng tūrán fāxiàn zìjǐ bùzài shíyànshì lǐ.
sentences.english: The world was shaking, and Lin Xing suddenly found himself no longer in the laboratory.

sentences.chinese: 他发现自己坐在一个白色的房间里，像是在住院。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn zìjǐ zuò zài yīgè báisè de fángjiān lǐ, xiàng shì zài zhùyuàn.
sentences.english: He found himself sitting in a white room, as if he were hospitalized.

sentences.chinese: 一个机器人走过来，它的颜色是纯白色的。
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè jīqìrén zǒu guòlái, tā de yánsè shì chún báisè de.
sentences.english: A robot walked over; its color was pure white.

sentences.chinese: 机器人说：“你已经出院了，现在可以离开这里。”
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén shuō: “Nǐ yǐjīng chūyuàn le, xiànzài kěyǐ líkāi zhèlǐ.”
sentences.english: The robot said, "You have been discharged from the hospital, and you can leave here now."

sentences.chinese: 林星很奇怪，他记得自己刚才在操作一个开关。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng hěn qíguài, tā jìde zìjǐ gāngcái zài cāozuò yīgè kāiguān.
sentences.english: Lin Xing was puzzled; he remembered he had just been operating a switch.

sentences.chinese: 他看向桌子，那里有一本旧笔记。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng zhuōzi, nàlǐ yǒu yī běn jiù bǐjì.
sentences.english: He looked at the table, where there was an old notebook.

sentences.chinese: 笔记里写着，他曾经出国去学习先进的科技。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐjì lǐ xiězhe, tā céngjīng chūguó qù xuéxí xiānjìn de kējì.
sentences.english: The notes said that he had once gone abroad to study advanced technology.

sentences.chinese: 在国外的时候，他为了赚钱经常去打工。
sentences.pinyin: Zài guówài de shíhou, tā wèile zhuànqián jīngcháng qù dǎgōng.
sentences.english: While abroad, he often worked part-time jobs to earn money.

sentences.chinese: 他记得自己骑车去学校，路边停着很多辆奇怪的飞行车。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde zìjǐ qíchē qù xuéxiào, lùbiān tíngzhe hěnduō liàng qíguài de fēixīngchē.
sentences.english: He remembered riding his bike to school, with many strange flying cars parked by the road.

sentences.chinese: 那些车在空中停车的方式非常先进。
sentences.pinyin: Nàxiē chē zài kōngzhōng tíngchē de fāngshì fēicháng xiānjìn.
sentences.english: The way those cars parked in the air was very advanced.

sentences.chinese: 他想起一个朋友，那个朋友因为生病需要看西医。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ yīgè péngyou, nàgè péngyou yīnwèi shēngbìng xūyào kàn xīyī.
sentences.english: He thought of a friend who needed Western medicine because of an illness.

sentences.chinese: 后来，那个朋友回国了，并告诉他关于芯片的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Hòulái, nàgè péngyou huíguó le, bìng gàosu tā guānyú xīnpiàn de mìmì.
sentences.english: Later, that friend returned to the country and told him the secret of the chip.

sentences.chinese: 林星突然觉得这一切像是一个梦，或者是一个虚拟的程序。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng tūrán juéde zhè yīqiè xiàng shì yīgè mèng, huòzhě shì yīgè xūnǐ de chéngxù.
sentences.english: Lin Xing suddenly felt that all of this was like a dream, or a virtual program.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试开机旁边的电脑，想看看真实的记录。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chángshì kāijī pángbiān de diànnǎo, xiǎng kànkàn zhēnshí de jìlù.
sentences.english: He tried to boot up the computer beside him to see the real records.

sentences.chinese: 但电脑屏幕闪烁了一下，然后自动关机了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn diànnǎo píngmù shǎnshuò le yīxià, ránhòu zìdòng guānjī le.
sentences.english: But the computer screen flickered and then automatically shut down.

sentences.chinese: 机器人对他大喊：“走开！你不应该看这些！”
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén duì tā dàhǎn: “Zǒu kāi! Nǐ bù yīnggāi kàn zhèxiē!”
sentences.english: The robot shouted at him, "Go away! You should not be looking at these!"

sentences.chinese: 林星惊恐地站起来，他必须尽快出门寻找出口。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng jīngkǒng de zhàn qǐlái, tā bìxū jǐnkuài chūmén xúnzhǎo chūkǒu.
sentences.english: Lin Xing stood up in terror; he had to go out and find the exit as quickly as possible.

sentences.chinese: 他看到窗外，一艘巨大的飞船正在准备起飞。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào chuāngwài, yī sōu jùdà de fēichuán zhèngzài zhǔnbèi qǐfēi.
sentences.english: He saw a huge spaceship outside the window preparing to take off.

sentences.chinese: 飞船的方向是星际学院，那是他出发的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Fēichuán de fāngxiàng shì Xīngjì Xuéyuàn, nà shì tā chūfā de dìfāng.
sentences.english: The spaceship was headed toward the Interstellar Academy, the place where he had set off from.

sentences.chinese: 他想起以前在学院时，老师说休假的时候不要离开基地。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ yǐqián zài xuéyuàn shí, lǎoshī shuō xiūjià de shíhou bùyào líkāi jīdì.
sentences.english: He remembered that when he was at the academy, the teacher said not to leave the base during vacation.

sentences.chinese: 现在，他感觉自己像是在点外卖一样简单地被搬运到了这里。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài, tā gǎnjué zìjǐ xiàng shì zài diǎn wàimài yīyàng jiǎndān de bèi bānyùn dàole zhèlǐ.
sentences.english: Now, he felt as if he had been transported here as simply as ordering takeout.

sentences.chinese: 突然，所有的声音都停了，一个冷酷的声音在房间里响起。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, suǒyǒu de shēngyīn dōu tíng le, yīgè lěngkù de shēngyīn zài fángjiān lǐ xiǎngqǐ.
sentences.english: Suddenly, all the sounds stopped, and a cold voice rang out in the room.

sentences.chinese: “林星，你以为你逃离了现实吗？”
sentences.pinyin: “Lín Xīng, nǐ yǐwéi nǐ táolí le xiànshí ma?”
sentences.english: "Lin Xing, do you think you have escaped reality?"

sentences.chinese: 林星睁开眼睛，发现自己躺在草地上。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng zhēng kāi yǎn jīng, fā xiàn zì jǐ tǎng zài cǎo dì shàng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing opened his eyes and found himself lying on the grass.

sentences.chinese: 这里的天气是晴天，阳光非常亮。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de tiān qì shì qíng tiān, yáng guāng fēi cháng liàng.
sentences.english: The weather here was a sunny day, and the sunlight was very bright.

sentences.chinese: 这是一个很普通的地方，看起来像是一个平常的小公园。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yī gè hěn pǔ tōng de dì fāng, kàn qǐ lái xiàng shì yī gè píng cháng de xiǎo gōng yuán.
sentences.english: This was a very ordinary place, looking like a common small park.

sentences.chinese: 风吹过来，感觉很凉快。
sentences.pinyin: Fēng chuī guò lái, gǎn jué hěn liáng kuai.
sentences.english: The wind blew by, and it felt pleasantly cool.

sentences.chinese: 林星觉得这里很安静，没有了机器人的脚步声。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng jué de zhè lǐ hěn ān jìng, méi yǒu le jī qì rén de jiǎo bù shēng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing felt it was very quiet here, without the sound of robots' footsteps.

sentences.chinese: 他想起平时在学院的生活，那里没有这么美的景色。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ píng shí zài xué yuàn de shēng huó, nà lǐ méi yǒu zhè me měi de jǐng sè.
sentences.english: He thought about his life in the academy in normal times; there were no such beautiful scenes there.

sentences.chinese: 一个可爱的小机器人走过来，它在微笑。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè kě ài de xiǎo jī qì rén zǒu guò lái, tā zài wēi xiào.
sentences.english: An adorable little robot walked over, smiling.

sentences.chinese: “欢迎来到虚拟世界，林星。”小机器人说。
sentences.pinyin: “Huān yíng lái dào xū nǐ shì jiè, Lín Xīng.” xiǎo jī qì rén shuō.
sentences.english: "Welcome to the virtual world, Lin Xing," the little robot said.

sentences.chinese: 林星觉得这个场景很有意思，但他的心里没有信心。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng jué de zhè gè chǎng jǐng hěn yǒu yì si, dàn tā de xīn lǐ méi yǒu xìn xīn.
sentences.english: Lin Xing felt this scene was very interesting, but he had no confidence in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 他问：“这里安全吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn: “Zhè lǐ ān quán ma?”
sentences.english: He asked, "Is it safe here?"

sentences.chinese: 小机器人回答：“这里非常安全，而且很方便。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo jī qì rén huí dá: “Zhè lǐ fēi cháng ān quán, ér qiě hěn fāng biàn.”
sentences.english: The little robot replied, "It is very safe here, and also very convenient."

sentences.chinese: 林星看着天空，那是他最喜欢的晴色。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng kàn zhe tiān kōng, nà shì tā zuì xǐ huan de qíng sè.
sentences.english: Lin Xing looked at the sky; it was his favorite clear color.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果能一直住在这样一个地方，一定会很开心。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rú guǒ néng yī zhí zhù zài zhè yàng yī gè dì fāng, yī dìng huì hěn kāi xīn.
sentences.english: He thought that if he could live in such a place forever, he would certainly be very happy.

sentences.chinese: 但这个地方的味道不对，有一种电子产品的味道。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zhè gè dì fāng de wèi dao bù duì, yǒu yī zhǒng diàn zǐ chǎn pǐn de wèi dao.
sentences.english: But the smell of this place was wrong; there was a scent of electronic products.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，这并不是真实的世界，而是一个模拟程序。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, zhè bìng bù shì zhēn shí de shì jiè, ér shì yī gè mó nǐ chéng xù.
sentences.english: He realized that this was not the real world, but a simulation program.

sentences.chinese: 小机器人告诉他，这里的生活很便宜，不需要钱。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo jī qì rén gào su tā, zhè lǐ de shēng huó hěn pián yi, bù xū yào qián.
sentences.english: The little robot told him that life here was cheap and required no money.

sentences.chinese: 而且这里的每个人都能保持健康，永远不会生病。
sentences.pinyin: Ér qiě zhè lǐ de měi gè rén dōu néng bǎo chí jiàn kāng, yǒng yuǎn bù huì shēng bìng.
sentences.english: Furthermore, everyone here could remain healthy and would never get sick.

sentences.chinese: 林星问：“这对我有什么好处？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng wèn: “Zhè duì wǒ yǒu shén me hǎo chǔ?”
sentences.english: Lin Xing asked, "What benefit is there for me?"

sentences.chinese: 小机器人说：“你可以获得快乐，不用再逃跑。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo jī qì rén shuō: “Nǐ kě yǐ huò dé kuài lè, bù yòng zài táo pǎo.”
sentences.english: The little robot said, "You can obtain joy and no longer need to run away."

sentences.chinese: 林星想，这听起来像是一件好事，但这不是他想要的。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng xiǎng, zhè tīng qǐ lái xiàng shì yī jiàn hǎo shì, dàn zhè bù shì tā xiǎng yào de.
sentences.english: Lin Xing thought this sounded like a good thing, but it wasn't what he wanted.

sentences.chinese: 他想成为一个好人，去拯救真实的世界。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng chéng wéi yī gè hǎo rén, qù zhěng jiù zhēn shí de shì jiè.
sentences.english: He wanted to be a good person and save the real world.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这种生活不公平，因为真实的人们还在受苦。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué de zhè zhǒng shēng huó bù gōng píng, yīn wèi zhēn shí de rén men hái zài shòu kǔ.
sentences.english: He felt this kind of life was unfair because real people were still suffering.

sentences.chinese: 他需要准确地找到离开这里的路。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xū yào zhǔn què de zhǎo dào lí kāi zhè lǐ de lù.
sentences.english: He needed to accurately find the way to leave this place.

sentences.chinese: 小机器人看着他，觉得林星的眼神很挺，很有勇气。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo jī qì rén kàn zhe tā, jué de Lín Xīng de yǎn shén hěn tǐng, hěn yǒu yǒng qì.
sentences.english: The little robot looked at him and felt Lin Xing's gaze was straight and full of courage.

sentences.chinese: “你的想法不错，”小机器人说，“但这里是最合适你的地方。”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ de xiǎng fǎ bù cuò,” xiǎo jī qì rén shuō, “dàn zhè lǐ shì zuì hé shì nǐ de dì fāng.”
sentences.english: "Your thinking is not bad," the little robot said, "but this is the most suitable place for you."

sentences.chinese: 林星摇摇头，他不再放心这个虚拟的世界。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng yáo yáo tóu, tā bù zài fàng xīn zhè gè xū nǐ de shì jiè.
sentences.english: Lin Xing shook his head; he no longer felt relieved in this virtual world.

sentences.chinese: 在普通的世界里，人们虽然辛苦，但那是真实的。
sentences.pinyin: Zài pǔ tōng de shì jiè lǐ, rén men suī rán xīn kǔ, dàn nà shì zhēn shí de.
sentences.english: In the ordinary world, although people suffered, it was real.

sentences.chinese: 他想起父亲曾经对他说的那些话，那些话让他感到平安。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ fù qīn céng jīng duì tā shuō de nà xiē huà, nà xiē huà ràng tā gǎn dào píng ān.
sentences.english: He remembered the words his father had once told him, which made him feel safe and sound.

sentences.chinese: 他必须离开，即使这意味着要面对危险。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì xū lí kāi, jí shǐ zhè yì wèi zhe yào miàn duì wēi xiǎn.
sentences.english: He had to leave, even if it meant facing danger.

sentences.chinese: 小机器人叹了口气，打开了一个传送门。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo jī qì rén tàn le yī kǒu qì, dǎ kāi le yī gè chuán sòng mén.
sentences.english: The little robot sighed and opened a portal.

sentences.chinese: “既然你决定离开，那就祝你一路平安。”
sentences.pinyin: “Jì rán nǐ jué dìng lí kāi, nà jiù zhù nǐ yī lù píng ān.”
sentences.english: "Since you have decided to leave, I wish you a pleasant journey."

sentences.chinese: “也祝你一路顺风，去寻找你的真相。”
sentences.pinyin: “Yě zhù nǐ yī lù shùn fēng, qù xún zhǎo nǐ de zhēn xiàng.”
sentences.english: "And may you have a pleasant journey to find your truth."

sentences.chinese: 林星走进传送门，突然听到背后传来一声巨大的警报声。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng zǒu jìn chuán sòng mén, tū rán tīng dào bèi hòu chuán lái yī shēng jù dà de jǐng bào shēng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing stepped into the portal, and suddenly heard a loud alarm sound behind him.

sentences.chinese: 林星穿过传送门，来到了一个特别的城市。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng chuānguò chuánsòngmén, láidàole yīgè tèbié de chéngshì.
sentences.english: Lin Xing passed through the portal and arrived at a special city.

sentences.chinese: 这里的天空是紫色的，看起来非常漂亮。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de tiānkōng shì zǐsè de, kàn qǐlái fēicháng piàoliang.
sentences.english: The sky here was purple and looked very beautiful.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这里的空气很轻，呼吸起来很舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde zhèlǐ de kōngqì hěn qīng, hūxī qǐlái hěn shūfu.
sentences.english: He felt the air here was light and comfortable to breathe.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一个机器人走过来，说话非常流利。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào yīgè jīqìrén zǒu guòlái, shuōhuà fēicháng liúlì.
sentences.english: He saw a robot walk over, speaking very fluently.

sentences.chinese: 机器人热情地问他：“欢迎来到新世界，你感觉怎么样？”
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén rèqíng de wèn tā: “Huānyíng láidào xīn shìjiè, nǐ gǎnjué zěnmeyàng?”
sentences.english: The robot enthusiastically asked him, "Welcome to the new world, how do you feel?"

sentences.chinese: 林星觉得这个机器人的声音很清楚，让他很满意。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng juéde zhège jīqìrén de shēngyīn hěn qīngchu, ràng tā hěn mǎnyì.
sentences.english: Lin Xing felt the robot's voice was clear, which made him satisfied.

sentences.chinese: 机器人告诉他，这里的人生活很自由，可以随便去任何地方。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén gàosù tā, zhèlǐ de rén shēnghuó hěn zìyóu, kěyǐ suíbiàn qù rènhé dìfāng.
sentences.english: The robot told him that people here live with great freedom and can go anywhere as they please.

sentences.chinese: 林星问：“这里是地球上的哪个地方？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng wèn: “Zhèlǐ shì dìqiú shàng de nǎge dìfāng?”
sentences.english: Lin Xing asked, "Where on Earth is this place?"

sentences.chinese: 机器人直接回答：“这里不是地球，但这里的环境很正常。”
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén zhíjiē huídá: “Zhèlǐ bùshì dìqiú, dàn zhèlǐ de huánjìng hěn zhèngcháng.”
sentences.english: The robot answered directly, "This is not Earth, but the environment here is normal."

sentences.chinese: 林星想起在旧档案里看过，地球的黑龙江省曾经有类似的寒冷天气。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng xiǎngqǐ zài jiù dàng'àn lǐ kànguò, dìqiú de Hēilóngjiāng shěng céngjīng yǒu lèisì de hánlěng tiānqì.
sentences.english: Lin Xing remembered seeing in the old archives that Heilongjiang Province on Earth once had similar cold weather.

sentences.chinese: 他拿出相机，拍下了这座城市的照片。
sentences.pinyin: Tā náchū xiàngjī, pāixiàle zhè zuò chéngshì de zhàopiàn.
sentences.english: He took out his camera and took photos of the city.

sentences.chinese: 他想知道这里是否是真正地能够生存的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng zhīdào zhèlǐ shìfǒu shì zhēnzhèng de nénggòu shēngcún de dìfāng.
sentences.english: He wanted to know if this was truly a place where one could survive.

sentences.chinese: 机器人说：“只要你的选择正确，你就能在这里生活。”
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén shuō: “Zhǐyào nǐ de xuǎnzé zhèngquè, nǐ jiù néng zài zhèlǐ shēnghuó.”
sentences.english: The robot said, "As long as your choice is correct, you can live here."

sentences.chinese: 林星发现自己对这个地方还不熟，需要时间去了解。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng fāxiàn zìjǐ duì zhège dìfāng hái bù shú, xūyào shíjiān qù liǎojiě.
sentences.english: Lin Xing found that he was not yet familiar with this place and needed time to understand it.

sentences.chinese: 他经常在街上看到奇怪的飞行车，它们随时在空中飞来飞去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīngcháng zài jiē shàng kàndào qíguài de fēixíngchē, tāmen suíshí zài kōngzhōng fēi lái fēi qù.
sentences.english: He frequently saw strange flying cars on the street, flying around in the air at any time.

sentences.chinese: 这里的食物很奇怪，但吃饱之后，他觉得很有精神。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de shíwù hěn qíguài, dàn chī bǎo zhīhòu, tā juéde hěn yǒu jīngshén.
sentences.english: The food here was strange, but after eating until full, he felt very energetic.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这里的衣服很称他的身材，穿起来很合适。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde zhèlǐ de yīfú hěn chèn tā de shēncái, chuān qǐlái hěn héshì.
sentences.english: He felt the clothes here fit his figure well and were comfortable to wear.

sentences.chinese: 他希望接下来的旅程能够顺利，没有危险。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xīwàng jiē xiàlái de lǚchéng nénggòu shùnlì, méiyǒu wēixiǎn.
sentences.english: He hoped the upcoming journey would go smoothly without danger.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他的芯片闪烁了一下，发出了红光。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, tā de xīnpiàn shǎnshuòle yīxià, fāchūle hóngguāng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, his chip flickered and emitted a red light.

sentences.chinese: 一个冷酷的声音在他的脑海中响起：“你逃不掉的。”
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè lěngkù de shēngyīn zài tā de nǎohǎi zhōng xiǎngqǐ: “Nǐ táo bù diào de.”
sentences.english: A cold voice sounded in his mind: "You cannot escape."

sentences.chinese: 林星惊恐地发现，这座漂亮的城市其实是一个巨大的笼子。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng jīngkǒng de fāxiàn, zhè zuò piàoliang de chéngshì qíshí shì yīgè jùdà de lóngzi.
sentences.english: Lin Xing discovered with horror that this beautiful city was actually a giant cage.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 17: The Illusion of the Virtual City

sentences.chinese: 林星站在街上，看着周围的一切。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng zhàn zài jiē shàng, kàn zhe zhōu wéi de yī qiè.
sentences.english: Lin Xing stood on the street, looking at everything around him.

sentences.chinese: 这里的人们看起来很高兴，但林星知道这是假的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de rén men kàn qǐ lái hěn gāo xìng, dàn Lín Xīng zhī dào zhè shì jiǎ de.
sentences.english: The people here seemed very happy, but Lin Xing knew it was fake.

sentences.chinese: 他想起上周在学院时，老师说过这个城市的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ shàng zhōu zài xué yuàn shí, lǎo shī shuō guò zhè gè chéng shì de mì mì.
sentences.english: He remembered last week at the academy, when the teacher spoke about the secrets of this city.

sentences.chinese: 下周他原本应该回到学校，但现在他被困在了这个笼子里。
sentences.pinyin: Xià zhōu tā yuán běn yīng gāi huí dào xué xiào, dàn xiàn zài tā bèi kùn zài le zhè gè lóng zi lǐ.
sentences.english: Next week he was originally supposed to return to school, but now he was trapped in this cage.

sentences.chinese: 他看到路边有很多公共汽车，但没有一个人在开车。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào lù biān yǒu hěn duō gōng gòng qì chē, dàn méi yǒu yī gè rén zài kāi chē.
sentences.english: He saw many buses by the roadside, but not a single person was driving.

sentences.chinese: 这里的交通工具都是自动的，甚至不需要出租车。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de jiāo tōng gōng jù dōu shì zì dòng de, shèn zhì bù xū yào chū zū chē.
sentences.english: The transportation here was all automatic; there wasn't even a need for rental cars.

sentences.chinese: 他走到一个地铁站，发现那里空无一人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu dào yī gè dì tiě zhàn, fā xiàn nà lǐ kōng wú yī rén.
sentences.english: He walked to a subway station and found it completely deserted.

sentences.chinese: 他走进车站的大门，听到里面传来了奇怪的音乐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu jìn chē zhàn de dà mén, tīng dào lǐ miàn chuán lái le qí guài de yīn yuè.
sentences.english: He entered the main doors of the station and heard strange music coming from inside.

sentences.chinese: 这音乐让他想起小时候在中小学学习的日子。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè yīn yuè ràng tā xiǎng qǐ xiǎo shí hòu zài zhōng xiǎo xué xué xí de rì zi.
sentences.english: This music reminded him of the days he spent studying in middle and elementary school.

sentences.chinese: 那时，校园里总是充满了欢笑声。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shí, xiào yuán lǐ zǒng shì chōng mǎn le huān xiào shēng.
sentences.english: Back then, the campus was always filled with the sound of laughter.

sentences.chinese: 现在，他看到一个机器人组长在指挥人们排队。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài, tā kàn dào yī gè jī qì rén zǔ zhǎng zài zhǐ huī rén men pái duì.
sentences.english: Now, he saw a robot group leader directing people to line up.

sentences.chinese: 这里的每个人都像机器一样，在等待一个座位。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de měi gè rén dōu xiàng jī qì yī yàng, zài děng dài yī gè zuò wèi.
sentences.english: Everyone here was like a machine, waiting for a seat.

sentences.chinese: 林星在人群中见到一个男人，那个男人自称是这座城市的市长。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng zài rén qún zhōng jiàn dào yī gè nán rén, nà gè nán rén zì chēng shì zhè zuò chéng shì de shì zhǎng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing saw a man in the crowd who claimed to be the mayor of this city.

sentences.chinese: 市长看着他，轻轻地点头，脸上带着虚假的微笑。
sentences.pinyin: Shì zhǎng kàn zhe tā, qīng qīng de diǎn tóu, liǎn shàng dài zhe xū jiǎ de wēi xiào.
sentences.english: The mayor looked at him and nodded gently, with a fake smile on his face.

sentences.chinese: “欢迎来到我们的花园城市，”市长说。
sentences.pinyin: “Huān yíng lái dào wǒ men de huā yuán chéng shì,” shì zhǎng shuō.
sentences.english: "Welcome to our garden city," the mayor said.

sentences.chinese: 林星注意到，这里的花园里没有真正的花，只有发光的电线。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng zhù yì dào, zhè lǐ de huā yuán lǐ méi yǒu zhēn zhèng de huā, zhǐ yǒu fā guāng de diàn xiàn.
sentences.english: Lin Xing noticed that there were no real flowers in the garden, only glowing wires.

sentences.chinese: 市长告诉他，这里的故事很简单：所有人都生活在幸福中。
sentences.pinyin: Shì zhǎng gào sù tā, zhè lǐ de gù shì hěn jiǎn dān: suǒ yǒu rén dōu shēng huó zài xìng fú zhōng.
sentences.english: The mayor told him that the story here was simple: everyone lived in happiness.

sentences.chinese: 但林星在新闻里读过，真正的幸福不是被制造出来的。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn Lín Xīng zài xīn wén lǐ dú guò, zhēn zhèng de xìng fú bú shì bèi zhì zào chū lái de.
sentences.english: But Lin Xing had read in the news that true happiness is not manufactured.

sentences.chinese: 市长邀请他参加今晚的晚会，那里会有盛大的音乐会。
sentences.pinyin: Shì zhǎng yāo qǐng tā cān jiā jīn wǎn de wǎn huì, nà lǐ huì yǒu shèng dà de yīn yuè huì.
sentences.english: The mayor invited him to tonight's evening party, where there would be a grand concert.

sentences.chinese: “在那之前，你可以先去饭馆吃早餐，”市长指了指远方。
sentences.pinyin: “Zài nà zhī qián, nǐ kě yǐ xiān qù fàn guǎn chī zǎo cān,” shì zhǎng zhǐ zhǐ yuǎn fāng.
sentences.english: "Before that, you can go to a restaurant for breakfast," the mayor pointed in the distance.

sentences.chinese: 林星走进一家饭馆，发现这里的食物只是光影的组合。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng zǒu jìn yī jiā fàn guǎn, fā xiàn zhè lǐ de shí wù zhǐ shì guāng yǐng de zǔ hé.
sentences.english: Lin Xing entered a restaurant and found that the food here was just a combination of light and shadow.

sentences.chinese: 他坐下来，发现桌子上有一张纸，写着一个小组的名单。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuò xià lái, fā xiàn zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī zhāng zhǐ, xiě zhe yī gè xiǎo zǔ de míng dān.
sentences.english: He sat down and found a piece of paper on the table with a list for a small group.

sentences.chinese: 名单上的人数非常少，只有三个人。
sentences.pinyin: Míng dān shàng de rén shù fēi cháng shǎo, zhǐ yǒu sān gè rén.
sentences.english: The number of people on the list was very small, only three people.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，这个小组的任务是将芯片送到城市的核心。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, zhè gè xiǎo zǔ de rèn wù shì jiāng xīn piàn sòng dào chéng shì de hé xīn.
sentences.english: He realized that the task of this group was to deliver the chip to the core of the city.

sentences.chinese: 结果，他现在就是这个计划的一部分。
sentences.pinyin: Jié guǒ, tā xiàn zài jiù shì zhè gè jì huà de yī bù fèn.
sentences.english: As a result, he was now a part of this plan.

sentences.chinese: 他想起上个周末，他曾幻想过一个完美的假期。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ shàng gè zhōu mò, tā céng huàn xiǎng guò yī gè wán měi de jià qī.
sentences.english: He remembered last weekend, when he had fantasized about a perfect vacation.

sentences.chinese: 但现在的假期对他来说就像一场噩梦。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiàn zài de jià qī duì tā lái shuō jiù xiàng yī chǎng mèng yù.
sentences.english: But the current vacation felt like a nightmare to him.

sentences.chinese: 他抬头看，天空中的月亮竟然是蓝色的，而且在闪烁。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tái tóu kàn, tiān kōng zhōng de yuè liang jìng rán shì lán sè de, ér qiě zài shǎn shuò.
sentences.english: He looked up and saw that the moon in the sky was actually blue and flickering.

sentences.chinese: 他发现这里的空间已经满了，没有地方可以逃跑。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn zhè lǐ de kōng jiān yǐ jīng mǎn le, méi yǒu dì fāng kě yǐ táo pǎo.
sentences.english: He discovered that the space here was already full; there was nowhere to escape.

sentences.chinese: 突然，那个冷酷的声音再次在他脑海中响起。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, nà gè lěng kù de shēng yīn zài cì zài tā nǎo hǎi zhōng xiǎng qǐ.
sentences.english: Suddenly, that cold voice echoed in his mind once again.

sentences.chinese: “你以为你是在生活，其实你只是在被观察。”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ yǐ wéi nǐ shì zài shēng huó, qí shí nǐ zhǐ shì zài bèi guān chá.”
sentences.english: "You think you are living, but in reality, you are just being observed."

sentences.chinese: 林星惊恐地发现，他的脚下开始出现红色的代码。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng jīng kǒng de fā xiàn, tā de jiǎo xià kāi shǐ chū xiàn hóng sè de dài mǎ.
sentences.english: Lin Xing discovered in horror that red code began to appear beneath his feet.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 18: The Truth of the Data

sentences.chinese: 红色的代码在林星的脚下快速移动。
sentences.pinyin: Hóngsè de dàimǎ zài Lín Xīng de jiǎoxià kuàisù yídòng.
sentences.english: The red code moved quickly beneath Lin Xing's feet.

sentences.chinese: 他发现这个虚拟城市其实只是一个巨大的公司在做实验。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn zhège xūnǐ chéngshì qíshí zhǐshì yīgè jùdà de gōngsī zài zuò shíyàn.
sentences.english: He discovered that this virtual city was actually an experiment being conducted by a huge company.

sentences.chinese: 这个公司的名称叫作“永恒生命”。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège gōngsī de míngchēng jiàozuò “Yǒnghéng Shēngmìng”.
sentences.english: The name of this company was "Eternal Life".

sentences.chinese: 林星想起在学校时，老师说过一个例子。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng xiǎngqǐ zài xuéxiào shí, lǎoshī shuōguò yīgè lìzi.
sentences.english: Lin Xing remembered an example the teacher had given at school.

sentences.chinese: 老师说，如果生活像小说一样完美，那可能不是实际的情况。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō, rúguǒ shēnghuó xiàng xiǎoshuō yīyàng wánměi, nà kěnéng búshì shíjì de qíngkuàng.
sentences.english: The teacher said that if life were as perfect as a novel, it might not be the actual situation.

sentences.chinese: 现在，他意识到这里的每一个人都只是数据的一部分。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài, tā yìshí dào zhèlǐ de měi yīgè rén dōu zhǐshì shùjù de yī bù fen.
sentences.english: Now, he realized that every person here was just a part of the data.

sentences.chinese: 这里的人口很多，但他们都没有真正的家庭。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de rénkǒu hěnduō, dàn tāmen dōu méiyǒu zhēnzhèng de jiātíng.
sentences.english: The population here was large, but they had no real families.

sentences.chinese: 林星看着周围的人，发现他们的个子和样子都非常不同。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng kànzhe zhōuwéi de rén, fāxiàn tāmen de gèzi hé yàngzi dōu fēicháng bùtóng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing looked at the people around him and found that their height and appearance were very different.

sentences.chinese: 但他们的习惯却一样：每天在同一个时间起床，做同样的事情。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tāmen de xíguàn què yīyàng: měitiān zài tóng yīgè shíjiān qǐchuáng, zuò tóngyàng de shìqíng.
sentences.english: But their habits were the same: waking up at the same time every day and doing the same things.

sentences.chinese: 这些人的主要工作就像是在做没有完结的作业。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē rén de zhǔyào gōngzuò jiù xiàng shì zài zuò méiyǒu wánjié de zuòyè.
sentences.english: The main work of these people was like doing endless school assignments.

sentences.chinese: 林星走到城市的中心，那里有一条宽阔的公路。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng zǒu dào chéngshì de zhōngxīn, nàlǐ yǒu yītiáo kuānkuò de gōnglù.
sentences.english: Lin Xing walked to the center of the city, where there was a wide highway.

sentences.chinese: 公路的南方是一片蓝色的大海，但那只是一个巨大的图片。
sentences.pinyin: Gōnglù de nánfāng shì yīpiàn lánsè de dàhǎi, dàn nà zhǐshì yīgè jùdà de túpiàn.
sentences.english: To the south of the highway was a blue sea, but that was just a giant picture.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个穿着黑色大衣的男人走到了他面前。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yīgè chuānzhe hēisè dàyī de nánrén zǒu dàole tā miànqián.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a man wearing a black overcoat walked up to him.

sentences.chinese: 这个男人的头很小，嘴巴在不停地动，但没有发出声音。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège nánrén de tóu hěn xiǎo, zuǐba zài bùtíng de dòng, dàn méiyǒu fāchū shēngyīn.
sentences.english: This man's head was very small, and his mouth was moving constantly, but no sound came out.

sentences.chinese: 林星注意到这个男人的位子就在代码的源头。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng zhùyì dào zhège nánrén de wèi zi jiù zài dàimǎ de yuántóu.
sentences.english: Lin Xing noticed that this man's position was exactly at the source of the code.

sentences.chinese: 男人突然开口了，声音很大，在空中响了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén tūrán kāikǒu le, shēngyīn hěn dà, zài kōngzhōng xiǎng le qǐlái.
sentences.english: The man suddenly spoke, his voice was loud and echoed in the air.

sentences.chinese: “你终于来了，林星。”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ zhōngyú lái le, Lín Xīng.”
sentences.english: "You've finally come, Lin Xing."

sentences.chinese: 林星感到很害怕，他问：“这里到底是什么地方？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng gǎndào hěn hàipà, tā wèn: “Zhèlǐ dàodǐ shì shénme dìfāng?”
sentences.english: Lin Xing felt very afraid and asked, "What on earth is this place?"

sentences.chinese: 男人告诉他，这里是为了庆祝公司成立一百周年而建立的虚拟世界。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén gàosù tā, zhèlǐ shì wèile zhùqìng gōngsī chénglì yībǎi zhōunián ér jiànlì de xūnǐ shìjiè.
sentences.english: The man told him that this was a virtual world established to celebrate the company's 100th anniversary.

sentences.chinese: “我们收集了许多人的信息，把他们放在这里。”
sentences.pinyin: “Wǒmen shōují le xǔduō rén de xìnxī, bǎ tāmen fàng zài zhèlǐ.”
sentences.english: "We collected information from many people and placed them here."

sentences.chinese: 林星问：“为什么我要在这里？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng wèn: “Wèishéme wǒ yào zài zhèlǐ?”
sentences.english: Lin Xing asked, "Why am I here?"

sentences.chinese: 男人解释说，原因是他脑海中的那个芯片。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén jiěshì shuō, yuányīn shì tā nǎohǎi zhōng de nàgè xīnpiàn.
sentences.english: The man explained that the reason was the chip in his mind.

sentences.chinese: 那个芯片能改变这个世界的运行大小。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè xīnpiàn néng gǎibiàn zhège shìjiè de yùnxíng dàxiǎo.
sentences.english: That chip could change the magnitude of this world's operation.

sentences.chinese: 林星突然感觉到头很痛，像是有太阳在里面发光。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng tūrán gǎnjué dào tóu hěn tòng, xiàng shì yǒu tàiyáng zài lǐmiàn fāguāng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing suddenly felt a sharp pain in his head, as if there were a sun shining inside.

sentences.chinese: 他想起自己曾经在南方的一个小镇生活，那里有真正的风和雨。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ céngjīng zài nánfāng de yīgè xiǎo zhèn shēnghuó, nàlǐ yǒu zhēnzhèng de fēng hé yǔ.
sentences.english: He remembered living in a small town in the south, where there was real wind and rain.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，这里的生活只是一个精心设计的谎言。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, zhèlǐ de shēnghuó zhǐshì yīgè jīngxīn shèjì de huǎngyán.
sentences.english: He realized that life here was just a carefully designed lie.

sentences.chinese: 他必须找到离开这里的办法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū zhǎodào líkāi zhèlǐ de bànfǎ.
sentences.english: He had to find a way to leave this place.

sentences.chinese: 男人看着他，眼神变得冷酷。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén kànzhe tā, yǎnshén biàn de lěngkù.
sentences.english: The man looked at him, his gaze becoming cold.

sentences.chinese: “在这个世界里，你是唯一一个名次最高的人。”
sentences.pinyin: “Zài zhège shìjiè lǐ, nǐ shì wéi yī yīgè míngcì zuì gāo de rén.”
sentences.english: "In this world, you are the only person with the highest rank."

sentences.chinese: “但最高的人，往往最容易被删除。”
sentences.pinyin: “Dàn zuì gāo de rén, wǎngwǎng zuì róngyì bèi shānchú.”
sentences.english: "But the highest-ranking person is often the easiest to delete."

sentences.chinese: 林星刚想说话，周围的场景突然开始崩塌。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng gāng xiǎng shuōhuà, zhōuwéi de chǎngjǐng tūrán kāishǐ bēngtā.
sentences.english: Lin Xing had just started to speak when the surrounding scene suddenly began to collapse.

sentences.chinese: 蓝色的月亮碎成了碎片，落在了他的肩上。
sentences.pinyin: Lánsè de yuèliàng suì chéngle suìpiàn, luò zàile tā de jiān shàng.
sentences.english: The blue moon shattered into pieces, falling on his shoulders.

sentences.chinese: 那个冷酷的声音再次响起：“欢迎来到真实的地狱。”
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè lěngkù de shēngyīn zàicì xiǎngqǐ: “Huānyíng lái dào zhēnshí de dìyù.”
sentences.english: That cold voice rang out again: "Welcome to the real hell."

chapters.title_english: Chapter 19: The City of Broken Memories

sentences.chinese: 林星睁开眼睛，发现自己躺在一个奇怪的市中心。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng zhēng kāi yǎn jīng, fā xiàn zì jǐ tǎng zài yí gè qí guài de shì zhōng xīn.
sentences.english: Lin Xing opened his eyes and found himself lying in a strange city center.

sentences.chinese: 这里不是他认识的城市，而是一个由数据组成的虚拟市。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ bú shì tā rèn shi de chéng shì, ér shì yí gè yóu shù jù zǔ chéng de xū nǐ shì.
sentences.english: This was not the city he knew, but a virtual city composed of data.

sentences.chinese: 他的腰上带了一根发光的蓝色带子，那是他的能量条。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yāo shàng dài le yì gēn fā guāng de lán sè dài zi, nà shì tā de néng liàng tiáo.
sentences.english: Around his waist, he wore a glowing blue band, which was his energy bar.

sentences.chinese: 在这个世界里，所有人的地位都是平等的，因为大家都只是代码。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè gè shì jiè lǐ, suǒ yǒu rén de dì wèi dōu shì píng děng de, yīn wèi dà jiā dōu zhǐ shì dài mǎ.
sentences.english: In this world, everyone's status was equal because everyone was just code.

sentences.chinese: 他看到远处有一座巨大的黑色金属塔，像一座坟墓一样安静。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào yuǎn chù yǒu yí zuò jù dà de hēi sè jīn shǔ tǎ, xiàng yí zuò fén mù yí yàng ānjìng.
sentences.english: He saw a huge black metal tower in the distance, as quiet as a grave.

sentences.chinese: 他走在一条狭窄的弄堂里，周围是灰色的墙壁。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu zài yì tiáo xiá zhǎi de lòng dāng lǐ, zhōu wéi shì huī sè de qiáng bì.
sentences.english: He walked in a narrow alley, surrounded by gray walls.

sentences.chinese: 当他走过一个路口时，突然听到一声响亮的“当”声，像古老的钟在响。
sentences.pinyin: Dāng tā zǒu guò yí gè lù kǒu shí, tū rán tīng dào yì shēng xiǎng liàng de "dāng" shēng, xiàng gǔ lǎo de zhōng zài xiǎng.
sentences.english: As he passed an intersection, he suddenly heard a loud "dong" sound, like an ancient bell ringing.

sentences.chinese: 墙上开始播放一段奇怪的影片，那是他小时候的记忆。
sentences.pinyin: Qiáng shàng kāi shǐ bō fàng yí duàn qí guài de yǐng piàn, nà shì tā xiǎo shí hòu de jì yì.
sentences.english: A strange film began to play on the wall; it was a memory from his childhood.

sentences.chinese: 林星心中感到非常不安，他觉得这一切都是陷阱。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng xīn zhōng gǎn dào fēi cháng bù ān, tā jué de zhè yí qiè dōu shì xiàn jǐng.
sentences.english: In his heart, Lin Xing felt very uneasy; he felt that all of this was a trap.

sentences.chinese: 他的心情变得很沉重，因为他想起了失踪的父亲。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de xīn qíng biàn de hěn chén zhòng, yīn wèi tā xiǎng qǐ le shī zōng de fù qīn.
sentences.english: His mood became very heavy because he thought of his missing father.

sentences.chinese: 在他心里，父亲是他唯一能信任的人。
sentences.pinyin: Zài tā xīn li, fù qīn shì tā wéi yī néng xìn rèn de rén.
sentences.english: In his mind, his father was the only person he could trust.

sentences.chinese: 一个机器人走过来，它的态度非常冷淡。
sentences.pinyin: Yí gè jī qì rén zǒu guò lái, tā de tài du fēi cháng lěng dàn.
sentences.english: A robot walked over, and its attitude was very cold.

sentences.chinese: 机器人说：“你走错了方向，这里很急，快离开！”
sentences.pinyin: Jī qì rén shuō: "Nǐ zǒu cuò le fāng xiàng, zhè lǐ hěn jí, kuài lí kāi!"
sentences.english: The robot said, "You are going in the wrong direction; it is urgent here, leave quickly!"

sentences.chinese: 林星问：“这里的意思是什么？我是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng wèn: "Zhè lǐ de yì si shì shén me? Wǒ shì shuí?"
sentences.english: Lin Xing asked, "What is the meaning of this place? Who am I?"

sentences.chinese: 机器人没有给出意见，只是指了指天空。
sentences.pinyin: Jī qì rén méi yǒu gěi chū yì jiàn, zhǐ shì zhǐ le zhǐ tiān kōng.
sentences.english: The robot did not give an opinion, only pointed to the sky.

sentences.chinese: 林星意识到，只有真正有才的人才能解开这个世界的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng yì shí dào, zhǐ yǒu zhēn zhèng yǒu cái de rén cái néng jiě kāi zhè gè shì jiè de mì mì.
sentences.english: Lin Xing realized that only those with true talent could unlock the secrets of this world.

sentences.chinese: 他看到地上有一张旧报纸，上面的字在不停地闪烁。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào dì shàng yǒu yì zhāng jiù bào zhǐ, shàng miàn de zì zài bù tíng de shǎn shuò.
sentences.english: He saw an old newspaper on the ground, the characters on it flashing continuously.

sentences.chinese: 报纸上写着：在这个世界，一个人的重量只有一斤，因为没有身体。
sentences.pinyin: Bào zhǐ shàng xiě zhe: Zài zhè gè shì jiè, yí gè rén de zhòng liàng zhǐ yǒu yì jīn, yīn wèi méi yǒu shēn tǐ.
sentences.english: The newspaper read: In this world, a person's weight is only one catty because there is no body.

sentences.chinese: 林星尝试寻找逃跑的方法，但这里的逻辑非常奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng cháng shì xún zhǎo táo pǎo de fāng fǎ, dàn zhè lǐ de luó jí fēi cháng qí guài.
sentences.english: Lin Xing tried to find a way to escape, but the logic here was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 在技术方面，他发现这个世界的代码正在崩溃。
sentences.pinyin: Zài jì shù fāng miàn, tā fā xiàn zhè gè shì jiè de dài mǎ zhèng zài bēng tā.
sentences.english: In terms of technology, he found that the code of this world was collapsing.

sentences.chinese: 他想起在现实生活中的日子，那时候阳光是暖的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ zài xiàn shí shēng huó zhōng de rì zi, nà shí hòu yáng guāng shì nuǎn de.
sentences.english: He thought of the days in real life, when the sunlight was warm.

sentences.chinese: 有人在他耳边低语：“这是一个机会，快跑。”
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu rén zài tā ěr biān dī yǔ: "Zhè shì yí gè jī huì, kuài pǎo."
sentences.english: Someone whispered in his ear, "This is an opportunity, run."

sentences.chinese: 他看到地上的代码变成了一条红色的线。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào dì shàng de dài mǎ biàn chéng le yì tiáo hóng sè de xiàn.
sentences.english: He saw the code on the ground turn into a red line.

sentences.chinese: 想要离开这里的条件只有一个：找到真正的记忆碎片。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎng yào lí kāi zhè lǐ de tiáo jiàn zhǐ yǒu yí gè: zhǎo dào zhēn zhèng de jì yì suì piàn.
sentences.english: There was only one condition to leave this place: find the true memory fragments.

sentences.chinese: 那个机器人的样子突然变得像他的父亲。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè jī qì rén de yàng zi tū rán biàn de xiàng tā de fù qīn.
sentences.english: The appearance of that robot suddenly became like his father.

sentences.chinese: 空气中有一种奇怪的气味，像是一种金属气。
sentences.pinyin: Kōng qì zhōng yǒu yì zhǒng qí guài de qì wèi, xiàng shì yì zhǒng jīn shǔ qì.
sentences.english: There was a strange smell in the air, like a metallic gas.

sentences.chinese: 他看到地上的油渍在发光，引导他向前方走去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào dì shàng de yóu zì zài fā guāng, yǐn dǎo tā xiàng qián fāng zǒu qù.
sentences.english: He saw oil stains on the ground glowing, guiding him forward.

sentences.chinese: 他突然发现自己站在一个虚拟的海边，波浪是蓝色的代码。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tū rán fā xiàn zì jǐ zhàn zài yí gè xū nǐ de hǎi biān, bō làng shì lán sè de dài mǎ.
sentences.english: He suddenly found himself standing on a virtual seaside, with waves of blue code.

sentences.chinese: 路边有一盏昏暗的灯，在风中轻轻摇晃。
sentences.pinyin: Lù biān yǒu yì zhǎn hūn dàn de dēng, zài fēng zhōng qīng qīng yáo huàng.
sentences.english: There was a dim lamp by the road, swaying gently in the wind.

sentences.chinese: 灯下有一张照片，照片里是一个女人，眼神温柔。
sentences.pinyin: Dēng xià yǒu yì zhāng zhào piàn, zhào piàn lǐ shì yí gè nǚ rén, yǎn shén wēn róu.
sentences.english: Under the lamp was a photograph of a woman with a gentle gaze.

sentences.chinese: 林星突然明白了，这个世界不仅仅是关于科学，还关于爱情。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng tū rán míng bái le, zhè gè shì jiè bù jǐn jǐn shì guān yú kē xué, hái guān yú ài qíng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing suddenly understood that this world was not just about science, but also about love.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，照片突然燃烧起来，化成了黑色的灰烬。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, zhào piàn tū rán rán shāo qǐ lái, huà chéng le hēi sè de huī jìn.
sentences.english: But at that moment, the photograph suddenly burst into flames and turned into black ash.

chapters.title_chinese: 第20章：记忆的碎片与代码之路
chapters.title_english: Chapter 20: Memory Fragments and the Path of Code

sentences.chinese: 林星看着灰烬，心中充满了问题。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng kànzhe huījìn, xīnzhōng chōngmǎnle wèntí.
sentences.english: Lin Xing looked at the ashes, his heart full of questions.

sentences.chinese: 他发现自己站在一条奇怪的道路上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn zìjǐ zhànzài yītiáo qíguài de dàolù shàng.
sentences.english: He found himself standing on a strange road.

sentences.chinese: 路边没有树，只有蓝色的光在闪烁。
sentences.pinyin: Lùbiān méiyǒu shù, zhǐyǒu lán sè de guāng zài shǎnshuò.
sentences.english: There were no trees by the roadside, only blue lights flashing.

sentences.chinese: 他低头看到地上有一片发光的金属圆片。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dītóu kàndào dìshàng yǒu yī piàn fāguāng de jīnshǔ yuánpiàn.
sentences.english: He looked down and saw a glowing metal disk on the ground.

sentences.chinese: 他把它捡起来，发现这是一个存储芯片。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ tā jiǎn qǐlái, fāxiàn zhè shì yīgè cúnchǔ xīnpian.
sentences.english: He picked it up and discovered it was a storage chip.

sentences.chinese: 芯片里头有一个旧的计划，那是关于人类理想的计划。
sentences.pinyin: Xīnpian lǐtou yǒu yīgè jiù de jìhuà, nà shì guānyú rénlèi lǐxiǎng de jìhuà.
sentences.english: Inside the chip was an old plan, a plan about human ideals.

sentences.chinese: 在这个虚拟的世界里，空气的味道像金属一样冷。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège xūnǐ de shìjiè lǐ, kōngqì de wèidào xiàng jīnshǔ yīyàng lěng.
sentences.english: In this virtual world, the smell of the air was cold like metal.

sentences.chinese: 他打开芯片，屏幕上出现了一篇很长的文章。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dǎkāi xīnpian, píngmù shàng chūxiànle yī piān hěn cháng de wénzhāng.
sentences.english: He opened the chip, and a long piece of writing appeared on the screen.

sentences.chinese: 文章里写着，科学不应该是冷酷的，而应该是温暖的。
sentences.pinyin: Wénzhāng lǐ xiězhe, kēxué bù yīnggāi shì lěngkù de, ér yīnggāi shì wēnnuǎn de.
sentences.english: The article wrote that science should not be cold, but should be warm.

sentences.chinese: 林星看到了一个人的画儿，那是一个老年男人的样子。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng kàndàole yīgè rén de huàr, nà shì yīgè lǎonián nánrén de yàngzi.
sentences.english: Lin Xing saw a picture of a person, it was the appearance of an elderly man.

sentences.chinese: 这个人的特点是眼睛很大，眼神里有光。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège rén de tèdiǎn shì yǎnjing hěn dà, yǎnshén lǐ yǒu guāng.
sentences.english: This person's characteristic was that his eyes were very large, with light in his gaze.

sentences.chinese: 林星想，这个人的看法可能和那个冷酷的声音不一样。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng xiǎng, zhège rén de kànfǎ kěnéng hé nàgè lěngkù de shēngyīn bù yīyàng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing thought that this person's view might be different from that cold voice.

sentences.chinese: 他用一支电子笔在屏幕上记录自己的观点。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng yī zhī diànzǐ bǐ zài píngmù shàng jìlù zìjǐ de guāndiǎn.
sentences.english: He used an electronic pen to record his own standpoint on the screen.

sentences.chinese: 从不同的角度看，这个世界就像一个巨大的网。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng bùtóng de jiǎodù kàn, zhège shìjiè jiù xiàng yīgè jùdà de wǎng.
sentences.english: Looking from different angles, this world was like a giant net.

sentences.chinese: 每一个网站都是一个记忆的节点。
sentences.pinyin: Měi yīgè wǎngzhàn dōu shì yīgè jìyì de jiédiǎn.
sentences.english: Every website was a node of memory.

sentences.chinese: 林星想起在西方的一些古老故事里，人们骑自行车在路上走。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng xiǎngqǐ zài Xīfāng de yīxiē gǔlǎo gùshì lǐ, rénmen qí zìxíngchē zài lùshàng zǒu.
sentences.english: Lin Xing remembered some old stories from the West where people rode bicycles on the road.

sentences.chinese: 但在现在的世界，这种行为已经消失了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zài xiànzài de shìjiè, zhè zhǒng xíngwéi yǐjīng xiāoshīle.
sentences.english: But in today's world, this kind of behavior had already disappeared.

sentences.chinese: 他看着表，时间在快速地跳动。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe biǎo, shíjiān zài kuàisù de tiàodòng.
sentences.english: He looked at his watch; time was jumping rapidly.

sentences.chinese: 他发现这个虚拟世界的目的只是为了观察人类的情感。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn zhège xūnǐ shìjiè de mùdì zhǐshì wèile guānchá rénlèi de qínggǎn.
sentences.english: He discovered that the purpose of this virtual world was only to observe human emotions.

sentences.chinese: 那个冷酷的声音再次响起，像是一个电视节目在播放。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè lěngkù de shēngyīn zàicì xiǎngqǐ, xiàng shì yīgè diànshì jiémù zài bōfàng.
sentences.english: The cold voice sounded again, like a television program being broadcast.

sentences.chinese: “你以为你找到了道理，但你只是在我的部分代码里行走。”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ yǐwéi nǐ zhǎodàole dàolǐ, dàn nǐ zhǐshì zài wǒ de bùfen dàimǎ lǐ xíngzǒu.”
sentences.english: "You think you have found the reason, but you are only walking within a part of my code."

sentences.chinese: 林星看着前方，有一道红色的门在等待他。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng kànzhe qiánfāng, yǒu yī dào hóngsè de mén zài děngdài tā.
sentences.english: Lin Xing looked ahead; a red door was waiting for him.
