sentences.chinese: 门边写着一个字：眼。
sentences.pinyin: Mén biān xiězhe yīgè zì: yǎn.
sentences.english: By the side of the door, one character was written: Eye.

sentences.chinese: 这意味着这里是所有秘密的 crux，是问题的核心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè yìwèizhe zhèlǐ shì suǒyǒu mìmì de crux, shì wèntí de héxīn.
sentences.english: This meant that this was the crux of all secrets, the core of the problem.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，自己的生命现在就在这个红色的网之中。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, zìjǐ de shēngmìng xiànzài jiù zài zhège hóngsè de wǎng zhīzhōng.
sentences.english: He realized that his own life was now within this red network.

sentences.chinese: 他必须思考，如何才能走出这条虚拟的道路。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū sīkǎo, rúhé cáinéng zǒuchū zhè tiáo xūnǐ de dàolù.
sentences.english: He had to think about how to exit this virtual path.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试改变自己的行为，不再害怕那个声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chángshì gǎibiàn zìjǐ de xíngwéi, bù zài hàipà nàgè shēngyīn.
sentences.english: He tried to change his behavior and no longer fear that voice.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果能把这些碎片拼在一起，就能找回真相。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rúguǒ néng bǎ zhèxiē suìpiàn pīn zài yīqǐ, jiù néng zhǎohuí zhēnxiàng.
sentences.english: He thought that if he could piece these fragments together, he could find the truth.

sentences.chinese: 他走在道路的边上，感觉整个世界在摇晃。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu zài dàolù de biān shàng, gǎnjué zhěnggè shìjiè zài yáohuàng.
sentences.english: He walked along the edge of the road, feeling the whole world shaking.

sentences.chinese: 他发现这个世界的特点是不断地在改变。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn zhège shìjiè de tèdiǎn shì bùduàn de zài gǎibiàn.
sentences.english: He found that the characteristic of this world was that it was constantly changing.

sentences.chinese: 他闭上眼，试图回忆那个温柔女人的样子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì shàng yǎn, shìtú huíyì nàgè wēnròu nǚrén de yàngzi.
sentences.english: He closed his eyes, trying to recall the appearance of that gentle woman.

sentences.chinese: 突然，红色的门打开了，里头是一片白光。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, hóngsè de mén dǎkāile, lǐtou shì yī piàn báiguāng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the red door opened, and inside was a sheet of white light.

sentences.chinese: 林星走进了那片白光，发现自己站在一个巨大的房间里。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng zǒu jìn le nà piàn bái guāng, fā xiàn zì jǐ zhàn zài yí gè jù dà de fáng jiān lǐ.
sentences.english: Lin Xing walked into the white light and found himself standing in a huge room.

sentences.chinese: 这里的墙壁是蓝色的，像天空一样广阔。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de qiáng bì shì lán sè de, xiàng tiān kōng yí yàng guǎng kuò.
sentences.english: The walls here were blue, as vast as the sky.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一个中年男人站在那里，他的脸看起来很疲惫。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào yí gè zhōng nián nán rén zhàn zài nà lǐ, tā de liǎn kàn qǐ lái hěn pí bèi.
sentences.english: He saw a middle-aged man standing there, his face looking very tired.

sentences.chinese: 这个男人告诉他，这里是模拟地球大自然的中心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè nán rén gào sù tā, zhè lǐ shì mó nǐ dì qiú dà zì rán de zhōng xīn.
sentences.english: This man told him that this was the center for simulating Earth's nature.

sentences.chinese: “欢迎来到国际气候控制室，”男人用一种很常用的语言说道。
sentences.pinyin: “Huān yíng lái dào guó jì qì hòu kòng zhì shì,” nán rén yòng yì zhǒng hěn cháng yòng de yǔ yán shuō dào.
sentences.english: "Welcome to the International Climate Control Room," the man said in a commonly used language.

sentences.chinese: 林星注意到，这个男人的衣服上有英文和英语的标志。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng zhù yì dào, zhè gè nán rén de yī fu shàng yǒu Yīng wén hé Yīng yǔ de biāo zhì.
sentences.english: Lin Xing noticed that there were English and English-language marks on the man's clothes.

sentences.chinese: 男人告诉他，这里可以控制一个世界的四季。
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén gào sù tā, zhè lǐ kě yǐ kòng zhì yí gè shì jiè de sì jì.
sentences.english: The man told him that they could control the four seasons of a world here.

sentences.chinese: 他按下一个按钮，窗外立刻变成了春天，到处是绿色。
sentences.pinyin: Tā àn xià yí gè àn niǔ, chuāng wài lì kè biàn chéng le chūn tiān, dào chù shì lǜ sè.
sentences.english: He pressed a button, and outside the window it immediately became spring, with green everywhere.

sentences.chinese: 接着，他再次按下按钮，窗外变成了夏天，太阳非常热。
sentences.pinyin: Jiē zhe, tā zài cì àn xià àn niǔ, chuāng wài biàn chéng le xià tiān, tài yáng fēi cháng rè.
sentences.english: Then, he pressed the button again, and outside it became summer, and the sun was very hot.

sentences.chinese: 然后，窗外变成了秋天，叶子开始掉落。
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu, chuāng wài biàn chéng le qiū tiān, yè zi kāi shǐ diào luò.
sentences.english: Afterward, it became autumn outside, and the leaves began to fall.

sentences.chinese: 最后，窗外开始下雪，进入了寒冷的冬天。
sentences.pinyin: Zuì hòu, chuāng wài kāi shǐ xià xuě, jìn rù le hán lěng de dōng tiān.
sentences.english: Finally, it started to snow outside, entering the cold winter.

sentences.chinese: 男人说：“在这里，我们可以让气温在几分钟内改变。”
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén shuō: “Zài zhè lǐ, wǒ men kě yǐ ràng qì wēn zài jǐ fēn zhōng nèi gǎi biàn.”
sentences.english: The man said, "Here, we can change the air temperature within a few minutes."

sentences.chinese: “现在的温度是零下二十度，”男人指着屏幕说。
sentences.pinyin: “Xiàn zài de wēn dù shì líng xià èr shí dù,” nán rén zhǐ zhe píng mù shuō.
sentences.english: "The current temperature is minus twenty degrees," the man said, pointing to the screen.

sentences.chinese: 林星看着屏幕，上面显示着这个世界的各种月份。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng kàn zhe píng mù, shàng miàn xiǎn shì zhe zhè gè shì jiè de gè zhǒng yuè fèn.
sentences.english: Lin Xing looked at the screen, which showed various months of this world.

sentences.chinese: 他发现，这个世界的阴天和多云都是由电脑控制的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn, zhè gè shì jiè de yīn tiān hé duō yún dōu shì yóu diàn nǎo kòng zhì de.
sentences.english: He discovered that the cloudy days and cloudy weather of this world were all controlled by computers.

sentences.chinese: 男人告诉他，这个模拟系统覆盖了千万公里的范围。
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén gào sù tā, zhè gè mó nǐ xì tǒng fù gài le qiān wàn gōng lǐ de fàn wéi.
sentences.english: The man told him that this simulation system covered a range of ten million kilometers.

sentences.chinese: 在这个系统里，有亿万个虚拟的住房供人们居住。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè gè xì tǒng lǐ, yǒu yì wàn gè xū nǐ de zhù fáng gōng rén men jū zhù.
sentences.english: In this system, there were hundreds of millions of virtual housings for people to live in.

sentences.chinese: 林星问：“这个地方在地球的哪个方向？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng wèn: “Zhè gè dì fang zài dì qiú de nǎ gè fāng xiàng?”
sentences.english: Lin Xing asked, "In which direction of Earth is this place?"

sentences.chinese: 男人回答：“在真实的地球上，这里位于东南方向，但现在它在地下。”
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén huí dá: “Zài zhēn shí de dì qiú shàng, zhè lǐ wèi yú dōng nán fāng xiàng, dàn xiàn zài tā zài dì xià.”
sentences.english: The man replied, "On the real Earth, this is located in the southeast, but now it is underground."

sentences.chinese: 林星看到一个年轻的助手走过来，手里拿着一个金属盒子。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng kàn dào yí gè nián qīng de zhù shǒu zǒu guò lái, shǒu lǐ ná zhe yí gè jīn shǔ hé zi.
sentences.english: Lin Xing saw a young assistant walk over, holding a metal box.

sentences.chinese: 盒子很重，大约有十公斤，或者说十千克。
sentences.pinyin: Hé zi hěn zhòng, dà yuē yǒu shí gōng jīn, huò zhě shuō shí qiān kè.
sentences.english: The box was heavy, weighing about ten kilograms, or ten kilograms (qianke).

sentences.chinese: 助手说：“先生，西南地区的模拟数据出错了。”
sentences.pinyin: Zhù shǒu shuō: “Xiān sheng, xī nán dì qū de mó nǐ shù jù chū cuò le.”
sentences.english: The assistant said, "Sir, the simulation data for the southwest region is wrong."

sentences.chinese: 林星感到很奇怪，因为他记得之前的记忆碎片里没有这些。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng gǎn dào hěn qí guài, yīn wèi tā jì dé zhī qián de jì yì suì piàn lǐ méi yǒu zhè xiē.
sentences.english: Lin Xing felt strange because he remembered these weren't in the previous memory fragments.

sentences.chinese: 他看着那个中年男人，觉得他像是一个在研究语言的科学家。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe nà gè zhōng nián nán rén, jué de tā xiàng shì yí gè zài yán jiū yǔ yán de kē xué jiā.
sentences.english: He looked at the middle-aged man and felt he was like a scientist studying languages.

sentences.chinese: 男人叹了一口气，云般轻的声音在房间里响起。
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén tàn le yì kǒu qì, yún bān qīng de shēng yīn zài fáng jiān lǐ xiǎng qǐ.
sentences.english: The man sighed, and a voice as light as a cloud sounded in the room.

sentences.chinese: “这就是真相，林星，我们试图用科技重建大自然。”
sentences.pinyin: “Zhè jiù shì zhēn xiàng, Lín Xīng, wǒ men shì tú yòng kē jì chóng jiàn dà zì rán.”
sentences.english: "This is the truth, Lin Xing; we tried to rebuild nature using technology."

sentences.chinese: 林星意识到，他之前看到的破碎城市只是这个系统的碎片。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng yì shí dào, tā zhī qián kàn dào de pò suì chéng shì zhǐ shì zhè gè xì tǒng de suì piàn.
sentences.english: Lin Xing realized that the broken city he had seen before was just a fragment of this system.

sentences.chinese: 这里的每一千个数据点都代表一个真实的人类记忆。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de měi yì qiān gè shù jù diǎn dōu dài biǎo yí gè zhēn shí de rén lèi jì yì.
sentences.english: Every thousand data points here represent a real human memory.

sentences.chinese: 他想起了那个温柔的女人，她是否也住在这些蓝色的房间里？
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ le nà gè wēn róu de nǚ rén, tā shì fǒu yě zhù zài zhè xiē lán sè de fáng jiān lǐ?
sentences.english: He thought of that gentle woman; was she also living in these blue rooms?

sentences.chinese: 突然，房间的灯光闪烁了一下，警报声再次响起。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, fáng jiān de dēng guāng shǎn shuò le yí xià, jǐng bào shēng zài cì xiǎng qǐ.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the lights in the room flickered, and the alarm sounded again.

sentences.chinese: 一个冷酷的声音从天花板传来：“非法进入者，请立即离开。”
sentences.pinyin: Yí gè lěng kù de shēng yīn cóng tiān cāi pán chuán lái: “Fēi fǎ jìn rù zhě, qǐng lì jí lí kāi.”
sentences.english: A cold voice came from the ceiling: "Illegal intruder, please leave immediately."

sentences.chinese: 男人惊恐地看着林星，低声说：“快跑！他们发现了你！”
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén jīng kǒng de kàn zhe Lín Xīng, dī shēng shuō: “Kuài pǎo! Tā men fā xiàn le nǐ!”
sentences.english: The man looked at Lin Xing in terror and whispered, "Run! They've found you!"

sentences.chinese: 林星回头看向那个男人，但白光再次将他包围。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng huí tóu kàn xiàng nà gè nán rén, dàn bái guāng zài cì jiāng tā bāo wéi.
sentences.english: Lin Xing looked back at the man, but the white light surrounded him again.

sentences.chinese: 他感觉到自己正在被快速地移动，速度快得惊人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎn jué dào zì jǐ zhèng zài bèi kuài sù de yí dòng, sù dù kuài dé jīng rén.
sentences.english: He felt himself being moved rapidly, at a terrifying speed.

sentences.chinese: 白光消失了，林星发现自己站在一个奇怪的房间里。
sentences.pinyin: Báiguāng xiāoshī le, Lín Xīng fāxiàn zìjǐ zhàn zài yígè qíguài de fángjiān lǐ.
sentences.english: The white light disappeared, and Lin Xing found himself standing in a strange room.

sentences.chinese: 这里像是一个巨大的博物馆，墙上挂着很多画，像是一个画家画出来的世界。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ xiàng shì yígè jùdà de bówùguǎn, qiáng shàng guà zhe hěnduō huà, xiàng shì yígè huàjiā huà chūlái de shìjiè.
sentences.english: It looked like a giant museum, with many paintings on the walls, like a world painted by a painter.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一张桌子上放着一个瓶子，一个手表，和一本护照。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào yìzhāng zhuōzi shàng fàng zhe yígè píngzi, yígè shǒubiǎo, hé yìběn hùzhào.
sentences.english: He saw a bottle, a wristwatch, and a passport lying on a table.

sentences.chinese: 这些东西看起来很旧，但它们在这个高科技的世界里非常奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxi kàn qǐlái hěn jiù, dàn tāmen zài zhège gāo kējì de shìjiè lǐ fēicháng qíguài.
sentences.english: These things looked old, but they were very strange in this high-tech world.

sentences.chinese: 林星走到一张椅子旁边，发现那里有一双球鞋和一只旧鞋。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng zǒu dào yìzhāng yǐzi pángbiān, fāxiàn nàlǐ yǒu yìshuāng qiúxié hé yìzhī jiù xié.
sentences.english: Lin Xing walked next to a chair and found a pair of athletic shoes and an old shoe.

sentences.chinese: 他想起在学院的时候，他的教师告诉过他，真实的世界有很多简单的东西。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zài xuéyuàn de shíhou, tā de jiàoshī gàosù guò tā, zhēnshí de shìjiè yǒu hěnduō jiǎndān de dōngxi.
sentences.english: He remembered when he was at the academy, his teacher told him that the real world had many simple things.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他的芯片接收到了一个微弱的信号。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, tā de xīnpiàn jiēshōu dào le yígè wēiruò de xìnhào.
sentences.english: Suddenly, his chip received a weak signal.

sentences.chinese: 一个声音在他脑海中响起，那是他的父亲，一个伟大的科学家。
sentences.pinyin: Yígè shēngyīn zài tā nǎohǎi zhōng xiǎngqǐ, nà shì tā de fùqīn, yígè wěidà de kēxuéjiā.
sentences.english: A voice sounded in his mind; it was his father, a great scientist.

sentences.chinese: 父亲的声音说：“林星，这里存放着人类丢失的记忆。”
sentences.pinyin: Fùqīn de shēngyīn shuō: “Lín Xīng, zhèlǐ cúnfàng zhe rénlèi diūshī de jìyì.”
sentences.english: His father's voice said, "Lin Xing, this place stores the lost memories of humanity."

sentences.chinese: 林星看向窗外，他惊讶地发现窗外不是城市，而是一个巨大的动物园。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng kàn xiàng chuāngwài, tā jīngyà de fāxiàn chuāngwài búshì chéngshì, ér shì yígè jùdà de dòngwùyuán.
sentences.english: Lin Xing looked out the window and was surprised to find that outside was not a city, but a giant zoo.

sentences.chinese: 在这个动物园里，他看到了狗，看到了各种奇怪的动物。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège dòngwùyuán lǐ, tā kàndào le gǒu, kàndào le gèzhǒng qíguài de dòngwù.
sentences.english: In this zoo, he saw dogs and various strange animals.

sentences.chinese: 他甚至看到了一种像传说中离兽一样的生物，它在天空飞翔。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shènzhì kàndào le yìzhǒng xiàng chuánshuō zhōng líshòu yíyàng de shēngwù, tā zài tiānkōng fēixiáng.
sentences.english: He even saw a creature like the mythical Li beast, it was flying in the sky.

sentences.chinese: 林星走在路上，看到河水在流动，湖水在闪光。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng zǒu zài lùshàng, kàndào héshuǐ zài liúdòng, húshuǐ zài shǎnguāng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing walked along the road, seeing the river flowing and the lake shimmering.

sentences.chinese: 他感到很饿，在桌子上发现了一碗方便面和一对筷子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎndào hěn è, zài zhuōzi shàng fāxiàn le yìwǎn fāngbiànmiàn hé yíduì kuàizi.
sentences.english: He felt hungry and found a bowl of instant noodles and a pair of chopsticks on the table.

sentences.chinese: 他一边吃食物，一边看着墙上的文字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìbiān chī shíwù, yìbiān kàn zhe qiáng shàng de wénzì.
sentences.english: While eating the food, he looked at the text on the wall.

sentences.chinese: 墙上写着一个很长的句子，但每个音节都像是在跳舞。
sentences.pinyin: Qiáng shàng xiě zhe yígè hěn cháng de jùzi, dàn měigè yīnjié dōu xiàng shì zài tiàowǔ.
sentences.english: A very long sentence was written on the wall, but every syllable seemed to be dancing.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试读出那个句子，突然，一个机器人走过来，对他说了一个笑话儿。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chángshì dú chū nàge jùzi, tūrán, yígè jīqìrén zǒu guòlái, duì tā shuō le yígè xiàohuar.
sentences.english: He tried to read the sentence, and suddenly, a robot walked over and told him a joke.

sentences.chinese: 机器人说：“你知道为什么篮球和排球不能在一起吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén shuō: “Nǐ zhīdào wèishéme lánqiú hé páiqiú bùnéng zài yìqǐ ma?”
sentences.english: The robot said, "Do you know why basketballs and volleyballs cannot be together?"

sentences.chinese: 林星愣住了，他没有笑，因为机器人的眼睛是红色的。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng lèng zhù le, tā méiyǒu xiào, yīnwèi jīqìrén de yǎnjing shì hóngsè de.
sentences.english: Lin Xing froze; he didn't laugh because the robot's eyes were red.

sentences.chinese: 机器人看着林星的头发，低声说：“你长得像那个作家。”
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén kàn zhe Lín Xīng de tóufa, dīshēng shuō: “Nǐ zhǎng de xiàng nàge zuòjiā.”
sentences.english: The robot looked at Lin Xing's hair and said in a low voice, "You look like that author."

sentences.chinese: 林星问：“什么作家？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng wèn: “Shénme zuòjiā?”
sentences.english: Lin Xing asked, "What author?"

sentences.chinese: 机器人回答：“一个记录所有真实历史的人。”
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén huídá: “Yígè jìlù suǒyǒu zhēnshí lìshǐ de rén.”
sentences.english: The robot replied, "A person who recorded all of the true history."

sentences.chinese: 林星突然觉得自己的腿在发抖，他意识到自己正处于一个关键的节骨眼上。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng tūrán juéde zìjǐ de tuǐ zài fādǒu, tā yìshí dào zìjǐ zhèng chǔyú yígè guānjiàn de jiégǔyǎn shàng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing suddenly felt his legs shaking; he realized he was at a critical juncture.

sentences.chinese: 他环顾四周，发现这里竟然有药店，有银行，甚至有停放的车辆。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huángù sìzhōu, fāxiàn zhèlǐ jìngrán yǒu yàodiàn, yǒu yínháng, shènzhì yǒu tíngfàng de chēliàng.
sentences.english: He looked around and found that there were actually pharmacies, banks, and even parked vehicles here.

sentences.chinese: 但这一切都是虚拟的，就像一个巨大的幻象。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zhè yíqiè dōu shì xūnǐ de, jiù xiàng yígè jùdà de huànxiàng.
sentences.english: But all of this was virtual, like a giant illusion.

sentences.chinese: 他记得自己以前见过这样的地方，在父亲的旧档案里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde zìjǐ yǐqián jiànguò zhèyàng de dìfang, zài fùqīn de jiù dàng'àn lǐ.
sentences.english: He remembered that he had seen such a place before, in his father's old files.

sentences.chinese: 他低头看了看自己的球鞋，发现鞋底沾着红色的代码。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dītóu kàn le kàn zìjǐ de qiúxié, fāxiàn xié dǐ zhān zhe hóngsè de dàimǎ.
sentences.english: He looked down at his athletic shoes and found red code sticking to the soles.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，这个世界在试图通过这些简单的东西欺骗他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, zhège shìjiè zài shìtú tōngguò zhèxiē jiǎndān de dōngxi qīpiàn tā.
sentences.english: He realized that this world was trying to deceive him through these simple things.

sentences.chinese: 他试图跑向出口，但周围的场景再次开始改变。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shìtú pǎo xiàng chūkǒu, dàn zhōuwéi de chǎngjǐng zàicì kāishǐ gǎibiàn.
sentences.english: He tried to run toward the exit, but the surrounding scene began to change again.

sentences.chinese: 那些动物突然变成了数据碎片，它们在空中消失了。
sentences.pinyin: Nàxiē dòngwù tūrán biànchéng le shùjù suìpiàn, tāmen zài kōngzhōng xiāoshī le.
sentences.english: Those animals suddenly turned into data fragments, and they disappeared into the air.

sentences.chinese: 林星大声喊道：“告诉我真相！”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng dàshēng hǎn dào: “Gàosù wǒ zhēnxiàng!”
sentences.english: Lin Xing shouted loudly, "Tell me the truth!"

sentences.chinese: 突然，地面的代码开始剧烈闪烁，一个巨大的黑洞在房间中央打开了。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, dìmiàn de dàimǎ kāishǐ jùliè shǎnshuò, yígè jùdà de hēidòng zài fángjiān zhōngyāng dǎkāi le.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the code on the ground began to flash violently, and a giant black hole opened in the center of the room.

sentences.chinese: 林星看着那个黑洞，感到十分害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng kànzhe nàge hēidòng, gǎndào shí fēn hàipà.
sentences.english: Lin Xing looked at the black hole and felt very afraid.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得全身都在发抖，因为这里的引力太强了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde quán shēn dōu zài fādǒu, yīnwèi zhèlǐ de yǐnlì tài qiáng le.
sentences.english: He felt his whole body shaking because the gravity here was too strong.

sentences.chinese: 黑洞里到处都是闪烁的蓝色代码。
sentences.pinyin: Hēidòng lǐ dào chù dōu shì shǎnshuò de lán sè dàimǎ.
sentences.english: Everywhere inside the black hole were flashing blue codes.

sentences.chinese: 他一直试图寻找出口，但周围的场景完全改变了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yī zhí shìtú xúnzhǎo chūkǒu, dàn zhōuwéi de chǎngjǐng wán quán gǎibiàn le.
sentences.english: He had been continuously trying to find an exit, but the surrounding scene had completely changed.

sentences.chinese: 一个冷酷的声音大声地响起：“欢迎来到数据的深渊。”
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè lěngkù de shēngyīn dà shēng de xiǎngqǐ: “Huānyíng lái dào shùjù de shēnyuān.”
sentences.english: A cold voice rang out loudly: "Welcome to the Abyss of Data."

sentences.chinese: 林星大声喊道：“你是谁？为什么要把我关在这里？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng dà shēng hǎndào: “Nǐ shì shéi? Wèishéme yào bǎ wǒ guān zài zhèlǐ?”
sentences.english: Lin Xing shouted in a loud voice: "Who are you? Why are you keeping me here?"

sentences.chinese: 声音回答说：“这里储存了全国所有人的记忆。”
sentences.pinyin: Shēngyīn huídá shuō: “Zhèlǐ chǔcún le quán guó suǒ yǒu rén de jìyì.”
sentences.english: The voice replied: "This place stores the memories of everyone in the whole nation."

sentences.chinese: “在这个地方，大部分人的记忆被变成了数字。”
sentences.pinyin: “Zài zhège dìfāng, dà bù fen rén de jìyì bèi biànchéng le shùzì.”
sentences.english: "In this place, the majority of people's memories have been turned into numbers."

sentences.chinese: “大多数人根本不知道自己生活在虚拟世界里。”
sentences.pinyin: “Dà duō shù rén gēnběn bù zhīdào zìjǐ shēnghuó zài xūnǐ shìjiè lǐ.”
sentences.english: "The great majority of people have no idea they are living in a virtual world."

sentences.chinese: 林星发现这里有许多巨大的发光方块，每一个方块代表一个人的一生。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng fāxiàn zhèlǐ yǒu xǔ duō jùdà de fāguāng fāngkuài, měi yīgè fāngkuài dàibiǎo yīgè rén de yī shēng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing found many huge glowing cubes here, each cube representing a person's whole life.

sentences.chinese: 他看到不少方块在慢慢消失，这意味着那些人被删除了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào bù shǎo fāngkuài zài mànmàn xiāoshī, zhè yìwèizhe nàxiē rén bèi shānchú le.
sentences.english: He saw quite a few cubes slowly disappearing, which meant those people had been deleted.

sentences.chinese: “这里的数据一共有一万亿个，”声音继续说道，“而你拥有全部的权限。”
sentences.pinyin: “Zhèlǐ de shùjù yī gòng yǒu yī wàn yì gè,” shēngyīn jìxù shuō dào, “ér nǐ yōngyǒu quán bù de quánxián.”
sentences.english: "There are one trillion pieces of data here altogether," the voice continued, "and you possess all the permissions."

sentences.chinese: 林星意识到，这个权限可以大大地改变这个世界的规则。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng yìshí dào, zhège quánxián kěyǐ dà dà de gǎibiàn zhège shìjiè de guīzé.
sentences.english: Lin Xing realized that this permission could greatly change the rules of this world.

sentences.chinese: 但他发现，多数的数据碎片已经损坏，无法修复。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tā fāxiàn, duō shù de shùjù suìpiàn yǐjīng sǔnhuài, wúfǎ xiūfù.
sentences.english: But he found that most of the data fragments were already damaged and could not be repaired.

sentences.chinese: 他想起自己的全家，不知道他们在哪里，是否也在这里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ de quán jiā, bù zhīdào tāmen zài nǎlǐ, shìfǒu yě zài zhèlǐ.
sentences.english: He thought of his whole family, not knowing where they were or if they were also here.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果能把所有人的记忆找回来，大家就能获得自由。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rúguǒ néng bǎ suǒ yǒu rén de jìyì zhǎo huílái, dà jiā jiù néng huòdé zìyóu.
sentences.english: He thought that if he could recover everyone's memories, everyone could gain freedom.

sentences.chinese: 但这个过程太长了，可能需要全年不停地工作。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zhège guòchéng tài cháng le, kěnéng xūyào quán nián bùtíng de gōngzuò.
sentences.english: But this process was too long; it might require working all year long without stopping.

sentences.chinese: 他老是想起那个温柔女人的照片，那是他唯一的希望。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lǎo shi xiǎngqǐ nàge wēnróu nǚrén de zhàopiàn, nà shì tā wéiyī de xīwàng.
sentences.english: He always thought of the photo of that gentle woman; she was his only hope.

sentences.chinese: 大量的数据在他眼前飞快地移动，像是一场数字风暴。
sentences.pinyin: Dà liàng de shùjù zài tā yǎnqián fēikuài de yídòng, xiàng shì yī chǎng shùjù fēngbào.
sentences.english: A large quantity of data moved rapidly before his eyes, like a digital storm.

sentences.chinese: 他感觉到自己的意识在扩展，他现在能看到全体居民的痛苦。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎnjué dào zìjǐ de yìshí zài kuòzhǎn, tā xiànzài néng kàndào quán tǐ jūmín de tòngkǔ.
sentences.english: He felt his consciousness expanding; he could now see the suffering of the entire population.

sentences.chinese: 他发现好多人在这里等待了很久，他们永远在寻找出路。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn hǎo duō rén zài zhèlǐ děngdài le hěn jiǔ, tāmen yǒng yuǎn zài xúnzhǎo chūlù.
sentences.english: He found that quite a lot of people had been waiting here for a long time, forever searching for a way out.

sentences.chinese: 但这里的墙壁太厚，目前的能量根本不够突破。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zhèlǐ de qiángbì tài hòu, mùqián de néngliàng gēnběn bù gòu tūpò.
sentences.english: But the walls here were too thick; the current energy was simply not enough to break through.

sentences.chinese: 大部分的记忆碎片在风暴中破碎，化成了灰烬。
sentences.pinyin: Dà bù fen de jìyì suìpiàn zài fēngbào zhōng pòsuì, huà chéng le huījìn.
sentences.english: In large part, the memory fragments shattered in the storm, turning into ash.

sentences.chinese: 林星突然发现，一个巨大的代码之门在他面前打开了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng tūrán fāxiàn, yīgè jùdà de dàimǎ zhī mén zài tā miànqián dǎkāi le.
sentences.english: Lin Xing suddenly discovered a huge gate of code opening before him.

sentences.chinese: 门后是一个他从未见过的世界，那里有真正的阳光。
sentences.pinyin: Mén hòu shì yīgè tā cóngwèi jiànguò de shìjiè, nàlǐ yǒu zhēnzhèng de yángguāng.
sentences.english: Behind the door was a world he had never seen, where there was real sunlight.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，只要跨过这道门，他就再也回不去了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhīdào, zhǐyào kuàguò zhè dào mén, tā jiù zài yě huí bù qù le.
sentences.english: He knew that once he crossed this door, he could never go back.

sentences.chinese: 但就在他准备走进去时，黑洞突然发出了巨大的轰鸣声。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài tā zhǔnbèi zǒu jìnqù shí, hēidòng tūrán fāchū le jùdà de hōngmíng shēng.
sentences.english: But just as he was preparing to walk in, the black hole suddenly emitted a massive roar.

sentences.chinese: 轰鸣声停止了，林星被一股力量推向了一面白色的墙。
sentences.pinyin: Hōngmíng shēng tíngzhǐ le, Lín Xīng bèi yī gǔ lìliàng tuī xiàng le yī miàn báisè de qiáng.
sentences.english: The roaring sound stopped, and Lin Xing was pushed by a force toward a white wall.

sentences.chinese: 他发现自己躺在草地上，天空是深蓝色的，像是一个安静的夜。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn zìjǐ tǎng zài cǎodì shàng, tiānkōng shì shēnlán sè de, xiàng shì yī gè ānjìng de yè.
sentences.english: He found himself lying on the grass, the sky was deep blue, like a quiet night.

sentences.chinese: 这里不是虚拟城市，也不是外地，而是真正的地球。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ bú shì xūnǐ chéngshì, yě bú shì wàidì, ér shì zhēnzhèng de dìqiú.
sentences.english: This was not the virtual city, nor was it some distant place; it was the real Earth.

sentences.chinese: 他慢慢举起手，发现手里拿着一张旧纸。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mànmàn jǔqǐ shǒu, fāxiàn shǒulǐ názhe yī zhāng jiù zhǐ.
sentences.english: He slowly raised his hand and found he was holding a piece of old paper.

sentences.chinese: 纸上写着一个词，那是他父亲的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐ shàng xiězhe yī gè cí, nà shì tā fùqīn de míngzì.
sentences.english: On the paper was written a word, which was his father's name.

sentences.chinese: 林星读了三遍，眼泪流了下来。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng dú le sān biàn, yǎnlèi liú le xiàlái.
sentences.english: Lin Xing read it three times, and tears flowed down.

sentences.chinese: 他感觉到背后的衣服很脏，像是在泥土里躺了很久。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎnjué dào bèihòu de yīfú hěn zāng, xiàng shì zài nítǔ lǐ tǎng le hěn jiǔ.
sentences.english: He felt the clothes on his back were dirty, as if he had been lying in the soil for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个机器人走过来，它手里拿着一个碗和一些药。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yī gè jīqìrén zǒu guòlái, tā shǒulǐ názhe yī gè wǎn hé yīxiē yào.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a robot walked over, holding a bowl and some medicine.

sentences.chinese: 机器人说：“咱得快点走，这里不安全。”
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén shuō: “Zán děi kuài diǎn zǒu, zhèlǐ bù ānquán.”
sentences.english: The robot said, "We have to move quickly; it's not safe here."

sentences.chinese: 林星看着机器人，觉得它像一个奇怪的蛋，圆圆的。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng kànzhe jīqìrén, juéde tā xiàng yī gè qíguài de dàn, yuán yuán de.
sentences.english: Lin Xing looked at the robot and thought it looked like a strange egg, very round.

sentences.chinese: 机器人指了指远处的船，那是唯一的逃生工具。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén zhǐ le zhǐ yuǎn chù de chuán, nà shì wéiyī de táoshēng gōngjù.
sentences.english: The robot pointed to a ship in the distance, the only means of escape.

sentences.chinese: 林星走过去，不小心碰到了一个金属按钮。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng zǒu guòqù, bù xiǎoxīn pèng dào le yī gè jīnshǔ ànniǔ.
sentences.english: Lin Xing walked over and accidentally touched a metal button.

sentences.chinese: 一个巨大的黑板从地下升起来，上面写着复杂的代码。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè jùdà de hēibǎn cóng dìxià shēng qǐlái, shàngmiàn xiězhe fùzá de dàimǎ.
sentences.english: A huge blackboard rose from the ground, with complex code written on it.

sentences.chinese: 代码的每一句都像是在对他说话。
sentences.pinyin: Dàimǎ de měi yī jù dōu xiàng shì zài duì tā shuōhuà.
sentences.english: Every sentence of the code seemed to be speaking to him.

sentences.chinese: 机器人低声提议道：“快走，在敌人占领这里之前离开。”
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén dīshēng tíyì dào: “Kuài zǒu, zài dírén zhànlǐng zhèlǐ zhīqián líkāi.”
sentences.english: The robot whispered a suggestion: "Leave quickly, before the enemy occupies this place."

sentences.chinese: 林星发现代码中有一个假信号，那是为了欺骗敌人的陷阱。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng fāxiàn dàimǎ zhōng yǒu yī gè jiǎ xìnhào, nà shì wèile qīpiàn dírén de xiànjǐng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing discovered a fake signal in the code, a trap meant to deceive the enemy.

sentences.chinese: 他想起在学院的时候，老师说过要小心这种细节。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zài xuéyuàn de shíhòu, lǎoshī shuō guò yào xiǎoxīn zhè zhǒng xìjié.
sentences.english: He remembered when he was at the academy, the teacher said to be careful of such details.

sentences.chinese: 突然，天空中飞过一只鸟，但那只鸟的眼睛在闪光。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, tiānkōng zhōng fēiguò yī zhī niǎo, dàn nà zhī niǎo de yǎnjīng zài shǎnguāng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a bird flew across the sky, but the bird's eyes were flashing.

sentences.chinese: 林星意识到，即使在真实的世界，他也不能完全放心。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng yìshí dào, jíshǐ zài zhēnshí de shìjiè, tā yě bùnéng wánquán fàngxīn.
sentences.english: Lin Xing realized that even in the real world, he could not be completely at ease.

sentences.chinese: 他留下了那张纸，决定跟着机器人走向那艘船。
sentences.pinyin: Tā liú xià le nà zhāng zhǐ, juédìng gēnzhe jīqìrén zǒuxiàng nà sōu chuán.
sentences.english: He left the piece of paper behind and decided to follow the robot toward the ship.

sentences.chinese: 但他不知道，在代码之门的另一边，一个巨大的影子正在靠近。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tā bù zhīdào, zài dàimǎ zhī mén de lìng yī biān, yī gè jùdà de yǐngzi zhèngzài kàojìn.
sentences.english: But he didn't know that on the other side of the code gate, a giant shadow was approaching.

sentences.chinese: 这个影子在寻找他，而且速度快得惊人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège yǐngzi zài xúnzhǎo tā, érqiě sùdù kuài dé jīngrén.
sentences.english: This shadow was searching for him, and its speed was terrifyingly fast.

sentences.chinese: 林星跟着机器人走进了这座城市。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng gēnzhe jīqìrén zǒujìnle zhè zuò chéngshì.
sentences.english: Lin Xing followed the robot into this city.

sentences.chinese: 这里看起来像是一个普通的院子，但空气中有一种奇怪的味道。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ kàn qǐlái xiàng shì yīgè pǔtōng de yuànzi, dàn kōngqì zhòng yǒu yī zhǒng qíguài de wèidào.
sentences.english: It looked like an ordinary courtyard, but there was a strange smell in the air.

sentences.chinese: 机器人告诉他，这个院是用来测试人类记忆的。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén gàosù tā, zhège yuàn shì yòng lái cèshì rénlèi jìyì de.
sentences.english: The robot told him that this institution was used to test human memory.

sentences.chinese: 他们走在绿色的草地上，但林星发现草地下面是冰冷的金属。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒu zài lǜsè de cǎodì shàng, dàn Lín Xīng fāxiàn cǎodì xiàmiàn shì bīnglěng de jīnshǔ.
sentences.english: They walked on the green grass, but Lin Xing discovered that beneath the lawn was cold metal.

sentences.chinese: 远处有一个巨大的广场，很多人在那里走动。
sentences.pinyin: Yuǎnchù yǒu yīgè jùdà de guǎngchǎng, hěnduō rén zài nàlǐ zǒudòng.
sentences.english: In the distance was a huge public square where many people were moving around.

sentences.chinese: 这些人看起来像是在运动，像是在参加体育活动。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē rén kàn qǐlái xiàng shì zài yùndòng, xiàng shì zài cānjiā tǐyù huódòng.
sentences.english: These people seemed to be exercising, as if participating in sports activities.

sentences.chinese: 林星看到一个体育场，里面有一场激烈的比赛。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng kàndào yīgè tǐyùchǎng, lǐmiàn yǒu yī cháng jīliè de bǐsài.
sentences.english: Lin Xing saw a stadium where a fierce match was taking place.

sentences.chinese: 在体育馆旁边，人们在玩网球，动作非常统一。
sentences.pinyin: Zài tǐyùguǎn pángbiān, rénmen zài wán wǎngqiú, dòngzuò fēicháng tǒngyī.
sentences.english: Next to the gymnasium, people were playing tennis, their movements perfectly synchronized.

sentences.chinese: 一个球队在球场上快速跑动，他们看起来不像人类。
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè qiúduì zài qiúchǎng shàng kuàisù pǎodòng, tāmen kàn qǐlái bù xiàng rénlèi.
sentences.english: A sports team was running quickly on the court; they didn't look human.

sentences.chinese: 那个球队的队长大声喊着命令，声音像机器一样。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè qiúduì de duìzhǎng dàshēng hǎnzhe mìnglìng, shēngyīn xiàng jīqì yīyàng.
sentences.english: The captain of that team shouted orders loudly, his voice sounding like a machine.

sentences.chinese: 林星注意到，这里的班长在监督每个人，确保没有人出错。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng zhùyì dào, zhèlǐ de bānzhǎng zài jiāndū měigè rén, quèbǎo méiyǒu rén chūcuò.
sentences.english: Lin Xing noticed that the team leader here was supervising everyone to ensure no one made a mistake.

sentences.chinese: 他们经过了一个停车场，那里没有车，只有巨大的充电桩。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen jīngguòle yīgè tíngchēchǎng, nàlǐ méiyǒu chē, zhǐyǒu jùdà de chōngdiàn zhuāng.
sentences.english: They passed a parking lot; there were no cars there, only giant charging piles.

sentences.chinese: 林星看到一辆旧的公交车停在路边，车身很脏。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng kàndào yī liàng jiù de gōngjiāochē tíng zài lùbiān, chēshēn hěn zàng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing saw an old public bus parked by the roadside, its body very dirty.

sentences.chinese: 他走近一看，发现公交车的脚，也就是底部的支撑件，在闪光。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu jìn yī kàn, fāxiàn gōngjiāochē de jiǎo, yě jiùshì dǐbù de zhīchēng jiàn, zài shǎnguāng.
sentences.english: He walked closer and found that the 'foot'—that is, the support part at the bottom—of the bus was flashing.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，这整座城市其实是一个巨大的实验室。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, zhè zhěng zuò chéngshì qíshí shì yīgè jùdà de shíyànshì.
sentences.english: He realized that this entire city was actually a giant laboratory.

sentences.chinese: 这里有超市，有公园，甚至有地铁，但这一切都是假的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ yǒu chāoshì, yǒu gōngyuán, shènzhì yǒu dìtiě, dàn zhè yīqiè dōu shì jiǎ de.
sentences.english: There were supermarkets, parks, and even a subway, but all of it was fake.

sentences.chinese: 他走进了一栋建筑，里面是一个冷冰冰的办公室。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒujìnle yī dòng jiànzhù, lǐmiàn shì yīgè lěngbīngbīng de bàngōngshì.
sentences.english: He entered a building, and inside was a cold office.

sentences.chinese: 办公室的屏幕上显示着所有人的数据，就像在管理一个队伍。
sentences.pinyin: Bàngōngshì de píngmù shàng xiǎnshìzhe suǒyǒu rén de shùjù, jiù xiàng zài guǎnlǐ yīgè duìwǔ.
sentences.english: The office screen displayed the data of everyone, as if managing a squadron.

sentences.chinese: 林星感到恐惧，因为他发现自己的名字也在名单上。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng gǎndào kǒngjù, yīnwèi tā fāxiàn zìjǐ de míngzì yě zài míngdān shàng.
sentences.english: Lin Xing felt terror because he discovered his own name was also on the list.

sentences.chinese: 那个巨大的影子突然出现在窗外，遮住了阳光。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè jùdà de yǐngzi tūrán chūxiàn zài chuāngwài, zhēzhùle yángguāng.
sentences.english: That giant shadow suddenly appeared outside the window, blocking the sunlight.

sentences.chinese: 影子在寻找他，而林星现在被困在这个假的世界里。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐngzi zài xúnzhǎo tā, ér Lín Xīng xiànzài bèi kùn zài zhège jiǎ de shìjiè lǐ.
sentences.english: The shadow was searching for him, and Lin Xing was now trapped in this fake world.

sentences.chinese: 他必须在被抓住之前，找到离开这里的唯一出口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū zài bèi zhuā zhú zhīqián, zhǎodào líkāi zhèlǐ de wéiyī chūkǒu.
sentences.english: He must find the only exit to leave this place before being caught.

sentences.chinese: 林星看着窗外的巨大影子，意识到这个假的世界就像一个巨大的店。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng kànzhe chuāngwài de jùdà yǐngzi, yìshí dào zhège jiǎ de shìjiè jiù xiàng yí gè jùdà de diàn.
sentences.english: Lin Xing looked at the giant shadow outside the window and realized this fake world was like a giant shop.

sentences.chinese: 这里的所有人，无论是经理、商人，还是那位优雅的太太，其实都只是程序的客人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de suǒyǒu rén, wú lùn shì jīng lǐ, shāng rén, háishì nà wèi yōuyǎ de tài tai, qíshí dōu zhǐshì chéngxù de kè rén.
sentences.english: Everyone here, whether the manager, the businessman, or that elegant lady, were actually just guests of the program.

sentences.chinese: 他快步跑出办公室，街道上的行人都在机械地走着。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kuàibù pǎo chū bàngōngshì, jiēdào shàng de xíng rén dōu zài jīxiè de zǒuzhe.
sentences.english: He ran quickly out of the office, and the pedestrians on the street were all walking mechanically.

sentences.chinese: 一个骑着电子车的青少年停在他面前，眼神空洞。
sentences.pinyin: Yí gè qí zhe diànzǐ chē de qīng shào nián tíng zài tā miànqián, yǎnshén kōngdòng.
sentences.english: A teenager riding an electronic bike stopped in front of him, eyes vacant.

sentences.chinese: 林星发现这里的生活非常奇怪，人们在快餐店吃着没有味道的快餐。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng fāxiàn zhèlǐ de shēnghuó fēicháng qíguài, rénmen zài kuài cān diàn chī zhe méiyǒu wèidào de kuài cān.
sentences.english: Lin Xing found life here very strange; people were eating tasteless fast food in fast food shops.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一个留学生在对着屏幕哭，因为他忘记了家乡的节日。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào yí gè liú xué shēng zài duìzhe píngmù kū, yīnwèi tā wàngjì le jiāxiāng de jié rì.
sentences.english: He saw an exchange student crying at a screen because he had forgotten the festivals of his hometown.

sentences.chinese: 在这个世界里，每个人都被分配了一个角色，比如司机或者同事。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège shìjiè lǐ, měi gè rén dōu bèi fēnpèi le yí gè jué sè, bǐrú sī jī huòzhě tóng shì.
sentences.english: In this world, everyone was assigned a role, such as a driver or a colleague.

sentences.chinese: 林星走进一家酒店，那里有一个像明星一样漂亮的人在微笑。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng zǒu jìn yì jiā jiǔ diàn, nàlǐ yǒu yí gè xiàng míng xīng yíyàng piàoliang de rén zài wēixiào.
sentences.english: Lin Xing walked into a hotel, where a person as beautiful as a celebrity was smiling.

sentences.chinese: 但那个人只是一个服务机器人，他在给顾客递上一瓶酒。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn nà gè rén zhǐshì yí gè fúwù jīqì rén, tā zài gěi gù kè dì shàng yì píng jiǔ.
sentences.english: But that person was just a service robot, handing a bottle of wine to a customer.

sentences.chinese: 林星在酒店的走廊里看到一台洗衣机在疯狂地运转，发出巨大的噪音。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xīng zài jiǔ diàn de zǒuláng lǐ kàndào yì tái xǐ yī jī zài fēngkuáng de yùnzhuǎn, fā chū jùdà de zàoyīn.
sentences.english: Lin Xing saw a washing machine running wildly in the hotel corridor, making a huge noise.

sentences.chinese: 他想起在真实的世界里，他有一个爱人，他们曾经一起去旅游。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zài zhēnshí de shìjiè lǐ, tā yǒu yí gè ài ren, tāmen céngjīng yìqǐ qù lǚ yóu.
sentences.english: He remembered that in the real world, he had a lover, and they had traveled together.

sentences.chinese: 那时，他们会去很多城市，像真正的旅客和游客一样探索世界。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shí, tāmen huì qù hěn duō chéngshì, xiàng zhēnzhèng de lǚ kè hé yóu kè yíyàng tànsuǒ shìjiè.
sentences.english: At that time, they would visit many cities, exploring the world like real travelers and tourists.

sentences.chinese: 他记得他们吃过很多好吃的，比如热腾腾的饺子，或者是精致的西餐。

sentences.chinese: 林晓觉得这里的气氛很好，她想在这里交朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo jué dé zhè lǐ de qì fēn hěn hǎo, tā xiǎng zài zhè lǐ jiāo péng you.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao felt the atmosphere here was very good and wanted to make friends here.

sentences.chinese: 她坐在窗边，拿出电脑开始工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuò zài chuāng biān, ná chū diàn nǎo kāi shǐ gōng zuò.
sentences.english: She sat by the window and took out her computer to start working.

sentences.chinese: 但是，她的电脑突然卡了，怎么也动不了。
sentences.pinyin: Dan shì, tā de diàn nǎo tū rán kǎ le, zěn me yě dòng bù liǎo.
sentences.english: However, her computer suddenly froze and wouldn't move at all.

sentences.chinese: 她试着重启，但电脑还是关机了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì zhe chóng qǐ, dàn diàn nǎo hái shì guān jī le.
sentences.english: She tried to restart it, but the computer still shut down.

sentences.chinese: 林晓很着急，因为她需要使用电脑发一封重要的邮件。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo hěn zháo jí, yīn wèi tā xū yào shǐ yòng diàn nǎo fā yì fēng zhòng yào de yóu jiàn.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao was very anxious because she needed to use the computer to send an important email.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个高大的男人走过来，他叫陆远。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yí gè gāo dà de nán rén zǒu guò lái, tā jiào Lù Yuǎn.
sentences.english: At that moment, a tall man walked over; his name was Lu Yuan.

sentences.chinese: 陆远微笑着说：“我可以借你我的电脑吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn wēi xiào zhe shuō: “Wǒ kě yǐ jiè nǐ wǒ de diàn nǎo ma?”
sentences.english: Lu Yuan said with a smile, "Can I lend you my computer?"

sentences.chinese: 林晓抬头看他，发现他的眼睛像星星一样亮。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo tái tóu kàn tā, fā xiàn tā de yǎn jīng xiàng xīng xing yí yàng liàng.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked up at him and found that his eyes were bright like stars.

sentences.chinese: 陆远告诉她，他刚从国外回来，之前出国学习了三年。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn gào su tā, tā gāng cóng guó wài huí lái, zhī qián chū guó xué xí le sān nián.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan told her that he had just returned from abroad, having studied overseas for three years.

sentences.chinese: 他现在在休假，打算在城市里参观一些博物馆。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàn zài zài xiū jià, dǎ suàn zài chéng shì lǐ cān guān yì xiē bó wù guǎn.
sentences.english: He is currently on vacation and plans to visit some museums in the city.

sentences.chinese: 两人开始聊天，林晓发现陆远是一个很温柔的人。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng rén kāi shǐ liáo tiān, Lín Xiǎo fā xiàn Lù Yuǎn shì yí gè hěn wēn róu de rén.
sentences.english: The two began to chat, and Lin Xiao found Lu Yuan to be a very gentle person.

sentences.chinese: 陆远说，他以前因为生病住院过一段时间，所以很珍惜现在的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn shuō, tā yǐ qián yīn wèi shēng bìng zhù yuàn guò yí duàn shí jiān, suǒ yǐ hěn zhēn xī xiàn zài de shēng huó.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan mentioned that he had been hospitalized for a while due to illness, so he cherishes his current life.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得温暖的咖啡对心情有很好的作用。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué dé wēn nuǎn de kā fēi duì xīn qíng yǒu hěn hǎo de zuò yòng.
sentences.english: He feels that warm coffee has a very good effect on one's mood.

sentences.chinese: 他们聊了很多，直到时间到了下午三点一刻。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men liáo le hěn duō, zhí dào shí jiān dào le xià wǔ sān diǎn yí kè.
sentences.english: They talked a lot until the time reached a quarter past three in the afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 林晓觉得有点累，想在沙发上睡一个短的午睡。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo jué dé yǒu diǎn lèi, xiǎng zài shā fā shàng shuì yí gè duǎn de wǔ shuì.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao felt a bit tired and wanted to take a short nap on the sofa.

sentences.chinese: 陆远在旁边安静地看书，不想打扰她。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn zài páng biān ān jìng de kàn shū, bù xiǎng dǎ rǎo tā.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan read a book quietly beside her, not wanting to disturb her.

sentences.chinese: 突然，林晓做了一个噩梦，她在梦中大声地哭。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, Lín Xiǎo zuò le yí gè è mèng, tā zài mèng zhōng dà shēng de kū.
sentences.english: Suddenly, Lin Xiao had a nightmare and cried loudly in her sleep.

sentences.chinese: 她梦见自己和最爱的人分开，再也见不到对方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mèng jiàn zì jǐ hé zuì ài de rén fēn kāi, zài yě jiàn bú dào duì fāng.
sentences.english: She dreamed that she was separated from the person she loved most and could never see them again.

sentences.chinese: 她猛然惊醒，发现陆远正担心地看着她。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měng rán jīng xǐng, fā xiàn Lù Yuǎn zhèng dān xīn de kàn zhe tā.
sentences.english: She woke up abruptly and found Lu Yuan looking at her worriedly.

sentences.chinese: 陆远递给她一张纸巾，轻声说：“没关系，我在。”
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn dì gěi tā yì zhāng zhǐ jīn, qīng shēng shuō: “Méi guān xi, wǒ zài.”
sentences.english: Lu Yuan handed her a tissue and said softly, "It's okay, I'm here."

sentences.chinese: 林晓脸红了，她觉得心跳变快了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo liǎn hóng le, tā jué dé xīn tiào biàn kuài le.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao blushed, feeling her heartbeat speed up.

sentences.chinese: 这时，陆远看了一下表，说他必须出发去加油站给车加油了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, Lù Yuǎn kàn le yí xià biǎo, shuō tā bì xū chū fā qù jiā yóu zhàn gěi chē jiā yóu le.
sentences.english: Then, Lu Yuan checked his watch and said he had to set off to the gas station to refuel his car.

sentences.chinese: 他走到出口，回头对林晓说：“明天你还来吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu dào chū kǒu, huí tóu duì Lín Xiǎo shuō: “Míng tiān nǐ hái lái ma?”
sentences.english: He walked to the exit, turned back to Lin Xiao, and asked, "Will you come again tomorrow?"

sentences.chinese: 林晓还没回答，陆远就走出了咖啡馆。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo hái méi huí dá, Lù Yuǎn jiù zǒu chū le kā fēi guǎn.
sentences.english: Before Lin Xiao could answer, Lu Yuan left the coffee shop.

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着窗外，发现路边的花在风中倒了下来。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kàn zhe chuāng wài, fā xiàn lù biān de huā zài fēng zhōng dǎo le xià lái.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked out the window and saw the flowers by the road had fallen in the wind.

sentences.chinese: 她突然想起，陆远在离开前，在桌子上留下了一张小卡片。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tū rán xiǎng qǐ, Lù Yuǎn zài lí kāi qián, zài zhuō zi shàng liú xià le yì zhāng xiǎo kǎ piàn.
sentences.english: She suddenly remembered that before leaving, Lu Yuan had left a small card on the table.

sentences.chinese: 卡片上写着：“我想认识你。”
sentences.pinyin: Kǎ piàn shàng xiě zhe: “Wǒ xiǎng rèn shi nǐ.”
sentences.english: The card read: "I want to get to know you."

sentences.chinese: 林晓笑了，但就在这时，她的手机响了，是一个陌生号码发来的短信。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo xiào le, dàn jiù zài zhè shí, tā de shǒu jī xiǎng le, shì yí gè mò shēng hào mǎ fā lái de xùn xìn.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao smiled, but just then, her phone rang—it was a text message from an unknown number.

sentences.chinese: 短信的内容让她脸色大变，她怎么也没想到，陆远竟然和她的前男友认识。
sentences.pinyin: Xùn xìn de nèi róng ràng tā liǎn sè dà biàn, tā zěn me yě méi xiǎng dào, Lù Yuǎn jìng rán hé tā de qián nán yǒu rèn shi.
sentences.english: The content of the message made her face change drastically; she never imagined that Lu Yuan actually knew her ex-boyfriend.

sentences.chinese: 林晓慢慢放下手机，心跳很快。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo màn man fàng xià shǒu jī, xīn tiào hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao slowly put down her phone, her heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 她想起短信里的那个名字，那是她的前男友。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ shùn xìn lǐ de nà gè míng zi, nà shì tā de qián nán yǒu.
sentences.english: She recalled the name in the text message; it was her ex-boyfriend.

sentences.chinese: 她怎么想到陆远会认识他？
sentences.pinyin: Tā zěn me xiǎng dào Lù Yuǎn huì rèn shi tā?
sentences.english: How could she have thought that Lu Yuan would know him?

sentences.chinese: 林晓决定先不去想这件事，她需要提高自己的心情。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo jué dìng xiān bù qù xiǎng zhè jiàn shì, tā xū yào tí gāo zì jǐ de xīn qíng.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao decided not to think about this for now; she needed to improve her mood.

sentences.chinese: 她走到桌子旁，把电脑开机，准备开始工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu dào zhuō zi páng, bǎ diàn nǎo kāi jī, zhǔn bèi kāi shǐ gōng zuò.
sentences.english: She walked to the table, booted up her computer, and prepared to start working.

sentences.chinese: 她现在是一家广告公司的实习生，每天有很多活儿要干。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàn zài shì yī jiā guǎng gào gōng sī de shí xí shēng, měi tiān yǒu hěn duō huó r yào gàn.
sentences.english: She is currently an intern at an advertising company, and there is a lot of work to do every day.

sentences.chinese: 她需要打印一份新的计划书，然后交给老板。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xū yào dǎ yìn yī fèn xīn de jì huà shū, rán hòu jiāo gěi lǎo bǎn.
sentences.english: She needed to print out a new proposal and then hand it to her boss.

sentences.chinese: 在打印机前，她看到人们在排队，她轻轻推开门，走到了队伍后面。
sentences.pinyin: Zài dǎ yìn jī qián, tā kàn dào rén men zài pái duì, tā qīng qīng tuī kāi mén, zǒu dào le duì wǔ hòu miàn.
sentences.english: In front of the printer, she saw people lining up; she gently pushed open the door and walked to the back of the line.

sentences.chinese: 突然，她听到有人在喊她的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, tā tīng dào yǒu rén zài hǎn tā de míng zi.
sentences.english: Suddenly, she heard someone calling her name.

sentences.chinese: 她回头一看，是她的同事小王。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huí tóu yī kàn, shì tā de tóng shì Xiǎo Wáng.
sentences.english: She looked back and saw her colleague, Xiao Wang.

sentences.chinese: 小王姓王，是一个很热情的人。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng xìng Wáng, shì yī gè hěn rè qíng de rén.
sentences.english: Xiao Wang's surname is Wang, and he is a very enthusiastic person.

sentences.chinese: 小王说：“林晓，我想和你商量一件事。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng shuō: “Lín Xiǎo, wǒ xiǎng hé nǐ shāng liang yī jiàn shì.”
sentences.english: Xiao Wang said, "Lin Xiao, I want to discuss something with you."

sentences.chinese: 林晓问：“什么事？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo wèn: “Shén me shì?”
sentences.english: Lin Xiao asked, "What is it?"

sentences.chinese: 小王说：“我想报名参加那个汉语比赛，你能帮助我吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng bào míng cān jiā nà gè hàn yǔ bǐ sài, nǐ néng bāng zhù wǒ ma?”
sentences.english: Xiao Wang said, "I want to sign up for that Chinese competition; can you help me?"

sentences.chinese: 林晓笑了，她说：“没问题，我们可以一起复习。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo xiào le, tā shuō: “Méi wèn tí, wǒ men kě yǐ yī qǐ fù xí.”
sentences.english: Lin Xiao smiled and said, "No problem, we can review together."

sentences.chinese: 他们开始了一段简单的对话，林晓感觉心情好了一些。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men kāi shǐ le yī duàn jiǎn dān de duì huà, Lín Xiǎo gǎn jué xīn qíng hǎo le yī xiē.
sentences.english: They began a simple conversation, and Lin Xiao felt her mood improve a bit.

sentences.chinese: 她想起陆远在卡片上写的字，那让他看起来像个温柔的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ Lù Yuǎn zài kǎ piàn shàng xiě de zì, nà ràng tā kàn qǐ lái xiàng gè wēn róu de rén.
sentences.english: She recalled the words Lu Yuan wrote on the card, which made him seem like a gentle person.

sentences.chinese: 但短信的内容改变了她的想法。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn shùn xìn de nèi róng gǎi biàn le tā de xiǎng fǎ.
sentences.english: But the content of the text message changed her thinking.

sentences.chinese: 她打算找出这个秘密，看看陆远到底是谁。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dǎ suàn zhǎo chū zhè gè mì mì, kàn kàn Lù Yuǎn dào dǐ shì shuí.
sentences.english: She planned to find out this secret and see who Lu Yuan really is.

sentences.chinese: 她记得陆远提到他曾经在国外生活，后来才回国。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì dé Lù Yuǎn tí dào tā céng jīng zài guó wài shēng huó, hòu lái cái huí guó.
sentences.english: She remembered Lu Yuan mentioning that he once lived abroad and only later returned to his home country.

sentences.chinese: 如果陆远和前男友认识，这会对她的生活产生影响吗？
sentences.pinyin: Rú guǒ Lù Yuǎn hé qián nán yǒu rèn shi, zhè huì duì tā de shēng huó chǎn shēng yǐng xiǎng ma?
sentences.english: If Lu Yuan knows her ex-boyfriend, will this have an influence on her life?

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着窗外，风把路边的一套遮雨布拉掉了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kàn zhe chuāng wài, fēng bǎ lù biān de yī tào zhē yǔ bù lā diào le.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked out the window; the wind pulled off a set of rain covers by the road.

sentences.chinese: 遮雨布掉在地上，像极了她现在混乱的心情。
sentences.pinyin: Zhē yǔ bù diào zài dì shàng, xiàng jí le tā xiàn zài hùn luàn de xīn qíng.
sentences.english: The rain cover fell to the ground, just like her current chaotic state of mind.

sentences.chinese: 她想换一种心情，于是决定往公园走走。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng huàn yī zhǒng xīn qíng, yú shì jué dìng wǎng gōng yuán zǒu zǒu.
sentences.english: She wanted to change her mood, so she decided to walk toward the park.

sentences.chinese: 在公园里，她看到一个男人在拉小提琴，声音很美。
sentences.pinyin: Zài gōng yuán lǐ, tā kàn dào yī gè nán rén zài lā xiǎo tí qín, shēng yīn hěn měi.
sentences.english: In the park, she saw a man playing the violin; the sound was beautiful.

sentences.chinese: 林晓突然提出一个想法：也许她应该直接问陆远。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo tū rán tí chū yī gè xiǎng fǎ: yě xǔ tā yīng gāi zhí jiē wèn Lù Yuǎn.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao suddenly proposed an idea: perhaps she should just ask Lu Yuan directly.

sentences.chinese: 但她担心这样会太快，于是决定先改掉自己的焦虑。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tā dān xīn zhè yàng huì tài kuài, yú shì jué dìng xiān gǎi diào zì jǐ de jiāo lǜ.
sentences.english: But she was worried that would be too fast, so she decided to first change her anxiety.

sentences.chinese: 她希望自己的生活不要被过去改变。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xī wàng zì jǐ de shēng huó bù yào bèi guò qù gǎi biàn.
sentences.english: She hoped her life would not be altered by the past.

sentences.chinese: 她想，也许每个人都有不为人知的过去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, yě xǔ měi gè rén dōu yǒu bù wéi rén zhī de guò qù.
sentences.english: She thought that perhaps everyone has a past that others don't know about.

sentences.chinese: 她慢慢走在路上，心中依然在思考那个问题。
sentences.pinyin: Tā màn man zǒu zài lù shàng, xīn zhōng yī rán zài sī kǎo nà gè wèn tí.
sentences.english: She walked slowly on the road, still thinking about that question in her heart.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，她的手机再次响了，是一个电话。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, tā de shǒu jī zài cì xiǎng le, shì yī gè diàn huà.
sentences.english: Just then, her phone rang again; it was a call.

sentences.chinese: 她看了一眼屏幕，那个号码竟然是陆远的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn le yī yǎn píng mù, nà gè hào mǎ jìng rán shì Lù Yuǎn de.
sentences.english: She glanced at the screen, and the number was actually Lu Yuan's.

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着手机，心跳很快。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe shǒujī, xīntiào hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at her phone, her heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 她犹豫了一下，接了电话。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yóuyù le yīxià, jiē le diànhuà.
sentences.english: She hesitated for a moment and answered the call.

sentences.chinese: 陆远的声音很温柔，他在请求林晓原谅他的突然联系。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn de shēngyīn hěn wēnróu, tā zài qǐngqiú Lín Xiǎo yuánliàng tā de tūrán liánxì.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan's voice was gentle; he was requesting Lin Xiao's forgiveness for contacting her so suddenly.

sentences.chinese: 林晓问他为什么会有她的电话。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo wèn tā wèishéme huì yǒu tā de diànhuà.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao asked him why he had her phone number.

sentences.chinese: 陆远开始说明情况，他说他想给林晓一个解释。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn kāishǐ shuōmíng qíngkuàng, tā shuō tā xiǎng gěi Lín Xiǎo yīgè jiěshì.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan began to explain the situation, saying he wanted to give Lin Xiao an explanation.

sentences.chinese: 他说他之前在另一个省工作，现在回到了这个城市。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō tā zhīqián zài lìng yīgè shěng gōngzuò, xiànzài huí dào le zhège chéngshì.
sentences.english: He said he had previously worked in another province and had now returned to this city.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林晓，他现在在一家大学从事教学工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Lín Xiǎo, tā xiànzài zài yījiā dàxué cóngshì jiāoxué gōngzuò.
sentences.english: He told Lin Xiao that he is now engaged in teaching work at a university.

sentences.chinese: 他认为好的教育可以改变一个人的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Tā rènwéi hǎo de jiàoyù kěyǐ gǎibiàn yīgè rén de shēnghuó.
sentences.english: He believes that a good education can change a person's life.

sentences.chinese: 林晓听着他的讲话，心情变得复杂。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo tīngzhe tā de jiǎnghuà, xīnqíng biànde fùzá.
sentences.english: Listening to his speech, Lin Xiao's mood became complicated.

sentences.chinese: 她想起以前的生活，那时她总是练习画画。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ yǐqián de shēnghuó, nàshí tā zǒngshì liànxí huàhuà.
sentences.english: She thought of her past life, when she used to practice painting.

sentences.chinese: 她喜欢在纸上画出美丽的风景，留下自己的心情。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xǐhuān zài zhǐ shàng huà chū měilì de fēngjǐng, liúxià zìjǐ de xīnqíng.
sentences.english: She loved to paint beautiful landscapes on paper, leaving behind her emotions.

sentences.chinese: 陆远说他记得她以前很喜欢爬山。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn shuō tā jìde tā yǐqián hěn xǐhuān páshān.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan said he remembered that she used to love mountain climbing.

sentences.chinese: 他记得林晓在山上照相的样子，那是他心中最美的画面。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde Lín Xiǎo zài shānshàng zhàoxiàng de yàngzi, nà shì tā xīnzhōng zuìměi de huàmiàn.
sentences.english: He remembered the way Lin Xiao took photos on the mountain; it was the most beautiful image in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 林晓觉得这是一个笑话，因为她现在已经不再做这些活动了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo juéde zhè shì yīgè xiàohua, yīnwèi tā xiànzài yǐjīng bù zài zuò zhèxiē huódòng le.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao felt this was a joke, because she no longer participates in these activities.

sentences.chinese: 她觉得现在的自己和以前完全不同，不能算作同一个人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde xiànzài de zìjǐ hé yǐqián wánquán bùtóng, bùnéng suàn zuò tóng yīgè rén.
sentences.english: She felt that her current self was completely different from the past, and could not be counted as the same person.

sentences.chinese: 她告诉陆远，她现在租了一个小公寓，每天工作很累。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Lù Yuǎn, tā xiànzài zū le yīgè xiǎo gōngyù, měitiān gōngzuò hěn lèi.
sentences.english: She told Lu Yuan that she now rents a small apartment and works very hard every day.

sentences.chinese: 她每天要检查很多文件，还要为客户提供服务。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měitiān yào jiǎnchá hěnduō wénjiàn, hái yào wèi kèhù tígōng fúwù.
sentences.english: Every day she has to examine many documents and provide service to customers.

sentences.chinese: 她必须练习怎么快速处理工作，为了省时间，她很少休息。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū liàn rúme kuàisù chǔlǐ gōngzuò, wèile shěng shíjiān, tā hěn shǎo xiūxi.
sentences.english: She must practice how to handle work quickly; to save time, she rarely rests.

sentences.chinese: 陆远在电话里说，他希望林晓能多活动身体，不要太累。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn zài diànhuà lǐ shuō, tā xīwàng Lín Xiǎo néng duō huódòng shēntǐ, bùyào tài lèi.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan said over the phone that he hoped Lin Xiao could move her body more and not be too tired.

sentences.chinese: 他建议林晓可以试着爬山，或者去公园走走。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiànyì Lín Xiǎo kěyǐ shìzhe páshān, huòzhě qù gōngyuán zǒuzǒu.
sentences.english: He suggested that Lin Xiao could try hiking or taking a walk in the park.

sentences.chinese: 林晓笑了，但心中却在求一份平静。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo xiào le, dàn xīnzhōng què zài qiú yī fèn píngjìng.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao smiled, but in her heart, she was seeking a sense of peace.

sentences.chinese: 她不想让过去的影响像水一样流进现在的日子里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎng ràng guòqù de yǐngxiǎng xiàng shuǐ yīyàng liú jìn xiànzài de rìzi lǐ.
sentences.english: She didn't want the influence of the past to flow into her current days like water.

sentences.chinese: 她告诉陆远，她现在不想讨论过去的事情。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Lù Yuǎn, tā xiànzài bù xiǎng tǎolùn guòqù de shìqíng.
sentences.english: She told Lu Yuan that she didn't want to discuss things from the past right now.

sentences.chinese: 她要求陆远不要再这样突然出现。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yāoqiú Lù Yuǎn bùyào zài zhèyàng tūrán chūxiàn.
sentences.english: She requested that Lu Yuan stop appearing so suddenly.

sentences.chinese: 陆远很诚恳地讲，他只是想重新认识她。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn hěn chéngkěn de jiǎng, tā zhǐshì xiǎng chóngxīn rènshi tā.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan spoke sincerely, saying he just wanted to get to know her again.

sentences.chinese: 他问林晓是否愿意和他见一面，讨论一下关于那个陌生号码的事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn Lín Xiǎo shìfǒu yuànyì hé tā jiàn yīmiàn, tǎolùn yīxià guānyú nàgè mòshēng hàomǎ de shì.
sentences.english: He asked Lin Xiao if she would be willing to meet him once to discuss the matter regarding that strange number.

sentences.chinese: 林晓突然想起，她需要洗澡，然后准备睡觉。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo tūrán xiǎngqǐ, tā xūyào xǐzǎo, ránhòu zhǔnbèi shuìjiào.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao suddenly remembered that she needed to take a shower and then prepare for bed.

sentences.chinese: 她不想让这个电话影响她的行动。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎng ràng zhège diànhuà yǐngxiǎng tā de xíngdòng.
sentences.english: She didn't want this phone call to affect her actions.

sentences.chinese: 她对陆远说：“请你走开吧，我现在很忙。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì Lù Yuǎn shuō: “Qǐng nǐ zǒukāi ba, wǒ xiànzài hěn máng.”
sentences.english: She said to Lu Yuan, "Please go away, I am very busy right now."

sentences.chinese: 但就在她挂掉电话后，她突然碰见了一个熟悉的人在门外。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài tā guàdiào diànhuà hòu, tā tūrán pèngjiàn le yīgè shúxī de rén zài ménwài.
sentences.english: But just after she hung up the phone, she suddenly ran into a familiar person outside the door.

sentences.chinese: 那是她的前男友，他正装作不经意地站在那里。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì tā de qián nányǒu, tā zhèng zhuāngzuò bùjīngyì de zhàn zài nàlǐ.
sentences.english: It was her ex-boyfriend, who was pretending to stand there casually.

sentences.chinese: 林晓心底一惊，她意识到自己无法轻易离开这段复杂的过去。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo xīndǐ yī jīng, tā yìshí dào zìjǐ wúfǎ qīngyì líkāi zhè duàn fùzá de guòqù.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao was shocked; she realized she could not easily leave this complicated past behind.

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着前男友，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kàn zhe qián nán yǒu, xīn tiào dé hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at her ex-boyfriend, her heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 他像是一个不请自来的客人，突然出现在她的面前。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàng shì yí gè bù qǐng zì lái de kè rén, tū rán chū xiàn zài tā de miàn qián.
sentences.english: He was like an uninvited guest, suddenly appearing in front of her.

sentences.chinese: 他笑着说：“好久不见，你现在应该过得不错吧？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiào zhe shuō: “Hǎo jiǔ bú jiàn, nǐ xiàn zài yīng gāi guò dé bú cuò ba?”
sentences.english: He smiled and said, "Long time no see, you should be doing well now, right?"

sentences.chinese: 林晓不想接他的话，她只想快点离开这里。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo bù xiǎng jiē tā de huà, tā zhǐ xiǎng kuài diǎn lí kāi zhè lǐ.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao didn't want to answer him; she just wanted to leave this place quickly.

sentences.chinese: 但前男友拿出了一封信，说这是以前交给她的东西，但她没拿到。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn qián nán yǒu ná chū le yì fēng xìn, shuō zhè shì yǐ qián jiāo gěi tā de dōng xī, dàn tā méi ná dào.
sentences.english: But her ex-boyfriend took out a letter, saying it was something handed over to her before, but she hadn't received it.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林晓，他现在想成为一个更好的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù Lín Xiǎo, tā xiàn zài xiǎng chéng wéi yí gè gèng hǎo de rén.
sentences.english: He told Lin Xiao that he now wanted to become a better person.

sentences.chinese: 林晓觉得他的做法很奇怪，因为他以前从来不这样做。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo jué dé tā de zuò fǎ hěn qí guài, yīn wèi tā yǐ qián cóng lái bù zhè yàng zuò.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao felt his way of handling things was strange, because he had never done this before.

sentences.chinese: 前男友说，他现在养了一只小狗，生活变得简单了。
sentences.pinyin: Qián nán yǒu shuō, tā xiàn zài yǎng le yì zhī xiǎo gǒu, shēng huó biàn dé jiǎn dān le.
sentences.english: Her ex-boyfriend said he now keeps a small dog, and life has become simpler.

sentences.chinese: 他说，他希望能够实现一个愿望，那就是和林晓重新开始。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, tā xī wàng néng gòu shí xiàn yí gè yuàn wàng, nà jiù shì hé Lín Xiǎo chóng xīn kāi shǐ.
sentences.english: He said he hoped to realize a wish, which was to start over with Lin Xiao.

sentences.chinese: 林晓心里很乱，她得出这样一个结论：他还没有改变。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo xīn lǐ hěn luàn, tā dé chū zhè yàng yí gè jié lùn: tā hái méi yǒu gǎi biàn.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao's mind was in chaos, and she arrived at this conclusion: he had not changed.

sentences.chinese: 她必须小心，不能让这个男人再次进入她的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì xū xiǎo xīn, bù néng ràng zhè gè nán rén zài cì jìn rù tā de shēng huó.
sentences.english: She must be careful and cannot let this man enter her life again.

sentences.chinese: 因为过去的所有痛苦，都变成了她心里的伤口。
sentences.pinyin: Yīn wèi guò qù de suǒ yǒu tòng kǔ, dōu biàn chéng le tā xīn lǐ de shāng kǒu.
sentences.english: Because all the pain of the past had turned into wounds in her heart.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，她的手机又响了，是陆远发来的信息。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, tā de shǒu jī yòu xiǎng le, shì Lù Yuǎn fā lái de xìn xī.
sentences.english: Just then, her phone rang again; it was a message from Lu Yuan.

sentences.chinese: 陆远在信息里说，他要在公司举行一个小型会议，邀请她参加。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn zài xìn xī lǐ shuō, tā yào zài gōng sī jǔ xíng yí gè xiǎo xíng huì yì, yāo qǐng tā cān jiā.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan said in the message that he was going to hold a small meeting at the company and invited her to attend.

sentences.chinese: 他希望能通过这个会议，取得林晓的信任。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xī wàng néng tōng guò zhè gè huì yì, qǔ dé Lín Xiǎo de xìn rèn.
sentences.english: He hoped that through this meeting, he could obtain Lin Xiao's trust.

sentences.chinese: 林晓知道，如果她愿意去，可能会带来新的麻烦。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo zhī dào, rú guǒ tā yuàn yì qù, kě néng huì dài lái xīn de má fan.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao knew that if she were willing to go, it might bring new trouble.

sentences.chinese: 但她也觉得，自己应该给陆远一个机会。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tā yě jué dé, zì jǐ yīng gāi gěi Lù Yuǎn yí gè jī huì.
sentences.english: But she also felt that she should give Lu Yuan a chance.

sentences.chinese: 她想，如果能完成这次工作，或许能让生活变得更好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rú guǒ néng wán chéng zhè cì gōng zuò, huò xǔ néng ràng shēng huó biàn dé gèng hǎo.
sentences.english: She thought that if she could complete this task, perhaps life could become better.

sentences.chinese: 她告诉自己，必须做到独立，不能再被过去影响。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù zì jǐ, bì xū zuò dào dú lì, bù néng zài bèi guò qù yǐng xiǎng.
sentences.english: She told herself that she must achieve independence and no longer be affected by the past.

sentences.chinese: 她决定去银行取一些钱，然后去见陆远。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué dìng qù yín háng qǔ yì xiē qián, rán hòu qù jiàn Lù Yuǎn.
sentences.english: She decided to go to the bank to withdraw some money and then go see Lu Yuan.

sentences.chinese: 在银行办手续的时候，她想到了陆远对她的好。
sentences.pinyin: Zài yín háng bàn shǒu xù de shí hòu, tā xiǎng dào le Lù Yuǎn duì tā de hǎo.
sentences.english: While handling the procedures at the bank, she thought of Lu Yuan's kindness toward her.

sentences.chinese: 陆远在工作中受到了很多人的尊敬，他是一个很优秀的人。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn zài gōng zuò zhōng shòu dào le hěn duō rén de zūn jìng, tā shì yí gè hěn yōu xiù de rén.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan received respect from many people at work; he was a very outstanding person.

sentences.chinese: 林晓想，陆远可能会变成她生命中最重要的那个人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo xiǎng, Lù Yuǎn kě néng huì biàn chéng tā shēng mìng zhōng zuì zhòng yào de nà gè rén.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao thought that Lu Yuan might become the most important person in her life.

sentences.chinese: 接下来，她需要面对的是那个复杂的前男友。
sentences.pinyin: Jiē xià lái, tā xū yào miàn duì de shì nà gè fù zá de qián nán yǒu.
sentences.english: Next, what she needed to face was that complicated ex-boyfriend.

sentences.chinese: 前男友看着她，说：“你快要忘记我了吧？”
sentences.pinyin: Qián nán yǒu kàn zhe tā, shuō: “Nǐ kuài yào wàng jì wǒ le ba?”
sentences.english: The ex-boyfriend looked at her and said, "You are about to forget me, aren't you?"

sentences.chinese: 林晓冷冷地说：“我已经把你交给了过去。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo lěng lěng de shuō: “Wǒ yǐ jīng bǎ nǐ jiāo gěi le guò qù.”
sentences.english: Lin Xiao said coldly, "I have already handed you over to the past."

sentences.chinese: 她走出银行，阳光照在她的脸上，感觉很温暖。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu chū yín háng, yáng guāng zhào zài tā de liǎn shàng, gǎn jué hěn wēn nuǎn.
sentences.english: She walked out of the bank, and the sunlight shone on her face, feeling very warm.

sentences.chinese: 她想，人生就像一场旅行，总会遇到不同的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rén shēng jiù xiàng yì chǎng lǚ xíng, zǒng huì yù dào bù tóng de rén.
sentences.english: She thought that life is like a journey; one will always meet different people.

sentences.chinese: 她必须勇敢地面对，才能拿到未来的幸福。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì xū yǒng gǎn de miàn duì, cái néng ná dào wèi lái de xìng fú.
sentences.english: She must face it bravely to obtain future happiness.

sentences.chinese: 她现在就要离开这里，去见那个等待她的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàn zài jiù yào lí kāi zhè lǐ, qù jiàn nà gè děng dāi tā de rén.
sentences.english: She was going to leave here now to see the person waiting for her.

sentences.chinese: 当她走到街角时，她突然看到陆远已经在那里接她了。
sentences.pinyin: Dāng tā zǒu dào jiē jiǎo shí, tā tū rán kàn dào Lù Yuǎn yǐ jīng zài nà lǐ jiē tā le.
sentences.english: When she walked to the street corner, she suddenly saw that Lu Yuan was already there to meet her.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，一个陌生的人走过来，递给了陆远一张照片。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, yí gè mò shēng de rén zǒu guò lái, dì gěi le Lù Yuǎn yì zhāng zhào piàn.
sentences.english: But just then, a stranger walked over and handed Lu Yuan a photograph.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 5: The Secret in the Photo

sentences.chinese: 林晓看到陆远拿到了那张照片，她的心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kàn dào Lù Yuǎn ná dào le nà zhāng zhào piàn, tā de xīn tiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao saw Lu Yuan take the photo, and her heart beat very fast.

sentences.chinese: 那个陌生人离开后，陆远看着照片，脸上的表情很复杂。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè mò shēng rén lí kāi hòu, Lù Yuǎn kàn zhe zhào piàn, liǎn shàng de biǎo qíng hěn fù zá.
sentences.english: After the stranger left, Lu Yuan looked at the photo with a complex expression on his face.

sentences.chinese: 他慢慢走过来，站在林晓面前。
sentences.pinyin: Tā màn màn zǒu guò lái, zhàn zài Lín Xiǎo miàn qián.
sentences.english: He slowly came over and stood in front of Lin Xiao.

sentences.chinese: 林晓问他，这张照片是谁送给他的。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo wèn tā, zhè zhāng zhào piàn shì shéi sòng gěi tā de.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao asked him who had given him the photo.

sentences.chinese: 陆远没有马上回答，而是让她靠在路边的长椅上休息。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn méi yǒu mǎ shàng huí dá, ér shì ràng tā kào zài lù biān de cháng yǐ zì shàng xiū xi.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan didn't answer immediately, but instead let her lean against the roadside bench to rest.

sentences.chinese: 他轻声说，这张照片来自一个很久以前的朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qīng shēng shuō, zhè zhāng zhào piàn lái zì yī gè hěn jiǔ yǐ qián de péng you.
sentences.english: He said softly that the photo came from a friend from a long time ago.

sentences.chinese: 林晓觉得这像是一个陷阱，因为她之前碰到过前男友。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo jué de zhè xiàng shì yī gè xiàn jǐng, yīn wèi tā zhī qián pèng dào guò qián nán yǒu。
sentences.english: Lin Xiao felt this was like a trap because she had run into her ex-boyfriend before.

sentences.chinese: 她担心陆远会因为这张照片而改变对她的看法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dān xīn Lù Yuǎn huì yīn wèi zhè zhāng zhào piàn ér gǎi biàn duì tā de kàn fǎ.
sentences.english: She worried that Lu Yuan would change his view of her because of this photo.

sentences.chinese: 陆远说，他很重视林晓，不想因为过去的事情而分开。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn shuō, tā hěn zhòng shì Lín Xiǎo, bù xiǎng yīn wèi guò qù de shì qíng ér fēn kāi.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan said he valued Lin Xiao very much and didn't want to separate because of things from the past.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉她，一个人的生活是由很多经历组成而成的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su tā, yī gè rén de shēng huó shì yóu hěn duō jīng lì zǔ chéng ér chéng de.
sentences.english: He told her that a person's life is made up of many experiences.

sentences.chinese: 经过一段时间的沉默，陆远终于把照片递给她看。
sentences.pinyin: Jīng guò yī duàn shí jiān de chén mò, Lù Yuǎn zhōng yú bǎ zhào piàn dì gěi tā kàn.
sentences.english: After a period of silence, Lu Yuan finally handed the photo to her to see.

sentences.chinese: 照片上是年轻时的陆远和林晓的前男友在一起。
sentences.pinyin: Zhào piàn shàng shì nián qīng shí de Lù Yuǎn hé Lín Xiǎo de qián nán yǒu zài yī qǐ.
sentences.english: In the photo, a young Lu Yuan was together with Lin Xiao's ex-boyfriend.

sentences.chinese: 林晓很惊讶，她问陆远他们是怎么认识的。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo hěn jīng yà, tā wèn Lù Yuǎn tā men shì zěn me rèn shi de.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao was very surprised and asked Lu Yuan how they knew each other.

sentences.chinese: 陆远解释说，他们是在同一个城市出生的，从小就是好朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn jiě shì shuō, tā men shì zài tóng yī gè chéng shì chū shēng de, cóng xiǎo jiù shì hǎo péng you.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan explained that they were born in the same city and had been good friends since childhood.

sentences.chinese: 他说，在这个城市生活，能碰到认识的人是很方便的事情。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, zài zhè gè chéng shì shēng huó, néng pèng dào rèn shi de rén shì hěn fāng biàn de shì qíng.
sentences.english: He said that living in this city, running into people you know is a very convenient thing.

sentences.chinese: 但现在，这种关系对他来说等于一种压力。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiàn zài, zhè zhǒng guān xì duì tā lái shuō děng yú yī zhǒng yā lì.
sentences.english: But now, this relationship is tantamount to a kind of pressure for him.

sentences.chinese: 他希望林晓能够接受这个事实，不要害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xī wàng Lín Xiǎo néng gòu jiē shòu zhè gè shì shí, bù yào hài pà.
sentences.english: He hoped Lin Xiao could accept this fact and not be afraid.

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着他，觉得他是一个很懂得照顾别人的人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kàn zhe tā, jué de tā shì yī gè hěn dǒng de zhào gù bié rén de rén.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at him and felt he was a person who knew how to take care of others.

sentences.chinese: 接着，陆远告诉她，他最近接到了一封来自家乡的信。
sentences.pinyin: Jiē zhe, Lù Yuǎn gào su tā, tā zuì jìn jiē dào le yī fēng lái zì jiā xiāng de xìn.
sentences.english: Then, Lu Yuan told her that he recently received a letter from his hometown.

sentences.chinese: 信里说他的父母希望他回家，进行一次简单的家庭聚会。
sentences.pinyin: Xìn lǐ shuō tā de fù mǔ xī wàng tā huí jiā, jìn xíng yī cì jiǎn dān de jiā tíng jù huì.
sentences.english: The letter said his parents wanted him to come home and conduct a simple family gathering.

sentences.chinese: 陆远想邀请林晓一起去，并说，我的家人一定会欢迎你的。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn xiǎng yāo qǐng Lín Xiǎo yī qǐ qù, bìng shuō, wǒ de jiā rén yī dìng huì huān yíng nǐ de.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan wanted to invite Lin Xiao to go with him, saying, "My family will definitely welcome you."

sentences.chinese: 林晓想，如果能通过这次机会了解陆远，也许是好事。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo xiǎng, rú guǒ néng tōng guò zhè cì jī huì liǎo jiě Lù Yuǎn, yě xǔ shì hǎo shì.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao thought that if she could get to know Lu Yuan through this opportunity, it might be a good thing.

sentences.chinese: 但她现在还没有足够的收入，不能随便买昂贵的礼物。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tā xiàn zài hái méi yǒu zú gòu de shōu rù, bù néng suí biàn mǎi áng guì de lǐ wù.
sentences.english: But she didn't have enough income right now and couldn't just buy expensive gifts.

sentences.chinese: 她担心自己的条件和他的家庭不称。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dān xīn zì jǐ de tiáo jiàn hé tā de jiā tíng bù chèn.
sentences.english: She worried that her conditions did not fit with his family.

sentences.chinese: 但陆远笑了，他说，对我来说，你的陪伴比任何东西都重要。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn Lù Yuǎn xiào le, tā shuō, duì wǒ lái shuō, nǐ de péi bàn bǐ rèn hé dōng xi dōu zhòng yào.
sentences.english: But Lu Yuan smiled and said, "To me, your company is more important than anything."

sentences.chinese: 他们两人一起走在近处的公园小路上，风很温柔。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men liǎng rén yī qǐ zǒu zài jìn chù de gōng yuán xiǎo lù shàng, fēng hěn wēn róu.
sentences.english: The two of them walked together on a nearby park path; the wind was gentle.

sentences.chinese: 林晓意识到，真正的爱情需要通过很多困难才能通往幸福。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo yì shí dào, zhēn zhèng de ài qíng xū yào tōng guò hěn duō kùn nan cái néng tōng wǎng xìng fú.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao realized that true love needs to go through many difficulties to lead to happiness.

sentences.chinese: 等到他们走到公园门口时，林晓的手机突然响了。
sentences.pinyin: děng dào tā men zǒu dào gōng yuán mén kǒu shí, Lín Xiǎo de shǒu jī tū rán xiǎng le.
sentences.english: By the time they walked to the park entrance, Lin Xiao's phone suddenly rang.

sentences.chinese: 这是一个她绝对不想接到的电话，号码竟然又是那个前男友的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yī gè tā jué duì bù xiǎng jiē dào de diàn huà, hào mǎ jìng rán yòu shì nà gè qián nán yǒu de.
sentences.english: This was a call she absolutely did not want to receive; the number was actually that ex-boyfriend's again.

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着手机屏幕，那个号码让她感到不安。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe shǒujī píngmù, nàge hàomǎ ràng tā gǎndào bù'ān.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at the phone screen, and that number made her feel uneasy.

sentences.chinese: 她不想接电话，但陆远轻轻地握住了她的手。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎng jiē diànhuà, dàn Lù Yuǎn qīngqīng de wòzhùle tā de shǒu.
sentences.english: She didn't want to answer the call, but Lu Yuan gently held her hand.

sentences.chinese: 陆远说：“咱们先走，不要管他。”
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn shuō: “Zánmen xiān zǒu, bùyào guǎn tā.”
sentences.english: Lu Yuan said, "Let's go first, ignore him."

sentences.chinese: 他们走进了一家安静的咖啡馆，店里有绿色的植物，看起来很舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒujìnle yījiā ānjìng de kāfēiguǎn, diàn lǐ yǒu lǜsè de zhíwù, kàn qǐlái hěn shūfú.
sentences.english: They walked into a quiet coffee shop; there were green plants inside, making it look very comfortable.

sentences.chinese: 林晓坐下来，长长地叹了一口气。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo zuò xiàlái, chángcháng de tànle yī kǒu qì.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao sat down and let out a long sigh.

sentences.chinese: 她告诉陆远，她从小就习惯在压力大的时候喝热茶。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Lù Yuǎn, tā cóngxiǎo jiù xíguàn zài yālì dà de shíhòu hē rè chá.
sentences.english: She told Lu Yuan that from childhood, she had a habit of drinking hot tea when under great stress.

sentences.chinese: 陆远笑了，他记得林晓是一个普通但温暖的女孩。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn xiàole, tā jìdé Lín Xiǎo shì yīgè pǔtōng dàn wēnnuǎn de nǚhái.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan smiled; he remembered that Lin Xiao was an ordinary but warm girl.

sentences.chinese: 他问林晓：“你的前男友经常给你打电话吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn Lín Xiǎo: “Nǐ de qián nányǒu jīngcháng gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà ma?”
sentences.english: He asked Lin Xiao, "Does your ex-boyfriend frequently call you?"

sentences.chinese: 林晓点头说：“是的，他总是这样，这很不正常。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo diǎntóu shuō: “Shì de, tā zǒng shì zhèyàng, zhè hěn bù zhèngcháng.”
sentences.english: Lin Xiao nodded and said, "Yes, he is always like this; it's very abnormal."

sentences.chinese: 陆远看着她，轻声说：“别担心，这只是一场小麻烦。”
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn kànzhe tā, qīngshēng shuō: “Bié dānxīn, zhè zhǐshì yī chǎng xiǎo máfan.”
sentences.english: Lu Yuan looked at her and said softly, "Don't worry, this is just a small episode of trouble."

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着窗外，想起以前的日子。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe chuāngwài, xiǎngqǐ yǐqián de rìzi.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked out the window and thought about the days of the past.

sentences.chinese: 大学开学的时候，她认识了一个来自克罗地亚的留学生。
sentences.pinyin: Dàxué kāixué de shíhòu, tā rènshíle yīgè láizì Kèluódìyà de liúxuéshēng.
sentences.english: When university started, she met an exchange student from Croatia.

sentences.chinese: 那个留学生叫马克，缩写就是“克”，他说话的普通话很生涩。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge liúxuéshēng jiào Mǎkè, suōxiě jiùshì “Kè”, tā shuōhuà de pǔtōnghuà hěn shēngsè.
sentences.english: That exchange student was named Mark, abbreviated as "Ke"; his Mandarin was very awkward.

sentences.chinese: 那时候，林晓经常帮他学习，教他很多常用的生词。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shíhòu, Lín Xiǎo jīngcháng bāng tā xuéxí, jiào tā hěnduō chángyòng de shēngcí.
sentences.english: At that time, Lin Xiao frequently helped him study, teaching him many commonly used new words.

sentences.chinese: 他们经常在图书馆坐到早晨，一起看窗外的星星。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen jīngcháng zài túshūguǎn zuò dào zǎochén, yīqǐ kàn chuāngwài de xīngxing.
sentences.english: They often stayed in the library until the early morning, watching the stars outside the window together.

sentences.chinese: 马克说他喜欢林晓，因为她不像其他女生那样流行追求名牌。
sentences.pinyin: Mǎkè shuō tā xǐhuān Lín Xiǎo, yīnwèi tā bù xiàng qítā nǚshēng nàyàng liúxíng zhuīqiú míngpái.
sentences.english: Mark said he liked Lin Xiao because she wasn't like other girls who followed the popular trend of chasing luxury brands.

sentences.chinese: 林晓觉得这是一件好事，因为她也喜欢简单地生活。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo juéde zhè shì yī jiàn hǎoshì, yīnwèi tā yě xǐhuān jiǎndān de shēnghuó.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao felt this was a good thing because she also liked to live simply.

sentences.chinese: 但后来，马克回国了，而她的前男友出现了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn hòulái, Mǎkè huíguóle, ér tā de qián nányǒu chūxiànle.
sentences.english: But later, Mark returned to his country, and her ex-boyfriend appeared.

sentences.chinese: 前男友是一个很有才的人，但他的爱让林晓觉得很累。
sentences.pinyin: Qián nányǒu shì yīgè hěn yǒu cái de rén, dàn tā de ài ràng Lín Xiǎo juéde hěn lèi.
sentences.english: Her ex-boyfriend was a very talented person, but his love made Lin Xiao feel exhausted.

sentences.chinese: 为了赚钱，林晓平时还要去餐厅打工。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile zhuànqián, Lín Xiǎo píngshí hái yào qù cāntīng dǎgōng.
sentences.english: To earn money, Lin Xiao also had to work a part-time job at a restaurant during normal times.

sentences.chinese: 她记得有一次，前男友生病住院，她照顾他直到他出院。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìdé yǒu yī cì, qián nányǒu shēngbìng zhùyuàn, tā zhàogù tā zhídào tā chūyuàn.
sentences.english: She remembered one time her ex-boyfriend was hospitalized, and she took care of him until he was discharged from the hospital.

sentences.chinese: 但那个男人并没有给她带来幸福，反而让她感到痛苦。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn nàge nánrén bìng méiyǒu gěi tā dài lái xìngfú, fǎn'ér ràng tā gǎndào tòngkǔ.
sentences.english: But that man did not bring her happiness; instead, he brought her pain.

sentences.chinese: 现在，林晓看着陆远，觉得他很特别。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài, Lín Xiǎo kànzhe Lù Yuǎn, juéde tā hěn tèbié.
sentences.english: Now, Lin Xiao looked at Lu Yuan and felt that he was very special.

sentences.chinese: 陆远说：“我以前学习过中医，我知道怎么让你放松。”
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn shuō: “Wǒ yǐqián xuéxíguò zhōngyī, wǒ zhīdào zěnme ràng nǐ fàngsōng.”
sentences.english: Lu Yuan said, "I studied traditional Chinese medicine before; I know how to make you relax."

sentences.chinese: 林晓惊讶地说：“你还会中医？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo jīngyà de shuō: “Nǐ hái huì zhōngyī?”
sentences.english: Lin Xiao said in surprise, "You also know Chinese medicine?"

sentences.chinese: 陆远笑着说：“这是我父亲的习惯，他也教给了我。”
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn xiàozhe shuō: “Zhè shì wǒ fùqīn de xíguàn, tā yě jiāo gěile wǒ.”
