sentences.english: Lu Yuan smiled and said, "This is my father's habit; he taught it to me as well."

sentences.chinese: 他们聊了很多，林晓发现陆远对很多事情都很熟。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen liáole hěnduō, Lín Xiǎo fāxiàn Lù Yuǎn duì hěnduō shìqíng dōu hěn shú.
sentences.english: They chatted a lot, and Lin Xiao found that Lu Yuan was familiar with many things.

sentences.chinese: 他不仅懂医学，还喜欢摄影，手里拿着一台旧相机。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bùjǐn dǒng yīxué, hái xǐhuān shèyǐng, shǒulǐ názhe yī tāi jiù xiàngjī.
sentences.english: He not only understood medicine but also liked photography, holding an old camera in his hand.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“平常人们只看照片，但我看的是故事。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Píngcháng rénmen zhǐ kàn zhàopiàn, dàn wǒ kàn de shì gùshì.”
sentences.english: He said, "Usually people only look at the photos, but I look at the stories."

sentences.chinese: 这种感觉很常见，但陆远表达的方式很温柔。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng gǎnjué hěn chángjiàn, dàn Lù Yuǎn biǎodá de fāngshì hěn wēnróu.
sentences.english: This kind of feeling is common, but Lu Yuan's way of expressing it was very gentle.

sentences.chinese: 林晓觉得自己的心情慢慢好起来了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo juéde zìjǐ de xīnqíng mànmàn hǎo qǐláile.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao felt her mood slowly improving.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，陆远突然低声云：“你看，他跟过来了。”
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, Lù Yuǎn tūrán dīshēng yún: “Nǐ kàn, tā gēn guòláile.”
sentences.english: Just then, Lu Yuan suddenly whispered, "Look, he followed us."

sentences.chinese: 林晓回头一看，前男友竟然就站在咖啡馆的第二层阳台上，冷冷地看着他们。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo huítóu yī kàn, qián nányǒu jìngrán jiù zhàn zài kāfēiguǎn de dì èr céng yángtái shàng, lěnglěng de kànzhe tāmen.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked back and saw that her ex-boyfriend was actually standing on the second-floor balcony of the coffee shop, looking at them coldly.

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着前男友冷冷的眼神，心里突然感到很不安。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe qián nányǒu lěng lěng de yǎnshén, xīnlǐ tūrán gǎndào hěn bù'ān.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at her ex-boyfriend's cold gaze and suddenly felt uneasy in her heart.

sentences.chinese: 陆远轻轻握住她的手，低声说：“别担心，我们离开这里。”
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn qīngqīng wò zhù tā de shǒu, dī shēng shuō: “Bié dānxīn, wǒmen líkāi zhèlǐ.”
sentences.english: Lu Yuan gently held her hand and whispered, "Don't worry, let's leave here."

sentences.chinese: 他们快步走出咖啡馆，走在寒冷的冬天街道上。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen kuàibù zǒuchū kāfēiguǎn, zǒu zài hánlěng de dōngtiān jiēdào shàng.
sentences.english: They walked quickly out of the coffee shop and onto the cold winter streets.

sentences.chinese: 林晓想起过去的事情，心里觉得多么难过。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo xiǎngqǐ guòqù de shìqíng, xīnlǐ juéde duōme nánguò.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao thought of things from the past and felt so sad in her heart.

sentences.chinese: 那会儿，她以为爱情很简单，但现在她知道了爱情很复杂。
sentences.pinyin: Nà huìr, tā yǐwéi àiqíng hěn jiǎndān, dàn xiànzài tā zhīdàole àiqíng hěn fùzá.
sentences.english: At that time, she thought love was simple, but now she knows love is complex.

sentences.chinese: 他们走在路上，路过一家很大的超市。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒu zài lùshàng, lùguò yī jiā hěn dà de chāoshì.
sentences.english: As they walked, they passed a very large supermarket.

sentences.chinese: 陆远指着超市门口的一张海报说：“你看，那是我的老朋友。”
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn zhǐzhe chāoshì ménkǒu de yī zhāng hǎibào shuō: “Nǐ kàn, nà shì wǒ de lǎo péngyou.”
sentences.english: Lu Yuan pointed to a poster at the entrance of the supermarket and said, "Look, that's an old friend of mine."

sentences.chinese: 海报上是一个中年男人的照片，他看起来很专业。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎibào shàng shì yīgè zhōngnián nánrén de zhàopiàn, tā kàn qǐlái hěn zhuānyè.
sentences.english: On the poster was a photo of a middle-aged man who looked very professional.

sentences.chinese: 他是红院长，一家大医院的院长，也是一名著名的西医。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì Hóng yuànzhǎng, yī jiā dà yīyuàn de yuànzhǎng, yěshì yī míng zhùmíng de xīyī.
sentences.english: He was Director Hong, the head of a large hospital and a famous Western medicine doctor.

sentences.chinese: 陆远说：“红院长以前教过我很多关于医学的词语。”
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn shuō: “Hóng yuànzhǎng yǐqián jiāoguò wǒ hěnduō guānyú yīxué de cíyǔ.”
sentences.english: Lu Yuan said, "Director Hong taught me many medical terms in the past."

sentences.chinese: 林晓好奇地问：“他是怎么教你的？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo hàoqí de wèn: “Tā shì zěnme jiāo nǐ de?”
sentences.english: Lin Xiao asked curiously, "How did he teach you?"

sentences.chinese: 陆远笑了笑说：“他会纠正我的读音，告诉我每个数字代表的意义。”
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn xiàole xiào shuō: “Tā huì jiūzhèng wǒ de dúyīn, gàosù wǒ měi gè shùzì dàibiǎo de yìyì.”
sentences.english: Lu Yuan smiled and said, "He would correct my pronunciation and tell me the meaning represented by each number."

sentences.chinese: 林晓觉得陆远的世界很精彩，她很喜欢他这种认真学习的态度。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo juéde Lù Yuǎn de shìjiè hěn jīngcǎi, tā hěn xǐhuān tā zhè zhǒng rènzhēn xuéxí de tàidù.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao felt that Lu Yuan's world was wonderful, and she really liked his attitude of studying seriously.

sentences.chinese: 上周，陆远还在帮一个考生准备考试，那个考生叫黄先生。
sentences.pinyin: Shàngzhōu, Lù Yuǎn hái zài bāng yīgè kǎoshēng zhǔnbèi kǎoshì, nàgè kǎoshēng jiào Huáng xiānshēng.
sentences.english: Last week, Lu Yuan was still helping an exam candidate prepare for a test; that candidate was called Mr. Huang.

sentences.chinese: 黄先生想选一个最好的专业，所以请陆远帮忙。
sentences.pinyin: Huáng xiānshēng xiǎng xuǎn yīgè zuì hǎo de zhuānyè, suǒyǐ qǐng Lù Yuǎn bāngmáng.
sentences.english: Mr. Huang wanted to choose the best major, so he asked Lu Yuan for help.

sentences.chinese: 陆远说：“下周我就能帮他完成最后一部分。”
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn shuō: “Xiàzhōu wǒ jiù néng bāng tā wánchéng zuìhòu yī bùfèn.”
sentences.english: Lu Yuan said, "Next week I will be able to help him complete the final part."

sentences.chinese: 不久，林晓的手机突然响了，是一条来自前男友的短信。
sentences.pinyin: Bùjiǔ, Lín Xiǎo de shǒujī tūrán xiǎngle, shì yī tiáo láizì qián nányǒu de duǎnxìn.
sentences.english: Before long, Lin Xiao's phone suddenly rang; it was a text message from her ex-boyfriend.

sentences.chinese: 短信里写着：“我想和你谈谈一件很重要的事情。”
sentences.pinyin: Duǎnxìn lǐ xiězhe: “Wǒ xiǎng hé nǐ tán tán yī jiàn hěn zhòngyào de shìqíng.”
sentences.english: The text read, "I want to talk to you about a very important matter."

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着手机，心跳得很快，她不知道该怎么回答。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe shǒujī, xīntiào de hěn kuài, tā bù zhīdào gāi zěnme huídá.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at the phone, her heart beating fast, not knowing how to answer.

sentences.chinese: 陆远注意到她的表情，温柔地说：“如果你不想回，就随便处理。”
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn zhùyì dào tā de biǎoqíng, wēnróu de shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ bù xiǎng huí, jiù suíbiàn chǔlǐ.”
sentences.english: Lu Yuan noticed her expression and said gently, "If you don't want to reply, just handle it as you wish."

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着陆远，发现他比任何人都懂她的心。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe Lù Yuǎn, fāxiàn tā bǐ rènhé rén dōu dǒng tā de xīn.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at Lu Yuan and found that he understood her heart better than anyone.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，一个穿着黑色外套的人挡在了他们面前。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, yīgè chuānzhe hēisè wàitào de rén dǎng zàile tāmen miànqián.
sentences.english: But just then, a person wearing a black coat blocked their way.

sentences.chinese: 那个人竟然就是那个红院长，他正用一种奇怪的眼神看着林晓。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè rén jìngrán jiùshì nàgè Hóng yuànzhǎng, tā zhèng yòng yī zhǒng qíguài de yǎnshén kànzhe Lín Xiǎo.
sentences.english: That person was actually Director Hong, and he was looking at Lin Xiao with a strange expression.

sentences.chinese: 红院长看着林晓，眼神里有一种奇怪的压力。
sentences.pinyin: Hóng yuànzhǎng kànzhe Lín Xiǎo, yǎnshén lǐ yǒu yī zhǒng qíguài de yālì.
sentences.english: Dean Hong looked at Lin Xiao, his eyes filled with a strange pressure.

sentences.chinese: 他突然说：“咱俩得谈谈，关于你那个外地的朋友。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán shuō: “Zán liǎ děi tán tán, guānyú nǐ nàgè wàidì de péngyǒu.”
sentences.english: He suddenly said, "We need to talk, about that friend of yours from out of town."

sentences.chinese: 林晓愣住了，她不明白这个人在意什么。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo lèngzhù le, tā bù míngbai zhège rén zàiyì shénme.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao was stunned; she didn't understand what this man cared about.

sentences.chinese: 陆远轻轻地把手放在林晓的背上，给她力量。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn qīngqīng de bǎ shǒu fàng zài Lín Xiǎo de bèi shàng, gěi tā lìliàng.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan gently placed his hand on Lin Xiao's back, giving her strength.

sentences.chinese: 红院长冷笑一声，从口袋里拿出一张黄色的纸。
sentences.pinyin: Hóng yuànzhǎng lěngxiào yī shēng, cóng kǒudài lǐ ná chū yī zhāng huángsè de zhǐ.
sentences.english: Dean Hong sneered and took a piece of yellow paper from his pocket.

sentences.chinese: 那张纸上写着几个词，看起来像是某种秘密的记录。
sentences.pinyin: Nà zhāng zhǐ shàng xiězhe jǐ gè cí, kàn qǐlái xiàng shì mǒu zhǒng mìmì de jìlù.
sentences.english: There were a few words written on that paper, looking like some kind of secret record.

sentences.chinese: “你以为你能逃掉？”红院长说了一句冷冰冰的话。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ yǐwéi nǐ néng táo diào?” Hóng yuànzhǎng shuō le yī jù lěngbīngbīng de huà.
sentences.english: "You think you can escape?" Dean Hong said in a cold voice.

sentences.chinese: 林晓觉得心跳超过了一百次每分钟，她感到很不安。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo juéde xīntiào chāoguò le yī bǎi cì měi fēnzhōng, tā gǎndào hěn bù'ān.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao felt her heart rate exceed one hundred beats per minute; she felt very uneasy.

sentences.chinese: 红院长指了指身后的墙，那里挂着一张旧照片。
sentences.pinyin: Hóng yuànzhǎng zhǐ le zhǐ shēnhòu de qiáng, nàlǐ guàzhe yī zhāng jiù zhàopiàn.
sentences.english: Dean Hong pointed to the wall behind him, where an old photo was hanging.

sentences.chinese: 照片里有一艘船，停在绿色的草地上，看起来很假。
sentences.pinyin: Zhàopiàn lǐ yǒu yī sōu chuán, tíng zài lǜsè de cǎodì shàng, kàn qǐlái hěn jiǎ.
sentences.english: In the photo, there was a boat stopped on green grass, which looked fake.

sentences.chinese: “这只是个玩笑，对吧？”林晓试着问。
sentences.pinyin: “Zhè zhǐshì gè wánxiào, duì ba?” Lín Xiǎo shìzhe wèn.
sentences.english: "This is just a joke, right?" Lin Xiao tried to ask.

sentences.chinese: 红院长没有回答，他举起手，指了指远处的鸟。
sentences.pinyin: Hóng yuànzhǎng méiyǒu huídá, tā jǔqǐ shǒu, zhǐ le zhǐ yuǎnchù de niǎo.
sentences.english: Dean Hong didn't answer; he raised his hand and pointed to a bird in the distance.

sentences.chinese: 他说话的方式很奇怪，像是在玩某种蛋头游戏。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà de fāngshì hěn qíguài, xiàng shì zài wán mǒu zhǒng dàn tóu yóuxì.
sentences.english: His way of speaking was strange, as if he were playing some kind of 'egg-head' game.

sentences.chinese: 林晓突然想起，她曾经在夜里听到过这个人的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo tūrán xiǎngqǐ, tā céngjīng zài yè lǐ tīng dào guò zhège rén de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao suddenly remembered that she had heard this man's voice at night.

sentences.chinese: 他总是提到一些奇怪的事情，试图占用她的时间。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒng shì tí dào yīxiē qíguài de shìqíng, shìtú zhànyòng tā de shíjiān.
sentences.english: He always mentioned strange things, trying to occupy her time.

sentences.chinese: 陆远皱起眉头，不想让林晓再受到惊吓。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn zhòu qǐ méitóu, bù xiǎng ràng Lín Xiǎo zài shòudào jīngxià.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan frowned, not wanting Lin Xiao to be frightened again.

sentences.chinese: 他挡在林晓面前，不让她碰那个奇怪的男人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dǎng zài Lín Xiǎo miànqián, bù ràng tā pèng nàgè qíguài de nánrén.
sentences.english: He blocked Lin Xiao, preventing her from touching that strange man.

sentences.chinese: “请您留步，”陆远平静地说，“我们现在要离开。”
sentences.pinyin: “Qǐng nín liúbù,” Lù Yuǎn píngjìng de shuō, “wǒmen xiànzài yào líkāi.”
sentences.english: "Please stay where you are," Lu Yuan said calmly, "we are leaving now."

sentences.chinese: 红院长看着他们，突然大笑起来，声音很大。
sentences.pinyin: Hóng yuànzhǎng kànzhe tāmen, tūrán dàxiào qǐlái, shēngyīn hěn dà.
sentences.english: Dean Hong looked at them and suddenly burst out laughing loudly.

sentences.chinese: 他拿起桌上的一个碗，随意地把它扔在地上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná qǐ zhuō shàng de yī gè wǎn, suíyì de bǎ tā rēng zài dìshàng.
sentences.english: He picked up a bowl from the table and casually threw it on the ground.

sentences.chinese: 林晓把这句话在心里重复了一遍，依然不理解。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo bǎ zhè jù huà zài xīnlǐ chóngfù le yī biàn, yīrán bù lǐjiě.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao repeated this sentence in her mind, still not understanding.

sentences.chinese: 红院长突然低声说：“你们以为赢了？这只是开始。”
sentences.pinyin: Hóng yuànzhǎng tūrán dīshēng shuō: “Nǐmen yǐwéi yíng le? Zhè zhǐshì kāishǐ.”
sentences.english: Dean Hong suddenly whispered, "You think you've won? This is just the beginning."

sentences.chinese: 他转身走开了，留下林晓和陆远在风中发抖。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhuǎnshēn zǒu kāi le, liú xià Lín Xiǎo hé Lù Yuǎn zài fēng zhōng fādǒu.
sentences.english: He turned and walked away, leaving Lin Xiao and Lu Yuan shivering in the wind.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 9: Secrets in the Cold Wind

sentences.chinese: 红院长走后，风变得很凉。
sentences.pinyin: Hóng yuànzhǎng zǒu hòu, fēng biàn de hěn liáng.
sentences.english: After Dean Hong left, the wind became very chilly.

sentences.chinese: 陆远紧紧抱着林晓，他不想让她害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn jǐnjǐn bàozhe Lín Xiǎo, tā bù xiǎng ràng tā pà.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan held Lin Xiao tightly; he didn't want her to be afraid.

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着天空，突然开始下雪了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe tiānkōng, tūrán kāishǐ xià xuě le.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at the sky, and suddenly it started to snow.

sentences.chinese: 雪花落在她的脸上，像是一场安静的梦。
sentences.pinyin: Xuěhuā luò zài tā de liǎn shàng, xiàng shì yī chǎng ānjìng de mèng.
sentences.english: The snowflakes fell on her face, like a quiet dream.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，林晓的手机响了，她接起电话说：“喂？”
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, Lín Xiǎo de shǒujī xiǎng le, tā jiē qǐ diànhuà shuō: “Wéi?”
sentences.english: Just then, Lin Xiao's phone rang, and she answered, "Hello?"

sentences.chinese: 电话那边是一个叫东方先生的人，他的声音很严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Diànhuà nàbiān shì yī gè jiào Dōngfāng xiānshēng de rén, tā de shēngyīn hěn yánsù.
sentences.english: On the other end of the phone was a man called Mr. Dongfang, and his voice was very serious.

sentences.chinese: 东方先生通知她，红院长在黑龙江省有一个秘密办公室。
sentences.pinyin: Dōngfāng xiānshēng tōngzhī tā, Hóng yuànzhǎng zài Hēilóngjiāng shěng yǒu yī gè mìmì bàngōngshì.
sentences.english: Mr. Dongfang notified her that Dean Hong had a secret office in Heilongjiang Province.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林晓，那里有一份关于她家庭的重要信息。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Lín Xiǎo, nàlǐ yǒu yī fèn guānyú tā jiātíng de zhòngyào xìnxī.
sentences.english: He told Lin Xiao that there was a piece of important information there about her family.

sentences.chinese: 林晓觉得心跳得很快，她不知道这个秘密是什么。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo juéde xīntiào de hěn kuài, tā bù zhīdào zhè gè mìmì shì shénme.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao felt her heart beating fast; she didn't know what this secret was.

sentences.chinese: 陆远温柔地看着她，他说：“不要担心，我们的爱情会给我们力量。”
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn wēnróu de kànzhe tā, tā shuō: “Bùyào dānxīn, wǒmen de àiqíng huì gěi wǒmen lìliàng.”
sentences.english: Lu Yuan looked at her tenderly and said, "Don't worry, our love will give us strength."

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着陆远，心里充满了感谢。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe Lù Yuǎn, xīnlǐ chōngmǎn le gǎnxiè.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at Lu Yuan, her heart full of gratitude.

sentences.chinese: 他们决定先去买一些快餐，因为他们太饿了。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen juédìng xiān qù mǎi yīxiē kuàicān, yīnwèi tāmen tài è le.
sentences.english: They decided to buy some fast food first because they were too hungry.

sentences.chinese: 在快餐店，林晓看到一只小猫在门口睡觉，样子很可爱。
sentences.pinyin: Zài kuàicān diàn, Lín Xiǎo kàndào yī zhī xiǎo māo zài ménkǒu shuìjiào, yàngzi hěn kě'ài.
sentences.english: At the fast food restaurant, Lin Xiao saw a small cat sleeping at the door; it looked very cute.

sentences.chinese: 她买了三斤新鲜的水果作为礼物，想送给照顾猫的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mǎi le sān jīn xīnxiān de shuǐguǒ zuòwéi lǐwù, xiǎng sòng gěi zhàogù māo de rén.
sentences.english: She bought three catties of fresh fruit as a gift, wanting to give it to the person taking care of the cat.

sentences.chinese: 结账时，林晓发现她的信用卡不见了，她非常着急。
sentences.pinyin: Jiézhàng shí, Lín Xiǎo fāxiàn tā de xìnyòngkǎ bùjiàn le, tā fēicháng zháojí.
sentences.english: When paying, Lin Xiao discovered her credit card was gone, and she became very anxious.

sentences.chinese: 她翻遍了包，最后只找到一张银行卡。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fān biàn le bāo, zuìhòu zhǐ zhǎodào yī zhāng yínhángkǎ.
sentences.english: She searched through her bag and finally only found a bank card.

sentences.chinese: 陆远笑着说：“没关系，我来付钱。”
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn xiàozhe shuō: “Méiguānxì, wǒ lái fù qián.”
sentences.english: Lu Yuan smiled and said, "It's okay, I'll pay."

sentences.chinese: 回到家后，林晓感到头疼，她吃了一片药片。
sentences.pinyin: Huí dào jiā hòu, Lín Xiǎo gǎndào tóuténg, tā chī le yī piàn yàopiàn.
sentences.english: After returning home, Lin Xiao felt a headache and took a pill.

sentences.chinese: 她坐在窗边，看着窗外的月亮，想起小时候大人们说的话。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuò zài chuāngbiān, kànzhe chuāngwài de yuèliang, xiǎngqǐ xiǎoshíhòu dàrénmen shuō de huà.
sentences.english: She sat by the window, looking at the moon outside, remembering things adults said when she was a child.

sentences.chinese: 大人们常说，月亮能听到所有的心愿。
sentences.pinyin: Dàrénmen cháng shuō, yuèliang néng tīngdào suǒyǒu de xīnyuàn.
sentences.english: Adults often said that the moon can hear all wishes.

sentences.chinese: 她想起曾经收到的一封旧信，那是她最珍视的东西。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ céngjīng shōudào de yī fēng jiù xìn, nà shì tā zuì zhēnshì de dōngxī.
sentences.english: She remembered an old letter she had once received, which was her most cherished possession.

sentences.chinese: 信里提到，她需要通过中级考试才能获得某种权利。
sentences.pinyin: Xìn lǐ tídào, tā xūyào tōngguò zhōngjí kǎoshì cái néng huòdé mǒu zhǒng quánlì.
sentences.english: The letter mentioned that she needed to pass the intermediate exam to obtain a certain right.

sentences.chinese: 现在她已经达到了那个级数，但红院长的出现让一切变得复杂。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài tā yǐjīng dádào le nà gè jíshù, dàn Hóng yuànzhǎng de chūxiàn ràng yīqiè biàn de fùzá.
sentences.english: Now she had reached that level, but Dean Hong's appearance made everything complicated.

sentences.chinese: 突然，她的手机收到一条短信，发信人竟然是红院长。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, tā de shǒujī shōudào yī tiáo duǎnxìn, fāxìnrén jìngrán shì Hóng yuànzhǎng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, her phone received a text message, and the sender was actually Dean Hong.

sentences.chinese: 短信上写着：“你以为你逃掉了吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Duǎnxìn shàng xiě zhe: “Nǐ yǐwéi nǐ táo diào le ma?”
sentences.english: The text read: "Did you think you had escaped?"

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着手机上的短信，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe shǒujī shàng de duǎnxìn, xīntiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at the text message on her phone, her heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 陆远走过来，轻轻地拉住她的手。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn zǒu guòlái, qīngqīng de lā zhù tā de shǒu.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan walked over and gently took her hand.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉她，为了远离红院长的影响，他们需要一次短暂的旅行。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù tā, wèile yuǎnlí Hóng yuànzhǎng de yǐngxiǎng, tāmen xūyào yī cì duǎnzàn de lǚxíng.
sentences.english: He told her that in order to get away from Dean Hong's influence, they needed a short trip.

sentences.chinese: 他们决定去一个安静的小镇旅游，希望能找到答案。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen juédìng qù yīgè ānjìng de xiǎo zhèn lǚyóu, xīwàng néng zhǎodào dá'àn.
sentences.english: They decided to travel to a quiet small town, hoping to find answers.

sentences.chinese: 由于市中心的交通非常糟糕，街道上到处都是车辆。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú shì zhōngxīn de jiāotōng fēicháng zāogāo, jiēdào shàng dàochù dōu shì chēliàng.
sentences.english: Because the traffic in the city center was very bad, there were vehicles everywhere on the streets.

sentences.chinese: 许多行人因为堵车而显得很不耐烦。
sentences.pinyin: Xǔduō xíngrén yīnwèi dǔchē ér xiǎndé hěn bù nàifán.
sentences.english: Many pedestrians seemed very impatient because of the traffic jam.

sentences.chinese: 陆远说，这里的道路太拥挤了，我们不能开车。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn shuō, zhèlǐ de dàolù tài yōngjǐ le, wǒmen bùnéng kāichē.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan said, the roads here are too crowded, we cannot drive.

sentences.chinese: 他们走到一个停车场，看到那里停着很多车。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒu dào yīgè tíngchēchǎng, kàndào nàlǐ tíngzhe hěnduō chē.
sentences.english: They walked to a parking lot and saw many cars parked there.

sentences.chinese: 陆远指着一辆黑色的出租车说，我们先坐车出去吧。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn zhǐzhe yī liàng hēisè de chūzūchē shuō, wǒmen xiān zuò chē chūqù ba.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan pointed to a black taxi and said, let's take a car out first.

sentences.chinese: 出租车司机是一个热情的中年人，他笑着问他们要去哪里。
sentences.pinyin: Chūzūchē sījī shì yīgè rèqíng de zhōngnián rén, tā xiàozhe wèn tāmen yào qù nǎlǐ.
sentences.english: The taxi driver was an enthusiastic middle-aged man who smiled and asked where they were going.

sentences.chinese: 在离开城市的公路上面，林晓看着窗外的风景，心情依然沉重。
sentences.pinyin: Zài líkāi chéngshì de gōnglù shàngmiàn, Lín Xiǎo kànzhe chuāngwài de fēngjǐng, xīnqíng yīrán chénzhòng.
sentences.english: On the highway leaving the city, Lin Xiao looked at the scenery outside the window, her mood still heavy.

sentences.chinese: 她想起红院长的话，觉得这次旅行像是在逃避。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ Hóng yuànzhǎng de huà, juéde zhè cì lǚxíng xiàng shì zài táobì.
sentences.english: She thought of Dean Hong's words and felt that this trip was like escaping.

sentences.chinese: 他们先坐了一段时间的公共汽车，然后换乘了地铁。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xiān zuòle yīduàn shíjiān de gōnggòng qìchē, ránhòu huànchéngle dìtiě.
sentences.english: They first took a public bus for a while, and then transferred to the subway.

sentences.chinese: 在地铁站，林晓看到了很多匆忙的旅客。
sentences.pinyin: Zài dìtiě zhàn, Lín Xiǎo kàndào le hěnduō cōngmáng de lǚkè.
sentences.english: At the subway station, Lin Xiao saw many hurried travelers.

sentences.chinese: 其中一些游客拿着地图，看起来是在寻找去公园的路。
sentences.pinyin: Qízhōng yīxiē yóukè ná zhe dìtú, kàn qǐlái shì zài xúnzhǎo qù gōngyuán de lù.
sentences.english: Some tourists were holding maps, appearing to be looking for the way to the park.

sentences.chinese: 陆远对她说：“不要担心，我会一直陪在你身边。”
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn duì tā shuō: “Bùyào dānxīn, wǒ huì yīzhí péi zài nǐ shēnbiān.”
sentences.english: Lu Yuan said to her: "Don't worry, I will always be by your side."

sentences.chinese: 到了小镇后，他们发现这里的公交车很少。
sentences.pinyin: Dào le xiǎo zhèn hòu, tāmen fāxiàn zhèlǐ de gōngjiāochē hěn shǎo.
sentences.english: After arriving at the small town, they found that public buses were very rare here.

sentences.chinese: 为了方便，陆远决定租两辆自行车。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile fāngbiàn, Lù Yuǎn juédìng zū liǎng liàng zìxíngchē.
sentences.english: For convenience, Lu Yuan decided to rent two bicycles.

sentences.chinese: 他教林晓如何骑车，林晓在风中开心地笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiāo Lín Xiǎo rúhé qíchē, Lín Xiǎo zài fēng zhōng kāixīn de xiào le.
sentences.english: He taught Lin Xiao how to ride a bike, and Lin Xiao smiled happily in the wind.

sentences.chinese: 她骑着车在安静的小路上走，感觉压力减轻了一些。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qízhe chē zài ānjìng de xiǎo lù shàng zǒu, gǎnjué yālì jiǎnqīng le yīxiē.
sentences.english: She rode her bike along the quiet small road, feeling the pressure lighten a bit.

sentences.chinese: 晚上，陆远送她回酒店，并温柔地说：“祝你今晚睡个好觉，一路平安。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnshàng, Lù Yuǎn sòng tā huí jiǔdiàn, bìng wēnróu de shuō: “Zhù nǐ jīn wǎn shuì gè hǎo jiào, yīlù píng'ān.”
sentences.english: In the evening, Lu Yuan saw her back to the hotel and said gently: "I wish you a good night's sleep, bon voyage (safe travels)."

sentences.chinese: 林晓开玩笑地说：“我也祝你一路顺风，明天见。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kāiwánxiào de shuō: “Wǒ yě zhù nǐ yīlù shùnfēng, míngtiān jiàn.”
sentences.english: Lin Xiao joked: "I also wish you a pleasant journey, see you tomorrow."

sentences.chinese: 但就在她关上门的一瞬间，她发现门外有一个熟悉的身影在等待。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài tā guān shàng mén de yī shùnjiān, tā fāxiàn mén wài yǒu yīgè shúxī de shēnyǐng zài děngdài.
sentences.english: But the moment she closed the door, she discovered a familiar figure waiting outside.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 11: The Shadow Outside the Door

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着门外的人，心跳快了一点点。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe mén wài de rén, xīntiào kuàile yī diǎn diǎn.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at the person outside the door, and her heart beat a little bit faster.

sentences.chinese: 那个人就是她的前男友，他站在那里，表情一般。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge rén jiùshì tā de qián nányǒu, tā zhàn zài nàlǐ, biǎoqíng yībān.
sentences.english: That person was her ex-boyfriend; he stood there with an ordinary expression.

sentences.chinese: 林晓心想，他为什么会在这里？
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo xīn xiǎng, tā wèishénme huì zài zhèlǐ?
sentences.english: Lin Xiao wondered, why is he here?

sentences.chinese: 他看着林晓，低声说：“我们谈谈吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe Lín Xiǎo, dīshēng shuō: “Wǒmen tán tán ba.”
sentences.english: He looked at Lin Xiao and said in a low voice, "Let's talk."

sentences.chinese: 林晓觉得很不舒服，她不想和他说话。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo juéde hěn bù shūfu, tā bù xiǎng hé tā shuōhuà.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao felt very uncomfortable; she didn't want to speak with him.

sentences.chinese: 但是，他挡在门口，让她不能走。
sentences.pinyin: Dànshì, tā dǎng zài ménkǒu, ràng tā bùnéng zǒu.
sentences.english: But he blocked the doorway, making it so she couldn't leave.

sentences.chinese: 林晓说：“现在已经很晚了，你不能在这里。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo shuō: “Xiànzài yǐjīng hěn wǎn le, nǐ bùnéng zài zhèlǐ.”
sentences.english: Lin Xiao said, "It's already very late; you can't be here."

sentences.chinese: 前男友说：“我知道，不过我只有几个问题。”
sentences.pinyin: Qián nányǒu shuō: “Wǒ zhīdào, bùguò wǒ zhǐyǒu jǐ gè wèntí.”
sentences.english: The ex-boyfriend said, "I know, but I only have a few questions."

sentences.chinese: 林晓觉得他现在的样子和以前不同。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo juéde tā xiànzài de yàngzi hé yǐqián bùtóng.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao felt that his current manner was different from before.

sentences.chinese: 以前的他很温柔，但现在的他好像变了。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐqián de tā hěn wēnróu, dàn xiànzài de tā hǎoxiàng biàn le.
sentences.english: He used to be very gentle, but now he seemed to have changed.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“陆远可能不是你认为的那个人。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Lù Yuǎn kěnéng bùshì nǐ rènwéi de nàge rén.”
sentences.english: He said, "Lu Yuan might not be the person you think he is."

sentences.chinese: 林晓很惊讶，她大声说：“不要这样说他！”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo hěn jīngyà, tā dàshēng shuō: “Bùyào zhèyàng shuō tā!”
sentences.english: Lin Xiao was surprised and said loudly, "Don't talk about him like that!"

sentences.chinese: 前男友笑了，冷冷地说：“你太天真了，他不但认识我，而且还知道很多秘密。”
sentences.pinyin: Qián nányǒu xiào le, lěnglěng de shuō: “Nǐ tài tiānzhēn le, tā bùdàn rènshi wǒ, érqiě hái zhīdào hěnduō mìmì.”
sentences.english: The ex-boyfriend laughed and said coldly, "You are too naive; he not only knows me, but also knows many secrets."

sentences.chinese: 林晓问：“什么秘密？你刚才在说什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo wèn: “Shénme mìmì? Nǐ gāngcái zài shuō shénme?”
sentences.english: Lin Xiao asked, "What secrets? What were you just saying?"

sentences.chinese: 前男友没有回答，只看着她的眼睛。
sentences.pinyin: Qián nányǒu méiyǒu huídá, zhǐ kànzhe tā de yǎnjīng.
sentences.english: The ex-boyfriend didn't answer, only looking into her eyes.

sentences.chinese: 林晓觉得这个气氛太可怕了，她想要离开。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo juéde zhège qìfēn tài kěpà le, tā xiǎng yào líkāi.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao felt the atmosphere was too scary; she wanted to leave.

sentences.chinese: 可是，她的身体好像不动了，因为她太害怕了。
sentences.pinyin: Kěshì, tā de shēntǐ hǎoxiàng bù dòng le, yīnwèi tā tài hàipà le.
sentences.english: However, her body seemed unable to move because she was too afraid.

sentences.chinese: 前男友说：“如果你想知道真相，明天来见我。”
sentences.pinyin: Qián nányǒu shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng zhīdào zhēnxiàng, míngtiān lái jiàn wǒ.”
sentences.english: The ex-boyfriend said, "If you want to know the truth, come meet me tomorrow."

sentences.chinese: 他给了林晓一张小纸条，上面写着一个地址。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gěile Lín Xiǎo yī zhāng xiǎo zhǐtiáo, shàngmiàn xiězhe yī gè dìzhǐ.
sentences.english: He gave Lin Xiao a small piece of paper with an address written on it.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林晓，那个地址在市中心，在公园以下的位置。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Lín Xiǎo, nàge dìzhǐ zài shì zhōngxīn, zài gōngyuán yǐxià de wèizhì.
sentences.english: He told Lin Xiao that the address was in the city center, in a location below the park.

sentences.chinese: 林晓接过纸条，心里觉得很不安。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo jiēguò zhǐtiáo, xīnlǐ juéde hěn bù'ān.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao took the paper, feeling very uneasy in her heart.

sentences.chinese: 她想，也许他是在骗我，但我不一定能确定。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, yěxǔ tā shì zài piàn wǒ, dàn wǒ bù yīdìng néng quèdìng.
sentences.english: She thought, perhaps he is lying to me, but I can't necessarily be sure.

sentences.chinese: 除了这个地址以外，纸条上没有其他信息。
sentences.pinyin: Chúle zhège dìzhǐ yǐwài, zhǐtiáo shàng méiyǒu qítā xìnxī.
sentences.english: Apart from this address, there was no other information on the paper.

sentences.chinese: 前男友转身走开了，动作很快。
sentences.pinyin: Qián nányǒu zhuǎnshēn zǒu kāi le, dòngzuò hěn kuài.
sentences.english: The ex-boyfriend turned and walked away, his movements quick.

sentences.chinese: 林晓赶紧关上门，靠在门上大口呼吸。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo gǎnjǐn guānshàng mén, kào zài mén shàng dàkǒu hūxī.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao quickly closed the door and leaned against it, breathing deeply.

sentences.chinese: 她刚才感觉呼吸不够，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gānggāng gǎnjué hūxī bùgòu, xīntiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: She had just felt her breathing was insufficient, and her heart was beating very fast.

sentences.chinese: 她想起陆远的笑容，觉得那个笑容不如现在的恐惧简单。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ Lù Yuǎn de xiàoróng, juéde nàge xiàoróng bùrú xiànzài de kǒngjù jiǎndān.
sentences.english: She thought of Lu Yuan's smile and felt that smile was not as simple as the current fear.

sentences.chinese: 她想给陆远打电话，但她觉得现在不行。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng gěi Lù Yuǎn dǎ diànhuà, dàn tā juéde xiànzài bùxíng.
sentences.english: She wanted to call Lu Yuan, but she felt it wouldn't do right now.

sentences.chinese: 因为现在是深夜，她不想打扰他睡觉。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi xiànzài shì shēnyè, tā bù xiǎng dǎrǎo tā shuìjiào.
sentences.english: Because it was midnight, she didn't want to disturb his sleep.

sentences.chinese: 在这个城市里，只有少数人知道她的过去。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège chéngshì lǐ, zhǐyǒu shǎoshù rén zhīdào tā de guòqù.
sentences.english: In this city, only a small number of people knew about her past.

sentences.chinese: 她想，只要我足够勇敢，就可以面对这一切。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, zhǐyào wǒ zúgòu yǒnggǎn, jiù kěyǐ miànduì zhè yīqiè.
sentences.english: She thought, as long as I am brave enough, I can face all of this.

sentences.chinese: 啊，这个夜晚真的太漫长了。
sentences.pinyin: Ā, zhège yèwǎn zhēnde tài màncháng le.
sentences.english: Ah, this night is truly too long.

sentences.chinese: 例如，她想到了红院长的那个眼神，想到了那些奇怪的短信。
sentences.pinyin: Lìrú, tā xiǎngdàole Hóng yuànzhǎng de nàge yǎnshén, xiǎngdàole nàxiē qíguài de xùnxīn.
sentences.english: For example, she thought of Dean Hong's gaze and those strange text messages.

sentences.chinese: 她意识到，自己的生活不再是以前那样简单了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, zìjǐ de shēnghuó bù zài shì yǐqián nàyàng jiǎndān le.
sentences.english: She realized that her life was no longer as simple as it was before.

sentences.chinese: 她只能一个人在房间里等待明天到来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐnéng yīgè rén zài fángjiān lǐ děngdài míngtiān dàolái.
sentences.english: She could only wait in her room alone for tomorrow to arrive.

sentences.chinese: 如果明天的事情很糟糕，她该怎么办呢？
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ míngtiān de shìqíng hěn zāogāo, tā gāi zěnme bàn ne?
sentences.english: If tomorrow's events are terrible, what should she do?

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，她的手机突然亮了，是一条来自陆远的短信。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhèshí, tā de shǒujī tūrán liàng le, shì yī tiáo láizì Lù Yuǎn de xùnxīn.
sentences.english: Just then, her phone suddenly lit up; it was a text message from Lu Yuan.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 12: Comfort in the Deep Night

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着手机，陆远的短信很短。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe shǒujī, Lù Yuǎn de duǎn xìn hěn duǎn.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at her phone; Lu Yuan's text was very short.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“我知道你现在有点儿担心，但我会陪着你。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ zhīdào nǐ xiànzài yǒudiǎnr dānxīn, dàn wǒ huì péizhe nǐ.”
sentences.english: He said, "I know you are a bit worried right now, but I will stay by your side."

sentences.chinese: 这句话让林晓的心情好了一点儿。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jù huà ràng Lín Xiǎo de xīnqíng hǎo le yīdiǎnr.
sentences.english: These words made Lin Xiao's mood a little better.

sentences.chinese: 她回了一条短信，问他现在在做什么。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huí le yī tiáo duǎn xìn, wèn tā xiànzài zài zuò shénme.
sentences.english: She replied with a text, asking him what he was doing now.

sentences.chinese: 陆远说他正在看一些旧照片，比如他们前年一起去旅游的照片。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn shuō tā zhèngzài kàn yīxiē jiù zhàopiàn, bǐrú tāmen qiánnián yīqǐ qù lǚyóu de zhàopiàn.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan said he was looking at some old photos, for example, photos of the trip they took together the year before last.

sentences.chinese: 他写道：“虽然现在情况很复杂，但我想起那时候，就觉得很温暖。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiě dào: “Suīrán xiànzài qíngkuàng hěn fùzá, dàn wǒ xiǎngqǐ nà shíhòu, jiù juéde hěn wēnnuǎn.”
sentences.english: He wrote, "Although the situation is very complicated now, when I think of that time, I feel very warm."

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着照片里蓝色的天空，想到了姓蓝的那个老同学，那是她中小学时的朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe zhàopiàn lǐ lán sè de tiānkōng, xiǎngdào le xìng Lán de nàgè lǎo tóngxué, nà shì tā zhōngxiǎoxué shí de péngyǒu.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at the blue sky in the photo and thought of an old classmate surnamed Lan, who was a friend from her middle and elementary school days.

sentences.chinese: 她想起很久以前，他们经常讨论未来会是什么样。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ hǎojiǔ yǐqián, tāmen jīngcháng tǎolùn wèilái huì shì shénmeyàng.
sentences.english: She remembered a long time ago, they often discussed what the future would be like.

sentences.chinese: 但是，最近的生活让她觉得压力很大，而且红院长的威胁让她害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Dànshì, zuìjìn de shēnghuó ràng tā juéde yālì hěn dà, érqiě Hóng yuànzhǎng de wēixié ràng tā hàipà.
sentences.english: However, recent life had made her feel a lot of pressure, and moreover, Dean Hong's threats frightened her.

sentences.chinese: 她想，如果明天的事情很糟糕的话，她该怎么办？
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rúguǒ míngtiān de shìqíng hěn zāogāo de huà, tā gāi zěnme bàn?
sentences.english: She thought, if tomorrow's events are terrible, what should she do?

sentences.chinese: 她开始重复地思考这个问题，心里不安。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kāishǐ chóngfù de sīkǎo zhège wèntí, xīnlǐ bù'ān.
sentences.english: She began to repeatedly think about this question, feeling uneasy in her heart.

sentences.chinese: 陆远似乎感觉到了，他发来一条语音信息。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn sìhū gǎnjué dào le, tā fā lái yī tiáo yǔyīn xìnxī.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan seemed to sense this and sent a voice message.

sentences.chinese: 他的声音很低，听起来非常温柔。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shēngyīn hěn dī, tīng qǐlái fēicháng wēnróu.
sentences.english: His voice was low and sounded very gentle.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你现在可能在想很多事情，或者在担心那个男人。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ xiànzài kěnéng zài xiǎng hěnduō shìqíng, huòzhě zài dānxīn nàgè nánrén.”
sentences.english: He said, "You might be thinking about many things right now, or worrying about that man."

sentences.chinese: “你或许可以试着睡一觉，或者听听音乐。”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ huòkě yǐ shìzhe shuì yī jiào, huòzhě tīngtīng yīnyuè.”
sentences.english: "You might try to get some sleep, or listen to some music."

sentences.chinese: “差不多快十二点了，现在休息才是最重要的。”
sentences.pinyin: “Chàbuduō kuài shí'èr diǎn le, xiànzài xiūxí cái shì zuì zhòngyào de.”
sentences.english: "It's almost twelve o'clock; resting now is the most important thing."

sentences.chinese: 林晓听着他的声音，觉得心里不再那么孤独。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo tīngzhe tā de shēngyīn, juéde xīnlǐ bù zài nàme gūdú.
sentences.english: Listening to his voice, Lin Xiao felt that her heart was no longer so lonely.

sentences.chinese: 她回复道：“谢谢你，我想我确实需要休息了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā huífù dào: “Xièxiè nǐ, wǒ xiǎng wǒ quèshí xūyào xiūxí le.”
sentences.english: She replied, "Thank you, I think I really do need some rest."

sentences.chinese: 陆远笑着说：“好，等你明天有空儿的时候，我们再详细聊。”
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn xiàozhe shuō: “Hǎo, děng nǐ míngtiān yǒukòngr de shíhòu, wǒmen zài xiángxì liáo.”
sentences.english: Lu Yuan smiled and said, "Okay, when you are available tomorrow, we will chat in detail."

sentences.chinese: 不一会儿，林晓终于感到了困意。
sentences.pinyin: Bù yīhuǐr, Lín Xiǎo zhōngyú gǎndào le kùnyì.
sentences.english: After a short while, Lin Xiao finally felt sleepy.

sentences.chinese: 她闭上眼睛，但脑海中突然浮现出红院长那个冷漠的眼神。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì shàng yǎnjīng, dàn nǎohǎi zhōng tūrán fúxiàn chū Hóng yuànzhǎng nàgè lěngmò de yǎnshén.
sentences.english: She closed her eyes, but Dean Hong's cold gaze suddenly flashed through her mind.

sentences.chinese: 她意识到，这场游戏才刚刚开始。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, zhè chǎng yóuxì cái gānggāng kāishǐ.
sentences.english: She realized that this game had only just begun.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十三章：名单上的秘密
chapters.title_english: Chapter 13: The Secret on the List

sentences.chinese: 第二天早晨，林晓来到了公司。
sentences.pinyin: Dì shí sān zhāng: Míng dān shàng de mì mì
sentences.english: The next morning, Lin Xiao arrived at the company.

sentences.chinese: 她的心情依然很沉重，因为红院长的威胁让她感到不安。
sentences.pinyin: Dì èr tiān zǎochén, Lín Xiǎo lái dào le gōngsī.
sentences.english: Her mood was still very heavy because Dean Hong's threats made her feel uneasy.

sentences.chinese: 在办公室里，她打开了计算机，准备开始工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de xīnqíng yīrán hěn chénzhòng, yīnwèi Hóng yuànzhǎng de wēixié ràng tā gǎndào bù'ān.
sentences.english: In the office, she turned on the computer and prepared to start working.

sentences.chinese: 这时，她的上司周先生走过来，递给她一份文件。
sentences.pinyin: Zài bàngōngshì lǐ, tā dǎkāi le jìsuànjī, zhǔnbèi kāishǐ gōngzuò.
sentences.english: At this time, her boss Mr. Zhou walked over and handed her a document.

sentences.chinese: “林晓，这是新项目的名单，请你核对一下。”
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, tā de shàngsī Zhōu xiānsheng zǒu guòlái, dì gěi tā yī fèn wénjiàn.
sentences.english: "Lin Xiao, this is the list for the new project, please check it."

sentences.chinese: 林晓接过文件，发现上面有上千个人的姓名。
sentences.pinyin: “Lín Xiǎo, zhè shì xīn xiàngmù de míngdān, qǐng nǐ héduì yīxià.”
sentences.english: Lin Xiao took the document and found that there were over a thousand people's full names on it.

sentences.chinese: 她开始认真地查这些名字，试图寻找红院长的踪迹。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo jiēguò wénjiàn, fāxiàn shàngmiàn yǒu shàng qiān gè rén de xìngmíng.
sentences.english: She began to carefully check these names, trying to find any trace of Dean Hong.

sentences.chinese: 在名单中，她看到了很多奇怪的姓氏。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kāishǐ rènzhēn de chá zhèxiē míngzì, shìtú xúnzhǎo Hóng yuànzhǎng de zōngjì.
sentences.english: In the list, she saw many strange surnames.

sentences.chinese: 比如全先生、向女士、还有封先生和平女士。
sentences.pinyin: Zài míngdān zhōng, tā kàndào le hěnduō qíguài de xìngshì.
sentences.english: For example, Mr. Quan, Ms. Xiang, as well as Mr. Feng and Ms. Ping.

sentences.chinese: 接着，她看到了怕先生、成先生和查先生的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐrú Quán xiānsheng, Xiàng nǚshì, hái yǒu Fēng xiānsheng hé Píng nǚshì.
sentences.english: Next, she saw the names of Mr. Pa, Mr. Cheng, and Mr. Zha.

sentences.chinese: 她继续往下看，发现了段先生、米先生和组先生。
sentences.pinyin: Jiēzhe, tā kàndào le Pà xiānsheng, Chéng xiānsheng hé Zhá xiānsheng de míngzì.
sentences.english: She continued looking down and found Mr. Duan, Mr. Mi, and Mr. Zu.

sentences.chinese: 然后是角先生、闻先生和阴先生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìxù wǎng xià kàn, fāxiàn le Duàn xiānsheng, Mǐ xiānsheng hé Zǔ xiānsheng.
sentences.english: Then came Mr. Jue, Mr. Wen, and Mr. Yin.

sentences.chinese: 最后，她看到了雪女士和题先生的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Ránhòu shì Jué xiānsheng, Wén xiānsheng hé Yīn xiānsheng.
sentences.english: Finally, she saw the names of Ms. Xue and Mr. Ti.

sentences.chinese: 林晓觉得这些名字组合在一起非常奇怪，像是一个秘密代码。
sentences.pinyin: Zuìhòu, tā kàndào le Xuě nǚshì hé Tí xiānsheng de míngzì.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao felt that these names combined together were very strange, like a secret code.

sentences.chinese: 她突然想到，红院长之前提到的“游戏”可能就在这里。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo juéde zhèxiē míngzì zǔhé zài yīqǐ fēicháng qíguài, xiàng shì yī gè mìmì dàimǎ.
sentences.english: She suddenly thought that the "game" Dean Hong mentioned before might be right here.

sentences.chinese: 她意识到，这些人的专业水平都非常高，而且背景复杂。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán xiǎngdào, Hóng yuànzhǎng zhīqián tí dào de “yóuxì” kěnéng jiù zài zhèlǐ.
sentences.english: She realized that these people's professional levels were all very high and their backgrounds were complex.

sentences.chinese: 她决定重点分析这份名单，看看这些人之间有什么联系。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, zhèxiē rén de zhuānyè shuǐpíng dōu fēicháng gāo, érqiě bèijǐng fùzá.
sentences.english: She decided to focus her analysis on this list to see what connection existed between these people.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，她的手机突然响了，是陆远发来的消息。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juédìng zhòngdiǎn fēnxī zhè fèn míngdān, kànkàn zhèxiē rén zhījiān yǒu shé me liánxì.
sentences.english: Just then, her phone suddenly rang; it was a message from Lu Yuan.

sentences.chinese: “林晓，你现在方便见面吗？我发现了一些关于红院长的线索。”
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, tā de shǒujī tūrán xiǎng le, shì Lù Yuǎn fā lái de xiāoxi.
sentences.english: "Lin Xiao, are you available to meet now? I've found some clues about Dean Hong."

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着屏幕，心中突然产生了一种强烈的直觉。
sentences.pinyin: “Lín Xiǎo, nǐ xiànzài fāngbiàn jiànmiàn ma? Wǒ fāxiàn le yīxiē guānyú Hóng yuànzhǎng de xiànsuǒ.”
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at the screen, and a strong intuition suddenly arose in her heart.

sentences.chinese: 她觉得这份名单和陆远发现的线索一定有关。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe píngmù, xīnzhōng tūrán chǎnshēng le yī zhǒng qiángliè de zhíjué.
sentences.english: She felt that this list must be related to the clues Lu Yuan had found.

sentences.chinese: 她拿起外套，急匆匆地离开了办公室。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde zhè fèn míngdān hé Lù Yuǎn fāxiàn de xiànsuǒ yīdìng yǒu guān.
sentences.english: She grabbed her coat and hurriedly left the office.

sentences.chinese: 但就在她走出大门的一刻，一个冷漠的声音在背后响起。
sentences.pinyin: Tā náqǐ wàitào, jí cōngcōng de líkāi le bàngōngshì.
sentences.english: But just as she stepped out the door, a cold voice sounded behind her.

sentences.chinese: “林晓，你还没查完，怎么就走了？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài tā zǒuchū dàmén de yī kè, yī gè lěngmò de shēngyīn zài bèihòu xiǎngqǐ.
sentences.english: "Lin Xiao, you haven't finished checking yet, why are you leaving?"

sentences.chinese: 她回头一看，红院长正站在阴影里，冷冷地看着她。
sentences.pinyin: “Lín Xiǎo, nǐ hái méi chá wán, zěnme jiù zǒu le?”
sentences.english: She looked back and saw Dean Hong standing in the shadows, looking at her coldly.

sentences.pinyin: Tā huítóu yī kàn, Hóng yuànzhǎng zhèng zhàn zài yīnyǐng lǐ, lěng lěng de kànzhe tā.

sentences.chinese: 林晓站在原地，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo zhàn zài yuán dì, xīn tiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao stood in place, her heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 她不敢直接回答红院长的问题。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù gǎn zhí jiē huí dá Hóng yuàn zhǎng de wèn tí.
sentences.english: She didn't dare to answer Dean Hong's question directly.

sentences.chinese: 红院长走近她，眼神冷漠，一点也不像个好人。
sentences.pinyin: Hóng yuàn zhǎng zǒu jìn tā, yǎn shén lěng mò, yī diǎn yě bù xiàng gè hǎo rén.
sentences.english: Dean Hong walked closer to her, his eyes cold, not looking like a good person at all.

sentences.chinese: 他问她是否看清楚了名单上的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn tā shì fǒu kàn qīng chu le míng dān shàng de míng zi.
sentences.english: He asked her if she had seen the names on the list clearly.

sentences.chinese: 林晓低着头，轻声说：“我看到了，但我不认为这是正确的做法。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo dī zhe tóu, qīng shēng shuō: “Wǒ kàn dào le, dàn wǒ bù rèn wéi zhè shì zhèng què de zuò fǎ.”
sentences.english: Lin Xiao lowered her head and said softly, "I saw them, but I don't think this is the correct way to do things."

sentences.chinese: 红院长冷笑一声，让她赶紧离开。
sentences.pinyin: Hóng yuàn zhǎng lěng xiào yī shēng, ràng tā gǎn xìn lí kāi.
sentences.english: Dean Hong sneered and told her to leave quickly.

sentences.chinese: 林晓走出大门，发现外面正好下起了小雨。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo zǒu chū dà mén, fā xiàn wài miàn zhèng hǎo xià qǐ le xiǎo yǔ.
sentences.english: As Lin Xiao walked out the main door, she found that it just happened to start raining lightly.

sentences.chinese: 她一直走在雨中，心里感到非常不舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yī zhí zǒu zài yǔ zhōng, xīn lǐ gǎn dào fēi cháng bù shū fu.
sentences.english: She walked continuously in the rain, feeling very uncomfortable in her heart.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，陆远撑着一把伞出现了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, Lù Yuǎn chēng zhe yī bǎ sǎn chū xiàn le.
sentences.english: Just then, Lu Yuan appeared holding an umbrella.

sentences.chinese: 他看着林晓，温柔地说：“你平安离开我就放心了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe Lín Xiǎo, wēn róu de shuō: “Nǐ píng ān lí kāi wǒ jiù fàng xīn le.”
sentences.english: Looking at Lin Xiao, he said gently, "I'm relieved that you left safely."

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着他，觉得这个男人特别温暖。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kàn zhe tā, jué de zhè gè nán rén tè bié wēn nuǎn.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at him and felt that this man was especially warm.

sentences.chinese: 陆远带她去了一家安静的咖啡馆。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn dài tā qù le yī jiā ā jìng de kā fēi guǎn.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan took her to a quiet coffee shop.

sentences.chinese: 那里的咖啡味道不错，环境也挺好。
sentences.pinyin: Nà lǐ de kā fēi wèi dào bù cuò, huán jìng yě tǐng hǎo.
sentences.english: The coffee there tasted not bad, and the environment was very good.

sentences.chinese: 林晓喝了一口热咖啡，身体终于觉得舒服了一些。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo hē le yī kǒu rè kā fēi, shēn tǐ zhōng yú jué de shū fu le yī xiē.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao took a sip of hot coffee, and her body finally felt a bit more comfortable.

sentences.chinese: 陆远注意到林晓在看一本旧词典，他笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn zhù yì dào Lín Xiǎo zài kàn yī běn jiù cí diǎn, tā xiào le.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan noticed Lin Xiao was looking at an old dictionary and smiled.

sentences.chinese: “你在学习中文吗？”陆远问。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ zài xué xí Zhōng wén ma?” Lù Yuǎn wèn.
sentences.english: "Are you studying Chinese?" Lu Yuan asked.

sentences.chinese: 林晓点点头，说：“我想让自己的表达更准确，这样沟通才合适。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo diǎn diǎn tóu, shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng ràng zì jǐ de biǎo dá gèng zhǔn què, zhè yàng gōu tōng cái hé shì.”
sentences.english: Lin Xiao nodded and said, "I want my expression to be more accurate, so that communication is appropriate."

sentences.chinese: 陆远挺起胸膛，自信地说：“如果你有不懂的地方，随时可以问我。”
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn tǐng qǐ xiōng táng, zì xìn de shuō: “Rú guǒ nǐ yǒu bù dǒng de dì fāng, suí shí kě yǐ wèn wǒ.”
sentences.english: Lu Yuan straightened his chest and said confidently, "If there is anything you don't understand, you can ask me at any time."

sentences.chinese: 两人聊了很多，林晓发现陆远的姓是海，是一个很有趣的人。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng rén liáo le hěn duō, Lín Xiǎo fā xiàn Lù Yuǎn de xìng shì Hǎi, shì yī gè hěn yǒu qù de rén.
sentences.english: The two chatted a lot, and Lin Xiao discovered Lu Yuan's surname was Hai, and he was a very interesting person.

sentences.chinese: 他们讨论了如何正确地处理红院长带来的麻烦。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men tǎo lùn le rú hé zhèng què de chǔ lǐ Hóng yuàn zhǎng dài lái de má fan.
sentences.english: They discussed how to correctly handle the trouble brought by Dean Hong.

sentences.chinese: 林晓希望接下来的事情能顺利进行。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo xī wàng jiē xià lái de shì qíng néng shùn lì jìn xíng.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao hoped that the following events would proceed smoothly.

sentences.chinese: 走出咖啡馆时，天空突然变晴了。
sentences.pinyin: Zǒu chū kā fēi guǎn shí, tiān kōng tū rán biàn qíng le.
sentences.english: When they walked out of the coffee shop, the sky suddenly cleared up.

sentences.chinese: 阳光洒在街道上，这是一个完美的晴天。
sentences.pinyin: Yáng guāng sǎ zài jiē dào shàng, zhè shì yī gè wán měi de qíng tiān.
sentences.english: Sunlight spilled over the street; it was a perfect sunny day.

sentences.chinese: 林晓开玩笑说，她现在肚子很饱，可以陪他走走。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kāi wán xiào shuō, tā xiàn zài dù zi hěn bǎo, kě yǐ péi tā zǒu zǒu.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao joked that she was very full now and could accompany him for a walk.

sentences.chinese: 在回家的路上，他们遇到一个迷路的人在问路。
sentences.pinyin: Zài huí jiā de lù shàng, tā men yù dào yī gè mí lù de rén zài wèn lù.
sentences.english: On the way home, they encountered a lost person asking for directions.

sentences.chinese: 林晓耐心地帮那个人指路，陆远在一旁看着她，眼神里充满了爱意。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo nài xīn de bāng nà gè rén zhǐ lù, Lù Yuǎn zài yī páng kàn zhe tā, yǎn shén lǐ chōng mǎn le ài yì.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao patiently helped the person find the way, and Lu Yuan watched her from the side, his eyes full of love.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，林晓的手机响了，是一个来自海先生办公室的紧急通知。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, Lín Xiǎo de shǒu jī xiǎng le, shì yī gè lái zì Hǎi xiān sheng bàn gōng shì de jǐn jí tōng zhī.
sentences.english: But just then, Lin Xiao's phone rang; it was an urgent notice from Mr. Hai's office.

sentences.chinese: 通知的内容让她的笑容瞬间消失了。
sentences.pinyin: Tōng zhī de nèi róng ràng tā de xiào róng shùn jiān xiāo shī le.
sentences.english: The content of the notice made her smile vanish instantly.

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着手机上的通知，脸色苍白。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe shǒujī shàng de tōngzhī, liǎnsè cāngbái.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at the notification on her phone, her face pale.

sentences.chinese: 海先生要求她立刻去市中心参加一个国际会议。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi xiānshēng yāoqiú tā lìkè qù shì zhōngxīn cānjiā yīgè guójì huìyì.
sentences.english: Mr. Hai required her to go to the city center immediately to attend an international conference.

sentences.chinese: 陆远关心地看着她，她的头发在风中轻轻飘动。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn guānxīn de kànzhe tā, tā de tóufa zài fēng zhōng qīngqīng piāodòng.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan looked at her with concern, her hair fluttering gently in the wind.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“别担心，我开车送你去，离那里只有五公里。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Bié dānxīn, wǒ kāichē sòng nǐ qù, lí nàlǐ zhǐyǒu wǔ gōnglǐ.”
sentences.english: He said, "Don't worry, I'll drive you there; it's only five kilometers away."

sentences.chinese: 他们很快到达了一个巨大的体育场门口。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen hěn kuài dàodále yīgè jùdà de tǐyùchǎng ménkǒu.
sentences.english: They soon arrived at the entrance of a huge stadium.

sentences.chinese: 这里的人数非常多，成千上万的人们在等待进入。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de rénshù fēicháng duō, chéng qiān shàng wàn de rénmen zài děngdài jìnrù.
sentences.english: The number of people here was enormous, with thousands of people waiting to enter.

sentences.chinese: 林晓心想，这个城市的住房压力很大，但这里的规模简直像一个小地球。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo xīn xiǎng, zhège chéngshì de zhùfáng yālì hěn dà, dàn zhèlǐ de guīmó jiǎnzhí xiàng yīgè xiǎo dìqiú.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao thought to herself that the housing pressure in this city was great, but the scale here was simply like a small earth.

sentences.chinese: 她走进大门，看到一个年轻的助手在引导人们。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu jìn dàmén, kàndào yīgè niánqīng de zhùshǒu zài yǐndǎo rénmen.
sentences.english: She walked through the main doors and saw a young assistant guiding the people.

sentences.chinese: 那个助手看起来很像一个作家，手里拿着笔记本，在写一个长句子。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè zhùshǒu kàn qǐlái hěn xiàng yīgè zuòjiā, shǒu lǐ názhe bǐjìběn, zài xiě yīgè cháng jùzi.
sentences.english: That assistant looked like an author, holding a notebook and writing a long sentence.

sentences.chinese: 林晓在会场找到了自己的座位，坐了下来。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo zài huìchǎng zhǎodàole zìjǐ de zuòwèi, zuòle xiàlái.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao found her seat in the venue and sat down.

sentences.chinese: 她看了一下手表，距离会议开始只有十分钟。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànle yīxià shǒubiǎo, jùlí huìyì kāishǐ zhǐyǒu shí fēnzhōng.
sentences.english: She checked her wristwatch; there were only ten minutes until the meeting started.

sentences.chinese: 这次会议的主题是关于大自然的保护。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì de zhǔtí shì guānyú dàzìrán de bǎohù.
sentences.english: The theme of this meeting was about the protection of nature.

sentences.chinese: 会议上，市长在讲话，他说现在地球上的动物面临很多危险。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì shàng, shìzhǎng zài jiǎnghuà, tā shuō xiànzài dìqiú shàng de dòngwù miànlín hěnduō wēixiǎn.
sentences.english: At the meeting, the mayor was speaking, saying that animals on earth are currently facing many dangers.

sentences.chinese: 他提到，在东南地区的森林里，很多动物失去了家园。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tí dào, zài dōngnán dìqū de sēnlín lǐ, hěnduō dòngwù shīqùle jiāyuán.
sentences.english: He mentioned that in the forests of the southeast region, many animals have lost their homes.

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着屏幕上的照片，那些可爱的动物让她的心很酸。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe píngmù shàng de zhàopiàn, nàxiē kě'ài de dòngwù ràng tā de xīn hěn suān.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at the photos on the screen; those cute animals made her heart ache.

sentences.chinese: 她想到动物园里的动物，虽然安全，但它们失去了自由。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngdào dòngwùyuán lǐ de dòngwù, suīrán ānquán, dàn tāmen shīqùle zìyóu.
sentences.english: She thought of the animals in the zoo; although they are safe, they have lost their freedom.

sentences.chinese: 市长说，保护环境需要全球的小组共同合作。
sentences.pinyin: Shìzhǎng shuō, bǎohù huánjìng xūyào quánqiú de xiǎozǔ gòngtóng hézuò.
sentences.english: The mayor said that protecting the environment requires the cooperation of global groups.

sentences.chinese: 他提到一些巨大的数字，比如某些物种的数量已经减少了几个亿。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tí dào yīxiē jùdà de shùzì, bǐrú mǒu xiē wùzhǒng de shùliàng yǐjīng jiǎnshǎole jǐ gè yì.
sentences.english: He mentioned some huge numbers, such as the population of certain species having decreased by hundreds of millions.

sentences.chinese: 林晓在笔记本上写道：我们需要保护每一千克土壤，每一公斤种子。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo zài bǐjìběn shàng xiě dào: Wǒmen xūyào bǎohù měi yī qiānkè tǔrǎng, měi yī gōngjīn zhǒngzi.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao wrote in her notebook: We need to protect every kilogram of soil and every kilogram of seed.

sentences.chinese: 突然，她的手机信号变得很差，无法发送信息。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, tā de shǒujī xìnhào biàn de hěn chà, wúfǎ fāsòng xìnxī.
sentences.english: Suddenly, her phone signal became very poor, and she could not send messages.

sentences.chinese: 她想起这个夏天，她本想在假期去旅行，但现在却在参加会议。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zhège xiàtiān, tā běn xiǎng zài jiàqī qù lǚxíng, dàn xiànzài què zài cānjiā huìyì.
sentences.english: She remembered this summer, she originally wanted to travel during the vacation, but now she was attending a meeting.

sentences.chinese: 会议休息时，她看到有人在讨论排球比赛，气氛很热闹。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì xiūxí shí, tā kàndào yǒurén zài tǎolùn páiqiú bǐsài, qìfēn hěn rènào.
sentences.english: During the meeting break, she saw people discussing a volleyball match, and the atmosphere was lively.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个男人走过来，递给她一本护照。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yīgè nánrén zǒu guòlái, dì gěi tā yī běn hùzhào.
sentences.english: At this moment, a man walked over and handed her a passport.

sentences.chinese: 林晓惊讶地发现，那是她的护照，她怎么把它弄丢了？
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo jīngyà de fāxiàn, nà shì tā de hùzhào, tā zěnme bǎ tā nòng diūle?
sentences.english: Lin Xiao was surprised to find it was her passport; how had she lost it?

sentences.chinese: 那个男人低声说：“海先生让我把这个还给你。”
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè nánrén dīshēng shuō: “Hǎi xiānshēng ràng wǒ bǎ zhège huán gěi nǐ.”
sentences.english: The man whispered, "Mr. Hai asked me to return this to you."

sentences.chinese: 林晓接过护照，突然感觉到一阵不安。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo jiēguò hùzhào, tūrán gǎnjué dào yīzhèn bù'ān.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao took the passport and suddenly felt a wave of unease.

sentences.chinese: 天空变得多云，阳光消失了，空气变得冰冷。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānkōng biàn de duōyún, yángguāng xiāoshīle, kōngqì biàn de bīnglěng.
sentences.english: The sky became cloudy, the sunlight disappeared, and the air turned cold.

sentences.chinese: 她走出体育场，走向最近的地铁站。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu chū tǐyùchǎng, zǒuxiàng zuìjìn de dìtiězhàn.
sentences.english: She walked out of the stadium and headed toward the nearest subway station.

sentences.chinese: 她想一个人思考，关于海先生和红院长的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng yīgè rén sīkǎo, guānyú Hǎi xiānshēng hé Hóng yuànzhǎng de mìmì.
sentences.english: She wanted to think alone about the secrets of Mr. Hai and Dean Hong.

sentences.chinese: 就在她进入地铁站的一瞬间，一个黑色的身影在人群中闪过。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tā jìnrù dìtiězhàn de yī shùnjiān, yīgè hēisè de shēnyǐng zài rénqún zhōng shǎnguò.
sentences.english: Just as she entered the subway station, a black figure flashed through the crowd.

sentences.chinese: 那个人拿着一张照片，正对着她冷笑。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè rén názhe yī zhāng zhàopiàn, zhèng duìzhe tā lěngxiào.
sentences.english: That person was holding a photo and sneering at her.

sentences.chinese: 林晓的心跳加快了，她意识到危险并没有离开。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo de xīntiào jiākuàile, tā yìshí dào wēixiǎn bìng méiyǒu líkāi.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao's heart beat faster; she realized the danger had not left.

sentences.chinese: 林晓在地铁站里感到非常害怕，但她想到了陆远。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo zài dìtiězhàn lǐ gǎndào fēicháng hàipà, dàn tā xiǎngdàole Lù Yuǎn.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao felt very scared in the subway station, but she thought of Lu Yuan.

sentences.chinese: 为了躲避那个黑色的身影，她决定回到他们曾经一起学习的校园。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile duǒbì nàge hēisè de shēnyǐng, tā juédìng huídào tāmen céngjīng yīqǐ xuéxí de xiàoyuán.
sentences.english: To avoid that black figure, she decided to return to the campus where they once studied together.

sentences.chinese: 现在是春天，校园里的花园里开满了美丽的花。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài shì chūntiān, xiàoyuán lǐ de huāyuán lǐ kāimǎnle měilì de huā.
sentences.english: It is now spring, and the garden on campus is full of beautiful flowers.

sentences.chinese: 这里的气温很舒服，温度不高也不低。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de qìwēn hěn shūfu, wēndù bù gāo yě bù dī.
sentences.english: The air temperature here is very comfortable, the temperature is neither too high nor too low.

sentences.chinese: 她走进一间安静的教室，坐在了一把旧椅子上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒujìn yī jiàn ānjìng de jiàoshì, zuò zàile yī bǎ jiù yǐzi shàng.
sentences.english: She walked into a quiet classroom and sat on an old chair.

sentences.chinese: 她记得这里曾经有一位非常有名的教师，他像个科学家一样研究历史。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde zhèlǐ céngjīng yǒu yī wèi fēicháng yǒumíng de jiàoshī, tā xiàng gè kēxuéjiā yīyàng yánjiū lìshǐ.
sentences.english: She remembered there was once a very famous teacher here who studied history like a scientist.

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着窗外，远处有一条小河和一个蓝色的湖。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe chuāngwài, yuǎnchù yǒu yī tiáo xiǎo hé hé yī gè lánsè de hú.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked out the window; in the distance, there was a small river and a blue lake.

sentences.chinese: 她想起去年秋天，她和陆远在这里讨论英文书。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ qùnián qiūtiān, tā hé Lù Yuǎn zài zhèlǐ tǎolùn Yīngwén shū.
sentences.english: She recalled last autumn, when she and Lu Yuan discussed English books here.

sentences.chinese: 陆远的英语非常好，他总是耐心地教她。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn de Yīngyǔ fēicháng hǎo, tā zǒng shì nàixīn de jiāo tā.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan's English was very good, and he always taught her patiently.

sentences.chinese: 当时，陆远穿着一件绿色的衣服和一双白色的球鞋。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngshí, Lù Yuǎn chuānzhe yī jiàn lǜsè de yīfu hé yī shuāng báisè de qiúxié.
sentences.english: At that time, Lu Yuan wore green clothes and a pair of white athletic shoes.

sentences.chinese: 他的眼睛里充满了温柔，看着林晓的脸微笑。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yǎnjing lǐ chōngmǎnle wēnróu, kànzhe Lín Xiǎo de liǎn wēixiào.
sentences.english: His eyes were full of tenderness, smiling at Lin Xiao's face.

sentences.chinese: 林晓记得那时候他们经常在校园里散步，偶尔会看到一只可爱的狗在跑。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo jìde nà shíhou tāmen jīngcháng zài xiàoyuán lǐ sànbù, ǒu'ěr huì kàndào yī zhī kě'ài de gǒu zài pǎo.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao remembered that they often strolled on campus then, and occasionally saw a cute dog running.

sentences.chinese: 突然，林晓在桌子上看到了一份旧的日报。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, Lín Xiǎo zài zhuōzi shàng kàndàole yī fèn jiù de rìbào.
sentences.english: Suddenly, Lin Xiao saw an old daily newspaper on the table.

sentences.chinese: 报纸上的新闻说，这个月份会有很多关于春节的庆祝活动。
sentences.pinyin: Bàozhǐ shàng de xīnwén shuō, zhège yuèfèn huì yǒu hěnduō guānyú Chūnjié de zhìzhù huódòng.
sentences.english: The news in the paper said there would be many celebrations for the Spring Festival this month.

sentences.chinese: 她想起春节的时候，陆远带她去尝试用筷子吃传统的晚餐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ Chūnjié de shíhou, Lù Yuǎn dài tā qù chángshì yòng kuàizi chī chuántǒng de wǎncān.
sentences.english: She thought of the Spring Festival, when Lu Yuan took her to try eating a traditional dinner with chopsticks.

sentences.chinese: 那是她第一次尝试满族风格的饮食，味道非常好。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì tā dì yī cì chángshì Mǎn zú fēnggé de yǐnshí, wèidào fēicháng hǎo.
sentences.english: That was her first time trying Manchu-style cuisine, and the taste was excellent.

sentences.chinese: 她记得那天早晨，他们一起吃了简单的早餐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde nà tiān zǎochén, tāmen yīqǐ chīle jiǎndān de zǎocān.
sentences.english: She remembered that morning, they had a simple breakfast together.

sentences.chinese: 陆远当时讲了一个很有意思的笑话儿，让她笑得腿都软了。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn dāngshí jiǎngle yī gè hěn yǒu yìsi de xiàohuar, ràng tā xiào de tuǐ dōu ruǎnle.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan told a very interesting joke then, making her laugh until her legs felt weak.

sentences.chinese: 现在，林晓在桌上发现了一个空的瓶子，里面有一张纸条。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài, Lín Xiǎo zài zhuōzi shàng fāxiànle yī gè kōng de píngzi, lǐmiàn yǒu yī zhāng zhǐtiáo.
sentences.english: Now, Lin Xiao found an empty bottle on the table with a note inside.

sentences.chinese: 纸条上写着：“我像个画家一样，想把你的样子画在心里。”
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐtiáo shàng xiězhe: “Wǒ xiàng gè huàjiā yīyàng, xiǎng bǎ nǐ de yàngzi huà zài xīnlǐ.”
sentences.english: The note read: "I am like a painter, wanting to paint your image in my heart."

sentences.chinese: 这是陆远以前写给她的情话。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì Lù Yuǎn yǐqián xiě gěi tā de qínghuà.
sentences.english: These were love words Lu Yuan had written to her before.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，林晓听到门外有声音，像是在打篮球。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, Lín Xiǎo tīngdào ménwài yǒu shēngyīn, xiàng shì zài dǎ lánqiú.
sentences.english: Just then, Lin Xiao heard a sound outside the door, as if someone was playing basketball.

sentences.chinese: 她紧张地站起来，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jǐnzhāng de zhàn qǐlái, xīntiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: She stood up nervously, her heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 她突然想起一个古老的传说，说有一种叫“离”的 mythical beast 会在人孤独时出现。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán xiǎngqǐ yī gè gǔlǎo de chuánshuō, shuō yǒu yī zhǒng jiào “lí” de mythical beast huì zài rén gūdú shí chūxiàn.
sentences.english: She suddenly remembered an old legend that a mythical beast called "Li" appears when people are lonely.

sentences.chinese: 但她现在不孤独，因为她心中有陆远。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tā xiànzài bù gūdú, yīnwèi tā xīnzhōng yǒu Lù Yuǎn.
sentences.english: But she is not lonely now, because she has Lu Yuan in her heart.

sentences.chinese: 然而，门被推开了，进来的人不是陆远，而是那个黑色的身影。
sentences.pinyin: Rán'ér, mén bèi tuī kāile, jìnlái de rén bùshì Lù Yuǎn, ér shì nàge hēisè de shēnyǐng.
sentences.english: However, the door was pushed open, and the person who entered was not Lu Yuan, but that black figure.

sentences.chinese: 那个人冷冷地看着她，眼神中没有任何温度。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge rén lěng lěng de kànzhe tā, yǎnshén zhōng méiyǒu rènhé wēndù.
sentences.english: That person looked at her coldly, with no warmth in his eyes.

sentences.chinese: 他手里拿着一张照片，照片上是林晓和陆远在湖边的样子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shǒu lǐ názhe yī zhāng zhàopiàn, zhàopiàn shàng shì Lín Xiǎo hé Lù Yuǎn zài húbiān de yàngzi.
sentences.english: He held a photo in his hand; the photo was of Lin Xiao and Lu Yuan by the lake.

sentences.chinese: “你以为回到这里就安全了？”那个人低声说。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ yǐwéi huídào zhèlǐ jiù ānquánle?” nàge rén dīshēng shuō.
sentences.english: "Did you think returning here would be safe?" the person said in a low voice.

sentences.chinese: 林晓感到全身冰冷，危险再次逼近。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo gǎndào quánshēn bīnglěng, wēixiǎn zàicì bījìn.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao felt cold all over; danger was approaching again.

sentences.chinese: 她必须尽快找到陆远，才能结束这场噩梦。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū jǐnkuài zhǎodào Lù Yuǎn, cáinéng jiéshù zhè chǎng èmèng.
sentences.english: She must find Lu Yuan as soon as possible to end this nightmare.

sentences.chinese: 但这个陌生人是谁？他为什么一直跟着她？
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zhège mòshēng rén shì shéi? Tā wèishéme yīzhí gēnzhe tā?
sentences.english: But who is this stranger? Why has he been following her?

chapters.title_chinese: 第十七章：寒冬里的追寻
chapters.title_english: Chapter 17: Searching in the Cold Winter

sentences.chinese: 那个陌生人拿着照片，在寒冷的街上快步走开。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge mòshēng rén názhe zhàopiàn, zài hánlěng de jiē shàng kuàibù zǒukāi.
sentences.english: The stranger held the photo and walked quickly away on the cold street.

sentences.chinese: 林晓感到害怕，她的心跳很快，感觉像是在面对一个巨大的难题。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo gǎndào hàipà, tā de xīntiào hěn kuài, gǎnjué xiàng shì zài miànduì yīgè jùdà de nántí.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao felt afraid; her heart was beating fast, feeling as if she were facing a huge difficult problem.

sentences.chinese: 现在的天气非常冷，温度已经零下五度了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài de tiānqì fēicháng lěng, wēndù yǐjīng língxià wǔ dù le.
sentences.english: The weather now was very cold, the temperature was already five degrees below zero.

sentences.chinese: 她低头看了一眼自己的鞋，因为跑得太快，一只鞋子快要掉了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dītóu kàn le yīyǎn zìjǐ de xié, yīnwèi pǎo de tài kuài, yī zhī xiézi kuài yào diào le.
sentences.english: She looked down at her shoes; because she had run too fast, one shoe was about to fall off.

sentences.chinese: 林晓决定向西南方向走，因为她记得陆远在那里工作。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo juédìng xiàng xīnán fāngxiàng zǒu, yīnwèi tā jìdé Lù Yuǎn zài nàlǐ gōngzuò.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao decided to walk toward the southwest, because she remembered Lu Yuan worked there.

sentences.chinese: 她走过一家银行，然后经过了一家药店。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒuguò yī jiā yínháng, ránhòu jīngguò le yī jiā yàodiàn.
sentences.english: She walked past a bank and then passed a pharmacy.

sentences.chinese: 路边的商店都关门了，只有蓝色的灯光在黑暗中闪烁。
sentences.pinyin: Lùbiān de shāngdiàn dōu guānmén le, zhǐyǒu lán sè de dēngguāng zài hēi'àn zhòng shǎnshuò.
sentences.english: The shops along the road were all closed, with only blue lights flashing in the darkness.

sentences.chinese: 她突然想起在大学的课堂上，陆远曾经教她学习语言。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán xiǎngqǐ zài dàxué de kètáng shàng, Lù Yuǎn céngjīng jiāo tā xuéxí yǔyán.
sentences.english: She suddenly remembered in the university classroom, Lu Yuan had once taught her to study languages.

sentences.chinese: 那时候，陆远站在黑板前，耐心地教她每一个音节的发音。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shíhou, Lù Yuǎn zhàn zài hēibǎn qián, nàixīn de jiāo tā měi yīgè yīnjié de fāyīn.
sentences.english: At that time, Lu Yuan stood in front of the blackboard, patiently teaching her the pronunciation of every syllable.

sentences.chinese: 黑板上的字是黑色的，但林晓只看着陆远的眼睛。
sentences.pinyin: Hēibǎn shàng de zì shì hēisè de, dàn Lín Xiǎo zhǐ kànzhe Lù Yuǎn de yǎnjīng.
sentences.english: The characters on the blackboard were black, but Lin Xiao only looked into Lu Yuan's eyes.

sentences.chinese: 她记得陆远说，学习语言就像查字典一样，需要很多耐心。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìdé Lù Yuǎn shuō, xuéxí yǔyán jiù xiàng chá zìdiǎn yīyàng, xūyào hěnduō nàixīn.
sentences.english: She remembered Lu Yuan saying that studying a language is like looking through a dictionary; it requires a lot of patience.

sentences.chinese: 他们还讨论过不同学科的科室，比如文学和艺术。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen hái tǎolùn guò bùtóng xuékē de kēshì, bǐrú wénxué hé yìshù.
sentences.english: They had also discussed the divisions of different branches of study, such as literature and art.

sentences.chinese: 林晓非常喜欢音乐，陆远也经常带她去听音乐会。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo fēicháng xǐhuān yīnyuè, Lù Yuǎn yě jīngcháng dài tā qù tīng yīnyuèhuì.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao loved music very much, and Lu Yuan often took her to concerts.

sentences.chinese: 那是他们最幸福的时间，就像过年一样热闹而温暖。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì tāmen zuì xìngfú de shíjiān, jiù xiàng guònián yīyàng rènào ér wēnnuǎn.
sentences.english: That was their happiest time, as lively and warm as celebrating the Chinese New Year.

sentences.chinese: 她终于在一家小餐厅找到了陆远。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhōngyú zài yī jiā xiǎo cāntǐng zhǎodào le Lù Yuǎn.
sentences.english: She finally found Lu Yuan in a small restaurant.

sentences.chinese: 陆远正拿着菜单，在思考要点什么样的食物。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn zhèng názhe càidān, zài sīkǎo yào diǎn shénme yàng de shíwù.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan was holding the menu, thinking about what kind of food to order.

sentences.chinese: 他看到林晓后，立刻站了起来，眼神里充满了担心。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào Lín Xiǎo hòu, lìkè zhàn le qǐlái, yǎnjīng lǐ chōngmǎn le dānxīn.
sentences.english: After seeing Lin Xiao, he immediately stood up, his eyes full of worry.

sentences.chinese: “你怎么在这里？这里太冷了！”陆远紧紧地抱住她。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ zěnme zài zhèlǐ? Zhèlǐ tài lěng le!” Lù Yuǎn jǐnjǐn de bàozhù tā.
sentences.english: "Why are you here? It's too cold here!" Lu Yuan hugged her tightly.

sentences.chinese: 林晓在他耳边低声说：“有人在跟踪我，他有我们的照片。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo zài tā ěrbiān dīshēng shuō: “Yǒurén zài gēnzōng wǒ, tā yǒu wǒmen de zhàopiàn.”
sentences.english: Lin Xiao whispered in his ear, "Someone is following me; he has photos of us."

sentences.chinese: 陆远的神情变得严肃，他知道危险还没有结束。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn de shénqíng biàndé yánsù, tā zhīdào wēixiǎn hái méiyǒu jiéshù.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan's expression became serious; he knew the danger had not yet ended.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，林晓注意到餐厅的窗外又出现了一个熟悉的身影。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, Lín Xiǎo zhùyì dào cāntǐng de chuāngwài yòu chūxiàn le yīgè shúxī de shēnyǐng.
sentences.english: Just then, Lin Xiao noticed a familiar figure appear again outside the restaurant window.

sentences.chinese: 那个身影穿着一件深色的衣服，正冷冷地看着他们。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge shēnyǐng chuānzhe yī jiàn shēnsè de yīfú, zhèng lěnglěng de kànzhe tāmen.
sentences.english: That figure was wearing dark clothes, looking at them coldly.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 18: The Secret Outside the Window

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着窗外那个黑色的身影，全身都在发抖。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe chuāngwài nàge hēisè de shēnyǐng, quánshēn dōu zài fādǒu.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at the black figure outside the window, her whole body trembling.

sentences.chinese: 陆远紧紧握住她的手，眼神十分坚定。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn jǐnjǐn wòzhù tā de shǒu, yǎnshén shífēn jiāndìng.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan gripped her hand tightly, his gaze very firm.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“不要害怕，我一定保护你。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Bùyào hàipà, wǒ yīdìng bǎohù nǐ.”
sentences.english: He said, "Don't be afraid, I will certainly protect you."

sentences.chinese: 林晓想起以前的生活，那时她觉得世界很安全。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo xiǎngqǐ yǐqián de shēnghuó, nàshí tā juéde shìjiè hěn ānquán.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao thought of her life before; at that time, she felt the world was safe.

sentences.chinese: 但现在，危险似乎到处都是。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiànzài, wēixiǎn sìhū dàochù dōu shì.
sentences.english: But now, danger seemed to be everywhere.

sentences.chinese: 那个身影在窗外站了一会儿，后来慢慢走开了。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge shēnyǐng zài chuāngwài zhànle yīhuìr, hòulái mànmàn zǒu kāile.
sentences.english: The figure stood outside the window for a while, and then slowly walked away.

sentences.chinese: 林晓低声说：“他之前给我发了好多照片，其中有一些是我全家的。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo dīshēng shuō: “Tā zhīqián gěi wǒ fāle hǎoduō zhàopiàn, qízhōng yǒuxiē shì wǒ quánjiā de.”
sentences.english: Lin Xiao whispered, "He sent me so many photos before, among which some were of my whole family."

sentences.chinese: 陆远心中大惊，他意识到对方掌握了大量关于林晓的信息。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn xīnzhōng dàjīng, tā yìshí dào duìfāng zhǎngwòle dàliàng guānyú Lín Xiǎo de xìnxī.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan was shocked; he realized the other party possessed a large amount of information about Lin Xiao.

sentences.chinese: 原来，这个人的目的不仅仅是跟踪，而是想控制她。
sentences.pinyin: Yuánlái, zhège rén de mùdì bùjǐnjǐn shì gēnzōng, ér shì xiǎng kòngzhì tā.
sentences.english: It turned out that this person's goal was not just stalking, but wanting to control her.

sentences.chinese: 林晓告诉陆远，她以前在全国不同的城市工作过，但从没见过这样的人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo gàosù Lù Yuǎn, tā yǐqián zài quánguó bùtóng de chéngshì gōngzuòguò, dàn cóngméi jiànguò zhèyàng de rén.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao told Lu Yuan that she had worked in different cities across the whole country before, but had never met such a person.

sentences.chinese: 在那些地方，大多数人都是友好的，只有极少数人会这样做。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nàxiē dìfāng, dàduōshù rén dōu shì yǒuhǎo de, zhǐyǒu jí shǎoshù rén huì zhèyàng zuò.
sentences.english: In those places, the majority of people were friendly, and only a very small minority would act this way.

sentences.chinese: 陆远看着她，心中产生了一种想要守护她一生的冲动。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn kànzhe tā, xīnzhōng chǎnshēngle yī zhǒng xiǎng yào shǒuhù tā yīshēng de chōngdòng.
sentences.english: Looking at her, Lu Yuan felt an impulse to protect her for all his life.

sentences.chinese: 他轻声说：“今后，无论发生什么，我都会在你身边。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā qīngshēng shuō: “Jīnhòu, wúlùn fāshēng shénme, wǒ dūhuì zài nǐ shēnbiān.”
sentences.english: He said softly, "From now on, no matter what happens, I will be by your side."

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着陆远，觉得这种感觉同样让她心安。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe Lù Yuǎn, juéde zhè zhǒng gǎnjué tóngyàng ràng tā xīn'ān.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at Lu Yuan and felt that this feeling equally brought her peace of mind.

sentences.chinese: 他们坐下来，开始讨论如何应对这个威胁。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zuò xiàlái, kāishǐ tǎolùn rúhé yìngduì zhège wēixié.
sentences.english: They sat down and began to discuss how to deal with this threat.

sentences.chinese: 陆远说：“我们要把全部线索告诉警察，这样才够安全。”
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn shuō: “Wǒmen yào bǎ quánbù xiànsuǒ gàosù jǐngchá, zhèyàng cái gòu ānquán.”
sentences.english: Lu Yuan said, "We must tell the police all the clues; only then will it be safe enough."

sentences.chinese: 林晓点头，她知道现在不能完全相信任何人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo diǎntóu, tā zhīdào xiànzài bùnéng wánquán xìnxìn rènhé rén.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao nodded; she knew she could not completely trust anyone right now.

sentences.chinese: 她想起去年和陆远认识的周年纪念日，那时候他们还很单纯。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ qùnián hé Lù Yuǎn rènshí de zhōunián jìniànrì, nàshí tāmen hái hěn dānchún.
sentences.english: She remembered the anniversary of when she met Lu Yuan last year; they were still very innocent then.

sentences.chinese: 当时他们在一起的时间一共只有几个月，但感情却大大地增长了。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngshí tāmen zài yīqǐ de shíjiān yīgòng zhǐyǒu jǐ gè yuè, dàn gǎnqíng què dàdà de zēngzhǎngle.
sentences.english: At that time, the total time they had been together was only a few months, but their feelings had grown greatly.

sentences.chinese: 现在，他们面临的情况变得十分复杂。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài, tāmen miànlín de qíngkuàng biàndé shífēn fùzá.
sentences.english: Now, the situation they faced had become very complex.

sentences.chinese: 在大多数情况下，林晓习惯一个人解决问题。
sentences.pinyin: Zài dàduōshù qíngkuàng xià, Lín Xiǎo xíguàn yīgè rén jiějué wèntí.
sentences.english: In most cases, Lin Xiao was used to solving problems alone.

sentences.chinese: 但这次，她发现大部分的压力让她快要崩溃。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zhè cì, tā fāxiàn dàbùfen de yālì ràng tā kuài yào bēngkuì.
sentences.english: But this time, she found that the majority of the pressure was making her almost break down.

sentences.chinese: 此时，陆远地手机响了，是他的同事发来的消息。
sentences.pinyin: Cǐshí, Lù Yuǎn de shǒujī xiǎngle, shì tā de tóngshì fā lái de xiāoxī.
sentences.english: At this moment, Lu Yuan's phone rang; it was a message from his colleague.

sentences.chinese: 消息说，全体员工都被要求参加一个紧急会议。
sentences.pinyin: Xiāoxī shuō, quántǐ yuángōng dōu bèi yāoqiú cānjiā yīgè jǐnjí huìyì.
sentences.english: The message said that all employees were required to attend an emergency meeting.

sentences.chinese: 会议的主题是关于公司在全国范围内的安全升级。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì de zhǔtí shì guānyú gōngsī zài quánguó fànwéi nèi de ānquán shēngjí.
sentences.english: The theme of the meeting was about the company's security upgrade nationwide.

sentences.chinese: 陆远意识到，这件事可能不仅仅影响他一个人，而且涉及很多人。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn yìshí dào, zhè jiàn shì kěnéng bùjǐnjǐn yǐngxiǎng tā yīgè rén, érqiě shèjí hěnduō rén.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan realized that this matter might not only affect him alone but involve many people.

sentences.chinese: 他在想，如果对方的级别在经理以上，那么事情就更糟糕了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài xiǎng, rúguǒ duìfāng de jíbié zài jīnglǐ yǐshàng, nàme shìqíng jiù gèng zāogāo le.
sentences.english: He wondered if the other party's level was manager or higher, then things would be even worse.

sentences.chinese: 他同时在思考，对方为什么会对林晓这么感兴趣。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tóngshí zài sīkǎo, duìfāng wèishéme huì duì Lín Xiǎo zhème gǎn xìngqù.
sentences.english: At the same time, he was thinking about why the other party was so interested in Lin Xiao.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，在很多人的心中，林晓是一个非常优秀的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhīdào, zài hěnduō rén de xīnzhōng, Lín Xiǎo shì yīgè fēicháng yōuxiù de rén.
sentences.english: He knew that in the hearts of many people, Lin Xiao was a very outstanding person.

sentences.chinese: 他看着林晓，发现她又在担心事情的后果了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe Lín Xiǎo, fāxiàn tā yòu zài dānxīn shìqíng de hòuguǒ le.
sentences.english: He looked at Lin Xiao and found she was once again worrying about the consequences.

sentences.chinese: 他温柔地抱住她，让她感觉到温暖。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wēnróu de bàozhù tā, ràng tā gǎnjué dào wēnnuǎn.
sentences.english: He hugged her gently, letting her feel the warmth.

sentences.chinese: 林晓闭上眼睛，心里默默地祈祷，希望这一切能快点结束。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo bìshàng yǎnjīng, xīn lǐ mòmò de qǐdǎo, xīwàng zhè yīqiè néng kuài diǎn jiéshù.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao closed her eyes and prayed silently in her heart, hoping that all of this could end quickly.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，她的手机突然收到了一条新短信，发件人竟然又是那个陌生人。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, tā de shǒujī tūrán shōudào le yī tiáo xīn duǎnxìn, fājiànrén jìngrán yòu shì nàge mòshēng rén.
sentences.english: But just then, her phone suddenly received a new text message, and the sender was actually that stranger again.

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着手机上的短信，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe shǒujī shàng de duǎnxìn, xīntiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at the text message on her phone, her heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 短信里写着：“我知道你现在在哪里。”
sentences.pinyin: Duǎnxìn lǐ xiězhe: “Wǒ zhīdào nǐ xiànzài zài nǎlǐ.”
sentences.english: The text read: "I know where you are right now."

sentences.chinese: 她实在太害怕了，身体在微微发抖。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shízài tài hàipà le, shēntǐ zài wēiwēi fādǒu.
sentences.english: She was really too scared, her body trembling slightly.

sentences.chinese: 当时，她以为那些危险已经过去了。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngshí, tā yǐwéi nàxiē wēixiǎn yǐjīng guòqù le.
sentences.english: At that time, she thought those dangers had already passed.

sentences.chinese: 但忽然，她意识到那个陌生人一直就在身边。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn hūrán, tā yìshí dào nàge mòshēng rén yīzhí jiù zài shēnbiān.
sentences.english: But suddenly, she realized that the stranger had been by her side all along.

sentences.chinese: 所以，她紧紧地抓住了陆远的手。
sentences.pinyin: Suǒyǐ, tā jǐnjǐn de zhuā zhù le Lù Yuǎn de shǒu.
sentences.english: Therefore, she gripped Lu Yuan's hand tightly.

sentences.chinese: 她觉得对方是故意地在威胁她，想让她感到绝望。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde duìfāng shì gùyì de zài wēixié tā, xiǎng ràng tā gǎndào juéwàng.
sentences.english: She felt that the other party was deliberately threatening her, wanting her to feel despair.

sentences.chinese: 她问陆远：“是不是有人在跟踪我们？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn Lù Yuǎn: “Shì bú shì yǒurén zài gēnzōng wǒmen?”
sentences.english: She asked Lu Yuan, "Is someone following us?"

sentences.chinese: 陆远看着她的眼睛，语气坚定地说：“正是因为有我在，你不需要担心。”
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn kànzhe tā de yǎnjīng, yǔqì jiāndìng de shuō: “Zhèngshì yīnwèi yǒu wǒ zài, nǐ bù xūyào dānxīn.”
sentences.english: Lu Yuan looked into her eyes and said in a firm tone, "It is precisely because I am here that you don't need to worry."

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着他，心中觉得这份爱可以永远延续。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe tā, xīnzhōng juéde zhè fèn ài kěyǐ yǒngyuǎn yánxù.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at him, feeling in her heart that this love could last forever.

sentences.chinese: 然后，她想起了很多事情。
sentences.pinyin: Ránhòu, tā xiǎngqǐ le hěnduō shìqíng.
sentences.english: Then, she remembered many things.

sentences.chinese: 她发现自己和陆远有着相同的梦想，都希望生活能平静一点。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn zìjǐ hé Lù Yuǎn yǒuzhe xiāngtóng de mèngxiǎng, dōu xīwàng shēnghuó néng píngjìng yīdiǎn.
sentences.english: She discovered that she and Lu Yuan shared the same dreams, both hoping that life could be a bit more peaceful.

sentences.chinese: 这就是真正地爱一个人，愿意为了对方面对所有困难。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiùshì zhēnzhèng de ài yīgè rén, yuànyì wèile duìfāng miànduì suǒyǒu kùnnán.
