sentences.english: This is what it means to truly love someone, being willing to face all difficulties for the other person.

sentences.chinese: 但林晓老是担心，自己会给陆远带来麻烦。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn Lín Xiǎo lǎoshì dānxīn, zìjǐ huì gěi Lù Yuǎn dàilái máfan.
sentences.english: But Lin Xiao was always worried that she would bring trouble to Lu Yuan.

sentences.chinese: 在过去的几天里，她经历了许多不安的事情。
sentences.pinyin: Zài guòqù de jǐ tiān lǐ, tā jīnglì le xǔduō bù'ān de shìqíng.
sentences.english: In the past few days, she had experienced many unsettling things.

sentences.chinese: 她觉得周围的环境越来越陌生，也越来越危险。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde zhōuwéi de huánjìng yuè lái yuè mòshēng, yě yuè lái yuè wēixiǎn.
sentences.english: She felt the surrounding environment becoming more and more strange, and more and more dangerous.

sentences.chinese: 她没想到事情会变得这么复杂。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méi xiǎngdào shìqíng huì biàn de zhème fùzá.
sentences.english: She didn't expect things to become so complicated.

sentences.chinese: 这时，陆远轻轻地吻了她的额头。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, Lù Yuǎn qīngqīng de wěn le tā de étóu.
sentences.english: At this moment, Lu Yuan gently kissed her forehead.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“这样想没有用，我们要一起解决。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zhèyàng xiǎng méiyǒu yòng, wǒmen yào yīqǐ jiějué.”
sentences.english: He said, "Thinking this way is useless; we must solve it together."

sentences.chinese: 林晓轻声问：“那么，我们该怎么做？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo qīngshēng wèn: “Nàme, wǒmen gāi zěnme zuò?”
sentences.english: Lin Xiao asked softly, "Then, what should we do?"

sentences.chinese: 她记得那时，她还很年轻，以为爱情就是那样简单的东西。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde nàshí, tā hái hěn niánqīng, yǐwéi àiqíng jiùshì nàyàng jiǎndān de dōngxī.
sentences.english: She remembered that back then, she was still very young and thought love was just that kind of simple thing.

sentences.chinese: 但现在她知道，真正的关系需要重新建立信任。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiànzài tā zhīdào, zhēnzhèng de guānxì xūyào chóngxīn jiànlì xìnrèn.
sentences.english: But now she knows that a genuine relationship requires rebuilding trust.

sentences.chinese: 这段路虽然很长，但只要有他在，她就有勇气走下去。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn lù suīrán hěn cháng, dàn zhǐyào yǒu tā zài, tā jiù yǒu yǒngqì zǒu xiàqù.
sentences.english: Although this road is long, as long as he is there, she has the courage to keep going.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，陆远的手机也响了，是一个未知的号码。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhèshí, Lù Yuǎn de shǒujī yě xiǎng le, shì yīgè wèizhī de hàomǎ.
sentences.english: Just then, Lu Yuan's phone also rang; it was an unknown number.

sentences.chinese: 陆远看着手机，脸色突然变得很严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn kànzhe shǒujī, liǎnsè tūrán biànde hěn yánsù.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan looked at his phone, and his expression suddenly became very serious.

sentences.chinese: 他说，这个电话来自他的公司。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, zhège diànhuà láizì tā de gōngsī.
sentences.english: He said that this call came from his company.

sentences.chinese: 他的公司在市中心，是一个很大的贸易公司。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de gōngsī zài shì zhōngxīn, shì yígè hěn dà de màoyì gōngsī.
sentences.english: His company is in the city center, a very large trading company.

sentences.chinese: 陆远在这个单位工作了很多年，现在是公司的经理。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn zài zhège dānwèi gōngzuòle hěnduō nián, xiànzài shì gōngsī de jīnglǐ.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan has worked in this work unit for many years and is now the company manager.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林晓，他必须回办公室处理一件紧急的事情。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Lín Xiǎo, tā bìxū huí bàngōngshì chǔlǐ yíjiàn jǐnjí de shìqíng.
sentences.english: He told Lin Xiao that he must return to the office to handle an urgent matter.

sentences.chinese: 林晓陪他一起走，路上她看到很多匆忙的商人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo péi tā yìqǐ zǒu, lùshàng tā kàndào hěnduō cōngmáng de shāngrén.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao walked with him, and on the way, she saw many hurried businessmen.

sentences.chinese: 进入大楼后，很多同事向陆远点头微笑，态度很友好。
sentences.pinyin: Jìnrù dàlóu hòu, hěnduō tóngshì xiàng Lù Yuǎn diǎntóu wēixiào, tàidù hěn yǒuhǎo.
sentences.english: After entering the building, many colleagues nodded and smiled at Lu Yuan, their attitude very friendly.

sentences.chinese: 陆远向她介绍，这里的每个人都是他的好同事。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn xiàng tā jièshào, zhèlǐ de měi gèrén dōu shì tā de hǎo tóngshì.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan introduced to her that everyone here was a good colleague of his.

sentences.chinese: 办公室里有很多客人，他们都在等待谈生意。
sentences.pinyin: Bàngōngshì lǐ yǒu hěnduō kèrén, tāmen dōu zài děngdài tán shēngyì.
sentences.english: There were many guests in the office, all waiting to discuss business.

sentences.chinese: 林晓注意到，有一个顾客在认真地看陆远的笔记。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo zhùyì dào, yǒu yígè gùkè zài rènzhēn de kàn Lù Yuǎn de bǐjì.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao noticed that a customer was carefully looking at Lu Yuan's notes.

sentences.chinese: 陆远笑着说，那些笔记是他高中时候就开始写的习惯。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn xiàozhe shuō, nàxiē bǐjì shì tā gāo zhōng shíhòu jiù kāishǐ xiě de xíguàn.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan said with a smile that those notes were a habit he started in high school.

sentences.chinese: 他记得在高中一年级的时候，他就是班长。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde zài gāo zhōng yì niánjí de shíhòu, tā jiùshì bānzhǎng.
sentences.english: He remembered that in the first grade of high school, he was the class monitor.

sentences.chinese: 那时候的他很优秀，还是学校足球队的队长。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shíhòu de tā hěn yōuxiù, háishì xuéxiào zúqiú duì de duìzhǎng.
sentences.english: He was very outstanding back then and was also the captain of the school soccer team.

sentences.chinese: 他带领自己的球队赢了很多比赛，是队里最勇敢的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàilǐng zìjǐ de qiúduì yíngle hěnduō bǐsài, shì duì lǐ zuì yǒnggǎn de rén.
sentences.english: He led his sports team to win many matches and was the bravest person in the team.

sentences.chinese: 他想起以前的队，每个人都像家人一样。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ yǐqián de duì, měi gèrén dōu xiàng jiārén yíyàng.
sentences.english: He thought of his old team, where everyone was like family.

sentences.chinese: 但现在，他的生活变得复杂了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiànzài, tā de shēnghuó biànde fùzá le.
sentences.english: But now, his life had become complicated.

sentences.chinese: 一个中年男人走过来，他是这个项目的组长。
sentences.pinyin: Yígè zhōngnián nánrén zǒu guòlái, tā shì zhège xiàngmù de zǔzhǎng.
sentences.english: A middle-aged man walked over; he was the group leader of this project.

sentences.chinese: 这个男人看起来像个严肃的家长，说话很有威严。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège nánrén kàn qǐlái xiàng gè yánsù de jiāzhǎng, shuōhuà hěn yǒu wēiyán.
sentences.english: This man looked like a stern head of household, speaking with great authority.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉陆远，大学校长想要见他，讨论一个合作计划。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Lù Yuǎn, dàxué xiàozhǎng xiǎng yào jiàn tā, tǎolùn yígè hézuò jìhuà.
sentences.english: He told Lu Yuan that the university president wanted to see him to discuss a cooperation plan.

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着陆远，觉得这个男人像个谜，她希望他是自己的爱人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe Lù Yuǎn, juéde zhège nánrén xiàng gè mí, tā xīwàng tā shì zìjǐ de àiren.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at Lu Yuan, feeling that this man was like a mystery; she hoped he could be her lover.

sentences.chinese: 这时，陆远的手机再次响起，是一个关于飞机起飞的通知。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, Lù Yuǎn de shǒujī zàicì xiǎngqǐ, shì yígè guānyú fēijī qǐfēi de tōngzhī.
sentences.english: At that moment, Lu Yuan's phone rang again; it was a notification about a plane taking off.

sentences.chinese: 他必须在两个小时内赶到机场，否则就没机会了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū zài liǎng gè xiǎoshí nèi gǎndào jīchǎng, fǒuzé jiù méi jīhuì le.
sentences.english: He must get to the airport within two hours, otherwise, there would be no chance.

sentences.chinese: 林晓突然意识到，红院长可能就在那架飞机上。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo tūrán yìshí dào, Hóng yuànzhǎng kěnéng jiù zài nà jià fēijī shàng.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao suddenly realized that Dean Hong might be on that plane.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十一章：机场的抉择
chapters.title_english: Chapter 21: The Choice at the Airport

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着陆远，心里感到很不安。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe Lù Yuǎn, xīnlǐ gǎndào hěn bù'ān.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at Lu Yuan, feeling very uneasy in her heart.

sentences.chinese: 她以为红院长会离开这个城市，但她担心他会再次出现。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǐwéi Hóng yuànzhǎng huì líkāi zhège chéngshì, dàn tā dānxīn tā huì zàicì chūxiàn.
sentences.english: She thought Dean Hong would leave the city, but she worried he would appear again.

sentences.chinese: 陆远发现林晓在发抖，他温柔地握住她的手。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn fāxiàn Lín Xiǎo zài fādǒu, tā wēnróu de wòzhù tā de shǒu.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan noticed Lin Xiao was trembling, and he gently held her hand.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“我知道你在担心，但请相信我。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ zhīdào nǐ zài dānxīn, dàn qǐng xiāngxìn wǒ.”
sentences.english: He said, "I know you are worried, but please believe me."

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着他的眼睛，感觉到了他内心深处的信心。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe tā de yǎnjīng, gǎnjué dàole tā nèixīn shēnchù de xìnxīn.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked into his eyes and felt the confidence deep within his heart.

sentences.chinese: 陆远非常关心她，这种感觉让林晓很感动。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn fēicháng guānxīn tā, zhè zhǒng gǎnjué ràng Lín Xiǎo hěn gǎndòng.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan cared for her deeply, and this feeling moved Lin Xiao very much.

sentences.chinese: 她认为陆远是一个勇敢的人，能够解决所有问题。
sentences.pinyin: Tā rènwéi Lù Yuǎn shì yígè yǒnggǎn de rén, nénggòu jiějué suǒyǒu wèntí.
sentences.english: She believed Lu Yuan was a brave person who could solve all the problems.

sentences.chinese: 但林晓心里还是觉得难过，因为她害怕失去他。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn Lín Xiǎo xīnlǐ háishì juéde nánguò, yīnwèi tā hàipà shīqù tā.
sentences.english: But Lin Xiao still felt sad in her heart because she was afraid of losing him.

sentences.chinese: 想到这里，她的心隐隐地疼。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎng dào zhèlǐ, tā de xīn yǐnyǐn de téng.
sentences.english: Thinking of this, her heart ached faintly.

sentences.chinese: 她低声说：“不好意思，我让你担心了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dīshēng shuō: “Bù hǎo yì si, wǒ ràng nǐ dānxīn le.”
sentences.english: She whispered, "I'm sorry for making you worry."

sentences.chinese: 陆远笑了，他说：“你的想法不对，照顾你是我的快乐。”
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn xiàole, tā shuō: “Nǐ de xiǎngfǎ búduì, zhàogù nǐ shì wǒ de kuàilè.”
sentences.english: Lu Yuan smiled and said, "Your way of thinking is wrong; taking care of you is my happiness."

sentences.chinese: 林晓听到这句话，心情突然变得开心起来。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo tīngdào zhè jù huà, xīnqíng tūrán biànde kāixīn qǐlái.
sentences.english: Hearing these words, Lin Xiao's mood suddenly became happy.

sentences.chinese: 他们快步走向机场，空气中有一种紧张的味道。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen kuàibù zǒuxiàng jīchǎng, kōngqì zhōng yǒu yì zhǒng jǐnzhāng de wèidào.
sentences.english: They walked quickly toward the airport, and there was a scent of tension in the air.

sentences.chinese: 林晓懂得陆远现在的压力很大，他必须努力地寻找红院长。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo dǒngde Lù Yuǎn xiànzài de yālì hěn dà, tā bìxū nǔlì de xúnzhǎo Hóng yuànzhǎng.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao understood that Lu Yuan was under great pressure now; he had to strive to find Dean Hong.

sentences.chinese: 她问陆远：“如果你找到了他，你会怎么做？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn Lù Yuǎn: “Rúguǒ nǐ zhǎodàole tā, nǐ huì zěnme zuò?”
sentences.english: She asked Lu Yuan, "If you find him, what will you do?"

sentences.chinese: 陆远没有立刻答应她的要求，而是陷入了思考。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn méiyǒu lìkè dāying tā de yāoqiú, érshì xiànrùle sīkǎo.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan did not immediately agree to her request, but instead fell into thought.

sentences.chinese: 林晓认为，陆远一定有一个更好的计划。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo rènwéi, Lù Yuǎn yídìng yǒu yígè gèng hǎo de jìhuà.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao believed that Lu Yuan must have a better plan.

sentences.chinese: 但此时，林晓感到身体有些难受，可能是因为太紧张了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn cǐshí, Lín Xiǎo gǎndào shēntǐ yǒuxiē nánshòu, kěnéng shì yīnwèi tài jǐnzhāng le.
sentences.english: But at this moment, Lin Xiao felt physically unwell, perhaps because she was too nervous.

sentences.chinese: 陆远停下来，耐心地照顾她，直到她放心。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn tíng xiàlái, nàixīn de zhàogù tā, zhídào tā fàngxīn.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan stopped and patiently took care of her until she felt relieved.

sentences.chinese: 林晓发现，陆远比任何人都懂她的心。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo fāxiàn, Lù Yuǎn bǐ rènhé rén dōu dǒng tā de xīn.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao discovered that Lu Yuan understood her heart better than anyone.

sentences.chinese: 她对他的一切都感到满意，因为他懂得如何爱一个人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì tā de yíqiè dōu gǎndào mǎnyì, yīnwèi tā dǒngde rúhé ài yígè rén.
sentences.english: She felt satisfied with everything about him because he knew how to love someone.

sentences.chinese: 就在他们到达登机口时，一个熟悉的身影出现在了人群中。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tāmen dàodá dēngjīkǒu shí, yígè shúxī de shēnyǐng chūxiàn zàile rénqún zhōng.
sentences.english: Just as they reached the boarding gate, a familiar figure appeared in the crowd.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十二章：短暂的平静

sentences.chinese: 那个熟悉的身影竟然是红院长，但他很快就消失在人群中。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge shúxī de shēnyǐng jìngrán shì Hóng yuànzhǎng, dàn tā hěn kuài jiù xiāoshī zài rénqún zhōng.
sentences.english: That familiar figure turned out to be Director Hong, but he quickly disappeared into the crowd.

sentences.chinese: 陆远看着林晓，轻声问她：“现在感觉怎么样？”
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn kànzhe Lín Xiǎo, qīngshēng wèn tā: “Xiànzài gǎnjué zěnmeyàng?”
sentences.english: Lu Yuan looked at Lin Xiao and asked softly, "How are you feeling now?"

sentences.chinese: 林晓对他笑了笑，虽然心里还是很不安。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo duì tā xiàole xiào, suīrán xīnlǐ háishì hěn bù'ān.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao smiled at him, although she was still uneasy in her heart.

sentences.chinese: 为了让她放松，陆远决定这个周末带她去休息。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile ràng tā fàngsōng, Lù Yuǎn juédìng zhège zhōumò dài tā qù xiūxi.
sentences.english: To let her relax, Lu Yuan decided to take her to rest this weekend.

sentences.chinese: 他们离开机场，回到了那家高级酒店。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen líkāi jīchǎng, huí dào le nà jiā gāojí jiǔdiàn.
sentences.english: They left the airport and returned to that high-end hotel.

sentences.chinese: 到了房间，林晓打开笔记本，想记录下今天发生的事情。
sentences.pinyin: Dào le fángjiān, Lín Xiǎo dǎkāi bǐjìběn, xiǎng jìlù xià jīntiān fāshēng de shìqíng.
sentences.english: Once in the room, Lin Xiao opened her notebook, wanting to record the events of today.

sentences.chinese: 她想起之前在那个小店里见到的秘密，心情变得更沉重了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zhīqián zài nàge xiǎo diàn lǐ jiàndào de mìmì, xīnqíng biàndé gèng chénzhòng le.
sentences.english: She thought of the secret she had seen in that small shop, and her mood became even heavier.

sentences.chinese: 到了中午，陆远问她想吃什么午餐。
sentences.pinyin: Dào le zhōngwǔ, Lù Yuǎn wèn tā xiǎng chī shénme wǔcān.
sentences.english: At noon, Lu Yuan asked her what she wanted for lunch.

sentences.chinese: 林晓说她不想出去，于是他们点了一些外卖。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo shuō tā bù xiǎng chūqù, yúshì tāmen diǎnle yīxiē wàimài.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao said she didn't want to go out, so they ordered some takeout.

sentences.chinese: 他们点了一份中餐和一份西餐，想尝试不同的味道。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen diǎnle yī fèn zhōngcān hé yī fèn xīcān, xiǎng chángshì bùtóng de wèidào.
sentences.english: They ordered a Chinese meal and a Western meal, wanting to try different flavors.

sentences.chinese: 虽然只是简单的午餐，但林晓觉得很温暖。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán zhǐshì jiǎndān de wǔcān, dàn Lín Xiǎo juéde hěn wēnnuǎn.
sentences.english: Although it was just a simple lunch, Lin Xiao felt it was very warm.

sentences.chinese: 下午，为了缓解压力，陆远陪她在酒店的健身房做了一些运动。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàwǔ, wèile huǎnjiě yālì, Lù Yuǎn péi tā zài jiǔdiàn de jiànshēnfáng zuòle yīxiē yùndòng.
sentences.english: In the afternoon, to relieve stress, Lu Yuan accompanied her to do some exercise in the hotel gym.

sentences.chinese: 晚上，陆远决定请客，带她去一家有名的饭馆吃晚餐。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnshàng, Lù Yuǎn juédìng qǐngkè, dài tā qù yī jiā yǒumíng de fànguǎn chī wǎncān.
sentences.english: In the evening, Lu Yuan decided to treat her and take her to a famous restaurant for dinner.

sentences.chinese: 那家饭馆的环境很好，服务员给他们端上了好酒。
sentences.pinyin: Nà jiā fànguǎn de huánjìng hěn hǎo, fúwùyuán gěi tāmen duān shàngle hǎo jiǔ.
sentences.english: The environment of that restaurant was very good, and the waiter served them some fine wine.

sentences.chinese: 陆远举起杯子，对林晓说：“干杯，为了我们的未来。”
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn jǔqǐ bēizi, duì Lín Xiǎo shuō: “Gānbēi, wèile wǒmen de wèilái.”
sentences.english: Lu Yuan raised his glass and said to Lin Xiao, "Cheers, to our future."

sentences.chinese: 晚餐后，他们走在街上，林晓看到路边有人在卖晚报。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎncān hòu, tāmen zǒu zài jiē shàng, Lín Xiǎo kàndào lùbiān yǒurén zài mài wǎnbào.
sentences.english: After dinner, they walked on the street, and Lin Xiao saw someone selling evening newspapers by the road.

sentences.chinese: 报纸上写着关于红院长的消息，林晓感到一阵心惊。
sentences.pinyin: Bàozhǐ shàng xiězhe guānyú Hóng yuànzhǎng de xiāoxī, Lín Xiǎo gǎndào yīzhèn xīnjīng.
sentences.english: The newspaper mentioned news about Director Hong, and Lin Xiao felt a surge of alarm.

sentences.chinese: 回到酒店后，陆远告诉她，明天晚上有一个重要的晚会。
sentences.pinyin: Huí dào jiǔdiàn hòu, Lù Yuǎn gàosù tā, míngtiān wǎnshàng yǒu yīgè zhòngyào de wǎnhuì.
sentences.english: After returning to the hotel, Lu Yuan told her that there was an important evening party tomorrow night.

sentences.chinese: 他希望林晓能陪他一起去，面对所有的真相。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xīwàng Lín Xiǎo néng péi tā yīqǐ qù, miànduì suǒyǒu de zhēnxiàng.
sentences.english: He hoped Lin Xiao could go with him to face all the truths.

sentences.chinese: 夜里，林晓躺在床上，无法入睡。
sentences.pinyin: Yèlǐ, Lín Xiǎo tǎng zài chuáng shàng, wúfǎ rùshuì.
sentences.english: During the night, Lin Xiao lay in bed, unable to fall asleep.

sentences.chinese: 她想起半夜时分，窗外总是有奇怪的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ bànyè shífèn, chuāngwài zǒng shì yǒu qíguài de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: She remembered that in the middle of the night, there were always strange sounds outside the window.

sentences.chinese: 在寂静的夜里，她只能紧紧握着陆远的手。
sentences.pinyin: Zài jìjìng de yèlǐ, tā zhǐnéng jǐnjǐn wòzhe Lù Yuǎn de shǒu.
sentences.english: In the silent night, she could only tightly hold Lu Yuan's hand.

sentences.chinese: 陆远吻了她的额头，温柔地说：“晚安，我会保护你。”
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn wěnle tā de étóu, wēnróu de shuō: “Wǎn'ān, wǒ huì bǎohù nǐ.”
sentences.english: Lu Yuan kissed her forehead and said gently, "Good night, I will protect you."

sentences.chinese: 但林晓知道，这场危险的游戏还没有结束。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn Lín Xiǎo zhīdào, zhè chǎng wēixiǎn de yóuxì hái méiyǒu jiéshù.
sentences.english: But Lin Xiao knew that this dangerous game had not yet ended.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十三章：旧日的碎片

sentences.chinese: 第二天早晨，林晓醒来时，发现陆远已经不在身边。
sentences.pinyin: Dì èr shí sān zhāng: Jiù rì de suì piàn
sentences.english: The next morning, when Lin Xiao woke up, she found that Lu Yuan was already gone.

sentences.chinese: 她走到厨房，看到桌上有一碗热腾腾的方便面，旁边有一张纸条。
sentences.pinyin: Dì èr tiān zǎochén, Lín Xiǎo xǐng lái shí, fā xiàn Lù Yuǎn yǐ jīng bù zài shēn biān.
sentences.english: She walked to the kitchen and saw a bowl of steaming instant noodles on the table, with a note beside it.

sentences.chinese: 纸条上写着：我去帮你找一个便宜的出租屋，这样我们在一起更方便。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu dào chú fáng, kàn dào zhuō shàng yǒu yì wǎn rè téng téng de fāng biàn miàn, páng biān yǒu yì zhāng zhǐ tiáo.
sentences.english: The note read: "I'm going to help you find a cheap rental apartment so it's more convenient for us to be together."

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着纸条，心中感到一阵温暖，因为陆远总是这么体贴，是个好处很多的人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐ tiáo shàng xiě zhe: Wǒ qù bāng nǐ zhǎo yí gè pián yi de chū zū wū, zhè yàng wǒ men zài yì qǐ gèng fāng biàn.
sentences.english: Looking at the note, Lin Xiao felt a wave of warmth in her heart because Lu Yuan was always so considerate and easy to get along with.

sentences.chinese: 她想起小时候，自己在一个小城市出生，那时候的生活很简单。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kàn zhe zhǐ tiáo, xīn zhōng gǎn dào yì zhèn wēn nuǎn, yīn wèi Lù Yuǎn zǒng shì zhè me tǐ tiē, shì gè hǎo chǔ hěn duō de rén.
sentences.english: She remembered her childhood, being born in a small city; life was very simple back then.

sentences.chinese: 她在那儿长大，每天听奶奶讲很多有趣的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ xiǎo shí hou, zì jǐ zài yí gè xiǎo chéng shì chū shēng, nà shí hou de shēng huó hěn jiǎn dān.
sentences.english: She grew up there, listening to her grandmother tell many interesting stories every day.

sentences.chinese: 但长大后的生活并不简单，她已经经历了太多的痛苦。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài nà r zhǎng dà, měi tiān tīng nǎi nai jiǎng hěn duō yǒu qù de gù shì.
sentences.english: But life after growing up was not simple; she had already experienced too much pain.

sentences.chinese: 这时候，她的手机突然响了，她收到了一条陌生短信。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zhǎng dà hòu de shēng huó bìng bù jiǎn dān, tā yǐ jīng jīng lì le tài duō de tòng kǔ.
sentences.english: At this moment, her phone suddenly rang, and she received a strange text message.

sentences.chinese: 短信说：“我知道你在哪里，快出来。”
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí hòu, tā de shǒu jī tū rán xiǎng le, tā shōu dào le yì tiáo mò shēng xìn xún.
sentences.english: The message said: "I know where you are, come out quickly."

sentences.chinese: 林晓心跳加快，她紧张地想：如果红院长回来了，我该怎么办？
sentences.pinyin: Xìn xún shuō: “Wǒ zhī dào nǐ zài nǎ lǐ, kuài chū lái.”
sentences.english: Lin Xiao's heart beat faster, and she thought nervously: If Dean Hong has returned, what should I do?

sentences.chinese: 她赶紧穿上衣服，走进了酒店的大门。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo xīn tiào jiā kuài, tā jǐn zhāng de xiǎng: Rú guǒ Hóng yuàn zhǎng huí lái le, wǒ gāi zěn me bàn?
sentences.english: She quickly put on her clothes and entered the hotel's main entrance.

sentences.chinese: 在街上，她看到很多人在排队买早点，人群中一个黑色的身影让她心惊。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎn jǐn chuān shàng yī fu, zǒu jìn le jiǔ diàn de dà mén.
sentences.english: On the street, she saw many people lining up to buy breakfast, and a black figure in the crowd startled her.

sentences.chinese: 那个身影看起来很像红院长，但她不确定是否真的见到了他。
sentences.pinyin: Zài jiē shàng, tā kàn dào hěn duō rén zài pái duì mǎi zǎo diǎn, rén qún zhōng yí gè hēi sè de shēn yǐng ràng tā xīn jīng.
sentences.english: That figure looked a lot like Dean Hong, but she wasn't sure if she had actually seen him.

sentences.chinese: 她想起之前见过那个人的眼神，冷漠得像一块冰，它让林晓感到害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè shēn yǐng kàn qǐ lái hěn xiàng Hóng yuàn zhǎng, dàn tā bù què dìng shì fǒu zhēn de jiàn dào le tā.
sentences.english: She recalled the look in that person's eyes she had seen before; it was as cold as a block of ice, and it made Lin Xiao feel afraid.

sentences.chinese: 她快步向前走，突然听到身后有人大喊：“站住！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ zhī qián jiàn guò nà gè rén de yǎn shén, lěng mò de xiàng yí kuài bīng, tā ràng Lín Xiǎo gǎn dào hài pà.
sentences.english: She walked quickly forward when she suddenly heard someone shout from behind: "Stop!"

sentences.chinese: 林晓猛地回头，结果发现是一个送快递的人，他要把包裹送到她手里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kuài bù xiàng qián zǒu, tū rán tīng dào shēn hòu yǒu rén dà hǎn: “Zhàn zhù!”
sentences.english: Lin Xiao turned around abruptly, only to find it was a delivery person who wanted to deliver a package to her.

sentences.chinese: 就在这个关键的节骨眼上，林晓才意识到自己太紧张了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo měng de huí tóu, jié guǒ fā xiàn shì yí gè sòng kuài dì de rén, tā yào bǎ bāo guǒ sòng dào tā shǒu lǐ.
sentences.english: At this critical juncture, Lin Xiao realized she had been too nervous.

sentences.chinese: 她接过包裹，轻轻点头示意谢谢。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè gè guān jiàn de jié gǔ jié yan shàng, Lín Xiǎo cái yì shí dào zì jǐ tài jǐn zhāng le.
sentences.english: She took the package and nodded slightly in thanks.

sentences.chinese: 其实，她早就想离开这个城市，逃离所有的阴影。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiē guò bāo guǒ, qīng qīng diǎn tóu shì yì xiè xiè.
sentences.english: In fact, she had long wanted to leave this city and escape all the shadows.

sentences.chinese: 但现在，陆远在她的身边，她不想再次失去他。
sentences.pinyin: Qí shí, tā zǎo jiù xiǎng lí kāi zhè gè chéng shì, táo lí suǒ yǒu de yīn yǐng.
sentences.english: But now, with Lu Yuan by her side, she didn't want to lose him again.

sentences.chinese: 她走出酒店，看到陆远正站在街角等她，眼神温柔。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiàn zài, Lù Yuǎn zài tā de shēn biān, tā bù xiǎng zài cì shī qù tā.
sentences.english: She walked out of the hotel and saw Lu Yuan standing at the street corner waiting for her, his gaze gentle.

sentences.chinese: 林晓跑过去抱住他，感觉所有的不安都消失了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu chū jiǔ diàn, kàn dào Lù Yuǎn zhèng zhàn zài jiē jiǎo děng tā, yǎn shén wēn róu.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao ran over and hugged him, feeling all her anxiety disappear.

sentences.chinese: 然而，就在他们相拥的时候，林晓发现陆远的口袋里掉出了一张照片。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo pǎo guò qù bào zhù tā, gǎn jué suǒ yǒu de bù ān dōu xiāo shì le.
sentences.english: However, just as they were embracing, Lin Xiao noticed a photo fall out of Lu Yuan's pocket.

sentences.chinese: 那是她出生时的照片，但照片背面写着红院长的名字。
sentences.pinyin: rán ér, jiù zài tā men xiāng yōng de shí hòu, Lín Xiǎo fā xiàn Lù Yuǎn de kǒu dài lǐ diào chū le yì zhāng zhào piàn.
sentences.english: It was a photo of her at birth, but Dean Hong's name was written on the back of the photo.

sentences.pinyin: Nà shì tā chū shēng shí de zhào piàn, dàn zhào piàn bèi miàn xiě zhe Hóng yuàn zhǎng de míng zi.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十四章：隐藏的碎片

sentences.chinese: 林晓低头看着那张照片，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo dī tóu kàn zhe nà zhāng zhào piàn, xīn tiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked down at the photograph, her heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 她看着照片里的小女孩，那是她的一部分记忆。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe zhào piàn lǐ de xiǎo nǚ hái, nà shì tā de yī bù fen jì yì.
sentences.english: She looked at the little girl in the photo; it was a part of her memory.

sentences.chinese: 陆远看到她的表情，轻轻地开口，他的嘴唇在颤抖。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn kàn dào tā de biǎo qíng, qīng qīng de kāi kǒu, tā de zuǐ chún zài chàn dǒu.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan saw her expression and spoke softly, his lips trembling.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林晓，红院长以前住在北方的东北地区。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su Lín Xiǎo, Hóng yuàn zhǎng yǐ qián zhù zài běi fāng de dōng běi dì qū.
sentences.english: He told Lin Xiao that Dean Hong used to live in the Northeast region of the North.

sentences.chinese: 那里冬天很冷，人们都要穿很厚的大衣。
sentences.pinyin: Nà lǐ dōng tiān hěn lěng, rén men dōu yào chuān hěn hòu de dà yī.
sentences.english: It was very cold there in winter, and people had to wear very thick overcoats.

sentences.chinese: 而林晓的母亲曾经住在南方，一个靠近大海的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Ér Lín Xiǎo de mǔ qīn céng jīng zhù zài nán fāng, yī gè kào jìn dà hǎi de dì fāng.
sentences.english: Meanwhile, Lin Xiao's mother once lived in the South, in a place near the sea.

sentences.chinese: 陆远拿出一张旧报纸，上面有一条关于红院长的旧新闻。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn ná chū yī zhāng jiù bào zhǐ, shàng miàn yǒu yī tiáo guān yú Hóng yuàn zhǎng de jiù xīn wén.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan took out an old newspaper, which contained an old news item about Dean Hong.

sentences.chinese: 报纸上有一张图片，显示红院长在某个市的广场上说话。
sentences.pinyin: Bào zhǐ shàng yǒu yī zhāng tú piàn, xiǎn shì Hóng yuàn zhǎng zài mǒu gè shì de guǎng chǎng shàng shuō huà.
sentences.english: There was a picture in the newspaper showing Dean Hong speaking at a public square in a certain city.

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着图片，发现红院长对面站着一位优雅的太太。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kàn zhe tú piàn, fā xiàn Hóng yuàn zhǎng duì miàn zhàn zhe yī wèi yōu yǎ de tài tai.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at the picture and noticed an elegant lady standing opposite Dean Hong.

sentences.chinese: 那个人手里拿着一瓶水，眼神很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén shǒu lǐ ná zhe yī píng shuǐ, yǎn shén hěn qí guài.
sentences.english: That person was holding a bottle of water, with a very strange look in her eyes.

sentences.chinese: 陆远说，他花了很多时间在网上寻找真相。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn shuō, tā huā le hěn duō shí jiān zài wǎng shàng xún zhǎo zhēn xiàng.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan said he spent a lot of time searching for the truth on the web.

sentences.chinese: 他访问了很多不同的网站，终于找到了这个线索。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fàng wèn le hěn duō bù tóng de wǎng zhàn, zhōng yú zhǎo dào le zhè gè xiàn suǒ.
sentences.english: He visited many different websites and finally found this clue.

sentences.chinese: 他拿出一支笔，在照片的一片空白处写下了几个字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū yī zhī bǐ, zài zhào piàn de yī piàn kòng bái chù xiě xià le jǐ gè zì.
sentences.english: He took out a pen and wrote a few words in a blank section of the photo.

sentences.chinese: 林晓接过照片，感觉这张纸有些脏，像是在一个阴暗的弄堂里放了很久。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo jiē guò zhào piàn, gǎn jué zhè zhāng zhǐ yǒu xiē zàng, xiàng shì zài yī gè yīn àn de lòng táng lǐ fàng le hěn jiǔ.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao took the photo and felt the paper was a bit dirty, as if it had been kept in a dark alley for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 陆远带她走到附近的草地上，那里有一座小石桥。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn dài tā zǒu dào fù jìn de cǎo dì shàng, nà lǐ yǒu yī zuò xiǎo shí qiáo.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan took her to a nearby lawn, where there was a small stone bridge.

sentences.chinese: 他们坐在桥边，阳光像太阳一样温暖地照在他们身上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zuò zài qiáo biān, yáng guāng xiàng tài yang yī yàng wēn nuǎn de zhào zài tā men shēn shang.
sentences.english: They sat by the bridge, the sunlight shining on them as warmly as the sun.

sentences.chinese: 林晓突然想起，她小时候喜欢画儿，喜欢画海边的风景。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo tū rán xiǎng qǐ, tā xiǎo shí hou xǐ huan huà r, xǐ huan huà hǎi biān de fēng jǐng.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao suddenly remembered that she loved drawing as a child, especially seaside scenery.

sentences.chinese: 她记得家里有一台旧洗衣机，总是发出很大的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì de jiā lǐ yǒu yī tái jiù xǐ yī jī, zǒng shì fā chū hěn dà de shēng yīn.
sentences.english: She remembered there was an old washing machine at home that always made a loud noise.

sentences.chinese: 她记得自己曾在这个城市的一个小网球场玩过。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì de zì jǐ céng zài zhè gè chéng shì de yī gè xiǎo wǎng qiú chǎng wán guò.
sentences.english: She remembered she had once played at a small tennis court in this city.

sentences.chinese: 但现在，这些碎片让她感到不安。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiàn zài, zhè xiē suì piàn ràng tā gǎn dào bù ān.
sentences.english: But now, these fragments made her feel uneasy.

sentences.chinese: 她觉得自己的心像被网一样困住了，无法呼吸。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué de zì jǐ de xīn xiàng bèi wǎng yī yàng kùn zhù le, wú fǎ hū xī.
sentences.english: She felt her heart was trapped like a net, unable to breathe.

sentences.chinese: 她看着陆远的眼，发现他的眼神里充满了担忧。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe Lù Yuǎn de yǎn, fā xiàn tā de yǎn shén lǐ chōng mǎn le dān yōu.
sentences.english: She looked into Lu Yuan's eyes and found them full of worry.

sentences.chinese: 陆远从口袋里拿出一颗药，递给林晓，让她平静下来。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn cóng kǒu dài lǐ ná chū yī kē yào, dì gěi Lín Xiǎo, ràng tā píng jìng xià lái.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan took a pill from his pocket and handed it to Lin Xiao to calm her down.

sentences.chinese: 他轻声说：“我知道这很难，但我们必须面对它。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā qīng shēng shuō: “Wǒ zhī dào zhè hěn nán, dàn wǒ men bì xū miàn duì tā.”
sentences.english: He said softly, "I know this is hard, but we must face it."

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着这张照片，意识到自己的出生是一个巨大的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kàn zhe zhè zhāng zhào piàn, yì shí dào zì jǐ de chū shēng shì yī gè jù dà de mì mì.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at the photo and realized her birth was a huge secret.

sentences.chinese: 红院长和她的父母之间一定有某种联系。
sentences.pinyin: Hóng yuàn zhǎng hé tā de fù mǔ zhī jiān yī dìng yǒu mǒu zhǒng lián xì.
sentences.english: There must be some kind of connection between Dean Hong and her parents.

sentences.chinese: 她看着远处的大海，心中充满了疑问。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe yuǎn chù de dà hǎi, xīn zhōng chōng mǎn le yí wèn.
sentences.english: She looked at the distant ocean, her heart full of questions.

sentences.chinese: 如果陆远一直在帮她，那么他又是谁？
sentences.pinyin: Rú guǒ Lù Yuǎn yī zhí zài bāng tā, nà me tā yòu shì shuí?
sentences.english: If Lu Yuan had been helping her all along, then who was he?

sentences.chinese: 他为什么知道这么多关于她的事情？
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèi shén me zhī dào zhè me duō guān yú tā de shì qing?
sentences.english: Why did he know so much about her?

sentences.chinese: 林晓突然意识到，陆远可能在隐瞒某些东西。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo tū rán yì shí dào, Lù Yuǎn kě néng zài yǐn máng mǒu xiē dōng xi.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao suddenly realized that Lu Yuan might be hiding something.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，她的手机响了，是一条来自红院长的短信。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, tā de shǒu jī xiǎng le, shì yī tiáo lái zì Hóng yuàn zhǎng de xùn xìn.
sentences.english: Just then, her phone rang; it was a message from Dean Hong.

sentences.chinese: 短信里写着：“照片背面的秘密，你还没发现吧？”
sentences.pinyin: Xùn xìn lǐ xiě zhe: “Zhào piàn bèi miàn de mì mì, nǐ hái méi fā xiàn ba?”
sentences.english: The message read: "The secret on the back of the photo, you haven't discovered it yet, have you?"

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十五章：迷雾中的真相

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着手机上的短信，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe shǒujī shàng de duǎnxìn, xīntiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at the text message on her phone, her heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 她看向身边的陆远，他正低头看着自己的表。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng shēnbiān de Lù Yuǎn, tā zhèng dītóu kànzhe zìjǐ de biǎo.
sentences.english: She looked at Lu Yuan by her side; he was looking down at his watch.

sentences.chinese: 这是一个阴天，天空灰蒙蒙的，像极了林晓现在的心情。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yígè yīntiān, tiānkōng huīméngméng de, xiàng jíle Lín Xiǎo xiànzài de xīnqíng.
sentences.english: It was a cloudy day, the sky was grey, just like Lin Xiao's current mood.

sentences.chinese: 她决定从另一个角度去思考这件事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juédìng cóng lìng yígè jiǎodù qù sīkǎo zhè jiàn shì.
sentences.english: She decided to think about this matter from another angle.

sentences.chinese: 陆远突然说：“我们去一个地方，那里有你想要的所有答案。”
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn tūrán shuō: “Wǒmen qù yígè dìfāng, nàlǐ yǒu nǐ xiǎng yào de suǒyǒu dá'àn.”
sentences.english: Lu Yuan suddenly said, "Let's go to a place where you will find all the answers you want."

sentences.chinese: 他带着林晓进入了一座古老的院子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàizhe Lín Xiǎo jìnrù le yí zuò gǔlǎo de yuànzi.
sentences.english: He led Lin Xiao into an ancient courtyard.

sentences.chinese: 这个院子很大，里头种了很多奇怪的植物。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè yuànzi hěn dà, lǐtou zhòngle hěn duō qíguài de zhíwù.
sentences.english: This courtyard was very large, and inside there were many strange plants.

sentences.chinese: 林晓发现这里像是一个秘密的医疗院，空气中有一股药水的味道。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo fāxiàn zhèlǐ xiàng shì yígè mìmì de yīliáo yuàn, kōngqì zhōng yǒu yì gǔ yàoshuǐ de wèidào.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao discovered that this place was like a secret medical institution, and there was a smell of medicinal liquid in the air.

sentences.chinese: 陆远走到院子边，指着西北方向的一座小房子说：“那里住着鱼先生。”
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn zǒu dào yuànzi biān, zhǐzhe xīběi fāngxiàng de yí zuò xiǎo fángzi shuō: “Nàlǐ zhùzhe Yú xiānshēng.”
sentences.english: Lu Yuan walked to the edge of the courtyard and pointed to a small house in the northwest direction, saying, "Mr. Yu lives there."

sentences.chinese: 鱼先生是陆远的表亲，也是红院长曾经的助手。
sentences.pinyin: Yú xiānshēng shì Lù Yuǎn de biǎoqīn, yěshì Hóng yuànzhǎng céngjīng de zhùshǒu.
sentences.english: Mr. Yu was Lu Yuan's cousin, and also Dean Hong's former assistant.

sentences.chinese: 在鱼先生面前，陆远终于说出了真相。
sentences.pinyin: Zài Yú xiānshēng miànqián, Lù Yuǎn zhōngyú shuō chūle zhēnxiàng.
sentences.english: In front of Mr. Yu, Lu Yuan finally told the truth.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林晓，红院长在西方国家学习了很多年，想用一种奇怪的方法控制人们。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Lín Xiǎo, Hóng yuànzhǎng zài xīfāng guójiā xuéxíle hěn duō nián, xiǎng yòng yì zhǒng qíguài de fāngfǎ kòngzhì rénmen.
sentences.english: He told Lin Xiao that Dean Hong had studied in Western countries for many years and wanted to use a strange method to control people.

sentences.chinese: 陆远拿出一篇旧的报告，那是红院长写的一篇关于心理控制的文章。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn ná chū yì piān jiù de bàogào, nà shì Hóng yuànzhǎng xiě de yì piān guānyú xīnlǐ kòngzhì de wénzhāng.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan took out an old report, which was an article written by Dean Hong about psychological control.

sentences.chinese: 报告的一部分被撕掉了，但剩下的内容让林晓感到恐惧。
sentences.pinyin: Bàogào de yí bùfen bèi sī diàole, dàn shèng xià de nèiróng ràng Lín Xiǎo gǎndào kǒngjù.
sentences.english: A part of the report had been torn away, but the remaining content made Lin Xiao feel terrified.

sentences.chinese: 林晓问：“你瞒了我多久？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo wèn: “Nǐ mánle wǒ duōjiǔ?”
sentences.english: Lin Xiao asked, "How long have you hidden this from me?"

sentences.chinese: 陆远看着她的面孔，眼神里充满了痛苦。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn kànzhe tā de miànkǒng, yǎnshén lǐ chōngmǎnle tòngkǔ.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan looked at her face, his eyes full of pain.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“我不知道怎样告诉你，我只想让你安全。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ bù zhīdào zěnyàng gàosù nǐ, wǒ zhǐ xiǎng ràng nǐ ānquán.”
sentences.english: He said, "I didn't know how to tell you, I just wanted you to be safe."

sentences.chinese: 为了缓解紧张的气氛，鱼先生给他们做了饺子和炖鸡。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile huǎnjiě jǐnzhāng de qìfēn, Yú xiānshēng gěi tāmen zuòle jiǎozi hé dùn jī.
sentences.english: To ease the tense atmosphere, Mr. Yu made dumplings and stewed chicken for them.

sentences.chinese: 他们坐在路边的长凳上吃饭，感受着微风。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zuò zài lùbiān de cháng dèng shàng chīfàn, gǎnshòuzhe wēifēng.
sentences.english: They sat on a roadside bench eating, feeling the breeze.

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着这个男人，意识到他为了保护她，承受了太多的压力。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe zhège nánrén, yìshí dào tā wèile bǎohù tā, chéngshòule tài duō de yālì.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at this man and realized that in order to protect her, he had endured too much pressure.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，鱼先生突然脸色大变，指着院子门口大喊。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, Yú xiānshēng tūrán liǎnsè dà biàn, zhǐzhe yuànzi ménkǒu dà hǎn.
sentences.english: But just then, Mr. Yu's face suddenly changed, and he shouted, pointing toward the courtyard gate.

sentences.chinese: 红院长竟然带着人，出现在了他们的面前。
sentences.pinyin: Hóng yuànzhǎng jìngrán dàizhe rén, chūxiàn zài le tāmen de miànqián.
sentences.english: Dean Hong had actually arrived with people, appearing right in front of them.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十六章：真相的代价

sentences.chinese: 红院长站在那里，他的个子很高，看起来非常冷漠。
sentences.pinyin: Hóng yuàn zhǎng zhàn zài nà lǐ, tā de gè zi hěn gāo, kàn qǐ lái fēi cháng lěng mò.
sentences.english: Dean Hong stood there, his stature was tall and he looked very cold.

sentences.chinese: 他看向林晓，眼神像是在看一个没有生命的例子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng Lín Xiǎo, yǎn shén xiàng shì zài kàn yī gè méi yǒu shēng mìng de lì zi.
sentences.english: He looked at Lin Xiao, his gaze as if he were looking at a lifeless example.

sentences.chinese: 林晓的心情突然变得很糟糕，她感到一种巨大的压力。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo de xīn qíng tū rán biàn de hěn zāo gāo, tā gǎn dào yī zhǒng jù dà de yā lì.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao's mood suddenly became very bad; she felt a huge amount of pressure.

sentences.chinese: 红院长说：“林晓，你知道我来这里的主要原因是关于你的家庭。”
sentences.pinyin: Hóng yuàn zhǎng shuō: “Lín Xiǎo, nǐ zhī dào wǒ lái zhè lǐ de zhǔ yào yuán yīn shì guān yú nǐ de jiā tíng.”
sentences.english: Dean Hong said, "Lin Xiao, you know the main reason I came here is about your family."

sentences.chinese: 林晓的心里很乱，她不知道这个男人到底想要什么事情。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo de xīn lǐ hěn luàn, tā bù zhī dào zhè gè nán rén dào dǐ xiǎng yào shén me shì qing.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao's mind was in chaos; she didn't know what matter this man actually wanted.

sentences.chinese: 红院长冷笑一声，说：“在我的心中，你只是一个实验的名称。”
sentences.pinyin: Hóng yuàn zhǎng lěng xiào yī shēng, shuō: “Zài wǒ de xīn zhōng, nǐ zhǐ shì yī gè shí yàn de míng chēng.”
sentences.english: Dean Hong sneered and said, "In my heart, you are just the name of an experiment."

sentences.chinese: 陆远立刻挡在林晓面前，他的态度非常坚定。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn lì kè dǎng zài Lín Xiǎo miàn qián, tā de tài du hěn jiān dìng.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan immediately blocked Lin Xiao; his attitude was very firm.

sentences.chinese: 他低声说：“请离开这里，我们需要安全。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dī shēng shuō: “Qǐng lí kāi zhè lǐ, wǒ men xū yào ān quán.”
sentences.english: He said in a low voice, "Please leave this place; we need safety."

sentences.chinese: 红院长看着陆远，说：“你以为你有个办法能救她吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Hóng yuàn zhǎng kàn zhe Lù Yuǎn, shuō: “Nǐ yǐ wéi nǐ yǒu gè bàn fǎ néng jiù tā ma?”
sentences.english: Dean Hong looked at Lu Yuan and said, "Do you think you have a way to save her?"

sentences.chinese: 他开始讲述一个关于一个少年的故事，像是在读一本阴暗的小说。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kāi shǐ jiǎng shù yī gè guān yú yī gè shào nián de gù shi, xiàng shì zài dú yī běn yīn àn de xiǎo shuō.
sentences.english: He began to tell a story about a youth, as if reading a dark novel.

sentences.chinese: 他说那个少年在大学的第一个学期就失去了所有。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō nà gè shào nián zài dà xué de dì yī gè xué qī jiù shī qù le suǒ yǒu.
sentences.english: He said that youth lost everything in the first semester of university.

sentences.chinese: 那个少年每天在体育馆练习体育，试图让自己变得健康。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè shào nián měi tiān zài tǐ yù guǎn liàn xí tǐ yù, shì tú ràng zì jǐ biàn de jiàn kāng.
sentences.english: That youth practiced sports in the gym every day, trying to make himself healthy.

sentences.chinese: 但实际上，他的生活并不平等，因为他被红院长控制了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn shí jì shang, tā de shēng huó bìng bù píng děng, yīn wèi tā bèi Hóng yuàn zhǎng kòng zhì le.
sentences.english: But in reality, his life was not equal because he was controlled by Dean Hong.

sentences.chinese: 红院长说：“就像那些为了分数而努力的学生，他以为只要完成作业就能自由。”
sentences.pinyin: Hóng yuàn zhǎng shuō: “Jiù xiàng nà xiē wèi le fēn shù ér nǔ lì de xué shēng, tā yǐ wéi zhǐ yào wán chéng zuò yè jiù néng zì yóu.”
sentences.english: Dean Hong said, "Just like those students who strive for grades, he thought he could be free as long as he completed his assignments."

sentences.chinese: 林晓听着，心中感到一阵寒冷，她意识到这个少年可能就是陆远。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo tīng zhe, xīn zhōng gǎn dào yī zhèn hán lěng, tā yì shí dào zhè gè shào nián kě néng jiù shì Lù Yuǎn.
sentences.english: Listening to this, Lin Xiao felt a chill in her heart, realizing this youth might be Lu Yuan.

sentences.chinese: 红院长继续说：“这个城市的中心人口很多，但没有人知道真相。”
sentences.pinyin: Hóng yuàn zhǎng jì xù shuō: “Zhè gè chéng shì de zhōng xīn rén kǒu hěn duō, dàn méi yǒu rén zhī dào zhēn xiàng.”
sentences.english: Dean Hong continued, "The population in the center of this city is large, but no one knows the truth."

sentences.chinese: 他指着周围的环境，谈论着这个地方的大小，仿佛这里是一个囚笼。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐ zhe zhōu wéi de huán jìng, tán lùn zhe zhè gè dì fang de dà xiǎo, fǎng fú zhè lǐ shì yī gè qiú lóng.
sentences.english: He pointed to the surrounding environment, discussing the size of this place as if it were a cage.

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着陆远，发现他的头低了下来，眼神中充满了痛苦。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kàn zhe Lù Yuǎn, fā xiàn tā de tóu dī le xià lái, yǎn shén zhōng chōng mǎn le tòng kǔ.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at Lu Yuan and noticed his head was lowered, his eyes full of pain.

sentences.chinese: 红院长说：“我看过一部影片，里面的人在绝望时会做很多傻事。”
sentences.pinyin: Hóng yuàn zhǎng shuō: “Wǒ kàn guò yī bù yǐng piàn, lǐ miàn de rén zài jué wàng shí huì zuò hěn duō shǎ shì.”
sentences.english: Dean Hong said, "I have seen a movie where people do many foolish things in despair."

sentences.chinese: 林晓突然大喊：“你到底是什么意思？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo tū rán dà hǎn: “Nǐ dào dǐ shì shén me yì si?”
sentences.english: Lin Xiao suddenly shouted, "What on earth do you mean?"

sentences.chinese: 红院长笑了，说：“我的意思是，你和陆远的关系只是一个偶然。”
sentences.pinyin: Hóng yuàn zhǎng xiào le, shuō: “Wǒ de yì si shì, nǐ hé Lù Yuǎn de guān xì zhǐ shì yī gè ǒu rán.”
sentences.english: Dean Hong smiled and said, "I mean that your relationship with Lu Yuan is just a coincidence."

sentences.chinese: 林晓觉得很急，她想知道真相，但红院长并不打算直接告诉她。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo jué de hěn jí, tā xiǎng zhī dào zhēn xiàng, dàn Hóng yuàn zhǎng bìng bù dǎ suàn zhí jiē gào su tā.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao felt urgent; she wanted to know the truth, but Dean Hong did not intend to tell her directly.

sentences.chinese: 陆远终于开口了，他的声音很轻，但很清晰。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn zhōng yú kāi kǒu le, tā de shēng yīn hěn qīng, dàn hěn qīng xī.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan finally spoke; his voice was soft but clear.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“我对你的意见是，不要相信他任何一句话。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ duì nǐ de yì jiàn shì, bù yào xiāng xìn tā rèn hé yī jù huà.”
sentences.english: He said, "My opinion for you is not to believe a single word he says."

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着陆远，意识到无论发生什么，他都在保护她。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kàn zhe Lù Yuǎn, yì shí dào wú lùn fā shēng shén me, tā dōu zài bǎo hù tā.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at Lu Yuan, realizing that no matter what happened, he was protecting her.

sentences.chinese: 红院长冷漠地看着他们，说：“这就是实际的情况，你们无法逃脱。”
sentences.pinyin: Hóng yuàn zhǎng lěng mò de kàn zhe tā men, shuō: “Zhè jiù shì shí jì de qíng kuàng, nǐ men wú fǎ táo tuō.”
sentences.english: Dean Hong looked at them coldly and said, "This is the actual situation; you cannot escape."

sentences.chinese: 他走近一步，空气变得凝固，林晓感到呼吸困难。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu jìn yī bù, kōng qì biàn de níng gù, Lín Xiǎo gǎn dào hū xī kùn nán.
sentences.english: He took a step closer, the air became frozen, and Lin Xiao felt it difficult to breathe.

sentences.chinese: 鱼先生试图阻拦，但红院长的人已经把他们围在了这个位置。
sentences.pinyin: Yú xiān shēng shì tú zǔ lán, dàn Hóng yuàn zhǎng de rén yǐ jīng bǎ tā men wéi zài le zhè gè wèi zhì.
sentences.english: Mr. Yu tried to stop him, but Dean Hong's men had already surrounded them at this position.

sentences.chinese: 林晓在心里默默祈祷，希望这一切只是一个噩梦。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo zài xīn lǐ mò mò qí dǎo, xī wàng zhè yī qiè zhǐ shì yī gè mèng mǐng.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao prayed silently in her heart, hoping all of this was just a nightmare.

sentences.chinese: 红院长拿出一张纸，上面写着一些奇怪的数字和符号。
sentences.pinyin: Hóng yuàn zhǎng ná chū yī zhāng zhǐ, shàng miàn xiě zhe yī xiē qí guài de shù zì hé fú hào.
sentences.english: Dean Hong took out a piece of paper with some strange numbers and symbols on it.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林晓，这是她生命中最重要的秘密，也是她必须面对的代价。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su Lín Xiǎo, zhè shì tā shēng mìng zhōng zuì zhòng yào de mì mì, yě shì tā bì xū miàn duì de dài jià.
sentences.english: He told Lin Xiao that this was the most important secret in her life and the price she must face.

sentences.chinese: 就在林晓准备接过那张纸时，远处突然传来了警笛的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài Lín Xiǎo zhǔn bèi jiē guò nà zhāng zhǐ shí, yuǎn chù tū rán chuán lái le jǐng dí de shēng yīn.
sentences.english: Just as Lin Xiao was preparing to take the paper, the sound of police sirens suddenly came from the distance.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十七章：最后的真相

sentences.chinese: 警笛的声音越来越近，红院长的脸色变了颜色。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngdí de shēngyīn yuè lái yuè jìn, Hóng yuànzhǎng de liǎnsè biànle yánsè.
sentences.english: The sirens grew closer, and Dean Hong's complexion changed color.

sentences.chinese: 他看着林晓，眼神里的样子不再那么自信。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe Lín Xiǎo, yǎnshén lǐ de yàngzi bù zài nàme zìxìn.
sentences.english: He looked at Lin Xiao, the manner in his eyes no longer so confident.

sentences.chinese: 红院长试图逃跑，但警察已经封锁了所有的方向。
sentences.pinyin: Hóng yuànzhǎng shìtú táopǎo, dàn jǐngchá yǐjīng fēngsuǒle suǒyǒu de fāngxiàng.
sentences.english: Dean Hong tried to escape, but the police had already blocked all directions.

sentences.chinese: 陆远紧紧抱着林晓，他的心跳很快。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn jǐnjǐn bàozhe Lín Xiǎo, tā de xīntiào hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan held Lin Xiao tightly, his heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 红院长大声说：“你们不懂，我的目的只是为了科学！”
sentences.pinyin: Hóng yuànzhǎng dàshēng shuō: “Nǐmen bù dǒng, wǒ de mùdì zhǐshì wèile kēxué!”
sentences.english: Dean Hong shouted, "You don't understand, my purpose was for science!"

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着他，冷冷地说：“你的行为根本不是科学，而是自私。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe tā, lěnglěng de shuō: “Nǐ de xíngwéi gēnběn bùshì kēxué, ér shì zìsī.”
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at him and said coldly, "Your behavior is not science at all, but selfishness."

sentences.chinese: 红院长拿出的那张纸掉在地上，被风吹到了红色的地毯上。
sentences.pinyin: Hóng yuànzhǎng ná chū de nà zhāng zhǐ diào zài dìshàng, bèi fēng chuī dàole hóngsè de dìtǎn shàng.
sentences.english: The paper Dean Hong had taken out fell to the ground, blown by the wind onto the red carpet.

sentences.chinese: 这张纸记录了林晓小时候的成绩和身体条件。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhǐ jìlùle Lín Xiǎo xiǎoshíhòu de chéngjī hé shēntǐ tiáojiàn.
sentences.english: This paper recorded Lin Xiao's grades and physical conditions from when she was a child.

sentences.chinese: 原来，红院长在很多年前把林晓当成一个实验项目。
sentences.pinyin: Yuánlái, Hóng yuànzhǎng zài hěnduō nián qián bǎ Lín Xiǎo dāngchéng yīgè shíyàn xiàngmù.
sentences.english: As it turned out, years ago, Dean Hong had treated Lin Xiao as an experimental project.

sentences.chinese: 他想通过一种特殊的方法，让青少年变得更聪明。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng tōngguò yī zhǒng tèshū de fāngfǎ, ràng qīngshàonián biàn de gèng cōngmíng.
sentences.english: He wanted to use a special method to make adolescents smarter.

sentences.chinese: 他认为这种计划可以让每一个青年在学习方面变得像明星一样出色。
sentences.pinyin: Tā rènwéi zhè zhǒng jìhuà kěyǐ ràng měi yīgè qīngnián zài xuéxí fāngmiàn biàn de xiàng míngxīng yīyàng chūsè.
sentences.english: He believed this plan could make every youth become as outstanding as a star in terms of learning.

sentences.chinese: 林晓觉得非常愤怒，因为这夺走了她童年的自由。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo juédé fēicháng fènnù, yīnwèi zhè duózǒule tā tóngnián de zìyóu.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao felt very angry because this had robbed her of her childhood freedom.

sentences.chinese: 她想起小时候，她最理想的生活是在球场上跑步，而不是在实验室里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ xiǎoshíhòu, tā zuì lǐxiǎng de shēnghuó shì zài qiúchǎng shàng pǎobù, ér bùshì zài shíyànshì lǐ.
sentences.english: She remembered that as a child, her ideal life was running on the sports ground, not being in a laboratory.

sentences.chinese: 在那间阴暗的房间里，只有一盏昏暗的灯在闪烁。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nà jiān yīn'àn de fángjiān lǐ, zhǐyǒu yī zhǎn hūnnàn de dēng zài shǎnshuò.
sentences.english: In that dark room, there was only one dim lamp flickering.

sentences.chinese: 空气里充满了奇怪的油味，让她至今感到恶心。
sentences.pinyin: Kōngqì lǐ chōngmǎnle qíguài de yóuwèi, ràng tā zhìjīn gǎndào ěxīn.
sentences.english: The air was filled with a strange smell of oil, which makes her feel nauseous to this day.

sentences.chinese: 红院长试图解释，他说他的观点是为了人类的进步。
sentences.pinyin: Hóng yuànzhǎng shìtú jiěshì, tā shuō tā de guāndiǎn shì wèile rénlèi de jìnbù.
sentences.english: Dean Hong tried to explain, saying his point of view was for the progress of humanity.

sentences.chinese: 但林晓认为，无论什么道理，都不能伤害一个孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn Lín Xiǎo rènwéi, wúlùn shénme dàolǐ, dōu bùnéng shānghài yīgè háizi.
sentences.english: But Lin Xiao believed that no matter the reason, one cannot hurt a child.

sentences.chinese: 她对红院长的看法很简单：他是一个没有心的怪物。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì Hóng yuànzhǎng de kànfǎ hěn jiǎndān: tā shì yīgè méiyǒu xīn de guàiwù.
sentences.english: Her view of Dean Hong was simple: he was a heartless monster.

sentences.chinese: 警察走过来，把红院长带走了，他的脚在地上拖着。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngchá zǒu guòlái, bǎ Hóng yuànzhǎng dài zǒule, tā de jiǎo zài dìshàng tuōzhe.
sentences.english: The police came over and took Dean Hong away, his feet dragging on the ground.

sentences.chinese: 这一刻，林晓终于感觉到压力消失了，她深深地呼吸了一口新鲜空气。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè yīkè, Lín Xiǎo zhōngyú gǎnjué dào yālì xiāoshīle, tā shēnshēn de hūxīle yī kǒu xīnxiān kōngqì.
sentences.english: At this moment, Lin Xiao finally felt the pressure disappear, and she took a deep breath of fresh air.

sentences.chinese: 陆远看着她，温柔地说：“现在，所有的这个问题都解决了。”
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn kànzhe tā, wēnróu de shuō: “Xiànzài, suǒyǒu de zhè gè wèntí dōu jiějuéle.”
sentences.english: Lu Yuan looked at her and said gently, "Now, all of this problem is solved."

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着陆远，意识到这个男人的特点就是永远在保护她。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe Lù Yuǎn, yìshí dào zhè gè nánrén de tèdiǎn jiùshì yǒngyuǎn zài bǎohù tā.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at Lu Yuan and realized that this man's characteristic is always protecting her.

sentences.chinese: 虽然他们之间有过误会，但现在的他们有了共同的观点。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán tāmen zhījiān yǒuguò wùhuì, dàn xiànzài de tāmen yǒule gòngtóng de guāndiǎn.
sentences.english: Although there had been misunderstandings between them, they now shared a common viewpoint.

sentences.chinese: 他们决定一起去旅行，去一个没有秘密的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen juédìng yīqǐ qù lǚxíng, qù yīgè méiyǒu mìmì de dìfāng.
sentences.english: They decided to travel together to a place with no secrets.

sentences.chinese: 他们计划在下一个节日的时候，去海边看日出。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen jìhuà zài xià yīgè jiérì de shíhòu, qù hǎibiān kàn rìchū.
sentences.english: They planned to go to the seaside to watch the sunrise during the next holiday.

sentences.chinese: 林晓想在电视节目里分享她的故事，告诉更多青少年要勇敢面对过去。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo xiǎng zài diànshì jiémù lǐ fēnxiǎng tā de gùshì, gàosù gèng duō qīngshàonián yào yǒnggǎn miànduì guòqù.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao wanted to share her story in a television program to tell more teenagers to bravely face the past.

sentences.chinese: 她走在回家的道上，心中充满了希望。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu zài huí jiā de dào shàng, xīnzhōng chōngmǎnle xīwàng.
sentences.english: She walked on the road home, her heart full of hope.

sentences.chinese: 她知道，真正的爱情不需要完美的条件，只需要真诚。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhīdào, zhēnzhèng de àiqíng bù xūyào wánměi de tiáojiàn, zhǐ xūyào zhēnchéng.
sentences.english: She knew that true love does not require perfect conditions, only sincerity.

sentences.chinese: 陆远牵起她的手，两人在夕阳下慢慢走着。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn qiān qǐ tā de shǒu, liǎng rén zài xīyáng xià mànmàn zǒuzhe.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan took her hand, and the two walked slowly under the sunset.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，林晓在地上看到了一部手机，屏幕亮着。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, Lín Xiǎo zài dìshàng kàndào le yī bù shǒujī, píngmù liàngzhe.
sentences.english: But just then, Lin Xiao saw a phone on the ground, the screen lit up.

sentences.chinese: 手机上出现了一条新信息，发信人的名字让她再次惊呆了。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒujī shàng chūxiànle yī tiáo xīn xìnxī, fā xìnrén de míngzì ràng tā zàicì jīng dāile.
sentences.english: A new message appeared on the phone, and the sender's name stunned her once again.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十八章：最后的答案

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着手机屏幕，上面的名字是“红院长”。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe shǒujī píngmù, shàngmiàn de míngzì shì “Hóng Yuànzhǎng”.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at the phone screen; the name on it was "Dean Hong."

sentences.chinese: 屏幕很亮，在夕阳下显得格外刺眼。
sentences.pinyin: Píngmù hěn liàng, zài xīyáng xià xiǎnde géwài cìyǎn.
sentences.english: The screen was very bright, appearing exceptionally piercing under the sunset.

sentences.chinese: 她感到一种可怕的压力，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎndào yīzhǒng kěpà de yālì, xīntiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: She felt a dreadful pressure, and her heart beat very fast.

sentences.chinese: 陆远注意到她的表情，轻声问她怎么了。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn zhùyì dào tā de biǎoqíng, qīngshēng wèn tā zěnmeliǎo.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan noticed her expression and asked her softly what was wrong.

sentences.chinese: 林晓把手机递给他，声音在发抖。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo bǎ shǒujī dì gěi tā, shēngyīn zài fādǒu.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao handed the phone to him, her voice trembling.

sentences.chinese: 短信里写着：“如果你想要公平，就来白色花园见我。”
sentences.pinyin: Duǎnxìn lǐ xiězhe: “Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng yào gōngpíng, jiù lái báisè huāyuán jiàn wǒ.”
sentences.english: The text read: "If you want fairness, come meet me at the White Garden."

sentences.chinese: 陆远看着这条短信，眼神变得刚强起来。
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn kànzhe zhè tiáo duǎnxìn, yǎnshén biànde gāngqiáng qǐlái.
sentences.english: Lu Yuan looked at the text, and his gaze became strong.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，那个坏人还没有放弃，他想用谎言给林晓带来坏处。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhīdào, nàge huàirén hái méiyǒu fàngqì, tā xiǎng yòng huǎngyán gěi Lín Xiǎo dàilái huàichu.
sentences.english: He knew that the bad person had not given up and wanted to bring harm to Lin Xiao with lies.

sentences.chinese: 他们快速走到了白色花园，那里的天气很凉快。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen kuàisù zǒudào le báisè huāyuán, nàlǐ de tiānqì hěn liángkuai.
sentences.english: They quickly walked to the White Garden, where the weather was pleasantly cool.

sentences.chinese: 花园里非常安静，只有风吹过树叶的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Huāyuán lǐ fēicháng ānjìng, zhǐyǒu fēng chuīguò shùyè de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: It was very quiet in the garden, with only the sound of the wind blowing through the leaves.

sentences.chinese: 突然，远处传来了大声的笑声，听起来非常难听。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yuǎnchù chuánlái le dàshēng de xiàoshēng, tīng qǐlái fēicháng nántīng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, loud laughter came from a distance, which sounded very unpleasant.

sentences.chinese: 红院长穿着一件白色的衣服，站在花丛中，样子很难看。
sentences.pinyin: Hóng Yuànzhǎng chuānzhe yī jiàn báisè de yīfu, zhàn zài huācóng zhōng, yàngzi hěn nánkàn.
sentences.english: Dean Hong was wearing white clothes, standing among the flowers, looking unsightly.

sentences.chinese: 他看着他们，语气中充满了不满。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe tāmen, yǔqì zhōng chōngmǎn le bùmǎn.
sentences.english: He looked at them, his tone filled with resentment.

sentences.chinese: “你们以为你们赢了？”红院长大声地问。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐmen yǐwéi nǐmen yíng le?” Hóng Yuànzhǎng dàshēng de wèn.
sentences.english: "Do you think you've won?" Dean Hong asked loudly.

sentences.chinese: 林晓看着他，突然觉得这个男人其实很可怜。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo kànzhe tā, tūrán juéde zhège nánrén qíshí hěn kělián.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked at him and suddenly felt that this man was actually quite pitiful.

sentences.chinese: 她不再害怕，而是用流利的语言告诉他：“仇恨没有意义。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zài hàipà, érshì yòng liúlì de yǔyán gàosù tā: “Chóuhèn méiyǒu yìyì.”
sentences.english: She was no longer afraid, but told him in fluent language: "Hatred has no meaning."

sentences.chinese: 红院长愣住了，他没想到林晓会这么热情地对待他。
sentences.pinyin: Hóng Yuànzhǎng lèng zhù le, tā méi xiǎngdào Lín Xiǎo huì zhème rèqíng de duìdài tā.
sentences.english: Dean Hong was stunned; he hadn't expected Lin Xiao to treat him so cordially.

sentences.chinese: 陆远走上前，小声地对红院长说：“现在结束这一切吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Lù Yuǎn zǒu shàngqián, xiǎoshēng de duì Hóng Yuànzhǎng shuō: “Xiànzài jiéshù zhè yīqiè ba.”
sentences.english: Lu Yuan stepped forward and said in a low voice to Dean Hong: "Let's end all this now."

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，花园的钟响了，发出“当”的一声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhèshí, huāyuán de zhōng xiǎng le, fāchū “dāng” de yī shēng.
sentences.english: Just then, the garden clock rang, making a "dong" sound.

sentences.chinese: 这个声音在安静的空气中回荡，像是一种信号。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shēngyīn zài ānjìng de kōngqì zhōng huídàng, xiàng shì yīzhǒng xìnhào.
sentences.english: This sound echoed in the quiet air, like a signal.

sentences.chinese: 林晓抬头看，天上的云朵像棉花一样可爱。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo táitóu kàn, tiānshàng de yúnduǒ xiàng miánhuā yīyàng kě'ài.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao looked up; the clouds in the sky were as adorable as cotton candy.

sentences.chinese: 她觉得生活其实很有意思，只要身边有爱的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde shēnghuó qíshí hěn yǒuyìsi, zhǐyào shēnbiān yǒu ài de rén.
sentences.english: She felt that life was actually very interesting, as long as there were loved ones around.

sentences.chinese: 她看向陆远，他依然那么漂亮，眼神里充满了爱意。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànxiàng Lù Yuǎn, tā yīrán nàme piàoliang, yǎnshén lǐ chōngmǎn le àiyì.
sentences.english: She looked at Lu Yuan, who was still so beautiful, his eyes full of love.

sentences.chinese: 红院长沉默了很久，最后轻轻地叹了一口气。
sentences.pinyin: Hóng Yuànzhǎng chénmò le hěn jiǔ, zuìhòu qīngqīng de tàn le yī kǒu qì.
sentences.english: Dean Hong remained silent for a long time, and finally gave a light sigh.

sentences.chinese: 他把所有的秘密交给了他们，终于决定离开。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ suǒyǒu de mìmì jiāogěi le tāmen, zhōngyú juédìng líkāi.
sentences.english: He handed over all the secrets to them and finally decided to leave.

sentences.chinese: 林晓和陆远紧紧相拥，心中充满了真正的快乐。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo hé Lù Yuǎn jǐnjǐn xiāngyōng, xīnzhōng chōngmǎn le zhēnzhèng de kuàilè.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao and Lu Yuan embraced tightly, their hearts filled with true happiness.

sentences.chinese: 他们知道，无论未来的气温如何，只要在一起就是温暖的。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zhīdào, wúlùn wèilái de qìwēn rúhé, zhǐyào zài yīqǐ jiùshì wēnnuǎn de.
sentences.english: They knew that no matter what the air temperature was in the future, as long as they were together, it would be warm.

word_usage.sentence: 一个学生举手问问题，样子很认真。
word_usage.context_meaning: Raising a hand to ask a question in a lecture.

word_usage.sentence: 林晓觉得这里的气氛很好，她想在这里交朋友。
word_usage.context_meaning: Wishing to meet new people and form friendships.

word_usage.sentence: 他现在在休假，打算在城市里参观一些博物馆。
word_usage.context_meaning: Taking a break/holiday from work or study.

word_usage.sentence: 陆远说，他以前因为生病住院过一段时间，所以很珍惜现在的生活。
word_usage.context_meaning: Being admitted to a hospital for medical treatment.

word_usage.sentence: 林晓是一个年轻的老师，她教学生写作文。
word_usage.context_meaning: Writing a school essay or composition.

books.title_english: The Secret of the Tang Dynasty Academy
books.description_chinese: 在繁荣的唐朝，十五岁的李明在书院学习。一个不一般的下午，窗外的老树突然倒下，一个神秘的人出现了。发生了什么事？
books.description_english: In the prosperous Tang Dynasty, fifteen-year-old Li Ming is studying at a famous academy. One unusual afternoon, an ancient tree suddenly crashes down, revealing a mysterious stranger. What secrets will unfold?

chapters.title_english: Chapter 1: The Secret of the Academy

sentences.chinese: 在很久以前的唐朝，有一个著名的书院。
sentences.pinyin: Zài hěn jiǔ yǐ qián de Táng cháo, yǒu yí gè zhù míng de shū yuàn.
sentences.english: Long ago in the Tang Dynasty, there was a famous academy.

sentences.chinese: 这里不仅教当地的少年，还欢迎来自远方的留学生。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ bù jǐn jiào dāng dì de shào nián, hái huān yíng lái zì yuǎn fāng de liú xué shēng.
sentences.english: It not only taught local youths but also welcomed exchange students from far away.

sentences.chinese: 李明是一个十五岁的青年，他的个子很高。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng shì yí gè shí wǔ suì de qīng nián, tā de gè zi hěn gāo.
sentences.english: Li Ming was a fifteen-year-old youth; his stature was very tall.

sentences.chinese: 他现在在书院的高级班学习，这相当于现代的高中。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàn zài zài shū yuàn de gāo jí bān xué xí, zhè xiāng dāng yú xiàn dài de gāo zhōng.
sentences.english: He was currently studying in the advanced class of the academy, which is equivalent to modern senior high school.

sentences.chinese: 在这个学期，李明想要拿到最高的分数。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè gè xué qī, Lǐ Míng xiǎng yào ná dào zuì gāo de fēn shù.
sentences.english: In this term, Li Ming wanted to achieve the highest grade.

sentences.chinese: 他的父亲是家里的家长，一个严肃的中年人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de fù qīn shì jiā lǐ de jiā zhǎng, yí gè yán sù de zhōng nián rén.
sentences.english: His father was the head of the household, a serious middle-aged man.

sentences.chinese: 父亲希望他能通过考试，成为一名高级官员。
sentences.pinyin: Fù qīn xī wàng tā néng tōng guò kǎo shì, chéng wéi yì míng gāo jí guān yuán.
sentences.english: His father hoped he could pass the exams and become a high-ranking official.

sentences.chinese: 今天书院开学了，教室里坐满了学生。
sentences.pinyin: Jīn tiān shū yuàn kāi xué le, jiào shì lǐ zuò mǎn le xué shēng.
sentences.english: Today the academy opened for the new term, and the classroom was full of students.

sentences.chinese: 每个学生面前都有一份厚厚的书本。
sentences.pinyin: Měi gè xué shēng miàn qián dōu yǒu yí fèn hòu hòu de shū běn.
sentences.english: In front of every student was a thick copy of a book.

sentences.chinese: 李明坐在第三层台阶上，看着周围的同学。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zuò zài dì sān céng tái jiē shàng, kàn zhe zhōu wéi de tóng xué.
sentences.english: Li Ming sat on the third layer of steps, looking at his classmates around him.

sentences.chinese: 他的班长是一个非常聪明的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de bān zhǎng shì yí gè fēi cháng cōng míng de rén.
sentences.english: His class monitor was a very intelligent person.

sentences.chinese: 班长告诉大家，这次的教学水平会更高。
sentences.pinyin: Bān zhǎng gào su dā jiā, zhè cì de jiào xué shuǐ píng huì gèng gāo.
sentences.english: The monitor told everyone that the level of teaching this time would be even higher.

sentences.chinese: 在课堂上，教师在黑板上写了很多生词。
sentences.pinyin: Zài kè táng shàng, jiào shī zài hēi bǎn shàng xiě le hěn duō shēng cí.
sentences.english: In the classroom, the teacher wrote many new words on the blackboard.

sentences.chinese: 这些词对于很多青少年来说很难。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiē cí duì yú hěn duō qīng shào nián lái shuō hěn nán.
sentences.english: These words were very difficult for many adolescents.

sentences.chinese: 李明认真地做作业，因为他想提高自己的成绩。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng rèn zhēn de zuò zuò yè, yīn wèi tā xiǎng tí gāo zì jǐ de chéng jì.
sentences.english: Li Ming did his assignments diligently because he wanted to improve his performance records.

sentences.chinese: 书院分为很多科，每科都有不同的老师。
sentences.pinyin: Shū yuàn fēn wéi hěn duō kē, měi kē dōu yǒu bù tóng de lǎo shī.
sentences.english: The academy was divided into many branches of study, each with different teachers.

sentences.chinese: 李明在历史科学习，他是这个年级的顶尖学生。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zài lì shǐ kē xué xí, tā shì zhè gè nián jí de dǐng jiān xué shēng.
sentences.english: Li Ming studied in the history division; he was the top student in his grade.

sentences.chinese: 他的水平已经达到了中级以上的程度。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shuǐ píng yǐ jīng dá dào le zhōng jí yǐ shàng de chéng dù.
sentences.english: His level had already reached a middle-level standard or above.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一位组长走进来，通知大家准备考试。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yí wèi zǔ zhǎng zǒu jìn lái, tōng zhī dā jiā zhǔn bèi kǎo shì.
sentences.english: At that moment, a group leader walked in and notified everyone to prepare for the exam.

sentences.chinese: 每一个考生都感到很紧张。
sentences.pinyin: Měi yí gè kǎo shēng dōu gǎn dào hěn jǐn zhāng.
sentences.english: Every exam candidate felt very nervous.

sentences.chinese: 这时，书院的校长走进了教室。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, shū yuàn de xiào zhǎng zǒu jìn le jiào shì.
sentences.english: Then, the headmaster of the academy entered the classroom.

sentences.chinese: 校长身后跟着院长，院长是这个机构的最高领导。
sentences.pinyin: Xiào zhǎng shēn hòu gēn zhe yuàn zhǎng, yuàn zhǎng shì zhè gè jī gòu de zuì gāo lǐng dǎo.
sentences.english: Behind the headmaster followed the dean, who was the highest leader of the institution.

sentences.chinese: 他们看向学生们，眼神中充满了期待。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men kàn xiàng xué shēng men, yǎn shén zhōng chōng mǎn le qī dài.
sentences.english: They looked at the students, their eyes full of expectation.

sentences.chinese: 院长说：“这里的教育涵盖了中小学的所有基础知识。”
sentences.pinyin: Yuàn zhǎng shuō: “Zhè lǐ de jiào yù hán gài le zhōng xiǎo xué de suǒ yǒu jī chǔ zhī shi.”
sentences.english: The dean said, "The education here covers all the basic knowledge of middle and elementary school."

sentences.chinese: 他强调，无论你是哪个级的学生，都要努力。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qiáng diào, wú lùn nǐ shì nǎ gè jí de xué shēng, dōu yào nǔ lì.
sentences.english: He emphasized that no matter which grade the student was in, they must work hard.

sentences.chinese: 在古代，大人对教育非常重视。
sentences.pinyin: Zài gǔ dài, dà ren duì jiào yù fēi cháng zhòng shì.
sentences.english: In ancient times, adults placed great importance on education.

sentences.chinese: 李明记得，他的老师曾说，知识能改变命运。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng jì de, tā de lǎo shī céng shuō, zhī shi néng gǎi biàn mìng yùn.
sentences.english: Li Ming remembered his teacher once saying that knowledge could change one's fate.

sentences.chinese: 他看着窗外的风景，心中想到了未来的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe chuāng wài de fēng jǐng, xīn zhōng xiǎng dào le wèi lái de shēng huó.
sentences.english: He looked at the scenery outside the window, thinking of his future life.

sentences.chinese: 突然，校长在课堂上停了下来。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, xiào zhǎng zài kè táng shàng tíng le xià lái.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the headmaster stopped in the classroom.

sentences.chinese: 他拿出一封秘密的信，脸色变得很严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū yì fēng mì mì de xìn, liǎn sè biàn de hěn yán sù.
sentences.english: He took out a secret letter, and his expression became very serious.

sentences.chinese: 这封信改变了所有人的命运。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fēng xìn gǎi biàn le suǒ yǒu rén de mìng yùn.
sentences.english: This letter changed everyone's fate.

sentences.chinese: 李明好奇地看着那封信，他不知道发生了什么。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng hào qí de kàn zhe nà fēng xìn, tā bù zhī dào fā shēng le shén me.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked at the letter curiously, not knowing what had happened.

sentences.chinese: 书院的平静生活在这一刻被打破了。
sentences.pinyin: Shū yuàn de píng jìng shēng huó zài zhè yí kè bèi dǎ pò le.
sentences.english: The peaceful life of the academy was shattered at this moment.

sentences.chinese: 校长慢慢地走到了黑板前面。
sentences.pinyin: Xiào zhǎng màn màn de zǒu dào le hēi bǎn qián miàn.
sentences.english: The principal slowly walked to the front of the blackboard.

sentences.chinese: 他没有说话，只是看着学生们。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méi yǒu shuō huà, zhǐ shì kàn zhe xué sheng men.
sentences.english: He did not speak, he just looked at the students.

sentences.chinese: 李明觉得今天的情况很不一般。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng jué de jīn tiān de qíng kuàng hěn bù yī bān.
sentences.english: Li Ming felt that today's situation was not ordinary.

sentences.chinese: 虽然教室里很安静，但是每个人的心都跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Suī rán jiào shì lǐ hěn ān jìng, dàn shì měi gè rén de xīn dōu tiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Although the classroom was very quiet, everyone's heart was beating very fast.

sentences.chinese: 校长告诉大家，这封信来自京城，而且非常重要。
sentences.pinyin: Xiào zhǎng gào su lǐ dà jiā, zhè fēng xìn lái zì jīng chéng, ér qiě fēi cháng zhòng yào.
sentences.english: The principal told everyone that this letter came from the capital and was moreover very important.

sentences.chinese: 信中说，书院不但要教书，还要保护一个古老的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Xìn zhōng shuō, shū yuàn bù dàn yào jiāo shū, hái yào bǎo hù yī gè gǔ lǎo de mì mì.
sentences.english: The letter said that the academy must not only teach books but also protect an ancient secret.

sentences.chinese: 除了李明以外，其他学生都露出了害怕的表情。
sentences.pinyin: Chú le Lǐ Míng yǐ wài, qí tā xué sheng dōu lù chū le hài pà de biǎo qíng.
sentences.english: Apart from Li Ming, the other students all showed expressions of fear.

sentences.chinese: 校长说：“如果你们想保护这个秘密的话，就必须听我的话。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiào zhǎng shuō: “Rú guǒ nǐ men xiǎng bǎo hù zhè gè mì mì de huà, jiù bì xū tīng wǒ de huà.”
sentences.english: The principal said, "If you want to protect this secret, you must listen to me."

sentences.chinese: 李明想问为什么，可是他不敢开口。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xiǎng wèn wèi shén me, kě shì tā bù gǎn kāi kǒu.
sentences.english: Li Ming wanted to ask why, but he did not dare to speak.

sentences.chinese: 因为在古代，违背校长的命令是非常严重的。
sentences.pinyin: Yīn wèi zài gǔ dài, wéi bèi xiào zhǎng de mìng lìng shì fēi cháng yán zhòng de.
sentences.english: Because in ancient times, disobeying the principal's orders was very serious.

sentences.chinese: 校长解释道，这个秘密涉及很多历史事件，比如很多年前的战争。
sentences.pinyin: Xiào zhǎng jiě shì dào, zhè gè mì mì shè jí hěn duō lì shǐ shì jiàn, bǐ rú hěn duō nián qián de zhàn zhēng.
sentences.english: The principal explained that this secret involved many historical events, for example, wars from many years ago.

sentences.chinese: 比如说，一些失踪的宝藏，例如皇室的古书。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐ rú shuō, yī xiē shī zōng de bǎo zàng, lì rú huáng shì de gǔ shū.
sentences.english: For instance, some missing treasures, such as royal ancient books.

sentences.chinese: 但这些东西现在不能被任何人发现。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zhè xiē dōng xi xiàn zài bù néng bèi rèn hé rén fā xiàn.
sentences.english: But these things cannot be discovered by anyone now.

sentences.chinese: 所以，学生们现在只能在书院里学习，不能随便出去。
sentences.pinyin: Suǒ yǐ, xué sheng men xiàn zài zhǐ néng zài shū yuàn lǐ xué xí, bù néng suí biàn chū qù.
sentences.english: Therefore, the students can only study in the academy now and cannot go out casually.

sentences.chinese: 不过，李明心中还是有疑问。
sentences.pinyin: Bù guò, Lǐ Míng xīn zhōng hái shì yǒu yí wèn.
sentences.english: However, Li Ming still had doubts in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得只要努力学习，就能找到真相。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué de zhǐ yào nǔ lì xué xí, jiù néng zhǎo dào zhēn xiàng.
sentences.english: He felt that as long as he studied hard, he could find the truth.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果能看到那封信，情况会更好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rú guǒ néng kàn dào nà fēng xìn, qíng kuàng huì gèng hǎo.
sentences.english: He thought that if he could see that letter, the situation would be better.

sentences.chinese: 然后，他看到校长又看了一眼窗外。
sentences.pinyin: Rán hòu, tā kàn dào xiào zhǎng yòu kàn le yī yǎn chuāng wài.
sentences.english: Then, he saw the principal look out the window again.

sentences.chinese: 李明发现，除了学习以外，书院里还隐藏着很多秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng fā xiàn, chú le xué xí yǐ wài, shū yuàn lǐ hái yǐn cáng zhe hěn duō mì mì.
sentences.english: Li Ming discovered that other than studying, there were many secrets hidden in the academy.

sentences.chinese: 他只希望自己能勇敢面对这一切。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐ xī wàng zì jǐ néng yǒng gǎn miàn duì zhè yī qiè.
sentences.english: He only hoped that he could bravely face all of this.

sentences.chinese: 但是，他知道这并不是一件简单的事情。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn shì, tā zhī dào zhè bìng bù shì yī jiàn jiǎn dān de shì qing.
sentences.english: But he knew that this was not a simple matter.

sentences.chinese: 因为这个秘密不仅关乎书院，而且关乎整个国家的命运。
sentences.pinyin: Yīn wèi zhè gè mì mì bù jǐn guān hū shū yuàn, ér qiě guān hū zhěng gè guó jiā de mìng yùn.
sentences.english: Because this secret not only concerns the academy but also concerns the fate of the entire country.

sentences.chinese: 突然，窗外传来了一声奇怪的响声，所有人都惊呆了。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, chuāng wài chuán lái le yī shēng qí guài de xiǎng shēng, suǒ yǒu rén dōu jīng dāi le.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a strange sound came from outside the window, and everyone was stunned.

sentences.chinese: 李明惊呆了，窗外的一棵老树突然倒了。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng jīng dāi le, chuāng wài de yì kē lǎo shù tū rán dǎo le.
sentences.english: Li Ming was stunned; an old tree outside the window suddenly fell.

sentences.chinese: 风在吹，树叶在飞，声音很大。
sentences.pinyin: Fēng zài chuī, shù yè zài fēi, shēng yīn hěn dà.
sentences.english: The wind was blowing, leaves were flying, and the sound was very loud.

sentences.chinese: 他赶紧走到窗前，看到对面站着一个人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎn jǐn zǒu dào chuāng qián, kàn dào duì miàn zhàn zhe yí gè rén.
sentences.english: He hurried to the window and saw a person standing opposite.

sentences.chinese: 那个人穿着一套黑色的衣服，看起来很神秘。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén chuān zhe yí tào hēi sè de yī fu, kàn qǐ lái hěn shén mì.
sentences.english: That person was wearing a set of black clothes and looked very mysterious.

sentences.chinese: 李明心里很紧张，他不知道对方是谁，也不知道这会带来什么危险。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xīn lǐ hěn jǐn zhāng, tā bù zhī dào duì fāng shì shuí, yě bù zhī dào zhè huì dài lái shén me wēi xiǎn.
sentences.english: Li Ming felt very nervous; he didn't know who the other person was, nor did he know what danger this would bring.

sentences.chinese: 他想起书院的老师说过，学习不仅要读书，还要学会思考，才能取得成功。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ shū yuàn de lǎo shī shuō guò, xué xí bù jǐn yào dú shū, hái yào xué huì sī kǎo, cái néng qǔ dé chéng gōng.
sentences.english: He remembered his academy teacher saying that studying is not just about reading books, but also about learning to think in order to achieve success.

sentences.chinese: 这时，对方大声喊了他的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, duì fāng dà shēng hǎn le tā de míng zi.
sentences.english: At that moment, the other person shouted his name loudly.

sentences.chinese: 李明感到很不好意思，因为他还没穿好衣服就跑到了窗边。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng gǎn dào hěn bù hǎo yì si, yīn wèi tā hái méi chuān hǎo yī fu jiù pǎo dào le chuāng biān.
sentences.english: Li Ming felt embarrassed because he had run to the window before he had finished dressing.

sentences.chinese: 那个人说：“快点儿，我有一件重要的事情要和你商量。”
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén shuō: “Kuài diǎn r, wǒ yǒu yí jiàn zhòng yào de shì qing yào hé nǐ shāng liang.”
sentences.english: The person said, "Hurry up, I have an important matter to discuss with you."

sentences.chinese: 李明小心地打开窗户，对方交给他一张小纸条。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xiǎo xīn de dǎ kāi chuāng hu, duì fāng jiāo gěi tā yì zhāng xiǎo zhǐ tiáo.
sentences.english: Li Ming carefully opened the window, and the other person handed him a small note.

sentences.chinese: 纸条上写着，他需要去书院后山的旧屋取一样东西。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐ tiáo shàng xiě zhe, tā xū yào qù shū yuàn hòu shān de jiù wū qǔ yí yàng dōng xi.
sentences.english: The note said that he needed to go to the old house on the back mountain of the academy to retrieve something.

sentences.chinese: 李明听说那里以前是一个被遗忘的图书馆，现在只有几个养鸟的人在干活儿。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng tīng shuō nà lǐ yǐ qián shì yí gè bèi yí wàng de tú shū guǎn, xiàn zài zhǐ yǒu jǐ gè yǎng niǎo de rén zài gàn huó r.
sentences.english: Li Ming had heard that it used to be a forgotten library, and now only a few people who raise birds were working there.

sentences.chinese: 他想起了之前借给同学的书，还没还回来，但现在这些都不重要了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ le zhī qián jiè gěi tóng xué de shū, hái méi huán huí lái, dàn xiàn zài zhè xiē dōu bù zhòng yào le.
sentences.english: He thought of the book he had lent to a classmate, which hadn't been returned yet, but now none of that was important.

sentences.chinese: 他决定立刻行动，但现在是深夜，他必须小心。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué dìng lì kè xíng dòng, dàn xiàn zài shì shēn yè, tā bì xū xiǎo xīn.
sentences.english: He decided to act immediately, but it was late at night, so he had to be careful.

sentences.chinese: 他看到那个人在纸条上打印了一个奇怪的红色印章，像是一个秘密的信号。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào nà gè rén zài zhǐ tiáo shàng dǎ yìn le yí gè qí guài de hóng sè yìn zhāng, xiàng shì yí gè mì mì de xìn hào.
sentences.english: He saw that the person had stamped a strange red seal on the note, which looked like a secret signal.

sentences.chinese: 李明问：“为什么不直接告诉我？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng wèn: “Wèi shén me bù zhí jiē gào sù wǒ?”
sentences.english: Li Ming asked, "Why not tell me directly?"

sentences.chinese: 那个人说：“秘密不能随便发出去，必须交给信任的人。”
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén shuō: “Mì mì bù néng suí biàn fā chū qù, bì xū jiāo gěi xìn rèn de rén.”
sentences.english: The person said, "Secrets cannot be sent out casually; they must be handed over to trusted people."

sentences.chinese: 李明在心中得出结论：这封信和昨天的秘密一定有关。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zài xīn zhōng dé chū jié lùn: zhè fēng xìn hé zuó tiān de mì mì yí dìng yǒu guān.
sentences.english: Li Ming arrived at the conclusion in his heart: this note must be related to yesterday's secret.

sentences.chinese: 他想起自己每天午睡的时间，如果现在出发，可以在天亮前完成任务。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ zì jǐ měi tiān wǔ shuì de shí jiān, rú guǒ xiàn zài chū fā, kě yǐ zài tiān liàng qián wán chéng rèn wu.
sentences.english: He thought of his daily nap time; if he set out now, he could complete the mission before dawn.

sentences.chinese: 他走到桌边，拉开抽屉，拿出了一把小灯。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu dào zhuō biān, lā kāi chōu tí, ná chū le yì bǎ xiǎo dēng.
sentences.english: He walked to the table, pulled open the drawer, and took out a small lamp.

sentences.chinese: 他知道这次任务很难，他对自己说：“加油！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhī dào zhè cì rèn wu hěn nán, tā duì zì jǐ shuō: “Jiā yóu!”
sentences.english: He knew this mission was difficult, and he said to himself, "Keep going!"

sentences.chinese: 在去后山的路上，他看到一个孩子在哭，因为他的风筝被树勾住了。
sentences.pinyin: Zài qù hòu shān de lù shàng, tā kàn dào yí gè hái zi zài kū, yīn wèi tā de fēng zhèng bèi shù gōu zhù le.
sentences.english: On the way to the back mountain, he saw a child crying because his kite was caught in a tree.

sentences.chinese: 李明停下来帮孩子拿回风筝，孩子看着他，眼神中充满了感动。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng tíng xià lái bāng hái zi ná huí fēng zhèng, hái zi kàn zhe tā, yǎn shén zhōng chōng mǎn le gǎn dòng.
sentences.english: Li Ming stopped to help the child get the kite back; the child looked at him, eyes full of emotion.

sentences.chinese: 李明觉得，在危险的时刻，帮助别人能让自己度过恐惧。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng jué dé, zài wēi xiǎn de shí kè, bāng zhù bié rén néng ràng zì jǐ dù guò kǒng jù.
sentences.english: Li Ming felt that in dangerous moments, helping others could help oneself get through fear.

sentences.chinese: 他终于来到了旧屋，那里很安静，只有风在吹。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhōng yú lái dào le jiù wū, nà lǐ hěn ā jìng, zhǐ yǒu fēng zài chuī.
sentences.english: He finally arrived at the old house; it was very quiet, with only the wind blowing.

sentences.chinese: 他记得老师说，每刻时间都很宝贵，不能浪费。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì dé lǎo shī shuō, měi kè shí jiān dōu hěn bǎo guì, bù néng làng fèi.
sentences.english: He remembered the teacher saying that every quarter hour is precious and should not be wasted.

sentences.chinese: 他进入屋子，在书架后面找到了那个盒子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìn rù wū zi, zài shū jià hòu miàn zhǎo dào le nà gè hé zi.
sentences.english: He entered the house and found the box behind the bookshelf.

sentences.chinese: 他终于得到了他一直在寻找的答案。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhōng yú dé dào le tā yì zhí zài xún zhǎo de dá àn.
sentences.english: He finally obtained the answer he had been searching for.

sentences.chinese: 但就在他准备离开时，身后突然传来了沉重的脚步声。
