sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài tā zhǔn bèi lí kāi shí, shēn hòu tū rán chuán lái le chén zhòng de jiǎo bù shēng.
sentences.english: But just as he was preparing to leave, heavy footsteps suddenly sounded behind him.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 4: The Visitor in the Shadows

sentences.chinese: 李明听到脚步声，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng tīng dào jiǎobù shēng, xīntiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Li Ming heard the footsteps, and his heart beat very fast.

sentences.chinese: 他赶紧把那个盒子放下。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎnjǐn bǎ nàge hézi fàngxià.
sentences.english: He quickly put down the box.

sentences.chinese: 他慢慢地转过身，看到一个穿着绿衣服的人站在门口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mànmàn de zhuǎnguò shēn, kàndào yīgè chuānzhe lǜ yīfu de rén zhàn zài ménkǒu.
sentences.english: He slowly turned around and saw a person wearing green clothes standing at the door.

sentences.chinese: 那个人挺起胸膛，看起来很严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge rén tǐng qǐ xiōngtáng, kàn qǐlái hěn yánsù.
sentences.english: That person straightened his chest, looking very serious.

sentences.chinese: 李明想起在书院的时候，经常有人开他的笑话，说他太胆小。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xiǎngqǐ zài shūyuàn de shíhou, jīngcháng yǒurén kāi tā de xiàohua, shuō tā tài dǎnxiǎo.
sentences.english: Li Ming remembered that back at the academy, people often made jokes about him, saying he was too timid.

sentences.chinese: 但现在，他不能表现得像个孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiànzài, tā bùnéng biǎoxiàn de xiàng gè háizi.
sentences.english: But now, he could not act like a child.

sentences.chinese: 那个陌生人走过阴暗的走廊，停在李明面前。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge mòshēng rén zǒuguò yīn'àn de zǒuláng, tíng zài Lǐ Míng miànqián.
sentences.english: The stranger walked past the dark corridor and stopped in front of Li Ming.

sentences.chinese: 他看着李明，问他是否拿到了那个秘密的答案。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe Lǐ Míng, wèn tā shìfǒu nádào le nàge mìmì de dá'àn.
sentences.english: He looked at Li Ming and asked if he had obtained the secret answer.

sentences.chinese: 李明没有立刻答应，因为他不知道对方是谁。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng méiyǒu lìkè dāying, yīnwèi tā bù zhīdào duìfāng shì shuí.
sentences.english: Li Ming did not agree immediately because he did not know who the other person was.

sentences.chinese: 对方提出了一个要求，要李明把盒子交给他。
sentences.pinyin: Duìfāng tíchū le yīgè yāoqiú, yào Lǐ Míng bǎ hézi jiāo gěi tā.
sentences.english: The other person proposed a request, wanting Li Ming to hand over the box.

sentences.chinese: 李明想推掉这个要求，因为这个盒子太重要了。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xiǎng tuīdiào zhège yāoqiú, yīnwèi zhège hézi tài zhòngyào le.
sentences.english: Li Ming wanted to push away this request because the box was too important.

sentences.chinese: 对方接着说，如果你接受我的帮助，我可以让你安全离开。
sentences.pinyin: Duìfāng jiēzhe shuō, rúguǒ nǐ jiēshòu wǒ de bāngzhù, wǒ kěyǐ ràng nǐ ānquán líkāi.
sentences.english: The other person continued, saying, "If you accept my help, I can let you leave safely."

sentences.chinese: 李明看着对方的眼睛，发现对方的眼神很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kànzhe duìfāng de yǎnjīng, fāxiàn duìfāng de yǎnshén hěn lěng.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked into the other person's eyes and found their gaze to be very cold.

sentences.chinese: 对方拿出了一张旧画，上面画着一座高山。
sentences.pinyin: Duìfāng náchū le yī zhāng jiù huà, shàngmiàn huàzhe yī zuò gāoshān.
sentences.english: The other person took out an old painting, which depicted a high mountain.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉李明，想要找到真正的答案，必须去爬山。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosu Lǐ Míng, xiǎngyào zhǎodào zhēnzhèng de dá'àn, bìxū qù páshān.
sentences.english: He told Li Ming that to find the true answer, he must go mountain climbing.

sentences.chinese: 在这个国家，只有那些敢于爬山的人才能看到真相。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège guójiā, zhǐyǒu nàxiē gǎnyú páshān de rén cáinéng kàndào zhēnxiàng.
sentences.english: In this country, only those who dare to climb mountains can see the truth.

sentences.chinese: 李明记得，他的父亲生在他之前不久就离开了。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng jìde, tā de fùqīn shēng zài tā zhīqián bùjiǔ jiù líkāi le.
sentences.english: Li Ming remembered that his father had left shortly after he was born.

sentences.chinese: 父亲给他留下了很多关于历史的知识，但没有提到这个盒子。
sentences.pinyin: Fùqīn gěi tā liúxià le hěnduō guānyú lìshǐ de zhīshi, dàn méiyǒu tí dào zhège hézi.
sentences.english: His father had left behind much knowledge about history, but had not mentioned this box.

sentences.chinese: 李明感觉到心口有些疼，那是对父亲的思念。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng gǎnjué dào xīnkǒu yǒuxiē téng, nà shì duì fùqīn de sīniàn.
sentences.english: Li Ming felt a slight pain in his chest; it was the longing for his father.

sentences.chinese: 他想起父亲曾经租了一间小房子，在那里面写了很多书。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ fùqīn céngjīng zū le yī jiàn xiǎo fángzi, zài nà lǐmiàn xiě le hěnduō shū.
sentences.english: He remembered that his father had once rented a small house where he wrote many books.

sentences.chinese: 那时候，父亲的收入很低，生活很辛苦。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shíhou, fùqīn de shōurù hěn dī, shēnghuó hěn xīnkǔ.
sentences.english: At that time, his father's income was very low, and life was very hard.

sentences.chinese: 但父亲总是告诉他，知识比金钱更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn fùqīn zǒngshì gàosu tā, zhīshi bǐ jīnqián gèng zhòngyào.
sentences.english: But his father always told him that knowledge was more important than money.

sentences.chinese: 现在，李明必须决定接下来怎么做。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài, Lǐ Míng bìxū juédìng jiēxiàlái zěnme zuò.
sentences.english: Now, Li Ming had to decide what to do next.

sentences.chinese: 他不能让这个秘密掉在坏人的手里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bùnéng ràng zhège mìmì diào zài huàirén de shǒu lǐ.
sentences.english: He could not let this secret fall into the hands of bad people.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试用另一种方式来接这个挑战。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chángshì yòng lìng yī zhǒng fāngshì lái jiē zhège tiǎozhàn.
sentences.english: He tried to accept this challenge in a different way.

sentences.chinese: 他决定换一件衣服，让自己看起来不像个学生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juédìng huàn yī jiàn yīfu, ràng zìjǐ kàn qǐlái bù xiàng gè xuéshēng.
sentences.english: He decided to change his clothes so that he would not look like a student.

sentences.chinese: 他快速地洗澡，洗掉了身上的灰尘。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kuàisù de xǐzǎo, xǐdiào le shēnshang de huīchén.
sentences.english: He quickly took a bath, washing away the dust from his body.

sentences.chinese: 他走出旧屋，看到门外排成一排的士兵。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒuchū jiùwū, kàndào ménwài pái chéng yī pái de shìbīng.
sentences.english: He walked out of the old house and saw rows of soldiers lined up outside the door.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到自己碰到了一个巨大的阴谋。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào zìjǐ pèngdào le yīgè jùdà de yīnmóu.
sentences.english: He realized that he had come across a huge conspiracy.

sentences.chinese: 他没想到会在这个深夜碰见这么多军队。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu xiǎngdào huì zài zhège shēnyè pèngjiàn zhème duō jūnduì.
sentences.english: He had not expected to run into so many troops in the middle of the night.

sentences.chinese: 汗水从他的额头流了下来。
sentences.pinyin: Hànshuǐ cóng tā de étóu liú le xiàlái.
sentences.english: Sweat flowed down from his forehead.

sentences.chinese: 他慢慢地爬向窗边，试图寻找逃跑的机会。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mànmàn de pá xiàng chuāngbiān, shìtú xúnzhǎo táopǎo de jīhuì.
sentences.english: He slowly crawled toward the window, attempting to find a chance to escape.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，那个绿衣服的人突然对他笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhèshí, nàge lǜ yīfu de rén tūrán duì tā xiào le.
sentences.english: Just then, the person in green suddenly smiled at him.

sentences.chinese: 那个绿衣服的人笑着说：“走开，你跑不掉的！”
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè lǜ yī fú de rén xiào zhe shuō: “Zǒu kāi, nǐ pǎo bù diào de!”
sentences.english: The man in green smiled and said, "Get away, you can't escape!"

sentences.chinese: 李明惊恐地看着他，心中大喊：“啊！”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng jīng kǒng de kàn zhe tā, xīn zhōng dà hǎn: “Ā!”
sentences.english: Li Ming looked at him in terror and screamed in his heart, "Ah!"

sentences.chinese: 他试图从椅子上跳起来，但对方的速度更快。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì tú cóng yǐ zi shàng tiào qǐ lái, dàn duì fāng de sù dù gèng kuài.
sentences.english: He tried to jump up from the chair, but the other person was faster.

sentences.chinese: 对方穿着一件黑色的长袍，像个幽灵一样走过来。
sentences.pinyin: Duì fāng chuān zhe yī jiàn hēi sè de cháng páo, xiàng gè yōu líng yī yàng zǒu guò lái.
sentences.english: The opponent wore a black robe and walked over like a ghost.

sentences.chinese: 这个陌生人告诉李明，书院的老师们现在都不能帮他。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè mò shēng rén gào sù Lǐ Míng, shū yuàn de lǎo shī men xiàn zài dōu bù néng bāng tā.
sentences.english: This stranger told Li Ming that the teachers at the academy could not help him now.

sentences.chinese: 有的老师在休假，有的因为生病而住院。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu de lǎo shī zài xiū jià, yǒu de yīn wèi shēng bìng ér zhù yuàn.
sentences.english: Some teachers were on vacation, and some were hospitalized due to illness.

sentences.chinese: 李明想离开这里，但所有的出口都被士兵堵住了。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xiǎng lí kāi zhè lǐ, dàn suǒ yǒu de chū kǒu dōu bèi shì bīng dǔ zhù le.
sentences.english: Li Ming wanted to leave this place, but all the exits were blocked by soldiers.

sentences.chinese: 陌生人冷笑着说：“你想出国吗？或者去外地？”
sentences.pinyin: Mò shēng rén lěng xiào zhe shuō: “Nǐ xiǎng chū guó ma? Huò zhě qù wài dì?”
sentences.english: The stranger sneered, "Do you want to go abroad? Or go to another part of the country?"

sentences.chinese: “在这个国家，没有我的允许，你不能随便出门。”
sentences.pinyin: “Zài zhè gè guó jiā, méi yǒu wǒ de yǔn xǔ, nǐ bù néng suí biàn chū mén.”
sentences.english: "In this country, you cannot go out casually without my permission."

sentences.chinese: 李明想起他之前在京城打工的日子，那时候生活很单纯。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xiǎng qǐ tā zhī qián zài jīng chéng dǎ gōng de rì zi, nà shí hòu shēng huó hěn dān chún.
sentences.english: Li Ming remembered the days when he worked temporary jobs in the capital; life was very simple then.

sentences.chinese: 他必须省下所有力气，寻找一个逃跑的机会。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì xū shěng xià suǒ yǒu lì qì, xún zhǎo yī gè táo pǎo de jī huì.
sentences.english: He had to save all his strength to find an opportunity to escape.

sentences.chinese: 陌生人拿出一个奇怪的黑色盒子，像是在开机一样打开了它。
sentences.pinyin: Mò shēng rén ná chū yī gè qí guài de hēi sè hé zi, xiàng shì zài kāi jī yī yàng dǎ kāi le tā.
sentences.english: The stranger took out a strange black box and opened it as if he were booting it up.

sentences.chinese: 在这个古代的夜晚，这个盒子发出诡异的光，仿佛在关机前最后闪烁。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè gè gǔ dài de yè wǎn, zhè gè hé zi fā chū guǐ yì de guāng, fǎng fú zài guān jī qián zuì hòu shǎn shuò.
sentences.english: In this ancient night, the box emitted an eerie light, as if flickering one last time before shutting down.

sentences.chinese: 陌生人从盒子里拿出一张奇怪的金属卡片，看起来像现代的银行卡。
sentences.pinyin: Mò shēng rén cóng hé zi lǐ ná chū yī zhāng qí guài de jīn shǔ kǎ piàn, kàn qǐ lái xiàng xiàn dài de yín háng kǎ.
sentences.english: The stranger took a strange metal card out of the box, which looked like a modern bank card.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“这是开启秘密大门的钥匙，但你现在得离开。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zhè shì kāi qǐ mì mì dà mén de yào shi, dàn nǐ xiàn zài děi lí kāi.”
sentences.english: He said, "This is the key to opening the secret door, but you must leave now."

sentences.chinese: 李明被强行带到院子里，那里停着很多马车。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng bèi qiáng xíng dài dào yuàn zi lǐ, nà lǐ tíng zhe hěn duō mǎ chē.
sentences.english: Li Ming was forcibly taken to the courtyard, where many carriages were parked.

sentences.chinese: 士兵们命令马车停车，准备将李明带走。
sentences.pinyin: Shì bīng men mìng lìng mǎ chē tíng chē, zhǔn bèi jiāng Lǐ Míng dài zǒu.
sentences.english: The soldiers ordered the carriages to stop, preparing to take Li Ming away.

sentences.chinese: 李明心中绝望，他想到如果能出院就不用面对这些痛苦，但他并不是病人。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xīn zhōng jué wàng, tā xiǎng dào rú guǒ néng chū yuàn jiù bù yòng miàn duì zhè xiē tòng kǔ, dàn tā bìng bù shì bìng rén.
sentences.english: Li Ming felt despair in his heart; he thought that if he could be discharged from the hospital, he wouldn't have to face this pain, but he wasn't a patient.

sentences.chinese: 他希望这一切只是一个噩梦，等到明天太阳升起时就能醒来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xī wàng zhè yī qiè zhǐ shì yī gè mèng nà, děng dào míng tiān tài yáng shēng qǐ shí jiù néng xǐng lái.
sentences.english: He hoped all this was just a nightmare and that he would wake up when the sun rose tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 陌生人告诉他，他们现在就要出发，去一个遥远的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Mò shēng rén gào sù tā, tā men xiàn zài jiù yào chū fā, qù yī gè yáo yuǎn de dì fāng.
sentences.english: The stranger told him that they were about to set off now to a distant place.

sentences.chinese: 李明看着那些被分开的同伴，心中充满了悲伤。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kàn zhe nà xiē bèi fēn kāi de tóng bàn, xīn zhōng chōng mǎn le bēi shāng.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked at his companions who were being separated, and his heart was filled with sadness.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，他看到一个送外卖的伙计在门口大喊大叫。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, tā kàn dào yī gè sòng wài mài de huǒ jì zài mén kǒu dà hǎn dà jiào.
sentences.english: Just then, he saw a takeout delivery boy shouting loudly at the door.

sentences.chinese: 这个混乱的机会让李明突然看到了一个逃跑的缝隙。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè hùn luàn de jī huì ràng Lǐ Míng tū rán kàn dào le yī gè táo pǎo de fèng xì.
sentences.english: This chaotic opportunity suddenly allowed Li Ming to see a gap for escape.

sentences.chinese: 李明趁乱跳出窗户，身体撞在冰冷的墙上。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng chèn luàn tiào chū chuāng hu, shēn tǐ zhuàng zài bīng lěng de qiáng shàng.
sentences.english: Li Ming took advantage of the chaos to jump out of the window, his body hitting the cold wall.

sentences.chinese: 他想起上周在书院读到的一段话，关于自由的意义。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ shàng zhōu zài shū yuàn dú dào de yī duàn huà, guān yú zì yóu de yì yì.
sentences.english: He remembered a passage he read at the academy last week about the meaning of freedom.

sentences.chinese: 他知道下周如果还在这里，他可能永远无法离开。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhī dào xià zhōu rú guǒ hái zài zhè lǐ, tā kě néng yǒng yuǎn wú fǎ lí kāi.
sentences.english: He knew that if he were still here next week, he might never be able to leave.

sentences.chinese: 他向东南方向跑去，那是离开这座城市的唯一路口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàng dōng nán fāng xiàng pǎo qù, nà shì lí kāi zhè zuò chéng shì de wéi yī lù kǒu.
sentences.english: He ran toward the southeast, the only exit to leave this city.

sentences.chinese: 街上的人们在惊慌地奔跑，因为这座城市发生了剧变。
sentences.pinyin: Jiē shàng de rén men zài jīng huāng de bēn pǎo, yīn wèi zhè zuò chéng shì fā shēng le jù biàn.
sentences.english: People on the street were running in panic because the city had undergone a drastic change.

sentences.chinese: 逃跑的人数很多，到处都是混乱的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Táo pǎo de rén shù hěn duō, dào chù dōu shì hùn luàn de shēng yīn.
sentences.english: The number of people escaping was large, and the sound of chaos was everywhere.

sentences.chinese: 他跑过那些简陋的住房，心中祈祷能找到一个安全的藏身处。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pǎo guò nà xiē jiǎn lòu de zhù fáng, xīn zhōng qí dǎo néng zhǎo dào yī gè ān quán de cáng shēn chù.
sentences.english: He ran past the simple housing, praying in his heart to find a safe hiding place.

sentences.chinese: 他想起书院里那位著名的作家，他曾写过许多关于勇气的书。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ shū yuàn lǐ nà wèi zhù míng de zuò jiā, tā céng xiě guò xǔ duō guān yú yǒng qì de shū.
sentences.english: He thought of the famous author in the academy, who had written many books about courage.

sentences.chinese: 在那个漫长的假期里，作家告诉他，真正的勇气是面对未知。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nà gè màn cháng de jià qī lǐ, zuò jiā gào sù tā, zhēn zhèng de yǒng qì shì miàn duì wèi zhī.
sentences.english: During that long vacation, the author told him that true courage is facing the unknown.

sentences.chinese: 李明想念他的全家，希望他们现在在家里平安。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xiǎng niàn tā de quán jiā, xī wàng tā men xiàn zài zài jiā lǐ píng ān.
sentences.english: Li Ming missed his whole family, hoping they were safe at home now.

sentences.chinese: 虽然在古代没有公共汽车，但他看到许多马车在飞快地行驶。
sentences.pinyin: Suī rán zài gǔ dài méi yǒu gōng gòng qì chē, dàn tā kàn dào xǔ duō mǎ chē zài fēi kuài de xíng shǐ.
sentences.english: Although there were no buses in ancient times, he saw many carriages speeding by.

sentences.chinese: 现在的天气很冷，像是在冬天一样，风像刀子一样割在脸上。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài de tiān qì hěn lěng, xiàng shì zài dōng tiān yī yàng, fēng xiàng dāo zi yī yàng gē zài liǎn shàng.
sentences.english: The weather now was very cold, as if it were winter, and the wind cut into his face like a knife.

sentences.chinese: 路边有一只受伤的动物，它在雪地里痛苦地呻吟。
sentences.pinyin: Lù biān yǒu yī zhī shòu shāng de dòng wù, tā zài xuě dì lǐ tòng kǔ de shēn yín.
sentences.english: There was an injured animal by the road, moaning in pain in the snow.

sentences.chinese: 他路过一个像动物园一样关着猛虎的笼子，那是市长用来展示权力的工具。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lù guò yī gè xiàng dòng wù yuán yī yàng guān zhe měng hǔ de lóng zi, nà shì shì zhǎng yòng lái zhǎn shì quán lì de gōng jù.
sentences.english: He passed by a cage of tigers that looked like a zoo, a tool used by the mayor to display power.

sentences.chinese: 李明在心中重复着一个句子：我必须活下去。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zài xīn zhōng chóng fù zhe yī gè jù zi: wǒ bì xū huó xià qù.
sentences.english: Li Ming repeated a sentence in his heart: I must survive.

sentences.chinese: 他希望这个周末能结束这场噩梦。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xī wàng zhè gè zhōu mò néng jié shù zhè chǎng è mèng.
sentences.english: He hoped this weekend could end this nightmare.

sentences.chinese: 他知道这个秘密不仅是本地的，而且具有国际的影响力。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhī dào zhè gè mì mì bù jǐn shì běn dì de, ér qiě jù yǒu guó jì de yǐng xiǎng lì.
sentences.english: He knew this secret was not just local, but had international influence.

sentences.chinese: 这个秘密可能改变整个地球的命运。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè mì mì kě néng gǎi biàn zhěng gè dì qiú de mìng yùn.
sentences.english: This secret could change the fate of the entire earth.

sentences.chinese: 他跑到了一个像地铁站一样深邃的地下排水道口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pǎo dào le yī gè xiàng dì tiě zhàn yī yàng shēn suì de dì xià pái shuǐ dào kǒu.
sentences.english: He ran to a deep underground drainage outlet that looked like a subway station.

sentences.chinese: 他记得夏天的时候，这里的水很清澈，现在却充满了泥泞。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì dé xià tiān de shí hòu, zhè lǐ de shuǐ hěn qīng chè, xiàn zài què chōng mǎn le ní nìng.
sentences.english: He remembered that in the summer, the water here was very clear, but now it was full of mud.

sentences.chinese: 他进入了阴暗的地下道，感受到了大自然的残酷与冰冷。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìn rù le yīn àn de dì xià dào, gǎn shòu dào le dà zì rán de cán kù yǔ bīng lěng.
sentences.english: He entered the dark underground passage, feeling the cruelty and coldness of nature.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个巨大的木制大门挡在了他的面前。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, yī gè jù dà de mù zhì dà mén dǎng zài le tā de miàn qián.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a huge wooden door blocked his path.

sentences.chinese: 他紧张地摸了摸自己的头发，发现额头上全是冷汗。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jǐn zhāng de mō le mō zì jǐ de tóu fa, fā xiàn é tóu shàng quán shì lěng hàn.
sentences.english: He nervously touched his hair, finding his forehead covered in cold sweat.

sentences.chinese: 他看到门边有一把钥匙，它闪着冰冷的光。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào mén biān yǒu yī bǎ yào shi, tā shǎn zhe bīng lěng de guāng.
sentences.english: He saw a key by the door; it shimmered with a cold light.

sentences.chinese: 他发现周围还有几把钥匙，它们看起来都一样。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn zhōu wéi hái yǒu jǐ bǎ yào shi, tā men kàn qǐ lái dōu yī yàng.
sentences.english: He found several other keys around him; they all looked the same.

sentences.chinese: 一个秘密的小组在暗中观察着他，他们想要夺回那个盒子。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè mì mì de xiǎo zǔ zài àn zhōng guān chá zhe tā, tā men xiǎng yào duó huí nà gè hé zi.
sentences.english: A secret group was observing him in the shadows, wanting to take back the box.

sentences.chinese: 此时，市长的士兵们正在附近搜查。
sentences.pinyin: Cǐ shí, shì zhǎng de shì bīng men zhèng zài fù jìn sōu chá.
sentences.english: At this moment, the mayor's soldiers were searching nearby.

sentences.chinese: 那个年轻的士兵看起来很紧张，手里拿着长矛。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè nián qīng de shì bīng kàn qǐ lái hěn jǐn zhāng, shǒu lǐ ná zhe cháng máo.
sentences.english: That young soldier looked very nervous, holding a spear in his hand.

sentences.chinese: 李明在阴影中找到了一个座位，那是个破旧的石凳。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zài yīn yǐng zhōng zhǎo dào le yī gè zuò wèi, nà shì gè pò jiù de shí dèng.
sentences.english: Li Ming found a seat in the shadows, which was an old stone stool.

sentences.chinese: 他习惯性地看向手腕，虽然那时没有手表，但他能感觉到时间在流逝。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xí guàn xìng de kàn xiàng shǒu wàn, suī rán nà shí méi yǒu shǒu biǎo, dàn tā néng gǎn jué dào shí jiān zài liú shì.
sentences.english: He habitually looked at his wrist; although there were no wristwatches then, he could feel time slipping away.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到自己现在需要一个像护照一样的凭证才能通过关卡。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào zì jǐ xiàn zài xū yào yī gè xiàng hù zhào yī yàng de píng zhèng cái néng tōng guò guān kǎ.
sentences.english: He realized he now needed a credential like a passport to pass through the checkpoint.

sentences.chinese: 他看到地上的一个球，像排球一样圆，但那是士兵丢掉的皮球。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào dì shàng de yī gè qiú, xiàng pái qiú yī yàng yuán, dàn nà shì shì bīng diū diào de pí qiú.
sentences.english: He saw a ball on the ground, round like a volleyball, but it was a leather ball dropped by a soldier.

sentences.chinese: 这就是他人生中最可怕的故事，而真正的挑战才刚刚开始。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiù shì tā rén shēng zhōng zuì kě pà de gù shì, ér zhēn zhèng de tiǎo zhàn cái gāng gāng kāi shǐ.
sentences.english: This was the most terrifying story of his life, and the real challenge had just begun.

sentences.chinese: 就在他准备推开大门时，身后传来了一阵急促的马蹄声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tā zhǔn bèi tuī kāi dà mén shí, shēn hòu chuán lái le yī zhèn jí cù de mǎ tí shēng.
sentences.english: Just as he was preparing to push open the door, a sound of hurried horse hooves came from behind him.

sentences.chinese: 马蹄声越来越近，李明的脸变得非常苍白。
sentences.pinyin: Mǎtí shēng yuè lái yuè jìn, Lǐ Míng de liǎn biàn de fēicháng cāngbái.
sentences.english: The sound of horse hooves grew closer, and Li Ming's face became very pale.

sentences.chinese: 他快步跑出大门，跑向远方的一条河。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kuàibù pǎo chū dàmén, pǎo xiàng yuǎnfāng de yī tiáo hé.
sentences.english: He hurried out of the gate and ran toward a river in the distance.

sentences.chinese: 他在河边看到一个奇怪的男人，那个男人像个画家一样拿着笔。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài hébiān kàndào yīgè qíguài de nánrén, nàgè nánrén xiàng gè huàjiā yīyàng názhe bǐ.
sentences.english: By the river, he saw a strange man who was holding a brush like a painter.

sentences.chinese: 男人的眼睛很亮，他看着李明说：“年轻人，你看起来很着急。”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén de yǎnjīng hěn liàng, tā kànzhe Lǐ Míng shuō: “Niánqīng rén, nǐ kàn qǐlái hěn zhāojí.”
sentences.english: The man's eyes were bright; he looked at Li Ming and said, "Young man, you look very anxious."

sentences.chinese: 李明喘着气，他的腿因为奔跑而感到疼痛。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng chuǎnzhe qì, tā de tuǐ yīnwèi bēnpǎo ér gǎndào téngtòng.
sentences.english: Li Ming gasped for air, and his legs felt painful from running.

sentences.chinese: 男人指了指地上的一个瓶子，笑着说：“这是一个笑话儿，你竟然在逃跑时丢了水瓶。”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén zhǐle zhǐ dìshàng de yīgè píngzi, xiàozhe shuō: “Zhè shì yīgè xiàohuar5, nǐ jìngrán zài táopǎo shí diūle shuǐpíng.”
sentences.english: The man pointed to a bottle on the ground and smiled, saying, "This is a joke, you actually lost your water bottle while escaping."

sentences.chinese: 李明没有笑，他现在最需要的是能离开这个城市的凭证。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng méiyǒu xiào, tā xiànzài zuì xūyào de shì néng líkāi zhège chéngshì de píngzhèng.
sentences.english: Li Ming did not laugh; what he needed most now was a credential to leave this city.

sentences.chinese: 男人告诉他，现在是春天的三个月份之中最冷的一个月。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén gàosù tā, xiànzài shì chūntiān de sān gè yuèfèn zhī zhōng zuì lěng de yīgè yuè.
sentences.english: The man told him that it was now the coldest month of the three months of spring.

sentences.chinese: 他记得去年春节的晚会，那时候书院的校园里到处是灯笼。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìdé qùnián Chūnjié de wǎnhuì, nà shíhòu shūyuàn de xiàoyuán lǐ dàochù shì dēnglóng.
sentences.english: He remembered the evening party of last year's Spring Festival, when the academy campus was full of lanterns.

sentences.chinese: 但现在，所有的美好都像秋天落叶一样消失了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiànzài, suǒyǒu de měihǎo dōu xiàng qiūtiān luòyè yīyàng xiāoshī le.
sentences.english: But now, all the beauty had vanished like autumn leaves.

sentences.chinese: 男人从怀里拿出一张像日报一样的纸，上面写着最新的新闻。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén cóng huái lǐ ná chū yī zhāng xiàng rìbào yīyàng de zhǐ, shàngmiàn xiězhe zuìxīn de xīnwén.
sentences.english: The man took a piece of paper from his robe that looked like a daily newspaper, with the latest news written on it.

sentences.chinese: 纸上说，朝廷在寻找一个知道秘密的科学家。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐ shàng shuō, cháotíng zài xúnzhǎo yīgè zhīdào mìmì de kēxuéjiā.
sentences.english: The paper said the imperial court was searching for a scientist who knew a secret.

sentences.chinese: 李明意识到，自己就是那个被寻找的人。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng yìshí dào, zìjǐ jiùshì nàgè bèi xúnzhǎo de rén.
sentences.english: Li Ming realized that he was the person being sought.

sentences.chinese: 男人问他：“你英语好吗？或者你会写英文？”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén wèn tā: “Nǐ Yīngyǔ hǎo ma? Huòzhě nǐ huì xiě Yīngwén?”
sentences.english: The man asked him, "Is your English good? Or can you write in English?"

sentences.chinese: 在古代，这些奇怪的语言是极少数人知道的秘密代码。
sentences.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, zhèxiē qíguài de yǔyán shì jí shǎoshù rén zhīdào de mìmì dàimǎ.
sentences.english: In ancient times, these strange languages were secret codes known only to a few.

sentences.chinese: 李明摇了摇头，他只知道书院的经书。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng yáole yáotóu, tā zhǐ zhīdào shūyuàn de jīngshū.
sentences.english: Li Ming shook his head; he only knew the scriptures of the academy.

sentences.chinese: 男人叹了口气，递给他一碗像方便面一样简单的面条。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén tànle kǒuqì, dì gěi tā yī wǎn xiàng fāngbiànmiàn yīyàng jiǎndān de miàntiáo.
sentences.english: The man sighed and handed him a bowl of noodles as simple as instant noodles.

sentences.chinese: 李明用筷子快速地吃完这顿简单的早餐。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng yòng kuàizi kuàisù de chī wán zhè dùn jiǎndān de zǎocān.
sentences.english: Li Ming used chopsticks to quickly finish this simple breakfast.

sentences.chinese: 他注意到男人穿着一双奇怪的球鞋，那是绿色的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhùyì dào nánrén chuānzhe yī shuāng qíguài de qiúxié, nà shì lǜsè de.
sentences.english: He noticed the man was wearing a pair of strange athletic shoes, which were green.

sentences.chinese: 这种鞋子在古代很罕见，看起来像是在打篮球时穿的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xiézi zài gǔdài hěn hǎnjiàn, kàn qǐlái xiàng shì zài dǎ lánqiú shí chuān de.
sentences.english: Such shoes were rare in ancient times and looked like something worn while playing basketball.

sentences.chinese: 男人说：“如果你有空儿，可以跟我去湖边看看。”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ yǒukòngr5, kěyǐ gēn wǒ qù húbiān kànkàn.”
sentences.english: The man said, "If you are available, you can come with me to the lake."

sentences.chinese: 在湖边，李明看到一只狗在追逐自己的尾巴。
sentences.pinyin: Zài húbiān, Lǐ Míng kàndào yī zhǐ gǒu zài zhuīzhú zìjǐ de wěiba.
sentences.english: By the lake, Li Ming saw a dog chasing its own tail.

sentences.chinese: 男人拿出一张菜单，但那不是餐厅的菜单，而是一张地图。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén ná chū yī zhāng càidān, dàn nà bùshì cāntīng de càidān, ér shì yī zhāng dìtú.
sentences.english: The man took out a menu, but it wasn't a restaurant menu; it was a map.

sentences.chinese: 地图上标出了最近的药店，那里有可以治伤的药。
sentences.pinyin: Dìtú shàng biāo chūle zuìjìn de yàodiàn, nàlǐ yǒu kěyǐ zhì shāng de yào.
sentences.english: The map marked the nearest pharmacy, where there was medicine to treat wounds.

sentences.chinese: 这时，天空出现了月亮，淡淡的光照在他们身上。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, tiānkōng chūxiànle yuèliang, dàndàn de guāng zhào zài tāmen shēnshàng.
sentences.english: At that moment, the moon appeared in the sky, casting a faint light upon them.

sentences.chinese: 在关键的节骨眼上，远处的士兵再次出现了。
sentences.pinyin: Zài guānjiàn de jiégǔyǎn shàng, yuǎnchù de shìbīng zàicì chūxiànle.
sentences.english: At the critical juncture, the soldiers in the distance appeared once again.

sentences.chinese: 李明想起了传说中那种能飞的离，希望自己也能像神兽一样飞走。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xiǎngqǐle chuánshuō zhōng nà zhǒng néng fēi de lí, xīwàng zìjǐ yě néng xiàng shénshòu yīyàng fēizǒu.
sentences.english: Li Ming thought of the legendary flying Li beast, hoping he could fly away like the mythical creature.

sentences.chinese: 他必须在被抓住之前找到离开这里的路。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū zài bèi zhuā zhū zhīqián zhǎodào líkāi zhèlǐ de lù.
sentences.english: He had to find a way to leave this place before being caught.

sentences.chinese: 男人突然低声说：“快跑，他们来了！”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén tūrán dīshēng shuō: “Kuài pǎo, tāmen lái le!”
sentences.english: The man suddenly whispered, "Run quickly, they are coming!"

sentences.chinese: 李明回头看了一眼，发现那个男人的眼神变得冰冷。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng huítóu kànle yīyǎn, fāxiàn nàgè nánrén de yǎnshén biàn de bīnglěng.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked back and found that the man's gaze had become cold.

sentences.chinese: 难道这个画家也是敌人的间谍？
sentences.pinyin: Nándào zhège huàjiā yěshì dírén de jiàndié?
sentences.english: Could this painter also be a spy for the enemy?

chapters.title_english: Chapter 8: The City in the Mist

sentences.chinese: 李明在恐惧中转身跑向西南方向。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zài kǒng jù zhōng zhuǎn shēn pǎo xiàng xī nán fāng xiàng.
sentences.english: Li Ming turned and ran toward the southwest in fear.

sentences.chinese: 他跑过一条狭窄的街，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pǎo guò yī tiáo xiá zhǎi de jiē, xīn tiào dé hěn kuài.
sentences.english: He ran through a narrow street, his heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 他的鞋子已经破了，脚在地上很疼。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de xié zi yǐ jīng pò le, jiǎo zài dì shàng hěn téng.
sentences.english: His shoes were already torn, and his feet hurt on the ground.

sentences.chinese: 这时，他看到一个穿着蓝色衣服的人在路边走。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, tā kàn dào yī gè chuān zhe lán sè yī fú de rén zài lù biān zǒu.
sentences.english: At that moment, he saw a person wearing blue clothes walking by the roadside.

sentences.chinese: 李明决定停下来问路，因为他不知道怎么离开这里。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng jué dìng tíng xià lái wèn lù, yīn wèi tā bù zhī dào zěn me lí kāi zhè lǐ.
sentences.english: Li Ming decided to stop and ask for directions, because he didn't know how to leave this place.

sentences.chinese: 他问那个蓝色衣服的人，去北方的路在什么样的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn nà gè lán sè yī fú de rén, qù běi fāng de lù zài shén me yàng de dì fāng.
sentences.english: He asked the person in blue what kind of place the road to the north was in.

sentences.chinese: 那个人看着他，说话的语言很奇怪，每个音节都很慢。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén kàn zhe tā, shuō huà de yǔ yán hěn qí guài, měi gè yīn jié dōu hěn màn.
sentences.english: The person looked at him; the language they spoke was strange, and every syllable was very slow.

sentences.chinese: 李明以前从来没有见过这种说话方式。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng yǐ qián cóng lái méi yǒu jiàn guò zhè zhǒng shuō huà fāng shì.
sentences.english: Li Ming had never seen this way of speaking before.

sentences.chinese: 周围有很多古老的车辆在慢慢移动，像是在寻找什么。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōu wéi yǒu hěn duō gǔ lǎo de chē liàng zài màn màn yí dòng, xiàng shì zài xún zhǎo shén me.
sentences.english: There were many ancient vehicles moving slowly around him, as if they were searching for something.

sentences.chinese: 街道两旁有一些像银行一样存放钱财的房子。
sentences.pinyin: Jiē dào liǎng páng yǒu yī xiē xiàng yín háng yī yàng cún fàng qián cái de fáng zi.
sentences.english: On both sides of the street, there were houses for storing money, like banks.

sentences.chinese: 远处传来了悠扬的音乐，像是一场盛大的音乐会。
sentences.pinyin: Yuǎn chù chuán lái le yōu yáng de yīn yuè, xiàng shì yī chǎng shèng dà de yīn yuè huì.
sentences.english: Melodious music drifted from afar, like a grand concert.

sentences.chinese: 但在这种危险的时候，音乐对他来说是一个难题。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zài zhè zhǒng wēi xiǎn de shí hòu, yīn yuè duì tā lái shuō shì yī gè nán tí.
sentences.english: But at such a dangerous time, the music was a difficult problem for him.

sentences.chinese: 他感到气温在下降，身体开始发抖。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎn dào qì wēn zài xià jiàng, shēn tǐ kāi shǐ fā dǒu.
sentences.english: He felt the air temperature dropping, and his body began to shiver.

sentences.chinese: 他非常饿，需要一些食物来让自己有力气走下去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fēi cháng è, xū yào yī xiē shí wù lái ràng zì jǐ yǒu lì qì zǒu xià qù.
sentences.english: He was very hungry and needed some food to give himself the strength to keep going.

sentences.chinese: 他看到前面有一个小饭馆，里面有热气和香味。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào qián miàn yǒu yī gè xiǎo fàn guǎn, lǐ miàn yǒu rè qì hé xiāng wèi.
sentences.english: He saw a small restaurant ahead, filled with steam and fragrance.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果能在这里休息一小时，情况会多么好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rú guǒ néng zài zhè lǐ xiū xī yī xiǎo shí, qíng kuàng huì duō me hǎo.
sentences.english: He thought about how wonderful it would be if he could rest here for an hour.

sentences.chinese: 但他不能停留，因为敌人可能就在后面。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tā bù néng tíng liú, yīn wèi dí rén kě néng jiù zài hòu miàn.
sentences.english: But he could not stay, because the enemy might be right behind him.

sentences.chinese: 他记得老师说过，向北走十公里就能到达一个叫药水的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì dé lǎo shī shuō guò, xiàng běi zǒu shí gōng lǐ jiù néng dào dá yī gè jiào Yào shuǐ de dì fāng.
sentences.english: He remembered his teacher saying that walking ten kilometers north would lead to a place called Yaoshui.

sentences.chinese: 药水那里有能救命的医生和安全的避难所。
sentences.pinyin: Yào shuǐ nà lǐ yǒu néng jiù mìng de yī shēng hé ān quán de bì nàn suǒ.
sentences.english: In Yaoshui, there were life-saving doctors and safe shelters.

sentences.chinese: 他不知道为什么敌人要这么快地追上来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zhī dào wèi shén me dí rén yào zhè me kuài de zhuī shàng lái.
sentences.english: He didn't know why the enemy was pursuing him so quickly.

sentences.chinese: 他必须在迷雾中找到正确的方向。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì xū zài mí wù zhōng zhǎo dào zhèng què de fāng xiàng.
sentences.english: He had to find the right direction in the mist.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他在饭馆的后门看到了一双熟悉的黑色靴子。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, tā zài fàn guǎn de hòu mén kàn dào le yī shuāng shú xī de hēi sè xué zi.
sentences.english: Suddenly, at the back door of the restaurant, he saw a pair of familiar black boots.

chapters.title_chinese: 第九章：黑色的靴子与寒冷的真相
chapters.title_english: Chapter 9: The Black Boots and the Cold Truth

sentences.chinese: 李明看着那双黑色靴子，心跳快了一点点。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kànzhe nà shuāng hēisè xuézi, xīntiào kuài le yī diǎn diǎn.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked at those black boots, and his heart beat a little bit faster.

sentences.chinese: 他低着头，不敢大声呼吸。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dīzhe tóu, bù gǎn dàshēng hūxī.
sentences.english: He lowered his head, not daring to breathe loudly.

sentences.chinese: 那是他以前在书院见过的靴子，但现在的气氛完全不同。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì tā yǐqián zài shūyuàn jiànguò de xuézi, dàn xiànzài de qìfēn wánquán bù tóng.
sentences.english: Those were boots he had seen before at the academy, but the atmosphere now was completely different.

sentences.chinese: 不一会儿，一个低沉的声音在他身后响起。
sentences.pinyin: Bù yīhuǐr, yī gè dīchén de shēngyīn zài tā shēnhòu xiǎngqǐ.
sentences.english: After a short while, a deep voice sounded behind him.

sentences.chinese: 这个声音有点儿奇怪，听起来很难听。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shēngyīn yǒudiǎnr qíguài, tīng qǐlái hěn nántīng.
sentences.english: This voice was a bit strange and sounded unpleasant to the ear.

sentences.chinese: “李明，你跑了多久了？”
sentences.pinyin: “Lǐ Míng, nǐ pǎo le duōjiǔ le?”
sentences.english: "Li Ming, how long have you been running?"

sentences.chinese: 李明感到有一点儿害怕，因为他不知道对方是好人还是坏人。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng gǎndào yǒu yī diǎn r hàipà, yīnwèi tā bù zhīdào duìfāng shì hǎorén háishì huàirén.
sentences.english: Li Ming felt a bit afraid because he didn't know if the other person was a good person or a villain.

sentences.chinese: 他想起老师说过，跟随坏人会有很多坏处。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ lǎoshī shuōguò, gēnsuí huàirén huì yǒu hěnduō huàichu.
sentences.english: He remembered his teacher saying that following bad people would bring many harms.

sentences.chinese: 他慢慢回头，看到一个穿着黑色长袍的男人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mànmàn huítóu, kàndào yī gè chuānzhe hēisè chángpáo de nánrén.
sentences.english: He slowly turned around and saw a man wearing a black robe.

sentences.chinese: 男人的脸在迷雾中显得很难看，而且眼神中充满了不满。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén de liǎn zài míwù zhōng xiǎnde hěn nánkàn, érqiě yǎnshén zhōng chōngmǎn le bùmǎn.
sentences.english: The man's face looked ugly in the mist, and his eyes were full of discontent.

sentences.chinese: 男人说：“你以为你能逃到药水，但现在的天气不行。”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén shuō: “Nǐ yǐwéi nǐ néng táo dào Yàoshuǐ, dàn xiànzài de tiānqì bù xíng.”
sentences.english: The man said, "You think you can escape to Yaoshui, but the current weather won't do."

sentences.chinese: 李明看向天空，冬天的风让气温降到了零下。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kàn xiàng tiānkōng, dōngtiān de fēng ràng qìwēn jiàng dào le língxià.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked at the sky; the winter wind had dropped the temperature to below zero.

sentences.chinese: 他感觉到衣服不够厚，身体在发抖。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎnjué dào yīfu bù gòu hòu, shēntǐ zài fādǒu.
sentences.english: He felt his clothes were not thick enough, and his body was shivering.

sentences.chinese: 男人冷笑一声说：“在这个地方，走十公里太短，但对于你来说可能太长。”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén lěngxiào yīshēng shuō: “Zài zhège dìfāng, zǒu shí gōnglǐ tài duǎn, dàn duìyú nǐ lái shuō kěnéng tài cháng.”
sentences.english: The man sneered and said, "In this place, walking ten kilometers is too short, but for you, it might be too long."

sentences.chinese: 李明低声问：“您是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng dīshēng wèn: “Nín shì shuí?”
sentences.english: Li Ming asked in a low voice, "Who are you?"

sentences.chinese: 男人回答：“我不一定是你的敌人，但你现在的情况很可怕。”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén huídá: “Wǒ bù yīdìng shì nǐ de dírén, dàn nǐ xiànzài de qíngkuàng hěn kěpà.”
sentences.english: The man replied, "I am not necessarily your enemy, but your current situation is dreadful."

sentences.chinese: 不久，男人告诉他，现在只有少数几个忠诚的人还在寻找那封信。
sentences.pinyin: Bùjiǔ, nánrén gàosu tā, xiànzài zhǐyǒu shǎoshù jǐ gè zhōngchéng de rén hái zài xúnzhǎo nà fēng xìn.
sentences.english: Before long, the man told him that only a small number of loyal people were still searching for that letter.

sentences.chinese: 不少士兵已经在城外等待，他们想抓住所有在这个等级以下的人。
sentences.pinyin: Bùshǎo shìbīng yǐjīng zài chéngwài děngdài, tāmen xiǎng zhuāzhù suǒyǒu zài zhège děngjí yǐxià de rén.
sentences.english: Many soldiers were already waiting outside the city; they wanted to capture everyone below this rank.

sentences.chinese: 李明觉得这个男人的话不太可靠，不如直接跑掉。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng juéde zhège nánrén de huà bù tài kěkào, bùrú zhíjiē pǎodiào.
sentences.english: Li Ming felt the man's words were not too reliable and thought it would be better to just run away.

sentences.chinese: 但男人大喊一声：“不要走！外面有陷阱！”
sentences.pinyin: Dàn nánrén dàhǎn yīshēng: “Bùyào zǒu! Wàimiàn yǒu xiànjǐng!”
sentences.english: But the man shouted, "Don't go! There are traps outside!"

sentences.chinese: 李明停住了脚步，他意识到在这个迷雾之城，信任是非常奢侈的。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng tíngzhù le jiǎobù, tā yìshí dào zài zhège míwù zhī chéng, xìnrèn shì fēicháng shēchǐ de.
sentences.english: Li Ming stopped in his tracks, realizing that in this City of Mist, trust was a great luxury.

sentences.chinese: 他看着男人的眼睛，发现对方虽然语气粗鲁，但并没有武器。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe nánrén de yǎnjīng, fāxiàn duìfāng suīrán yǔqì cūlǔ, dàn bìng méiyǒu wǔqì.
sentences.english: He looked into the man's eyes and found that although the other's tone was coarse, he had no weapon.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，远处传来了沉重的脚步声，像是有很多人在靠近。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhèshí, yuǎnchù chuánlái le chénzhòng de jiǎobùshēng, xiàng shì yǒu hěnduō rén zài kàojìn.
sentences.english: Just then, heavy footsteps came from the distance, as if many people were approaching.

sentences.chinese: 男人突然低声说：“快跟我来，否则你会被他们抓走。”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén tūrán dīshēng shuō: “Kuài gēn wǒ lái, fǒuzé nǐ huì bèi tāmen zhuā zǒu.”
sentences.english: The man suddenly whispered, "Quickly follow me, otherwise you will be captured by them."

sentences.chinese: 李明犹豫了，但他知道自己没有选择。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng yóuyù le, dàn tā zhīdào zìjǐ méiyǒu xuǎnzé.
sentences.english: Li Ming hesitated, but he knew he had no choice.

sentences.chinese: 他们迅速消失在黑暗的巷子中，而追兵的火把已经照亮了街道。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xùnsù xiāoshī zài hēiyàn de làngzi zhōng, ér zhuībīng de huǒbǎ yǐjīng zhàoliàng le jiēdào.
sentences.english: They quickly disappeared into the dark alley, while the torches of the pursuing soldiers had already lit up the street.

sentences.chinese: 李明跟着男人在狭窄的弄中快速走着。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng gēnzhe nánrén zài xiázhǎi de lòng zhōng kuàisù zǒuzhe.
sentences.english: Li Ming followed the man, walking quickly through the narrow alley.

sentences.chinese: 他们走出了这个市，来到了一个安静的村庄。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒuchūle zhège shì, láidàole yīgè ānjìng de cūnzhuāng.
sentences.english: They left this city and arrived at a quiet village.

sentences.chinese: 男人带他来到一家小店，这里看起来像是一个休息的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén dài tā láidào yījiā xiǎo diàn, zhèlǐ kàn qǐlái xiàng shì yīgè xiūxí de dìfāng.
sentences.english: The man took him to a small inn, which looked like a place to rest.

sentences.chinese: 这里的主人是一个年长的商人，他穿着一件黑色的长袍。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de zhǔrén shì yīgè niánzhǎng de shāngrén, tā chuānzhe yī jiàn hēisè de chángpáo.
sentences.english: The owner here was an elderly merchant, wearing a long black robe.

sentences.chinese: 商人看着李明，问他的姓名是什么。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngrén kànzhe Lǐ Míng, wèn tā de xìngmíng shì shénme.
sentences.english: The merchant looked at Li Ming and asked what his full name was.

sentences.chinese: 李明低着头，不敢说话，他的嘴在发抖。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng dīzhe tóu, bù gǎn shuōhuà, tā de zuǐ zài fādǒu.
sentences.english: Li Ming lowered his head, not daring to speak, his mouth trembling.

sentences.chinese: 商人笑了笑，说这里的客人大多是远方来的旅客。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngrén xiàole xiào, shuō zhèlǐ de kèrén dàduō shì yuǎnfāng lái de lǚkè.
sentences.english: The merchant smiled and said that most of the guests here were travelers from afar.

sentences.chinese: 这些旅客在旅行的时候，喜欢在这里住几天。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē lǚkè zài lǚxíng de shíhòu, xǐhuān zài zhèlǐ zhù jǐ tiān.
sentences.english: These travelers liked to stay here for a few days during their journeys.

sentences.chinese: 有些人是为了旅游而来到这里，有些人则是为了逃避生活。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒuxiē rén shì wèile lǚyóu ér láidào zhèlǐ, yǒuxiē rén zé shì wèile táobì shēnghuó.
sentences.english: Some came here for tourism, while others came to escape their lives.

sentences.chinese: 商人告诉李明，他的家庭曾经非常富有，现在只剩下这个店。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngrén gàosù Lǐ Míng, tā de jiātíng céngjīng fēicháng fùyǒu, xiànzài zhǐ shèng xià zhège diàn.
sentences.english: The merchant told Li Ming that his family had once been very wealthy, and now only this inn remained.

sentences.chinese: 店里现在有几位同事在帮忙，他们像家人一样工作。
sentences.pinyin: Diàn lǐ xiànzài yǒu jǐ wèi tóngshì zài bāngmáng, tāmen xiàng jiārén yīyàng gōngzuò.
sentences.english: There are currently several colleagues helping in the shop, working like family.

sentences.chinese: 商人领李明进入一个像办公室一样的房间，那里有很多书。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngrén lǐng Lǐ Míng jìnrù yīgè xiàng bàngōngshì yīyàng de fángjiān, nàlǐ yǒu hěnduō shū.
sentences.english: The merchant led Li Ming into a room that was like an office, where there were many books.

sentences.chinese: 其中有一本小说，讲述了一个关于大海的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Qízhōng yǒu yī běn xiǎoshuō, jiǎngshùle yīgè guānyú dàhǎi de gùshì.
sentences.english: Among them was a novel that told a story about the sea.

sentences.chinese: 李明看着书，突然觉得自己的全身都放松了。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kànzhe shū, tūrán juédé zìjǐ de quánshēn dōu fàngsōngle.
sentences.english: Looking at the book, Li Ming suddenly felt his whole body relax.

sentences.chinese: 商人说，这个城市的人口很多，但真正懂书的人很少。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngrén shuō, zhège chéngshì de rénkǒu hěnduō, dàn zhēnzhèng dǒng shū de rén hěn shǎo.
sentences.english: The merchant said that the population of this city is large, but few people truly understand books.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个太太走进来，她是商人的妻子。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yīgè tàitai zǒu jìnlái, tā shì shāngrén de qīzi.
sentences.english: At this moment, a married woman walked in; she was the merchant's wife.

sentences.chinese: 她问他们是否需要吃午餐，因为现在已经中午了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn tāmen shìfǒu xūyào chī wǔcān, yīnwèi xiànzài yǐjīng zhōngwǔle.
sentences.english: She asked if they needed lunch, as it was already noon.

sentences.chinese: 李明很饿，他吃了一顿简单的快餐，虽然味道一般，但让他有了力气。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng hěn è, tā chīle yī dùn jiǎndān de kuàicān, suīrán wèidào yībān, dàn ràng tā yǒule lìqì.
sentences.english: Li Ming was very hungry; he ate a simple quick meal, which, although ordinary in taste, gave him strength.

sentences.chinese: 太太告诉他，这里的人生活很简单，没有大城市的复杂。
sentences.pinyin: Tàitai gàosù tā, zhèlǐ de rén shēnghuó hěn jiǎndān, méiyǒu dà chéngshì de fùzá.
sentences.english: The wife told him that life here was simple, without the complexity of the big city.

sentences.chinese: 商人提到，在未来的日子里，人们可能会发明像公交车一样的车子在公路上跑。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngrén tí dào, zài wèilái de rìzi lǐ, rénmen kěnéng huì fāmíng xiàng gōngjiāochē yīyàng de chēzi zài gōnglù shàng pǎo.
sentences.english: The merchant mentioned that in the future, people might invent vehicles like buses to run on highways.

sentences.chinese: 李明觉得这像是在听梦话，因为现在只有马车。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng juédé zhè xiàng shì zài tīng mènghuà, yīnwèi xiànzài zhǐyǒu mǎchē.
sentences.english: Li Ming felt as if he were listening to a dream, because there were only horse carriages now.

sentences.chinese: 商人还开玩笑说，以后人们可能会在地下像地铁一样快速移动。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngrén hái kāiwánxiào shuō, yǐhòu rénmen kěnéng huì zài dìxià xiàng dìtiě yīyàng kuàisù yídòng.
sentences.english: The merchant also joked that in the future, people might move quickly underground like a subway.

sentences.chinese: 李明看着商人的头，觉得这个男人虽然奇怪，但很有智慧。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kànzhe shāngrén de tóu, juédé zhège nánrén suīrán qíguài, dàn hěn yǒu zhìhuì.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked at the merchant's head and felt that although this man was strange, he was very wise.

sentences.chinese: 商人说，他曾经在一家大公司工作，那是管理贸易的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngrén shuō, tā céngjīng zài yījiā dà gōngsī gōngzuò, nà shì guǎnlǐ màoyì de dìfāng.
sentences.english: The merchant said he had once worked in a large company, a place that managed trade.

sentences.chinese: 现在，他只想在这个安静的地方迎接每一个客人。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài, tā zhǐ xiǎng zài zhège ānjìng de dìfāng yíngjiē měi yīgè kèrén.
sentences.english: Now, he only wants to welcome every guest in this quiet place.

sentences.chinese: 晚上，他们一起吃了晚餐，讨论了接下来的方向。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnshàng, tāmen yīqǐ chīle wǎncān, tǎolùnle jiē xiàlái de fāngxiàng.
sentences.english: In the evening, they had dinner together and discussed the next direction.

sentences.chinese: 商人告诉李明，他不能一直躲在这里，因为追兵还在寻找他。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngrén gàosù Lǐ Míng, tā bùnéng yīzhí duǒ zài zhèlǐ, yīnwèi zhuībīng hái zài xúnzhǎo tā.
sentences.english: The merchant told Li Ming that he could not hide here forever because the pursuers were still looking for him.

sentences.chinese: 李明在灯光下思考，觉得自己像个小说里的明星，被所有人关注。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zài dēngguāng xià sīkǎo, juédé zìjǐ xiàng gè xiǎoshuō lǐ de míngxīng, bèi suǒyǒu rén guānzhù.
sentences.english: Thinking under the lamplight, Li Ming felt like a celebrity in a novel, being watched by everyone.

sentences.chinese: 但这种关注让他感到害怕，因为他不知道真相在哪里。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zhè zhǒng guānzhù ràng tā gǎndào hàipà, yīnwèi tā bù zhīdào zhēnxiàng zài nǎlǐ.
sentences.english: But this attention made him afraid, because he did not know where the truth lay.

sentences.chinese: 突然，窗外传来了马蹄声，打破了夜晚的安静。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, chuāngwài chuánláile mǎtíshēng, dǎpòle yèwǎn de ānjìng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the sound of horse hooves came from outside the window, breaking the silence of the night.

sentences.chinese: 商人低声说：“他们找到了这里。”
sentences.pinyin: Shāngrén dīshēng shuō: “Tāmen zhǎodàole zhèlǐ.”
sentences.english: The merchant whispered, "They have found this place."

sentences.chinese: 李明心中一惊，意识到平静的生活再次结束了。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xīnzhōng yī jīng, yìshí dào píngjìng de shēnghuó zàicì jiéshùle.
sentences.english: Li Ming was startled, realizing that his peaceful life had ended once again.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 11: Escape in the Rainy Night

sentences.chinese: 客栈的灯光在风中摇晃。
sentences.pinyin: Kèzhàn de dēngguāng zài fēng zhōng yáohuàng.
sentences.english: The lights of the inn flickered in the wind.

sentences.chinese: 商人看着窗外，低声说：“这里太危险了，我们必须离开这个酒店。”
sentences.pinyin: Shāngrén kànzhe chuāngwài, dīshēng shuō: “Zhèlǐ tài wēixiǎn le, wǒmen bìxū líkāi zhège jiǔdiàn.”
sentences.english: The merchant looked outside the window and whispered, "It is too dangerous here, we must leave this hotel."

sentences.chinese: 李明看着房间里头，发现桌上有一瓶药和一些酒。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kànzhe fángjiān lǐtou, fāxiàn zhuōshàng yǒu yī píng yào hé yīxiē jiǔ.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked inside the room and found a bottle of medicine and some wine on the table.

sentences.chinese: 商人告诉他，这些药可以让人在逃跑时保持清醒。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngrén gàosù tā, zhèxiē yào kěyǐ ràng rén zài táopǎo shí bǎochí qīngxǐng.
sentences.english: The merchant told him that this medicine could keep a person alert during an escape.

sentences.chinese: 突然，有人在门外大喊大叫。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yǒurén zài ménwài dàhǎn dàjiào.
sentences.english: Suddenly, someone was shouting loudly outside the door.

sentences.chinese: 那个人的声音很像这个酒店的经理，他正在催促顾客快点离开。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge rén de shēngyīn hěn xiàng zhège jiǔdiàn de jīnglǐ, tā zhèngzài cuīcù gùkè kuàidiǎn líkāi.
sentences.english: That person's voice sounded very much like the manager of the hotel; he was urging the customers to leave quickly.

sentences.chinese: 李明闻到了空气中有一种奇怪的气味，像是一种燃烧的油的味道。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng wén dào le kōngqì zhōng yǒu yī zhǒng qíguài de qìwèi, xiàng shì yī zhǒng ránshāo de yóu de wèidào.
sentences.english: Li Ming smelled a strange scent in the air, like the smell of burning oil.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，敌人可能在用火网包围这里，就像捕捉小鸡一样捕捉他们。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, dírén kěnéng zài yòng huǒwǎng bāowéi zhèlǐ, jiù xiàng bǔzhuō xiǎojī yīyàng bǔzhuō tāmen.
sentences.english: He realized that the enemy might be surrounding the place with a net of fire, catching them like catching little chickens.

sentences.chinese: 在那个时代，没有现代的网站可以查询地图，他们只能依赖记忆。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nàge shídài, méiyǒu xiàndài de wǎngzhàn kěyǐ cháxún dìtú, tāmen zhǐnéng yīlài jìyì.
sentences.english: In that era, there were no modern websites to check maps; they could only rely on memory.

sentences.chinese: 商人从衣服里拿出一片薄薄的纸，那是他们逃跑的唯一道路。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngrén cóng yīfú lǐ ná chū yī piàn báobáo de zhǐ, nà shì tāmen táopǎo de wéiyī dàolù.
sentences.english: The merchant took out a thin sheet of paper from his clothes; it was their only road for escape.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉李明，这道门后面有一条小路，可以通向城市的边缘。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Lǐ Míng, zhè dào mén hòumiàn yǒu yī tiáo xiǎolù, kěyǐ tōngxiàng chéngshì de biānyuán.
sentences.english: He told Li Ming that behind this door there was a small path that could lead to the edge of the city.

sentences.chinese: 他们迅速跑出房间，看到路边有很多惊慌的行人。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xùnsù pǎo chū fángjiān, kàndào lùbiān yǒu hěnduō jīnghuāng de xíngrén.
sentences.english: They quickly ran out of the room and saw many panicked pedestrians by the roadside.

sentences.chinese: 有些游客在雨中奔跑，他们以为今天是一个热闹的节日，没想到变成了噩梦。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒuxiē yóukè zài yǔ zhōng bēnpǎo, tāmen yǐwéi jīntiān shì yī gè rènào de jiérì, méi xiǎngdào biànchéng le mèng'è.
sentences.english: Some travelers were running in the rain; they thought today was a lively festival, not expecting it to become a nightmare.

sentences.chinese: 李明看到一个男人在照顾他的爱人，两人的爱情在战火中显得如此脆弱。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kàndào yī gè nánrén zài zhàogù tā de àiren, liǎng rén de àiqíng zài zhànhuǒ zhōng xiǎndé rúcǐ cuìruò.
sentences.english: Li Ming saw a man taking care of his spouse; the love between the two seemed so fragile amidst the flames of war.

sentences.chinese: 他们避开主道路，走在阴暗的边墙下面。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen bìkāi zhǔ dàolù, zǒu zài yīnyàn de biānqiáng xiàmiàn.
sentences.english: They avoided the main road and walked beneath the dark side walls.

sentences.chinese: 商人指了指远处，那里有一个人骑着马在巡逻。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngrén zhǐ le zhǐ yuǎnchù, nàlǐ yǒu yī gè rén qízhe mǎ zài xúnluó.
sentences.english: The merchant pointed into the distance, where a man was riding a horse on patrol.

sentences.chinese: 李明心中一惊，他想起书院里没有自行车，只有马和自己的双脚。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xīnzhōng yī jīng, tā xiǎngqǐ shūyuàn lǐ méiyǒu zìxíngchē, zhǐyǒu mǎ hé zìjǐ de shuāngjiǎo.
sentences.english: Li Ming was startled; he remembered there were no bicycles in the academy, only horses and his own two feet.

sentences.chinese: 他们躲在一面破墙后面，屏住呼吸。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen duǒ zài yī miàn pòqiáng hòumiàn, bǐng zhù hūxī.
sentences.english: They hid behind a broken wall, holding their breath.

sentences.chinese: 为了掩盖行踪，他们走进了一家卖饺子的面馆。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile yǎngài xíngzōng, tāmen zǒujìn le yī jiā mài jiǎozi de miànguǎn.
sentences.english: To cover their tracks, they entered a noodle shop that sold dumplings.

sentences.chinese: 面馆里很安静，只有几个疲惫的顾客在吃东西。
sentences.pinyin: Miànguǎn lǐ hěn ānjìng, zhǐyǒu jǐ gè píbèi de gùkè zài chī dōngxī.
sentences.english: The noodle shop was very quiet, with only a few exhausted customers eating.

sentences.chinese: 商人买了一份礼物，打算给路上的接头人。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngrén mǎi le yī fèn lǐwù, dǎsuàn gěi lùshàng de jiētóurén.
sentences.english: The merchant bought a gift, intending to give it to the contact person on the road.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，马蹄声再次在门外响起。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, mǎtí shēng zàicì zài ménwài xiǎngqǐ.
sentences.english: But just then, the sound of horse hooves rang out outside the door again.

sentences.chinese: 一个冰冷的声音在问：“你们看到那个年轻人了吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè bīnglěng de shēngyīn zài wèn: “Nǐmen kàndào nàge niánqīng rén le ma?”
sentences.english: A cold voice asked, "Have you seen that young man?"

sentences.chinese: 李明感觉到心跳加速，他知道自己已经被逼到了绝路。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng gǎnjué dào xīntiào jiāsù, tā zhīdào zìjǐ yǐjīng bèi bī dào le juélù.
sentences.english: Li Ming felt his heart race; he knew he had been driven into a dead end.

sentences.chinese: 他看向商人，商人的眼神中充满了决绝。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng shāngrén, shāngrén de yǎnshén zhōng chōngmǎn le juéjué.
sentences.english: He looked at the merchant, whose eyes were full of determination.

sentences.chinese: 他们必须在天亮之前穿过这座城市，否则永远无法回家。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen bìxū zài tiānliàng zhīqián chuānguò zhè zuò chéngshì, fǒuzé yǒngyuǎn wúfǎ huíjiā.
sentences.english: They had to cross the city before dawn, otherwise they could never return home.

sentences.chinese: 但窗外的雨越下越大，道路变得泥泞不堪。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn chuāngwài de yǔ yuè xià yuè dà, dàolù biàn de níníng bùkān.
sentences.english: But the rain outside grew heavier, and the road became muddy.

sentences.chinese: 一个黑影突然出现在门口，手里拿着一把长剑。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè hēiyǐng tūrán chūxiàn zài ménkǒu, shǒulǐ názhe yī bǎ chángjiàn.
sentences.english: A dark figure suddenly appeared at the door, holding a long sword.

sentences.chinese: 这个黑影竟然是李明在书院时认识的一个旧识。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège hēiyǐng jìngrán shì Lǐ Míng zài shūyuàn shí rènshí de yī gè jiùshí.
sentences.english: This dark figure was actually an old acquaintance Li Ming knew from the academy.

sentences.chinese: 对方冷冷地笑了，说：“李明，你终于被我找到了。”
sentences.pinyin: Duìfāng lěnglěng de xiào le, shuō: “Lǐ Míng, nǐ zhōngyú bèi wǒ zhǎodào le.”
sentences.english: The other person smiled coldly and said, "Li Ming, I have finally found you."

chapters.title_english: Chapter 12: Betrayal of an Old Acquaintance

sentences.chinese: 雨水打在屋顶上，发出沉重的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔshuǐ dǎ zài wūdǐng shàng, fāchū chénzhòng de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: The rain hit the roof, making a heavy sound.

sentences.chinese: 李明看着眼前的这个男人，他觉得这是一个很奇怪的样子。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kànzhe yǎnqián de zhège nánrén, tā juédé zhè shì yīgè hěn qíguài de yàngzi.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked at the man before him; he felt he had a very strange appearance.

sentences.chinese: 这个男人曾经是书院的一名学生，现在却成了敌人的杀手。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège nánrén céngjīng shì shūyuàn de yī míng xuéshēng, xiànzài què chéngle dírén de shāshǒu.
sentences.english: This man was once a student at the academy, but now he had become an assassin for the enemy.

sentences.chinese: 对方的态度很冷淡，手里拿着的长剑在雨光中闪烁。
sentences.pinyin: Duìfāng de tàidù hěn lěngdàn, shǒulǐ názhe de chángjiàn zài yǔguāng zhōng shǎnshuò.
sentences.english: The other man's attitude was cold, and the long sword in his hand shimmered in the rain light.

sentences.chinese: 李明心里非常害怕，但他的心中依然有一个想法：他必须活下去。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xīnlǐ fēicháng hàipà, dàn tā de xīnzhōng yīrán yǒu yīgè xiǎngfǎ: tā bìxū huó xiàqù.
sentences.english: Li Ming was very scared in his heart, but in his mind, he still had one thought: he must survive.

sentences.chinese: 对方低声说：“你以为逃跑是一个好办法吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Duìfāng dīshēng shuō: “Nǐ yǐwéi táopǎo shì yīgè hǎo bànfǎ ma?”
sentences.english: The other man whispered, "Do you think escaping is a good way?"

sentences.chinese: 李明感觉到对方的语气中有一种危险的味道。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng gǎnjué dào duìfāng de yǔqì zhōng yǒu yī zhǒng wēixiǎn de wèidào.
sentences.english: Li Ming felt a hint of danger in the other's tone.

sentences.chinese: 这个旧识冷笑着说：“在实际的情况下，你没有逃跑的机会。”
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jiùshí lěngxiàozhe shuō: “Zài shíjì de qíngkuàng xià, nǐ méiyǒu táopǎo de jīhuì.”
sentences.english: The old acquaintance sneered, "In reality, you have no opportunity to escape."

sentences.chinese: 李明想起书院老师教过的例子，面对敌人时不能失去信心。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xiǎngqǐ shūyuàn lǎoshī jiāoguò de lìzi, miànduì dírén shí bùnéng shīqù xìnxīn.
sentences.english: Li Ming remembered the examples taught by the academy teacher: one must not lose confidence when facing the enemy.

sentences.chinese: 他试图寻找一个逃跑的方法，但房间的条件太糟糕了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shìtú xúnzhǎo yīgè táopǎo de fāngfǎ, dàn fángjiān de tiáojiàn tài zāogāo le.
sentences.english: He tried to find a method to escape, but the conditions of the room were too poor.

sentences.chinese: 窗户太小，大小只能让一只猫通过。
sentences.pinyin: Chuānghù tài xiǎo, dàxiǎo zhǐ néng ràng yī zhī māo tōngguò.
sentences.english: The window was too small; its size only allowed a cat to pass through.

sentences.chinese: 对方说：“这就是你被抓的原因，你太天真了。”
sentences.pinyin: Duìfāng shuō: “Zhè jiùshì nǐ bèi zhuā de yuányīn, nǐ tài tiānzhēn le.”
sentences.english: The other man said, "This is the reason you were caught; you are too naive."

sentences.chinese: 李明问他：“你为什么要帮他们做这件事？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng wèn tā: “Nǐ wèishéme yào bāng tāmen zuò zhè jiàn shìqíng?”
sentences.english: Li Ming asked him, "Why do you want to help them do this matter?"

sentences.chinese: 对方看着他，眼神中没有一丝感情，仿佛在看一张没有生命的图片。
sentences.pinyin: Duìfāng kànzhe tā, yǎnshén zhōng méiyǒu yī sī gǎnqíng, fǎngfú zài kàn yī zhāng méiyǒu shēngmìng de túpiàn.
sentences.english: The other man looked at him, without a trace of emotion in his eyes, as if looking at a lifeless picture.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“在这个世界上，每个人都有自己的做法，我的做法就是执行命令。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zài zhège shìjiè shàng, měi gèrén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de zuòfǎ, wǒ de zuòfǎ jiùshì zhíxíng mìnglìng.”
sentences.english: He said, "In this world, everyone has their own way of doing things; my way is to execute orders."

sentences.chinese: 李明觉得这件事非常不公平，他想表达自己的意见。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng juédé zhè jiàn shì fēicháng bù gōngpíng, tā xiǎng biǎodá zìjǐ de yìjiàn.
sentences.english: Li Ming felt this matter was very unfair and wanted to express his opinion.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“背叛朋友不是一件好事。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Bèipàn péngyǒu bùshì yī jiàn hǎoshì.”
sentences.english: He said, "Betraying a friend is not a good deed."

sentences.chinese: 对方笑了，他说：“‘朋友’这个名称在战场上没有意思。”
sentences.pinyin: Duìfāng xiàole, tā shuō: “‘Péngyǒu’ zhège míngchēng zài zhànchǎng shàng méiyǒu yìsi.”
sentences.english: The other man laughed and said, "The name 'friend' has no meaning on the battlefield."

sentences.chinese: 对方的心情看起来很愉快，他似乎很享受这种猫捉老鼠的感觉。
sentences.pinyin: Duìfāng de xīnqíng kàn qǐlái hěn yúkuài, tā sìhū hěn xiǎngshòu zhè zhǒng māo zhuō lǎoshǔ de gǎnjué.
sentences.english: The other man's mood seemed very happy; he seemed to enjoy this cat-and-mouse feeling.

sentences.chinese: 李明注意到对方的衣服上有一个奇怪的单位标志，那是禁卫军的符号。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zhùyì dào duìfāng de yīfú shàng yǒu yīgè qíguài de dānwèi biāozhì, nà shì jìnwèijūn de fúhào.
sentences.english: Li Ming noticed a strange unit symbol on the other's clothes; it was the symbol of the Imperial Guard.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到对方在很多方面都比他强大，尤其是武艺方面。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào duìfāng zài hěnduō fāngmiàn dōu bǐ tā qiángdà, yóuqí shì wǔyì fāngmiàn.
sentences.english: He realized the other was stronger than him in many respects, especially in martial arts.

sentences.chinese: 对方说：“如果你有才，就应该早点加入我们。”
sentences.pinyin: Duìfāng shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ yǒu cái, jiù yīnggāi zǎodiǎn jiārù wǒmen.”
sentences.english: The other man said, "If you had talent, you should have joined us sooner."

sentences.chinese: 李明心中产生了一个想法，他决定用语言分散对方的注意力。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xīnzhōng chǎnshēngle yīgè xiǎngfǎ, tā juédìng yòng yǔyán fēnsàn duìfāng de zhùyìlì.
sentences.english: An idea arose in Li Ming's heart; he decided to use words to distract the other's attention.

sentences.chinese: 他问：“你们的计划是什么？你们想要那封信的哪一部分？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn: “Nǐmen de jìhuà shì shénme? Nǐmen xiǎng yào nà fēng xìn de nǎ yī bùfen?”
sentences.english: He asked, "What is your plan? Which part of that letter do you want?"

sentences.chinese: 对方愣了一下，显然没想到李明敢这么问。
sentences.pinyin: Duìfāng lèngle yīxià, xiǎnrán méiyǒu xiǎngdào Lǐ Míng gǎn zhème wèn.
sentences.english: The other man paused, clearly not expecting Li Ming to dare ask this.

sentences.chinese: 这时，李明看到桌上有一条旧绸带，他意识到这是一个机会。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, Lǐ Míng kàndào zhuō shàng yǒu yī tiáo jiù chóudài, tā yìshí dào zhè shì yīgè jīhuì.
sentences.english: At that moment, Li Ming saw an old silk ribbon on the table and realized this was a chance.

sentences.chinese: 他快速地用绸带绊住了对方的脚，这是一个简单的技巧，但在这个时候很有用。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kuàisù de yòng chóudài bànzhùle duìfāng de jiǎo, zhè shì yīgè jiǎndān de jìqiǎo, dàn zài zhège shíhòu hěn yǒuyòng.
sentences.english: He quickly used the ribbon to trip the other man's foot; it was a simple trick, but very useful at this time.

sentences.chinese: 对方失去平衡，身体向后倒去。
sentences.pinyin: Duìfāng shīqù pínghéng, shēntǐ xiàng hòu dǎo qù.
sentences.english: The other man lost his balance and fell backward.

sentences.chinese: 李明没有时间思考，他迅速冲向大门。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng méiyǒu shíjiān sīkǎo, tā xùnsù chōng xiàng dàmén.
sentences.english: Li Ming had no time to think and rushed toward the main door.

sentences.chinese: 他想起以前看过的一段类似影片，主角总是能在最后一刻逃脱。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ yǐqián kànguò de yī duàn lèisì yǐngpiàn, zhǔjué zǒng shì néng zài zuìhòu yī kè táotuō.
sentences.english: He remembered a similar film clip he had seen before, where the protagonist always escapes at the last moment.

sentences.chinese: 他现在的感觉就是：只要能跑出去，就有希望。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiànzài de gǎnjué jiùshì: zhǐyào néng pǎo chūqù, jiù yǒu xīwàng.
sentences.english: His feeling now was: as long as he could run out, there was hope.

sentences.chinese: 但就在他触碰到门把手时，门外突然传来了更多沉重的脚步声。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài tā chùpèng dào mén bǎshǒu shí, mén wài tūrán chuánláile gèng duō chénzhòng de jiǎobù shēngyīn.
sentences.english: But just as he touched the door handle, more heavy footsteps suddenly sounded from outside.

sentences.chinese: 李明推开门，发现门外是一个白色的房间。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng tuī kāi mén, fā xiàn mén wài shì yí gè bái sè de fáng jiān.
sentences.english: Li Ming pushed open the door and found a white room outside.

sentences.chinese: 房间里没有士兵，只有很多奇怪的画儿。
sentences.pinyin: Fáng jiān lǐ méi yǒu shì bīng, zhǐ yǒu hěn duō qí guài de huà r.
sentences.english: There were no soldiers in the room, only many strange paintings.

sentences.chinese: 他看到墙上的画儿颜色很奇怪，像是在告诉他什么秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào qiáng shàng de huà r yán sè hěn qí guài, xiàng shì zài gào sù tā shén me mì mì.
sentences.english: He saw that the colors of the paintings on the wall were very strange, as if they were telling him some secret.

sentences.chinese: 李明注意到，每幅画的特点都不一样。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zhù yì dào, měi fú huà de tè diǎn dōu bù yí yàng.
sentences.english: Li Ming noticed that the characteristics of each painting were different.

sentences.chinese: 他在桌子上发现了一本旧笔记。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài zhuō zi shàng fā xiàn le yì běn jiù bǐ jì.
sentences.english: He found an old notebook on the table.

sentences.chinese: 这本笔记是用一支细笔写的，字迹很小。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn bǐ jì shì yòng yì zhī xì bǐ xiě de, zì jì hěn xiǎo.
sentences.english: This notebook was written with a fine brush, and the handwriting was very small.

sentences.chinese: 他翻开笔记，发现里面记录了一些关于科学的知识。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fān kāi bǐ jì, fā xiàn lǐ miàn jì lù le yì xiē guān yú kē xué de zhī shi.
sentences.english: He opened the notebook and found that it recorded some knowledge about science.

sentences.chinese: 在古代，这种科学知识是禁忌，也是很多学者的理想。
sentences.pinyin: Zài gǔ dài, zhè zhǒng kē xué zhī shi shì jìn jì, yě shì hěn duō xué zhě de lǐ xiǎng.
sentences.english: In ancient times, this kind of scientific knowledge was taboo, and also the ideal of many scholars.

sentences.chinese: 李明在笔记中看到了一些复杂的词语，他并不完全明白。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zài bǐ jì zhōng kàn dào le yì xiē fù zá de cí yǔ, tā bìng bù wán quán míng bai.
sentences.english: Li Ming saw some complex terms in the notebook, which he did not fully understand.

sentences.chinese: 但其中一部分内容引起了他的注意。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn qí zhōng bù fen nèi róng yǐn qǐ le tā de zhù yì.
sentences.english: But a part of the content caught his attention.

sentences.chinese: 笔记里提到，一个人的行为可以揭露他的真实目的。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐ jì lǐ tí dào, yí gè rén de xíng wéi kě yǐ jiē lù tā de zhēn shí mù dì.
sentences.english: The notebook mentioned that a person's behavior can reveal their true purpose.

sentences.chinese: 李明思考起这件事，他有了自己的看法。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng sī kǎo qǐ zhè jiàn shì, tā yǒu le zì jǐ de kàn fǎ.
sentences.english: Li Ming thought about this and formed his own view.

sentences.chinese: 他认为，如果从不同的角度去看，真相会不同。
sentences.pinyin: Tā rèn wéi, rú guǒ cóng bù tóng de jiǎo dù qù kàn, zhēn xiàng huì bù tóng.
sentences.english: He believed that if looked at from different angles, the truth would be different.

sentences.chinese: 他的观点是：那个背叛他的旧识其实在帮他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de guān diǎn shì: nà gè bèi pàn tā de jiù shí qí shí zài bāng tā.
sentences.english: His standpoint was: the old acquaintance who betrayed him was actually helping him.

sentences.chinese: 这时，他看到一张像照片一样的精细画像。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, tā kàn dào yì zhāng xiàng zhào piàn yí yàng de jīng xì huà xiàng.
sentences.english: At this moment, he saw a detailed portrait that looked like a photograph.

sentences.chinese: 画像上的眼睛像真的一样，死死地盯着他。
sentences.pinyin: Huà xiàng shàng de yǎn jīng xiàng zhēn de yí yàng, sǐ sǐ de dīng zhe tā.
sentences.english: The eyes in the portrait were like real ones, staring fixedly at him.

sentences.chinese: 李明感觉到，这张画的眼中有隐藏的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng gǎn jué dào, zhè zhāng huà de yǎn zhōng yǒu yǐn cáng de mì mì.
sentences.english: Li Ming felt that there was a hidden secret in the eyes of this painting.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，这是对方给他留下的一个计划。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, zhè shì duì fāng gěi tā liú xià de yí gè jì huà.
sentences.english: He realized that this was a plan left for him by the other party.

sentences.chinese: 在这个计划里，每一个节目都像是一场游戏。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè gè jì huà lǐ, měi yí gè jié mù dōu xiàng shì yì chǎng yóu xì.
sentences.english: In this plan, every item was like a game.

sentences.chinese: 他必须思考这个问题的道理，才能找到出口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì xū sī kǎo zhè gè wèn tí de dào lǐ, cái néng zhǎo dào chū kǒu.
sentences.english: He had to think through the reason behind this problem to find the exit.

sentences.chinese: 他看了一眼墙上的表，时间不多了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn le yì yǎn qiáng shàng de biǎo, shí jiān bù duō le.
sentences.english: He glanced at the clock on the wall; time was running out.

sentences.chinese: 他必须快点离开，因为门外的脚步声又近了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì xū kuài diǎn lí kāi, yīn wèi mén wài de jiǎo bù shēng yòu jìn le.
sentences.english: He had to leave quickly, because the footsteps outside were getting closer again.

sentences.chinese: 李明在房间里紧张地思考，门外的脚步声越来越近。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zài fángjiān lǐ jǐnzhāng de sīkǎo, mén wài de jiǎobù shēng yuè lái yuè jìn.
sentences.english: Li Ming thought nervously in the room, the footsteps outside getting closer and closer.

sentences.chinese: 他突然发现墙上有一个隐藏的入口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán fāxiàn qiáng shàng yǒu yīgè yǐncáng de rùkǒu.
sentences.english: He suddenly discovered a hidden entrance on the wall.

sentences.chinese: 他迅速走进这个狭小的通道，在最后一刻避开了敌人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xùnsù zǒujìn zhège xiǎoxiào de tōngdào, zài zuìhòu yīkè bìkāile dírén.
sentences.english: He quickly entered this narrow passage, avoiding the enemy at the last moment.

sentences.chinese: 通道的尽头是一个旧仓库，这里被叫作“静心阁”。
sentences.pinyin: Tōngdào de jìntóu shì yīgè jiù cāngkù, zhèlǐ bèi jiàozuò “jìngxīn gé”.
sentences.english: The end of the passage was an old warehouse, which was called "Jingxin Pavilion."

sentences.chinese: 窗外突然开始下雪，白色的雪花覆盖了整个城市。
sentences.pinyin: Chuāngwài tūrán kāishǐ xià xuě, báisè de xuěhuā fùgàile zhěnggè chéngshì.
sentences.english: Outside the window, it suddenly began to snow, and white snowflakes covered the entire city.

sentences.chinese: 李明在仓库的桌子上收到了一封信。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zài cāngkù de zhuōzi shàng shōudào le yī fēng xìn.
sentences.english: Li Ming received a letter on the table in the warehouse.

sentences.chinese: 这封信来自一个他很久没见到的老朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fēng xìn láizì yīgè tā hěn jiǔ méi jiàndào de lǎo péngyǒu.
sentences.english: The letter came from an old friend he hadn't seen for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 信中说，这个朋友出生在南方，长大后去了很远的地方学习。
sentences.pinyin: Xìn zhōng shuō, zhège péngyǒu chūshēng zài nánfāng, zhǎngdà hòu qùle hěn yuǎn de dìfāng xuéxí.
sentences.english: The letter said that this friend was born in the south and went to a far place to study after growing up.

sentences.chinese: 现在，他已经回国，并在这里出租了一间小房子。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài, tā yǐjīng huíguó, bìng zài zhèlǐ chūzū le yī jiàn xiǎo fángzi.
sentences.english: Now, he had returned to his home country and rented a small house here.

sentences.chinese: 信里写道：“欢迎你来到这里，咱们必须见面谈谈。”
sentences.pinyin: Xìn lǐ xiědào: “Huānyíng nǐ lái dào zhèlǐ, zánmen bìxū jiànmiàn tán tán.”
sentences.english: The letter read: "Welcome here, we must meet and talk."

sentences.chinese: 李明心中充满疑问：对方怎么知道他在哪里？
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xīnzhōng chōngmǎn yíwèn: duìfāng zěnme zhīdào tā zài nǎlǐ?
sentences.english: Li Ming's heart was full of questions: how did the other party know where he was?

sentences.chinese: 他想起小时候，他们一起报名参加过书院的比赛，那时他们成了好朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ xiǎoshíhòu, tāmen yīqǐ bàomíng cānjiāguò shūyuàn de bǐsài, nàshí tāmen chéngle hǎo péngyǒu.
sentences.english: He remembered when they were young, they signed up together for a competition at the academy, and they became good friends then.

sentences.chinese: 在那个年代，交朋友需要真诚，而现在的世界充满了背叛。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nàgè niándài, jiāo péngyǒu xūyào zhēnchéng, ér xiànzài de shìjiè chōngmǎnle bèipàn.
sentences.english: In that era, making friends required sincerity, but the current world was full of betrayal.

sentences.chinese: 李明走出仓库，看到街道上的人们正在排队买年货，准备过年。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zǒuchū cāngkù, kàndào jiēdào shàng de rénmen zhèngzài páiduì mǎi niánhuò, zhǔnbèi guònián.
sentences.english: Li Ming walked out of the warehouse and saw people on the street lining up to buy New Year goods, preparing to celebrate the Chinese New Year.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一个男人在骑车，速度很快，像是一只鸟准备起飞一样。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào yīgè nánrén zài qíchē, sùdù hěn kuài, xiàng shì yī zhǐ niǎo zhǔnbèi qǐfēi yīyàng.
sentences.english: He saw a man riding a bike, moving very fast, like a bird preparing to take off.

sentences.chinese: 那个男人突然停下来，对着李明点头示意。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè nánrén tūrán tíng xiàlái, duìzhe Lǐ Míng diǎntóu shìyì.
sentences.english: That man suddenly stopped and nodded to Li Ming.

sentences.chinese: 李明意识到，这就是信中的那个人。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng yìshí dào, zhè jiùshì xìn zhōng de nàgè rén.
sentences.english: Li Ming realized that this was the person in the letter.

sentences.chinese: 他们走进一家安静的茶馆，开始了长久的对话。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒujìn yī jiā ānjìng de cháguǎn, kāishǐle chángjiǔ de duìhuà.
sentences.english: They entered a quiet teahouse and began a long conversation.

sentences.chinese: 男人告诉他，书院即将举行一个巨大的秘密会议。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén gàosù tā, shūyuàn jíjiāng jǔxíng yīgè jùdà de mìmì huìyì.
sentences.english: The man told him that the academy was about to hold a huge secret meeting.

sentences.chinese: 为了进入那个会议，李明必须请求一个特殊的许可。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jìnrù nàgè huìyì, Lǐ Míng bìxū qǐngqiú yīgè tèshū de xǔkě.
sentences.english: In order to enter that meeting, Li Ming had to request a special permit.

sentences.chinese: 男人说：“如果你能见到那个执政官，结果可能会改变。”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ néng jiàndào nàgè zhízhèngguān, jiéguǒ kěnéng huì gǎibiàn.”
sentences.english: The man said: "If you can see that governor, the result might change."

sentences.chinese: 李明问：“如果对方不答应，我怎么办？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng wèn: “Rúguǒ duìfāng bù dāyìng, wǒ zěnme bàn?”
sentences.english: Li Ming asked: "If the other party doesn't agree, what should I do?"

sentences.chinese: 男人笑了笑，拿出两杯热茶，轻声说：“干杯，为了我们的胜利。”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén xiàole xiào, ná chū liǎng bēi rè chá, qīngshēng shuō: “Gānbēi, wèile wǒmen de shènglì.”
sentences.english: The man smiled, took out two cups of hot tea, and said softly: "Cheers, to our victory."

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，一个伙计把一盘点心送到他们桌上。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, yīgè huǒjì bǎ yī pán diǎnxīn sòngdào tāmen zhuō shàng.
sentences.english: Just then, a waiter delivered a plate of dim sum to their table.

sentences.chinese: 男人低声说：“记得，现在不能照相，也不能留下任何证据。”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén dīshēng shuō: “Jìdé, xiànzài bùnéng zhàoxiàng, yě bùnéng liú xià rènhé zhèngjù.”
sentences.english: The man whispered: "Remember, you cannot take photos now, nor leave any evidence."

sentences.chinese: 虽然在古代没有照相机，但男人指的是不能让任何人记录下他们的样子。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán zài gǔdài méiyǒu zhàoxiàngjī, dàn nánrén zhǐ de shì bùnéng ràng rènhé rén jìlù xià tāmen de yàngzi.
sentences.english: Although there were no cameras in ancient times, the man meant that they could not let anyone record their appearance.

sentences.chinese: 李明想起以前在书院听讲的时候，老师说过，秘密就像火，必须小心处理。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xiǎngqǐ yǐqián zài shūyuàn tīngjiǎng de shíhòu, lǎoshī shuōguò, mìmì jiù xiàng huǒ, bìxū xiǎoxīn chǔlǐ.
sentences.english: Li Ming remembered when he attended lectures at the academy, the teacher said that secrets are like fire and must be handled carefully.

sentences.chinese: 突然，门外传来一声大喊：“站住！不要走！”
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, mén wài chuán lái yīshēng dàhǎn: “Zhànzhù! Bùyào zǒu!”
sentences.english: Suddenly, a loud shout came from outside: "Stand still! Don't leave!"

sentences.chinese: 李明心跳加快，他接到一个信号，必须立刻离开。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xīntiào jiākuài, tā jiēdào yīgè xìnhào, bìxū lìkè líkāi.
sentences.english: Li Ming's heart raced; he received a signal that he must leave immediately.

sentences.chinese: 他请求朋友帮他掩护，然后迅速消失在雪地中。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qǐngqiú péngyǒu bāng tā yǎnhù, ránhòu xùnsù xiāoshī zài xuědì zhōng.
sentences.english: He requested his friend to cover for him and then quickly disappeared into the snow.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，这场游戏才刚刚开始，而他必须找到真正的出路。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhīdào, zhè chǎng yóuxì cái gānggāng kāishǐ, ér tā bìxū zhǎodào zhēnzhèng de chūlù.
sentences.english: He knew that this game had just begun, and he had to find the real way out.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十五章：雪地中的回忆

sentences.chinese: 李明在雪地中奔跑，冷风像刀一样。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zài xuě dì zhōng bēn pǎo, lěng fēng xiàng dāo yī yàng.
sentences.english: Li Ming ran through the snow, the cold wind like a knife.

sentences.chinese: 他刚刚跑出很远，忽然听到身后有马蹄声。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gāng gāng pǎo chū hěn yuǎn, hū rán tīng dào shēn hòu yǒu mǎ tí shēng.
sentences.english: He had just run a long distance when he suddenly heard the sound of horse hooves behind him.

sentences.chinese: 刚才的惊慌让他呼吸很急，他实在太累了。
sentences.pinyin: Gāng cái de jīng huāng ràng tā hū xī hěn jí, tā shí zài tài lèi le.
sentences.english: The panic of a moment ago made his breathing heavy; he was truly too tired.

sentences.chinese: 他躲在一棵大树后面，看着到处都是白色的雪。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duǒ zài yī kē dà shù hòu miàn, kàn zhe dào chù dōu shì bái sè de xuě.
sentences.english: He hid behind a large tree, seeing white snow everywhere.

sentences.chinese: 他想起以前在书院的日子，那时候的生活很安静。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ yǐ qián zài shū yuàn de rì zi, nà shí hou de shēng huó hěn ān jìng.
sentences.english: He thought of the days before at the academy, when life was very quiet.

sentences.chinese: 他从小就喜欢读书，老师说他一定能成为一个伟大的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo jiù xǐ huan dú shū, lǎo shī shuō tā yī dìng néng chéng wéi yī gè wěi dà de rén.
sentences.english: He had loved reading since childhood, and his teacher said he would certainly become a great man.

sentences.chinese: 小时候，他每天都在书院学习，一年到头，全年都在看书。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo shí hou, tā měi tiān dōu zài shū yuàn xué xí, yī nián dào tóu, quán nián dōu zài kàn shū.
sentences.english: In his childhood, he studied at the academy every day, reading books all year long.

sentences.chinese: 在那段日子里，他一共读了许多古老的书。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nà duàn rì zi lǐ, tā yī gòng dú le xǔ duō gǔ lǎo de shū.
sentences.english: During that period, he read many ancient books altogether.

sentences.chinese: 其中有一本书讲的是一个关于忠诚的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Qí zhōng yǒu yī běn shū jiǎng de shì yī gè guān yú zhōng chéng de gù shi.
sentences.english: Among them was a book that told a story about loyalty.

sentences.chinese: 他记得前年冬天，老师告诉他，一个人一生最重要的是正直。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì de qián nián dōng tiān, lǎo shī gào su tā, yī gè rén yī shēng zuì zhòng yào de shì zhèng zhí.
sentences.english: He remembered the winter the year before last, when his teacher told him that the most important thing in one's life is integrity.

sentences.chinese: 当时，他还不明白这个道理，但现在他明白了。
sentences.pinyin: Dāng shí, tā hái bù míng bai zhè ge dào lǐ, dàn xiàn zài tā míng bai le.
sentences.english: At that time, he did not yet understand this logic, but now he did.

sentences.chinese: 他想，也许只有通过这次危险，他才能真正长大。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, yě xǔ zhǐ yǒu tōng guò zhè cì wēi xiǎn, tā cái néng zhēn zhèng zhǎng dà.
sentences.english: He thought that perhaps only by going through this danger could he truly grow up.

sentences.chinese: 他原来以为生活很简单，但现在发现世界很复杂。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yuán lái yǐ wéi shēng huó hěn jiǎn dān, dàn xiàn zài fā xiàn shì jiè hěn fù zá.
sentences.english: He originally thought life was simple, but now he found the world to be complex.

sentences.chinese: 他已经跑了差不多一个时辰，身体快要支撑不住了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǐ jīng pǎo le chà bu duō yī gè shí chén, shēn tǐ kuài yào zhī chēng bù zhù le.
sentences.english: He had already run for almost two hours, and his body was about to give out.

sentences.chinese: 他在夜里行走，周围好像有很多眼睛在看着他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài yè li xíng zǒu, zhōu wéi hǎo xiàng yǒu hěn duō yǎn jīng zài kàn zhe tā.
sentences.english: He walked during the night, and it seemed as if there were many eyes watching him.

sentences.chinese: 他好久没有这样害怕过了，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hǎo jiǔ méi yǒu zhè yàng hài pà guò le, xīn tiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: It had been quite a while since he had been this afraid; his heart beat fast.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，今后他必须更加小心，不能再相信随便一个人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, jīn hòu tā bì xū gèng jiā xiǎo xīn, bù néng zài xiāng xìn suí biàn yī gè rén.
sentences.english: He realized that henceforth he must be more careful and cannot trust just anyone.

sentences.chinese: 他记得小时候，他有一个同样热爱读书的朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì de xiǎo shí hou, tā yǒu yī gè tóng yàng rè ài dú shū de péng you.
sentences.english: He remembered that in his childhood, he had a friend who similarly loved reading.

sentences.chinese: 后来，那个朋友去了远方，他们再也没有见过面。
sentences.pinyin: Hòu lái, nà ge péng you qù le yuǎn fāng, tā men zài yě méi yǒu jiàn guò miàn.
sentences.english: Later, that friend went far away, and they never saw each other again.

sentences.chinese: 在书院的时候，平时他们总是坐在一起讨论问题。
sentences.pinyin: Zài shū yuàn de shí hou, píng shí tā men zǒng shì zuò zài yī qǐ tǎo lùn wèn tí.
sentences.english: At the academy, they ordinarily always sat together to discuss problems.

sentences.chinese: 现在，他可能再也回不去那个温暖的地方了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài, tā kě néng zài yě huí bù qù nà ge wēn nuǎn de dì fang le.
