sentences.english: Now, he might never be able to return to that warm place.

sentences.chinese: 他想，以后如果能活下来，他要写一本书记录这一切。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, yǐ hòu rú guǒ néng huó xià lái, tā yào xiě yī běn shū jì lù zhè yī qiè.
sentences.english: He thought that if he could survive in the future, he would write a book to record all this.

sentences.chinese: 他想起书院成立一百周年那天，所有人都在庆祝。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ shū yuàn chéng lì yī bǎi zhōu nián nà tiān, suǒ yǒu rén dōu zài qìng zhù.
sentences.english: He thought of the day of the academy's hundredth anniversary, when everyone was celebrating.

sentences.chinese: 那时他觉得世界很美好，可以永远这样下去。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shí tā jué de shì jiè hěn měi hǎo, kě yǐ yǒng yuǎn zhè yàng xià qù.
sentences.english: At that time, he felt the world was beautiful and could go on like this forever.

sentences.chinese: 但现在，他必须在寒冷中寻找生存的机会。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiàn zài, tā bì xū zài hán lěng zhōng xún zhǎo shēng cún de jī huì.
sentences.english: But now, he must seek a chance for survival in the cold.

sentences.chinese: 他同时感觉到，敌人就在不远处。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tóng shí gǎn jué dào, dí rén jiù zài bù yuǎn chù.
sentences.english: At the same time, he felt that the enemy was not far away.

sentences.chinese: 他必须快点找到那个接头的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì xū kuài diǎn zhǎo dào nà ge jiē tóu de rén.
sentences.english: He must quickly find the contact person.

sentences.chinese: 他想起那个信号，那是一个特殊的标志。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ nà ge xìn hào, nà shì yī gè tè shū de biāo zhì.
sentences.english: He remembered the signal, which was a special mark.

sentences.chinese: 他继续向前走，雪变得越来越深。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì xù xiàng qián zǒu, xuě biàn de yuè lái yuè shēn.
sentences.english: He continued to walk forward, and the snow became deeper and deeper.

sentences.chinese: 他突然看到远处有一盏灯火。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tū rán kàn dào yuǎn chù yǒu yī zhǎn dēng huǒ.
sentences.english: He suddenly saw a lamp light in the distance.

sentences.chinese: 那盏灯火在黑暗中闪烁，像是在呼唤他。
sentences.pinyin: Nà zhǎn dēng huǒ zài hēi àn zhōng shǎn shuò, xiàng shì zài hū huàn tā.
sentences.english: That lamp flickered in the darkness, as if calling to him.

sentences.chinese: 他不知道那里是谁，但那是他唯一的希望。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zhī dào nà lǐ shì shéi, dàn nà shì tā wéi yī de xī wàng.
sentences.english: He didn't know who was there, but it was his only hope.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十六章：灯火下的陌生人
chapters.title_english: Chapter 16: The Stranger Under the Lamp

sentences.chinese: 李明慢慢走向那盏灯火，雪地里的风越来越冷。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng màn màn zǒu xiàng nà zhǎn dēng huǒ, xuě dì lǐ de fēng yuè lái yuè lěng.
sentences.english: Li Ming walked slowly toward the lamp light, and the wind in the snow became colder and colder.

sentences.chinese: 他想，那里或是一个陷阱，或者是一个救他的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, nà lǐ huò shì yī gè xiàn jǐng, huò zhě shì yī gè jiù tā de rén.
sentences.english: He thought, that place might be a trap, or perhaps it was someone coming to save him.

sentences.chinese: 他小心地走近，发现那是一座小木屋。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎo xīn de zǒu jìn, fā xiàn nà shì yī zuò xiǎo mù wū.
sentences.english: He approached carefully and discovered it was a small wooden hut.

sentences.chinese: 就在他快到门口时，他看到一个老人坐在屋里。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tā kuài dào mén kǒu shí, tā kàn dào yī gè lǎo rén zuò zài wū lǐ.
sentences.english: Just as he was about to reach the door, he saw an old man sitting inside the house.

sentences.chinese: 那个老人看着他，眼神里有一种相同的悲伤，像李明自己一样。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè lǎo rén kàn zhe tā, yǎn shén lǐ yǒu yī zhǒng xiāng tóng de bēi shāng, xiàng Lǐ Míng zì jǐ yī yàng.
sentences.english: The old man looked at him, and in his eyes was a similar sadness, just like Li Ming himself.

sentences.chinese: 老人低声说：“你早就该来了，我一直在等你。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén dī shēng shuō: “Nǐ zǎo jiù gāi lái le, wǒ yī zhí zài děng nǐ.”
sentences.english: The old man said in a low voice, "You should have come long ago; I have been waiting for you."

sentences.chinese: 李明很惊讶，因为他最近没有告诉任何人自己的位置。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng hěn jīng yà, yī n wèi tā zuì jìn méi yǒu gào sù rén hé rén zì jǐ de wèi zhì.
sentences.english: Li Ming was very surprised because he had not told anyone his location recently.

sentences.chinese: 他想，这个老人正是那个能帮他解开秘密的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, zhè gè lǎo rén zhèng shì nà gè néng bāng tā jiě kāi mì mì de rén.
sentences.english: He thought this old man was precisely the person who could help him unlock the secret.

sentences.chinese: 这时，老人示意他快进来，因为外面随时会有敌人出现。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, lǎo rén shì yì tā kuài jìn lái, yī n wèi wài miàn suí shí huì yǒu dí rén chū xiàn.
sentences.english: At this time, the old man signaled for him to come in quickly, because enemies could appear at any time outside.

sentences.chinese: 李明走进屋子，正好看到桌上有一杯热茶。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zǒu jìn wū zi, zhèng hǎo kàn dào zhuō shàng yǒu yī bēi rè chá.
sentences.english: Li Ming entered the house and just happened to see a cup of hot tea on the table.

sentences.chinese: 老人说：“在那会儿，我也像你一样在逃跑。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén shuō: “Zài nà huì r, wǒ yě xiàng nǐ yī yàng zài táo pǎo.”
sentences.english: The old man said, "Back then, I was running away just like you."

sentences.chinese: 那时，整个国家都陷入了混乱，人们老是担心明天。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shí, zhěng gè guó jiā dōu xiàn rù le hùn luàn, rén men lǎo shi dān xīn míng tiān.
sentences.english: At that time, the whole country had fallen into chaos, and people were always worrying about tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 那时候，李明在书院时还很年轻，不懂这些道理。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shí hou, Lǐ Míng zài shū yuàn shí hái hěn nián qīng, bù dǒng zhè xiē dào lǐ.
sentences.english: At that time, when Li Ming was at the academy, he was still young and didn't understand these reasons.

sentences.chinese: 老人看着他，轻声说：“在那时候，我必须重新开始我的生活。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén kàn zhe tā, qīng shēng shuō: “Zài nà shí hou, wǒ bì xū chóng xīn kāi shǐ wǒ de shēng huó.”
sentences.english: The old man looked at him and said softly, "At that time, I had to start my life over again."

sentences.chinese: 李明发现，老人身边放着一本很旧的书，封皮和他的笔记很像。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng fā xiàn, lǎo rén shēn biān fàng zhe yī běn hěn jiù de shū, fēng pí hé tā de bǐ jì hěn xiàng.
sentences.english: Li Ming noticed that beside the old man was a very old book, the cover of which looked very similar to his notes.

sentences.chinese: 老人问他：“你是故意走到这里的，还是随便走走？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén wèn tā: “Nǐ shì gù yì zǒu dào zhè lǐ de, hái shì suí biàn zǒu zǒu?”
sentences.english: The old man asked him, "Did you come here deliberately, or were you just walking randomly?"

sentences.chinese: 李明回答说：“我是跟着信号来的。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng huí dá shuō: “Wǒ shì gēn zhe xìn hào lái de.”
sentences.english: Li Ming replied, "I came following the signal."

sentences.chinese: 这时候，窗外突然传来了马蹄声，声音非常近。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí hou, chuāng wài tū rán chuán lái le mǎ tí shēng, shēng yīn fēi cháng jìn.
sentences.english: At this moment, the sound of horse hooves suddenly came from outside the window, and the sound was very close.

sentences.chinese: 李明的心跳加快了，他知道敌人已经找到了这里。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng de xīn tiào jiā kuài le, tā zhī dào dí rén yǐ jīng zhǎo dào le zhè lǐ.
sentences.english: Li Ming's heart beat faster; he knew the enemies had already found this place.

sentences.chinese: 老人冷静地站起来，指了指屋后的暗门。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén lěng jìng de zhàn qǐ lái, zhǐ le zhǐ wū hòu de àn mén.
sentences.english: The old man stood up calmly and pointed to a secret door at the back of the house.

sentences.chinese: “快走，这里不能久留。”
sentences.pinyin: “Kuài zǒu, zhè lǐ bù néng jiǔ liú.”
sentences.english: "Go quickly, you cannot stay here long."

sentences.chinese: 李明回头看了一眼，发现老人正对着他微笑，那笑容里藏着一个巨大的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng huí tóu kàn le yī yǎn, fā xiàn lǎo rén zhèng duì zhe tā wēi xiào, nà xiào róng lǐ cáng zhe yī gè jù dà de mì mì.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked back and found the old man smiling at him, a huge secret hidden in that smile.

sentences.chinese: 他推开暗门，再次进入了寒冷的黑夜。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tuī kāi àn mén, zài cì jìn rù le hán lěng de hēi yè.
sentences.english: He pushed open the secret door and entered the cold night once again.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十七章：秘密名单与深夜的追逐
chapters.title_english: Chapter 17: The Secret List and the Midnight Chase

sentences.chinese: 寒冷的夜风吹在李明的脸上。
sentences.pinyin: Hán lěng de yè fēng chuī zài Lǐ Míng de liǎn shàng.
sentences.english: The cold night wind blew against Li Ming's face.

sentences.chinese: 他沿着高高的墙快步走着，心中充满了不安。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yán zhe gāo gāo de qiáng kuài bù zǒu zhe, xīn zhōng chōng mǎn le bù ān.
sentences.english: He walked quickly along the high wall, his heart filled with unease.

sentences.chinese: 他想起老人刚才给他的那张纸，上面写着很多名字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ lǎo rén gāng cái gěi tā de nà zhāng zhǐ, shàng miàn xiě zhe hěn duō míng zi.
sentences.english: He thought of the piece of paper the old man had just given him, on which many names were written.

sentences.chinese: 那是一份名单，记录了所有被敌人追杀的人。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì yī fèn míng dān, jì lù le suǒ yǒu bèi dí rén zhuī shā de rén.
sentences.english: It was a list, recording all the people being hunted by the enemy.

sentences.chinese: 名单上的第一个名字是东方，一个来自东方的学者。
sentences.pinyin: Míng dān shàng de dì yī gè míng zi shì Dōng fāng, yī gè lái zì dōng fāng de xué zhě.
sentences.english: The first name on the list was Dongfang, a scholar from the East.

sentences.chinese: 接着是全先生、加先生和占先生。
sentences.pinyin: Jiē zhe shì Quán xiān sheng, Jiā xiān sheng hé Zhàn xiān sheng.
sentences.english: Then there were Mr. Quan, Mr. Jia, and Mr. Zhan.

sentences.chinese: 李明记得，这些人都曾是书院的老师。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng jì de, zhè xiē rén dōu céng shì shū yuàn de lǎo shī.
sentences.english: Li Ming remembered that these people had all been teachers at the academy.

sentences.chinese: 他低头看，名单上还有向先生、封先生和平先生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dī tóu kàn, míng dān shàng hái yǒu Xiàng xiān sheng, Fēng xiān sheng hé Píng xiān sheng.
sentences.english: Looking down, he saw Mr. Xiang, Mr. Feng, and Mr. Ping on the list.

sentences.chinese: 甚至还有怕先生、成先生、查先生和段先生。
sentences.pinyin: Shèn zhì hái yǒu Pà xiān sheng, Chéng xiān sheng, Zhā xiān sheng hé Duàn xiān sheng.
sentences.english: There were even Mr. Pa, Mr. Cheng, Mr. Zha, and Mr. Duan.

sentences.chinese: 海先生的名字在最后，他曾告诉李明关于大海的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi xiān sheng de míng zi zài zuì hòu, tā céng gào su Lǐ Míng guān yú dà hǎi de gù shì.
sentences.english: Mr. Hai's name was last; he had once told Li Ming stories about the great sea.

sentences.chinese: 李明突然意识到，这些人的身份非常特殊，其中很多人是满族的人。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng tū rán yì shí dào, zhè xiē rén de shēn fèn fēi cháng tè shū, qí zhōng hěn duō rén shì Mǎn zú de rén.
sentences.english: Li Ming suddenly realized that these people's identities were very special, and many of them were of Manchu ethnicity.

sentences.chinese: 他必须把这份名单留给正确的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì xū bǎ zhè fèn míng dān liú gěi zhèng què de rén.
sentences.english: He had to leave this list to the right person.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，他听到身后传来了急促的脚步声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, tā tīng dào shēn hòu chuán lái le jí cù de jiǎo bù shēng.
sentences.english: Just then, he heard hurried footsteps coming from behind him.

sentences.chinese: “咱得快点跑！”他对自己低声说了一句。
sentences.pinyin: “Zán děi kuài diǎn pǎo!” tā duì zì jǐ dī shēng shuō le yī jù.
sentences.english: "We've got to run faster!" he whispered to himself.

sentences.chinese: 他迅速跑进了一个阴暗的花园。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xùn sù pǎo jìn le yī gè yīn àn de huā yuán.
sentences.english: He quickly ran into a dark garden.

sentences.chinese: 花园里长满了绿色的草，在月光下显得很诡异。
sentences.pinyin: Huā yuán lǐ zhǎng mǎn le lǜ sè de cǎo, zài yuè guāng xià xiǎn de hěn guǐ yì.
sentences.english: The garden was overgrown with green grass, which looked eerie under the moonlight.

sentences.chinese: 他小心地走着，怕碰到花园里的石头。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎo xīn de zǒu zhe, pà pèng dào huā yuán lǐ de shí tou.
sentences.english: He walked carefully, afraid of bumping into the stones in the garden.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他撞到了一个穿着红衣服的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, tā zhuàng dào le yī gè chuān zhe hóng yī fu de rén.
sentences.english: Suddenly, he collided with a person wearing red clothes.

sentences.chinese: 那个人姓红，是书院的一名学生，也是李明的朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén xìng Hóng, shì shū yuàn de yī míng xué sheng, yě shì Lǐ Míng de péng you.
sentences.english: That person's surname was Hong; he was a student at the academy and a friend of Li Ming.

sentences.chinese: 红同学惊恐地看着他，手里还拿着一个破碗。
sentences.pinyin: Hóng tóng xué jīng kǒng de kàn zhe tā, shǒu lǐ hái ná zhe yī gè pò wǎn.
sentences.english: Student Hong looked at him in terror, still holding a broken bowl in his hand.

sentences.chinese: “李明！你怎么在这里？”红同学小声问。
sentences.pinyin: “Lǐ Míng! Nǐ zěn me zài zhè lǐ?” Hóng tóng xué xiǎo shēng wèn.
sentences.english: "Li Ming! Why are you here?" Student Hong asked in a low voice.

sentences.chinese: 李明赶紧举起手，示意他安静。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng gǎn jǐn jǔ qǐ shǒu, shì yì tā ān jìng.
sentences.english: Li Ming quickly raised his hand, signaling him to be quiet.

sentences.chinese: 两人在草丛中低声交谈了一会儿。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng rén zài cǎo cóng zhōng dī shēng jiāo tán le yī huì r.
sentences.english: The two of them talked in low voices in the grass for a while.

sentences.chinese: 红同学告诉他，现在有一组士兵在附近搜查。
sentences.pinyin: Hóng tóng xué gào su tā, xiàn zài yǒu yī zǔ shì bīng zài fù jìn sōu chá.
sentences.english: Student Hong told him that a group of soldiers was searching nearby.

sentences.chinese: 他们的领头人姓米，一个非常凶狠的将军。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men de lǐng tóu rén xìng Mǐ, yī gè fēi cháng xiōng hěn de jiāng jūn.
sentences.english: Their leader was named Mi, a very fierce general.

sentences.chinese: 另外还有一个姓组的人在协助搜查。
sentences.pinyin: Lì wài hái yǒu yī gè xìng Zǔ de rén zài xié zhù sōu chá.
sentences.english: Additionally, there was someone surnamed Zu assisting in the search.

sentences.chinese: 李明感到压力很大，他把名单背在身后，紧紧地捂住。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng gǎn dào yā lì hěn dà, tā bǎ míng dān bēi zài shēn hòu, jǐn jǐn de wǔ zhù.
sentences.english: Li Ming felt great pressure; he carried the list on his back, covering it tightly.

sentences.chinese: 他想起书院里那些友好的日子，现在一切都变了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ shū yuàn lǐ nà xiē yǒu hǎo de rì zi, xiàn zài yī qiè dōu biàn le.
sentences.english: He thought of those friendly days at the academy; now everything had changed.

sentences.chinese: 他不能让这份秘密落入敌人手中。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù néng ràng zhè fèn mì mì luò rù dí rén shǒu zhōng.
sentences.english: He could not let this secret fall into the hands of the enemy.

sentences.chinese: 红同学指了指远方：“那边有条小河，有一艘船。”
sentences.pinyin: Hóng tóng xué zhǐ le zhǐ yuǎn fāng: “Nà biān yǒu tiáo xiǎo hé, yǒu yī sōu chuán.”
sentences.english: Student Hong pointed in the distance: "There is a small river over there, and a boat."

sentences.chinese: 李明看向河边，那里确实停着一只小船。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kàn xiàng hé biān, nà lǐ què shí tíng zhe yī zhī xiǎo chuán.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked toward the riverbank, and indeed, a small boat was moored there.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，只有通过这条河，才能离开这个危险的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhī dào, zhǐ yǒu tōng guò zhè tiáo hé, cái néng lí kāi zhè gè wēi xiǎn de dì fang.
sentences.english: He knew that only by crossing this river could he leave this dangerous place.

sentences.chinese: 但就在他准备跑向船边时，一个冰冷的声音在他身后响起。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài tā zhǔn bèi pǎo xiàng chuán biān shí, yī gè bīng lěng de shēng yīn zài tā shēn hòu xiǎng qǐ.
sentences.english: But just as he was preparing to run toward the boat, a cold voice sounded behind him.

sentences.chinese: “李明，把名单给我。”
sentences.pinyin: “Lǐ Míng, bǎ míng dān gěi wǒ.”
sentences.english: "Li Ming, give me the list."

sentences.chinese: 李明慢慢转过身，看到一个穿着深蓝色衣服的男人。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng màn màn zhuǎn guò shēn, kàn dào yī gè chuān zhe shēn lán sè yī fú de nán rén.
sentences.english: Li Ming slowly turned around and saw a man wearing deep blue clothes.

sentences.chinese: 这个男人的姓是蓝，他是书院里最可怕的监察官。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè nán rén de xìng shì Lán, tā shì shū yuàn lǐ zuì kě pà de jiān chá guān.
sentences.english: This man's surname was Lan; he was the most fearsome inspector in the academy.

sentences.chinese: 蓝监察官身后站着一群人，他们分别姓角、闻、阴、雪、题和鱼。
sentences.pinyin: Lán jiān chá guān shēn hòu zhàn zhe yī qún rén, tā men fēn bié xìng Jué, Wén, Yīn, Xuě, Tí hé Yú.
sentences.english: Behind Inspector Lan stood a group of people with the surnames Jue, Wen, Yin, Xue, Ti, and Yu.

sentences.chinese: 这些人的名字在书院的记录里出现过很多遍。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiē rén de míng zì zài shū yuàn de jì lù lǐ chū xiàn guò hěn duō biàn.
sentences.english: Their names had appeared many times in the academy's records.

sentences.chinese: 李明心中非常难受，因为他以为这些人都已经死了。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xīn zhōng fēi cháng nán shòu, yīn wèi tā yǐ wéi zhè xiē rén dōu yǐ jīng sǐ le.
sentences.english: Li Ming felt very distressed in his heart because he thought these people were already dead.

sentences.chinese: 蓝监察官冷冷地问：“你为什么要把名单带走？”
sentences.pinyin: Lán jiān chá guān lěng lěng de wèn: “Nǐ wèi shén me yào bǎ míng dān dài zǒu?”
sentences.english: Inspector Lan asked coldly, "Why did you take the list away?"

sentences.chinese: 他手里拿着一本厚厚的字典，上面写着很多古老的词。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shǒu lǐ ná zhe yī běn hòu hòu de zì diǎn, shàng miàn xiě zhe hěn duō gǔ lǎo de cí.
sentences.english: He held a thick dictionary in his hand, which contained many ancient terms.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉李明，这些名单上的名字代表了西北地区的千个秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù Lǐ Míng, zhè xiē míng dān shàng de míng zì dài biǎo le xī běi dì qū de qiān gè mì mì.
sentences.english: He told Li Ming that the names on these lists represented a thousand secrets of the Northwest region.

sentences.chinese: 其中一个叫黄的人，曾是凉州最强大的将领。
sentences.pinyin: Qí zhōng yī gè jiào Huáng de rén, céng shì Liáng zhōu zuì qiáng dà de jiāng lǐng.
sentences.english: Among them, a man named Huang was once the most powerful general of Liang Province.

sentences.chinese: 蓝监察官说，只要拿到名单，就能控制万千军队。
sentences.pinyin: Lán jiān chá guān shuō, zhǐ yào ná dào míng dān, jiù néng kòng zhì wàn qiān jūn duì.
sentences.english: Inspector Lan said that as long as they got the list, they could control tens of thousands of troops.

sentences.chinese: 李明看着他们，感觉自己像一只被抓住了的鸟。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kàn zhe tā men, gǎn jué zì jǐ xiàng yī zhī bèi zhuā zhù le de niǎo.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked at them and felt like a bird that had been caught.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个姓蛋的人走上前，嘲笑地看着李明。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yī gè xìng Dàn de rén zǒu shàng qián, cháo xiào de kàn zhe Lǐ Míng.
sentences.english: At this moment, a person with the surname Dan stepped forward and looked at Li Ming mockingly.

sentences.chinese: 在这个古代的夜晚，李明突然想起一个奇怪的梦。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè gè gǔ dài de yè wǎn, Lǐ Míng tū rán xiǎng qǐ yī gè qí guài de mèng.
sentences.english: On this ancient night, Li Ming suddenly remembered a strange dream.

sentences.chinese: 梦里他看到了一个现代的洗衣机，在水边洗着白色的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Mèng lǐ tā kàn dào le yī gè xiàn dài de xǐ yī jī, zài shuǐ biān xǐ zhe bái sè de yī fú.
sentences.english: In the dream, he saw a modern washing machine washing white clothes by the water.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到这样是不可能的，那只是他惊恐时的幻觉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào zhè yàng shì bù kě néng de, nà zhǐ shì tā jīng kǒng shí de huàn jué.
sentences.english: He realized that this was impossible; it was just a hallucination caused by his terror.

sentences.chinese: 蓝监察官走近一步，眼神像冰一样冷。
sentences.pinyin: Lán jiān chá guān zǒu jìn yī bù, yǎn shén xiàng bīng yī yàng lěng.
sentences.english: Inspector Lan took a step closer, his gaze as cold as ice.

sentences.chinese: 他要求李明立刻把名单交给他们，否则就永远留在河边。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yāo qiú Lǐ Míng lì kè bǎ míng dān jiāo gěi tā men, fǒu zé jiù yǒng yuǎn liú zài hé biān.
sentences.english: He demanded that Li Ming hand over the list immediately, otherwise he would remain by the river forever.

sentences.chinese: 李明看着河水，突然发现船上的绳子被解开了。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kàn zhe hé shuǐ, tū rán fā xiàn chuán shàng de shéng zi bèi jiě kāi le.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked at the river water and suddenly discovered that the rope on the boat had been untied.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到这是一个机会，但对手离他只有一步之遥。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào zhè shì yī gè jī huì, dàn duì shǒu lí tā zhǐ yǒu yī bù zhī yáo.
sentences.english: He realized this was an opportunity, but his opponent was only one step away.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，森林里突然传来了一声巨大的响声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, sēn lín lǐ tū rán chuán lái le yī shēng jù dà de xiǎng shēng.
sentences.english: Just then, a loud noise suddenly echoed from the forest.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十九章：森林中的秘密约定
chapters.title_english: Chapter 19: Secret Agreement in the Forest

sentences.chinese: 森林里传来的响声让蓝监察官停了下来。
sentences.pinyin: Sēnlín lǐ chuán lái de xiǎng shēng ràng Lán jiāncháguān tíng le xià lái.
sentences.english: The noise coming from the forest made Inspector Lan stop.

sentences.chinese: 那是一个奇怪的声音，像是在呼唤李明。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì yí gè qíguài de shēngyīn, xiàng shì zài hūhuàn Lǐ Míng.
sentences.english: It was a strange sound, as if it were calling Li Ming.

sentences.chinese: 突然，李明看到远处有一个红色的信号。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, Lǐ Míng kàndào yuǎnchù yǒu yí gè hóngsè de xìnhào.
sentences.english: Suddenly, Li Ming saw a red signal in the distance.

sentences.chinese: 他记得在书院的信中，老师说过这就是救援的标志。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde zài shūyuàn de xìn zhōng, lǎoshī shuō guò zhè jiùshì jiùyuán de biāozhì.
sentences.english: He remembered in the letter from the academy, the teacher had said this was the sign for rescue.

sentences.chinese: 李明小声地对同伴说：“快，那是我们的机会！”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xiǎoshēng de duì tóngbàn shuō: “Kuài, nà shì wǒmen de jīhuì!”
sentences.english: Li Ming whispered to his companion, "Quick, that is our chance!"

sentences.chinese: 他们迅速跑向森林深处，离开了冰冷的河边。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xùnsù pǎo xiàng sēnlín shēnchù, líkāi le bīnglěng de hébiān.
sentences.english: They quickly ran into the depths of the forest, leaving the freezing riverside.

sentences.chinese: 在那里，他们遇到了一位来自东北的神秘商人。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nàlǐ, tāmen yùdào le yí wèi láizì Dōngběi de shénmì shāngrén.
sentences.english: There, they met a mysterious merchant from the Northeast.

sentences.chinese: 商人看着李明，轻声问他：“你觉得现在的情况怎么样？”
sentences.pinyin: Shāngrén kànzhe Lǐ Míng, qīngshēng wèn tā: “Nǐ juéde xiànzài de qíngkuàng zěnmeyàng?”
sentences.english: The merchant looked at Li Ming and asked softly, "How do you think the current situation is?"

sentences.chinese: 李明感到很难过，因为他失去了许多好朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng gǎndào hěn nánguò, yīnwèi tā shīqù le xǔduō hǎo péngyǒu.
sentences.english: Li Ming felt very sad because he had lost many good friends.

sentences.chinese: 商人递给他一张像报纸一样的旧纸片，上面写着很多数字。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngrén dì gěi tā yì zhāng xiàng bàozhǐ yíyàng de jiù zhǐpiàn, shàngmiàn xiězhe hěnduō shùzì.
sentences.english: The merchant handed him an old piece of paper like a newspaper, with many numbers written on it.

sentences.chinese: 商人说：“这些数字是打开秘密宝库的钥匙，里面有亿万两的金子。”
sentences.pinyin: Shāngrén shuō: “Zhèxiē shùzì shì dǎkāi mìmì bǎokù de yàoshi, lǐmiàn yǒu yì wàn liǎng de jīnzi.”
sentences.english: The merchant said, "These numbers are the keys to open the secret treasury, which contains hundreds of millions of taels of gold."

sentences.chinese: 在古代，人们没有计算机，只能用手计算这些信息。
sentences.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, rénmen méiyǒu jìsuànjī, zhǐnéng yòng shǒu jìsuàn zhèxiē xìnxī.
sentences.english: In ancient times, people did not have computers; they could only calculate this information by hand.

sentences.chinese: 商人还给了李明一盒药片，说可以治疗寒冷带来的病痛。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngrén hái gěi le Lǐ Míng yì hé yàopiàn, shuō kěyǐ zhìliáo hánlěng dài lái de bìngtòng.
sentences.english: The merchant also gave Li Ming a box of pills, saying they could treat the pain caused by the cold.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉李明，现在的温度太低，必须小心身体。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Lǐ Míng, xiànzài de wēndù tài dī, bìxū xiǎoxīn shēntǐ.
sentences.english: He told Li Ming that the temperature was too low now and he must be careful with his health.

sentences.chinese: 突然，商人从怀里拿出一个奇怪的金属片，说这是他送给李明的礼物。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, shāngrén cóng huái lǐ ná chū yí gè qíguài de jīnshǔ piàn, shuō zhè shì tā sònggěi Lǐ Míng de lǐwù.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the merchant took out a strange piece of metal from his robe and said it was a gift given to Li Ming.

sentences.chinese: 这个金属片看起来像现代的信用卡，但其实是一枚特殊的令牌。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè jīnshǔ piàn kàn qǐlái xiàng xiàndài de xìnyòngkǎ, dàn qíshí shì yì méi tèshū de lìngpái.
sentences.english: This piece of metal looked like a modern credit card, but it was actually a special command token.

sentences.chinese: 商人开玩笑说，如果以后有出租车，他可以载李明去远方。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngrén kāiwánxiào shuō, rúguǒ yǐhòu yǒu chūzūchē, tā kěyǐ zài Lǐ Míng qù yuǎnfāng.
sentences.english: The merchant joked that if there were taxis in the future, he could drive Li Ming to a far-off place.

sentences.chinese: 虽然“出租车”和“短信”在那个时代不存在，但商人说这是他幻想中的未来。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán “chūzūchē” hé “duǎnxìn” zài nàge shídài bù cúnzài, dàn shāngrén shuō zhè shì tā huǎngxiǎng zhōng de wèilái.
sentences.english: Although "taxis" and "text messages" did not exist in that era, the merchant said these were in his fantasies of the future.

sentences.chinese: 他甚至模仿现代人接电话的样子，大声喊了一句：“喂！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shènzhì mófǎng xiàndài rén jiē diànhuà de yàngzi, dàshēng hǎn le yí jù: “Wéi!”
sentences.english: He even imitated the way modern people answer the phone, shouting loudly, "Hello!"

sentences.chinese: 这时，远处传来一声沉重的钟响，当，当，当。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yuǎnchù chuán lái yì shēng chénzhòng de zhōng xiǎng, dāng, dāng, dāng.
sentences.english: At this moment, a heavy bell rang from afar: dong, dong, dong.

sentences.chinese: 那是敌人再次靠近的警报。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì dírén zàicì kàojìn de jǐngbào.
sentences.english: That was the alarm that the enemy was approaching again.

sentences.chinese: 李明意识到，他必须在敌人发现之前，弄清楚这些数字的真正含义。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng yìshí dào, tā bìxū zài dírén fāxiàn zhīqián, nòng qīngchǔ zhèxiē shùzì de zhēnzhèng hányì.
sentences.english: Li Ming realized that he must figure out the true meaning of these numbers before the enemy discovered them.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十章：数字的真相与深夜的抉择
chapters.title_english: Chapter 20: The Truth of the Numbers and the Midnight Choice

sentences.chinese: 李明看着手中的数字，心中十分急。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kànzhe shǒuzhōng de shùzì, xīnzhōng shí fēn jí.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked at the numbers in his hand, feeling very urgent.

sentences.chinese: 他一直思考这些数字的含义，突然发现它们对应的是书院地图上的位置。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yī zhí sīkǎo zhèxiē shùzì de hányì, tūrán fāxiàn tāmen duìyìng de shì shūyuàn dìtú shàng de wèizhì.
sentences.english: He had been thinking about the meaning of these numbers continuously, and suddenly discovered they corresponded to locations on the academy map.

sentences.chinese: 这个发现非常准确，让他感到一种久违的快乐。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fāxiàn fēicháng zhǔn què, ràng tā gǎndào yī zhǒng jiǔ wéi de kuài lè.
sentences.english: This discovery was very accurate, giving him a long-lost sense of joy.

sentences.chinese: 商人看着他，笑着说：“你的反应不错。”
sentences.pinyin: Shāngrén kànzhe tā, xiàozhe shuō: “Nǐ de fǎnyìng bù cuò.”
sentences.english: The merchant looked at him and said with a smile, "Your reaction is not bad."

sentences.chinese: 此时，窗外的月光很亮，照在冰冷的地面上。
sentences.pinyin: Cǐshí, chuāngwài de yuèguāng hěn liàng, zhào zài bīnglěng de dìmiàn shàng.
sentences.english: At this moment, the moonlight outside the window was bright, shining on the cold ground.

sentences.chinese: 虽然夜晚很凉快，但李明的心里却很热。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán yèwǎn hěn liáng kuai, dàn Lǐ Míng de xīnlǐ què hěn rè.
sentences.english: Although the night was pleasantly cool, Li Ming's heart was burning.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，只有拿到全部的秘密，才能让全体书院的学生获得平等和公平的待遇。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, zhǐyǒu ná dào quán bù de mìmì, cáinéng ràng quán tǐ shūyuàn de xuéshēng huòdé píng děng hé gōng píng de dàiyù.
sentences.english: He realized that only by obtaining all the secrets could the entire student body of the academy receive equal and fair treatment.

sentences.chinese: 在这个世界上，并不是每个人都能成为好人，但李明希望自己能帮到大家。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège shìjiè shàng, bìng bú shì měi gèrén dōu néng chéngwéi hǎo rén, dàn Lǐ Míng xīwàng zìjǐ néng bāng dào dàjiā.
sentences.english: In this world, not everyone can be a good person, but Li Ming hoped he could help everyone.

sentences.chinese: 商人低声说：“拿到秘密确实有好处，但你必须保证绝对的安全。”
sentences.pinyin: Shāngrén dī shēng shuō: “Ná dào mìmì quèshí yǒu hǎo chǔ, dàn nǐ bìxū bǎozhèng juéduì de ān quán.”
sentences.english: The merchant whispered, "Getting the secrets indeed has benefits, but you must ensure absolute safety."

sentences.chinese: 李明点点头，他觉得现在的计划很合适。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng diǎn diǎntóu, tā juéde xiànzài de jìhuà hěn hé shì.
sentences.english: Li Ming nodded, feeling that the current plan was suitable.

sentences.chinese: 他完全相信这个商人，因为商人之前救过他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wán quán xiāngxìn zhège shāngrén, yīnwèi shāngrén zhīqián jiù guò tā.
sentences.english: He completely trusted this merchant because the merchant had saved him before.

sentences.chinese: 为了让大家健康地生活，他必须完成这个任务。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile ràng dàjiā jiàn kāng de shēnghuó, tā bìxū wánchéng zhège rènwu.
sentences.english: To let everyone live healthily, he had to complete this mission.

sentences.chinese: 他想起书院里那些可爱的孩子，他们应该在安静的环境中学习。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ shūyuàn lǐ nàxiē kě ài de háizi, tāmen yīnggāi zài ān jìng de huánjìng zhòng xuéxí.
sentences.english: He thought of the adorable children in the academy; they should study in a quiet environment.

sentences.chinese: “我想让他们生活在平安的世界里，”李明轻声说。
sentences.pinyin: “Wǒ xiǎng ràng tāmen shēnghuó zài píng ān de shìjiè lǐ,” Lǐ Míng qīng shēng shuō.
sentences.english: "I want them to live in a safe and sound world," Li Ming said softly.

sentences.chinese: 商人看着天上的星星，淡淡地说：“明天应该是晴天。”
sentences.pinyin: Shāngrén kànzhe tiān shàng de xīngxīng, dàndàn de shuō: “Míngtiān yīnggāi shì qíng tiān.”
sentences.english: The merchant looked at the stars in the sky and said calmly, "Tomorrow should be a clear day."

sentences.chinese: 李明感到十分开心，因为晴天方便他们行动。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng gǎndào shí fēn kāi xīn, yīnwèi qíng tiān fāngbiàn tāmen xíngdòng.
sentences.english: Li Ming felt very happy, because a clear day would make their movement convenient.

sentences.chinese: 在古代，想要快速传递消息并不便宜，但商人有自己的办法。
sentences.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, xiǎngyào kuàisù chuándì xiāoxi bìng bù biàn yí, dàn shāngrén yǒu zìjǐ de bànfǎ.
sentences.english: In ancient times, sending messages quickly was not cheap, but the merchant had his own ways.

sentences.chinese: 商人告诉他，只要能成功，结果就挺好。
sentences.pinyin: Shāngrén gàosù tā, zhǐyào néng chénggōng, jiéguǒ jiù tǐng hǎo.
sentences.english: The merchant told him that as long as they could succeed, the result would be very good.

sentences.chinese: 李明非常感谢商人的帮助，他深深地鞠了一躬。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng fēicháng gǎn xiè shāngrén de bāngzhù, tā shēn shēn de jūle yī gōng.
sentences.english: Li Ming was very grateful for the merchant's help and bowed deeply.

sentences.chinese: 商人拍拍他的肩膀说：“放心吧，我会帮你。”
sentences.pinyin: Shāngrén pāipāi tā de jiān bǎng shuō: “Fàng xīn ba, wǒ huì bāng nǐ.”
sentences.english: The merchant patted his shoulder and said, "Rest assured, I will help you."

sentences.chinese: 此时，远处的钟声再次响起，声音十分刚强。
sentences.pinyin: Cǐshí, yuǎn chù de zhōngshēng zàicì xiǎngqǐ, shēngyīn shí fēn gāng qiáng.
sentences.english: At this moment, the distant bell rang again, the sound very strong and firm.

sentences.chinese: 敌人已经走到了村口，情况变得十分紧迫。
sentences.pinyin: Dírén yǐjīng zǒu dào le cūn kǒu, qíngkuàng biàn de shí fēn jǐn pò.
sentences.english: The enemy had already reached the village entrance, and the situation had become very pressing.

sentences.chinese: 商人拿出一张小地图，指着一条小路说：“走这里，这里最安全。”
sentences.pinyin: Shāngrén ná chū yī zhāng xiǎo dìtú, zhǐzhe yī tiáo xiǎo lù shuō: “Zǒu zhèlǐ, zhèlǐ zuì ān quán.”
sentences.english: The merchant took out a small map and pointed to a path, saying, "Go this way, this is the safest."

sentences.chinese: 李明准备出发，商人对他低声说：“一路顺风，一路平安。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zhǔnbèi chūfā, shāngrén duì tā dī shēng shuō: “Yī lù shùn fēng, yī lù píng ān.”
sentences.english: As Li Ming prepared to set off, the merchant whispered to him, "Bon voyage, and may your journey be safe."

sentences.chinese: 李明笑了，他知道这次离开后，可能很久不能回来了。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xiàole, tā zhīdào zhè cì líkāi hòu, kěnéng hěn jiǔ bù néng huí lái le.
sentences.english: Li Ming smiled, knowing that after leaving this time, he might not be able to return for a long while.

sentences.chinese: 他回头看了看这个临时的小屋，轻声说了一句：“晚安。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā huítóu kànle kàn zhège línshí de xiǎo wū, qīng shēng shuōle yī jù: “Wǎn ān.”
sentences.english: He looked back at the temporary small hut and whispered, "Good night."

sentences.chinese: 他迅速跑进黑暗中，试图寻找那个准确的坐标点。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xùnsù pǎo jìn hēi'àn zhòng, shìtú xúnzhǎo nàge zhǔn què de zuòbiāo diǎn.
sentences.english: He quickly ran into the darkness, attempting to find that exact coordinate point.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，只要能把名单交给正确的人，一切都会好起来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhīdào, zhǐyào néng bǎ míngdān jiāo gěi zhèngquè de rén, yī qiè dōu huì hǎo qǐ lái.
sentences.english: He knew that as long as he could give the list to the right person, everything would improve.

sentences.chinese: 但就在他快要到达目的地时，一个熟悉的声音在身后响起。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài tā kuài yào dàodá mùdì dì shí, yī gè shú xī de shēngyīn zài shēnhòu xiǎngqǐ.
sentences.english: But just as he was about to reach the destination, a familiar voice sounded behind him.

sentences.chinese: “李明，你以为你真的能逃掉吗？”
sentences.pinyin: “Lǐ Míng, nǐ yǐwéi nǐ zhēn de néng táo diào ma?”
sentences.english: "Li Ming, do you really think you can escape?"

sentences.chinese: 李明猛地停住脚步，心跳加快。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng měng de tíng zhù jiǎobù, xīn tiào jiā kuài.
sentences.english: Li Ming stopped abruptly, his heart racing.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，对方竟然一直跟着他，而且就在他身后一步之遥。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, duìfāng jìng rán yī zhí gēnzhe tā, érqiě jiù zài tā shēnhòu yī bù zhī yáo.
sentences.english: He realized that the opponent had actually been following him all along, and was only a step away behind him.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十一章：古寺的真相
chapters.title_english: Chapter 21: The Truth of the Ancient Temple

sentences.chinese: 李明慢慢转过身，看到那个熟悉的人。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng màn màn zhuǎn guò shēn, kàn dào nà gè shú xī de rén.
sentences.english: Li Ming slowly turned around and saw that familiar person.

sentences.chinese: 对方看着他，脸上没有正常的表情。
sentences.pinyin: Duì fāng kàn zhe tā, liǎn shàng méi yǒu zhèng cháng de biǎo qíng.
sentences.english: The other person looked at him, and there was no normal expression on their face.

sentences.chinese: “把名单给我，你就能获得真正的自由。”对方直接说道。
sentences.pinyin: “Bǎ míng dān gěi wǒ, nǐ jiù néng huò dé zhēn zhèng de zì yóu.” Duì fāng zhí jiē shuō dào.
sentences.english: "Give me the list, and you will gain true freedom," the other person said directly.

sentences.chinese: 李明没有说话，他轻快地跳向一边，试图通过旁边的破墙逃跑。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng méi yǒu shuō huà, tā qīng kuài de tiào xiàng yī biān, shì tú tōng guò páng biān de pò qiáng táo pǎo.
sentences.english: Li Ming did not speak; he leaped lightly to the side, attempting to escape through a broken wall nearby.

sentences.chinese: 他跑进了一座古老的寺庙，靠在冰冷的石墙上大口喘气。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pǎo jìn le yī zuò gǔ lǎo de sì miào, kào zài bīng lěng de shí qiáng shàng dà kǒu chuǎn qì.
sentences.english: He ran into an ancient temple and leaned against the cold stone wall, panting heavily.

sentences.chinese: 这里很安静，空气让他觉得很舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ hěn ā jìng, kōng qì ràng tā jué dé hěn shū fu.
sentences.english: It was very quiet here, and the air made him feel comfortable.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一只小猫在墙边睡觉，样子很漂亮。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào yī zhǐ xiǎo māo zài qiáng biān shuì jiào, yàng zi hěn piào liang.
sentences.english: He saw a small cat sleeping by the wall, looking very beautiful.

sentences.chinese: 李明想起书院的日子，那时候的生活很正常，没有这么多危险。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xiǎng qǐ shū yuàn de rì zi, nà shí hou de shēng huó hěn zhèng cháng, méi yǒu zhè me duō wēi xiǎn.
sentences.english: Li Ming thought back to his days at the academy; life was normal then, without so many dangers.

sentences.chinese: 他打开怀里的秘密笔记，那是他唯一的希望。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dǎ kāi huái lǐ de mì mì bǐ jì, nà shì tā wéi yī de xī wàng.
sentences.english: He opened the secret notebook in his bosom; it was his only hope.

sentences.chinese: 笔记里有很多复杂的字，他需要一本词典才能读清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐ jì lǐ yǒu hěn duō fù zá de zì, tā xū yào yī běn cí diǎn cái néng dú qīng chu.
sentences.english: There were many complex characters in the notebook; he needed a dictionary to read them clearly.

sentences.chinese: 他思考了很久，终于找到了正确的答案。
sentences.pinyin: Tā sī kǎo le hěn jiǔ, zhōng yú zhǎo dào le zhèng què de dá àn.
sentences.english: He thought for a long time and finally found the correct answer.

sentences.chinese: 他发现这个秘密其实很有意思，它关乎国家的未来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn zhè gè mì mì qí shí hěn yǒu yì si, tā guān hū guó jiā de wèi lái.
sentences.english: He discovered that this secret was actually very interesting; it concerned the future of the nation.

sentences.chinese: 他希望有一天，天下的人都能永远生活在和平之中。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xī wàng yǒu yī tiān, tiān xià de rén dōu néng yǒng yuǎn shēng huó zài hé píng zhī zhōng.
sentences.english: He hoped that one day, all the people under heaven could live in peace forever.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个声音在后面响起，是一个热情的老僧人。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, yī gè shēng yīn zài hòu miàn xiǎng qǐ, shì yī gè rè qíng de lǎo sēng rén.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a voice sounded from behind; it was an enthusiastic old monk.

sentences.chinese: 老僧人说：“孩子，你饿了吗？先吃饱再说。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo sēng rén shuō: “Hái zi, nǐ è le ma? Xiān chī bǎo zài shuō.”
sentences.english: The old monk said, "Child, are you hungry? Eat your fill first."

sentences.chinese: 李明吃了一些简单的食物，感觉身体好多了。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng chī le yī xiē jiǎn dān de shí wù, gǎn jué shēn tǐ hǎo duō le.
sentences.english: Li Ming ate some simple food and felt much better physically.

sentences.chinese: 老僧人说话非常流利，而且很有智慧。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo sēng rén shuō huà fēi cháng liú lì, ér qiě hěn yǒu zhì huì.
sentences.english: The old monk spoke very fluently and was very wise.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉李明，想要顺利离开这里，必须等待一个晴天。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su Lǐ Míng, xiǎng yào shùn lì lí kāi zhè lǐ, bì xū děng dài yī gè qíng tiān.
sentences.english: He told Li Ming that in order to leave this place smoothly, he must wait for a sunny day.

sentences.chinese: 因为只有在晴天，山上的小路才会干燥，才能走得快。
sentences.pinyin: Yīn wèi zhǐ yǒu zài qíng tiān, shān shàng de xiǎo lù cái huì gān zào, cái néng zǒu dé kuài.
sentences.english: Because only on a sunny day would the mountain paths be dry, allowing him to walk quickly.

sentences.chinese: 李明对老僧人的帮助感到很满意。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng duì lǎo sēng rén de bāng zhù gǎn dào hěn mǎn yì.
sentences.english: Li Ming felt very satisfied with the old monk's help.

sentences.chinese: 虽然路还很长，但他的心情变得轻松了。
sentences.pinyin: Suī rán lù hái hěn cháng, dàn tā de xīn qíng biàn dé qīng sōng le.
sentences.english: Although the road was still long, his mood became lighter.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，寺庙的大门突然被猛地推开，一群士兵冲了进来。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, sì miào de dà mén tū rán bèi měng de tuī kāi, yī qún shì bīng chōng le jìn lái.
sentences.english: Just then, the temple's main gate was suddenly pushed open violently, and a group of soldiers rushed in.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十二章：暴雨前的阴影

sentences.chinese: 士兵们大声地喊叫，声音在古寺的墙壁间回荡。
sentences.pinyin: Shì bīng men dà shēng de hǎn jiào, shēng yīn zài gǔ sì de qiáng bì jiān huí dàng.
sentences.english: The soldiers shouted loudly, their voices echoing between the walls of the ancient temple.

sentences.chinese: 李明惊呆了，他没有想到敌人会这么快找到这里。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng jīng dāi le, tā méi yǒu xiǎng dào dí rén huì zhè me kuài zhǎo dào zhè lǐ.
sentences.english: Li Ming was stunned; he had not expected the enemy to find this place so quickly.

sentences.chinese: 老僧人迅速地给李明披上一件厚厚的大衣。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo sēng rén xùn sù de gěi Lǐ Míng pī shàng yī jiàn hòu hòu de dà yī.
sentences.english: The old monk quickly draped a thick overcoat over Li Ming.

sentences.chinese: 老僧人低声云：“快走，从后门走，那里有熟人可以帮你。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo sēng rén dī shēng yún: “Kuài zǒu, cóng hòu mén zǒu, nà lǐ yǒu shú rén kě yǐ bāng nǐ.”
sentences.english: The old monk whispered: "Go quickly, leave through the back door, there are acquaintances there who can help you."

sentences.chinese: 李明知道，现在的日子变得非常危险。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zhī dào, xiàn zài de rì zi biàn de fēi cháng wēi xiǎn.
sentences.english: Li Ming knew that his days had become very dangerous.

sentences.chinese: 他穿过狭窄的走廊，看到大部分士兵都在大门口聚集。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chuān guò xiá zhǎi de zǒu láng, kàn dào dà bù fen shì bīng dōu zài dà mén kǒu jù jí.
sentences.english: He walked through the narrow corridor and saw that the majority of the soldiers were gathering at the main gate.

sentences.chinese: 在这种普通的情况下，他或许能逃掉，但对方的人数太多了。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè zhǒng pǔ tōng de qíng kuàng xià, tā huò xǔ néng táo diào, dàn duì fāng de rén shù tài duō le.
sentences.english: In an ordinary situation like this, he might have been able to escape, but the opposing number of people was too great.

sentences.chinese: 士兵们的习惯是先封锁出口，再搜查房间。
sentences.pinyin: Shì bīng men de xí guàn shì xiān fēng suǒ chū kǒu, zài sōu chá fáng jiān.
sentences.english: It was the soldiers' habit to seal the exits first and then search the rooms.

sentences.chinese: 李明在半夜的黑暗中奔跑，只能看到天上几颗微弱的星星。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zài bàn yè de hēi àn zhōng bēn pǎo, zhǐ néng kàn dào tiān shàng jǐ kē wēi ruò de xīng xing.
sentences.english: Li Ming ran in the midnight darkness, able to see only a few faint stars in the sky.

sentences.chinese: 他想起在南方生活的时候，天气总是多云，不像这里这么寒冷。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ zài nán fāng shēng huó de shí hou, tiān qì zǒng shì duō yún, bù xiàng zhè lǐ zhè me hán lěng.
sentences.english: He remembered when he lived in the South, the weather was always cloudy, not as cold as here.

sentences.chinese: 他现在必须做出主要的选择：是继续逃亡，还是面对敌人？
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàn zài bì xū zuò chū zhǔ yào de xuǎn zé: shì jì xù táo wáng, hái shì miàn duì dí rén?
sentences.english: He now had to make a major choice: to continue fleeing or to face the enemy?

sentences.chinese: 在逃亡的路上，他遇到了一个中年男人，对方是一位中医。
sentences.pinyin: Zài táo wáng de lù shàng, tā yù dào le yī gè zhōng nián nán rén, duì fāng shì yī wèi zhōng yī.
sentences.english: On the road of escape, he met a middle-aged man who was a practitioner of traditional Chinese medicine.

sentences.chinese: 这位中医告诉他，全国现在有很多地方都在流行一种奇怪的病。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi zhōng yī gào su tā, quán guó xiàn zài yǒu hěn duō dì fāng dōu zài liú xíng yī zhǒng qí guài de bìng.
sentences.english: This doctor told him that in many places across the whole nation, a strange disease was spreading.

sentences.chinese: 这种病导致大量的人失去了意识，这大大地影响了国家的稳定。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng bìng dǎo zhì dà liàng de rén shī qù le yì shí, zhè dà dà de yǐng xiǎng le guó jiā de wěn dìng.
sentences.english: This disease caused a large quantity of people to lose consciousness, which greatly affected the stability of the country.

sentences.chinese: 中医说，大多数人认为这是天灾，但实际上是有人在投毒。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōng yī shuō, dà duō shù rén rèn wéi zhè shì tiān zāi, dàn shí jì shàng shì yǒu rén zài tóu dú.
sentences.english: The doctor said that the majority of people thought it was a natural disaster, but in reality, someone was poisoning them.

sentences.chinese: 大多数士兵其实并不想打仗，他们只是普通的人。
sentences.pinyin: Dà duō shù shì bīng qí shí bìng bù xiǎng dǎ zhàng, tā men zhǐ shì pǔ tōng de rén.
sentences.english: The great majority of soldiers did not actually want to fight; they were just ordinary people.

sentences.chinese: 李明发现，这个中医说的是普通话，这在当时是很常见的。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng fā xiàn, zhè gè zhōng yī shuō de shì pǔ tōng huà, zhè zài dāng shí shì hěn cháng jiàn de.
sentences.english: Li Ming found that this doctor spoke Mandarin, which was very common at that time.

sentences.chinese: 他们来到一个小屋子，中医为他准备了一顿简单的中餐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men lái dào yī gè xiǎo wū zi, zhōng yī wèi tā zhǔn bèi le yī dùn jiǎn dān de zhōng cān.
sentences.english: They arrived at a small hut, and the doctor prepared a simple Chinese meal for him.

sentences.chinese: 虽然只是平常的饭菜，但李明觉得这顿饭足够让他恢复体力。
sentences.pinyin: Suī rán zhǐ shì píng cháng de fàn cài, dàn Lǐ Míng jué de zhè dùn fàn gòu ràng tā huī fù tǐ lì.
sentences.english: Although it was just ordinary food, Li Ming felt this meal was enough to restore his strength.

sentences.chinese: 中医告诉他，在很多地方，这种简单的药方是常用的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōng yī gào su tā, zài hěn duō dì fāng, zhè zhǒng jiǎn dān de yào fāng shì cháng yòng de.
sentences.english: The doctor told him that in many places, this simple prescription was in common usage.

sentences.chinese: 他给李明看了很多药草，这些药草在山林中很常见。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gěi Lǐ Míng kàn le hěn duō yào cǎo, zhè xiē yào cǎo zài shān lín zhōng hěn cháng jiàn.
sentences.english: He showed Li Ming many medicinal herbs, which were commonly seen in the mountains and forests.

sentences.chinese: 中医说：“如果你能走到山那边，你的机会会更多。”
sentences.pinyin: Zhōng yī shuō: “Rú guǒ nǐ néng zǒu dào shān nà biān, nǐ de jī huì huì gèng duō.”
sentences.english: The doctor said: "If you can get to the other side of the mountain, your opportunities will be greater."

sentences.chinese: 李明在屋子里休息，听着外面的风声，心中充满了不安。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zài wū zi lǐ xiū xi, tīng zhe wài miàn de fēng shēng, xīn zhōng chōng mǎn le bù ān.
sentences.english: Li Ming rested in the hut, listening to the wind outside, his heart filled with anxiety.

sentences.chinese: 他想起以前在书院时，早晨总是安静的，现在却充满了杀气。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ yǐ qián zài shū yuàn shí, zǎo chén zǒng shì ān jìng de, xiàn zài què chōng mǎn le shā qì.
sentences.english: He remembered that back at the academy, the early mornings were always quiet, but now they were filled with murderous intent.

sentences.chinese: 他看到桌上有一份像晚报一样的告示，上面写着通缉令。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào zhuō shàng yǒu yī fèn xiàng wǎn bào yī yàng de gào shì, shàng miàn xiě zhe tōng jī lìng.
sentences.english: He saw a notice on the table that looked like an evening newspaper, with a wanted poster on it.

sentences.chinese: 告示上说，任何提供线索的人将获得一百两银子以上的高额奖励。
sentences.pinyin: Gào shì shàng shuō, rèn hé tí gōng xiàn suǒ de rén jiāng huò dé yī bǎi liǎng yín zi yǐ shàng de gāo é jiǎng lì.
sentences.english: The notice stated that anyone providing clues would receive a high reward of one hundred taels of silver or more.

sentences.chinese: 好多人为了钱，变成了敌人的眼睛。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎo duō rén wèi le qián, biàn chéng le dí rén de yǎn jīng.
sentences.english: Quite a lot of people, for the sake of money, became the eyes of the enemy.

sentences.chinese: 此时，夜晚已经进入了三更，时间紧迫。
sentences.pinyin: Cǐ shí, yè wǎn yǐ jīng jìn rù le sān gēng, shí jiān jǐn pò.
sentences.english: At this time, the night had already entered the third watch, and time was pressing.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，自己的行踪已经不再是秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, zì jǐ de xíng zōng yǐ jīng bù zài shì mì mì.
sentences.english: He realized that his whereabouts were no longer a secret.

sentences.chinese: 他必须在明天太阳升起前，离开这个危险的小村庄。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì xū zài míng tiān tài yáng shēng qǐ qián, lí kāi zhè gè wēi xiǎn de xiǎo cūn zhuāng.
sentences.english: He had to leave this dangerous small village before the sun rose tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 就在他准备出门时，门外突然传来了急促的马蹄声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tā zhǔn bèi chū mén shí, mén wài tū rán chuán lái le jí cù de mǎ tí shēng.
sentences.english: Just as he was preparing to go out, the sound of urgent horse hooves suddenly came from outside.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十三章：西方的密使
chapters.title_english: Chapter 23: The Secret Envoy from the West

sentences.chinese: 马蹄声在门前响起，李明的心跳得特别快。
sentences.pinyin: mǎ tí shēng zài mén qián xiǎng qǐ, lǐ míng de xīn tiào de tè bié kuài.
sentences.english: The sound of horse hooves rang out in front of the door, and Li Ming's heart beat particularly fast.

sentences.chinese: 他迅速躲在门后，看到一个穿着红色长袍的男人。
sentences.pinyin: tā xùn sù duǒ zài mén hòu, kàn dào yí gè chuān zhe hóng sè cháng páo de nán rén.
sentences.english: He quickly hid behind the door and saw a man wearing a red robe.

sentences.chinese: 这个男人手里拿着一篇古老的文书，上面写着秘密的指令。
sentences.pinyin: zhè gè nán rén shǒu lǐ ná zhe yì piān gǔ lǎo de wén shū, shàng miàn xiě zhe mì mì de zhǐ lìng.
sentences.english: This man held a piece of ancient document in his hand, which contained secret instructions.

sentences.chinese: 李明记得，在过去，这种红色长袍通常代表着极高的地位。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ míng jì dé, zài guò qù, zhè zhǒng hóng sè cháng páo tōng cháng dài biǎo zhe jí gāo de dì wèi.
sentences.english: Li Ming remembered that in the past, such red robes usually represented a very high status.

sentences.chinese: 男人并没有进入村庄，而是停在了一个黄色的旧车旁。
sentences.pinyin: nán rén bìng méi yǒu jìn rù cūn zhuāng, ér shì tíng zài le yí gè huáng sè de jiù chē páng.
sentences.english: The man did not enter the village but stopped beside an old yellow cart.

sentences.chinese: 车上放着许多奇怪的东西，其中有一个黑色的金属盒子。
sentences.pinyin: chē shàng fàng zhe xǔ duō qí guài de dōng xi, qí zhōng yǒu yí gè hēi sè de jīn shǔ hé zi.
sentences.english: Many strange things were placed on the cart, including a black metal box.

sentences.chinese: 李明好奇地看着，那竟然是一个西方的相机，可以记录下眼前的景象。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ míng hào qí de kàn zhe, nà jìng rán shì yí gè xī fāng de xiàng jī, kě yǐ jì lù xià yǎn qián de jǐng xiàng.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked curiously; it was actually a camera from the West, capable of recording the scene before them.

sentences.chinese: 在这个时代，这种东西非常罕见，像是一种魔法。
sentences.pinyin: zài zhè gè shí dài, zhè zhǒng dōng xi fēi cháng hán jiàn, xiàng shì yì zhǒng mó fǎ.
sentences.english: In this era, such a thing was very rare, like a kind of magic.

sentences.chinese: 男人身边跟着一个西医，他穿着白色的衣服，眼神很冷。
sentences.pinyin: nán rén shēn biān gēn zhe yí gè xī yī, tā chuān zhe bái sè de yī fu, yǎn shén hěn lěng.
sentences.english: Following the man was a Western doctor, dressed in white clothes with a cold gaze.

sentences.chinese: 他们正在讨论怎样才能在不惊动士兵的情况下，把名单送到越国。
sentences.pinyin: tā men zhèng zài tǎo lùn zěn yàng cái néng zài bù jīng dòng shì bīng de qíng kuàng xià, bǎ míng dān sòng dào yuè guó.
sentences.english: They were discussing how to send the list to the Yue state without alerting the soldiers.

sentences.chinese: 西医低声说，他们已经在这里等了十分钟，时间不多了。
sentences.pinyin: xī yī dī shēng shuō, tā men yǐ jīng zài zhè lǐ děng le shí fēn zhōng, shí jiān bù duō le.
sentences.english: The Western doctor whispered that they had been waiting here for ten minutes and time was running out.

sentences.chinese: 他看着天空，今天是个阴天，光线很暗，适合行动。
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn zhe tiān kōng, jīn tiān shì gè yīn tiān, guāng xiàn hěn àn, shì hé xíng dòng.
sentences.english: He looked at the sky; today was a cloudy day, the light was dim, and it was suitable for action.

sentences.chinese: 突然，那个男人的马卡在了泥地里，无法前进。
sentences.pinyin: tū rán, nà gè nán rén de mǎ kǎ zài le ní dì lǐ, wú fǎ qián jìn.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the man's horse got stuck in the mud and could not move forward.

sentences.chinese: 男人愤怒地大喊，声音很大，打破了夜晚的安静。
sentences.pinyin: nán rén fèn nù de dà hǎn, shēng yīn hěn dà, dǎ pò le yè wǎn de ānjìng.
sentences.english: The man shouted angrily, his voice loud, breaking the silence of the night.

sentences.chinese: 李明在门后紧张地观察，他知道如果被发现，后果将非常严重。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ míng zài mén hòu jǐn zhāng de guān chá, tā zhī dào rú guǒ bèi fā xiàn, hòu guǒ jiāng fēi cháng yán zhòng.
sentences.english: Li Ming observed nervously from behind the door, knowing that the consequences would be severe if he were discovered.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个老年人慢慢走到了他们面前。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí, yí gè lǎo nián rén màn màn zǒu dào le tā men miàn qián.
sentences.english: At this moment, an elderly man slowly walked up in front of them.

sentences.chinese: 那个老人是李明的老朋友，他经常帮李明传递消息。
sentences.pinyin: nà gè lǎo rén shì lǐ míng de lǎo péng you, tā jīng cháng bāng lǐ míng chuán dì xiāo xī.
sentences.english: That old man was an old friend of Li Ming, who frequently helped Li Ming pass messages.

sentences.chinese: 老人笑着说：“你们在找那个书生吗？他带了几个公斤重的金子。”
sentences.pinyin: lǎo rén xiào zhe shuō: “nǐ men zài zhǎo nà gè shū shēng ma? tā dài le jǐ gè gōng jīn zhòng de jīn zi.”
sentences.english: The old man smiled and said, "Are you looking for that scholar? He is carrying several kilograms of gold."

sentences.chinese: 男人听到“金子”两个字，眼睛突然亮了。
sentences.pinyin: nán rén tīng dào “jīn zi” liǎng gè zì, yǎn jīng tū rán liàng le.
sentences.english: Upon hearing the words "gold," the man's eyes suddenly lit up.

sentences.chinese: 他问老人，那个书生的名字读音是怎样的。
sentences.pinyin: tā wèn lǎo rén, nà gè shū shēng de míng zi dú yīn shì zěn yàng de.
sentences.english: He asked the old man what the pronunciation of the scholar's name was.

sentences.chinese: 老人回答道：“他叫李明，一个很聪明的人。”
sentences.pinyin: lǎo rén huí dá dào: “tā jiào lǐ míng, yí gè hěn cōng míng de rén.”
sentences.english: The old man replied, "His name is Li Ming, a very clever man."

sentences.chinese: 男人冷笑一声说：“那么，带我去见他！”
sentences.pinyin: nán rén lěng xiào yì shēng shuō: “nà me, dài wǒ qù jiàn tā!”
sentences.english: The man sneered and said, "In that case, take me to see him!"

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十四章：危机的陷阱

sentences.chinese: 老人带着男人往村子深处走去。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén dàizhe nánrén wǎng cūnzi shēnchù zǒu qù.
sentences.english: The old man led the man towards the depths of the village.

sentences.chinese: 李明躲在墙后，心里非常担心。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng duǒ zài qiáng hòu, xīnlǐ fēicháng dānxīn.
sentences.english: Li Ming hid behind the wall, feeling very worried.

sentences.chinese: 他想到如果被抓到，他的计划就无法实现了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngdào rúguǒ bèi zhuā dào, tā de jìhuà jiù wúfǎ shíxiàn le.
sentences.english: He thought that if he were caught, his plan could not be realized.

sentences.chinese: 这里的交通很不方便，只有一条小路连接着山外。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de jiāotōng hěn bù fāngbiàn, zhǐyǒu yītiáo xiǎolù liánjiē zhe shān wài.
sentences.english: The transportation here was very inconvenient, with only one small path connecting to the outside of the mountains.

sentences.chinese: 李明记得，他必须小心地观察敌人的行动。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng jìde, tā bìxū xiǎoxīn de guānchá dírén de xíngdòng.
sentences.english: Li Ming remembered that he must carefully observe the enemy's movements.

sentences.chinese: 他看到那个男人姓王，是一个贪财的将领。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào nàge nánrén xìng Wáng, shì yīgè tāncái de jiànglǐng.
sentences.english: He saw that the man's surname was Wang, a greedy general.

sentences.chinese: 王将领在寻找金子，而老人却在为他设陷阱。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng jiànglǐng zài xúnzhǎo jīnzi, ér lǎorén què zài wéi tā shè xiànjǐng.
sentences.english: General Wang was searching for gold, while the old man was setting a trap for him.

sentences.chinese: 老人告诉王将领，李明曾经在书院写过一篇出色的作文。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén gàosù Wáng jiànglǐng, Lǐ Míng céngjīng zài shūyuàn xiěguò yī piān chū sè de zuòwén.
sentences.english: The old man told General Wang that Li Ming had once written an excellent essay at the academy.

sentences.chinese: 那篇作文里提到了一个古老的宝藏，起到了引导的作用。
sentences.pinyin: Nà piān zuòwén lǐ tí dào le yīgè gǔlǎo de bǎozàng, qǐ dào le yǐndǎo de zuòyòng.
sentences.english: That essay mentioned an ancient treasure, which served as a guide.

sentences.chinese: 王将领并不关心文学，他只想知道金子在哪里。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng jiànglǐng bìng bù guānxīn wénxué, tā zhǐ xiǎng zhīdào jīnzi zài nǎlǐ.
sentences.english: General Wang did not care about literature; he only wanted to know where the gold was.

sentences.chinese: 他命令士兵们在村子里寻找，不能让任何人影响他的计划。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mìnglìng shìbīngmen zài cūnzi lǐ xúnzhǎo, bùnéng ràng rènhé rén yǐngxiǎng tā de jìhuà.
sentences.english: He ordered the soldiers to search the village, and no one was allowed to influence his plan.

sentences.chinese: 李明发现，士兵们开始在村子里的每一个房间参观。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng fāxiàn, shìbīngmen kāishǐ zài cūnzi lǐ de měi yīgè fángjiān cānguān.
sentences.english: Li Ming noticed that the soldiers began to visit every room in the village.

sentences.chinese: 他们像疯了一样地翻找所有东西。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xiàng fēng le yīyàng de fānzhǎo suǒyǒu dōngxi.
sentences.english: They searched through everything like madmen.

sentences.chinese: 李明意识到，他不能在这里等待，必须快点办好离开的事情。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng yìshí dào, tā bùnéng zài zhèlǐ děngdài, bìxū kuàidiǎn bàn hǎo líkāi de shìqíng.
sentences.english: Li Ming realized he could not wait here and had to quickly handle the matter of leaving.

sentences.chinese: 他想起以前在书院实习的时候，老师教过他如何掩盖行踪。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ yǐqián zài shūyuàn shíxí de shíhòu, lǎoshī jiāoguò tā rúhé yǎngài xíngzōng.
sentences.english: He remembered when he was interning at the academy, his teacher taught him how to cover his tracks.

sentences.chinese: 他努力地在脑海中复习那些逃生的技巧。
sentences.pinyin: Tā nǔlì de zài nǎohǎi zhōng fùxí nàxiē táoshēng de jìqiǎo.
sentences.english: He strove to review those escape techniques in his mind.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，只要能完成这次逃脱，他就赢了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhīdào, zhǐyào néng wánchéng zhè cì táotuō, tā jiù yíng le.
sentences.english: He knew that as long as he could complete this escape, he would win.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个奇怪的广告出现在村口的告示牌上。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yīgè qíguài de guǎnggào chūxiàn zài cūn kǒu de gàoshìpái shàng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a strange advertisement appeared on the notice board at the village entrance.

sentences.chinese: 那是老人的主意，为了吸引敌人的注意力。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì lǎorén de zhǔyì, wèile xīyǐn dírén de zhùyìlì.
sentences.english: It was the old man's idea, to attract the enemy's attention.

sentences.chinese: 广告上写着：西方有更强大的金矿。
sentences.pinyin: Guǎnggào shàng xiě zhe: Xīfāng yǒu gèng qiángdà de jīinkuàng.
sentences.english: The advertisement read: There are larger gold mines in the West.

sentences.chinese: 王将领看到后，眼神变了。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng jiànglǐng kàndào hòu, yǎnshén biàn le.
sentences.english: After General Wang saw it, his expression changed.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这里可能没有金子，而变成了浪费时间的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde zhèlǐ kěnéng méiyǒu jīnzi, ér biànchéng le làngfèi shíjiān de dìfāng.
sentences.english: He felt that there might be no gold here, and it had become a place of wasting time.

sentences.chinese: 但老人低声说：“你应该先在村里做完这件事。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàn lǎorén dīshēng shuō: “Nǐ yīnggāi xiān zài cūn lǐ zuò wán zhè jiàn shì.”
sentences.english: But the old man whispered, "You should finish this matter in the village first."

sentences.chinese: 王将领不耐烦地看着老人，认为他是在帮助李明。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng jiànglǐng bùnàifán de kànzhe lǎorén, rènwéi tā zài bāngzhù Lǐ Míng.
sentences.english: General Wang looked at the old man impatiently, believing he was helping Li Ming.

sentences.chinese: 李明在阴影中看着他们，他想知道老人能否做到让敌人离开。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zài yīnyǐng zhōng kànzhe tāmen, tā xiǎng zhīdào lǎorén néngfǒu zuòdào ràng dírén líkāi.
sentences.english: Li Ming watched them from the shadows, wondering if the old man could achieve making the enemy leave.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一名士兵在厨房发现有人在做饭，大声喊了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, yī míng shìbīng zài chúfáng fāxiàn yǒurén zài zuòfàn, dàshēng hǎn le qǐlái.
sentences.english: At that moment, a soldier discovered someone cooking in the kitchen and shouted loudly.

sentences.chinese: 混乱中，李明决定参加这次混乱，寻找机会逃走。
sentences.pinyin: Hùnluàn zhōng, Lǐ Míng juédìng cānjiā zhè cì hùnluàn, xúnzhǎo jīhuì táozǒu.
sentences.english: In the chaos, Li Ming decided to participate in the turmoil to find a chance to escape.

sentences.chinese: 他必须使用所有的智慧来应对这个局面。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū shǐyòng suǒyǒu de zhìhuì lái yìngduì zhège júmiàn.
sentences.english: He must use all his wisdom to deal with this situation.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，自己的身份已经变成了敌人的目标。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, zìjǐ de shēnfèn yǐjīng biànchéng le dírén de mùbiāo.
sentences.english: He realized that his identity had become the enemy's target.

sentences.chinese: 他就要离开这个村庄，去寻找真正的答案。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiùyào líkāi zhège cūnzhāng, qù xúnzhǎo zhēnzhèng de dá'àn.
sentences.english: He was about to leave this village to find the true answer.

sentences.chinese: 但就在他准备跑向森林时，王将领突然回头看了他一眼。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài tā zhǔnbèi pǎo xiàng sēnlín shí, Wáng jiànglǐng tūrán huítóu kàn le tā yīyǎn.
sentences.english: But just as he was preparing to run toward the forest, General Wang suddenly looked back at him.

sentences.chinese: 王将领冷冷地笑了，仿佛早就知道他在那里。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng jiànglǐng lěnglěng de xiào le, fǎngfú zǎojiù zhīdào tā zài nàlǐ.
sentences.english: General Wang smiled coldly, as if he had known he was there all along.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十五章：森林中的博弈
chapters.title_english: Chapter 25: The Gambit in the Forest

sentences.chinese: 王将领的目光像冰一样冷，李明感到心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng jiànglǐng de mùguāng xiàng bīng yīyàng lěng, Lǐ Míng gǎndào xīntiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: General Wang's gaze was as cold as ice, and Li Ming felt his heart beating rapidly.

sentences.chinese: 他想起书院老师曾经的教育，说面对敌人要冷静。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ shūyuàn lǎoshī céngjīng de jiàoyù, shuō miànduì dírén yào lěngjìng.
sentences.english: He recalled the education from his academy teacher, who said one must remain calm when facing enemies.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，如果现在逃跑，行动一定会失败。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhīdào, rúguǒ xiànzài táopǎo, xíngdòng yīdìng huì shībài.
sentences.english: He knew that if he fled now, the action would certainly fail.

sentences.chinese: 王将领走近他，仔细检查他的衣服和随身的东西。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng jiànglǐng zǒujìn tā, zǐxì jiǎnchá tā de yīfú hé suíshēn de dōngxī.
sentences.english: General Wang approached him and carefully inspected his clothes and personal belongings.

sentences.chinese: “你打算去哪里？”王将领冷冷地问。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ dǎsuàn qù nǎlǐ?” Wáng jiànglǐng lěng lěng de wèn.
sentences.english: "Where do you plan to go?" General Wang asked coldly.

sentences.chinese: 李明低下头，假装害怕，心中却在思考如何找出逃生的机会。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng dīxià tóu, jiǎzhuāng hàipà, xīnzhōng què zài sīkǎo rúhé zhǎochū táoshēng de jīhuì.
sentences.english: Li Ming lowered his head, pretending to be afraid, while secretly thinking about how to find a chance to escape.

sentences.chinese: 他提到自己只是一个想过平静生活的书生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tí dào zìjǐ zhǐshì yīgè xiǎng guò píngjìng shēnghuó de shūshēng.
sentences.english: He mentioned that he was merely a scholar who wanted to live a peaceful life.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“我愿意为您服务，只要您能照顾我的家人。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ yuànyì wèi nín fúwù, zhǐyào nín néng zhàogù wǒ de jiārén.”
sentences.english: He said, "I am willing to serve you, as long as you can take care of my family."

sentences.chinese: 王将领笑了，他并不相信李明的话。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng jiànglǐng xiàole, tā bìng bù xiāngxìn Lǐ Míng de huà.
sentences.english: General Wang laughed; he did not believe Li Ming's words.

sentences.chinese: 在他看来，李明现在已经成为了一个危险的人物。
sentences.pinyin: Zài tā kàn lái, Lǐ Míng xiànzài yǐjīng chéngwéi le yīgè wēixiǎn de rénwù.
sentences.english: In his view, Li Ming had now become a dangerous figure.

sentences.chinese: 在这种情况下，说谎等于是在玩火。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng xià, shuōhuǎng děngyú shì zài wánhuǒ.
sentences.english: In this situation, lying was tantamount to playing with fire.

sentences.chinese: 但李明懂得如何利用敌人的骄傲。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn Lǐ Míng dǒngde rúhé lìyòng dírén de jiāo'ào.
sentences.english: But Li Ming understood how to exploit the enemy's pride.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉王将领，他能帮将领提高军队的组织能力。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Wáng jiànglǐng, tā néng bāng jiànglǐng tígāo jūnduì de zǔzhī nénglì.
sentences.english: He told General Wang that he could help the general improve the army's organizational capabilities.

sentences.chinese: 他解释说，一个强大的军队是由所有优秀的士兵组成。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiěshì shuō, yīgè qiángdà de jūnduì shì yóu suǒyǒu yōuxiù de shìbīng zǔchéng.
sentences.english: He explained that a strong army is composed of all excellent soldiers.

sentences.chinese: 他建议将领改变目前的训练方法，改用更聪明的方式。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiànyì jiànglǐng gǎibiàn mùqián de xùnliàn fāngfǎ, gǎi yòng gèng cōngmíng de fāngshì.
sentences.english: He suggested the general change the current training methods and alter them to a smarter way.

sentences.chinese: 他建议士兵们不要只练体力，还要练习思考。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiànyì shìbīngmen bùyào zhǐ liàn tǐlì, hái yào liànxí sīkǎo.
sentences.english: He suggested that soldiers should not only train their physical strength but also practice thinking.

sentences.chinese: 王将领对这个想法很感兴趣，因为他不懂书生的道理。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng jiànglǐng duì zhège xiǎngfǎ hěn gǎn xìngqù, yīnwèi tā bù dǒng shūshēng de dàolǐ.
sentences.english: General Wang was very interested in this idea because he did not understand the reasoning of scholars.

sentences.chinese: 他问李明，这种方法是否方便在军队中实施。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn Lǐ Míng, zhè zhǒng fāngfǎ shìfǒu fāngbiàn zài jūnduì zhōng shíshī.
sentences.english: He asked Li Ming whether this method was convenient to implement within the army.

sentences.chinese: 李明数了数周围的士兵，心中计算着距离。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng shǔle shǔ zhōuwéi de shìbīng, xīnzhōng jìsuànzhe jùlí.
sentences.english: Li Ming counted the soldiers around him, calculating the distance in his mind.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，只要能让王将领觉得他有用，就算赢了一半。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhīdào, zhǐyào néng ràng Wáng jiànglǐng juéde tā yǒuyòng, jiù suàn yíngle yībàn.
sentences.english: He knew that as long as he could make General Wang feel he was useful, it would count as winning half the battle.

sentences.chinese: 他请求王将领给他一点时间，让他向将领证明他的能力。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qiú Wáng jiànglǐng gěi tā yīdiǎn shíjiān, ràng tā xiàng jiànglǐng zhèngmíng tā de nénglì.
sentences.english: He requested that General Wang give him some time to prove his abilities to the general.

sentences.chinese: 经过一段时间的交谈，王将领决定暂时不抓他。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò yīduàn shíjiān de jiāotán, Wáng jiànglǐng juédìng zànshí bù zhuā tā.
sentences.english: After a period of conversation, General Wang decided not to capture him for the time being.

sentences.chinese: 李明意识到，只要能改变对方的想法，他就能够生存。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng yìshí dào, zhǐyào néng gǎibiàn duìfāng de xiǎngfǎ, tā jiù nénggòu shēngcún.
sentences.english: Li Ming realized that as long as he could change the other party's mind, he would be able to survive.

sentences.chinese: 在这种紧张的生活中，每一秒都像是一场战斗。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè zhǒng jǐnzhāng de shēnghuó zhōng, měi yī miǎo dōu xiàng shì yī chǎng zhàndòu.
sentences.english: In this tense life, every second felt like a battle.

sentences.chinese: 他必须在心中练习每一句话，确保语气称心如意。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū zài xīnzhōng liànxí měi yī jù huà, quèbǎo yǔqì chèn xīn rú yì.
sentences.english: He had to practice every sentence in his mind to ensure the tone was fitting and satisfactory.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，现在的平静只是暂时的，真正的行动还没开始。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhīdào, xiànzài de píngjìng zhǐshì zànshí de, zhēnzhèng de xíngdòng hái méi kāishǐ.
sentences.english: He knew the current peace was only temporary; the real operation had not yet begun.

sentences.chinese: 他必须在最短的时间内，找出那个秘密名单的真正去向。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū zài zuìduǎn de shíjiān nèi, zhǎochū nàgè mìmì míngdān de zhēnzhèng qùxiàng.
sentences.english: He had to find the true destination of that secret list in the shortest time possible.

sentences.chinese: 王将领看着他，眼神中依然有怀疑。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng jiànglǐng kànzhe tā, yǎnshén zhōng yīrán yǒu huáiyí.
sentences.english: General Wang looked at him, suspicion still remaining in his eyes.

sentences.chinese: “如果你不能让我满意，你的生命就到此为止。”
sentences.pinyin: “Rúguǒ nǐ bùnéng ràng wǒ mǎnyì, nǐ de shēngmìng jiù dào cǐ wéi zhǐ.”
sentences.english: "If you cannot satisfy me, your life ends here."

sentences.chinese: 李明点头，心中却在计划如何逃离这个陷阱。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng diǎntóu, xīnzhōng què zài jìhuà rúhé táolí zhège xiànjǐng.
sentences.english: Li Ming nodded, but in his heart, he was planning how to escape this trap.

sentences.chinese: 他看着森林的深处，那里有他唯一的希望。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe sēnlín de shēnchù, nàlǐ yǒu tā wéiyī de xīwàng.
sentences.english: He looked into the depths of the forest, where his only hope lay.

sentences.chinese: 突然，远方传来了急促的号角声，打破了森林的安静。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yuǎnfāng chuánláile jícù de hàojiǎo shēng, dǎpòle sēnlín de ānjìng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the sound of an urgent horn echoed from afar, breaking the silence of the forest.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十六章：最后的博弈

sentences.chinese: 号角声越来越近，王将领认为敌人已经到了。
sentences.pinyin: Hàojiǎo shēng yuè lái yuè jìn, Wáng jiànglǐng rènwéi dírén yǐjīng dàole.
sentences.english: The horn sounded closer and closer, and General Wang believed the enemy had arrived.

sentences.chinese: 他要求李明立刻带路，离开这个森林。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yāoqiú Lǐ Míng lìkè dàilù, líkāi zhège sēnlín.
sentences.english: He required Li Ming to lead the way immediately and leave this forest.

sentences.chinese: 李明看着王将领的衣服，那是将领的装扮，显得很威严。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kànzhe Wáng jiànglǐng de yīfú, nà shì jiànglǐng de zhuāngbàn, xiǎndé hěn wēiyán.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked at General Wang's clothes; it was the attire of a general, looking very majestic.

sentences.chinese: 但李明知道，对方并不重视他的生命。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn Lǐ Míng zhīdào, duìfāng bìng bù zhòngshì tā de shēngmìng.
sentences.english: But Li Ming knew that the other party did not value his life.

sentences.chinese: 两人开始讨论怎么走才能最快离开。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng rén kāishǐ tǎolùn zěnme zǒu cáinéng zuì kuài líkāi.
sentences.english: The two began to discuss how to leave as quickly as possible.

sentences.chinese: 李明讲起了一个古老的传说，说这里有周朝时期的秘密通道。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng jiǎng qǐle yīgè gǔlǎo de chuánshuō, shuō zhèlǐ yǒu Zhōu cháo shíqī de mìmì tōngdào.
sentences.english: Li Ming spoke of an ancient legend, saying there was a secret passage here from the Zhou Dynasty.

sentences.chinese: 他拿出一个旧的笔记本，向王将领说明路线。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū yīgè jiù de bǐjìběn, xiàng Wáng jiànglǐng shuōmíng lùxiàn.
sentences.english: He took out an old notebook and explained the route to General Wang.

sentences.chinese: 笔记本里记录了许多重点，包括如何通过那些危险的山路。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐjìběn lǐ jìlùle xǔduō zhòngdiǎn, bāokuò rúhé tōngguò nàxiē wēixiǎn de shānlù.
sentences.english: The notebook recorded many key points, including how to pass through those dangerous mountain paths.

sentences.chinese: 王将领听了他的讲话，眼神中闪过一丝犹豫。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng jiànglǐng tīngle tā de jiǎnghuà, yǎnshén zhòng shǎnguò yīsī yóuyù.
sentences.english: General Wang listened to his speech, and a hint of hesitation flashed in his eyes.

sentences.chinese: 他让士兵重复一遍刚才的通知，确认敌军的位置。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ràng shìbīng chóngfù yībiàn gāngcái de tōngzhī, quèrèn díjūn de wèizhì.
sentences.english: He had the soldiers repeat the notice from a moment ago to confirm the enemy's position.

sentences.chinese: 敌军的人数已经超过了一千人，形势非常危险。
sentences.pinyin: Díjūn de rénshù yǐjīng chāoguòle yīqiān rén, xíngshì fēicháng wēixiǎn.
sentences.english: The number of enemy troops had already exceeded one thousand, and the situation was very dangerous.

sentences.chinese: 李明引导他们进行一次快速的运动，穿过茂密的树林。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng yǐndǎo tāmen jìnxíng yīcì kuàisù de yùndòng, chuānguò màomì de shùlín.
sentences.english: Li Ming guided them to conduct a rapid movement through the dense forest.

sentences.chinese: 他选了一条最隐蔽的小路，因为他通晓这里的地形。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xuǎnle yītiáo zuì yǐnbì de xiǎolù, yīnwèi tā tōngxiǎo zhèlǐ de dìxíng.
sentences.english: He chose the most hidden path because he knew the local terrain well.

sentences.chinese: 路边有一辆破旧的马车，上面放着几斤沉重的铁矿石。
sentences.pinyin: Lùbiān yǒu yī liàng pòjiù de mǎchē, shàngmiàn fàngzhe jǐ jīn chénzhòng de tiě kuàngshí.
sentences.english: By the side of the road was an old carriage with several catties of heavy iron ore on it.

sentences.chinese: 李明心想，如果能像那样利用环境，或许能逃脱。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng xīn xiǎng, rúguǒ néng xiàng nàyàng lìyòng huánjìng, huòxǔ néng táotuō.
sentences.english: Li Ming thought to himself that if he could use the environment in that way, he might escape.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个来自黑龙江方向的密使骑马冲了过来。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yīgè láizì Hēilóngjiāng fāngxiàng de mìshǐ qímǎ chōngle guòlái.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a secret envoy from the direction of Heilongjiang rushed over on horseback.

sentences.chinese: 密使大喊：“快走！敌人的包围圈已经形成了！”
sentences.pinyin: Mìshǐ dàhǎn: “Kuài zǒu! Dírén de bāowéiquān yǐjīng xíngchéngle!”
sentences.english: The envoy shouted, "Go quickly! The enemy's encirclement has already formed!"

sentences.chinese: 王将领意识到李明的话是真的，赶紧下令撤退。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng jiànglǐng yìshí dào Lǐ Míng de huà shì zhēn de, gǎnjǐn xiàlìng chètuì.
sentences.english: General Wang realized Li Ming's words were true and quickly ordered a retreat.

sentences.chinese: 然而，在撤退的途中，李明发现马车上的铁矿石其实是某种信号。
sentences.pinyin: Rán'ér, zài chètuì de túzhōng, Lǐ Míng fāxiàn mǎchē shàng de tiě kuàngshí qíshí shì mǒu zhǒng xìnhào.
sentences.english: However, during the retreat, Li Ming discovered that the iron ore on the carriage was actually a kind of signal.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，真正的敌人并不是在后面，而是在前面等待他们。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, zhēnzhèng de dírén bìng bùshì zài hòumiàn, ér shì zài qiánmiàn děngdài tāmen.
sentences.english: He realized that the real enemy was not behind them, but waiting for them ahead.

sentences.chinese: 森林的出口处，无数把长剑在月光下闪烁。
sentences.pinyin: Sēnlín de chūkǒu chù, wúshù bǎ chángjiàn zài yuèguāng xià shǎnshuò.
sentences.english: At the exit of the forest, countless long swords shimmered in the moonlight.

sentences.chinese: 李明看着眼前的绝境，心中只有一个念头：这是最后的机会。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kànzhe yǎnqián de juéjìng, xīnzhōng zhǐyǒu yīgè niàntou: zhè shì zuìhòu de jīhuì.
sentences.english: Looking at the dead end before him, Li Ming had only one thought: this is the last chance.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十七章：最后的决战与新生
chapters.title_english: Chapter 27: The Final Battle and New Life

sentences.chinese: 李明看着前方，那里是一座巨大的古城。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng kànzhe qiánfāng, nàlǐ shì yī zuò jùdà de gǔchéng.
sentences.english: Li Ming looked ahead, where there was a huge ancient city.

sentences.chinese: 这座古城是权力的中心，也是所有秘密的终点。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔchéng shì quánlì de zhōngxīn, yěshì suǒyǒu mìmì de zhōngdiǎn.
sentences.english: This ancient city was the center of power and the endpoint of all secrets.

sentences.chinese: 王将领的军队像一个巨大的队，在广场上集合。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng jiànglǐng de jūnduì xiàng yīgè jùdà de duì, zài guǎngchǎng shàng jíhé.
sentences.english: General Wang's army was like a giant squadron, gathering in the public square.

sentences.chinese: 队长在前面大喊，命令士兵们准备战斗。
sentences.pinyin: Duìzhǎng zài qiánmiàn dàhǎn, mìnglìng shìbīngmen zhǔnbèi zhàndòu.
sentences.english: The captain shouted in front, ordering the soldiers to prepare for battle.

sentences.chinese: 李明意识到，这场战斗将决定国家的未来。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng yìshí dào, zhè cháng zhàndòu jiāng juédìng guójiā de wèilái.
sentences.english: Li Ming realized that this bout of fighting would determine the future of the country.

sentences.chinese: 他记得在书院的院子里，老师说过，真正的勇气不在于力量。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìdé zài shūyuàn de yuànzi lǐ, lǎoshī shuōguò, zhēnzhèng de yǒngqì bù zàiyú lìliàng.
sentences.english: He remembered in the courtyard of the academy, his teacher had said that true courage does not lie in strength.

sentences.chinese: 他想起那个小院，那是他心中最安静的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ nàgè xiǎo yuàn, nà shì tā xīnzhōng zuì ānjìng de dìfāng.
sentences.english: He thought of that small院 (institution/yard), which was the quietest place in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 现在，他必须面对这个残酷的世界。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài, tā bìxū miànduì zhège cánkù de shìjiè.
sentences.english: Now, he had to face this cruel world.

sentences.chinese: 士兵们在像体育场一样宽广的空地上地移动。
sentences.pinyin: Shìbīngmen zài xiàng tǐyùchǎng yīyàng kuānguǎng de kòngdì shàng yídòng.
sentences.english: The soldiers moved on an open space as wide as a stadium.

sentences.chinese: 虽然古代没有现代的体育馆，但这里的规模同样惊人。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán gǔdài méiyǒu xiàndài de tǐyùguǎn, dàn zhèlǐ de guīmó tóngyàng jīngrén.
sentences.english: Although ancient times did not have modern gymnasiums, the scale here was equally astonishing.

sentences.chinese: 这里不像公园那样安静，而是充满了杀气。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ bù xiàng gōngyuán nàyàng ānjìng, ér shì chōngmǎnle shāqì.
sentences.english: It was not as quiet as a park, but was full of murderous intent.

sentences.chinese: 李明在草地上快速奔跑，他的脚在泥土中地深陷。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zài cǎodì shàng kuàisù bēnpǎo, tā de jiǎo zài nítǔ zhōng shēn xiàn.
sentences.english: Li Ming ran quickly on the grass, his feet sinking deep into the soil.

sentences.chinese: 他的衣服变得很脏，但他不在乎。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yīfú biàn de hěn zàng, dàn tā bù zàihu.
sentences.english: His clothes became very dirty, but he didn't care.

sentences.chinese: 他看到远处有一座高塔，像一个巨大的座，支撑着天空。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào yuǎnchù yǒu yī zuò gāotǎ, xiàng yīgè jùdà de zuò, zhīchēngzhe tiānkōng.
sentences.english: He saw a high tower in the distance, like a giant base, supporting the sky.

sentences.chinese: 太阳升起来了，光芒照在他的脸上。
sentences.pinyin: Tàiyáng shēng qǐláile, guāngmáng zhào zài tā de liǎn shàng.
sentences.english: The sun rose, and the light shone on his face.

sentences.chinese: 他突然想到，如果生活在和平年代，他或许会喜欢体育。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán xiǎngdào, rúguǒ shēnghuó zài hépíng niándài, tā huòxǔ huì xǐhuān tǐyù.
sentences.english: He suddenly thought that if he lived in a peaceful era, he might like sports.

sentences.chinese: 他可能会加入一个球队，在球场上比赛。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kěnéng huì jiārù yīgè qiúduì, zài qiúchǎng shàng bǐsài.
sentences.english: He might join a sports team and compete on a sports ground.

sentences.chinese: 他可能会和朋友打网球，或者去海边散步。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kěnéng huì hé péngyǒu dǎ wǎngqiú, huòzhě qù hǎibiān sànbù.
sentences.english: He might play tennis with friends or take a walk by the seaside.

sentences.chinese: 他甚至会想象现代的超市，那里有来自克国的异域商品。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shènzhì huì xiǎngxiàng xiàndài de chāoshì, nàlǐ yǒu láizì Kè guó de yìyù shāngpǐn.
sentences.english: He would even imagine a modern supermarket, with exotic goods from Croatia.

sentences.chinese: 他会想象那些巨大的停车场，停满了奇怪的机器。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huì xiǎngxiàng nàxiē jùdà de tíngchēchǎng, tíng mǎnle qíguài de jīqì.
sentences.english: He would imagine those huge parking lots, filled with strange machines.

sentences.chinese: 但现在，他必须在这一场生死之战中生存下来。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiànzài, tā bìxū zài zhè yī cháng shēngsǐ zhī zhàn zhōng shēngcún xiàlái.
sentences.english: But now, he had to survive in this life-and-death struggle.

sentences.chinese: 他利用地形，引导敌军进入一个狭窄的陷阱。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lìyòng dìxíng, yǐndǎo díjūn jìnrù yīgè xiázhǎi de xiànjǐng.
sentences.english: He used the terrain to lead the enemy army into a narrow trap.

sentences.chinese: 最终，正义战胜了阴谋，权力重新回到了人民手中。
sentences.pinyin: Zuìzhōng, zhèngyì zhànshèngle yīnmó, quánlì chóngxīn huí dàole rénmín shǒuzhōng.
sentences.english: In the end, justice triumphed over conspiracy, and power returned to the people.

sentences.chinese: 李明站在城墙上，看着远方的地平线，心中充满了希望。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Míng zhàn zài chéngqiáng shàng, kànzhe yuǎnfāng de dìpíngxiàn, xīnzhōng chōngmǎnle xīwàng.
sentences.english: Li Ming stood on the city wall, looking at the distant horizon, his heart full of hope.

sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎn kuài dào qiàn, bìng shì tú yòng cí diǎn chá zhǎo “duì bù qǐ” de zhèng què dú yīn.
sentences.english: He quickly apologized and tried to use the dictionary to look up the correct pronunciation of "sorry."

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，学习语言不仅是学习词语，还要学习怎么在尴尬的时候微笑。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, xué xí yǔ yán bù jǐn shì xué xí cí yǔ, hái yào xué xí zěn me zài gān gà de shí hou wēi xiào.
sentences.english: He realized that learning a language is not just learning words, but also learning how to smile when embarrassed.

sentences.chinese: 他走出诊所，在路边看到一份晚报。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu chū zhěn suǒ, zài lù biān kàn dào yí fèn wǎn bào.
sentences.english: He walked out of the clinic and saw an evening newspaper by the road.

sentences.chinese: 报纸上写着关于越南，也就是越国的文化交流活动。
sentences.pinyin: Bào zhǐ shàng xiě zhe guān yú Yuè guó de wén huà jiāo liú huó dòng.
sentences.english: The newspaper wrote about cultural exchange activities in Vietnam (Yue).

sentences.chinese: 大卫想，如果他能把普通话学好，他以后可以去很多地方。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi xiǎng, rú guǒ tā néng bǎ pǔ tōng huà xué hǎo, tā yǐ hòu kě yǐ qù hěn duō dì fang.
sentences.english: David thought that if he could learn Mandarin well, he could go to many places in the future.

sentences.chinese: 他终于找到了他的教室，受到了同学们的欢迎。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhōng yú zhǎo dào le tā de jiào shì, shòu dào le tóng xué men de huān yíng.
