sentences.english: He finally found his classroom and received a warm welcome from his classmates.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，他发现自己的笔记本不见了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, tā fā xiàn zì jǐ de bǐ jì běn bú jiàn le.
sentences.english: But just then, he discovered his notebook was missing.

sentences.chinese: 他回头看，那个中医医生正拿着笔记本在笑。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huí tóu kàn, nà gè zhōng yī yī shēng zhèng ná zhe bǐ jì běn zài xiào.
sentences.english: He looked back and saw that the TCM doctor was holding the notebook and laughing.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 2: The Secret of the Notebook

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着那个中医医生，心里很紧张。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe nàge zhōngyī yīshēng, xīnlǐ hěn jǐnzhāng.
sentences.english: David looked at the Chinese medicine doctor, feeling very nervous.

sentences.chinese: 医生拿着那个黑色的笔记本，笑着说：“你的书在这里。”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng názhe nàge hēisè de bǐjìběn, xiàozhe shuō: “Nǐ de shū zài zhèlǐ.”
sentences.english: The doctor held the black notebook and smiled, saying, "Your book is here."

sentences.chinese: 大卫赶紧拿回来，发现笔记本里多了一张日报。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi gǎnjǐn ná huílái, fāxiàn bǐjìběn lǐ duōle yī zhāng rìbào.
sentences.english: David quickly took it back and found an extra daily newspaper inside the notebook.

sentences.chinese: 报纸上写着，下周有一个非常大的文化晚会。
sentences.pinyin: Bàozhǐ shàng xiězhe, xiàzhōu yǒu yīgè fēicháng dà de wénhuà wǎnhuì.
sentences.english: The newspaper said there would be a very large cultural evening party next week.

sentences.chinese: 医生说：“我前年去过北方，那里很冷。”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō: “Wǒ qiánnián qùguò běifāng, nàlǐ hěn lěng.”
sentences.english: The doctor said, "The year before last, I went to the North; it was very cold there."

sentences.chinese: 他告诉大卫，在东北，冬天像夏天一样热闹，因为大家喜欢在家里喝茶。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Dàwèi, zài dōngběi, dōngtiān xiàng xiàtiān yīyàng rènào, yīnwèi dàjiā xǐhuān zài jiālǐ hē chá.
sentences.english: He told David that in the Northeast, winter is as lively as summer because everyone likes to drink tea at home.

sentences.chinese: 大卫问：“那东南和西南怎么样？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi wèn: “Nà dōngnán hé xīnán zěnmeyàng?”
sentences.english: David asked, "Then how about the Southeast and Southwest?"

sentences.chinese: 医生挥挥手说：“那里很暖和，春天的时候花很多。”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng huīhuīshǒu shuō: “Nàlǐ hěn nuǎnhuo, chūntiān de shíhòu huā hěnduō.”
sentences.english: The doctor waved his hand and said, "It's very warm there, and there are many flowers in spring."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这个医生很奇怪，他总是说一些奇怪的事情。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéde zhège yīshēng hěn qíguài, tā zǒngshì shuō yīxiē qíguài de shìqíng.
sentences.english: David thought this doctor was very strange; he always said strange things.

sentences.chinese: 医生突然问：“你上周在做什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tūrán wèn: “Nǐ shàngzhōu zài zuò shénme?”
sentences.english: The doctor suddenly asked, "What were you doing last week?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫回答：“我准备这个学期的假期。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi huídá: “Wǒ zhǔnbèi zhège xuéqī de jiàqī.”
sentences.english: David replied, "I was preparing for this semester's vacation."

sentences.chinese: 医生点点头，说：“如果你想过年，你应该学习怎么庆祝春节。”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng diǎndiǎn tóu, shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng guònián, nǐ yīnggāi xuéxí zěnme qìngzhù chūnjié.”
sentences.english: The doctor nodded and said, "If you want to celebrate the New Year, you should learn how to celebrate the Spring Festival."

sentences.chinese: 大卫想，如果他能去西北地区看一看，那一定很有趣。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎng, rúguǒ tā néng qù xīběi dìqū kàn yī kàn, nà yīdìng hěn yǒuqù.
sentences.english: David thought that if he could visit the Northwest region, it would certainly be interesting.

sentences.chinese: 但现在的问题是，这个医生为什么在学校里？
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiànzài de wèntí shì, zhège yīshēng wèishéme zài xuéxiào lǐ?
sentences.english: But the problem now was, why was this doctor in the school?

sentences.chinese: 医生说：“我在这里教音乐，但我更喜欢西餐。”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō: “Wǒ zài zhèlǐ jiāo yīnyuè, dàn wǒ gèng xǐhuān xīcān.”
sentences.english: The doctor said, "I teach music here, but I prefer Western food."

sentences.chinese: 大卫笑了，一个中医医生喜欢西餐，这太好笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiàole, yīgè zhōngyī yīshēng xǐhuān xīcān, zhè tài hǎoxiào le.
sentences.english: David laughed; a Chinese medicine doctor liking Western food was too funny.

sentences.chinese: 外面突然变成了阴天，风很大。
sentences.pinyin: Wàimiàn tūrán biànchéngle yīntiān, fēng hěn dà.
sentences.english: Outside, it suddenly became a cloudy day, and the wind was strong.

sentences.chinese: 医生看了看表，说：“周末快到了，我要回家了。”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng kànle kàn biǎo, shuō: “Zhōumò kuài dàole, wǒ yào huí jiā le.”
sentences.english: The doctor looked at his watch and said, "The weekend is coming; I need to go home."

sentences.chinese: 他走到门口，回头对大卫说：“下周见！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu dào ménkǒu, huítóu duì Dàwèi shuō: “Xiàzhōu jiàn!”
sentences.english: He walked to the door, turned back to David, and said, "See you next week!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫还没说话，医生就轻声说了一句：“晚安。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi hái méi shuōhuà, yīshēng jiù qīngshēng shuōle yī jù: “Wǎn'ān.”
sentences.english: Before David could speak, the doctor softly said, "Good night."

sentences.chinese: 现在还是下午两点，大卫觉得非常困惑。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài háishì xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn, Dàwèi juéde fēicháng kùnhuò.
sentences.english: It was only two o'clock in the afternoon; David felt very confused.

sentences.chinese: 他打开笔记本，发现里面有一张小纸条，写着一个地址。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dǎkāi bǐjìběn, fāxiàn lǐmiàn yǒu yī zhāng xiǎo zhǐtiáo, xiězhe yīgè dìzhǐ.
sentences.english: He opened the notebook and found a small slip of paper inside with an address written on it.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着纸条上的地址，觉得非常奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe zhǐtiáo shàng de dìzhǐ, juéde fēicháng qíguài.
sentences.english: David looked at the address on the note and thought it was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 这个地址和学校的地址完全不同。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìzhǐ hé xuéxiào de dìzhǐ wánquán bù tóng.
sentences.english: This address was completely different from the school's address.

sentences.chinese: 他想知道那个医生是个什么样的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng zhīdào nàge yīshēng shì gè shénme yàng de rén.
sentences.english: He wanted to know what kind of person that doctor was.

sentences.chinese: 医生说“晚安”的时候，大卫当时觉得他疯了。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō “wǎn'ān” de shíhou, Dàwèi dāngshí juéde tā fēng le.
sentences.english: When the doctor said "Goodnight," David felt at that time that he was crazy.

sentences.chinese: 那时是下午两点，怎么能说晚安呢？
sentences.pinyin: Nàshí shì xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn, zěnme néng shuō wǎn'ān ne?
sentences.english: At that time, it was two in the afternoon; how could he say goodnight?

sentences.chinese: 大卫心想，今后我一定要小心这个医生。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xīnxiǎng, jīnhòu wǒ yīdìng yào xiǎoxīn zhège yīshēng.
sentences.english: David thought to himself, from now on, I must be careful with this doctor.

sentences.chinese: 他决定以后去那个地址看看。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juédìng yǐhòu qù nàge dìzhǐ kànkan.
sentences.english: He decided to go to that address later.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果那个地方在学校以下，走路就能到。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rúguǒ nàge dìfāng zài xuéxiào yǐxià, zǒulù jiù néng dào.
sentences.english: He thought that if the place was below the school's area, he could walk there.

sentences.chinese: 但如果距离在三公里以上，他就得坐车。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn rúguǒ jùlí zài sān gōnglǐ yǐshàng, tā jiù děi zuò chē.
sentences.english: But if the distance was three kilometers or more, he would have to take a car.

sentences.chinese: 他打开手机地图，发现那里有许多奇怪的小店。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dǎkāi shǒujī dìtú, fāxiàn nàlǐ yǒu xǔduō qíguài de xiǎodiàn.
sentences.english: He opened the mobile map and found many strange little shops there.

sentences.chinese: 其中有一家店的名字叫“奇怪的药店”。
sentences.pinyin: Qízhōng yǒu yī jiā diàn de míngzì jiào “qíguài de yàodiàn”.
sentences.english: Among them, there was a shop called "The Strange Pharmacy."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这太有趣了，所以他决定现在就去。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéde zhè tài yǒuqù le, suǒyǐ tā juédìng xiànzài jiù qù.
sentences.english: David thought this was too interesting, so he decided to go right now.

sentences.chinese: 他收拾好东西，然后走出了教室。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shōushí hǎo dōngxi, ránhòu zǒuchū le jiàoshì.
sentences.english: He packed his things and then walked out of the classroom.

sentences.chinese: 走廊里有不少学生，大多数人都在聊天。
sentences.pinyin: Zǒuláng lǐ yǒu bùshǎo xuéshēng, dàduōshù rén dōu zài liáotiān.
sentences.english: There were quite a lot of students in the corridor; the great majority of them were chatting.

sentences.chinese: 大部分学生在讨论明天的考试，其他人在看手机。
sentences.pinyin: Dà bùfèn xuéshēng zài tǎolùn míngtiān de kǎoshì, qítā rén zài kàn shǒujī.
sentences.english: Most of the students were discussing tomorrow's exam, and others were looking at their phones.

sentences.chinese: 大卫发现，很多人看他的眼神越来越奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi fāxiàn, hěnduō rén kàn tā de yǎnshén yuè lái yuè qíguài.
sentences.english: David noticed that many people's looks toward him were becoming more and more strange.

sentences.chinese: 可能是因为他现在穿了一件非常大的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Kěnéng shì yīnwèi tā xiànzài chuān le yī jiàn fēicháng dà de yīfú.
sentences.english: Perhaps it was because he was currently wearing a very large piece of clothing.

sentences.chinese: 这时，他又想到了那个医生。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, tā yòu xiǎngdào le nàge yīshēng.
sentences.english: At this moment, he thought of that doctor again.

sentences.chinese: 那个医生说话的方式那样奇怪，动作那么特别。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge yīshēng shuōhuà de fāngshì nàyàng qíguài, dòngzuò nàme tèbié.
sentences.english: That doctor's way of speaking was that strange, and his movements were so special.

sentences.chinese: 大卫记得那会儿医生笑的样子，觉得多么神秘啊！
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi jìde nàhuìr yīshēng xiào de yàngzi, juéde duōme shénmì a!
sentences.english: David remembered the doctor's smiling face at that time and thought how mysterious it was!

sentences.chinese: 他想知道医生怎样才能在下午说“晚安”。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng zhīdào yīshēng zěnyàng cáinéng zài xiàwǔ shuō “wǎn'ān”.
sentences.english: He wanted to know how the doctor could say "Goodnight" in the afternoon.

sentences.chinese: 他想，这种行为到底怎么样才算正常？
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, zhèzhǒng xíngwéi dàodǐ zěnmeyàng cái suàn zhèngcháng?
sentences.english: He wondered how this kind of behavior could possibly be considered normal?

sentences.chinese: 后来，他走到了那个地址的门口。
sentences.pinyin: Hòulái, tā zǒudào le nàge dìzhǐ de ménkǒu.
sentences.english: Later, he walked to the entrance of that address.

sentences.chinese: 那里有大量奇怪的药草，味道非常浓。
sentences.pinyin: Nàlǐ yǒu dàliàng qíguài de yàocǎo, wèidào fēicháng nóng.
sentences.english: There were a large quantity of strange herbs there, and the smell was very strong.

sentences.chinese: 好多人在这里排队，多数人看起来都病了。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎoduō rén zài zhèlǐ páiduì, duōshù rén kàn qǐlái dōu bìng le.
sentences.english: Quite a lot of people were lining up here; the majority of them looked sick.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看到这里有不同种类的药，数量大大地超过了他的想象。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kàndào zhèlǐ yǒu bùtóng zhǒnglèi de yào, shùliàng dàdà de chāoguò le tā de xiǎngxiàng.
sentences.english: David saw different kinds of medicine here, and the quantity greatly exceeded his imagination.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试重新阅读纸条上的字，但字迹太乱了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chángshì chóngxīn yuèdú zhǐtiáo shàng de zì, dàn zìjì tài luàn le.
sentences.english: He tried to re-read the words on the note, but the handwriting was too messy.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这样寻找答案太慢了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde zhèyàng xúnzhǎo dá'àn tài màn le.
sentences.english: He felt that searching for answers this way was too slow.

sentences.chinese: 他想，这么奇怪的地方，一定有秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, zhème qíguài de dìfāng, yīdìng yǒu mìmì.
sentences.english: He thought that such a strange place must have a secret.

sentences.chinese: 他走进店里，发现这里的人说话方式很特别。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒujìn diàn lǐ, fāxiàn zhèlǐ de rén shuōhuà fāngshì hěn tèbié.
sentences.english: He walked into the shop and found that the people here had a very special way of speaking.

sentences.chinese: 他们不说话，而是用手势交流。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen bù shuōhuà, érshì yòng shǒushì jiāoliú.
sentences.english: They didn't speak, but instead communicated using gestures.

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这种沟通方式太奇怪了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéde zhèzhǒng gōutōng fāngshì tài qíguài le.
sentences.english: David thought this way of communication was too strange.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个穿着白衣服的人走过来，对他笑了笑。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yīgè chuānzhe bái yīfú de rén zǒu guòlái, duì tā xiào le xiào.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a person wearing white clothes walked over and smiled at him.

sentences.chinese: 那个穿白衣服的人对着大卫笑了笑，然后指了指后面的院子。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge chuān bái yīfú de rén duìzhe Dàwèi xiàole xiào, ránhòu zhǐle zhǐ hòumiàn de yuànzi.
sentences.english: The person in white smiled at David and then pointed to the courtyard behind him.

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这个地方有点儿奇怪，但好奇心让他走了进去。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juédé zhège dìfāng yǒudiǎnr qíguài, dàn hàoqíxīn ràng tā zǒu le jìnqù.
sentences.english: David felt this place was a bit strange, but curiosity led him inside.

sentences.chinese: 院子里有很多奇怪的车辆，它们看起来像是一百年前的旧车。
sentences.pinyin: Yuànzi lǐ yǒu hěnduō qíguài de chēliàng, tāmen kàn qǐlái xiàng shì yī bǎi nián qián de jiù chē.
sentences.english: There were many strange vehicles in the courtyard; they looked like old cars from a hundred years ago.

sentences.chinese: 大卫想，我在这里待了多久了？感觉像过了好久一样。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎng, wǒ zài zhèlǐ dāile duōjiǔ le? Gǎnjué xiàng guòle hǎojiǔ yīyàng.
sentences.english: David thought, how long have I been here? It felt as if a long time had passed.

sentences.chinese: 这时候，那个穿白衣服的人走过来，用很小声的声音说话了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shíhòu, nàge chuān bái yīfú de rén zǒu guòlái, yòng hěn xiǎoshēng de shēngyīn shuōhuà le.
sentences.english: At this moment, the person in white walked over and spoke in a very low voice.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“欢迎来到我们的安静音乐会。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Huānyíng lái dào wǒmen de ānjìng yīnyuèhuì.”
sentences.english: He said, "Welcome to our quiet concert."

sentences.chinese: 大卫很惊讶，因为他刚才明明看到大家都在用手势交流。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi hěn jīngyà, yīnwèi tā gāngcái míngmíng kàndào dàjiā dōu zài yòng shǒushì jiāoliú.
sentences.english: David was surprised because he had clearly seen everyone communicating with gestures just now.

sentences.chinese: 他问：“音乐会怎么能安静呢？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn: “Yīnyuèhuì zěnme néng ānjìng ne?”
sentences.english: He asked, "How can a concert be quiet?"

sentences.chinese: 那个男人笑了，说：“我们从小就学习这种安静的艺术。”
sentences.pinyin: Nàge nánrén xiàole, shuō: “Wǒmen cóngxiǎo jiù xuéxí zhè zhǒng ānjìng de yìshù.”
sentences.english: The man smiled and said, "We have studied this art of silence since childhood."

sentences.chinese: 他说他在小时候就发现，安静比说话更有意思。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō tā zài xiǎoshíhòu jiù fāxiàn, ānjìng bǐ shuōhuà gèng yǒu yìsi.
sentences.english: He said that in his childhood, he discovered that silence was more interesting than speaking.

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这个想法不太正常，但还是决定听听看。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juédé zhège xiǎngfǎ bù tài zhèngcháng, dàn háishì juédìng tīngtīng kàn.
sentences.english: David felt this idea was not too normal, but he decided to listen anyway.

sentences.chinese: 不一会儿，人们开始在院子里走动，每个人都拿着一个奇怪的乐器。
sentences.pinyin: Bù yīhuǐr, rénmen kāishǐ zài yuànzi lǐ zǒudòng, měi gèrén dōu názhe yīgè qíguài de yuèqì.
sentences.english: After a short while, people began to move around the courtyard, each holding a strange instrument.

sentences.chinese: 不久，一个老人走上台，他看起来已经一百岁了。
sentences.pinyin: Bùjiǔ, yīgè lǎorén zǒu shàng tái, tā kàn qǐlái yǐjīng yī bǎi suì le.
sentences.english: Soon, an old man walked onto the stage; he looked like he was already a hundred years old.

sentences.chinese: 老人告诉大家，他早就准备好了一个特别的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén gàosù dàjiā, tā zǎojiù zhǔnbèi hǎole yīgè tèbié de gùshì.
sentences.english: The old man told everyone that he had long ago prepared a special story.

sentences.chinese: 这个故事关于一个不爱说话的医生，也就是大卫之前见到的那个中医。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège gùshì guānyú yīgè bù ài shuōhuà de yīshēng, yě jiùshì Dàwèi zhīqián jiàndào de nàge zhōngyī.
sentences.english: This story was about a doctor who didn't like to talk, which was the Chinese medicine doctor David had seen before.

sentences.chinese: 大卫想起刚才那个医生对他说的“晚安”，觉得有一点儿好笑。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎngqǐ gāngcái nàge yīshēng duì tā shuō de “wǎn'ān”, juédé yǒu yīdiǎnr hǎoxiào.
sentences.english: David remembered the "goodnight" the doctor had said to him just now and found it a little bit funny.

sentences.chinese: 他刚刚想笑出声，结果发现周围的人都盯着他看。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gānggāng xiǎng xiào chūshēng, jiéguǒ fāxiàn zhōuwéi de rén dōu dīngzhe tā kàn.
sentences.english: He had just recently wanted to laugh out loud, but found that the people around him were all staring at him.

sentences.chinese: 他赶紧闭上嘴，因为这里的人对他说话的方式有点儿敏感。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎnjǐn bìshàng zuǐ, yīnwèi zhèlǐ de rén duì tā shuōhuà de fāngshì yǒudiǎnr mǐngǎn.
sentences.english: He quickly shut his mouth because the people here were slightly sensitive to his way of speaking.

sentences.chinese: 那时候，大卫突然意识到，他可能进了一个奇怪的俱乐部。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shíhòu, Dàwèi tūrán yìshí dào, tā kěnéng jìnle yīgè qíguài de jùlèbù.
sentences.english: At that time, David suddenly realized that he might have entered a strange club.

sentences.chinese: 他只想要一点点答案，但现在他觉得自己进入了一个巨大的谜团。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐ xiǎng yào yī diǎn diǎn dá'àn, dàn xiànzài tā juédé zìjǐ jìnrùle yīgè jùdà de mítuán.
sentences.english: He only wanted a little bit of answers, but now he felt he had entered a giant mystery.

sentences.chinese: 突然，那个中医医生出现在他身后，对着他的耳朵轻轻说了一句话。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, nàge zhōngyī yīshēng chūxiàn zài tā shēnhòu, duìzhe tā de ěrduo qīngqīng shuōle yī jù huà.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the Chinese medicine doctor appeared behind him and whispered a sentence into his ear.

sentences.chinese: 中医医生在他耳边说：“跟我来，我想请客。”
sentences.pinyin: Zhōngyī yīshēng zài tā ěrbiān shuō: “Gēn wǒ lái, wǒ xiǎng qǐngkè.”
sentences.english: The TCM doctor whispered in his ear, "Come with me, I'd like to treat you to a meal."

sentences.chinese: 大卫很惊讶，因为这个医生像个神秘的商人。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi hěn jīngyà, yīnwèi zhège yīshēng xiàng gè shénmì de shāngrén.
sentences.english: David was surprised because this doctor seemed like a mysterious businessman.

sentences.chinese: 医生带着他走出这个奇怪的院子。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng dàizhe tā zǒuchū zhège qíguài de yuànzi.
sentences.english: The doctor led him out of that strange courtyard.

sentences.chinese: 街道上有许多行人，大家都看着这个奇怪的组合。
sentences.pinyin: Jiēdào shàng yǒu xǔduō xíngrén, dàjiā dōu kànzhe zhège qíguài de zǔhé.
sentences.english: There were many pedestrians on the street, and everyone was looking at this odd pair.

sentences.chinese: 医生告诉大卫，他认识一个老朋友，在市中心开了一家店。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng gàosù Dàwèi, tā rènshí yīgè lǎo péngyǒu, zài shì zhōngxīn kāile yījiā diàn.
sentences.english: The doctor told David that he knew an old friend who owned a shop in the city center.

sentences.chinese: 他们走进一家很大的酒店，那里有很多旅客和游客。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒujìn yījiā hěn dà de jiǔdiàn, nàlǐ yǒu hěnduō lǚkè hé yóukè.
sentences.english: They entered a large hotel, where there were many travelers and tourists.

sentences.chinese: 酒店的大厅里，一个司机正在和他的同事说话。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǔdiàn de dàtīng lǐ, yīgè sījī zhèngzài hé tā de tóngshì shuōhuà.
sentences.english: In the hotel lobby, a driver was talking to his colleague.

sentences.chinese: 一个优雅的太太走过来，她是这里的主人。
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè yōuyǎ de tàitai zǒu guòlái, tā shì zhèlǐ de zhǔrén.
sentences.english: An elegant lady walked over; she was the owner of the place.

sentences.chinese: 她笑着说：“欢迎你们，我的客人！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàozhe shuō: “Huānyíng nǐmen, wǒ de kèrén!”
sentences.english: She smiled and said, "Welcome, my guests!"

sentences.chinese: 医生对她说：“我想给我的新朋友介绍一下这里的中餐。”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng duì tā shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng gěi wǒ de xīn péngyǒu jièshào yīxià zhèlǐ de zhōngcān.”
sentences.english: The doctor said to her, "I want to introduce my new friend to the Chinese food here."

sentences.chinese: 太太带他们去了一个安静的办公室，那里其实是一个私人餐厅。
sentences.pinyin: Tàitai dài tāmen qùle yīgè ānjìng de bàngōngshì, nàlǐ qíshí shì yīgè sīrén cāntīng.
sentences.english: The lady took them to a quiet office, which was actually a private dining room.

sentences.chinese: 她问大卫：“你现在想吃午餐，还是想等晚餐？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn Dàwèi: “Nǐ xiànzài xiǎng chī wǔcān, háishì xiǎng děng wǎncān?”
sentences.english: She asked David, "Would you like to have lunch now, or wait for dinner?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫肚子很饿，他说：“我现在就想吃！”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi dùzi hěn è, tā shuō: “Wǒ xiànzài jiù xiǎng chī!”
sentences.english: David was very hungry and said, "I want to eat now!"

sentences.chinese: 太太笑着叫来一名服务员，服务员像对待重要顾客一样对待大卫。
sentences.pinyin: Tàitai xiàozhe jiào lái yī míng fúwùyuán, fúwùyuán xiàng duìdài zhòngyào gùkè yīyàng duìdài Dàwèi.
sentences.english: The lady smiled and called a waiter, who treated David like an important customer.

sentences.chinese: 桌子上放着一瓶白色的酒，大卫不知道这是什么。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng fàngzhe yī píng báisè de jiǔ, Dàwèi bù zhīdào zhè shì shénme.
sentences.english: On the table sat a bottle of white liquor; David didn't know what it was.

sentences.chinese: 不久，服务员端上来一盘香喷喷的鸡肉。
sentences.pinyin: Bùjiǔ, fúwùyuán duān shànglái yī pán xiāngpēnpēn de jīròu.
sentences.english: Soon, the waiter brought out a plate of fragrant chicken.

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这里的饭馆比他在超市见到的食物好多了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéde zhèlǐ de fànguǎn bǐ tā zài chāoshì jiàndào de shíwù hǎo duōle.
sentences.english: David felt that the food at this restaurant was much better than the food he saw at the supermarket.

sentences.chinese: 他一边吃，一边想：这个医生到底是谁？
sentences.pinyin: Tā yībiān chī, yībiān xiǎng: Zhège yīshēng dàodǐ shì shéi?
sentences.english: As he ate, he wondered: Who exactly is this doctor?

sentences.chinese: 为什么一个医生会认识酒店的主人？
sentences.pinyin: Wèishéme yīgè yīshēng huì rènshí jiǔdiàn de zhǔrén?
sentences.english: Why would a doctor know the owner of a hotel?

sentences.chinese: 就在大卫准备喝那瓶酒的时候，医生突然拿走了它。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài Dàwèi zhǔnbèi hē nà píng jiǔ de shíhòu, yīshēng tūrán ná zǒule tā.
sentences.english: Just as David was about to drink that bottle of liquor, the doctor suddenly took it away.

sentences.chinese: 医生严肃地说：“这个不能喝，这是药！”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng yánsù de shuō: “Zhège bùnéng hē, zhè shì yào!”
sentences.english: The doctor said seriously, "You can't drink this; it's medicine!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫愣住了，他觉得这个世界越来越奇怪了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi lèngzhùle, tā juéde zhège shìjiè yuè lái yuè qíguàile.
sentences.english: David was stunned; he felt the world was becoming stranger and stranger.

sentences.chinese: 突然，办公室的门开了，一个拿着笔记本的人走了进来。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, bàngōngshì de mén kāile, yīgè názhe bǐjìběn de rén zǒu le jìnlái.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the office door opened, and a person holding a notebook walked in.

sentences.chinese: 那个人看着大卫，露出了一个诡异的微笑。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè rén kànzhe Dàwèi, lùchūle yīgè guǐyì de wēixiào.
sentences.english: That person looked at David and gave a weird smile.

sentences.chinese: 大卫发现，那个人手里拿着另一个一模一样的笔记本！
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi fāxiàn, nàgè rén shǒulǐ názhe lìng yīgè yīmóyīyàng de bǐjìběn!
sentences.english: David discovered that the person was holding another identical notebook!

chapters.title_chinese: 第六章：笔记本的双胞胎

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着那个一模一样的笔记本，觉得自己的眼睛出问题了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe nàge yīmúyīyàng de bǐjìběn, juéde zìjǐ de yǎnjīng chū wèntí le.
sentences.english: David looked at that identical notebook and felt something was wrong with his eyes.

sentences.chinese: 那个陌生人笑着说：“你好，我也是一个留学生。”
sentences.pinyin: Nàge mòshēngrén xiàozhe shuō: “Nǐ hǎo, wǒ yěshì yīgè liúxuéshēng.”
sentences.english: The stranger smiled and said, "Hello, I am also an international student."

sentences.chinese: 医生突然生气了，他对陌生人喊道：“走开！这是我的病人！”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tūrán shēngqì le, tā duì mòshēngrén hǎndào: “Zǒu kāi! Zhè shì wǒ de bìngrén!”
sentences.english: The doctor suddenly got angry and shouted at the stranger, "Go away! This is my patient!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫很奇怪，他并没有住院，为什么他是病人？
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi hěn qíguài, tā bìng méiyǒu zhùyuàn, wèishéme tā shì bìngrén?
sentences.english: David was very confused; he wasn't hospitalized, so why was he the patient?

sentences.chinese: 陌生人不理医生，而是看着大卫说：“我想出国，但我的笔记本丢了。”
sentences.pinyin: Mòshēngrén bù lǐ yīshēng, érshì kànzhe Dàwèi shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng chūguó, dàn wǒ de bǐjìběn diū le.”
sentences.english: The stranger ignored the doctor and looked at David, saying, "I want to go abroad, but my notebook is lost."

sentences.chinese: 大卫发现，两个笔记本长得完全一样，他们必须把笔记本分开。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi fāxiàn, liǎng gè bǐjìběn zhǎng de wánquán yīyàng, tāmen bìxū bǎ bǐjìběn fēnkāi.
sentences.english: David found that the two notebooks looked exactly the same, and they had to separate them.

sentences.chinese: 医生赶紧说：“快开机看看，里面写了什么！”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng gǎnjǐn shuō: “Kuài kāijī kànkan, lǐmiàn xiěle shénme!”
sentences.english: The doctor hurriedly said, "Quickly boot it up and see what's written inside!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫尝试开机，但笔记本突然关机了，像是在跟他开玩笑。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi chángshì kāijī, dàn bǐjìběn tūrán guānjī le, xiàng shì zài gēn tā kāi wánxiào.
sentences.english: David tried to turn it on, but the notebook suddenly shut down, as if it were playing a joke on him.

sentences.chinese: 陌生人叹了口气说：“我原本打算明天就出发回国。”
sentences.pinyin: Mòshēngrén tànle kǒuqì shuō: “Wǒ yuánběn dǎsuàn míngtiān jiù chūfā huíguó.”
sentences.english: The stranger sighed and said, "I originally planned to set off to return to my home country tomorrow."

sentences.chinese: 他说他来自外地，为了打工赚钱才来到这里的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō tā láizì wàidì, wèile dǎgōng zhuànqián cái lái dào zhèlǐ de.
sentences.english: He said he came from another part of the country and came here to work a part-time job to earn money.

sentences.chinese: 医生看着他，突然温柔地说：“你是不是该出院了？”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng kànzhe tā, tūrán wēnróu de shuō: “Nǐ shì bù shì gāi chūyuàn le?”
sentences.english: The doctor looked at him and suddenly said gently, "Isn't it time for you to be discharged from the hospital?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫彻底糊涂了，他问：“你们在说什么？谁住院了？谁出院了？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi chèdǐ hútu le, tā wèn: “Nǐmen zài shuō shénme? Shéi zhùyuàn le? Shéi chūyuàn le?”
sentences.english: David was completely bewildered and asked, "What are you talking about? Who was hospitalized? Who is being discharged?"

sentences.chinese: 陌生人笑着说：“我只是在休假，但我的假期结束了。”
sentences.pinyin: Mòshēngrén xiàozhe shuō: “Wǒ zhǐshì zài xiūjià, dàn wǒ de jiàqī jiéshù le.”
sentences.english: The stranger smiled and said, "I'm just on vacation, but my holiday is over."

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，大卫的手机响了，是他点的一份外卖到了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, Dàwèi de shǒujī xiǎng le, shì tā diǎn de yī fèn wàimài dào le.
sentences.english: Just then, David's phone rang; the takeout he ordered had arrived.

sentences.chinese: 他想离开这个奇怪的办公室，赶紧走向出口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng líkāi zhège qíguài de bàngōngshì, gǎnjǐn zǒuxiàng chūkǒu.
sentences.english: He wanted to leave this strange office and hurried toward the exit.

sentences.chinese: 他在门口遇到一个骑车的人，不得不停下来问路。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài ménkǒu yùdào yīgè qíchē de rén, bùdébù tíng xiàlái wènlù.
sentences.english: At the door, he met someone riding a bike and had to stop to ask for directions.

sentences.chinese: 那个人告诉他，去机场的路很近，飞机马上就要起飞了。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge rén gàosù tā, qù jīchǎng de lù hěn jìn, fēijī mǎshàng jiù yào qǐfēi le.
sentences.english: That person told him the way to the airport was very close and the plane was about to take off.

sentences.chinese: 陌生人突然大喊：“我的笔记本！我要带着它出门！”
sentences.pinyin: Mòshēngrén tūrán dàhǎn: “Wǒ de bǐjìběn! Wǒ yào dàizhe tā chūmén!”
sentences.english: The stranger suddenly shouted, "My notebook! I need to take it with me when I leave!"

sentences.chinese: 医生笑着对他挥手，说：“祝你一路平安！”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng xiàozhe duì tā huīshǒu, shuō: “Zhù nǐ yī lù píng ān!”
sentences.english: The doctor smiled and waved at him, saying, "Have a pleasant journey!"

sentences.chinese: 陌生人也笑着回答：“谢谢，祝你也一路顺风！”
sentences.pinyin: Mòshēngrén yě xiàozhe huídá: “Xièxiè, zhù nǐ yě yī lù shùn fēng!”
sentences.english: The stranger also smiled and replied, "Thanks, bon voyage to you too!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着他们两个，觉得这简直是一场噩梦。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe tāmen liǎng gè, juéde zhè jiǎnzhí shì yī chǎng èmèng.
sentences.english: David looked at the two of them and felt this was simply a nightmare.

sentences.chinese: 就在大卫准备走的时候，他发现自己的笔记本里多了一张机票！
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài Dàwèi zhǔnbèi zǒu de shíhòu, tā fāxiàn zìjǐ de bǐjìběn lǐ duōle yī zhāng jīpiào!
sentences.english: Just as David was preparing to leave, he discovered there was an extra plane ticket in his notebook!

sentences.chinese: 机票上的目的地竟然是一个他从未听过的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Jīpiào shàng de mùdìdì jìngrán shì yīgè tā cóngwèi tīngguò de dìfāng.
sentences.english: The destination on the ticket was actually a place he had never heard of before.

chapters.title_chinese: 第七章：机票与奇怪的功课
chapters.title_english: Chapter 7: The Ticket and the Strange Homework

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着机票，觉得生活突然变了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe jīpiào, juéde shēnghuó tūrán biàn le.
sentences.english: David looked at the ticket and felt that his life had suddenly changed.

sentences.chinese: 他想起昨天的中文课，老师要求大家写一篇作文。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zuótiān de Zhōngwén kè, lǎoshī yāoqiú dàjiā xiě yì piān zuòwén.
sentences.english: He recalled yesterday's Chinese class, where the teacher required everyone to write an essay.

sentences.chinese: 他现在根本没有心情复习课文，因为这张机票太奇怪了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiànzài gēnběn méiyǒu xīnqíng fùxí kèwén, yīnwèi zhè zhāng jīpiào tài qíguài le.
sentences.english: He was in no mood at all to review the lesson now because this ticket was too strange.

sentences.chinese: 他决定和那个拿着笔记本的陌生人商量这件事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juédìng hé nàge názhe bǐjìběn de mòshēngrén shāngliang zhè jiàn shì.
sentences.english: He decided to consult with the stranger holding the notebook about this matter.

sentences.chinese: 大卫请求他解释一下这张机票是怎么回事。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi qǐngqiú tā jiěshì yíxià zhè zhāng jīpiào shì zěnme huí shì.
sentences.english: David requested him to explain what was going on with this ticket.

sentences.chinese: 陌生人笑了，开始讲一个很长的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Mòshēngrén xiào le, kāishǐ jiǎng yí gè hěn cháng de gùshì.
sentences.english: The stranger smiled and began to tell a very long story.

sentences.chinese: 他说这个地方的天气很冷，经常是零下十度。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō zhège dìfāng de tiānqì hěn lěng, jīngcháng shì língxià shí dù.
sentences.english: He said the weather in that place was very cold, often ten degrees below zero.

sentences.chinese: 大卫听得入神，觉得自己像是在听讲一个古老的传说。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi tīng de rùshén, juéde zìjǐ xiàng shì zài tīngjiǎng yí gè gǔlǎo de chuánshuō.
sentences.english: David listened intently, feeling as if he were attending a lecture on an ancient legend.

sentences.chinese: 两人开始讨论这个目的地的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng rén kāishǐ tǎolùn zhège mùdìdì de míngzi.
sentences.english: The two began to discuss the name of this destination.

sentences.chinese: 陌生人提到，那个地方的人说话很有趣。
sentences.pinyin: Mòshēngrén tídào, nàge dìfāng de rén shuōhuà hěn yǒuqù.
sentences.english: The stranger mentioned that the people in that place spoke very interestingly.

sentences.chinese: 他故意重复了一个很长的音节，听起来像是在唱歌。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gùyì chóngfù le yí gè hěn cháng de yīnjié, tīng qǐlái xiàng shì zài chànggē.
sentences.english: He intentionally repeated a very long syllable, which sounded like singing.

sentences.chinese: 大卫试图模仿那个音节，但结果像是在哭。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi shìtú mófǎng nàge yīnjié, dàn jiéguǒ xiàng shì zài kū.
sentences.english: David tried to imitate that syllable, but the result sounded like he was crying.

sentences.chinese: 陌生人说：“你的发音需要改，得改变一下方式。”
sentences.pinyin: Mòshēngrén shuō: “Nǐ de fāyīn xūyào gǎi, děi gǎibiàn yíxià fāngshì.”
sentences.english: The stranger said, "Your pronunciation needs to be corrected; you have to change the method."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这个对话越来越像一场喜剧。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéde zhège duìhuà yuè lái yuè xiàng yì chǎng xǐjù.
sentences.english: David felt that this conversation was becoming more and more like a comedy.

sentences.chinese: 陌生人突然讲话，说他可以帮大卫换一张机票。
sentences.pinyin: Mòshēngrén tūrán jiǎnghuà, shuō tā kěyǐ bāng Dàwèi huàn yì zhāng jīpiào.
sentences.english: The stranger suddenly spoke, saying he could help David exchange the ticket.

sentences.chinese: 大卫问：“为什么要把机票换掉？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi wèn: “Wèishéme yào bǎ jīpiào huàndiào?”
sentences.english: David asked, "Why change the ticket?"

sentences.chinese: 陌生人说，如果他想去一个更温暖的地方，可以改机票日期。
sentences.pinyin: Mòshēngrén shuō, rúguǒ tā xiǎng qù yí gè gèng wēnnuǎn de dìfāng, kěyǐ gǎi jīpiào rìqī.
sentences.english: The stranger said if he wanted to go to a warmer place, he could change the ticket date.

sentences.chinese: 大卫想到了一个重点：他还没交那篇作文！
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎngdào le yí gè zhòngdiǎn: tā hái méi jiāo nà piān zuòwén!
sentences.english: David thought of a key point: he hadn't handed in that essay yet!

sentences.chinese: 他赶紧翻开笔记本，发现笔记本里的内容也改变了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎnjǐn fān kāi bǐjìběn, fāxiàn bǐjìběn lǐ de nèiróng yě gǎibiàn le.
sentences.english: He hurriedly opened his notebook and found that the content inside had also changed.

sentences.chinese: 原来的笔记不见了，变成了一篇关于中医的奇怪论文。
sentences.pinyin: Yuánlái de bǐjì bújiàn le, biànchéng le yì piān guānyú zhōngyī de qíguài lùnwén.
sentences.english: The original notes were gone, transformed into a strange thesis about traditional Chinese medicine.

sentences.chinese: 大卫惊呆了，他不知道该怎么面对老师。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi jīngdāi le, tā bù zhīdào gāi zěnme miànduì lǎoshī.
sentences.english: David was stunned; he didn't know how to face the teacher.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着笔记本里关于中医的论文，觉得这是一件非常奇怪的事情。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi kàn zhe bǐ jì běn lǐ guān yú zhōng yī de lùn wén, jué de zhè shì yī jiàn fēi cháng qí guài de shì qing.
sentences.english: David looked at the thesis about Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) in his notebook and felt this was a very strange matter.

sentences.chinese: 他原本以为那是他的英语作文，结果变成了中医的秘密指南。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yuán běn yǐ wéi nà shì tā de yīng yǔ zuò wén, jié guǒ biàn chéng le zhōng yī de mì mì zhǐ nán.
sentences.english: He had originally thought it was his English essay, but it had turned into a secret guide to TCM.

sentences.chinese: 他心中感到非常不安，因为他完全不懂这些复杂的词语。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xīn zhōng gǎn dào fēi cháng bù ān, yīn wèi tā wán quán bù dǒng zhè xiē fù zá de cí yǔ.
sentences.english: He felt very uneasy in his heart because he completely didn't understand these complex words.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试读了几遍，但还是没有懂得这些文字的意思。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cháng shì dú le jǐ biàn, dàn hái shì méi yǒu dǒng de zhè xiē wén zì de yì si.
sentences.english: He tried reading it a few times, but still didn't comprehend the meaning of these characters.

sentences.chinese: 此时，那个拿着双胞胎笔记本的陌生人走过来，样子看起来很自信。
sentences.pinyin: Cǐ shí, nà gè ná zhe shuāng bāo tāi bǐ jì běn de mò shēng rén zǒu guò lái, yàng zi kàn qǐ lái hěn zì xìn.
sentences.english: At this moment, the stranger holding the twin notebook walked over, looking very confident.

sentences.chinese: 陌生人说：“你不需要担心，这种事情在我们的俱乐部很常见。”
sentences.pinyin: Mò shēng rén shuō: “Nǐ bù xū yào dān xīn, zhè zhǒng shì qing zài wǒ men de jù lè bù hěn cháng jiàn.”
sentences.english: The stranger said, "You don't need to worry; this kind of thing is very common in our club."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这个人的态度太奇怪了，像是在开玩笑。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi jué de zhè gè rén de tài du tài qí guài le, xiàng shì zài kāi wán xiào.
sentences.english: David felt this person's attitude was too strange, as if he were joking.

sentences.chinese: 他问：“我应该怎么把我的作文找出来？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn: “Wǒ yīng gāi zěn me bǎ wǒ de zuò wén zhǎo chū lái?”
sentences.english: He asked, "How should I find my essay?"

sentences.chinese: 陌生人笑了笑，说：“你的想法太简单了，我们需要一个更好的办法。”
sentences.pinyin: Mò shēng rén xiào le xiào, shuō: “Nǐ de xiǎng fǎ tài jiǎn dān le, wǒ men xū yào yī gè gèng hǎo de bàn fǎ.”
sentences.english: The stranger smiled and said, "Your way of thinking is too simple; we need a better method."

sentences.chinese: 大卫感到很困惑，他的心情变得非常糟糕。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi gǎn dào hěn kùn huò, tā de xīn qíng biàn de fēi cháng zāo gāo.
sentences.english: David felt very confused, and his mood became very bad.

sentences.chinese: 他听说这个俱乐部的人都很有趣，但现在他觉得这像是一场噩梦。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīng shuō zhè gè jù lè bù de rén dōu hěn yǒu qù, dàn xiàn zài tā jué de zhè xiàng shì yī chǎng è mèng.
sentences.english: He had heard that the people in this club were very interesting, but now he felt this was like a nightmare.

sentences.chinese: 陌生人告诉他，如果他努力学习中医，可能会在很多方面获得进步。
sentences.pinyin: Mò shēng rén gào su tā, rú guǒ tā nǔ lì xué xí zhōng yī, kě néng huì zài hěn duō fāng miàn huò dé jìn bù.
sentences.english: The stranger told him that if he worked hard to study TCM, he might make progress in many aspects.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着他，心中没有信心，因为他根本不关心中医。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi kàn zhe tā, xīn zhōng méi yǒu xìn xīn, yīn wèi tā gēn běn bù guān xīn zhōng yī.
sentences.english: David looked at him, lacking confidence in his heart, because he didn't care about TCM at all.

sentences.chinese: 他问：“你这种做法能帮我交作业吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn: “Nǐ zhè zhǒng zuò fǎ néng bāng wǒ jiāo zuò yè ma?”
sentences.english: He asked, "Can this way of handling things help me hand in my homework?"

sentences.chinese: 陌生人说：“你可以尝试写一封信给老师，告诉他你的笔记本被‘魔法’改变了。”
sentences.pinyin: Mò shēng rén shuō: “Nǐ kě yǐ cháng shì xiě yī fēng xìn gěi lǎo shī, gào su tā nǐ de bǐ jì běn bèi ‘mó fǎ’ gǎi biàn le.”
sentences.english: The stranger said, "You could try writing a letter to the teacher, telling him your notebook was changed by 'magic'."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这个意见太糟糕了，老师绝对不会相信这种理由。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi jué de zhè gè yì jiàn tài zāo gāo le, lǎo shī jué duì bù huì xìn zhè zhǒng lǐ yóu.
sentences.english: David felt this suggestion was too terrible; the teacher would definitely not trust such a reason.

sentences.chinese: 他开始数笔记本里的页数，试图找出原来作文的痕迹。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kāi shǐ shǔ bǐ jì běn lǐ de yè shù, shì tú zhǎo chū yuán lái zuò wén de hén jī.
sentences.english: He began to count the pages in the notebook, trying to find traces of the original essay.

sentences.chinese: 他发现每一页都被中医的知识填满了，完全没有影响到排版。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn měi yī yè dōu bèi zhōng yī de zhī shi tián mǎn le, wán quán méi yǒu yǐng xiǎng dào pái bǎn.
sentences.english: He discovered that every page was filled with TCM knowledge, without affecting the layout at all.

sentences.chinese: 大卫想到，如果他现在就离开，也许能去图书馆重新写一遍。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi xiǎng dào, rú guǒ tā xiàn zài jiù lí kāi, yě xǔ néng qù tú shū guǎn chóng xīn xiě yī biàn.
sentences.english: David thought that if he left now, maybe he could go to the library and rewrite it.

sentences.chinese: 他打算立刻走掉，但陌生人突然拉住了他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dǎ suàn lì kè zǒu diào, dàn mò shēng rén tū rán lā zhù le tā.
sentences.english: He planned to leave immediately, but the stranger suddenly grabbed him.

sentences.chinese: “你应该先参观一下我们的秘密药房，”陌生人建议道。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ yīng gāi xiān cān guān yī xià wǒ men de mì mì yào fáng,” mò shēng rén jiàn yì dào.
sentences.english: "You should first tour our secret pharmacy," the stranger suggested.

sentences.chinese: 大卫感觉自己被卷入了一个巨大的阴谋，但他好奇心太强了。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi gǎn jué zì jǐ bèi juǎn rù le yī gè jù dà de yīn mó, dàn tā hào qí xīn tài qiáng le.
sentences.english: David felt he was being sucked into a huge conspiracy, but his curiosity was too strong.

sentences.chinese: 他小心地跟着陌生人走在走廊里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎo xīn de gēn zhe mò shēng rén zǒu zài zǒu láng lǐ.
sentences.english: He carefully followed the stranger down the corridor.

sentences.chinese: 他发现这里的装修风格很独特，让他感觉像回到了古代中国。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn zhè lǐ de zhuāng xiū fēng gé hěn dú tè, ràng tā gǎn jué xiàng huí dào le gǔ dài zhōng guó.
sentences.english: He noticed the decoration style here was very unique, making him feel as if he had returned to ancient China.

sentences.chinese: 陌生人说：“在医学方面，我们需要不同的感觉来判断病情。”
sentences.pinyin: Mò shēng rén shuō: “Zài yī xué fāng miàn, wǒ men xū yào bù tóng de gǎn jué lái pàn duàn bìng qíng.”
sentences.english: The stranger said, "In the medical field, we need different sensations to judge the condition."

sentences.chinese: 大卫听得一脸茫然，他完全不明白对方在说什么。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi tīng de yī liǎn máng rán, tā wán quán bù míng bái duì fāng zài shuō shén me.
sentences.english: David listened with a blank expression; he completely didn't understand what the other person was saying.

sentences.chinese: 他心想：我的英语老师如果看到我在这里参观药房，一定会很惊讶。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xīn xiǎng: Wǒ de yīng yǔ lǎo shī rú guǒ kàn dào wǒ zài zhè lǐ cān guān yào fáng, yī dìng huì hěn jīng yà.
sentences.english: He thought to himself: If my English teacher saw me touring a pharmacy here, he would be very surprised.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，他发现墙上挂着一张照片，照片里的人竟然长得像他！
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, tā fā xiàn qiáng shàng guà zhe yī zhāng zhào piàn, zhào piàn lǐ de rén jìng rán zhǎng de xiàng tā!
sentences.english: Just then, he noticed a photo hanging on the wall; the person in the photo actually looked like him!

sentences.chinese: 大卫惊呆了，他意识到这件事情比他想象的要复杂得多。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi jīng dāi le, tā yì shí dào zhè jiàn shì qing bǐ tā xiǎng xiàng de yào fù zá de duō.
sentences.english: David was stunned; he realized this matter was much more complex than he had imagined.

sentences.chinese: 他赶紧问：“为什么照片里的人是我？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎn jǐn wèn: “Wèi shén me zhào piàn lǐ de rén shì wǒ?”
sentences.english: He quickly asked, "Why is the person in the photo me?"

sentences.chinese: 陌生人神秘地笑了，说：“这就是我们要讨论的重点。”
sentences.pinyin: Mò shēng rén shén mì de xiào le, shuō: “Zhè jiù shì wǒ men yào tǎo lùn de zhòng diǎn.”
sentences.english: The stranger smiled mysteriously and said, "That is exactly the point we need to discuss."

sentences.chinese: 突然，走廊尽头的门开了，一个穿着白衣服的人拿着一张信封走了出来。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, zǒu láng jìn tóu de mén kāi le, yī gè chuān zhe bái yī fú de rén ná zhe yī zhāng xìn fēng zǒu le chū lái.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the door at the end of the corridor opened, and a person in white clothes walked out holding an envelope.

sentences.chinese: 那个穿着白衣服的人走过来，他叫段先生。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge chuānzhe bái yīfú de rén zǒu guòlái, tā jiào Duàn xiānshēng.
sentences.english: The person wearing white clothes walked over; his name was Mr. Duan.

sentences.chinese: 他把信封给大卫，并说这是一个重要的通知。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ xìnfēng gěi Dàwèi, bìng shuō zhè shì yīgè zhòngyào de tōngzhī.
sentences.english: He gave the envelope to David and said it was an important notice.

sentences.chinese: 大卫打开信封，发现里面是一张奇怪的检查表。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi dǎkāi xìnfēng, fāxiàn lǐmiàn shì yī zhāng qíguài de jiǎnchá biǎo.
sentences.english: David opened the envelope and found a strange inspection form inside.

sentences.chinese: 段先生认真地看着大卫，说他需要检查大卫的身体。
sentences.pinyin: Duàn xiānshēng rènzhēn de kànzhe Dàwèi, shuō tā xūyào jiǎnchá Dàwèi de shēntǐ.
sentences.english: Mr. Duan looked at David seriously and said he needed to examine David's body.

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这像个笑话，因为他身体很好。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juédé zhè xiàng gè xiàohua, yīnwèi tā shēntǐ hěn hǎo.
sentences.english: David felt this was like a joke because he was in great health.

sentences.chinese: 段先生认为，大卫的颜色看起来不对，脸太白了。
sentences.pinyin: Duàn xiānshēng rènwéi, Dàwèi de yánsè kàn qǐlái bùduì, liǎn tài bái le.
sentences.english: Mr. Duan believed that David's complexion looked wrong—his face was too pale.

sentences.chinese: 他拿出一瓶绿色的药水，说这能照顾大卫的健康。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū yī píng lǜsè de yàoshuǐ, shuō zhè néng zhàogù Dàwèi de jiànkāng.
sentences.english: He took out a bottle of green liquid medicine, saying it could take care of David's health.

sentences.chinese: 大卫不想喝，但段先生说这药水对青少年很有帮助。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi bù xiǎng hē, dàn Duàn xiānshēng shuō zhè yàoshuǐ duì qīngshàonián hěn yǒu bāngzhù.
sentences.english: David didn't want to drink it, but Mr. Duan said this liquid medicine was very helpful for teenagers.

sentences.chinese: 大卫问：“这有什么道理？我只是个学生！”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi wèn: “Zhè yǒu shéme dàolǐ? Wǒ zhǐshì gè xuéshēng!”
sentences.english: David asked, "What's the logic in this? I'm just a student!"

sentences.chinese: 段先生解释说，他的观点是大卫太累了。
sentences.pinyin: Duàn xiānshēng jiěshì shuō, tā de guāndiǎn shì Dàwèi tài lèi le.
sentences.english: Mr. Duan explained that his viewpoint was that David was too tired.

sentences.chinese: 他说明这瓶药水可以让大卫变得聪明。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuōmíng zhè píng yàoshuǐ kěyǐ ràng Dàwèi biàn dé cōngmíng.
sentences.english: He explained that this bottle of liquid medicine could make David smarter.

sentences.chinese: 大卫不相信，因为这听起来太奇怪了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi bù xiāngxìn, yīnwèi zhè tīng qǐlái tài qíguài le.
sentences.english: David didn't believe it because it sounded too strange.

sentences.chinese: 段先生说：“在我的看法里，你现在的状态很糟糕。”
sentences.pinyin: Duàn xiānshēng shuō: “Zài wǒ de kànfǎ lǐ, nǐ xiànzài de zhuàngtài hěn zāogāo.”
sentences.english: Mr. Duan said, "In my view, your current state is very bad."

sentences.chinese: 他认为大卫应该重视身体，而不是只看笔记本。
sentences.pinyin: Tā rènwéi Dàwèi yīnggāi zhòngshì shēntǐ, ér bùshì zhǐ kàn bǐjìběn.
sentences.english: He believed David should value his health instead of just looking at the notebook.

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得段先生的观点很奇怪，但这部分解释还算合理。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juédé Duàn xiānshēng de guāndiǎn hěn qíguài, dàn zhè bùfen jiěshì hái suàn hélǐ.
sentences.english: David felt Mr. Duan's point of view was strange, but this part of the explanation was considered reasonable.

sentences.chinese: 突然，段先生问大卫怎么来这里的。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, Duàn xiānshēng wèn Dàwèi zěnme lái zhèlǐ de.
sentences.english: Suddenly, Mr. Duan asked David how he got here.

sentences.chinese: 大卫说他坐地铁来的，因为比出租车快。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi shuō tā zuò dìtiě lái de, yīnwèi bǐ chūzūchē kuài.
sentences.english: David said he took the subway because it was faster than a taxi.

sentences.chinese: 段先生点点头，说地铁里的人太多，不健康。
sentences.pinyin: Duàn xiānshēng diǎntóu, shuō dìtiě lǐ de rén tài duō, bù jiànkāng.
sentences.english: Mr. Duan nodded and said there are too many people in the subway, which is unhealthy.

sentences.chinese: 他建议大卫多吃天然食物，少喝咖啡。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiànyì Dàwèi duō chī tiānrán shíwù, shǎo hē kāfēi.
sentences.english: He suggested David eat more natural food and drink less coffee.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着那瓶绿色的药水，突然觉得肚子很饿。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe nà píng lǜsè de yàoshuǐ, tūrán juédé dùzi hěn è.
sentences.english: David looked at the bottle of green liquid medicine and suddenly felt very hungry.

sentences.chinese: 就在他准备喝药水的时候，药水瓶突然爆炸了！
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tā zhǔnbèi hē yàoshuǐ de shíhòu, yàoshuǐ píng tūrán bàozhà le!
sentences.english: Just as he was preparing to drink the liquid, the bottle suddenly exploded!

sentences.chinese: 绿色的药水爆炸了，大卫的脸上全是绿色的液体。
sentences.pinyin: Lǜ sè de yào shuǐ bào zhà le, Dà wèi de liǎn shàng quán shì lǜ sè de yè tǐ.
sentences.english: The green potion exploded, and David's face was covered in green liquid.

sentences.chinese: 段先生没有惊讶，他只是拿出一张长长的纸。
sentences.pinyin: Duàn xiān sheng méi yǒu jīng yà, tā zhǐ shì ná chū yī zhāng cháng cháng de zhǐ.
sentences.english: Mr. Duan was not surprised; he simply took out a long piece of paper.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“看，这就是我们要找的人，他们的姓名都在这里。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Kàn, zhè jiù shì wǒ men yào zhǎo de rén, tā men de xìng míng dōu zài zhè lǐ.”
sentences.english: He said, "Look, these are the people we are looking for; their full names are all here."

sentences.chinese: 大卫擦了擦脸，好奇地看着这张名单。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi cā le cā liǎn, hào qí de kàn zhe zhè zhāng míng dān.
sentences.english: David wiped his face and looked at the list curiously.

sentences.chinese: 名单上的名字非常奇怪，像是一个名字博物馆。
sentences.pinyin: Míng dān shàng de míng zì fēi cháng qí guài, xiàng shì yī gè míng zì bó wù guǎn.
sentences.english: The names on the list were very strange, like a museum of names.

sentences.chinese: 第一个名字叫东方，第二个叫全，第三个叫凉。
sentences.pinyin: Dì yī gè míng zì jiào Dōng fāng, dì èr gè jiào Quán, dì sān gè jiào Liáng.
sentences.english: The first name was Dongfang, the second was Quan, and the third was Liang.

sentences.chinese: 大卫问：“这些人是谁？他们是你的病人吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi wèn: “Zhè xiē rén shì shuí? Tā men shì nǐ de bìng rén ma?”
sentences.english: David asked, "Who are these people? Are they your patients?"

sentences.chinese: 段先生说：“不，他们是一个特殊的秘密小组。”
sentences.pinyin: Duàn xiān sheng shuō: “Bù, tā men shì yī gè tè shū de mì mì xiǎo zǔ.”
sentences.english: Mr. Duan said, "No, they are a special secret group."

sentences.chinese: 名单继续写着：加、向、周，还有封和平。
sentences.pinyin: Míng dān jì xù xiě zhe: Jiā, Xiàng, Zhōu, hái yǒu Fēng hé Píng.
sentences.english: The list continued: Jia, Xiang, Zhou, and also Feng and Ping.

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这太荒谬了，他问：“真的有人姓怕吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi jué de zhè tài huāng miù le, tā wèn: “Zhēn de yǒu rén xìng Pà ma?”
sentences.english: David thought this was too absurd and asked, "Is there really someone with the surname Pa?"

sentences.chinese: 段先生点点头说：“是的，怕先生是个很胆小的人。”
sentences.pinyin: Duàn xiān sheng diǎn diǎn tóu shuō: “Shì de, Pà xiān sheng shì gè hěn dǎn xiǎo de rén.”
sentences.english: Mr. Duan nodded and said, "Yes, Mr. Pa is a very timid person."

sentences.chinese: 接着是成、查、海、米，然后是红、组和蓝。
sentences.pinyin: Jiē zhe shì Chéng, Zhā, Hǎi, Mǐ, rán hòu shì Hóng, Zǔ hé Lán.
sentences.english: Next were Cheng, Zha, Hai, Mi, and then Hong, Zu, and Lan.

sentences.chinese: 大卫大笑起来，他说：“这不像一个名单，像是一盒彩色铅笔！”
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi dà xiào qǐ lái, tā shuō: “Zhè bù xiàng yī gè míng dān, xiàng shì yī hé cǎi sè qiān bǐ!”
sentences.english: David burst out laughing and said, "This doesn't look like a list; it looks like a box of colored pencils!"

sentences.chinese: 段先生严肃地说：“你没见过这么专业的名单吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Duàn xiān sheng yán sù de shuō: “Nǐ méi jiàn guò zhè me zhuān yè de míng dān ma?”
sentences.english: Mr. Duan said seriously, "Have you never seen such a professional list?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫摇摇头，继续往下看，发现了闻、阴、雪和题。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi yáo yáo tóu, jì xù wǎng xià kàn, fā xiàn le Wén, Yīn, Xuě hé Tí.
sentences.english: David shook his head and continued looking down, discovering Wen, Yin, Xue, and Ti.

sentences.chinese: 最后一个人叫黄，他的名字下面画了一个大圈。
sentences.pinyin: Zuì hòu yī gè rén jiào Huáng, tā de míng zì xià miàn huà le yī gè dà quān.
sentences.english: The last person was named Huang, and there was a big circle drawn under his name.

sentences.chinese: 大卫突然意识到，这些名字的第一个字组合起来像是一首诗。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi tū rán yì shí dào, zhè xiē míng zì de dì yī gè zì zǔ hé qǐ lái xiàng shì yī shǒu shī.
sentences.english: David suddenly realized that the first characters of these names combined like a poem.

sentences.chinese: 他问段先生：“为什么这些人都在这里？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn Duàn xiān sheng: “Wèi shé me zhè xiē rén dōu zài zhè lǐ?”
sentences.english: He asked Mr. Duan, "Why are all these people here?"

sentences.chinese: 段先生看着大卫，神秘地笑了笑。
sentences.pinyin: Duàn xiān sheng kàn zhe Dà wèi, mì mì de xiào le xiào.
sentences.english: Mr. Duan looked at David and smiled mysteriously.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“因为他们都丢失了笔记本，就像你一样。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Yīn wèi tā men dōu diū shī le bǐ jì běn, jiù xiàng nǐ yī yàng.”
sentences.english: He said, "Because they all lost their notebooks, just like you."

sentences.chinese: 大卫惊呆了，他看着自己被药水染绿的手。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi jīng dāi le, tā kàn zhe zì jǐ bèi yào shuǐ rǎn lǜ de shǒu.
sentences.english: David was stunned, looking at his hand dyed green by the potion.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，门外传来了巨大的脚步声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, mén wài chuán lái le jù dà de jiǎo bù shēng.
sentences.english: Just then, loud footsteps sounded from outside the door.

sentences.chinese: 一个巨大的阴影出现在门后，大卫觉得这次真的麻烦了。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè jù dà de yīn yǐng chū xiàn zài mén hòu, Dà wèi jué de zhè cì zhēn de má fan le.
sentences.english: A huge shadow appeared behind the door, and David felt that this time it was really trouble.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十一章：绿色的巨人和奇怪的体育馆
chapters.title_english: Chapter 11: The Green Giant and the Strange Gym

sentences.chinese: 那个巨大的阴影走进了房间，大卫吓得差点跳起来。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge jùdà de yīnyǐng zǒu jìnle fángjiān, Dàwèi xià de chàdiǎn tiào qǐlái.
sentences.english: The huge shadow walked into the room, and David almost jumped out of his skin.

sentences.chinese: 他的个子非常高，像一座小山一样。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de gèzi fēicháng gāo, xiàng yī zuò xiǎo shān yīyàng.
sentences.english: His height was very tall, like a small mountain.

sentences.chinese: 这个人穿着一件巨大的黑色大衣，遮住了身体的一部分。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège rén chuānzhe yī jiàn jùdà de hēisè dàyī, zhēzhùle shēntǐ de yī bù fen.
sentences.english: This person was wearing a huge black overcoat, which covered a portion of his body.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着他的头，发现他竟然在笑。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe tā de tóu, fāxiàn tā jìngrán zài xiào.
sentences.english: David looked at his head and found that he was actually smiling.

sentences.chinese: “你好，大卫，”这个人的声音非常大，像雷一样响。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ hǎo, Dàwèi,” zhège rén de shēngyīn fēicháng dà, xiàng léi yīyàng xiǎng.
sentences.english: “Hello, David,” this person's voice was very loud, echoing like thunder.

sentences.chinese: 大卫张开嘴，但一个字也说不出来。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi zhāngkāi zuǐ, dàn yīgè zì yě shuō bù chūlái.
sentences.english: David opened his mouth, but couldn't say a single word.

sentences.chinese: 段先生笑着说：“这是我们的体育中心主任，王先生。”
sentences.pinyin: Duàn xiānshēng xiàozhe shuō: “Zhè shì wǒmen de tǐyù zhōngxīn zhǔrèn, Wáng xiānshēng.”
sentences.english: Mr. Duan smiled and said, “This is the director of our sports center, Mr. Wang.”

sentences.chinese: 王先生说，他来自南方的一个小城市，那里的人口不多。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng xiānshēng shuō, tā láizì nánfāng de yīgè xiǎo chéngshì, nàlǐ de rénkǒu bù duō.
sentences.english: Mr. Wang said he came from a small city in the South, where the population is not large.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉大卫，这里的主要习惯是每天运动。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Dàwèi, zhèlǐ de zhǔyào xíguàn shì měitiān yùndòng.
sentences.english: He told David that the main habit here is to exercise every day.

sentences.chinese: 王先生拿出一张图片，上面是一个巨大的体育馆。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng xiānshēng ná chū yī zhāng túpiàn, shàngmiàn shì yīgè jùdà de tǐyùguǎn.
sentences.english: Mr. Wang took out a picture, which showed a huge gymnasium.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“今天是我们公司的十周年纪念日，我们要去那里庆祝。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Jīntiān shì wǒmen gōngsī de shí zhōunián jìniàn rì, wǒmen yào qù nàlǐ qìngzhù.”
sentences.english: He said, “Today is the tenth anniversary of our company, and we are going there to celebrate.”

sentences.chinese: 大卫很困惑，他问：“为什么一个公司要在体育馆庆祝？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi hěn kùnhuò, tā wèn: “Wèishéme yīgè gōngsī yào zài tǐyùguǎn qìngzhù?”
sentences.english: David was confused and asked, “Why would a company celebrate in a gym?”

sentences.chinese: 王先生解释说，这是为了庆祝他们在这个城市建立的名称。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng xiānshēng jiěshì shuō, zhè shì wèile qìngzhù tāmen zài zhège chéngshì jiànlì de míngchēng.
sentences.english: Mr. Wang explained that this was to celebrate the name they established in this city.

sentences.chinese: 大卫低头看了看自己绿色的手，觉得这才是最奇怪的原因。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi dītóu kànle kàn zìjǐ lǜsè de shǒu, juéde zhè cáishì zuì qíguài de yuányīn.
sentences.english: David looked down at his green hands and felt that this was the strangest cause of all.

sentences.chinese: “你的手怎么变成绿色的了？”王先生好奇地问。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ de shǒu zěnme biàn chéng lǜsè de le?” Wáng xiānshēng hàoqí dì wèn.
sentences.english: “Why have your hands turned green?” Mr. Wang asked curiously.

sentences.chinese: 大卫赶紧把手藏在身后，因为他不想讨论那个爆炸的药水。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi gǎnjǐn bǎ shǒu cáng zài shēnhòu, yīnwèi tā bù xiǎng tǎolùn nàge bàozhà de yàoshuǐ.
sentences.english: David quickly hid his hands behind his back because he didn't want to discuss that exploding potion.

sentences.chinese: 他突然想起自己的作业还没写完，分数可能会很低。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ de zuòyè hái méi xiě wán, fēnshù kěnéng huì hěn dī.
sentences.english: He suddenly remembered that his homework wasn't finished yet, and his grade might be very low.

sentences.chinese: 他问王先生：“这里有网络吗？我需要发送一条信息给老师。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn Wáng xiānshēng: “Zhèlǐ yǒu wǎngluò ma? Wǒ xūyào fāsòng yī tiáo xìnxī gěi lǎoshī.”
sentences.english: He asked Mr. Wang, “Is there internet here? I need to send a message to my teacher.”

sentences.chinese: 王先生指了指窗外，那里有一条很长的公路。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng xiānshēng zhǐle zhǐ chuāngwài, nàlǐ yǒu yī tiáo hěn cháng de gōnglù.
sentences.english: Mr. Wang pointed out the window, where there was a very long highway.

sentences.chinese: “公路那边就是公园，公园对面是停车场，那里有网络。”
sentences.pinyin: “Gōnglù nàbiān jiùshì gōngyuán, gōngyuán duìmiàn shì tíngchēchǎng, nàlǐ yǒu wǎngluò.”
sentences.english: “Across the highway is the park, and opposite the park is the parking lot; there is internet there.”

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这个城市的布局像大海一样复杂，让他头晕。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéde zhège chéngshì de bùjú xiàng dàhǎi yīyàng fùzá, ràng tā tóuyūn.
sentences.english: David felt the layout of this city was as complex as the ocean, making him dizzy.

sentences.chinese: 他看着天上，太阳很大，照在他的脸上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe tiānshàng, tàiyáng hěn dà, zhào zài tā de liǎn shàng.
sentences.english: He looked up at the sky; the sun was huge, shining on his face.

sentences.chinese: 他想起昨晚半夜的时候，他还在想那个奇怪的笔记本。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zuówǎn bànyè de shíhòu, tā hái zài xiǎng nàge qíguài de bǐjìběn.
sentences.english: He remembered that at midnight last night, he was still thinking about that strange notebook.

sentences.chinese: 在夜里，他梦见自己变成了一只绿色的鱼，在水里游泳。
sentences.pinyin: Zài yèlǐ, tā mèngjiàn zìjǐ biànchéngle yī zhǐ lǜsè de yú, zài shuǐ lǐ yóuyǒng.
sentences.english: During the night, he dreamed that he turned into a green fish, swimming in the water.

sentences.chinese: 王先生看着大卫，觉得这个年轻人的表情很有趣。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng xiānshēng kànzhe Dàwèi, juéde zhège niánqīng rén de biǎoqíng hěn yǒuqù.
sentences.english: Mr. Wang looked at David and thought this young man's expression was very interesting.

sentences.chinese: “别担心，大卫，”王先生说，“我们会给你找一个合适的位置。”
sentences.pinyin: “Bié dānxīn, Dàwèi,” Wáng xiānshēng shuō, “wǒmen huì gěi nǐ zhǎo yīgè héshì de wèizhi.”
sentences.english: “Don't worry, David,” Mr. Wang said, “we will find a suitable position for you.”

sentences.chinese: 他指了指地图上的一个点，那个点的大小只有指甲那么大。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐle zhǐ dìtú shàng de yīgè diǎn, nàge diǎn de dàxiǎo zhǐyǒu zhǐjia nàme dà.
sentences.english: He pointed to a spot on the map; the size of that spot was only as big as a fingernail.

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得自己的生活现在变成了一场奇怪的体育比赛。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéde zìjǐ de shēnghuó xiànzài biànchéngle yī chǎng qíguài de tǐyù bǐsài.
sentences.english: David felt his life had now become a strange sports competition.

sentences.chinese: 他跟着王先生走出了房间，走向那个神秘的体育馆。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gēnzhe Wáng xiānshēng zǒu chūle fángjiān, zǒuxiàng nàge shénmì de tǐyùguǎn.
sentences.english: He followed Mr. Wang out of the room and headed toward that mysterious gym.

sentences.chinese: 就在他们快到门口的时候，大卫的笔记本突然在包里响了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tāmen kuài dào ménkǒu de shíhòu, Dàwèi de bǐjìběn tūrán zài bāo lǐ xiǎngle qǐlái.
sentences.english: Just as they were about to reach the door, David's notebook suddenly made a sound in his bag.

sentences.chinese: 他打开笔记本，发现里面出现了一张新的照片。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dǎkāi bǐjìběn, fāxiàn lǐmiàn chūxiànle yī zhāng xīn de zhàopiàn.
sentences.english: He opened the notebook and found a new photo had appeared.

sentences.chinese: 照片里，大卫正穿着一件绿色的衣服，站在大海边，对着镜头笑。
sentences.pinyin: Zhàopiàn lǐ, Dàwèi zhèng chuānzhe yī jiàn lǜsè de yīfú, zhàn zài dàhǎi biān, duìzhe jìngtóu xiào.
sentences.english: In the photo, David was wearing green clothes, standing by the sea, smiling at the camera.

sentences.chinese: 但奇怪的是，照片里的他，头顶上竟然有一个小太阳！
sentences.pinyin: Dàn qíguài de shì, zhàopiàn lǐ de tā, tóudǐng shàng jìngrán yǒu yīgè xiǎo tàiyáng!
sentences.english: But the strange thing was, in the photo, there was actually a small sun on top of his head!

chapters.title_chinese: 第十二章：绿色的梦与奇怪的广场
chapters.title_english: Chapter 12: Green Dreams and the Strange Plaza

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着照片，心里非常奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe zhàopiàn, xīnlǐ fēicháng qíguài.
sentences.english: David looked at the photo, feeling very strange in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 照片里的他站在海边，像个快乐的少年。
sentences.pinyin: Zhàopiàn lǐ de tā zhàn zài hǎibiān, xiàng gè kuàilè de shàonián.
sentences.english: In the photo, he was standing by the seaside, looking like a happy youth.

sentences.chinese: 王先生看着照片，笑了说：“这个学期，你会发现很多有趣的事情。”
sentences.pinyin: Wáng xiānshēng kànzhe zhàopiàn, xiàole shuō: “Zhège xuéqī, nǐ huì fāxiàn hěnduō yǒuqù de shìqíng.”
sentences.english: Mr. Wang looked at the photo and smiled, saying, "This semester, you will discover many interesting things."

sentences.chinese: 大卫问：“这在实际生活中可能吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi wèn: “Zhè zài shíjì shēnghuó zhōng kěnéng ma?”
sentences.english: David asked, "Is this possible in actual life?"

sentences.chinese: 王先生没有回答，而是带他走向体育馆外面。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng xiānshēng méiyǒu huídá, ér shì dài tā zǒuxiàng tǐyùguǎn wàimiàn.
sentences.english: Mr. Wang didn't answer but instead led him outside the gymnasium.

sentences.chinese: 他们走出大门，发现自己站在一个巨大的广场上。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒuchū dàmén, fāxiàn zìjǐ zhàn zài yīgè jùdà de guǎngchǎng shàng.
sentences.english: They walked out the main gate and found themselves standing in a huge public square.

sentences.chinese: 广场中间有一座奇怪的雕像，看起来像一个巨大的洗衣机。
sentences.pinyin: Guǎngchǎng zhōngjiān yǒu yī zuò qíguài de diāoxiàng, kàn qǐlái xiàng yīgè jùdà de xǐyījī.
sentences.english: In the middle of the square was a strange statue that looked like a giant washing machine.

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这太荒谬了，就像在读一本奇怪的小说。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juédé zhè tài huāngmiù le, jiù xiàng zài dú yī běn qíguài de xiǎoshuō.
sentences.english: David thought this was too absurd, like reading a strange novel.

sentences.chinese: 突然，远处传来了“当，当”的声音，像是在敲钟。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yuǎnchù chuánláile “dāng, dāng” de shēngyīn, xiàng shì zài qiāo zhōng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a "dong, dong" sound came from the distance, as if a bell were ringing.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看向声音的方向，发现那里有一条狭窄的小弄堂。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kàn xiàng shēngyīn de fāngxiàng, fāxiàn nàlǐ yǒu yī tiáo xiázhǎi de xiǎo lòngtáng.
sentences.english: David looked in the direction of the sound and found a narrow little alley there.

sentences.chinese: 弄堂里有人在卖旧报纸，报纸上写着一些奇怪的数字。
sentences.pinyin: Lòngtáng lǐ yǒurén zài mài jiù bàozhǐ, bàozhǐ shàng xiězhe yīxiē qíguài de shùzì.
sentences.english: In the alley, someone was selling old newspapers, and the newspapers had some strange numbers written on them.

sentences.chinese: 王先生说：“看，那是寻找真相的方法。”
sentences.pinyin: Wáng xiānshēng shuō: “Kàn, nà shì xúnzhǎo zhēnxiàng de fāngfǎ.”
sentences.english: Mr. Wang said, "Look, that is the method for finding the truth."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得很急，他想知道为什么自己变成了绿色。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juédé hěn jí, tā xiǎng zhīdào wèishéme zìjǐ biànchéngle lǜsè.
sentences.english: David felt urgent; he wanted to know why he had turned green.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一个男人在吃快餐，那个人穿着一件油腻的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào yīgè nánrén zài chī kuàicān, nàgè rén chuānzhe yī jiàn yóunì de yīfú.
sentences.english: He saw a man eating fast food, and that man was wearing greasy clothes.

sentences.chinese: 那个男人看起来像个电影影片里的明星，但现在却很狼狈。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè nánrén kàn qǐlái xiàng gè diànyǐng yǐngpiàn lǐ de míngxīng, dàn xiànzài què hěn lángbèi.
sentences.english: That man looked like a celebrity from a movie film, but now he was in a wretched state.

sentences.chinese: 大卫想：“如果我有机会成为明星，我绝不会穿这样的衣服。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎng: “Rúguǒ wǒ yǒu jīhuì chéngwéi míngxīng, wǒ jué bù huì chuān zhèyàng de yīfú.”
sentences.english: David thought, "If I had the opportunity to become a star, I would never wear clothes like that."

sentences.chinese: 王先生指着天空说：“看，白天的星星。”
sentences.pinyin: Wáng xiānshēng zhǐzhe tiānkōng shuō: “Kàn, báitiān de xīngxing.”
sentences.english: Mr. Wang pointed to the sky and said, "Look, stars in the daytime."

sentences.chinese: 大卫抬头看，虽然是白天，但天空真的有几颗闪亮的星星。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi táitóu kàn, suīrán shì báitiān, dàn tiānkōng zhēnde yǒu jǐ kē shǎnliàng de xīngxing.
sentences.english: David looked up; although it was daytime, there really were a few shining stars in the sky.

sentences.chinese: “我的家庭告诉我，这是不可能的，”大卫喃喃自语。
sentences.pinyin: “Wǒ de jiātíng gàosù wǒ, zhè shì bù kěnéng de,” Dàwèi nánnán zìyǔ.
sentences.english: "My family told me this is impossible," David muttered to himself.

sentences.chinese: 这时，他发现自己的腰带上突然出现了一张小纸条。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, tā fāxiàn zìjǐ de yāodài shàng tūrán chūxiànle yī zhāng xiǎo zhǐtiáo.
sentences.english: At that moment, he discovered a small slip of paper had suddenly appeared on his belt.

sentences.chinese: 纸条上写着：“去寻找关于爱情的故事。”
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐtiáo shàng xiězhe: “Qù xúnzhǎo guānyú àiqíng de gùshì.”
sentences.english: The slip read: "Go find a story about romance."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这太奇怪了，他现在只想洗掉身上的绿色气味。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juédé zhè tài qíguài le, tā xiànzài zhǐ xiǎng xǐ diào shēnshàng de lǜsè qìwèi.
sentences.english: David thought this was too strange; right now, he only wanted to wash off the green smell on his body.

sentences.chinese: 他想起家里那台洗衣机，希望它能把这种绿色洗掉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ jiālǐ nà tái xǐyījī, xīwàng tā néng bǎ zhè zhǒng lǜsè xǐ diào.
sentences.english: He thought of the washing machine at home, hoping it could wash away this kind of green.

sentences.chinese: 王先生突然拿出一盏灯，在白天点亮了它。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng xiānshēng tūrán ná chū yī zhǎn dēng, zài báitiān diǎnliàngle tā.
sentences.english: Mr. Wang suddenly took out a lamp and lit it in broad daylight.

sentences.chinese: 灯光照在另一张照片上，照片里大卫正在旅游。
sentences.pinyin: Dēngguāng zhào zài lìng yī zhāng zhàopiàn shàng, zhàopiàn lǐ Dàwèi zhèngzài lǚyóu.
sentences.english: The light shone on another photograph, in which David was traveling.

sentences.chinese: “你在这个地方见过我吗？”王先生问。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ zài zhège dìfāng jiànguò wǒ ma?” Wáng xiānshēng wèn.
sentences.english: "Have you seen me in this place?" Mr. Wang asked.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着照片，发现自己的成绩单竟然贴在背景的墙上。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe zhàopiàn, fāxiàn zìjǐ de chéngjī dān jìngrán tiē zài bèijǐng de qiáng shàng.
sentences.english: David looked at the photo and discovered that his grade report was actually pasted on the wall in the background.

sentences.chinese: 他的成绩非常糟糕，这让他感到很尴尬。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de chéngjī fēicháng zāogāo, zhè ràng tā gǎndào hěn gāngà.
sentences.english: His grades were very poor, which made him feel very embarrassed.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一阵奇怪的油烟味飘了过来。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yīzhèn qíguài de yóuyān wèi piāo le guòlái.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a strange smell of oil smoke drifted over.

sentences.chinese: 大卫意识到，这个世界的所有逻辑都消失了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi yìshí dào, zhège shìjiè de suǒyǒu luójí dōu xiāoshī le.
sentences.english: David realized that all the logic of this world had disappeared.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，一个穿着白衣服的人跑过来，大喊：“快走！那个绿色的怪物来了！”
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, yīgè chuānzhe bái yīfú de rén pǎo guòlái, dà hǎn: “Kuài zǒu! Nàgè lǜsè de guàiwù lái le!”
sentences.english: Just then, a person dressed in white ran over and shouted, "Run! The green monster is coming!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫低头看了看自己绿色的手，愣住了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi dītóu kànle kàn zìjǐ lǜsè de shǒu, lèng zhù le.
sentences.english: David looked down at his green hands and froze.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十三章：绿色的逃亡计划

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着自己绿色的手，觉得这太奇怪了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe zìjǐ lǜsè de shǒu, juéde zhè tài qíguài le.
sentences.english: David looked at his green hands and felt it was too strange.

sentences.chinese: 他想，这绝对不是科学能解释的事情。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, zhè juéduì búshì kēxué néng jiěshì de shìqing.
sentences.english: He thought this was absolutely not something science could explain.

sentences.chinese: 那个穿着白衣服的人拉着他的脚，大喊：“快跑！”
sentences.pinyin: Nàge chuānzhe bái yīfu de rén lāzhe tā de jiǎo, dàhǎn: “Kuài pǎo!”
sentences.english: The person in white pulled his foot and shouted, "Run!"

sentences.chinese: 他们跑向学校的球场，那里有很多绿色的草地。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen pǎo xiàng xuéxiào de qiúchǎng, nàlǐ yǒu hěnduō lǜsè de cǎodì.
sentences.english: They ran toward the school stadium, where there was a lot of green grass.

sentences.chinese: 大卫想，如果他躺在草地上，可能没有人能发现他。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎng, rúguǒ tā tǎng zài cǎodì shàng, kěnéng méiyǒu rén néng fāxiàn tā.
sentences.english: David thought that if he lay on the grass, maybe no one would notice him.

sentences.chinese: 但这时候，他的手机响了，收到了一条短信。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zhè shíhou, tā de shǒujī xiǎng le, shōudào le yì tiáo duǎnxìn.
sentences.english: But at that moment, his phone rang and he received a text message.

sentences.chinese: 短信说：“你的绿色皮肤是最好的礼物，请尽快来见我。”
sentences.pinyin: Duǎnxìn shuō: “Nǐ de lǜsè pífū shì zuì hǎo de lǐwù, qǐng jǐnkuài lái jiàn wǒ.”
sentences.english: The text said, "Your green skin is the best gift, please come see me as soon as possible."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这个人的行为非常奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéde zhège rén de xíngwéi fēicháng qíguài.
sentences.english: David felt this person's behavior was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 他看向路边，发现一个穿着红色衣服的人在骑自行车。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànxiàng lùbiān, fāxiàn yíge chuānzhe hóngsè yīfu de rén zài qí zìxíngchē.
sentences.english: He looked at the roadside and found a person wearing red clothes riding a bicycle.

sentences.chinese: 那个人停在路边，手里拿着一支笔和一张白纸。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge rén tíng zài lùbiān, shǒulǐ názhe yì zhī bǐ hé yì zhāng bái zhǐ.
sentences.english: That person stopped by the roadside, holding a pen and a piece of white paper.

sentences.chinese: 他对着大卫喊道：“嘿！你就是那个绿色的学生吧？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā duìzhe Dàwèi hǎndào: “Hēi! Nǐ jiùshì nàge lǜsè de xuéshēng ba?”
sentences.english: He shouted to David, "Hey! You are that green student, right?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫从另一个角度看过去，发现那个人在画儿。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi cóng lìng yíge jiǎodù kànguòqù, fāxiàn nàge rén zài huàr.
sentences.english: David looked from another angle and found the person was drawing a picture.

sentences.chinese: 那张画儿上的绿人长得和大卫一模一样。
sentences.pinyin: Nà zhāng huàr shàng de lǜ rén zhǎng de hé Dàwèi yìyàng.
sentences.english: The green person in the picture looked exactly like David.

sentences.chinese: 大卫很困惑，问他：“你的目的是什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi hěn kùnhuò, wèn tā: “Nǐ de mùdì shì shénme?”
sentences.english: David was confused and asked him, "What is your purpose?"

sentences.chinese: 那个人笑了，说：“我想研究你，因为你现在像一个科学科目的实验品。”
sentences.pinyin: Nàge rén xiào le, shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng yánjiū nǐ, yīnwèi nǐ xiànzài xiàng yíge kēxué kēmù de shíyànpǐn.”
sentences.english: The person smiled and said, "I want to study you because you are now like a specimen for a science branch."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这里的空气突然变得很紧张。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéde zhèlǐ de kōngqì tūrán biànde hěn jǐnzhāng.
sentences.english: David felt the air here suddenly became very tense.

sentences.chinese: 他想逃跑，但发现自己的脚在发抖。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng táopǎo, dàn fāxiàn zìjǐ de jiǎo zài fādǒu.
sentences.english: He wanted to escape, but found his feet were shaking.

sentences.chinese: 那个红衣人拿出一片小圆盘，像是一个旧的计算机零件。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge hóngyī rén ná chū yí piàn xiǎo yuánpán, xiàng shì yíge jiù de jìsuànjī língjiàn.
sentences.english: The man in red took out a small disk, which looked like an old computer part.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“这是一个特殊的计划，能让你变回原来的颜色。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zhè shì yíge tèshū de jìhuà, néng ràng nǐ biànhuí yuánlái de yánsè.”
sentences.english: He said, "This is a special plan that can turn you back to your original color."

sentences.chinese: 大卫问：“这真的能行吗？我的理想是变回正常人。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi wèn: “Zhè zhēn de néng xíng ma? Wǒ de lǐxiǎng shì biànhuí zhèngcháng rén.”
sentences.english: David asked, "Does this really work? My ideal is to become a normal person again."

sentences.chinese: 红衣人说：“当然，但这需要你参加一个特殊的节目。”
sentences.pinyin: Hóngyī rén shuō: “Dāngrán, dàn zhè xūyào nǐ cānjiā yíge tèshū de jié mù.”
sentences.english: The man in red said, "Of course, but this requires you to participate in a special program."

sentences.chinese: 这个节目是在一个西方风格的节日里表演的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jiémù shì zài yíge Xīfāng fēnggé de jiérì lǐ biǎoyǎn de.
sentences.english: This program was performed during a Western-style holiday.

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这像是一篇奇怪的小说，而不是真实的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéde zhè xiàng shì yì piān qíguài de xiǎoshuō, ér búshì zhēnshí de shēnghuó.
sentences.english: David felt this was like a strange piece of a novel, rather than real life.

sentences.chinese: 他看着眼前的道路，不知道该走哪道门。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe yǎnqián de dàolù, bù zhīdào gāi zǒu nǎ dào mén.
sentences.english: He looked at the road in front of him, not knowing which path to take.

sentences.chinese: 红衣人说：“你现在是最高级的绿色，得小心你的内脏，不要太激动。”
sentences.pinyin: Hóngyī rén shuō: “Nǐ xiànzài shì zuì gāo jí de lǜsè, děi xiǎoxīn nǐ de nèizàng, búyào tài jīdòng.”
sentences.english: The man in red said, "You are now the highest level of green; you must be careful with your organs and not get too excited."

sentences.chinese: 大卫惊呆了，他问：“你怎么知道我的脏器有问题？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi jīngdāi le, tā wèn: “Nǐ zěnme zhīdào wǒ de zàngqì yǒu wèntí?”
sentences.english: David was stunned and asked, "How do you know my viscera have a problem?"

sentences.chinese: 红衣人尴尬地笑了，说：“我只是在开玩笑。”
sentences.pinyin: Hóngyī rén gāngà de xiào le, shuō: “Wǒ zhǐshì zài kāi wánxiào.”
sentences.english: The man in red smiled awkwardly and said, "I was just joking."

sentences.chinese: 为了分散注意力，红衣人扔给他一个网球。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile fēnsàn zhùyìlì, hóngyī rén rēng gěi tā yíge wǎngqiú.
sentences.english: To distract him, the man in red threw him a tennis ball.

sentences.chinese: 大卫接住球，开始在球场边做简单的运动。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi jiē zhù qiú, kāishǐ zài qiúchǎng biān zuò jiǎndān de yùndòng.
sentences.english: David caught the ball and began doing simple exercises by the side of the stadium.

sentences.chinese: 他突然意识到，这个世界的逻辑真的完全消失了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán yìshí dào, zhège shìjiè de luójí zhēn de wánquán xiāoshī le.
sentences.english: He suddenly realized that the logic of this world had truly completely disappeared.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，那个绿色的巨人突然出现在了道路的尽头。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, nàge lǜsè de jùrén tūrán chūxiàn zài le dàolù de jìntóu.
sentences.english: Just then, the green giant suddenly appeared at the end of the road.

sentences.chinese: 巨人看着大卫，大喊了一声：“我的笔记本在哪里！”
sentences.pinyin: Jùrén kànzhe Dàwèi, dàhǎn le yìshēng: “Wǒ de bǐjìběn zài nǎlǐ!”
sentences.english: The giant looked at David and shouted, "Where is my notebook!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着那个绿色的巨人，觉得他看起来像一个巨大的西兰花。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe nàge lǜsè de jùrén, juéde tā kàn qǐlái xiàng yīgè jùdà de xīlánhuā.
sentences.english: David looked at the green giant and felt he looked like a giant piece of broccoli.

sentences.chinese: 巨人走过来，大声说：“我的笔记本里有我怎么做饭的秘密！”
sentences.pinyin: Jùrén zǒu guòlái, dàshēng shuō: “Wǒ de bǐjìběn lǐ yǒu wǒ zěnme zuòfàn de mìmì!”
sentences.english: The giant walked over and shouted, "My notebook has the secrets of how I cook!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫很害怕，但他突然想到，也许可以通过交朋友来解决问题。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi hěn hàipà, dàn tā tūrán xiǎngdào, yěxǔ kěyǐ tōngguò jiāo péngyǒu lái jiějué wèntí.
sentences.english: David was scared, but he suddenly thought that maybe he could solve the problem by making friends.

sentences.chinese: 他小心地举手，问巨人：“你姓什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎoxīn de jǔshǒu, wèn jùrén: “Nǐ xìng shénme?”
sentences.english: He carefully raised his hand and asked the giant, "What is your surname?"

sentences.chinese: 巨人愣住了，然后自豪地说：“我姓绿，我的全名叫作绿大壮。”
sentences.pinyin: Jùrén lèngzhù le, ránhòu zìháo de shuō: “Wǒ xìng Lǜ, wǒ de quánmíng jiàozuò Lǜ Dàzhuàng.”
sentences.english: The giant froze, then said proudly, "My surname is Lu, my full name is Lu Dazhuang."

sentences.chinese: 大卫试着微笑，问他为什么要找那个笔记本。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi shìzhe wēixiào, wèn tā wèishéme yào zhǎo nàge bǐjìběn.
sentences.english: David tried to smile and asked why he wanted to find that notebook.

sentences.chinese: 绿大壮说，他正在一家奇怪的公司实习，需要完成一个任务。
sentences.pinyin: Lǜ Dàzhuàng shuō, tā zhèngzài yījiā qíguài de gōngsī shíxí, xūyào wánchéng yīgè rènwu.
sentences.english: Lu Dazhuang said he was interning at a strange company and needed to complete a task.

sentences.chinese: 如果他能取得成功，他的梦想就要实现了。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ tā néng qǔdé chénggōng, tā de mèngxiǎng jiùyào shíxiàn le.
sentences.english: If he could achieve success, his dream would be about to come true.

sentences.chinese: 他的梦想就是成为一个专业的厨师，为所有人准备美食。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de mèngxiǎng jiùshì chéngwéi yīgè zhuānyè de chúshī, wèi suǒyǒu rén zhǔnbèi měishí.
sentences.english: His dream was to become a professional chef and prepare delicacies for everyone.

sentences.chinese: 大卫意识到，这个笔记本对他有很大的作用。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi yìshí dào, zhège bǐjìběn duì tā yǒu hěn dà de zuòyòng.
sentences.english: David realized that this notebook had a great effect on him.

sentences.chinese: 绿大壮说：“如果你能帮我办这件事，我会给你很多钱。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǜ Dàzhuàng shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ néng bāng wǒ bàn zhè jiàn shì, wǒ huì gěi nǐ hěn duō qián.”
sentences.english: Lu Dazhuang said, "If you can handle this matter for me, I will give you a lot of money."

sentences.chinese: 大卫想，这可能是最好的帮助方式。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎng, zhè kěnéng shì zuì hǎo de bāngzhù fāngshì.
sentences.english: David thought this might be the best way to help.

sentences.chinese: 突然，红衣人跑过来，指着远处的门说：“那是入口！”
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, hóngyīrén pǎo guòlái, zhǐzhe yuǎnchù de mén shuō: “Nà shì rùkǒu!”
sentences.english: Suddenly, the man in red ran over, pointed to a distant door and said, "That is the entrance!"

sentences.chinese: 门后面正在举行一个奇怪的会议。
sentences.pinyin: Mén hòumiàn zhèngzài jǔxíng yīgè qíguài de huìyì.
sentences.english: Behind the door, a strange meeting was being held.

sentences.chinese: 红衣人告诉大卫，现在这里的交通非常糟糕，只能走路去。
sentences.pinyin: Hóngyīrén gàosu Dàwèi, xiànzài zhèlǐ de jiāotōng fēicháng zāogāo, zhǐnéng zǒulù qù.
sentences.english: The man in red told David that the traffic here was very bad now, and they could only go on foot.

sentences.chinese: 大卫决定把笔记本交给绿大壮，希望能换来和平。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juédìng bǎ bǐjìběn jiāogěi Lǜ Dàzhuàng, xīwàng néng huàn lái hépíng.
sentences.english: David decided to hand over the notebook to Lu Dazhuang, hoping to exchange it for peace.

sentences.chinese: 他把笔记本递过去，绿大壮开心地大笑，声音像风在吹一样。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ bǐjìběn dì guòqù, Lǜ Dàzhuàng kāixīn de dàxiào, shēngyīn xiàng fēng zài chuī yīyàng.
sentences.english: He handed the notebook over, and Lu Dazhuang laughed happily, his voice sounding like the wind blowing.

sentences.chinese: 绿大壮说：“谢谢你！现在我们可以一起参加那个会议了。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǜ Dàzhuàng shuō: “Xièxiè nǐ! Xiànzài wǒmen kěyǐ yīqǐ cānjiā nàge huìyì le.”
sentences.english: Lu Dazhuang said, "Thank you! Now we can participate in that meeting together."

sentences.chinese: 会议的主题是关于如何使用神奇的药水。
sentences.pinyin: Huìyì de zhǔtí shì guānyú rúhé shǐyòng shénqí de yàoshuǐ.
sentences.english: The theme of the meeting was about how to use magical potions.

sentences.chinese: 大卫发现，药水可以让小猫变成大象，或者让石头变成面包。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi fāxiàn, yàoshuǐ kěyǐ ràng xiǎomāo biànchéng dàxiàng, huòzhě ràng shítou biànchéng miànbāo.
sentences.english: David discovered that the potion could turn a kitten into an elephant or a stone into bread.

sentences.chinese: 在会议上，每个人都要发一张入场券，然后去取自己的座位。
sentences.pinyin: Zài huìyì shàng, měi gèrén dōu yào fā yī zhāng rùchǎngquàn, ránhòu qù qǔ zìjǐ de zuòwèi.
sentences.english: At the meeting, everyone had to be issued an admission ticket and then go get their seat.

sentences.chinese: 绿大壮为了表现自己，大声喊道：“加油！”
sentences.pinyin: Lǜ Dàzhuàng wèile biǎoxiàn zìjǐ, dàshēng hǎndào: “Jiāyóu!”
sentences.english: To show off, Lu Dazhuang shouted loudly, "Go for it!"

sentences.chinese: 他想证明自己能够做到所有的要求。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng zhèngmíng zìjǐ nénggòu zuòdào suǒyǒu de yāoqiú.
sentences.english: He wanted to prove that he could accomplish all the requirements.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个穿着蓝色外套的人走过来，问大卫是否愿意借他一支笔。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, yīgè chuānzhe lánsè wàitào de rén zǒu guòlái, wèn Dàwèi shìfǒu yuànyì jiè tā yī zhī bǐ.
