sentences.english: At this moment, a person wearing a blue coat walked over and asked David if he would be willing to lend him a pen.

sentences.chinese: 大卫借给他笔，两人开始聊天，发现他们都养了奇怪的宠物。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi jiè gěi tā bǐ, liǎng rén kāishǐ liáotiān, fāxiàn tāmen dōu yǎng le qíguài de chǒngwù.
sentences.english: David lent him the pen, and the two began to chat, discovering they both kept strange pets.

sentences.chinese: 大卫发现，这个世界的人都喜欢把简单的东西变得复杂。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi fāxiàn, zhège shìjiè de rén dōu xǐhuan bǎ jiǎndān de dōngxi biàn de fùzá.
sentences.english: David found that people in this world liked to make simple things complicated.

sentences.chinese: 绿大壮看着大卫，说：“你带来的好运气让我很开心。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǜ Dàzhuàng kànzhe Dàwèi, shuō: “Nǐ dàilái de hǎo yùnqì ràng wǒ hěn kāixīn.”
sentences.english: Lu Dazhuang looked at David and said, "The good luck you brought makes me very happy."

sentences.chinese: 他决定给大卫一套特别的绿色衣服，作为感谢。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juédìng gěi Dàwèi yī tào tèbié de lǜsè yīfu, zuòwéi gǎnxiè.
sentences.english: He decided to give David a set of special green clothes as a thank you.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着那套衣服，觉得这简直是个笑话。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe nà tào yīfu, juéde zhè jiǎnzhí shì gè xiàohuà.
sentences.english: David looked at that set of clothes and felt it was simply a joke.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，会议室的灯突然熄灭了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhèshí, huìyìshì de dēng tūrán xīmiè le.
sentences.english: Just then, the lights in the meeting room suddenly went out.

sentences.chinese: 一个黑色的影子突然出现，抢走了绿大壮的笔记本。
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè hēisè de yǐngzi tūrán chūxiàn, qiǎngzǒule Lǜ Dàzhuàng de bǐjìběn.
sentences.english: A black shadow suddenly appeared and snatched away Lu Dazhuang's notebook.

sentences.chinese: 绿大壮大喊：“我的秘密菜谱又不见了！”
sentences.pinyin: Lǜ Dàzhuàng dàhǎn: “Wǒ de mìmì càipǔ yòu bùjiàn le!”
sentences.english: Lu Dazhuang screamed, "My secret recipes are gone again!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着黑暗，心想这次又要怎么解决？
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe hēiyàn, xīnxiǎng zhè cì yòu yào zěnme jiějué?
sentences.english: David looked into the darkness, wondering how to solve it this time?

chapters.title_chinese: 第十五章：绿色的秘密餐厅

sentences.chinese: 黑暗中，大卫听到一个奇怪的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Hēi àn zhōng, Dà wèi tīng dào yī gè qí guài de shēng yīn.
sentences.english: In the darkness, David heard a strange sound.

sentences.chinese: 那个黑色的影子拿着笔记本，往门外跑去。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè hēi sè de yǐng zi ná zhe bǐ jì běn, wǎng mén wài pǎo qù.
sentences.english: The black shadow took the notebook and ran towards the door.

sentences.chinese: 绿大壮大喊：“你必须把我的菜谱还给我！”
sentences.pinyin: Lǜ dà zhuàng dà hǎn: “Nǐ bì xū bǎ wǒ de cài pǔ huán gěi wǒ!”
sentences.english: Green Big-Strong shouted, "You must return my recipe to me!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得不能这样坐着，于是他决定追上去。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi jué de bù néng zhè yàng zuò zhe, yú shì tā jué dìng zhuī shàng qù.
sentences.english: David felt he couldn't just sit there, so he decided to chase after him.

sentences.chinese: 他在走廊里跑，发现墙上贴满了奇怪的广告。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài zǒu láng lǐ pǎo, fā xiàn qiáng shàng tiē mǎn le qí guài de guǎng gào.
sentences.english: As he ran in the corridor, he found the walls covered in strange advertisements.

sentences.chinese: 这些广告说，这里有一个能提高收入的教育中心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiē guǎng gào shuō, zhè lǐ yǒu yī gè néng tí gāo shōu rù de jiào yù zhōng xīn.
sentences.english: These ads said there was an education center here that could increase income.

sentences.chinese: 大卫想，如果能在这里成为一个有钱人，那太方便了。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi xiǎng, rú guǒ néng zài zhè lǐ chéng wéi yī gè yǒu qián rén, nà tài fāng biàn le.
sentences.english: David thought, if he could become a rich person here, that would be very convenient.

sentences.chinese: 但他现在必须拿到那个笔记本，因为绿大壮看起来快要哭了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tā xiàn zài bì xū ná dào nà gè bǐ jì běn, yīn wèi Lǜ dà zhuàng kàn qǐ lái kuài yào kū le.
sentences.english: But he must get that notebook now, because Green Big-Strong looked like he was about to cry.

sentences.chinese: 绿大壮的眼泪像小河一样流了下来。
sentences.pinyin: Lǜ dà zhuàng de yǎn lèi xiàng xiǎo hé yī yàng liú le xià lái.
sentences.english: Green Big-Strong's tears flowed down like a small river.

sentences.chinese: 大卫被绿大壮的样子感动了，他大声说：“我会帮你的！”
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi bèi Lǜ dà zhuàng de yàng zi gǎn dòng le, tā dà shēng shuō: “Wǒ huì bāng nǐ de!”
sentences.english: David was moved by Green Big-Strong's appearance and said loudly, "I will help you!"

sentences.chinese: 他们追到了一个巨大的大厅，那里有很多人在排队。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zhuī dào le yī gè jù dà de dà tīng, nà lǐ yǒu hěn duō rén zài pái duì.
sentences.english: They chased him to a huge hall where many people were lining up.

sentences.chinese: 这些人都在报名参加一个奇怪的旅行活动。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiē rén dōu zài bào míng cān jiā yī gè qí guài de lǚ xíng huó dòng.
sentences.english: These people were all signing up for a strange travel activity.

sentences.chinese: 一个服务员笑着说：“欢迎来到‘绿色美食之行’！”
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè fú wù yuán xiào zhe shuō: “Huān yíng lái dào ‘Lǜ sè měi shí zhī xíng’!”
sentences.english: A waiter smiled and said, "Welcome to the 'Green Gourmet Trip'!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫赶紧提出一个问题：“你们看到一个黑影了吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi gǎn jǐn tí chū yī gè wèn tí: “Nǐ men kàn dào yī gè hēi yǐng le ma?”
sentences.english: David quickly raised a question: "Did you see a black shadow?"

sentences.chinese: 服务员接话道：“哦，那是我们的打印员，他负责把所有菜谱打印出来。”
sentences.pinyin: Fú wù yuán jiē huà dào: “Ó, nà shì wǒ men de dǎ yìn yuán, tā fù zé bǎ suǒ yǒu cài pǔ dǎ yìn chū lái.”
sentences.english: The waiter answered, "Oh, that's our printer; he's responsible for printing out all the recipes."

sentences.chinese: 接下来，那个黑影出现在一个巨大的打印机后面。
sentences.pinyin: Jiē xià lái, nà gè hēi yǐng chū xiàn zài yī gè jù dà de dǎ yìn jī hòu miàn.
sentences.english: Next, the black shadow appeared behind a huge printer.

sentences.chinese: 黑影拿出笔记本，大声说：“我想把这个菜谱变成我的！”
sentences.pinyin: Hēi yǐng ná chū bǐ jì běn, dà shēng shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhè gè cài pǔ biàn chéng wǒ de!”
sentences.english: The shadow took out the notebook and said loudly, "I want to turn this recipe into mine!"

sentences.chinese: 绿大壮大喊：“我不愿意！那是我的秘密！”
sentences.pinyin: Lǜ dà zhuàng dà hǎn: “Wǒ bù yuàn yì! Nà shì wǒ de mì mì!”
sentences.english: Green Big-Strong shouted, "I'm not willing! That's my secret!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫想得出结论：这个黑影其实是一个想偷菜谱的厨师。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi xiǎng de chū jié lùn: zhè gè hēi yǐng qí shí shì yī gè xiǎng tōu cài pǔ de chú shī.
sentences.english: David arrived at the conclusion: this black shadow was actually a chef who wanted to steal the recipe.

sentences.chinese: 黑影接着说：“只要我有了这个菜谱，我就能得到很多钱！”
sentences.pinyin: Hēi yǐng jiē zhe shuō: “Zhǐ yào wǒ yǒu le zhè gè cài pǔ, wǒ jiù néng dé dào hěn duō qián!”
sentences.english: The shadow continued, "As long as I have this recipe, I can get a lot of money!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫赶紧跑过去，接住了快要掉在地上的笔记本。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi gǎn jǐn pǎo guò qù, jiē zhù le kuài yào diào zài dì shàng de bǐ jì běn.
sentences.english: David quickly ran over and caught the notebook just as it was about to fall on the ground.

sentences.chinese: 他把笔记本还给绿大壮，并要求黑影道歉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ bǐ jì běn huán gěi Lǜ dà zhuàng, bìng yāo qiú hēi yǐng dào qiàn.
sentences.english: He returned the notebook to Green Big-Strong and requested the shadow to apologize.

sentences.chinese: 黑影最后接受了大卫的建议，决定通过合法工作来收钱。
sentences.pinyin: Hēi yǐng zuì hòu jiē shòu le Dà wèi de jiàn yì, jué dìng tōng guò hé fǎ gōng zuò lái shōu qián.
sentences.english: The shadow eventually accepted David's suggestion and decided to collect money through legal work.

sentences.chinese: 绿大壮开心极了，他决定给大卫提供最好的服务。
sentences.pinyin: Lǜ dà zhuàng kāi xīn jí le, tā jué dìng gěi Dà wèi tí gōng zuì hǎo de fú wù.
sentences.english: Green Big-Strong was overjoyed and decided to provide David with the best service.

sentences.chinese: 他邀请大卫去他的秘密餐厅，在那里度过一个愉快的下午。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yāo qǐng Dà wèi qù tā de mì mì cān tīng, zài nà lǐ dù guò yī gè yú kuài de xià wǔ.
sentences.english: He invited David to his secret restaurant to spend a pleasant afternoon there.

sentences.chinese: 绿大壮说：“在吃饭之前，你必须先去洗澡，因为你身上有药水的味道。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǜ dà zhuàng shuō: “Zài chī fàn zhī qián, nǐ bì xū xiān qù xǐ zǎo, yīn wèi nǐ shēn shang yǒu yào shuǐ de wèi dào.”
sentences.english: Green Big-Strong said, "Before eating, you must take a shower first, because you smell like medicine."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这很奇怪，但还是照做了。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi jué de zhè hěn qí guài, dàn hái shì zhào zuò le.
sentences.english: David thought this was strange, but he did it anyway.

sentences.chinese: 在餐厅里，绿大壮拿出了很多绿色的菜。
sentences.pinyin: Zài cān tīng lǐ, Lǜ dà zhuàng ná chū le hěn duō lǜ sè de cài.
sentences.english: In the restaurant, Green Big-Strong brought out many green dishes.

sentences.chinese: 大卫吃了一口，发现味道竟然非常好。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi chī le yī kǒu, fā xiàn wèi dào jìng rán fēi cháng hǎo.
sentences.english: David took a bite and found the taste was actually very good.

sentences.chinese: 他心想，虽然这个世界没有逻辑，但食物是有逻辑的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xīn xiǎng, suī rán zhè gè shì jiè méi yǒu luó jí, dàn shí wù shì yǒu luó jí de.
sentences.english: He thought to himself, although this world has no logic, food does have logic.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，绿大壮突然说：“其实，我还有一个更大的秘密。”
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, Lǜ dà zhuàng tū rán shuō: “Qí shí, wǒ hái yǒu yī gè gèng dà de mì mì.”
sentences.english: Just then, Green Big-Strong suddenly said, "Actually, I have an even bigger secret."

sentences.chinese: 大卫好奇地问：“是什么秘密？”
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi hào qí de wèn: “Shì shén me mì mì?”
sentences.english: David asked curiously, "What secret?"

sentences.chinese: 绿大壮指了指窗外，那里出现了一个巨大的、会飞的笔记本。
sentences.pinyin: Lǜ dà zhuàng zhǐ le zhǐ chuāng wài, nà lǐ chū xiàn le yī gè jù dà de, huì fēi de bǐ jì běn.
sentences.english: Green Big-Strong pointed out the window, where a huge, flying notebook had appeared.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十六章：飞行的笔记本与奇怪的训练
chapters.title_english: Chapter 16: The Flying Notebook and the Strange Training

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着天空，那个巨大的笔记本像鸟一样在飞。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe tiānkōng, nàgè jùdà de bǐjìběn xiàng niǎo yīyàng zài fēi.
sentences.english: David looked at the sky; that giant notebook was flying like a bird.

sentences.chinese: 绿大壮说：“那是我的生活日记，它有自己的想法。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǜ Dàzhuàng shuō: “Nà shì wǒ de shēnghuó rìjì, tā yǒu zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.”
sentences.english: Green Big-Strong said, "That is my life diary, it has its own thoughts."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这个世界的生活太奇怪了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juédé zhège shìjiè de shēnghuó tài qíguài le.
sentences.english: David felt that life in this world was too strange.

sentences.chinese: 绿大壮要求大卫帮他把笔记本找回来。
sentences.pinyin: Lǜ Dàzhuàng yāoqiú Dàwèi bāng tā bǎ bǐjìběn zhǎo huílái.
sentences.english: Green Big-Strong requested David to help him get the notebook back.

sentences.chinese: 大卫问：“我怎么能够抓到一个飞行的笔记本？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi wèn: “Wǒ zěnme nénggòu zhuā dào yīgè fēixíng de bǐjìběn?”
sentences.english: David asked, "How can I be able to catch a flying notebook?"

sentences.chinese: 绿大壮笑着说：“你需要进行特殊的训练。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǜ Dàzhuàng xiàozhe shuō: “Nǐ xūyào jìnxíng tèshū de xùnliàn.”
sentences.english: Green Big-Strong smiled and said, "You need to conduct special training."

sentences.chinese: 他让大卫穿上一种奇怪的衣服，看起来像是在装成一只大鸟。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ràng Dàwèi chuān shàng yī zhǒng qíguài de yīfú, kàn qǐlái xiàng shì zài zhuāng chéng yī zhī dà niǎo.
sentences.english: He let David put on a strange set of clothes; it looked like he was dressing up as a big bird.

sentences.chinese: 绿大壮说：“我们要进入那个笔记本的秘密世界。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǜ Dàzhuàng shuō: “Wǒmen yào jìnrù nàgè bǐjìběn de mìmì shìjiè.”
sentences.english: Green Big-Strong said, "We need to enter the notebook's secret world."

sentences.chinese: 为了进入那里，他们必须租一只会说话的巨大蜗牛。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile jìnrù nàlǐ, tāmen bìxū zū yī zhī huì shuōhuà de jùdà wōniú.
sentences.english: To enter there, they had to rent a giant talking snail.

sentences.chinese: 蜗牛走得非常慢，但它能通过任何墙壁。
sentences.pinyin: Wōniú zǒu dé fēicháng màn, dàn tā néng tōngguò rènhé qiángbì.
sentences.english: The snail walked very slowly, but it could pass through any wall.

sentences.chinese: 绿大壮说：“我们要走过这条长路，直到超过那座山。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǜ Dàzhuàng shuō: “Wǒmen yào zǒuguò zhè tiáo cháng lù, zhídào chāoguò nà zuò shān.”
sentences.english: Green Big-Strong said, "We have to walk past this long road until we surpass that mountain."

sentences.chinese: 他告诉大卫，那个笔记本是由很多个小秘密组成的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Dàwèi, nàgè bǐjìběn shì yóu hěnduō gè xiǎo mìmì zǔchéng de.
sentences.english: He told David that the notebook was composed of many small secrets.

sentences.chinese: “首先，我们要练习怎么在空中跑步。”绿大壮认真地说。
sentences.pinyin: “Shǒuxiān, wǒmen yào liànxí zěnme zài kōngzhōng pǎobù.” Lǜ Dàzhuàng rènzhēn de shuō.
sentences.english: "First, we need to practice how to run in the air," Green Big-Strong said seriously.

sentences.chinese: 大卫开始练习，他跑得像个醉汉，但绿大壮说这很专业。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kāishǐ liànxí, tā pǎo dé xiàng gè zuìhàn, dàn Lǜ Dàzhuàng shuō zhè hěn zhuānyè.
sentences.english: David started to practice; he ran like a drunkard, but Green Big-Strong said it was very professional.

sentences.chinese: “你要多练，才能在空中行动。”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ yào duō liàn, cáinéng zài kōngzhōng xíngdòng.”
sentences.english: "You need to train more to be able to move in the air."

sentences.chinese: 经过一个小时的努力，大卫终于能够在离地十厘米的地方跑动了。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò yīgè xiǎoshí de nǔlì, Dàwèi zhōngyú nénggòu zài lí dì shí límǐ de dìfāng pǎodòng le.
sentences.english: After an hour of effort, David was finally able to run ten centimeters above the ground.

sentences.chinese: 绿大壮说：“现在，我们要去爬山，在山顶抓住它。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǜ Dàzhuàng shuō: “Xiànzài, wǒmen yào qù páshān, zài shāndǐng zhuā zhù tā.”
sentences.english: Green Big-Strong said, "Now, we are going to climb a mountain and catch it at the peak."

sentences.chinese: 大卫累得快要死了，他问：“为什么我的生活变成了这样？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi lèi dé kuài yào sǐ le, tā wèn: “Wèishéme wǒ de shēnghuó biànchéng le zhèyàng?”
sentences.english: David was so tired he felt like he was dying; he asked, "Why has my life become like this?"

sentences.chinese: 绿大壮说：“每个人生下来都有不同的命运，你的命运就是帮我。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǜ Dàzhuàng shuō: “Měi gèrén shēng xiàlái dōu yǒu bùtóng de mìngyùn, nǐ de mìngyùn jiùshì bāng wǒ.”
sentences.english: Green Big-Strong said, "Everyone is born with a different destiny; your destiny is to help me."

sentences.chinese: 大卫没有答应，但他没有选择，因为蜗牛已经把他送给了笔记本。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi méiyǒu dāying, dàn tā méiyǒu xuǎnzhé, yīnwèi wōniú yǐjīng bǎ tā sònggěi le bǐjìběn.
sentences.english: David didn't agree, but he had no choice because the snail had already delivered him to the notebook.

sentences.chinese: 蜗牛突然加速，直接把大卫送到了笔记本面前。
sentences.pinyin: Wōniú tūrán jiāsù, zhíjiē bǎ Dàwèi sòngdào le bǐjìběn miànqián.
sentences.english: The snail suddenly accelerated and sent David directly in front of the notebook.

sentences.chinese: 大卫走过来，发现笔记本在对他微笑。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi zǒu guòlái, fāxiàn bǐjìběn zài duì tā wēixiào.
sentences.english: David came over and found the notebook smiling at him.

sentences.chinese: 他终于通过了绿大壮的第一个考验。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhōngyú tōngguò le Lǜ Dàzhuàng de dì yī gè kǎoyàn.
sentences.english: He finally passed Green Big-Strong's first test.

sentences.chinese: 这时，笔记本突然开口说话了，声音像个通晓一切的老师。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, bǐjìběn tūrán kāikǒu shuōhuà le, shēngyīn xiàng gè tōngxiǎo yīqiè de lǎoshī.
sentences.english: At that moment, the notebook suddenly started talking, its voice sounding like a teacher who knows everything.

sentences.chinese: 它说：“如果你想拿走我，你必须回答一个问题。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng ná zǒu wǒ, nǐ bìxū huídá yīgè wèntí.”
sentences.english: It said, "If you want to take me away, you must answer a question."

sentences.chinese: 大卫刚准备说话，笔记本突然变成了一个巨大的蛋糕！
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi gāng zhǔnbèi shuōhuà, bǐjìběn tūrán biànchéng le yīgè jùdà de dàngāo!
sentences.english: Just as David was about to speak, the notebook suddenly turned into a giant cake!

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着眼前这个巨大的黄色蛋糕，觉得非常奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe yǎnqián zhège jùdà de huángsè dàngāo, juédé fēicháng qíguài.
sentences.english: David looked at the huge yellow cake in front of him and felt it was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 蛋糕突然开口说话了，声音非常难听。
sentences.pinyin: Dàngāo tūrán kāikǒu shuōhuà le, shēngyīn fēicháng nántīng.
sentences.english: The cake suddenly started speaking, and its voice was very unpleasant.

sentences.chinese: 它说：“大卫，这是一个难题，你必须回答正确才能拿回笔记本。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Dàwèi, zhè shì yīgè nántí, nǐ bìxū huídá zhèngquè cáinéng náhuí bǐjìběn.”
sentences.english: It said, "David, this is a difficult problem; you must answer correctly to get your notebook back."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这个情况很可怕，因为蛋糕在对他大笑。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juédé zhège qíngkuàng hěn kěpà, yīnwèi dàngāo zài duì tā dàxiào.
sentences.english: David felt the situation was dreadful because the cake was laughing at him.

sentences.chinese: 蛋糕说：“你看，我的白色奶油不够多，这让我很不满。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàngāo shuō: “Nǐ kàn, wǒ de báisè nǎiyóu bùgòu duō, zhè ràng wǒ hěn bùmǎn.”
sentences.english: The cake said, "Look, my white cream is not enough, which makes me very dissatisfied."

sentences.chinese: 大卫不好意思地笑了笑，说：“我觉得你的奶油已经很多了。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi bù hǎoyìsi de xiàole xiào, shuō: “Wǒ juédé nǐ de nǎiyóu yǐjīng hěnduō le.”
sentences.english: David smiled embarrassedly and said, "I think you already have a lot of cream."

sentences.chinese: 蛋糕生气了，大喊道：“不行！我觉得我的奶油不如那个绿大壮的脸那么白！”
sentences.pinyin: Dàngāo shēngqì le, dàhǎn dào: “Bùxíng! Wǒ juédé wǒ de nǎiyóu bùrú nàgè Lǜ Dàzhuàng de liǎn nàme bái!”
sentences.english: The cake got angry and shouted, "No way! I think my cream is not as white as Green Big-Strong's face!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫心想，把奶油和绿大壮的脸比较，真是太难看了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xīnxiǎng, bǎ nǎiyóu hé Lǜ Dàzhuàng de liǎn bǐjiào, zhēnshì tài nánkàn le.
sentences.english: David thought to himself that comparing cream to Green Big-Strong's face was truly unsightly.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个老年人走过来，他穿着一件很短的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, yīgè lǎonián rén zǒu guòlái, tā chuānzhe yī jiàn hěn duǎn de yīfú.
sentences.english: Just then, an elderly man walked over, wearing very short clothes.

sentences.chinese: 这个老人看起来很难过，因为他丢了东西。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège lǎorén kàn qǐlái hěn nánguò, yīnwèi tā diūle dōngxī.
sentences.english: This old man looked sad because he had lost something.

sentences.chinese: 老人说：“不要相信这个蛋糕，它是个坏人！”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén shuō: “Bùyào xiāngxìn zhège dàngāo, tā shì gè huàirén!”
sentences.english: The old man said, "Don't trust this cake, it's a bad person!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫很惊讶，问：“一个蛋糕怎么会是坏人呢？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi hěn jīngyà, wèn: “Yīgè dàngāo zěnme huì shì huàirén ne?”
sentences.english: David was surprised and asked, "How can a cake be a bad person?"

sentences.chinese: 老人说：“它会把人们骗到厨房里去卖掉！”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén shuō: “Tā huì bǎ rénmen piàn dào chúfáng lǐ qù mài diào!”
sentences.english: The old man said, "It tricks people into the kitchen to sell them!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这个想法太离谱，但老人说这样做有很多坏处。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juédé zhège xiǎngfǎ tài lípǔ, dàn lǎorén shuō zhèyàng zuò yǒu hěnduō huàichu.
sentences.english: David thought this idea was too absurd, but the old man said doing this had many harms.

sentences.chinese: 突然，蛋糕试图用奶油推大卫，大卫被推到了墙上。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, dàngāo shìtú yòng nǎiyóu tuī Dàwèi, Dàwèi bèi tuī dàole qiáng shàng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the cake tried to push David with cream, and David was pushed against the wall.

sentences.chinese: 大卫的背很疼，感觉身体非常难受。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi de bèi hěn téng, gǎnjué shēntǐ fēicháng nánshòu.
sentences.english: David's back hurt, and he felt very unwell.

sentences.chinese: 在这个奇怪的地方，只有少数人知道蛋糕会攻击人。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège qíguài de dìfāng, zhǐyǒu shǎoshù rén zhīdào dàngāo huì gōngjí rén.
sentences.english: In this strange place, only a small number of people know that cakes attack people.

sentences.chinese: 大卫只能尝试跟蛋糕商量，希望它能冷静下来。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi zhǐnéng chángshì gēn dàngāo shāngliáng, xīwàng tā néng lěngjìng xiàlái.
sentences.english: David could only try to negotiate with the cake, hoping it would calm down.

sentences.chinese: 但蛋糕继续说一些难听的话，让大卫觉得很烦。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn dàngāo jìxù shuō yīxiē nántīng de huà, ràng Dàwèi juédé hěn fán.
sentences.english: But the cake continued to say unpleasant things, making David feel annoyed.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着蛋糕，心想这次的挑战比之前的所有事情都难过。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe dàngāo, xīnxiǎng zhècì de tiǎozhàn bǐ zhīqián de suǒyǒu shìqíng dōu nánguò.
sentences.english: David looked at the cake and thought this challenge was more distressing than all the previous things.

sentences.chinese: 他突然发现，蛋糕的底部写着一行小字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán fāxiàn, dàngāo de dǐbù xiězhe yī háng xiǎozì.
sentences.english: He suddenly noticed a line of small text written on the bottom of the cake.

sentences.chinese: 他赶紧读了起来，发现那是解开谜题的关键。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎnjǐn dúle qǐlái, fāxiàn nà shì jiěkāi mítí de guānjiàn.
sentences.english: He quickly read it and found that it was the key to solving the puzzle.

sentences.chinese: 就在他准备回答时，蛋糕突然开始变色，变成了深紫色！
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tā zhǔnbèi huídá shí, dàngāo tūrán kāishǐ biànsè, biànchéngle shēn zǐsè!
sentences.english: Just as he was preparing to answer, the cake suddenly began to change color, turning deep purple!

chapters.title_chinese: 第十八章：紫色的蛋糕与奇怪的逻辑
chapters.title_english: Chapter 18: The Purple Cake and Strange Logic

sentences.chinese: 深紫色的蛋糕突然大喊一声：“啊！你为什么还不回答我的问题！”
sentences.pinyin: Shēn zǐ sè de dàngāo tūrán dà hǎn yī shēng: “ā! Nǐ wèi shén me hái bù huí dá wǒ de wèn tí!”
sentences.english: The deep purple cake suddenly shouted, "Ah! Why haven't you answered my question yet!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫被吓了一跳，他觉得这个蛋糕不但很没礼貌，而且实在太吵了。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi bèi xià le yī tiào, tā jué de zhè ge dàngāo bù dàn hěn méi lǐ mào, ér qiě shí zài tài chǎo le.
sentences.english: David was startled; he felt that this cake was not only rude but also really too noisy.

sentences.chinese: 他看着蛋糕，心想：如果我回答错了，这个蛋糕可能快要爆炸了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe dàngāo, xīn xiǎng: rú guǒ wǒ huí dá cuò le, zhè ge dàngāo kě néng kuài yào bào zhà le.
sentences.english: He looked at the cake and thought: if I answer incorrectly, this cake might be about to explode.

sentences.chinese: 蛋糕冷笑一声说：“以前的挑战很简单，但现在的挑战不一般。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàngāo lěng xiào yī shēng shuō: “yǐ qián de tiǎo zhàn hěn jiǎn dān, dàn xiàn zài de tiǎo zhàn bù yī bān.”
sentences.english: The cake sneered and said, "Previous challenges were simple, but the current challenge is not ordinary."

sentences.chinese: 大卫问：“为什么现在的挑战不一样？”
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi wèn: “wèi shén me xiàn zài de tiǎo zhàn bù yī yàng?”
sentences.english: David asked, "Why is the current challenge different?"

sentences.chinese: 蛋糕说：“因为你现在面对的是一个逻辑蛋糕，这里到处都是谜题。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàngāo shuō: “yīn wèi nǐ xiàn zài miàn duì de shì yī gè luó jí dàngāo, zhè lǐ dào chù dōu shì mí tí.”
sentences.english: The cake said, "Because you are now facing a logic cake; there are puzzles everywhere here."

sentences.chinese: 它给出了一个例子，说：“例如，如果你看到一个红色的球，它不一定是圆的。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā gěi chū le yī gè lì zi, shuō: “lì rú, rú guǒ nǐ kàn dào yī gè hóng sè de qiú, tā bù yī dìng shì yuán de.”
sentences.english: It gave an example, saying, "For instance, if you see a red ball, it is not necessarily round."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这太奇怪了，因为在平常的生活中，球当然是圆的。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi jué de zhè tài qí guài le, yīn wèi zài píng cháng de shēng huó zhōng, qiú dāng rán shì yuán de.
sentences.english: David thought this was too strange, because in ordinary life, balls are of course round.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试用平时常用的逻辑去思考，可是蛋糕摇了摇头。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cháng shì yòng píng shí cháng yòng de luó jí qù sī kǎo, kě shì dàngāo yáo le yáo tóu.
sentences.english: He tried to think using the logic commonly used in normal times, but the cake shook its head.

sentences.chinese: 蛋糕说：“在这里，只要你敢想象，任何事情都可以发生。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàngāo shuō: “zài zhè lǐ, zhǐ yào nǐ gǎn xiǎng xiàng, rèn hé shì qíng dōu kě yǐ fā shēng.”
sentences.english: The cake said, "Here, as long as you dare to imagine, anything can happen."

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着周围，发现除了这个紫色蛋糕以外，天空也变成了紫色。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi kàn zhe zhōu wéi, fā xiàn chú le zhè ge zǐ sè dàngāo yǐ wài, tiān kōng yě biàn chéng le zǐ sè.
sentences.english: David looked around and found that apart from this purple cake, the sky had also turned purple.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这好像是一个巨大的梦，而且这个梦差不多快要把他吞掉了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué de zhè hǎo xiàng shì yī gè jù dà de mèng, ér qiě zhè ge mèng chà bù duō kuài yào bǎ tā tūn diào le.
sentences.english: He felt as if this were a giant dream, and this dream was almost about to swallow him.

sentences.chinese: 原来，这个蛋糕不仅仅是一个甜点，它同时还是一个奇怪的门卫。
sentences.pinyin: Yuán lái, zhè ge dàngāo bù jǐn jǐn shì yī gè tián diǎn, tā tóng shí hái shì yī gè qí guài de mén wèi.
sentences.english: It turned out that this cake was not just a dessert; it was simultaneously a strange gatekeeper.

sentences.chinese: 大卫问：“我怎么才能离开这里？”
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi wèn: “wǒ zěn me cái néng lí kāi zhè lǐ?”
sentences.english: David asked, "How can I leave this place?"

sentences.chinese: 蛋糕说：“很简单，你得告诉我，一个普通的蛋糕和我的区别是什么。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàngāo shuō: “hěn jiǎn dān, nǐ děi gào sù wǒ, yī gè pǔ tōng de dàngāo hé wǒ de qū bié shì shén me.”
sentences.english: The cake said, "It's simple, you must tell me what the difference between an ordinary cake and me is."

sentences.chinese: 大卫想了想，说：“一般的蛋糕只在生日的时候出现，不过你却在说话。”
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi xiǎng le xiǎng, shuō: “yī bān de dàngāo zhǐ zài shēng rì de shí hòu chū xiàn, bù guò nǐ què zài shuō huà.”
sentences.english: David thought for a moment and said, "Ordinary cakes only appear during birthdays, but you are speaking."

sentences.chinese: 蛋糕似笑非笑地说：“这个答案太普通了，同样地，你的思考方式也太普通。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàngāo sì xiào fēi xiào de shuō: “zhè ge dá àn tài pǔ tōng le, tóng yàng de, nǐ de sī kǎo fāng shì yě tài pǔ tōng.”
sentences.english: The cake said with a half-smile, "This answer is too ordinary; similarly, your way of thinking is also too ordinary."

sentences.chinese: 大卫感到很挫败，但他在笔记本上看到了一些提示。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi gǎn dào hěn cuò bài, dàn tā zài bǐ jì běn shàng kàn dào le yī xiē tí shì.
sentences.english: David felt frustrated, but he saw some hints in his notebook.

sentences.chinese: 笔记本写着：面对奇怪的敌人，也许你需要用同样奇怪的方式回答。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐ jì běn xiě zhe: miàn duì qí guài de dí rén, yě xǔ nǐ xū yào yòng tóng yàng qí guài de fāng shì huí dá.
sentences.english: The notebook wrote: Facing a strange enemy, perhaps you need to answer in a similarly strange way.

sentences.chinese: 大卫突然大喊：“我的区别就是我比你更甜！”
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi tū rán dà hǎn: “wǒ de qū bié jiù shì wǒ bǐ nǐ gèng tián!”
sentences.english: David suddenly shouted, "My difference is that I am sweeter than you!"

sentences.chinese: 蛋糕愣住了，它显然没想过有人会这么说。
sentences.pinyin: Dàngāo lèng zhù le, tā xiǎn rán méi xiǎng guò yǒu rén huì zhè me shuō.
sentences.english: The cake froze; it clearly had never thought that someone would say such a thing.

sentences.chinese: 因为太惊讶，蛋糕的颜色开始从紫色变成绿色，然后变成黄色。
sentences.pinyin: Yīn wèi tài jīng yà, dàngāo de yán sè kāi shǐ cóng zǐ sè biàn chéng lǜ sè, rán hòu biàn chéng huáng sè.
sentences.english: Because it was so surprised, the cake's color began to change from purple to green, and then to yellow.

sentences.chinese: 大卫意识到，只要他表现得足够疯狂，就可以赢过这个蛋糕。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi yì shí dào, zhǐ yào tā biǎo xiàn de zú gòu fēng kuáng, jiù kě yǐ yíng guò zhè ge dàngāo.
sentences.english: David realized that as long as he acted crazy enough, he could beat this cake.

sentences.chinese: 但是，蛋糕突然恢复了原样，它说：“你的答案很有趣，但还不够。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàn shì, dàngāo tū rán huī fù le yuán yàng, tā shuō: “nǐ de dá àn hěn yǒu qù, dàn hái bù gòu.”
sentences.english: However, the cake suddenly returned to its original state and said, "Your answer is interesting, but not enough."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得很烦，他想：“我以前从来没见过这么麻烦的食物。”
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi jué de hěn fán, tā xiǎng: “wǒ yǐ qián cóng lái méi jiàn guò zhè me má fan de shí wù.”
sentences.english: David felt annoyed and thought, "I have never seen such troublesome food before."

sentences.chinese: 他发现蛋糕的底部又出现了一行字，写着：“答案在你的绿色的手心里。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn dàngāo de dǐ bù yòu chū xiàn le yī háng zì, xiě zhe: “dá àn zài nǐ de lǜ sè de shǒu xīn lǐ.”
sentences.english: He found another line of text appearing at the bottom of the cake, saying: "The answer is in your green palm."

sentences.chinese: 大卫低头看，发现手心里的绿色药水竟然在发光。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi dī tóu kàn, fā xiàn shǒu xīn lǐ de lǜ sè yào shuǐ jì rán zài fā guāng.
sentences.english: David looked down and found that the green potion in his palm was actually glowing.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，原来他之前的所有经历，包括那个绿色的巨人，其实都是这个谜题的一部分。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, yuán lái tā zhī qián de suǒ yǒu jīng lì, bāo kuò nà ge lǜ sè de jù rén, qí shí dōu shì zhè ge mí tí de yī bù fèn.
sentences.english: He realized that it turned out all his previous experiences, including that green giant, were actually part of this puzzle.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试把手放在蛋糕上，同时大声读出笔记本上的咒语。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cháng shì bǎ shǒu fàng zài dàngāo shàng, tóng shí dà shēng dú chū bǐ jì běn shàng de zhòu yǔ.
sentences.english: He tried placing his hand on the cake while simultaneously reading the incantation from the notebook aloud.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，蛋糕突然开始剧烈地抖动，好像快要裂开了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, dàngāo tū rán kāi shǐ jù liè de dǒu dòng, hǎo xiàng kuài yào liè kāi le.
sentences.english: At that moment, the cake suddenly began to shake violently, as if it were about to split open.

sentences.chinese: 大卫惊恐地后退，他不知道接下来会发生什么。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi jīng kǒng de hòu tuì, tā bù zhī dào jiē xià lái huì fā shēng shén me.
sentences.english: David stepped back in terror, not knowing what would happen next.

sentences.chinese: 突然，蛋糕裂成两半，里面竟然坐着一个穿着白衣服的小人！
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, dàngāo liè chéng liǎng bàn, lǐ miàn jì rán zuò zhe yī gè chuān zhe bái yī fú de xiǎo rén!
sentences.english: Suddenly, the cake split in half, and inside sat a little person wearing white clothes!

sentences.chinese: 小人看着大卫，露出了一个诡异的微笑，轻声说：“欢迎来到真正的游戏。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo rén kàn zhe dà wèi, lù chū le yī gè guǐ yì de wēi xiào, qīng shēng shuō: “huān yíng lái dào zhēn zhèng de yóu xì.”
sentences.english: The little person looked at David, revealed a weird smile, and whispered, "Welcome to the real game."

chapters.title_chinese: 第十九章：小人的游戏规则
chapters.title_english: Chapter 19: The Little Man's Game Rules

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着面前这个白色的小人，觉得这绝对不正常。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe miànqián zhège báisè de xiǎorén, juéde zhè juéduì bù zhèngcháng.
sentences.english: David looked at the little white man in front of him and felt that this was absolutely not normal.

sentences.chinese: 小人忽然跳了起来，大声说：“我是这个游戏的裁判！”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎorén hūrán tiào le qǐlái, dàshēng shuō: “Wǒ shì zhège yóuxì de cáipàn!”
sentences.english: The little man suddenly jumped up and shouted, "I am the referee of this game!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫很困惑，问他：“这到底是什么游戏？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi hěn kùnhuò, wèn tā: “Zhè dàodǐ shì shénme yóuxì?”
sentences.english: David was very confused and asked him, "What on earth is this game?"

sentences.chinese: 小人笑着说：“这是一个寻找相同东西的游戏，比如，你要找一个和我一样的小人。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎorén xiàozhe shuō: “Zhè shì yīgè xúnzhǎo xiāngtóng dōngxī de yóuxì, bǐrú, nǐ yào zhǎo yīgè hé wǒ yīyàng de xiǎorén.”
sentences.english: The little man smiled and said, "This is a game of finding identical things, for example, you have to find a little man just like me."

sentences.chinese: 大卫想，这可能等于在大海里找一粒沙子。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎng, zhè kěnéng děngyú zài dàhǎi lǐ zhǎo yī lì shāzi.
sentences.english: David thought this might be tantamount to looking for a grain of sand in the ocean.

sentences.chinese: 小人继续说：“或者，你可以找一个相同颜色的笔记本，比如说，紫色的。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎorén jìxù shuō: “Huòzhě, nǐ kěyǐ zhǎo yīgè xiāngtóng yánsè de bǐjìběn, bǐrúshuō, zǐsè de.”
sentences.english: The little man continued, "Or, you could look for a notebook of the same color, for instance, a purple one."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这个小人老是喜欢开玩笑，而且他说话的方式非常奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéde zhège xiǎorén lǎoshì xǐhuān kāi wánxiào, érqiě tā shuōhuà de fāngshì fēicháng qíguài.
sentences.english: David felt that this little man always liked to joke, and moreover, the way he spoke was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 小人看着大卫，说：“虽然你现在很害怕，但你该尝试一下。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎorén kànzhe Dàwèi, shuō: “Suīrán nǐ xiànzài hěn hàipà, dàn nǐ gāi chángshì yīxià.”
sentences.english: The little man looked at David and said, "Although you are very scared right now, you should give it a try."

sentences.chinese: 大卫问：“如果我赢了的话，我可以回家吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi wèn: “Rúguǒ wǒ yíng le de huà, wǒ kěyǐ huíjiā ma?”
sentences.english: David asked, "If I win, can I go home?"

sentences.chinese: 小人故意露出一个神秘的微笑，说：“那要看你的运气。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎorén gùyì lùchū yīgè shénmì de wēixiào, shuō: “Nà yào kàn nǐ de yùnqì.”
sentences.english: The little man deliberately showed a mysterious smile and said, "That depends on your luck."

sentences.chinese: 大卫想起过去的一段时间，自己的生活简直像一场笑话。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎngqǐ guòqù de yīduàn shíjiān, zìjǐ de shēnghuó jiǎnzhí xiàng yī chǎng xiàohuà.
sentences.english: David thought about the past period of time; his life was simply like a joke.

sentences.chinese: 最近他身边总是出现奇怪的人，比如那个中医医生和绿大壮。
sentences.pinyin: Zuìjìn tā shēnbiān zǒngshì chūxiàn qíguài de rén, bǐrú nàgè zhōngyī yīshēng hé Lǜ Dàzhuàng.
sentences.english: Recently, strange people have always appeared by his side, such as that Chinese medicine doctor and Big Green.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得自己不再是一个普通的人，而是一个迷路的小丑。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde zìjǐ bù zài shì yīgè pǔtōng de rén, ér shì yīgè mílù de xiǎochǒu.
sentences.english: He felt he was no longer an ordinary person, but a lost clown.

sentences.chinese: 小人指了指大卫的口袋，说：“你身上正好有一个东西可以帮到你。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎorén zhǐ le zhǐ Dàwèi de kǒudài, shuō: “Nǐ shēnshàng zhènghǎo yǒu yīgè dōngxī kěyǐ bāng dào nǐ.”
sentences.english: The little man pointed to David's pocket and said, "You happen to have something on you that can help you."

sentences.chinese: 大卫摸了摸口袋，发现那张机票还在。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi mō le mō kǒudài, fāxiàn nà zhāng jīpiào hái zài.
sentences.english: David felt his pocket and found that the plane ticket was still there.

sentences.chinese: 小人说：“这张机票正是进入下一关的钥匙。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎorén shuō: “Zhè zhāng jīpiào zhèngshì jìnrù xià yī guān de yàoshi.”
sentences.english: The little man said, "This plane ticket is precisely the key to entering the next level."

sentences.chinese: 大卫问：“我能随便地使用它吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi wèn: “Wǒ néng suíbiàn de shǐyòng tā ma?”
sentences.english: David asked, "Can I use it as I please?"

sentences.chinese: 小人回答：“不能，你必须在正确的时间和地点使用。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎorén huídá: “Bùnéng, nǐ bìxū zài zhèngquè de shíjiān hé dìdiǎn shǐyòng.”
sentences.english: The little man replied, "No, you must use it at the correct time and place."

sentences.chinese: 大卫发现，这个小人的逻辑和正常人的逻辑完全不同。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi fāxiàn, zhège xiǎorén de luójí hé zhèngcháng rén de luójí wánquán bùtóng.
sentences.english: David discovered that this little man's logic was completely different from a normal person's logic.

sentences.chinese: 他想，或许这个世界其实是一个巨大的梦。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, huòxǔ zhège shìjiè qíshí shì yīgè jùdà de mèng.
sentences.english: He thought, perhaps this world is actually a giant dream.

sentences.chinese: 他看着近在咫尺的小人，决定自己面对这个挑战。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe jìn zài zhǐchǐ de xiǎorén, juédìng zìjǐ miànduì zhège tiǎozhàn.
sentences.english: Looking at the little man who was so close, he decided to face this challenge himself.

sentences.chinese: 小人突然大喊：“时间到了！快看你的笔记本！”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎorén tūrán dàhǎn: “Shíjiān dào le! Kuài kàn nǐ de bǐjìběn!”
sentences.english: The little man suddenly shouted, "Time is up! Quick, look at your notebook!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫赶紧打开笔记本，发现上面的字竟然在自己地跳舞。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi gǎnjǐn dǎkāi bǐjìběn, fāxiàn shàngmiàn de zì jìngrán zài zìjǐ de tiàowǔ.
sentences.english: David hurriedly opened the notebook and found that the words on it were actually dancing by themselves.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，笔记本里突然飞出了一只绿色的鸟，直接撞在了小人的脸上。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, bǐjìběn lǐ tūrán fēi chū le yī zhī lǜsè de niǎo, zhíjiē zhuàng zài le xiǎorén de liǎn shàng.
sentences.english: Just then, a green bird suddenly flew out of the notebook and hit the little man right in the face.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十章：奇怪的记忆照片

sentences.chinese: 小人被绿色的鸟撞到了，他生气地大喊：“这只鸟是谁的？”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎorén bèi lǜsè de niǎo zhuàng dào le, tā shēngqì de dàhǎn: “Zhè zhī niǎo shì shéi de?”
sentences.english: The little man was hit by the green bird, and he shouted angrily, "Whose bird is this?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着笔记本，发现里头出现了一张旧照片。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe bǐjìběn, fāxiàn lǐtou chūxiàn le yì zhāng jiù zhàopiàn.
sentences.english: David looked at the notebook and found an old photo inside.

sentences.chinese: 照片里是一个年轻的青年，他正骑着一只巨大的绿色蜗牛。
sentences.pinyin: Zhàopiàn lǐ shì yígè niánqīng de qīngnián, tā zhèng jìzhe yì zhī jùdà de lǜsè wōniú.
sentences.english: In the photo was a young man riding a giant green snail.

sentences.chinese: 小人看到照片，突然点头说：“哦，这是我的老师，角教授。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎorén kàndào zhàopiàn, tūrán diǎntóu shuō: “Ó, zhè shì wǒ de lǎoshī, Jué jiàoshòu.”
sentences.english: Seeing the photo, the little man suddenly nodded and said, "Oh, this is my teacher, Professor Jue."

sentences.chinese: 角教授以前负责教学，他教学生怎么在云朵上走路。
sentences.pinyin: Jué jiàoshòu yǐqián fùzé jiāoxué, tā jiāo xuéshēng zěnme zài yúnduǒ shàng zǒulù.
sentences.english: Professor Jue used to be in charge of teaching; he taught students how to walk on clouds.

sentences.chinese: 小人告诉大卫，角教授出生在一个会下雪的夏天。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎorén gàosù Dàwèi, Jué jiàoshòu chūshēng zài yígè huì xiàxuě de xiàtiān.
sentences.english: The little man told David that Professor Jue was born in a summer where it snowed.

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这太奇怪了，他问：“这怎么可能？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéde zhè tài qíguài le, tā wèn: “Zhè zěnme kěnéng?”
sentences.english: David thought this was too strange and asked, "How is that possible?"

sentences.chinese: 小人叹了一口气，说：“在我们的世界，逻辑是不存在的。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎorén tàn le yì kǒu qì, shuō: “Zài wǒmen de shìjiè, luójí shì bù cùnzài de.”
sentences.english: The little man sighed and said, "In our world, logic does not exist."

sentences.chinese: 突然，照片里的青年活了过来，他走进了大卫的现实世界。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, zhàopiàn lǐ de qīngnián huó le guòlái, tā zǒujìn le Dàwèi de xiànshí shìjiè.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the youth in the photo came to life and entered David's real world.

sentences.chinese: 青年看着大卫，笑着说：“你好！很高兴见到你。”
sentences.pinyin: Qīngnián kànzhe Dàwèi, xiàozhe shuō: “Nǐ hǎo! Hěn gāoxìng jiàndào nǐ.”
sentences.english: The youth looked at David and smiled, "Hello! Nice to see you."

sentences.chinese: 大卫吓得大叫：“怎么办！你为什么在我的房间里？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xià de dàjiào: “Zěnme bàn! Nǐ wèishéme zài wǒ de fángjiān lǐ?”
sentences.english: David screamed in fright, "What should I do! Why are you in my room?"

sentences.chinese: 青年拍拍大卫的肩膀，说：“别担心，我只是想找我的爱人。”
sentences.pinyin: Qīngnián pāipāi Dàwèi de jiānbǎng, shuō: “Bié dānxīn, wǒ zhǐshì xiǎng zhǎo wǒ de àiren.”
sentences.english: The youth patted David on the shoulder and said, "Don't worry, I'm just looking for my spouse."

sentences.chinese: 他告诉大卫，他刚才在地铁站碰见了一个长得像大白菜的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Dàwèi, tā gāngcái zài dìtiězhàn pèngjiàn le yígè zhǎng de xiàng dàbáicài de rén.
sentences.english: He told David that he had just run into someone who looked like a large cabbage at the subway station.

sentences.chinese: 然后他在等公交车的时候，又碰到了一只会说话的狗。
sentences.pinyin: Ránhòu tā zài děng gōngjiāochē de shíhou, yòu pèngdào le yì zhī huì shuōhuà de gǒu.
sentences.english: Then, while waiting for the bus, he bumped into a talking dog.

sentences.chinese: 青年拿出一个秤，称了一下大卫的笔记本。
sentences.pinyin: Qīngnián ná chū yígè chèng, chēng le yíxià Dàwèi de bǐjìběn.
sentences.english: The youth took out a scale and weighed David's notebook.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“这个笔记本有十公斤，不对，应该是十千克！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zhège bǐjìběn yǒu shí gōngjīn, búduì, yīnggāi shì shí qiānkè!”
sentences.english: He said, "This notebook weighs ten kilograms—no, it should be ten kilograms!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫愣住了，心想：公斤和千克不是一样的意思吗？
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi lèng zhù le, xīn xiǎng: Gōngjīn hé qiānkè búshì yíyàng de yìsi ma?
sentences.english: David was stunned, thinking: Aren't kilograms and kilograms the same thing?

sentences.chinese: 青年突然拿出相机，对着大卫照相。
sentences.pinyin: Qīngnián tūrán ná chū xiàngjī, duìzhe Dàwèi zhàoxiàng.
sentences.english: The youth suddenly took out a camera and took a photo of David.

sentences.chinese: 闪光灯亮了，大卫发现自己变成了照片里那个骑蜗牛的人。
sentences.pinyin: Shǎnguāngdēng liàng le, Dàwèi fāxiàn zìjǐ biànchéng le zhàopiàn lǐ nàgè jì wōniú de rén.
sentences.english: The flash went off, and David found that he had become the person riding the snail in the photo.

sentences.chinese: 青年笑着说：“现在你长大了，可以跟我一起去旅行了。”
sentences.pinyin: Qīngnián xiàozhe shuō: “Xiànzài nǐ zhǎngdà le, kěyǐ gēn wǒ yìqǐ qù lǚxíng le.”
sentences.english: The youth smiled and said, "Now that you've grown up, you can travel with me."

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，笔记本再次变色，变成了一种奇怪的亮橙色。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhèshí, bǐjìběn zàicì biànsè, biànchéng le yì zhǒng qíguài de liàng chéngsè.
sentences.english: Just then, the notebook changed color again, turning into a strange bright orange.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十一章：橙色的旅行计划

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着亮橙色的笔记本，觉得这颜色像个巨大的橘子。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe liàngchéngsè de bǐjìběn, juéde zhè yánsè xiàng gè jùdà de júzi.
sentences.english: David looked at the bright orange notebook and felt that the color was like a giant orange.

sentences.chinese: 青年笑着说：“快看，我们要去一个国际旅行！”
sentences.pinyin: Qīngnián xiàozhe shuō: “Kuài kàn, wǒmen yào qù yīgè guójì lǚxíng!”
sentences.english: The youth smiled and said, "Look quickly, we are going on an international trip!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫低头看，发现自己现在穿着一套奇怪的衣服，头发变成了亮橙色。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi dītóu kàn, fāxiàn zìjǐ xiànzài chuānzhe yī tào qíguài de yīfú, tóufa biànchéngle liàngchéngsè.
sentences.english: David looked down and found that he was now wearing a strange set of clothes, and his hair had turned bright orange.

sentences.chinese: 他惊恐地摸了摸头发，大喊：“我的头发怎么了？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīngkǒng de mōle mō tóufa, dàhǎn: “Wǒ de tóufa zěnme le?”
sentences.english: He touched his hair in horror and shouted, "What happened to my hair?"

sentences.chinese: 青年指着笔记本说：“这是一个信号，说明你已经准备好离开地球了。”
sentences.pinyin: Qīngnián zhǐzhe bǐjìběn shuō: “Zhè shì yīgè xìnhào, shuōmíng nǐ yǐjīng zhǔnbèi hǎo líkāi dìqiú le.”
sentences.english: The youth pointed to the notebook and said, "This is a signal, meaning you are ready to leave the Earth."

sentences.chinese: 笔记本上突然出现了一篇新闻，说一个著名的作家在旅行中丢了信用卡。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐjìběn shàng tūrán chūxiànle yī piān xīnwén, shuō yīgè zhùmíng de zuòjiā zài lǚxíng zhōng diūle xìnyòngkǎ.
sentences.english: A news report suddenly appeared in the notebook, saying a famous author had lost his credit card during a trip.

sentences.chinese: 这个作家是个中年人，他现在在寻找他的全家。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège zuòjiā shì gè zhōngnián rén, tā xiànzài zài xúnzhǎo tā de quánjiā.
sentences.english: This author was a middle-aged man, and he was now searching for his whole family.

sentences.chinese: 大卫读了一句句子，发现这个作家曾经在中小学当过教师。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi dúle yī jù jùzi, fāxiàn zhège zuòjiā céngjīng zài zhōngxiǎoxué dāngguò jiàoshī.
sentences.english: David read a sentence and found that this author had once been a teacher in middle and elementary school.

sentences.chinese: “这太奇怪了！”大卫说，“为什么这个新闻在我的笔记本里？”
sentences.pinyin: “Zhè tài qíguài le!” Dàwèi shuō, “Wèishéme zhège xīnwén zài wǒ de bǐjìběn lǐ?”
sentences.english: "This is too strange!" David said, "Why is this news in my notebook?"

sentences.chinese: 青年回答：“因为在这个世界，中级逻辑就是没有逻辑。”
sentences.pinyin: Qīngnián huídá: “Yīnwèi zài zhège shìjiè, zhōngjí luójí jiùshì méiyǒu luójí.”
sentences.english: The youth replied, "Because in this world, middle-level logic is that there is no logic."

sentences.chinese: 突然，笔记本变成了一张巨大的护照，上面写着大卫的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, bǐjìběn biànchéngle yī zhāng jùdà de hùzhào, shàngmiàn xiězhe Dàwèi de míngzì.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the notebook turned into a giant passport with David's name on it.

sentences.chinese: 青年告诉他，他们要先去一个动物园，那里有几千只奇怪的动物。
sentences.pinyin: Qīngnián gàosù tā, tāmen yào xiān qù yīgè dòngwùyuán, nàlǐ yǒu jǐ qiān zhī qíguài de dòngwù.
sentences.english: The youth told him that they first had to go to a zoo, where there were thousands of strange animals.

sentences.chinese: “这些动物会说话吗？”大卫问。
sentences.pinyin: “Zhèxiē dòngwù huì shuōhuà ma?” Dàwèi wèn.
sentences.english: "Can these animals speak?" David asked.

sentences.chinese: 青年点点头：“它们不仅会说话，还会讨论住房问题。”
sentences.pinyin: Qīngnián diǎndiǎn tóu: “Tāmen bùjǐn huì shuōhuà, hái huì tǎolùn zhùfáng wèntí.”
sentences.english: The youth nodded: "They not only speak, but they also discuss housing issues."

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着手表，发现时间每分钟都在跳舞，一会儿快，一会儿慢。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe shǒubiǎo, fāxiàn shíjiān měi fēnzhōng dōu zài tiàowǔ, yīhuǐ'er kuài, yīhuǐ'er màn.
sentences.english: David looked at his wristwatch and found that time was dancing every minute, sometimes fast and sometimes slow.

sentences.chinese: 这时，周围的环境突然改变了，他们回到了一个教室。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, zhōuwéi de huánjìng tūrán gǎibiànle, tāmen huídàole yīgè jiàoshì.
sentences.english: At this moment, the surrounding environment suddenly changed, and they returned to a classroom.

sentences.chinese: 教室里坐着一个小组，人数大约有五个人。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshì lǐ zuòzhe yīgè xiǎozǔ, rénshù dàyuē yǒu wǔ gè rén.
sentences.english: In the classroom sat a group, the number of people being about five.

sentences.chinese: 这些人看起来很年轻，但他们正严肃地讨论大自然。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē rén kàn qǐlái hěn niánqīng, dàn tāmen zhèng yánsù de tǎolùn dàzìrán.
sentences.english: These people looked young, but they were seriously discussing nature.

sentences.chinese: 其中一个人指着窗外说：“今天天气多云，适合骑蜗牛。”
sentences.pinyin: Qízhōng yīgè rén zhǐzhe chuāngwài shuō: “Jīntiān tiānqì duōyún, shìhé qí wōniú.”
sentences.english: One of them pointed out the window and said, "The weather is cloudy today, perfect for riding snails."

sentences.chinese: 大卫赶紧找了一个座位坐下，心想这比在动物园好。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi gǎnjǐn zhǎole yīgè zuòwèi zuò xià, xīnxiǎng zhè bǐ zài dòngwùyuán hǎo.
sentences.english: David quickly found a seat and sat down, thinking this was better than being at the zoo.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个巨大的音响响了起来，播放着大门乐队的音乐。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, yīgè jùdà de yīnxiǎng xiǎngle qǐlái, bōfàngzhe Dàmén yuèduàn de yīnyuè.
sentences.english: Just then, a giant speaker started blaring, playing music by The Doors.

sentences.chinese: 人们开始随着音乐跳舞，样子非常滑稽。
sentences.pinyin: Rénmen kāishǐ suízhe yīnyuè tiàowǔ, yàngzi fēicháng huájī.
sentences.english: People began to dance to the music, looking very ridiculous.

sentences.chinese: 青年对大卫说：“快，用你的护照买票，我们要出发了！”
sentences.pinyin: Qīngnián duì Dàwèi shuō: “Kuài, yòng nǐ de hùzhào mǎipiào, wǒmen yào chūfā le!”
sentences.english: The youth said to David, "Quick, use your passport to buy a ticket, we are setting off!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫摸了摸口袋，发现里面没有钱，只有一张写着“谢谢”的纸条。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi mōle mō kǒudài, fāxiàn lǐmiàn méiyǒu qián, zhǐyǒu yī zhāng xiězhe “xièxiè” de zhǐtiáo.
sentences.english: David felt his pocket and found there was no money, only a slip of paper saying "Thank you."

sentences.chinese: 他看着那个亮橙色的笔记本，它现在变成了一个小闹钟。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe nàgè liàngchéngsè de bǐjìběn, tā xiànzài biànchéngle yīgè xiǎo nàozhōng.
sentences.english: He looked at the bright orange notebook; it had now turned into a small alarm clock.

sentences.chinese: 闹钟大喊：“快走！如果再过十分钟，你就会变成一只蜗牛！”
sentences.pinyin: Nàozhōng dàhǎn: “Kuài zǒu! Rúguǒ zài guò shí fēnzhōng, nǐ jiù huì biànchéng yī zhī wōniú!”
sentences.english: The alarm clock shouted, "Go quickly! If ten more minutes pass, you will turn into a snail!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫吓得跳了起来，赶紧跟着青年跑向大门。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xià de tiàole qǐlái, gǎnjǐn gēnzhe qīngnián pǎo xiàng dàmén.
sentences.english: David jumped up in fright and quickly ran toward the door with the youth.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，他发现青年其实也没有护照。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhèshí, tā fāxiàn qīngnián qíshí yě méiyǒu hùzhào.
sentences.english: Just then, he discovered that the youth actually didn't have a passport either.

sentences.chinese: 青年尴尬地笑了笑，说：“其实我也不知道我们要去哪里。”
sentences.pinyin: Qīngnián gāngà de xiàole xiào, shuō: “Qíshí wǒ yě bù zhīdào wǒmen yào qù nǎlǐ.”
sentences.english: The youth smiled awkwardly and said, "Actually, I don't know where we are going either."

sentences.chinese: 大卫愣住了，他看着周围跳舞的人们，觉得这个世界彻底疯了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi lèngzhù le, tā kànzhe zhōuwéi tiàowǔ de rénmen, juéde zhège shìjiè chèdǐ fēng le.
sentences.english: David was stunned; looking at the people dancing around him, he felt this world had gone completely crazy.

sentences.chinese: 突然，笔记本再次变色，变成了一种深蓝色。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, bǐjìběn zàicì biàn sè, biànchéngle yī zhǒng shēnlánsè.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the notebook changed color again, turning a deep blue.

sentences.chinese: 一个声音从笔记本里传出来：“欢迎来到深海办公室！”
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè shēngyīn cóng bǐjìběn lǐ chuán chūlái: “Huānyíng láidào shēnhǎi bàngōngshì!”
sentences.english: A voice came from the notebook: "Welcome to the Deep Sea Office!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫还没反应过来，脚下突然出现了一个巨大的蓝色洞口。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi hái méi fǎnyìng guòlái, jiǎoxià tūrán chūxiànle yīgè jùdà de lánsè dòngkǒu.
sentences.english: Before David could react, a giant blue hole suddenly appeared beneath his feet.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十二章：深海办公室的早晨
chapters.title_english: Chapter 22: Morning at the Deep Sea Office

sentences.chinese: 大卫掉进了蓝色洞口，发现自己坐在一把奇怪的椅子上。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi diào jìn le lán sè dòng kǒu, fā xiàn zì jǐ zuò zài yì bǎ qí guài de yǐ zi shàng.
sentences.english: David fell into the blue hole and found himself sitting on a strange chair.

sentences.chinese: 这里是深海办公室，但窗外竟然是一个巨大的校园。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ shì shēn hǎi bàn gōng shì, dàn chuāng wài jìng rán shì yí gè jù dà de xiào yuán.
sentences.english: This was the Deep Sea Office, but outside the window was actually a huge campus.

sentences.chinese: 天空没有太阳，而是一个巨大的月亮。
sentences.pinyin: Tiān kōng méi yǒu tài yáng, ér shì yí gè jù dà de yuè liang.
sentences.english: There was no sun in the sky, but instead a giant moon.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着日历，发现这个月份非常奇怪，一年有二十个月。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi kàn zhe rì lì, fā xiàn zhè gè yuè fèn fēi cháng qí guài, yì nián yǒu èr shí gè yuè.
sentences.english: David looked at the calendar and found this month was very strange; a year had twenty months.

sentences.chinese: 一个穿着蓝色衣服的男人走过来，手里拿着一份早餐。
sentences.pinyin: Yí gè chuān zhe lán sè yī fu de nán rén zǒu guò lái, shǒu lǐ ná zhe yí fèn zǎo cān.
sentences.english: A man wearing blue clothes walked over, holding a breakfast.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“早安！这里的气温总是二十度，非常舒服。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zǎo ān! Zhè lǐ de qì wēn zǒng shì èr shí dù, fēi cháng shū fu.”
sentences.english: He said, "Good morning! The air temperature here is always twenty degrees, very comfortable."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这里的温度太奇怪了，因为他感觉自己在水下。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi jué de zhè lǐ de wēn dù tài qí guài le, yīn wèi tā gǎn jué zì jǐ zài shuǐ xià.
sentences.english: David felt the temperature here was too strange because he felt like he was underwater.

sentences.chinese: 办公室外面有一条河，河水像镜子一样亮。
sentences.pinyin: Bàn gōng shì wài miàn yǒu yì tiáo hé, hé shuǐ xiàng jìng zi yí yàng liàng.
sentences.english: Outside the office, there was a river, and the river water was as bright as a mirror.

sentences.chinese: 河的旁边是一个蓝色的湖，湖里有一只穿着球鞋的狗在游泳。
sentences.pinyin: Hé de páng biān shì yí gè lán sè de hú, hú lǐ yǒu yì zhī chuān zhe qiú xié de gǒu zài yóu yǒng.
sentences.english: Beside the river was a blue lake, where a dog wearing athletic shoes was swimming.

sentences.chinese: 大卫揉了揉眼睛，觉得这是一个巨大的笑话儿。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi róu le róu yǎn jing, jué de zhè shì yí gè jù dà de xiào huar.
sentences.english: David rubbed his eyes, feeling that this was one giant joke.

sentences.chinese: 那个男人说：“我是这里的科学家，我研究怎么让狗说话。”
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè nán rén shuō: “Wǒ shì zhè lǐ de kē xué jiā, wǒ yán jiū zěn me ràng gǒu shuō huà.”
sentences.english: The man said, "I am the scientist here; I study how to make dogs talk."

sentences.chinese: 大卫问：“他能说英语吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi wèn: “Tā néng shuō Yīng yǔ ma?”
sentences.english: David asked, "Can he speak English?"

sentences.chinese: 科学家点头说：“他的英语非常流利，甚至比你的英文写得好。”
sentences.pinyin: Kē xué jiā diǎn tóu shuō: “Tā de Yīng yǔ fēi cháng liú lì, shèn zhì bǐ nǐ de Yīng wén xiě de hǎo.”
sentences.english: The scientist nodded and said, "His English is very fluent, even better than your written English."

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个画家走进来，他的脸是绿色的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yí gè huà jiā zǒu jìn lái, tā de liǎn shì lǜ sè de.
sentences.english: At that moment, a painter walked in; his face was green.

sentences.chinese: 画家指着窗外说：“看，那个花园里有一只离！”
sentences.pinyin: Huà jiā zhǐ zhe chuāng wài shuō: “Kàn, nà gè huā yuán lǐ yǒu yì zhī lí!”
sentences.english: The painter pointed out the window and said, "Look, there is a Li in that garden!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫惊呆了，他记得离是一种古代的 mythical beast。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi jīng dāi le, tā jì dé lí shì yì zhǒng gǔ dài de mythical beast.
sentences.english: David was stunned; he remembered that the Li was an ancient mythical beast.

sentences.chinese: 他看着自己的腿，发现腿也变成了绿色。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe zì jǐ de tuǐ, fā xiàn tuǐ yě biàn chéng le lǜ sè.
sentences.english: He looked at his own legs and found his legs had also turned green.

sentences.chinese: 科学家说：“别担心，这只是秋天的正常颜色。”
sentences.pinyin: Kē xué jiā shuō: “Bié dān xīn, zhè zhǐ shì qiū tiān de zhèng cháng yán sè.”
sentences.english: The scientist said, "Don't worry, this is just the normal color of autumn."

sentences.chinese: 大卫大喊：“现在是秋天吗？为什么这里有蓝色的大海？”
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi dà hǎn: “Xiàn zài shì qiū tiān ma? Wèi shén me zhè lǐ yǒu lán sè de dà hǎi?”
sentences.english: David shouted, "Is it autumn now? Why is there a blue ocean here?"

sentences.chinese: 科学家拿出一个瓶子，说：“喝这个，你的脸会变回原样。”
sentences.pinyin: Kē xué jiā ná chū yí gè píng zi, shuō: “Hē zhè gè, nǐ de liǎn huì biàn huí yuán yàng.”
sentences.english: The scientist took out a bottle and said, "Drink this, and your face will return to normal."

sentences.chinese: 大卫接过瓶子，发现这像是在药店买的药水。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi jiē guò píng zi, fā xiàn zhè xiàng shì zài yào diàn mǎi de yào shuǐ.
sentences.english: David took the bottle and found it looked like a potion bought from a pharmacy.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个满族朋友走进来，手里拿着一个篮球。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, yí gè Mǎn zú péng you zǒu jìn lái, shǒu lǐ ná zhe yí gè lán qiú.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a Manchu friend walked in, holding a basketball.

sentences.chinese: 他大喊：“快看！我的球在街上跳舞！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dà hǎn: “Kuài kàn! Wǒ de qiú zài jiē shàng tiào wǔ!”
sentences.english: He shouted, "Look! My ball is dancing in the street!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫看向窗外，真的有一个篮球在街道上跳舞。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi kàn xiàng chuāng wài, zhēn de yǒu yí gè lán qiú zài jiē dào shàng tiào wǔ.
sentences.english: David looked out the window and saw a basketball actually dancing on the street.

sentences.chinese: 就在这个节骨眼上，笔记本突然飞过来，变成了一张菜单。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè gè jié gǔ yǎn shàng, bǐ jì běn tū rán fēi guò lái, biàn chéng le yì zhāng cài dān.
sentences.english: At this critical juncture, the notebook suddenly flew over and turned into a menu.

sentences.chinese: 菜单上写着：早餐吃月亮，午餐吃星星。
sentences.pinyin: Cài dān shàng xiě zhe: zǎo cān chī yuè liang, wǔ cān chī xīng xing.
sentences.english: The menu read: Breakfast: eat the moon; Lunch: eat stars.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着菜单，觉得这个世界彻底疯了。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi kàn zhe cài dān, jué de zhè gè shì jiè chè dǐ fēng le.
sentences.english: David looked at the menu and felt the world had gone completely crazy.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试用英语问：“我怎么才能回家？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā cháng shì yòng Yīng yǔ wèn: “Wǒ zěn me cái néng huí jiā?”
sentences.english: He tried to ask in English, "How can I go home?"

sentences.chinese: 科学家笑了笑，指了指远处的街道。
sentences.pinyin: Kē xué jiā xiào le xiào, zhǐ le zhǐ yuǎn chù de jiē dào.
sentences.english: The scientist smiled and pointed toward the distant street.

sentences.chinese: 大卫站起来，发现自己的球鞋不见了。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi zhàn qǐ lái, fā xiàn zì jǐ de qiú xié bù jiàn le.
sentences.english: David stood up and found his athletic shoes were gone.

sentences.chinese: 他光着脚走在蓝色的地板上，感觉很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Tā guāng zhe jiǎo zǒu zài lán sè de dì bǎn shàng, gǎn jué hěn qí guài.
sentences.english: He walked barefoot on the blue floor, feeling very strange.

sentences.chinese: 突然，笔记本再次变色，变成了一种亮紫色，并发出巨大的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, bǐ jì běn zài cì biàn sè, biàn chéng le yì zhǒng liàng zǐ sè, bìng fā chū jù dà de shēng yīn.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the notebook changed color again, becoming a bright purple and emitting a loud sound.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十三章：紫色的派对与奇怪的药水
chapters.title_english: Chapter 23: The Purple Party and the Strange Potion

sentences.chinese: 那个亮紫色的笔记本大喊了一声：“欢迎参加万人的派对！”
sentences.pinyin: Nàge liàng zǐsè de bǐjìběn dà hǎnle yīshēng: “Huānyíng cānjiā wàn rén de pàiduì!”
sentences.english: That bright purple notebook shouted, "Welcome to the party of ten thousand people!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫吓得举起手，觉得这太疯狂了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xià de jǔ qǐ shǒu, juéde zhè tài fēngkuángle.
sentences.english: David raised his hand in shock, feeling this was too crazy.

sentences.chinese: 他看着周围，发现这里的家具全是假的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe zhōuwéi, fāxiàn zhèlǐ de jiājù quán shì jiǎ de.
sentences.english: He looked around and found that all the furniture here was fake.

sentences.chinese: 一个巨大的紫色蛋糕占了房间的一半。
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè jùdà de zǐsè dàngāo zhànle fángjiān de yībàn.
sentences.english: A giant purple cake occupied half of the room.

sentences.chinese: 笔记本说了一句奇怪的话：“只要你唱歌，就能回家。”
sentences.pinyin: Bǐjìběn shuōle yījù qíguài de huà: “Zhǐyào nǐ chànggē, jiù néng huí jiā.”
sentences.english: The notebook said a strange sentence: "As long as you sing, you can go home."

sentences.chinese: 大卫小声说：“咱能换个简单的方法吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎoshēng shuō: “Zán néng huàn gè jiǎndān de fāngfǎ ma?”
sentences.english: David whispered, "Can we change to a simpler method?"

sentences.chinese: 他靠在墙上，心想这里简直像个噩梦。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kào zài qiáng shàng, xīnxiǎng zhèlǐ jiǎnzhí xiàng gè èmèng.
sentences.english: He leaned against the wall, thinking this place was simply like a nightmare.

sentences.chinese: 他记得昨夜的梦，但现在的情况更奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìdé zuóyè de mèng, dàn xiànzài de qíngkuàng gèng qíguài.
sentences.english: He remembered last night's dream, but the current situation was even stranger.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个穿着白衣服的小人提着一个篮子走过来。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yīgè chuānzhe bái yīfu de xiǎorén tízhe yīgè lánzi zǒu guòlái.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a little person wearing white clothes walked over carrying a basket.

sentences.chinese: 小人说：“请留在这里，我们要开始游戏了。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎorén shuō: “Qǐng liú zài zhèlǐ, wǒmen yào kāishǐ yóuxìle.”
sentences.english: The little person said, "Please stay here, we are about to start the game."

sentences.chinese: 他递给大卫一个碗，里面装着绿色的药水。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dì gěi Dàwèi yīgè wǎn, lǐmiàn zhuāngzhe lǜsè de yàoshuǐ.
sentences.english: He handed David a bowl containing green potion.

sentences.chinese: 大卫不小心碰到了碗，药水洒在了他的衣服上。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi bù xiǎoxīn pèngdàole wǎn, yàoshuǐ sǎ zàile tā de yīfu shàng.
sentences.english: David accidentally bumped the bowl, and the potion spilled on his clothes.

sentences.chinese: 他赶紧拿出一张纸，试图擦掉药水。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎnjǐn ná chū yī zhāng zhǐ, shìtú cā diào yàoshuǐ.
sentences.english: He hurriedly took out a piece of paper, trying to wipe away the potion.

sentences.chinese: 这时，他感觉到背上有什么东西在动。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, tā gǎnjué dào bèi shàng yǒu shéme dōngxī zài dòng.
sentences.english: At this moment, he felt something moving on his back.

sentences.chinese: 他回头一看，发现自己变成了一艘小船！
sentences.pinyin: Tā huítóu yī kàn, fāxiàn zìjǐ biànchéngle yī sōu xiǎochuán!
sentences.english: He looked back and found that he had turned into a small boat!

sentences.chinese: 他现在在草地上慢慢地滑动。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiànzài zài cǎodì shàng mànmàn de huádòng.
sentences.english: He was now sliding slowly on the grass.

sentences.chinese: 他记得段先生给他的药，但这次的药水更神奇。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìdé Duàn xiānshēng gěi tā de yào, dàn zhè cì de yàoshuǐ gèng shénqí.
sentences.english: He remembered the medicine Mr. Duan gave him, but this potion was even more magical.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个像蛋一样圆的机器人滚了过来。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yīgè xiàng dàn yīyàng yuán de jīqìrén gǔnle guòlái.
sentences.english: Then, a robot as round as an egg rolled over.

sentences.chinese: 机器人大声说了一个词：“逃跑！”
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén dàshēng shuōle yīgè cí: “Táopǎo!”
sentences.english: The robot loudly said a word: "Escape!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫把这句话读了三遍，突然感觉身体变轻了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi bǎ zhè jù huà dúle sān biàn, tūrán gǎnjué shēntǐ biàn qīngle.
sentences.english: David read this sentence three times and suddenly felt his body become light.

sentences.chinese: 他像一只小鸟一样，飞向了窗外。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàng yī zhī xiǎoniǎo yīyàng, fēi xiàngle chuāngwài.
sentences.english: He flew toward the window like a little bird.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，他发现窗外竟然是一个巨大的笔记本页面！
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, tā fāxiàn chuāngwài jìngrán shì yīgè jùdà de bǐjìběn yèmiàn!
sentences.english: But just then, he discovered that outside the window was actually a giant notebook page!

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十四章：笔记本上的大城市
chapters.title_english: Chapter 24: The Big City on the Notebook Page

sentences.chinese: 大卫发现自己掉在了一张巨大的纸上。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi fāxiàn zìjǐ diào zàile yī zhāng jùdà de zhǐ shàng.
sentences.english: David found himself falling onto a giant piece of paper.

sentences.chinese: 这里的一切都非常奇怪，像是一个亮亮的小世界。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de yīqiè dōu fēicháng qíguài, xiàng shì yīgè liàngliàng de xiǎo shìjiè.
sentences.english: Everything here was very strange, like a bright little world.

sentences.chinese: 他一直走，发现纸上有一个巨大的城市。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yīzhí zǒu, fāxiàn zhǐ shàng yǒu yīgè jùdà de chéngshì.
sentences.english: He walked straight ahead and found a giant city on the paper.

sentences.chinese: 这个城市的人全部都是笔记本里的字。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de rén quánbù dōu shì bǐjìběn lǐ de zì.
sentences.english: The people of this city were all characters from the notebook.

sentences.chinese: 一个字走过来，大声地问他：“你是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè zì zǒu guòlái, dàshēng de wèn tā: “Nǐ shì shéi?”
sentences.english: A character walked over and asked him loudly, "Who are you?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫十分惊讶，他觉得这个字看起来很可爱。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi shífēn jīngyà, tā juédé zhège zì kàn qǐlái hěn kě'ài.
sentences.english: David was very surprised; he thought this character looked very cute.

sentences.chinese: 大卫说：“我只是想回家，请问这里安全吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi shuō: “Wǒ zhǐshì xiǎng huí jiā, qǐngwèn zhèlǐ ānquán ma?”
sentences.english: David said, "I just want to go home, is it safe here?"

sentences.chinese: 那个字笑着说：“这里非常安全，而且很安静。”
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè zì xiàozhe shuō: “Zhèlǐ fēicháng ānquán, érqiě hěn ānjìng.”
sentences.english: The character smiled and said, "It is very safe here, and very quiet."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这里的空气很凉快，心情变得很开心。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juédé zhèlǐ de kōngqì hěn liángkuai, xīnqíng biàn dé hěn kāixīn.
sentences.english: David felt the air here was pleasantly cool, and his mood became very happy.

sentences.chinese: 字告诉他，这里的规则是非常公平的。
sentences.pinyin: Zì gàosù tā, zhèlǐ de guīzé shì fēicháng gōngpíng de.
sentences.english: The character told him that the rules here were very fair.

sentences.chinese: 所有的人在这里都是平等的，没有谁比谁更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Suǒyǒu de rén zài zhèlǐ dōu shì píngděng de, méiyǒu shéi bǐ shéi gèng zhòngyào.
sentences.english: Everyone here was equal; no one was more important than anyone else.

sentences.chinese: 大卫问：“我想知道怎么离开这里，你的答案准确吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi wèn: “Wǒ xiǎng zhīdào zěnme líkāi zhèlǐ, nǐ de dá'àn zhǔnquè ma?”
sentences.english: David asked, "I want to know how to leave here, is your answer accurate?"

sentences.chinese: 字回答：“我的答案一定不错，但我需要你帮我一个忙。”
sentences.pinyin: Zì huídá: “Wǒ de dá'àn yīdìng bùcuò, dàn wǒ xūyào nǐ bāng wǒ yīgè máng.”
sentences.english: The character replied, "My answer is certainly correct, but I need you to do me a favor."

sentences.chinese: 字说，他一生都在寻找一个合适的朋友一起跳舞。
sentences.pinyin: Zì shuō, tā yīshēng dōu zài xúnzhǎo yīgè héshì de péngyǒu yīqǐ tiàowǔ.
sentences.english: The character said he had been looking for a suitable friend to dance with all his life.

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这太奇怪了，但为了回家，他觉得这样挺好。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juédé zhè tài qíguài le, dàn wèile huí jiā, tā juédé zhèyàng tǐng hǎo.
sentences.english: David thought this was too strange, but for the sake of going home, he thought it was pretty good.

sentences.chinese: 这时，全体字都跑了过来，他们想看大卫跳舞。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, quántǐ zì dōu pǎo le guòlái, tāmen xiǎng kàn Dàwèi tiàowǔ.
sentences.english: At that moment, all the characters ran over; they wanted to see David dance.

sentences.chinese: 字说：“如果你能跳完这首歌，我们就帮你。”
sentences.pinyin: Zì shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ néng tiàowán zhè shǒu gē, wǒmen jiù bāng nǐ.”
sentences.english: The character said, "If you can finish dancing to this song, we will help you."

sentences.chinese: 大卫开始跳舞，他发现自己的全身都在动，像个奇怪的球。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kāishǐ tiàowǔ, tā fāxiàn zìjǐ de quánshēn dōu zài dòng, xiàng gè qíguài de qiú.
sentences.english: David started to dance, and he found his whole body moving like a strange ball.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这样跳够了，于是大声喊道：“我跳完了！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā juédé zhèyàng tiào gòu le, yúshì dàshēng hǎndào: “Wǒ tiàowán le!”
sentences.english: He felt he had danced enough, so he shouted loudly, "I'm finished!"

sentences.chinese: 字们非常快乐，他们大声地感谢大卫。
sentences.pinyin: Zìmen fēicháng kuàilè, tāmen dàshēng de gǎnxiè Dàwèi.
sentences.english: The characters were very joyful and thanked David loudly.

sentences.chinese: 字说：“在这个全国最著名的纸上城市，你是最会跳舞的人。”
sentences.pinyin: Zì shuō: “Zài zhège quánguó zuì zhùmíng de zhǐ shàng chéngshì, nǐ shì zuì huì tiàowǔ de rén.”
sentences.english: The character said, "In this most famous paper city in the whole nation, you are the best dancer."

sentences.chinese: 大卫问：“那么现在我可以走了吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi wèn: “Nàme xiànzài wǒ kěyǐ zǒu le ma?”
sentences.english: David asked, "So can I leave now?"

sentences.chinese: 字说：“没问题，只要你保持健康，你就能平安回去。”
sentences.pinyin: Zì shuō: “Méi wèntí, zhǐyào nǐ bǎochí jiànkāng, nǐ jiù néng píng'ān huíqù.”
sentences.english: The character said, "No problem, as long as you stay healthy, you can return safe and sound."

sentences.chinese: 大卫完全没想到，离开的方法竟然是跳舞。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi wánquán méi xiǎngdào, líkāi de fāngfǎ jìngrán shì tiàowǔ.
sentences.english: David had totally not expected that the way to leave was actually dancing.

sentences.chinese: 他看着那些字，觉得他们虽然奇怪，但生活在全年不休息的城市里一定很累。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe nàxiē zì, juédé tāmen suīrán qíguài, dàn shēnghuó zài quánnián bù xiūxí de chéngshì lǐ yīdìng hěn lèi.
sentences.english: He looked at those characters and felt that although they were strange, living in a city that doesn't rest all year long must be tiring.

sentences.chinese: 字给了他一个亮亮的小球，说：“拿着这个，你就会放心。”
sentences.pinyin: Zì gěile tā yīgè liàngliàng de xiǎo qiú, shuō: “Názhe zhège, nǐ jiù huì fàngxīn.”
sentences.english: The character gave him a bright little ball and said, "Hold this, and you will feel relieved."

sentences.chinese: 大卫接过球，觉得这个球的大小正好合适。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi jiēguò qiú, juédé zhège qiú de dàxiǎo zhènghǎo héshì.
sentences.english: David took the ball and felt its size was just right.

sentences.chinese: 他再次感谢这些字，并祝他们每天快乐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zàicì gǎnxiè zhèxiē zì, bìng zhù tāmen měitiān kuàilè.
sentences.english: He thanked the characters again and wished them happiness every day.

sentences.chinese: 突然，那个像蛋一样的机器人又出现了。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, nàgè xiàng dàn yīyàng de jīqìrén yòu chūxiàn le.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the egg-like robot appeared again.

sentences.chinese: 机器人大声说：“快走！笔记本要关上了！”
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén dàshēng shuō: “Kuài zǒu! Bǐjìběn yào guān shàng le!”
sentences.english: The robot said loudly, "Quick, go! The notebook is about to close!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫赶紧跑向纸的边缘，心想这次一定要成功。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi gǎnjǐn pǎo xiàng zhǐ de biānyuán, xīn xiǎng zhè cì yīdìng yào chénggōng.
sentences.english: David hurried toward the edge of the paper, thinking he must succeed this time.

sentences.chinese: 但就在他跳出去的一瞬间，他发现自己掉进了一个巨大的药水瓶里！
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài tā tiào chūqù de yī shùnjiān, tā fāxiàn zìjǐ diào jìnlle yīgè jùdà de yàoshuǐ píng lǐ!
sentences.english: But the moment he jumped out, he found himself falling into a giant potion bottle!

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十五章：药水瓶里的高级生活
chapters.title_english: Chapter 25: High-Class Life in the Potion Bottle

sentences.chinese: 大卫掉进了药水瓶，但这里并不糟糕。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi diào jìn le yàoshuǐ píng, dàn zhèlǐ bìng bù zāogāo.
sentences.english: David fell into the potion bottle, but it wasn't bad here.

sentences.chinese: 这里的天气永远是晴天，天空非常漂亮。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de tiānqì yǒngyuǎn shì qíngtiān, tiānkōng fēicháng piàoliang.
sentences.english: The weather here is forever a sunny day, and the sky is very beautiful.

sentences.chinese: 他发现自己穿着一件高级的白衣服，感觉很舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn zìjǐ chuānzhe yī jiàn gāojí de bái yīfu, gǎnjué hěn shūfu.
sentences.english: He found himself wearing a high-grade white outfit and felt very comfortable.

sentences.chinese: 一个热情的小机器人游过来，对他说：“欢迎来到药水度假村！”
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè rèqíng de xiǎo jīqìrén yóu guòlái, duì tā shuō: “Huānyíng lái dào yàoshuǐ dùjiàcūn!”
sentences.english: An enthusiastic little robot swam over and said to him, "Welcome to the Potion Resort!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这个地方很有意思，因为这里的鱼会说话。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéde zhège dìfāng hěn yǒu yìsi, yīnwèi zhèlǐ de yú huì shuōhuà.
sentences.english: David thought this place was very interesting because the fish here could talk.

sentences.chinese: 机器人告诉他，在这里，你可以随时自由地飞翔。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén gàosù tā, zài zhèlǐ, nǐ kěyǐ suíshí zìyóu de fēixiáng.
sentences.english: The robot told him that here, you can fly freely at any time.

sentences.chinese: 大卫尝试了一下，发现身体变得很轻，飞得很高。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi chángshì le yīxià, fāxiàn shēntǐ biàn de hěn qīng, fēi de hěn gāo.
sentences.english: David tried it and found his body became very light, flying very high.

sentences.chinese: 他问机器人：“我怎么才能出去？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn jīqìrén: “Wǒ zěnme cáinéng chūqù?”
sentences.english: He asked the robot, "How can I get out?"

sentences.chinese: 机器人说：“你必须找到正确的出口，而且要走很长的一段路。”
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén shuō: “Nǐ bìxū zhǎodào zhèngquè de chūkǒu, érqiě yào zǒu hěn cháng de yī duàn lù.”
sentences.english: The robot said, "You must find the correct exit, and you have to walk a very long way."

sentences.chinese: 大卫听不清楚，因为药水在耳朵里响。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi tīng bù qīngchu, yīnwèi yàoshuǐ zài ěrduo lǐ xiǎng.
sentences.english: David couldn't hear clearly because the potion was ringing in his ears.

sentences.chinese: 他直接问机器人：“你是不是经常在这里骗人？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhíjiē wèn jīqìrén: “Nǐ shì bù shì jīngcháng zài zhèlǐ piàn rén?”
sentences.english: He asked the robot directly, "Do you often deceive people here?"

sentences.chinese: 机器人笑了，说：“我是一个真正诚实的人。”
sentences.pinyin: Jīqìrén xiào le, shuō: “Wǒ shì yī gè zhēnzhèng chéngshí de rén.”
sentences.english: The robot laughed and said, "I am a truly honest person."

sentences.chinese: 这时候，一个熟人出现了，竟然是那个中医医生！
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shíhou, yī gè shú rén chūxiàn le, jìngrán shì nà gè zhōngyī yīshēng!
sentences.english: At that moment, an acquaintance appeared; it was actually that traditional Chinese medicine doctor!

sentences.chinese: 医生看着大卫，满意地笑了，说：“你的颜色现在很称这件衣服。”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng kànzhe Dàwèi, mǎnyì de xiào le, shuō: “Nǐ de yánsè xiànzài hěn chèn zhè jiàn yīfu.”
sentences.english: The doctor looked at David, smiled with satisfaction, and said, "Your color fits this outfit very well now."

sentences.chinese: 大卫很惊讶，问医生在这里做什么。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi hěn jīngyà, wèn yīshēng zài zhèlǐ zuò shénme.
sentences.english: David was surprised and asked the doctor what he was doing here.

sentences.chinese: 医生说：“我在这里做高级药水，这样人们会更健康。”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō: “Wǒ zài zhèlǐ zuò gāojí yàoshuǐ, zhèyàng rénmen huì gèng jiànkāng.”
sentences.english: The doctor said, "I make high-level potions here so that people will be healthier."

sentences.chinese: 他们一起吃了一顿大餐，大卫吃得非常饱。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen yīqǐ chī le yī dùn dàcān, Dàwèi chī de fēicháng bǎo.
sentences.english: They had a big feast together, and David ate until he was very full.

sentences.chinese: 医生告诉他，只要心态好，一切都会顺利。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng gàosù tā, zhǐyào xīntài hǎo, yīqiè dōu huì shùnlì.
sentences.english: The doctor told him that as long as one has a good mindset, everything will go smoothly.

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这里太舒服了，不想离开。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéde zhèlǐ tài shūfu le, bù xiǎng líkāi.
sentences.english: David felt it was too comfortable here and didn't want to leave.

sentences.chinese: 但突然，药水瓶开始剧烈地摇晃起来。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tūrán, yàoshuǐ píng kāishǐ jùliè de yáohuàng qǐlái.
sentences.english: But suddenly, the potion bottle began to shake violently.

sentences.chinese: 大卫惊恐地发现，有人在尝试把这个瓶子打开。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi jīngkǒng de fāxiàn, yǒurén zài chángshì bǎ zhège píngzi dǎkāi.
sentences.english: David discovered in horror that someone was trying to open the bottle.

sentences.chinese: 一个巨大的影子出现在瓶口，大卫大喊：“救命！”
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè jùdà de yǐngzi chūxiàn zài píngkǒu, Dàwèi dàhǎn: “Jiùmìng!”
sentences.english: A huge shadow appeared at the mouth of the bottle, and David screamed, "Help!"

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十六章：巨大的猫与药水瓶
chapters.title_english: Chapter 26: The Giant Cat and the Potion Bottle

sentences.chinese: 那个巨大的影子其实是一只巨大的猫。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge jùdà de yǐngzi qíshí shì yī zhǐ jùdà de māo.
sentences.english: That giant shadow was actually a giant cat.

sentences.chinese: 它把头低了下来，好奇地看着药水瓶里的大卫。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ tóu dī le xiàlái, hàoqí de kànzhe yàoshuǐ píng lǐ de Dàwèi.
sentences.english: It lowered its head, looking curiously at David inside the potion bottle.

sentences.chinese: 大卫吓得大喊：“救命！不要吃我！”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xià de dà hǎn: “Jiùmìng! Bùyào chī wǒ!”
sentences.english: David shouted in fear, "Help! Don't eat me!"

sentences.chinese: 猫突然把瓶子推倒了，药水流了一地。
sentences.pinyin: Māo tūrán bǎ píngzi tuīdǎo le, yàoshuǐ liú le yī dì.
sentences.english: The cat suddenly pushed the bottle over, and the potion spilled everywhere.

sentences.chinese: 大卫掉在地上，发现自己回到了那个奇怪的办公室。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi diào zài dìshàng, fāxiàn zìjǐ huí dào le nàge qíguài de bàngōngshì.
sentences.english: David fell to the ground and found himself back in that strange office.

sentences.chinese: 办公室对面坐着那个中医医生，他正在午睡。
sentences.pinyin: Bàngōngshì duìmiàn zuòzhe nàge zhōngyī yīshēng, tā zhèngzài wǔshuì.
sentences.english: Opposite the office sat the Chinese medicine doctor, who was taking a nap.

sentences.chinese: 医生睡得很香，胸口挺得很直。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuì de hěn xiāng, xiōngkǒu tǐng de hěn zhí.
sentences.english: The doctor was sleeping soundly, his chest sticking out straight.

sentences.chinese: 大卫赶紧爬起来，试图拉住医生的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi gǎnjǐn pá qǐlái, shìtú lā zhù yīshēng de yīfu.
sentences.english: David quickly climbed up and tried to pull the doctor's clothes.

sentences.chinese: 医生突然醒了，大声喊道：“站住！你在干什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tūrán xǐng le, dàshēng hǎn dào: “Zhànzhù! Nǐ zài gàn shénme?”
sentences.english: The doctor suddenly woke up and shouted loudly, "Stop! What are you doing?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫紧张地放下手中的笔记本，小声说：“我想回家。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi jǐnzhāng de fàngxià shǒuzhōng de bǐjìběn, xiǎoshēng shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng huí jiā.”
sentences.english: David nervously put down the notebook in his hand and whispered, "I want to go home."

sentences.chinese: 医生看了看表，现在是三点一刻。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng kàn le kàn biǎo, xiànzài shì sān diǎn yī kè.
sentences.english: The doctor looked at his watch; it was a quarter past three.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“现在是休息时间，不要打扰我干活儿。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Xiànzài shì xiūxi shíjiān, bùyào dǎrǎo wǒ gàn huó r.”
sentences.english: He said, "It's break time now, don't disturb me while I'm working."

sentences.chinese: 这时，大卫发现办公室的电脑卡住了，屏幕上有一幅绿色的画。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, Dàwèi fāxiàn bàngōngshì de diànnǎo kǎ zhù le, píngmù shàng yǒu yī fú lǜsè de huà.
sentences.english: At this moment, David noticed the office computer was lagging, and there was a green painting on the screen.

sentences.chinese: 画里是一个穿着黑衣服的人，看起来像是在黑龙江省工作。
sentences.pinyin: Huà lǐ shì yīgè chuānzhe hēi yīfu de rén, kàn qǐlái xiàng shì zài Hēilóngjiāng shěng gōngzuò.
sentences.english: In the painting was a person wearing black clothes, who looked like they worked in Heilongjiang Province.

sentences.chinese: 医生说：“为了省时间，我们直接去停车场吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō: “Wèile shěng shíjiān, wǒmen zhíjiē qù tíngchēchǎng ba.”
sentences.english: The doctor said, "To save time, let's go straight to the parking lot."

sentences.chinese: 他带着大卫走到门口，那里停着一辆奇怪的车。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàizhe Dàwèi zǒu dào ménkǒu, nàlǐ tíngzhe yī liàng qíguài de chē.
sentences.english: He led David to the door, where a strange car was parked.

sentences.chinese: 医生说：“快停车，我们要在这里等一个人。”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō: “Kuài tíngchē, wǒmen yào zài zhèlǐ děng yīgè rén.”
sentences.english: The doctor said, "Pull over quickly, we need to wait for someone here."

sentences.chinese: 大卫靠在车门上，心想这到底是怎么回事。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kào zài chēmén shàng, xīn xiǎng zhè dàodǐ shì zěnme huí shì.
sentences.english: David leaned against the car door, wondering what on earth was going on.

sentences.chinese: 他发现笔记本里留下了一张新的纸条。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn bǐjìběn lǐ liúxià le yī zhāng xīn de zhǐtiáo.
sentences.english: He found a new note left behind in the notebook.

sentences.chinese: 纸条上写着：等到太阳下山，秘密才会出现。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐtiáo shàng xiězhe: Děngdào tàiyáng xiàshān, mìmì cái huì chūxiàn.
sentences.english: The note read: Wait until the sun sets, and then the secret will appear.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着远方，觉得这个世界比药水瓶里更奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe yuǎnfāng, juéde zhège shìjiè bǐ yàoshuǐ píng lǐ gèng qíguài.
sentences.english: David looked into the distance, feeling that this world was even stranger than the potion bottle.

sentences.chinese: 突然，那只巨大的猫又出现了，它在车顶上跳舞。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, nà zhǐ jùdà de māo yòu chūxiàn le, tā zài chētǐng shàng tiàowǔ.
sentences.english: Suddenly, that giant cat appeared again, dancing on the roof of the car.

sentences.chinese: 大卫惊呆了，他不知道这次又要面对什么挑战。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi jīngdāi le, tā bù zhīdào zhè cì yòu yào miànduì shénme tiǎozhàn.
sentences.english: David was stunned; he didn't know what challenge he would face this time.

sentences.chinese: 他看向医生，发现医生的帽子竟然变成了绿色！
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng yīshēng, fāxiàn yīshēng de màozi jìngrán biànchéng le lǜsè!
sentences.english: He looked at the doctor and found that the doctor's hat had actually turned green!

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十七章：绿帽子的秘密晚餐
chapters.title_english: Chapter 27: The Secret Dinner of the Green Hat

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着医生绿色的帽子，觉得这太奇怪了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe yīshēng lǜsè de màozi, juéde zhè tài qíguài le.
sentences.english: David looked at the doctor's green hat and thought it was too strange.

sentences.chinese: 医生突然拿出一只手机，大声说：“喂！鱼先生，你到了吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng tūrán ná chū yī zhī shǒujī, dàshēng shuō: “Wéi! Yú xiānshēng, nǐ dào le ma?”
sentences.english: The doctor suddenly took out a phone and said loudly, "Hello! Mr. Yu, have you arrived?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫惊讶地发现，这个鱼先生竟然是一条穿着西装的鱼！
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi jīngyà de fāxiàn, zhège Yú xiānshēng jìngrán shì yī tiáo chuānzhe xīzhuāng de yú!
