sentences.english: David was surprised to find that this Mr. Yu was actually a fish wearing a suit!

sentences.chinese: 鱼先生来自深海银行，他开着一辆很小的红色汽车来到这里。
sentences.pinyin: Yú xiānshēng láizì shēnhǎi yínháng, tā kāizhe yī liàng hěn xiǎo de hóngsè qìchē lái dào zhèlǐ.
sentences.english: Mr. Yu came from the Deep Sea Bank, and he arrived here driving a very small red car.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉大卫，这辆车是出租的，而且价格非常便宜。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Dàwèi, zhè liàng chē shì chūzū de, érqiě jiàgé fēicháng biányí.
sentences.english: He told David that this car was rented, and the price was very cheap.

sentences.chinese: 鱼先生说：“大卫，我知道你现在很困惑，但跟我走有好处。”
sentences.pinyin: Yú xiānshēng shuō: “Dàwèi, wǒ zhīdào nǐ xiànzài hěn kùnhuò, dàn gēn wǒ zǒu yǒu hǎochu.”
sentences.english: Mr. Yu said, "David, I know you are very confused right now, but there are benefits to coming with me."

sentences.chinese: 他们来到一个奇怪的餐厅，那里有很多人在排队。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen lái dào yī gè qíguài de cāntǐng, nàlǐ yǒu hěnduō rén zài páiduì.
sentences.english: They arrived at a strange restaurant where many people were lining up.

sentences.chinese: 每个人都拿着一个笔记本，试图用一种奇怪的语言交流。
sentences.pinyin: Měi gè rén dōu názhe yī gè bǐjìběn, shìtú yòng yī zhǒng qíguài de yǔyán jiāoliú.
sentences.english: Everyone was holding a notebook, trying to communicate using a strange language.

sentences.chinese: 鱼先生给大卫递了一碗方便面和几个饺子。
sentences.pinyin: Yú xiānshēng gěi Dàwèi dì le yī wǎn fāngbiànmiàn hé jǐ gè jiǎozi.
sentences.english: Mr. Yu gave David a bowl of instant noodles and a few dumplings.

sentences.chinese: 大卫尝试用筷子夹饺子，结果饺子飞到了医生的绿帽子上。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi chángshì yòng kuàizi jiā jiǎozi, jiéguǒ jiǎozi fēi dào le yīshēng de lǜ màozi shàng.
sentences.english: David tried to pick up the dumplings with chopsticks, and as a result, a dumpling flew onto the doctor's green hat.

sentences.chinese: 医生一点也不生气，反而笑着说：“干杯！为了这个飞行的饺子！”
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng yīdiǎn yě bù shēngqì, fǎn'ér xiàozhe shuō: “Gānbēi! Wèile zhège fēixíng de jiǎozi!”
sentences.english: The doctor wasn't angry at all, but instead smiled and said, "Cheers! To this flying dumpling!"

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，大卫的手机响了，他收到了一条奇怪的消息。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, Dàwèi de shǒujī xiǎng le, tā shōudào le yī tiáo qíguài de xiāoxī.
sentences.english: Just then, David's phone rang, and he received a strange message.

sentences.chinese: 他接到一个通知，说他的笔记本被送到了一家网吧。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiēdào yī gè tōngzhī, shuō tā de bǐjìběn bèi sòngdào le yī jiā wǎngbā.
sentences.english: He received a notification saying his notebook had been delivered to an internet cafe.

sentences.chinese: 大卫问鱼先生：“你现在有空儿吗？我想去拿我的笔记本。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi wèn Yú xiānshēng: “Nǐ xiànzài yǒu kòngr ma? Wǒ xiǎng qù ná wǒ de bǐjìběn.”
sentences.english: David asked Mr. Yu, "Are you free right now? I want to go get my notebook."

sentences.chinese: 鱼先生看着大卫的脸，认真地说：“你的面色看起来很紧张。”
sentences.pinyin: Yú xiānshēng kànzhe Dàwèi de liǎn, rènzhēn de shuō: “Nǐ de miàn sè kàn qǐlái hěn jǐnzhāng.”
sentences.english: Mr. Yu looked at David's face and said seriously, "Your complexion looks very nervous."

sentences.chinese: 他告诉大卫，现在网络信号不好，网在周围飘来飘去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Dàwèi, xiànzài wǎngluò xìnhào bù hǎo, wǎng zài zhōuwéi piāo lái piāo qù.
sentences.english: He told David that the network signal was bad now, and the net was floating around.

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这个世界完全没有逻辑，但他也习惯了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéde zhège shìjiè wánquán méiyǒu luójí, dàn tā yě xíguàn le.
sentences.english: David felt this world had no logic at all, but he had gotten used to it.

sentences.chinese: 他们决定一起去网吧，看看那个笔记本到底在做什么。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen juédìng yīqǐ qù wǎngbā, kànkàn nàge bǐjìběn dàodǐ zài zuò shénme.
sentences.english: They decided to go to the internet cafe together to see what that notebook was actually doing.

sentences.chinese: 就在他们出发的时候，医生的绿帽子突然开口说话了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tāmen chūfā de shíhou, yīshēng de lǜ màozi tūrán kāikǒu shuōhuà le.
sentences.english: Just as they were setting off, the doctor's green hat suddenly started talking.

sentences.chinese: 帽子说：“真正的秘密，在最后一章才会出现！”
sentences.pinyin: Màozi shuō: “Zhēnzhèng de mìmì, zài zuìhòu yī zhāng cái huì chūxiàn!”
sentences.english: The hat said, "The real secret will only appear in the final chapter!"

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十八章：最后的秘密与大混乱
chapters.title_english: Chapter 28: The Final Secret and Great Chaos

sentences.chinese: 大卫和医生坐上了一辆彩色的公共汽车。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi hé yīshēng zuò shàng le yī liàng cǎisè de gōnggòng qìchē.
sentences.english: David and the doctor got on a colorful bus.

sentences.chinese: 这辆车开得很快，十分钟就开了十公里。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē kāi de hěn kuài, shí fēnzhōng jiù kāi le shí gōnglǐ.
sentences.english: The bus drove very fast, covering ten kilometers in ten minutes.

sentences.chinese: 他们来到了一个叫作“友好”的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen lái dào le yī gè jiào zuò “yǒuhǎo” de dìfāng.
sentences.english: They arrived at a place called "Youhao" (Friendly).

sentences.chinese: 这里有一个巨大的体育场，里面有亿万个笔记本在飞。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ yǒu yī gè jùdà de tǐyùchǎng, lǐmiàn yǒu yìwàn gè bǐjìběn zài fēi.
sentences.english: There was a huge stadium here, with hundreds of millions of notebooks flying inside.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个男人跑过来，大喊：“我是这里的经理！”
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yī gè nánrén pǎo guòlái, dàhǎn: “Wǒ shì zhèlǐ de jīnglǐ!”
sentences.english: Suddenly, a man ran over and shouted, "I am the manager here!"

sentences.chinese: 他手里拿着一张名单，上面写着所有奇怪的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shǒu lǐ názhe yī zhāng míngdān, shàngmiàn xiězhe suǒyǒu qíguài de rén.
sentences.english: He was holding a list of names, which listed all the strange people.

sentences.chinese: 名单上有市长、校长，甚至还有一个班长。
sentences.pinyin: Míngdān shàng yǒu shìzhǎng, xiàozhǎng, shènzhì hái yǒu yī gè bānzhǎng.
sentences.english: On the list were the mayor, the president, and even a class monitor.

sentences.chinese: 经理告诉大卫，他们现在要组建一支排球球队。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ gàosù Dàwèi, tāmen xiànzài yào zǔjiàn yī zhī páiqiú qiúduì.
sentences.english: The manager told David that they were now going to form a volleyball team.

sentences.chinese: 大卫很惊讶，因为他根本不会打排球。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi hěn jīngyà, yīnwèi tā gēnběn bù huì dǎ páiqiú.
sentences.english: David was surprised because he didn't know how to play volleyball at all.

sentences.chinese: 一个组长走过来，说：“没关系，你只要在队里站着就好。”
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè zǔzhǎng zǒu guòlái, shuō: “Méiguānxì, nǐ zhǐyào zài duì lǐ zhànzhe jiù hǎo.”

books.description_chinese: 夜晚的海边，林峰遇到了一个像幽灵一样的人。那个黑色的包里装了什么？一场可怕的追逐在旧大楼中开始。
books.description_english: On a freezing night by the sea, Lin Feng encounters a ghost-like figure. What is hidden inside the heavy black bag? A terrifying chase begins inside an old building.

sentences.chinese: 夜晚的海边很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Yè wǎn de hǎi biān hěn lěng.
sentences.english: The seaside at night was very cold.

sentences.chinese: 林峰一个人走在路边。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yī gè rén zǒu zài lù biān.
sentences.english: Lin Feng was walking alone by the roadside.

sentences.chinese: 他现在住在城市的一座小房子里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàn zài zhù zài chéng shì de yī zuò xiǎo fáng zi lǐ.
sentences.english: He now lives in a small house in the city.

sentences.chinese: 他的爱人三年前失踪了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de ài ren sān nián qián shī zōng le.
sentences.english: His spouse disappeared three years ago.

sentences.chinese: 林峰在很多方面都失去了希望。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zài hěn duō fāng miàn dōu shī qù le xī wàng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng had lost hope in many respects.

sentences.chinese: 但是，他每天都在寻找她的方向。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn shì, tā měi tiān dōu zài xún zhǎo tā de fāng xiàng.
sentences.english: However, he searches for her direction every day.

sentences.chinese: 他走进了一条狭窄的弄口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu jìn le yī tiáo xiá zhǎi de lòng kǒu.
sentences.english: He walked into a narrow alley.

sentences.chinese: 在这个角度看去，街道很黑。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè gè jiǎo dù kàn qù, jiē dào hěn hēi.
sentences.english: Looking from this angle, the street was very dark.

sentences.chinese: 一个男人坐在他对面。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè nán rén zuò zài tā duì miàn.
sentences.english: A man was sitting opposite him.

sentences.chinese: 那个男人靠在墙边，低着头。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè nán rén kào zài qiáng biān, dī zhe tóu.
sentences.english: That man was leaning against the wall, head lowered.

sentences.chinese: 林峰走近了一些。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zǒu jìn le yī xiē.
sentences.english: Lin Feng stepped a bit closer.

sentences.chinese: 他想问路，因为这里太陌生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng wèn lù, yīn wèi zhè lǐ tài mò shēng.
sentences.english: He wanted to ask for directions because this place was too strange.

sentences.chinese: 他走到男人面前，轻声说话。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu dào nán rén miàn qián, qīng shēng shuō huà.
sentences.english: He walked in front of the man and spoke softly.

sentences.chinese: 突然，男人抬起头，脸上的表情很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, nán rén tái qǐ tóu, liǎn shàng de biǎo qíng hěn qí guài.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the man raised his head, the expression on his face was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 林峰碰到了一双冰冷的手。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng pèng dào le yī shuāng bīng lěng de shǒu.
sentences.english: Lin Feng encountered a pair of ice-cold hands.

sentences.chinese: 他感到对方的手抓住了他的脚。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎn dào duì fāng de shǒu zhuā zhù le tā de jiǎo.
sentences.english: He felt the other person's hand grab his foot.

sentences.chinese: 他惊恐地往后退，退到了草地上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīng kǒng de wǎng hòu tuì, tuì dào le cǎo dì shàng.
sentences.english: He retreated in terror, backing onto the grass.

sentences.chinese: 这个人的观点很奇怪，他说他认识林峰的妻子。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè rén de guān diǎn hěn qí guài, tā shuō tā rèn shi Lín Fēng de qī zi.
sentences.english: This person's viewpoint was very strange; he said he knew Lin Feng's wife.

sentences.chinese: 林峰直接问他：“你在说什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhí jiē wèn tā: “Nǐ zài shuō shén me?”
sentences.english: Lin Feng asked him directly, "What are you talking about?"

sentences.chinese: 男人挺起胸膛，冷冷地笑了一声。
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén tǐng qǐ xiōng táng, lěng lěng de xiào le yī shēng.
sentences.english: The man straightened his chest and gave a cold laugh.

sentences.chinese: 林峰感觉到一种危险在身边。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎn jué dào yī zhǒng wēi xiǎn zài shēn biān.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt a kind of danger by his side.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到自己的位置不对，这里太危险了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào zì jǐ de wèi bù duì, zhè lǐ tài wēi xiǎn le.
sentences.english: He realized his position was wrong; this place was too dangerous.

sentences.chinese: 他看向天空，但现在没有太阳。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng tiān kōng, dàn xiàn zài méi yǒu tài yang.
sentences.english: He looked at the sky, but there was no sun now.

sentences.chinese: 他碰见了一个不该遇见的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pèng jiàn le yī gè bù gāi yù jiàn de rén.
sentences.english: He ran into someone he should not have met.

sentences.chinese: 他看到对方的脸，心中突然感到一阵寒意。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào duì fāng de miàn, xīn zhōng tū rán gǎn dào yī zhèn hán yì.
sentences.english: He saw the other person's face, and a sudden chill ran through his heart.

sentences.chinese: 林峰看着那个人的脸，他想起了一个可怕的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe nàge rén de liǎn, tā xiǎngqǐle yīgè kěpà de míngzì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at that person's face and recalled a terrifying name.

sentences.chinese: 那个人像一个幽灵，在黑暗中看着他。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge rén xiàng yīgè yōulíng, zài hēi'àn zhōng kànzhe tā.
sentences.english: That person was like a ghost, watching him in the darkness.

sentences.chinese: 林峰没有时间思考，他迅速跑进了一栋旧大楼。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng méiyǒu shíjiān sīkǎo, tā xùnsù pǎo jìnle yī dòng jiù dàlóu.
sentences.english: Lin Feng had no time to think; he quickly ran into an old building.

sentences.chinese: 这里曾经是一个教育中心，现在却很安静。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ céngjīng shì yīgè jiàoyù zhōngxīn, xiànzài què hěn ānjìng.
sentences.english: This place used to be an education center, but now it was very quiet.

sentences.chinese: 他走进一个房间，看到墙上有很多旧的广告。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒujìn yīgè fángjiān, kàndào qiángshàng yǒu hěnduō jiù de guǎnggào.
sentences.english: He entered a room and saw many old advertisements on the wall.

sentences.chinese: 这些广告是常见的，但其中一个让他想到了什么。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē guǎnggào shì chángjiàn de, dàn qízhōng yīgè ràng tā xiǎngdàole shénme.
sentences.english: These advertisements were common, but one of them made him think of something.

sentences.chinese: 他在桌子上发现了一份奇怪的文件。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài zhuōzi shàng fāxiànle yī fèn qíguài de wénjiàn.
sentences.english: He found a strange document on the table.

sentences.chinese: 这份文件看起来像是一篇作文，但内容很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn wénjiàn kàn qǐlái xiàng shì yī piān zuòwén, dàn nèiróng hěn qíguài.
sentences.english: This document looked like an essay, but the content was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 文件里提到了一些秘密的教学计划。
sentences.pinyin: Wénjiàn lǐ tí dào le yīxiē mìmì de jiàoxué jìhuà.
sentences.english: The document mentioned some secret teaching plans.

sentences.chinese: 林峰开始检查这些纸，他想找出真正的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kāishǐ jiǎnchá zhèxiē zhǐ, tā xiǎng zhǎochū zhēnzhèng de mìmì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng began to examine these papers, wanting to find the true secret.

sentences.chinese: 他发现这不仅仅是简单的教育问题，而是一场巨大的阴谋。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn zhè bù jǐnjǐn shì jiǎndān de jiàoyù wèntí, ér shì yī chǎng jùdà de yīnmóu.
sentences.english: He discovered this wasn't just a simple education issue, but a huge conspiracy.

sentences.chinese: 他想起自己实习的时候，也见过类似的表格。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ shíxí de shíhòu, yě jiànguò lèisì de biǎogé.
sentences.english: He recalled that during his internship, he had seen similar tables.

sentences.chinese: 那个时候，他的老师在表上画了一个红色的圈。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge shíhòu, tā de lǎoshī zài biǎo shàng huàle yīgè hóngsè de quān.
sentences.english: At that time, his teacher had drawn a red circle on the table.

sentences.chinese: 林峰现在打算弄清楚这个圈的意思。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiànzài dǎsuàn nòng qīngchǔ zhège quān de yìsi.
sentences.english: Lin Feng now planned to figure out the meaning of this circle.

sentences.chinese: 他数了数房间里的椅子，发现有三把椅子在移动。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shǔle shǔ fángjiān lǐ de yǐzi, fāxiàn yǒu sān bǎ yǐzi zài yídòng.
sentences.english: He counted the chairs in the room and found that three chairs had moved.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到有人在监视他，这不是一个笑话。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào yǒurén zài jiānshì tā, zhè bùshì yīgè xiàohua.
sentences.english: He realized someone was monitoring him; this was no joke.

sentences.chinese: 他快速地翻开一本词典，试图寻找文件里不明白的词。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kuàisù de fānkāi yī běn cídiǎn, shìtú xúnzhǎo wénjiàn lǐ bù míngbái de cí.
sentences.english: He quickly opened a dictionary, trying to find words in the document he didn't understand.

sentences.chinese: 词典的说明页告诉他，某些词在不同科目的书里意思不同。
sentences.pinyin: Cídiǎn de shuōmíng yè gàosù tā, mǒu xiē cí zài bùtóng kē mù de shū lǐ yìsi bùtóng.
sentences.english: The dictionary's explanation page told him that some words have different meanings in books of different subjects.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到对方在用一种特殊的练习方式来传递信息。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào duìfāng zài yòng yī zhǒng tèshū de liànxí fāngshì lái chuándì xìnxī.
sentences.english: He realized the other party was using a special practice method to transmit information.

sentences.chinese: 他必须练习这种方法，才能读懂对方的话。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū liàn zhè zhǒng fāngfǎ, cáinéng dú dǒng duìfāng de huà.
sentences.english: He had to practice this method to be able to understand their words.

sentences.chinese: 他重复地读着那段文字，试图找出重点。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chóngfù de dúzhe nà duàn wénzì, shìtú zhǎochū zhòngdiǎn.
sentences.english: He read the text repeatedly, trying to find the key point.

sentences.chinese: 他想起之前收到的通知，说有人要来参观这里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zhīqián shōudào de tōngzhī, shuō yǒurén yào lái cānguān zhèlǐ.
sentences.english: He remembered a notice he received earlier saying someone was coming to visit here.

sentences.chinese: 如果那个人现在来了，他将被困在这里。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nàge rén xiànzài láile, tā jiāng bèi kùn zài zhèlǐ.
sentences.english: If that person came now, he would be trapped here.

sentences.chinese: 林峰求自己保持冷静，他不能在这里被抓住。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng qiú zìjǐ bǎochí lěngjìng, tā bùnéng zài zhèlǐ bèi zhuā zhù.
sentences.english: Lin Feng begged himself to stay calm; he couldn't be caught here.

sentences.chinese: 他算了一下时间，距离对方发现他大概只有五分钟。
sentences.pinyin: Tā suànle yīxià shíjiān, jùlí duìfāng fāxiàn tā dàgài zhǐyǒu wǔ fēnzhōng.
sentences.english: He calculated the time; there were probably only five minutes before the other party found him.

sentences.chinese: 他不能重复之前的错误，必须立刻离开。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bùnéng chóngfù zhīqián de cuòwù, bìxū lìkè líkāi.
sentences.english: He couldn't repeat previous mistakes; he had to leave immediately.

sentences.chinese: 他选了一个窗户，试图跳下去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xuǎnle yīgè chuānghù, shìtú tiào xiàqù.
sentences.english: He chose a window and tried to jump down.

sentences.chinese: 他想到如果被发现，他可能再也没有机会逃跑。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngdào rúguǒ bèi fāxiàn, tā kěnéng zài yě méiyǒu jīhuì táopǎo.
sentences.english: He thought that if he were discovered, he might never have another chance to escape.

sentences.chinese: 他再次检查了房间，确保没有留下任何东西。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zàicì jiǎnchále fángjiān, quèbǎo méiyǒu liú xià rènhé dōngxī.
sentences.english: He checked the room again to ensure nothing was left behind.

sentences.chinese: 他听到走廊里传来了脚步声，声音越来越近。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīngdào zǒuláng lǐ chuánláile jiǎobù shēng, shēngyīn yuè lái yuè jìn.
sentences.english: He heard footsteps coming from the hallway, the sound getting closer and closer.

sentences.chinese: 那个人在说话，声音冷得像冰一样。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge rén zài shuōhuà, shēngyīn lěng de xiàng bīng yīyàng.
sentences.english: That person was speaking, the voice as cold as ice.

sentences.chinese: 林峰屏住呼吸，躲在门后。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng bǐngzhù hūxī, duǒ zài mén hòu.
sentences.english: Lin Feng held his breath, hiding behind the door.

sentences.chinese: 门慢慢地开了，一个黑色的影子出现了。
sentences.pinyin: Mén mànmàn de kāile, yīgè hēisè de yǐngzi chūxiànle.
sentences.english: The door slowly opened, and a black shadow appeared.

sentences.chinese: 黑色的影子走进了房间。
sentences.pinyin: Hēi sè de yǐng zi zǒu jìn le fáng jiān.
sentences.english: The black shadow walked into the room.

sentences.chinese: 林峰看着他的脸，那是一张非常难看的脸。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn zhe tā de liǎn, nà shì yī zhāng fēi cháng nán kàn de liǎn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at his face; it was a very ugly face.

sentences.chinese: 这个人拿着一个黑色的包，包里似乎有很多公斤的重物。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge rén ná zhe yī gè hēi sè de bāo, bāo lǐ sì hū yǒu hěn duō gōng jīn de zhòng wù.
sentences.english: This person was holding a black bag, which seemed to contain many kilograms of heavy objects.

sentences.chinese: 林峰在想，这个包里是不是有几千克的秘密文件？
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zài xiǎng, zhè ge bāo lǐ shì bú shì yǒu jǐ qiān kè de mì mì wén jiàn?
sentences.english: Lin Feng wondered if there were several kilograms of secret documents in the bag.

sentences.chinese: 窗外开始下雪了，这是最冷的冬天。
sentences.pinyin: Chuāng wài kāi shǐ xià xuě le, zhè shì zuì lěng de dōng tiān.
sentences.english: It started to snow outside; this is the coldest winter.

sentences.chinese: 天气预报说今天多云，现在温度已经零下十度。
sentences.pinyin: Tiān qì yù bào shuō jīn tiān duō yún, xiàn zài wēn dù yǐ jīng líng xià shí dù.
sentences.english: The weather forecast said it was cloudy today, and the temperature is already ten degrees below zero.

sentences.chinese: 林峰记得这个人在国际机场见过他。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jì dé zhè ge rén zài guó jì jī chǎng jiàn guò tā.
sentences.english: Lin Feng remembered seeing this person at the international airport.

sentences.chinese: 那个人的计划很危险，林峰必须离开这里。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge rén de jì huà hěn wēi xiǎn, Lín Fēng bì xū lí kāi zhè lǐ.
sentences.english: That person's plan was very dangerous, and Lin Feng had to leave this place.

sentences.chinese: 他看到桌子上有一碗方便面，面条是黄色的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī wǎn fāng biàn miàn, miàn tiáo shì huáng sè de.
sentences.english: He saw a bowl of instant noodles on the table; the noodles were yellow.

sentences.chinese: 旁边有一个蓝色的杯子和一个绿色的本子。
sentences.pinyin: Páng biān yǒu yī gè lán sè de bēi zi hé yī gè lǜ sè de běn zi.
sentences.english: Beside it was a blue cup and a green notebook.

sentences.chinese: 它们在桌子上，像是在等待着什么。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zài zhuō zi shàng, xiàng shì zài děng dài zhe shén me.
sentences.english: They were on the table, as if waiting for something.

sentences.chinese: 林峰突然想起在黑龙江的时候，那里的人非常友好。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng tū rán xiǎng qǐ zài Hēi lóng jiāng de shí hou, nà lǐ de rén fēi cháng yǒu hǎo.
sentences.english: Lin Feng suddenly remembered when he was in Heilongjiang, the people there were very friendly.

sentences.chinese: 但现在，他面对的是一个巨大的难题。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiàn zài, tā miàn duì de shì yī gè jù dà de nán tí.
sentences.english: But now, he was facing a huge difficult problem.

sentences.chinese: 他看向墙上的黑板，上面写着一些奇怪的问题。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng qiáng shàng de hēi bǎn, shàng miàn xiě zhe yī xiē qí guài de wèn tí.
sentences.english: He looked at the blackboard on the wall, where some strange questions were written.

sentences.chinese: 他离那个影子很近，只能听到对方的呼吸声。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lí nà ge yǐng zi hěn jìn, zhǐ néng tīng dào duì fāng de hū xī shēng.
sentences.english: He was very close to the shadow, only able to hear the other person's breathing.

sentences.chinese: 这个房间的门是黑色的，像一扇巨大的大门。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge fáng jiān de mén shì hēi sè de, xiàng yī shàn jù dà de dà mén.
sentences.english: The door of this room was black, like a giant main gate.

sentences.chinese: 林峰觉得自己的心跳很快，这是一个严重的问题。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jué dé zì jǐ de xīn tiào hěn kuài, zhè shì yī gè yán zhòng de wèn tí.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt his heart beating very fast; this was a serious problem.

sentences.chinese: 他想逃跑，但门被锁住了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng táo pǎo, dàn mén bèi suǒ zhù le.
sentences.english: He wanted to escape, but the door was locked.

sentences.chinese: 影子慢慢转过身，看着林峰。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi màn màn zhuǎn guò shēn, kàn zhe Lín Fēng.
sentences.english: The shadow slowly turned around and looked at Lin Feng.

sentences.chinese: 林峰发现对方的眼睛里没有光。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng fā xiàn duì fāng de yǎn jīng lǐ méi yǒu guāng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng found that there was no light in the other person's eyes.

sentences.chinese: 这是一个关于生存的计划。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yī gè guān yú shēng cún de jì huà.
sentences.english: This was a plan for survival.

sentences.chinese: 他必须在对方发现他之前找到出口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì xū zài duì fāng fā xiàn tā zhī qián zhǎo dào chū kǒu.
sentences.english: He had to find the exit before the other person discovered him.

sentences.chinese: 但此时，影子突然开口说话了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn cǐ shí, yǐng zi tū rán kāi kǒu shuō huà le.
sentences.english: But at this moment, the shadow suddenly spoke.

sentences.chinese: “你觉得你能跑掉吗？”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ jué dé nǐ néng pǎo diào ma?”
sentences.english: "Do you think you can get away?"

sentences.chinese: 林峰全身在发抖。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng quán shēn zài fǎ dòu.
sentences.english: Lin Feng's whole body was shaking.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这个影子十分可怕。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué de zhè ge yǐng zi shí fēn kě pà.
sentences.english: He felt this shadow was utterly terrifying.

sentences.chinese: 影子说话的声音不大，但让林峰感到心急。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi shuō huà de shēng yīn bù dà, dàn ràng Lín Fēng gǎn dào xīn jí.
sentences.english: The shadow's voice wasn't loud, but it made Lin Feng feel anxious.

sentences.chinese: 他一直盯着那个影子的眼睛。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yī zhí dīng zhe nà ge yǐng zi de yǎn jīng.
sentences.english: He kept staring straight at the shadow's eyes.

sentences.chinese: 原来，那个人的眼睛真的没有光。
sentences.pinyin: Yuán lái, nà ge rén de yǎn jīng zhēn de méi yǒu guāng.
sentences.english: As it turned out, that person's eyes really had no light.

sentences.chinese: 林峰想，他一生中从来没有见过这样的人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎng, tā yī shēng zhōng cóng lái méi yǒu jiàn guò zhè yàng de rén.
sentences.english: Lin Feng thought that in all his life, he had never seen such a person.

sentences.chinese: 他必须离开这里，而且必须快。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì xū lí kāi zhè lǐ, ér qiě bì xū kuài.
sentences.english: He had to leave this place, and he had to be fast.

sentences.chinese: 他发现这里有不少门。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn zhè lǐ yǒu bù shǎo mén.
sentences.english: He discovered there were quite a few doors here.

sentences.chinese: 大部分的门都关着。
sentences.pinyin: Dà bù fen de mén dōu guān zhe.
sentences.english: The majority of the doors were closed.

sentences.chinese: 他走到了一个房间，那里有大量的文件在地上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu dào le yī gè fáng jiān, nà lǐ yǒu dà liàng de wén jiàn zài dì shàng.
sentences.english: He walked into a room where a large quantity of documents were on the floor.

sentences.chinese: 这些文件是这里的全部秘密吗？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiē wén jiàn shì zhè lǐ de quán bù mì mì ma?
sentences.english: Were these documents all the secrets of this place?

sentences.chinese: 林峰快速地看了一下，主要的内容是关于一个计划。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kuài sù de kàn le yī xià, zhǔ yào de nèi róng shì guān yú yī gè jì huà.
sentences.english: Lin Feng took a quick look; the main content was about a plan.

sentences.chinese: 这个计划让林峰感到实在太奇怪了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge jì huà ràng Lín Fēng gǎn dào shí zài tài qí guài le.
sentences.english: This plan made Lin Feng feel it was really too strange.

sentences.chinese: 他忽然听到门外有大声的说话声。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hū rán tīng dào mén wài yǒu dà shēng de shuō huà shēng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, he heard loud voices outside the door.

sentences.chinese: 那是好多个人的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì hǎo duō gè rén de shēng yīn.
sentences.english: Those were the voices of quite a lot of people.

sentences.chinese: 他听到对方说，全体成员必须在今晚完成任务。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīng dào duì fāng shuō, quán tǐ chéng yuán bì xū zài jīn wǎn wán chéng rèn wu.
sentences.english: He heard the other party say that all members must complete the mission tonight.

sentences.chinese: 林峰意识到，这里的人大多数都不是好人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yì shí dào, zhè lǐ de rén dà duō shù dōu bù shì hǎo rén.
sentences.english: Lin Feng realized that the great majority of people here were not good people.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果被他们发现，他一定没有机会逃跑。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rú guǒ bèi tā men fā xiàn, tā yī dìng méi yǒu jī huì táo pǎo.
sentences.english: He thought that if he were discovered by them, he surely would have no chance to escape.

sentences.chinese: 他看着窗外，外面全年都这么冷吗？
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe chuāng wài, wài miàn quán nián dōu zhè me lěng ma?
sentences.english: He looked out the window; was it this cold all year long outside?

sentences.chinese: 现在是深夜，所有的人都应该在睡觉。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài shì shēn yè, suǒ yǒu de rén dōu yīng gāi zài shuì jiào.
sentences.english: It was now midnight, and all people should be sleeping.

sentences.chinese: 但这里却有很多人在走动。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zhè lǐ què yǒu hěn duō rén zài zǒu dòng.
sentences.english: But here, many people were moving around.

sentences.chinese: 多数的人穿着黑色的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Duō shù de rén chuān zhe hēi sè de yī fú.
sentences.english: The majority of them were wearing black clothes.

sentences.chinese: 林峰觉得自己的情况完全变了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jué de zì jǐ de qíng kuàng wán quán biàn le.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt his situation had completely changed.

sentences.chinese: 他平常是一个很安静的人，但现在他必须勇敢。
sentences.pinyin: Tā píng cháng shì yī gè hěn ān jìng de rén, dàn xiàn zài tā bì xū yǒng gǎn.
sentences.english: He was usually a very quiet person, but now he had to be brave.

sentences.chinese: 他想，只要能找到出口，一切就挺好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, zhǐ yào néng zhǎo dào chū kǒu, yī qiè jiù tǐng hǎo.
sentences.english: He thought that as long as he could find the exit, everything would be very good.

sentences.chinese: 他数了数，走廊里一共有一个出口和三个死胡同。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shǔ le shǔ, zǒu láng lǐ yī gòng yǒu yī gè chū kǒu hé sān gè sǐ hú tóng.
sentences.english: He counted; there was altogether one exit and three dead ends in the corridor.

sentences.chinese: 他现在得快点走，因为时间不够了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàn zài děi kuài diǎn zǒu, yīn wèi shí jiān bù gòu le.
sentences.english: He had to move faster now because there wasn't enough time.

sentences.chinese: 他发现他的心跳大大地加快了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn tā de xīn tiào dà dà de jiā kuài le.
sentences.english: He noticed his heartbeat had greatly increased.

sentences.chinese: 他想，大家都在寻找他，他不能在这里等。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, dà jiā dōu zài xún zhǎo tā, tā bù néng zài zhè lǐ děng.
sentences.english: He thought that everyone was searching for him, and he couldn't wait here.

sentences.chinese: 他刚走两步，就听到背后有一个声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gāng zǒu liǎng bù, jiù tīng dào bèi hòu yǒu yī gè shēng yīn.
sentences.english: He had just taken two steps when he heard a voice behind him.

sentences.chinese: “你在这里做什么？”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ zài zhè lǐ zuò shén me?”
sentences.english: "What are you doing here?"

sentences.chinese: 这个声音多么冷酷啊！
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge shēng yīn duō me lěng kù a!
sentences.english: How cold this voice was!

sentences.chinese: 林峰赶紧跑了起来，他必须在被抓完之前逃出去。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎn jǐn pǎo le qǐ lái, tā bì xū zài bèi zhuā wán zhī qián táo chū qù.
sentences.english: Lin Feng hurriedly started running; he had to escape before he was completely caught.

sentences.chinese: 林峰在黑暗的走廊里飞快地跑。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zài hēi àn de zǒu láng lǐ fēi kuài de pǎo.
sentences.english: Lin Feng ran quickly through the dark corridor.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得对方是故意在玩游戏，想让他害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué de duì fāng shì gù yì zài wán yóu xì, xiǎng ràng tā hài pà.
sentences.english: He felt the other party was deliberately playing a game, wanting to make him afraid.

sentences.chinese: 他跑到了一个房间门口，正好看到门开着。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pǎo dào le yí gè fáng jiān mén kǒu, zhèng hǎo kàn dào mén kāi zhe.
sentences.english: He ran to a room door and just happened to see the door was open.

sentences.chinese: 他赶紧跑进去，发现这里正是他寻找的办公室。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎn jǐn pǎo jìn qù, fā xiàn zhè lǐ zhèng shì tā xún zhǎo de bàn gōng shì.
sentences.english: He rushed inside and found that this was precisely the office he was looking for.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果被抓到，他可能永远不能离开这里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rú guǒ bèi zhuā dào, tā kě néng yǒng yuǎn bù néng lí kāi zhè lǐ.
sentences.english: He thought that if he were caught, he might never be able to leave this place.

sentences.chinese: 这里的气氛特别奇怪，空气中有一种冷冷的味道。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de qì fēn tè bié qí guài, kōng qì zhōng yǒu yì zhǒng lěng lěng de wèi dào.
sentences.english: The atmosphere here was especially strange, with a cold smell in the air.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，真正危险的东西就在这个房间里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhī dào, zhēn zhèng wēi xiǎn de dōng xī jiù zài zhè gè fáng jiān lǐ.
sentences.english: He knew that the truly dangerous thing was in this room.

sentences.chinese: 林峰经常在噩梦中看到这样的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jīng cháng zài è mèng zhōng kàn dào zhè yàng de dì fāng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng frequently saw places like this in his nightmares.

sentences.chinese: 他老是担心有人在暗处看着他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lǎo shi dān xīn yǒu rén zài àn chù kàn zhe tā.
sentences.english: He was always worried that someone was watching him from the shadows.

sentences.chinese: 桌子上放着许多文件，还有一台旧计算机。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe xǔ duō wén jiàn, hái yǒu yí tái jiù jì suàn jī.
sentences.english: Many documents were on the table, and there was an old computer.

sentences.chinese: 他不敢相信，这个地方竟然这么阴森。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù gǎn xiāng xìn, zhè gè dì fāng jìng rán zhè me yīn sēn.
sentences.english: He couldn't believe this place was so eerie.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，对方可能随时会进来抓他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhī dào, duì fāng kě néng suí shí huì jìn lái zhuā tā.
sentences.english: He knew the other party could come in to catch him at any time.

sentences.chinese: 除了这个房间以外，他没有其他地方可以躲。
sentences.pinyin: Chú le zhè gè fáng jiān yǐ wài, tā méi yǒu qí tā dì fāng kě yǐ duǒ.
sentences.english: Apart from this room, he had nowhere else to hide.

sentences.chinese: 他想起这个秘密组织在全国都有分部。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ zhè gè mì mì zǔ zhī zài quán guó dōu yǒu fēn bù.
sentences.english: He remembered that this secret organization had branches nationwide.

sentences.chinese: 他们甚至在北方有很大的基地。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men shèn zhì zài běi fāng yǒu hěn dà de jī dì.
sentences.english: They even had a large base in the north.

sentences.chinese: 有些人为了逃避他们，选择出国生活。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu xiē rén wèi le táo bì they, xuǎn zé chū guó shēng huó.
sentences.english: Some people chose to go abroad to escape them.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他的手机响了。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, tā de shǒu jī xiǎng le.
sentences.english: Suddenly, his phone rang.

sentences.chinese: “喂？”林峰小声地回答，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: “Wéi?” Lín Fēng xiǎo shēng de huí dá, xīn tiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: "Hello?" Lin Feng answered in a low voice, his heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 电话那边没有人说话，只有沉重的呼吸声。
sentences.pinyin: Diàn huà nà biān méi yǒu rén shuō huà, zhǐ yǒu chén zhòng de hū xī shēng.
sentences.english: There was no one speaking on the other end of the phone, only heavy breathing.

sentences.chinese: 林峰低头看到桌上有一个普通的笔记本。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng dī tóu kàn dào zhuō shàng yǒu yí gè pǔ tōng de bǐ jì běn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked down and saw an ordinary notebook on the table.

sentences.chinese: 他打开它，发现里面记录了许多节日的时间。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dǎ kāi tā, fā xiàn lǐ miàn jì lù le xǔ duō jié rì de shí jiān.
sentences.english: He opened it and found that many holiday dates were recorded inside.

sentences.chinese: 但在日期的下面，写着一个神秘的队名。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zài rì qī de xià miàn, xiě zhe yí gè mì mì de duì míng.
sentences.english: But beneath the dates, a mysterious team name was written.

sentences.chinese: 这个笔记本记录了所有被他们抓走的人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè bǐ jì běn jì lù le suǒ yǒu bèi tā men zhuā zǒu de rén.
sentences.english: This notebook recorded everyone who had been taken by them.

sentences.chinese: 林峰看着笔记本，心里感到非常难过。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe bǐjìběn, xīnlǐ gǎndào fēicháng nánguò.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the notebook, feeling extremely sad in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 这些笔记记录了许多人的名字，他们都被强行分开。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē bǐjì jìlùle xǔduō rén de míngzì, tāmen dōu bèi qiángxíng fēnkāi.
sentences.english: These notes recorded the names of many people, all of whom had been forcibly separated.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一个名字，那是他的好朋友，记录说他因为住院而失踪。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào yīgè míngzì, nà shì tā de hǎo péngyǒu, jìlù shuō tā yīnwèi zhùyuàn ér shīzōng.
sentences.english: He saw a name, it was his good friend, and the record said he disappeared because of hospitalization.

sentences.chinese: 林峰低头看着那个名字，心中充满了不满。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng dītóu kànzhe nàgè míngzì, xīnlǐ chōngmǎnle bùmǎn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng lowered his head to look at that name, his heart filled with resentment.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这个世界太危险，人们像商品一样被卖掉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde zhège shìjiè tài wēixiǎn, rénmen xiàng shāngpǐn yīyàng bèi màidiào.
sentences.english: He felt the world was too dangerous, and people were sold like commodities.

sentences.chinese: 突然，窗外吹来一阵冷风，吹动了绿色的窗帘。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, chuāngwài chuī lái yīzhèn lěngfēng, chuīdòngle lǜsè de chuānglián.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a cold wind blew from outside, moving the green curtains.

sentences.chinese: 林峰感到心口很疼，呼吸变得困难，非常难受。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎndào xīnkǒu hěn téng, hūxī biàndé kùnnán, fēicháng nánshòu.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt a sharp pain in his chest, his breathing became difficult, and he felt very unwell.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，现在离开这里是最好的选择。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhīdào, xiànzài líkāi zhèlǐ shì zuì hǎo de xuǎnzé.
sentences.english: He knew that leaving this place now was the best choice.

sentences.chinese: 但他不能就这样走开，他必须留下证据。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tā bùnéng jiù zhèyàng zǒukāi, tā bìxū liúxià zhèngjù.
sentences.english: But he couldn't just walk away; he had to leave behind evidence.

sentences.chinese: 他快速地在笔记本上写下几个生词，那是他给自己留的暗号。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kuàisù de zài bǐjìběn shàng xiě xià jǐ gè shēngcí, nà shì tā gěi zìjǐ liú de ànhào.
sentences.english: He quickly wrote a few new words in the notebook, which were secret codes he left for himself.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果能省掉一些时间，或许能跑得更快。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rúguǒ néng shěngdiào yīxiē shíjiān, huòxǔ néng pǎo dé gèng kuài.
sentences.english: He thought that if he could save some time, perhaps he could run faster.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他听到外面有人在喊他的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, tā tīngdào wàimiàn yǒurén zài hǎn tā de míngzì.
sentences.english: Suddenly, he heard someone outside shouting his name.

sentences.chinese: 那个声音非常难听，像野兽在咆哮。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè shēngyīn fēicháng nántīng, xiàng yěshòu zài páoxiào.
sentences.english: That voice was very unpleasant to hear, like a wild beast roaring.

sentences.chinese: 林峰赶紧放下笔记本，试图寻找出口。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎnjǐn fàngxià bǐjìběn, shìtú xúnzhǎo chūkǒu.
sentences.english: Lin Feng quickly put down the notebook and tried to find an exit.

sentences.chinese: 他推开门，发现走廊里有一个黑色的影子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tuīkāi mén, fāxiàn zǒuláng lǐ yǒu yīgè hēisè de yǐngzi.
sentences.english: He pushed open the door and found a black shadow in the corridor.

sentences.chinese: 那个影子对他喊道：“快点儿！跟我走！”
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè yǐngzi duì tā hǎndào: “Kuài diǎnr! Gēn wǒ zǒu!”
sentences.english: The shadow shouted at him, "Hurry up! Come with me!"

sentences.chinese: 林峰害怕地往后拉了一下门，他觉得这个人的语气不行。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hàipà de wǎng hòu lāle yīxià mén, tā juéde zhège rén de yǔqì bùxíng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng fearfully pulled the door back a bit; he felt the person's tone was not right.

sentences.chinese: 他想，不如直接跳窗逃走，而不是相信这个陌生人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, bùrú zhíjiē tiào chuāng táozǒu, ér bùshì xiāngxìn zhège mòshēng rén.
sentences.english: He thought it would be better to just jump out the window and escape rather than trust this stranger.

sentences.chinese: 影子冷笑一声，说：“你觉得你能跑掉？你太天真了。”
sentences.pinyin: Yǐngzi lěngxiào yīshēng, shuō: “Nǐ juéde nǐ néng pǎodiào? Nǐ tài tiānzhēn le.”
sentences.english: The shadow sneered and said, "You think you can run away? You are too naive."

sentences.chinese: 林峰感到一阵眩晕，身体突然倒在地上。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎndào yīzhèn xuànyūn, shēntǐ tūrán dǎo zài dìshàng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt a wave of dizziness, and his body suddenly collapsed to the ground.

sentences.chinese: 他看到对方手里拿着一个奇怪的电子设备。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào duìfāng shǒulǐ názhe yīgè qíguài de diànzǐ shèbèi.
sentences.english: He saw the other person holding a strange electronic device.

sentences.chinese: 对方按了一下按钮，设备开机了，发出红色的光。
sentences.pinyin: Duìfāng ànle yīxià ànniǔ, shèbèi kāijī le, fāchū hóngsè de guāng.
sentences.english: The person pressed a button, the device booted up, emitting a red light.

sentences.chinese: “你的单位已经不再需要你了，”影子冷冷地说。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ de dānwèi yǐjīng bù zài xūyào nǐ le,” yǐngzi lěnglěng de shuō.
sentences.english: "Your work unit no longer needs you," the shadow said coldly.

sentences.chinese: 林峰想起自己以前打工的日子，那时候生活很简单。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ yǐqián dǎgōng de rìzi, nà shíhòu shēnghuó hěn jiǎndān.
sentences.english: Lin Feng remembered the days when he worked temporary jobs; life was very simple back then.

sentences.chinese: 他记得有个同事去克罗地亚休假，之后就再也没有出院回来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde yǒu gè tóngshì qù Kèluódìyà xiūjià, zhīhòu jiù zài yě méiyǒu chūyuàn huílái.
sentences.english: He remembered a colleague who went to Croatia for a vacation and never came back after being discharged from the hospital.

sentences.chinese: 现在，他意识到那个同事可能也在这本笔记里。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài, tā yìshí dào nàgè tóngshì kěnéng yě zài zhè běn bǐjì lǐ.
sentences.english: Now, he realized that colleague might also be in this notebook.

sentences.chinese: 影子走近他，低声说：“干活儿的人不需要休息。”
sentences.pinyin: Yǐngzi zǒujìn tā, dīshēng shuō: “Gàn huó r de rén bù xūyào xiūxi.”
sentences.english: The shadow approached him and said in a low voice, "Those who do the work do not need rest."

sentences.chinese: 林峰试图反抗，但他的手被对方死死地拉住。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng shìtú fǎnkàng, dàn tā de shǒu bèi duìfāng sǐsǐ de lāzhù.
sentences.english: Lin Feng tried to resist, but his hand was gripped tightly by the other party.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得自己的手指快要掉下来了，疼得他想叫。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde zìjǐ de shǒuzhǐ kuài yào diàoxiàlái le, téng de tā xiǎng jiào.
sentences.english: He felt as if his fingers were about to fall off, and it hurt so much he wanted to scream.

sentences.chinese: “不好意思，我们要换一个地方谈谈，”影子说。
sentences.pinyin: “Bù hǎo yì si, wǒmen yào huàn yīgè dìfāng tántan,” yǐngzi shuō.
sentences.english: "Sorry, we need to change locations to talk," the shadow said.

sentences.chinese: 他强行把林峰推向走廊尽头的一辆车。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qiángxíng bǎ Lín Fēng tuī xiàng zǒuláng jìntóu de yī liàng chē.
sentences.english: He forcibly pushed Lin Feng toward a car at the end of the corridor.

sentences.chinese: 车子已经停车在阴暗的角落里，发动机在低吼。
sentences.pinyin: Chēzi yǐjīng tíngchē zài yīnyàn de jiǎoluò lǐ, fādòngjī zài dīhǒu.
sentences.english: The car was already parked in a dark corner, the engine growling low.

sentences.chinese: 林峰被扔进车后座，他绝望地看向窗外。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng bèi rēng jìn chē hòuzuò, tā juéwàng de kànxiàng chuāngwài.
sentences.english: Lin Feng was thrown into the back seat, looking out the window in despair.

sentences.chinese: 他想拿起手机求救，但对方迅速帮他关机了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng náqǐ shǒujī qiújiù, dàn duìfāng xùnsù bāng tā guānjī le.
sentences.english: He wanted to pick up his phone for help, but the other person quickly turned it off for him.

sentences.chinese: 车子迅速启动，离开了那个恐怖的建筑。
sentences.pinyin: Chēzi xùnsù qǐdòng, líkāile nàgè kǒngbù de jiànzhù.
sentences.english: The car started quickly and left that terrifying building.

sentences.chinese: 林峰在车里颤抖，他知道这次出门可能再也回不去。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zài chē lǐ chàndǒu, tā zhīdào zhè cì chūmén kěnéng zài yě huí bù qù.
sentences.english: Lin Feng trembled in the car, knowing that this time leaving home might mean never returning.

sentences.chinese: 他想起那些被抓走的人，心中充满了恐惧。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ nàxiē bèi zhuā zǒu de rén, xīnlǐ chōngmǎnle kǒngjù.
sentences.english: He thought of those who had been taken away, his heart filled with fear.

sentences.chinese: 他必须在被他们彻底控制之前，找到反击的机会。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū zài bèi tāmen chèdǐ kòngzhì zhīqián, zhǎodào fǎnjī de jīhuì.
sentences.english: He had to find a chance to fight back before being completely controlled by them.

sentences.chinese: 车子在深夜的街道上飞驰，像一个巨大的黑色棺材。
sentences.pinyin: Chēzi zài shēnyè de jiēdào shàng fēichí, xiàng yīgè jùdà de hēisè guāncai.
sentences.english: The car sped through the midnight streets like a giant black coffin.

sentences.chinese: 林峰闭上眼，心中只有一个念头：活下去。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng bìshàng yǎn, xīnlǐ zhǐyǒu yīgè niàntou: huó xiàqù.
sentences.english: Lin Feng closed his eyes, with only one thought in his mind: survive.

sentences.chinese: 突然，车子猛地刹车，一个身影挡在了路中间。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, chēzi měng de shāchē, yīgè shēnyǐng dǎng zàile lù zhōngjiān.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the car braked sharply, and a figure stood blocking the middle of the road.

sentences.chinese: 车子猛地停了下来，林峰的心情非常紧张。
sentences.pinyin: Chē zi měng de tíng le xià lái, Lín Fēng de xīn qíng fēi cháng jǐn zhāng.
sentences.english: The car came to a sudden stop, and Lin Feng's mood was extremely tense.

sentences.chinese: 他看向窗外，一个奇怪的人站在路中间。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng chuāng wài, yí gè qí guài de rén zhàn zài lù zhōng jiān.
sentences.english: He looked out the window; a strange person was standing in the middle of the road.

sentences.chinese: 那个人的个子很高，穿着一件黑色的长大衣。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén de gè zi hěn gāo, chuān zhe yí jiàn hēi sè de cháng dà yī.
sentences.english: That person was very tall, wearing a long black overcoat.

sentences.chinese: 他的头低着，遮住了脸，像是一个从恐怖小说里走出来的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de tóu dī zhe, zhē zhù le liǎn, xiàng shì yí gè cóng kǒng bù xiǎo shuō lǐ zǒu chū lái de rén.
sentences.english: His head was lowered, hiding his face, like someone who had walked out of a horror novel.

sentences.chinese: 林峰觉得这件事情非常不对劲。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jué de zhè jiàn shì qing fēi cháng bú duì jìn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt that this matter was very wrong.

sentences.chinese: 对方慢慢地开口，声音冷得让人发抖。
sentences.pinyin: Duì fāng màn màn de kāi kǒu, shēng yīn lěng de ràng rén fā dǒu.
sentences.english: The other person slowly spoke, his voice so cold it made one shiver.

sentences.chinese: “你带了那个笔记本吗？”对方问，嘴唇在微微颤抖。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ dài le nà gè bǐ jì běn ma?” duì fāng wèn, zuǐ chún zài wēi wēi chàn dǒu.
sentences.english: "Do you have that notebook?" the other asked, his lips trembling slightly.

sentences.chinese: 林峰没有回答，他想起笔记本里记录的那些关于公司的信息。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng méi yǒu huí dá, tā xiǎng qǐ bǐ jì běn lǐ jì lù de nà xiē guān yú gōng sī de xìn xī.
sentences.english: Lin Feng did not answer; he thought of the information about the company recorded in the notebook.

sentences.chinese: 那家公司的名称在笔记本上被圈了起来，看起来像是一个巨大的陷阱。
sentences.pinyin: Nà jiā gōng sī de míng chēng zài bǐ jì běn shàng bèi quān le qǐ lái, kàn qǐ lái xiàng shì yí gè jù dà de xiàn jǐng.
sentences.english: The name of that company was circled in the notebook, looking like a giant trap.

sentences.chinese: 林峰在实际生活中从来没有见过这样的人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zài shí jì shēng huó zhōng cóng lái méi yǒu jiàn guò zhè yàng de rén.
sentences.english: Lin Feng had never seen such a person in actual life.

sentences.chinese: 他习惯在安静的地方生活，而不是在深夜的街道上被追杀。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xí guàn zài ānjìng de dì fang shēng huó, ér bú shì zài shēn yè de jiē dào shàng bèi zhuī shā.
sentences.english: He was used to living in quiet places, not being hunted on the streets in the dead of night.

sentences.chinese: 他想起自己的家庭，想起那个温柔的太太，心中充满了恐惧。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ zì jǐ de jiā tíng, xiǎng qǐ nà gè wēn róu de tài tai, xīn zhōng chōng mǎn le kǒng jù.
sentences.english: He thought of his family, and of his gentle wife, his heart filling with fear.

sentences.chinese: 突然，那个陌生人的手机响了，发出“当”的一声响亮的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, nà gè mò shēng rén de shǒu jī xiǎng le, fā chū “dāng” de yì shēng xiǎng liàng de shēng yīn.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the stranger's phone rang, making a loud "dong" sound.

sentences.chinese: 陌生人看了一眼屏幕，上面的图片是一个奇怪的符号。
sentences.pinyin: Mò shēng rén kàn le yì yǎn píng mù, shàng miàn de tú piàn shì yí gè qí guài de fú hào.
sentences.english: The stranger glanced at the screen; the picture on it was a strange symbol.

sentences.chinese: 林峰注意到这个符号像是一个圆圈，圆心是一个黑点。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhù yì dào zhè gè fú hào xiàng shì yí gè yuán quān, zhōng xīn shì yí gè hēi diǎn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng noticed this symbol looked like a circle with a black dot at the center.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，这个符号可能是某种组织的中心标志。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, zhè gè fú hào kě néng shì mǒu zhǒng zǔ zhī de zhōng xīn biāo zhì.
sentences.english: He realized this symbol might be the central emblem of some organization.

sentences.chinese: “这是一个例子，”陌生人冷笑着说，“这就是不听话的人的下场。”
sentences.pinyin: “Zhè shì yí gè lì zi,” mò shēng rén lěng xiào zhe shuō, “zhè jiù shì bù tīng huà de rén de xià chǎng.”
sentences.english: "This is an example," the stranger said with a cold laugh, "this is what happens to people who don't listen."

sentences.chinese: 林峰在想，对方抓走这么多人的原因到底是什么？
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zài xiǎng, duì fāng zhuā zǒu zhè me duō rén de yuán yīn dào dǐ shì shén me?
sentences.english: Lin Feng wondered what the root cause of the other party kidnapping so many people was.

sentences.chinese: 这个城市的人口很多，但为什么只有这些人失踪了？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè chéng shì de rén kǒu hěn duō, dàn wèi shén me zhǐ yǒu zhè xiē rén shī zōng le?
sentences.english: The population of this city is large, but why did only these people disappear?

sentences.chinese: 他感觉到对方并不认为他和他们是平等的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎn jué dào duì fāng bìng bù rèn wéi tā hé tā men shì píng děng de.
sentences.english: He felt that the other party did not consider him equal to them.

sentences.chinese: 在对方眼里，林峰就像是一个在做作业的学生，只要分数不够就会被淘汰。
sentences.pinyin: Zài duì fāng yǎn lǐ, Lín Fēng jiù xiàng shì yí gè zài zuò zuò yè de xué sheng, zhǐ yào fēn shù bú gòu jiù huì bèi táo tài.
sentences.english: In the other's eyes, Lin Feng was like a student doing homework; if the grade wasn't high enough, he would be eliminated.

sentences.chinese: 林峰看向天上，夜里没有星星，只有浓浓的黑雾。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn xiàng tiān shàng, yè li méi yǒu xīng xīng, zhǐ yǒu nóng nóng de hēi wù.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked up at the sky; there were no stars at night, only thick black fog.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得现在的处境就像是一部恐怖影片，而他是唯一的主角。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué de xiàn zài de chǔ jìng jiù xiàng shì yí bù kǒng bù yǐng piàn, ér tā shì wéi yī de zhǔ jué.
sentences.english: He felt his current situation was like a horror movie, and he was the sole protagonist.

sentences.chinese: 他注意到对方腰间带了一根黑色的皮带，上面挂着一把锋利的刀。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhù yì dào duì fāng yāo jiān dài le yì gēn hēi sè de pí dài, shàng miàn guà zhe yì bǎ fēng lì de dāo.
sentences.english: He noticed the other party wore a black belt around his waist, with a sharp knife hanging from it.

sentences.chinese: 刀刃的大小刚好能切断一个人的喉咙。
sentences.pinyin: Dāo rèn de dà xiǎo gāng hǎo néng qiē duàn yí gè rén de hóu lóng.
sentences.english: The size of the blade was just right to slit a person's throat.

sentences.chinese: 林峰闭上眼，想象自己现在在宽阔的大海边，那里没有危险。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng bì shàng yǎn, xiǎng xiàng zì jǐ xiàn zài zài kuān kuò de dà hǎi biān, nà lǐ méi yǒu wēi xiǎn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng closed his eyes, imagining himself now by the vast ocean, where there was no danger.

sentences.chinese: 但现实是，他必须面对这个恐怖的夜晚。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiàn shí shì, tā bì xū miàn duì zhè gè kǒng bù de yè wǎn.
sentences.english: But the reality was, he had to face this terrifying night.

sentences.chinese: 他突然发现，笔记本的最后一页写着一个地址。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tū rán fā xiàn, bǐ jì běn de zuì hòu yí yè xiě zhe yí gè dì zhǐ.
sentences.english: He suddenly discovered that the last page of the notebook had an address written on it.

sentences.chinese: 那个地址就在这座城市的中心地带。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè dì zhǐ jiù zài zhè zuò chéng shì de zhōng xīn dì dài.
sentences.english: That address was in the center of the city.

sentences.chinese: 林峰必须在对方再次行动之前，离开这辆车。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng bì xū zài duì fāng zài cì xíng dòng zhī qián, lí kāi zhè liàng chē.
sentences.english: Lin Feng had to leave this car before the other party acted again.

sentences.chinese: 他猛地推开车门，向黑暗的街道跑去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā měng de tuī kāi chē mén, xiàng hēi àn de jiē dào pǎo qù.
sentences.english: He abruptly pushed open the car door and ran toward the dark street.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，一只冰冷的手抓住了他的肩膀。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, yì zhī bīng lěng de shǒu zhuā zhù le tā de jiān bǎng.
sentences.english: But just then, an icy hand grabbed his shoulder.

sentences.chinese: 林峰心里非常害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xīn lǐ fēicháng hàipà.
sentences.english: Lin Feng was very scared in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 那只冰冷的手用力抓着他。
sentences.pinyin: Nà zhī bīnglěng de shǒu yònglì zhuāzhe tā.
sentences.english: That cold hand was gripping him tightly.

sentences.chinese: 他突然想到了一个方法，猛地回头用胳膊撞对方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán xiǎngdào le yī gè fāngfǎ, měngde huítóu yòng gēbo zhuàng duìfāng.
sentences.english: He suddenly thought of a method and abruptly turned around to hit the opponent with his arm.

sentences.chinese: 对方松开了手，林峰趁机跑进了一条阴暗的小路。
sentences.pinyin: Duìfāng sōngkāi le shǒu, Lín Fēng chènjī pǎo jìn le yī tiáo yīnyàn de xiǎolù.
sentences.english: The opponent let go, and Lin Feng took the chance to run into a dark alley.

sentences.chinese: 他跑得很快，呼吸急促，感觉这里的空气很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pǎo de hěn kuài, hūxī jícù, gǎnjué zhèlǐ de kōngqì hěn lěng.
sentences.english: He ran very fast, breathing heavily, feeling that the air here was very cold.

sentences.chinese: 街道两边的路灯忽明忽暗。
sentences.pinyin: Jiēdào liǎngbiān de lǔdēng hū míng hū àn.
sentences.english: The street lamps on both sides of the road flickered.

sentences.chinese: 他看到地上有一张旧报纸，上面写着一个奇怪的数字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào dìshàng yǒu yī zhāng jiù bàozhǐ, shàngmiàn xiězhe yī gè qíguài de shùzì.
sentences.english: He saw an old newspaper on the ground with a strange number written on it.

sentences.chinese: 这个数字看起来像是一个代码。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège shùzì kàn qǐlái xiàng shì yī gè dàimǎ.
sentences.english: This number looked like a code.

sentences.chinese: 林峰记得笔记本里的那个地址，就在这个方向。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jìde bǐjìběn lǐ de nàge dìzhǐ, jiù zài zhège fāngxiàng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng remembered the address in the notebook; it was in this direction.

sentences.chinese: 他躲进一家废弃的商店，这里有一瓶没喝完的水。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duǒ jìn yī jiā fèiqì de shāngdiàn, zhèlǐ yǒu yī píng méi hē wán de shuǐ.
sentences.english: He hid in an abandoned shop, where there was a bottle of unfinished water.

sentences.chinese: 墙上挂着一张奇怪的画儿，画里的人没有眼睛。
sentences.pinyin: Qiáng shàng guàzhe yī zhāng qíguài de huà r, huà lǐ de rén méiyǒu yǎnjīng.
sentences.english: A strange painting hung on the wall; the person in the painting had no eyes.

sentences.chinese: 这个样子一点也不正常。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège yàngzi yīdiǎn yě bù zhèngcháng.
sentences.english: This appearance was not normal at all.

sentences.chinese: 林峰在桌子上发现了一篇旧文章，讲的是关于科学的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zài zhuōzi shàng fāxiàn le yī piān jiù wénzhāng, jiǎng de shì guānyú kēxué de mìmì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng found an old piece of writing on the table, talking about secrets of science.

sentences.chinese: 文章里提到，某些人的成绩被记录在一个秘密的网中。
sentences.pinyin: Wénzhāng lǐ tí dào, mǒu xiē rén de chéngjì bèi jìlù zài yī gè mìmì de wǎng zhōng.
sentences.english: The article mentioned that the performance records of certain people were recorded in a secret network.

sentences.chinese: 这不是学校的成绩，而是关于人体实验的记录。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bùshì xuéxiào de chéngjì, ér shì guānyú réntǐ shíyàn de jìlù.
sentences.english: These were not school grades, but records of human experiments.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一张照片，照片上的男人看起来像一个著名的明星。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào yī zhāng zhàopiàn, zhàopiàn shàng de nánrén kàn qǐlái xiàng yī gè zhùmíng de míngxīng.
sentences.english: He saw a photograph; the man in the photo looked like a famous star.

sentences.chinese: 但这个人的特点很奇怪，他的眼神冰冷。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zhège rén de tèdiǎn hěn qíguài, tā de yǎnshén bīnglěng.
sentences.english: But this person's characteristic was strange; his gaze was ice-cold.

sentences.chinese: 林峰想到，对方的目的可能是为了寻找某种理想的身体。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎngdào, duìfāng de mùdì kěnéng shì wèile xúnzhǎo mǒu zhǒng lǐxiǎng de shēntǐ.
sentences.english: Lin Feng thought that the opponent's purpose might be to find some kind of ideal body.

sentences.chinese: 这里的气味很奇怪，有一种油的味道。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de qìwèi hěn qíguài, yǒu yī zhǒng yóu de wèidào.
sentences.english: The smell here was strange, with a scent of oil.

sentences.chinese: 他发现桌上有一支笔和一张薄薄的片。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn zhuō shàng yǒu yī zhī bǐ hé yī zhāng báobáo de piàn.
sentences.english: He found a pen and a thin sheet on the table.

sentences.chinese: 那片上面写着关于爱情的故事，但读起来像是一个诅咒。
sentences.pinyin: Nà piàn shàngmiàn xiězhe guānyú àiqíng de gùshì, dàn dú qǐlái xiàng shì yī gè zǔzhòu.
sentences.english: That sheet had a story about romance written on it, but it read like a curse.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他的手机收到了一条短信。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, tā de shǒujī shōudào le yī tiáo duǎnxìn.
sentences.english: Suddenly, his phone received a text message.

sentences.chinese: 短信里说：“你以为你能逃掉吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Duǎnxìn lǐ shuō: “Nǐ yǐwéi nǐ néng táodiào ma?”
sentences.english: The text said: "Do you think you can escape?"

sentences.chinese: 林峰看向窗外，天空没有星星，只有一片黑暗。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànxiàng chuāngwài, tiānkōng méiyǒu xīngxing, zhǐyǒu yī piàn hēiyàn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked out the window; there were no stars in the sky, only darkness.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，自己已经掉进了一个巨大的网球场大小的陷阱里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, zìjǐ yǐjīng diào jìn le yī gè jùdà de wǎngqiú chǎng dàxiǎo de xiànjǐng lǐ.
sentences.english: He realized he had fallen into a trap the size of a giant tennis court.

sentences.chinese: 虽然这里不是真的网球场，但感觉就像被球一样被玩弄。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán zhèlǐ bùshì zhēn de wǎngqiú chǎng, dàn gǎnjué jiù xiàng bèi qiú yīyàng bèi wánnòng.
sentences.english: Although this wasn't a real tennis court, it felt as if he were being played with like a ball.

sentences.chinese: 他必须找到离开这里的机会。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū zhǎodào líkāi zhèlǐ de jīhuì.
sentences.english: He had to find an opportunity to leave this place.

sentences.chinese: 他看到角落里有一个像礼物一样的盒子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào jiǎoluò lǐ yǒu yī gè xiàng lǐwù yīyàng de hézi.
sentences.english: He saw a box in the corner that looked like a gift.

sentences.chinese: 他打开盒子，里面没有礼物，只有一张纸条。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dǎkāi hézi, lǐmiàn méiyǒu lǐwù, zhǐyǒu yī zhāng zhǐtiáo.
sentences.english: He opened the box; there was no gift inside, only a slip of paper.

sentences.chinese: 纸条上写着：真正的答案在城市的中心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐtiáo shàng xiězhe: Zhēnzhèng de dá'àn zài chéngshì de zhōngxīn.
sentences.english: The paper read: The real answer is in the center of the city.

sentences.chinese: 林峰深吸一口气，决定向中心地带走去。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng shēn xī yī kǒu qì, juédìng xiàng zhōngxīn dìdài zǒu qù.
sentences.english: Lin Feng took a deep breath and decided to walk toward the center.

sentences.chinese: 就在他走出商店的一眼，他发现有人在黑暗中看着他。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tā zǒuchū shāngdiàn de yī yǎn, tā fāxiàn yǒurén zài hēiyàn zhōng kànzhe tā.
sentences.english: Just as he stepped out of the shop, he noticed someone watching him in the darkness.

sentences.chinese: 林峰在市中心的街道上快步走着。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zài shì zhōng xīn de jiē dào shàng kuài bù zǒu zhe.
sentences.english: Lin Feng walked quickly through the streets of the city center.

sentences.chinese: 他感觉到那个黑影在跟着他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎn jué dào nà gè hēi yǐng zài gēn zhe tā.
sentences.english: He felt that the dark shadow was following him.

sentences.chinese: 他跑进了一家药店，希望那里有很多人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pǎo jìn le yī jiā yào diàn, xī wàng nà lǐ yǒu hěn duō rén.
sentences.english: He ran into a pharmacy, hoping there were many people there.

sentences.chinese: 但药店里只有一名店员，没有其他顾客。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn yào diàn lǐ zhǐ yǒu yī míng diàn yuán, méi yǒu qí tā gù kè.
sentences.english: But there was only one clerk in the pharmacy, and no other customers.

sentences.chinese: 他走出药店，看到对面是一家很大的超市。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu chū yào diàn, kàn dào duì miàn shì yī jiā hěn dà de chāo shì.
sentences.english: He walked out of the pharmacy and saw a large supermarket opposite.

sentences.chinese: 超市里头很亮，但林峰不敢久留。
sentences.pinyin: Chāo shì lǐ tou hěn liàng, dàn Lín Fēng bù gǎn jiǔ liú.
sentences.english: It was very bright inside the supermarket, but Lin Feng didn't dare stay long.

sentences.chinese: 他想起笔记本里提到的一个商人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ bì jì běn lǐ tí dào de yī gè shāng rén.
sentences.english: He remembered a businessman mentioned in the notebook.

sentences.chinese: 那个商人来自南方，是一个外地人。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè shāng rén lái zì nán fāng, shì yī gè wài dì rén.
sentences.english: That businessman came from the South and was an outsider.

sentences.chinese: 传闻这个商人住在市中心的一家高级酒店里。
sentences.pinyin: Chuán wén zhè gè shāng rén zhù zài shì zhōng xīn de yī jiā gāo jí jiǔ diàn lǐ.
sentences.english: Rumor had it that this businessman lived in a luxury hotel in the city center.

sentences.chinese: 林峰决定去那里寻找答案。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jué dìng qù nà lǐ xún zhǎo dá àn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng decided to go there to find the answer.

sentences.chinese: 在去酒店的路上，他经过了一个体育馆。
sentences.pinyin: Zài qù jiǔ diàn de lù shàng, tā jīng guò le yī gè tǐ yù guǎn.
sentences.english: On the way to the hotel, he passed a gymnasium.

sentences.chinese: 体育馆旁边有一个小院子，院子里有一台旧洗衣机。
sentences.pinyin: Tǐ yù guǎn páng biān yǒu yī gè xiǎo yuàn zi, yuàn zi lǐ yǒu yī tái jiù xǐ yī jī.
sentences.english: Next to the gymnasium was a small courtyard, and there was an old washing machine in the courtyard.

sentences.chinese: 洗衣机上面放着一只红色的鞋。
sentences.pinyin: Xǐ yī jī shàng miàn fàng zhe yī zhī hóng sè de xié.
sentences.english: A red shoe was placed on top of the washing machine.

sentences.chinese: 林峰停了下来，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng tíng le xià lái, xīn tiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Lin Feng stopped, his heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 这只鞋看起来像是一个信号。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī xié kàn qǐ lái xiàng shì yī gè xìn hào.
sentences.english: This shoe looked like a signal.

sentences.chinese: 他走进一个安静的饭馆，想看看周围的情况。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu jìn yī gè ā jìng de fàn guǎn, xiǎng kàn kàn zhōu wéi de qíng kuàng.
sentences.english: He walked into a quiet restaurant, wanting to see the surrounding situation.

sentences.chinese: 饭馆的主人正在给客人倒水。
sentences.pinyin: Fàn guǎn de zhǔ rén zhèng zài gěi kè rén dào shuǐ.
sentences.english: The owner of the restaurant was pouring water for a guest.

sentences.chinese: 林峰在角落里看到一个男人，看起来像是在等人的办公室职员。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zài jiǎo luò lǐ kàn dào yī gè nán rén, kàn qǐ lái xiàng shì zài děng rén de bàn gōng shì zhí yuán.
sentences.english: Lin Feng saw a man in the corner who looked like an office employee waiting for someone.

sentences.chinese: 那个男人在看手机，手机上有一个奇怪的节目。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè nán rén zài kàn shǒu jī, shǒu jī shàng yǒu yī gè qí guài de jié mù.
sentences.english: That man was looking at his phone, and there was a strange program on the phone.

sentences.chinese: 节目里在说关于越国的秘密计划。
sentences.pinyin: Jié mù lǐ zài shuō guān yú Yuè guó de mì mì jì huà.
sentences.english: The program was talking about a secret plan regarding Vietnam.

sentences.chinese: 林峰突然意识到，这个城市里到处都是陷阱。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng tū rán yì shí dào, zhè gè chéng shì lǐ dào chù dōu shì xiàn jǐng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng suddenly realized that there were traps everywhere in this city.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，他的手机响了，是一个陌生号码在接通。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, tā de shǒu jī xiǎng le, shì yī gè mò shēng hào mǎ zài jiē tōng.
sentences.english: Just then, his phone rang; it was an unknown number connecting.

sentences.chinese: 电话那头传来一个冷冰冰的声音：
sentences.pinyin: Diàn huà nà tóu chuán lái yī gè lěng bīng bīng de shēng yīn:
sentences.english: A cold voice came from the other end of the phone:

sentences.chinese: “你终于来到这里了。”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ zhōng yú lái dào zhè lǐ le.”
sentences.english: "You have finally arrived here."

sentences.chinese: 林峰拿着手机，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng názhe shǒujī, xīntiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Lin Feng held the phone, his heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 那个声音说，他必须参加一个秘密的会议。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge shēngyīn shuō, tā bìxū cānjiā yīgè mìmì de huìyì.
sentences.english: That voice said he must participate in a secret meeting.

sentences.chinese: 这个会议叫作“最后的审判”。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège huìyì jiàozuò “zuìhòu de shěnpàn”.
sentences.english: This meeting is called "The Final Judgment."

sentences.chinese: 对方告诉他，会议将在城市的中心举行。
sentences.pinyin: Duìfāng gàosù tā, huìyì jiāng zài chéngshì de zhōngxīn jǔxíng.
sentences.english: The other party told him the meeting would be held in the center of the city.

sentences.chinese: 林峰知道，如果他想实现活下去的目标，就必须去。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhīdào, rúguǒ tā xiǎng shíxiàn huó xiàqù de mùbiāo, jiù bìxū qù.
sentences.english: Lin Feng knew that if he wanted to realize his goal of surviving, he had to go.

sentences.chinese: 他必须在十分钟内出发。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū zài shí fēnzhōng nèi chūfā.
sentences.english: He had to set off within ten minutes.

sentences.chinese: 他跑向路边的一辆旧车，发现车子没油了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pǎo xiàng lùbiān de yī liàng jiù chē, fāxiàn chēzi méi yóu le.
sentences.english: He ran to an old car by the roadside and found it was out of gas.

sentences.chinese: 他赶紧去加油站加油。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎnjǐn qù jiāyóuzhàn jiāyóu.
sentences.english: He hurried to the gas station to refuel.

sentences.chinese: 在加油站，他看到一个男人在哭。
sentences.pinyin: Zài jiāyóuzhàn, tā kàndào yīgè nánrén zài kū.
sentences.english: At the gas station, he saw a man crying.

sentences.chinese: 那个男人姓王，他说他想回国，但是办不了手续。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge nánrén xìng Wáng, tā shuō tā xiǎng huíguó, dànshì bàn bùliǎo shǒuxù.
sentences.english: That man's surname was Wang; he said he wanted to return to his home country, but couldn't handle the paperwork.

sentences.chinese: 林峰没有时间交朋友，他只是快速地走开了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng méiyǒu shíjiān jiāo péngyou, tā zhǐshì kuàisù de zǒu kāi le.
sentences.english: Lin Feng had no time to make friends; he simply walked away quickly.

sentences.chinese: 他想到了那个笔记本的作用，那是他唯一的武器。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngdào le nàge bǐjìběn de zuòyòng, nà shì tā wéiyī de wǔqì.
sentences.english: He thought of the function of that notebook; it was his only weapon.

sentences.chinese: 他使用笔记本里的地图，找到了一个隐藏的入口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shǐyòng bǐjìběn lǐ de dìtú, zhǎodào le yīgè yǐncáng de rùkǒu.
sentences.english: He used the map in the notebook to find a hidden entrance.

sentences.chinese: 入口在一家旧饭店的后面。
sentences.pinyin: Rùkǒu zài yī jiā jiù fàndiàn de hòumiàn.
sentences.english: The entrance was behind an old restaurant.

sentences.chinese: 那个饭店的人每天在那里做饭，但现在那里没人。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge fàndiàn de rén měitiān zài nàlǐ zuòfàn, dàn xiànzài nàlǐ méirén.
sentences.english: The people at that restaurant cooked there every day, but now no one was there.

sentences.chinese: 林峰走进一个黑暗的房间，看到一个黑色的套子盖在桌子上。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zǒujìn yīgè hēi'àn de fángjiān, kàndào yīgè hēisè de tàozi gài zài zhuōzi shàng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng walked into a dark room and saw a black cover draped over a table.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个男人出现了。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yīgè nánrén chūxiàn le.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a man appeared.

sentences.chinese: 这个男人看起来很冷酷，像是在监狱里出生的一样。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège nánrén kàn qǐlái hěn lěngkù, xiàng shì zài jiānyù lǐ chūshēng de yīyàng.
sentences.english: This man looked very cold, as if he had been born in prison.

sentences.chinese: 男人举手示意林峰安静。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén jǔshǒu shìyì Lín Fēng ānjìng.
sentences.english: The man raised his hand to signal Lin Feng to be quiet.

sentences.chinese: 男人说：“把笔记本交给我也好，或者你尝试逃跑。”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén shuō: “Bǎ bǐjìběn jiāogěi wǒ yě hǎo, huòzhě nǐ chángshì táopǎo.”
sentences.english: The man said, "You can hand the notebook over to me, or you can try to escape."

sentences.chinese: 林峰知道，对方想要取走笔记本里的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhīdào, duìfāng xiǎng qǔ zǒu bǐjìběn lǐ de mìmì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng knew the other party wanted to take the secrets in the notebook.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果能取得对方的信任，也许能逃掉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rúguǒ néng qǔdé duìfāng de xìnrèn, yěxǔ néng táodiào.
sentences.english: He thought that if he could obtain the other party's trust, he might be able to escape.

sentences.chinese: 他借口说笔记本在车里，但对方不相信。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jièkǒu shuō bǐjìběn zài chē lǐ, dàn duìfāng bù xiāngxìn.
sentences.english: He used the excuse that the notebook was in the car, but the other party didn't believe him.

sentences.chinese: 男人冷笑一声，说他能做到任何事情来让他开口。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén lěngxiào yī shēng, shuō tā néng zuòdào rènhé shìqíng lái ràng tā kāikǒu.
sentences.english: The man sneered, saying he could achieve anything to make him speak.

sentences.chinese: 林峰感觉到周围的环境在变。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎnjué dào zhōuwéi de huánjìng zài biàn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt the surrounding environment changing.

sentences.chinese: 这里的空气变得冰冷，像是在午睡的死人一样安静。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de kōngqì biàndé bīnglěng, xiàng shì zài wǔshuì de sǐrén yīyàng ānjìng.
sentences.english: The air here became ice-cold, as quiet as a dead person taking a nap.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到自己变成了一个猎物。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào zìjǐ biànchéng le yīgè lièwù.
sentences.english: He realized he had become prey.

sentences.chinese: 男人说，他现在为那个秘密组织工作。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén shuō, tā xiànzài wéi nàge mìmì zǔzhī gōngzuò.
sentences.english: The man said he was currently working as an agent for that secret organization.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林峰，一旦完成这次任务，他就可以自由。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Lín Fēng, yīdàn wánchéng zhè cì rènwù, tā jiù kěyǐ zìyóu.
sentences.english: He told Lin Feng that once this mission was completed, he could be free.

sentences.chinese: 林峰尝试用语言来办这件事，但没有用。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng chángshì yòng yǔyán lái bàn zhè jiàn shì, dàn méiyǒu yòng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng tried to handle the matter using words, but it was useless.

sentences.chinese: 他必须交出笔记本，否则就要面对死亡。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū jiāo chū bǐjìběn, fǒuzé jiù yào miànduì sǐwáng.
sentences.english: He had to hand over the notebook, otherwise he would face death.

sentences.chinese: 就在林峰准备交出笔记本的时候，门外传来了巨大的响声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài Lín Fēng zhǔnbèi jiāo chū bǐjìběn de shíhou, mén wài chuánlái le jùdà de xiǎngshēng.
sentences.english: Just as Lin Feng was preparing to hand over the notebook, a loud noise came from outside the door.

sentences.chinese: 巨大的响声带来了一种可怕的感觉。
sentences.pinyin: Jù dà de xiǎng shēng dài lái le yì zhǒng kě pà de gǎn jué.
sentences.english: The loud noise brought a terrifying feeling.

sentences.chinese: 林峰的心跳很快，他不知道接下来会发生什么。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng de xīn tiào hěn kuài, tā bù zhī dào jiē xià lái huì fā shēng shén me.
sentences.english: Lin Feng's heart beat fast; he didn't know what would happen next.

sentences.chinese: 那个男人突然大喊：“快走！”
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè nán rén tū rán dà hǎn: “Kuài zǒu!”
sentences.english: The man suddenly shouted, "Go quickly!"

sentences.chinese: 林峰很惊讶，他不知道这个男人为什么愿意帮助他。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hěn jīng yà, tā bù zhī dào zhè gè nán rén wèi shén me yuàn yì bāng zhù tā.
sentences.english: Lin Feng was surprised; he didn't know why this man was willing to help him.

sentences.chinese: 男人拿出手机，快速地打印了一张地图，然后交给林峰。
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén ná chū shǒu jī, kuài sù de dǎ yìn le yì zhāng dì tú, rán hòu jiāo gěi Lín Fēng.
sentences.english: The man took out a phone, quickly printed a map, and then gave it to Lin Feng.

sentences.chinese: “拿着这个，往北走，那里有你的机会。”
sentences.pinyin: “Ná zhe zhè gè, wǎng běi zǒu, nà lǐ yǒu nǐ de jī huì.”
sentences.english: "Take this, go north, your opportunity is there."

sentences.chinese: 林峰拿到地图，心中在想：我现在怎么办？
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng ná dào dì tú, xīn zhōng zài xiǎng: wǒ xiàn zài zěn me bàn?
sentences.english: Lin Feng got the map and thought to himself: what should I do now?

sentences.chinese: 他必须在敌人进来之前离开这个房间。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì xū zài dí rén jìn lái zhī qián lí kāi zhè gè fáng jiān.
sentences.english: He must leave this room before the enemies come in.

sentences.chinese: 他接着听到门外有人在说话，声音来自那个秘密组织。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiē zhe tīng dào mén wài yǒu rén zài shuō huà, shēng yīn lái zì nà gè mì mì zǔ zhī.
sentences.english: He then heard people talking outside the door, voices coming from that secret organization.

sentences.chinese: 这些人想要提高抓捕的效率，以便成为组织最强的成员。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiē rén xiǎng yào tí gāo zhuā bǔ de xiào lǜ, yǐ biàn chéng wéi zǔ zhī zuì qiáng de chéng yuán.
sentences.english: These people wanted to increase the efficiency of their captures in order to become the strongest members of the organization.

sentences.chinese: 林峰看到桌子上有一个文件夹，里面记录了组织成员的收入情况。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn dào zhuō zi shàng yǒu yí gè wén jiàn jiá, lǐ miàn jì lù le zǔ zhī chéng yuán de shōu rù qíng kuàng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng saw a folder on the table, which recorded the income of the organization's members.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，这些人的生活被金钱改变了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, zhè xiē rén de shēng huó bèi jīn qián gǎi biàn le.
sentences.english: He realized that these people's lives had been changed by money.

sentences.chinese: 他快速地收起了一些文件，希望能得出关于组织的秘密结论。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kuài sù de shōu qǐ le yì xiē wén jiàn, xī wàng néng dé chū guān yú zǔ zhī de mì mì jié lùn.
sentences.english: He quickly collected some documents, hoping to arrive at a secret conclusion about the organization.

sentences.chinese: 男人对他说：“如果你能逃掉，请改变你的名字，不要让他们找到你。”
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén duì tā shuō: “Rú guǒ nǐ néng táo diào, qǐng gǎi biàn nǐ de míng zi, bú yào ràng tā men zhǎo dào nǐ.”
sentences.english: The man said to him, "If you can escape, please change your name; don't let them find you."

sentences.chinese: 林峰提出一个问题：“你为什么帮我？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng tí chū yí gè wèn tí: “Nǐ wèi shén me bāng wǒ?”
sentences.english: Lin Feng raised a question: "Why are you helping me?"

sentences.chinese: 男人冷笑一声，像是在庆祝某种胜利，轻声说了一句：“干杯。”
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén lěng xiào yì shēng, xiàng shì zài qìng zhù mǒu zhǒng shèng lì, qīng shēng shuō le yí jù: “Gān bēi.”
sentences.english: The man sneered, as if celebrating some kind of victory, and whispered, "Cheers."

sentences.chinese: 虽然没有酒，但这句话让林峰感到一阵寒意。
sentences.pinyin: Suī rán méi yǒu jiǔ, dàn zhè jù huà ràng Lín Fēng gǎn dào yì zhèn hán yì.
sentences.english: Although there was no wine, these words gave Lin Feng a chill.

sentences.chinese: 林峰在走廊里看到人们排成一行，他们在为组织服务。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zài zǒu láng lǐ kàn dào rén men pái chéng yì háng, tā men zài wèi zǔ zhī fú wù.
sentences.english: Lin Feng saw people lined up in the corridor; they were serving the organization.

sentences.chinese: 他必须在不引起注意的情况下活动身体，慢慢向出口走去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì xū zài bù yǐn qǐ zhù yì de qíng kuàng xià huó dòng shēn tǐ, màn màn xiàng chū kǒu zǒu qù.
sentences.english: He had to move his body without attracting attention, slowly walking toward the exit.

sentences.chinese: 他接到一个奇怪的信号，手机收到了一条来自未知号码的信息。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiē dào yí gè qí guài de xìn hào, shǒu jī shōu dào le yì tiáo lái zì wèi zhī hào mǎ de xìn xī.
sentences.english: He received a strange signal, and his phone received a message from an unknown number.

sentences.chinese: 信息上写着：“不要相信任何人，即使是那个帮你的人。”
sentences.pinyin: Xìn xī shàng xiě zhe: “Bú yào xiāng xìn rèn hé rén, jí shǐ shì nà gè bāng nǐ de rén.”
sentences.english: The message read: "Do not trust anyone, even the person helping you."

sentences.chinese: 林峰心中产生了一个想法：他不能接受这个男人的所有话。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xīn zhōng chǎn shēng le yí gè xiǎng fǎ: tā bù néng jiē shòu zhè gè nán rén de suǒ yǒu huà.
sentences.english: An idea occurred to Lin Feng: he could not accept everything this man said.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果他能拿到更多证据，就能改变这一切。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rú guǒ tā néng ná dào gèng duō zhèng jù, jiù néng gǎi biàn zhè yì qiè.
sentences.english: He thought that if he could obtain more evidence, he could change everything.

sentences.chinese: 他跑向洗澡间，试图在那里躲起来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pǎo xiàng xǐ zǎo jiān, shì tú zài nà lǐ duǒ qǐ lái.
sentences.english: He ran to the bathroom, attempting to hide there.

sentences.chinese: 水在流，声音掩盖了他的呼吸声。
sentences.pinyin: Shuǐ zài liú, shēng yīn yǎn gài le tā de hū xī shēng.
sentences.english: Water was flowing, and the sound masked his breathing.

sentences.chinese: 他在这里度过了最紧张的十分钟。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài zhè lǐ dù guò le zuì jǐn zhāng de shí fēn zhōng.
sentences.english: He spent the most tense ten minutes here.

sentences.chinese: 他发现墙上有一个报名表，上面写着加入组织的条件。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn qiáng shàng yǒu yí gè bào míng biǎo, shàng miàn xiě zhe jiā rù zǔ zhī de tiáo jiàn.
sentences.english: He discovered a sign-up form on the wall, listing the conditions for joining the organization.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，很多人为了钱而报名，成为了组织的工具。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, hěn duō rén wèi le qián ér bào míng, chéng wéi le zǔ zhī de gōng jù.
sentences.english: He realized that many people signed up for money and became tools of the organization.

sentences.chinese: 他必须改掉自己的计划，不能只是一味地逃跑。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì xū gǎi diào zì jǐ de jì huà, bù néng zhǐ shì yí wèi de táo pǎo.
sentences.english: He had to change his plan; he couldn't just blindly run away.

sentences.chinese: 他终于找到了出口，但门外站着一个黑色的影子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhōng yú zhǎo dào le chū kǒu, dàn mén wài zhàn zhe yí gè hēi sè de yǐng zi.
sentences.english: He finally found the exit, but a black shadow was standing outside the door.

sentences.chinese: 那个影子看着他，冷冷地说：“你以为你能走掉吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè yǐng zi kàn zhe tā, lěng lěng de shuō: “Nǐ yǐ wéi nǐ néng zǒu diào ma?”
sentences.english: The shadow looked at him and said coldly, "Do you think you can get away?"

sentences.chinese: 林峰看着面前的黑影，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe miànqián de hēiyǐng, xīntiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the black shadow in front of him, his heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 那个黑影大声喊道：“站住！你不能走！”
sentences.pinyin: Nàge hēiyǐng dàshēng hǎndào: “Zhànzhù! Nǐ bùnéng zǒu!”
sentences.english: The black shadow shouted loudly: "Stop! You cannot leave!"

sentences.chinese: 林峰没有听他的话，他立刻转身跑了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng méiyǒu tīng tā de huà, tā lìkè zhuǎnshēn pǎo le qǐlái.
sentences.english: Lin Feng did not listen to him; he immediately turned and started running.

sentences.chinese: 他走进了一条狭窄的走廊，试图通过这个出口逃离。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒujìn le yìtiáo xiǎzhǎi de zǒuláng, shìtú tōngguò zhège chūkǒu táolí.
sentences.english: He entered a narrow corridor, attempting to escape through this exit.

sentences.chinese: 他发现这个组织的成员是由很多贪钱的人组成。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn zhège zǔzhī de chéngyuán shì yóu hěnduō tān qián de rén zǔchéng.
sentences.english: He discovered that the members of this organization were composed of many people greedy for money.

sentences.chinese: 这些人为了更好的生活，放弃了自己的自由。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē rén wèile gèng hǎo de shēnghuó, fàngqì le zìjǐ de zìyóu.
sentences.english: These people gave up their freedom for a better life.

sentences.chinese: 林峰想起自己从小长大时的样子，那时候生活很简单。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ cóngxiǎo zhǎngdà shí de yàngzi, nàshíhou shēnghuó hěn jiǎndān.
sentences.english: Lin Feng remembered what he was like growing up; life was very simple back then.

sentences.chinese: 他不想让这种黑暗的组织控制他的生与死。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎng ràng zhèzhǒng hēiyàn de zǔzhī kòngzhì tā de shēng yǔ sǐ.
sentences.english: He did not want this kind of dark organization to control his life and death.

sentences.chinese: 他快速走过一个房间，看到桌子上有一台旧相机。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kuàisù zǒuguò yígè fángjiān, kàndào zhuōzi shàng yǒu yìtái jiù xiàngjī.
sentences.english: He quickly walked past a room and saw an old camera on the table.

sentences.chinese: 他下意识地用它照相，想记录下这里的证据。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàyìshí de yòng tā zhàoxiàng, xiǎng jìlù xià zhèlǐ de zhèngjù.
sentences.english: He instinctively took a photograph with it, wanting to record evidence of this place.

sentences.chinese: 但黑影就在后面，距离已经不超过五米。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn hēiyǐng jiù zài hòumiàn, jùlí yǐjīng bù chāoguò wǔ mǐ.
sentences.english: But the black shadow was right behind him, the distance already not exceeding five meters.

sentences.chinese: 林峰必须加快运动速度，否则会被抓住。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng bìxū jiākuài yùndòng sùdù, fǒuzé huì bèi zhuāzhù.
sentences.english: Lin Feng had to speed up his movement, otherwise he would be caught.

sentences.chinese: 他跑进一个狭小的通风管，只能在里面慢慢爬。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pǎojìn yígè xiǎoxiǎo de tōngfēngguǎn, zhǐnéng zài lǐmiàn mànmàn pá.
sentences.english: He ran into a small ventilation pipe and could only crawl slowly inside.

sentences.chinese: 这个过程非常痛苦，但这是唯一的出路。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège guòchéng fēicháng tòngkǔ, dàn zhè shì wéiyī de chūlù.
sentences.english: This process was very painful, but it was the only way out.

sentences.chinese: 他想起以前和朋友一起爬山的时候，虽然累，但心中是快乐的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ yǐqián hé péngyǒu yìqǐ páshān de shíhou, suīrán lèi, dàn xīnzhōng shì kuàilè de.
sentences.english: He remembered when he used to go hiking with friends; although it was tiring, he was happy in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 现在，他必须进行一场生死之战。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài, tā bìxū jìnxíng yìchǎng shēngsǐ zhī zhàn.
sentences.english: Now, he had to conduct a battle of life and death.

sentences.chinese: 他终于爬出了通风管，进入了一个巨大的仓库。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhōngyú pá chū le tōngfēngguǎn, jìnrù le yígè jùdà de cāngkù.
sentences.english: He finally crawled out of the ventilation pipe and entered a huge warehouse.

sentences.chinese: 仓库里有很多租来的旧车，看起来像是在准备某种行动。
sentences.pinyin: Cāngkù lǐ yǒu hěnduō zū lái de jiù chē, kàn qǐlái xiàng shì zài zhǔnbèi mǒu zhǒng xíngdòng.
sentences.english: There were many rented old cars in the warehouse, looking as if they were preparing for some operation.

sentences.chinese: 林峰看到远处有一架小型飞机准备起飞。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàndào yuǎnchù yǒu yíjià xiǎoxíng fēijī zhǔnbèi qǐfēi.
