sentences.english: Lin Feng saw a small plane in the distance preparing to take off.

sentences.chinese: 如果能登上那架飞机，他就能离开这个可怕的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ néng dēngshàng nà jià fēijī, tā jiù néng líkāi zhège kěpà de dìfāng.
sentences.english: If he could board that plane, he could leave this terrifying place.

sentences.chinese: 他向一个守卫发出请求，希望对方能让他过去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàng yígè shǒuwèi fāchū qǐngqiú, xīwàng duìfāng néng ràng tā guòqù.
sentences.english: He made a request to a guard, hoping the other party would let him pass.

sentences.chinese: 但守卫冷冷地看着他，要求他交出笔记本。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn shǒuwèi lěnglěng de kànzhe tā, yāoqiú tā jiāo chū bǐjìběn.
sentences.english: But the guard looked at him coldly and required him to hand over the notebook.

sentences.chinese: 林峰知道对方不会让他轻易离开。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhīdào duìfāng búhuì ràng tā qīngyì líkāi.
sentences.english: Lin Feng knew the other party would not let him leave easily.

sentences.chinese: 他装作害怕的样子，突然猛地推倒了守卫。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhuāngzuò hàipà de yàngzi, tūrán měngde tuīdǎo le shǒuwèi.
sentences.english: He pretended to be afraid and suddenly pushed the guard over.

sentences.chinese: 他迅速跑过来，冲向了飞机的舱门。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xùnsù guòlái, chōngxiàng le fēijī de cāngmén.
sentences.english: He quickly came over and rushed toward the plane's cabin door.

sentences.chinese: 经过一番激烈的挣扎，他终于跳上了飞机。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò yìpān jīliè de zhēngzhá, tā zhōngyú tiào shàng le fēijī.
sentences.english: After a period of intense struggle, he finally jumped onto the plane.

sentences.chinese: 就在飞机起飞的一瞬间，他看到黑影在地面上愤怒地大喊。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài fēijī qǐfēi de yìshùnjiān, tā kàndào hēiyǐng zài dìmiàn shàng fènnù de dàhǎn.
sentences.english: At the moment the plane took off, he saw the black shadow shouting angrily on the ground.

sentences.chinese: 林峰看着窗外，他知道自己送给这个组织了一个巨大的麻烦。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe chuāngwài, tā zhīdào zìjǐ sònggěi zhège zǔzhī yígè jùdà de máfan.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked out the window, knowing he had given this organization a huge problem.

sentences.chinese: 但当他看向机舱内部时，他发现驾驶座上坐着一个陌生人。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn dāng tā kànxiàng jīcāng nèibù shí, tā fāxiàn jiàshǐzuò shàng zuòzhe yígè mòshēng rén.
sentences.english: But when he looked inside the cabin, he found a stranger sitting in the pilot's seat.

sentences.chinese: 那个陌生人转过头，对着林峰笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge mòshēng rén zhuǎn guò tóu, duìzhe Lín Fēng xiào le.
sentences.english: That stranger turned his head and smiled at Lin Feng.

sentences.chinese: 林峰看着那个陌生人的笑容，心里有一点儿害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe nàge mòshēng rén de xiàoróng, xīnlǐ yǒu yīdiǎnr hàipà.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the stranger's smile, feeling a bit scared in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 他刚刚跳上飞机，现在却发现自己进入了另一个陷阱。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gānggāng tiào shàng fēijī, xiànzài què fāxiàn zìjǐ jìnrùle lìng yīgè xiànjǐng.
sentences.english: He had just jumped onto the plane, but now he discovered he had entered another trap.

sentences.chinese: “你是谁？”林峰问，他的声音有点儿发抖。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ shì shéi?” Lín Fēng wèn, tā de shēngyīn yǒudiǎnr fādǒu.
sentences.english: "Who are you?" Lin Feng asked, his voice trembling slightly.

sentences.chinese: 那个男人没有回答，只是看了看表，现在是半夜一点一刻。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge nánrén méiyǒu huídá, zhǐshì kànle kàn biǎo, xiànzài shì bànyè yīdiǎn yī kè.
sentences.english: The man didn't answer, he just looked at his watch; it was 1:15 in the middle of the night.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林峰，他们快要降落在另一个城市了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Lín Fēng, tāmen kuàiyào jiàngluò zài lìng yīgè chéngshì le.
sentences.english: He told Lin Feng that they were about to land in another city.

sentences.chinese: 林峰觉得这个飞行时间太短，不对劲。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng juédé zhège fēixíng shíjiān tài duǎn, bù duìjìn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt that this flight time was too short; it wasn't right.

sentences.chinese: 他想起自己从小就对地图很感兴趣。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ cóngxiǎo jiù duì dìtú hěn gǎn xìngqù.
sentences.english: He remembered that he had been interested in maps since childhood.

sentences.chinese: 小时候，他经常研究不同城市的距离。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎoshíhou, tā jīngcháng yánjiū bùtóng chéngshì de jùlí.
sentences.english: In his childhood, he often studied the distances between different cities.

sentences.chinese: 他计算了一下，从刚才起飞的地方到这里，至少需要两个小时。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìsuànle yīxià, cóng gāngcái qǐfēi de dìfāng dào zhèlǐ, zhìshǎo xūyào liǎng gè xiǎoshí.
sentences.english: He calculated that from where they had just taken off to here, it would take at least two hours.

sentences.chinese: 但现在才过了十分钟，他们怎么可能到了？
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiànzài cái guòle shí fēnzhōng, tāmen zěnme kěnéng dào le?
sentences.english: But only ten minutes had passed; how could they have arrived?

sentences.chinese: 林峰意识到，这架飞机的一部分设备被改动了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yìshí dào, zhè jià fēijī de yī bùfen shèbèi bèi gǎidòng le.
sentences.english: Lin Feng realized that a part of the plane's equipment had been altered.

sentences.chinese: 他发现这个男人在最近的时间里，一直在观察他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn zhège nánrén zài zuìjìn de shíjiān lǐ, yīzhí zài guānchá tā.
sentences.english: He noticed that this man had been observing him recently.

sentences.chinese: “你在这架飞机上待了多久？”林峰问。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ zài zhè jià fēijī shàng dāile duōjiǔ?” Lín Fēng wèn.
sentences.english: "How long have you been on this plane?" Lin Feng asked.

sentences.chinese: 男人笑了，说：“好久了，我早就地在等你了。”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén xiàole, shuō: “Hǎojiǔ le, wǒ zǎojiù zài děng nǐ le.”
sentences.english: The man smiled and said, "Quite a while; I've been waiting for you for a long time."

sentences.chinese: 林峰感到很不舒服，因为这个男人的眼神不太友好。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎndào hěn bù shūfu, yīnwèi zhège nánrén de yǎnshén bù tài yǒuhǎo.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt very uncomfortable because the man's gaze was not too friendly.

sentences.chinese: 他发现机舱里的氧气似乎不够，呼吸变得困难。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn jīcāng lǐ de yǎngqì sìhū bù gòu, hūxī biànde kùnnán.
sentences.english: He noticed that the oxygen in the cabin seemed insufficient, and breathing became difficult.

sentences.chinese: 这时候，飞机突然剧烈地摇晃了一下。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shíhòu, fēijī tūrán jùliè de yáohuàngle yīxià.
sentences.english: At this moment, the plane suddenly shook violently.

sentences.chinese: 林峰感觉到身体向一边倾斜，他抓住了椅子。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎnjué dào shēntǐ xiàng yībiān qīngxié, tā zhuāzhùle yǐzi.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt his body tilt to one side and grabbed the chair.

sentences.chinese: 不一会儿，男人拿出一个黑色的盒子。
sentences.pinyin: Bù yīhuǐr, nánrén ná chū yīgè hēisè de hézi.
sentences.english: After a short while, the man took out a black box.

sentences.chinese: 盒子里面只有少数几个按钮，但看起来很危险。
sentences.pinyin: Hézi lǐmiàn zhǐyǒu shǎoshù jǐ gè ànniǔ, dàn kàn qǐlái hěn wēixiǎn.
sentences.english: Inside the box were only a few buttons, but it looked very dangerous.

sentences.chinese: 林峰想逃跑，但发现门被锁住了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎng táopǎo, dàn fāxiàn mén bèi suǒzhù le.
sentences.english: Lin Feng wanted to escape, but found the door was locked.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，之前的逃脱只是一个假象，他被更危险的人抓住了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, zhīqián de táotuō zhǐshì yīgè jiǎxiàng, tā bèi gèng wēixiǎn de rén zhuāzhù le.
sentences.english: He realized that the previous escape was just an illusion; he had been caught by someone even more dangerous.

sentences.chinese: 不久，男人开口说话了，声音冷得让人心惊。
sentences.pinyin: Bùjiǔ, nánrén kāikǒu shuōhuà le, shēngyīn lěng de ràng rén xīnjīng.
sentences.english: Soon, the man spoke, his voice so cold it was chilling.

sentences.chinese: “你以为你能逃掉吗？你只知道了真相的一点点。”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ yǐwéi nǐ néng táodiào ma? Nǐ zhǐ zhīdàole zhēnxiàng de yī diǎn diǎn.”
sentences.english: "Do you think you can escape? You only know a little bit of the truth."

sentences.chinese: 林峰看着窗外，黑夜像一面墙，将他完全包围。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe chuāngwài, hēiyè xiàng yī miàn qiáng, jiāng tā wánquán bāowéi.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked out the window; the dark night was like a wall, surrounding him completely.

sentences.chinese: 差不多在三分钟后，飞机突然开始急速下降。
sentences.pinyin: Chàbuduō zài sān fēnzhōng hòu, fēijī tūrán kāishǐ jísù xiàjiàng.
sentences.english: In about three minutes, the plane suddenly began a rapid descent.

sentences.chinese: 飞机在黑夜中急速下降，林峰感到身体在空中剧烈摇晃。
sentences.pinyin: Fēijī zài hēiyè zhōng jísù xiàjiàng, Lín Fēng gǎndào shēntǐ zài kōngzhōng jùliè yáohuàng.
sentences.english: The plane descended rapidly in the dark night, and Lin Feng felt his body shaking violently in the air.

sentences.chinese: 他试图举起手抓住前面的椅子，但力量不足。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shìtú jǔqǐ shǒu zhuāzhù qiánmiàn de yǐzi, dàn lìliàng bùzú.
sentences.english: He tried to lift his hand to grab the chair in front of him, but he lacked the strength.

sentences.chinese: 那个男人冷笑一声，说了一句让他心惊的话。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge nánrén lěngxiào yīshēng, shuōle yījù ràng tā xīnjīng de huà.
sentences.english: The man sneered and said a sentence that chilled him to the bone.

sentences.chinese: “咱俩现在都在地狱的入口。”
sentences.pinyin: “Zán liǎ xiànzài dōu zài dìyù de rùkǒu.”
sentences.english: "The two of us are now at the entrance of hell."

sentences.chinese: 林峰看着窗外，看到下方是一片深绿色的草地和一条小船。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe chuāngwài, kàndào xiàfāng shì yīpiàn shēn lǜsè de cǎodì hé yītiáo xiǎochuán.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked out the window and saw a stretch of deep green grass and a small boat below.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到飞机快要撞向那堵像墙一样的山壁。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào fēijī kuài yào zhuàng xiàng nà dǔ xiàng qiáng yīyàng de shānbì.
sentences.english: He realized the plane was about to hit a mountain wall that looked like a wall.

sentences.chinese: 飞机猛烈地碰撞，巨大的响声震耳欲聋。
sentences.pinyin: Fēijī měngliè de pèngzhuàng, jùdà de xiǎngshēng zhèn'ěrdùlóng.
sentences.english: The plane collided violently, and the loud noise was deafening.

sentences.chinese: 林峰被甩到了飞机的后部分，头部撞在了金属板上。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng bèi shuǎi dào le fēijī de hòubùfèn, tóubù zhuàng zài le jīnshǔ bǎn shàng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng was thrown to the rear part of the plane, his head hitting a metal plate.

sentences.chinese: 他感到背部剧痛，意识开始模糊。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎndào bèibù jùtòng, yìshí kāishǐ móhu.
sentences.english: He felt a sharp pain in his back, and his consciousness began to blur.

sentences.chinese: 在昏迷前，他听到飞机里响起了诡异的音乐。
sentences.pinyin: Zài hūnmí qián, tā tīngdào fēijī lǐ xiǎngqǐ le guǐyì de yīnyuè.
sentences.english: Before losing consciousness, he heard eerie music playing inside the plane.

sentences.chinese: 当他再次睁眼时，他发现自己躺在一个阴暗的房间里。
sentences.pinyin: Dāng tā zàicì zhēngyǎn shí, tā fāxiàn zìjǐ tǎng zài yīgè yīn'àn de fángjiān lǐ.
sentences.english: When he opened his eyes again, he found himself lying in a dim room.

sentences.chinese: 他的手被绳子绑在椅子上，面前放着一个白色的碗。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shǒu bèi shéngzi bǎng zài yǐzi shàng, miànqián fàngzhe yīgè báisè de wǎn.
sentences.english: His hands were tied to a chair with rope, and a white bowl was placed in front of him.

sentences.chinese: 碗里装着一种绿色的药水，散发着奇怪的味道。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎn lǐ zhuāngzhe yīzhǒng lǜsè de yàoshuǐ, sànfāzhe qíguài de wèidào.
sentences.english: The bowl contained a green medicinal liquid, emitting a strange smell.

sentences.chinese: 一个黑色的影子走过来，手里拿着一张白纸。
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè hēisè de yǐngzi zǒu guòlái, shǒulǐ názhe yīzhāng báizhǐ.
sentences.english: A black shadow walked over, holding a piece of white paper.

sentences.chinese: 影子在纸上写了一个词，然后在他面前晃了晃。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐngzi zài zhǐ shàng xiěle yīgè cí, ránhòu zài tā miànqián huàngle huàng.
sentences.english: The shadow wrote a word on the paper and then waved it in front of him.

sentences.chinese: “喝掉这碗药，否则我就掰断你的手指，像掰假手指一样简单。”
sentences.pinyin: “Hē diào zhè wǎn yào, fǒuzé wǒ jiù bāiduàn nǐ de shǒuzhǐ, xiàng bāi jiǎ shǒuzhǐ yīyàng jiǎndān.”
sentences.english: "Drink this medicine, or I will snap your fingers as easily as snapping a fake finger."

sentences.chinese: 林峰惊恐地看着对方，他知道这可能是某种剧毒的药。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jīngkǒng de kànzhe duìfāng, tā zhīdào zhè kěnéng shì mǒu zhǒng jùdú de yào.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the other person in horror, knowing this might be some kind of highly toxic medicine.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试在心里读一遍之前的笔记，寻找逃脱的方法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chángshì zài xīnlǐ dú yībiàn zhīqián de bǐjì, xúnzhǎo táotuō de fāngfǎ.
sentences.english: He tried to read through his previous notes once in his mind, searching for a way to escape.

sentences.chinese: 这时，他碰到了桌子上的一个药瓶，瓶子掉在地上碎了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, tā pèngdào le zhuōzi shàng de yīgè yàopíng, píngzi diào zài dìshàng suì le.
sentences.english: At that moment, he bumped into a medicine bottle on the table, and the bottle fell and broke on the floor.

sentences.chinese: 影子愤怒地大喊，声音像被掐住脖子的鸟一样难听。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐngzi fènnù de dàhǎn, shēngyīn xiàng bèi qiāzhù bózi de niǎo yīyàng nántīng.
sentences.english: The shadow shouted angrily, his voice sounding as unpleasant as a bird with its throat squeezed.

sentences.chinese: 这个组织占领了这里的每一寸土地，他没有任何退路。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège zǔzhī zhànlǐng le zhèlǐ de měiyī cùn tǔdì, tā méiyǒu rènhé tuìlù.
sentences.english: This organization occupied every inch of land here; he had no way back.

sentences.chinese: 影子在他耳边低声说：“我会给你留最后一次机会。”
sentences.pinyin: Yǐngzi zài tā ěrbiān dīshēng shuō: “Wǒ huì gěi nǐ liú zuìhòu yīcì jīhuì.”
sentences.english: The shadow whispered in his ear: "I will leave you one last chance."

sentences.chinese: 林峰看着那个像蛋一样圆的监控摄像头，心中充满了绝望。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe nàge xiàng dàn yīyàng yuán de jiānkòng shèxiàngtóu, xīnzhōng chōngmǎn le juéwàng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the egg-shaped surveillance camera, his heart filled with despair.

sentences.chinese: 林峰在地上看到了一个黑色的文件夹。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zài dì shàng kàn dào le yí gè hēi sè de wén jiàn jiá.
sentences.english: Lin Feng saw a black folder on the ground.

sentences.chinese: 他快速打开它，发现里面有一张名单。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kuài sù dǎ kāi tā, fā xiàn lǐ miàn yǒu yì zhāng míng dān.
sentences.english: He opened it quickly and found a list inside.

sentences.chinese: 这张名单上写着很多人的姓名。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng míng dān shàng xiě zhe hěn duō rén de xìng míng.
sentences.english: Many people's full names were written on this list.

sentences.chinese: 这些名字非常奇怪，像是一个秘密的组织。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiē míng zi fēi cháng qí guài, xiàng shì yí gè mì mì de zǔ zhī.
sentences.english: These names were very strange, like a secret organization.

sentences.chinese: 第一个名字叫东方，他可能在东边工作。
sentences.pinyin: Dì yī gè míng zi jiào Dōng fāng, tā kě néng zài dōng biān gōng zuò.
sentences.english: The first name was Dongfang; he might work in the East.

sentences.chinese: 第二个名字是全，第三个是加。
sentences.pinyin: Dì èr gè míng zi shì Quán, dì sān gè shì Jiā.
sentences.english: The second name was Quan, and the third was Jia.

sentences.chinese: 林峰心跳很快，他继续向后看。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xīn tiào hěn kuài, tā jì xù xiàng hòu kàn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng's heart beat fast as he continued to look further.

sentences.chinese: 他看到了周，还有封，和平。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào le Zhōu, hái yǒu Fēng, hé Píng.
sentences.english: He saw Zhou, as well as Feng and Ping.

sentences.chinese: 这些人是谁？他们为什么在这里？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiē rén shì shéi? Tā men wèi shén me zài zhè lǐ?
sentences.english: Who were these people? Why were they here?

sentences.chinese: 名单上还有怕，成，和查。
sentences.pinyin: Míng dān shàng hái yǒu Pà, Chéng, hé Zhā.
sentences.english: On the list, there were also Pa, Cheng, and Zha.

sentences.chinese: 林峰觉得这些名字像是一把把刀。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jué de zhè xiē míng zi xiàng shì yì bǎ bǎ dāo.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt these names were like knives.

sentences.chinese: 接下来是段，海，和米。
sentences.pinyin: Jiē xià lái shì Duàn, Hǎi, hé Mǐ.
sentences.english: Next were Duan, Hai, and Mi.

sentences.chinese: 他突然想起，这些人可能都是被抓走的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tū rán xiǎng qǐ, zhè xiē rén kě néng dōu shì bèi zhuā zǒu de rén.
sentences.english: He suddenly remembered that these people might all be those who were kidnapped.

sentences.chinese: 红，组，和蓝的名字紧接着出现。
sentences.pinyin: Hóng, Zǔ, hé Lán de míng zi jǐn jiē zhe chū xiàn.
sentences.english: Hong, Zu, and Lan's names appeared immediately after.

sentences.chinese: 角，闻，和阴的名字让林峰感到冷。
sentences.pinyin: Jué, Wén, hé Yīn de míng zi ràng Lín Fēng gǎn dào lěng.
sentences.english: Jue, Wen, and Yin's names made Lin Feng feel cold.

sentences.chinese: 雪，题，和鱼的名字在最后面。
sentences.pinyin: Xuě, Tí, hé Yú de míng zi zài zuì hòu miàn.
sentences.english: Xue, Ti, and Yu's names were at the very end.

sentences.chinese: 最后一个名字是黄，这个名字被红色的笔圈了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Zuì hòu yí gè míng zi shì Huáng, zhè gè míng zi bèi hóng sè de bǐ quān le qǐ lái.
sentences.english: The last name was Huang, and this name was circled with a red pen.

sentences.chinese: 影子突然在他身后说话了。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi tū rán zài tā shēn hòu shuō huà le.
sentences.english: The shadow suddenly spoke behind him.

sentences.chinese: “你看到了，对吗？”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ kàn dào le, duì ma?”
sentences.english: "You saw it, didn't you?"

sentences.chinese: 林峰害怕地转过头，看到影子的眼睛在发光。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hài pà de zhuǎn guò tóu, kàn dào yǐng zi de yǎn jīng zài fā guāng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng turned his head in fear and saw the shadow's eyes glowing.

sentences.chinese: 影子冷冷地说：“这些人现在都不在了。”
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi lěng lěng de shuō: “Zhè xiē rén xiàn zài dōu bù zài le.”
sentences.english: The shadow said coldly: "These people are no longer here."

sentences.chinese: 林峰看着名单，意识到自己可能就是下一个。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn zhe míng dān, yì shí dào zì jǐ kě néng jiù shì xià yí gè.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the list and realized he might be the next one.

sentences.chinese: 他必须在被发现之前逃离这个房间。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì xū zài bèi fā xiàn zhī qián táo lí zhè gè fáng jiān.
sentences.english: He had to escape this room before being discovered.

sentences.chinese: 但门突然被锁上了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn mén tū rán bèi suǒ shàng le.
sentences.english: But the door was suddenly locked.

sentences.chinese: 一个低沉的声音在房间里响起。
sentences.pinyin: Yí gè dī chén de shēng yīn zài fáng jiān lǐ xiǎng qǐ.
sentences.english: A deep voice sounded in the room.

sentences.chinese: 那个低沉的声音在房间里响起，像是一个古老的恐怖故事。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge dīchén de shēngyīn zài fángjiān lǐ xiǎngqǐ, xiàng shì yīgè gǔlǎo de kǒngbù gùshì.
sentences.english: That low voice echoed in the room, like an ancient horror story.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“林峰，你还记得前年夏天的事情吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Lín Fēng, nǐ hái jìdé qiánnián xiàtiān de shìqíng ma?”
sentences.english: He said, "Lin Feng, do you still remember what happened the summer before last?"

sentences.chinese: 林峰感到很奇怪，他努力回忆，但大脑一片空白。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎndào hěn qíguài, tā nǔlì huíyì, dàn dànǎo yīpiàn kòngbái.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt very strange; he tried hard to recall, but his mind was a blank.

sentences.chinese: 声音继续说：“那个阴天，气温很低，你在西南方向的一家出租屋里。”
sentences.pinyin: Shēngyīn jìxù shuō: “Nàge yīntiān, qìwēn hěn dī, nǐ zài xīnán fāngxiàng de yījiā chūzū wū lǐ.”
sentences.english: The voice continued, "That cloudy day, the temperature was very low, and you were in a rented house in the southwest direction."

sentences.chinese: 林峰突然想起，他确实在那个地方住过一段时间。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng tūrán xiǎngqǐ, tā quèshí zài nàge dìfāng zhùguò yīduàn shíjiān.
sentences.english: Lin Feng suddenly remembered that he had indeed lived in that place for a period of time.

sentences.chinese: 他在那里发现了一个奇怪的网站，记录了许多人的行为。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài nàlǐ fāxiànle yīgè qíguài de wǎngzhàn, jìlùle xǔduō rén de xíngwéi.
sentences.english: There, he discovered a strange website that recorded the behavior of many people.

sentences.chinese: 那个网站说，很多人在春天或秋天会失踪。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge wǎngzhàn shuō, hěnduō rén zài chūntiān huò qiūtiān huì shīzōng.
sentences.english: The website said that many people disappeared in spring or autumn.

sentences.chinese: 声音冷冷地笑了一声，说：“上周你以为你逃掉了，但下周你依然在我的掌控中。”
sentences.pinyin: Shēngyīn lěnglěng de xiào le yīshēng, shuō: “Shàngzhōu nǐ yǐwéi nǐ táo diào le, dàn xiàzhōu nǐ yīrán zài wǒ de zhǎngkòng zhōng.”
sentences.english: The voice laughed coldly and said, "Last week you thought you had escaped, but next week you will still be under my control."

sentences.chinese: 林峰看着镜子里的自己，他的头发因为恐惧而竖了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe jìngzi lǐ de zìjǐ, tā de tóufa yīnwèi kǒngjù ér shù le qǐlái.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at himself in the mirror; his hair stood up due to fear.

sentences.chinese: 他记得那个周末，他参加了一个奇怪的晚会。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìdé nàge zhōumò, tā cānjiāle yīgè qíguài de wǎnhuì.
sentences.english: He remembered that weekend, he attended a strange evening party.

sentences.chinese: 在那场晚会上，人们喝着苦涩的酒，听着像尖叫一样的音乐会。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nà chǎng wǎnhuì shàng, rénmen hēzhe kǔsè de jiǔ, tīngzhe xiàng jiānjiào yīyàng de yīnyuèhuì.
sentences.english: At that party, people drank bitter liquor and listened to a concert that sounded like screaming.

sentences.chinese: 一个男人在他耳边低声说了一个词，那个词的每一个音节都让他感到不安。
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè nánrén zài tā ěrbiān dīshēng shuōle yīgè cí, nàge cí de měi yīgè yīnjié dōu ràng tā gǎndào bù'ān.
sentences.english: A man whispered a word in his ear, and every syllable of that word made him feel uneasy.

sentences.chinese: 男人说：“如果你有空儿，就去东南方向的森林看看。”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ yǒukòngr, jiù qù dōngnán fāngxiàng de sēnlín kànkàn.”
sentences.english: The man said, "If you are available, go take a look at the forest in the southeast direction."

sentences.chinese: 林峰记得那是他的假期，他本想去休息，结果却陷入了陷阱。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jìdé nà shì tā de jiàqī, tā běn xiǎng qù xiūxi, jiéguǒ què xiànrùle xiànjǐng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng remembered that was his vacation; he had intended to rest, but instead fell into a trap.

sentences.chinese: 这时，房间的角落里突然出现了一只黑色的猫。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, fángjiān de jiǎoluò lǐ tūrán chūxiànle yīzhī hēisè de māo.
sentences.english: Just then, a black cat suddenly appeared in the corner of the room.

sentences.chinese: 这只猫盯着林峰，眼睛像两颗冰冷的石头。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī māo dīngzhe Lín Fēng, yǎnjīng xiàng liǎng kē bīnglěng de shítou.
sentences.english: The cat stared at Lin Feng, its eyes like two cold stones.

sentences.chinese: 林峰意识到，这个组织一直在监视他的一举一动。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yìshí dào, zhège zǔzhī yīzhí zài jiānshì tā de yījǔ yīdòng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng realized that this organization had been monitoring his every move.

sentences.chinese: 他必须找到离开这个房间的方法，否则他将永远消失在名单里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū zhǎodào líkāi zhège fángjiān de fāngfǎ, fǒuzé tā jiāng yǒngyuǎn xiāoshī zài míngdān lǐ.
sentences.english: He had to find a way to leave this room, otherwise, he would disappear from the list forever.

sentences.chinese: 突然，墙上的灯闪烁了一下，门锁传来了轻微的响声。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, qiáng shàng de dēng shǎnshuò le yīxià, ménsuǒ chuánláile qīngwēi de xiǎngshēng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the light on the wall flickered, and a slight sound came from the door lock.

sentences.chinese: 林峰猛地冲向大门，但门缝里伸出了一只苍白的手。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng měngde chōng xiàng dàmén, dàn ménfèng lǐ shēnchūle yīzhī cāngbái de shǒu.
sentences.english: Lin Feng rushed toward the main door, but a pale hand reached out from the gap in the door.

sentences.chinese: 那只手紧紧抓住了门框，将他再次推回黑暗之中。
sentences.pinyin: Nà zhī shǒu jǐnjǐn zhuāzhùle ménkuàng, jiāng tā zàicì tuī huí hēi'àn zhī zhōng.
sentences.english: That hand gripped the doorframe tightly and pushed him back into the darkness once more.

sentences.chinese: 声音再次响起：“游戏才刚刚开始。”
sentences.pinyin: Shēngyīn zàicì xiǎngqǐ: “Yóuxì cái gānggāng kāishǐ.”
sentences.english: The voice sounded again: "The game has only just begun."

sentences.chinese: 林峰被推回黑暗，他感觉到头很疼，口袋里只有几颗药片。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng bèi tuī huí hēi àn, tā gǎn jué dào tóu hěn téng, kǒu dài lǐ zhǐ yǒu jǐ kē yào piàn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng was pushed back into the darkness; he felt a terrible headache, and there were only a few pills in his pocket.

sentences.chinese: 他必须离开这个房间，寻找一条逃生的道路。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì xū lí kāi zhè ge fáng jiān, xún zhǎo yī tiáo táo shēng de dào lù.
sentences.english: He had to leave this room and find a way to escape.

sentences.chinese: 他终于发现了一个小窗户，跳了出去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhōng yú fā xiàn le yī gè xiǎo chuāng hù, tiào le chū qù.
sentences.english: He finally found a small window and jumped out.

sentences.chinese: 他发现自己在一个巨大的停车场里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn zì jǐ zài yī gè jù dà de tíng chē chǎng lǐ.
sentences.english: He found himself in a massive parking lot.

sentences.chinese: 这里停着很多辆车辆，但没有一个人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ tíng zhe hěn duō liàng chē liàng, dàn méi yǒu yī gè rén.
sentences.english: Many vehicles were parked here, but there wasn't a single person.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一辆黑色的出租车，但司机不在车里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào yī liàng hēi sè de chū zū chē, dàn sī jī bù zài chē lǐ.
sentences.english: He saw a black taxi, but the driver was not in the car.

sentences.chinese: 他跑向远处的公路，希望那里有交通工具。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pǎo xiàng yuǎn chù de gōng lù, xī wàng nà lǐ yǒu jiāo tōng gōng jù.
sentences.english: He ran toward the distant highway, hoping there would be some transportation there.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一条宽大的道路，上面没有行人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào yī tiáo kuān dà de dào lù, shàng miàn méi yǒu xíng rén.
sentences.english: He saw a wide road, but there were no pedestrians on it.

sentences.chinese: 林峰想起这个组织在城市的每个角落都有人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎng qǐ zhè ge zǔ zhī zài chéng shì de měi gè jiǎo luò dōu yǒu rén.
sentences.english: Lin Feng remembered that this organization had people in every corner of the city.

sentences.chinese: 他跑过一个安静的公园，那里没有游客在旅游。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pǎo guò yī gè ā jìng de gōng yuán, nà lǐ méi yǒu yóu kè zài lǚ yóu.
sentences.english: He ran through a quiet park, where no tourists were sightseeing.

sentences.chinese: 他经过一个体育场，那个巨大的球场现在很冷清。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīng guò yī gè tǐ yù chǎng, nà ge jù dà de qiú chǎng xiàn zài hěn lěng qīng.
sentences.english: He passed a sports stadium; that huge court was now desolate.

sentences.chinese: 他想起自己以前在球队打球的日子，那时候没有这么多危险。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ zì jǐ yǐ qián zài qiú duì dǎ qiú de rì zi, nà shí hòu méi yǒu zhè me duō wēi xiǎn.
sentences.english: He thought back to the days when he played for a sports team; there wasn't so much danger back then.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一个广场，那里有几个像旅客一样的人在旅行。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào yī gè guǎng chǎng, nà lǐ yǒu jǐ gè xiàng lǚ kè yī yàng de rén zài lǚ xíng.
sentences.english: He saw a public square, where a few people who looked like travelers were journeying.

sentences.chinese: 他想向他们求助，但那些人的眼神很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng xiàng tā men qiú zhù, dàn nà xiē rén de yǎn shén hěn qí guài.
sentences.english: He wanted to ask them for help, but their expressions were strange.

sentences.chinese: 他发现附近有一辆自行车，他决定骑车离开这里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn fù jìn yǒu yī liàng zì xíng chē, tā jué dìng qí chē lí kāi zhè lǐ.
sentences.english: He noticed a bicycle nearby and decided to ride a bike to leave this place.

sentences.chinese: 他快速地骑向市中心，希望找到地铁站。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kuài sù de qí xiàng shì zhōng xīn, xī wàng zhǎo dào dì tiě zhàn.
sentences.english: He cycled quickly toward the city center, hoping to find a subway station.

sentences.chinese: 在路上，他看到一辆公交车停在路边。
sentences.pinyin: Zài lù shàng, tā kàn dào yī liàng gōng jiāo chē tíng zài lù biān.
sentences.english: On the way, he saw a bus stopped by the roadside.

sentences.chinese: 那辆公共汽车没有乘客，门慢慢地开了。
sentences.pinyin: Nà liàng gōng gòng qì chē méi yǒu chéng kè, mén màn màn de kāi le.
sentences.english: That public bus had no passengers, and the door opened slowly.

sentences.chinese: 林峰不敢上去，他继续在这一道道街道中奔跑。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng bù gǎn shàng qù, tā jì xù zài zhè yī dào dào jiē dào zhōng bēn pǎo.
sentences.english: Lin Feng didn't dare to get on; he continued running through these streets.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，这个城市的所有交通都被控制了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, zhè ge chéng shì de suǒ yǒu jiāo tōng dōu bèi kòng zhì le.
sentences.english: He realized that all the traffic in this city was controlled.

sentences.chinese: 他突然听到身后传来了急促的脚步声。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tū rán tīng dào shēn hòu chuán lái le jí cù de jiǎo bù shēng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, he heard rapid footsteps behind him.

sentences.chinese: 那些黑色的影子再次出现了，他们像猎狗一样在追他。
sentences.pinyin: Nà xiē hēi sè de yǐng zi zài cì chū xiàn le, tā men xiàng liè gǒu yī yàng zài zhuī tā.
sentences.english: Those black shadows appeared again, chasing him like hounds.

sentences.chinese: 林峰在街道上拼命奔跑，心跳得像鼓一样快。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zài jiē dào shàng pīn mìng bēn pǎo, xīn tiào de xiàng gǔ yī yàng kuài.
sentences.english: Lin Feng ran desperately through the streets, his heart beating as fast as a drum.

sentences.chinese: 他跑进了一个狭窄的小巷，但出口被堵住了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pǎo jìn le yī gè xiá zhǎi de xiǎo xiàng, dàn chū kǒu bèi dǔ zhù le.
sentences.english: He ran into a narrow alley, but the exit was blocked.

sentences.chinese: 他回头看，那些影子已经离他只有几米远。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huí tóu kàn, nà xiē yǐng zi yǐ jīng lí tā zhǐ yǒu jǐ mǐ yuǎn.
sentences.english: He looked back, and the shadows were already only a few meters away.

sentences.chinese: 一个冰冷的声音在他耳边响起：
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè bīng lěng de shēng yīn zài tā ěr biān xiǎng qǐ:
sentences.english: A cold voice sounded in his ear:

sentences.chinese: “你以为骑自行车就能跑掉吗？”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ yǐ wéi qí zì xíng chē jiù néng pǎo diào ma?”
sentences.english: "Did you think you could escape just by riding a bicycle?"

chapters.title_chinese: 第十八章：阴影中的对话

sentences.chinese: 林峰靠在冰冷的墙上，他以为自己能逃掉，但现在他被堵在了死胡同里。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kào zài bīng lěng de qiáng shàng, tā yǐ wéi zì jǐ néng táo diào, dàn xiàn zài tā bèi dǔ zài le sǐ hú tòng lǐ.
sentences.english: Lin Feng leaned against the ice-cold wall; he thought he could escape, but now he was trapped in a dead end.

sentences.chinese: 那个影子慢慢走过来，手里拿着一封信。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè yǐng zi màn màn zǒu guò lái, shǒu lǐ ná zhe yī fēng xìn.
sentences.english: The shadow walked over slowly, holding a letter in its hand.

sentences.chinese: “这是给你的信，”影子冷冷地说，“你得相信我。”
sentences.pinyin: “Zhè shì gěi nǐ de xìn,” yǐng zi lěng lěng de shuō, “nǐ děi xiāng xìn wǒ.”
sentences.english: "This is a letter for you," the shadow said coldly, "you must trust me."

sentences.chinese: 林峰心中没有信心，他知道这个组织的所有做法都很残忍。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xīn zhōng méi yǒu xìn xīn, tā zhī dào zhè gè zǔ zhī de suǒ yǒu zuò fǎ dōu hěn cán rěn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng had no confidence in his heart; he knew that all the methods of this organization were cruel.

sentences.chinese: 对方突然问他：“你为什么这么关心那个笔记本？”
sentences.pinyin: Duì fāng tū rán wèn tā: “Nǐ wèi shén me zhè me guān xīn nà gè bǐ jì běn?”
sentences.english: The other party suddenly asked him, "Why do you care so much about that notebook?"

sentences.chinese: 林峰没有回答，他在心中寻找逃跑的办法。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng méi yǒu huí dá, tā zài xīn zhōng xún zhǎo táo pǎo de bàn fǎ.
sentences.english: Lin Feng did not answer; he searched for a way to escape in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 他努力地呼吸，试图让自己冷静下来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā nǔ lì de hū xī, shì tú ràng zì jǐ lěng jìng xià lái.
sentences.english: He breathed hard, trying to calm himself down.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，对方发出了一个奇怪的笑声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, duì fāng fā chū le yī gè qí guài de xiào shēng.
sentences.english: Just then, the other party let out a strange laugh.

sentences.chinese: 林峰发现，这个人的眼睛里没有一点温度。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng fā xiàn, zhè gè rén de yǎn jīng lǐ méi yǒu yī diǎn wēn dù.
sentences.english: Lin Feng noticed that there was not a bit of warmth in this person's eyes.

sentences.chinese: 在这个组织里，任何不听话的人都会受到严重的惩罚。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè gè zǔ zhī lǐ, rèn hé bù tīng huà de rén dōu huì shòu dào yán zhòng de chéng fá.
sentences.english: In this organization, anyone who did not obey would receive severe punishment.

sentences.chinese: 林峰想起小时候在学校听讲的样子，那时候的生活多么简单。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎng qǐ xiǎo shí hou zài xué xiào tīng jiǎng de yàng zi, nà shí hou de shēng huó duō me jiǎn dān.
sentences.english: Lin Feng remembered how he used to attend lectures in school as a child; life was so simple then.

sentences.chinese: 他听说过这个组织在很多城市流行，像一种可怕的疾病一样传播。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīng shuō guò zhè gè zǔ zhī zài hěn duō chéng shì liú xíng, xiàng yī zhǒng kě pà de jí bìng yī yàng chuán bō.
sentences.english: He had heard that this organization was popular (widespread) in many cities, spreading like a terrifying disease.

sentences.chinese: 空气中有一种奇怪的味道，像是旧书和血混合在一起的感觉。
sentences.pinyin: Kōng qì zhōng yǒu yī zhǒng qí guài de wèi dao, xiàng shì jiù shū hé xuè hùn hé zài yī qǐ de gǎn jué.
sentences.english: There was a strange smell in the air, a feeling like a mixture of old books and blood.

sentences.chinese: 影子突然说：“咱们商量一下吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi tū rán shuō: “Zán men shāng liang yī xià ba.”
sentences.english: The shadow suddenly said, "Let's discuss this."

sentences.chinese: 林峰愣住了，他没想到对方想和他进行一次对话。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng lèng zhù le, tā méi xiǎng dào duì fāng xiǎng hé tā jìn xíng yī cì duì huà.
sentences.english: Lin Feng was stunned; he hadn't expected the other party to want to have a conversation with him.

sentences.chinese: “小心一点，”影子提醒道，“这里的环境很危险。”
sentences.pinyin: “Xiǎo xīn yī diǎn,” yǐng zi tí xǐng dào, “zhè lǐ de huán jìng hěn wēi xiǎn.”
sentences.english: "Be careful," the shadow reminded him, "the environment here is very dangerous."

sentences.chinese: 他们现在站在一座旧大楼的第三层，窗外是黑色的夜空。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men xiàn zài zhàn zài yī zuò jiù dà lóu de dì sān céng, chuāng wài shì hēi sè de yè kōng.
sentences.english: They were now standing on the third floor of an old building, with the black night sky outside the window.

sentences.chinese: 恐惧影响了他的思考，但林峰必须保持清醒。
sentences.pinyin: Kǒng jù yǐng xiǎng le tā de sī kǎo, dàn Lín Fēng bì xū bǎo chí qīng xǐng.
sentences.english: Fear influenced his thinking, but Lin Feng had to stay alert.

sentences.chinese: 影子的态度突然变得温和，但这让林峰感到更害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi de tài du tū rán biàn de wēn hé, dàn zhè ràng Lín Fēng gǎn dào gèng hài pà.
sentences.english: The shadow's attitude suddenly became gentle, but this made Lin Feng feel even more afraid.

sentences.chinese: “我的想法很简单，”影子说，“你只要把笔记本给我。”
sentences.pinyin: “Wǒ de xiǎng fǎ hěn jiǎn dān,” yǐng zi shuō, “nǐ zhǐ yào bǎ bǐ jì běn gěi wǒ.”
sentences.english: "My way of thinking is simple," the shadow said, "you just need to give me the notebook."

sentences.chinese: 林峰不明白这个意思，他觉得对方在骗他。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng bù míng bai zhè gè yì si, tā jué de duì fāng zài piàn tā.
sentences.english: Lin Feng didn't understand the meaning of this; he felt the other party was lying to him.

sentences.chinese: “我有一个意见，”林峰试着开口，“如果你让我走，我就给你。”
sentences.pinyin: “Wǒ yǒu yī gè yì jiàn,” Lín Fēng shì zhe kāi kǒu, “rú guǒ nǐ ràng wǒ zǒu, wǒ jiù gěi nǐ.”
sentences.english: "I have a suggestion," Lin Feng tried to speak, "if you let me go, I will give it to you."

sentences.chinese: 林峰感到对方在犹豫，这种感觉让他有一点希望。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎn dào duì fāng zài yóu yù, zhè zhǒng gǎn jué ràng tā yǒu yī diǎn xī wàng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt the other party hesitating, and this feeling gave him a glimmer of hope.

sentences.chinese: 但他并没有被对方的语气感动，因为他懂得这个组织的残酷。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tā bìng méi yǒu bèi duì fāng de yǔ qì gǎn dòng, yīn wèi tā dǒng de zhè gè zǔ zhī de cán kù.
sentences.english: But he was not moved by the other party's tone because he understood the cruelty of this organization.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，只有极少数有才的人才能在这样的环境下生存。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhī dào, zhǐ yǒu jí shǎo shù yǒu cái de rén cái néng zài zhè yàng de huán jìng xià shēng cún.
sentences.english: He knew that only a very few talented people could survive in such an environment.

sentences.chinese: 但现在的条件对他非常不利，他被完全包围了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiàn zài de tiáo jiàn duì tā fēi cháng bù lì, tā bèi wán quán bāo wéi le.
sentences.english: But the conditions now were very unfavorable for him; he was completely surrounded.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试理解对方的话，但还是不懂对方真正的目的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cháng shì lǐ jiě duì fāng de huà, dàn hái shì bù dǒng duì fāng zhēn zhèng de mù dì.
sentences.english: He tried to comprehend the other party's words, but he still didn't understand the other party's true purpose.

sentences.chinese: 影子再次逼近，声音变得低沉。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi zài cì bī jìn, shēng yīn biàn de dī chén.
sentences.english: The shadow approached again, its voice becoming low.

sentences.chinese: “你以为你懂了，但你其实什么都不知道。”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ yǐ wéi nǐ dǒng le, dàn nǐ qí shí shén me dōu bù zhī dào.”
sentences.english: "You thought you understood, but in fact, you know nothing."

sentences.chinese: 林峰突然看到墙角有一个破洞，他心中燃起了一丝希望。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng tū rán kàn dào qiáng jiǎo yǒu yī gè pò dòng, tā xīn zhōng rán qǐ le yī sī xī wàng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng suddenly saw a hole in the corner of the wall, and a spark of hope ignited in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 他必须在对方发现之前，跳进那个黑暗的洞口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì xū zài duì fāng fā xiàn zhī qián, tiào jìn nà gè hēi sè de dòng kǒu.
sentences.english: He had to jump into that dark hole before the other party noticed.

sentences.chinese: 就在他准备跳下去的一瞬间，一只手死死抓住了他的脚踝。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tā zhǔn bèi tiào xià qù de yī shùn jiān, yī zhī shǒu sǐ sǐ zhuā zhù le tā de jiǎo huái.
sentences.english: Just as he was about to jump down, a hand gripped his ankle tightly.

sentences.chinese: 林峰大声叫了起来，他拼命地踢对方的手。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng dà shēng jiào le qǐ lái, tā pīn mìng de tī duì fāng de shǒu.
sentences.english: Lin Feng screamed loudly, kicking the other person's hand with all his might.

sentences.chinese: 那只手突然松开了，林峰迅速跳进了那个破洞。
sentences.pinyin: Nà zhī shǒu tū rán sōng kāi le, Lín Fēng xùn sù tiào jìn le nà gè pò dòng.
sentences.english: The hand suddenly let go, and Lin Feng quickly jumped into the hole.

sentences.chinese: 他发现自己掉进了一个白色的房间，墙上的颜色很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn zì jǐ diào jìn le yí gè bái sè de fáng jiān, qiáng shàng de yán sè hěn qí guài.
sentences.english: He found himself falling into a white room; the color of the walls was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 房间里坐着一个男人，他穿着西方的衣服，看起来很冷静。
sentences.pinyin: Fáng jiān lǐ zuò zhe yí gè nán rén, tā chuān zhe Xī fāng de yī fu, kàn qǐ lái hěn lěng jìng.
sentences.english: A man was sitting in the room, wearing Western clothes and looking very calm.

sentences.chinese: 这个男人开始讲话，他的声音没有感情。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè nán rén kāi shǐ jiǎng huà, tā de shēng yīn méi yǒu gǎn qíng.
sentences.english: This man began to speak, his voice devoid of emotion.

sentences.chinese: “你认为你能逃掉吗？”男人问他。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ rèn wéi nǐ néng táo diào ma?” nán rén wèn tā.
sentences.english: "Do you think you can escape?" the man asked him.

sentences.chinese: 林峰感到呼吸很困难，心脏像被卡住了一样。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎn dào hū xī hěn kùn nan, xīn zàng xiàng bèi kǎ zhù le yí yàng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt it was difficult to breathe, his heart feeling as if it were blocked.

sentences.chinese: 男人告诉他，这个组织重视每个细节，包括他现在的位置。
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén gào su tā, zhè gè zǔ zhī zhòng shì měi gè xì jié, bāo kuò tā xiàn zài de wèi zhì.
sentences.english: The man told him that the organization values every detail, including his current location.

sentences.chinese: 男人拿出一张信用卡和一张银行卡，放在桌子上。
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén ná chū yì zhāng xìn yòng kǎ hé yì zhāng yín háng kǎ, fàng zài zhuō zi shàng.
sentences.english: The man took out a credit card and a bank card and placed them on the table.

sentences.chinese: “如果你答应我的要求，我可以照顾你的全家。”
sentences.pinyin: “Rú guǒ nǐ dā ying wǒ de yāo qiú, wǒ kě yǐ zhào gu nǐ de quán jiā.”
sentences.english: "If you agree to my requests, I can take care of your whole family."

sentences.chinese: 林峰听到这句话，心中充满了恐惧。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng tīng dào zhè jù huà, xīn zhōng chōng mǎn le kǒng jù.
sentences.english: Hearing these words, Lin Feng's heart was filled with fear.

sentences.chinese: 他不想相信这个男人，因为这个组织到处都是谎言。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎng xiāng xìn zhè gè nán rén, yīn wèi zhè gè zǔ zhī dào chù dōu shì huǎng yán.
sentences.english: He didn't want to believe this man, because this organization was full of lies everywhere.

sentences.chinese: 男人开始讲这个组织的道理，说他们是为了改变世界。
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén kāi shǐ jiǎng zhè gè zǔ zhī de dào li, shuō tā men shì wèi le gǎi biàn shì jiè.
sentences.english: The man began to explain the reasoning of the organization, saying they were trying to change the world.

sentences.chinese: 林峰问他：“你的看法是什么？为什么要做这些事？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng wèn tā: “Nǐ de kàn fǎ shì shén me? Wèi shén me yào zuò zhè xiē shì?”
sentences.english: Lin Feng asked him, "What is your view? Why do these things?"

sentences.chinese: 男人笑了，他说他们需要讨论很多复杂的词语来解释这个计划。
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén xiào le, tā shuō tā men xū yào tǎo lùn hěn duō fù zá de cí yǔ lái jiě shì zhè gè jì huà.
sentences.english: The man smiled and said they needed to discuss many complex terms to explain this plan.

sentences.chinese: 林峰发现这个男人的眼睛很冷，像是在看一个脏脏的器官，而不是一个人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng fā xiàn zhè gè nán rén de yǎn jīng hěn lěng, xiàng shì zài kàn yí gè zàng zàng de qì guān, ér bú shì yí gè rén.
sentences.english: Lin Feng noticed the man's eyes were cold, as if he were looking at a dirty organ rather than a person.

sentences.chinese: 男人说，在西方，人们对权力的理解不同。
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén shuō, zài Xī fāng, rén men duì quán lì de lǐ jiě bù tóng.
sentences.english: The man said that in the West, people's understanding of power is different.

sentences.chinese: 他认为人类不应该只依赖大自然，而应该掌控一切。
sentences.pinyin: Tā rèn wéi rén lèi bù yīng gāi zhǐ yī lài dà zì rán, ér yīng gāi zhǎng kòng yí qiè.
sentences.english: He believed that humans should not rely solely on nature, but should control everything.

sentences.chinese: 林峰试图通过这个男人的话，看能不能通向出口。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng shì tú tōng guò zhè gè nán rén de huà, kàn néng bù néng tōng xiàng chū kǒu.
sentences.english: Lin Feng tried to use the man's words to see if he could find a way through to the exit.

sentences.chinese: 但男人的每一句话都像是一个陷阱。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn nán rén de měi yí jù huà dōu xiàng shì yí gè xiàn jǐng.
sentences.english: But every sentence the man spoke seemed like a trap.

sentences.chinese: 男人站起来，走到林峰面前，低声说了一句：“晚安。”
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén zhàn qǐ lái, zǒu dào Lín Fēng miàn qián, dī shēng shuō le yí jù: “Wǎn ān.”
sentences.english: The man stood up, walked over to Lin Feng, and whispered, "Good night."

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，房间的灯突然全部熄灭了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, fáng jiān de dēng tū rán quán bù xī miè le.
sentences.english: At that moment, the lights in the room suddenly all went out.

sentences.chinese: 黑暗中，林峰听到了锁门的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Hēi àn zhōng, Lín Fēng tīng dào le suǒ mén de shēng yīn.
sentences.english: In the darkness, Lin Feng heard the sound of the door being locked.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十章：黑暗中的选择

sentences.chinese: 黑暗中，林峰只能听到自己的心跳声。
sentences.pinyin: Hēi àn zhōng, Lín Fēng zhǐ néng tīng dào zì jǐ de xīn tiào shēng.
sentences.english: In the darkness, Lin Feng could only hear the sound of his own heartbeat.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这里好像是一个巨大的棺材。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué de zhè lǐ hǎo xiàng shì yī gè jù dà de guān cai.
sentences.english: He felt as if this place was a giant coffin.

sentences.chinese: 为什么那个男人要锁上门？
sentences.pinyin: Wèi shén me nà gè nán rén yào suǒ shàng mén?
sentences.english: Why did that man lock the door?

sentences.chinese: 林峰以前从未感到这么害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yǐ qián cóng wèi gǎn dào zhè me hài pà.
sentences.english: Lin Feng had never felt this scared before.

sentences.chinese: 他试着推门，但是门被锁得很死。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì zhe tuī mén, dàn shì mén bèi suǒ de hěn sǐ.
sentences.english: He tried to push the door, but it was locked tightly.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，只要找到钥匙，就可以离开这里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhī dào, zhǐ yào zhǎo dào yào shi, jiù kě yǐ lí kāi zhè lǐ.
sentences.english: He knew that as long as he found the key, he could leave this place.

sentences.chinese: 可是，房间里太黑了，他什么都看不见。
sentences.pinyin: Kě shì, fáng jiān lǐ tài hēi le, tā shén me dōu kàn bù jiàn.
sentences.english: But it was too dark in the room; he couldn't see anything.

sentences.chinese: 也许钥匙就在房间的某个地方。
sentences.pinyin: Yě xǔ yào shi jiù zài fáng jiān de mǒu gè dì fang.
sentences.english: Perhaps the key was somewhere in the room.

sentences.chinese: 他开始在地上摸索，同时在心中思考。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kāi shǐ zài dì shàng mō suǒ, tóng shí zài xīn zhōng sī kǎo.
sentences.english: He began to grope on the floor, while thinking in his heart at the same time.

sentences.chinese: 他想起那个笔记本，其中记录了许多秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ nà gè bǐ jì běn, qí zhōng jì lù le xǔ duō mì mì.
sentences.english: He thought of that notebook, among which many secrets were recorded.

sentences.chinese: 那些秘密不但很危险，而且非常奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Nà xiē mì mì bù dàn hěn wēi xiǎn, ér qiě fēi cháng qí guài.
sentences.english: Those secrets were not only dangerous but also very strange.

sentences.chinese: 例如，笔记本里写着关于这个组织的不同计划。
sentences.pinyin: Lì rú, bǐ jì běn lǐ xiě zhe guān yú zhè gè zǔ zhī de bù tóng jì huà.
sentences.english: For example, the notebook wrote about different plans of this organization.

sentences.chinese: 这些计划在以前的记录中从未出现过。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiē jì huà zài yǐ qián de jì lù zhōng cóng wèi chū xiàn guò.
sentences.english: These plans had never appeared in previous records.

sentences.chinese: 林峰想，今后如果能活下来，他一定要告诉警察。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎng, jīn hòu rú guǒ néng huó xià lái, tā yī dìng yào gào su jǐng chá.
sentences.english: Lin Feng thought that if he could survive in the future, he must tell the police.

sentences.chinese: 他摸到了一个冰冷的金属盒子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mō dào le yī gè bīng lěng de jīn shǔ hé zi.
sentences.english: He felt a cold metal box.

sentences.chinese: 盒子上面写着：十级以上禁止进入。
sentences.pinyin: Hé zi shàng miàn xiě zhe: shí jí yǐ shàng jìn zhǐ jìn rù.
sentences.english: On the box it was written: Entry forbidden for level ten and above.

sentences.chinese: 他心中想：十级以下的人可能不能打开它。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xīn zhōng xiǎng: shí jí yǐ xià de rén kě néng bù néng dǎ kāi tā.
sentences.english: He thought to himself: people below level ten might not be able to open it.

sentences.chinese: 但这个时候，他没有其他选择。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zhè gè shí hou, tā méi yǒu qí tā xuǎn zé.
sentences.english: But at this moment, he had no other choice.

sentences.chinese: 他用力打开盒子，里面有一把小钥匙。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng lì dǎ kāi hé zi, lǐ miàn yǒu yī bǎ xiǎo yào shi.
sentences.english: He forced the box open, and inside was a small key.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这把钥匙并不一般。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué de zhè bǎ yào shi bìng bù yī bān.
sentences.english: He felt that this key was not ordinary.

sentences.chinese: 它看起来像是一个古老的钥匙，而且颜色很深。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐ lái xiàng shì yī gè gǔ lǎo de yào shi, ér qiě yán sè hěn shēn.
sentences.english: It looked like an ancient key, and its color was very dark.

sentences.chinese: 不过，他不知道这把钥匙能打开什么样的门。
sentences.pinyin: Bù guò, tā bù zhī dào zhè bǎ yào shi néng dǎ kāi shén me yàng de mén.
sentences.english: However, he didn't know what kind of door this key could open.

sentences.chinese: 他走到门边，试着把钥匙放进去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu dào mén biān, shì zhe bǎ yào shi fàng jìn qù.
sentences.english: He walked to the door and tried to put the key in.

sentences.chinese: 钥匙转动了，门慢慢地开了。
sentences.pinyin: Yào shi zhuǎn dòng le, mén màn màn de kāi le.
sentences.english: The key turned, and the door slowly opened.

sentences.chinese: 门外是一个走廊，而且走廊里又出现了那个黑色的影子。
sentences.pinyin: Mén wài shì yī gè zǒu láng, ér qiě zǒu láng lǐ yòu chū xiàn le nà gè hēi sè de yǐng zi.
sentences.english: Outside the door was a corridor, and the black shadow appeared in the corridor once again.

sentences.chinese: 林峰惊呆了，啊！怎么可能这么快！
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jīng dāi le, ā! Zěn me kě néng zhè me kuài!
sentences.english: Lin Feng was stunned, Ah! How could it be this fast!

sentences.chinese: 影子看着他，冷冷地说：“你以为你可以走掉吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi kàn zhe tā, lěng lěng de shuō: “Nǐ yǐ wéi nǐ kě yǐ zǒu diào ma?”
sentences.english: The shadow looked at him and said coldly: "Do you think you can get away?"

sentences.chinese: 林峰问：“你为什么在这里？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng wèn: “Nǐ wèi shén me zài zhè lǐ?”
sentences.english: Lin Feng asked: "Why are you here?"

sentences.chinese: 影子回答：“因为你拿了不属于你的东西。”
sentences.pinyin: Yǐng zi huí dá: “Yīn wèi nǐ ná le bù shǔ yú nǐ de dōng xi.”
sentences.english: The shadow answered: "Because you took something that doesn't belong to you."

sentences.chinese: 林峰发现这个影子的声音和以前不同，好像变大了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng fā xiàn zhè gè yǐng zi de shēng yīn hé yǐ qián bù tóng, hǎo xiàng biàn dà le.
sentences.english: Lin Feng discovered that the shadow's voice was different from before, it seemed to have become louder.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，这个影子不一定是一个人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, zhè gè yǐng zi bù yī dìng shì yī gè rén.
sentences.english: He realized that this shadow was not necessarily a person.

sentences.chinese: 后来，他发现影子身后还站着另外三个人。
sentences.pinyin: Hòu lái, tā fā xiàn yǐng zi shēn hòu hái zhàn zhe lì wài sān gè rén.
sentences.english: Later, he discovered that there were three other people standing behind the shadow.

sentences.chinese: 他们看着林峰，眼神同样冷酷。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men kàn zhe Lín Fēng, yǎn shén tóng yàng lěng kù.
sentences.english: They looked at Lin Feng, their eyes equally cold.

sentences.chinese: 林峰知道，现在的情况比以前更糟糕了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhī dào, xiàn zài de qíng kuàng bǐ yǐ qián gèng zāo gāo le.
sentences.english: Lin Feng knew that the current situation was even worse than before.

sentences.chinese: 林峰看着眼前的四个人，心中充满了恐惧。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe yǎnqián de sì gè rén, xīnzhōng chōngmǎnle kǒngjù.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the four people in front of him, his heart filled with fear.

sentences.chinese: 如果他现在跑，应该没有机会逃掉。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ tā xiànzài pǎo, yīnggāi méiyǒu jīhuì táodiào.
sentences.english: If he ran now, he probably wouldn't have a chance to escape.

sentences.chinese: 当时他以为只有一个影子，但现在情况变了。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngshí tā yǐwéi zhǐyǒu yīgè yǐngzi, dàn xiànzài qíngkuàng biànle.
sentences.english: At that time, he thought there was only one shadow, but now the situation had changed.

sentences.chinese: 他想知道对方到底怎么样，为什么要抓他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng zhīdào duìfāng dàodǐ zěnmeyàng, wèishéme yào zhuā tā.
sentences.english: He wanted to know how the other party actually was and why they wanted to capture him.

sentences.chinese: 他不知道对方会怎样对待他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zhīdào duìfāng huì zěnyàng duìdài tā.
sentences.english: He didn't know how they would treat him.

sentences.chinese: 对方或是在等他说话，或者在等他绝望。
sentences.pinyin: Duìfāng huò shì zài děng tā shuōhuà, huòzhě zài děng tā juéwàng.
sentences.english: They might be waiting for him to speak, or perhaps waiting for him to despair.

sentences.chinese: 所以林峰决定先观察，不能随便行动。
sentences.pinyin: Suǒyǐ Lín Fēng juédìng xiān guānchá, bùnéng suíbiàn xíngdòng.
sentences.english: Therefore, Lin Feng decided to observe first and not act randomly.

sentences.chinese: 他想找一个机会，比如利用房间里的桌子，比如说把桌子推倒。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng zhǎo yīgè jīhuì, bǐrú lìyòng fángjiān lǐ de zhuōzi, bǐrúshuō bǎ zhuōzi tuīdǎo.
sentences.english: He wanted to find an opportunity, for example, by using the table in the room, for instance, pushing the table over.

sentences.chinese: 然后他可以快速跑向那个门。
sentences.pinyin: Ránhòu tā kěyǐ kuàisù pǎo xiàng nàgè mén.
sentences.english: Then he could run quickly toward that door.

sentences.chinese: 如果对方发现他的话，他可能会被立刻抓住。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ duìfāng fāxiàn tā de huà, tā kěnéng huì bèi lìkè zhuāzhù.
sentences.english: If the other party discovered him, he might be caught immediately.

sentences.chinese: 这四个人的眼神非常相同，都像没有感情的机器。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè sì gè rén de yǎnshén fēicháng xiāngtóng, dōu xiàng méiyǒu gǎnqíng de jīqì.
sentences.english: The expressions of these four people were identical; they were all like emotionless machines.

sentences.chinese: 在这种环境下，沉默等于死亡。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhèzhǒng huánjìng xià, chénmò děngyú sǐwáng.
sentences.english: In this kind of environment, silence is tantamount to death.

sentences.chinese: 而且这些人的动作非常快，他不能低估他们。
sentences.pinyin: Érqiě zhèxiē rén de dòngzuò fēicháng kuài, tā bùnéng dīgū tāmen.
sentences.english: Moreover, these people's movements were very fast; he could not underestimate them.

sentences.chinese: 他必须能够在这个死路中找到出口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū nénggòu zài zhège sǐlù zhōng zhǎodào chūkǒu.
sentences.english: He must be able to find an exit in this dead end.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉自己，必须冷静下来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù zìjǐ, bìxū lěngjìng xiàlái.
sentences.english: He told himself that he must calm down.

sentences.chinese: 虽然他现在很害怕，但他不能放弃。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán tā xiànzài hěn hàipà, dàn tā bùnéng fàngqì.
sentences.english: Although he was very scared now, he could not give up.

sentences.chinese: 他知道自己该做什么了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhīdào zìjǐ gāi zuò shénme le.
sentences.english: He knew what he should do.

sentences.chinese: 他想到了过去在笔记本里看到的线索。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngdàole guòqù zài bǐjìběn lǐ kàndào de xiànsuǒ.
sentences.english: He thought of the clues he had seen in the notebook in the past.

sentences.chinese: 这时，领头的那个影子突然开口说话了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, lǐngtóu de nàgè yǐngzi tūrán kāikǒu shuōhuà le.
sentences.english: At this moment, the leading shadow suddenly spoke.

sentences.chinese: 这样冷酷的声音让他感到全身发抖。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèyàng lěngkù de shēngyīn ràng tā gǎndào quánshēn fādǒu.
sentences.english: Such a cold voice made his whole body tremble.

sentences.chinese: 那么小的声音，却像雷一样响在耳边。
sentences.pinyin: Nàme xiǎo de shēngyīn, què xiàng léi yīyàng xiǎng zài ěrbiān.
sentences.english: Such a small voice, yet it sounded like thunder in his ears.

sentences.chinese: 那会儿林峰还在犹豫，但现在他必须行动。
sentences.pinyin: Nàhuìr Lín Fēng hái zài yóuyù, dàn xiànzài tā bìxū xíngdòng.
sentences.english: At that time, Lin Feng was still hesitating, but now he must act.

sentences.chinese: 那时他还没有意识到，这个房间其实是一个陷阱。
sentences.pinyin: Nàshí tā hái méiyǒu yìshí dào, zhège fángjiān qíshí shì yīgè xiànjǐng.
sentences.english: Then, he had not yet realized that this room was actually a trap.

sentences.chinese: 那时候他以为门是唯一的出口。
sentences.pinyin: Nàshíhou tā yǐwéi mén shì wéiyī de chūkǒu.
sentences.english: At that time, he thought the door was the only exit.

sentences.chinese: 那样想太简单了。
sentences.pinyin: Nàyàng xiǎng tài jiǎndān le.
sentences.english: Thinking that way was too simple.

sentences.chinese: 他必须重新思考逃跑的计划。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū chóngxīn sīkǎo táopǎo de jìhuà.
sentences.english: He must rethink his escape plan.

sentences.chinese: 他深深地吸了一口气，看向那个影子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shēnshēn de xīle yī kǒuqì, kànxiàng nàgè yǐngzi.
sentences.english: He took a deep breath and looked at the shadow.

sentences.chinese: 他突然发现，对方的手里拿着那个笔记本。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán fāxiàn, duìfāng de shǒu lǐ názhe nàgè bǐjìběn.
sentences.english: He suddenly discovered that the other party was holding that notebook in their hand.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十二章：阴影中的名单
chapters.title_english: Chapter 22: The List in the Shadows

sentences.chinese: 林峰看着那个笔记本，那是他唯一的希望。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe nàge bǐjìběn, nà shì tā wéiyī de xīwàng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the notebook; it was his only hope.

sentences.chinese: 那个拿着本子的影子慢慢走过来，他是一个中年男人。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge názhe běnzi de yǐngzi mànman zǒu guòlái, tā shì yígè zhōngnián nánrén.
sentences.english: The shadow holding the book walked over slowly; he was a middle-aged man.

sentences.chinese: 他的声音低沉，像是一个习惯命令别人的经理。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shēngyīn dīchén, xiàng shì yígè xíguàn mìnglìng biérén de jīnglǐ.
sentences.english: His voice was low, like a manager accustomed to giving orders to others.

sentences.chinese: “你以为你能拿回它？”男人冷冷地问。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ yǐwéi nǐ néng ná huí tā?” nánrén lěnglěng de wèn.
sentences.english: "Do you think you can take it back?" the man asked coldly.

sentences.chinese: 林峰注意到，这个男人的衣服非常高级，看起来像是个高级官员。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhùyì dào, zhège nánrén de yīfu fēicháng gāojí, kàn qǐlái xiàng shì gè gāojí guānyuán.
sentences.english: Lin Feng noticed that the man's clothes were very high-end, looking like a high-ranking official.

sentences.chinese: 这个男人在组织里应该是中级成员，但他的权力很大。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège nánrén zài zǔzhī lǐ yīnggāi shì zhōngjí chéngyuán, dàn tā de quánlì hěn dà.
sentences.english: This man should be a middle-level member in the organization, but his power is great.

sentences.chinese: 林峰想起，这个组织里有很多人，包括他的前同事。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎngqǐ, zhège zǔzhī lǐ yǒu hěn duō rén, bāokuò tā de qián tóngshì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng remembered that there are many people in this organization, including his former colleagues.

sentences.chinese: 他记得那个人的名字，那是一个在名单上的名。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde nàge rén de míngzi, nà shì yígè zài míngdān shàng de míng.
sentences.english: He remembered that person's name; it was a name on the list.

sentences.chinese: 男人打开笔记本，翻到了一页关于周年的记录。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén dǎkāi bǐjìběn, fān dào le yì yè guānyú zhōunián de jìlù.
sentences.english: The man opened the notebook and flipped to a page about an anniversary record.

sentences.chinese: “每年的这个日子，我们都会清理掉没用的人。”
sentences.pinyin: “Měinián de zhège rìzi, wǒmen dōu huì qīnglǐ diào méiyòng de rén.”
sentences.english: "On this day every year, we clear out the useless people."

sentences.chinese: 林峰感到一阵寒意，这些坏人太可怕了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎndào yízhèn hányì, zhèxiē huàirén tài kěpà le.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt a chill; these bad people are too terrifying.

sentences.chinese: 在这个房间里，没有大人能救他，他只能靠自己。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège fángjiān lǐ, méiyǒu dàren néng jiù tā, tā zhǐnéng kào zìjǐ.
sentences.english: In this room, there are no adults who can save him; he can only rely on himself.

sentences.chinese: 他突然发现，笔记本里记录了很多人的信息。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán fāxiàn, bǐjìběn lǐ jìlù le hěn duō rén de xìnxī.
sentences.english: He suddenly discovered that the notebook recorded information about many people.

sentences.chinese: 这里有高中学生的名单，还有很多青少年的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ yǒu gāozhōng xuéshēng de míngdān, hái yǒu hěn duō qīngshàonián de míngzi.
sentences.english: There were lists of senior high school students and the names of many adolescents.

sentences.chinese: 有些是年级第一的考生，有些是优秀的青年。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒuxiē shì niánjí dìyī de kǎoshēng, yǒuxiē shì yōuxiù de qīngnián.
sentences.english: Some were exam candidates who ranked first in their grade, and some were outstanding youths.

sentences.chinese: 甚至有一个留学生的记录，他来自很远的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Shènzhì yǒu yígè liúxuéshēng de jìlù, tā láizì hěn yuǎn de dìfāng.
sentences.english: There was even a record of an international student who came from a far-off place.

sentences.chinese: 在这个组织看来，这些少年只是实验的工具。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège zǔzhī kànlái, zhèxiē shàonián zhǐshì shíyàn de gōngjù.
sentences.english: In the eyes of this organization, these youngsters are just tools for experiments.

sentences.chinese: 笔记本里写着，他们会在开学之前把人抓走。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐjìběn lǐ xiězhe, tāmen huì zài kāixué zhīqián bǎ rén zhuā zǒu.
sentences.english: The notebook stated that they would kidnap people before the start of the school term.

sentences.chinese: 一个学期的计划，就是为了提高这些人的心理水平。
sentences.pinyin: Yígè xuéqī de jìhuà, jiùshì wèile tígāo zhèxiē rén de xīnlǐ shuǐpíng.
sentences.english: A semester's plan was meant to improve the psychological level of these people.

sentences.chinese: 林峰看到，一个组长负责管理这些孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàndào, yígè zǔzhǎng fùzé guǎnlǐ zhèxiē háizi.
sentences.english: Lin Feng saw that a group leader was responsible for managing these children.

sentences.chinese: 那个组长曾经是一个学校的班长，现在却成了恶魔。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge zǔzhǎng céngjīng shì yígè xuéxiào de bānzhǎng, xiànzài què chéngle èmó.
sentences.english: That group leader was once a class monitor at a school, but now he has become a demon.

sentences.chinese: 甚至连一个大学的校长和一名院长也参与了这件事。
sentences.pinyin: Shènzhì lián yígè dàxué de xiàozhǎng hé yì míng yuànzhǎng yě cānyù le zhè jiàn shì.
sentences.english: Even a university president and a dean were involved in this matter.

sentences.chinese: 这些人在社会上是受尊敬的家长，但在黑暗中却是怪物。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē rén zài shèhuì shàng shì shòu zūnjìng de jiāzhǎng, dàn zài hēi'àn zhōng què shì guàiwù.
sentences.english: These people are respected heads of households in society, but in the darkness, they are monsters.

sentences.chinese: 林峰发现，被抓的人从少年到老年都有。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng fāxiàn, bèi zhuā de rén cóng shàonián dào lǎonián dōu yǒu.
sentences.english: Lin Feng found that the kidnapped people ranged from youth to old age.

sentences.chinese: 一个老朋友的名字出现在了名单的最后一行。
sentences.pinyin: Yígè lǎo péngyou de míngzi chūxiàn zài le míngdān de zuìhòu yì háng.
sentences.english: An old friend's name appeared on the last line of the list.

sentences.chinese: 林峰的心跳加快了，他必须救出那个朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng de xīntiào jiākuài le, tā bìxū jiù chū nàge péngyou.
sentences.english: Lin Feng's heart beat faster; he must rescue that friend.

sentences.chinese: 他看向那个男人，对方的眼神像冰一样冷。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànxiàng nàge nánrén, duìfāng de yǎnshén xiàng bīng yíyàng lěng.
sentences.english: He looked at the man, whose eyes were cold as ice.

sentences.chinese: “你现在的级数太低，不配知道真相。”男人笑了。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ xiànzài de jíshù tài dī, búpèi zhīdào zhēnxiàng.” nánrén xiào le.
sentences.english: "Your current level is too low; you don't deserve to know the truth," the man smiled.

sentences.chinese: 林峰突然意识到，这个男人的身份可能就是这个行动的队长。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng tūrán yìshí dào, zhège nánrén de shēnfèn kěnéng jiùshì zhège xíngdòng de duìzhǎng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng suddenly realized that this man's identity might be the captain of this operation.

sentences.chinese: 他必须在对方再次行动之前，抢回那个笔记本。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū zài duìfāng zàicì xíngdòng zhīqián, qiǎng huí nàge bǐjìběn.
sentences.english: He must snatch back that notebook before the other party acts again.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十三章：最后的晚餐

sentences.chinese: 林峰看着队长，对方在用非常标准的普通话说话。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe duìzhǎng, duìfāng zài yòng fēicháng biāozhǔn de pǔtōnghuà shuōhuà.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the captain, who was speaking in very standard Mandarin.

sentences.chinese: 队长笑着说：“我知道你来自东北，那里的人很勇敢。”
sentences.pinyin: Duìzhǎng xiàozhe shuō: “Wǒ zhīdào nǐ láizì dōngběi, nàlǐ de rén hěn yǒnggǎn.”
sentences.english: The captain smiled and said, "I know you are from the Northeast; people there are very brave."

sentences.chinese: 他把笔记本放在桌子上，旁边是一本厚厚的字典。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ bǐjìběn fàng zài zhuōzi shàng, pángbiān shì yī běn hòuhòu de zìdiǎn.
sentences.english: He placed the notebook on the table, next to a thick dictionary.

sentences.chinese: 林峰注意到字典的读音部分被圈了起来，像是一个秘密代码。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhùyì dào zìdiǎn de dúyīn bùfèn bèi quān le qǐlái, xiàng shì yī gè mìmì dàimǎ.
sentences.english: Lin Feng noticed that the pronunciation section of the dictionary had been circled, like a secret code.

sentences.chinese: 队长指着桌上的食物，示意林峰坐下来。
sentences.pinyin: Duìzhǎng zhǐzhe zhuō shàng de shíwù, shìyì Lín Fēng zuò xiàlái.
sentences.english: The captain pointed to the food on the table, gesturing for Lin Feng to sit down.

sentences.chinese: 桌上有中餐，也有西餐，看起来像是在请客。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuō shàng yǒu zhōngcān, yěyǒu xīcān, kàn qǐlái xiàng shì zài qǐngkè.
sentences.english: There was Chinese food and Western food on the table, making it look like he was treating him to a meal.

sentences.chinese: 但林峰知道，这绝不是普通的午餐。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn Lín Fēng zhīdào, zhè jué bùshì pǔtōng de wǔcān.
sentences.english: But Lin Feng knew this was by no means an ordinary lunch.

sentences.chinese: 队长说：“我的父亲曾是一名中医，而我学习的是西医。”
sentences.pinyin: Duìzhǎng shuō: “Wǒ de fùqīn céng shì yī míng zhōngyī, ér wǒ xuéxí de shì xīyī.”
sentences.english: The captain said, "My father was once a practitioner of traditional Chinese medicine, while I studied Western medicine."

sentences.chinese: “我们都明白，有时候药和毒是一样的。”
sentences.pinyin: “Wǒmen dōu míngbái, yǒu shíhou yào hé dú shì yīyàng de.”
sentences.english: "We both understand that sometimes medicine and poison are the same thing."

sentences.chinese: 林峰感到背后的风很凉，让他打了一个冷战。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎndào bèihòu de fēng hěn liáng, ràng tā dǎ le yī gè lěngzhàn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt a cool breeze behind him, making him shiver.

sentences.chinese: 他看到桌上有几个饺子和一只烤鸡。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào zhuō shàng yǒu jǐ gè jiǎozi hé yī zhǐ kǎo jī.
sentences.english: He saw a few dumplings and a roasted chicken on the table.

sentences.chinese: 这些快餐看起来很诱人，但林峰不敢吃。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē kuàicān kàn qǐlái hěn yòurén, dàn Lín Fēng bù gǎn chī.
sentences.english: This fast food looked tempting, but Lin Feng didn't dare eat it.

sentences.chinese: 他想起早晨在路边看到的晚报，上面写着很多失踪的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zǎochén zài lùbiān kàndào de wǎnbào, shàngmiàn xiězhe hěnduō shīzōng de rén.
sentences.english: He remembered the evening newspaper he saw on the roadside this morning, which listed many missing people.

sentences.chinese: 这些人有的来自西北，有的来自南方。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē rén yǒu de láizì xīběi, yǒu de láizì nánfāng.
sentences.english: Some of these people were from the Northwest, some from the South.

sentences.chinese: 队长问他：“你过年的时候回不去家了吧？”
sentences.pinyin: Duìzhǎng wèn tā: “Nǐ guònián de shíhou huí bù qù jiā le ba?”
sentences.english: The captain asked him, "You won't be able to go home for the New Year, will you?"

sentences.chinese: “春节快到了，但你可能没机会过年了。”
sentences.pinyin: “Chūnjié kuài dào le, dàn nǐ kěnéng méi jīhuì guònián le.”
sentences.english: "The Spring Festival is coming soon, but you might not have the chance to celebrate the New Year."

sentences.chinese: 林峰强忍着恐惧，问他为什么要把这些人抓走。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng qiáng rěnzhe kǒngjù, wèn tā wèishéme yào bǎ zhèxiē rén zhuā zǒu.
sentences.english: Lin Feng fought back his fear and asked why he had kidnapped these people.

sentences.chinese: 队长没有回答，只是看着手中的外卖盒子。
sentences.pinyin: Duìzhǎng méiyǒu huídá, zhǐshì kànzhe shǒuzhōng de wàimài hézi.
sentences.english: The captain didn't answer, only looking at the takeout box in his hand.

sentences.chinese: 他轻声说：“在这个计划里，每一个人都像这盒快餐一样，用完就扔。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā qīngshēng shuō: “Zài zhège jìhuà lǐ, měi yī gè rén dōu xiàng zhè hé kuàicān yīyàng, yòng wán jiù rēng.”
sentences.english: He said softly, "In this plan, every person is like this box of fast food—thrown away once used."

sentences.chinese: 林峰看到桌上有一个小秤，上面放着一斤白色的粉末。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàndào zhuō shàng yǒu yī gè xiǎo chèng, shàngmiàn fàngzhe yī jīn báisè de fěnmò.
sentences.english: Lin Feng saw a small scale on the table, with one catty of white powder on it.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，这可能是某种危险的化学品。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, zhè kěnéng shì mǒu zhǒng wēixiǎn de huàxué pǐn.
sentences.english: He realized this might be some kind of dangerous chemical.

sentences.chinese: 他必须在晚餐开始之前，抢回笔记本并逃走。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū zài wǎncān kāishǐ zhīqián, qiǎng huí bǐjìběn bìng táozǒu.
sentences.english: He had to grab the notebook and escape before dinner began.

sentences.chinese: 就在他准备行动时，队长突然拿起了刀。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tā zhǔnbèi xíngdòng shí, duìzhǎng tūrán ná qǐ le dāo.
sentences.english: Just as he was preparing to act, the captain suddenly picked up a knife.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十四章：最后的信号

sentences.chinese: 队长拿起了刀，眼神冷得像冰。
sentences.pinyin: Duì zhǎng ná qǐ le dāo, yǎn shén lěng de xiàng bīng.
sentences.english: The captain picked up the knife, his gaze as cold as ice.

sentences.chinese: 林峰看着桌上的白色粉末，心跳很快。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn zhe zhuō shàng de bái sè fěn mò, xīn tiào hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the white powder on the table, his heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 他想起在日报上看到的那个新闻。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ zài rì bào shàng kàn dào de nà gè xīn wén.
sentences.english: He remembered the news he had seen in the daily newspaper.

sentences.chinese: 新闻说，市长在体育场开会时失踪了。
sentences.pinyin: Xīn wén shuō, shì zhǎng zài tǐ yù chǎng kāi huì shí shī zōng le.
sentences.english: The news said the mayor had disappeared during a meeting at the stadium.

sentences.chinese: 这个组织的人数很多，也许有几千人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè zǔ zhī de rén shù hěn duō, yě xǔ yǒu jǐ qiān rén.
sentences.english: The number of people in this organization was huge, perhaps thousands.

sentences.chinese: 他们甚至控制了这座城市的住房和地铁站。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men shèn zhì kòng zhì le zhè zuò chéng shì de zhù fáng hé dì tiě zhàn.
sentences.english: They even controlled the housing and subway stations of this city.

sentences.chinese: 队长突然说话了，他的声音很年轻。
sentences.pinyin: Duì zhǎng tū rán shuō huà le, tā de shēng yīn hěn nián qīng.
sentences.english: The captain suddenly spoke, his voice very young.

sentences.chinese: “你觉得你能逃到地球的哪个角落？”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ jué dé nǐ néng táo dào dì qiú de nǎ gè jiǎo luò?”
sentences.english: "Where on earth do you think you can escape to?"

sentences.chinese: 林峰低头看了看自己的手表，时间不多了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng dī tóu kàn le kàn zì jǐ de shǒu biǎo, shí jiān bù duō le.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked down at his wristwatch; there wasn't much time left.

sentences.chinese: 他发现队长在写一个句子，那是某种秘密代码。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn duì zhǎng zài xiě yí gè jù zi, nà shì mǒu zhǒng mì mì dài mǎ.
sentences.english: He noticed the captain was writing a sentence, which was some kind of secret code.

sentences.chinese: 这种代码在他们的秘密小组里非常常用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng dài mǎ zài tā men de mì mì xiǎo zǔ lǐ fēi cháng cháng yòng.
sentences.english: This kind of code was very common in their secret group.

sentences.chinese: 林峰突然看到桌上有一本笔记本，旁边还有一本护照。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng tū rán kàn dào zhuō shàng yǒu yì běn bǐ jì běn, páng biān hái yǒu yì běn hù zhào.
sentences.english: Lin Feng suddenly saw a notebook on the table, and there was also a passport beside it.

sentences.chinese: 那是队长的护照，上面写着他的真实身份。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì duì zhǎng de hù zhào, shàng miàn xiě zhe tā de zhēn shí shēn fèn.
sentences.english: It was the captain's passport, and it listed his true identity.

sentences.chinese: 他曾经是一名教师，在一家中小学教书。
sentences.pinyin: Tā céng jīng shì yì míng jiào shī, zài yì jiā zhōng xiǎo xué jiāo shū.
sentences.english: He had once been a teacher, teaching at a middle and elementary school.

sentences.chinese: 在那间教室里，他教学生们如何思考。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nà jiān jiào shì lǐ, tā jiāo xué shēng men rú hé sī kǎo.
sentences.english: In that classroom, he taught students how to think.

sentences.chinese: 但现在，他成了一个杀手，一个像动物一样的怪物。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiàn zài, tā chéng le yí gè shā shǒu, yí gè xiàng dòng wù yí yàng de guài wù.
sentences.english: But now, he had become a killer, a monster like an animal.

sentences.chinese: 林峰想起小时候去动物园看动物的日子，那时很安全。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎng qǐ xiǎo shí hou qù dòng wù yuán kàn dòng wù de rì zi, nà shí hěn ān quán.
sentences.english: Lin Feng thought of the days when he went to the zoo to see animals as a child; it was safe then.

sentences.chinese: 现在，他觉得自己就像被关在笼子里的动物。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài, tā jué dé zì jǐ jiù xiàng bèi guān zài lóng zi lǐ de dòng wù.
sentences.english: Now, he felt like an animal locked in a cage.

sentences.chinese: 他必须抢回笔记本，因为里面记录了亿万资金的去向。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì xū qiǎng huí bǐ jì běn, yīn wèi lǐ miàn jì lù le yì wàn zī jīn de qù xiàng.
sentences.english: He had to snatch back the notebook because it recorded the destination of hundreds of millions in funds.

sentences.chinese: 万一这些钱被他们用了，人们就再也没有希望了。
sentences.pinyin: Wàn yī zhè xiē qián bèi tā men yòng le, rén men jiù zài yě méi yǒu xī wàng le.
sentences.english: If this money were used by them, people would have no hope left.

sentences.chinese: 林峰猛地站起来，推翻了座位。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng měng de zhàn qǐ lái, tuī fān le zuò wèi.
sentences.english: Lin Feng suddenly stood up and knocked over his seat.

sentences.chinese: 他抢过笔记本，用尽全力向门外跑去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qiǎng guò bǐ jì běn, yòng jìn quán lì xiàng mén wài pǎo qù.
sentences.english: He grabbed the notebook and ran out the door with all his might.

sentences.chinese: 他跑了三公里，才终于看到了一点信号。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pǎo le sān gōng lǐ, cái zhōng yú kàn dào le yì diǎn xìn hào.
sentences.english: He ran for three kilometers before he finally saw a bit of signal.

sentences.chinese: 他拿出手机，试图给外界发送消息。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū shǒu jī, shì tú gěi wài jiè fā sòng xiāo xī.
sentences.english: He took out his phone, attempting to send a message to the outside world.

sentences.chinese: 他跑过一个排球场，看到那里没有人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pǎo guò yí gè pái qiú chǎng, kàn dào nà lǐ méi yǒu rén.
sentences.english: He ran past a volleyball court and saw that no one was there.

sentences.chinese: 他记得在很多地方，人们必须排队才能买到早餐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì dé zài hěn duō dì fang, rén men bì xū pái duì cái néng mǎi dào zǎo cān.
sentences.english: He remembered that in many places, people had to line up to buy breakfast.

sentences.chinese: 但在这个恐怖的夜晚，街道上空无一人。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zài zhè gè kǒng bù de yè wǎn, jiē dào shàng kōng wú yì rén.
sentences.english: But on this terrifying night, the streets were empty.

sentences.chinese: 他想起一个作家的书里写过，勇气是面对恐惧的唯一方法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ yí gè zuò jiā de shū lǐ xiě guò, yǒng qì shì miàn duì kǒng jù de wéi yī fāng fǎ.
sentences.english: He recalled a writer's book saying that courage is the only way to face fear.

sentences.chinese: 他已经没有退路了，必须把真相告诉全世界。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǐ jīng méi yǒu tuì lù le, bì xū bǎ zhēn xiàng gào su quán shì jiè.
sentences.english: He already had no way back; he had to tell the truth to the whole world.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，他的手机响了，信号非常弱。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, tā de shǒu jī xiǎng le, xìn hào fēi cháng ruò.
sentences.english: Just then, his phone rang, and the signal was very weak.

sentences.chinese: 一个低沉的声音在电话里响起：“你跑不掉的。”
sentences.pinyin: Yí gè dī chén de shēng yīn zài diàn huà lǐ xiǎng qǐ: “Nǐ pǎo bù diào de.”
sentences.english: A low voice sounded over the phone: "You cannot escape."

sentences.chinese: 林峰回头看，黑暗中出现了一个巨大的影子。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng huí tóu kàn, hēi àn zhōng chū xiàn le yí gè jù dà de yǐng zi.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked back, and a huge shadow appeared in the darkness.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十五章：最后的迷宫

sentences.chinese: 那个巨大的影子慢慢走过来，林峰感觉到空气的温度在下降。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge jùdà de yǐngzi mànman zǒu guòlái, Lín Fēng gǎnjué dào kōngqì de wēndù zài xiàjiàng.
sentences.english: The giant shadow slowly approached, and Lin Feng felt the temperature of the air dropping.

sentences.chinese: 他想起这个组织曾经在大学校园里做过实验。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zhège zǔzhī céngjīng zài dàxué xiàoyuán lǐ zuòguò shíyàn.
sentences.english: He remembered that this organization had once conducted experiments on the university campus.

sentences.chinese: 他现在就在那个旧的实验区，这里像一个巨大的坟墓。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiànzài jiù zài nàge jiù de shíyàn qū, zhèlǐ xiàng yīgè jùdà de fénmù.
sentences.english: He was now in that old experimental area, which felt like a giant grave.

sentences.chinese: 他跑过一条狭窄的街，看见远处有一个银行的大门，但门锁住了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pǎo guò yītiáo xiǎozhǎi de jiē, kànjiàn yuǎnchù yǒu yīgè yínháng de dàmén, dàn mén suǒzhù le.
sentences.english: He ran down a narrow street and saw the door of a bank in the distance, but it was locked.

sentences.chinese: 月亮被云遮住了，四周变得越来越黑。
sentences.pinyin: Yuèliang bèi yún zhēzhù le, sìzhōu biàn de yuè lái yuè hēi.
sentences.english: The moon was covered by clouds, and the surroundings became darker and darker.

sentences.chinese: 他突然跑进了一个废弃的花园，那里有一把破旧的椅子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán pǎo jìn le yīgè fèiqì de huāyuán, nàlǐ yǒu yī bǎ pòjiù de yǐzi.
sentences.english: He suddenly ran into an abandoned garden, where there was a worn-out chair.

sentences.chinese: 椅子上面放着一个玻璃瓶子，里面有一张纸条。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐzi shàngmiàn fàngzhe yīgè bōlí píngzi, lǐmiàn yǒu yī zhāng zhǐtiáo.
sentences.english: On the chair lay a glass bottle with a note inside.

sentences.chinese: 纸条是用英文写的，但林峰能看懂，因为他学过英语。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐtiáo shì yòng Yīngwén xiě de, dàn Lín Fēng néng kàndǒng, yīnwèi tā xuéguò Yīngyǔ.
sentences.english: The note was written in English, but Lin Feng could understand it because he had studied English.

sentences.chinese: 纸条说：真相在那个像湖一样的水池边。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐtiáo shuō: Zhēnxiàng zài nàge xiàng hú yīyàng de shuǐchí biān.
sentences.english: The note said: The truth is by the pool that looks like a lake.

sentences.chinese: 林峰快步走去，路边有一条小河，水声在深夜里很可怕。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kuàibù zǒu qù, lùbiān yǒu yītiáo xiǎo hé, shuǐshēng zài shēnyè lǐ hěn kěpà.
sentences.english: Lin Feng walked quickly; there was a small river by the road, and the sound of water was terrifying in the dead of night.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一个男人坐在那里，像一个孤独的画家在画画。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào yīgè nánrén zuò zài nàlǐ, xiàng yīgè gūdú de huàjiā zài huàhuà.
sentences.english: He saw a man sitting there, like a lonely painter painting a picture.

sentences.chinese: 但那个男人不是画家，而是一个疯狂的科学家。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn nàge nánrén bùshì huàjiā, ér shì yīgè fēngkuáng de kēxuéjiā.
sentences.english: But the man was not a painter, but a mad scientist.

sentences.chinese: 科学家的眼睛里没有光，只有冷酷的计算。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā de yǎnjing lǐ méiyǒu guāng, zhǐyǒu lěngkù de jìsuàn.
sentences.english: There was no light in the scientist's eyes, only cold calculation.

sentences.chinese: 他看着林峰，突然讲了一个奇怪的笑话儿，但林峰一点也不觉得好笑。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe Lín Fēng, tūrán jiǎngle yīgè qíguài de xiàohuar, dàn Lín Fēng yīdiǎn yě bù juéde hǎoxiào.
sentences.english: He looked at Lin Feng and suddenly told a strange joke, but Lin Feng didn't find it funny at all.

sentences.chinese: 科学家的桌子上放着一副筷子和一个菜单，这在深夜的荒野里太奇怪了。
sentences.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā de zhuōzi shàng fàngzhe yī fù kuàizi hé yīgè càidān, zhè zài shēnyè de huāngyě lǐ tài qíguài le.
sentences.english: On the scientist's table were a pair of chopsticks and a menu, which was too strange in the wilderness at midnight.

sentences.chinese: 林峰注意到，科学家的腿在发抖，他似乎在恐惧什么。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhùyì dào, kēxuéjiā de tuǐ zài fādǒu, tā sìhū zài kǒngjù shénme.
sentences.english: Lin Feng noticed the scientist's leg was shaking; he seemed to be afraid of something.

sentences.chinese: 林峰问他笔记本在哪里，科学家只是冷冷地点头，指了指远处的篮球场。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng wèn tā bǐjìběn zài nǎlǐ, kēxuéjiā zhǐshì lěng lěng de diǎntóu, zhǐ le zhǐ yuǎnchù de lánqiú chǎng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng asked him where the notebook was, and the scientist simply nodded coldly, pointing toward a distant basketball court.

sentences.chinese: 林峰跑过去，看到一个篮球在地上慢慢滚动。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng pǎo guòqù, kàndào yīgè lánqiú zài dìshàng mànman gǔndòng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng ran over and saw a basketball rolling slowly on the ground.

sentences.chinese: 他发现一个黑色的袋子，里面就是那个记录了所有月份秘密的笔记本。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn yīgè hēisè de dàizi, lǐmiàn jiùshì nàge jìlù le suǒyǒu yuèfèn mìmì de bǐjìběn.
sentences.english: He found a black bag, and inside was the notebook that recorded the secrets of every month.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，一只巨大的狗突然从黑暗中冲了出来，对着他大叫。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, yī zhǐ jùdà de gǒu tūrán cóng hēi'àn zhōng chōng le chūlái, duìzhe tā dàjiào.
sentences.english: Just then, a huge dog suddenly rushed out of the darkness, barking loudly at him.

sentences.chinese: 林峰穿着球鞋，快速地转身奔跑，心跳得非常快。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng chuānzhe qiúxié, kuàisù de zhuǎnshēn bēnpǎo, xīntiào de fēicháng kuài.
sentences.english: Wearing athletic shoes, Lin Feng turned and ran quickly, his heart beating very fast.

sentences.chinese: 他想起在课堂上老师说过，在这种节骨眼上，不能犹豫。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zài kètáng shàng lǎoshī shuōguò, zài zhè zhǒng jié gǔjié yàng shàng, bùnéng yóuyù.
sentences.english: He remembered his teacher saying in class that at such a critical juncture, one must not hesitate.

sentences.chinese: 他必须把这个笔记本送到安全的地方，送到那个唯一能信任的人手中。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū bǎ zhège bǐjìběn sòngdào āntián de dìfāng, sòngdào nàge wéiyī néng xìnrèn de rén shǒu zhōng.
sentences.english: He had to deliver this notebook to a safe place, into the hands of the only person he could trust.

sentences.chinese: 他之前见过这个组织的人，但从未见到过真正的头目。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhīqián jiànguò zhège zǔzhī de rén, dàn cóngwèi jiàndào guò zhēnzhèng de tóumù.
sentences.english: He had seen people from this organization before, but had never seen the actual leader.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，语言在绝对的权力面前没有任何用处。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, yǔyán zài juéduì de quánlì miànqián méiyǒu rènhé yòngchù.
