sentences.english: He realized that language is useless in the face of absolute power.

sentences.chinese: 结果，他被逼到了死胡同，身后传来了沉重的脚步声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiéguǒ, tā bèi bī dào le sǐhútòng, shēnhòu chuánlái le chénzhòng de jiǎobù shēng.
sentences.english: As a result, he was forced into a dead end, and heavy footsteps sounded behind him.

sentences.chinese: 他回头看，那个巨大的影子已经到了他的面前。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huítóu kàn, nàge jùdà de yǐngzi yǐjīng dào le tā de miànqián.
sentences.english: He looked back, and the giant shadow had already arrived in front of him.

sentences.chinese: 影子开口说话了，声音像冰一样冷。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐngzi kāikǒu shuōhuà le, shēngyīn xiàng bīng yīyàng lěng.
sentences.english: The shadow spoke, its voice cold as ice.

sentences.chinese: “你以为你能拿着它离开这里吗？”
sentences.pinyin: "Nǐ yǐwéi nǐ néng názhe tā líkāi zhèlǐ ma?"
sentences.english: "Do you think you can leave here with it?"

sentences.chinese: 林峰紧紧抱着笔记本，眼神变得坚定。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jǐnjǐn bàozhe bǐjìběn, yǎnshén biàn de jiāndìng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng hugged the notebook tightly, his gaze becoming determined.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，最后的战斗就在这一刻开始了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhīdào, zuìhòu de zhàndòu jiù zài zhè yīkè kāishǐ le.
sentences.english: He knew the final battle began at this very moment.

sentences.chinese: 但突然，一个巨大的黑影从他背后猛地抓住了他的脖子。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tūrán, yīgè jùdà de hēiyǐng cóng tā bèihòu měngde zhuāzhù le tā de bózi.
sentences.english: But suddenly, a huge dark shadow grabbed his neck violently from behind.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十六章：最后的自由

sentences.chinese: 林峰感到脖子上的压力很大，他一点也不舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎndào bózi shàng de yālì hěn dà, tā yīdiǎn yě bù shūfu.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt a great pressure on his neck; he was not comfortable at all.

sentences.chinese: 对方的声音在耳边响起，听起来并不热情。
sentences.pinyin: Duìfāng de shēngyīn zài ěrbiān xiǎngqǐ, tīng qǐlái bìng bù rèqíng.
sentences.english: The other person's voice sounded in his ear, and it did not sound enthusiastic.

sentences.chinese: “把笔记本给我，我可以让你平安离开。”
sentences.pinyin: “Bǎ bǐjìběn gěi wǒ, wǒ kěyǐ ràng nǐ píng'ān líkāi.”
sentences.english: "Give me the notebook, and I can let you leave safely."

sentences.chinese: 林峰冷笑一声，他知道这个组织从来没有公平可言。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng lěngxiào yīshēng, tā zhīdào zhège zǔzhī cónglái méiyǒu gōngpíng kěyán.
sentences.english: Lin Feng sneered; he knew this organization never spoke of fairness.

sentences.chinese: 他突然用力转身，用肘部猛击对方的肋骨。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán yònglì zhuǎnshēn, yòng zhǒubù měngjī duìfāng de lèigǔ.
sentences.english: He suddenly turned with force, striking the other's ribs with his elbow.

sentences.chinese: 对方吃痛，抓他的手变得很轻，林峰趁机逃脱了。
sentences.pinyin: Duìfāng chītòng, zhuā tā de shǒu biànde hěn qīng, Lín Fēng chènjī táotuō le.
sentences.english: The opponent felt pain, and the grip on him became light; Lin Feng took the chance to escape.

sentences.chinese: 他跑进一个安静的走廊，这里比外面凉快很多。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pǎo jìn yīgè ānjìng de zǒuláng, zhèlǐ bǐ wàimiàn liángkuai hěn duō.
sentences.english: He ran into a quiet corridor, which was much cooler than outside.

sentences.chinese: 他看向窗外，外面竟然是个晴天，天空非常亮。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànxiàng chuāngwài, wàimiàn jìngrán shì gè qíngtiān, tiānkōng fēicháng liàng.
sentences.english: He looked out the window; it happened to be a sunny day, and the sky was very bright.

sentences.chinese: 这种天气对他逃跑很方便，因为能看清楚所有的路。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèzhǒng tiānqì duì tā táopǎo hěn fāngbiàn, yīnwèi néng kàn qīngchu suǒyǒu de lù.
sentences.english: This kind of weather was convenient for his escape because he could see all the roads clearly.

sentences.chinese: 他打开相机，准确地拍下了走廊尽头的秘密大门。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dǎkāi xiàngjī, zhǔnquè de pāixià le zǒuláng jìntóu de mìmì dàmén.
sentences.english: He opened the camera and accurately photographed the secret door at the end of the corridor.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果能把这些照片发出去，将是一件好事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rúguǒ néng bǎ zhèxiē zhàopiàn fā chūqù, jiāng shì yī jiàn hǎoshì.
sentences.english: He thought that if he could send these photos out, it would be a good thing.

sentences.chinese: 他记得平时队长说话很流利，但现在对方在后面大喊，声音不再清晰。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde píngshí duìzhǎng shuōhuà hěn liúlì, dàn xiànzài duìfāng zài hòumiàn dàhǎn, shēngyīn bù zài qīngxī.
sentences.english: He remembered that the captain usually spoke fluently, but now the other person was shouting behind him, and the voice was no longer clear.

sentences.chinese: 林峰快速跑向出口，他必须找到一个合适的地方躲起来。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kuàisù pǎo xiàng chūkǒu, tā bìxū zhǎodào yīgè héshì de dìfāng duǒ qǐlái.
sentences.english: Lin Feng ran quickly toward the exit; he had to find a suitable place to hide.

sentences.chinese: 他走进一个房间，看到桌上有些食物，但他现在一点也不饱，因为他太紧张了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒujìn yīgè fángjiān, kàndào zhuōshàng yǒu xiē shíwù, dàn tā xiànzài yīdiǎn yě bù bǎo, yīnwèi tā tài jǐnzhāng le.
sentences.english: He walked into a room and saw some food on the table, but he wasn't full at all now because he was too nervous.

sentences.chinese: 他发现房间里有一个漂亮的小盒子，里面放着一把钥匙。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn fángjiān lǐ yǒu yīgè piàoliang de xiǎo hézi, lǐmiàn fàngzhe yī bǎ yàoshi.
sentences.english: He found a pretty small box in the room, with a key inside.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试用钥匙开门，这一次很顺利，门开了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chángshì yòng yàoshi kāimén, zhè yīcì hěn shùnlì, mén kāi le.
sentences.english: He tried to open the door with the key; this time it went smoothly, and the door opened.

sentences.chinese: 他跑到了一个开阔的广场，心中突然感到一种久违的自由。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pǎo dào le yīgè kāikuò de guǎngchǎng, xīnzhōng tūrán gǎndào yī zhǒng jiǔwéi de zìyóu.
sentences.english: He ran to an open square and suddenly felt a long-lost sense of freedom.

sentences.chinese: 他看到远处有警察在走动，他知道自己现在安全了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào yuǎnchù yǒu jǐngchá zài zǒudòng, tā zhīdào zìjǐ xiànzài ānquán le.
sentences.english: He saw police officers moving in the distance and knew he was safe now.

sentences.chinese: 他大声呼喊，警察热情地向他走来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàshēng hūhǎn, jǐngchá rèqíng de xiàng tā zǒu lái.
sentences.english: He shouted loudly, and the police walked toward him enthusiastically.

sentences.chinese: 林峰把笔记本交给警察，详细地描述了所有的事情。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng bǎ bǐjìběn jiāo gěi jǐngchá, xiángxì de miáoshù le suǒyǒu de shìqíng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng handed the notebook to the police and described everything in detail.

sentences.chinese: 警察看着笔记本，满意地点了点头，说他的描述非常正确。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngchá kànzhe bǐjìběn, mǎnyì de diǎn le diǎntóu, shuō tā de miáoshù fēicháng zhèngquè.
sentences.english: The police looked at the notebook, nodded with satisfaction, and said his description was very correct.

sentences.chinese: “你做得不错，”警察对他说，“现在你可以放心了。”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ zuò dé bùcuò,” jǐngchá duì tā shuō, “xiànzài nǐ kěyǐ fàngxīn le.”
sentences.english: "You did not bad," the police told him, "now you can feel relieved."

sentences.chinese: 林峰深深地吸了一口气，感觉身体变得健康了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng shēnshēn de xī le yī kǒuqì, gǎnjué shēntǐ biànde jiànkāng le qǐlái.
sentences.english: Lin Feng took a deep breath and felt his body becoming healthy again.

sentences.chinese: 他感谢警察救了他的命，心中充满了快乐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎnxiè jǐngchá jiù le tā de mìng, xīnzhōng chōngmǎn le kuàilè.
sentences.english: He thanked the police for saving his life, and his heart was full of joy.

sentences.chinese: 他想起之前那些被抓走的人，他们不再能开心地下班回家。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zhīqián nàxiē bèi zhuā zǒu de rén, tāmen bù zài néng kāixīn de xiàbān huíjiā.
sentences.english: He thought of those people who had been taken away before; they could no longer happily go home after work.

sentences.chinese: 他看着警察，问他们是否已经熟知这个组织的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe jǐngchá, wèn tāmen shìfǒu yǐjīng shúzhī zhège zǔzhī de mìmì.
sentences.english: He looked at the police and asked if they were already familiar with the secrets of this organization.

sentences.chinese: 警察回答说，他们已经调查了很久，这次抓捕的时机很称心。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngchá huídá shuō, tāmen yǐjīng diàochá le hěn jiǔ, zhè cì zhuābǔ de shíjī hěn chènxīn.
sentences.english: The police replied that they had been investigating for a long time and that the timing of this arrest was very fitting.

sentences.chinese: 林峰觉得这个过程虽然惊险，但确实很有意思。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng juéde zhège guòchéng suīrán jīngxiǎn, dàn quèshí hěn yǒuyìsi.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt that although the process was thrilling, it was indeed very interesting.

sentences.chinese: 他现在不需要随便地逃跑，也不需要担心被追杀。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiànzài bù xūyào suíbiàn de táopǎo, yě bù xūyào dānxīn bèi zhuīshā.
sentences.english: He no longer needed to run randomly, nor did he need to worry about being hunted.

sentences.chinese: 他走进警车，座椅很舒服，他终于可以安静地休息了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒujìn jǐngchē, zuòyǐ hěn shūfu, tā zhōngyú kěyǐ ānjìng de xiūxi le.
sentences.english: He got into the police car; the seat was comfortable, and he could finally rest in peace.

sentences.chinese: 警察笑着对他说：“欢迎回到正常的生活。”
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngchá xiàozhe duì tā shuō: “Huānyíng huí dào zhèngcháng de shēnghuó.”
sentences.english: The police officer smiled and said to him, "Welcome back to normal life."

sentences.chinese: 林峰看着窗外，阳光照在脸上，感觉世界如此美好。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe chuāngwài, yángguāng zhào zài liǎn shàng, gǎnjué shìjiè rúcǐ měihǎo.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked out the window, the sunlight shining on his face, feeling the world was so beautiful.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，在这个世界上，做一个好人虽然不容易，但最终会有好处。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhīdào, zài zhège shìjiè shàng, zuò yīgè hǎorén suīrán bù róngyì, dàn zuìzhōng huì yǒu hǎochù.
sentences.english: He knew that in this world, being a good person is not easy, but in the end, there are benefits.

sentences.chinese: 他看着那些被逮捕的黑衣人，觉得他们现在的样子一点也不可爱。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe nàxiē bèi dàibǔ de hēiyīrén, juéde tāmen xiànzài de yàngzi yīdiǎn yě bù kě'ài.
sentences.english: He looked at the arrested men in black and felt that they didn't look cute at all now.

sentences.chinese: 他希望所有人都能在平安的环境中生活。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xīwàng suǒyǒu rén dōu néng zài píng'ān de huánjìng zhōng shēnghuó.
sentences.english: He hoped everyone could live in a safe environment.

sentences.chinese: 警察开车带他离开，临走前，同事对他说了句：“一路平安！”
sentences.pinyin: Jǐngchá kāichē dài tā líkāi, línzǒu qián, tóngshì duì tā shuō le jù: “Yī lù píng'ān!”
sentences.english: The police drove him away, and before leaving, a colleague said to him, "Have a pleasant journey!"

sentences.chinese: 林峰微笑着回答：“谢谢，祝你们也一路顺风！”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng wēixiàozhe huídá: “Xièxiè, zhù nǐmen yě yī lù shùn fēng!”
sentences.english: Lin Feng smiled and replied, "Thank you, I wish you a pleasant journey too!"

sentences.chinese: 他看着后视镜，那个黑暗的迷宫终于在他身后消失了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe hòushìjìng, nàgè hēiyàn de mígōng zhōngyú zài tā shēnhòu xiāoshī le.
sentences.english: He looked in the rearview mirror; that dark maze had finally disappeared behind him.

sentences.chinese: 他现在可以自由地选择去哪里，做任何想做的事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiànzài kěyǐ zìyóu de xuǎnzé qù nǎlǐ, zuò rènhé xiǎng zuò de shì.
sentences.english: He could now freely choose where to go and do anything he wanted.

sentences.chinese: 他决定给自己买一件便宜的衣服，然后去睡一个长觉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juédìng gěi zìjǐ mǎi yī jiàn piányi de yīfu, ránhòu qù shuì yīgè cháng jiào.
sentences.english: He decided to buy himself some cheap clothes and then take a long nap.

sentences.chinese: 他终于明白了，真正的自由是建立在勇气之上的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhōngyú míngbái le, zhēnzhèng de zìyóu shì jiànlì zài yǒngqì zhī shàng de.

word_usage.sentence: 他跑进一个安静的走廊，这里比外面凉快很多。
word_usage.context_meaning: The pleasantly cool temperature of the corridor.

word_usage.sentence: 他看着那些被逮捕的黑衣人，觉得他们现在的样子一点也不可爱。
word_usage.context_meaning: Sarcastic use, meaning the villains are not lovely/cute at all now.

word_usage.sentence: 他快速跑向出口，他必须找到一个合适的地方躲起来。
word_usage.context_meaning: Looking for a suitable or appropriate place to hide.

word_usage.sentence: 他想，如果能把这些照片发出去，将是一件好事。
word_usage.context_meaning: A good deed or a positive outcome.

word_usage.sentence: 他知道，在这个世界上，做一个好人虽然不容易，但最终会有好处。
他知道，在这个世界上，做一个好人虽然不容易，但最终会有好处。
word_usage.context_meaning: The benefits or advantages of being good.

word_usage.sentence: 他看到远处有警察在走动，他知道自己现在安全了。
他跑进一个安静的走廊，这里比外面凉快很多。
“把笔记本给我，我可以让你平安离开。”
他记得平时队长说话很流利，但现在对方在后面大喊，声音不再清晰。
他想起之前那些被抓走的人，他们不再能开心地下班回家。
他感谢警察救了他的命，心中充满了快乐。
word_usage.context_meaning: A state of happiness and joy.

word_usage.sentence: 他感谢警察救了他的命，心中充满了快乐。
“你做得不错，”警察对他说，“现在你可以放心了。”
这种天气对他逃跑很方便，因为能看清楚所有的路。
word_usage.context_meaning: Making the escape easier or more convenient.

word_usage.sentence: 他看向窗外，外面竟然是个晴天，天空非常亮。
他看向窗外，外面竟然是个晴天，天空非常亮。
林峰觉得这个过程虽然惊险，但确实很有意思。
警察笑着对他说：“欢迎回到正常的生活。”
警察看着笔记本，满意地点了点头，说他的描述非常正确。
他记得平时队长说话很流利，但现在对方在后面大喊，声音不再清晰。
这种天气对他逃跑很方便，因为能看清楚所有的路。
警察看着笔记本，满意地点了点头，说他的描述非常正确。
word_usage.context_meaning: Being pleased or satisfied with the results.

word_usage.sentence: 他发现房间里有一个漂亮的小盒子，里面放着一把钥匙。
对方的声音在耳边响起，听起来并不热情。
word_usage.context_meaning: Cordial or enthusiastic tone (or lack thereof).

word_usage.sentence: 他看着警察，问他们是否已经熟知这个组织的秘密。
word_usage.context_meaning: Being familiar with the secrets (熟知).

word_usage.sentence: 他打开相机，准确地拍下了走廊尽头的秘密大门。
word_usage.context_meaning: The device used to take photos.

word_usage.sentence: 警察回答说，他们已经调查了很久，这次抓捕的时机很称心。
他跑到了一个开阔的广场，心中突然感到一种久违的自由。
林峰感到脖子上的压力很大，他一点也不舒服。
对方吃痛，抓他的手变得很轻，林峰趁机逃脱了。
他现在不需要随便地逃跑，也不需要担心被追杀。
word_usage.context_meaning: Running randomly or without a plan.

word_usage.sentence: 他尝试用钥匙开门，这一次很顺利，门开了。
他走进一个房间，看到桌上有些食物，但他现在一点也不饱，因为他太紧张了。
word_usage.context_meaning: Feeling full after eating (or lack thereof due to stress).

books.description_chinese: 这是一个关于日常生活的小故事。林晓在晴朗的天气里遇到了奇怪的声音，她会发现什么秘密？快来一起学习简单的中文吧！
books.description_english: A gentle slice-of-life tale about the simple joys and mysteries of daily living. When Lin Xiao hears a strange sound on a bright sunny day, what will she discover? Perfect for HSK 2 learners to practice natural Chinese.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 1: The Beginning of a New Life

sentences.chinese: 今天是一个晴天。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān shì yīgè qíngtiān.
sentences.english: Today is a sunny day.

sentences.chinese: 天上的太阳很大，光线很亮。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānshàng de tàiyáng hěn dà, guāngxiàn hěn liàng.
sentences.english: The sun in the sky is big, and the light is bright.

sentences.chinese: 林晓站在车站，看着自己的行李。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo zhàn zài chēzhàn, kànzhe zìjǐ de xínglǐ.
sentences.english: Lin Xiao stood at the station, looking at her luggage.

sentences.chinese: 她的行李很轻，但她的心情很复杂。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de xínglǐ hěn qīng, dàn tā de xīnqíng hěn fùzá.
sentences.english: Her luggage was light, but her mood was complex.

sentences.chinese: 她刚从一个小城市来到北京。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gāng cóng yīgè xiǎo chéngshì lái dào Běijīng.
sentences.english: She had just come to Beijing from a small city.

sentences.chinese: 这对她来说是一个真正自由的机会。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè duì tā lái shuō shì yīgè zhēnzhèng zìyóu de jīhuì.
sentences.english: For her, this was a truly free opportunity.

sentences.chinese: 她想在这里找到一份合适的工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng zài zhèlǐ zhǎodào yī fèn héshì de gōngzuò.
sentences.english: She wanted to find a suitable job here.

sentences.chinese: 平时，她在家里帮父母照顾农场。
sentences.pinyin: Píngshí, tā zài jiālǐ bāng fùmǔ zhàogù nóngchǎng.
sentences.english: Ordinarily, she helped her parents take care of the farm at home.

sentences.chinese: 平常的生活很普通，但她想要更多。
sentences.pinyin: Píngcháng de shēnghuó hěn pǔtōng, dàn tā xiǎng yào gèng duō.
sentences.english: Ordinary life was common, but she wanted more.

sentences.chinese: 她觉得学习新东西很有意思。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde xuéxí xīn dōngxī hěn yǒuyìsi.
sentences.english: She felt that learning new things was interesting.

sentences.chinese: 她希望自己的中文能说得更流利。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xīwàng zìjǐ de Zhōngwén néng shuō de gèng liúlì.
sentences.english: She hoped her Chinese could be more fluent.

sentences.chinese: 她想清楚地告诉大家她的梦想。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qīngchǔ de gàosù dàjiā tā de mèngxiǎng.
sentences.english: She wanted to clearly tell everyone about her dreams.

sentences.chinese: 她穿了一件漂亮的白衣服，看起来很舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chuānle yī jiàn piàoliang de bái yīfú, kàn qǐlái hěn shūfú.
sentences.english: She wore a beautiful white dress and looked comfortable.

sentences.chinese: 车站里的人很多，但这里很安全。
sentences.pinyin: Chēzhàn lǐ de rén hěnduō, dàn zhèlǐ hěn ānquán.
sentences.english: There were many people in the station, but it was safe here.

sentences.chinese: 她看着周围的人，觉得每个人都平等。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe zhōuwéi de rén, juéde měi gè rén dōu píngděng.
sentences.english: She looked at the people around her and felt that everyone was equal.

sentences.chinese: 在这个大城市里，竞争应该是公平的。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège dà chéngshì lǐ, jìngzhēng yīnggāi shì gōngpíng de.
sentences.english: In this big city, competition should be fair.

sentences.chinese: 只要努力，结果就会是正确的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǔlì, jiéguǒ jiù huì shì zhèngquè de.
sentences.english: As long as one works hard, the result will be correct.

sentences.chinese: 她检查了时间，她的计划很准确。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiǎnchá le shíjiān, tā de jìhuà hěn zhǔnquè.
sentences.english: She checked the time; her plan was accurate.

sentences.chinese: 她直接走向了出租车。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhíjiē zǒuxiàng le chūzūchē.
sentences.english: She walked directly toward the taxi.

sentences.chinese: 司机是一个很可爱的人，说话挺好。
sentences.pinyin: Sījī shì yīgè hěn kě'ài de rén, shuōhuà tǐng hǎo.
sentences.english: The driver was a very lovely person, and his manner was very good.

sentences.chinese: 司机问她：“去哪里？这里坐车很方便。”
sentences.pinyin: Sījī wèn tā: “Qù nǎlǐ? Zhèlǐ zuòchē hěn fāngbiàn.”
sentences.english: The driver asked her, "Where to? Taking a car here is very convenient."

sentences.chinese: 林晓笑着说：“去市中心，谢谢。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Xiǎo xiàozhe shuō: “Qù shì zhōngxīn, xièxiè.”
sentences.english: Lin Xiao smiled and said, "To the city center, thank you."

sentences.chinese: 车窗打开了，风吹进来，感觉很凉快。
sentences.pinyin: Chēchuāng dǎkāi le, fēng chuī jìnlái, gǎnjué hěn liángkuai.
sentences.english: The car window opened, the wind blew in, and it felt pleasantly cool.

sentences.chinese: 她觉得这种生活不错。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde zhè zhǒng shēnghuó bùcuò.
sentences.english: She felt that this kind of life was not bad.

sentences.chinese: 她想，健康的生活比钱更重要。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, jiànkāng de shēnghuó bǐ qián gèng zhòngyào.
sentences.english: She thought that a healthy life is more important than money.

sentences.chinese: 在这个过程中，她希望一切顺利。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège guòchéng zhōng, tā xīwàng yīqiè shùnlì.
sentences.english: In this process, she hoped everything would go smoothly.

sentences.chinese: 她记得离开时，妈妈对她说：“一路平安！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde líkāi shí, māma duì tā shuō: “Yī lù píng'ān!”
sentences.english: She remembered when she left, her mother said to her, "Have a pleasant journey!"

sentences.chinese: 爸爸也对她说：“一路顺风！”
sentences.pinyin: Bàba yě duì tā shuō: “Yī lù shùnfēng!”
sentences.english: Her father also said to her, "Bon voyage!"

sentences.chinese: 她希望家人在家里平安。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xīwàng jiārén zài jiālǐ píng'ān.
sentences.english: She hoped her family was safe and sound at home.

sentences.chinese: 她想，能离开家去闯荡是有好处的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, néng líkāi jiā qù chuǎngdàng shì yǒu hǎochù de.
sentences.english: She thought that being able to leave home to seek her fortune had its benefits.

sentences.chinese: 她现在感觉很快乐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiànzài gǎnjué hěn kuàilè.
sentences.english: She felt very happy now.

sentences.chinese: 她的生活现在回到了正常的状态。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de shēnghuó xiànzài huí dàole zhèngcháng de zhuàngtài.
sentences.english: Her life has now returned to a normal state.

sentences.chinese: 她到了新家，那是一个安静的小房间。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàole xīn jiā, nà shì yīgè ānjìng de xiǎo fángjiān.
sentences.english: She arrived at her new home, which was a quiet little room.

sentences.chinese: 房间虽然便宜，但是很干净。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān suīrán piányí, dànshì hěn gānjìng.
sentences.english: Although the room was cheap, it was very clean.

sentences.chinese: 她坐下来，看着窗外的晴景。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuò xiàlái, kànzhe chuāngwài de qíng jǐng.
sentences.english: She sat down and looked at the clear scenery outside the window.

sentences.chinese: 她想，这就是她想要的自由生活。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, zhè jiùshì tā xiǎng yào de zìyóu shēnghuó.
sentences.english: She thought, this is the free life she wanted.

sentences.chinese: 时间快到了，她准备休息。
sentences.pinyin: Shíjiān kuài dàole, tā zhǔnbèi xiūxí.
sentences.english: It was almost time, and she prepared to rest.

sentences.chinese: 她对自己轻声说了一句：“晚安。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì zìjǐ qīngshēng shuōle yī jù: “Wǎn'ān.”
sentences.english: She whispered to herself, "Good night."

sentences.chinese: 突然，她听到门外有一个奇怪的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, tā tīngdào ménwài yǒu yīgè qíguài de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: Suddenly, she heard a strange sound outside the door.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 2: The Visitor Outside the Door

sentences.chinese: 她听到门外有一个奇怪的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīng dào mén wài yǒu yī gè qí guài de shēng yīn.
sentences.english: She heard a strange sound outside the door.

sentences.chinese: 那个声音很响，像是在敲门。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè shēng yīn hěn xiǎng, xiàng shì zài qiāo mén.
sentences.english: That sound was loud, like someone was knocking.

sentences.chinese: 她以为是风吹的，但声音又出现了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yǐ wéi shì fēng chuī de, dàn shēng yīn yòu chū xiàn le.
sentences.english: She thought it was the wind blowing, but the sound appeared again.

sentences.chinese: 她走过去，小声地问：“谁在外面？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu guò qù, xiǎo shēng de wèn: “Shéi zài wài miàn?”
sentences.english: She walked over and asked in a low voice, "Who is outside?"

sentences.chinese: 门外传来一个大声的喊叫：“喂！有人在吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Mén wài chuán lái yī gè dà shēng de hǎn jiào: “Wéi! Yǒu rén zài ma?”
sentences.english: A loud shout came from outside the door: "Hello! Is anyone there?"

sentences.chinese: 她打开门，看到一个年轻的男人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dǎ kāi mén, kàn dào yī gè nián qīng de nán rén.
sentences.english: She opened the door and saw a young man.

sentences.chinese: 这个男人的名字叫大卫，是一个美国留学生。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè nán rén de míng zì jiào Dà wèi, shì yī gè Měi guó liú xué shēng.
sentences.english: This man's name is David, an American international student.

sentences.chinese: 大卫用不太标准的普通话说话。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi yòng bù tài biāo zhǔn de pǔ tōng huà shuō huà.
sentences.english: David spoke in Mandarin that was not very standard.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“对不起，我想问路，请问社区中心怎么走？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Duì bù qǐ, wǒ xiǎng wèn lù, qǐng wèn shè qū zhōng xīn zěn me zǒu?”
sentences.english: He said, "Sorry, I want to ask for directions, how do I get to the community center?"

sentences.chinese: 她笑了，因为他的读音很有意思。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiào le, yīn wèi tā de dú yīn hěn yǒu yì si.
sentences.english: She smiled because his pronunciation was very interesting.

sentences.chinese: 她觉得这像一个有趣的笑话。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué dé zhè xiàng yī gè yǒu qù de xiào hua.
sentences.english: She felt this was like a funny joke.

sentences.chinese: 她告诉他：“咱们一起走吧，我就在附近。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù tā: “Zán men yī qǐ zǒu ba, wǒ jiù zài fù jìn.”
sentences.english: She told him, "Let's go together, I live nearby."

sentences.chinese: 大卫很高兴，他说：“啊！太谢谢你了！”
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi hěn gāo xìng, tā shuō: “Ā! Tài xiè xiè nǐ le!”
sentences.english: David was very happy and said, "Ah! Thank you so much!"

sentences.chinese: 他们一边走，一边开始对话。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men yī biān zǒu, yī biān kāi shǐ duì huà.
sentences.english: As they walked, they began a conversation.

sentences.chinese: 大卫告诉她，他最近在学习中文。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi gào sù tā, tā zuì jìn zài xué xí Zhōng wén.
sentences.english: David told her that he has been studying Chinese recently.

sentences.chinese: 他说他在课上认真听讲，但还是觉得很难。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō tā zài kè shàng rèn zhēn tīng jiǎng, dàn hái shì jué dé hěn nán.
sentences.english: He said he listens attentively in class, but still finds it very difficult.

sentences.chinese: 他经常在词典和字典之间找词语。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīng cháng zài cí diǎn hé zì diǎn zhī jiān zhǎo cí yǔ.
sentences.english: He often looks for terms between the dictionary and the character dictionary.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“很多生词对我来说太难了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Hěn duō shēng cí duì wǒ lái shuō tài nán le.”
sentences.english: He said, "Many new words are too difficult for me."

sentences.chinese: 她耐心地给他讲这些词的意思。
sentences.pinyin: Tā nài xīn de gěi tā jiǎng zhè xiē cí de yì si.
sentences.english: She patiently explained the meanings of these words to him.

sentences.chinese: 她认为学习语言的重点是多练习。
sentences.pinyin: Tā rèn wéi xué xí yǔ yán de zhòng diǎn shì duō liàn xí.
sentences.english: She believed the key point of learning a language is to practice more.

sentences.chinese: 大卫分享了他的想法，他说他想在当地交朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi fēn xiǎng le tā de xiǎng fǎ, tā shuō tā xiǎng zài dāng dì jiāo péng you.
sentences.english: David shared his thoughts; he said he wanted to make friends locally.

sentences.chinese: 他听说这个社区的人都很友好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīng shuō zhè gè shè qū de rén dōu hěn yǒu hǎo.
sentences.english: He had heard that the people in this community are all very friendly.

sentences.chinese: 他们讨论了现在流行什么音乐和电影。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men tǎo lùn le xiàn zài liú xíng shén me yīn yuè hé diàn yǐng.
sentences.english: They discussed what music and movies are popular now.

sentences.chinese: 大卫说，在很多地方，这种交流是很常见的。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi shuō, zài hěn duō dì fāng, zhè zhǒng jiāo liú shì hěn cháng jiàn de.
sentences.english: David said that in many places, this kind of exchange is very common.

sentences.chinese: 到了社区中心，他们看到很多人在讲话。
sentences.pinyin: Dào le shè qū zhōng xīn, tā men kàn dào hěn duō rén zài jiǎng huà.
sentences.english: When they arrived at the community center, they saw many people giving speeches.

sentences.chinese: 大卫想和他们商量怎么参加活动。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi xiǎng hé tā men shāng liang zěn me cān jiā huó dòng.
sentences.english: David wanted to discuss with them how to participate in the activities.

sentences.chinese: 由于时间不早了，她提醒他：“快点儿，活动快开始了。”
sentences.pinyin: Yóu yú shí jiān bù zǎo le, tā tí xǐng tā: “Kuài diǎn r, huó dòng kuài kāi shǐ le.”
sentences.english: Since it was getting late, she reminded him, "Hurry up, the activity is about to start."

sentences.chinese: 为了庆祝大卫找到了路，他们去小店买了两杯果汁。
sentences.pinyin: Wèi le qìng zhù Dà wèi zhǎo dào le lù, tā men qù xiǎo diàn mǎi le liǎng bēi guǒ zhī.
sentences.english: To celebrate David finding the way, they went to a small shop and bought two glasses of juice.

sentences.chinese: 大卫举起杯子说：“干杯！”
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi jǔ qǐ bēi zi shuō: “Gān bēi!”
sentences.english: David raised his glass and said, "Cheers!"

sentences.chinese: 回到家后，她觉得今天很有意义。

sentences.chinese: 我刚刚想伸手敲门，大卫突然停了下来。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gānggang xiǎng shēnshǒu qiāomén, Dàwèi tūrán tíngle xiàlái.
sentences.english: I had just recently wanted to reach out and knock on the door when David suddenly stopped.

sentences.chinese: 他低声说：“我有点儿担心，不知道里面的人会怎么看我。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dīshēng shuō: “Wǒ yǒudiǎnr dānxīn, bù zhīdào lǐmiàn de rén huì zěnme kàn wǒ.”
sentences.english: He said in a low voice, "I'm slightly worried; I don't know how the people inside will view me."

sentences.chinese: 我安慰他：“没关系，我们可以试着问问。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ ānwèi tā: “Méiguānxì, wǒmen kěyǐ shìzhe wènwen.”
sentences.english: I comforted him, "It's okay, we can try asking."

sentences.chinese: 大卫想了想，说：“也许我可以先写一张纸条。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎngle xiǎng, shuō: “Yěxǔ wǒ kěyǐ xiān xiě yī zhāng zhǐtiáo.”
sentences.english: David thought for a moment and said, "Perhaps I can write a note first."

sentences.chinese: 他从口袋里拿出一张纸，写了几个字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng kǒudài lǐ ná chū yī zhāng zhǐ, xiěle jǐ gè zì.
sentences.english: He took a piece of paper from his pocket and wrote a few words.

sentences.chinese: 他写道：我想知道这里是否还保留着以前的模样。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiě dào: Wǒ xiǎng zhīdào zhèlǐ shìfǒu hái bǎoliú zhe yǐqián de múyàng.
sentences.english: He wrote: I want to know if this place still retains its former appearance.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，只要是十岁以下的孩子，以前都可以免费进书店。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosu wǒ, zhǐyào shì shí suì yǐxià de háizi, yǐqián dōu kěyǐ miǎnfèi jìn shūdiàn.
sentences.english: He told me that as long as they were children under ten years old, they could enter the bookstore for free in the past.

sentences.chinese: 我看着他，觉得他是一个很温柔的人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe tā, juéde tā shì yī gè hěn wēnróu de rén.
sentences.english: Looking at him, I felt he was a very gentle person.

sentences.chinese: 我们等了多久？大概十分钟吧。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen děngle duōjiǔ? Dàgài shí fēnzhōng ba.
sentences.english: How long did we wait? About ten minutes, probably.

sentences.chinese: 突然，门开了，一个老奶奶走了出来。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, mén kāile, yī gè lǎonǎinai zǒu le chūlái.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the door opened, and an old grandmother walked out.

sentences.chinese: 她看着大卫，眼睛里闪过一点点光芒。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe Dàwèi, yǎnjīng lǐ shǎnguò yī diǎndiǎn guāngmáng.
sentences.english: She looked at David, and a little bit of light flashed in her eyes.

sentences.chinese: 她轻声问：“你是大卫吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā qīngshēng wèn: “Nǐ shì Dàwèi ma?”
sentences.english: She asked softly, "Are you David?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫愣住了，他不知道该怎么回答。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi lèngzhù le, tā bù zhīdào gāi zěnme huídá.
sentences.english: David was stunned; he didn't know how he should answer.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，老奶奶从身后拿出了一个旧笔记本。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, lǎonǎinai cóng shēnhòu ná chūle yī gè jiù bǐjìběn.
sentences.english: Just then, the grandmother took out an old notebook from behind her.

sentences.chinese: 那是大卫小时候丢在书店里的笔记本。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì Dàwèi xiǎoshíhou diū zài shūdiàn lǐ de bǐjìběn.
sentences.english: It was the notebook David had lost in the bookstore during his childhood.

sentences.chinese: 大卫快要哭出来了，他紧紧地抱住了那个笔记本。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kuàiyào kū chūlái le, tā jǐnjǐn de bàozhù le nà gè bǐjìběn.
sentences.english: David was about to cry; he hugged the notebook tightly.

sentences.chinese: 他终于找回了自己丢失的一部分记忆。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhōngyú zhǎohuí le zìjǐ diūshī de yī bùfen jìyì.
sentences.english: He finally recovered a part of his lost memories.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，老奶奶突然指了指笔记本的最后一页。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, lǎonǎinai tūrán zhǐle zhǐ bǐjìběn de zuìhòu yī yè.
sentences.english: But just then, the grandmother suddenly pointed to the last page of the notebook.

sentences.chinese: 她说：“这里有一封信，是你父亲留给你的。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zhèlǐ yǒu yī fēng xìn, shì nǐ fùqīn liú gěi nǐ de.”
sentences.english: She said, "There is a letter here, left for you by your father."

sentences.chinese: 大卫的手开始发抖，他慢慢地打开了那一页。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi de shǒu kāishǐ fādǒu, tā mànmàn de dǎkāile nà yī yè.
sentences.english: David's hands began to shake, and he slowly opened that page.

sentences.chinese: 大卫慢慢地打开了那一页。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi mànman de dǎkāile nà yī yè.
sentences.english: David slowly opened that page.

sentences.chinese: 信纸已经很旧了，但上面的字很清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Xìnzhǐ yǐjīng hěn jiùle, dàn shàngmiàn de zì hěn qīngchǔ.
sentences.english: The letter paper was already very old, but the words on it were clear.

sentences.chinese: 他的父亲在信里写道：“亲爱的儿子，当你看到这封信时，你可能已经长成了一个个子很高的青年。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā de fùqīn zài xìn lǐ xiě dào: “Qīn'ài de érzi, dāng nǐ kàndào zhè fēng xìn shí, nǐ kěnéng yǐjīng zhǎng chéngle yīgè gèzi hěn gāo de qīngnián.”
sentences.english: His father wrote in the letter: "Dear son, when you see this letter, you may have already grown into a young man with a tall stature."

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着镜子里的自己，轻轻摸了摸头。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe jìngzi lǐ de zìjǐ, qīngqīng mōle mō tóu.
sentences.english: David looked at himself in the mirror and gently touched his head.

sentences.chinese: 信中提到，他的父亲曾经在南方的海边城市生活过。
sentences.pinyin: Xìn zhōng tídào, tā de fùqīn céngjīng zài nánfāng de hǎibiān chéngshì shēnghuóguò.
sentences.english: The letter mentioned that his father once lived in a coastal city in the South.

sentences.chinese: 那里有蓝蓝的大海，每天都有温暖的太阳。
sentences.pinyin: Nàlǐ yǒu lán lán de dàhǎi, měitiān dōu yǒu wēnnuǎn de tàiyáng.
sentences.english: There was a blue sea there, and a warm sun every day.

sentences.chinese: 父亲在信里写了很多关于那个家庭的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Fùqīn zài xìn lǐ xiěle hěnduō guānyú nàgè jiātíng de gùshì.
sentences.english: His father wrote many stories about that family in the letter.

sentences.chinese: 他说，他最习惯的事情就是每天早起散步。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, tā zuì xíguàn de shìqíng jiùshì měitiān zǎoqǐ sànbù.
sentences.english: He said the thing he was most accustomed to was waking up early for a walk every day.

sentences.chinese: 信中还提到了一件特别的衣服，是一件深蓝色的大衣。
sentences.pinyin: Xìn zhōng hái tídào le yī jiàn tèbié de yīfú, shì yī jiàn shēnlánsè de dàyī.
sentences.english: The letter also mentioned a special piece of clothing, a deep blue overcoat.

sentences.chinese: 大卫记得，他小时候确实有一件这样的大衣，但现在已经不知道大小了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi jìdé, tā xiǎoshíhòu quèshí yǒu yī jiàn zhèyàng de dàyī, dàn xiànzài yǐjīng bù zhīdào dàxiǎo le.
sentences.english: David remembered that he indeed had such an overcoat when he was a child, but now he didn't know the size.

sentences.chinese: 信里还有一张小小的图片，是一个社区中心的照片。
sentences.pinyin: Xìn lǐ hái yǒu yī zhāng xiǎoxiǎo de túpiàn, shì yīgè shèqū zhōngxīn de zhàopiàn.
sentences.english: There was also a small picture in the letter, a photograph of a community center.

sentences.chinese: 这个中心的名称叫“希望之家”。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège zhōngxīn de míngchēng jiào “Xīwàng zhī Jiā”.
sentences.english: The name of this center was called "House of Hope".

sentences.chinese: 父亲写道：“这里是我生命中最重要的中心，它改变了我。”
sentences.pinyin: Fùqīn xiě dào: “Zhèlǐ shì wǒ shēngmìng zhōng zuì zhòngyào de zhōngxīn, tā gǎibiànle wǒ.”
sentences.english: His father wrote: "This is the center of my life, it changed me."

sentences.chinese: 信中还提到，父亲曾经在那里的体育馆教少年们打球。
sentences.pinyin: Xìn zhōng hái tídào, fùqīn céngjīng zài nàlǐ de tǐyùguǎn jiào shàonián men dǎqiú.
sentences.english: The letter also mentioned that his father once taught youngsters how to play ball in the sports hall there.

sentences.chinese: 他给大卫举了一个例子，说学习体育就像学习生活，需要耐心。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gěi Dàwèi jǔle yīgè lìzi, shuō xuéxí tǐyù jiù xiàng xuéxí shēnghuó, xūyào nàixīn.
sentences.english: He gave David an example, saying that learning sports is like learning about life; it requires patience.

sentences.chinese: 大卫读到这里，嘴唇在微微发抖。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi dú dào zhèlǐ, zuǐchún zài wēiwēi fādǒu.
sentences.english: Reading to this point, David's lips were trembling slightly.

sentences.chinese: 他发现信中提到了一次特殊的周年纪念活动。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn xìn zhōng tídào le yī cì tèshū de zhōunián jìniàn huódòng.
sentences.english: He found that the letter mentioned a special anniversary celebration.

sentences.chinese: 那是他父亲在那个城市工作十周年的纪念日。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì tā fùqīn zài nàgè chéngshì gōngzuò shí zhōunián de jìniàn rì.
sentences.english: It was the anniversary of his father working in that city for ten years.

sentences.chinese: 父亲在信中写道：“实际的生活并不总是简单的，但我们要寻找办法面对困难。”
sentences.pinyin: Fùqīn zài xìn zhōng xiě dào: “Shíjì de shēnghuó bìng bù zǒng shì jiǎndān de, dàn wǒmen yào xúnzhǎo bànfǎ miànduì kùnnán.”
sentences.english: His father wrote in the letter: "Actual life is not always simple, but we must find a way to face difficulties."

sentences.chinese: 大卫想起了自己现在的生活，他总是担心考试的分数，或者在写作业时感到压力。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎngqǐle zìjǐ xiànzài de shēnghuó, tā zǒng shì dānxīn kǎoshì de fēnshù, huòzhě zài xiě zuòyè shí gǎndào yālì.
sentences.english: David thought of his own current life; he was always worried about exam grades or felt pressure while doing homework.

sentences.chinese: 但现在，这些事情在他看来不再那么重要了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiànzài, zhèxiē shìqíng zài tā kàn lái bù zài nàme zhòngyào le.
sentences.english: But now, these matters no longer seemed so important to him.

sentences.chinese: 他突然意识到，父亲留给他的信息不仅仅是关于过去，更是关于未来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán yìshí dào, fùqīn liú gěi tā de xìnxī bùjǐnjǐn shì guānyú guòqù, gèng shì guānyú wèilái.
sentences.english: He suddenly realized that the information his father left him was not just about the past, but more about the future.

sentences.chinese: 信的最后提到了一部旧影片，记录了他在那个市中心的日常生活。
sentences.pinyin: Xìn de zuìhòu tídào le yī bù jiù yǐngpiàn, jìlùle tā zài nàgè shì zhōngxīn de rìcháng shēnghuó.
sentences.english: At the end of the letter, an old film was mentioned, recording his daily life in that city center.

sentences.chinese: 影片就在一个黑色的皮带盒子里，放在公路边的旧仓库里。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐngpiàn jiù zài yīgè hēisè de pídài hézi lǐ, fàng zài gōnglù biān de jiù cāngkù lǐ.
sentences.english: The film was in a black leather belt box, placed in an old warehouse by the highway.

sentences.chinese: 大卫想知道，父亲离开那个地方的原因是什么。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎng zhīdào, fùqīn líkāi nàgè dìfāng de yuányīn shì shénme.
sentences.english: David wanted to know what the reason was for his father leaving that place.

sentences.chinese: 他决定去寻找那个皮带盒子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juédìng qù xúnzhǎo nàgè pídài hézi.
sentences.english: He decided to go look for that belt box.

sentences.chinese: 他想把这些碎片拼凑起来，就像在读一本关于自己生活的小说。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng bǎ zhèxiē suìpiàn pīncòu qǐlái, jiù xiàng zài dú yī běn guānyú zìjǐ shēnghuó de xiǎoshuō.
sentences.english: He wanted to piece these fragments together, just like reading a novel about his own life.

sentences.chinese: 他走出房门，决定先去吃顿中餐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒuchū fángmén, juédìng xiān qù chī dùn zhōngcān.
sentences.english: He walked out the door and decided to have some Chinese food first.

sentences.chinese: 他走进一家小店，点了一份简单的午餐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒujìn yī jiā xiǎo diàn, diǎnle yī fèn jiǎndān de wǔcān.
sentences.english: He walked into a small shop and ordered a simple lunch.

sentences.chinese: 他在笔记本上记录下所有新发现的信息。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài bǐjìběn shàng jìlù xià suǒyǒu xīn fāxiàn de xìnxī.
sentences.english: He recorded all the newly discovered information in his notebook.

sentences.chinese: 就在他准备离开时，一个陌生人走进了店里。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tā zhǔnbèi líkāi shí, yīgè mòshēng rén zǒujìnle diàn lǐ.
sentences.english: Just as he was preparing to leave, a stranger walked into the shop.

sentences.chinese: 那个人的样子，竟然和信中的图片非常像。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè rén de yàngzi, jìngrán hé xìn zhōng de túpiàn fēicháng xiàng.
sentences.english: That person's appearance was actually very similar to the picture in the letter.

sentences.chinese: 大卫坐在快餐店的椅子上，看着那个陌生人。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi zuò zài kuàicān diàn de yǐzi shàng, kànzhe nàge mòshēng rén.
sentences.english: David sat on a chair in the fast food restaurant, looking at the stranger.

sentences.chinese: 他的样子真的和照片里的人一模一样。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yàngzi zhēn de hé zhào piàn lǐ de rén yīmúyīyàng.
sentences.english: His appearance was exactly the same as the person in the photograph.

sentences.chinese: 大卫的心里突然跳得很快，他感到非常紧张。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi de xīnlǐ tūrán tiào de hěn kuài, tā gǎndào fēicháng jǐnzhāng.
sentences.english: David's heart suddenly beat very fast; he felt extremely nervous.

sentences.chinese: 那个陌生人的态度很客气，他微笑着看向大卫。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge mòshēng rén de tàidù hěn kèqì, tā wēixiào zhe kàn xiàng Dàwèi.
sentences.english: The stranger's attitude was very polite, and he looked at David with a smile.

sentences.chinese: 大卫心中在想，这个人是谁，为什么会出现在这里？
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xīnzhōng zài xiǎng, zhège rén shì shuí, wèishéme huì chūxiàn zài zhèlǐ?
sentences.english: In his heart, David was wondering who this person was and why he appeared here.

sentences.chinese: 陌生人坐在大卫对面，点了一份简单的午餐。
sentences.pinyin: Mòshēng rén zuò zài Dàwèi duìmiàn, diǎnle yī fèn jiǎndān de wǔcān.
sentences.english: The stranger sat opposite David and ordered a simple lunch.

sentences.chinese: 大卫注意到，这个人的特点是眼睛很大，看起来很聪明。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi zhùyì dào, zhège rén de tèdiǎn shì yǎnjīng hěn dà, kàn qǐlái hěn cōngmíng.
sentences.english: David noticed that this person's characteristic was having large eyes, looking very intelligent.

sentences.chinese: 陌生人拿出一份报纸，上面有一些奇怪的数字。
sentences.pinyin: Mòshēng rén ná chū yī fèn bàozhǐ, shàngmiàn yǒu yīxiē qíguài de shùzì.
sentences.english: The stranger took out a newspaper, which had some strange numbers on it.

sentences.chinese: 大卫好奇地问：“请问，这些数字是什么意思？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi hàoqí de wèn: “Qǐngwèn, zhèxiē shùzì shì shénme yìsi?”
sentences.english: David asked curiously, "Excuse me, what do these numbers mean?"

sentences.chinese: 陌生人笑了笑，说他正在寻找一个正确的方法来解决一个问题。
sentences.pinyin: Mòshēng rén xiàole xiào, shuō tā zhèngzài xúnzhǎo yīgè zhèngquè de fāngfǎ lái jiějué yīgè wèntí.
sentences.english: The stranger smiled and said he was looking for a correct method to solve a problem.

sentences.chinese: 他说，他在很多方面都需要帮助，尤其是关于这个城市的方向。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, tā zài hěnduō fāngmiàn dōu xūyào bāngzhù, yóuqí shì guānyú zhège chéngshì de fāngxiàng.
sentences.english: He said he needed help in many aspects, especially regarding the direction of this city.

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这是一个好机会，可以问问关于父亲的事情。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéde zhè shì yīgè hǎo jīhuì, kěyǐ wèn wèn guānyú fùqīn de shìqíng.
sentences.english: David felt this was a good opportunity to ask about his father.

sentences.chinese: 但此时，大卫的心情很复杂，他不知道该怎么开口。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn cǐshí, Dàwèi de xīnqíng hěn fùzá, tā bù zhīdào gāi zěnme kāikǒu.
sentences.english: But at this moment, David's mood was complex; he didn't know how to start the conversation.

sentences.chinese: 陌生人看到大卫在笔记本上画儿，赞叹道：“你画得很好。”
sentences.pinyin: Mòshēng rén kàndào Dàwèi zài bǐjìběn shàng huàr, zàntàn dào: “Nǐ huà de hěn hǎo.”
sentences.english: The stranger saw David drawing in his notebook and praised, "You draw very well."

sentences.chinese: 大卫有些害羞，他说他的理想是成为一名艺术家。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi yǒuxiē hàixiū, tā shuō tā de lǐxiǎng shì chéngwéi yī míng yìshùjiā.
sentences.english: David was a bit shy and said his ideal was to become an artist.

sentences.chinese: 陌生人说，他以前经常去海边旅游，那里有很多美丽的景色。
sentences.pinyin: Mòshēng rén shuō, tā yǐqián jīngcháng qù hǎibiān lǚyóu, nàlǐ yǒu hěnduō měilì de jǐngsè.
sentences.english: The stranger said he used to travel to the seaside often, where there were many beautiful scenes.

sentences.chinese: 他记得那些日子里，天空的星星比城市里看到的要亮得多。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde nàxiē rìzi lǐ, tiānkōng de xīngxing bǐ chéngshì lǐ kàndào de yào liàng de duō.
sentences.english: He remembered that during those days, the stars in the sky were much brighter than those seen in the city.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉大卫，他以前曾经是一个著名的明星，但现在他只想安静地生活。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Dàwèi, tā yǐqián céngjīng shì yīgè zhùmíng de míngxīng, dàn xiànzài tā zhǐ xiǎng ānjìng de shēnghuó.
sentences.english: He told David that he used to be a famous star, but now he just wants to live quietly.

sentences.chinese: 陌生人从口袋里拿出一片小金属片，上面刻着一条线。
sentences.pinyin: Mòshēng rén cóng kǒudài lǐ ná chū yī piàn xiǎo jīnshǔ piàn, shàngmiàn kèzhe yī tiáo xiàn.
sentences.english: The stranger took a small piece of metal from his pocket, with a line engraved on it.

sentences.chinese: 他说，这个小东西是他这次旅行的目的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, zhège xiǎo dōngxi shì tā zhè cì lǚxíng de mùdì.
sentences.english: He said this small thing was the purpose of his trip.

sentences.chinese: 大卫问他是否有任何意见，可以让他帮上忙。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi wèn tā shìfǒu yǒu rènhé yìjiàn, kěyǐ ràng tā bāng shàng máng.
sentences.english: David asked if he had any suggestions on how he could be of help.

sentences.chinese: 陌生人说：“如果你不急，我们可以一起去球场走走。”
sentences.pinyin: Mòshēng rén shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ bù jí, wǒmen kěyǐ yīqǐ qù qiúchǎng zǒuzǒu.”
sentences.english: The stranger said, "If you aren't in a hurry, we can take a walk at the sports ground together."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这个提议很有趣，于是他答应了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéde zhège tíyì hěn yǒuqù, yúshì tā dāyìngle.
sentences.english: David found this proposal interesting, so he agreed.

sentences.chinese: 他们走出店门，外面的空气很清新，没有油烟的味道。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒuchū diàn mén, wàimiàn de kōngqì hěn qīngxīn, méiyǒu yóuyān de wèidào.
sentences.english: They walked out of the shop; the air outside was fresh, without the smell of grease.

sentences.chinese: 街道两边的灯亮了起来，照亮了回家的路。
sentences.pinyin: Jiēdào liǎngbiān de dēng liàngle qǐlái, zhào liàngle huí jiā de lù.
sentences.english: The lights on both sides of the street lit up, illuminating the way home.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着对方，觉得这个人的出现改变了他生活的方向。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe duìfāng, juéde zhège rén de chūxiàn gǎibiànle tā shēnghuó de fāngxiàng.
sentences.english: David looked at the other person and felt that this person's appearance had changed the direction of his life.

sentences.chinese: 他们聊了很多，直到准备去吃晚餐的时间到了。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen liáole hěnduō, zhídào zhǔnbèi qù chī wǎncān de shíjiān dàole.
sentences.english: They chatted a lot until it was time to prepare for dinner.

sentences.chinese: 大卫在笔记本上记录下这个人的话，觉得生活充满了惊喜。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi zài bǐjìběn shàng jìlù xià zhège rén de huà, juéde shēnghuó chōngmǎnle jīngxǐ.
sentences.english: David recorded the man's words in his notebook, feeling that life was full of surprises.

sentences.chinese: 但就在他们走向球场的时候，陌生人突然停了下来。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài tāmen zǒuxiàng qiúchǎng de shíhòu, mòshēng rén tūrán tíngle xiàlái.
sentences.english: But just as they were walking toward the sports ground, the stranger suddenly stopped.

sentences.chinese: 他看着远方，脸色变得严肃起来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe yuǎnfāng, liǎnsè biàndé yánsù qǐlái.
sentences.english: He looked into the distance, and his expression became serious.

sentences.chinese: 他轻声说：“看来，有人在跟着我们。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā qīngshēng shuō: “Kànlái, yǒurén zài gēnzhe wǒmen.”
sentences.english: He said softly, "It seems someone is following us."

sentences.chinese: 大卫心中一惊，赶紧回头看向身后。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xīnzhōng yī jīng, gǎnjǐn huítóu kàn xiàng shēnhòu.
sentences.english: David was startled in his heart and quickly looked back behind him.

sentences.chinese: 大卫回头看，但路边没有人。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi huítóu kàn, dàn lùbiān méiyǒu rén.
sentences.english: David looked back, but there was no one by the roadside.

sentences.chinese: 那个陌生人闭上眼，仔细听了一下。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge mòshēng rén bìshàng yǎn, zǐxì tīngle yīxià.
sentences.english: The stranger closed his eyes and listened carefully.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“别担心，这只是我的一个习惯行为。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Bié dānxīn, zhè zhǐshì wǒ de yīgè xíguàn xíngwéi.”
sentences.english: He said, "Don't worry, this is just a habitual behavior of mine."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这个人的观点很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juédé zhège rén de guāndiǎn hěn qíguài.
sentences.english: David felt that this person's viewpoint was very strange.

sentences.chinese: 他们继续走在前往球场的道路上。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen jìxù zǒu zài qiánwǎng qiúchǎng de dàolù shàng.
sentences.english: They continued walking on the road toward the sports field.

sentences.chinese: 空气很新鲜，周围是绿色的草地。
sentences.pinyin: Kōngqì hěn xīnxiān, zhōuwéi shì lǜsè de cǎodì.
sentences.english: The air was fresh, and they were surrounded by green meadows.

sentences.chinese: 大卫注意到，陌生人的脚边放着一辆旧自行车。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi zhùyì dào, mòshēng rén de jiǎobiān fàngzhe yī liàng jiù zìxíngchē.
sentences.english: David noticed an old bicycle placed by the stranger's foot.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“在西方，很多人喜欢骑车去运动。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zài Xīfāng, hěnduō rén xǐhuān qíchē qù yùndòng.”
sentences.english: He said, "In the West, many people like to ride bikes for exercise."

sentences.chinese: 大卫想，从这个角度看，生活确实很简单。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎng, cóng zhège jiǎodù kàn, shēnghuó quèshí hěn jiǎndān.
sentences.english: David thought that from this angle, life was indeed very simple.

sentences.chinese: 陌生人从衣服里头拿出一支笔，在大卫的笔记本上写了什么。
sentences.pinyin: Mòshēng rén cóng yīfú lǐtou ná chū yī zhī bǐ, zài Dàwèi de bǐjìběn shàng xiěle shénme.
sentences.english: The stranger took a pen from inside his clothes and wrote something in David's notebook.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉大卫，他是一名研究科学的老师。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Dàwèi, tā shì yī míng yánjiū kēxué de lǎoshī.
sentences.english: He told David that he was a teacher who studied science.

sentences.chinese: 大卫对科学没有太多看法，但他觉得这个老师很有趣。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi duì kēxué méiyǒu tài duō kànfǎ, dàn tā juédé zhège lǎoshī hěn yǒuqù.
sentences.english: David didn't have much of an opinion on science, but he found this teacher very interesting.

sentences.chinese: 突然，大卫的手机收到了一条短信。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, Dàwèi de shǒujī shōudào le yī tiáo duǎnxìn.
sentences.english: Suddenly, David's phone received a text message.

sentences.chinese: 那是他的朋友发来的，问他节日期间有什么计划。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì tā de péngyǒu fā lái de, wèn tā jiérì qījiān yǒu shénme jìhuà.
sentences.english: It was from his friend, asking what his plans were for the holiday.

sentences.chinese: 大卫没有立刻回答，因为他现在面临一个很大的问题。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi méiyǒu lìkè huídá, yīnwèi tā xiànzài miànlín yīgè hěn dà de wèntí.
sentences.english: David didn't answer immediately because he was now facing a big problem.

sentences.chinese: 这个陌生人到底是谁？
sentences.pinyin: Zhège mòshēng rén dàodǐ shì shuí?
sentences.english: Who exactly was this stranger?

sentences.chinese: 他们走到一个体育院的门口。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒu dào yīgè tǐyù yuàn de ménkǒu.
sentences.english: They walked to the entrance of a sports institute.

sentences.chinese: 这里有一个很大的院子，里面人们正在打网球。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ yǒu yīgè hěn dà de yuànzi, lǐmiàn rénmen zhèngzài dǎ wǎngqiú.
sentences.english: There was a large courtyard here, where people were playing tennis.

sentences.chinese: 网球在网上面跳来跳去，声音很大。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎngqiú zài wǎng shàngmiàn tiào lái tiào qù, shēngyīn hěn dà.
sentences.english: The tennis balls were bouncing up and down on the net, making a loud noise.

sentences.chinese: 陌生人说：“你看，这就是生活的一部分，简单而快乐。”
sentences.pinyin: Mòshēng rén shuō: “Nǐ kàn, zhè jiùshì shēnghuó de yī bùfen, jiǎndān ér kuàilè.”
sentences.english: The stranger said, "See, this is a part of life, simple and happy."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得他说的话很有道理。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juédé tā shuō de huà hěn dàolǐ.
sentences.english: David felt that what he said made sense.

sentences.chinese: 他们走到道边休息，陌生人拿出一瓶酒，分享给大卫。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒu dào dàobiān xiūxí, mòshēng rén ná chū yī píng jiǔ, fēnxiǎng gěi Dàwèi.
sentences.english: They walked to the side of the road to rest, and the stranger took out a bottle of wine to share with David.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着自己的手表，发现时间过得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe zìjǐ de biǎo, fāxiàn shíjiān guò dé hěn kuài.
sentences.english: David looked at his watch and found that time was passing quickly.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“我想看今晚的电视节目，所以得快点回家。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng kàn jīnwǎn de diànshì jiémù, suǒyǐ děi kuài diǎn huí jiā.”
sentences.english: He said, "I want to watch tonight's TV program, so I have to go home soon."

sentences.chinese: 陌生人笑了，从包里拿出一个小礼物送给大卫。
sentences.pinyin: Mòshēng rén xiàole, cóng bāo lǐ ná chū yīgè xiǎo lǐwù sòng gěi Dàwèi.
sentences.english: The stranger smiled and took a small gift from his bag for David.

sentences.chinese: 这是一个精美的小盒子，里面放着一种奇怪的药。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yīgè jīngměi de xiǎo hézi, lǐmiàn fàngzhe yī zhǒng qíguài de yào.
sentences.english: It was an exquisite small box containing a strange medicine.

sentences.chinese: 陌生人说：“如果你觉得累，这个可以帮你。”
sentences.pinyin: Mòshēng rén shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ juédé lèi, zhège kěyǐ bāng nǐ.”
sentences.english: The stranger said, "If you feel tired, this can help you."

sentences.chinese: 大卫接过礼物，心中充满了好奇。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi jiēguò lǐwù, xīnzhōng chōngmǎn le hàoqí.
sentences.english: David took the gift, his heart filled with curiosity.

sentences.chinese: 他想知道这个人的真实身份，以及他为什么跟着自己。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng zhīdào zhège rén de zhēnshí shēnfèn, yǐjí tā wèishéme gēnzhe zìjǐ.
sentences.english: He wanted to know the man's true identity and why he was following him.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，陌生人突然指了指远处的路边。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, mòshēng rén tūrán zhǐle zhǐ yuǎnchù de lùbiān.
sentences.english: Just then, the stranger suddenly pointed to the roadside in the distance.

sentences.chinese: 那里停着一辆黑色的车，车窗缓缓降了下来。
sentences.pinyin: Nàlǐ tíngzhe yī liàng hēisè de chē, chēchuāng huǎnhuǎn jiàngle xiàlái.
sentences.english: A black car was parked there, and the window slowly rolled down.

sentences.chinese: 一个冷漠的声音响起：“把笔记本给我。”
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè lěngmò de shēngyīn xiǎngqǐ: “Bǎ bǐjìběn gěi wǒ.”
sentences.english: A cold voice rang out: "Give me the notebook."

sentences.chinese: 大卫紧紧抱着笔记本，心跳越来越快。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi jǐnjǐn bàozhe bǐjìběn, xīntiào yuè lái yuè kuài.
sentences.english: David held the notebook tightly, his heart beating faster and faster.

sentences.chinese: 面对黑车里那个冷漠的声音，他感到多么害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì hēichē lǐ nàge lěngmò de shēngyīn, tā gǎndào duōme hàipà.
sentences.english: Facing that cold voice in the black car, he felt so afraid.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，笔记本里的大量信息可能非常重要。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, bǐjìběn lǐ de dàliàng xìnxī kěnéng fēicháng zhòngyào.
sentences.english: He realized that the large amount of information in the notebook might be very important.

sentences.chinese: 他没有把笔记本交给对方，而是迅速跑向附近的公交车站。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu bǎ bǐjìběn jiāo gěi duìfāng, érshì xùnsù pǎo xiàng fùjìn de gōngjiāo chēzhàn.
sentences.english: He did not hand the notebook to the other party, but instead ran quickly toward a nearby bus stop.

sentences.chinese: 他跳上了一辆公交车，希望能尽快离开这里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tiào shàngle yì liàng gōngjiāo chē, xīwàng néng jǐnkuài líkāi zhèlǐ.
sentences.english: He jumped onto a public bus, hoping to leave this place as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 车上的乘客不少，大多数人都在安静地休息。
sentences.pinyin: Chē shàng de chéngkè bù shǎo, dà duō shù rén dōu zài ānjìng de xiūxí.
sentences.english: There were quite a lot of passengers on the bus, and the great majority of them were resting quietly.

sentences.chinese: 大部分人闭着眼睛，像是在午睡。
sentences.pinyin: Dà bù fen rén bìzhe yǎnjīng, xiàng shì zài wǔshuì.
sentences.english: Most people had their eyes closed, as if they were taking a nap.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着窗外，发现这座城市的人口非常多。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe chuāngwài, fāxiàn zhè zuò chéngshì de rénkǒu fēicháng duō.
sentences.english: David looked out the window and found that the population of this city was very large.

sentences.chinese: 街道上的人数很多，人群在不停地流动。
sentences.pinyin: Jiēdào shàng de rénshù hěnduō, rénqún zài bùtíng de liúdòng.
sentences.english: The number of people on the streets was high, and the crowds were flowing constantly.

sentences.chinese: 他来到市中心的广场，这里有许多人在散步。
sentences.pinyin: Tā láidào shì zhōngxīn de guǎngchǎng, zhèlǐ yǒu xǔduō rén zài sànbù.
sentences.english: He arrived at the city center plaza, where many people were strolling.

sentences.chinese: 他看到很多老年人在那里聊天，生活看起来很慢。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào hěnduō lǎonián rén zài nàlǐ liáotiān, shēnghuó kàn qǐlái hěn màn.
sentences.english: He saw many elderly people chatting there; life seemed very slow.

sentences.chinese: 多数人都在讨论最近的天气，而只有少部分人在关注周围。
sentences.pinyin: Duōshù rén dōu zài tǎolùn zuìjìn de tiānqì, ér zhǐyǒu shǎo bùfen rén zài guānzhù zhōuwéi.
sentences.english: The majority of people were discussing the recent weather, while only a small part were paying attention to their surroundings.

sentences.chinese: 他想起父亲在信中留给他的话，心中感到一阵温暖。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ fùqīn zài xìn zhōng liú gěi tā de huà, xīnzhōng gǎndào yì zhèn wēnnuǎn.
sentences.english: He thought of the words his father had left for him in the letter, and felt a wave of warmth in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 他走进一家小店，点了一盘热腾腾的饺子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒujìn yì jiā xiǎo diàn, diǎnle yì pán rèténgténg de jiǎozi.
sentences.english: He walked into a small shop and ordered a plate of steaming dumplings.

sentences.chinese: 他一边吃，一边思考为什么有人想要这个笔记本。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìbiān chī, yìbiān sīkǎo wèishéme yǒurén xiǎng yào zhège bǐjìběn.
sentences.english: While eating, he wondered why someone would want this notebook.

sentences.chinese: 他发现笔记本里的秘密大大地改变了他的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn bǐjìběn lǐ de mìmì dàdà de gǎibiànle tā de shēnghuó.
sentences.english: He discovered that the secrets in the notebook had greatly changed his life.

sentences.chinese: 他想，怎么会有这么多人关注一个旧笔记本？
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, zěnme huì yǒu zhème duō rén guānzhù yígè jiù bǐjìběn?
sentences.english: He thought, how could so many people be interested in an old notebook?

sentences.chinese: 他看到好多奇怪的人在广场的角落里观察他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào hǎoduō qíguài de rén zài guǎngchǎng de jiǎoluò lǐ guānchá tā.
sentences.english: He saw quite a lot of strange people observing him from the corners of the plaza.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，他不能一个人面对这些麻烦。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, tā bùnéng yígè rén miànduì zhèxiē máfan.
sentences.english: He realized that he could not face these troubles alone.

sentences.chinese: 大家都在平静地生活，但他的世界却突然变得危险。
sentences.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zài píngjìng de shēnghuó, dàn tā de shìjiè què tūrán biànde wēixiǎn.
sentences.english: Everyone was living peacefully, but his world had suddenly become dangerous.

sentences.chinese: 就在他准备离开店门时，一个熟悉的声音在他耳边响起。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tā zhǔnbèi líkāi diànmén shí, yígè shúxī de shēngyīn zài tā ěrbiān xiǎngqǐ.
sentences.english: Just as he was preparing to leave the shop, a familiar voice sounded in his ear.

chapters.title_chinese: 第九章：意想不到的帮助

sentences.chinese: 那个声音是大卫最好的朋友，林先生。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge shēng yīn shì Dà wèi zuì hǎo de péng yǒu, Lín xiān sheng.
sentences.english: That voice belonged to David's best friend, Mr. Lin.

sentences.chinese: 林先生笑着说：“别担心，我来接你回家。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng xiào zhe shuō: “Bié dān xīn, wǒ lái jiē nǐ huí jiā.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin said with a smile, "Don't worry, I've come to pick you up and take you home."

sentences.chinese: 听到熟悉的声音，大卫终于放心了。
sentences.pinyin: Tīng dào shú xī de shēng yīn, Dà wèi zhōng yú fàng xīn le.
sentences.english: Hearing the familiar voice, David finally felt relieved.

sentences.chinese: 林先生看着广场上那些奇怪的人，低声说：“这些人老是跟着你，太奇怪了。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng kàn zhe guǎng chǎng shàng nà xiē qí guài de rén, dī shēng shuō: “Zhè xiē rén lǎo shi gēn zhe nǐ, tài qí guài le.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin looked at the strange people in the square and whispered, "These people are always following you, it's too strange."

sentences.chinese: 大卫把笔记本紧紧抱在怀里，他现在没有信心面对这些人。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi bǎ bǐ jì běn jǐn jǐn bào zài huái lǐ, tā xiàn zài méi yǒu xìn xīn miàn duì zhè xiē rén.
sentences.english: David hugged the notebook tightly in his arms; he had no confidence to face these people right now.

sentences.chinese: 林先生拍拍他的肩膀，说：“相信我，我会帮你解决这个问题的。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng pāi pā tā de jiān bǎng, shuō: “Xiāng xìn wǒ, wǒ huì bāng nǐ jiě jué zhè ge wèn tí de.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin patted his shoulder and said, "Believe me, I will help you solve this problem."

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着林先生，觉得他是一个真正的好人。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi kàn zhe Lín xiān sheng, jué de tā shì yí gè zhēn zhèng de hǎo rén.
sentences.english: David looked at Mr. Lin and felt that he was a truly good person.

sentences.chinese: 林先生答应帮大卫分析笔记本里的秘密，并带他离开这里。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng dā ying bāng Dà wèi fēn xī bǐ jì běn lǐ de mì mì, bìng dài tā lí kāi zhè lǐ.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin agreed to help David analyze the secrets in the notebook and take him away from here.

sentences.chinese: 他们快速通过了拥挤的人群，走向一个安静的停车场。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men kuài sù tōng guò le yōng jǐ de rén qún, zǒu xiàng yí gè ānjìng de tíng chē chǎng.
sentences.english: They quickly passed through the crowded crowd and walked toward a quiet parking lot.

sentences.chinese: 在停车场里，林先生开着车，把大卫带到了他最喜欢的餐厅。
sentences.pinyin: Zài tíng chē chǎng lǐ, Lín xiān sheng kāi zhe chē, bǎ Dà wèi dài dào le tā zuì xǐ huān de cān tīng.
sentences.english: In the parking lot, Mr. Lin drove and took David to his favorite restaurant.

sentences.chinese: 林先生说：“今天我请客，让你心情开心一点。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng shuō: “Jīn tiān wǒ qǐng kè, ràng nǐ xīn qíng kāi xīn yì diǎn.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin said, "I'm treating today, to make you feel a bit happier."

sentences.chinese: 餐厅里的食物味道非常好，大卫吃得很饱。
sentences.pinyin: Cān tīng lǐ de shí wù wèi dao fēi cháng hǎo, Dà wèi chī de hěn bǎo.
sentences.english: The taste of the food in the restaurant was very good, and David ate until he was full.

sentences.chinese: 两人在餐桌旁聊起了很多往事。
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng rén zài cān zhuō páng liáo qǐ le hěn duō wǎng shì.
sentences.english: The two of them chatted about many things from the past at the dining table.

sentences.chinese: 林先生说，每个人的人生都像一个长故事，有快乐也有危险。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng shuō, měi gè rén de rén shēng dōu xiàng yí gè cháng gù shì, yǒu kuài lè yě yǒu wēi xiǎn.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin said that everyone's life is like a long story, with both happiness and danger.

sentences.chinese: 大卫用相机拍下了餐厅窗外的景色，想记住这个安静的时刻。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi yòng xiàng jī pāi xià le cān tīng chuāng wài de jǐng sè, xiǎng jì zhù zhè ge ānjìng de shí kè.
sentences.english: David used a camera to take a picture of the scenery outside the restaurant window, wanting to remember this quiet moment.

sentences.chinese: 林先生问他：“你对现在的计划满意吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng wèn tā: “Nǐ duì xiàn zài de jì huà mǎn yì ma?”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin asked him, "Are you satisfied with the current plan?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫点点头，觉得能遇到朋友是一件好事。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi diǎn diǎn tóu, jué de néng yù dào péng you shì yí jiàn hǎo shì.
sentences.english: David nodded, feeling that meeting a friend was a good thing.

sentences.chinese: 但就在他们准备离开时，林先生的手机响了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài tā men zhǔn bèi lí kāi shí, Lín xiān sheng de shǒu jī xiǎng le.
sentences.english: But just as they were preparing to leave, Mr. Lin's phone rang.

sentences.chinese: 电话那头的人说，半夜时分，那个黑色车的人又出现了。
sentences.pinyin: Diàn huà nà tóu de rén shuō, bàn yè shí fèn, nà ge hēi sè chē de rén yòu chū xiàn le.
sentences.english: The person on the other end of the phone said that at midnight, the person from the black car had appeared again.

sentences.chinese: 大卫意识到，即使坐公共汽车回家，可能也不安全了。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi yì shí dào, jí shǐ zuò gōng gòng qì chē huí jiā, kě néng yě bù ān quán le.
sentences.english: David realized that even taking the bus home might no longer be safe.

sentences.chinese: 林先生看着大卫，表情很严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng kàn zhe Dà wèi, biǎo qíng hěn yán sù.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin looked at David with a very serious expression.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“现在回家太危险，我们不能坐地铁。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Xiàn zài huí jiā tài wēi xiǎn, wǒ men bù néng zuò dì tiě.”
sentences.english: He said, "It's too dangerous to go home now; we cannot take the subway."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得心里很不安，因为他只带了一个小包。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi jué de xīn lǐ hěn bù ān, yīn wèi tā zhǐ dài le yí gè xiǎo bāo.
sentences.english: David felt uneasy in his heart because he only brought a small bag.

sentences.chinese: 虽然他很害怕，但是他知道必须保护好那个笔记本。
sentences.pinyin: Suī rán tā hěn hài pà, dàn shì tā zhī dào bì xū bǎo hù hǎo nà gè bǐ jì běn.
sentences.english: Although he was very scared, he knew he had to protect that notebook.

sentences.chinese: 林先生说，除了这里以外，他还有一个安全的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng shuō, chú le zhè lǐ yǐ wài, tā hái yǒu yí gè ān quán de dì fang.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin said that apart from here, he had another safe place.

sentences.chinese: 那个地方在城市的另一边，那里有一个很大的公园。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè dì fang zài chéng shì de lìng yì biān, nà lǐ yǒu yí gè hěn dà de gōng yuán.
sentences.english: That place was on the other side of the city, where there is a large park.

sentences.chinese: 不过，现在已经是半夜了，公园里的人很少。
sentences.pinyin: Bù guò, xiàn zài yǐ jīng shì bàn yè le, gōng yuán lǐ de rén hěn shǎo.
sentences.english: However, it was already midnight, and there were very few people in the park.

sentences.chinese: 林先生告诉大卫，那个地方住着他的一个老朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng gào su Dà wèi, nà gè dì fang zhù zhe tā de yí gè lǎo péng you.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin told David that an old friend of his lived there.

sentences.chinese: 这位老朋友来自外地，以前是一个警察。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo péng you lái zì wài dì, yǐ qián shì yí gè jǐng chá.
sentences.english: This old friend was from out of town and used to be a police officer.

sentences.chinese: 林先生说：“只要我们快点走，就能安全到达。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng shuō: “Zhǐ yào wǒ men kuài diǎn zǒu, jiù néng ān quán dào dá.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin said, "As long as we move quickly, we can arrive safely."

sentences.chinese: 大卫想到了其他的方法，但林先生摇了摇头。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi xiǎng dào le qí tā de fāng fǎ, dàn Lín xiān sheng yáo le yáo tóu.
sentences.english: David thought of other methods, but Mr. Lin shook his head.

sentences.chinese: 林先生说，现在只能相信他。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng shuō, xiàn zài zhǐ néng xiāng xìn tā.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin said they could only trust him now.

sentences.chinese: 他们走出店门，夜晚的空气很冷，而且没有灯光。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zǒu chū diàn mén, yè wǎn de kōng qì hěn lěng, ér qiě méi yǒu dēng guāng.
sentences.english: They walked out of the shop; the night air was cold, and moreover, there were no lights.

sentences.chinese: 大卫发现，夜晚的街道和早晨的样子完全不同。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi fā xiàn, yè wǎn de jiē dào hé zǎo chén de yàng zi wán quán bù tóng.
sentences.english: David discovered that the streets at night were completely different from how they looked in the early morning.

sentences.chinese: 他不但觉得冷，而且觉得周围有人在看他们。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù dàn jué de lěng, ér qiě jué de zhōu wéi yǒu rén zài kàn tā men.
sentences.english: He not only felt cold, but also felt that there were people around watching them.

sentences.chinese: 可是，他不敢回头看，只能快步跟着林先生走。
sentences.pinyin: Kě shì, tā bù gǎn huí tóu kàn, zhǐ néng kuài bù gēn zhe Lín xiān sheng zǒu.
sentences.english: But he didn't dare look back and could only walk quickly following Mr. Lin.

sentences.chinese: 林先生轻声说：“别担心，我会随时保护你。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng qīng shēng shuō: “Bié dān xīn, wǒ huì suí shí bǎo hù nǐ.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin said softly, "Don't worry, I will protect you at any time."

sentences.chinese: 大卫在心里默默记录，把这些奇怪的经历当作笔记写下来。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi zài xīn lǐ mò mò jì lù, bǎ zhè xiē qí guài de jīng lì dàng zuò bǐ jì xiě xià lái.
sentences.english: David recorded silently in his mind, writing these strange experiences as notes.

sentences.chinese: 但就在他们快要到达公园门口时，远处传来了发动机的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài tā men kuài yào dào dá gōng yuán mén kǒu shí, yuǎn chù chuán lái le fā dòng jī de shēng yīn.
sentences.english: But just as they were about to reach the park entrance, the sound of an engine came from the distance.

sentences.chinese: 那辆黑色的车再次出现了，而且这次它开得非常快。
sentences.pinyin: Nà liàng hēi sè de chē zài cì chū xiàn le, ér qiě zhè cì tā kāi de fēi cháng kuài.
sentences.english: That black car appeared again, and this time it was driving very fast.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十一章：深夜的避风港

sentences.chinese: 黑色的车子在他们身后快速地开过来。
sentences.pinyin: Hēisè de chēzi zài tāmen shēnhòu kuàisù de kāi guòlái.
sentences.english: The black car drove quickly up behind them.

sentences.chinese: 林先生拉住大卫，迅速跑向附近的地铁站。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng lā zhù Dàwèi, xùnsù pǎo xiàng fùjìn de dìtiězhàn.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin grabbed David and ran quickly toward a nearby subway station.

sentences.chinese: 虽然现在很晚，但这里还有一些青年在走动。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán xiànzài hěn wǎn, dàn zhèlǐ hái yǒu yīxiē qīngnián zài zǒudòng.
sentences.english: Although it was very late, there were still some young people walking around.

sentences.chinese: 林先生对大卫说：“快，我们要完全离开这里。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng duì Dàwèi shuō: “Kuài, wǒmen yào wánquán líkāi zhèlǐ.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin said to David, "Quick, we need to leave this place completely."

sentences.chinese: 大卫感到全身都在发抖，十分害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi gǎndào quánshēn dōu zài fǎdǒu, shífēn hàipà.
sentences.english: David felt his whole body shaking, feeling utterly terrified.

sentences.chinese: 他们跑进车站，看到一个姓全的人在看晚报。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen pǎo jìn chēzhàn, kàndào yīgè xìng Quán de rén zài kàn wǎnbào.
sentences.english: They ran into the station and saw a man surnamed Quan reading an evening newspaper.

sentences.chinese: 那个全先生看起来很严肃，像是一个老师。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè Quán xiānshēng kàn qǐlái hěn yánsù, xiàng shì yīgè lǎoshī.
sentences.english: That Mr. Quan looked very serious, like a teacher.

sentences.chinese: 林先生认识他，因为全先生在全国很多学校教书。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng rènshi tā, yīnwèi Quán xiānshēng zài quánguó hěnduō xuéxiào jiāoshū.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin knew him because Mr. Quan taught at many schools across the whole nation.

sentences.chinese: 林先生赶紧请全先生帮他们掩护。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng gǎnjǐn qǐng Quán xiānshēng bāng tāmen yǎnhù.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin quickly asked Mr. Quan to help cover for them.

sentences.chinese: 全先生看着大卫，问他的姓名。
sentences.pinyin: Quán xiānshēng kànzhe Dàwèi, wèn tā de xìngmíng.
sentences.english: Mr. Quan looked at David and asked for his full name.

sentences.chinese: 大卫紧张地回答，并把那个重要的笔记本紧紧抱在怀里。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi jǐnzhāng de huídá, bìng bǎ nàgè zhòngyào de bǐjìběn jǐnjǐn bào zài huái lǐ.
sentences.english: David answered nervously, holding that important notebook tightly in his arms.

sentences.chinese: 全先生说：“没关系，我全家都住在附近，你们可以去我那里。”
sentences.pinyin: Quán xiānshēng shuō: “Méiguānxì, wǒ quánjiā dōu zhù zài fùjìn, nǐmen kěyǐ qù wǒ nàlǐ.”
sentences.english: Mr. Quan said, "It's okay, my whole family lives nearby; you can come to my place."

sentences.chinese: 大卫想，这个陌生人的帮助对他的一生来说可能很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎng, zhège mòshēngrén de bāngzhù duì tā de yīshēng lái shuō kěnéng hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.english: David thought that this stranger's help might be very important for his entire life.

sentences.chinese: 全先生告诉他们，他的朋友周老师也住在同一栋楼。
sentences.pinyin: Quán xiānshēng gàosù tāmen, tā de péngyǒu Zhōu lǎoshī yě zhù zài tóng yī dòng lóu.
sentences.english: Mr. Quan told them that his friend, Teacher Zhou, also lived in the same building.

sentences.chinese: 周老师是一个满族人，性格非常温和。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōu lǎoshī shì yīgè Mǎn zú rén, xìnggé fēicháng wēnhé.
sentences.english: Teacher Zhou was a Manchu person with a very gentle personality.

sentences.chinese: 此时，全体乘客都在等待最后一班车。
sentences.pinyin: Cǐshí, quántǐ chéngkè dōu zài děngdài zuìhòu yī bān chē.
sentences.english: At this moment, all the passengers were waiting for the last train.

sentences.chinese: 全先生说：“现在不能坐出租车，因为外面不安全。”
sentences.pinyin: Quán xiānshēng shuō: “Xiànzài bùnéng zuò chūzūchē, yīnwèi wàimiàn bù ānquán.”
sentences.english: Mr. Quan said, "We can't take a taxi now because it's unsafe outside."

sentences.chinese: 他检查了一下时间，发现这个月全年最冷的夜晚到了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiǎnchá le yīxià shíjiān, fāxiàn zhège yuè quánnián zuì lěng de yèwǎn dào le.
sentences.english: He checked the time and found that the coldest night of the whole year had arrived.

sentences.chinese: 他问大卫：“你以前是考生吗？你的样子很像学生。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn Dàwèi: “Nǐ yǐqián shì kǎoshēng ma? Nǐ de yàngzi hěn xiàng xuéshēng.”
sentences.english: He asked David, "Were you an exam candidate before? You look very much like a student."

sentences.chinese: 大卫点点头，心中想，这些全部的麻烦到底是怎么回事。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi diǎndiǎn tóu, xīnzhōng xiǎng, zhèxiē quánbù de máfan dàodǐ shì zěnme huí shì.
sentences.english: David nodded, wondering in his heart what all these troubles were actually about.

sentences.chinese: 他们一共三个人，悄悄地走出了地铁站的后门。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen yīgòng sān gè rén, qiāoqiāo de zǒu chū le dìtiězhàn de hòumén.
sentences.english: Altogether, the three of them quietly walked out of the subway station's back door.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，一个冷漠的声音在他们身后响起。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhèshí, yīgè lěngmò de shēngyīn zài tāmen shēnhòu xiǎngqǐ.
sentences.english: But just then, a cold voice sounded behind them.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十二章：寒夜里的追逐
chapters.title_english: Chapter 12: Pursuit in the Cold Night

sentences.chinese: 那个冷漠的声音在他们身后响起，让他们的心跳加快。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè lěng mò de shēng yīn zài tā men shēn hòu xiǎng qǐ, ràng tā men de xīn tiào jiā kuài.
sentences.english: That cold voice sounded behind them, making their hearts beat faster.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个穿着黑色外套的人从阴影中走了出来。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yī gè chuān zhe hēi sè wài tào de rén cóng yīn yǐng zhōng zǒu le chū lái.
sentences.english: At this time, a person wearing a black coat stepped out from the shadows.

sentences.chinese: 大卫忽然感到很害怕，因为他记得那个声音。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi hū rán gǎn dào hěn hài pà, yīn wèi tā jì dé nà gè shēng yīn.
sentences.english: David suddenly felt very scared because he remembered that voice.

sentences.chinese: 那个人看着大卫，冷冷地说：“笔记本一定在你手里。”
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén kàn zhe Dà wèi, lěng lěng de shuō: “Nǐ běn jì běn yī dìng zài nǐ shǒu lǐ.”
sentences.english: The person looked at David and said coldly, "The notebook must be in your hands."

sentences.chinese: 林先生挡在大卫前面，问他：“你为什么一直跟着我们？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng dǎng zài Dà wèi qián miàn, wèn tā: “Nǐ wèi shén me yī zhí gēn zhe wǒ men?”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin stood in front of David and asked him, "Why have you been following us?"

sentences.chinese: 对方没有回答，只是看着他们，眼神里没有感情。
sentences.pinyin: Duì fāng méi yǒu huí dá, zhǐ shì kàn zhe tā men, yǎn shén lǐ méi yǒu gǎn qíng.
sentences.english: The other party did not answer, only looked at them, with no emotion in their eyes.

sentences.chinese: 大卫想起以前在父亲的信中看到的描述，那个人正是信中提到的危险人物。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi xiǎng qǐ yǐ qián zài fù qīn de xìn zhōng kàn dào de miáo shù, nà gè rén zhèng shì xìn zhōng tí dào de wēi xiǎn rén wù.
sentences.english: David recalled the descriptions he had seen in his father's letter before; that person was precisely the dangerous figure mentioned in the letter.

sentences.chinese: 在过去的时间里，大卫一直以为这只是一个简单的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Zài guò qù de shí jiān lǐ, Dà wèi yī zhí yǐ wéi zhè zhǐ shì yī gè jiǎn dān de gù shì.
sentences.english: In the past, David had always thought this was just a simple story.

sentences.chinese: 但这时候，他意识到现实比故事更可怕。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zhè shí hou, tā yì shí dào xiàn shí bǐ gù shì gèng kě pà.
sentences.english: But at this moment, he realized that reality was scarier than a story.

sentences.chinese: 对方说：“今后，你们最好不要再试图寻找真相。”
sentences.pinyin: Duì fāng shuō: “Jīn hòu, nǐ men zuì hǎo bù yào zài shì tú xún zhǎo zhēn xiàng.”
sentences.english: The other party said, "Henceforth, you had better not try to find the truth again."

sentences.chinese: 林先生轻声对大卫说：“如果对方攻击我们的话，你就快跑。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng qīng shēng duì Dà wèi shuō: “Rú guǒ duì fāng gōng jī wǒ men de huà, nǐ jiù kuài pǎo.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin whispered to David, "If the other party attacks us, you run quickly."

sentences.chinese: 大卫点点头，虽然他实在不想离开林先生。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi diǎn diǎn tóu, suī rán tā shí zài bù xiǎng lí kāi Lín xiān sheng.
sentences.english: David nodded, although he really did not want to leave Mr. Lin.

sentences.chinese: 因为此时是夜里，街道上没有一个人，四周非常安静。
sentences.pinyin: Yīn wèi cǐ shí shì yè li, jiē dào shàng méi yǒu yī gè rén, sì zhōu fēi cháng ā jìng.
sentences.english: Because it was nighttime, there was not a single person on the street, and the surroundings were very quiet.

sentences.chinese: 对方突然向前走了一步，动作很快。
sentences.pinyin: Duì fāng tū rán xiàng qián zǒu le yī bù, dòng zuò hěn kuài.
sentences.english: The other party suddenly took a step forward, the movement was very fast.

sentences.chinese: 大卫心想，如果这样继续下去，他们一定会被抓住的。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi xīn xiǎng, rú guǒ zhè yàng jì xù xià qù, tā men yī dìng huì bèi zhuā zhù de.
sentences.english: David thought to himself, if it continued this way, they would certainly be caught.

sentences.chinese: 当时，林先生迅速拉住大卫的手，带着他向旁边的小巷跑去。
sentences.pinyin: Dāng shí, Lín xiān sheng xùn sù lā zhù Dà wèi de shǒu, dài zhe tā xiàng páng biān de xiǎo xiàng pǎo qù.
sentences.english: At that time, Mr. Lin quickly grabbed David's hand and led him to run toward a side alley.

sentences.chinese: 那个人又追了上来，脚步声在墙壁间回荡。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén yòu zhuī le shàng lái, jiǎo bù shēng zài qiáng bì jiān huí dàng.
sentences.english: That person chased after them again, the sound of footsteps echoing between the walls.

sentences.chinese: 大卫在奔跑中想起，那时他还是一个学生，生活很简单。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi zài bēn pǎo zhōng xiǎng qǐ, nà shí tā hái shì yī gè xué sheng, shēng huó hěn jiǎn dān.
sentences.english: While running, David remembered that at that time he was still a student, and life was very simple.

sentences.chinese: 那时候，他每天只需要考虑考试，而不是怎么逃跑。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shí hou, tā měi tiān zhǐ xū yào kǎo lǜ kǎo shì, ér bù shì zěn me táo pǎo.
sentences.english: At that time, he only needed to think about exams every day, not how to escape.

sentences.chinese: 那会儿，他最担心的就是成绩单上的分数。
sentences.pinyin: Nà huì r, tā zuì dān xīn de jiù shì chéng jì dān shàng de fēn shù.
sentences.english: Back then, what he worried about most were the scores on his report card.

sentences.chinese: 现在，他的生活发生了巨大的改变。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài, tā de shēng huó fā shēng le jù dà de gǎi biàn.
sentences.english: Now, his life has undergone a huge change.

sentences.chinese: 林先生带着他们穿过几个相同的转角，试图甩掉对方。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng dài zhe tā men chuān guò jǐ gè xiāng tóng de zhuǎn jiǎo, shì tú shuǎi diào duì fāng.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin led them through several identical corners, trying to shake off the other party.

sentences.chinese: 他们跑过了一些小店，比如一家关闭的药店，还有一家书店。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men pǎo guò le yī xiē xiǎo diàn, bǐ rú yī jiā guān bì de yào diàn, hái yǒu yī jiā shū diàn.
sentences.english: They ran past some small shops, for example, a closed pharmacy and a bookstore.

sentences.chinese: 比如说，书店的窗户上贴着很多旧海报。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐ rú shuō, shū diàn de chuāng hù shàng tiē zhe hěn duō jiù hǎi bào.
sentences.english: For instance, there were many old posters pasted on the bookstore window.

sentences.chinese: 其中一些海报已经破了，在风中飘动。
sentences.pinyin: Qí zhōng yī xiē hǎi bào yǐ jīng pò le, zài fēng zhōng piāo dòng.
sentences.english: Among them, some posters were already torn, fluttering in the wind.

sentences.chinese: 林先生在心中计划，然后他们需要找到一个安全的地方重新休息。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng zài xīn zhōng jì huà, rán hòu tā men xū yào zhǎo dào yī gè ā n quán de dì fāng chóng xīn xiū xi.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin planned in his mind that afterward, they needed to find a safe place to rest once more.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，对方可能是故意在引导他们走向死胡同。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhī dào, duì fāng kě néng shì gù yì zài yǐn dǎo tā men zǒu xiàng sǐ hú tòng.
sentences.english: He knew the other party might be deliberately leading them toward a dead end.

sentences.chinese: 所以，他不能走直线，而要走一些复杂的路。
sentences.pinyin: Suǒ yǐ, tā bù néng zǒu zhí xiàn, ér yào zǒu yī xiē fù zá de lù.
sentences.english: Therefore, he could not walk in a straight line but had to take some complex routes.

sentences.chinese: 这种策略在以前的训练中被提到过，例如在城市中隐藏自己的行踪。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng cè lüè zài yǐ qián de xùn liàn zhōng bèi tí dào guò, lì rú zài chéng shì zhōng yǐn cáng zì jǐ de xíng zōng.
sentences.english: This kind of strategy had been mentioned in previous training, such as hiding one's tracks in the city.

sentences.chinese: 后来，他们终于跑进了一个狭窄的社区中心。
sentences.pinyin: Hòu lái, tā men zhōng yú pǎo jìn le yī gè xiá zhǎi de shè qū zhōng xīn.
sentences.english: Later, they finally ran into a narrow community center.

sentences.chinese: 这里有许多老房子，很多房子的样子都那样，灰色的墙壁，红色的屋顶。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ yǒu xǔ duō lǎo fáng zi, hěn duō fáng zi de yàng zi dōu nà yàng, huī sè de qiáng bì, hóng sè de wū dǐng.
sentences.english: There were many old houses here, and many of the houses looked like that, with gray walls and red roofs.

sentences.chinese: 大卫发现，这里的建筑风格和父亲信中描述的完全相同。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi fā xiàn, zhè lǐ de jiàn zhù fēng gé hé fù qīn xìn zhōng miáo shù de wán quán xiāng tóng.
sentences.english: David discovered that the architectural style here was completely identical to the description in his father's letter.

sentences.chinese: 原来，这个地方就是父亲曾经生活过的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Yuán lái, zhè gè dì fāng jiù shì fù qīn céng jīng shēng huó guò de dì fāng.
sentences.english: It turned out that this place was where his father had once lived.

sentences.chinese: 当时，大卫心中一惊，意识到他们已经回到了原点。
sentences.pinyin: Dāng shí, Dà wèi xīn zhōng yī jīng, yì shí dào tā men yǐ jīng huí dào le yuán diǎn.
sentences.english: At that time, David was startled, realizing they had already returned to the starting point.

sentences.chinese: 在那时，他感觉到一种奇怪的亲切感，同时又感到巨大的压力。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nà shí, tā gǎn jué dào yī zhǒng qí guài de qīn qiè gǎn, tóng shí yòu gǎn dào jù dà de yā lì.
