sentences.english: At that time, he felt a strange sense of familiarity, and at the same time, felt immense pressure.

sentences.chinese: 对方在门外停了下来，没有立刻进来。
sentences.pinyin: Duì fāng zài mén wài tíng le xià lái, méi yǒu lì kè jìn lái.
sentences.english: The other party stopped outside the door and did not come in immediately.

sentences.chinese: 林先生低声说：“对方已经发现了我们，但这里有很多房间，我们可以躲起来。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng dī shēng shuō: “Duì fāng yǐ jīng fā xiàn le wǒ men, dàn zhè lǐ yǒu hěn duō fáng jiān, wǒ men kě yǐ duǒ qǐ lái.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin whispered, "The other party has already discovered us, but there are many rooms here, we can hide."

sentences.chinese: 他告诉大卫，只要待在两层楼以上的地方，就比较安全。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su Dà wèi, zhǐ yào dāi zài liǎng céng lóu yǐ shàng de dì fāng, jiù bǐ jiào ā n quán.
sentences.english: He told David that as long as they stayed in a place on the second floor or higher, it would be safer.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着林先生，觉得他像一个真正的保护者。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi kàn zhe Lín xiān sheng, jué de tā xiàng yī gè zhēn zhèng de bǎo hù zhě.
sentences.english: David looked at Mr. Lin and felt he was like a true protector.

sentences.chinese: 那么，接下来的路该怎么走？
sentences.pinyin: Nà me, jiē xià lái de lù gāi zěn me zǒu?
sentences.english: So, how should the road ahead be walked?

sentences.chinese: 就在他们准备往楼上走时，走廊里传来了“当”的一声巨响。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tā men zhǔn bèi wǎng lóu shàng zǒu shí, zǒu láng lǐ chuán lái le “dāng” de yī shēng jù xiǎng.
sentences.english: Just as they were preparing to go upstairs, a loud "dong" sound echoed in the corridor.

sentences.chinese: 那是门被撞开的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì mén bèi zhuàng kāi de shēng yīn.
sentences.english: That was the sound of the door being smashed open.

sentences.chinese: 大卫心跳加速，他知道，真正的挑战才刚刚开始。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi xīn tiào jiā sù, tā zhī dào, zhēn zhèng de tiǎo zhàn cái gāng gāng kāi shǐ.
sentences.english: David's heart raced; he knew the real challenge had just begun.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十三章：旧照片里的线索

sentences.chinese: 门被撞开了，但林先生反应很快，他迅速带着大卫躲进了一个房间。
sentences.pinyin: Mén bèi zhuàng kāi le, dàn Lín xiān sheng fǎn yìng hěn kuài, tā xùn sù dài zhe Dà wèi duǒ jìn le yí gè fáng jiān.
sentences.english: The door was crashed open, but Mr. Lin reacted quickly and swiftly led David to hide in a room.

sentences.chinese: 房间里很安静，窗外是一个阴天，没有太阳。
sentences.pinyin: Fáng jiān lǐ hěn ā jìng, chuāng wài shì yí gè yīn tiān, méi yǒu tài yáng.
sentences.english: The room was very quiet, and outside the window it was a cloudy day with no sun.

sentences.chinese: 大卫的心还在跳，他看着桌子上的一份旧日报。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi de xīn hái zài tiào, tā kàn zhe zhuō zi shàng de yí fèn jiù rì bào.
sentences.english: David's heart was still pounding as he looked at an old daily newspaper on the table.

sentences.chinese: 林先生轻声说：“别怕，这里暂时安全。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng qīng shēng shuō: “Bié pà, zhè lǐ zàn shí ān quán.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin said softly, "Don't be afraid, it is temporarily safe here."

sentences.chinese: 为了让大卫冷静下来，林先生开始讲他的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Wèi le ràng Dà wèi lěng jìng xià lái, Lín xiān sheng kāi shǐ jiǎng tā de gù shì.
sentences.english: To help David calm down, Mr. Lin began to tell his story.

sentences.chinese: 他说他前年去过很多地方，包括寒冷的北方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō tā qián nián qù guò hěn duō dì fāng, bāo kuò hán lěng de běi fāng.
sentences.english: He said that the year before last he had visited many places, including the cold north.

sentences.chinese: 他曾在东北看过雪，也曾在西北的沙漠里行走。
sentences.pinyin: Tā céng zài dōng běi kàn guò xuě, yě céng zài xī běi de shā mò lǐ xíng zǒu.
sentences.english: He had seen snow in the Northeast and walked through the deserts of the Northwest.

sentences.chinese: 林先生指着一张地图说：“我的朋友住在西南，而我的家人在东南。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng zhǐ zhe yì zhāng dì tú shuō: “Wǒ de péng you zhù zài xī nán, ér wǒ de jiā rén zài dōng nán.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin pointed to a map and said, "My friend lives in the southwest, and my family is in the southeast."

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着地图，想起父亲笔记本里提到的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi kàn zhe dì tú, xiǎng qǐ fù qīn bǐ jì běn lǐ tí dào de dì fāng.
sentences.english: David looked at the map, remembering the places mentioned in his father's notebook.

sentences.chinese: 林先生说：“上周我收到一封信，信里提到一个叫药水的地方。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng shuō: “Shàng zhōu wǒ shōu dào yì fēng xìn, xìn lǐ tí dào yí gè jiào yào shuǐ de dì fāng.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin said, "Last week I received a letter mentioning a place called Yaksu."

sentences.chinese: 大卫惊讶地问：“那是什么地方？”
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi jīng yà de wèn: “Nà shì shén me dì fāng?”
sentences.english: David asked in surprise, "What kind of place is that?"

sentences.chinese: 林先生解释说，那里在边境附近，环境很凉，像春天一样舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng jiě shì shuō, nà lǐ zài biān jìng fù jìn, huán jìng hěn liáng, xiàng chūn tiān yí yàng shū fu.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin explained that it was near the border, and the environment was cool, as comfortable as spring.

sentences.chinese: 他们聊到了很多美好的回忆，比如夏天在海边度假。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men liáo dào le hěn duō měi hǎo de huí yì, bǐ rú xià tiān zài hǎi biān dù jià.
sentences.english: They talked about many beautiful memories, such as vacationing at the seaside in summer.

sentences.chinese: 林先生记得，很多年前的春节，他全家一起过年，非常热闹。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng jì de, hěn duō nián qián de chūn jié, tā quán jiā yì qǐ guò nián, fēi cháng rè nao.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin remembered that many years ago during the Spring Festival, his whole family celebrated the New Year together, and it was very lively.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“那个时候，人们非常友好，大家都互相帮助。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nà gè shí hou, rén men fēi cháng yǒu hǎo, dà jiā dōu hù xiāng bāng zhù.”
sentences.english: He said, "At that time, people were very friendly, and everyone helped each other."

sentences.chinese: 大卫想起了自己的童年，那时候的周末总是充满欢笑。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi xiǎng qǐ le zì jǐ de tóng nián, nà shí hou de zhōu mò zǒng shì chōng mǎn huān xiào.
sentences.english: David thought of his own childhood, when weekends were always full of laughter.

sentences.chinese: 林先生问他：“你下周有假期吗？我们可以一起去找答案。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng wèn tā: “Nǐ xià zhōu yǒu jià qī ma? Wǒ men kě yǐ yì qǐ qù zhǎo dá àn.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin asked him, "Do you have a vacation next week? We can go find the answers together."

sentences.chinese: 大卫点点头，虽然现在很危险，但他觉得有了希望。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi diǎn diǎn tóu, suī rán xiàn zài hěn wēi xiǎn, dàn tā jué de yǒu le xī wàng.
sentences.english: David nodded; although it was dangerous now, he felt there was hope.

sentences.chinese: 为了庆祝这个决定，林先生说：“等我们离开这里，我请你吃西餐。”
sentences.pinyin: Wèi le qìng zhù zhè gè jué dìng, Lín xiān sheng shuō: “Děng wǒ men lí kāi zhè lǐ, wǒ qǐng nǐ chī xī cān.”
sentences.english: To celebrate this decision, Mr. Lin said, "Once we leave here, I'll treat you to Western food."

sentences.chinese: 大卫笑了，但突然，走廊里传来了沉重的脚步声。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi xiào le, dàn tū rán, zǒu láng lǐ chuán lái le chén zhòng de jiǎo bù shēng.
sentences.english: David smiled, but suddenly, heavy footsteps echoed in the hallway.

sentences.chinese: 脚步声停在了房间门口。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǎo bù shēng tíng zài le fáng jiān mén kǒu.
sentences.english: The footsteps stopped right at the door of the room.

sentences.chinese: 脚步声在门外停住了，大卫和林先生紧张地看着门。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǎobùshēng zài mén wài tíngzhù le, Dàwèi hé Lín xiānshēng jǐnzhāng de kànzhe mén.
sentences.english: The footsteps stopped outside the door, and David and Mr. Lin looked at the door nervously.

sentences.chinese: 门开了，进来的是一个中年男人，他看起来像个成功的商人。
sentences.pinyin: Mén kāi le, jìnlái de shì yígè zhōngnián nánrén, tā kàn qǐlái xiàng gè chénggōng de shāngrén.
sentences.english: The door opened, and a middle-aged man walked in; he looked like a successful businessman.

sentences.chinese: 他不是来攻击他们的，而是这个房子的主人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā búshì lái gōngjí tāmen de, érshì zhège fángzi de zhǔrén.
sentences.english: He wasn't there to attack them, but was the owner of the house.

sentences.chinese: 他礼貌地问他们是不是新来的客人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lǐmào de wèn tāmen shì bú shì xīn lái de kèrén.
sentences.english: He politely asked if they were new guests.

sentences.chinese: 林先生快速反应，说他们是来帮他整理办公室的同事。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng kuàisù fǎnyìng, shuō tāmen shì lái bāng tā zhěnglǐ bàngōngshì de tóngshì.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin reacted quickly, saying they were colleagues who had come to help him organize the office.

sentences.chinese: 那个男人点点头，说他的公司最近很忙，主要的工作都在处理一份重要的合同。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge nánrén diǎntóu, shuō tā de gōngsī zuìjìn hěn máng, zhǔyào de gōngzuò dōu zài chǔlǐ yífèn zhòngyào de hétóng.
sentences.english: The man nodded, saying his company had been very busy lately, and the main work was handling an important contract.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉他们，他的单位就在附近的体育馆旁边。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù tāmen, tā de dānwèi jiù zài fùjìn de tǐyùguǎn pángbiān.
sentences.english: He told them his work unit was located right next to the nearby gymnasium.

sentences.chinese: 大卫注意到，这个男人的爱人，也就是他的太太，正在客厅里喝一瓶水。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi zhùyì dào, zhège nánrén de àirén, yě jiùshì tā de tàitai, zhèngzài kètīng lǐ hē yì píng shuǐ.
sentences.english: David noticed that the man's spouse, his wife, was drinking a bottle of water in the living room.

sentences.chinese: 太太看起来很温柔，她问大卫是不是一名留学生。
sentences.pinyin: Tàitai kàn qǐlái hěn wēnróu, tā wèn Dàwèi shì bú shì yì míng liúxuésheng.
sentences.english: The wife seemed very gentle, and she asked David if he was an international student.

sentences.chinese: 大卫紧张地回答说，是的，他今年刚到这个城市，现在是第一学期的学生。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi jǐnzhāng de huídá shuō, shì de, tā jīnnián gāng dào zhège chéngshì, xiànzài shì dì yī xuéqī de xuésheng.
sentences.english: David answered nervously that yes, he had just arrived in this city this year and was a student in the first semester.

sentences.chinese: 太太笑了，问他在学校哪个年级，成绩怎么样。
sentences.pinyin: Tàitai xiào le, wèn tā zài xuéxiào nǎge niánjí, chéngjì zěnmeyàng.
sentences.english: The wife smiled and asked what grade he was in at school and how his grades were.

sentences.chinese: 大卫说他学习还行，但他的班长比他聪明得多，是个真正的才。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi shuō tā xuéxí hái xíng, dàn tā de bānzhǎng bǐ tā cōngmíng dé duō, shì gè zhēnzhèng de cái.
sentences.english: David said his studies were okay, but his class monitor was much smarter than him, a true talent.

sentences.chinese: 为了缓解紧张，林先生开始聊起学校的话题，提到学校的校长最近在关注体育科的发展。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile huǎnjiě jǐnzhāng, Lín xiānshēng kāishǐ liáo qǐ xuéxiào de huàtí, tídào xuéxiào de xiàozhǎng zuìjìn zài guānzhù tǐyù kē de fāzhǎn.
sentences.english: To ease the tension, Mr. Lin began talking about school topics, mentioning that the school principal had recently been focusing on the development of the physical education department.

sentences.chinese: 他说学校的足球球队最近在比赛中拿到了高级别的奖项。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō xuéxiào de qiúduì zuìjìn zài bǐsài zhōng ná dào le gāo jíbié de jiǎngxiàng.
sentences.english: He said the school's sports team had recently won a high-level award in a competition.

sentences.chinese: 这时，门外传来司机的声音，说有一位旅客在门口问路。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, mén wài chuánlái sījī de shēngyīn, shuō yǒu yī wèi lǚkè zài ménkǒu wèn lù.
sentences.english: At that moment, the driver's voice came from outside, saying a traveler was at the door asking for directions.

sentences.chinese: 那个男人走出去看，发现那只是一个迷路的游客。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge nánrén zǒu chūqù kàn, fāxiàn nà zhǐshì yígè mílù de yóukè.
sentences.english: The man went out to look and found it was just a lost tourist.

sentences.chinese: 男人回到房间，告诉他们可以先休息，然后指了指角落里的洗衣机，说衣服可以洗。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén huí dào fángjiān, gàosù tāmen kěyǐ xiān xiūxi, ránhòu zhǐ le zhǐ jiǎoluò lǐ de xǐyījī, shuō yīfu kěyǐ xǐ.
sentences.english: The man returned to the room, told them they could rest first, and pointed to the washing machine in the corner, saying clothes could be washed.

sentences.chinese: 大卫注意到桌子上有一本中医的书，他想起父亲以前也喜欢研究这个。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi zhùyì dào zhuōzi shàng yǒu yì běn zhōngyī de shū, tā xiǎngqǐ fùqīn yǐqián yě xǐhuan yánjiū zhège.
sentences.english: David noticed a book on traditional Chinese medicine on the table and remembered his father used to enjoy studying this.

sentences.chinese: 林先生轻声对大卫说，这里暂时安全，但我们要小心，因为这里的家长们都认识对方。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng qīngshēng duì Dàwèi shuō, zhèlǐ zànshí ānquán, dàn wǒmen yào xiǎoxīn, yīnwèi zhèlǐ de jiāzhǎng men dōu rènshi duìfāng.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin whispered to David that it was temporarily safe here, but they had to be careful because the heads of households here all knew each other.

sentences.chinese: 他们需要在这个地方隐藏一段时间，直到下周假期开始。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xūyào zài zhège dìfāng yǐncáng yí duàn shíjiān, zhídào xiàzhōu jiàqī kāishǐ.
sentences.english: They needed to hide in this place for a while until the holiday started next week.

sentences.chinese: 林先生拿出一张纸，上面写着他们需要准备的东西，包括两斤新鲜的水果。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng ná chū yì zhāng zhǐ, shàngmiàn xiězhe tāmen xūyào zhǔnbèi de dōngxi, bāokuò liǎng jīn xīnxiān de shuǐguǒ.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin took out a piece of paper listing things they needed to prepare, including two catties of fresh fruit.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉大卫，我们要像真正的住客一样生活，不能让别人怀疑。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Dàwèi, wǒmen yào xiàng zhēnzhèng de zhùkè yíyàng shēnghuó, bùnéng ràng biérén huáiyí.
sentences.english: He told David they had to live like real residents so that others wouldn't be suspicious.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着窗外，心想生活怎么突然变得像电影一样复杂。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe chuāngwài, xīnxiǎng shēnghuó zěnme tūrán biàn dé xiàng diànyǐng yíyàng fùzá.
sentences.english: David looked out the window, thinking how life had suddenly become as complex as a movie.

sentences.chinese: 就在他们准备休息时，林先生的手机突然收到了一条消息。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tāmen zhǔnbèi xiūxi shí, Lín xiānshēng de shǒujī tūrán shōudào le yì tiáo xiāoxi.
sentences.english: Just as they were preparing to rest, Mr. Lin's phone suddenly received a message.

sentences.chinese: 消息来自一个不认识的人，说：“我知道你们在那个店里。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiāoxi láizì yígè bù rènshi de rén, shuō: “Wǒ zhīdào nǐmen zài nàge diàn lǐ.”
sentences.english: The message came from someone unknown, saying: "I know you are in that shop."

sentences.chinese: 大卫的心跳再次加快，他看向林先生。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi de xīntiào zàicì jiākuài, tā kàn xiàng Lín xiānshēng.
sentences.english: David's heart raced again, and he looked at Mr. Lin.

sentences.chinese: 林先生的脸色变得苍白，他低声说：“他们找到了我们。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng de liǎnsè biàn dé cāngbái, tā dīshēng shuō: “Tāmen zhǎodào le wǒmen.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin's face turned pale, and he whispered: "They have found us."

sentences.chinese: 林先生看着手机，脸上的表情很严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng kàn zhe shǒu jī, liǎn shàng de biǎo qíng hěn yán sù.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin looked at his phone, the expression on his face very serious.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“我们不能在这里待太久，得快点离开。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ men bù néng zài zhè lǐ dāi tài jiǔ, děi kuài diǎn lí kāi.”
sentences.english: He said, "We cannot stay here too long, we must leave quickly."

sentences.chinese: 他们走出店门，街道上有许多行人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zǒu chū diàn mén, jiē dào shàng yǒu xǔ duō xíng rén.
sentences.english: They walked out of the shop; there were many pedestrians on the street.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看到一个骑自行车的青少年，速度非常快。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi kàn dào yī gè jì zì xíng chē de qīng shào nián, sù dù fēi cháng kuài.
sentences.english: David saw a teenager riding a bicycle, moving very fast.

sentences.chinese: 林先生低声说：“那个人的衣服很脏，但他的动作像个专业的队长。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng dī shēng shuō: “Nà gè rén de yī fú hěn zàng, dàn tā de dòng zuò xiàng gè zhuān yè de duì zhǎng.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin whispered, "That person's clothes are very dirty, but his movements are like a professional captain."

sentences.chinese: 大卫想起他在高中学习的时候，生活很安静。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi xiǎng qǐ tā zài gāo zhōng xué xí de shí hòu, shēng huó hěn ān jìng.
sentences.english: David remembered when he was studying in senior high school, life was very quiet.

sentences.chinese: 现在，他觉得周围的一切都变得很高级，像是一场复杂的电影。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài, tā jué dé zhōu wéi de yī qiè dōu biàn de hěn gāo jí, xiàng shì yī chǎng fù zá de diàn yǐng.
sentences.english: Now, he felt everything around him had become very high-level, like a complex movie.

sentences.chinese: 他们走过一家超市，那里有很多顾客在买东西。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zǒu guò yī jiā chāo shì, nà lǐ yǒu hěn duō gù kè zài mǎi dōng xī.
sentences.english: They walked past a supermarket, where many customers were buying things.

sentences.chinese: 林先生突然停下来，看向对面的一家酒店。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng tū rán tíng xià lái, kàn xiàng duì miàn de yī jiā jiǔ diàn.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin suddenly stopped and looked at a hotel across the street.

sentences.chinese: “那里有一个我的老朋友，他是这家酒店的经理。”
sentences.pinyin: “Nà lǐ yǒu yī gè wǒ de lǎo péng yǒu, tā shì zhè jiā jiǔ diàn de jīng lǐ.”
sentences.english: "There is an old friend of mine there; he is the manager of this hotel."

sentences.chinese: 林先生拿出他的银行卡，准备进去登记。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng ná chū tā de yín háng kǎ, zhǔn bèi jìn qù dēng jì.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin took out his bank card, preparing to go in and register.

sentences.chinese: 大卫注意到，酒店门口有一队穿着制服的人，像是在等待他们的组长。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi zhù yì dào, jiǔ diàn mén kǒu yǒu yī duì chuān zhe zhì fú de rén, xiàng shì zài děng dài tā men de zǔ zhǎng.
sentences.english: David noticed a team of people in uniforms at the hotel entrance, as if they were waiting for their group leader.

sentences.chinese: 林先生带大卫进入酒店，走廊里非常安静。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng dài Dà wèi jìn rù jiǔ diàn, zǒu láng lǐ fēi cháng ān jìng.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin led David into the hotel; the corridor was very quiet.

sentences.chinese: 他们来到一个房间，里面有一台老旧的计算机。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men lái dào yī gè fáng jiān, lǐ miàn yǒu yī tái lǎo jiù de jì suàn jī.
sentences.english: They came to a room which had an old computer inside.

sentences.chinese: 林先生说：“我需要查一些资料，关于那个院长。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng shuō: “Wǒ xū yào chá yī xiē zī liào, guān yú nà gè yuàn zhǎng.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin said, "I need to check some information regarding that president."

sentences.chinese: 大卫感到压力很大，他觉得心口有点不舒服，像是有脏器在疼痛。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi gǎn dào yā lì hěn dà, tā jué dé xīn kǒu yǒu diǎn bù shū fú, xiàng shì yǒu zàng qì zài téng tòng.
sentences.english: David felt great pressure; he felt a bit uncomfortable in his chest, as if an internal organ was aching.

sentences.chinese: 林先生给了他两颗药片，告诉他这是西医常用的药。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng gěi le tā liǎng kē yào piàn, gào sù tā zhè shì xī yī cháng yòng de yào.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin gave him two tablets, telling him this was medicine commonly used in Western medicine.

sentences.chinese: “先休息一下，吃点东西。”林先生指了指桌上的鸡肉面。
sentences.pinyin: “Xiān xiū xī yī xià, chī diǎn dōng xī.” Lín xiān sheng zhǐ le zhǐ zhuō shàng de jī ròu miàn.
sentences.english: "Rest for a bit, eat something." Mr. Lin pointed to the chicken noodles on the table.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着那碗面，但完全没有胃口。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi kàn zhe nà wǎn miàn, dàn wán quán méi yǒu wèi kǒu.
sentences.english: David looked at the bowl of noodles, but had no appetite at all.

sentences.chinese: 这时，计算机屏幕上突然跳出一个红色的警告标志。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, jì suàn jī píng mù shàng tū rán tiào chū yī gè hóng sè de jǐng gào biāo zhì.
sentences.english: At that moment, a red warning sign suddenly jumped up on the computer screen.

sentences.chinese: 林先生的脸色再次变了，他低声说：“他们已经在路上了。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng de liǎn sè zài cì biàn le, tā dī shēng shuō: “Tā men yǐ jīng zài lù shàng le.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin's expression changed again, and he whispered, "They are already on their way."

sentences.chinese: 林先生的声音很急，他立刻让大卫关机。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng de shēng yīn hěn jí, tā lì kè ràng Dà wèi guān jī.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin's voice was urgent; he immediately told David to turn off the computer.

sentences.chinese: 大卫听话地关机，然后快速地放下手中的碗。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi tīng huà de guān jī, rán hòu kuài sù de fàng xià shǒu zhōng de wǎn.
sentences.english: David obeyed and turned it off, then quickly put down the bowl in his hand.

sentences.chinese: “他们快到了，我们必须立刻离开这里。”林先生说。
sentences.pinyin: “Tā men kuài dào le, wǒ men bì xū lì kè lí kāi zhè lǐ.” Lín xiān sheng shuō.
sentences.english: "They are almost here, we must leave this place immediately," Mr. Lin said.

sentences.chinese: 大卫感觉到心跳很快，他觉得身体有点卡，不能马上动起来。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi gǎn jué dào xīn tiào hěn kuài, tā jué de shēn tǐ yǒu diǎn kǎ, bù néng mǎ shàng dòng qǐ lái.
sentences.english: David felt his heart beating fast; he felt his body was a bit stiff (lagging), unable to move immediately.

sentences.chinese: 林先生帮他把外套拉上，告诉他现在不能休息，必须活动一下身体。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng bāng tā bǎ wài tào lā shàng, gào su tā xiàn zài bù néng xiū xi, bì xū huó dòng yī xià shēn tǐ.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin helped him pull up his coat and told him he couldn't rest now and must move his body around.

sentences.chinese: 大卫慢慢爬起来，虽然他之前因为生病住院，但现在必须勇敢。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi màn màn pá qǐ lái, suī rán tā zhī qián yīn wèi shēng bìng zhù yuàn, dàn xiàn zài bì xū yǒng gǎn.
sentences.english: David slowly climbed up; although he had been hospitalized due to illness before, he had to be brave now.

sentences.chinese: 他记得林先生说，出院后需要多运动，比如去爬山，但现在情况太紧急了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì de Lín xiān sheng shuō, chū yuàn hòu xū yào duō yùn dòng, bǐ rú qù pá shān, dàn xiàn zài qíng kuàng tài jǐn jí le.
sentences.english: He remembered Mr. Lin saying that after leaving the hospital, one needs more exercise, such as mountain climbing, but the current situation was too urgent.

sentences.chinese: 林先生快速地在纸上画了一个简单的地图，标记了出口的位置。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng kuài sù de zài zhǐ shàng huà le yī gè jiǎn dān de dì tú, biāo jì le chū kǒu de wèi zhì.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin quickly drew a simple map on a piece of paper, marking the location of the exit.

sentences.chinese: “我们要分开走，这样比较安全。”林先生低声说。
sentences.pinyin: “Wǒ men yào fēn kāi zǒu, zhè yàng bǐ jiào ā n quán.” Lín xiān sheng dī shēng shuō.
sentences.english: "We need to separate and walk, this is safer," Mr. Lin said in a low voice.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着地图，心想如果能出国，也许就能逃离这些麻烦。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi kàn zhe dì tú, xīn xiǎng rú guǒ néng chū guó, yě xǔ jiù néng táo lí zhè xiē má fan.
sentences.english: David looked at the map, thinking that if he could go abroad, perhaps he could escape these troubles.

sentences.chinese: 但现在，他们必须先出门。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiàn zài, tā men bì xū xiān chū mén.
sentences.english: But for now, they had to go out first.

sentences.chinese: 林先生提醒他：“记住，如果看到我举手，你就立刻走开。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng tí xǐng tā: “Jì zhù, rú guǒ kàn dào wǒ jǔ shǒu, nǐ jiù lì kè zǒu kāi.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin reminded him: "Remember, if you see me raise my hand, walk away immediately."

sentences.chinese: 他们悄悄走出房间，靠在走廊的墙边听声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men qiāo qiāo zǒu chū fáng jiān, kào zài zǒu láng de qiáng biān tīng shēng yīn.
sentences.english: They quietly left the room and leaned against the corridor wall to listen for sounds.

sentences.chinese: 外面吹来一阵冷风，大卫打了一个冷战。
sentences.pinyin: Wài miàn chuī lái yī zhèn lěng fēng, Dà wèi dǎ le yī gè lěng zhàn.
sentences.english: A cold wind blew from outside, and David shivered.

sentences.chinese: 林先生说，他以前为了省钱，经常在餐厅打工，所以很熟悉这种后门通道。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng shuō, tā yǐ qián wèi le shěng qián, jīng cháng zài cān tīng dǎ gōng, suǒ yǐ hěn shú xī zhè zhǒng hòu mén tōng dào.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin said that in the past, to save money, he often worked part-time in restaurants, so he was very familiar with this kind of back-door passage.

sentences.chinese: 大卫想起林先生曾经说过，他最喜欢在休假的时候去交朋友，但现在他看起来非常严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi xiǎng qǐ Lín xiān sheng céng jīng shuō guò, tā zuì xǐ huan zài xiū jià de shí hou qù jiāo péng you, dàn xiàn zài tā kàn qǐ lái fēi cháng yán sù.
sentences.english: David recalled Mr. Lin once saying that he loved to make friends during his vacations, but now he looked very serious.

sentences.chinese: 他们走到了地下车库，看到一辆车停在那里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zǒu dào le dì xià chē kù, kàn dào yī liàng chē tíng zài nà lǐ.
sentences.english: They walked to the underground garage and saw a car parked there.

sentences.chinese: 林先生说：“快，我们得赶紧加油，然后马上出发。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng shuō: “Kuài, wǒ men děi gǎn jǐn jiā yóu, rán hòu mǎ shàng chū fā.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin said, "Quick, we must refuel quickly and then set off immediately."

sentences.chinese: 大卫帮林先生开机启动车辆，发动机的声音在安静的车库里很响。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi bāng Lín xiān sheng kāi jī qǐ dòng chē liàng, fā dòng jī de shēng yīn zài ā n jìng de chē kù lǐ hěn xiǎng.
sentences.english: David helped Mr. Lin start the engine; the sound of the engine was loud in the quiet garage.

sentences.chinese: 林先生告诉大卫，如果以后生活平静了，他可以教大卫怎么骑车。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng gào su Dà wèi, rú guǒ yǐ hòu shēng huó píng jìng le, tā kě yǐ jiāo Dà wèi zěn me qí chē.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin told David that if life became peaceful in the future, he could teach David how to ride a bike.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，大卫看到窗外有一只小猫在走，它看起来很自在。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, Dà wèi kàn dào chuāng wài yǒu yī zhī xiǎo māo zài zǒu, tā kàn qǐ lái hěn zì zài.
sentences.english: Just then, David saw a small cat walking outside the window; it looked very relaxed.

sentences.chinese: 大卫突然想起，他必须把父亲留下的那个笔记本留下，不能让它在逃跑时变成负担。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi tū rán xiǎng qǐ, tā bì xū bǎ fù qīn liú xià de nà gè bǐ jì běn liú xià, bù néng ràng tā zài táo pǎo shí chéng wéi fù dān.
sentences.english: David suddenly thought that he must leave behind the notebook his father had left, so it wouldn't become a burden while escaping.

sentences.chinese: 不对，他不能把它留下，他必须把它带走。
sentences.pinyin: Bù duì, tā bù néng bǎ tā liú xià, tā bì xū bǎ tā dài zǒu.
sentences.english: No, he couldn't leave it behind; he had to take it with him.

sentences.chinese: 林先生快速停车，让大卫把笔记本放好。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng kuài sù tíng chē, ràng Dà wèi bǎ bǐ jì běn fàng hǎo.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin quickly stopped the car and let David put the notebook away safely.

sentences.chinese: “我们要快，像飞机起飞一样迅速。”林先生说。
sentences.pinyin: “Wǒ men yào kuài, xiàng fēi jī qǐ fēi yī yàng xùn sù.” Lín xiān sheng shuō.
sentences.english: "We have to be fast, as swift as a plane taking off," Mr. Lin said.

sentences.chinese: 大卫想起自己曾经在一家外卖公司干活儿，那时候他习惯了快节奏的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi xiǎng qǐ zì jǐ céng jīng zài yī jiā wài mài gōng sī gàn huó r, nà shí hou tā xí guàn le kuài jié zòu de shēng huó.
sentences.english: David remembered that he had once worked at a takeout company; at that time, he was used to a fast-paced life.

sentences.chinese: 他换了一件深色的衣服，这样在黑夜里不容易被发现。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huàn le yī jiàn shēn sè de yī fu, zhè yàng zài hēi yè lǐ bù róng yì bèi fā xiàn.
sentences.english: He changed into dark-colored clothes so that he wouldn't be easily spotted in the dark.

sentences.chinese: 林先生看着大卫，轻声说：“别担心，我们会没事的。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng kàn zhe Dà wèi, dī shēng shuō: “Bié dān xīn, wǒ men huì méi shì de.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin looked at David and said softly, "Don't worry, we will be fine."

sentences.chinese: 他们开车离开，在路边看到很多车停在路口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men kāi chē lí kāi, zài lù biān kàn dào hěn duō chē tíng zài lù kǒu.
sentences.english: They drove away and saw many cars parked at the intersection.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着窗外，心中感到一种奇怪的孤独感。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi kàn zhe chuāng wài, xīn zhōng gǎn dào yī zhǒng qí guài de gū dú gǎn.
sentences.english: David looked out the window, feeling a strange sense of loneliness in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 他希望有一天，他不再需要这样逃跑，而是能平静地生活。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xī wàng yǒu yī tiān, tā bù zài xū yào zhè yàng táo pǎo, ér shì néng píng jìng de shēng huó.
sentences.english: He hoped that one day, he would no longer need to escape like this, but could live peacefully.

sentences.chinese: 突然，林先生猛地踩了刹车，车子差点倒在路边。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, Lín xiān sheng měng de cǎi le shā chē, chē zi chà diǎn dǎo zài lù biān.
sentences.english: Suddenly, Mr. Lin slammed on the brakes, and the car almost tipped over by the roadside.

sentences.chinese: 大卫惊叫一声，看向前方。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi jīng jiào yī shēng, kàn xiàng qián fāng.
sentences.english: David cried out in surprise and looked ahead.

sentences.chinese: 在路口，那个黑色的车再次出现了，而且它正对着他们开过来。
sentences.pinyin: Zài lù kǒu, nà gè hēi sè de chē zài cì chū xiàn le, ér qiě tā zhèng duì zhe tā men kāi guò lái.
sentences.english: At the intersection, that black car appeared again, and it was driving straight toward them.

sentences.chinese: 林先生的脸色变得极其难看，他低声说：“他们还是找到了我们。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng de liǎn sè biàn de jí qí nán kàn, tā dī shēng shuō: “Tā men hái shì zhǎo dào le wǒ men.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin's face became extremely grim, and he whispered, "They still found us."

sentences.chinese: 大卫感觉到一种巨大的压力，他不知道这次还能不能逃掉。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi gǎn jué dào yī zhǒng jù dà de yā lì, tā bù zhī dào zhè cì hái néng bù néng táo diào.
sentences.english: David felt a huge amount of pressure; he didn't know if he could escape this time.

sentences.chinese: 林先生猛地打方向盘，车子在路边停了下来。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng měng de dǎ fāng xiàng pán, chē zi zài lù biān tíng le xià lái.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin suddenly turned the steering wheel, and the car stopped by the roadside.

sentences.chinese: 大卫心跳很快，他看着窗外多云的天空。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi xīn tiào hěn kuài, tā kàn zhe chuāng wài duō yún de tiān kōng.
sentences.english: David's heart beat fast as he looked at the cloudy sky outside the window.

sentences.chinese: 虽然现在是冬天，但今天没有下雪。
sentences.pinyin: Suī rán xiàn zài shì dōng tiān, dàn jīn tiān méi yǒu xià xuě.
sentences.english: Although it is winter, it didn't snow today.

sentences.chinese: 林先生说：“我们要快，那个黑色的车就在后面。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng shuō: “Wǒ men yào kuài, nà gè hēi sè de chē jiù zài hòu miàn.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin said, "We have to be quick, that black car is right behind us."

sentences.chinese: 他们迅速跑向附近的一个体育场，那里有很多人们在运动。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men xùn sù pǎo xiàng fù jìn de yí gè tǐ yù chǎng, nà lǐ yǒu hěn duō rén men zài yùn dòng.
sentences.english: They quickly ran toward a nearby stadium, where many people were exercising.

sentences.chinese: 林先生在人群中低声说：“我们需要一个安全的住房来躲避。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng zài rén qún zhōng dī shēng shuō: “Wǒ men xū yào yí gè ān quán de zhù fáng lái duǒ bì.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin whispered in the crowd, "We need a safe housing to hide in."

sentences.chinese: 大卫想起他的父亲曾是一位著名的国际作家。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi xiǎng qǐ tā de fù qīn céng shì yí wèi zhù míng de guó jì zuò jiā.
sentences.english: David remembered that his father was once a famous international author.

sentences.chinese: 他的父亲在书里写过，地球上的每一个角落都有秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de fù qīn zài shū lǐ xiě guò, dì qiú shàng de měi yí gè jiǎo luò dōu yǒu mì mì.
sentences.english: His father wrote in his books that every corner of the earth has secrets.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着林先生，林先生已经进入中年，但他的眼神依然很年轻。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi kàn zhe Lín xiān sheng, Lín xiān sheng yǐ jīng jìn rù zhōng nián, dàn tā de yǎn shén yī rán hěn nián qīng.
sentences.english: David looked at Mr. Lin; Mr. Lin had already entered middle age, but his eyes were still very young.

sentences.chinese: 林先生的头发在风中乱了，他看起来很焦虑。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng de tóu fa zài fēng zhōng luàn le, tā kàn qǐ lái hěn jiāo lǜ.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin's hair was messy in the wind, and he looked very anxious.

sentences.chinese: 他拿出手机，但发现这里没有信号。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū shǒu jī, dàn fā xiàn zhè lǐ méi yǒu xìn hào.
sentences.english: He took out his phone but found there was no signal here.

sentences.chinese: “我的信用卡在车里，我们现在没有钱，”林先生叹了口气。
sentences.pinyin: “Wǒ de xìn yòng kǎ zài chē lǐ, wǒ men xiàn zài méi yǒu qián,” Lín xiān sheng tàn le kǒu qì.
sentences.english: "My credit card is in the car, we have no money now," Mr. Lin sighed.

sentences.chinese: 他们走进体育场的大门，这里像是一个巨大的迷宫。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zǒu jìn tǐ yù chǎng de dà mén, zhè lǐ xiàng shì yí gè jù dà de mí gōng.
sentences.english: They entered the main doors of the stadium, which felt like a giant maze.

sentences.chinese: 他们看到一个小组正在讨论事情，领头的是一个中级管理人员。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men kàn dào yí gè xiǎo zǔ zhèng zài tǎo lùn shì qíng, lǐng tóu de shì yí gè zhōng jí guǎn lǐ rén yuán.
sentences.english: They saw a group discussing something, led by a middle-level manager.

sentences.chinese: 大卫注意到那个人的样子像是一个市长，看起来很有权力。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi zhù yì dào nà gè rén de yàng zi xiàng shì yí gè shì zhǎng, kàn qǐ lái hěn yǒu quán lì.
sentences.english: David noticed the man looked like a mayor and seemed very powerful.

sentences.chinese: 林先生低声说：“我们不能让那些人发现我们。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng dī shēng shuō: “Wǒ men bù néng ràng nà xiē rén fā xiàn wǒ men.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin whispered, "We cannot let those people find us."

sentences.chinese: 他们走在走廊里，大卫想起小时候在中小学学习的日子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zǒu zài zǒu láng lǐ, Dà wèi xiǎng qǐ xiǎo shí hou zài zhōng xiǎo xué xué xí de rì zi.
sentences.english: Walking in the corridor, David thought back to his days studying in middle and elementary school.

sentences.chinese: 那时候的生活很简单，每天只要学习简单的句子。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shí hou de shēng huó hěn jiǎn dān, měi tiān zhǐ yào xué xí jiǎn dān de jù zi.
sentences.english: Life was simple then, only learning simple sentences every day.

sentences.chinese: 现在，他面对的是一个巨大的阴谋，涉及上亿的资金。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài, tā miàn duì de shì yí gè jù dà de yīn móu, shè jí shàng yì de zī jīn.
sentences.english: Now, he was facing a huge conspiracy involving hundreds of millions of funds.

sentences.chinese: 林先生告诉大卫，那个笔记本的价值超过一千万。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng gào su Dà wèi, nà gè bǐ jì běn de jià zhí chāo guò yī qiān wàn.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin told David that the notebook was worth more than ten million.

sentences.chinese: 他们走在体育场内部，走了大约一公里才找到一个安静的房间。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men zǒu zài tǐ yù chǎng nèi bù, zǒu le dà yuē yī gōng lǐ cái zhǎo dào yí gè ān jìng de fáng jiān.
sentences.english: They walked inside the stadium, going about one kilometer before finding a quiet room.

sentences.chinese: 房间里有一个旧的天平，上面放着一个一千克的金属块。
sentences.pinyin: Fáng jiān lǐ yǒu yí gè jiù de tiān píng, shàng miàn fàng zhe yí gè yī qiān kè de jīn shǔ kuài.
sentences.english: In the room was an old scale with a one-kilogram metal block on it.

sentences.chinese: 大卫好奇地看着它，它看起来很沉重。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi hào qí de kàn zhe tā, tā kàn qǐ lái hěn chén zhòng.
sentences.english: David looked at it curiously; it looked very heavy.

sentences.chinese: 林先生说：“不要管它，我们要想办法离开这里。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng shuō: “Bù yào guǎn tā, wǒ men yào xiǎng bàn fǎ lí kāi zhè lǐ.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin said, "Ignore it, we need to find a way to leave here."

sentences.chinese: 在房间的窗外，可以看到大自然的美景，虽然现在是阴天。
sentences.pinyin: Zài fáng jiān de chuāng wài, kě yǐ kàn dào dà zì rán de měi jǐng, suī rán xiàn zài shì yīn tiān.
sentences.english: Outside the room's window, one could see the beauty of nature, although it was a cloudy day.

sentences.chinese: 林先生想起他以前去动物园看动物的时候，心情很放松。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng xiǎng qǐ tā yǐ qián qù dòng wù yuán kàn dòng wù de shí hou, xīn qíng hěn fàng sōng.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin remembered how relaxed he felt when he used to go to the zoo to see animals.

sentences.chinese: 但现在，他感觉自己像是一只被追捕的动物。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiàn zài, tā gǎn jué zì jǐ xiàng shì yì zhī bèi zhuī bǔ de dòng wù.
sentences.english: But now, he felt like an animal being hunted.

sentences.chinese: 他看着那些复杂的设备，它们在黑暗中闪着光。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe nà xiē fù zá de shè bèi, tā men zài hēi àn zhōng shǎn zhe guāng.
sentences.english: He looked at the complex equipment; they were flashing in the dark.

sentences.chinese: 林先生在笔记本上写下一行字，时间过去了十分钟。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiān sheng zài bǐ jì běn shàng xiě xià yì háng zì, shí jiān guò qù le shí fēn zhōng.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin wrote a line in the notebook, and ten minutes passed.

sentences.chinese: 他计算着距离，他们还需要跑五公斤的距离才能到达安全点。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì suàn zhe jù lí, tā men hái xū yào pǎo wǔ gōng jīn de jù lí cái néng dào dá ān quán diǎn.
sentences.english: He calculated the distance; they still needed to run five kilograms (kilometers) to reach the safety point.

sentences.chinese: 突然，门外传来了沉重的脚步声。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, mén wài chuán lái le chén zhòng de jiǎo bù shēng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, heavy footsteps sounded outside the door.

sentences.chinese: 大卫屏住呼吸，他知道那个黑色车的人来了。
sentences.pinyin: Dà wèi bǐng zhù hū xī, tā zhī dào nà gè hēi sè chē de rén lái le.
sentences.english: David held his breath, knowing the people from the black car had arrived.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十八章：意外的避风港

sentences.chinese: 大卫的心跳得很快，他的脸变得很白。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi de xīntiào de hěn kuài, tā de liǎn biàn de hěn bái.
sentences.english: David's heart beat very fast, and his face became very pale.

sentences.chinese: 林先生低声说：“快，跟我来，这里有一个秘密的房间。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng dīshēng shuō: “Kuài, gēn wǒ lái, zhèlǐ yǒu yīgè mìmì de fángjiān.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin whispered, "Quick, come with me, there is a secret room here."

sentences.chinese: 他们走进一个小房间，里面有一把旧椅子和一个破旧的座位。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒujìn yīgè xiǎo fángjiān, lǐmiàn yǒu yī bǎ jiù yǐzi hé yīgè pòjiù de zuòwèi.
sentences.english: They entered a small room, inside of which was an old chair and a worn-out seat.

sentences.chinese: 林先生看了看他的手表，现在是深夜。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng kànle kàn tā de shǒubiǎo, xiànzài shì shēnyè.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin looked at his wristwatch; it was now midnight.

sentences.chinese: 为了掩盖身份，林先生拿出一个护照，交给大卫。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile yǎngài shēnfèn, Lín xiānshēng ná chū yīgè hùzhào, jiāo gěi Dàwèi.
sentences.english: To hide their identities, Mr. Lin took out a passport and gave it to David.

sentences.chinese: 房间的角落里放着一个排球和一颗篮球。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān de jiǎoluò lǐ fàngzhe yīgè páiqiú hé yī kē lánqiú.
sentences.english: In the corner of the room sat a volleyball and a basketball.

sentences.chinese: 这里看起来像是一个旧的教室，墙上还写着教师的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ kàn qǐlái xiàng shì yīgè jiù de jiàoshì, qiáng shàng hái xiězhe jiàoshī de míngzì.
sentences.english: This place looked like an old classroom, and the teacher's name was still written on the wall.

sentences.chinese: 林先生打开电视，电视里正在播报最近的新闻。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng dǎkāi diànshì, diànshì lǐ zhèngzài bōbào zuìjìn de xīnwén.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin turned on the television, which was broadcasting the latest news.

sentences.chinese: 因为太紧张，大卫觉得很饿，林先生给了他一碗方便面。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi tài jǐnzhāng, Dàwèi juéde hěn è, Lín xiānshēng gěile tā yī wǎn fāngbiànmiàn.
sentences.english: Because he was so nervous, David felt very hungry, and Mr. Lin gave him a bowl of instant noodles.

sentences.chinese: 大卫用筷子吃面，想起以前每天早上吃早餐的日子。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi yòng kuàizi chī miàn, xiǎngqǐ yǐqián měitiān zǎoshang chī zǎocān de rìzi.
sentences.english: David ate the noodles with chopsticks, remembering the days when he ate breakfast every morning.

sentences.chinese: 他记得那个月份，那是秋天，天气很凉快。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde nàgè yuèfèn, nà shì qiūtiān, tiānqì hěn liángkuai.
sentences.english: He remembered that month; it was autumn, and the weather was very cool.

sentences.chinese: 窗外，圆圆的月亮在天空发光。
sentences.pinyin: Chuāngwài, yuányuán de yuèliang zài tiānkōng fāguāng.
sentences.english: Outside the window, a round moon was shining in the sky.

sentences.chinese: 林先生说：“如果你以后有空儿，我可以告诉你这个地方的故事。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ yǐhòu yǒu kòngr, wǒ kěyǐ gàosù nǐ zhège dìfāng de gùshì.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin said, "If you are available in the future, I can tell you the story of this place."

sentences.chinese: 这个房间在大学的校园里面，非常安静。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān zài dàxué de xiàoyuán lǐmiàn, fēicháng ānjìng.
sentences.english: This room was inside a university campus and was very quiet.

sentences.chinese: 此时，外面的气温很低，温度在下降。
sentences.pinyin: Cǐshí, wàimiàn de qìwēn hěn dī, wēndù zài xiàjiàng.
sentences.english: At this moment, the air temperature outside was very low, and the temperature was dropping.

sentences.chinese: 房间外面有一条小河，远处还有一个大湖。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān wàimiàn yǒu yī tiáo xiǎo hé, yuǎn chù hái yǒu yīgè dà hú.
sentences.english: Outside the room, there was a small river, and in the distance, there was a large lake.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一只狗在门外叫了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yī zhī gǒu zài mén wài jiào le qǐlái.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a dog started barking outside the door.

sentences.chinese: 大卫低头看了看自己的球鞋，上面沾满了泥土。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi dītóu kànle kàn zìjǐ de qiúxié, shàngmiàn zhān mǎnle nítǔ.
sentences.english: David looked down at his athletic shoes, which were covered in mud.

sentences.chinese: 他拿起桌上的一个水瓶子，喝了一口水。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná qǐ zhuō shàng de yīgè shuǐ píngzi, hēle yī kǒu shuǐ.
sentences.english: He picked up a water bottle from the table and took a sip of water.

sentences.chinese: 林先生告诉他，这里曾经住过一位著名的画家。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng gàosù tā, zhèlǐ céngjīng zhùguò yī wèi zhùmíng de huàjiā.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin told him that a famous painter once lived here.

sentences.chinese: 那位画家有一双很亮、很温柔的眼睛。
sentences.pinyin: Nà wèi huàjiā yǒu yī shuāng hěn liàng, hěn wēnróu de yǎnjing.
sentences.english: That painter had a pair of very bright, gentle eyes.

sentences.chinese: 林先生笑着说：“这里离那个黑色车的人很远，现在很安全。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng xiàozhe shuō: “Zhèlǐ lí nàgè hēisè chē de rén hěn yuǎn, xiànzài hěn ānquán.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin said with a smile, "This place is far from the person in the black car; it is safe now."

sentences.chinese: 他接着说，这里还住过一位伟大的科学家。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiēzhe shuō, zhèlǐ hái zhùguò yī wèi wěidà de kēxuéjiā.
sentences.english: He continued, saying that a great scientist had also lived here.

sentences.chinese: 为了缓解紧张的气氛，林先生讲了一个笑话儿。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile huǎnjiě jǐnzhāng de qìfēn, Lín xiānshēng jiǎngle yīgè xiàohuar.
sentences.english: To ease the tense atmosphere, Mr. Lin told a joke.

sentences.chinese: 大卫终于笑了起来，他的心情好了一些。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi zhōngyú xiào le qǐlái, tā de xīnqíng hǎo le yīxiē.
sentences.english: David finally laughed, and his mood improved a bit.

sentences.chinese: 房间的墙壁是绿色的，看起来很舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān de qiángbì shì lǜsè de, kàn qǐlái hěn shūfu.
sentences.english: The walls of the room were green, which looked very comfortable.

sentences.chinese: 林先生说：“我们不能一直待在这里，明天我们要去参加一个晚会。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng shuō: “Wǒmen bùnéng yīzhí dāi zài zhèlǐ, míngtiān wǒmen yào qù cānjiā yīgè wǎnhuì.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin said, "We cannot stay here forever; tomorrow we must attend an evening party."

sentences.chinese: 大卫问：“为什么要去晚会？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi wèn: “Wèishéme yào qù wǎnhuì?”
sentences.english: David asked, "Why do we have to go to a party?"

sentences.chinese: 林先生的表情变得严肃，他看向门外。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng de biǎoqíng biàn de yánsù, tā kàn xiàng mén wài.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin's expression became serious as he looked toward the door.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，门外传来了敲门声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, mén wài chuánláile qiāomén shēng.
sentences.english: Just then, there was a knock at the door.

sentences.chinese: 一个声音在问：“请问有人在里面吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè shēngyīn zài wèn: “Qǐngwèn yǒu rén zài lǐmiàn ma?”
sentences.english: A voice asked, "Excuse me, is anyone inside?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫和林先生对视了一眼，他们知道，对方还是找到了这里。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi hé Lín xiānshēng duìshì le yīyǎn, tāmen zhīdào, duìfāng háishì zhǎodào le zhèlǐ.
sentences.english: David and Mr. Lin looked at each other; they knew the other party had found them after all.

sentences.chinese: 大卫和林先生在门后屏住呼吸。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi hé Lín xiānshēng zài mén hòu bǐng zhù hūxī.
sentences.english: David and Mr. Lin held their breath behind the door.

sentences.chinese: 门外的声音停了，只有冷风在街上吹。
sentences.pinyin: Mén wài de shēngyīn tíng le, zhǐyǒu lěng fēng zài jiē shàng chuī.
sentences.english: The sound outside stopped, and only the cold wind blew on the street.

sentences.chinese: 现在的天气很冷，气温已经零下五度了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài de tiānqì hěn lěng, qìwēn yǐjīng líng xià wǔ dù le.
sentences.english: The weather now is very cold; the temperature is already five degrees below zero.

sentences.chinese: 大卫感觉到自己的腿在发抖。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi gǎnjué dào zìjǐ de tuǐ zài fādǒu.
sentences.english: David felt his legs trembling.

sentences.chinese: 林先生低声说：“在这个节骨眼上，我们不能被发现。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng dī shēng shuō: “Zài zhège jié gǔ yǎn shàng, wǒmen bùnéng bèi fāxiàn.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin whispered, "At this critical juncture, we cannot be discovered."

sentences.chinese: 他看着窗外，街道上停着一辆黑色的车。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe chuāng wài, jiēdào shàng tíng zhe yī liàng hēisè de chē.
sentences.english: He looked out the window; a black car was parked on the street.

sentences.chinese: 那辆车的颜色很深，在夜色中像一个黑色的影子。
sentences.pinyin: Nà liàng chē de yánsè hěn shēn, zài yèsè zhōng xiàng yī gè hēisè de yǐngzi.
sentences.english: The color of that vehicle was very deep, like a black shadow in the night.

sentences.chinese: 周围没有其他车辆，只有安静的街道。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōuwéi méiyǒu qítā chēliàng, zhǐyǒu ānjìng de jiēdào.
sentences.english: There were no other vehicles around, only the quiet street.

sentences.chinese: 林先生想起以前在课堂上教英语的时候。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng xiǎngqǐ yǐqián zài kètáng shàng jiāo Yīngyǔ de shíhòu.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin remembered when he used to teach English in the classroom.

sentences.chinese: 那时候，他面对黑板，教学生如何发音。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shíhòu, tā miànduì hēibǎn, jiāo xuéshēng rúhé fāyīn.
sentences.english: Back then, he faced the blackboard, teaching students how to pronounce.

sentences.chinese: 他记得每一个音节都要说得很清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìdé měi yī gè yīnjié dōu yào shuō de hěn qīngchǔ.
sentences.english: He remembered that every syllable had to be spoken very clearly.

sentences.chinese: 语言是沟通的桥梁，但现在语言成了他的难题。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔyán shì gōutōng de qiáo liáng, dàn xiànzài yǔyán chéng le tā de nántí.
sentences.english: Language is a bridge for communication, but now language has become his difficult problem.

sentences.chinese: 他担心对方会说英文，而他不想在此时沟通。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dānxīn duìfāng huì shuō Yīngwén, ér tā bù xiǎng zài cǐshí gōutōng.
sentences.english: He worried the other party might speak English, and he didn't want to communicate at this moment.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着自己的鞋，心想如果现在能去一个安全的地方就好了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe zìjǐ de xié, xīn xiǎng rúguǒ xiànzài néng qù yī gè ānquán de dìfāng jiù hǎo le.
sentences.english: David looked at his shoes, thinking it would be great if he could go to a safe place now.

sentences.chinese: 他想起家附近有一个蓝色的小花园。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ jiā fùjìn yǒu yī gè lánsè de xiǎo huāyuán.
sentences.english: He thought of a small blue garden near his home.

sentences.chinese: 那里很安静，经常能听到轻柔的音乐。
sentences.pinyin: Nàlǐ hěn ānjìng, jīngcháng néng tīng dào qīngróu de yīnyuè.
sentences.english: It was very quiet there, and he could often hear gentle music.

sentences.chinese: 他甚至想象自己正在参加一场完美的音乐会。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shènzhì xiǎngxiàng zìjǐ zhèngzài cānjiā yī chǎng wánměi de yīnyuèhuì.
sentences.english: He even imagined himself attending a perfect concert.

sentences.chinese: 但现实是，他们必须离开这个房间。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiànshí shì, tāmen bìxū líkāi zhège fángjiān.
sentences.english: But the reality was that they had to leave this room.

sentences.chinese: 林先生指了指地图上的一个药店和一家银行。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng zhǐ le zhǐ dìtú shàng de yī gè yàodiàn hé yī jiā yínháng.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin pointed to a pharmacy and a bank on the map.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“我们从后门走，经过那个饭馆。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒmen cóng hòumén zǒu, jīngguò nà gè fànguǎn.”
sentences.english: He said, "We'll go out the back door and pass that restaurant."

sentences.chinese: 大卫记得那个饭馆，他见过那里的菜单。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi jìdé nà gè fànguǎn, tā jiànguò nàlǐ de càidān.
sentences.english: David remembered that restaurant; he had seen the menu there.

sentences.chinese: 菜单上有很多好吃的菜，但现在他完全不想吃饭。
sentences.pinyin: Càidān shàng yǒu hěnduō hǎo chī de cài, dàn xiànzài tā wánquán bù xiǎng chīfàn.
sentences.english: There were many delicious dishes on the menu, but now he didn't want to eat at all.

sentences.chinese: 他们悄悄地走出房门，走在寒冷的街上。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen qiāoqiāo de zǒuchū fángmén, zǒu zài hánlěng de jiē shàng.
sentences.english: They quietly walked out of the room and walked on the cold street.

sentences.chinese: 突然，大卫听到身后传来了急促的脚步声。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, Dàwèi tīng dào shēnhòu chuán lái le jícù de jiǎobù shēng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, David heard hurried footsteps coming from behind him.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十章：狭窄的小弄堂

sentences.chinese: 大卫和林先生一直快步向前走，不敢回头。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi hé Lín xiānshēng yīzhí kuàibù xiàngqián zǒu, bù gǎn huítóu.
sentences.english: David and Mr. Lin kept walking forward quickly, not daring to look back.

sentences.chinese: 他们走进了一个很深的小弄，这里很安静。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒujìnle yīgè hěn shēn de xiǎo lòng, zhèlǐ hěn ānjìng.
sentences.english: They entered a very deep small alley; it was very quiet here.

sentences.chinese: 在弄堂的对面，有一座古老的石桥。
sentences.pinyin: Zài lòngtáng de duìmiàn, yǒu yī zuò gǔlǎo de shíqiáo.
sentences.english: Opposite the alley, there was an ancient stone bridge.

sentences.chinese: 林先生低声说：“快看，那里有一位老朋友。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng dīshēng shuō: “Kuài kàn, nàlǐ yǒu yī wèi lǎo péngyǒu.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin whispered, "Look quickly, there is an old friend there."

sentences.chinese: 在那座桥的面前，站着一个穿着黑色外套的人。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nà zuò qiáo de miànqián, zhànzhe yīgè chuānzhe hēisè wàitào de rén.
sentences.english: In front of that bridge stood a person wearing a black coat.

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这场追逐战让他感到非常累。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéde zhè chǎng zhuīzhúzhàn ràng tā gǎndào fēicháng lèi.
sentences.english: David felt that this bout of chasing had made him very tired.

sentences.chinese: 他想起快要开学了，他原本应该在准备学习。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ kuàiyào kāixué le, tā yuánběn yīnggāi zài zhǔnbèi xuéxí.
sentences.english: He remembered that school was about to start; he originally should have been preparing for his studies.

sentences.chinese: 现在他的生活条件变得很糟糕，到处都是危险。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài tā de shēnghuó tiáojiàn biànde hěn zāogāo, dàochù dōu shì wēixiǎn.
sentences.english: Now his living conditions had become very bad, and there was danger everywhere.

sentences.chinese: 林先生带他来到一栋旧楼的第三层。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng dài tā láidào yī dòng jiù lóu de dì sān céng.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin took him to the third floor of an old building.

sentences.chinese: 房间里有一排旧椅子，他们坐在其中一张座上休息。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ yǒu yī pái jiù yǐzi, tāmen zuò zài qízhōng yī zhāng zuò shàng xiūxí.
sentences.english: There was a row of old chairs in the room, and they rested on one of the seats.

sentences.chinese: 林先生拿出一台旧机器，开始打印一篇重要的文件。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng ná chū yī tái jiù jīqì, kāishǐ dǎyìn yī piān zhòngyào de wénjiàn.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin took out an old machine and began to print an important document.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着那篇文件，里面有很多他不认识的词。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe nà piān wénjiàn, lǐmiàn yǒu hěnduō tā bù rènshí de cí.
sentences.english: David looked at the piece of writing; there were many words in it that he didn't recognize.

sentences.chinese: 林先生说：“你的汉语水平挺高的，但这些词太难了。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng shuō: “Nǐ de Hànyǔ shuǐpíng tǐng gāo de, dàn zhèxiē cí tài nán le.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin said, "Your Chinese level is quite high, but these words are too difficult."

sentences.chinese: 大卫点点头，他觉得现在的压力已经够大了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi diǎntóu, tā juéde xiànzài de yālì yǐjīng gòu dà le.
sentences.english: David nodded; he felt the current pressure was already enough.

sentences.chinese: 这时，窗外传来了嘈杂的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, chuāngwài chuánláile cáozá de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: At this moment, noisy sounds came from outside the window.

sentences.chinese: 他们看到楼下有一群人在排队，似乎在等什么东西。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen kàndào lóuxià yǒu yīqún rén zài páiduì, sìhū zài děng shénme dōngxī.
sentences.english: They saw a group of people lining up downstairs, seemingly waiting for something.

sentences.chinese: 林先生说：“我们要等到他们离开才能走。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng shuō: “Wǒmen yào děngdào tāmen líkāi cáinéng zǒu.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin said, "We have to wait until they leave before we can go."

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着窗外，心中感到不安。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe chuāngwài, xīnzhōng gǎndào bù'ān.
sentences.english: David looked out the window, feeling uneasy in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 突然，门外传来了沉重的敲门声。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, ménwài chuánláile chénzhòng de qiāomén shēng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a heavy knocking sound came from outside the door.

sentences.chinese: 那个声音冷冷地问：“我知道你们在里面。”
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè shēngyīn lěnglěng de wèn: “Wǒ zhīdào nǐmen zài lǐmiàn.”
sentences.english: That voice asked coldly, "I know you are inside."

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十一章：门口的对峙

sentences.chinese: 大卫和林先生站在门后面，心跳很快。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi hé Lín xiānshēng zhàn zài mén hòumiàn, xīntiào hěn kuài.
sentences.english: David and Mr. Lin stood behind the door, their hearts beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 门外的人再次说话了，声音冷冰冰的。
sentences.pinyin: Mén wài de rén zàicì shuōhuà le, shēngyīn lěngbīngbīng de.
sentences.english: The person outside spoke again, their voice ice-cold.

sentences.chinese: “把笔记本交给我就行，我们会让你离开。”
sentences.pinyin: “Bǎ bǐjìběn jiāo gěi wǒ jiù xíng, wǒmen huì ràng nǐ líkāi.”
sentences.english: "Just hand over the notebook to me, and we will let you leave."

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着林先生，低声问：“现在怎么办？”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe Lín xiānshēng, dīshēng wèn: “Xiànzài zěnme bàn?”
sentences.english: David looked at Mr. Lin and asked in a low voice, "What should we do now?"

sentences.chinese: 林先生没有说话，只是轻轻点头，示意大卫不要出声。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng méiyǒu shuōhuà, zhǐshì qīngqīng diǎntóu, shìyì Dàwèi bùyào chūshēng.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin didn't speak, he just nodded slightly, signaling David to remain silent.

sentences.chinese: 林先生走到门边，轻轻打开了一道缝。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng zǒu dào mén biān, qīngqīng dǎkāi le yī dào fèng.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin walked to the door and gently opened a crack.

sentences.chinese: 一个穿着黑衣服的人站在门口，他的眼神很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè chuānzhe hēi yīfú de rén zhàn zài ménkǒu, tā de yǎnshén hěn lěng.
sentences.english: A person dressed in black stood at the doorway, his eyes cold.

sentences.chinese: 他要求大卫拿出那个笔记本，并把它交给对方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yāoqiú Dàwèi ná chū nàgè bǐjìběn, bìng bǎ tā jiāo gěi duìfāng.
sentences.english: He demanded that David take out the notebook and hand it over to the other party.

sentences.chinese: 大卫想起笔记本里有父亲留给他的信，他不能就这样交给陌生人。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎngqǐ bǐjìběn lǐ yǒu fùqīn liú gěi tā de xìn, tā bùnéng jiù zhèyàng jiāo gěi mòshēng rén.
sentences.english: David remembered the letter his father had left him in the notebook; he couldn't just hand it over to a stranger.

sentences.chinese: 这封信对他来说非常重要，因为他从小就在国外长大。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fēng xìn duì tā lái shuō fēicháng zhòngyào, yīnwèi tā cóngxiǎo jiù zài guówài zhǎngdà.
sentences.english: This letter was very important to him because he had grown up abroad since he was a child.

sentences.chinese: 他的父亲出生在很多年前的一个小村庄，后来为了工作才回国。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de fùqīn chūshēng zài hěnduō nián qián de yīgè xiǎo cūnzhuāng, hòulái wèile gōngzuò cái huíguó.
sentences.english: His father was born in a small village many years ago and later returned to his home country for work.

sentences.chinese: 大卫记得父亲说过，他在那个村庄养过一只小狗，那是他童年最美好的回忆。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi jìdé fùqīn shuōguò, tā zài nàgè cūnzhuāng yǎngguò yī zhǐ xiǎo gǒu, nà shì tā tóngnián zuì měihǎo de huíyì.
sentences.english: David remembered his father saying he had raised a small dog in that village, which was the most beautiful memory of his childhood.

sentences.chinese: 父亲在回国之前，把很多秘密记录在那个本子上，并把它送给大卫。
sentences.pinyin: Fùqīn zài huíguó zhīqián, bǎ hěnduō mìmì jìlù zài nàgè běnzi shàng, bìng bǎ tā sòng gěi Dàwèi.
sentences.english: Before returning to his home country, his father recorded many secrets in that notebook and gave it to David.

sentences.chinese: 现在，这个笔记本成了很多人想要的东西。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài, zhège bǐjìběn chéngle hěnduō rén xiǎng yào de dōngxī.
sentences.english: Now, this notebook had become something many people wanted.

sentences.chinese: 黑衣人说：“我知道你现在的收入不高，如果你把本子给我们，我们会给你很多钱。”
sentences.pinyin: Hēiyīrén shuō: “Wǒ zhīdào nǐ xiànzài de shōurù bù gāo, rúguǒ nǐ bǎ běnzi gěi wǒmen, wǒmen huì gěi nǐ hěnduō qián.”
sentences.english: The man in black said, "I know your current income is not high; if you give the notebook to us, we will give you a lot of money."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得这是一种威胁，而不是欢迎。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéde zhè shì yī zhǒng wēixié, ér bùshì huānyíng.
sentences.english: David felt this was a threat, not a welcome.

sentences.chinese: 林先生突然开口说：“你们想要的结果，不可能通过威胁取得。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng tūrán kāikǒu shuō: “Nǐmen xiǎng yào de jiéguǒ, bù kěnéng tōngguò wēixié qǔdé.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin suddenly spoke, "The result you want cannot be obtained through threats."

sentences.chinese: 黑衣人冷笑一声，让身边的人走进房间。
sentences.pinyin: Hēiyīrén lěngxiào yīshēng, ràng shēnbiān de rén zǒu jìn fángjiān.
sentences.english: The man in black sneered and let the people beside him enter the room.

sentences.chinese: 林先生赶紧关上门，大卫被推到了房间的角落。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng gǎnjǐn guānshàng mén, Dàwèi bèi tuī dào le fángjiān de jiǎoluò.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin quickly closed the door, and David was pushed into the corner of the room.

sentences.chinese: 房间里有一个小的出口，那是以前出租房的旧入口。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ yǒu yīgè xiǎo de chūkǒu, nà shì yǐqián chūzū fáng de jiù rùkǒu.
sentences.english: There was a small exit in the room, which was the old entrance of the rental house.

sentences.chinese: 林先生对大卫说：“快，从这里进入走廊，然后跑到街对面！”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng duì Dàwèi shuō: “Kuài, cóng zhèlǐ jìnrù zǒuláng, ránhòu pǎo dào jiē duìmiàn!”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin said to David, "Quick, enter the corridor from here, and then run to the opposite side of the street!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫接过林先生递给他的一个小包，里面是一些重要的文件。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi jiēguò Lín xiānshēng dì gěi tā de yīgè xiǎo bāo, lǐmiàn shì yīxiē zhòngyào de wénjiàn.
sentences.english: David took the small bag Mr. Lin handed to him, which contained some important documents.

sentences.chinese: 林先生说：“这些文件必须送到安全的地方，你必须拿到它们。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng shuō: “Zhèxiē wénjiàn bìxū sòng dào āntián de dìfāng, nǐ bìxū ná dào tāmen.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin said, "These documents must be delivered to a safe place; you must get them."

sentences.chinese: 大卫接过包，心中感到压力很大。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi jiēguò bāo, xīnzhōng gǎndào yālì hěn dà.
sentences.english: David took the bag, feeling a great deal of pressure in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 接下来，他必须在黑暗中快速行动。
sentences.pinyin: Jiē xià lái, tā bìxū zài hēi'àn zhōng kuàisù xíngdòng.
sentences.english: Next, he had to act quickly in the dark.

sentences.chinese: 他走出房间，跑到了一个狭窄的走廊。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu chū fángjiān, pǎo dào le yīgè xiǎozhǎi de zǒuláng.
sentences.english: He walked out of the room and ran into a narrow corridor.

sentences.chinese: 在走廊的尽头，他突然碰到一个正在照相的游客。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zǒuláng de jìntóu, tā tūrán pèng dào yīgè zhèngzài zhàoxiàng de yóukè.
sentences.english: At the end of the corridor, he suddenly ran into a tourist who was taking photographs.

sentences.chinese: 游客看起来很迷茫，他来自一个很远的国家。
sentences.pinyin: Yóukè kàn qǐlái hěn mímáng, tā láizì yīgè hěn yuǎn de guójiā.
sentences.english: The tourist looked confused; he came from a very distant country.

sentences.chinese: 大卫没有时间解释，他赶紧让游客让路。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi méiyǒu shíjiān jiěshì, tā gǎnjǐn ràng yóukè ràng lù.
sentences.english: David had no time to explain; he quickly asked the tourist to make way.

sentences.chinese: 在跑向街道的过程中，大卫碰见了一个熟悉的面孔，那是之前在店里见到的老奶奶。
sentences.pinyin: Zài pǎo xiàng jiēdào de guòchéng zhōng, Dàwèi pèng jiàn le yīgè shúxī de miànkǒng, nà shì zhīqián zài diàn lǐ jiàn dào de lǎo nǎinai.
sentences.english: While running toward the street, David bumped into a familiar face—the old lady he had seen in the shop before.

sentences.chinese: 老奶奶看到大卫，惊讶地喊道：“你怎么在这里？”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo nǎinai kàn dào Dàwèi, jīngyà de hǎn dào: “Nǐ zěnme zài zhèlǐ?”
sentences.english: The old lady saw David and shouted in surprise, "Why are you here?"

sentences.chinese: 大卫没有停下，他只是快速地跑过，结果不小心撞到了一个垃圾桶。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi méiyǒu tíng xià, tā zhǐshì kuàisù de pǎo guò, jiéguǒ bù xiǎoxīn zhuàng dào le yīgè lājītǒng.
sentences.english: David didn't stop; he just ran past quickly, and as a result, accidentally bumped into a trash can.

sentences.chinese: 黑衣人的声音在身后响起：“站住！不要跑！”
sentences.pinyin: Hēiyīrén de shēngyīn zài shēnhòu xiǎngqǐ: “Zhàn zhù! Bùyào pǎo!”
sentences.english: The voice of the man in black sounded behind him: "Stop! Don't run!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫感到心跳快得像要跳出来一样。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi gǎndào xīntiào kuài dé xiàng yào tiào chūlái yīyàng.
sentences.english: David felt his heart beating so fast it felt like it would jump out.

sentences.chinese: 他想起林先生说过，必须通过努力才能取得自由。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ Lín xiānshēng shuōguò, bìxū tōngguò nǔlì cái néng qǔdé zìyóu.
sentences.english: He remembered Mr. Lin saying that freedom can only be obtained through effort.

sentences.chinese: 他跑到了街道的尽头，看到一个出租车公司在出租车。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pǎo dào le jiēdào de jìntóu, kàn dào yīgè chūzūchē gōngsī zài chūzū chē.
sentences.english: He ran to the end of the street and saw a taxi company renting out cars.

sentences.chinese: 他决定租一辆车快速离开这里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juédìng zū yī liàng chē kuàisù líkāi zhèlǐ.
sentences.english: He decided to rent a car to leave the place quickly.

sentences.chinese: 在等待出租车的过程中，他接到了一条来自陌生号码的短信。
sentences.pinyin: Zài děngdài chūzūchē de guòchéng zhōng, tā jiē dào le yī tiáo láizì mòshēng hàomǎ de duǎnxìn.
sentences.english: While waiting for the taxi, he received a text message from an unknown number.

sentences.chinese: 短信里写着：“不要相信任何人，即使是林先生。”
sentences.pinyin: Duǎnxìn lǐ xiě zhe: “Bùyào xiāngxìn rènhé rén, jíshǐ shì Lín xiānshēng.”
sentences.english: The message read: "Do not trust anyone, even Mr. Lin."

sentences.chinese: 大卫愣住了，他不知道该如何接受这个信息。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi lèng zhù le, tā bù zhīdào gāi rúhé jiēshòu zhège xìnxī.
sentences.english: David froze; he didn't know how to accept this information.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果林先生骗他，那他该怎么办？
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rúguǒ Lín xiānshēng piàn tā, nà tā gāi zěnme bàn?
sentences.english: He thought, if Mr. Lin were lying to him, what should he do?

sentences.chinese: 他从包里取出那封信，再次读了一遍。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng bāo lǐ qǔ chū nà fēng xìn, zàicì dú le yī biàn.
sentences.english: He took out the letter from the bag and read it once more.

sentences.chinese: 他得出结论：只有自己才能保护好这些秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dé chū jié lùn: zhǐyǒu zìjǐ cái néng bǎohù hǎo zhèxiē mìmì.
sentences.english: He arrived at the conclusion: only he could protect these secrets.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，一辆出租车停在他面前。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, yī liàng chūzūchē tíng zài tā miànqián.
sentences.english: Just then, a taxi stopped in front of him.

sentences.chinese: 大卫快速地走进车里，对司机说：“请快点开车！”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kuàisù de zǒu jìn chē lǐ, duì sījī shuō: “Qǐng kuài diǎn kāichē!”
sentences.english: David quickly entered the car and said to the driver, "Please drive fast!"

sentences.chinese: 当车子启动时，他回头看到林先生正站在窗边看着他。
sentences.pinyin: Dāng chēzi qǐdòng shí, tā huítóu kàn dào Lín xiānshēng zhèng zhàn zài chuāng biān kànzhe tā.
sentences.english: As the car started, he looked back and saw Mr. Lin standing by the window watching him.

sentences.chinese: 林先生对着他轻轻挥了挥手，像是在说再见。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng duìzhe tā qīngqīng huī le huī shǒu, xiàng shì zài shuō zàijiàn.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin waved his hand gently at him, as if saying goodbye.

sentences.chinese: 但大卫注意到，林先生的眼神里有一种奇怪的悲伤。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn Dàwèi zhùyì dào, Lín xiānshēng de yǎnshén lǐ yǒu yī zhǒng qíguài de bēishāng.
sentences.english: But David noticed a strange sadness in Mr. Lin's eyes.

sentences.chinese: 他不知道林先生是否受到了威胁，或者他本身就是计划的一部分。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zhīdào Lín xiānshēng shìfǒu shòudào le wēixié, huòzhě tā běnshēn jiùshì jìhuà de yī bùfèn.
sentences.english: He didn't know if Mr. Lin had received threats, or if he himself was part of the plan.

sentences.chinese: 出租车开远了，大卫靠在椅子上，深深地呼吸。
sentences.pinyin: Chūzūchē kāi yuǎn le, Dàwèi kào zài yǐzi shàng, shēn shēn de hūxī.
sentences.english: The taxi drove away, and David leaned back in the seat, breathing deeply.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，这场追逐还没有结束，真正的秘密可能才刚刚开始显露。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhīdào, zhè chǎng zhuīzhú hái méiyǒu jiéshù, zhēnzhèng de mìmì kěnéng cái gānggāng kāishǐ xiǎnlù.
sentences.english: He knew this chase was not over yet, and the real secrets might have just begun to reveal themselves.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十二章：旧照片的颜色
chapters.title_english: Chapter 22: The Colors of Old Photographs

sentences.chinese: 大卫在出租车上打开了那个笔记本。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi zài chūzūchē shàng dǎkāile nàge bǐjìběn.
sentences.english: David opened the notebook in the taxi.

sentences.chinese: 他发现里面有一张很旧的照片。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn lǐmiàn yǒu yī zhāng hěn jiù de zhàopiàn.
sentences.english: He discovered an old photograph inside.

sentences.chinese: 照片上的颜色已经变了，有些地方变成了黄色。
sentences.pinyin: Zhàopiàn shàng de yánsè yǐjīng biànle, yǒuxiē dìfāng biànchéngle huángsè.
sentences.english: The colors in the photo had changed; some parts had turned yellow.

sentences.chinese: 那是他父亲年轻时的样子，穿着一件白色的衬衫。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì tā fùqīn niánqīng shí de yàngzi, chuānzhe yī jiàn báisè de chènshān.
sentences.english: It was his father as a young man, wearing a white shirt.

sentences.chinese: 在照片的背面，写着几个国家的名字：克、越、中国。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhàopiàn de bèimiàn, xiězhe jǐ gè guójiā de míngzì: Kè, Yuè, Zhōngguó.
sentences.english: On the back of the photo, the names of several countries were written: Croatia, Vietnam, and China.

sentences.chinese: 大卫感觉心跳得很快，他想知道父亲在那里的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi gǎnjué xīntiào de hěn kuài, tā xiǎng zhīdào fùqīn zài nàlǐ de shēnghuó.
sentences.english: David felt his heart beating fast; he wanted to know about his father's life there.

sentences.chinese: 他记得父亲经常告诉他，要努力学习，做一个好人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde fùqīn jīngcháng gàosù tā, yào nǔlì xuéxí, zuò yīgè hǎorén.
sentences.english: He remembered his father often told him to study hard and be a good person.

sentences.chinese: 大卫打开一个旧的网站，试图寻找关于那些地方的信息。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi dǎkāi yīgè jiù de wǎngzhàn, shìtú xúnzhǎo guānyú nàxiē dìfāng de xìnxī.
sentences.english: David opened an old website, trying to find information about those places.

sentences.chinese: 在这个网站上，他看到了很多常用的词汇，描述着异国的风景。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège wǎngzhàn shàng, tā kàndàole hěnduō chángyòng de cíhuì, miáoshùzhe yìguó de fēngjǐng.
sentences.english: On this website, he saw many commonly used words describing foreign landscapes.

sentences.chinese: 他发现父亲曾经在克罗地亚工作过一段时间。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn fùqīn céngjīng zài Kèluódìyà gōngzuòguò yīduàn shíjiān.
sentences.english: He discovered that his father had worked in Croatia for a period of time.

sentences.chinese: 照片里还有一个女人，她穿着红色的裙子，笑容很热情。
sentences.pinyin: Zhàopiàn lǐ hái yǒu yīgè nǚrén, tā chuānzhe hóngsè de qúnzi, xiàoróng hěn rèqíng.
sentences.english: There was also a woman in the photo, wearing a red dress with an enthusiastic smile.

sentences.chinese: 大卫猜测，这也许就是父亲年轻时的爱情。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi cāicè, zhè yěxǔ jiùshì fùqīn niánqīng shí de àiqíng.
sentences.english: David guessed that this might have been his father's young romance.

sentences.chinese: 看到这些，大卫感到很感动，因为他意识到父亲一直很关心他。
sentences.pinyin: Kàndào zhèxiē, Dàwèi gǎndào hěn gǎndòng, yīnwèi tā yìshí dào fùqīn yīzhí hěn guānxīn tā.
sentences.english: Seeing this, David felt very moved because he realized his father had always cared about him.

sentences.chinese: 即使在那么远的地方，父亲也永远记得把这些记录下来。
sentences.pinyin: Jìshǐ zài nàme yuǎn de dìfāng, fùqīn yě yǒngyuǎn jìde bǎ zhèxiē jìlù xiàlái.
sentences.english: Even in such a distant place, his father always remembered to record these things.

sentences.chinese: 大卫对那些帮助过他的人感到非常感谢。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi duì nàxiē bāngzhùguò tā de rén gǎndào fēicháng gǎnxiè.
sentences.english: David felt very grateful to the people who had helped him.

sentences.chinese: 虽然他现在还不熟这个城市的每一个角落，但他不再害怕了。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán tā xiànzài hái bù shú zhège chéngshì de měi yīgè jiǎoluò, dàn tā bù zài hàipàle.
sentences.english: Although he is not yet familiar with every corner of this city, he is no longer afraid.

sentences.chinese: 这种感觉特别奇怪，像是在经历一场冒险。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng gǎnjué tèbié qíguài, xiàng shì zài jīnglì yī chǎng màoxiǎn.
sentences.english: This feeling was particularly strange, as if he were experiencing an adventure.

sentences.chinese: 他看着窗外的街道，思考着这些颜色背后的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe chuāngwài de jiēdào, sīkǎozhe zhèxiē yánsè bèihòu de gùshì.
sentences.english: He looked at the streets outside the window, thinking about the stories behind these colors.

sentences.chinese: 突然，手机收到了一条新消息。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, shǒujī shōudào le yī tiáo xīn xiāoxi.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the phone received a new message.

sentences.chinese: 消息上写着：“我知道你在看那些照片，快离开那里。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiāoxi shàng xiězhe: “Wǒ zhīdào nǐ zài kàn nàxiē zhàopiàn, kuài líkāi nàlǐ.”
sentences.english: The message read: "I know you are looking at those photos, leave there quickly."

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十三章：不安的午后

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着手机上的消息，心跳加快了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe shǒujī shàng de xiàoxi, xīntiào jiākuài le.
sentences.english: David looked at the message on his phone, and his heart beat faster.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这个陌生人的出现，对他现在的生活有了很大的影响。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde zhège mòshēng rén de chūxiàn, duì tā xiànzài de shēnghuó yǒu le hěn dà de yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.english: He felt that the appearance of this stranger had a great influence on his current life.

sentences.chinese: 他想知道这个发消息的人姓什么，但对方没有说。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng zhīdào zhège fā xiāoxi de rén xìng shénme, dàn duìfāng méiyǒu shuō.
sentences.english: He wanted to know the surname of the person sending the message, but the other party didn't say.

sentences.chinese: 大卫决定先离开这个房间，他小心地走到了窗边。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juédìng xiān líkāi zhège fángjiān, tā xiǎoxīn de zǒu dào le chuāngbiān.
sentences.english: David decided to leave the room first; he carefully walked to the window.

sentences.chinese: 外面的交通很糟糕，很多车停在路上，像是一条长长的龙。
sentences.pinyin: Wàimiàn de jiāotōng hěn zāogāo, hěnduō chē tíng zài lùshàng, xiàng shì yī tiáo chángcháng de lóng.
sentences.english: The traffic outside was terrible; many cars were stopped on the road, like a long dragon.

sentences.chinese: 他想起林先生之前告诉他的做法，在这种时候，不能随便相信任何人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ Lín xiānshēng zhīqián gàosù tā de zuòfǎ, zài zhè zhǒng shíhou, bùnéng suíbiàn xiāngxìn rènhé rén.
sentences.english: He remembered the method Mr. Lin had told him before: in times like these, you cannot trust anyone blindly.

sentences.chinese: 他需要一个计划来完成这次逃亡，实现他寻找真相的目标。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xūyào yī gè jìhuà lái wánchéng zhè cì táowáng, shíxiàn tā xúnzhǎo zhēnxiàng de mùbiāo.
sentences.english: He needed a plan to complete this escape and realize his goal of finding the truth.

sentences.chinese: 他走出家门，看到路边有一个很大的广告，上面写着一个艺术中心的参观活动。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu chū jiāmén, kàndào lùbiān yǒu yī gè hěn dà de guǎnggào, shàngmiàn xiězhe yī gè yìshù zhōngxīn de cānguān huódòng.
sentences.english: Walking out of the house, he saw a large advertisement by the road about a tour of an art center.

sentences.chinese: 那个中心叫作“城市之光”，离这里很近。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge zhōngxīn jiàozuò “Chéngshì zhī Guāng”, lí zhèlǐ hěn jìn.
sentences.english: That center was called "City Light," and it was very close to here.

sentences.chinese: 大卫想，如果他能参加那个活动，或许能暂时躲起来。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎng, rúguǒ tā néng cānjiā nàge huódòng, huòxǔ néng zànshí duǒ qǐlái.
sentences.english: David thought that if he could participate in that event, he might be able to hide for a while.

sentences.chinese: 他走在街上，感觉时间过得很快，现在已经是三点一刻了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu zài jiē shàng, gǎnjué shíjiān guò de hěn kuài, xiànzài yǐjīng shì sān diǎn yī kè le.
sentences.english: Walking on the street, he felt time passing quickly; it was already a quarter past three.

sentences.chinese: 他想起自己以前在学校写作文的时候，总是喜欢写关于冒险的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ yǐqián zài xuéxiào xiě zuòwén de shíhou, zǒng shì xǐhuan xiě guānyú màoxiǎn de gùshì.
sentences.english: He remembered when he used to write essays in school, he always liked writing stories about adventures.

sentences.chinese: 现在，他的生活变成了一个真正的冒险故事。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài, tā de shēnghuó biànchéng le yī gè zhēnzhèng de màoxiǎn gùshì.
sentences.english: Now, his life had turned into a real adventure story.

sentences.chinese: 他走进艺术中心，那里有很多实习的学生在工作。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu jìn yìshù zhōngxīn, nàlǐ yǒu hěnduō shíxí de xuéshēng zài gōngzuò.
sentences.english: He entered the art center, where many interns were working.

sentences.chinese: 一个学生走过来，问他需要什么帮助。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè xuéshēng zǒu guòlái, wèn tā xūyào shénme bāngzhù.
sentences.english: A student walked over and asked if he needed any help.

sentences.chinese: 大卫礼貌地回答，他只是想在里面度过一个下午。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi lǐmào de huídá, tā zhǐshì xiǎng zài lǐmiàn dùguò yī gè xiàwǔ.
sentences.english: David politely replied that he just wanted to spend an afternoon inside.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一个房间里放着一套旧的办公家具，他决定在那里坐一会儿。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào yī gè fángjiān lǐ fàngzhe yī tào jiù de bàngōng jiājù, tā juédìng zài nàlǐ zuò yīhuǐr.
sentences.english: He saw a set of old office furniture in a room and decided to sit there for a while.

sentences.chinese: 他开始复习笔记本上的那些线索，思考这些信息的实际作用。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kāishǐ fùxí bǐjìběn shàng de nàxiē xiànsuǒ, sīkǎo zhèxiē xìnxī de shíjì zuòyòng.
sentences.english: He began to review the clues in the notebook, thinking about the actual effect of this information.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，要做到绝对安全，他必须学会如何正确地使用这些秘密信息。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, yào zuòdào juéduì ānquán, tā bìxū xuéhuì rúhé zhèngquè de shǐyòng zhèxiē mìmì xìnxī.
sentences.english: He realized that to achieve absolute safety, he must learn how to correctly use this secret information.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他看到一个男人走进了大厅，那个人的样子像极了之前的追踪者。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, tā kàndào yī gè nánrén zǒu jìn le dàtīng, nàge rén de yàngzi xiàng jí le zhīqián de zhuīzōngzhě.
sentences.english: Suddenly, he saw a man enter the lobby; the man's appearance looked exactly like the previous pursuer.

sentences.chinese: 大卫感到很害怕，他差点哭了出来，但他强迫自己冷静下来。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi gǎndào hěn hàipà, tā chàdiǎn kū le chūlái, dàn tā qiángpò zìjǐ lěngjìng xiàlái.
sentences.english: David felt very scared and almost cried, but he forced himself to calm down.

sentences.chinese: 他想，他应该立刻离开这里，否则就要被发现了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, tā yīnggāi lìkè líkāi zhèlǐ, fǒuzé jiùyào bèi fāxiàn le.
sentences.english: He thought he should leave immediately, otherwise, he was going to be discovered.

sentences.chinese: 他不知道该怎么办，因为后门被锁上了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zhīdào gāi zěnme bàn, yīnwèi hòumén bèi suǒ shàng le.
sentences.english: He didn't know how to handle it because the back door was locked.

sentences.chinese: 这时，他想起林先生说过，这里的管理人员会为访客提供导览服务。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, tā xiǎngqǐ Lín xiānshēng shuōguo, zhèlǐ de guǎnlǐ rényuán huì wéi fǎngkè tígōng dǎolǎn fúwù.
sentences.english: At that moment, he remembered Mr. Lin saying that the management staff here would act as guides for visitors.

sentences.chinese: 他决定假装成一个游客，以此来掩盖自己的紧张。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juédìng jiǎzhuāng chéng yī gè yóukè, yǐ cǐ lái yǎngài zìjǐ de jǐnzhāng.
sentences.english: He decided to pretend to be a tourist to cover up his nervousness.

sentences.chinese: 他的心情开始变复杂，既好奇又恐惧。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de xīnqíng kāishǐ biàn fùzá, jì hàoqí yòu kǒngjù.
sentences.english: His mood began to change and become complex, both curious and fearful.

sentences.chinese: 他快速地走完最后一段走廊，终于找到了出口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kuàisù de zǒu wán zuìhòu yī duàn zǒuláng, zhōngyú zhǎodào le chūkǒu.
sentences.english: He quickly walked the final corridor and finally found the exit.

sentences.chinese: 他走出大门，呼吸到了新鲜的空气。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu chū dàmén, hūxī dào le xīnxiān de kōngqì.
sentences.english: He walked out the main door and breathed in the fresh air.

sentences.chinese: 但他发现，那辆黑色的车竟然已经等在门口了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tā fāxiàn, nà liàng hēisè de chē jìngrán yǐjīng děng zài ménkǒu le.
sentences.english: But he discovered that the black car was actually already waiting at the door.

sentences.chinese: 车窗缓缓降了下来，一个冷漠的声音响起。
sentences.pinyin: Chēchuāng huǎnhuǎn jiàng le xiàlái, yī gè lěngmò de shēngyīn xiǎngqǐ.
sentences.english: The window slowly rolled down, and a cold voice rang out.

sentences.chinese: “大卫，你终于来了。”
sentences.pinyin: “Dàwèi, nǐ zhōngyú lái le.”
sentences.english: "David, you've finally come."

sentences.chinese: 大卫愣住了，他不知道对方是谁，但对方似乎知道他的一切。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi lèng zhù le, tā bù zhīdào duìfāng shì shéi, dàn duìfāng sìhū zhīdào tā de yīqiè.
sentences.english: David froze; he didn't know who the other party was, but they seemed to know everything about him.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十四章：意外的选择

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着车里的男人，感到非常紧张。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe chē lǐ de nánrén, gǎndào fēicháng jǐnzhāng.
sentences.english: David looked at the man in the car and felt very nervous.

sentences.chinese: 男人对他说：“你必须跟我走，否则你的生活会变得很麻烦。”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén duì tā shuō: “Nǐ bìxū gēn wǒ zǒu, fǒuzé nǐ de shēnghuó huì biàn de hěn máfan.”
sentences.english: The man said to him, "You must come with me, otherwise your life will become very troublesome."

sentences.chinese: 大卫想起之前林先生提到过的那些警告，心中充满了不安。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎngqǐ zhīqián Lín xiānshēng tí dào guò de nàxiē jǐnggào, xīnzhōng chōngmǎn le bù'ān.
sentences.english: David recalled the warnings Mr. Lin had mentioned before, and his heart was filled with unease.

sentences.chinese: 他不知道这个男人是谁，但对方似乎懂得所有关于他父亲的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù zhīdào zhège nánrén shì shéi, dàn duìfāng sìhū dǒngde suǒyǒu guānyú tā fùqīn de mìmì.
sentences.english: He didn't know who this man was, but the other party seemed to understand all the secrets about his father.

sentences.chinese: 男人邀请大卫上车，往城市的另一边开去。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén yāoqǐng Dàwèi shàng chē, wǎng chéngshì de lìng yī biān kāi qù.
sentences.english: The man invited David into the car and drove towards the other side of the city.

sentences.chinese: 在车上，男人开始提出一个奇怪的要求。
sentences.pinyin: Zài chē shàng, nánrén kāishǐ tí chū yī gè qíguài de yāoqiú.
sentences.english: In the car, the man began to put forward a strange request.

sentences.chinese: 他说，他想让大卫成为他的助手，帮他找出笔记本中隐藏的地图。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, tā xiǎng ràng Dàwèi chéngwéi tā de zhùshǒu, bāng tā zhǎo chū bǐjìběn zhōng yǐncáng de dìtú.
sentences.english: He said he wanted David to become his assistant to help him find the map hidden in the notebook.

sentences.chinese: 大卫愣住了，他没有想到对方会这样对他。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi lèng zhù le, tā méiyǒu xiǎng dào duìfāng huì zhèyàng duì tā.
sentences.english: David was stunned; he had not anticipated that the other party would treat him this way.

sentences.chinese: 他问：“为什么是我？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn: “Wèishéme shì wǒ?”
sentences.english: He asked, "Why me?"

sentences.chinese: 男人解释说，大卫的父亲曾经是一个伟大的教育家，他在教学方法上很有名。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén jiěshì shuō, Dàwèi de fùqīn céngjīng shì yī gè wěidà de jiàoyùjiā, tā zài jiāoxué fāngfǎ shàng hěn yǒumíng.
sentences.english: The man explained that David's father had once been a great educator and was very famous for his teaching methods.

sentences.chinese: 他的父亲不仅教学生知识，更懂得如何教育一个人的内心。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de fùqīn bùjǐn jiāo xuéshēng zhīshì, gèng dǒngde rúhé jiàoyù yī gè rén de nèixīn.
sentences.english: His father not only taught students knowledge but also understood how to educate a person's heart.

sentences.chinese: 男人说：“我想通过你，提高我对你父亲研究的理解。”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng tōngguò nǐ, tígāo wǒ duì nǐ fùqīn yánjiū de lǐjiě.”
sentences.english: The man said, "I want to use you to improve my understanding of your father's research."

sentences.chinese: 大卫虽然害怕，但他愿意尝试了解真相。
