sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi suīrán hàipà, dàn tā yuànyì chángshì liǎojiě zhēnxiàng.
sentences.english: Although David was afraid, he was willing to try and learn the truth.

sentences.chinese: 他想起父亲生前的样子，决定勇敢面对。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ fùqīn shēng qián de yàngzi, juédìng yǒnggǎn miànduì.
sentences.english: He recalled his father's appearance before he passed away and decided to face it bravely.

sentences.chinese: 男人接着说，他打算带大卫去一个安静的地方，在那里他们可以安全地检查所有资料。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén jiēzhe shuō, tā dǎsuàn dài Dàwèi qù yī gè ānjìng de dìfāng, zài nàlǐ tāmen kěyǐ ānquán de jiǎnchá suǒyǒu zīliào.
sentences.english: The man continued, saying he planned to take David to a quiet place where they could safely examine all the materials.

sentences.chinese: 那个地方提供很好的服务，而且没有人会打扰他们。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge dìfāng tígōng hěn hǎo de fúwù, érqiě méiyǒu rén huì dǎrǎo tāmen.
sentences.english: That place provided excellent service, and no one would disturb them.

sentences.chinese: 大卫心中在数着时间，希望林先生能尽快找到他。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xīnzhōng zài shǔ zhe shíjiān, xīwàng Lín xiānshēng néng jǐnkuài zhǎodào tā.
sentences.english: David was counting the time in his heart, hoping Mr. Lin could find him as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 男人提到，如果你想改变现状，就得学会面对危险。
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén tí dào, rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng gǎibiàn xiànzhuàng, jiù děi xuéhuì miànduì wēixiǎn.
sentences.english: The man mentioned that if you want to change the current situation, you must learn to face danger.

sentences.chinese: 大卫意识到，他必须改掉胆小的习惯，才能在这个危险的世界生存。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi yìshí dào, tā bìxū gǎi diào dǎnxiǎo de xíguàn, cáinéng zài zhège wēixiǎn de shìjiè shēngcún.
sentences.english: David realized he must change his timid habits to survive in this dangerous world.

sentences.chinese: 车子开到了一个像酒店一样的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Chēzi kāi dào le yī gè xiàng jiǔdiàn yīyàng de dìfāng.
sentences.english: The car drove to a place that looked like a hotel.

sentences.chinese: 男人告诉大卫：“你可以先去洗澡，休息一下，我会照顾好你的安全。”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén gàosù Dàwèi: “Nǐ kěyǐ xiān qù xǐzǎo, xiūxí yīxià, wǒ huì zhàogù hǎo nǐ de ānquán.”
sentences.english: The man told David, "You can take a shower first and rest for a while; I will take care of your safety."

sentences.chinese: 大卫走进浴室，看着水流在手指间流过，心情复杂。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi zǒu jìn yùshì, kànzhe shuǐliú zài shǒuzhǐ jiān liú guò, xīnqíng fùzá.
sentences.english: David entered the bathroom, watching the water flow over his fingers, his emotions complex.

sentences.chinese: 他想起小时候和父亲一起去旅行的日子，那时候的生活简单而快乐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ xiǎoshíhòu hé fùqīn yīqǐ qù lǚxíng de rìzi, nà shíhòu de shēnghuó jiǎndān ér kuàilè.
sentences.english: He recalled the days when he traveled with his father as a child; life was simple and happy then.

sentences.chinese: 他突然想到，如果能找回那些记忆，也许能帮他解决现在的麻烦。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán xiǎng dào, rúguǒ néng zhǎo huí nàxiē jìyì, yěxǔ néng bāng tā jiějué xiànzài de máfan.
sentences.english: He suddenly thought that if he could recover those memories, perhaps he could help solve his current troubles.

sentences.chinese: 男人在门外喊道：“我已经帮你报名参加了一个研究小组，那里有你需要的答案。”
sentences.pinyin: Nánrén zài mén wài hǎn dào: “Wǒ yǐjīng bāng nǐ bàomíng cānjiā le yī gè yánjiū xiǎozǔ, nàlǐ yǒu nǐ xūyào de dá'àn.”
sentences.english: The man shouted from outside the door, "I have already signed you up for a research group; the answers you need are there."

sentences.chinese: 大卫走出浴室，看着镜子里的自己，感觉自己正在经历一个巨大的改变。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi zǒu chū yùshì, kànzhe jìngzi lǐ de zìjǐ, gǎnjué zìjǐ zhèngzài jīnglì yī gè jùdà de gǎibiàn.
sentences.english: David stepped out of the bathroom, looked at himself in the mirror, and felt he was undergoing a huge transformation.

sentences.chinese: 他求男人告诉他真相，但男人只是冷冷地笑了笑。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qiú nánrén gàosù tā zhēnxiàng, dàn nánrén zhǐshì lěnglěng de xiào le xiào.
sentences.english: He begged the man to tell him the truth, but the man only smiled coldly.

sentences.chinese: 大卫知道，对方并不完全懂他的心情。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi zhīdào, duìfāng bìng bù wánquán dǒng tā de xīnqíng.
sentences.english: David knew the other party didn't fully understand his feelings.

sentences.chinese: 他看着窗外，发现周围的环境变得更安静了，安静得可怕。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe chuāngwài, fāxiàn zhōuwéi de huánjìng biàn de gèng ānjìng le, ānjìng de kěpà.
sentences.english: He looked out the window and found the surrounding environment had become even quieter, frighteningly quiet.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，这里的每一个细节都经过精心检查。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, zhèlǐ de měi yī gè xìjié dōu jīngguò jīngxīn jiǎnchá.
sentences.english: He realized that every detail here had been carefully inspected.

sentences.chinese: 就在大卫准备询问更多细节时，他的手机突然响了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài Dàwèi zhǔnbèi xúnwèn gèng duō xìjié shí, tā de shǒujī tūrán xiǎng le.
sentences.english: Just as David was preparing to ask for more details, his phone suddenly rang.

sentences.chinese: 那是林先生发来的消息，只有简单的几个字：“快跑！”

sentences.english: It was a message from Mr. Lin, with only a few simple words: "Run fast!"

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十五章：最后的行动

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着手机上的通知，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe shǒujī shàng de tōngzhī, xīntiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: David looked at the notification on his phone, his heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 林先生的警告说明情况非常危险。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng de jǐnggào shuōmíng qíngkuàng fēicháng wēixiǎn.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin's warning indicated that the situation was very dangerous.

sentences.chinese: 他认为现在不能犹豫，必须立刻行动。
sentences.pinyin: Tā rènwéi xiànzài bùnéng yóuyù, bìxū lìkè xíngdòng.
sentences.english: He believed that he could not hesitate now and must take action immediately.

sentences.chinese: 他快速地选了一个方向，跑出了房间。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kuàisù de xuǎnle yīgè fāngxiàng, pǎo chūle fángjiān.
sentences.english: He quickly chose a direction and ran out of the room.

sentences.chinese: 他走过那条狭窄的小路，感觉时间在变慢。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒuguò nà tiáo xiǎzhǎi de xiǎolù, gǎnjué shíjiān zài biàn màn.
sentences.english: He walked past that narrow little road, feeling time slow down.

sentences.chinese: 他想起林先生曾经要求他练习逃跑的路线。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ Lín xiānshēng céngjīng yāoqiú tā liànxí táopǎo de lùxiàn.
sentences.english: He remembered that Mr. Lin had once required him to practice the escape routes.

sentences.chinese: 那时林先生说，练习等于生存，不能马虎。
sentences.pinyin: Nàshí Lín xiānshēng shuō, liànxí děngyú shēngcún, bùnéng mǎhu.
sentences.english: At that time, Mr. Lin said that practice equals survival, and one cannot be careless.

sentences.chinese: 大卫在心里重复着那个计划，一遍又一遍。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi zài xīnlǐ chóngfùzhe nàgè jìhuà, yībiàn yòu yībiàn.
sentences.english: David repeated the plan in his mind, over and over again.

sentences.chinese: 他知道这个计划是由几个简单的步骤组成。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhīdào zhège jìhuà shì yóu jǐ gè jiǎndān de bùzhòu zǔchéng.
sentences.english: He knew that this plan was composed of several simple steps.

sentences.chinese: 经过这段时间的压力，他能够冷静下来思考。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò zhè duàn shíjiān de yālì, tā nénggòu lěngjìng xiàlái sīkǎo.
sentences.english: After going through this period of pressure, he was able to think calmly.

sentences.chinese: 他发现自己的速度已经超过了之前的记录。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn zìjǐ de sùdù yǐjīng chāoguòle zhīqián de jìlù.
sentences.english: He found that his speed had already surpassed his previous record.

sentences.chinese: 他跑向公园，那里是他和林先生约好的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā pǎo xiàng gōngyuán, nàlǐ shì tā hé Lín xiānshēng yuē hǎo de dìfāng.
sentences.english: He ran toward the park, which was the place he and Mr. Lin had agreed upon.

sentences.chinese: 他看到林先生正走过来，脸色依然很严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào Lín xiānshēng zhèng zǒu guòlái, liǎnsè yīrán hěn yánsù.
sentences.english: He saw Mr. Lin coming over, his expression still very serious.

sentences.chinese: 林先生重视这个笔记本，因为里面有重要的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng zhòngshì zhège bǐjìběn, yīnwèi lǐmiàn yǒu zhòngyào de mìmì.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin valued this notebook because it contained important secrets.

sentences.chinese: 大卫请求林先生告诉他真相，不要再隐瞒了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi qǐngqiú Lín xiānshēng gàosù tā zhēnxiàng, bùyào zài yǐnmánle.
sentences.english: David requested Mr. Lin to tell him the truth and stop hiding it.

sentences.chinese: 林先生叹了口气，说真相有时很难称心如意。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng tànle kǒuqì, shuō zhēnxiàng yǒushí hěn nán chènxīn rúyì.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin sighed and said that the truth is sometimes hard to fit one's desires.

sentences.chinese: 他说，在这个世界上，安全算是一个奢侈的东西。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, zài zhège shìjiè shàng, ānquán suàn shì yīgè shēchǐ de dōngxī.
sentences.english: He said that in this world, safety is regarded as a luxury.

sentences.chinese: 他们开始进行最后的对话，讨论如何结束这场追逐。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen kāishǐ jìnxíng zuìhòu de duìhuà, tǎolùn rúhé jiéshù zhè chǎng zhuīzhú.
sentences.english: They began to conduct their final conversation, discussing how to end this chase.

sentences.chinese: 林先生告诉他，要通过一个通晓当地路的人才能离开。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng gàosù tā, yào tōngguò yīgè tōngxiǎo dāngdì lù de rén cáinéng líkāi.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin told him that they could only leave through someone who knows the local roads well.

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着自己简单的装扮，觉得自己像个普通学生。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe zìjǐ jiǎndān de zhuāngbàn, juéde zìjǐ xiàng gè pǔtōng xuéshēng.
sentences.english: David looked at his simple attire, feeling like an ordinary student.

sentences.chinese: 但林先生说，简单的样子反而能帮他隐藏。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn Lín xiānshēng shuō, jiǎndān de yàngzi fǎn'ér néng bāng tā yǐncáng.
sentences.english: But Mr. Lin said that a simple appearance could instead help him hide.

sentences.chinese: 他们决定在明天天亮前离开这个城市。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen juédìng zài míngtiān tiānliàng qián líkāi zhège chéngshì.
sentences.english: They decided to leave this city before dawn tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，远处再次响起了那个熟悉的发动机声音。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, yuǎnchù zàicì xiǎngqǐle nàgè shúxī de fādòngjī shēngyīn.
sentences.english: Just then, the familiar sound of an engine rang out again in the distance.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十六章：最后的逃脱

sentences.chinese: 那辆黑色的车离他们越来越近，发动机的声音非常难听。
sentences.pinyin: Nà liàng hēisè de chē lí tāmen yuè lái yuè jìn, fādòngjī de shēngyīn fēicháng nántīng.
sentences.english: That black car was getting closer and closer, and the sound of the engine was very unpleasant.

sentences.chinese: 林先生低声说：“快走，时间不够了！”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānsheng dīshēng shuō: “Kuài zǒu, shíjiān bù gòu le!”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin whispered, "Go quickly, there is not enough time!"

sentences.chinese: 大卫感到心里非常难过，因为他必须离开这个城市。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi gǎndào xīnlǐ fēicháng nánguò, yīnwèi tā bìxū líkāi zhège chéngshì.

sentences.chinese: 他们跑进一条绿色的森林小路，树木很多，可以帮他们隐藏。

sentences.chinese: 突然，大卫不小心踩到一块石头，脚掉在了一个深坑里。

sentences.chinese: 他的脚突然很疼，他觉得很难受，差点哭出来。

sentences.chinese: 林先生赶紧把他拉起来，但大卫的衣服弄得很脏，看起来很难看。

sentences.chinese: 林先生说：“不要担心，现在安全比衣服重要。”

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着远处的坏人，觉得那些人真的很可怕。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi kànzhe yuǎnchù de huàirén, juéde nàxiē rén zhēnde hěn kěpà.
sentences.english: David looked at the bad people in the distance and felt that those people were truly terrifying.

sentences.chinese: 他问林先生：“他们为什么要卖掉我们父亲的秘密？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn Lín xiānsheng: “Tāmen wèishéme yào mài diào wǒmen fùqīn de mìmì?”
sentences.english: He asked Mr. Lin, "Why did they sell out our father's secret?"

sentences.chinese: 林先生叹气说：“贪心是有坏处的，他们只想要钱。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānsheng tànqì shuō: “Tānxīn shì yǒu huàichu de, tāmen zhǐ xiǎng yào qián.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin sighed and said, "Greed has its harms; they only wanted money."

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得现在的处境不如以前安静的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi juéde xiànzài de chǔjìng bùrú yǐqián ānjìng de shēnghuó.
sentences.english: David felt that the current situation was not as good as his previous quiet life.

sentences.chinese: 他看着林先生，有些不满地问：“我们现在去哪里？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe Lín xiānsheng, yǒuxiē bùmǎn de wèn: “Wǒmen xiànzài qù nǎlǐ?”
sentences.english: He looked at Mr. Lin and asked somewhat discontentedly, "Where are we going now?"

sentences.chinese: 林先生说：“我们要去一个短途车站，那里有离开这里的车。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānsheng shuō: “Wǒmen yào qù yī gè duǎntú chēzhàn, nàlǐ yǒu líkāi zhèlǐ de chē.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lin said, "We need to go to a short-distance station; there are cars leaving here."

sentences.chinese: 大卫想走快一点，但林先生说：“不行，你的脚受伤了，要慢慢走。”
sentences.pinyin: Dàwèi xiǎng zǒu kuài yīdiǎn, dàn Lín xiānsheng shuō: “Bùxíng, nǐ de jiǎo shòushāng le, yào mànman zǒu.”
sentences.english: David wanted to walk faster, but Mr. Lin said, "That won't do, your foot is injured; you must walk slowly."

sentences.chinese: 走在路上，大卫低着头，思考着未来的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Zǒu zài lùshàng, Dàwèi dīzhe tóu, sīkǎo zhe wèilái de shēnghuó.
sentences.english: Walking on the road, David lowered his head, thinking about his future life.

sentences.chinese: 他不好意思地对林先生说：“谢谢你一直帮我。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā bù hǎoyìsi de duì Lín xiānsheng shuō: “Xièxiè nǐ yīzhí bāng wǒ.”
sentences.english: He said to Mr. Lin embarrassedly, "Thank you for helping me all this time."

sentences.chinese: 林先生笑了，轻轻推了一下大卫的肩膀。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānsheng xiào le, qīngqīng tuī le yīxià Dàwèi de jiānbǎng.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin smiled and gently pushed David's shoulder.

sentences.chinese: 他们终于看到了车站，但门口站着一个穿着黑衣服的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zhōngyú kàndào le chēzhàn, dàn ménkǒu zhànzhe yī gè chuānzhe hēiyīfu de rén.
sentences.english: They finally saw the station, but a person dressed in black was standing at the entrance.

sentences.chinese: 那个人看着大卫，冷冷地笑了，手里拿着那个笔记本。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè rén kànzhe Dàwèi, lěnglěng de xiào le, shǒulǐ názhe nà gè bǐjìběn.
sentences.english: That person looked at David, smiled coldly, and was holding that notebook in his hand.

sentences.pinyin: Lóng huídá dào: “Nǐ de xuètǒng juédìng le nǐ nénggòu zhǎngkòng fēng, nàme nǐ jiùshì bèi xuǎnzhòng de rén.”
sentences.english: The dragon replied, "Your bloodline determines that you can control the wind, so you are the chosen one."

sentences.chinese: 林风看着自己的手，心想：我怎么会有这么大的力量？
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn zhe zìjǐ de shǒu, xīn xiǎng: wǒ zěnme huì yǒu zhème dà de lìliàng?
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at his hand and thought: how can I have so much power?

sentences.chinese: 他觉得这种感觉正好，就像找到了失踪的碎片。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juéde zhè zhǒng gǎnjué zhènghǎo, jiù xiàng zhǎodào le shīzōng de suìpiàn.
sentences.english: He felt this feeling was just right, like finding a missing piece.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，他不能再像那样生活在底层了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, tā bùnéng zài xiàng nà yàng shēnghuó zài dǐcéng le.
sentences.english: He realized he could no longer live in the lower levels like that.

sentences.chinese: 他必须离开这里，去寻找真正的力量。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū líkāi zhèlǐ, qù xúnzhǎo zhēnzhèng de lìliàng.
sentences.english: He had to leave here to find true power.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，城市的警卫发现了他们。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, chéngshì de jǐngwèi fāxiàn le tāmen.
sentences.english: Just then, the city guards discovered them.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 2: Escaping the City of Shadows

sentences.chinese: 警卫们大声喊道：“站住！不要跑！”
sentences.pinyin: Jǐng wèi men dà shēng hǎn dào: “Zhàn zhù! Bù yào pǎo!”
sentences.english: The guards shouted loudly, "Stop! Do not run!"

sentences.chinese: 林风感到心里很急，因为他知道被抓住会很可怕。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎn dào xīn lǐ hěn jí, yīn wèi tā zhī dào bèi zhuā zhù huì hěn kě pà.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt urgent in his heart because he knew being caught would be dreadful.

sentences.chinese: 他直接看向那些士兵，发现他们的盔甲亮得像镜子一样。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhí jiē kàn xiàng nà xiē shì bīng, fā xiàn tā men de kuī jiǎ liàng de xiàng jìng zi yī yàng.
sentences.english: He looked directly at the soldiers and found their armor as bright as mirrors.

sentences.chinese: 这些警卫的动作非常准确，很快就堵住了所有的路。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiē jǐng wèi de dòng zuò fēi cháng zhǔn què, hěn kuài jiù dǔ zhù le suǒ yǒu de lù.
sentences.english: These guards' movements were very accurate, and they quickly blocked all the roads.

sentences.chinese: 林风意识到，这里的法律并不公平，底层的人永远没有平等的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yì shí dào, zhè lǐ de fǎ lǜ bìng bù gōng píng, dǐ céng de rén yǒng yuǎn méi yǒu píng děng de shēng huó.
sentences.english: Lin Feng realized that the laws here were not fair; people at the bottom never had an equal life.

sentences.chinese: 他一直奔跑，试图寻找一个安全的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yī zhí bēn pǎo, shì tú xún zhǎo yī gè ān quán de dì fāng.
sentences.english: He kept running, trying to find a safe place.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一个小巷，觉得那里比较合适。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào yī gè xiǎo xiàng, jué dé nà lǐ bǐ jiào hé shì.
sentences.english: He saw a small alley and felt it was more suitable.

sentences.chinese: 在巷子里，他遇到了一个特别的小女孩。
sentences.pinyin: Zài xiàng zi lǐ, tā yù dào le yī gè tè bié de xiǎo nǚ hái.
sentences.english: In the alley, he met a very special little girl.

sentences.chinese: 她长得很漂亮，眼睛里闪烁着好奇的光。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǎng de hěn piào liang, yǎn jīng lǐ shǎn shuò zhe hào qí de guāng.
sentences.english: She was very beautiful, with a curious light flashing in her eyes.

sentences.chinese: 她看着林风，笑着说：“你的魔力很有意思。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe Lín Fēng, xiào zhe shuō: “Nǐ de mó lì hěn yǒu yì si.”
sentences.english: She looked at Lin Feng and said with a smile, "Your magic is very interesting."

sentences.chinese: 林风很惊讶，因为这个女孩看起来很可爱，但她能看到他的力量。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hěn jīng yà, yīn wèi zhè gè nǚ hái kàn qǐ lái hěn kě ài, dàn tā néng kàn dào tā de lì liàng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng was surprised because the girl looked very adorable, yet she could see his power.

sentences.chinese: 女孩说，她正是这个城市的秘密守护者。
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ hái shuō, tā zhèng shì zhè gè chéng shì de mì mì shǒu hù zhě.
sentences.english: The girl said that she was precisely the secret guardian of this city.

sentences.chinese: 她告诉林风，真正的力量不是用来打架的，而是为了自由。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù Lín Fēng, zhēn zhèng de lì liàng bú shì yòng lái dǎ jià de, ér shì wèi le zì yóu.
sentences.english: She told Lin Feng that true power is not for fighting, but for freedom.

sentences.chinese: 林风觉得她的想法不错，这与他之前的想法不同。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jué dé tā de xiǎng fǎ bù cuò, zhè yǔ tā zhī qián de xiǎng fǎ bù tóng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt her idea was not bad; it was different from his previous thoughts.

sentences.chinese: 女孩热情地邀请他进入一个隐藏的门。
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ hái rè qíng de yāo qǐng tā jìn rù yī gè yǐn cáng de mén.
sentences.english: The girl enthusiastically invited him into a hidden door.

sentences.chinese: 门后是一个高级的魔法空间，那里的一切都非常漂亮。
sentences.pinyin: Mén hòu shì yī gè gāo jí de mó fǎ kōng jiān, nà lǐ de yī qiè dōu fēi cháng piào liang.
sentences.english: Behind the door was a high-level magic space, where everything was very beautiful.

sentences.chinese: 林风看到天上的星星在室内闪烁，这实在太神奇了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn dào tiān shàng de xīng xīng zài shì nèi shǎn shuò, zhè shí zài tài shén qí le.
sentences.english: Lin Feng saw the stars in the sky twinkling indoors; this was indeed too magical.

sentences.chinese: 女孩说：“在这个空间里，实际的规则和外面完全相同。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ hái shuō: “Zài zhè gè kōng jiān lǐ, shí jì de guī zé hé wài miàn wán quán xiāng tóng.”
sentences.english: The girl said, "In this space, the actual rules are exactly the same as outside."

sentences.chinese: 林风问：“我怎么才能学会这种高级魔法？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng wèn: “Wǒ zěn me cái néng xué huì zhè zhǒng gāo jí mó fǎ?”
sentences.english: Lin Feng asked, "How can I learn this kind of advanced magic?"

sentences.chinese: 女孩回答：“你必须有信心，并且做出正确的选择。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ hái huí dá: “Nǐ bì xū yǒu xìn xīn, bìng qiě zuò chū zhèng què de xuǎn zé.”
sentences.english: The girl replied, "You must have confidence and make the correct choice."

sentences.chinese: 林风感谢她的帮助，他觉得这个女孩虽然年纪小，但心智很熟。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎn xiè tā de bāng zhù, tā jué dé zhè gè nǚ hái suī rán nián jì xiǎo, dàn xīn zhì hěn shú.
sentences.english: Lin Feng thanked her for her help; he felt that although the girl was young, her mind was mature.

sentences.chinese: 他发现自己的手依然在疼，那是刚才释放魔力留下的痕迹。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn zì jǐ de shǒu yī rán zài téng, nà shì gāng cái shì fàng mó lì liú xià de hén jì.
sentences.english: He found that his hand still hurt; it was a mark left by releasing magic just now.

sentences.chinese: 女孩告诉他，如果他故意地控制能量，疼痛就会消失。
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ hái gào sù tā, rú guǒ tā gù yì de kòng zhì néng liàng, téng tòng jiù huì xiāo shī.
sentences.english: The girl told him that if he deliberately controlled the energy, the pain would disappear.

sentences.chinese: 林风尝试了一下，发现这个方法确实正确。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng cháng shì le yī xià, fā xiàn zhè gè fāng fǎ què shí zhèng què.
sentences.english: Lin Feng tried it and found that this method was indeed correct.

sentences.chinese: 女孩说，每个人的魔力都不同，但追求自由的心是相同的。
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ hái shuō, měi gè rén de mó lì dōu bù tóng, dàn zhuī qiú zì yóu de xīn shì xiāng tóng de.
sentences.english: The girl said that everyone's magic is different, but the heart that pursues freedom is the same.

sentences.chinese: 她告诉林风，他必须离开这个城市，去寻找一个真正的地方学习。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù Lín Fēng, tā bì xū lí kāi zhè gè chéng shì, qù xún zhǎo yī gè zhēn zhèng de dì fāng xué xí.
sentences.english: She told Lin Feng that he must leave this city to find a genuine place to study.

sentences.chinese: 林风看着这个温暖的空间，觉得这里比阴冷的底层好得多。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn zhe zhè gè wēn nuǎn de kōng jiān, jué dé zhè lǐ bǐ yīn lěng de dǐ céng hǎo dé duō.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at this warm space and felt it was much better than the cold bottom level.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，主要的问题是他还没有掌握控制力量的方法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, zhǔ yào de wèn tí shì tā hái méi yǒu zhǎng wò kòng zhì lì liàng de fāng fǎ.
sentences.english: He realized the main problem was that he had not yet mastered the method of controlling power.

sentences.chinese: 他必须学会如何让魔力变得稳定，而不是随意爆发。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì xū xué huì rú hé ràng mó lì biàn dé wěn dìng, ér bú shì suí yì bào fā.
sentences.english: He must learn how to make the magic stable instead of bursting randomly.

sentences.chinese: 女孩说：“你一定能成功，因为你拥有纯净的灵魂。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǚ hái shuō: “Nǐ yī dìng néng chéng gōng, yīn wèi nǐ yōng yǒu chún jìng de líng hún.”
sentences.english: The girl said, "You will certainly succeed because you possess a pure soul."

sentences.chinese: 林风听了之后，心中充满了信心。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng tīng le zhī hòu, xīn zhōng chōng mǎn le xìn xīn.
sentences.english: After hearing this, Lin Feng's heart was filled with confidence.

sentences.chinese: 他清楚地知道，自己再也不能回到过去的生活了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā qīng chu de zhī dào, zì jǐ zài yě bù néng huí dào guò qù de shēng huó le.
sentences.english: He knew clearly that he could never go back to his past life.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果每个人都能平等地学习魔法，世界会变得更好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rú guǒ měi gè rén dōu píng děng de xué xí mó fǎ, shì jiè huì biàn dé gèng hǎo.
sentences.english: He thought that if everyone could learn magic equally, the world would become better.

sentences.chinese: 但现实是，只有少数权贵才能接触到这些知识。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiàn shí shì, zhǐ yǒu shǎo shù quán guì cái néng jiē chù dào zhè xiē zhī shi.
sentences.english: But the reality is that only a few elites can access this knowledge.

sentences.chinese: 林风决定用自己的方式去改变这个不公平的世界。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jué dìng yòng zì jǐ de fāng shì qù gǎi biàn zhè gè bù gōng píng de shì jiè.
sentences.english: Lin Feng decided to use his own way to change this unfair world.

sentences.chinese: 他再次看向那个女孩，心中充满了感激。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài cì kàn xiàng nà gè nǚ hái, xīn zhōng chōng mǎn le gǎn jī.
sentences.english: He looked at the girl again, his heart full of gratitude.

sentences.chinese: 他们一起走向森林的出口，那里是通往新世界的路。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men yī qǐ zǒu xiàng sēn lín de chū kǒu, nà lǐ shì tōng wǎng xīn shì jiè de lù.
sentences.english: Together they walked toward the forest exit, the road leading to a new world.

sentences.chinese: 就在他们快要离开时，天空中突然响起了一声巨大的龙吼。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tā men kuài yào lí kāi shí, tiān kōng zhōng tū rán xiǎng qǐ le yī shēng jù dà de lóng hǒu.
sentences.english: Just as they were about to leave, a huge dragon roar suddenly sounded in the sky.

sentences.chinese: 林风抬头一看，一只黑色的巨龙正向他们飞来。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng tái tóu yī kàn, yī zhī hēi sè de jù lóng zhèng xiàng tā men fēi lái.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked up and saw a black giant dragon flying toward them.

sentences.chinese: 黑色的巨龙在空中盘旋，它的眼睛像火一样红。
sentences.pinyin: Hēisè de jùlóng zài kōngzhōng pánxuán, tā de yǎnjīng xiàng huǒ yīyàng hóng.
sentences.english: The black dragon circled in the sky, its eyes red as fire.

sentences.chinese: 林风和女孩快速跑向森林深处，直到他们看到一个巨大的湖。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hé nǚhái kuàisù pǎo xiàng sēnlín shēnchù, zhídào tāmen kàndào yīgè jùdà de hú.
sentences.english: Lin Feng and the girl ran quickly into the depths of the forest until they saw a huge lake.

sentences.chinese: 湖边有一座白色的城堡，那里是传说中的魔法学院。
sentences.pinyin: Hú biān yǒu yī zuò báisè de chéngbǎo, nàlǐ shì chuánshuō zhōng de mófǎ xuéyuàn.
sentences.english: Beside the lake was a white castle, the legendary Magic Academy.

sentences.chinese: 林风记得在旧书里读过，这座学院像一个国际中心，吸引了来自整个地球的魔法师。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jìdé zài jiù shū lǐ dúguò, zhè zuò xuéyuàn xiàng yīgè guójì zhōngxīn, xīyǐnle láizì zhěnggè dìqiú de mófǎshī.
sentences.english: Lin Feng remembered reading in old books that this academy was like an international center, attracting mages from all over the Earth.

sentences.chinese: 在这个世界，人们把这里称为真理之塔。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège shìjiè, rénmen bǎ zhèlǐ chēngwéi zhēnlǐ zhī tǎ.
sentences.english: In this world, people call this place the Tower of Truth.

sentences.chinese: 他们走进城堡，发现这里像一个巨大的校园。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒu jìn chéngbǎo, fāxiàn zhèlǐ xiàng yīgè jùdà de xiàoyuán.
sentences.english: They entered the castle and found that it was like a giant campus.

sentences.chinese: 一个穿着长袍的教师走过来，他的眼神很严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè chuānzhe chángpáo de jiàoshī zǒu guòlái, tā de yǎnshén hěn yánsù.
sentences.english: A teacher wearing a robe walked over, his gaze very serious.

sentences.chinese: “你们终于来了，”教师说，“这里的学生分为初级和中级。”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐmen zhōngyú láile,” jiàoshī shuō, “zhèlǐ de xuéshēng fēnwéi chūjí hé zhōngjí.”
sentences.english: "You have finally arrived," the teacher said, "students here are divided into primary and middle levels."

sentences.chinese: 林风好奇地问：“这里有多少学生？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hàoqí de wèn: “Zhèlǐ yǒu duōshǎo xuéshēng?”
sentences.english: Lin Feng asked curiously, "How many students are here?"

sentences.chinese: 教师回答说：“人数很多，但能留到最后的很少。”
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshī huídá shuō: “Rénshù hěnduō, dàn néng liú dào zuìhòu de hěn shǎo.”
sentences.english: The teacher replied, "The number of people is large, but few can stay until the end."

sentences.chinese: 教师带他们走进一间教室，里面有很多椅子和座位。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshī dài tāmen zǒu jìn yī jiān jiàoshì, lǐmiàn yǒu hěnduō yǐzi hé zuòwèi.
sentences.english: The teacher took them into a classroom, which had many chairs and seats.

sentences.chinese: 林风坐在一个木椅子上，感到心跳很快。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zuò zài yīgè mù yǐzi shàng, gǎndào xīntiào hěn kuài.
sentences.english: Lin Feng sat on a wooden chair, feeling his heart beat fast.

sentences.chinese: 教师告诉他们，这里的学习不像中小学那样简单。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshī gàosù tāmen, zhèlǐ de xuéxí bù xiàng zhōng xiǎo xué nàyàng jiǎndān.
sentences.english: The teacher told them that studying here was not as simple as in middle and elementary school.

sentences.chinese: 他拿出一个玻璃瓶子，里面装着发光的蓝色液体。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū yīgè bōlí píngzi, lǐmiàn zhuāngzhe fāguāng de lán sè yètǐ.
sentences.english: He took out a glass bottle containing a glowing blue liquid.

sentences.chinese: “这是魔法信号，”教师解释道，“当它发光时，就意味着危险。”
sentences.pinyin: “Zhè shì mófǎ xìnhào,” jiàoshī jiěshì dào, “dāng tā fāguāng shí, jiù yìwèizhe wēixiǎn.”
sentences.english: "This is a magic signal," the teacher explained, "when it glows, it means danger."

sentences.chinese: 林风注意到教师的手腕上戴着一块古怪的手表，指针在反方向旋转。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhùyì dào jiàoshī de shǒuwàn shàng dàizhe yī kuài gǔguài de shǒubiǎo, zhǐzhēn zài fǎn fāngxiàng xuánzhuǎn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng noticed the teacher wore a strange wristwatch on his wrist, the hands rotating in the opposite direction.

sentences.chinese: 教师开始讲述一个古老的故事，关于世界在冬天和夏天的平衡。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshī kāishǐ jiǎngshù yīgè gǔlǎo de gùshì, guānyú shìjiè zài dōngtiān hé xiàtiān de pínghéng.
sentences.english: The teacher began to tell an ancient story about the balance of the world in winter and summer.

sentences.chinese: 他说，当气温下降，温度变得极低时，黑龙会苏醒。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, dāng qìwēn xiàjiàng, wēndù biàn dé jí dī shí, hēilóng huì sùxǐng.
sentences.english: He said that when the air temperature drops and the temperature becomes extremely low, the black dragon awakens.

sentences.chinese: 此时，窗外突然传来了奇怪的动物叫声，听起来像是一只巨大的狗。
sentences.pinyin: Cǐshí, chuāngwài tūrán chuánláile qíguài de dòngwù jiàoshēng, tīng qǐlái xiàng shì yī zhǐ jùdà de gǒu.
sentences.english: At that moment, strange animal sounds suddenly came from outside the window, sounding like a giant dog.

sentences.chinese: 教师指着黑板上的一个句子，告诉林风这是开启禁忌之门的咒语。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshī zhǐzhe hēibǎn shàng de yīgè jùzi, gàosù Lín Fēng zhè shì kāiqǐ jìjì zhī mén de zhòuyǔ.
sentences.english: The teacher pointed to a sentence on the blackboard and told Lin Feng that this was the incantation to open the forbidden door.

sentences.chinese: 林风发现这个学院不仅教魔法，还有很多奇怪的活动。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng fāxiàn zhège xuéyuàn bùjǐn jiào mófǎ, hái yǒu hěnduō qíguài de huódòng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng discovered that this academy not only taught magic but also had many strange activities.

sentences.chinese: 比如，有些学生在操场上玩排球，他们穿着特制的球鞋。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐrú, yǒuxiē xuéshēng zài cāochǎng shàng wán páiqiú, tāmen chuānzhe tèzhì de qiúxié.
sentences.english: For example, some students were playing volleyball on the playground, wearing special athletic shoes.

sentences.chinese: 一个魔法球队正在训练，球在空中飞快地移动，它们仿佛有自己的生命。
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè mófǎ qiúduì zhèngzài xùnliàn, qiú zài kōngzhōng fēikuài de yídòng, tāmen fǎngfú yǒu zìjǐ de shēngmìng.
sentences.english: A magic sports team was training, the ball moving quickly in the air; they seemed to have a life of their own.

sentences.chinese: 这里的学生被分成了很多小组，共同研究魔法。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de xuéshēng bèi fēnchéngle hěnduō xiǎozǔ, gòngtóng yánjiū mófǎ.
sentences.english: The students here were divided into many small groups to study magic together.

sentences.chinese: 林风在图书馆里遇到了一位著名的作家，他正在写关于黑龙的书。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zài túshūguǎn lǐ yùdàole yī wèi zhùmíng de zuòjiā, tā zhèngzài xiě guānyú hēilóng de shū.
sentences.english: Lin Feng met a famous author in the library who was writing a book about the black dragon.

sentences.chinese: 作家告诉他，这里的住房很舒适，但每个人必须遵守规则。
sentences.pinyin: Zuòjiā gàosù tā, zhèlǐ de zhùfáng hěn shūshì, dàn měi gèrén bìxū zūnshǒu guīzé.
sentences.english: The author told him that the housing here was comfortable, but everyone must follow the rules.

sentences.chinese: 突然，校园里传来了紧急新闻：黑龙已经找到了这里。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, xiàoyuán lǐ chuánláile jǐnjí xīnwén: hēilóng yǐjīng zhǎodàole zhèlǐ.
sentences.english: Suddenly, urgent news spread across the campus: the black dragon had already found this place.

sentences.chinese: 林风想起今天早上还没吃早餐，肚子响了一声。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎngqǐ jīntiān zǎoshang hái méi chī zǎocān, dùzi xiǎngle yī shēng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng remembered he hadn't eaten breakfast this morning, and his stomach growled.

sentences.chinese: 他看向窗外，湖水开始沸腾，天空变成了血红色。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng chuāngwài, húshuǐ kāishǐ fèitěng, tiānkōng biànchéngle xuè hóngsè.
sentences.english: He looked out the window; the lake water began to boil, and the sky turned blood red.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙巨大的身影再次出现，遮住了所有的光。
sentences.pinyin: Hēilóng jùdà de shēnyǐng zàicì chūxiàn, zhēzhùle suǒyǒu de guāng.
sentences.english: The huge figure of the black dragon appeared again, blocking all the light.

sentences.chinese: 林风站起来，他感觉到体内的魔力正在觉醒。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhàn qǐlái, tā gǎnjué dào tǐnèi de mólì zhèngzài juéxǐng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng stood up, feeling the magic power within his body awakening.

sentences.chinese: 他必须保护这个地方，保护那些信任他的人们。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū bǎohù zhège dìfāng, bǎohù nàxiē xìnrèn tā de rénmen.
sentences.english: He must protect this place and the people who trust him.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙的阴影笼罩了整个学院，天空变成了血红色。
sentences.pinyin: Hēilóng de yǐnyǐng lǒngzhào le zhěnggè xuéyuàn, tiānkōng biànchéng le xuèhóngsè.
sentences.english: The black dragon's shadow loomed over the entire academy, and the sky turned blood-red.

sentences.chinese: 林风感觉到自己的腿在发抖，但他的眼睛里充满了勇气。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎnjué dào zìjǐ de tuǐ zài fādǒu, dàn tā de yǎnjīng lǐ chōngmǎn le yǒngqì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt his legs shaking, but his eyes were full of courage.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一位穿着黑色长袍的老师走过来，他叫海老师。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, yī wèi chuānzhe hēisè chángpáo de lǎoshī zǒu guòlái, tā jiào Hǎi lǎoshī.
sentences.english: At that moment, a teacher wearing a black robe walked over; his name was Teacher Hai.

sentences.chinese: 海老师的脸很严肃，他告诉林风：“快跟我来，这里太危险了！”
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi lǎoshī de liǎn hěn yánsù, tā gàosù Lín Fēng: “Kuài gēn wǒ lái, zhèlǐ tài wēixiǎn le!”
sentences.english: Teacher Hai's face was very serious, and he told Lin Feng: "Come with me quickly, it is too dangerous here!"

sentences.chinese: 他们跑进了一间巨大的课堂，这里像是一个古老的博物馆。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen pǎo jìn le yī jiàn jùdà de kètáng, zhèlǐ xiàng shì yīgè gǔlǎo de bówùguǎn.
sentences.english: They ran into a huge classroom, which looked like an ancient museum.

sentences.chinese: 墙上挂着很多画，其中一张画是一个著名的画家画的。
sentences.pinyin: Qiáng shàng guàzhe hěnduō huà, qízhōng yī zhāng huà shì yīgè zhùmíng de huàjiā huà de.
sentences.english: Many paintings hung on the wall, one of which was painted by a famous painter.

sentences.chinese: 画里是一个寒冷的秋天，气温在零下十度。
sentences.pinyin: Huà lǐ shì yīgè hánlěng de qiūtiān, qìwēn zài língxià shí dù.
sentences.english: In the painting, it was a cold autumn, and the temperature was ten degrees below zero.

sentences.chinese: 在画的旁边，有一个奇怪的物体，看起来像是一个巨大的篮球，但它在发光。
sentences.pinyin: Zài huà de pángbiān, yǒu yīgè qíguài de wùtǐ, kàn qǐlái xiàng shì yīgè jùdà de lánqiú, dàn tā zài fāguāng.
sentences.english: Beside the painting, there was a strange object that looked like a huge basketball, but it was glowing.

sentences.chinese: 海老师说，这里的知识不仅是魔法，还有像科学家那样研究自然的方法。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi lǎoshī shuō, zhèlǐ de zhīshí bùjǐn shì mófǎ, hái yǒu xiàng kēxuéjiā nàyàng yánjiū zìrán de fāngfǎ.
sentences.english: Teacher Hai said that the knowledge here was not only magic, but also methods of studying nature like a scientist.

sentences.chinese: 林风看到黑板上写着一种古老的语言，那是龙的文字。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàndào hēibǎn shàng xiězhe yī zhǒng gǔlǎo de yǔyán, nà shì lóng de wénzì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng saw an ancient language written on the blackboard; it was the script of dragons.

sentences.chinese: 海老师说：“在我的组长看来，学习这种语言是保护世界的唯一办法。”
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi lǎoshī shuō: “Zài wǒ de zǔzhǎng kàn lái, xuéxí zhè zhǒng yǔyán shì bǎohù shìjiè de wéiyī bànfǎ.”
sentences.english: Teacher Hai said, "In my group leader's view, learning this language is the only way to protect the world."

sentences.chinese: 林风突然觉得肚子很难受，因为他还没吃食物。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng tūrán juéde dùzi hěn nánshòu, yīnwèi tā hái méi chī shíwù.
sentences.english: Lin Feng suddenly felt uncomfortable in his stomach because he hadn't eaten any food.

sentences.chinese: 海老师指了指桌子，那里有一盘烤鸡和一副筷子。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi lǎoshī zhǐ zhǐ zhuōzi, nàlǐ yǒu yī pán kǎojī hé yī fù kuàizi.
sentences.english: Teacher Hai pointed to the table, where there was a plate of roast chicken and a pair of chopsticks.

sentences.chinese: 林风快速地吃了起来，他觉得这比听笑话儿更让他开心。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kuàisù de chī le qǐlái, tā juéde zhè bǐ tīng xiàohuar5 gèng ràng tā kāixīn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng began to eat quickly; he felt this made him happier than listening to a joke.

sentences.chinese: 突然，窗外传来了巨大的响声，像是有很多车辆在碰撞。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, chuāngwài chuánlái le jùdà de xiǎngshēng, xiàng shì yǒu hěnduō chēliàng zài pèngzhuàng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a huge sound came from outside the window, as if many vehicles were colliding.

sentences.chinese: 他看向窗外，看到一辆奇怪的金属车在飞快地移动。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng chuāngwài, kàndào yī liàng qíguài de jīnshǔ chē zài fēikuài de yídòng.
sentences.english: He looked out the window and saw a strange metal vehicle moving rapidly.

sentences.chinese: 林风想离开这个房间去战斗，但海老师制止了他。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎng líkāi zhège fángjiān qù zhàndòu, dàn Hǎi lǎoshī zhìzhǐ le tā.
sentences.english: Lin Feng wanted to leave the room to fight, but Teacher Hai stopped him.

sentences.chinese: “走开！现在还不是时候，”海老师大声说。
sentences.pinyin: “Zǒukāi! Xiànzài hái bùshì shíhou,” Hǎi lǎoshī dàshēng shuō.
sentences.english: "Go away! Now is not the time," Teacher Hai said loudly.

sentences.chinese: 林风低头看了看自己的鞋，发现鞋底在发光。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng dītóu kàn le kàn zìjǐ de xié, fāxiàn xiédǐ zài fāguāng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked down at his shoes and found the soles were glowing.

sentences.chinese: 这时，房间里响起了奇怪的音乐，那是来自远古的召唤。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, fángjiān lǐ xiǎngqǐ le qíguài de yīnyuè, nà shì láizì yuǎngǔ de zhàohuàn.
sentences.english: At that moment, strange music sounded in the room; it was a summons from ancient times.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙在外面咆哮，它的声音让整个建筑都在颤抖。
sentences.pinyin: Hēilóng zài wàimiàn páoxiào, tā de shēngyīn ràng zhěnggè jiànzhù dōu zài chàndǒu.
sentences.english: The black dragon roared outside, and its voice made the entire building tremble.

sentences.chinese: 林风意识到，他必须学会控制体内的魔力才能生存。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yìshí dào, tā bìxū xuéhuì kòngzhì tǐnèi de mólì cáinéng shēngcún.
sentences.english: Lin Feng realized that he must learn to control the magic within his body to survive.

sentences.chinese: 他看向海老师，问他黑龙到底想要什么。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn xiàng Hǎi lǎoshī, wèn tā hēilóng dàodǐ xiǎng yào shénme.
sentences.english: He looked at Teacher Hai and asked him what the black dragon actually wanted.

sentences.chinese: 海老师沉默了，眼神中透露出深深的担忧。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi lǎoshī chénmò le, yǎnshén zhōng tòulù chū shēnshēn de dānyōu.
sentences.english: Teacher Hai fell silent, his eyes revealing deep worry.

sentences.chinese: 窗外的血红色天空突然裂开了，一个巨大的黑洞出现了。
sentences.pinyin: Chuāngwài de xuèhóngsè tiānkōng tūrán lièkāi le, yīgè jùdà de hēidòng chūxiàn le.
sentences.english: The blood-red sky outside the window suddenly split open, and a huge black hole appeared.

chapters.title_chinese: 第五章：血色天空下的秘密
chapters.title_english: Chapter 5: Secrets Under the Blood-Red Sky

sentences.chinese: 黑洞在红色天空中心旋转，像一只巨大的眼睛。
sentences.pinyin: Hēidòng zài hóngsè tiānkōng zhōngxīn xuánzhuǎn, xiàng yī zhǐ jùdà de yǎnjīng.
sentences.english: The black hole swirled in the center of the red sky, like a giant eye.

sentences.chinese: 海老师走到墙边，他的脸色变得很苍白。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi lǎoshī zǒu dào qiáng biān, tā de liǎnsè biànde hěn cāngbái.
sentences.english: Teacher Hai walked to the wall, his face turning very pale.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“咱得快点离开这里，黑龙在寻找那个古老的秘密。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Zán děi kuài diǎn líkāi zhèlǐ, hēilóng zài xúnzhǎo nàge gǔlǎo de mìmì.”
sentences.english: He said, "We must leave here quickly; the black dragon is searching for that ancient secret."

sentences.chinese: 林风感觉到身边有一种奇怪的力量在流动。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎnjué dào shēnbiān yǒu yī zhǒng qíguài de lìliàng zài liúdòng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt a strange power flowing around him.

sentences.chinese: 海老师从背后的袋子里拿出一张旧纸，上面写着奇怪的句子。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi lǎoshī cóng bèi hòu de dàizi lǐ ná chū yī zhāng jiù zhǐ, shàngmiàn xiězhe qíguài de jùzi.
sentences.english: Teacher Hai took an old piece of paper from the bag on his back, which had strange sentences written on it.

sentences.chinese: 这张纸记录了万年前的预言，关于一个被选中的孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhǐ jìlù le wàn nián qián de yùyán, guānyú yī gè bèi xuǎnzhòng de háizi.
sentences.english: This paper recorded a prophecy from ten thousand years ago, about a chosen child.

sentences.chinese: 林风看着纸上的黄色文字，觉得这些字在发光。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe zhǐ shàng de huángsè wénzì, juéde zhèxiē zì zài fāguāng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the yellow characters on the paper and felt that these words were glowing.

sentences.chinese: “这上面写了什么？”林风问。
sentences.pinyin: “Zhè shàngmiàn xiěle shénme?” Lín Fēng wèn.
sentences.english: "What is written here?" Lin Feng asked.

sentences.chinese: 海老师叹了口气，声音有些难听，因为他太紧张了。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi lǎoshī tànle kǒu qì, shēngyīn yǒuxiē nántīng, yīnwèi tā tài jǐnzhāng le.
sentences.english: Teacher Hai sighed, and his voice sounded unpleasant because he was too nervous.

sentences.chinese: 他指着纸上一个像蛋一样的符号说：“这是力量的源头。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐzhe zhǐ shàng yī gè xiàng dàn yīyàng de fúhào shuō: “Zhè shì lìliàng de yuántóu.”
sentences.english: He pointed to a symbol on the paper that looked like an egg and said, "This is the source of power."

sentences.chinese: 突然，黑龙发出一声巨吼，震碎了窗户上的玻璃。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, hēilóng fāchū yī shēng jù hǒu, zhèn suì le chuānghu shàng de bōlí.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the black dragon let out a huge roar, shattering the glass of the windows.

sentences.chinese: 林风被震得向后碰在桌子上，桌上的药水瓶被打翻了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng bèi zhèn de xiàng hòu pèng zài zhuōzi shàng, zhuō shàng de yàoshuǐ píng bèi dǎ fān le.
sentences.english: Lin Feng was shaken and bumped backward onto the table, knocking over a bottle of potion.

sentences.chinese: 蓝色的药水流在地上，像一条发光的小河。
sentences.pinyin: Lán sè de yàoshuǐ liú zài dìshàng, xiàng yī tiáo fāguāng de xiǎo hé.
sentences.english: The blue potion flowed on the ground like a small glowing river.

sentences.chinese: 海老师迅速举起手，用魔力在空中画了一个圆圈。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi lǎoshī xùnsù jǔqǐ shǒu, yòng mólì zài kōngzhōng huà le yī gè yuánquān.
sentences.english: Teacher Hai quickly raised his hand and drew a circle in the air with magic.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林风：“快喝这碗药，它能让你在短时间内控制魔力。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Lín Fēng: “Kuài hē zhè wǎn yào, tā néng ràng nǐ zài duǎn shíjiān nèi kòngzhì mólì.”
sentences.english: He told Lin Feng, "Drink this bowl of medicine quickly; it can help you control your magic for a short time."

sentences.chinese: 林风接过碗，喝下了苦涩的药草汁。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jiēguò wǎn, hē xià le kǔsè de yào cǎo zhī.
sentences.english: Lin Feng took the bowl and drank the bitter herbal juice.

sentences.chinese: 海老师告诉他，这种药是用深海的草和特殊的矿石做的。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi lǎoshī gàosù tā, zhè zhǒng yào shì yòng shēnhǎi de cǎo hé tèshū de kuàngshí zuò de.
sentences.english: Teacher Hai told him that this medicine was made from deep-sea grass and special minerals.

sentences.chinese: “我们要去森林里的湖边，那里有一条能飞的船。”
sentences.pinyin: “Wǒmen yào qù sēnlín lǐ de húbiān, nàlǐ yǒu yī tiáo néng fēi de chuán.”
sentences.english: "We need to go to the lakeside in the forest; there is a boat that can fly there."

sentences.chinese: 林风看着海老师，问他为什么要帮他。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe Hǎi lǎoshī, wèn tā wèishéme yào bāng tā.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at Teacher Hai and asked why he was helping him.

sentences.chinese: 海老师眼神温柔，想到了远在故乡的爱人。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi lǎoshī yǎnshén wēnróu, xiǎngdào le yuǎn zài gùxiāng de àiren.
sentences.english: Teacher Hai's gaze softened as he thought of his lover far away in his hometown.

sentences.chinese: 他低声说：“因为你让我想起了我想保护的人。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dīshēng shuō: “Yīnwèi nǐ ràng wǒ xiǎngqǐ le wǒ xiǎng bǎohù de rén.”
sentences.english: He whispered, "Because you remind me of the people I want to protect."

sentences.chinese: 他们迅速穿过走廊，林风感觉到腰上的皮带在发热。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xùnsù chuānguò zǒuláng, Lín Fēng gǎnjué dào yāo shàng de pídài zài fārè.
sentences.english: They quickly hurried through the corridor, and Lin Feng felt the belt on his waist heating up.

sentences.chinese: 那是海老师之前给他的护身符，现在正占用了他的一部分精神力。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì Hǎi lǎoshī zhīqián gěi tā de hùshēnfú, xiànzài zhèng zhànyòng le tā de yī bùfèn jīngshénlì.
sentences.english: It was the amulet Teacher Hai had given him earlier, and it was now occupying a part of his mental energy.

sentences.chinese: 他们跑出图书馆，黑夜被血红色的光芒覆盖。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen pǎo chū túshūguǎn, hēiyè bèi xuè hóngsè de guāngmáng fùgài.
sentences.english: They ran out of the library, and the dark night was covered by a blood-red light.

sentences.chinese: 林风深呼吸，在心中把咒语读了一遍又一遍。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng shēnhūxī, zài xīnzhōng bǎ zhòuyǔ dú le yī biàn yòu yī biàn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng took a deep breath and read the spell over and over again in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 就在他们快要到达湖边时，地面突然裂开了，一个巨大的假象出现，将他们困在原地。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tāmen kuài yào dàodá húbiān shí, dìmiàn tūrán liè kāi le, yī gè jùdà de jiǎxiàng chūxiàn, jiāng tāmen kùn zài yuándì.
sentences.english: Just as they were about to reach the lakeside, the ground suddenly split open, and a giant illusion appeared, trapping them in place.

chapters.title_chinese: 第六章：迷雾之河的试炼
chapters.title_english: Chapter 6: Trial of the Misty River

sentences.chinese: 林风看着周围的假象，心中感到非常焦虑。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe zhōuwéi de jiǎxiàng, xīnzhōng gǎndào fēicháng jiāolǜ.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the illusions around him, feeling very anxious in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 海老师告诉他，这个幻境是来自大自然的古老力量。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi lǎoshī gàosù tā, zhège huànjìng shì láizì dà zì rán de gǔlǎo lìliàng.
sentences.english: Teacher Hai told him that this phantom realm was an ancient power from nature.

sentences.chinese: 天空突然变得多云，血红色的光被灰色的云遮住了。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānkōng tūrán biànde duō yún, xuè hóngsè de guāng bèi huīsè de yún zhēzhù le.
sentences.english: The sky suddenly became cloudy, and the blood-red light was covered by grey clouds.

sentences.chinese: 林风注意到，他的头发在风中飞舞，闪烁着蓝色的光芒。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhùyì dào, tā de tóufa zài fēngzhōng fēiwǔ, shǎnshuòzhe lánsè de guāngmáng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng noticed that his hair was flying in the wind, shimmering with a blue light.

sentences.chinese: 他们现在被困在一条巨大的河边，河水是深绿色的。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xiànzài bèi kùn zài yītiáo jùdà de hé biān, héshuǐ shì shēn lǜsè de.
sentences.english: They were now trapped by a huge river, and the river water was deep green.

sentences.chinese: 海老师说，要打破假象，必须向东南方向走。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi lǎoshī shuō, yào dǎpò jiǎxiàng, bìxū xiàng dōngnán fāngxiàng zǒu.
sentences.english: Teacher Hai said that to break the illusion, they must head in the southeast direction.

sentences.chinese: 但这里有一个难题：他们必须用一种古老的语言说话。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zhèlǐ yǒu yīgè nántí: tāmen bìxū yòng yīzhǒng gǔlǎo de yǔyán shuōhuà.
sentences.english: But there was a difficult problem here: they had to speak in an ancient language.

sentences.chinese: 这种语言的每一个音节都像唱歌一样，非常复杂。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèzhǒng yǔyán de měiyī gè yīnjié dōu xiàng chànggē yīyàng, fēicháng fùzá.
sentences.english: Every syllable of this language was like singing, very complex.

sentences.chinese: 林风尝试说话，但他的发音并不流利。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng chángshì shuōhuà, dàn tā de fāyīn bìng bù liúlì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng tried to speak, but his pronunciation was not fluent.

sentences.chinese: 海老师开玩笑说，这比学习英语或者英文要难得多。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi lǎoshī kāiwánxiào shuō, zhè bǐ xuéxí Yīngyǔ huòzhě Yīngwén yào nán dé duō.
sentences.english: Teacher Hai joked that this was much harder than learning English or the English language.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一只像猫一样的小生物从草丛里跳了出来。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yīzhī xiàng māo yīyàng de xiǎo shēngwù cóng cǎocóng lǐ tiào le chūlái.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a small creature like a cat jumped out from the grass.

sentences.chinese: 它是一只名为离的 mythical beast，眼睛闪着金光。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì yīzhī míngwéi Lí de mythical beast, yǎnjīng shǎnzhe jīnguāng.
sentences.english: It was a mythical beast called a Li, its eyes flashing with golden light.

sentences.chinese: 这只离说，只有内心纯洁的人才能通过这里的西南之门。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī Lí shuō, zhǐyǒu nèixīn chúnjié de rén cáinéng tōngguò zhèlǐ de xīnán zhī mén.
sentences.english: This Li said that only those with a pure heart could pass through the southwest gate here.

sentences.chinese: 林风想起在书里读到的历史，关于周朝和全家的古老传说。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎngqǐ zài shū lǐ dú dào de lìshǐ, guānyú Zhōu cháo hé Quán jiā de gǔlǎo chuánshuō.
sentences.english: Lin Feng remembered the history he read in books, ancient legends about the Zhou Dynasty and the Quan family.

sentences.chinese: 他还记得关于凉国在古代战争中的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hái jìdé guānyú Liáng guó zài gǔdài zhànzhēng zhōng de gùshì.
sentences.english: He also remembered stories about the Liang state in ancient wars.

sentences.chinese: 在这个幻境中，时间很奇怪，明明现在是冬天，却像春天一样温暖。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège huànjìng zhōng, shíjiān hěn qíguài, míngmíng xiànzài shì dōngtiān, què xiàng chūntiān yīyàng wēnnuǎn.
sentences.english: In this phantom realm, time was strange; it was clearly winter, yet it was as warm as spring.

sentences.chinese: 林风老是觉得有人在看着他，但周围没有人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng lǎoshì juéde yǒurén zài kànzhe tā, dàn zhōuwéi méiyǒu rén.
sentences.english: Lin Feng always felt someone was watching him, but there was no one around.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一个难看的石像，石像的脸上刻着组姓的标志。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào yīgè nánkàn de shíxiàng, shíxiàng de liǎn shàng kèzhe Zǔ xìng de biāozhì.
sentences.english: He saw an ugly stone statue, with the mark of the Zu surname carved on its face.

sentences.chinese: 那个石像突然开口云：“你想过年吗？还是想回家？”
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè shíxiàng tūrán kāikǒu yún: “Nǐ xiǎng guònián ma? Háishì xiǎng huíjiā?”
sentences.english: The statue suddenly spoke, saying: "Do you want to celebrate the New Year? Or do you want to go home?"

sentences.chinese: 林风意识到，这个石像在测试他的欲望。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yìshí dào, zhège shíxiàng zài cèshì tā de yùwàng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng realized that the statue was testing his desires.

sentences.chinese: 他坚定地说：“我想保护我的朋友，我想去黑省寻找真相。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiāndìng de shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng bǎohù wǒ de péngyǒu, wǒ xiǎng qù Hēi shěng xúnzhǎo zhēnxiàng.”
sentences.english: He said firmly: "I want to protect my friends, and I want to go to the Hei province to find the truth."

sentences.chinese: 听到这句话，绿色的河水突然分开了。
sentences.pinyin: Tīngdào zhè jù huà, lǜsè de héshuǐ tūrán fēnkāi le.
sentences.english: Hearing these words, the green river water suddenly parted.

sentences.chinese: 一个蓝色的光圈在他们面前出现，连接着真实的世界。
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè lánsè de guāngquān zài tāmen miànqián chūxiàn, liánjiēzhe zhēnshí de shìjiè.
sentences.english: A blue circle of light appeared before them, connecting to the real world.

sentences.chinese: 他们迅速跳进光圈，离开了这个诡异的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xùnsù tiào jìn guāngquān, líkāi le zhège guǐyì de dìfāng.
sentences.english: They quickly jumped into the light circle and left this eerie place.

sentences.chinese: 然而，当他们睁开眼时，发现自己站在一个巨大的祭坛之上，而黑龙就在他们头顶盘旋。
sentences.pinyin: Rán'ér, dāng tāmen zhēngkāi yǎn shí, fāxiàn zìjǐ zhàn zài yīgè jùdà de jìtán zhī shàng, ér hēilóng jiù zài tāmen tóudǐng pánxuán.
sentences.english: However, when they opened their eyes, they found themselves standing on a huge altar, and the black dragon was circling above their heads.

chapters.title_chinese: 第七章：祭坛的秘密与古老的契约
chapters.title_english: Chapter 7: Secrets of the Altar and the Ancient Covenant

sentences.chinese: 林风站在巨大的祭坛上，看着头顶盘旋的黑龙。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhàn zài jù dà de jì tán shàng, kàn zhe tóu dǐng pán xuán de hēi lóng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng stood on the giant altar, looking at the black dragon circling overhead.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙的声音像雷一样，在空中响起。
sentences.pinyin: Hēi lóng de shēng yīn xiàng léi yī yàng, zài kōng zhōng xiǎng qǐ.
sentences.english: The black dragon's voice was like thunder, echoing in the air.

sentences.chinese: 它说，这个祭坛叫作“命运之门”。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, zhè ge jì tán jiào zuò “mìng yùn zhī mén”.
sentences.english: It said that this altar is called the "Gate of Destiny."

sentences.chinese: 这里是连接不同世界的交通中心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ shì lián jiē bù tóng shì jiè de jiāo tōng zhōng xīn.
sentences.english: This place is a transportation hub connecting different worlds.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙要求林风交出一件东西。
sentences.pinyin: Hēi lóng yāo qiú Lín Fēng jiāo chū yī jiàn dōng xī.
sentences.english: The black dragon demanded that Lin Feng hand over something.

sentences.chinese: 林风必须把一个古老的信封交给黑龙。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng bì xū bǎ yī gè gǔ lǎo de xìn fēng jiāo gěi hēi lóng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng had to deliver an ancient envelope to the black dragon.

sentences.chinese: 这个信封里有一封信，写着关于黑省的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge xìn fēng lǐ yǒu yī fēng xìn, xiě zhe guān yú hēi shěng de mì mì.
sentences.english: Inside this envelope was a letter describing the secrets of the Black Province.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙说，如果林风能完成这个任务，它就会帮助他。
sentences.pinyin: Hēi lóng shuō, rú guǒ Lín Fēng néng wán chéng zhè ge rèn wu, tā jiù huì bāng zhù tā.
sentences.english: The black dragon said that if Lin Feng could complete this task, it would help him.

sentences.chinese: 林风小心地打开信封，发现里面是一篇像作文一样的文字。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎo xīn de dǎ kāi xìn fēng, fā xiàn lǐ miàn shì yī piān xiàng zuò wén yī yàng de wén zì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng carefully opened the envelope and found text inside that looked like an essay.

sentences.chinese: 这不是简单的文章，而是一个强大的咒语。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù shì jiǎn dān de wén zhāng, ér shì yī gè qiáng dà de zhòu yǔ.
sentences.english: This was not a simple article, but a powerful spell.

sentences.chinese: 林风知道，使用这个咒语会产生巨大的作用。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhī dào, shǐ yòng zhè ge zhòu yǔ huì chǎn shēng jù dà de zuò yòng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng knew that using this spell would have a great effect.

sentences.chinese: 他需要复习在图书馆学到的知识，才能正确地读它。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xū yào fù xí zài tú shū guǎn xué dào de zhī shi, cái néng zhèng què de dú tā.
sentences.english: He needed to review the knowledge he learned in the library to read it correctly.

sentences.chinese: 海老师在他身边低声说：“你要小心，黑龙在试探你。”
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi lǎo shī zài tā shēn biān dī shēng shuō: “Nǐ yào xiǎo xīn, hēi lóng zài shì tàn nǐ.”
sentences.english: Teacher Hai whispered beside him, "Be careful, the black dragon is testing you."

sentences.chinese: 林风记得海老师姓海，他是这个世界最博学的学者。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jì dé Hǎi lǎo shī xìng Hǎi, tā shì zhè ge shì jiè zuì bó xué de xué zhě.
sentences.english: Lin Feng remembered that Teacher Hai's surname is Hai; he is the most learned scholar in this world.

sentences.chinese: 海老师告诉他，许多学生在学院实习时，都想取得这种力量。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi lǎo shī gào su tā, xǔ duō xué shēng zài xué yuàn shí xí shí, dōu xiǎng qǔ dé zhè zhǒng lì liàng.
sentences.english: Teacher Hai told him that many students, while interning at the academy, wanted to acquire this kind of power.

sentences.chinese: 但很少有人能真正做到这一点。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn hěn shǎo yǒu rén néng zhēn zhèng zuò dào zhè yī diǎn.
sentences.english: But few people could actually achieve this.

sentences.chinese: 突然，祭坛的地面开始变色。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, jì tán de dì miàn kāi shǐ biàn sè.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the ground of the altar began to change color.

sentences.chinese: 灰色的石头变成了金色的光芒。
sentences.pinyin: Huī sè de shí tou biàn chéng le jīn sè de guāng máng.
sentences.english: The gray stones turned into golden light.

sentences.chinese: 一个巨大的入口在林风面前出现。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè jù dà de rù kǒu zài Lín Fēng miàn qián chū xiàn.
sentences.english: A huge entrance appeared before Lin Feng.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙说，这个入口能带他去参观禁忌的圣殿。
sentences.pinyin: Hēi lóng shuō, zhè ge rù kǒu néng dài tā qù cān guān jìn jì de shèng diàn.
sentences.english: The black dragon said this entrance could take him to visit the Forbidden Temple.

sentences.chinese: 但首先，他必须参加一场古老的仪式。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn shǒu xiān, tā bì xū cān jiā yī chǎng gǔ lǎo de yí shì.
sentences.english: But first, he had to participate in an ancient ritual.

sentences.chinese: 林风想，如果能实现自己的目标，他愿意尝试。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎng, rú guǒ néng shí xiàn zì jǐ de mù biāo, tā yuàn yì cháng shì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng thought that if he could realize his goals, he was willing to try.

sentences.chinese: 他借用海老师的魔杖，试图引导光芒。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiè yòng Hǎi lǎo shī de mó wàng, shì tú yǐn dǎo guāng máng.
sentences.english: He borrowed Teacher Hai's magic wand, attempting to guide the light.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个奇怪的广告在空中闪过，那是来自另一个世界的幻象。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yī gè qí guài de guǎng gào zài kōng zhōng shǎn guò, nà shì lái zì lìng yī gè shì jiè de huàn xiàng.
sentences.english: At that moment, a strange advertisement flashed in the air—a phantom from another world.

sentences.chinese: 林风没有理会它，他正专注于眼前的挑战。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng méi yǒu lǐ huì tā, tā zhèng zhuān zhù yú yǎn qián de tiǎo zhàn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng ignored it; he was focusing on the challenge before him.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，自己现在是以一名救世主为身份在战斗。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, zì jǐ xiàn zài shì yǐ yī míng jiù shì zhǔ wéi shēn fèn zài zhàn dòu.
sentences.english: He realized that he was now fighting in the capacity of a savior.

sentences.chinese: 他想取回被偷走的力量，让世界变回原来的样子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǔ huí bèi tōu zǒu de lì liàng, ràng shì jiè biàn huí yuán lái de yàng zi.
sentences.english: He wanted to retrieve the stolen power and make the world change back to how it was.

sentences.chinese: 一个年轻的祭司走过来，看着林风，突然哭了。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè nián qīng de jì sī zǒu guò lái, kàn zhe Lín Fēng, tū rán kū le.
sentences.english: A young priest walked over, looked at Lin Feng, and suddenly cried.

sentences.chinese: 祭司说，他等了很久，终于等到了能办成这件事的人。
sentences.pinyin: Jì sī shuō, tā děng le hěn jiǔ, zhōng yú děng dào le néng bàn chéng zhè jiàn shì de rén.
sentences.english: The priest said he had waited a long time and finally found someone who could handle this matter.

sentences.chinese: 林风深呼吸，准备进入那个光圈。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng shēn hū xī, zhǔn bèi jìn rù nà ge guāng quān.
sentences.english: Lin Feng took a deep breath, preparing to enter the circle of light.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，一旦进入，他就就要面对真正的敌人了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhī dào, yī dàn jìn rù, tā jiù yào miàn duì zhēn zhèng de dí rén le.
sentences.english: He knew that once he entered, he would be facing the true enemy.

sentences.chinese: 他最后看了一眼海老师，坚定地走进了光芒之中。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zuì hòu kàn le yī yǎn Hǎi lǎo shī, jiān dìng de zǒu jìn le guāng máng zhī zhōng.
sentences.english: He took one last look at Teacher Hai and firmly stepped into the light.

chapters.title_chinese: 第八章：光芒之城的试炼
chapters.title_english: Chapter 8: Trials of the City of Light

sentences.chinese: 林风走进了光圈，感到身体变得很轻。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zǒu jìn le guāng quān, gǎn dào shēn tǐ biàn dé hěn qīng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng stepped into the light circle, feeling his body become very light.

sentences.chinese: 他发现自己来到了一个白色的城市，这里的空气能提高人的魔力。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn zì jǐ lái dào le yī gè bái sè de chéng shì, zhè lǐ de kōng qì néng tí gāo rén de mó lì.
sentences.english: He found himself in a white city, where the air could raise a person's magic power.

sentences.chinese: 一个白色的精灵走过来，对他进行检查。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè bái sè de jīng líng zǒu guò lái, duì tā jìn xíng jiǎn chá.
sentences.english: A white elf walked over and performed an inspection on him.

sentences.chinese: 精灵说，这里是光芒之城，所有进入的人必须接受试炼。
sentences.pinyin: Jīng líng shuō, zhè lǐ shì guāng máng zhī chéng, suǒ yǒu jìn rù de rén bì xū jiē shòu shì liàn.
sentences.english: The elf said this was the City of Light, and everyone who entered must undergo trials.

sentences.chinese: 林风想起海老师的话，他知道自己必须变得更强。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎng qǐ Hǎi lǎo shī de huà, tā zhī dào zì jǐ bì xū biàn dé gèng qiáng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng recalled Teacher Hai's words and knew he must become stronger.

sentences.chinese: 精灵拿出一本古老的书，告诉林风这里的人如何学习魔法。
sentences.pinyin: Jīng líng ná chū yī běn gǔ lǎo de shū, gào sù Lín Fēng zhè lǐ de rén rú hé xué xí mó fǎ.
sentences.english: The elf took out an ancient book and told Lin Feng how the people here study magic.

sentences.chinese: 在这里，教育不仅仅是读书，更是对心灵的训练。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè lǐ, jiào yù bù jǐn jǐn shì dú shū, gèng shì duì xīn líng de xùn liàn.
sentences.english: Here, education is not just reading books, but training of the soul.

sentences.chinese: 精灵开始教学，教林风如何控制体内的光芒。
sentences.pinyin: Jīng líng kāi shǐ jiāo xué, jiào Lín Fēng rú hé kòng zhì tǐ nèi de guāng máng.
sentences.english: The elf began teaching, showing Lin Feng how to control the light within his body.

sentences.chinese: 林风努力学习，他想要成为一名伟大的法师。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng nǔ lì xué xí, tā xiǎng yào chéng wéi yī míng wěi dà de fǎ shī.
sentences.english: Lin Feng studied hard; he wanted to become a great mage.

sentences.chinese: 精灵告诉他，想要获得力量，必须懂得耐心的重要性。
sentences.pinyin: Jīng líng gào sù tā, xiǎng yào huò dé lì liàng, bì xū dǒng de nài xīn de zhòng yào xìng.
sentences.english: The elf told him that to obtain power, one must understand the importance of patience.

sentences.chinese: 林风问，我应该怎么做才能拿到那把传说中的光之剑？
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng wèn, wǒ yīng gāi zěn me zuò cái néng ná dào nà bǎ chuán shuō zhōng de guāng zhī jiàn?
sentences.english: Lin Feng asked, "What should I do to get the legendary Sword of Light?"

sentences.chinese: 精灵笑了，说你必须先找出城市中心的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Jīng líng xiào le, shuō nǐ bì xū xiān zhǎo chū chéng shì zhōng xīn de mì mì.
sentences.english: The elf smiled and said he must first find the secret of the city center.

sentences.chinese: 林风打算在城市里走走，看看能不能得出一些结论。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng dǎ suàn zài chéng shì lǐ zǒu zǒu, kàn kàn néng bù néng dé chū yī xiē jié lùn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng planned to walk around the city to see if he could arrive at some conclusions.

sentences.chinese: 他看到很多精灵在排队，他们正在求光之神给予力量。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào hěn duō jīng líng zài pái duì, tā men zhèng zài qiú guāng zhī shén jǐ yǔ lì liàng.
sentences.english: He saw many elves standing in line, seeking power from the God of Light.

sentences.chinese: 这里的生活很安静，精灵们用服务他人来获得快乐。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de shēng huó hěn ā jìng, jīng líng men yòng fú wù tā rén lái huò dé kuài lè.
sentences.english: Life here was very peaceful; the elves found happiness by serving others.

sentences.chinese: 林风想到，如果他能拿到光之剑，就能改变这个世界的命运。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎng dào, rú guǒ tā néng ná dào guāng zhī jiàn, jiù néng gǎi biàn zhè gè shì jiè de mìng yùn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng thought that if he could get the Sword of Light, he could change the fate of the world.

sentences.chinese: 他想起在阴影之城的生活，那时候他的收入很低，每天都很辛苦。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ zài yīn yǐng zhī chéng de shēng huó, nà shí hòu tā de shōu rù hěn dī, měi tiān dōu hěn xīn kǔ.
sentences.english: He recalled his life in the Shadow City; back then, his income was very low, and every day was hard.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果能改变过去，他一定会更努力地学习。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rú guǒ néng gǎi biàn guò qù, tā yī dìng huì gèng nǔ lì de xué xí.
sentences.english: He thought that if he could change the past, he would certainly study harder.

sentences.chinese: 精灵看着他，问他是否愿意为了保护世界而放弃休息。
sentences.pinyin: Jīng líng kàn zhe tā, wèn tā shì fǒu yuàn yì wèi le bǎo hù shì jiè ér fàng qì xiū xī.
sentences.english: The elf looked at him and asked if he was willing to give up rest to protect the world.

sentences.chinese: 林风坚定地回答，我愿意。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jiān dìng de huí dá, wǒ yuàn yì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng answered firmly, "I am willing."

sentences.chinese: 精灵说，那么接下来，你得去洗澡，洗掉身上所有的阴影之气。
sentences.pinyin: Jīng líng shuō, nà me jiē xià lái, nǐ dé qù xǐ zǎo, xǐ diào shēn shang suǒ yǒu de yīn yǐng zhī qì.
sentences.english: The elf said, "Then next, you must take a bath to wash away all the shadow energy from your body."

sentences.chinese: 林风走进水池，感觉到水在洗涤他的灵魂。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zǒu jìn shuǐ chí, gǎn jué dào shuǐ zài xǐ dí tā de líng hún.
sentences.english: Lin Feng stepped into the pool, feeling the water cleansing his soul.

sentences.chinese: 他发现这里的水能收走身体里的疲劳。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn zhè lǐ de shuǐ néng shōu zǒu shēn tǐ lǐ de pí láo.
sentences.english: He discovered that the water here could take away the fatigue in the body.

sentences.chinese: 他开始数水池里的光点，一个，两个，三个。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kāi shǐ shǔ shuǐ chí lǐ de guāng diǎn, yī gè, liǎng gè, sān gè.
sentences.english: He began to count the points of light in the pool: one, two, three.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，这里的每一个光点都在影响他的魔力流动。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, zhè lǐ de měi yī gè guāng diǎn dōu zài yǐng xiǎng tā de mó lì liú dòng.
sentences.english: He realized that every point of light here was influencing his magic flow.

sentences.chinese: 精灵告诉他，只有懂魔法的人，才能看到这些光点。
sentences.pinyin: Jīng líng gào sù tā, zhǐ yǒu dǒng mó fǎ de rén, cái néng kàn dào zhè xiē guāng diǎn.
sentences.english: The elf told him that only those who understand magic could see these points of light.

sentences.chinese: 林风慢慢明白了，真正的力量不是抢来的，而是得来的。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng màn màn míng bái le, zhēn zhèng de lì liàng bù shì qiǎng lái de, ér shì dé lái de.
sentences.english: Lin Feng slowly understood that true power is not snatched, but earned.

sentences.chinese: 他拿出自己的笔记本，记录下这里的每一个细节。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū zì jǐ de bǐ jì běn, jì lù xià zhè lǐ de měi yī gè xì jié.
sentences.english: He took out his notebook and recorded every detail of the place.

sentences.chinese: 他想，这次旅行将是他人生中最重要的转折点。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, zhè cì lǚ xíng jiāng shì tā rén shēng zhōng zuì zhòng yào de zhuǎn zhé diǎn.
sentences.english: He thought this journey would be the most important turning point of his life.

sentences.chinese: 他决定改掉以前懒惰的习惯，每天早起练习。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué dìng gǎi diào yǐ qián lǎn duò de xí guàn, měi tiān zǎo qǐ liàn xí.
sentences.english: He decided to change his previous lazy habits and practice early every morning.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，天空中突然传来了黑龙的吼声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, tiān kōng zhōng tū rán chuán lái le hēi lóng de hǒu shēng.
sentences.english: Just then, the roar of the black dragon suddenly echoed in the sky.

sentences.chinese: 光芒之城的白色天空，突然变成了一片深紫色。
sentences.pinyin: Guāng máng zhī chéng de bái sè tiān kōng, tū rán biàn chéng le yī piàn shēn zǐ sè.
sentences.english: The white sky of the City of Light suddenly turned a deep purple.

chapters.title_chinese: 第九章：紫色的风暴与魔力训练
chapters.title_english: Chapter 9: The Purple Storm and Magic Training

sentences.chinese: 深紫色的天空像一块巨大的布，覆盖在光芒之城上面。
sentences.pinyin: shēn zǐ sè de tiān kōng xiàng yī kuài jù dà de bù, fù gài zài guāng máng zhī chéng shàng miàn.
sentences.english: The deep purple sky was like a giant piece of cloth covering the City of Light.

sentences.chinese: 林风看着天空，认为这是一种危险的信号。
sentences.pinyin: lín fēng kàn zhe tiān kōng, rèn wéi zhè shì yī zhǒng wēi xiǎn de xìn hào.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the sky and believed this was a dangerous signal.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙在空中飞快地活动，它的翅膀很大。
sentences.pinyin: hēi lóng zài kōng zhōng fēi kuài de huó dòng, tā de chì bǎng hěn dà.
sentences.english: The black dragon moved quickly in the air, its wings were huge.

sentences.chinese: 它突然起飞，速度超过了这里的任何生物。
sentences.pinyin: tā tū rán qǐ fēi, sù dù chāo guò le zhè lǐ de rén hé shēng wù.
sentences.english: It suddenly took off, its speed surpassing any creature here.

sentences.chinese: 林风知道，如果他想生存，就必须改变以前的生活。
sentences.pinyin: lín fēng zhī dào, rú guǒ tā xiǎng shēng cún, jiù bì xū gǎi biàn yǐ qián de shēng huó.
sentences.english: Lin Feng knew that if he wanted to survive, he must change his previous life.

sentences.chinese: 他不能再做一个懒惰的人，因为生存等于战斗。
sentences.pinyin: tā bù néng zài zuò yī gè lǎn duò de rén, yīn wèi shēng cún děng yú zhàn dòu.
sentences.english: He could no longer be a lazy person, because survival is equal to fighting.

sentences.chinese: 他走进一座古老的塔，那里的人租给他一个小房间。
sentences.pinyin: tā zǒu jìn yī zuò gǔ lǎo de tǎ, nà lǐ de rén zū gěi tā yī gè xiǎo fáng jiān.
sentences.english: He entered an ancient tower, where the people rented him a small room.

sentences.chinese: 房间很小，但对林风来说，这个地方很称心。
sentences.pinyin: fáng jiān hěn xiǎo, dàn duì lín fēng lái shuō, zhè gè dì fāng hěn chèn xīn.
sentences.english: The room was small, but for Lin Feng, this place was very suitable.

sentences.chinese: 海老师告诉他，真正的魔力是由精神和身体组成。
sentences.pinyin: hǎi lǎo shī gào sù tā, zhēn zhèng de mó lì shì yóu jīng shén hé shēn tǐ zǔ chéng.
sentences.english: Teacher Hai told him that true magic is composed of spirit and body.

sentences.chinese: 海老师要求林风每天进行高强度的运动。
sentences.pinyin: hǎi lǎo shī yāo qiú lín fēng měi tiān jìn xíng gāo qiáng dù de yùn dòng.
sentences.english: Teacher Hai required Lin Feng to conduct high-intensity exercise every day.

sentences.chinese: 林风开始练习控制光芒，他每天重复同样的动作。
sentences.pinyin: lín fēng kāi shǐ liàn xí kòng zhì guāng máng, tā měi tiān chóng fù tóng yàng de dòng zuò.
sentences.english: Lin Feng began to practice controlling the light, repeating the same movements every day.

sentences.chinese: 他不断地练，直到身体感到疲惫。
sentences.pinyin: tā bù duàn de liàn, zhí dào shēn tǐ gǎn dào pí bèi.
sentences.english: He practiced continuously until his body felt exhausted.

sentences.chinese: 海老师讲了很多关于古代魔法的故事。
sentences.pinyin: hǎi lǎo shī jiǎng le hěn duō guān yú gǔ dài mó fǎ de gù shì.
sentences.english: Teacher Hai spoke a lot about ancient magic stories.

sentences.chinese: 他说明，只有重视基础的人，才能拥有强大的力量。
sentences.pinyin: tā shuō míng, zhǐ yǒu zhòng shì jī chǔ de rén, cái néng yōng yǒu qiáng dà de lì liàng.
sentences.english: He explained that only those who value the basics can possess powerful strength.

sentences.chinese: 海老师让林风尝试进入一个特殊的魔力空间。
sentences.pinyin: hǎi lǎo shī ràng lín fēng cháng shì jìn rù yī gè tè shū de mó lì kōng jiān.
sentences.english: Teacher Hai let Lin Feng try to enter a special magic space.

sentences.chinese: 在这个空间里，林风能够感觉到空气中流动的能量。
sentences.pinyin: zài zhè gè kōng jiān lǐ, lín fēng néng gòu gǎn jué dào kōng qì zhōng liú dòng de néng liàng.
sentences.english: In this space, Lin Feng was able to feel the energy flowing in the air.

sentences.chinese: 他算了一下，自己的魔力增长速度比以前快了很多。
sentences.pinyin: tā suàn le yī xià, zì jǐ de mó lì zēng zhǎng sù dù bǐ yǐ qián kuài le hěn duō.
sentences.english: He calculated that his magic growth rate was much faster than before.

sentences.chinese: 为了记录进步，林风用魔法照相的方式留下影像。
sentences.pinyin: wèi le jì lù jìn bù, lín fēng yòng mó fǎ zhào xiàng de fāng shì liú xià yǐng xiàng.
sentences.english: To record his progress, Lin Feng used a magical photography method to leave images.

sentences.chinese: 他选了一个最安静的角落，开始尝试复杂的咒语。
sentences.pinyin: tā xuǎn le yī gè zuì ā jìng de jiǎo luò, kāi shǐ cháng shì fù zá de zhòu yǔ.
sentences.english: He chose the quietest corner and began to try complex spells.

sentences.chinese: 一个声音突然通知他，试炼的时间到了。
sentences.pinyin: yī gè shēng yīn tū rán tōng zhī tā, shì liàn de shí jiān dào le.
sentences.english: A voice suddenly notified him that the time for the trial had arrived.

sentences.chinese: 林风请求海老师给他更多的时间，因为他还没准备好。
sentences.pinyin: lín fēng qǐng qiú hǎi lǎo shī gěi tā gèng duō de shí jiān, yīn wèi tā hái méi zhǔn bèi hǎo.
sentences.english: Lin Feng requested Teacher Hai to give him more time because he wasn't ready yet.

sentences.chinese: 但海老师认为，最好的学习就是在实战中进行。
sentences.pinyin: dàn hǎi lǎo shī rèn wéi, zuì hǎo de xué xí jiù shì zài shí zhàn zhōng jìn xíng.
sentences.english: But Teacher Hai believed that the best learning takes place during actual combat.

sentences.chinese: 海老师送给林风一块古老的护身符，作为鼓励。
sentences.pinyin: hǎi lǎo shī sòng gěi lín fēng yī kuài gǔ lǎo de hù shēn fú, zuò wéi gǔ lì.
sentences.english: Teacher Hai gave Lin Feng an ancient amulet as encouragement.

sentences.chinese: 这块护身符装在精美的丝绸袋子里。
sentences.pinyin: zhè kuài hù shēn fú zhuāng zài jīng měi de sī chóu dài zi lǐ.
sentences.english: This amulet was placed in an exquisite silk bag.

sentences.chinese: 林风深呼吸，准备进入最后的测试。
sentences.pinyin: lín fēng shēn hū xī, zhǔn bèi jìn rù zuì hòu de cè shì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng took a deep breath, preparing to enter the final test.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，这次测试将决定他是否能通往更高层次的境界。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhī dào, zhè cì cè shì jiāng jué dìng tā shì fǒu néng tōng wǎng gèng gāo céng cì de jìng jiè.
sentences.english: He knew this test would determine whether he could pass through to a higher level of existence.

sentences.chinese: 就在他准备开始时，地面的震动突然加强了。
sentences.pinyin: jiù zài tā zhǔn bèi kāi shǐ shí, dì miàn de zhèn dòng tū rán jiā qiáng le.
sentences.english: Just as he was about to start, the vibration of the ground suddenly intensified.

sentences.chinese: 紫色的天空突然裂开，无数的黑色碎片落下。
sentences.pinyin: zǐ sè de tiān kōng tū rán liè kāi, wú shù de hēi sè suì piàn luò xià.
sentences.english: The purple sky suddenly cracked, and countless black fragments fell.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙再次出现，这一次它直接冲向了这座塔。
sentences.pinyin: hēi lóng zài cì chū xiàn, zhè yī cì tā zhí jiē chōng xiàng le zhè zuò tǎ.
sentences.english: The black dragon appeared again, and this time it charged directly toward the tower.

sentences.chinese: 林风看着巨大的阴影，心中产生了一种前所未有的恐惧。
sentences.pinyin: lín fēng kàn zhe jù dà de yīn yǐng, xīn zhōng chǎn shēng le yī zhǒng qián suǒ wèi yǒu de kǒng jù.
sentences.english: Looking at the giant shadow, an unprecedented fear arose in Lin Feng's heart.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十章：风暴后的宁静与新的希望
chapters.title_english: Chapter 10: Calm After the Storm and New Hope

sentences.chinese: 黑龙的冲击力非常强，但林风在最后一刻使用了防御魔法。
sentences.pinyin: Hēilóng de chōngjīlì fēicháng qiáng, dàn Lín Fēng zài zuìhòu yīkè shǐyòngle fángyù mófǎ.
sentences.english: The black dragon's impact was very strong, but Lin Feng used defensive magic at the last moment.

sentences.chinese: 他感觉到身体变得很轻，像一片叶子一样在空中漂浮。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎnjué dào shēntǐ biàndé hěn qīng, xiàng yī piàn yèzi yīyàng zài kōngzhōng piāofú.
sentences.english: He felt his body become very light, floating in the air like a leaf.

sentences.chinese: 幸运地，防御成功了，黑龙被巨大的光芒推开，飞回了深紫色的大雾中。
sentences.pinyin: Xìngyùn de, fángyù chénggōngle, hēilóng bèi jùdà de guāngmáng tuī kāi, fēi huíle shēn zǐsè de dàwù zhōng.
sentences.english: Fortunately, the defense was successful; the black dragon was pushed back by a huge light and flew back into the deep purple mist.

sentences.chinese: 塔内的气氛重新变得安静，所有人都松了一口气。
sentences.pinyin: Tǎ nèi de qìfēn chóngxīn biàndé ānjìng, suǒyǒu rén dōu sōngle yī kǒu qì.
sentences.english: The atmosphere inside the tower became quiet again, and everyone breathed a sigh of relief.

sentences.chinese: 海老师走过来，看着林风，眼神中充满了满意。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi lǎoshī zǒu guòlái, kànzhe Lín Fēng, yǎnshén zhōng chōngmǎnle mǎnyì.
sentences.english: Teacher Hai walked over and looked at Lin Feng, his eyes full of satisfaction.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你的进步挺好，现在的你比平时更强大了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ de jìnbù tǐng hǎo, xiànzài de nǐ bǐ píngshí gèng qiángdàle.”
sentences.english: He said, "Your progress is very good; you are stronger now than you usually are."

sentences.chinese: 林风虽然很累，但心里非常开心，因为他第一次战胜了恐惧。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng suīrán hěn lèi, dàn xīnlǐ fēicháng kāixīn, yīnwèi tā dì yī cì zhànshèngle kǒngjù.
sentences.english: Although Lin Feng was very tired, he was very happy in his heart because he had defeated fear for the first time.

sentences.chinese: 海老师告诉他，只要保持健康，魔力就会继续增长。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi lǎoshī gàosù tā, zhǐyào bǎochí jiànkāng, mólì jiù huì jìxù zēngzhǎng.
sentences.english: Teacher Hai told him that as long as he stayed healthy, his magic power would continue to grow.

sentences.chinese: 为了庆祝胜利，学院为他们准备了一顿丰盛的晚餐。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile qìngzhù shènglì, xuéyuàn wèi tāmen zhǔnbèile yī dùn fēngshèng de wǎncān.
sentences.english: To celebrate the victory, the academy prepared a sumptuous dinner for them.

sentences.chinese: 林风吃得很饱，觉得这种感觉非常舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng chī dé hěn bǎo, juédé zhè zhǒng gǎnjué fēicháng shūfu.
sentences.english: Lin Feng ate until he was full and felt that this feeling was very comfortable.

sentences.chinese: 大家在餐桌上快乐地聊天，讨论着未来的计划。
sentences.pinyin: Dàjiā zài cānzhuō shàng kuàilè de liáotiān, tǎolùnzhe wèilái de jìhuà.
sentences.english: Everyone chatted happily at the dining table, discussing future plans.

sentences.chinese: 海老师说，学习魔法没有便宜的捷径，只有努力才能成功。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi lǎoshī shuō, xuéxí mófǎ méiyǒu piányi de jiéjìng, zhǐyǒu nǔlì cáinéng chénggōng.
sentences.english: Teacher Hai said that there are no cheap shortcuts to learning magic; only hard work can lead to success.

sentences.chinese: 在这个过程中，面对困难并克服它，这就是最大的好处。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège guòchéng zhōng, miànduì kùnnán bìng kèfú tā, zhè jiùshì zuìdà de hǎochù.
sentences.english: In this process, facing difficulties and overcoming them is the greatest benefit.

sentences.chinese: 晚餐后，林风走到窗边，发现天空终于变晴了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎncān hòu, Lín Fēng zǒu dào chuāngbiān, fāxiàn tiānkōng zhōngyú biàn qíngle.
sentences.english: After dinner, Lin Feng walked to the window and found that the sky had finally cleared.

sentences.chinese: 这是一个久违的晴天，金色的阳光照在白色的塔上。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yīgè jiǔwéi de qíngtiān, jīnsè de yángguāng zhào zài báisè de tǎ shàng.
sentences.english: It was a long-awaited sunny day, with golden sunlight shining on the white tower.

sentences.chinese: 海老师对他说：“现在的天气很凉快，你可以出去走走。”
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi lǎoshī duì tā shuō: “Xiànzài de tiānqì hěn liángkuai, nǐ kěyǐ chūqù zǒuzǒu.”
sentences.english: Teacher Hai said to him, "The weather is very pleasantly cool now; you can go for a walk."

sentences.chinese: 林风发现，在阳光下思考魔法问题更加方便。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng fāxiàn, zài yángguāng xià sīkǎo mófǎ wèntí gèngjiā fāngbiàn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng found that it was more convenient to think about magic problems under the sunlight.

sentences.chinese: 他想随便找个地方休息，所以他走向了学院的花园。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng suíbiàn zhǎo gè dìfāng xiūxi, suǒyǐ tā zǒuxiàngle xuéyuàn de huāyuán.
sentences.english: He wanted to find a place to rest as he pleased, so he walked toward the academy garden.

sentences.chinese: 在花园里，他遇到了几个新同学，他们热情地欢迎他加入。
sentences.pinyin: Zài huāyuán lǐ, tā yùdàole jǐ gè xīn tóngxué, tāmen rèqíng de huānyíng tā jiārù.
sentences.english: In the garden, he met several new classmates who warmly welcomed him to join.

sentences.chinese: 林风觉得这里的环境很正常，不像在阴影之城那样压抑。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng juédé zhèlǐ de huánjìng hěn zhèngcháng, bù xiàng zài Yīnyǐng zhī Chéng nàyàng yāyì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt that the environment here was normal, not as oppressive as in the City of Shadows.

sentences.chinese: 他希望接下来的训练能进行得顺利，不再有突如其来的袭击。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xīwàng jiē xiàlái de xùnliàn néng jìnxíng dé shùnlì, bù zài yǒu tūrúqílái de xíjī.
sentences.english: He hoped that the upcoming training would proceed smoothly, without any more sudden attacks.

sentences.chinese: 海老师看着他，轻声说：“只要你足够专注，一切都会平安。”
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi lǎoshī kànzhe tā, qīngshēng shuō: “Zhǐyào nǐ zúgòu zhuānzhù, yīqiè dōu huì píng'ān.”
sentences.english: Teacher Hai looked at him and said softly, "As long as you are focused enough, everything will be safe."

sentences.chinese: 林风听了之后终于放心了，他对着海老师深深地鞠了一躬。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng tīngle zhīhòu zhōngyú fàngxīnle, tā duìzhe Hǎi lǎoshī shēnshēn de jūle yī gōng.
sentences.english: After hearing this, Lin Feng finally felt relieved, and he bowed deeply to Teacher Hai.

sentences.chinese: 夜晚降临，林风躺在床上，轻声对自己说了一句“晚安”。
sentences.pinyin: Yèwǎn jiànglín, Lín Fēng tǎng zài chuángshàng, qīngshēng duì zìjǐ shuōle yī jù “wǎn'ān”.
sentences.english: Night fell, and Lin Feng lay in bed, softly saying "Good night" to himself.

sentences.chinese: 就在他快要睡着时，他听到窗外传来一声奇怪的呼唤，那不是黑龙的声音，而是一个女人的声音，她祝他明天出发时一路顺风，一路平安。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tā kuàiyào shuìzháo shí, tā tīngdào chuāngwài chuán lái yī shēng qíguài de hūhuàn, nà bùshì hēilóng de shēngyīn, ér shì yīgè nǚrén de shēngyīn, tā zhù tā míngtiān chūfā shí yīlù shùnfēng, yīlù píng'ān.
sentences.english: Just as he was about to fall asleep, he heard a strange call from outside the window; it wasn't the black dragon's voice, but a woman's voice, wishing him a pleasant journey and a safe trip when he set out tomorrow.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十一章：神秘的呼唤与禁忌之门
chapters.title_english: Chapter 11: The Mysterious Call and the Forbidden Gate

sentences.chinese: 林风在半夜突然睁开了眼睛。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zài bànyè tūrán zhēngkāile yǎnjīng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng suddenly opened his eyes in the middle of the night.

sentences.chinese: 他想起那个女人的声音，心中感到非常奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ nàge nǚrén de shēngyīn, xīnzhōng gǎndào fēicháng qíguài.
