sentences.english: He thought of the woman's voice and felt very strange in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 他小声对自己说：“谁在窗外？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎoshēng duì zìjǐ shuō: “Shéi zài chuāngwài?”
sentences.english: He whispered to himself, "Who is outside the window?"

sentences.chinese: 不一会儿，他决定起床，轻轻推开窗户。
sentences.pinyin: Bù yīhuǐr, tā juédìng qǐchuáng, qīngqīng tuīkāi chuānghù.
sentences.english: After a short while, he decided to get up and gently push open the window.

sentences.chinese: 窗外没有一个人，只有冷风吹过，让他低下了头。
sentences.pinyin: Chuāngwài méiyǒu yīgè rén, zhǐyǒu lěngfēng chuīguò, ràng tā dīxiàle tóu.
sentences.english: There was no one outside, only the cold wind blowing, making him lower his head.

sentences.chinese: 他想起海老师说过，在这个世界，少数的人能听到灵魂的呼唤。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ Hǎi lǎoshī shuōguò, zài zhège shìjiè, shǎoshù de rén néng tīngdào línghún de hūhuàn.
sentences.english: He remembered Teacher Hai saying that in this world, a small number of people can hear the call of souls.

sentences.chinese: 林风觉得现在的魔力还不够，他不能就这样出门。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng juéde xiànzài de mólì hái bùgòu, tā bùnéng jiù zhèyàng chūmén.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt that his current magic was not enough; he could not just go out like this.

sentences.chinese: 如果他现在离开，后果可能很坏，这对他有很大的坏处。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ tā xiànzài líkāi, hòuguǒ kěnéng hěn huài, zhè duì tā yǒu hěn dà de huàichu.
sentences.english: If he left now, the consequences could be bad; it would be a great harm to him.

sentences.chinese: 他想，与其在黑暗中冒险，不如在房间里多练习一会儿。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, yǔqí zài hēi'àn zhōng màoxiǎn, bùrú zài fángjiān lǐ duō liànxí yīhuǐr.
sentences.english: He thought that instead of risking it in the dark, it would be better to practice more in the room for a while.

sentences.chinese: 但他的心不安，他觉得有人在不满地看着他。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tā de xīn bù'ān, tā juéde yǒurén zài bùmǎn de kànzhe tā.
sentences.english: But his heart was uneasy; he felt someone was looking at him with dissatisfaction.

sentences.chinese: 他想起那些坏人，他们总是想抢走古老的魔力。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ nàxiē huàirén, tāmen zǒngshì xiǎng qiǎngzǒu gǔlǎo de mólì.
sentences.english: He thought of those bad people who always wanted to steal the ancient magic.

sentences.chinese: 这时，他看到窗台上的一个魔法通讯器突然卡住了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, tā kàndào chuāngtái shàng de yīgè mófǎ tōngxùnqì tūrán kǎzhùle.
sentences.english: At that moment, he saw a magic communicator on the windowsill suddenly freeze/lag.

sentences.chinese: 它发出奇怪的声音，然后突然关机了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāchū qíguài de shēngyīn, ránhòu tūrán guānjīle.
sentences.english: It made a strange sound and then suddenly turned off.

sentences.chinese: 林风觉得很奇怪，因为这个机器从来不会自己停下来。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng juéde hěn qíguài, yīnwèi zhège jīqì cónglái bùhuì zìjǐ tíng xiàlái.
sentences.english: Lin Feng found it very strange because this machine never stopped by itself.

sentences.chinese: 他想起海老师在休假之前，告诉他这个机器连接着外地的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ Hǎi lǎoshī zài xiūjià zhīqián, gàosù tā zhège jīqì liánjiēzhe wàidì de dìfāng.
sentences.english: He remembered that before Teacher Hai went on vacation, he told him this machine connected to places in other parts of the country.

sentences.chinese: 在那个世界，人们可以像出国一样，通过魔法门去另一个国家。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nàge shìjiè, rénmen kěyǐ xiàng chūguó yīyàng, tōngguò mófǎ mén qù lìng yīgè guójiā.
sentences.english: In that world, people could go to another country through a magic gate, just like going abroad.

sentences.chinese: 林风走到门前，发现门被某种力量关上了，他只能用力推门。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zǒu dào mén qián, fāxiàn mén bèi mǒu zhǒng lìliàng guānshàngle, tā zhǐnéng yònglì tuī mén.
sentences.english: Lin Feng walked to the door and found it closed by some force; he could only push the door with effort.

sentences.chinese: 他用力一推，门终于开了，但他不小心把手中的书掉在了地上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yònglì yī tuī, mén zhōngyú kāile, dàn tā bù xiǎoxīn bǎ shǒuzhōng de shū diàozàile dìshàng.
sentences.english: He gave a hard push, and the door finally opened, but he accidentally dropped the book in his hand on the ground.

sentences.chinese: 他赶紧放下手中的东西，捡起那本书。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎnjǐn fàngxià shǒuzhōng de dōngxī, jiǎn qǐ nà běn shū.
sentences.english: He quickly put down the things in his hand and picked up the book.

sentences.chinese: 书上写着，如果一个人在禁忌之门前停下，就不能回头。
sentences.pinyin: Shū shàng xiězhe, rúguǒ yīgè rén zài jìnjì zhī mén qián tíng xià, jiù bùnéng huítóu.
sentences.english: The book said that if a person stops before the Forbidden Gate, they must not look back.

sentences.chinese: 林风想，如果我不能通过这个门，那就不行。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎng, rúguǒ wǒ bùnéng tōngguò zhège mén, nà jiù bùxíng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng thought, if I cannot pass through this gate, then it won't do.

sentences.chinese: 他走到走廊尽头，那里有一个发光的出口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu dào zǒuláng jìntóu, nàlǐ yǒu yīgè fāguāng de chūkǒu.
sentences.english: He walked to the end of the corridor, where there was a glowing exit.

sentences.chinese: 他想起之前受伤的伙伴，他们已经出院了，现在正分开在不同的城市练习。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zhīqián shòushāng de huǒbàn, tāmen yǐjīng chūyuànle, xiànzài zhèng fēnkāi zài bùtóng de chéngshì liànxí.
sentences.english: He thought of his previously injured companions; they had already been discharged from the hospital and were now practicing separately in different cities.

sentences.chinese: 他希望有一天能和他们再次见面。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xīwàng yǒu yītiān néng hé tāmen zàicì jiànmiàn.
sentences.english: He hoped that one day he could meet them again.

sentences.chinese: 他记得在光芒之城，人们习惯在下午午睡，但现在是深夜。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìdé zài Guāngmáng zhī Chéng, rénmen xíguàn zài xiàwǔ wǔshuì, dàn xiànzài shì shēnyè.
sentences.english: He remembered that in the City of Light, people were used to taking a nap in the afternoon, but now it was deep night.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一个黑色的影子在墙上倒了下来，像是一只巨大的手。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào yīgè hēisè de yǐngzi zài qiáng shàng dǎole xiàlái, xiàng shì yī zhī jùdà de shǒu.
sentences.english: He saw a black shadow collapse/fall onto the wall, looking like a giant hand.

sentences.chinese: 林风感到很紧张，他不好意思地对着空气道歉，希望没有打扰到谁。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎndào hěn jǐnzhāng, tā bù hǎoyìsi de duìzhe kōngqì dàoqiàn, xīwàng méiyǒu dǎrǎo dào shéi.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt very nervous; he apologetically apologized to the air, hoping he hadn't disturbed anyone.

sentences.chinese: 他想起那个女人的声音，她似乎在引导他走向这个出口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ nàge nǚrén de shēngyīn, tā sìhū zài yǐndǎo tā zǒuxiàng zhège chūkǒu.
sentences.english: He thought of the woman's voice; she seemed to be guiding him toward this exit.

sentences.chinese: 他深呼吸，决定跨入那道光芒之中。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shēnhūxī, juédìng kuà rù nà dào guāngmáng zhī zhōng.
sentences.english: He took a deep breath and decided to step into the light.

sentences.chinese: 就在他进入的一瞬间，他听到身后传来一声巨大的轰鸣。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tā jìnrù de yī shùnjiān, tā tīngdào shēnhòu chuán lái yī shēng jùdà de hōngmíng.
sentences.english: The moment he entered, he heard a loud boom behind him.

sentences.chinese: 一个巨大的黑洞在他身后出现，将所有的路都堵住了。
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè jùdà de hēidòng zài tā shēnhòu chūxiàn, jiāng suǒyǒu de lù dōu dǔzhùle.
sentences.english: A huge black hole appeared behind him, blocking all the paths.

sentences.chinese: 他回头看，发现自己再也回不去了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huítóu kàn, fāxiàn zìjǐ zài yě huí bù qùle.
sentences.english: He looked back and found that he could no longer return.

sentences.chinese: 此时，一个冷漠的声音在他耳边响起：“欢迎来到真正的试炼之地。”
sentences.pinyin: Cǐshí, yīgè lěngmò de shēngyīn zài tā ěrbiān xiǎngqǐ: “Huānyíng láidào zhēnzhèng de shìliàn zhī dì.”
sentences.english: At this moment, a cold voice sounded in his ear: "Welcome to the true land of trials."

chapters.title_chinese: 第十二章：冰原之上的试炼
chapters.title_english: Chapter 12: Trial on the Frozen Plains

sentences.chinese: 林风走进了一个奇怪的世界。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zǒu jìn le yí gè qí guài de shì jiè.
sentences.english: Lin Feng entered a strange world.

sentences.chinese: 这里到处都在下雪，白色的雪覆盖了所有的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ dào chù dōu zài xià xuě, bái sè de xuě fù gài le suǒ yǒu de dì fāng.
sentences.english: It was snowing everywhere, and white snow covered everything.

sentences.chinese: 他感觉到这里的空气越来越冷。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎn jué dào zhè lǐ de kōng qì yuè lái yuè lěng.
sentences.english: He felt that the air here was becoming colder and colder.

sentences.chinese: 在他面前，一个巨大的冰雪巨人站住了。
sentences.pinyin: Zài tā miàn qián, yí gè jù dà de bīng xuě jù rén zhàn zhù le.
sentences.english: In front of him, a giant ice monster stood still.

sentences.chinese: 这个巨人的身体非常重，大约有一亿千克。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge jù rén de shēn tǐ fēi cháng zhòng, dà yuē yǒu yì yì qiān kè.
sentences.english: The body of this giant was very heavy, about one hundred million kilograms.

sentences.chinese: 林风惊讶地发现，这个巨人的体重可能超过了一亿公斤。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jīng yà de fā xiàn, zhè ge jù rén de tǐ zhòng kě néng chāo guò le yì yì gōng jīn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng was surprised to find that the giant's weight might exceed one hundred million kilograms.

sentences.chinese: 巨人看着他，声音像雷一样大。
sentences.pinyin: Jù rén kàn zhe tā, shēng yīn xiàng léi yí yàng dà.
sentences.english: The giant looked at him, his voice as loud as thunder.

sentences.chinese: “你见过这里的守卫吗？”巨人问。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ jiàn guò zhè lǐ de shǒu wèi ma?” jù rén wèn.
sentences.english: "Have you seen the guards here?" the giant asked.

sentences.chinese: 林风摇了摇头，因为他以前从来没有见过这样的生物。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yáo le yáo tóu, yīn wèi tā yǐ qián cóng lái méi yǒu jiàn guò zhè yàng de shēng wù.
sentences.english: Lin Feng shook his head because he had never seen such a creature before.

sentences.chinese: 巨人告诉他，这个世界有几千公里那么大。
sentences.pinyin: Jù rén gào su tā, zhè ge shì jiè yǒu jǐ qiān gōng lǐ nà me dà.
sentences.english: The giant told him that this world was several thousand kilometers large.

sentences.chinese: 林风想知道自己在这个世界出生的时候会发生什么。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎng zhī dào zì jǐ zài zhè ge shì jiè chū shēng de shí hou huì fā shēng shén me.
sentences.english: Lin Feng wondered what would happen if he were born in this world.

sentences.chinese: 他想，如果一个人在这里长大，一定会变得很强。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng, rú guǒ yí gè rén zài zhè lǐ zhǎng dà, yí dìng huì biàn de hěn qiáng.
sentences.english: He thought that if a person grew up here, they would definitely become very strong.

sentences.chinese: 巨人说，他已经在这里等了许多年。
sentences.pinyin: Jù rén shuō, tā yǐ jīng zài zhè lǐ děng le xǔ duō nián.
sentences.english: The giant said that he had already been waiting here for many years.

sentences.chinese: 突然，林风听到一个声音在耳边响起，像是在打电话一样：“喂！”
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, Lín Fēng tīng dào yí gè shēng yīn zài ěr biān xiǎng qǐ, xiàng shì zài dǎ diàn huà yí yàng: “Wéi!”
sentences.english: Suddenly, Lin Feng heard a voice ring in his ear, as if someone were on the phone: "Hello!"

sentences.chinese: 他回头看，发现一个透明的小精灵飞到了他面前。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huí tóu kàn, fā xiàn yí gè tòu míng de xiǎo jīng líng fēi dào le tā miàn qián.
sentences.english: He looked back and found a transparent little sprite flying in front of him.

sentences.chinese: 小精灵说：“你接到我的邀请信了吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo jīng líng shuō: “Nǐ jiē dào wǒ de yāo qǐng xìn le ma?”
sentences.english: The little sprite said, "Did you receive my invitation letter?"

sentences.chinese: 林风摸了摸口袋，他确实收到了一封发光的信。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng mō le mō kǒu dài, tā què shí shōu dào le yì fēng fā guāng de xìn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt his pocket; he had indeed received a glowing letter.

sentences.chinese: 信上写着，如果他有空儿，就请他去冰原的中心。
sentences.pinyin: Xìn shàng xiě zhe, rú guǒ tā yǒu kòng r, jiù qǐng tā qù bīng yuán de zhōng xīn.
sentences.english: The letter said that if he were available, he was invited to the center of the ice plains.

sentences.chinese: 林风点头表示同意。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng diǎn tóu biǎo shì tóng yì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng nodded in agreement.

sentences.chinese: 小精灵说，要把信送到中心需要走很多路。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo jīng líng shuō, yào bǎ xìn sòng dào zhōng xīn xū yào zǒu hěn duō lù.
sentences.english: The little sprite said that delivering the letter to the center required walking a long way.

sentences.chinese: 他们开始走，每走一分钟，周围的雾就浓一点。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men kāi shǐ zǒu, měi zǒu yì fēn zhōng, zhōu wéi de wù jiù nóng yì diǎn.
sentences.english: They began to walk; for every minute they walked, the surrounding mist grew thicker.

sentences.chinese: 在这个世界的入口，很多寻求力量的人正在排队。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè ge shì jiè de rù kǒu, hěn duō xún qiú lì liàng de rén zhèng zài pái duì.
sentences.english: At the entrance of this world, many people seeking power were lining up.

sentences.chinese: 林风想，如果他迷路了，该怎么办？
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎng, rú guǒ tā mí lù le, gāi zěn me bàn?
sentences.english: Lin Feng wondered, if he got lost, what should be done?

sentences.chinese: 他记得海老师说过，在关键的节骨眼上，必须保持冷静。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì dé Hǎi lǎo shī shuō guò, zài guān jiàn de jié gǔ yǎn shàng, bì xū bǎo chí lěng jìng.
sentences.english: He remembered Teacher Hai saying that at the critical juncture, one must remain calm.

sentences.chinese: 结果，他发现自己的魔力在冰雪中变得更强了。
sentences.pinyin: Jié guǒ, tā fā xiàn zì jǐ de mó lì zài bīng xuě zhōng biàn de gèng qiáng le.
sentences.english: As a result, he found that his magic became stronger in the ice and snow.

sentences.chinese: 他终于见到了冰原的中心，那里有一座巨大的出租魔力塔。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhōng yú jiàn dào le bīng yuán de zhōng xīn, nà lǐ yǒu yí zuò jù dà de chū zū mó lì tǎ.
sentences.english: He finally saw the center of the ice plains, where there was a huge magic rental tower.

sentences.chinese: 塔上的老人告诉他，这里的魔力可以租给那些需要的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tǎ shàng de lǎo rén gào su tā, zhè lǐ de mó lì kě yǐ zū gěi nà xiē xū yào de rén.
sentences.english: The old man on the tower told him that the magic here could be rented to those in need.

sentences.chinese: 林风看着这座塔，意识到真正的试炼才刚刚开始。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn zhe zhè zuò tǎ, yì shí dào zhēn zhèng de shì liàn cái gāng gāng kāi shǐ.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the tower and realized that the true trial had only just begun.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十三章：魔力塔的名单
chapters.title_english: Chapter 13: The List of the Magic Tower

sentences.chinese: 林风走进了这座巨大的出租魔力塔。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zǒu jìn le zhè zuò jù dà de chū zū mó lì tǎ.
sentences.english: Lin Feng walked into the giant Magic Rental Tower.

sentences.chinese: 塔里的老人递给他一张古老的名单。
sentences.pinyin: Tǎ lǐ de lǎo rén dì gěi tā yī zhāng gǔ lǎo de míng dān.
sentences.english: The old man in the tower handed him an ancient list.

sentences.chinese: 老人说，这里记录了所有来自东方的强者。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén shuō, zhè lǐ jì lù le suǒ yǒu lái zì Dōng fāng de qiáng zhě.
sentences.english: The old man said that all the strong ones from the East were recorded here.

sentences.chinese: 林风在名单上看到了很多奇怪的姓名。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zài míng dān shàng kàn dào le hěn duō qí guài de xìng míng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng saw many strange full names on the list.

sentences.chinese: 有的人姓向，有的人姓封。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu de rén xìng Xiàng, yǒu de rén xìng Fēng.
sentences.english: Some were surnamed Xiang, some were surnamed Feng.

sentences.chinese: 还有的人姓平，或者姓成。
sentences.pinyin: Hái yǒu de rén xìng Píng, huò zhě xìng Chéng.
sentences.english: Others were surnamed Ping, or surnamed Cheng.

sentences.chinese: 他继续往下看，看到了姓查、姓米的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì xù wǎng xià kàn, kàn dào le xìng Zhā, xìng Mǐ de rén.
sentences.english: He continued looking down and saw people surnamed Zha and Mi.

sentences.chinese: 名单上还有姓红、姓角和姓闻的人。
sentences.pinyin: Míng dān shàng hái yǒu xìng Hóng, xìng Jué hé xìng Wén de rén.
sentences.english: On the list, there were also people surnamed Hong, Jue, and Wen.

sentences.chinese: 最后，他看到了姓雪、姓题和姓黄的人。
sentences.pinyin: Zuì hòu, tā kàn dào le xìng Xuě, xìng Tí hé xìng Huáng de rén.
sentences.english: Finally, he saw people surnamed Xue, Ti, and Huang.

sentences.chinese: 这些人都是在春节期间来到这里的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiē rén dōu shì zài Chūn jié qī jiān lái dào zhè lǐ de.
sentences.english: These people all came here during the Spring Festival.

sentences.chinese: 老人告诉他，这不仅仅是一个名字的列表。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén gào sù tā, zhè bù jǐn jǐn shì yī gè míng zi de liè biǎo.
sentences.english: The old man told him that this was not just a list of names.

sentences.chinese: 这是一个关于力量的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yī gè guān yú lì liàng de mì mì.
sentences.english: It was a secret about power.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个穿着绿衣服的魔法师走了过来。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yī gè chuān zhe lǜ yī fú de mó fǎ shī zǒu le guò lái.
sentences.english: At that moment, a magician wearing green clothes walked over.

sentences.chinese: 他的眼睛像绿色的宝石一样发光。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yǎn jīng xiàng lǜ sè de bǎo shí yī yàng fā guāng.
sentences.english: His eyes glowed like green gemstones.

sentences.chinese: 这位魔法师姓加，他是这里的管理员。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi mó fǎ shī xìng Jiā, tā shì zhè lǐ de guǎn lǐ yuán.
sentences.english: This magician was surnamed Jia; he was the administrator here.

sentences.chinese: 加先生看着林风，眼神里有一丝难过。
sentences.pinyin: Jiā xiān sheng kàn zhe Lín Fēng, yǎn shén lǐ yǒu yī sī nán guò.
sentences.english: Mr. Jia looked at Lin Feng, and there was a hint of sadness in his eyes.

sentences.chinese: 他说，很多年轻人来到这里，但很少有人能留下来。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, hěn duō nián qīng rén lái dào zhè lǐ, dàn hěn shǎo yǒu rén néng liú xià lái.
sentences.english: He said that many young people come here, but very few can stay.

sentences.chinese: 林风问他，为什么这里会有这么多不同的姓氏？
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng wèn tā, wèi shén me zhè lǐ huì yǒu zhè me duō bù tóng de xìng shì?
sentences.english: Lin Feng asked him why there were so many different surnames here.

sentences.chinese: 加先生笑了，他说这就像城市的交通一样复杂。
sentences.pinyin: Jiā xiān sheng xiào le, tā shuō zhè jiù xiàng chéng shì de jiāo tōng yī yàng fù zá.
sentences.english: Mr. Jia smiled and said it was as complex as city traffic.

sentences.chinese: 在现实世界，人们坐公交车或者出租车去工作。
sentences.pinyin: Zài xiàn shí shì jiè, rén men zuò gōng jiāo chē huò zhě chū zū chē qù gōng zuò.
sentences.english: In the real world, people take the bus or a taxi to go to work.

sentences.chinese: 但在魔力世界，人们通过姓名和血缘寻找力量。
sentences.pinyin: Zài mó lì shì jiè, rén men tōng guò xìng míng hé xuè yuán xún zhǎo lì liàng.
sentences.english: But in the magic world, people seek power through names and bloodlines.

sentences.chinese: 林风想起在光芒之城度过的那个周末。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎng qǐ zài Guāng máng zhī chéng dù guò de nà gè zhōu mò.
sentences.english: Lin Feng thought of the weekend he spent in the City of Light.

sentences.chinese: 那时候他还没意识到，自己的名字也在这个名单的深处。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shí hòu tā hái méi yì shí dào, zì jǐ de míng zi yě zài zhè gè míng dān de shēn chù.
sentences.english: At that time, he hadn't realized that his own name was also deep within this list.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，塔顶突然响起了一声巨大的龙吼。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, tǎ dǐng tū rán xiǎng qǐ le yī shēng jù dà de lóng hǒu.
sentences.english: Just then, a loud dragon roar suddenly sounded from the top of the tower.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙再次回来了，而且它这次带了一个巨大的阴影。
sentences.pinyin: Hēi lóng zài cì huí lái le, ér qiě tā zhè cì dài le yī gè jù dà de yīn yǐng.
sentences.english: The Black Dragon had returned, and this time it brought a massive shadow.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十四章：幻象之城的迷宫
chapters.title_english: Chapter 14: The Labyrinth of the Illusion City

sentences.chinese: 黑龙带来的阴影突然覆盖了魔力塔，将林风卷入了一个奇怪的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Hēilóng dài lái de yīnyǐng tūrán fùgài le mólì tǎ, jiāng Lín Fēng juǎn rù le yī gè qíguài de dìfāng.
sentences.english: The shadow brought by the Black Dragon suddenly covered the Magic Tower, sweeping Lin Feng into a strange place.

sentences.chinese: 他睁开眼，发现自己站在一条热闹的街上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhēng kāi yǎn, fāxiàn zìjǐ zhàn zài yī tiáo rènao de jiē shàng.
sentences.english: He opened his eyes and found himself standing on a bustling street.

sentences.chinese: 这里看起来像是一个现代城市，而不是魔力世界。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ kàn qǐlái xiàng shì yī gè xiàndài chéngshì, ér bùshì mólì shìjiè.
sentences.english: This place looked like a modern city, not the magic world.

sentences.chinese: 他看到人们在银行前面排队，有人在超市买东西。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàndào rénmen zài yínháng qiánmiàn páiduì, yǒurén zài chāoshì mǎi dōngxi.
sentences.english: He saw people queuing in front of the bank, and some people buying things at the supermarket.

sentences.chinese: 林风感到很困惑，因为这里没有魔力，只有嘈杂的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎndào hěn kùnhuò, yīnwèi zhèlǐ méiyǒu mólì, zhǐyǒu cáozá de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt very confused because there was no magic here, only noisy sounds.

sentences.chinese: 他走到一个地铁站门口，但那里没有车，只有一张巨大的日报贴在墙上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu dào yī gè dìtiězhàn ménkǒu, dàn nàlǐ méiyǒu chē, zhǐyǒu yī zhāng jùdà de rìbào tiē zài qiáng shàng.
sentences.english: He walked to the entrance of a subway station, but there were no trains, only a huge daily newspaper pasted on the wall.

sentences.chinese: 日报上写着：市长宣布今晚将举行一场盛大的晚会。
sentences.pinyin: Rìbào shàng xiě zhe: shìzhǎng xuānbù jīn wǎn jiāng jǔxíng yī chǎng shèngdà de wǎnhuì.
sentences.english: The newspaper read: The mayor announced that a grand evening party would be held tonight.

sentences.chinese: 林风想离开这里，他走向一座巨大的大门。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎng líkāi zhèlǐ, tā zǒu xiàng yī zuò jùdà de dàmén.
sentences.english: Lin Feng wanted to leave this place and walked toward a huge gate.

sentences.chinese: 门后面是一个像体育场一样大的广场，人们在里面大声唱歌，像是在开音乐会。
sentences.pinyin: Mén hòumiàn shì yī gè xiàng tǐyùchǎng yīyàng dà de guǎngchǎng, rénmen zài lǐmiàn dàshēng chànggē, xiàng shì zài kāi yīnyuèhuì.
sentences.english: Behind the gate was a square as large as a stadium, where people were singing loudly, as if they were holding a concert.

sentences.chinese: 他靠在墙边，想起海老师说过，这是黑龙制造的幻象迷宫。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kào zài qiáng biān, xiǎngqǐ Hǎi lǎoshī shuō guò, zhè shì hēilóng zhìzào de huànxiàng mígōng.
sentences.english: He leaned against the wall, remembering Teacher Hai saying that this was an illusion labyrinth created by the Black Dragon.

sentences.chinese: 要通过这个迷宫，他必须找到真实的东西。
sentences.pinyin: Yào tōngguò zhège mígōng, tā bìxū zhǎodào zhēnshí de dōngxi.
sentences.english: To pass through this labyrinth, he had to find things that were real.

sentences.chinese: 他走进一家饭馆，服务员给了他一张菜单。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu jìn yī jiā fànguǎn, fúwùyuán gěi le tā yī zhāng càidān.
sentences.english: He entered a restaurant, and the waiter gave him a menu.

sentences.chinese: 菜单上写着西餐，但林风发现这些食物都是假的。
sentences.pinyin: Càidān shàng xiě zhe xīcān, dàn Lín Fēng fāxiàn zhèxiē shíwù dōu shì jiǎ de.
sentences.english: The menu listed Western-style food, but Lin Feng discovered that this food was all fake.

sentences.chinese: 他走出饭馆，看到一个药店和一个动物园，但动物园里的动物都在睡觉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu chū fànguǎn, kàndào yī gè yàodiàn hé yī gè dòngwùyuán, dàn dòngwùyuán lǐ de dòngwù dōu zài shuìjiào.
sentences.english: He walked out of the restaurant and saw a pharmacy and a zoo, but the animals in the zoo were all sleeping.

sentences.chinese: 他走过一个公园，公园里有一个美丽的花园，花朵在发光。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu guò yī gè gōngyuán, gōngyuán lǐ yǒu yī gè měilì de huāyuán, huāduǒ zài fāguāng.
sentences.english: He walked through a park, and in the park there was a beautiful garden where the flowers were glowing.

sentences.chinese: 一个穿着奇怪衣服的人走过来，问他是否有护照。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè chuān zhe qíguài yīfu de rén zǒu guòlái, wèn tā shìfǒu yǒu hùzhào.
sentences.english: A person wearing strange clothes came over and asked if he had a passport.

sentences.chinese: 林风没有护照，对方就要求他用信用卡支付进入下一区域的费用。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng méiyǒu hùzhào, duìfāng jiù yāoqiú tā yòng xìnyòngkǎ zhīfù jìn rù xià yī qūyù de fèiyòng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng had no passport, so the other party requested him to use a credit card to pay the fee for entering the next area.

sentences.chinese: 林风在口袋里只找到了几包方便面，他无奈地笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zài kǒudài lǐ zhǐ zhǎodào le jǐ bāo fāngbiànmiàn, tā wúnài de xiào le.
sentences.english: Lin Feng found only a few packs of instant noodles in his pocket and smiled helplessly.

sentences.chinese: 他记得在那个友好的人群中，有一个人告诉他，真正的出口在城市的尽头。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìdé zài nàgè yǒuhǎo de rénqún zhōng, yǒu yī gè rén gàosù tā, zhēnzhèng de chūkǒu zài chéngshì de jìntóu.
sentences.english: He remembered that among that friendly crowd, someone told him the real exit was at the end of the city.

sentences.chinese: 他继续走，路过一个满是雾气的广场，感觉这里的空气很沉重。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìxù zǒu, lùguò yī gè mǎn shì wùqì de guǎngchǎng, gǎnjué zhèlǐ de kōngqì hěn chénzhòng.
sentences.english: He continued walking, passing a square full of mist, feeling that the air here was very heavy.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，这个城市的所有建筑——银行、超市、饭馆——都是为了困住他的心。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, zhège chéngshì de suǒyǒu jiànzhù —— yínháng, chāoshì, fànguǎn —— dōu shì wèile kùn zhù tā de xīn.
sentences.english: He realized that all the buildings in this city—the bank, the supermarket, the restaurant—were meant to trap his heart.

sentences.chinese: 他闭上眼睛，不再看这些虚假的景象，而是尝试用体内的魔力去感受。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì shàng yǎnjīng, bù zài kàn zhèxiē xūjiǎ de jǐngxiàng, ér shì chángshì yòng tǐnèi de mólì qù gǎnshòu.
sentences.english: He closed his eyes, stopped looking at these fake images, and tried to feel with the magic inside his body.

sentences.chinese: 突然，地面的幻象开始裂开，真正的魔力塔再次出现。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, dìmiàn de huànxiàng kāishǐ liè kāi, zhēnzhèng de mólì tǎ zài cì chūxiàn.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the illusion on the ground began to crack, and the real Magic Tower appeared again.

sentences.chinese: 但就在他准备跳出去时，黑龙的声音在他耳边响起：
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài tā zhǔnbèi tiào chūqù shí, hēilóng de shēngyīn zài tā ěrbiān xiǎngqǐ:
sentences.english: But just as he was preparing to jump out, the Black Dragon's voice sounded in his ear:

sentences.chinese: “你以为你已经通过了试炼吗？”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ yǐwéi nǐ yǐjīng tōngguò le shìliàn ma?”
sentences.english: "Do you think you have already passed the trial?"

chapters.title_chinese: 第十五章：魔力塔的真实面貌
chapters.title_english: Chapter 15: The True Face of the Magic Tower

sentences.chinese: 黑龙的声音像雷一样，林风感觉到脚下的地面在颤抖。
sentences.pinyin: Hēilóng de shēngyīn xiàng léi yīyàng, Lín Fēng gǎnjué dào jiǎoxià de dìmiàn zài chàndǒu.
sentences.english: The black dragon's voice was like thunder, and Lin Feng felt the ground beneath his feet trembling.

sentences.chinese: 他发现自己不再在幻象之城，而是在魔力塔的第十层。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn zìjǐ bù zài zài huànxiàng zhī chéng, ér shì zài mólì tǎ de dì shí céng.
sentences.english: He discovered that he was no longer in the City of Illusions, but on the tenth floor of the Magic Tower.

sentences.chinese: 这里看起来像一个巨大的办公室，空气中有种奇怪的味道，像是旧书和药水的混合。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ kàn qǐlái xiàng yīgè jùdà de bàngōngshì, kōngqì zhōng yǒu zhǒng qíguài de wèidào, xiàng shì jiù shū hé yàoshuǐ de hùnhé.
sentences.english: It looked like a giant office, and there was a strange smell in the air, like a mixture of old books and potions.

sentences.chinese: 墙上挂着一份奇怪的名单，上面写着很多人的名称。
sentences.pinyin: Qiáng shàng guàzhe yī fèn qíguài de míngdān, shàngmiàn xiězhe hěnduō rén de míngchēng.
sentences.english: A strange list was hanging on the wall, with the names of many people written on it.

sentences.chinese: 林风看到一个名额被圈了起来，那是他的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàndào yīgè míng'é bèi quānle qǐlái, nà shì tā de míngzi.
sentences.english: Lin Feng saw one spot circled; it was his name.

sentences.chinese: 一个穿着白衣服的人走过来，他看起来像是一个院长。
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè chuānzhe bái yīfú de rén zǒu guòlái, tā kàn qǐlái xiàng shì yīgè yuànzhǎng.
sentences.english: A person dressed in white walked over; he looked like a dean.

sentences.chinese: 这个院长告诉林风，这里不是学校，而是一个魔力管理单位。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège yuànzhǎng gàosù Lín Fēng, zhèlǐ bùshì xuéxiào, ér shì yīgè mólì guǎnlǐ dānwèi.
sentences.english: This dean told Lin Feng that this was not a school, but a magic management unit.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林风，想要离开这里，必须通过一场非常难的考试。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Lín Fēng, xiǎngyào líkāi zhèlǐ, bìxū tōngguò yī cháng fēicháng nán de kǎoshì.
sentences.english: He told Lin Feng that in order to leave this place, he must pass a very difficult exam.

sentences.chinese: 林风看到桌子上有一件奇怪的衣服，像是一个考生的制服。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàndào zhuōzi shàng yǒu yī jiàn qíguài de yīfú, xiàng shì yīgè kǎoshēng de zhìfú.
sentences.english: Lin Feng saw a strange piece of clothing on the table, like a candidate's uniform.

sentences.chinese: 院长说，现在的魔力水平要求很高，很多考生在这里失败了。
sentences.pinyin: Yuànzhǎng shuō, xiànzài de mólì shuǐpíng yāoqiú hěn gāo, hěnduō kǎoshēng zài zhèlǐ shībàile.
sentences.english: The dean said that the current magic level requirements are very high, and many candidates have failed here.

sentences.chinese: 为了准备考试，林风必须学习很多复杂的词语。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile zhǔnbèi kǎoshì, Lín Fēng bìxū xuéxí hěnduō fùzá de cíyǔ.
sentences.english: To prepare for the exam, Lin Feng had to study many complex terms.

sentences.chinese: 他打开一本巨大的字典，里面记录了古老的魔力符号。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dǎkāi yī běn jùdà de zìdiǎn, lǐmiàn jìlùle gǔlǎo de mólì fúhào.
sentences.english: He opened a huge dictionary, which recorded ancient magic symbols.

sentences.chinese: 他发现有些词语的读音非常奇怪，必须用普通话才能读正确。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn yǒuxiē cíyǔ de dúyīn fēicháng qíguài, bìxū yòng pǔtōnghuà cáinéng dú zhèngquè.
sentences.english: He found that the pronunciation of some terms was very strange and could only be read correctly using Mandarin.

sentences.chinese: 院长给了他一本词典，让他学习每一个生词。
sentences.pinyin: Yuànzhǎng gěile tā yī běn cídiǎn, ràng tā xuéxí měi yīgè shēngcí.
sentences.english: The dean gave him a dictionary and asked him to study every new word.

sentences.chinese: 林风在笔记本上认真地写笔记，因为这些知识是离开这里的唯一条件。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zài bǐjìběn shàng rènzhēn de xiě bǐjì, yīnwèi zhèxiē zhīshí shì líkāi zhèlǐ de wéiyī tiáojiàn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng carefully wrote notes in his notebook, as this knowledge was the only condition for leaving this place.

sentences.chinese: 在这座塔里，学习魔力就像是在学校开学一样严格。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè zuò tǎ lǐ, xuéxí mólì jiù xiàng shì zài xuéxiào kāixué yīyàng yángé.
sentences.english: In this tower, studying magic was as strict as the start of a new school term.

sentences.chinese: 他发现这里的教育分了很多科，有攻击科，也有治疗科。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn zhèlǐ de jiàoyù fēnle hěnduō kē, yǒu gōngjī kē, yěyǒu zhìliáo kē.
sentences.english: He found that the education here was divided into many branches, including an attack branch and a healing branch.

sentences.chinese: 在治疗科，林风学习了中医和西医的区别。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhìliáo kē, Lín Fēng xuéxíle zhōngyī hé xīyī de qūbié.
sentences.english: In the healing branch, Lin Feng learned the difference between traditional Chinese medicine and Western medicine.

sentences.chinese: 中医使用药片和草药，而西医则使用不同的魔力手术。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōngyī shǐyòng yàopiàn hé cǎoyào, ér xīyī zé shǐyòng bùtóng de mólì shǒushù.
sentences.english: Traditional Chinese medicine used pills and herbs, while Western medicine used different magic surgeries.

sentences.chinese: 院长告诉他，只有真正的才子才能掌握这两种力量。
sentences.pinyin: Yuànzhǎng gàosù tā, zhǐyǒu zhēnzhèng de cáizǐ cáinéng zhǎngwò zhè liǎng zhǒng lìliàng.
sentences.english: The dean told him that only a true talent could master both types of power.

sentences.chinese: 林风想起在底层生活的时候，那些艰苦的日子。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎngqǐ zài dǐcéng shēnghuó de shíhòu, nàxiē jiānkǔ de rìzi.
sentences.english: Lin Feng thought back to the hard days when he lived in the lower levels.

sentences.chinese: 那时候他必须去打工，为了买一份晚报或者简单的外卖食物。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shíhòu tā bìxū qù dǎgōng, wèile mǎi yī fèn wǎnbào huòzhě jiǎndān de wàimài shíwù.
sentences.english: At that time, he had to work temporary jobs just to buy an evening newspaper or a simple takeout meal.

sentences.chinese: 他曾经以为能帮别人是一个好人该做的好事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā céngjīng yǐwéi néng bāng biérén shì yīgè hǎorén gāi zuò de hǎoshì.
sentences.english: He once thought that helping others was a good deed that a good person should do.

sentences.chinese: 但现在，他意识到真正的力量才是保护他人的唯一方式。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiànzài, tā yìshí dào zhēnzhèng de lìliàng cáishì bǎohù tārén de wéiyī fāngshì.
sentences.english: But now, he realized that true power was the only way to protect others.

sentences.chinese: 突然，他看到一个穿着奇怪衣服的人走进来，那个人自称是越国的使者。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, tā kàndào yīgè chuānzhe qíguài yīfú de rén zǒu jìnlái, nàgè rén zìchēng shì Yuèguó de shǐzhě.
sentences.english: Suddenly, he saw a person in strange clothes walk in; that person claimed to be an envoy from the Yue state.

sentences.chinese: 那个使者告诉他，现在在南方流行一种新的魔力控制法。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè shǐzhě gàosù tā, xiànzài zài nánfāng liúxíng yī zhǒng xīn de mólì kòngzhì fǎ.
sentences.english: The envoy told him that a new method of magic control was popular in the south now.

sentences.chinese: 院长冷冷地说，这里的规则由校长决定，外人不能干涉。
sentences.pinyin: Yuànzhǎng lěng lěng de shuō, zhèlǐ de guīzé yóu xiàozhǎng juédìng, wàirén bùnéng gānshè.
sentences.english: The dean said coldly that the rules here were decided by the principal, and outsiders could not interfere.

sentences.chinese: 林风注意到，这个使者的脚上戴着一个沉重的魔力锁链。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhùyì dào, zhège shǐzhě de jiǎo shàng dàizhe yīgè chénzhòng de mólì suǒliàn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng noticed that there was a heavy magic chain on the envoy's foot.

sentences.chinese: 林风看着字典，突然发现一个秘密：这个塔的名称其实是一个巨大的陷阱。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe zìdiǎn, tūrán fāxiàn yīgè mìmì: zhège tǎ de míngchēng qíshí shì yīgè jùdà de xiànjǐng.
sentences.english: Looking at the dictionary, Lin Feng suddenly discovered a secret: the name of this tower was actually a giant trap.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，这里不是在帮助他，而是在吸收他的魔力。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, zhèlǐ bùshì zài bāngzhù tā, ér shì zài xīshōu tā de mólì.
sentences.english: He realized that this place was not helping him, but absorbing his magic.

sentences.chinese: 他快速地翻看笔记，试图寻找破解的方法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kuàisù de fānkàn bǐjì, shìtú xúnzhǎo pòjiě de fāngfǎ.
sentences.english: He quickly flipped through his notes, trying to find a way to break it.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，黑龙再次在窗外发出巨大的吼声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, hēilóng zàicì zài chuāngwài fāchū jùdà de hǒushēng.
sentences.english: Just then, the black dragon let out another huge roar outside the window.

sentences.chinese: 塔内的灯光开始闪烁，整个房间开始剧烈地摇晃。
sentences.pinyin: Tǎ nèi de dēngguāng kāishǐ shǎnshuò, zhěnggè fángjiān kāishǐ jùliè de yáowàng.
sentences.english: The lights inside the tower began to flicker, and the whole room began to shake violently.

sentences.chinese: 院长突然变了脸色，他的眼神变得像野兽一样凶狠。
sentences.pinyin: Yuànzhǎng tūrán biànle liǎnsè, tā de yǎnshén biàn de xiàng yěshòu yīyàng xiōnghěn.
sentences.english: The dean's expression suddenly changed, and his eyes became as fierce as a beast's.

sentences.chinese: 他对着林风大喊：“你居然发现了这个秘密！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā duìzhe Lín Fēng dàhǎn: "Nǐ jūrán fāxiànle zhège mìmì!"
sentences.english: He shouted at Lin Feng: "You actually discovered this secret!"

sentences.chinese: 林风感觉到一股强大的压力向他袭来，他必须立刻做出选择。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎnjué dào yī gǔ qiángdà de yālì xiàng tā xí lái, tā bìxū lìkè zuòchū xuǎnzé.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt a powerful pressure rushing toward him; he had to make a choice immediately.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十六章：镜中之城的幻象
chapters.title_english: Chapter 16: Illusions of the Mirror City

sentences.chinese: 林风面对院长的压力，突然感觉到周围的空间在变化。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng miàn duì yuàn zhǎng de yā lì, tū rán gǎn jué dào zhōu wéi de kōng jiān zài biàn huà.
sentences.english: Facing the Dean's pressure, Lin Feng suddenly felt the space around him changing.

sentences.chinese: 他发现自己不再在魔力塔里，而是站在一个巨大的广场中心。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn zì jǐ bù zài zài mó lì tǎ lǐ, ér shì zhàn zài yí gè jù dà de guǎng chǎng zhōng xīn.
sentences.english: He found that he was no longer in the Magic Tower, but standing in the center of a huge public square.

sentences.chinese: 这里的天空没有太阳，只有一片奇怪的灰色。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de tiān kōng méi yǒu tài yang, zhǐ yǒu yí piàn qí guài de huī sè.
sentences.english: There was no sun in the sky here, only a strange gray.

sentences.chinese: 一个个子很高的人走过来，他穿着一件黑色的长大衣。
sentences.pinyin: Yí gè gè zi hěn gāo de rén zǒu guò lái, tā chuān zhe yí jiàn hēi sè de cháng dà yī.
sentences.english: A very tall man walked over, wearing a long black overcoat.

sentences.chinese: 这个人看起来像是一个商人，但他的眼睛在发光。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge rén kàn qǐ lái xiàng shì yí gè shāng rén, dàn tā de yǎn jīng zài fā guāng.
sentences.english: This man looked like a merchant, but his eyes were glowing.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林风，这里是一个特殊的市，一个由记忆组成的城市。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su Lín Fēng, zhè lǐ shì yí gè tè shū de shì, yí gè yóu jì yì zǔ chéng de chéng shì.
sentences.english: He told Lin Feng that this was a special city, a city composed of memories.

sentences.chinese: 这个城市的人口很多，但每个人都像小说里的角色一样没有灵魂。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge chéng shì de rén kǒu hěn duō, dàn měi gè rén dōu xiàng xiǎo shuō lǐ de jué sè yí yàng méi yǒu líng hún.
sentences.english: The population of this city was large, but everyone was like a character in a novel without a soul.

sentences.chinese: 那个高个子男人说，他是这里的主人，而林风是一个不请自来的客人。
sentences.pinyin: Nà ge gāo gè zi nán rén shuō, tā shì zhè lǐ de zhǔ rén, ér Lín Fēng shì yí gè bù qǐng zì lái de kè rén.
sentences.english: The tall man said he was the master here, and Lin Feng was an uninvited guest.

sentences.chinese: 男人指了指远方，那里有一座巨大的体育馆，像一座山一样。
sentences.pinyin: Nán rén zhǐ le zhǐ yuǎn fāng, nà lǐ yǒu yí zuò jù dà de tǐ yù guǎn, xiàng yí zuò shān yí yàng.
sentences.english: The man pointed into the distance, where there was a huge gymnasium, like a mountain.

sentences.chinese: 他说，在这个体育馆里，林风必须完成一项魔力作业，才能离开。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, zài zhè ge tǐ yù guǎn lǐ, Lín Fēng bì xū wán chéng yí xiàng mó lì zuò yè, cái néng lí kāi.
sentences.english: He said that in this gym, Lin Feng must complete a magic assignment before he could leave.

sentences.chinese: 林风注意到，这个城市的建筑很奇怪，有的像办公室，有的像公司。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhù yì dào, zhè ge chéng shì de jiàn zhù hěn qí guài, yǒu de xiàng bàn gōng shì, yǒu de xiàng gōng sī.
sentences.english: Lin Feng noticed that the buildings in this city were strange; some looked like offices, others like companies.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一个停车场，但那里停的不是车，而是巨大的飞龙。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào yí gè tíng chē chǎng, dàn nà lǐ tíng de bú shì chē, ér shì jù dà de fēi lóng.
sentences.english: He saw a parking lot, but what was parked there were not cars, but giant flying dragons.

sentences.chinese: 一名司机正在给飞龙喂食，动作非常熟练。
sentences.pinyin: Yī míng sī jī zhèng zài gěi fēi lóng wèi shí, dòng zuò fēi cháng shú liàn.
sentences.english: A driver was feeding a flying dragon, his movements very skilled.

sentences.chinese: 在司机的旁边，有几个同事在讨论关于黑龙的新信息。
sentences.pinyin: Zài sī jī de páng biān, yǒu jǐ gè tóng shì zài tǎo lùn guān yú hēi lóng de xīn xìn xī.
sentences.english: Beside the driver, several colleagues were discussing new information about the Black Dragon.

sentences.chinese: 林风听到他们的声音很奇怪，像是从很远的大海传来的。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng tīng dào tā men de shēng yīn hěn qí guài, xiàng shì cóng hěn yuǎn de dà hǎi chuán lái de.
sentences.english: Lin Feng heard that their voices were strange, as if they were coming from a distant sea.

sentences.chinese: 他走近一看，发现这些人的嘴在动，但没有发出真正的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒu jìn yí kàn, fā xiàn zhè xiē rén de zuǐ zài dòng, dàn méi yǒu fā chū zhēn zhèng de shēng yīn.
sentences.english: Walking closer, he found that these people's mouths were moving, but they were not making real sounds.

sentences.chinese: 他看到墙上有一张图片，图片里是一个温暖的家庭。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào qiáng shàng yǒu yì zhāng tú piàn, tú piàn lǐ shì yí gè wēn nuǎn de jiā tíng.
sentences.english: He saw a picture on the wall; in the picture was a warm family.

sentences.chinese: 一个太太在给孩子们准备中餐，桌上有各种好吃的午餐食物。
sentences.pinyin: Yí gè tài tai zài gěi hái zi men zhǔn bèi zhōng cān, zhuō shàng yǒu gè zhǒng hǎo chī de wǔ cān shí wù.
sentences.english: A married woman was preparing a Chinese meal for the children, and there were various delicious lunch foods on the table.

sentences.chinese: 林风想起了自己的家，心中感到一阵酸楚。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎng qǐ le zì jǐ de jiā, xīn zhōng gǎn dào yí zhèn suān chǔ.
sentences.english: Lin Feng thought of his own home and felt a pang of sorrow in his heart.

sentences.chinese: 这时，广场上的钟突然响了，声音震耳欲聋。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, guǎng chǎng shàng de zhōng tū rán xiǎng le, shēng yīn zhèn ěr dú lóng.
sentences.english: At that moment, the clock in the square suddenly rang, the sound deafening.

sentences.chinese: 一个声音在他耳边响起：“欢迎来到试炼的第二位区域。”
sentences.pinyin: Yí gè shēng yīn zài tā ěr biān xiǎng qǐ: “Huān yíng lái dào shì liàn de dì èr wèi qū yù.”
sentences.english: A voice sounded in his ear: "Welcome to the second position area of the trial."

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，这里的每一处位置都是一个陷阱。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, zhè lǐ de měi yì chù wèi zhì dōu shì yí gè xiàn jǐng.
sentences.english: He realized that every single location here was a trap.

sentences.chinese: 他必须在夜里找到出口，否则他会永远变成这里的居民。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì xū zài yè li zhǎo dào chū kǒu, fǒu zé tā huì yǒng yuǎn biàn chéng zhè lǐ de jū mín.
sentences.english: He had to find the exit during the night, otherwise, he would forever become a resident here.

sentences.chinese: 他想起海老师曾说过，真正的力量不在于体育锻炼，而在于内心的坚定。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ hǎi lǎo shī céng shuō guò, zhēn zhèng de lì liàng bú zài yú tǐ yù duàn liàn, ér zài yú nèi xīn de jiān dìng.
sentences.english: He remembered Teacher Hai once saying that true power lies not in physical education, but in the firmness of the heart.

sentences.chinese: 他开始在街道上奔跑，经过一个卖中餐的小摊。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kāi shǐ zài jiē dào shàng bēn pǎo, jīng guò yí gè mài zhōng cān de xiǎo tān.
sentences.english: He began to run through the streets, passing a small stall selling Chinese food.

sentences.chinese: 他发现这里的商人并不想要钱，他们想要的是记忆。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn zhè lǐ de shāng rén bìng bù xiǎng yào qián, tā men xiǎng yào de shì jì yì.
sentences.english: He discovered that the merchants here did not want money; what they wanted were memories.

sentences.chinese: 林风跑向城市的东北方向，那里有一道光芒在闪烁。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng pǎo xiàng chéng shì de dōng běi fāng xiàng, nà lǐ yǒu yí dào guāng máng zài shǎn shuò.
sentences.english: Lin Feng ran toward the northeast direction of the city, where a beam of light was flickering.

sentences.chinese: 他感觉到院长的压力依然在追踪他，像一只饥饿的野兽。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎn jué dào yuàn zhǎng de yā lì yī rán zài zhuī zōng tā, xiàng yì zhī jī è de yě shòu.
sentences.english: He felt the Dean's pressure still tracking him, like a hungry beast.

sentences.chinese: 他再次看向天空，发现灰色的云朵正在裂开。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài cì kàn xiàng tiān kōng, fā xiàn huī sè de yún duǒ zhèng zài liè kāi.
sentences.english: He looked at the sky again and found the gray clouds were splitting open.

sentences.chinese: 他必须快一点，因为这个幻象之城正在慢慢崩溃。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bì xū kuài yì diǎn, yīn wèi zhè ge huàn xiàng zhī chéng zhèng zài màn màn bēng kuì.
sentences.english: He had to be faster, because this illusion city was slowly collapsing.

sentences.chinese: 就在他快要触碰到那道光时，一个巨大的阴影遮住了他。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tā kuài yào chù pèng dào nà dào guāng shí, yí gè jù dà de yīn yǐng zhē zhù le tā.
sentences.english: Just as he was about to touch that light, a huge shadow covered him.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙再次出现了，但这一次，它在对他微笑。
sentences.pinyin: Hēi lóng zài cì chū xiàn le, dàn zhè yí cì, tā zài duì tā wēi xiào.
sentences.english: The Black Dragon appeared again, but this time, it was smiling at him.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十七章：记忆之店的秘密
chapters.title_english: Chapter 17: Secrets of the Memory Shop

sentences.chinese: 黑龙的微笑让林风感到很奇怪，它没有攻击他，而是用尾巴指了指下方。
sentences.pinyin: Hēilóng de wēixiào ràng Lín Fēng gǎndào hěn qíguài, tā méiyǒu gōngjí tā, érshì yòng wěiba zhǐle zhǐ xiàfāng.
sentences.english: The black dragon's smile made Lin Feng feel very strange; it didn't attack him, but pointed downward with its tail.

sentences.chinese: 在那片崩溃的幻象之中，出现了一座奇怪的小房子。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nà piàn bēngkuì de huànxiàng zhī zhōng, chūxiànle yī zuò qíguài de xiǎo fángzi.
sentences.english: Amidst the collapsing illusions, a strange little house appeared.

sentences.chinese: 那是一个神奇的店，门口挂着一盏红色的灯。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì yīgè shénqí de diàn, ménkǒu guàzhe yī zhǎn hóngsè de dēng.
sentences.english: It was a magical shop, with a red lantern hanging at the door.

sentences.chinese: 林风走进去，发现这里不像一个魔法商店，而像是一个现代的房间。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zǒu jìnqù, fāxiàn zhèlǐ bù xiàng yīgè mófǎ shāngdiàn, ér xiàng shì yīgè xiàndài de fángjiān.
sentences.english: Lin Feng walked inside and found that it didn't look like a magic store, but rather a modern room.

sentences.chinese: 这里的空气很新鲜，墙上挂着许多精美的画儿。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de kōngqì hěn xīnxiān, qiáng shàng guàzhe xǔduō jīngměi de huàr.
sentences.english: The air here was fresh, and many exquisite paintings hung on the walls.

sentences.chinese: 一个自称是店长的男人坐在一个舒服的座上，手里拿着一份报纸。
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè zìchēng shì diànzhǎng de nánrén zuò zài yīgè shūfú de zuò shàng, shǒulǐ názhe yī fèn bàozhǐ.
sentences.english: A man calling himself the shopkeeper sat in a comfortable seat, holding a newspaper in his hand.

sentences.chinese: 他看着林风，笑着说：“欢迎来到记忆之店，这里记录了所有旅客的旅游故事。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe Lín Fēng, xiàozhe shuō: “Huānyíng lái dào jìyì zhī diàn, zhèlǐ jìlùle suǒyǒu lǚkè de lǚyóu gùshì.”
sentences.english: He looked at Lin Feng and smiled, saying, "Welcome to the Memory Shop; here we record the travel stories of all travelers."

sentences.chinese: 林风在心里感到很困惑，因为他从未见过这样的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zài xīnlǐ gǎndào hěn kùnhuò, yīnwèi tā cóngwèi jiànguò zhèyàng de dìfāng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt confused in his heart because he had never seen such a place.

sentences.chinese: 店长指了指桌子上的一个笔记本，上面写着很多奇怪的数字。
sentences.pinyin: Diànzhǎng zhǐle zhǐ zhuōzi shàng de yīgè bǐjìběn, shàngmiàn xiězhe hěnduō qíguài de shùzì.
sentences.english: The shopkeeper pointed to a notebook on the table, which had many strange numbers written on it.

sentences.chinese: “在这个世界，记忆可以像商品一样买卖，”店长说。
sentences.pinyin: “Zài zhège shìjiè, jìyì kěyǐ xiàng shāngpǐn yīyàng mǎimài,” diànzhǎng shuō.
sentences.english: "In this world, memories can be bought and sold like commodities," the shopkeeper said.

sentences.chinese: 他拿出一片发光的晶体，晶体里像影片一样播放着过去的事情。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū yī piàn fāguāng de jīngtǐ, jīngtǐ lǐ xiàng yǐngpiàn yīyàng bōfàngzhe guòqù de shìqíng.
sentences.english: He took out a glowing crystal, and inside the crystal, past events played like a movie.

sentences.chinese: 林风看到了一些照片，那是关于古老爱情的故事，非常感人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàndào le yīxiē zhàopiàn, nà shì guānyú gǔlǎo àiqíng de gùshì, fēicháng gǎnrén.
sentences.english: Lin Feng saw some photographs, which were stories of ancient romance, very touching.

sentences.chinese: 店长递给林风一瓶蓝色的药水，说这是给勇敢者的礼物。
sentences.pinyin: Diànzhǎng dì gěi Lín Fēng yī píng lánsè de yàoshuǐ, shuō zhè shì gěi yǒnggǎn zhě de lǐwù.
sentences.english: The shopkeeper handed Lin Feng a bottle of blue potion, saying it was a gift for the brave.

sentences.chinese: “你现在的压力很大，先吃点快餐休息一下吧。”
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ xiànzài de yālì hěn dà, xiān chī diǎn kuàicān xiūxí yīxià ba.”
sentences.english: "You are under a lot of pressure right now, have some fast food and rest for a while."

sentences.chinese: 店长指了指桌上的食物，那里有几斤新鲜的水果和简单的面包。
sentences.pinyin: Diànzhǎng zhǐle zhǐ zhuō shàng de shíwù, nàlǐ yǒu jǐ jīn xīnxiān de shuǐguǒ hé jiǎndān de miànbāo.
sentences.english: The shopkeeper pointed to the food on the table, where there were a few catties of fresh fruit and simple bread.

sentences.chinese: 林风坐下来，看到旁边有一个奇怪的机器，像是一台洗衣机，但它在清洗人们的痛苦记忆。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zuò xiàlái, kàndào pángbiān yǒu yīgè qíguài de jīqì, xiàng shì yī tái xǐyījī, dàn tā zài qīngxǐ rénmen de tòngkǔ jìyì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng sat down and saw a strange machine next to him, looking like a washing machine, but it was cleaning people's painful memories.

sentences.chinese: 这时，门外走进了一个游客，他看起来像是一个大城市的明星，穿着华丽的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, mén wài zǒu jìnle yīgè yóukè, tā kàn qǐlái xiàng shì yīgè dà chéngshì de míngxīng, chuānzhe huálì de yīfú.
sentences.english: At this moment, a tourist walked in from outside; he looked like a celebrity from a big city, wearing gorgeous clothes.

sentences.chinese: 那个游客对着店长说：“我想买一条关于勇气的新记忆。”
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè yóukè duìzhe diànzhǎng shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī tiáo guānyú yǒngqì de xīn jìyì.”
sentences.english: That tourist said to the shopkeeper, "I want to buy a new memory about courage."

sentences.chinese: 林风注意到，这个游客的眼睛里没有光，显得很空洞。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhùyì dào, zhège yóukè de yǎnjīng lǐ méiyǒu guāng, xiǎndé hěn kōngdòng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng noticed that there was no light in the tourist's eyes, making him look very hollow.

sentences.chinese: 店长拿起一支金色的笔，在笔记本上写了一篇新的契约。
sentences.pinyin: Diànzhǎng ná qǐ yī zhī jīnsè de bǐ, zài bǐjìběn shàng xiěle yī piān xīn de qìyuē.
sentences.english: The shopkeeper picked up a golden pen and wrote a new contract in the notebook.

sentences.chinese: 突然，林风的口袋里响起了声音，虽然在这个世界没有手机，但他收到了一条魔力短信。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, Lín Fēng de kǒudài lǐ xiǎngqǐle shēngyīn, suīrán zài zhège shìjiè méiyǒu shǒujī, dàn tā shōudào le yī tiáo mólì duǎnxìn.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a sound rang out from Lin Feng's pocket; although there were no phones in this world, he received a magic text message.

sentences.chinese: 短信的内容很简单，只有三个字：“快离开”。
sentences.pinyin: Duǎnxìn de nèiróng hěn jiǎndān, zhǐyǒu sān gè zì: “Kuài líkāi”.
sentences.english: The content of the text was simple, only three words: "Leave quickly."

sentences.chinese: 林风心中一惊，他突然想起海老师曾经告诉过他，不要相信任何给予礼物的陌生人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xīnzhōng yī jīng, tā tūrán xiǎngqǐ Hǎi lǎoshī céngjīng gàosù guò tā, bùyào xiāngxìn rènhé jǐyǔ lǐwù de mòshēng rén.
sentences.english: Lin Feng was startled; he suddenly remembered that Teacher Hai had once told him not to trust any stranger who gave gifts.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，店里响起了巨大的铃声，当，当，当！
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, diàn lǐ xiǎngqǐle jùdà de língshēng, dāng, dāng, dāng!
sentences.english: Just then, a loud bell rang in the shop: dong, dong, dong!

sentences.chinese: 声音震耳欲聋，整个房间开始剧烈地摇晃。
sentences.pinyin: Shēngyīn zhèn'ěr-dùlóng, zhěnggè fángjiān kāishǐ jùliè de yáoshàng.
sentences.english: The sound was deafening, and the entire room began to shake violently.

sentences.chinese: 窗外的天空突然变黑，无数的星星开始快速旋转，形成了一个巨大的漩涡。
sentences.pinyin: Chuāngwài de tiānkōng tūrán biàn hēi, wúshù de xīngxing kāishǐ kuàisù xuánzhuǎn, xíngchéngle yīgè jùdà de xuánwō.
sentences.english: The sky outside the window suddenly turned black, and countless stars began to rotate rapidly, forming a huge vortex.

sentences.chinese: 林风意识到，这个店其实是院长布置的另一个陷阱。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yìshí dào, zhège diàn qíshí shì yuànzhǎng bùzhì de lìng yīgè xiànjǐng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng realized that this shop was actually another trap set by the Dean.

sentences.chinese: 他想起在学院时，班长总是提醒他要时刻保持警惕。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zài xuéyuàn shí, bānzhǎng zǒng shì tíxǐng tā yào shíkè bǎochí jǐngtì.
sentences.english: He remembered that back at the academy, the class monitor always reminded him to stay vigilant at all times.

sentences.chinese: 他迅速站起来，把药水瓶扔在地上，药水里的油瞬间点燃了火焰。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xùnsù zhàn qǐlái, bǎ yàoshuǐ píng rēng zài dìshàng, yàoshuǐ lǐ de yóu shùnjiān diǎnránle huǒyàn.
sentences.english: He quickly stood up and threw the potion bottle on the ground; the oil in the potion instantly ignited into flames.

sentences.chinese: 火焰在房间里蔓延，那些记录记忆的纸片纷纷被烧掉。
sentences.pinyin: Huǒyàn zài fángjiān lǐ mányàn, nàxiē jìlù jìyì de zhǐpiàn fēnfēn bèi shāo diào.
sentences.english: The flames spread through the room, and those pieces of paper recording memories were burned away one by one.

sentences.chinese: 林风冲向大门，但门已经被一道黑色的光芒封住了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng chōng xiàng dàmén, dàn mén yǐjīng bèi yī dào hēisè de guāngmáng fēng zhù le.
sentences.english: Lin Feng rushed toward the main door, but the door had already been sealed by a beam of black light.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙在窗外再次发出低吼，它的眼神中充满了警告。
sentences.pinyin: Hēilóng zài chuāngwài zàicì fāchū dī hǒu, tā de yǎnshén zhōng chōngmǎnle jǐnggào.
sentences.english: The black dragon let out a low roar outside the window, its eyes full of warning.

sentences.chinese: 林风看向那道封印，意识到他必须用自己的魔力去打破它，否则将永远被困在这里。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn xiàng nà dào fēngyìn, yìshí dào tā bìxū yòng zìjǐ de mólì qù dǎpò tā, fǒuzé jiāng yǒngyuǎn bèi kùn zài zhèlǐ.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the seal and realized he must use his own magic to break it, otherwise he would be trapped here forever.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十八章：记忆之城的幻象市场
chapters.title_english: Chapter 18: The Phantom Market of the Memory City

sentences.chinese: 林风闭上眼睛，将所有的魔力集中在面前的封印上。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng bì shàng yǎnjīng, jiāng suǒyǒu de mólì jízhōng zài miànqián de fēngyìn shàng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng closed his eyes and concentrated all his magic on the seal in front of him.

sentences.chinese: 他感觉到封印像一张巨大的网，试图捕捉他的灵魂。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎnjué dào fēngyìn xiàng yī zhāng jùdà de wǎng, shìtú bǔzhuō tā de línghún.
sentences.english: He felt the seal was like a giant net, trying to capture his soul.

sentences.chinese: 突然，封印破碎了，他被吸进了一个奇怪的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, fēngyìn pòsuì le, tā bèi xī jìn le yī gè qíguài de dìfāng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the seal shattered, and he was sucked into a strange place.

sentences.chinese: 这里看起来像一个热闹的城市，人们在庆祝一个未知的节日。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ kàn qǐlái xiàng yī gè rènào de chéngshì, rénmen zài qìngzhù yī gè wèizhī de jiérì.
sentences.english: It looked like a bustling city, where people were celebrating an unknown festival.

sentences.chinese: 林风看到很多行人走在街上，他们看起来很开心。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn dào hěnduō xíngrén zǒu zài jiē shàng, tāmen kàn qǐlái hěn kāixīn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng saw many pedestrians walking on the street; they looked very happy.

sentences.chinese: 一个自称是这座城市经理的男人走过来，向他微笑。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè zìchēng shì zhè zuò chéngshì jīnglǐ de nánrén zǒu guòlái, xiàng tā wēixiào.
sentences.english: A man who called himself the manager of this city walked over and smiled at him.

sentences.chinese: 这个经理穿着奇怪的衣服，手里拿着一个像网球一样的发光球。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège jīnglǐ chuānzhe qíguài de yīfu, shǒu lǐ názhe yī gè xiàng wǎngqiú yīyàng de fāguāng qiú.
sentences.english: This manager wore strange clothes and held a glowing ball that looked like a tennis ball.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林风，这里是一个巨大的记忆网站，记录着所有人的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosu Lín Fēng, zhèlǐ shì yī gè jùdà de jìyì wǎngzhàn, jìlùzhe suǒyǒu rén de shēnghuó.
sentences.english: He told Lin Feng that this was a giant memory website, recording everyone's lives.

sentences.chinese: 他指着旁边的一台发光的计算机说，这里可以查到任何人的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐzhe pángbiān de yī tái fāguāng de jìsuànjī shuō, zhèlǐ kěyǐ chá dào rènhé rén de mìmì.
sentences.english: Pointing to a glowing computer nearby, he said that any person's secrets could be found here.

sentences.chinese: 在这个世界里，人们不骑马，而是骑着飞行的自行车在空中移动。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège shìjiè lǐ, rénmen bù qí mǎ, ér shì qí zhe fēixíng de zìxíngchē zài kōngzhōng yídòng.
sentences.english: In this world, people did not ride horses, but instead rode flying bicycles in the sky.

sentences.chinese: 林风走在街上，看到一家酒店，里头充满了香气。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zǒu zài jiē shàng, kàn dào yī jiā jiǔdiàn, lǐtou chōngmǎn le xiāngqì.
sentences.english: Walking down the street, Lin Feng saw a hotel, the interior of which was filled with fragrance.

sentences.chinese: 酒店的顾客们正在喝着一种蓝色的酒，吃着像饺子一样的魔力点心。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǔdiàn de gùkè men zhèngzài hēzhe yī zhǒng lánsè de jiǔ, chīzhe xiàng jiǎozi yīyàng de mólì diǎnxīn.
sentences.english: The customers of the hotel were drinking a blue wine and eating magic snacks that looked like dumplings.

sentences.chinese: 经理说，这里的每一个节目都是由人们的记忆组成的。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ shuō, zhèlǐ de měi yī gè jiémù dōu shì yóu rénmen de jìyì zǔchéng de.
sentences.english: The manager said that every program here was composed of people's memories.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一个穿着盔甲的队长带着他的队伍走过来。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yī gè chuānzhe kuījiǎ de duìzhǎng dàizhe tā de duì zǒu guòlái.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a captain wearing armor walked over with his squadron.

sentences.chinese: 队长看着林风，眼神冷漠，像是在寻找一个逃犯。
sentences.pinyin: Duìzhǎng kànzhe Lín Fēng, yǎnshén lěngmò, xiàng shì zài xúnzhǎo yī gè táofàn.
sentences.english: The captain looked at Lin Feng with cold eyes, as if searching for a fugitive.

sentences.chinese: 队长要求林风出示他的身份证明，就像在现代世界要求银行卡一样。
sentences.pinyin: Duìzhǎng yāoqiú Lín Fēng chūshì tā de shēnfèn zhèngmíng, jiù xiàng zài xiàndài shìjiè yāoqiú yínhángkǎ yīyàng.
sentences.english: The captain demanded that Lin Feng show his identification, just like demanding a bank card in the modern world.

sentences.chinese: 林风意识到，这个地方的逻辑很混乱，就像一个被弄脏的梦。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yìshí dào, zhège dìfāng de luójí hěn hùnluàn, jiù xiàng yī gè bèi nòngzàng de mèng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng realized that the logic of this place was chaotic, like a soiled dream.

sentences.chinese: 他感觉到自己的脏器在剧烈跳动，那是恐惧的反应。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎnjué dào zìjǐ de zàngqì zài jùliè tiàodòng, nà shì kǒngjù de fǎnyìng.
sentences.english: He felt his internal organs beating violently; it was a reaction to fear.

sentences.chinese: 这时，他看到一个熟悉的身影，那是他的一个老朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, tā kàn dào yī gè shúxī de shēnyǐng, nà shì tā de yī gè lǎopéngyou.
sentences.english: At that moment, he saw a familiar figure—it was an old friend of his.

sentences.chinese: 老朋友低声说，不要在这里留下任何真实的记忆。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎopéngyou dīshēng shuō, bùyào zài zhèlǐ liúxià rènhé zhēnshí de jìyì.
sentences.english: The old friend whispered, "Do not leave any real memories behind here."

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林风，这个世界的重点是欺骗，所有的美好都是假象。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosu Lín Fēng, zhège shìjiè de zhòngdiǎn shì qīpiàn, suǒyǒu de měihǎo dōu shì jiǎxiàng.
sentences.english: He told Lin Feng that the key point of this world is deception; all the beauty is an illusion.

sentences.chinese: 林风抬头看，天空中竟然挂着三个巨大的月亮。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng táitóu kàn, tiānkōng zhōng jìngrán guàzhe sān gè jùdà de yuèliang.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked up and saw that there were actually three giant moons hanging in the sky.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到自己必须尽快离开这个诡异的幻象市场。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào zìjǐ bìxū jǐnkuài líkāi zhège guǐyì de huànxiàng shìchǎng.
sentences.english: He realized he had to leave this eerie phantom market as quickly as possible.

sentences.chinese: 就在他转身准备离开时，队长突然大喊一声，挥起了手中的长剑。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tā zhuǎnshēn zhǔnbèi líkāi shí, duìzhǎng tūrán dàhǎn yī shēng, huī qǐ le shǒu zhōng de chángjiàn.
sentences.english: Just as he turned to leave, the captain suddenly shouted and swung the long sword in his hand.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十九章：幻象市场的陷阱
chapters.title_english: Chapter 19: The Traps of the Illusion Market

sentences.chinese: 队长挥剑砍向一个透明的影子，但剑刃直接穿过了它。
sentences.pinyin: Duìzhǎng huī jiàn kǎn xiàng yīgè tòumíng de yǐngzi, dàn jiànrèn zhíjiē chuānguòle tā.
sentences.english: The captain swung his sword at a transparent shadow, but the blade passed straight through it.

sentences.chinese: 林风发现，这里的敌人不是真实的，而是记忆的碎片。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng fāxiàn, zhèlǐ de dírén bùshì zhēnshí de, ér shì jìyì de suìpiàn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng discovered that the enemies here were not real, but fragments of memories.

sentences.chinese: “快点儿！跑！”队长大喊一声，拉起林风就往出口跑。
sentences.pinyin: “Kuài diǎn r! Pǎo!” Duìzhǎng dà hǎn yīshēng, lā qǐ Lín Fēng jiù wǎng chūkǒu pǎo.
sentences.english: "Hurry up! Run!" the captain shouted, pulling Lin Feng as they ran toward the exit.

sentences.chinese: 他们跑到了市场的对面，那里有一座奇怪的白色建筑。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen pǎodàole shìchǎng de duìmiàn, nàlǐ yǒu yī zuò qíguài de báisè jiànzhù.
sentences.english: They ran to the opposite side of the market, where there was a strange white building.

sentences.chinese: 队长说，这里像是一个巨大的医院，很多人在这里住院，为了忘记痛苦的记忆。
sentences.pinyin: Duìzhǎng shuō, zhèlǐ xiàng shì yīgè jùdà de yīyuàn, hěnduō rén zài zhèlǐ zhùyuàn, wèile wàngjì tòngkǔ de jìyì.
sentences.english: The captain said this place was like a giant hospital, where many people were hospitalized to forget painful memories.

sentences.chinese: 林风以为这是一个安全的地方，但很快他就发现了真相。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yǐwéi zhè shì yīgè ānquán de dìfāng, dàn hěn kuài tā jiù fāxiànle zhēnxiàng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng thought it was a safe place, but he soon discovered the truth.

sentences.chinese: 在这个建筑里，人们举行着奇怪的仪式，试图把记忆变成金币。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège jiànzhù lǐ, rénmen jǔxíngzhe qíguài de yíshì, shìtú bǎ jìyì biàn chéng jīnbì.
sentences.english: Inside this building, people were holding strange ceremonies, trying to turn memories into gold coins.

sentences.chinese: 一个穿着白袍的人举手示意他们停下，他的眼神很冷漠。
sentences.pinyin: Yīgè chuānzhe báipáo de rén jǔshǒu shìyì tāmen tíng xià, tā de yǎnshén hěn lěngmò.
sentences.english: A man in a white robe raised his hand to signal them to stop, his gaze cold.

sentences.chinese: “听说你们是来寻找出口的？”白袍人轻声问。
sentences.pinyin: “Tīng shuō nǐmen shì lái xúnzhǎo chūkǒu de?” Báipáo rén qīngshēng wèn.
sentences.english: "I heard you are looking for the exit?" the white-robed man asked softly.

sentences.chinese: 林风和队长开始与他进行对话，试图商量离开的方法。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hé duìzhǎng kāishǐ yǔ tā jìnxíng duìhuà, shìtú shāngliang líkāi de fāngfǎ.
sentences.english: Lin Feng and the captain began a dialogue with him, trying to discuss a way to leave.

sentences.chinese: 白袍人说，在这个世界，想要离开必须付出代价，不能白白地干活儿。
sentences.pinyin: Báipáo rén shuō, zài zhège shìjiè, xiǎng yào líkāi bìxū fùchū dàijià, bùnéng báibái de gàn huó r.
sentences.english: The white-robed man said that in this world, leaving requires a price; one cannot just work for free.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林风，这里的人曾经来自很多地方，有些人甚至想回国，但永远回不去了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Lín Fēng, zhèlǐ de rén céngjīng láizì hěnduō dìfāng, yǒuxiē rén shènzhì xiǎng huíguó, dàn yǒngyuǎn huí bù qùle.
sentences.english: He told Lin Feng that the people here came from many places; some even wanted to return to their home countries, but could never go back.

sentences.chinese: 林风注意到白袍人的桌子上有一个小盒子，上面刻着奇怪的文字。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhùyì dào báipáo rén de zhuōzi shàng yǒu yīgè xiǎo hézi, shàngmiàn kèzhe qíguài de wénzì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng noticed a small box on the white-robed man's table, with strange characters carved on it.

sentences.chinese: 盒子旁边有一只奇怪的小动物，白袍人说他养了它很多年。
sentences.pinyin: Hézi pángbiān yǒu yī zhǐ qíguài de xiǎo dòngwù, báipáo rén shuō tā yǎngle tā hěnduō nián.
sentences.english: Beside the box was a strange small animal; the white-robed man said he had raised it for many years.

sentences.chinese: “咱们得赶紧走，”林风低声对队长说，“这个地方太危险了。”
sentences.pinyin: “Zánmen děi gǎnjǐn zǒu,” Lín Fēng dīshēng duì duìzhǎng shuō, “zhège dìfāng tài wēixiǎnle.”
sentences.english: "We have to leave quickly," Lin Feng whispered to the captain, "this place is too dangerous."

sentences.chinese: 突然，一阵强风吹过，白袍人的表情变得凶狠起来。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yīzhèn qiángfēng chuīguò, báipáo rén de biǎoqíng biàn dé xiōnghěn qǐlái.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a strong wind blew, and the white-robed man's expression became fierce.

sentences.chinese: 他发出一声尖叫，周围的墙壁开始像机器一样开机，发出巨大的噪音。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāchū yīshēng jiānjiào, zhōuwéi de qiángbì kāishǐ xiàng jīqì yīyàng kāijī, fāchū jùdà de zàoyīn.
sentences.english: He let out a scream, and the surrounding walls began to boot up like machines, making a huge noise.

sentences.chinese: 林风感觉到一股压力袭来，他意识到自己受到了这个建筑的攻击。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎnjué dào yī gǔ yālì xílái, tā yìshí dào zìjǐ shòudào le zhège jiànzhù de gōngjī.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt a pressure hitting him and realized he was receiving an attack from the building.

sentences.chinese: 他想起在学院听讲的时候，海老师说过，面对幻象要努力保持内心平静。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zài xuéyuàn tīngjiǎng de shíhòu, Hǎi lǎoshī shuōguò, miànduì huànxiàng yào nǔlì bǎochí nèixīn píngjìng.
sentences.english: He remembered when attending lectures at the academy, Teacher Hai had said that one must strive to keep the heart calm when facing illusions.

sentences.chinese: “加油，林风！用你的魔力！”队长在旁边喊道。
sentences.pinyin: “Jiāyóu, Lín Fēng! Yòng nǐ de mólì!” Duìzhǎng zài pángbiān hǎn dào.
sentences.english: "Keep it up, Lin Feng! Use your magic!" the captain shouted beside him.

sentences.chinese: 林风闭上眼，他开始关心自己内心真正的力量，而不是眼前的假象。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng bì shàng yǎn, tā kāishǐ guānxīn zìjǐ nèixīn zhēnzhèng de lìliàng, ér bùshì yǎnqián de jiǎxiàng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng closed his eyes and began to care about the true power within his heart, rather than the illusion before him.

sentences.chinese: 他记得以前在家里帮母亲做饭时的平静，那是他最真实的记忆。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìdé yǐqián zài jiālǐ bāng mǔqīn zuò fàn shí de píngjìng, nà shì tā zuì zhēnshí de jìyì.
sentences.english: He remembered the peace of helping his mother cook meals at home; that was his most real memory.

sentences.chinese: 他突然想起，在记忆之店里，他见过一个来自克国的魔法师。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán xiǎngqǐ, zài jìyì zhī diàn lǐ, tā jiànguò yīgè láizì Kè guó de mófǎ shī.
sentences.english: He suddenly remembered that in the Memory Shop, he had met a magician from Croatia.

sentences.chinese: 那个魔法师告诉他，真正的力量来自于对真实的坚持。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè mófǎ shī gàosù tā, zhēnzhèng de lìliàng láizì yú duì zhēnshí de jiānchí.
sentences.english: That magician told him that true power comes from persisting in the truth.

sentences.chinese: 林风猛地睁开眼，一道金色的光芒从他心中发出来。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng měng de zhēng kāi yǎn, yī dào jīnsè de guāngmáng cóng tā xīnzhōng fā chūlái.
sentences.english: Lin Feng snapped his eyes open, and a golden light radiated from his heart.

sentences.chinese: 这道光芒带来了一阵温暖，瞬间击碎了周围的白色墙壁。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè dào guāngmáng dàilái le yīzhèn wēnnuǎn, shùnjiān jī suìle zhōuwéi de báisè qiángbì.
sentences.english: This light brought a wave of warmth, instantly shattering the surrounding white walls.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，他们看到一个破旧的酒馆，里面的人在干杯庆祝。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, tāmen kàndào yīgè pòjiù de jiǔguǎn, lǐmiàn de rén zài gānbēi qìngzhù.
sentences.english: Just then, they saw a shabby tavern where people were drinking a toast in celebration.

sentences.chinese: 但林风知道，那又是另一个幻象，他们不能停下来。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn Lín Fēng zhīdào, nà yòu shì lìng yīgè huànxiàng, tāmen bùnéng tíng xiàlái.
sentences.english: But Lin Feng knew that was another illusion; they could not stop.

sentences.chinese: 现在已经是深夜十点一刻，月亮的位置在移动。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài yǐjīng shì shēnyè shí diǎn yī kè, yuèliàng de wèizhì zài yídòng.
sentences.english: It was now 10:15 PM, and the position of the moon was shifting.

sentences.chinese: 他们快要到达出口了，但黑龙的阴影再次覆盖了大地。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen kuàiyào dàodá chūkǒu le, dàn hēilóng de yǐngzi zàicì fùgài le dàdì.
sentences.english: They were about to reach the exit, but the shadow of the Black Dragon covered the earth once again.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙在空中盘旋，它的眼睛盯着林风，仿佛在等待最后的时刻。
sentences.pinyin: Hēilóng zài kōngzhōng pánxuán, tā de yǎnjīng dīngzhe Lín Fēng, fǎngfú zài děngdài zuìhòu de shíkè.
sentences.english: The Black Dragon circled in the sky, its eyes staring at Lin Feng, as if waiting for the final moment.

sentences.chinese: 林风握紧拳头，他知道接下来的路将更加艰难。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng wòjǐn quántóu, tā zhīdào jiē xiàlái de lù jiāng gèngjiā jiānnán.
sentences.english: Lin Feng clenched his fists, knowing the road ahead would be even more difficult.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十章：记忆的碎片与古老的约定
chapters.title_english: Chapter 20: Fragments of Memory and the Ancient Covenant

sentences.chinese: 林风感觉周围的空气变得很沉重。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎnjué zhōuwéi de kōngqì biànde hěn chénzhòng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt that the air around him had become very heavy.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙在空中盘旋，它的眼睛像两颗巨大的红宝石。
sentences.pinyin: Hēilóng zài kōngzhōng pánxuán, tā de yǎnjīng xiàng liǎng kē jùdà de hóngbǎoshí.
sentences.english: The black dragon circled in the sky, its eyes like two giant rubies.

sentences.chinese: 林风挺起胸膛，面对这个恐怖的生物。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng tǐng qǐ xiōngtáng, miànduì zhège kǒngbù de shēngwù.
sentences.english: Lin Feng straightened his chest, facing this terrifying creature.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，如果现在逃跑，就永远无法离开这个幻象市场。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhīdào, rúguǒ xiànzài táopǎo, jiù yǒngyuǎn wúfǎ líkāi zhège huànxiàng shìchǎng.
sentences.english: He knew that if he ran away now, he would never be able to leave this illusion market.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，他碰到了一位穿着白色长袍的老人。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhèshí, tā pèngdào le yī wèi chuānzhe báisè chángpáo de lǎorén.
sentences.english: Just then, he came across an old man wearing a long white robe.

sentences.chinese: 老人来自一个古老的魔法家族，他手里拿着一个奇怪的相机。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén láizì yī gè gǔlǎo de mófǎ jiāzú, tā shǒulǐ názhe yī gè qíguài de xiàngjī.
sentences.english: The old man came from an ancient magic family, and he held a strange camera in his hand.

sentences.chinese: 老人说：“这个相机可以记录魔力，而不是照片。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén shuō: “Zhège xiàngjī kěyǐ jìlù mólì, ér bùshì zhàopiàn.”
sentences.english: The old man said, "This camera can record magic, not photos."

sentences.chinese: 林风很惊讶，他之前从没提到过这种魔法工具。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hěn jīngyà, tā zhīqián cóng méi tí dào guò zhè zhǒng mófǎ gōngjù.
sentences.english: Lin Feng was very surprised; he had never mentioned such a magic tool before.

sentences.chinese: 老人告诉他，想要离开这里，必须去报名参加一个古老的仪式。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén gàosù tā, xiǎngyào líkāi zhèlǐ, bìxū qù bàomíng cānjiā yī gè gǔlǎo de yíshì.
sentences.english: The old man told him that in order to leave this place, he must sign up for an ancient ritual.

sentences.chinese: 他拿出一张纸，上面打印着复杂的符文和地图。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná chū yī zhāng zhǐ, shàngmiàn dǎyìn zhe fùzá de fúwén hé dìtú.
sentences.english: He took out a piece of paper with complex runes and a map printed on it.

sentences.chinese: 林风看着地图，发现他们必须爬一座很高的山。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe dìtú, fāxiàn tāmen bìxū pá yī zuò hěn gāo de shān.
sentences.english: Looking at the map, Lin Feng found that they had to climb a very high mountain.

sentences.chinese: 老人说：“爬山虽然累，但那是唯一的路。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén shuō: “Páshān suīrán lèi, dàn nà shì wéiyī de lù.”
sentences.english: The old man said, "Climbing mountains is tiring, but it is the only way."

sentences.chinese: 林风决定相信这个老人，因为老人的眼神很温和。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng juédìng xiāngxìn zhège lǎorén, yīnwèi lǎorén de yǎnshén hěn wēnhé.
sentences.english: Lin Feng decided to believe this old man because the old man's eyes were very gentle.

sentences.chinese: 他们开始行动，在黑暗的森林中慢慢走过。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen kāishǐ xíngdòng, zài hēi'àn de sēnlín zhōng mànmàn zǒuguò.
sentences.english: They began their operation, walking slowly through the dark forest.

sentences.chinese: 经过很多危险的河流，林风看到河水在发光，像银色的丝绸一样流过大地。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò hěnduō wēixiǎn de héliú, Lín Fēng kàndào héshuǐ zài fāguāng, xiàng yínsè de sīchóu yīyàng liúguò dàdì.
sentences.english: After passing through many dangerous rivers, Lin Feng saw the river water glowing, flowing across the land like silver silk.

sentences.chinese: 早晨到来时，他们终于看到了那座山。
sentences.pinyin: Zǎochén dàolái shí, tāmen zhōngyú kàndào le nà zuò shān.
sentences.english: When early morning arrived, they finally saw that mountain.

sentences.chinese: 林风觉得身体很累，但他还是努力爬向山顶。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng juéde shēntǐ hěn lèi, dàn tā háishì nǔlì pá xiàng shāndǐng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt his body was very tired, but he still struggled to climb toward the summit.

sentences.chinese: 在路上，他碰见了几个迷路的小精灵。
sentences.pinyin: Zài lùshàng, tā pèngjiàn le jǐ gè mílù de xiǎo jīnglí.
sentences.english: On the way, he ran into several lost little elves.

sentences.chinese: 这些小精灵需要照顾，林风耐心地帮他们找到了回家的路。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē xiǎo jīnglí xūyào zhàogù, Lín Fēng nàixīn de bāng tāmen zhǎodào le huíjiā de lù.
sentences.english: These little elves needed care, and Lin Feng patiently helped them find their way home.

sentences.chinese: 小精灵们很感动，他们给林风画了一幅神奇的画。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎo jīnglímen hěn gǎndòng, tāmen gěi Lín Fēng huà le yī fú shénqí de huà.
sentences.english: The little elves were touched, and they drew a magical painting for Lin Feng.

sentences.chinese: 画中显示出黑龙的弱点，这让林风感到很有希望。
sentences.pinyin: Huà zhōng xiǎnshì chū hēilóng de ruòdiǎn, zhè ràng Lín Fēng gǎndào hěn yǒu xīwàng.
sentences.english: The painting showed the black dragon's weakness, which gave Lin Feng a feeling of hope.

sentences.chinese: 他们坐下来讨论怎么通过最后的关卡。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zuò xiàlái tǎolùn zěnme tōngguò zuìhòu de guānkǎ.
sentences.english: They sat down to discuss how to pass the final checkpoint.

sentences.chinese: 林风提出一个计划，让老人用相机吸引黑龙的注意。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng tíchū yī gè jìhuà, ràng lǎorén yòng xiàngjī xīyǐn hēilóng de zhùyì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng proposed a plan to let the old man use the camera to attract the black dragon's attention.

sentences.chinese: 老人答应了他的请求，并笑着说：“这是一个好主意。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén dāying le tā de qǐngqiú, bìng xiàozhe shuō: “Zhè shì yī gè hǎo zhǔyì.”
sentences.english: The old man agreed to his request and said with a smile, "That is a good idea."

sentences.chinese: 接着，林风换上了一件轻便的衣服，准备快速移动。
sentences.pinyin: Jiēzhe, Lín Fēng huàn shàng le yī jiàn qīngbiàn de yīfu, zhǔnbèi kuàisù yídòng.
sentences.english: Then, Lin Feng changed into a pair of light clothes, preparing to move quickly.

sentences.chinese: 他拉住老人的手，提醒他小心陷阱。
sentences.pinyin: Tā lā zhù lǎorén de shǒu, tíxǐng tā xiǎoxīn xiànjǐng.
sentences.english: He pulled the old man's hand, reminding him to be careful of traps.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，黑龙突然降落，发出了巨大的吼声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhèshí, hēilóng tūrán jiàngluò, fāchū le jùdà de hǒushēng.
sentences.english: Just then, the black dragon suddenly descended, letting out a massive roar.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙开始讲话，声音像雷一样响亮。
sentences.pinyin: Hēilóng kāishǐ jiǎnghuà, shēngyīn xiàng léi yīyàng xiǎngliàng.
sentences.english: The black dragon began to speak, its voice as loud as thunder.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙嘲笑林风，说他的计划像一个笑话一样可笑。
sentences.pinyin: Hēilóng cháoxiào Lín Fēng, shuō tā de jìhuà xiàng yī gè xiàohua yīyàng kěxiào.
sentences.english: The black dragon mocked Lin Feng, saying his plan was as ridiculous as a joke.

sentences.chinese: 林风没有害怕，他大声说：“我不是来开玩笑的！”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng méiyǒu hàipà, tā dàshēng shuō: “Wǒ bùshì lái kāi wánxiào de!”
sentences.english: Lin Feng was not afraid; he shouted, "I am not here to joke around!"

sentences.chinese: 等到黑龙再次攻击时，林风突然跳向一边。
sentences.pinyin: Děngdào hēilóng zàicì gōngjī shí, Lín Fēng tūrán tiào xiàng yībiān.
sentences.english: By the time the black dragon attacked again, Lin Feng suddenly jumped to the side.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，这场战斗比他想象的更艰难，但他也更强大了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, zhè chǎng zhàndòu bǐ tā xiǎngxiàng de gèng jiānnán, dàn tā yě gèng qiángdà le.
sentences.english: He realized that this battle was even more difficult than he had imagined, but he had also become stronger.

sentences.chinese: 就在他准备反击时，地面的阴影突然将他拉入了另一个空间。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài tā zhǔnbèi fǎnjī shí, dìmiàn de yīnyǐng tūrán jiāng tā lā rù le lìng yī gè kōngjiān.
sentences.english: Just as he was preparing to counterattack, the shadow on the ground suddenly pulled him into another dimension.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十一章：阴影空间的真理
chapters.title_english: Chapter 21: Truth of the Shadow Space

sentences.chinese: 林风睁开眼，发现自己站在一个灰色的空间里。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhēng kāi yǎn, fā xiàn zì jǐ zhàn zài yí gè huī sè de kōng jiān lǐ.
sentences.english: Lin Feng opened his eyes and found himself standing in a gray space.

sentences.chinese: 这里看起来很一般，没有山，也没有水。
sentences.pinyin: Yè lǐ kàn qǐ lái hěn yī bān, méi yǒu shān, yě méi yǒu shuǐ.
sentences.english: It looked quite ordinary, with no mountains and no water.

sentences.chinese: 但是，这里的空气中充满了奇怪的压力。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn shì, zhè lǐ de kōng qì zhōng chōng mǎn le qí guài de yā lì.
sentences.english: However, the air here was filled with a strange pressure.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙的声音在空中响起，好像在嘲笑他。
sentences.pinyin: Hēi lóng de shēng yīn zài kōng zhōng xiǎng qǐ, hǎo xiàng zài cháo xiào tā.
sentences.english: The Black Dragon's voice echoed in the air, as if mocking him.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙说：“在这里，你的魔力不一定有用。”
sentences.pinyin: Hēi lóng shuō: “Zài zhè lǐ, nǐ de mó lì bù yī dìng yǒu yòng.”
sentences.english: The Black Dragon said, "Here, your magic is not necessarily useful."

sentences.chinese: 林风感觉到自己的力量在消失，而且身体变得很重。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎn jué dào zì jǐ de lì liàng zài xiāo shī, ér qiě shēn tǐ biàn de hěn zhòng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt his power disappearing, and his body became very heavy.

sentences.chinese: 虽然他很害怕，但他没有放弃。
sentences.pinyin: Suī rán tā hěn hài pà, dàn tā méi yǒu fàng qì.
sentences.english: Although he was afraid, he did not give up.

sentences.chinese: 他想起海老师说过，在这个空间以外，有另一种力量。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ Hǎi lǎo shī shuō guò, zài zhè gè kōng jiān yǐ wài, yǒu lìng yì zhǒng lì liàng.
sentences.english: He remembered Teacher Hai saying that outside of this space, there was another kind of power.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试调用这种力量，因为他知道这是唯一的机会。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cháng shì diào yòng zhè zhǒng lì liàng, yīn wèi tā zhī dào zhè shì wéi yī de jī huì.
sentences.english: He tried to call upon this power because he knew it was the only chance.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙冷笑一声，说：“你只是一只小鸟，怎么能打败我？”
sentences.pinyin: Hēi lóng lěng xiào yì shēng, shuō: “Nǐ zhǐ shì yì zhī xiǎo niǎo, zěn me néng dǎ bài wǒ?”
sentences.english: The Black Dragon sneered, saying, "You are merely a little bird, how can you defeat me?"

sentences.chinese: 林风大声回答：“只要我有勇气，我就可以赢！”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng dà shēng huí dá: “Zhǐ yào wǒ yǒu yǒng qì, wǒ jiù kě yǐ yíng!”
sentences.english: Lin Feng answered loudly, "As long as I have courage, I can win!"

sentences.chinese: 黑龙说：“勇气并不代表力量，例如很多勇士都死在这里。”
sentences.pinyin: Hēi lóng shuō: “Yǒng qì bìng bù dài biǎo lì liàng, lì rú hěn duō yǒng shì dōu sǐ zài zhè lǐ.”
sentences.english: The Black Dragon said, "Courage does not represent power; for example, many warriors have died here."

sentences.chinese: 它举起巨大的爪子，给林风看一个例子：一个被冻住的石像。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jǔ qǐ jù dà de zhǎo zi, gěi Lín Fēng kàn yí gè lì zi: yí gè bèi dòng zhù de shí xiàng.
sentences.english: It raised its giant claw and showed Lin Feng an example: a frozen stone statue.

sentences.chinese: 林风看着石像，意识到如果自己不快点行动的话，也会变成那样。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn zhe shí xiàng, yì shí dào rú guǒ zì jǐ bù kuài diǎn xíng dòng de huà, yě huì biàn chéng nà yàng.
sentences.english: Looking at the statue, Lin Feng realized that if he didn't act quickly, he would become like that too.

sentences.chinese: 他突然想到，这里的规则可能和外面不一样。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tū rán xiǎng dào, zhè lǐ de guī zé kě néng hé wài miàn bù yī yàng.
sentences.english: He suddenly thought that the rules here might be different from the outside.

sentences.chinese: 也许他不需要用强力攻击，或者可以用某种技巧。
sentences.pinyin: Yě xǔ tā bù xū yào yòng qiáng lì gōng jī, huò zhě kě yǐ yòng mǒu zhǒng jì qiao.
sentences.english: Perhaps he didn't need to use powerful attacks, or maybe he could use some kind of technique.

sentences.chinese: 他试着改变魔力的方向，不但让魔力在身体里流动，还让它向外扩散。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì zhe gǎi biàn mó lì de fāng xiàng, bù dàn ràng mó lì zài shēn tǐ lǐ liú dòng, hái ràng tā xiàng wài kuò sàn.
sentences.english: He tried to change the direction of the magic, not only letting it flow within his body but also letting it diffuse outward.

sentences.chinese: 不过，这种尝试非常危险。
sentences.pinyin: Bù guò, zhè zhǒng cháng shì fēi cháng wēi xiǎn.
sentences.english: However, this attempt was very dangerous.

sentences.chinese: 可是，林风没有选择，因为他必须离开这里。
sentences.pinyin: Kě shì, Lín Fēng méi yǒu xuǎn zé, yīn wèi tā bì xū lí kāi zhè lǐ.
sentences.english: But Lin Feng had no choice because he had to leave this place.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙看着他，觉得他的动作很奇怪，比如他开始在原地转圈。
sentences.pinyin: Hēi lóng kàn zhe tā, jué de tā de dòng zuò hěn qí guài, bǐ rú tā kāi shǐ zài yuán dì zhuàn quān.
sentences.english: The Black Dragon watched him, thinking his movements were strange, such as when he started spinning in place.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙问：“你在做什么？或者你在跳舞？”
sentences.pinyin: Hēi lóng wèn: “Nǐ zài zuò shén me? Huò zhě nǐ zài tiào wǔ?”
sentences.english: The Black Dragon asked, "What are you doing? Or are you dancing?"

sentences.chinese: 林风没有说话，他先闭上眼睛，然后突然睁开眼，发出一道白光。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng méi yǒu shuō huà, tā xiān bì shàng yǎn jīng, rán hòu tū rán zhēng kāi yǎn, fā chū yí dào bái guāng.
