sentences.english: Lin Feng didn't speak; he first closed his eyes, and then suddenly opened them, emitting a beam of white light.

sentences.chinese: 比如说，这道光像一把剑一样，切开了阴影。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐ rú shuō, zhè dào guāng xiàng yì bǎ jiàn yí yàng, qiē kāi le yīn yǐng.
sentences.english: For example, this light was like a sword, cutting through the shadow.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙被光芒闪了一下，它很惊讶，但它很快恢复了过来。
sentences.pinyin: Hēi lóng bèi guāng máng shǎn le yí xià, tā hěn jīng yà, dàn tā hěn kuài huī fù le guò lái.
sentences.english: The Black Dragon was blinded for a moment; it was surprised, but it recovered quickly.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙吼道：“你该死！你居然能在这里使用光魔法！”
sentences.pinyin: Hēi lóng hǒu dào: “Nǐ gāi sǐ! Nǐ jū rán néng zài zhè lǐ shǐ yòng guāng mó fǎ!”
sentences.english: The Black Dragon roared, "You should die! You can actually use light magic here!"

sentences.chinese: 林风感到很累，所以他不得不后退一步。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎn dào hěn lèi, suǒ yǐ tā bù dé bù hòu tuì yí bù.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt very tired, so he had to take a step back.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，面对黑龙，单靠光魔法是不够的，或需要某种古老的咒语。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yì shí dào, miàn duì hēi lóng, dān kào guāng mó fǎ shì bù gòu de, huò xū yào mǒu zhǒng gǔ lǎo de zhòu yǔ.
sentences.english: He realized that facing the Black Dragon, light magic alone was not enough; perhaps some ancient spell was needed.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，地面的阴影再次波动，一个巨大的门在林风面前打开了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, dì miàn de yīn yǐng zài cì bō dòng, yí gè jù dà de mén zài Lín Fēng miàn qián dǎ kāi le.
sentences.english: Just then, the shadows on the ground fluctuated again, and a giant door opened in front of Lin Feng.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十二章：时间的走廊

sentences.chinese: 林风走进了那扇巨大的门，发现这里是一个奇怪的时间走廊。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zǒu jìn le nà shàn jù dà de mén, fā xiàn zhè lǐ shì yī gè qí guài de shí jiān zǒu láng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng stepped through the giant door and found himself in a strange corridor of time.

sentences.chinese: 走廊里有很多镜子，每面镜子都显示着不同年龄的人。
sentences.pinyin: Zǒu láng lǐ yǒu hěn duō jìng zi, měi miàn jìng zi dōu xiǎn shì zhe bù tóng nián líng de rén.
sentences.english: There were many mirrors in the corridor, each showing people of different ages.

sentences.chinese: 他看到一个中年男人在练习魔法，那个男人看起来很严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào yī gè zhōng nián nán rén zài liàn xí mó fǎ, nà gè nán rén kàn qǐ lái hěn yán sù.
sentences.english: He saw a middle-aged man practicing magic; the man looked very serious.

sentences.chinese: 林风想起自己从小就想学习这种力量，但那时候没有人教他。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎng qǐ zì jǐ cóng xiǎo jiù xiǎng xué xí zhè zhǒng lì liàng, dàn nà shí hòu méi yǒu rén jiāo tā.
sentences.english: Lin Feng remembered that he had wanted to learn this power since childhood, but no one taught him back then.

sentences.chinese: 走廊的墙上写着：这里是记录魔法周年庆典的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Zǒu láng de qiáng shàng xiě zhe: zhè lǐ shì jì lù mó fǎ zhōu nián qìng diǎn de dì fāng.
sentences.english: Written on the corridor wall was: This is the place that records the magic anniversary celebrations.

sentences.chinese: 一个大人走过来，他穿着白色的长袍，眼神温和。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè dà ren zǒu guò lái, tā chuān zhe bái sè de cháng páo, yǎn shén wēn hé.
sentences.english: An adult walked over, wearing white robes with a gentle look in his eyes.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林风，这里记录了每一个学期的魔法进步。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su Lín Fēng, zhè lǐ jì lù le měi yī gè xué qī de mó fǎ jìn bù.
sentences.english: He told Lin Feng that the magical progress of every semester was recorded here.

sentences.chinese: 林风看到镜子里有一个少年，那个少年正在努力读书。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn dào jìng zi lǐ yǒu yī gè shào nián, nà gè shào nián zhèng zài nǔ lì dú shū.
sentences.english: Lin Feng saw a youth in the mirror, and that youth was studying hard.

sentences.chinese: 那个少年在魔法学院的第一年级，看起来非常年轻。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè shào nián zài mó fǎ xué yuàn de dì yī nián jí, kàn qǐ lái fēi cháng nián qīng.
sentences.english: That youth was in the first grade of the magic academy and looked very young.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个来自远方王国的留学生出现在镜子中，他正在学习古老的咒语。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yī gè lái zì yuǎn fāng wáng guó de liú xué shēng chū xiàn zài jìng zi zhōng, tā zhèng zài xué xí gǔ lǎo de zhòu yǔ.
sentences.english: At this moment, an exchange student from a distant kingdom appeared in the mirror, studying ancient spells.

sentences.chinese: 林风继续走，看到了一个进入老年阶段的法师，他虽然老了，但魔力很强。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jì xù zǒu, kàn dào le yī gè jìn rù lǎo nián jiē duàn de fǎ shī, tā suī rán lǎo le, dàn mó lì hěn qiáng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng continued walking and saw a mage who had entered old age; although he was old, his magic was powerful.

sentences.chinese: 这里有青少年在奔跑，也有青年在讨论如何打败黑龙。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ yǒu qīng shào nián zài bēn pǎo, yě yǒu qīng nián zài tǎo lùn rú hé dǎ bài hēi lóng.
sentences.english: There were adolescents running here, and young people discussing how to defeat the Black Dragon.

sentences.chinese: 林风想起他在高中时期，过得非常简单，没有这么多危险。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xiǎng qǐ tā zài gāo zhōng shí qī, guò de fēi cháng jiǎn dān, méi yǒu zhè me duō wēi xiǎn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng thought back to his senior high school days, which were very simple and without so many dangers.

sentences.chinese: 他记得上周他还在为了生存而战斗，而下周他可能要面对最终的决战。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì de shàng zhōu tā hái zài wèi le shēng cún ér zhàn dòu, ér xià zhōu tā kě néng yào miàn duì zuì zhōng de jué zhàn.
sentences.english: He remembered that last week he was still fighting for survival, and next week he might face the final battle.

sentences.chinese: 他希望在战争结束以后，能有一个长长的假期去休息。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xī wàng zài zhàn zhēng jié shù yǐ hòu, néng yǒu yī gè cháng cháng de jià qī qù xiū xi.
sentences.english: He hoped that after the war ended, he could have a long vacation to rest.

sentences.chinese: 突然，走廊的景象变了，他看到现代城市的奇怪幻象。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, zǒu láng de jǐng xiàng biàn le, tā kàn dào xiàn dài chéng shì de qí guài huàn xiàng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the scenery of the corridor changed, and he saw strange illusions of a modern city.

sentences.chinese: 他看到人们在坐公共汽车，还有人在地下的地铁里快速移动。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn dào rén men zài zuò gōng gòng qì chē, hái yǒu rén zài dì xià de dì tiě lǐ kuài sù yí dòng.
sentences.english: He saw people riding the bus, and others moving quickly in the underground subway.

sentences.chinese: 这些景象让他困惑，他记得前年的时候，世界还没有这么乱。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiē jǐng xiàng ràng tā kùn huò, tā jì de qián nián de shí hòu, shì jiè hái méi yǒu zhè me luàn.
sentences.english: These scenes confused him; he remembered that the year before last, the world was not this chaotic.

sentences.chinese: 他看了一眼日历，这个月份是魔力最强的时刻。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn le yī yǎn rì lì, zhè gè yuè fèn shì mó lì zuì qiáng de shí kè.
sentences.english: He glanced at the calendar; this month was the time when magic was strongest.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个姓蓝的魔法师出现了，他拿着一本书。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yī gè xìng Lán de mó fǎ shī chū xiàn le, tā ná zhe yī běn shū.
sentences.english: Just then, a mage surnamed Lan appeared, holding a book.

sentences.chinese: 蓝先生对林风说：“如果你迷路了，可以问路，但不要相信所有的镜子。”
sentences.pinyin: Lán xiān sheng duì Lín Fēng shuō: “Rú guǒ nǐ mí lù le, kě yǐ wèn lù, dàn bù yào xiāng xìn suǒ yǒu de jìng zi.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lan said to Lin Feng: "If you are lost, you can ask for directions, but do not trust all the mirrors."

sentences.chinese: 林风看到镜子里的自己正在骑车穿过森林，那是一个美好的梦。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kàn dào jìng zi lǐ de zì jǐ zhèng zài qí chē chuān guò sēn lín, nà shì yī gè měi hǎo de mèng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng saw himself in the mirror riding a bike through the forest; it was a beautiful dream.

sentences.chinese: 但突然，黑龙的吼声打破了平静，巨大的爪子撕裂了走廊的白色墙壁。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn tū rán, hēi lóng de hǒu shēng dǎ pò le píng jìng, jù dà de zhuǎ zi sī liè le zǒu láng de bái sè qiáng bì.
sentences.english: But suddenly, the roar of the Black Dragon broke the silence, and giant claws tore through the white walls of the corridor.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙再次出现了，它想要夺走时间走廊里的所有记忆。
sentences.pinyin: Hēi lóng zài cì chū xiàn le, tā xiǎng yào duó zǒu shí jiān zǒu láng lǐ de suǒ yǒu jì yì.
sentences.english: The Black Dragon appeared again, wanting to steal all the memories in the corridor of time.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十三章：记忆的碎片与蓝先生的警告
chapters.title_english: Chapter 23: Fragments of Memory and Mr. Lan's Warning

sentences.chinese: 黑龙的爪子撕裂了墙壁，时间走廊开始崩溃。
sentences.pinyin: Hēilóng de zhuǎzi sīliè le qiángbì, shíjiān zǒuláng kāishǐ bēngkuì.
sentences.english: The black dragon's claws tore through the walls, and the Time Corridor began to collapse.

sentences.chinese: 林风心中感到非常害怕，因为这里是他记忆的一部分。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng xīnzhōng gǎndào fēicháng hàipà, yīnwèi zhèlǐ shì tā jìyì de yī bù fen.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt terrified in his heart because this place was a part of his memories.

sentences.chinese: 蓝先生看着黑龙，态度很冷静。
sentences.pinyin: Lán xiānshēng kànzhe hēilóng, tàidù hěn lěngjìng.
sentences.english: Mr. Lan looked at the black dragon, his attitude very calm.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉林风：“现在的事情很危险，我们要快点走。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Lín Fēng: “Xiànzài de shìqing hěn wēixiǎn, wǒmen yào kuài diǎn zǒu.”
sentences.english: He told Lin Feng, "The current situation is very dangerous; we must leave quickly."

sentences.chinese: 林风问：“为什么黑龙想要这些记忆？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng wèn: “Wèishéme hēilóng xiǎng yào zhèxiē jìyì?”
sentences.english: Lin Feng asked, "Why does the black dragon want these memories?"

sentences.chinese: 蓝先生解释说，这是因为黑龙想要通过夺取记忆来改变自己的样子。
sentences.pinyin: Lán xiānshēng jiěshì shuō, zhè shì yīnwèi hēilóng xiǎng yào tōngguò duóqǔ jìyì lái gǎibiàn zìjǐ de yàngzi.
sentences.english: Mr. Lan explained that it was because the black dragon wanted to change its appearance by stealing memories.

sentences.chinese: 这是黑龙的一种习惯，它通过吸收他人的理想来变得更强。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì hēilóng de yī zhǒng xíguàn, tā tōngguò xīshōu tārén de lǐxiǎng lái biàn de gèng qiáng.
sentences.english: This is a habit of the black dragon; it becomes stronger by absorbing others' ideals.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙的目的是控制所有人的想法。
sentences.pinyin: Hēilóng de mùdì shì kòngzhì suǒyǒu rén de xiǎngfǎ.
sentences.english: The black dragon's purpose is to control everyone's way of thinking.

sentences.chinese: 林风看着黑龙巨大的头，感觉到一股冰冷的气扑面而来。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe hēilóng jùdà de tóu, gǎnjué dào yī gǔ bīnglěng de qì pūmiàn ér lái.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the black dragon's massive head and felt a blast of cold air hitting his face.

sentences.chinese: 他想起在学院学习的时候，海老师说过，魔力不仅是科学，更是艺术。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zài xuéyuàn xuéxí de shíhou, Hǎi lǎoshī shuōguò, mólì bùjǐn shì kēxué, gèng shì yìshù.
sentences.english: He remembered when he was studying at the academy, Teacher Hai said that magic is not only science but also art.

sentences.chinese: 当时林风的成绩很好，分数很高，但在实战方面，他还需要进步。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngshí Lín Fēng de chéngjì hěn hǎo, fēnshù hěn gāo, dàn zài shízhàn fāngmiàn, tā hái xūyào jìnbù.
sentences.english: At that time, Lin Feng's achievements were great and his scores were high, but in terms of actual combat, he still needed improvement.

sentences.chinese: 现在，他必须找到一个办法来对抗黑龙。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài, tā bìxū zhǎodào yī gè bànfǎ lái duìkàng hēilóng.
sentences.english: Now, he had to find a way to fight the black dragon.

sentences.chinese: 蓝先生说：“你的看法不对，不能只用力量，要用正确的方法。”
sentences.pinyin: Lán xiānshēng shuō: “Nǐ de kànfǎ bùduì, bùnéng zhǐ yòng lìliàng, yào yòng zhèngquè de fāngfǎ.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lan said, "Your view is wrong; you cannot rely only on power, you must use the correct method."

sentences.chinese: 他指着走廊尽头的一条路，那看起来像是一条现代的公路。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐzhe zǒuláng jìntóu de yī tiáo lù, nà kàn qǐlái xiàng shì yī tiáo xiàndài de gōnglù.
sentences.english: He pointed to a path at the end of the corridor that looked like a modern highway.

sentences.chinese: 林风好奇地问：“这里为什么会有公路啊？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hàoqí de wèn: “Zhèlǐ wèishéme huì yǒu gōnglù ā?”
sentences.english: Lin Feng asked curiously, "Why is there a highway here?"

sentences.chinese: 蓝先生笑了笑，说这是记忆的特点，它会把不同的时间弄在一起。
sentences.pinyin: Lán xiānshēng xiào le xiào, shuō zhè shì jìyì de tèdiǎn, tā huì bǎ bùtóng de shíjiān lòng zài yīqǐ.
sentences.english: Mr. Lan smiled and said this is a characteristic of memory; it mixes different times together.

sentences.chinese: 林风的心情变得复杂，他意识到这里的每一个细节都有特别的意思。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng de xīnqíng biàn de fùzá, tā yìshí dào zhèlǐ de měi yī gè xìjié dōu yǒu tèbié de yìsi.
sentences.english: Lin Feng's mood became complex as he realized every detail here had a special meaning.

sentences.chinese: 他尝试用一种新的做法，将魔力凝聚成一个光球。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chángshì yòng yī zhǒng xīn de zuòfǎ, jiāng mólì níngjù chéng yī gè guāngqiú.
sentences.english: He tried a new way of handling things, condensing his magic into a sphere of light.

sentences.chinese: 这个光球的大小在不断变化，像一个在球场上跳动的球。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè guāngqiú de dàxiǎo zài bùduàn biànhuà, xiàng yī gè zài qiúchǎng shàng tiàodòng de qiú.
sentences.english: The size of this light sphere changed constantly, like a ball bouncing on a sports court.

sentences.chinese: 蓝先生对这个想法没有意见，反而鼓励他尝试。
sentences.pinyin: Lán xiānshēng duì zhè gè xiǎngfǎ méiyǒu yìjiàn, fǎn'ér gǔlì tā chángshì.
sentences.english: Mr. Lan had no objection to this idea; instead, he encouraged him to try.

sentences.chinese: “这是一个好机会，”蓝先生说，“你可以改变攻击的方向。”
sentences.pinyin: “Zhè shì yī gè hǎo jīhuì,” Lán xiānshēng shuō, “nǐ kěyǐ gǎibiàn gōngjī de fāngxiàng.”
sentences.english: "This is a good opportunity," Mr. Lan said, "you can change the direction of the attack."

sentences.chinese: 林风闭上眼，思考黑龙攻击的原因。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng bì shàng yǎn, sīkǎo hēilóng gōngjī de yuányīn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng closed his eyes and thought about the cause of the black dragon's attacks.

sentences.chinese: 他发现黑龙虽然强大，但它的动作太慢。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn hēilóng suīrán qiángdà, dàn tā de dòngzuò tài màn.
sentences.english: He discovered that although the black dragon was powerful, its movements were too slow.

sentences.chinese: 林风在心中制定了一个计划，决定利用这个弱点。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zài xīnzhōng zhìdìng le yī gè jìhuà, juédìng lìyòng zhè gè ruòdiǎn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng formulated a plan in his heart, deciding to exploit this weakness.

sentences.chinese: 他突然想起小时候在海边奔跑的感觉，那种自由让他的魔力变得纯净。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán xiǎngqǐ xiǎoshíhou zài hǎibiān bēnpǎo de gǎnjué, nà zhǒng zìyóu ràng tā de mólì biàn de chúnjìng.
sentences.english: He suddenly remembered the feeling of running by the seaside as a child; that freedom made his magic pure.

sentences.chinese: 他将这种感觉融入到攻击中，光球迅速向黑龙冲去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiāng zhè zhǒng gǎnjué róngrù dào gōngjī zhōng, guāngqiú xùnsù xiàng hēilóng chōng qù.
sentences.english: He integrated this feeling into the attack, and the light sphere rushed toward the black dragon.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙被这个出乎意料的攻击弄得措手不及。
sentences.pinyin: Hēilóng bèi zhè gè chū hū yìliào de gōngjī lòng de cuòshǒu bùjí.
sentences.english: The black dragon was caught off guard by this unexpected attack.

sentences.chinese: 蓝先生看着林风，眼神中充满了赞赏。
sentences.pinyin: Lán xiānshēng kànzhe Lín Fēng, yǎnshén zhōng chōngmǎn le zànshǎng.
sentences.english: Mr. Lan looked at Lin Feng, his eyes full of admiration.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到林风已经不再是那个只会在书本上学习的学生了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào Lín Fēng yǐjīng bù zài shì nà gè zhǐ huì zài shūběn shàng xuéxí de xuéshēng le.
sentences.english: He realized that Lin Feng was no longer just a student who knew how to study from books.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，走廊的地面突然裂开了，一个巨大的深渊出现。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, zǒuláng de dìmiàn tūrán liè kāi le, yī gè jùdà de shēnyuān chūxiàn.
sentences.english: But just then, the floor of the corridor suddenly cracked, and a massive abyss appeared.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙发出一声怒吼，将林风和蓝先生推向了深渊的边缘。
sentences.pinyin: Hēilóng fāchū yī shēng nùhǒu, jiāng Lín Fēng hé Lán xiānshēng tuī xiàng le shēnyuān de biānyuán.
sentences.english: The black dragon let out a roar and pushed Lin Feng and Mr. Lan toward the edge of the abyss.

sentences.chinese: 在坠落的一瞬间，林风看到深渊下方竟然是另一个完全不同的世界。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhuìluò de yī shùnjiān, Lín Fēng kàndào shēnyuān xiàfāng jìngrán shì lìng yī gè wánquán bùtóng de shìjiè.
sentences.english: In the instant of falling, Lin Feng saw that below the abyss was an entirely different world.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十四章：深渊之下的新世界
chapters.title_english: Chapter 24: The New World Beneath the Abyss

sentences.chinese: 林风和蓝先生在深渊中坠落，最后落在了一片绿色的草地上面。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hé Lán Xiānshēng zài shēnyuān zhōng zhuìluò, zuìhòu luò zài le yī piàn lǜsè de cǎodì shàngmiàn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng and Mr. Lan fell into the abyss, finally landing on a stretch of green meadow.

sentences.chinese: 这里的颜色非常奇怪，天空是紫色的，而草地是金色的。
sentences.pinyin: Yè lǐ de yánsè fēicháng qíguài, tiānkōng shì zǐsè de, ér cǎodì shì jīnsè de.
sentences.english: The colors here were very strange; the sky was purple, while the meadow was golden.

sentences.chinese: 林风站起来，发现这里有一个巨大的院子，院子中间有一座古老的院。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhàn qǐlái, fāxiàn zhèlǐ yǒu yī gè jùdà de yuànzi, yuànzi zhōngjiān yǒu yī zuò gǔlǎo de yuàn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng stood up and found a huge courtyard here, with an ancient institution in the middle of the courtyard.

sentences.chinese: 在院子的边上，他看到了三个奇怪的人，他们分别姓阴、段和鱼。
sentences.pinyin: Zài yuànzi de biān shàng, tā kàndào le sān gè qíguài de rén, tāmen fēnbié xìng Yīn, Duàn hé Yú.
sentences.english: At the edge of the courtyard, he saw three strange people, whose surnames were Yin, Duan, and Yu.

sentences.chinese: 阴先生看着林风，用一种严肃的角度观察他的魔力。
sentences.pinyin: Yīn xiānshēng kànzhe Lín Fēng, yòng yī zhǒng yánsù de jiǎodù guānchá tā de mólì.
sentences.english: Mr. Yin looked at Lin Feng, observing his magic from a serious angle.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你的魔力级数很高，但你的行为太冲动了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ de mólì jíshù hěn gāo, dàn nǐ de xíngwéi tài chōngdòng le.”
sentences.english: He said, "Your magic level is very high, but your behavior is too impulsive."

sentences.chinese: 林风感到很奇怪，他问：“这里是什么地方？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎndào hěn qíguài, tā wèn: “Zhèlǐ shì shénme dìfāng?”
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt strange and asked, "What place is this?"

sentences.chinese: 段先生走过来，他的面色很冷，说这里是世界的西北之端。
sentences.pinyin: Duàn xiānshēng zǒu guòlái, tā de miànsè hěn lěng, shuō zhèlǐ shì shìjiè de xīběi zhī duān.
sentences.english: Mr. Duan walked over, his face cold, and said that this was the northwest end of the world.

sentences.chinese: 鱼先生则有不同的观点，他认为林风是预言中的救世主。
sentences.pinyin: Yú xiānshēng zé yǒu bùtóng de guāndiǎn, tā rènwéi Lín Fēng shì yùyán zhōng de jiùshìzhǔ.
sentences.english: Mr. Yu, on the other hand, had a different point of view; he believed Lin Feng was the savior in the prophecy.

sentences.chinese: 蓝先生告诉林风，他们必须在这里制定一个新的计划。
sentences.pinyin: Lán xiānshēng gàosù Lín Fēng, tāmen bìxū zài zhèlǐ zhìdìng yī gè xīn de jìhuà.
sentences.english: Mr. Lan told Lin Feng that they must formulate a new plan here.

sentences.chinese: 他们沿着一条小道走，路边开满了发光的蓝色花朵。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen yánzhe yī tiáo xiǎodào zǒu, lùbiān kāimǎn le fāguāng de lánsè huāduǒ.
sentences.english: They walked along a small path, and the roadside was covered with glowing blue flowers.

sentences.chinese: 这条道路通向一座巨大的石塔，那是这个世界的中心部分。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo dàolù tōngxiàng yī zuò jùdà de shítǎ, nà shì zhège shìjiè de zhōngxīn bùfen.
sentences.english: This road led to a huge stone tower, which was the central part of this world.

sentences.chinese: 林风问：“我们为什么会来到这里？”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng wèn: “Wǒmen wèishéme huì lái dào zhèlǐ?”
sentences.english: Lin Feng asked, "Why did we come here?"

sentences.chinese: 阴先生解释道，深渊的道理很简单：只有失去一切的人才能看到真相。
sentences.pinyin: Yīn xiānshēng jiěshì dào, shēnyuān de dàolǐ hěn jiǎndān: zhǐyǒu shīqù yīqiè de rén cáinéng kàndào zhēnxiàng.
sentences.english: Mr. Yin explained that the reason of the abyss is simple: only those who have lost everything can see the truth.

sentences.chinese: 林风看着自己的手表，发现时间已经停止了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe zìjǐ de biǎozhǐ, fāxiàn shíjiān yǐjīng tíngzhǐ le.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at his watch and found that time had already stopped.

sentences.chinese: 他意识到，在这个世界，时间不再是问题。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìshí dào, zài zhège shìjiè, shíjiān bù zài shì wèntí.
sentences.english: He realized that in this world, time was no longer an issue.

sentences.chinese: 为了省力气，他们决定在石塔下面休息。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile shěng lìqì, tāmen juédìng zài shítǎ xiàmiàn xiūxí.
sentences.english: To save energy, they decided to rest beneath the stone tower.

sentences.chinese: 林风看着天空，思考着黑龙现在的位置。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànzhe tiānkōng, sīkǎo zhe hēilóng xiànzài de wèizhì.
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at the sky, thinking about the Black Dragon's current location.

sentences.chinese: 他知道，黑龙一定在寻找进入这个世界的道路。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhīdào, hēilóng yīdìng zài xúnzhǎo jìnrù zhège shìjiè de dàolù.
sentences.english: He knew that the Black Dragon must be searching for the way to enter this world.

sentences.chinese: 如果黑龙进来了，这里的平静将被打破。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ hēilóng jìnlái le, zhèlǐ de píngjìng jiāng bèi dǎpò.
sentences.english: If the Black Dragon entered, the peace here would be shattered.

sentences.chinese: 蓝先生轻声说：“不要怕，我们会一起面对。”
sentences.pinyin: Lán xiānshēng qīngshēng shuō: “Bùyào pà, wǒmen huì yīqǐ miànduì.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lan said softly, "Don't be afraid, we will face it together."

sentences.chinese: 林风点头，但他感觉到地底深处传来了震动。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng diǎntóu, dàn tā gǎnjué dào dìdǐ shēnchù chuánlái le zhèndòng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng nodded, but he felt a vibration coming from deep underground.

sentences.chinese: 一个巨大的黑色阴影再次出现在地平线上。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè jùdà de hēisè yīnyǐng zàicì chūxiàn zài dìpíngxiàn shàng.
sentences.english: A huge black shadow appeared once again on the horizon.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙竟然找到了这里！
sentences.pinyin: Hēilóng jìngrán zhǎodào le zhèlǐ!
sentences.english: The Black Dragon had actually found this place!

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十五章：深渊的决战
chapters.title_english: Chapter 25: The Decisive Battle of the Abyss

sentences.chinese: 黑龙的吼声在深渊中回荡，声音十分恐怖。
sentences.pinyin: Hēilóng de hǒushēng zài shēnyuān zhōng huídàng, shēngyīn shífēn kǒngbù.
sentences.english: The black dragon's roar echoed in the abyss, the sound was utterly terrifying.

sentences.chinese: 林风感觉到全身在发抖，但他的眼神很坚定。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎnjué dào quánshēn zài fādǒu, dàn tā de yǎnshén hěn jiāndìng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt his whole body shaking, but his gaze was firm.

sentences.chinese: 蓝先生看着天空说：“这头龙一生都在寻找这个秘密。”
sentences.pinyin: Lán xiānshēng kànzhe tiānkōng shuō: “Zhè tóu lóng yīshēng dōu zài xúnzhǎo zhège mìmì.”
sentences.english: Mr. Lan looked at the sky and said, "This dragon has been searching for this secret all its life."

sentences.chinese: 不久，黑龙降落在地面上，巨大的翅膀遮住了光。
sentences.pinyin: Bùjiǔ, hēilóng jiàngluò zài dìmiàn shàng, jùdà de chìbǎng zhēzhù le guāng.
sentences.english: Soon, the black dragon landed on the ground, its huge wings blocking the light.

sentences.chinese: 这里原本是深渊的南方，现在到处都是黑色的火焰。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ yuánběn shì shēnyuān de nánfāng, xiànzài dàochù dōu shì hēisè de huǒyàn.
sentences.english: This place was originally the south of the abyss; now there were black flames everywhere.

sentences.chinese: 林风记得以前海老师说过，真正的力量来自内心。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng jìdé yǐqián Hǎi lǎoshī shuōguò, zhēnzhèng de lìliàng láizì nèixīn.
sentences.english: Lin Feng remembered Teacher Hai saying before that true power comes from within.

sentences.chinese: 他看向周围，发现这里有好多古老的石头柱子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànxiàng zhōuwéi, fāxiàn zhèlǐ yǒu hǎoduō gǔlǎo de shítou zhùzi.
sentences.english: He looked around and found there were quite a lot of ancient stone pillars here.

sentences.chinese: 这些柱子一共三十根，全部刻着金色的文字。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē zhùzi yīgòng sānshí gēn, quánbù kèzhe jīnsè de wénzì.
sentences.english: There were thirty pillars altogether, all engraved with golden characters.

sentences.chinese: 其中一部分文字在发光，告诉林风如何使用这里的魔力。
sentences.pinyin: Qízhōng yī bùfen wénzì zài fāguāng, gàosù Lín Fēng rúhé shǐyòng zhèlǐ de mólì.
sentences.english: Among them, some characters were glowing, telling Lin Feng how to use the magic here.

sentences.chinese: 林风意识到，他必须在以后变得更强大，才能保护大家。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yìshí dào, tā bìxū zài yǐhòu biàn de gèng qiángdà, cáinéng bǎohù dàjiā.
sentences.english: Lin Feng realized that he must become stronger in the future to protect everyone.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙再次攻击，大量的黑色魔力像雨一样落下。
sentences.pinyin: Hēilóng zàicì gōngjī, dàliàng de hēisè mólì xiàng yǔ yīyàng luòxià.
sentences.english: The black dragon attacked again, and a great amount of black magic fell like rain.

sentences.chinese: 林风用光魔法挡住攻击，但这种压力太大了，已经不够了。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yòng guāng mófǎ dǎngzhù gōngjī, dàn zhè zhǒng yālì tài dà le, yǐjīng bù gòu le.
sentences.english: Lin Feng used light magic to block the attack, but this pressure was too great; it was no longer enough.

sentences.chinese: 同时，蓝先生在后面大喊：“快看那些文字！”
sentences.pinyin: Tóngshí, Lán xiānshēng zài hòumiàn dàhǎn: “Kuài kàn nàxiē wénzì!”
sentences.english: At the same time, Mr. Lan shouted from behind, "Quick, look at those characters!"

sentences.chinese: 林风发现，大多数文字都指向了北方的祭坛。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng fāxiàn, dàduōshù wénzì dōu zhǐxiàng le běifāng de jìtán.
sentences.english: Lin Feng discovered that the great majority of the characters pointed toward the northern altar.

sentences.chinese: 在那个祭坛以上的地方，有一颗发光的宝石。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nàge jìtán yǐshàng de dìfāng, yǒu yī kē fāguāng de bǎoshí.
sentences.english: Above that altar, there was a glowing gem.

sentences.chinese: 后来，林风决定冲向那个祭坛，尽管那里十分危险。
sentences.pinyin: Hòulái, Lín Fēng juédìng chōngxiàng nàge jìtán, jǐnguǎn nàlǐ shífēn wēixiǎn.
sentences.english: Later, Lin Feng decided to rush toward that altar, even though it was very dangerous.

sentences.chinese: 他发现这里的魔力分布很不均匀，大部分集中在中心。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn zhèlǐ de mólì fēnbù hěn bù jūnyún, dàbùfen jízhōng zài zhōngxīn.
sentences.english: He found that the magic here was distributed unevenly, with the majority concentrated in the center.

sentences.chinese: 很多其他的人在以前的试炼中失败了，但林风不能失败。
sentences.pinyin: Hěnduō qítā de rén zài yǐqián de shìliàn zhōng shībài le, dàn Lín Fēng bùnéng shībài.
sentences.english: Many other people had failed in previous trials, but Lin Feng could not fail.

sentences.chinese: 他想起自己的全家，想起那些信任他的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ de quánjiā, xiǎngqǐ nàxiē xìnrèn tā de rén.
sentences.english: He thought of his whole family and those who trusted him.

sentences.chinese: 如果他赢了，今后这个世界将不再有恐惧。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ tā yíng le, jīnhòu zhège shìjiè jiāng bù zài yǒu kǒngjù.
sentences.english: If he won, henceforth this world would no longer have fear.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙又一次飞向他，速度大大地加快了。
sentences.pinyin: Hēilóng yòu yī cì fēixiàng tā, sùdù dàdà de jiākuài le.
sentences.english: The black dragon flew toward him once again, its speed greatly increasing.

sentences.chinese: 林风感觉到，全国甚至全世界的命运现在都在他一个人身上。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng gǎnjué dào, quánguó shènzhì quán shìjiè de mìngyùn xiànzài dōu zài tā yī gè rén shēnshàng.
sentences.english: Lin Feng felt that the fate of the whole nation, and even the whole world, was now on him alone.

sentences.chinese: 这里的全体生物都在等待一个救世主。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de quántǐ shēngwù dōu zài děngdài yī gè jiùshìzhǔ.
sentences.english: All the creatures here were waiting for a savior.

sentences.chinese: 虽然多数人认为这不可能，但林风不相信失败。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán duōshù rén rènwéi zhè bù kěnéng, dàn Lín Fēng bù xiāngxìn shībài.
sentences.english: Although most people thought this was impossible, Lin Feng did not believe in failure.

sentences.chinese: 他记得原来这个深渊是全年都被封印的，现在封印破了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìdé yuánlái zhège shēnyuān shì quánnián dōu bèi fēngyìn de, xiànzài fēngyìn pò le.
sentences.english: He remembered that originally this abyss was sealed all year long, but now the seal was broken.

sentences.chinese: 他需要大量的时间来准备，但现在没有时间了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xūyào dàliàng de shíjiān lái zhǔnbèi, dàn xiànzài méiyǒu shíjiān le.
sentences.english: He needed a large quantity of time to prepare, but there was no time now.

sentences.chinese: 他感觉到身体里有不少新的力量在觉醒。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎnjué dào shēntǐ lǐ yǒu bùshǎo xīn de lìliàng zài juéxǐng.
sentences.english: He felt that not a few new powers were awakening in his body.

sentences.chinese: 他大喊一声，将全部的魔力集中在手中。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàhǎn yī shēng, jiāng quánbù de mólì jízhōng zài shǒuzhōng.
sentences.english: He gave a loud shout and concentrated all of his magic in his hand.

sentences.chinese: 他看向蓝先生，两人在同一时间发动了攻击。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànxiàng Lán xiānshēng, liǎng rén zài tóng yī shíjiān fādòng le gōngjī.
sentences.english: He looked at Mr. Lan, and the two of them launched an attack at the same time.

sentences.chinese: 光芒照亮了整个深渊，黑龙发出了痛苦的叫声。
sentences.pinyin: Guāngmáng zhàoliàng le zhěnggè shēnyuān, hēilóng fāchū le tòngkǔ de jiàoshēng.
sentences.english: The light illuminated the entire abyss, and the black dragon let out a cry of pain.

sentences.chinese: 但就在光芒消失时，黑龙的眼睛里出现了一个奇怪的符号。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài guāngmáng xiāoshī shí, hēilóng de yǎnjīng lǐ chūxiàn le yī gè qíguài de fúhào.
sentences.english: But just as the light vanished, a strange symbol appeared in the black dragon's eyes.

sentences.chinese: 它突然停止了攻击，对着林风说了一句让他震惊的话。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán tíngzhǐ le gōngjī, duìzhe Lín Fēng shuō le yī jù ràng tā zhènjīng de huà.
sentences.english: It suddenly stopped attacking and said a sentence to Lin Feng that shocked him.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十六章：最终的真相与新的开始
chapters.title_english: Chapter 26: The Final Truth and a New Beginning

sentences.chinese: 黑龙看着林风，用一种平常的声音说：“你终于找到了我。”
sentences.pinyin: Hēilóng kànzhe Lín Fēng, yòng yì zhǒng píng cháng de shēngyīn shuō: “Nǐ zhōngyú zhǎodàole wǒ.”
sentences.english: The Black Dragon looked at Lin Feng and said in an ordinary voice, "You have finally found me."

sentences.chinese: 林风愣住了，这不是他常见到的那个凶猛的怪物。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng lèng zhùle, zhè búshì tā cháng jiàn dào de nàge xiōngměng de guàiwù.
sentences.english: Lin Feng was stunned; this was not the ferocious monster he commonly saw.

sentences.chinese: 黑龙说，它并不是真正的敌人，它只是在守护一个古老的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Hēilóng shuō, tā bìng búshì zhēnzhèng de dírén, tā zhǐshì zài shǒuhù yígè gǔlǎo de mìmì.
sentences.english: The Black Dragon said that it was not the true enemy, but was merely guarding an ancient secret.

sentences.chinese: 在过去的一千年里，它经常一个人在深渊中等待。
sentences.pinyin: Zài guòqù de yì qiān nián lǐ, tā jīngcháng yígè rén zài shēnyuān zhōng děngdài.
sentences.english: In the past thousand years, it frequently waited alone in the abyss.

sentences.chinese: 它告诉林风，许多在西方传说中的魔力，其实都来自这里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù Lín Fēng, xǔduō zài Xīfāng chuánshuō zhōng de mólì, qíshí dōu láizì zhèlǐ.
sentences.english: It told Lin Feng that much of the magic in Western legends actually originated from here.

sentences.chinese: 林风发现，黑龙眼中的符号是一个常用的咒语词。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng fāxiàn, hēilóng yǎnzhōng de fúhào shì yígè chángyòng de zhòuyǔ cí.
sentences.english: Lin Feng discovered that the symbol in the Black Dragon's eye was a commonly used spell word.

sentences.chinese: 这个词的意思是“重新开始”。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège cí de yìsi shì “chóngxīn kāishǐ”.
sentences.english: This word meant "to start again."

sentences.chinese: 黑龙说，最近有人试图偷走所有人的记忆，所以它必须测试林风。
sentences.pinyin: Hēilóng shuō, zuìjìn yǒurén shìtú tōuzǒu suǒyǒu rén de jìyì, suǒyǐ tā bìxū cèshì Lín Fēng.
sentences.english: The Black Dragon said that recently someone had attempted to steal everyone's memories, so it had to test Lin Feng.

sentences.chinese: 林风意识到，自己之前经历的所有试炼，其实都是为了让他变得完全强大。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng yìshí dào, zìjǐ zhīqián jīnglì de suǒyǒu shìliàn, qíshí dōu shì wèile ràng tā biàn de wánquán qiángdà.
sentences.english: Lin Feng realized that all the trials he had experienced previously were actually to make him completely powerful.

sentences.chinese: 现在的他，差不多已经拥有了保护这个世界的力量。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài de tā, chàbuduō yǐjīng yōngyǒule bǎohù zhège shìjiè de lìliàng.
sentences.english: Now, he almost possessed the strength to protect this world.

sentences.chinese: 忽然，深渊的天空变成了阴天，巨大的乌云覆盖了上方。
sentences.pinyin: Hūrán, shēnyuān de tiānkōng biànchéngle yīntiān, jùdà de wūyún fùgàile shàngfāng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the sky of the abyss became overcast, and huge dark clouds covered the area above.

sentences.chinese: 一群奇怪的鸟在空中飞舞，发出尖叫声。
sentences.pinyin: Yì qún qíguài de niǎo zài kōngzhōng fēiwǔ, fāchū jiānjiào shēng.
sentences.english: A flock of strange birds flew in the sky, letting out screams.

sentences.chinese: 这些鸟不是普通的动物，而是阴影空间的哨兵。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē niǎo búshì pǔtōng de dòngwù, érshì yīnyǐng kōngjiān de shàobīng.
sentences.english: These birds were not ordinary animals, but sentinels of the shadow space.

sentences.chinese: 林风看向蓝先生，蓝先生说：“我们的时间很短，必须快点。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng kànxiàng Lán Xiānsheng, Lán Xiānsheng shuō: “Wǒmen de shíjiān hěn duǎn, bìxū kuài diǎn.”
sentences.english: Lin Feng looked at Mr. Lan, and Mr. Lan said, "Our time is short, we must hurry."

sentences.chinese: 黑龙告诉林风，只要走到近处的那个光门，战斗就完结了。
sentences.pinyin: Hēilóng gàosù Lín Fēng, zhǐyào zǒu dào jìnchù de nàge guāngmén, zhàndòu jiù wán jié le.
sentences.english: The Black Dragon told Lin Feng that as long as he walked to the nearby light gate, the battle would be finished.

sentences.chinese: 但林风知道，真正的责任将会很长，他不能逃避。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn Lín Fēng zhīdào, zhēnzhèng de zérèn jiāng huì hěn cháng, tā bùnéng táobì.
sentences.english: But Lin Feng knew that the true responsibility would be long, and he could not escape it.

sentences.chinese: 他必须随时准备好面对未来的挑战。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū suíshí zhǔnbèi hǎo miànduì wèilái de tiǎozhàn.
sentences.english: He had to be ready at any time to face future challenges.

sentences.chinese: 林风深呼吸，对自己说：“我准备好了。”
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng shēnhūxī, duì zìjǐ shuō: “Wǒ zhǔnbèi hǎole.”
sentences.english: Lin Feng took a deep breath and said to himself, "I am ready."

sentences.chinese: 他看向黑龙，发现黑龙在微笑。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànxiàng hēilóng, fāxiàn hēilóng zài wēixiào.
sentences.english: He looked at the Black Dragon and found it was smiling.

sentences.chinese: 林风和蓝先生一起走进了光门，光芒将他们包裹。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng hé Lán Xiānsheng yìqǐ zǒu jìnle guāngmén, guāngmáng jiāng tāmen bāoguǒ.
sentences.english: Lin Feng and Mr. Lan entered the light gate together, and the light enveloped them.

sentences.chinese: 当他们再次睁开眼时，他们回到了学院的森林。
sentences.pinyin: Dāng tāmen zàicì zhēngkāi yǎn shí, tāmen huí dàole xuéyuàn de sēnlín.
sentences.english: When they opened their eyes again, they had returned to the academy's forest.

sentences.chinese: 天空不再是血红色，而是明亮的蓝色。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānkōng bù zài shì xuèhóngsè, ér shì míngliàng de lánsè.
sentences.english: The sky was no longer blood-red, but a bright blue.

sentences.chinese: 林风知道，他的生活将重新开始，但这一次他不再是那个弱小的人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Fēng zhīdào, tā de shēnghuó jiāng chóngxīn kāishǐ, dàn zhè yícì tā bù zài shì nàge ruòxiǎo de rén.
sentences.english: Lin Feng knew that his life would start anew, but this time he was no longer that weak person.

sentences.chinese: 然而，在他口袋里，突然出现了一张奇怪的纸条。
sentences.pinyin: Rán'ér, zài tā kǒudài lǐ, tūrán chūxiànle yì zhāng qíguài de zhǐtiáo.
sentences.english: However, in his pocket, a strange slip of paper suddenly appeared.

那时候，他经常问自己：为什么我不一样？

word_usage.sentence: 林风惊讶地问：“你等了我多久？”

他想知道，怎样才能和这条龙说话。

word_usage.sentence: 林风觉得有点儿难过，但他也早就习惯了。

他觉得这种感觉正好，就像找到了失踪的碎片。
林风看着自己的手，心想：我怎么会有这么大的力量？

word_usage.sentence: 这时，一只巨大的蓝色龙出现了。
这时候，林风感到有一点儿害怕，但更多的是好奇。
他试着伸出手，这样龙就停止了吼叫。
龙回答道：“你的血统决定了你能够掌控风，那么你就是被选中的人。”
那会儿，他以为只有自己能听到。

word_usage.sentence: 那时，他总是一个人在森林里走。

他意识到，他不能再像那样生活在底层了。

word_usage.sentence: 你一定能成功，因为你拥有纯净的灵魂。
他一直奔跑，试图寻找一个安全的地方。

sentences.pinyin: Tā tíxǐng wǒ, búyào zài shēnyè yí gè rén qù hébiān.
sentences.english: He reminded me not to go to the riverside alone late at night.

sentences.chinese: 因为夜晚的河边很冷，而且很危险。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi yèwǎn de hébiān hěn lěng, érqiě hěn wēixiǎn.
sentences.english: Because the riverside at night is very cold and dangerous.

sentences.chinese: 我点点头，手里拿着一个碗，喝着热汤。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ diǎndiǎn tóu, shǒulǐ ná zhe yí gè wǎn, hē zhe rè tāng.
sentences.english: I nodded, holding a bowl in my hand, drinking hot soup.

sentences.chinese: 汤里有一个鸡蛋，味道非常好。
sentences.pinyin: Tāng lǐ yǒu yí gè jīdàn, wèidào fēicháng hǎo.
sentences.english: There was an egg in the soup, and it tasted very good.

sentences.chinese: 突然，我的手碰到了桌子上的一个小药瓶。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, wǒ de shǒu pèng dào le zhuōzi shàng de yí gè xiǎo yàopíng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, my hand touched a small medicine bottle on the table.

sentences.chinese: 老爷爷说，这是用来治感冒的药。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo yéye shuō, zhè shì yòng lái zhì gǎnmào de yào.
sentences.english: The old grandfather said this medicine is used to treat colds.

sentences.chinese: 我想起我曾经在船上见过这种药。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngqǐ wǒ céngjīng zài chuán shàng jiàn guò zhè zhǒng yào.
sentences.english: I remembered that I had seen this kind of medicine on a boat before.

sentences.chinese: 窗外，绿色的草在风中摇摆。
sentences.pinyin: Chuāngwài, lǜsè de cǎo zài fēng zhōng yáobǎi.
sentences.english: Outside the window, green grass was swaying in the wind.

sentences.chinese: 一只小鸟在树上唱歌，声音很清脆。
sentences.pinyin: Yì zhī xiǎo niǎo zài shù shàng chànggē, shēngyīn hěn qīngcuì.
sentences.english: A small bird was singing in the tree, its voice very clear.

sentences.chinese: 我用一句话问他：“我可以去寻找那个秘密吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yòng yí jù huà wèn tā: “Wǒ kěyǐ qù xúnzhǎo nà gè mìmì ma?”
sentences.english: I asked him in one sentence: "Can I go look for that secret?"

sentences.chinese: 他看着我，决定留给我一个机会。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe wǒ, juédìng liú gěi wǒ yí gè jīhuì.
sentences.english: He looked at me and decided to leave me an opportunity.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，如果我想成功，就不能偷懒。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosu wǒ, rúguǒ wǒ xiǎng chénggōng, jiù bùnéng tōulǎn.
sentences.english: He told me that if I wanted to succeed, I could not be lazy.

sentences.chinese: 但我发现，这张地图上的标记非常奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ fāxiàn, zhè zhāng dìtú shàng de biāojì fēicháng qíguài.
sentences.english: But I discovered that the markings on this map were very strange.

sentences.chinese: 它像是一个假信号，在引导我去错误的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàng shì yí gè jiǎ xìnhào, zài yǐndǎo wǒ qù cuòwù de dìfāng.
sentences.english: It looked like a fake signal, leading me to the wrong place.

sentences.chinese: 我决定明天就开始我的冒险。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ juédìng míngtiān jiù kāishǐ wǒ de màoxiǎn.
sentences.english: I decided to start my adventure tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 第二天早晨，我准备出发去寻找地图上的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Dì èr tiān zǎochén, wǒ zhǔnbèi chūfā qù xúnzhǎo dìtú shàng de mìmì.
sentences.english: The next morning, I prepared to set off to find the secrets on the map.

sentences.chinese: 我的钱不够多，所以我想省一点钱。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de qián bù gòu duō, suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng shěng yīdiǎn qián.
sentences.english: I didn't have enough money, so I wanted to save a bit.

sentences.chinese: 我走出旅馆，看到一个卖水果的老人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǒuchū lǚguǎn, kàndào yīgè mài shuǐguǒ de lǎorén.
sentences.english: I walked out of the hotel and saw an old man selling fruit.

sentences.chinese: 他穿一件白色的衣服，看起来很友善。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chuān yī jiàn báisè de yīfu, kàn qǐlái hěn yǒushàn.
sentences.english: He was wearing white clothes and looked very friendly.

sentences.chinese: 我向他问路，但我的中文说得不好，声音很低。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiàng tā wèn lù, dàn wǒ de Zhōngwén shuō dé bù hǎo, shēngyīn hěn dī.
sentences.english: I asked him for directions, but my Chinese wasn't good, and my voice was low.

sentences.chinese: 老人听不懂，他的表情有点不满。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén tīng bù dǒng, tā de biǎoqíng yǒudiǎn bù mǎn.
sentences.english: The old man couldn't understand, and his expression was a bit dissatisfied.

sentences.chinese: 我觉得很不好意思，低头向他道歉。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ juéde hěn bù hǎo yì si, dītóu xiàng tā dàoqiàn.
sentences.english: I felt embarrassed and lowered my head to apologize to him.

sentences.chinese: 我想，我的中文不如当地人好，这让我很难过。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng, wǒ de Zhōngwén bù rú dāngdì rén hǎo, zhè ràng wǒ hěn nánguò.
sentences.english: I thought my Chinese was not as good as the locals', which made me feel sad.

sentences.chinese: 突然，一阵大风吹来，我的地图掉在地上。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yī zhèn dà fēng chuī lái, wǒ de dìtú diào zài dìshàng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, a strong gust of wind blew, and my map dropped to the ground.

sentences.chinese: 地图被风吹到了一个很深的水沟里。
sentences.pinyin: Dìtú bèi fēng chuī dàole yīgè hěn shēn de shuǐgōu lǐ.
sentences.english: The map was blown into a very deep ditch.

sentences.chinese: 我尝试去拿，但我的手臂太短，够不到。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ chángshì qù ná, dàn wǒ de shǒubì tài duǎn, gòu bù dào.
sentences.english: I tried to get it, but my arm was too short and couldn't reach.

sentences.chinese: 我只能用一根木棍去推这张纸。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ néng yòng yī gēn mùgùn qù tuī zhè zhāng zhǐ.
sentences.english: I could only use a wooden stick to push the piece of paper.

sentences.chinese: 可是，木棍卡在石头中间，怎么也动不了。
sentences.pinyin: Kěshì, mùgùn kǎ zài shítou zhōngjiān, zěnme yě dòng bù liǎo.
sentences.english: However, the stick got stuck between the rocks and wouldn't move at all.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个奇怪的人走过来，他看起来像个坏人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yīgè qíguài de rén zǒu guò lái, tā kàn qǐlái xiàng gè huài rén.
sentences.english: At that moment, a strange man walked over; he looked like a bad person.

sentences.chinese: 他的脸很难看，说话的声音也很难听。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de liǎn hěn nánkàn, shuōhuà de shēngyīn yě hěn nántīng.
sentences.english: His face was ugly, and the sound of his voice was unpleasant to hear.

sentences.chinese: 他对我大喊：“不要在这里浪费时间！”
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì wǒ dà hǎn: “Bù yào zài zhèlǐ làngfèi shíjiān!”
sentences.english: He shouted at me, "Don't waste time here!"

sentences.chinese: 我被他吓到了，觉得这个情况很可怕。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bèi tā xià dàole, juéde zhège qíngkuàng hěn kěpà.
sentences.english: I was frightened by him and felt the situation was dreadful.

sentences.chinese: 他用力推了我一把，我直接倒在地上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yònglì tuīle wǒ yī bǎ, wǒ zhíjiē dǎo zài dìshàng.
sentences.english: He pushed me hard, and I fell straight to the ground.

sentences.chinese: 我的腿撞到了石头，疼得我想哭。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de tuǐ zhuàng dàole shítou, téng dé wǒ xiǎng kū.
sentences.english: My leg hit a rock, and it hurt so much I wanted to cry.

sentences.chinese: 我的心情变得很难受，感觉这次旅行太难了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de xīnqíng biàn dé hěn nánshòu, gǎnjué zhè cì lǚxíng tài nán le.
sentences.english: My mood became very uncomfortable; I felt this trip was too difficult.

sentences.chinese: 那个男人说，一个人旅行有很多坏处，很容易遇到危险。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gè nánrén shuō, yīgè rén lǚxíng yǒu hěnduō huàichu, hěn róngyì yù dào wēixiǎn.
sentences.english: The man said that traveling alone has many disadvantages and it's easy to encounter danger.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你不行，你不能一个人去那么远的地方。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ bù xíng, nǐ bù néng yīgè rén qù nàme yuǎn de dìfāng.”
sentences.english: He said, "You're no good; you can't go to such a far place alone."

sentences.chinese: 我想反驳他，但我现在太虚弱了，只能放下地图。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng fǎnbó tā, dàn wǒ xiànzài tài xūruò le, zhǐ néng fàngxià dìtú.
sentences.english: I wanted to argue with him, but I was too weak now and could only let go of the map.

sentences.chinese: 他把我和地图分开，拿走了我的地图。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ wǒ hé dìtú fēnkāi, ná zǒule wǒ de dìtú.
sentences.english: He separated me from the map and took it away.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，如果我想拿回地图，就得跟我走。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, rúguǒ wǒ xiǎng ná huí dìtú, jiù děi gēn wǒ zǒu.
sentences.english: He told me that if I wanted the map back, I had to follow him.

sentences.chinese: 我看着他离开的背影，心里充满了疑惑。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe tā líkāi de bèiyǐng, xīnlǐ chōngmǎn le yíhuò.
sentences.english: I looked at his departing figure, my heart filled with doubt.

sentences.chinese: 他到底是谁？他为什么要拿走我的地图？
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàodǐ shì shuí? Tā wèishéme yào ná zǒu wǒ de dìtú?
sentences.english: Who on earth is he? Why did he take my map?

sentences.chinese: 我慢慢站起来，感觉全身都很累。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ mànman zhàn qǐlái, gǎnjué quánshēn dōu hěn lèi.
sentences.english: I slowly stood up, feeling my whole body was exhausted.

sentences.chinese: 那个男人一直走在我的前面，没有回头。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge nánrén yīzhí zǒu zài wǒ de qiánmiàn, méiyǒu huítóu.
sentences.english: That man kept walking in front of me without looking back.

sentences.chinese: 我实在不想跟着他，但我必须拿回我的地图。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shízài bù xiǎng gēnzhe tā, dàn wǒ bìxū ná huí wǒ de dìtú.
sentences.english: I really didn't want to follow him, but I had to get my map back.

sentences.chinese: 他忽然停了下来，回头看了我一眼。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hūrán tíngle xiàlái, huítóu kànle wǒ yīyǎn.
sentences.english: He suddenly stopped and looked back at me.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“你一定想知道我是谁。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ yīdìng xiǎng zhīdào wǒ shì shuí.”
sentences.english: He said, "You must want to know who I am."

sentences.chinese: 我点头，心里十分好奇。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ diǎntóu, xīnlǐ shífēn hàoqí.
sentences.english: I nodded, feeling extremely curious.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，他一生都在研究这张地图。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, tā yīshēng dōu zài yánjiū zhè zhāng dìtú.
sentences.english: He told me that he had spent his whole life studying this map.

sentences.chinese: 这张地图的全部秘密，正是他想要寻找的真正答案。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng dìtú de quánbù mìmì, zhèngshì tā xiǎngyào xúnzhǎo de zhēnzhèng dá'àn.
sentences.english: The entirety of the map's secrets was precisely the true answer he wanted to find.

sentences.chinese: 他经常在全国各地旅行，寻找地图上的标记。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jīngcháng zài quánguó gèdì lǚxíng, xúnzhǎo dìtú shàng de biāojì.
sentences.english: He frequently travels all over the country, searching for the markings on the map.

sentences.chinese: 他说这里的风景全年都很美，到处都是绿色的山。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō zhèlǐ de fēngjǐng quánnián dōu hěn měi, dàochù dōu shì lǜsè de shān.
sentences.english: He told me that the scenery here is beautiful all year long, with green mountains everywhere.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，很多人老是试图偷走这张地图，但他们完全不明白它的意义。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, hěnduō rén lǎoshì shìtú tōu zǒu zhè zhāng dìtú, dàn tāmen wánquán bù míngbái tā de yìyì.
sentences.english: He told me that many people are always trying to steal this map, but they completely fail to understand its meaning.

sentences.chinese: 他问我：“你为什么想要这张地图？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn wǒ: “Nǐ wèishéme xiǎngyào zhè zhāng dìtú?”
sentences.english: He asked me, "Why do you want this map?"

sentences.chinese: 我告诉他，我想在旅行中寻找自我。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gàosù tā, wǒ xiǎng zài lǚxíng zhōng xúnzhǎo zìwǒ.
sentences.english: I told him that I wanted to find myself during my travels.

sentences.chinese: 他笑了笑说：“这个想法挺好。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàole xiào shuō: “Zhège xiǎngfǎ tǐng hǎo.”
sentences.english: He smiled and said, "That idea is pretty good."

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，真正的冒险需要很长的时间，不能太快。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, zhēnzhèng de màoxiǎn xūyào hěn cháng de shíjiān, bùnéng tài kuài.
sentences.english: He told me that a true adventure requires a long time; it cannot be too fast.

sentences.chinese: 他说他并不是故意拿走地图的，只是为了测试我。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō tā bìng bùshì gùyì ná zǒu dìtú de, zhǐshì wèile cèshì wǒ.
sentences.english: He said he didn't take the map on purpose, but only to test me.

sentences.chinese: 现在，我们一共两个人，要一起前往那个奇怪的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài, wǒmen yīgòng liǎng gè rén, yào yīqǐ qiánwǎng nàge qíguài de dìfāng.
sentences.english: Now, there are two of us altogether, heading together toward that strange place.

sentences.chinese: 他说，全体旅行者在出发前都要做好准备。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, quántǐ lǚxíngzhě zài chūfā qián dōu yào zuò hǎo zhǔnbèi.
sentences.english: He said that all travelers must be well-prepared before setting out.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，在这个旅途中，我可以随时问他问题。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, zài zhège lǚxíng zhōng, wǒ kěyǐ suíshí wèn tā wèntí.
sentences.english: He told me that during this journey, I could ask him questions at any time.

sentences.chinese: 但我发现他说话的方式很奇怪，像是在隐藏什么。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ fāxiàn tā shuōhuà de fāngshì hěn qíguài, xiàng shì zài yǐncáng shénme.
sentences.english: But I noticed his way of speaking was strange, as if he were hiding something.

sentences.chinese: 我担心他会永远地拿走我的地图，不还给我。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dānxīn tā huì yǒngyuǎn de ná zǒu wǒ de dìtú, bù huán gěi wǒ.
sentences.english: I worried that he would take my map forever and not return it to me.

sentences.chinese: 我决定在接下来的日子里，仔细观察这个男人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ juédìng zài jiē xiàlái de rìzi lǐ, zǐxì guānchá zhège nánrén.
sentences.english: I decided to observe this man carefully in the coming days.

sentences.chinese: 就在我们准备离开时，他突然指向远方的一座高山。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài wǒmen zhǔnbèi líkāi shí, tā tūrán zhǐxiàng yuǎnfāng de yī zuò gāoshān.
sentences.english: Just as we were preparing to leave, he suddenly pointed toward a high mountain in the distance.

sentences.chinese: 那座高山在云雾中若隐若现。
sentences.pinyin: Nà zuò gāo shān zài yún wù zhōng ruò yǐn ruò xiàn.
sentences.english: That high mountain appeared and disappeared in the mist.

sentences.chinese: 向导看着我，轻声说我们要先去市中心。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo kàn zhe wǒ, qīng shēng shuō wǒ men yào xiān qù shì zhōng xīn.
sentences.english: The guide looked at me and whispered that we had to go to the city center first.

sentences.chinese: 我们走出小村庄，来到一个很大的停车场。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men zǒu chū xiǎo cūn zhuāng, lái dào yī gè hěn dà de tíng chē chǎng.
sentences.english: We walked out of the small village and arrived at a very large parking lot.

sentences.chinese: 那里停着很多车，但没有我们的车。
sentences.pinyin: Nà lǐ tíng zhe hěn duō chē, dàn méi yǒu wǒ men de chē.
sentences.english: There were many cars parked there, but not ours.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，我们要坐公交车去市里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ, wǒ men yào zuò gōng jiāo chē qù shì lǐ.
sentences.english: He told me that we needed to take the public bus to the city.

sentences.chinese: 在等待的时候，他从大衣口袋里拿出一个旧笔记本。
sentences.pinyin: Zài děng dài de shí hòu, tā cóng dà yī kǒu dài lǐ ná chū yī gè jiù bǐ jì běn.
sentences.english: While waiting, he took an old notebook out of his overcoat pocket.

sentences.chinese: 他在笔记本上写了一些奇怪的符号，像是某种秘密代码。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài bǐ jì běn shàng xiě le yī xiē qí guài de fú hào, xiàng shì mǒu zhǒng mì mì dài mǎ.
sentences.english: He wrote some strange symbols in the notebook, like some kind of secret code.

sentences.chinese: 我问他：“你是谁？你的工作是什么？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Nǐ shì shuí? Nǐ de gōng zuò shì shén me?”
sentences.english: I asked him, "Who are you? What is your job?"

sentences.chinese: 他笑了笑，说他以前在一家大公司工作，是一名组长。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiào le xiào, shuō tā yǐ qián zài yī jiā dà gōng sī gōng zuò, shì yī míng zǔ zhǎng.
sentences.english: He smiled and said he used to work in a large company as a group leader.

sentences.chinese: 他说他曾经有过很多同事，他们一起在办公室里讨论计划。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō tā céng jīng yǒu guò hěn duō tóng shì, tā men yī qǐ zài bàn gōng shì lǐ tǎo lùn jì huà.
sentences.english: He said he once had many colleagues, and they discussed plans together in the office.

sentences.chinese: 他还认识很多商人，这些人经常在城市里买卖古董。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hái rèn shí hěn duō shāng rén, zhè xiē rén jīng cháng zài chéng shì lǐ mǎi mài gǔ dǒng.
sentences.english: He also knew many businessmen who often traded antiques in the city.

sentences.chinese: 公交车来了，司机是一个很热情的中年男人。
sentences.pinyin: Gōng jiāo chē lái le, sī jī shì yī gè hěn rè qíng de zhōng nián nán rén.
sentences.english: The bus arrived; the driver was a very enthusiastic middle-aged man.

sentences.chinese: 司机告诉我们，现在的公路比以前好多了，去市中心很快。
sentences.pinyin: Sī jī gào sù wǒ men, xiàn zài de gōng lù bǐ yǐ qián hǎo duō le, qù shì zhōng xīn hěn kuài.
sentences.english: The driver told us that the highways are much better than before, and getting to the city center is very fast.

sentences.chinese: 我们进入了市中心，这里的人非常多。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men jìn rù le shì zhōng xīn, zhè lǐ de rén fēi cháng duō.
sentences.english: We entered the city center, where there were so many people.

sentences.chinese: 我们先经过了一个巨大的体育馆，那里正在举行体育比赛。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men xiān jīng guò le yī gè jù dà de tǐ yù guǎn, nà lǐ zhèng zài jǔ xíng tǐ yù bǐ sài.
sentences.english: We first passed a huge gymnasium, where a sports competition was taking place.

sentences.chinese: 在旁边的球场上，一支足球球队正在训练。
sentences.pinyin: Zài páng biān de qiú chǎng shàng, yī zhī zú qiú qiú duì zhèng zài xùn liàn.
sentences.english: On the nearby sports ground, a soccer team was training.

sentences.chinese: 我看到很多学生在跑步，其中一个看起来像班长一样在指挥大家。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào hěn duō xué sheng zài pǎo bù, qí zhōng yī gè kàn qǐ lái xiàng bān zhǎng yī yàng zài zhǐ huī dà jiā.
sentences.english: I saw many students running, and one of them seemed to be directing everyone like a class monitor.

sentences.chinese: 向导说，他以前认识这个学校的校长，他们经常一起聊天。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo shuō, tā yǐ qián rèn shí zhè gè xué xiào de xiào zhǎng, tā men jīng cháng yī qǐ liáo tiān.
sentences.english: The guide said he used to know the president of this school, and they often chatted together.

sentences.chinese: 我们离开体育区，走进一条窄窄的弄堂。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men lí kāi tǐ yù qū, zǒu jìn yī tiáo zhǎi zhǎi de lòng dāng.
sentences.english: We left the sports area and walked into a narrow alley.

sentences.chinese: 这里的房子很旧，但很有味道。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de fáng zi hěn jiù, dàn hěn yǒu wèi dào.
sentences.english: The houses here were very old, but they had a lot of character.

sentences.chinese: 我们看到一个女人在窗边晾衣服，旁边有一台老旧的洗衣机。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men kàn dào yī gè nǚ rén zài chuāng biān liàng yī fu, páng biān yǒu yī tái lǎo jiù de xǐ yī jī.
sentences.english: We saw a woman hanging clothes by the window, with an old washing machine beside her.

sentences.chinese: 那个女人看着我们，向导礼貌地打招呼，称呼她为太太。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè nǚ rén kàn zhe wǒ men, xiàng dǎo lǐ mào de dǎ zhāo hū, chēng hu tā wèi tài tai.
sentences.english: The woman looked at us, and the guide greeted her politely, calling her Madam.

sentences.chinese: 太太笑着说，她的爱人正在屋里准备午餐。
sentences.pinyin: Tài tai xiào zhe shuō, tā de ài ren zhèng zài wū lǐ zhǔn bèi wǔ cān.
sentences.english: The madam smiled and said her spouse was inside preparing lunch.

sentences.chinese: 她问我们是不是这里的客人，想要邀请我们进去坐坐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn wǒ men shì bú shì zhè lǐ de kè rén, xiǎng yào yāo qǐng wǒ men jìn qù zuò zuò.
sentences.english: She asked if we were guests here and wanted to invite us in to sit for a while.

sentences.chinese: 但向导摇了摇头，说我们必须快点去那个广场。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiàng dǎo yáo le yáo tóu, shuō wǒ men bì xū kuài diǎn qù nà gè guǎng chǎng.
sentences.english: But the guide shook his head and said we had to get to that public square quickly.

sentences.chinese: 在广场中心，有一座古老的石像。
sentences.pinyin: Zài guǎng chǎng zhōng xīn, yǒu yī zuò gǔ lǎo de shí xiàng.
sentences.english: In the center of the square, there was an ancient stone statue.

sentences.chinese: 向导告诉我，这座石像的真正主人隐藏在地图的秘密里。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo gào sù wǒ, zhè zuò shí xiàng de zhēn zhèng zhǔ rén yǐn cáng zài dì tú de mì mì lǐ.
sentences.english: The guide told me that the true owner of this statue was hidden in the secrets of the map.

sentences.chinese: 为了节省时间，我们决定离开广场，换乘地铁。
sentences.pinyin: Wèi le jié shěng shí jiān, wǒ men jué dìng lí kāi guǎng chǎng, huàn chéng dì tiě.
sentences.english: To save time, we decided to leave the square and transfer to the subway.

sentences.chinese: 地铁的速度很快，像是一条地下的长龙。
sentences.pinyin: Dì tiě de sù dù hěn kuài, xiàng shì yī tiáo dì xià de cháng lóng.
sentences.english: The subway was very fast, like a long dragon underground.

sentences.chinese: 但在地铁站出口，我们突然看到一辆黑色的出租车在等着我们。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zài dì tiě zhàn chū kǒu, wǒ men tū rán kàn dào yī liàng hēi sè de chū zū chē zài děng zhe wǒ men.
sentences.english: But at the subway station exit, we suddenly saw a black taxi waiting for us.

sentences.chinese: 出租车的司机看着向导，眼神里充满了恐惧。
sentences.pinyin: Chū zū chē de sī jī kàn zhe xiàng dǎo, yǎn shén lǐ chōng mǎn le kǒng jù.
sentences.english: The taxi driver looked at the guide, his eyes filled with fear.

sentences.chinese: 他低声说：“你终于回来了，但他们已经在找你了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā dī shēng shuō: “Nǐ zhōng yú huí lái le, dàn tā men yǐ jīng zài zhǎo nǐ le.”
sentences.english: He whispered, "You've finally come back, but they are already looking for you."

sentences.chinese: 出租车司机的话让我很紧张。
sentences.pinyin: Chū zū chē sī jī de huà ràng wǒ hěn jǐn zhāng.
sentences.english: The taxi driver's words made me very nervous.

sentences.chinese: 向导告诉我，我们需要快点离开这条道路。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo gào sù wǒ, wǒ men xū yào kuài diǎn lí kāi zhè tiáo dào lù.
sentences.english: The guide told me that we needed to leave this road quickly.

sentences.chinese: 他带我走过一条狭窄的小道，来到了城市的一个安静角落。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dài wǒ zǒu guò yī tiáo xiá zhǎi de xiǎo dào, lái dào le chéng shì de yī gè ā jìng jiǎo luò.
sentences.english: He led me through a narrow path to a quiet corner of the city.

sentences.chinese: 路边停着很多自行车，空气中有一种奇怪的味道。
sentences.pinyin: Lù biān tíng zhe hěn duō zì xíng chē, kōng qì zhōng yǒu yī zhǒng qí guài de wèi dào.
sentences.english: Many bicycles were parked by the roadside, and there was a strange smell in the air.

sentences.chinese: 我们走进了一座很大的院子，这里看起来像是一个旧的医院。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men zǒu jìn le yī zuò hěn dà de yuàn zi, zhè lǐ kàn qǐ lái xiàng shì yī gè jiù de yī yuàn.
sentences.english: We entered a large courtyard; it looked like an old hospital.

sentences.chinese: 向导说，这里的院长是一个很有名的人。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo shuō, zhè lǐ de yuàn zhǎng shì yī gè hěn yǒu míng de rén.
sentences.english: The guide said that the president of this institution is a very famous person.

sentences.chinese: 在这个院子里，有一个小小的草地，几个人在那里打网球。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè gè yuàn zi lǐ, yǒu yī gè xiǎo xiǎo de cǎo dì, jǐ gè rén zài nà lǐ dǎ wǎng qiú.
sentences.english: In this courtyard, there was a small lawn where a few people were playing tennis.

sentences.chinese: 我看到一个男人在指挥一个队，他应该是这里的队长。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào yī gè nán rén zài zhǐ huī yī gè duì, tā yīng gāi shì zhè lǐ de duì zhǎng.
sentences.english: I saw a man directing a team; he must be the team captain here.

sentences.chinese: 向导带我走进一间办公室，那里有一台很旧的计算机。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo dài wǒ zǒu jìn yī jiān bàn gōng shì, nà lǐ yǒu yī tái hěn jiù de jì suàn jī.
sentences.english: The guide took me into an office where there was a very old computer.

sentences.chinese: 他打开一个秘密的网站，试图寻找地图的真相。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dǎ kāi yī gè mì mì de wǎng zhàn, shì tú xún zhǎo dì tú de zhēn xiàng.
sentences.english: He opened a secret website, trying to find the truth about the map.

sentences.chinese: 这时，一个穿着西装的经理走了进来。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, yī gè chuān zhe xī zhuāng de jīng lǐ zǒu jìn lái.
sentences.english: At that moment, a manager wearing a suit walked in.

sentences.chinese: 他看着我们，眼神很冷，像是在看一个不欢迎的顾客。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe wǒ men, yǎn shén hěn lěng, xiàng shì zài kàn yī gè bù huān yíng de gù kè.
sentences.english: He looked at us with cold eyes, as if he were looking at an unwelcome customer.

sentences.chinese: 经理说，这里的院长现在在看西医，不能被打扰。
sentences.pinyin: Jīng lǐ shuō, zhè lǐ de yuàn zhǎng xiàn zài zài kàn xī yī, bù néng bèi dǎ rǎo.
sentences.english: The manager said that the president is currently seeing a Western medicine doctor and cannot be disturbed.

sentences.chinese: 向导低声告诉我，这个院长其实是一个研究西医的专家，但他现在很危险。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo dī shēng gào sù wǒ, zhè gè yuàn zhǎng qí shí shì yī gè yán jiū xī yī de zhuān jiā, dàn tā xiàn zài hěn wēi xiǎn.
sentences.english: The guide whispered to me that the president is actually an expert in Western medicine, but he is in danger now.

sentences.chinese: 突然，经理要求看我的银行卡，想知道我从哪里来的钱。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, jīng lǐ yāo qiú kàn wǒ de yín háng kǎ, xiǎng zhī dào wǒ cóng nǎ lǐ lái de qián.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the manager asked to see my bank card, wanting to know where my money came from.

sentences.chinese: 我感到很不安，因为我不知道这个地方到底是什么院。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gǎn dào hěn bù ān, yīn wèi wǒ bù zhī dào zhè gè dì fāng dào dǐ shì shén me yuàn.
sentences.english: I felt uneasy because I didn't know exactly what kind of institution this place was.

sentences.chinese: 我们离开办公室，走在院子的小路上，看到一群鸡在跑。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men lí kāi bàn gōng shì, zǒu zài yuàn zi de xiǎo lù shàng, kàn dào yī qún jī zài pǎo.
sentences.english: We left the office and walked along the small paths of the courtyard, seeing a flock of chickens running.

sentences.chinese: 向导说，我们要离开这里，去附近的酒店休息。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo shuō, wǒ men yào lí kāi zhè lǐ, qù fù jìn de jiǔ diàn xiū xī.
sentences.english: The guide said we should leave this place and rest at a nearby hotel.

sentences.chinese: 但我发现，我的手机没有网，无法联系任何人。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ fā xiàn, wǒ de shǒu jī méi yǒu wǎng, wú fǎ lián xì rèn hé rén.
sentences.english: But I discovered that my phone had no network connection and I couldn't contact anyone.

sentences.chinese: 就在我们准备离开时，那个经理突然在后面喊住了我们。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài wǒ men zhǔn bèi lí kāi shí, nà gè jīng lǐ tū rán zài hòu miàn hǎn zhù le wǒ men.
sentences.english: Just as we were preparing to leave, that manager suddenly called out to us from behind.

sentences.chinese: 经理快步走到我们面前，手里拿着一个旧信封。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ kuàibù zǒu dào wǒmen miànqián, shǒulǐ názhe yīgè jiù xìnfēng.
sentences.english: The manager walked quickly in front of us, holding an old envelope.

sentences.chinese: 他看着向导，脸上有一种奇怪的表情。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe xiàngdǎo, liǎn shàng yǒu yī zhǒng qíguài de biǎoqíng.
sentences.english: He looked at the guide, and there was a strange expression on his face.

sentences.chinese: 经理说：“你以前在这里工作，你应该记得我。”
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ shuō: “Nǐ yǐqián zài zhèlǐ gōngzuò, nǐ yīnggāi jìdé wǒ.”
sentences.english: The manager said, "You worked here before; you should remember me."

sentences.chinese: 向导看着经理的脸，沉默了一会儿。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo kànzhe jīnglǐ de liǎn, chénmòle yīhuǐ'er.
sentences.english: The guide looked at the manager's face and remained silent for a while.

sentences.chinese: 经理告诉我，他前年在这里碰到过一个西方游客。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ gàosù wǒ, tā qiánnián zài zhèlǐ pèngdào guò yīgè Xīfāng yóukè.
sentences.english: The manager told me that the year before last, he had come across a Western tourist here.

sentences.chinese: 那个游客留下了一张表，上面写着一些奇怪的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè yóukè liú xiàle yī zhāng biǎo, shàngmiàn xiězhe yīxiē qíguài de míngzì.
sentences.english: That tourist left a table/list, which had some strange names written on it.

sentences.chinese: 经理说，他以前见过很多像向导这样的人，但很少见到这么神秘的。
sentences.pinyin: Jīnglǐ shuō, tā yǐqián jiànguò hěnduō xiàng xiàngdǎo zhèyàng de rén, dàn hěn shǎo jiàndào zhème shénmì de.
sentences.english: The manager said he had seen many people like the guide before, but rarely seen one so mysterious.

sentences.chinese: 向导接过信封，看了看里头，然后低声说：“谢谢。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo jiēguò xìnfēng, kànle kàn lǐtou, ránhòu dīshēng shuō: “Xièxiè.”
sentences.english: The guide took the envelope, looked inside, and then said softly, "Thank you."

sentences.chinese: 我们离开院子，走到马路对面的一家小酒店。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen líkāi yuànzi, zǒu dào mǎlù duìmiàn de yījiā xiǎo jiǔdiàn.
sentences.english: We left the courtyard and walked to a small hotel across the road.

sentences.chinese: 酒店的房间很小，但很干净。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǔdiàn de fángjiān hěn xiǎo, dàn hěn gānjìng.
sentences.english: The hotel room was small but very clean.

sentences.chinese: 向导坐在我面前，告诉我关于这张地图的道理。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo zuò zài wǒ miànqián, gàosù wǒ guānyú zhè zhāng dìtú de dàolǐ.
sentences.english: The guide sat in front of me and explained the logic/reasoning regarding this map.

sentences.chinese: 他说，过去很多青少年为了寻找宝藏而来到这里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, guòqù hěnduō qīngshàonián wèile xúnzhǎo bǎozàng ér lái dào zhèlǐ.
sentences.english: He said that in the past, many teenagers came here to search for treasure.

sentences.chinese: 但大多数人都没有能留在身边的人，最后都迷路了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn dàduōshù rén dōu méiyǒu néng liú zài shēnbiān de rén, zuìhòu dōu mílùle.
sentences.english: But most people had no one to stay by their side and eventually got lost.

sentences.chinese: 这时，酒店的经理走进来，问我们的姓名。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, jiǔdiàn de jīnglǐ zǒu jìnlái, wèn wǒmen de xìngmíng.
sentences.english: At that moment, the hotel manager came in and asked for our full names.

sentences.chinese: 他姓全，是一个很热情的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xìng Quán, shì yīgè hěn rèqíng de rén.
sentences.english: His surname is Quan; he is a very warm person.

sentences.chinese: 全经理提到，他年轻时去过一个叫凉州的地方，那里很远。
sentences.pinyin: Quán jīnglǐ tí dào, tā niánqīng shí qùguò yīgè jiào Liángzhōu de dìfāng, nàlǐ hěn yuǎn.
sentences.english: Manager Quan mentioned that when he was young, he had been to a place called Liangzhou, which was very far away.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，在那个地方，他碰见了一个认识地图的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, zài nàgè dìfāng, tā pèngjiànle yīgè rènshi dìtú de rén.
sentences.english: He told me that in that place, he bumped into someone who knew about the map.

sentences.chinese: 我看着向导，发现他的眼神变得很复杂。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe xiàngdǎo, fāxiàn tā de yǎnshén biànde hěn fùzá.
sentences.english: I looked at the guide and noticed his expression became very complex.

sentences.chinese: 我意识到，这个旅程比我想象的要危险得多。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yìshí dào, zhège lǚchéng bǐ wǒ xiǎngxiàng de yào wēixiǎn dé duō.
sentences.english: I realized that this journey was much more dangerous than I had imagined.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，窗外突然传来了急促的敲门声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, chuāngwài tūrán chuánláile jí cù de qiāomén shēng.
sentences.english: Just then, a hurried knocking sound suddenly came from outside the window.

sentences.chinese: 敲门声很大，向导赶紧走到门口。
sentences.pinyin: Qiāo mén shēng hěn dà, xiàng dǎo gǎn jǐn zǒu dào mén kǒu.
sentences.english: The knocking was loud, and the guide hurried to the door.

sentences.chinese: 他听到外面有人在喊他的名字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīng dào wài miàn yǒu rén zài hǎn tā de míng zì.
sentences.english: He heard someone outside shouting his name.

sentences.chinese: 原来是全经理的朋友，一个在凉州工作的老师。
sentences.pinyin: Yuán lái shì Quán jīng lǐ de péng yǒu, yí gè zài Liáng zhōu gōng zuò de lǎo shī.
sentences.english: It turned out to be Manager Quan's friend, a teacher working in Liangzhou.

sentences.chinese: 老师说，他最近接到了一封奇怪的信。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo shī shuō, tā zuì jìn jiē dào le yì fēng qí guài de xìn.
sentences.english: The teacher said he had recently received a strange letter.

sentences.chinese: 他把那篇信打印了出来，递给我们看。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ nà piān xìn dǎ yìn le chū lái, dì gěi wǒ men kàn.
sentences.english: He printed out that piece of letter and handed it to us to see.

sentences.chinese: 信里提到，凉州快要举行一个古老的节日。
sentences.pinyin: Xìn lǐ tí dào, Liáng zhōu kuài yào jǔ xíng yí gè gǔ lǎo de jié rì.
sentences.english: The letter mentioned that Liangzhou was about to hold an ancient festival.

sentences.chinese: 这个节日很特别，很多地方的家长都会带孩子去参加。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè jié rì hěn tè bié, hěn duō dì fang de jiā zhǎng dōu huì dài hái zi qù cān jiā.
sentences.english: This festival is very special; many heads of households bring their children to participate.

sentences.chinese: 老师告诉我，他以前也是一名考生，在那个城市学习。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo shī gào sù wǒ, tā yǐ qián yě shì yì míng kǎo shēng, zài nà gè chéng shì xué xí.
sentences.english: The teacher told me that he was also an exam candidate in the past and studied in that city.

sentences.chinese: 他记得开学的时候，那里的人们会对陌生人非常友好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jì de kāi xué de shí hou, nà lǐ de rén men huì duì mò shēng rén fēi cháng yǒu hǎo.
sentences.english: He remembered that when school started, the people there were very friendly to strangers.

sentences.chinese: 我们坐在酒店三层的房间里，仔细看这张打印的纸。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men zuò zài jiǔ diàn sān céng de fáng jiān lǐ, zǐ xì kàn zhè zhāng dǎ yìn de zhǐ.
sentences.english: We sat in a room on the third floor of the hotel, carefully looking at this printed paper.

sentences.chinese: 向导突然提出，我们现在就出发去凉州。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo tū rán tí chū, wǒ men xiàn zài jiù chū fā qù Liáng zhōu.
sentences.english: The guide suddenly proposed that we set off for Liangzhou right now.

sentences.chinese: 全经理笑着说：“既然你要去，今天我请客！”
sentences.pinyin: Quán jīng lǐ xiào zhe shuō: “Jì rán nǐ yào qù, jīn tiān wǒ qǐng kè!”
sentences.english: Manager Quan said with a smile, "Since you are going, I'll treat everyone today!"

sentences.chinese: 我们在餐厅里坐下，大家举起杯子，大声说：“干杯！”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men zài cān tīng lǐ zuò xià, dà jiā jǔ qǐ bēi zi, dà shēng shuō: “Gān bēi!”
sentences.english: We sat down in the restaurant, everyone raised their glasses and shouted, "Cheers!"

sentences.chinese: 窗外开始吹起冷风，像是在提醒我们旅途的危险。
sentences.pinyin: Chuāng wài kāi shǐ chuī qǐ lěng fēng, xiàng shì zài tí xǐng wǒ men lǚ tú de wēi xiǎn.
sentences.english: Cold wind began to blow outside, as if reminding us of the dangers of the journey.

sentences.chinese: 全经理说，在凉州有一场著名的音乐会，人们会拉二胡。
sentences.pinyin: Quán jīng lǐ shuō, zài Liáng zhōu yǒu yì cháng zhù míng de yīn yuè huì, rén men huì lā èr hú.
sentences.english: Manager Quan said there is a famous concert in Liangzhou where people play the erhu.

sentences.chinese: 我想象着那个场景，心里感到挺兴奋的。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xiàng zhe nà gè chǎng jǐng, xīn lǐ gǎn dào tǐng xīng fèn de.
sentences.english: I imagined that scene and felt quite excited.

sentences.chinese: 但向导的脸色依然很严肃，他靠在椅子上沉思。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiàng dǎo de liǎn sè yī rán hěn yán sù, tā kào zài yǐ zi shàng chén sī.
sentences.english: But the guide's expression remained serious; he leaned against the chair in deep thought.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，要找到地图的秘密，我们需要爬上一座高山。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ, yào zhǎo dào dì tú de mì mì, wǒ men xū yào pá shàng yì zuò gāo shān.
sentences.english: He told me that to find the secret of the map, we need to climb a high mountain.

sentences.chinese: 在那座山上，有一个古老的石碑，上面有很多层文字。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nà zuò shān shàng, yǒu yí gè gǔ lǎo de shí bēi, shàng miàn yǒu hěn duō céng wén zì.
sentences.english: On that mountain, there is an ancient stone tablet with many layers of text.

sentences.chinese: 我们走出酒店，看到门口排了一长排出租车。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men zǒu chū jiǔ diàn, kàn dào mén kǒu pái le yì cháng pái chū zū chē.
sentences.english: We walked out of the hotel and saw a long row of taxis lined up at the door.

sentences.chinese: 向导突然举手叫了一辆车，眼神坚定。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo tū rán jǔ shǒu jiào le yí liàng chē, yǎn shén jiān dìng.
sentences.english: The guide suddenly raised his hand to hail a car, his eyes determined.

sentences.chinese: 他低声说，我们必须在节日开始前到达，否则会受到敌人的攻击。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dī shēng shuō, wǒ men bì xū zài jié rì kāi shǐ qián dào dá, fǒu zé huì shòu dào dí rén de gōng jī.
sentences.english: He whispered that we must arrive before the festival begins, otherwise we will receive an attack from the enemy.

sentences.chinese: 出租车开在路上，向导看着窗外，脸色很严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Chū zū chē kāi zài lù shàng, xiàng dǎo kàn zhe chuāng wài, liǎn sè hěn yán sù.
sentences.english: The taxi drove along the road, and the guide looked out the window with a very serious expression.

sentences.chinese: 他说，为了安全，我们要先去见几个朋友。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, wèi le ān quán, wǒ men yào xiān qù jiàn jǐ gè péng you.
sentences.english: He said that for safety, we needed to meet a few friends first.

sentences.chinese: 车子停在一个小镇的餐厅门口。
sentences.pinyin: Chē zi tíng zài yī gè xiǎo zhèn de cān tīng mén kǒu.
sentences.english: The car stopped at the entrance of a restaurant in a small town.

sentences.chinese: 这家餐厅很有名，这里既有中国菜，也有西餐。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cān tīng hěn yǒu míng, zhè lǐ jì yǒu Zhōng guó cài, yě yǒu xī cān.
sentences.english: This restaurant is very famous; it has both Chinese food and Western-style food.

sentences.chinese: 我们走进餐厅，看到一张大桌子，那里坐着一群青年。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men zǒu jìn cān tīng, kàn dào yī zhāng dà zhuō zi, nà lǐ zuò zhe yī qún qīng nián.
sentences.english: We walked into the restaurant and saw a large table where a group of young people were sitting.

sentences.chinese: 向导介绍说，这些人是他信任的伙伴。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo jiè shào shuō, zhè xiē rén shì tā xìn rèn de huǒ bàn.
sentences.english: The guide introduced them, saying these people were partners he trusted.

sentences.chinese: 第一个人姓向，他是一个很聪明的人。
sentences.pinyin: Dì yī gè rén xìng Xiàng, tā shì yī gè hěn cōng míng de rén.
sentences.english: The first person's surname was Xiang; he was a very smart man.

sentences.chinese: 第二个人姓封，他负责查地图上的路线。
sentences.pinyin: Dì èr gè rén xìng Fēng, tā fù zé zhā dì tú shàng de lù xiàn.
sentences.english: The second person's surname was Feng; he was responsible for checking the routes on the map.

sentences.chinese: 第三个人姓平，他总是笑着说话。
sentences.pinyin: Dì sān gè rén xìng Píng, tā zǒng shì xiào zhe shuō huà.
sentences.english: The third person's surname was Ping; he always spoke with a smile.

sentences.chinese: 第四个人姓怕，虽然他的姓很奇怪，但他很勇敢。
sentences.pinyin: Dì sì gè rén xìng Pà, suī rán tā de xìng hěn qí guài, dàn tā hěn yǒng gǎn.
sentences.english: The fourth person's surname was Pa; although his surname was strange, he was very brave.

sentences.chinese: 第五个人姓成，他知道很多关于高山的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Dì wǔ gè rén xìng Chéng, tā zhī dào hěn duō guān yú gāo shān de mì mì.
sentences.english: The fifth person's surname was Cheng; he knew many secrets about the high mountains.

sentences.chinese: 第六个人姓查，他是一个非常有经验的医生。
sentences.pinyin: Dì liù gè rén xìng Zhā, tā shì yī gè fēi cháng yǒu jīng yàn de yī shēng.
sentences.english: The sixth person's surname was Zha; he was a very experienced doctor.

sentences.chinese: 第七个人姓海，他来自远方的海岸。
sentences.pinyin: Dì qī gè rén xìng Hǎi, tā lái zì yuǎn fāng de hǎi àn.
sentences.english: The seventh person's surname was Hai; he came from a distant coast.

sentences.chinese: 第八个人姓米，他能说很多种语言。
sentences.pinyin: Dì bā gè rén xìng Mǐ, tā néng shuō hěn duō zhǒng yǔ yán.
sentences.english: The eighth person's surname was Mi; he could speak many languages.

sentences.chinese: 第九个人姓红，她穿着一件红色的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Dì jiǔ gè rén xìng Hóng, tā chuān zhe yī jiàn hóng sè de yī fu.
sentences.english: The ninth person's surname was Hong; she was wearing a red piece of clothing.

sentences.chinese: 第十个人姓蓝，他的眼睛像蓝色的天空一样漂亮。
sentences.pinyin: Dì shí gè rén xìng Lán, tā de yǎn jīng xiàng lán sè de tiān kōng yī yàng piào liang.
sentences.english: The tenth person's surname was Lan; his eyes were as beautiful as the blue sky.

sentences.chinese: 第十一个人姓角，他是一个沉默的人。
sentences.pinyin: Dì shí yī gè rén xìng Jué, tā shì yī gè chén mò de rén.
sentences.english: The eleventh person's surname was Jue; he was a silent person.

sentences.chinese: 第十二个人姓闻，他能听到很多奇怪的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Dì shí èr gè rén xìng Wén, tā néng tīng dào hěn duō qí guài de shēng yīn.
sentences.english: The twelfth person's surname was Wen; he could hear many strange sounds.

sentences.chinese: 第十三个人姓阴，他喜欢在阴天出门。
sentences.pinyin: Dì shí sān gè rén xìng Yīn, tā xǐ huan zài yīn tiān chū mén.
sentences.english: The thirteenth person's surname was Yin; he liked to go out on cloudy days.

sentences.chinese: 第十四个人姓雪，她的皮肤像雪一样白。
sentences.pinyin: Dì shí sì gè rén xìng Xuě, tā de pí fū xiàng xuě yī yàng bái.
sentences.english: The fourteenth person's surname was Xue; her skin was as white as snow.

sentences.chinese: 第十五个人姓题，他总是在思考难题。
sentences.pinyin: Dì shí wǔ gè rén xìng Tí, tā zǒng shì zài sī kǎo nán tí.
sentences.english: The fifteenth person's surname was Ti; he was always thinking about difficult problems.

sentences.chinese: 第十六个人姓鱼，他非常喜欢钓鱼。
sentences.pinyin: Dì shí liù gè rén xìng Yú, tā fēi cháng xǐ huan diào yú.
sentences.english: The sixteenth person's surname was Yu; he really loved fishing.

sentences.chinese: 最后一个人姓黄，他是这个小组的负责人。
sentences.pinyin: Zuì hòu yī gè rén xìng Huáng, tā shì zhè gè xiǎo zǔ de fù zé rén.
sentences.english: The last person's surname was Huang; he was the leader of this group.

sentences.chinese: 黄先生告诉我们，地图的一部分在石碑上，另一部分在他们这里。
sentences.pinyin: Huáng xiān sheng gào su wǒ men, dì tú de yī bù fen zài shí bēi shàng, lìng yī bù fen zài tā men zhè lǐ.
sentences.english: Mr. Huang told us that one part of the map was on the stone tablet, and another part was with them.

sentences.chinese: 我们点了一些鱼和蔬菜，开始讨论计划。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men diǎn le yī xiē yú hé shū cài, kāi shǐ tǎo lùn jì huà.
sentences.english: We ordered some fish and vegetables and began to discuss the plan.

sentences.chinese: 突然，黄先生的手机响了，他的表情突然变得很紧张。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, Huáng xiān sheng de shǒu jī xiǎng le, tā de biǎo qíng tū rán biàn de hěn jǐn zhāng.
sentences.english: Suddenly, Mr. Huang's phone rang, and his expression suddenly became very tense.

sentences.chinese: 他低声说，敌人已经到了这个小镇。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dī shēng shuō, dí rén yǐ jīng dào le zhè gè xiǎo zhèn.
sentences.english: He whispered, "The enemy has already arrived in this small town."

sentences.chinese: 黄先生看着手机，脸上的表情变得很严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Huáng xiān sheng kàn zhe shǒu jī, liǎn shàng de biǎo qíng biàn de hěn yán sù.
sentences.english: Mr. Huang looked at his phone, the expression on his face becoming very serious.

sentences.chinese: 他低声说，敌人们已经出现在小镇的入口处了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dī shēng shuō, dí rén men yǐ jīng chū xiàn zài xiǎo zhèn de rù kǒu chù le.
sentences.english: He whispered that the enemies had already appeared at the entrance of the town.

sentences.chinese: 我们要小心，他们想把地图交给他们的老板。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men yào xiǎo xīn, tā men xiǎng bǎ dì tú jiāo gěi tā men de lǎo bǎn.
sentences.english: We had to be careful; they wanted to hand the map over to their boss.

sentences.chinese: 向导突然站起来，他的眼神像鹰一样锐利。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo tū rán zhàn qǐ lái, tā de yǎn shén xiàng yīng yī yàng ruì lì.
sentences.english: The guide suddenly stood up, his gaze as sharp as an eagle's.

sentences.chinese: 他说，我们必须马上离开，不能在这里等死。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, wǒ men bì xū má shàng lí kāi, bù néng zài zhè lǐ děng sǐ.
sentences.english: He said we must leave immediately and cannot wait for death here.

sentences.chinese: 黄先生告诉我，他在这里实习了三年，很熟悉这里的路。
sentences.pinyin: Huáng xiān sheng gào sù wǒ, tā zài zhè lǐ shí xí le sān nián, hěn shú xī zhè lǐ de lù.
sentences.english: Mr. Huang told me he had interned here for three years and was very familiar with the roads.

sentences.chinese: 他出生在这个小镇，所以他知道怎么办才能逃走。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chū shēng zài zhè gè xiǎo zhèn, suǒ yǐ tā zhī dào zěn me bàn cái néng táo zǒu.
sentences.english: He was born in this town, so he knew how to handle things to escape.

sentences.chinese: 我们快速地收拾东西，我把地图仔细地放进一个皮套里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men kuài sù de shōu shí dōng xī, wǒ bǎ dì tú zǐ xì de fàng jìn yī gè pí tào lǐ.
sentences.english: We quickly packed our things, and I carefully placed the map into a leather case.

sentences.chinese: 黄先生说，这张地图的作用很大，它是实现我们目标的唯一办法。
sentences.pinyin: Huáng xiān sheng shuō, zhè zhāng dì tú de zuò yòng hěn dà, tā shì shí xiàn wǒ men mù biāo de wéi yī bàn fǎ.
sentences.english: Mr. Huang said the effect of this map is great; it is the only way to realize our goal.

sentences.chinese: 他问我，你信不信我们能成功逃离？
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn wǒ, nǐ xìn bù xìn wǒ men néng chéng gōng táo lí?
sentences.english: He asked me, "Do you believe we can successfully escape?"

sentences.chinese: 我看着他，认真地回答说，我信。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhe tā, rèn zhēn de huí dá shuō, wǒ xìn.
sentences.english: I looked at him and answered seriously, "I believe."

sentences.chinese: 向导说，我们要参加一场与时间的比赛。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo shuō, wǒ men yào cān jiā yī chǎng yǔ shí jiān de bǐ sài.
sentences.english: The guide said we had to participate in a race against time.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我们，最好的做法是走后山的秘密小路。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ men, zuì hǎo de zuò fǎ shì zǒu hòu shān de mì mì xiǎo lù.
sentences.english: He told us the best method was to take the secret path behind the mountain.

sentences.chinese: 我们走出餐厅，看到街上已经出现了一些奇怪的人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men zǒu chū cān tīng, kàn dào jiē shàng yǐ jīng chū xiàn le yī xiē qí guài de rén.
sentences.english: We walked out of the restaurant and saw some strange people already appearing on the street.

sentences.chinese: 那些人的姓氏虽然不同，但他们都穿着一样的黑衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Nà xiē rén de xìng shì suī rán bù tóng, dàn tā men dōu chuān zhe yī yàng de hēi yī fú.
sentences.english: Although those people's surnames were different, they were all wearing the same black clothes.

sentences.chinese: 他们叫作“影子人”，是专门寻找古物的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā men jiào zuò “yǐng zi rén”, shì zhuān mén xún zhǎo gǔ wù de rén.
