sentences.english: They are called "Shadow People," specialists in searching for antiques.

sentences.chinese: 黄先生突然想起，他曾经借给一个朋友一辆车，现在可以用到。
sentences.pinyin: Huáng xiān sheng tū rán xiǎng qǐ, tā céng jīng jiè gěi yī gè péng yǒu yī liàng chē, xiàn zài kě yǐ yòng dào.
sentences.english: Mr. Huang suddenly remembered he had once lent a car to a friend, which could be used now.

sentences.chinese: 他迅速地发了一条信息给那个朋友，要求取回车钥匙。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xùn sù de fā le yī tiáo xìn xī gěi nà gè péng yǒu, yāo qiú qǔ huí chē yào shi.
sentences.english: He quickly sent a message to that friend, requesting to retrieve the car keys.

sentences.chinese: 为了安全，我们必须把所有的线索交给最信任的人。
sentences.pinyin: Wèi le ā n quán, wǒ men bì xū bǎ suǒ yǒu de xiàn suǒ jiāo gěi zuì xìn rèn de rén.
sentences.english: For safety, we must hand over all clues to the most trusted person.

sentences.chinese: 在逃跑的过程中，我想起在学校写作文的日子，那时生活很简单。
sentences.pinyin: Zài táo pǎo de guò chéng zhōng, wǒ xiǎng qǐ zài xué xiào xiě zuò wén de rì zi, nà shí shēng huó hěn jiǎn dān.
sentences.english: During the escape, I thought of the days writing essays at school; life was simple then.

sentences.chinese: 现在，我的生活变成了这场危险的冒险。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài, wǒ de shēng huó biàn chéng le zhè chǎng wēi xiǎn de mào xiǎn.
sentences.english: Now, my life has turned into this dangerous adventure.

sentences.chinese: 向导看着我，轻声说，你要复习一下我们之前讨论的计划。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo kàn zhe wǒ, qīng shēng shuō, nǐ yào fù xí yī xià wǒ men zhī qián tǎo lùn de jì huà.
sentences.english: The guide looked at me and whispered, "You need to review the plan we discussed earlier."

sentences.chinese: 他很关心我的状态，因为我是这个旅程中唯一的记录者。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hěn guān xīn wǒ de zhuàng tài, yīn wèi wǒ shì zhè gè lǚ chéng zhōng wéi yī de jì lù zhě.
sentences.english: He cared deeply about my state because I am the only chronicler of this journey.

sentences.chinese: 我们来到一个农家院，那里有人在做饭，香味飘了出来。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men lái dào yī gè nóng jiā yuàn, nà lǐ yǒu rén zài zuò fàn, xiāng wèi piāo le chū lái.
sentences.english: We came to a farmhouse where someone was cooking, and the aroma wafted out.

sentences.chinese: 院子里养了很多狗，它们对着陌生人大叫。
sentences.pinyin: Yuàn zi lǐ yǎng le hěn duō gǒu, tā men duì zhe mò shēng rén dà jiào.
sentences.english: Many dogs were raised in the courtyard, and they barked loudly at strangers.

sentences.chinese: 向导对我说，在这个环境下，这些狗能为我们提供警报。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo duì wǒ shuō, zài zhè gè huán jìng xià, zhè xiē gǒu néng wéi wǒ men tí gōng jǐng bào.
sentences.english: The guide said to me, "In this environment, these dogs can act as an alarm for us."

sentences.chinese: 我们需要使用这些狗的反应来判断敌人的位置。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào shǐ yòng zhè xiē gǒu de fǎn yìng lái pàn duàn dí rén de wèi zhì.
sentences.english: We needed to use the reactions of these dogs to judge the enemies' positions.

sentences.chinese: 黄先生终于取得了车钥匙，我们快速地跳上车。
sentences.pinyin: Huáng xiān sheng zhōng yú qǔ dé le chē yào shi, wǒ men kuài sù de tiào shàng chē.
sentences.english: Mr. Huang finally obtained the car keys, and we quickly jumped into the car.

sentences.chinese: 他开车飞快地离开，窗外的景色迅速改变。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kāi chē fēi kuài de lí kāi, chuāng wài de jǐng sè xùn sù gǎi biàn.
sentences.english: He drove away rapidly, and the scenery outside the window changed quickly.

sentences.chinese: 我们终于做到了第一步，成功离开了小镇。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men zhōng yú zuò dào le dì yī bù, chéng gōng lí kāi le xiǎo zhèn.
sentences.english: We finally achieved the first step: successfully leaving the town.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，车子突然在半路熄火了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, chē zi tū rán zài bàn lù xī huǒ le.
sentences.english: But just then, the car suddenly stalled halfway.

sentences.chinese: 后视镜里，黑色的车队正快速向我们靠近。
sentences.pinyin: Hòu shì jìng lǐ, hēi sè de chē duì zhèng kuài sù xiàng wǒ men kào jìn.
sentences.english: In the rearview mirror, a convoy of black cars was rapidly approaching us.

chapters.title_english: Chapter 10: Choices on the Mountain Road

sentences.chinese: 黑色的车队就要追上我们了。
sentences.pinyin: Hēisè de chēduì jiù yào zhuī shàng wǒmen le.
sentences.english: The black convoy was about to catch up with us.

sentences.chinese: 黄先生用力地转动钥匙，但车子还是没启动。
sentences.pinyin: Huáng xiānshēng yònglì de zhuǎndòng yàoshi, dàn chēzi háishì méi qǐdòng.
sentences.english: Mr. Huang turned the key forcefully, but the car still wouldn't start.

sentences.chinese: 我感到非常害怕，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gǎndào fēicháng hàipà, xīntiào dé hěn kuài.
sentences.english: I felt very scared, and my heart was beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 这时候，黄先生突然想起后备箱里有一套旧工具。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shíhòu, Huáng xiānshēng tūrán xiǎngqǐ hòubèixiāng lǐ yǒu yī tào jiù gōngjù.
sentences.english: At that moment, Mr. Huang suddenly remembered there was a set of old tools in the trunk.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“我必须快点找出问题，否则我们没机会离开。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ bìxū kuài diǎn zhǎo chū wèntí, fǒuzé wǒmen méi jīhuì líkāi.”
sentences.english: He said, "I must find the problem quickly, otherwise we have no chance of leaving."

sentences.chinese: 他赶紧拿出工具，试图帮助车子重新启动。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎnjǐn ná chū gōngjù, shìtú bāngzhù chēzi chóngxīn qǐdòng.
sentences.english: He quickly took out the tools, trying to help the car restart.

sentences.chinese: 我看着窗外，想到如果被抓到，我的生活将会彻底改变。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe chuāngwài, xiǎngdào rúguǒ bèi zhuā dào, wǒ de shēnghuó jiāng huì chèdǐ gǎibiàn.
sentences.english: Looking out the window, I thought that if I were caught, my life would be completely changed.

sentences.chinese: 我问他：“如果车子不能开，我们怎么办？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Rúguǒ chēzi bùnéng kāi, wǒmen zěnme bàn?”
sentences.english: I asked him, "What should we do if the car can't run?"

sentences.chinese: 黄先生一边修车，一边对我说：“我们应该往山上的小路走。”
sentences.pinyin: Huáng xiānshēng yībiān xiū chē, yībiān duì wǒ shuō: “Wǒmen yīnggāi wǎng shānshàng de xiǎolù zǒu.”
sentences.english: While repairing the car, Mr. Huang said to me, "We should go towards the small path on the mountain."

sentences.chinese: 他提到，那条路虽然难走，但可以避开所有敌人的眼睛。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tí dào, nà tiáo lù suīrán nán zǒu, dàn kěyǐ bìkāi suǒyǒu dírén de yǎnjīng.
sentences.english: He mentioned that although that road is difficult to travel, it can avoid all the enemies' eyes.

sentences.chinese: 我愿意跟着他，因为他已经成为了我在这场旅程中唯一的依靠。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yuànyì gēnzhe tā, yīnwèi tā yǐjīng chéngwéi le wǒ zài zhè chǎng lǚchéng zhōng wéiyī de yīkào.
sentences.english: I was willing to follow him because he had already become my only reliance on this journey.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，我收到了一条奇怪的短信。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, wǒ shōudào le yī tiáo qíguài de duǎnxìn.
sentences.english: Just then, I received a strange text message.

sentences.chinese: 短信里是一个奇怪的广告，但我觉得这不像是普通的商业信息。
sentences.pinyin: Duǎnxìn lǐ shì yīgè qíguài de guǎnggào, dàn wǒ juédé zhè bù xiàng shì pǔtōng de shāngyè xìnxī.
sentences.english: Inside the text was a strange advertisement, but I felt it didn't seem like a normal commercial message.

sentences.chinese: 我意识到，有人在尝试通过这种方式给我带来信号。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yìshí dào, yǒurén zài chángshì tōngguò zhè zhǒng fāngshì gěi wǒ dài lái xìnhào.
sentences.english: I realized someone was trying to bring me a signal through this method.

sentences.chinese: 我拿出手机，仔细研究短信的内容，想得出某种结论。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ ná chū shǒujī, zǐxì yánjiū duǎnxìn de nèiróng, xiǎng dé chū mǒu zhǒng jié lùn.
sentences.english: I took out my phone and studied the content of the message carefully, wanting to reach some conclusion.

sentences.chinese: 我得出结论：有人在暗中观察我们，并试图给我们提供帮助。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dé chū jiélùn: yǒurén zài ànzhōng guānchá wǒmen, bìng shìtú gěi wǒmen tígōng bāngzhù.
sentences.english: I arrived at the conclusion: someone is observing us in secret and trying to provide us with help.

sentences.chinese: 接着，黄先生大喊一声，车子终于启动了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiēzhe, Huáng xiānshēng dà hǎn yī shēng, chēzi zhōngyú qǐdòng le.
sentences.english: Then, Mr. Huang gave a loud shout, and the car finally started.

sentences.chinese: 他迅速开车往山上开去，试图提高速度。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xùnsù kāichē wǎng shānshàng kāi qù, shìtú tígāo sùdù.
sentences.english: He quickly drove towards the mountain, trying to increase the speed.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，在这座山里度过今晚，是目前最安全的打算。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, zài zhè zuò shān lǐ dùguò jīnwǎn, shì mùqián zuì ānquán de dǎsuàn.
sentences.english: He told me that spending tonight in these mountains was the safest plan for now.

sentences.chinese: 他问我是否愿意接受这个危险的计划。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn wǒ shìfǒu yuànyì jiēshòu zhè gè wēixiǎn de jìhuà.
sentences.english: He asked me if I was willing to accept this dangerous plan.

sentences.chinese: 我点头同意，因为我知道我们必须尽快拿到那张地图的真正含义。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ diǎntóu tóngyì, yīnwèi wǒ zhīdào wǒmen bìxū jǐnkuài ná dào nà zhāng dìtú de zhēnzhèng hányì.
sentences.english: I nodded in agreement because I knew we must obtain the true meaning of that map as soon as possible.

sentences.chinese: 在这段路上，他向我提到了他的过去。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè duàn lù shàng, tā xiàng wǒ tí dào le tā de guòqù.
sentences.english: On this road, he mentioned his past to me.

sentences.chinese: 他说他曾经在城市里工作，收入很高，但生活并不快乐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō tā céngjīng zài chéngshì lǐ gōngzuò, shōurù hěn gāo, dàn shēnghuó bìng bù kuàilè.
sentences.english: He said he once worked in the city and had a high income, but life was not happy.

sentences.chinese: 他决定改变自己的生活方式，离开城市成为一名向导。
sentences.pinyin: Tā juédìng gǎibiàn zìjǐ de shēnghuó fāngshì, líkāi chéngshì chéngwéi yī míng xiàngdǎo.
sentences.english: He decided to change his lifestyle, leave the city, and become a guide.

sentences.chinese: 他说，这种改变对他的人生产生了巨大的影响。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, zhè zhǒng gǎibiàn duì tā de rénshēng chǎnshēng le jùdà de yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.english: He said this change had a huge influence on his life.

sentences.chinese: 他现在收到的每一分钱，都用来帮助像我这样迷路的人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiànzài shōu dào de měi yī fēn qián, dōu yòng lái bāngzhù xiàng wǒ zhèyàng mílù de rén.
sentences.english: Every cent he receives now is used to help people who are lost like me.

sentences.chinese: 接下来，我们进入了一片浓雾之中。
sentences.pinyin: Jiē xià lái, wǒmen jìn rù le yī piàn nóngwù zhī zhōng.
sentences.english: Next, we entered a thick fog.

sentences.chinese: 我想起之前在酒店听到经理说的话，心中依然不安。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngqǐ zhīqián zài jiǔdiàn tīng dào jīnglǐ shuō de huà, xīnzhōng yīrán bù'ān.
sentences.english: I recalled what I heard the manager say at the hotel, and I was still uneasy.

sentences.chinese: 我意识到，我必须改掉自己的胆小，变得更加勇敢。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yìshí dào, wǒ bìxū gǎi diào zìjǐ de dǎnxiǎo, biàn dé gèngjiā yǒnggǎn.
sentences.english: I realized I must change my cowardice and become braver.

sentences.chinese: 我们终于在山顶找到了一个隐蔽的洞穴。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zhōngyú zài shāndǐng zhǎodào le yīgè yǐnbì de dòngxué.
sentences.english: We finally found a hidden cave at the top of the mountain.

sentences.chinese: 我们走进洞穴，但就在这时，我们听到洞穴深处传来了脚步声。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zǒu jìn dòngxué, dàn jiù zài zhè shí, wǒmen tīng dào dòngxué shēnchù chuán lái le jiǎobù shēng.
sentences.english: We walked into the cave, but just then, we heard footsteps coming from deep within the cave.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十一章：洞穴里的秘密老师
chapters.title_english: Chapter 11: The Secret Teacher in the Cave

sentences.chinese: 我们小心地走进洞穴深处。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiǎoxīn de zǒu jìn dòngxué shēn chù.
sentences.english: We carefully walked into the depths of the cave.

sentences.chinese: 脚步声越来越近，一个老人走了过来。
sentences.pinyin: Jiǎobù shēng yuè lái yuè jìn, yī gè lǎorén zǒu guò lái.
sentences.english: Footsteps grew closer, and an old man came over.

sentences.chinese: 他穿着一件很旧的衣服，看起来像是在这里生活了很多年。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chuān zhe yī jiàn hěn jiù de yīfu, kàn qǐlái xiàng shì zài zhèlǐ shēnghuó le hěn duō nián.
sentences.english: He was wearing very old clothes and looked as if he had lived here for many years.

sentences.chinese: 老人看着我们，脸上带着微笑，说：“欢迎来到我的家。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén kàn zhe wǒmen, liǎn shàng dài zhe wēixiào, shuō: “Huānyíng lái dào wǒ de jiā.”
sentences.english: The old man looked at us with a smile on his face and said, "Welcome to my home."

sentences.chinese: 他让我们进入一个温暖的房间，那里有很多书。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ràng wǒmen jìn rù yī gè wēnnuǎn de fángjiān, nàlǐ yǒu hěn duō shū.
sentences.english: He let us enter a warm room that had many books.

sentences.chinese: 老人告诉我们，他来自一个遥远的城市，曾经在那里的大学从事教学工作。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén gàosù wǒmen, tā lái zì yī gè yáoyuǎn de chéngshì, céngjīng zài nàlǐ de dàxué cóngshì jiāoxué gōngzuò.
sentences.english: The old man told us that he came from a distant city and once worked in teaching at a university there.

sentences.chinese: 他认为教育是世界上最重要的事情，所以他在这里继续研究。
sentences.pinyin: Tā rènwéi jiàoyù shì shìjiè shàng zuì zhòngyào de shìqíng, suǒyǐ tā zài zhèlǐ jìxù yánjiū.
sentences.english: He believed that education is the most important thing in the world, so he continued his research here.

sentences.chinese: 他要求我们先休息，并提供了一些简单的服务，比如热茶和面包。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yāoqiú wǒmen xiān xiūxi, bìng tígōng le yīxiē jiǎndān de fúwù, bǐrú rè chá hé miànbāo.
sentences.english: He requested that we rest first and provided some simple services, such as hot tea and bread.

sentences.chinese: 我感觉很累，请求他能不能让我洗澡。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gǎnjué hěn lèi, qǐngqiú tā néng bù néng ràng wǒ xǐzǎo.
sentences.english: I felt very tired and requested if he could let me take a shower.

sentences.chinese: 老人笑着说，这里的水是来自山上的自然流，非常干净。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén xiào zhe shuō, zhèlǐ de shuǐ shì lái zì shān shàng de zìrán liú, fēicháng gānjìng.
sentences.english: The old man smiled and said the water here comes from a natural flow from the mountain and is very clean.

sentences.chinese: 他照顾我们的起居，并检查了我们的身体状况，确保我们没有受伤。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhàogù wǒmen de qǐjū, bìng jiǎnchá le wǒmen de shēntǐ zhuàngkuàng, quèbǎo wǒmen méiyǒu shòushāng.
sentences.english: He took care of our daily needs and inspected our physical condition to ensure we weren't injured.

sentences.chinese: 他开始数他书架上的书，每一本书都组成了一个巨大的知识库。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kāishǐ shǔ tā shūjià shàng de shū, měi yī běn shū dōu zǔchéng le yī gè jùdà de zhīshì kù.
sentences.english: He began to count the books on his shelf; every book constituted a huge knowledge base.

sentences.chinese: 他说，在这种安静的环境里生活，等于找到了真正的自由。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, zài zhè zhǒng ānjìng de huánjìng lǐ shēnghuó, děngyú zhǎodào le zhēnzhèng de zìyóu.
sentences.english: He said that living in such a quiet environment is equal to finding true freedom.

sentences.chinese: 他问我为什么要寻找那张地图，我告诉他我的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn wǒ wèishéme yào xúnzhǎo nà zhāng dìtú, wǒ gàosù tā wǒ de gùshì.
sentences.english: He asked me why I was searching for that map, and I told him my story.

sentences.chinese: 他认为我的勇敢并不算太高，但我的好奇心很强。
sentences.pinyin: Tā rènwéi wǒ de yǒnggǎn bìng bù suàn tài gāo, dàn wǒ de hàoqí xīn hěn qiáng.
sentences.english: He thought my bravery wasn't considered very high, but my curiosity was strong.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，想要读懂地图，需要经过长期的练习。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, xiǎng yào dú dǒng dìtú, xūyào jīngguò chángqī de liànxí.
sentences.english: He told me that to understand the map, one needs to go through long-term practice.

sentences.chinese: 他让我每天练习数地图上的标记，并尝试理解它们的含义。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ràng wǒ měitiān liànxí shǔ dìtú shàng de biāojì, bìng chángshì lǐjiě tāmen de hányì.
sentences.english: He had me practice counting the marks on the map every day and try to understand their meaning.

sentences.chinese: 他说明，这些标记并不是简单的符号，而是一种古老的语言。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuōmíng, zhèxiē biāojì bìng bùshì jiǎndān de fúhào, ér shì yī zhǒng gǔlǎo de yǔyán.
sentences.english: He explained that these marks are not simple symbols, but an ancient language.

sentences.chinese: 他开始教我如何观察，这就像是在练一种特殊的眼睛。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kāishǐ jiào wǒ rúhé guānchá, zhè jiù xiàng shì zài liàn yī zhǒng tèshū de yǎnjīng.
sentences.english: He began to teach me how to observe, which was like training a special kind of eye.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，学习这种语言需要耐心，不能急于求成。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, xuéxí zhè zhǒng yǔyán xūyào nàixīn, bùnéng jíyú qiúchéng.
sentences.english: He told me that learning this language requires patience and one cannot rush for success.

sentences.chinese: 他开了一个小小的笑话，说如果我学不会，就得帮他打扫洞穴。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kāi le yī gè xiǎoxiǎo de xiàohua, shuō rúguǒ wǒ xué bù huì, jiù děi bāng tā dǎsǎo dòngxué.
sentences.english: He made a small joke, saying that if I couldn't learn it, I would have to help him clean the cave.

sentences.chinese: 我意识到，能遇到这样一位老师，是我最大的运气。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yìshí dào, néng yù dào zhèyàng yī wèi lǎoshī, shì wǒ zuìdà de yùnqì.
sentences.english: I realized that meeting such a teacher was my greatest luck.

sentences.chinese: 他要求我必须每天学习三个小时，不能偷懒。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yāoqiú wǒ bìxū měitiān xuéxí sān gè xiǎoshí, bùnéng tōulǎn.
sentences.english: He required that I must study for three hours every day and not be lazy.

sentences.chinese: 为了方便学习，我决定租用他的一张旧桌子作为我的书桌。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile fāngbiàn xuéxí, wǒ juédìng zūyòng tā de yī zhāng jiù zhuōzi zuòwéi wǒ de shūzhuō.
sentences.english: To make studying easier, I decided to rent one of his old tables to use as my desk.

sentences.chinese: 这张桌子虽然旧，但大小正称我的需要。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhuōzi suīrán jiù, dàn dàxiǎo zhèng chèn wǒ de xūyào.
sentences.english: Although the table was old, the size fit my needs perfectly.

sentences.chinese: 我发现，在这种环境下学习，能够让我更专注。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ fāxiàn, zài zhè zhǒng huánjìng xià xuéxí, nénggòu ràng wǒ gèng zhuānzhù.
sentences.english: I found that studying in this environment enabled me to be more focused.

sentences.chinese: 我请求他教我更多关于这个地区的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ qǐngqiú tā jiào wǒ gèng duō guānyú zhège dìqū de mìmì.
sentences.english: I requested that he teach me more secrets about this region.

sentences.chinese: 老人看着我，眼神变得严肃起来。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén kàn zhe wǒ, yǎnshén biàn de yánsù qǐlái.
sentences.english: The old man looked at me, and his gaze became serious.

sentences.chinese: 他让我等一会儿，然后走进内屋拿了一个盒子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ràng wǒ děng yī huìr, ránhòu zǒu jìn nèiwū ná le yī gè hézi.
sentences.english: He let me wait a moment, then walked into the inner room and took out a box.

sentences.chinese: 等到他回来时，盒子里有一张更详细的地图。
sentences.pinyin: Děng dào tā huílái shí, hézi lǐ yǒu yī zhāng gèng xiángxì de dìtú.
sentences.english: By the time he returned, there was a more detailed map in the box.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，这张地图是由三个部分组成的，而我们现在只有一部分。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, zhè zhāng dìtú shì yóu sān gè bùfèn zǔchéng de, ér wǒmen xiànzài zhǐyǒu yī bùfèn.
sentences.english: He told me that this map was composed of three parts, and we only had one part now.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，洞穴外面突然传来了巨大的响声，像是有很多人在寻找我们。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, dòngxué wàimiàn tūrán chuán lái le jùdà de xiǎngshēng, xiàng shì yǒu hěn duō rén zài xúnzhǎo wǒmen.
sentences.english: Just then, a loud noise suddenly came from outside the cave, as if many people were searching for us.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十二章：逃离洞穴的计划
chapters.title_english: Chapter 12: The Plan to Escape the Cave

sentences.chinese: 洞穴外面传来的声音越来越大，我的心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Dòng xué wài miàn chuán lái de shēng yīn yuè lái yuè dà, wǒ de xīn tiào dé hěn kuài.
sentences.english: The sounds coming from outside the cave grew louder, and my heart beat fast.

sentences.chinese: 向导看着我，低声说：“不要害怕，只要我们行动正确，就能离开这里。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo kàn zhe wǒ, dī shēng shuō: “Bú yào hài pà, zhǐ yào wǒ men xíng dòng zhèng què, jiù néng lí kāi zhè lǐ.”
sentences.english: The guide looked at me and whispered, "Don't be afraid, as long as our actions are correct, we can leave here."

sentences.chinese: 老人拿出一瓶药水，让我们喝一点，说这样能让心情安静。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén ná chū yì píng yào shuǐ, ràng wǒ men hē yì diǎn, shuō zhè yàng néng ràng xīn qíng ān jìng.
sentences.english: The old man took out a bottle of medicinal liquid and let us drink a bit, saying it would make our minds quiet.

sentences.chinese: 喝完药水后，我感觉身体很舒服，不再那么紧张了。
sentences.pinyin: Hē wán yào shuǐ hòu, wǒ gǎn jué shēn tǐ hěn shū fu, bú zài nà me jǐn zhāng le.
sentences.english: After drinking the liquid, I felt very comfortable and no longer so nervous.

sentences.chinese: 老人指着地图说，这张地图不仅有这里的秘密，还记录了去北方和南方的路。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén zhǐ zhe dì tú shuō, zhè zhāng dì tú bù jǐn yǒu zhè lǐ de mì mì, hái jì lù le qù běi fāng hé nán fāng de lù.
sentences.english: The old man pointed to the map and said this map not only had the secrets of this place but also recorded the roads to the North and South.

sentences.chinese: 他说，如果我们要找剩下的部分，可能需要去东北，甚至去黑龙江省。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, rú guǒ wǒ men yào zhǎo shèng xià de bù fèn, kě néng xū yào qù dōng běi, shèn zhì qù hēi lóng jiāng shěng.
sentences.english: He said if we wanted to find the remaining parts, we might need to go to the Northeast, even to Heilongjiang Province.

sentences.chinese: 那里现在应该是冬天，天气非常凉快，但也很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Nà lǐ xiàn zài yīng gāi shì dōng tiān, tiān qì fēi cháng liáng kuai, dàn yě hěn lěng.
sentences.english: It should be winter there now; the weather is pleasantly cool, but also very cold.

sentences.chinese: 向导点头说，去西北或者西南的方向现在太危险，因为敌人就在附近。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo diǎn tóu shuō, qù xī běi huò zhě xī nán de fāng xiàng xiàn zài tài wēi xiǎn, yīn wèi dí rén jiù zài fù jìn.
sentences.english: The guide nodded and said going in the Northwest or Southwest directions is too dangerous now because the enemy is nearby.

sentences.chinese: 老人告诉我们，最好的好处是，这个洞穴有一个直接通往山下的秘密出口。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén gào su wǒ men, zuì hǎo de hǎo chǔ shì, zhè ge dòng xué yǒu yí gè zhí jiē tōng wǎng shān xià de mì mì chū kǒu.
sentences.english: The old man told us the best advantage is that this cave has a secret exit leading directly down the mountain.

sentences.chinese: 那个出口离这里很近，只要走一段路就能到达。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ge chū kǒu lí zhè lǐ hěn jìn, zhǐ yào zǒu yí duàn lù jiù néng dào dá.
sentences.english: That exit is very close to here; we only need to walk a short distance to reach it.

sentences.chinese: 现在是半夜，洞穴里很黑，只有老人手中的灯亮着。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàn zài shì bàn yè, dòng xué lǐ hěn hēi, zhǐ yǒu lǎo rén shǒu zhōng de dēng liàng zhe.
sentences.english: It was midnight now; it was very dark in the cave, and only the lamp in the old man's hand was bright.

sentences.chinese: 我们轻声说话，为了不让外面的人听到我们的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men qīng shēng shuō huà, wèi le bú ràng wài miàn de rén tīng dào wǒ men de shēng yīn.
sentences.english: We spoke softly so that the people outside would not hear our voices.

sentences.chinese: 老人说，我们必须在早晨太阳升起之前离开。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén shuō, wǒ men bì xū zài zǎo chén tài yáng shēng qǐ zhī qián lí kāi.
sentences.english: The old man said we must leave before the sun rises in the early morning.

sentences.chinese: 他希望我们能够平安地到达下一个目的地，过上快乐的生活。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xī wàng wǒ men néng gòu píng ān de dào dá xià yí gè mù dì dì, guò shàng kuài lè de shēng huó.
sentences.english: He hoped we could arrive at the next destination safe and sound and live a happy life.

sentences.chinese: 向导问：“明天会是晴天吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo wèn: “Míng tiān huì shì qíng tiān ma?”
sentences.english: The guide asked, "Will tomorrow be a sunny day?"

sentences.chinese: 老人看了看天空，说：“现在是阴天，但明天应该是晴，是个出行的好日子。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén kàn le kàn tiān kōng, shuō: “Xiàn zài shì yīn tiān, dàn míng tiān yīng gāi shì qíng, shì gè chū xíng de hǎo rì zi.”
sentences.english: The old man looked at the sky and said, "It is a cloudy day now, but tomorrow should be clear; it's a good day for travel."

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我们，如果明天是晴天，我们就直接往东南方向走。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su wǒ men, rú guǒ míng tiān shì qíng tiān, wǒ men jiù zhí jiē wǎng dōng nán fāng xiàng zǒu.
sentences.english: He told us that if tomorrow is a sunny day, we will go directly in the southeast direction.

sentences.chinese: 如果我们能顺利离开，以后我可以带你们去海边走走。
sentences.pinyin: Rú guǒ wǒ men néng shùn lì lí kāi, yǐ hòu wǒ kě yǐ dài nǐ men qù hǎi biān zǒu zǒu.
sentences.english: If we can leave smoothly, I can take you to the seaside for a walk in the future.

sentences.chinese: 我想，在海边晒太阳一定很不错。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng, zài hǎi biān shài tài yáng yí dìng hěn bú cuò.
sentences.english: I thought that sunbathing at the seaside would definitely be not bad.

sentences.chinese: 老人看着我们，眼神里充满了友好，像是一位真正的老师。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo rén kàn zhe wǒ men, yǎn shén lǐ chōng mǎn le yǒu hǎo, xiàng shì yí wèi zhēn zhèng de lǎo shī.
sentences.english: The old man looked at us, his eyes full of friendliness, like a true teacher.

sentences.chinese: 他提醒我们，在北方旅行，衣服必须穿得厚一点，这样才正确。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tí xǐng wǒ men, zài běi fāng lǚ xíng, yī fu bì xū chuān dé hòu yì diǎn, zhè yàng cái zhèng què.
sentences.english: He reminded us that when traveling in the North, clothes must be worn thicker; that is the correct way.

sentences.chinese: 我们决定在洞穴的角落休息一会儿，等待天亮。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men jué dìng zài dòng xué de jiǎo luò xiū xi yí huì r, děng dài tiān liàng.
sentences.english: We decided to rest in a corner of the cave for a while, waiting for dawn.

sentences.chinese: 向导对我轻声说了一句：“晚安”，然后闭上了眼睛。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo duì wǒ qīng shēng shuō le yí jù: “Wǎn ān”, rán hòu bì shàng le yǎn jīng.
sentences.english: The guide whispered to me, "Good night," and then closed his eyes.

sentences.chinese: 天上的星星在云层后面闪烁，仿佛在指引我们的方向。
sentences.pinyin: Tiān shàng de xīng xīng zài yún céng hòu miàn shǎn shuò, fǎng fú zài zhǐ yǐn wǒ men de fāng xiàng.
sentences.english: The stars in the sky twinkled behind the clouds, as if guiding our direction.

sentences.chinese: 我躺在冰冷的石头上，虽然不那么舒服，但心里感到很平安。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tǎng zài bīng lěng de shí tou shàng, suī rán bù nà me shū fu, dàn xīn lǐ gǎn dào hěn píng ān.
sentences.english: I lay on the cold stone; although it wasn't that comfortable, I felt very safe in my heart.

sentences.chinese: 我想起在城市里的生活，那里虽然方便，但这里更安静。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐ zài chéng shì lǐ de shēng huó, nà lǐ suī rán pián yi, dàn zhè lǐ gèng ān jìng.
sentences.english: I thought of life in the city; although it was convenient, it was quieter here.

sentences.chinese: 突然，外面的嘈杂声消失了，一切又回到了安静的状态。
sentences.pinyin: Tū rán, wài miàn de cáo zá shēng xiāo shī le, yí qiè yòu huí dào le ān jìng de zhuàng tài.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the noise outside disappeared, and everything returned to a quiet state.

sentences.chinese: 我睁开眼，发现天色已经开始变亮了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhēng kāi yǎn, fā xiàn tiān sè yǐ jīng kāi shǐ biàn liàng le.
sentences.english: I opened my eyes and found that the sky had already begun to brighten.

sentences.chinese: 向导突然坐了起来，他的表情变得非常严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo tū rán zuò le qǐ lái, tā de biǎo qíng biàn dé fēi cháng yán sù.
sentences.english: The guide suddenly sat up, his expression becoming very serious.

sentences.chinese: 他指着洞穴口，低声说：“看，他们进来了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐ zhe dòng xué kǒu, dī shēng shuō: “Kàn, tā men jìn lái le.”
sentences.english: He pointed to the cave entrance and whispered, "Look, they have come in."

sentences.chinese: 我们意识到，时间不多了，必须立刻行动。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men yì shí dào, shí jiān bú duō le, bì xū lì kè xíng dòng.
sentences.english: We realized time was running out and we had to act immediately.

sentences.chinese: 就在我们准备跑向秘密出口时，一个黑色的影子突然出现在我们面前。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài wǒ men zhǔn bèi pǎo xiàng mì mì chū kǒu shí, yí gè hēi sè de yǐng zi tū rán chū xiàn zài wǒ men miàn qián.
sentences.english: Just as we were preparing to run toward the secret exit, a black shadow suddenly appeared before us.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十三章：山林里的陌生人
chapters.title_english: Chapter 13: The Stranger in the Mountain Forest

sentences.chinese: 那个黑色的影子突然说话了，声音很低。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge hēisè de yǐngzi tūrán shuōhuà le, shēngyīn hěn dī.
sentences.english: That black shadow suddenly spoke, his voice very low.

sentences.chinese: 他看起来是一个中年男人，穿着一件深色的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐlái shì yīgè zhōngnián nánrén, chuānzhe yī jiàn shēnsè de yīfú.
sentences.english: He looked like a middle-aged man, wearing dark clothes.

sentences.chinese: 他的衣服颜色像黑夜一样，让我们很难看清他的脸。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yīfú yánsè xiàng hēiyè yīyàng, ràng wǒmen hěn nán kànqīng tā de liǎn.
sentences.english: The color of his clothes was like the dark night, making it hard for us to see his face clearly.

sentences.chinese: 他并没有攻击我们，而是用很标准的普通话问我们是谁。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìng méiyǒu gōngjī wǒmen, érshì yòng hěn biāozhǔn de pǔtōnghuà wèn wǒmen shì shéi.
sentences.english: He didn't attack us, but instead asked who we were in very standard Mandarin.

sentences.chinese: 向导看着他，眼神里有一丝惊讶，低声说：“你是东方先生吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo kànzhe tā, yǎnshén lǐ yǒu yīsī jīngyà, dīshēng shuō: “Nǐ shì Dōngfāng xiānshēng ma?”
sentences.english: The guide looked at him with a hint of surprise in his eyes and whispered, "Are you Mr. Dongfang?"

sentences.chinese: 那个男人点点头，说他以前在高中教书，后来研究中医。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge nánrén diǎndiǎn tóu, shuō tā yǐqián zài gāozhōng jiāoshū, hòulái yánjiū zhōngyī.
sentences.english: The man nodded and said he used to teach in senior high school and later studied traditional Chinese medicine.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，他平时住在山边的房子里，很少见客人。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, tā píngshí zhù zài shānbiān de fángzi lǐ, hěn shǎo jiàn kèrén.
sentences.english: He told me that he ordinarily lives in a house by the mountainside and rarely sees guests.

sentences.chinese: 他说，在山里遇到他并不是一件正常的事情。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, zài shānlǐ yùdào tā bìng bùshì yī jiàn zhèngcháng de shìqíng.
sentences.english: He said that meeting him in the mountains is not a normal occurrence.

sentences.chinese: 他邀请我们去他的家休息，那里有简单的食物和酒。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yāoqǐng wǒmen qù tā de jiā xiūxí, nàlǐ yǒu jiǎndān de shíwù hé jiǔ.
sentences.english: He invited us to rest at his home, where there was simple food and wine.

sentences.chinese: 我们跟着他走，路边有很多常见的小花和奇怪的树。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen gēnzhe tā zǒu, lùbiān yǒu hěnduō chángjiàn de xiǎohuā hé qíguài de shù.
sentences.english: We followed him, and by the roadside, there were many commonly seen small flowers and strange trees.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，这些植物在当地是非常常用的药材。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, zhèxiē zhíwù zài dāngdì shì fēicháng chángyòng de yàocái.
sentences.english: He told me that these plants are very commonly used medicinal materials in the local area.

sentences.chinese: 他说，普通人一般看不出这些药材的区别。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, pǔtōng rén yībān kàn bù chū zhèxiē yàocái de qūbié.
sentences.english: He said that ordinary people generally cannot tell the difference between these medicinal materials.

sentences.chinese: 他的房子很普通，但里面非常干净。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de fángzi hěn pǔtōng, dàn lǐmiàn fēicháng gānjìng.
sentences.english: His house was very ordinary, but the inside was very clean.

sentences.chinese: 他给我们拿了一些水果，说这些苹果每公斤十块钱。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gěi wǒmen nále yīxiē shuǐguǒ, shuō zhèxiē píngguǒ měi gōngjīn shí kuài qián.
sentences.english: He brought us some fruit, saying these apples cost ten yuan per kilogram.

sentences.chinese: 在中国，人们也常用“斤”来计算重量，一公斤等于两斤。
sentences.pinyin: Zài Zhōngguó, rénmen yě chángyòng “jīn” lái jìsuàn zhòngliàng, yī gōngjīn děngyú liǎng jīn.
sentences.english: In China, people also commonly use the "catty" to calculate weight; one kilogram equals two catties.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，他现在的身份是一个中级研究员，专门研究古地图。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, tā xiànzài de shēnfèn shì yīgè zhōngjí yánjiūyuán, zhuānmén yánjiū gǔ dìtú.
sentences.english: He told me that his current status is a middle-level researcher, specializing in ancient maps.

sentences.chinese: 这让我非常激动，因为我们正在寻找地图的第二部分。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ràng wǒ fēicháng jīdòng, yīnwèi wǒmen zhèngzài xúnzhǎo dìtú de dì èr bùfèn.
sentences.english: This made me very excited because we are searching for the second part of the map.

sentences.chinese: 平常我不需要面对这么多危险，但这次旅程改变了我。
sentences.pinyin: Píngcháng wǒ bù xūyào miànduì zhème duō wēixiǎn, dàn zhè cì lǚchéng gǎibiànle wǒ.
sentences.english: Usually, I don't need to face so many dangers, but this journey has changed me.

sentences.chinese: 他提到他曾经去过加拿大，所以他知道我来自那个地方。
sentences.pinyin: Tā títào tā céngjīng qùguò Jiānádà, suǒyǐ tā zhīdào wǒ láizì nàge dìfāng.
sentences.english: He mentioned that he had been to Canada, so he knew I came from that place.

sentences.chinese: 他笑着说：“加国的冬天很冷，但这里的山林更神秘。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàozhe shuō: “Jiā guó de dōngtiān hěn lěng, dàn zhèlǐ de shānlín gèng shénmì.”
sentences.english: He smiled and said, "Canada's winter is very cold, but the mountain forests here are more mysterious.

sentences.chinese: 就在我们聊天时，窗外突然传来了急促的刹车声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài wǒmen liáotiān shí, chuāngwài tūrán chuánláile jícù de shāchē shēng.
sentences.english: Just as we were chatting, the sound of sudden braking came from outside the window.

sentences.chinese: 黑色的车队竟然找到了这里！
sentences.pinyin: Hēisè de chēduì jìngrán zhǎodàole zhèlǐ!
sentences.english: The black convoy had actually found this place!

chapters.title_chinese: 第十四章：森林里的紧急逃脱
chapters.title_english: Chapter 14: Emergency Escape from the Forest

sentences.chinese: 黑色的车队停在门外，我的心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Hēisè de chēduì tíng zài mén wài, wǒ de xīntiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: The black convoy stopped outside the door, and my heart was beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 向导看着我，他的头发在风中飞舞。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo kànzhe wǒ, tā de tóufa zài fēng zhōng fēiwǔ.
sentences.english: The guide looked at me, his hair flying in the wind.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“别担心，我知道这里有一个秘密的出口。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Bié dānxīn, wǒ zhīdào zhèlǐ yǒu yígè mìmì de chūkǒu.”
sentences.english: He said, "Don't worry, I know there is a secret exit here."

sentences.chinese: 他带我跑向森林深处，那里的大自然非常美丽，但现在很危险。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dài wǒ pǎo xiàng sēnlín shēnchù, nàlǐ de dà zì rán fēicháng měilì, dàn xiànzài hěn wēixiǎn.
sentences.english: He led me deep into the forest, where nature was beautiful but now dangerous.

sentences.chinese: 我们跑过一个小山坡，看到远处有一个旧的体育场。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen pǎo guò yígè xiǎo shānpō, kàndào yuǎnchù yǒu yígè jiù de tǐ yù chǎng.
sentences.english: We ran over a small hill and saw an old stadium in the distance.

sentences.chinese: 向导告诉我，这里以前是一个中小学的校园。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo gàosù wǒ, zhèlǐ yǐqián shì yígè zhōng xiǎo xué de xiàoyuán.
sentences.english: The guide told me that this place used to be a middle and elementary school campus.

sentences.chinese: 他指着一座破旧的建筑说：“那里以前是教室，现在我们可以躲在里面。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐzhe yí zuò pòjiù de jiànzhù shuō: “Nàlǐ yǐqián shì jiào shì, xiànzài wǒmen kěyǐ duǒ zài lǐmiàn.”
sentences.english: Pointing to a dilapidated building, he said, "That used to be a classroom; we can hide inside now."

sentences.chinese: 我们快步走进建筑，像个年轻的教师在带领学生一样。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen kuàibù zǒu jìn jiànzhù, xiàng gè niánqīng de jiào shī zài dàilǐng xuéshēng yíyàng.
sentences.english: We walked quickly into the building, like a young teacher leading students.

sentences.chinese: 在房间里，我发现了一本旧书，作者是一位著名的作家。
sentences.pinyin: Zài fángjiān lǐ, wǒ fāxiàn le yì běn jiù shū, zuòzhě shì yí wèi zhùmíng de zuò jiā.
sentences.english: Inside the room, I found an old book written by a famous author.

sentences.chinese: 书里写着：“地球上的每一个角落都有秘密。”
sentences.pinyin: Shū lǐ xiězhe: “Dìqiú shàng de měi yí gè jiǎoluò dōu yǒu mìmì.”
sentences.english: The book said, "Every corner of the earth has secrets."

sentences.chinese: 我读了一个句子，突然觉得这个世界非常宽广。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dú le yí gè jù zi, tūrán juéde zhège shìjiè fēicháng kuānguǎng.
sentences.english: I read a sentence and suddenly felt that this world was incredibly vast.

sentences.chinese: 向导在窗边观察，他说：“他们还没发现我们。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo zài chuāng biān guānchá, tā shuō: “Tāmen hái méi fāxiàn wǒmen.”
sentences.english: The guide observed from the window and said, "They haven't found us yet."

sentences.chinese: 这时，我的手机突然有了信号。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, wǒ de shǒujī tūrán yǒu le xìn hào.
sentences.english: At that moment, my phone suddenly got a signal.

sentences.chinese: 我尝试打电话，电话通了，对方说：“喂？你在哪里？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ chángshì dǎ diànhuà, diànhuà tōng le, duìfāng shuō: “Wéi? Nǐ zài nǎlǐ?”
sentences.english: I tried to make a call; it went through, and the other person said, "Hello? Where are you?"

sentences.chinese: 是我在加拿大的朋友，他问我假期过得怎么样。
sentences.pinyin: Shì wǒ zài Jiānádà de péngyou, tā wèn wǒ jià qī guò de zěnmeyàng.
sentences.english: It was my friend in Canada, asking how my vacation was going.

sentences.chinese: 我低声说：“我现在在中国，但我遇到了麻烦。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dīshēng shuō: “Wǒ xiànzài zài Zhōngguó, dàn wǒ yùdào le máfan.”
sentences.english: I whispered, "I am in China right now, but I've run into trouble."

sentences.chinese: 我想告诉他，上周我还觉得这次旅行很轻松。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gàosù tā, shàng zhōu wǒ hái juéde zhè cì lǚxíng hěn qīngsōng.
sentences.english: I wanted to tell him that last week I still felt this trip was relaxing.

sentences.chinese: 但现在，我希望下周能安全地回到家。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn xiànzài, wǒ xīwàng xià zhōu néng ānquán de huí dào jiā.
sentences.english: But now, I hope I can return home safely next week.

sentences.chinese: 向导看着我，轻声说：“我们要尽快离开这里。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo kànzhe wǒ, qīngshēng shuō: “Wǒmen yào jǐnkuài líkāi zhèlǐ.”
sentences.english: The guide looked at me and said softly, "We must leave here as soon as possible."

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，这个地区的住房很贵，很多地方都是出租的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, zhège dìqū de zhù fáng hěn guì, hěnduō dìfāng dōu shì chū zū de.
sentences.english: He told me that housing in this area is very expensive, and many places are for rent.

sentences.chinese: 他计划带我去市中心，那里有国际车站。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìhuà dài wǒ qù shì zhōngxīn, nàlǐ yǒu guó jì chēzhàn.
sentences.english: He planned to take me to the city center, where there is an international station.

sentences.chinese: 我们可以坐公共汽车离开这个小镇。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ zuò gōng gòng qì chē líkāi zhège xiǎo zhèn.
sentences.english: We could take a bus to leave this small town.

sentences.chinese: 他记得夏天这里很热，但现在是冬天，天气很冷。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jìde xià tiān zhèlǐ hěn rè, dàn xiànzài shì dōng tiān, tiānqì hěn lěng.
sentences.english: He remembered that it was very hot here in the summer, but now it is winter, and the weather is cold.

sentences.chinese: 他说：“如果现在下雪，我们的路会更难走。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Rúguǒ xiànzài xià xuě, wǒmen de lù huì gèng nán zǒu.”
sentences.english: He said, "If it snows now, our path will be even harder to travel."

sentences.chinese: 我们走出建筑，看到林子里有一些野生动物。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zǒuchū jiànzhù, kàndào lín zi lǐ yǒu yìxiē yěshēng dòng wù.
sentences.english: We walked out of the building and saw some wild animals in the woods.

sentences.chinese: 有一只小猴子在树上看着我们，它看起来很好奇。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu yì zhī xiǎo hóuzi zài shù shàng kànzhe wǒmen, tā kàn qǐlái hěn hàoqí.
sentences.english: There was a little monkey watching us from a tree; it looked very curious.

sentences.chinese: 附近还有几只鸟，它们在不停地叫。
sentences.pinyin: Fùjìn hái yǒu jǐ zhī niǎo, tāmen zài bùtíng de jiào.
sentences.english: There were also a few birds nearby, chirping incessantly.

sentences.chinese: 向导说，这里的动物比动物园里的要聪明得多。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo shuō, zhèlǐ de dòng wù bǐ dòng wù yuán lǐ de yào cōngmíng de duō.
sentences.english: The guide said the animals here were much smarter than those in the zoo.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，这个小镇的市长曾经花了几千块钱保护这些森林。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, zhège xiǎo zhèn de shì zhǎng céngjīng huā le jǐ qiān kuài qián bǎohù zhèxiē sēnlín.
sentences.english: He told me that the mayor of this town had once spent thousands of yuan protecting these forests.

sentences.chinese: 我们必须分成几个小组，才能在森林里快速移动。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū fēnchéng jǐ gè xiǎo zǔ, cáinéng zài sēnlín lǐ kuàisù yídòng.
sentences.english: We had to split into several small groups to move quickly through the forest.

sentences.chinese: 我们要找到一个有座位的地方休息，然后排队通过秘密通道。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zhǎodào yí gè yǒu zuò wèi de dìfāng xiūxi, ránhòu pái duì tōngguò mìmì tōngdào.
sentences.english: We needed to find a place with seats to rest, and then line up to go through the secret passage.

sentences.chinese: 就在我们准备出发时，窗外传来了巨大的喊叫声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài wǒmen zhǔnbèi chūfā shí, chuāng wài chuán lái le jùdà de hǎnjiào shēng.
sentences.english: Just as we were preparing to set off, a loud shout came from outside the window.

sentences.chinese: 黑色的车队已经包围了这座旧学校！
sentences.pinyin: Hēisè de chēduì yǐjīng bāowéi le zhè zuò jiù xuéxiào!
sentences.english: The black convoy had already surrounded the old school!

chapters.title_chinese: 第十五章：森林深处的秘密花园
chapters.title_english: Chapter 15: The Secret Garden Deep in the Forest

sentences.chinese: 我们迅速离开了旧学校的校园，在森林里奔跑。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xùnsù líkāile jiù xuéxiào de xiàoyuán, zài sēnlín lǐ bēnpǎo.
sentences.english: We quickly left the old school campus and ran into the forest.

sentences.chinese: 向导告诉我，这里曾经是一个科学家的秘密基地。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo gàosù wǒ, zhèlǐ céngjīng shì yīgè kēxuéjiā de mìmì jīdì.
sentences.english: The guide told me that this place used to be a scientist's secret base.

sentences.chinese: 他希望能在这里研究植物，让它们在秋天也能结果。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xīwàng néng zài zhèlǐ yánjiū zhíwù, ràng tāmen zài qiūtiān yě néng jiēguǒ.
sentences.english: He hoped to study plants here so they could bear fruit even in autumn.

sentences.chinese: 我们走在绿色的树林里，空气很清新。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zǒu zài lǜsè de shùlín lǐ, kōngqì hěn qīngxīn.
sentences.english: We walked through the green woods, and the air was very fresh.

sentences.chinese: 我的腿很累，但我们不能停下来。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de tuǐ hěn lèi, dàn wǒmen bùnéng tíng xiàlái.
sentences.english: My legs were very tired, but we couldn't stop.

sentences.chinese: 突然，我们看到了一座蓝色的房子，旁边有一个美丽的花园。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, wǒmen kàndàole yī zuò lánsè de fángzi, pángbiān yǒu yīgè měilì de huāyuán.
sentences.english: Suddenly, we saw a blue house with a beautiful garden beside it.

sentences.chinese: 花园里有一条小河，河水流向远方的湖。
sentences.pinyin: Huāyuán lǐ yǒu yī tiáo xiǎo hé, héshuǐ liúxiàng yuǎnfāng de hú.
sentences.english: In the garden, there was a small river, and the river water flowed toward a distant lake.

sentences.chinese: 房子里坐着一位老画家，他正看着窗外的月亮。
sentences.pinyin: Fángzi lǐ zuòzhe yī wèi lǎo huàjiā, tā zhèng kànzhe chuāngwài de yuèliang.
sentences.english: An old painter was sitting in the house, looking at the moon outside the window.

sentences.chinese: 他的眼睛很亮，看到我们后，他轻轻点头表示欢迎。
sentences.pinyin: Tā de yǎnjing hěn liàng, kàndào wǒmen hòu, tā qīngqīng diǎntóu biǎoshì huānyíng.
sentences.english: His eyes were bright, and after seeing us, he nodded gently in welcome.

sentences.chinese: 他邀请我们进去休息，并给了我们一份简单的早餐。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yāoqǐng wǒmen jìnqù xiūxi, bìng gěile wǒmen yī fèn jiǎndān de zǎocān.
sentences.english: He invited us in to rest and gave us a simple breakfast.

sentences.chinese: 桌子上放着一份当地的日报，上面写着最新的新闻。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng fàngzhe yī fèn dāngdì de rìbào, shàngmiàn xiězhe zuìxīn de xīnwén.
sentences.english: A local daily newspaper was on the table, with the latest news written on it.

sentences.chinese: 老画家说，这个月份的天气很奇怪，气温变化很快。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo huàjiā shuō, zhège yuèfèn de tiānqì hěn qíguài, qìwēn biànhuà hěn kuài.
sentences.english: The old painter said the weather this month was strange, and the air temperature changed quickly.

sentences.chinese: 他说，这里的温度在春天和秋天之间跳跃。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, zhèlǐ de wēndù zài chūntiān hé qiūtiān zhījiān tiàoyuè.
sentences.english: He said the temperature here jumped between spring and autumn.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，这里的森林在春节期间会举办盛大的晚会。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, zhèlǐ de sēnlín zài Chūnjié qījiān huì jǔbàn shèngdà de wǎnhuì.
sentences.english: He told me that the forest here holds a grand evening party during the Spring Festival.

sentences.chinese: 我好奇地问他，他是否会英语，或者懂一些英文。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hàoqí de wèn tā, tā shìfǒu huì Yīngyǔ, huòzhě dǒng yīxiē Yīngwén.
sentences.english: I curiously asked him if he spoke English or understood some English writing.

sentences.chinese: 他笑了，用简单的英语告诉我们，他曾经在国外生活过。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàole, yòng jiǎndān de Yīngyǔ gàosù wǒmen, tā céngjīng zài guówài shēnghuóguò.
sentences.english: He smiled and told us in simple English that he had lived abroad.

sentences.chinese: 他指着墙上的画说，那是一只像离一样的神兽。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐzhe qiáng shàng de huà shuō, nà shì yī zhǐ xiàng lí yīyàng de shénshòu.
sentences.english: He pointed to a painting on the wall and said it was a mythical beast like a 'Li'.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，他年轻时曾去很多个城市，走过很多条街。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, tā niánqīng shí céng qù hěnduō gè chéngshì, zǒuguò hěnduō tiáo jiē.
sentences.english: He told me that when he was young, he went to many cities and walked many streets.

sentences.chinese: 他问向导，最近是否有空儿帮他整理画室。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn xiàngdǎo, zuìjìn shìfǒu yǒukòngr bāng tā zhěnglǐ huàshì.
sentences.english: He asked the guide if he was available recently to help him organize the studio.

sentences.chinese: 向导看着他，眼神里充满了尊敬。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo kànzhe tā, yǎnshén lǐ chōngmǎnle zūnjìng.
sentences.english: The guide looked at him, his eyes full of respect.

sentences.chinese: 我们在房间里找到了一把旧椅子，坐在上面休息。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zài fángjiān lǐ zhǎodàole yī bǎ jiù yǐzi, zuò zài shàngmiàn xiūxi.
sentences.english: We found an old chair in the room and sat on it to rest.

sentences.chinese: 这时，我发现我的脚受伤了，需要去药店买药。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, wǒ fāxiàn wǒ de jiǎo shòushāngle, xūyào qù yàodiàn mǎi yào.
sentences.english: At this moment, I discovered my foot was injured and I needed to go to a pharmacy to buy medicine.

sentences.chinese: 老画家指了指桌上的菜单，说这里有能治病的草药汤。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo huàjiā zhǐle zhǐ zhuō shàng de càidān, shuō zhèlǐ yǒu néng zhìbìng de cǎoyào tāng.
sentences.english: The old painter pointed to the menu on the table and said there was a medicinal herb soup here that could cure illnesses.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，这种汤的颜色是绿色的，但味道很好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, zhè zhǒng tāng de yánsè shì lǜsè de, dàn wèidào hěn hǎo.
sentences.english: He told me the color of this soup was green, but the taste was very good.

sentences.chinese: 我们在这里休息了几个小时，心情慢慢平静下来。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zài zhèlǐ xiūxile jǐ gè xiǎoshí, xīnqíng mànmàn píngjìng xiàlái.
sentences.english: We rested here for a few hours, and my mood gradually calmed down.

sentences.chinese: 但我突然想起，黑色的车队还在后面追我们。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ tūrán xiǎngqǐ, hēisè de chēduì hái zài hòumiàn zhuī wǒmen.
sentences.english: But I suddenly remembered that the black convoy was still chasing us.

sentences.chinese: 老画家看着窗外，低声说：“他们快到了。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎo huàjiā kànzhe chuāngwài, dīshēng shuō: “Tāmen kuài dàole.”
sentences.english: The old painter looked out the window and said softly, "They are almost here."

sentences.chinese: 他指了指花园后面的秘密出口。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐle zhǐ huāyuán hòumiàn de mìmì chūkǒu.
sentences.english: He pointed to a secret exit behind the garden.

sentences.chinese: 我们必须在他们进入这里之前离开。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū zài tāmen jìnrù zhèlǐ zhīqián líkāi.
sentences.english: We had to leave before they entered this place.

sentences.chinese: 我看着他，意识到这个老人知道很多关于地图的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe tā, yìshí dào zhège lǎorén zhīdào hěnduō guānyú dìtú de mìmì.
sentences.english: I looked at him and realized this old man knew many secrets about the map.

sentences.chinese: 他递给我一个小盒子，说这是给我的礼物。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dì gěi wǒ yīgè xiǎo hézi, shuō zhè shì gěi wǒ de lǐwù.
sentences.english: He handed me a small box, saying it was a gift for me.

sentences.chinese: 就在我们准备离开时，远处传来了狗的叫声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài wǒmen zhǔnbèi líkāi shí, yuǎnchù chuánláile gǒu de jiàoshēng.
sentences.english: Just as we were preparing to leave, the sound of a dog barking came from the distance.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十六章：雪夜的避难所
chapters.title_english: Chapter 16: Shelter in the Snowy Night

sentences.chinese: 狗的叫声越来越近，我们赶紧通过秘密出口跑了出去。
sentences.pinyin: Gǒu de jiào shēng yuè lái yuè jìn, wǒ men gǎn xíng tōng guò mì mì chū kǒu pǎo le chū qù.
sentences.english: The barking of the dogs grew closer, and we quickly ran out through the secret exit.

sentences.chinese: 外面的天气突然变得很冷，气温已经零下十度了。
sentences.pinyin: Wài miàn de tiān qì tū rán biàn de hěn lěng, qì wēn yǐ jīng líng xià shí dù le.
sentences.english: The weather outside suddenly became very cold; the temperature was already ten degrees below zero.

sentences.chinese: 向导告诉我，我们需要在附近的村庄找一个安全的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo gào su wǒ, wǒ men xū yào zài fù jìn de cūn zhuāng zhǎo yī gè ā n quán de dì fang.
sentences.english: The guide told me that we needed to find a safe place in a nearby village.

sentences.chinese: 在路上，我们看到很多车辆在雪地里行驶，但没有一辆车愿意停下来帮我们。
sentences.pinyin: Zài lù shàng, wǒ men kàn dào hěn duō chē liàng zài xuě dì lǐ xíng shǐ, dàn méi yǒu yī liàng chē yuàn yì tíng xià lái bāng wǒ men.
sentences.english: On the road, we saw many vehicles driving in the snow, but not a single car was willing to stop and help us.

sentences.chinese: 终于，我们来到一个叫段先生的人家里。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōng yú, wǒ men lái dào yī gè jiào Duàn xiān sheng de rén jiā lǐ.
sentences.english: Finally, we arrived at the home of a man named Mr. Duan.

sentences.chinese: 段先生是一个退休的老师，他的家像一个小小的课堂，到处都是书。
sentences.pinyin: Duàn xiān sheng shì yī gè tuì xiū de lǎo shī, tā de jiā xiàng yī gè xiǎo xiǎo de kè táng, dào chù dōu shì shū.
sentences.english: Mr. Duan was a retired teacher, and his home was like a small classroom, with books everywhere.

sentences.chinese: 他非常热情，问我们是不是想在这里过年。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fēi cháng rè qíng, wèn wǒ men shì bú shì xiǎng zài zhè lǐ guò nián.
sentences.english: He was very welcoming and asked if we wanted to celebrate the Chinese New Year here.

sentences.chinese: 他说，现在的局势是一个难题，因为黑色的车队还在寻找我们。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, xiàn zài de jú shì shì yī gè nán tí, yīn wèi hēi sè de chē duì hái zài xún zhǎo wǒ men.
sentences.english: He said the current situation was a difficult problem because the black convoy was still searching for us.

sentences.chinese: 为了掩盖我们的行踪，段先生建议我们去村口的银行后面休息。
sentences.pinyin: Wèi le yǎn gài wǒ men de xíng zōng, Duàn xiān sheng jiàn yì wǒ men qù cūn kǒu de yín háng hòu miàn xiū xi.
sentences.english: To cover our tracks, Mr. Duan suggested we rest behind the bank at the village entrance.

sentences.chinese: 他帮我们准备了很多食物，其中最美味的是热腾腾的饺子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bāng wǒ men zhǔn bèi le hěn duō shí wù, qí zhōng zuì měi wèi de shì rè téng téng de jiǎo zi.
sentences.english: He helped us prepare a lot of food, the most delicious of which were the steaming hot dumplings.

sentences.chinese: 我们在一个小的饭馆里坐下，感受着久违的温暖。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men zài yī gè xiǎo de fàn guǎn lǐ zuò xià, gǎn shòu zhe jiǔ wéi de wēn nuǎn.
sentences.english: We sat down in a small restaurant, feeling a long-awaited warmth.

sentences.chinese: 段先生开始跟我们聊天，他对我学习中文的语言能力很感兴趣。
sentences.pinyin: Duàn xiān sheng kāi shǐ gēn wǒ men liáo tiān, tā duì wǒ xué xí zhōng wén de yǔ yán néng lì hěn gǎn xìng qù.
sentences.english: Mr. Duan began to chat with us, and he was very interested in my Chinese language ability.

sentences.chinese: 他教我如何正确地读每一个音节，并让我重复一遍。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiào wǒ rú hé zhèng què de dú měi yī gè yīn jié, bìng ràng wǒ chóng fù yī biàn.
sentences.english: He taught me how to correctly pronounce each syllable and asked me to repeat it.

sentences.chinese: 他说，学习语言就像听音乐，需要有节奏感。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, xué xí yǔ yán jiù xiàng tīng yīn yuè, xū yào yǒu jié zòu gǎn.
sentences.english: He said that learning a language is like listening to music; it needs a sense of rhythm.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，他年轻时曾经在很多著名的音乐会上演奏过。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào su wǒ, tā nián qīng shí céng jīng zài hěn duō zhù míng de yīn yuè huì shàng yǎn zòu guò.
sentences.english: He told me that when he was young, he had performed at many famous concerts.

sentences.chinese: 这时，他拿出一个沉重的包裹，说这是他要送到城市里的重要东西。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, tā ná chū yī gè chén zhòng de bāo guǒ, shuō zhè shì tā yào sòng dào chéng shì lǐ de zhòng yào dōng xi.
sentences.english: At that moment, he brought out a heavy package and said it was something important he needed to deliver to the city.

sentences.chinese: 这个包裹大约有五千克重，里面似乎藏着另一部分地图。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè bāo guǒ dà yuē yǒu wǔ qiān kè zhòng, lǐ miàn sì hū cáng zhe lìng yī bù fèn dì tú.
sentences.english: This package weighed about five kilograms and seemed to hide another part of the map.

sentences.chinese: 我们决定在段先生的帮助下，继续进行我们的秘密计划。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men jué dìng zài Duàn xiān sheng de bāng zhù xià, jì xù jìn xíng wǒ men de mì mì jì huà.
sentences.english: We decided to continue conducting our secret plan with Mr. Duan's help.

sentences.chinese: 但就在我们准备休息时，窗外突然出现了一辆黑色的车。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài wǒ men zhǔn bèi xiū xi shí, chuāng wài tū rán chū xiàn le yī liàng hēi sè de chē.
sentences.english: But just as we were preparing to rest, a black car suddenly appeared outside the window.

sentences.chinese: 那个司机看着段先生的房子，眼神里充满了杀气。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè sī jī kàn zhe Duàn xiān sheng de fáng zi, yǎn shén lǐ chōng mǎn le shā qì.
sentences.english: The driver looked at Mr. Duan's house, his eyes filled with murderous intent.

sentences.chinese: 窗外的黑车还在，我们不敢出去。
sentences.pinyin: Chuāng wài de hēi chē hái zài, wǒ men bù gǎn chū qù.
sentences.english: The black car was still outside; we didn't dare to go out.

sentences.chinese: 段先生看着那个沉重的包裹，表情很严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Duàn xiān sheng kàn zhe nà gè chén zhòng de bāo guǒ, biǎo qíng hěn yán sù.
sentences.english: Mr. Duan looked at the heavy package, his expression very serious.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我们，这个包裹里有组先生留下的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ men, zhè gè bāo guǒ lǐ yǒu Zǔ xiān sheng liú xià de mì mì.
sentences.english: He told us that inside this package were secrets left by Mr. Zu.

sentences.chinese: 组先生是他的一个老朋友，很多年前就失踪了。
sentences.pinyin: Zǔ xiān sheng shì tā de yí gè lǎo péng you, hěn duō nián qián jiù shī zōng le.
sentences.english: Mr. Zu was an old friend of his who had disappeared many years ago.

sentences.chinese: 段先生说，组先生非常重视这张地图，因为它能指引去往高级古城的路。
sentences.pinyin: Duàn xiān sheng shuō, Zǔ xiān sheng fēi cháng zhòng shì zhè zhāng dì tú, yīn wèi tā néng zhǐ yǐn qù wǎng gāo jí gǔ chéng de lù.
sentences.english: Mr. Duan said that Mr. Zu valued this map greatly because it could guide the way to an advanced ancient city.

sentences.chinese: 咱们现在必须商量怎么离开这里，段先生小声地说道。
sentences.pinyin: Zán men xiàn zài bì xū shāng liang zěn me lí kāi zhè lǐ, Duàn xiān sheng xiǎo shēng de shuō dào.
sentences.english: "We must discuss how to leave this place now," Mr. Duan said in a low voice.

sentences.chinese: 我和向导坐在一起，开始讨论接下来的计划。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hé xiàng dǎo zuò zài yì qǐ, kāi shǐ tǎo lùn jiē xià lái de jì huà.
sentences.english: I sat with the guide and began to discuss the next plan.

sentences.chinese: 我听说那个黑色的车队在寻找一份名单，名单上写着所有知道秘密的人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tīng shuō nà gè hēi sè de chē duì zài xún zhǎo yí fèn míng dān, míng dān shàng xiě zhe suǒ yǒu zhī dào mì mì de rén.
sentences.english: I heard that the black car convoy was looking for a list of names, which listed everyone who knew the secret.

sentences.chinese: 向导看着我，轻声讲了他的想法。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo kàn zhe wǒ, qīng shēng jiǎng le tā de xiǎng fǎ.
sentences.english: The guide looked at me and softly explained his thoughts.

sentences.chinese: 他说，我们需要换一件衣服，伪装成当地的农民。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, wǒ men xū yào huàn yí jiàn yī fu, wěi zhuāng chéng dāng dì de nóng mín.
sentences.english: He said we needed to change our clothes and disguise ourselves as local farmers.

sentences.chinese: 他对我微笑，让我对自己有信心，我们一定能成功。
sentences.pinyin: Tā duì wǒ wēi xiào, ràng wǒ duì zì jǐ yǒu xìn xīn, wǒ men yí dìng néng chéng gōng.
sentences.english: He smiled at me, telling me to have confidence in myself; we would surely succeed.

sentences.chinese: 在这危险的时刻，向导的鼓励让我很感动。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè wēi xiǎn de shí kè, xiàng dǎo de gǔ lì ràng wǒ hěn gǎn dòng.
sentences.english: In this dangerous moment, the guide's encouragement moved me deeply.

sentences.chinese: 这时，段先生接到了一个电话，他的脸色突然变了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, Duàn xiān sheng jiē dào le yí gè diàn huà, tā de liǎn sè tū rán biàn le.
sentences.english: Just then, Mr. Duan received a phone call, and his expression suddenly changed.

sentences.chinese: 他说，他在城市里有一个学生，那个学生现在正在听讲一个关于历史的讲座。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, tā zài chéng shì lǐ yǒu yí gè xué sheng, nà gè xué sheng xiàn zài zhèng zài tīng jiǎng yí gè guān yú lì shǐ de jiǎng zuò.
sentences.english: He said he had a student in the city who was currently attending a lecture on history.

sentences.chinese: 那个学生可能会知道更多关于地图的对话记录。
sentences.pinyin: Nà gè xué sheng kě néng huì zhī dào gèng duō guān yú dì tú de duì huà jì lù.
sentences.english: That student might know more about the conversation records regarding the map.

sentences.chinese: 段先生决定把这个秘密送给那个学生，让他帮忙寻找真相。
sentences.pinyin: Duàn xiān sheng jué dìng bǎ zhè gè mì mì sòng gěi nà gè xué sheng, ràng tā bāng máng xún zhǎo zhēn xiàng.
sentences.english: Mr. Duan decided to give this secret to that student and let him help find the truth.

sentences.chinese: 他开始给我们讲话，解释为什么这份地图如此重要。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kāi shǐ gěi wǒ men jiǎng huà, jiě shì wèi shén me zhè fèn dì tú rú cǐ zhòng yào.
sentences.english: He began to speak to us, explaining why this map was so important.

sentences.chinese: 我们在这个安静的夜晚，进行了一次深刻的对话。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men zài zhè gè ā jìng de yè wǎn, jìn xíng le yí cì shēn kè de duì huà.
sentences.english: On this quiet night, we had a profound conversation.

sentences.chinese: 但就在这时，窗外的黑车突然熄了火，司机走下了车。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài zhè shí, chuāng wài de hēi chē tū rán xī le huǒ, sī jī zǒu xià le chē.
sentences.english: But just then, the black car outside suddenly turned off its engine, and the driver stepped out.

sentences.chinese: 他手里拿着一个手电筒，光线正慢慢扫向我们的窗户。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shǒu lǐ ná zhe yí gè shǒu diàn tǒng, guāng xiàn zhèng màn màn sǎo xiàng wǒ men de chuāng hu.
sentences.english: He held a flashlight in his hand, and the beam of light was slowly scanning toward our window.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十八章：深夜的逃生计划

sentences.chinese: 手电筒的光线在窗户上移动，我们不敢出声。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒudiàntǒng de guāngxiàn zài chuānghu shàng yídòng, wǒmen bù gǎn chūshēng.
sentences.english: The flashlight beam moved across the window; we didn't dare make a sound.

sentences.chinese: 段先生低声说，现在的实际情况非常危险。
sentences.pinyin: Duàn xiānshēng dīshēng shuō, xiànzài de shíjì qíngkuàng fēicháng wēixiǎn.
sentences.english: Mr. Duan whispered that the actual situation was very dangerous.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我们，那个人在寻找地图的一部分。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒmen, nàge rén zài xúnzhǎo dìtú de yī bù fen.
sentences.english: He told us that the man was looking for a portion of the map.

sentences.chinese: 那个人的声音在外面响了起来，听起来很冷酷。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge rén de shēngyīn zài wàimiàn xiǎng le qǐlái, tīng qǐlái hěn lěngkù.
sentences.english: That person's voice echoed outside, sounding very cold.

sentences.chinese: 我们必须找一个办法尽快离开这里，保证安全。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū zhǎo yīgè bànfǎ jǐnkuài líkāi zhèlǐ, bǎozhèng ānquán.
sentences.english: We had to find a way to leave here quickly to ensure safety.

sentences.chinese: 段先生指了指后门，那里有一个小出口。
sentences.pinyin: Duàn xiānshēng zhǐ le zhǐ hòumén, nàlǐ yǒu yīgè xiǎo chūkǒu.
sentences.english: Mr. Duan pointed to the back door, where there was a small exit.

sentences.chinese: 他看着我，说我像个孩子，但现在必须像个大人一样勇敢。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kànzhe wǒ, shuō wǒ xiàng gè háizi, dàn xiànzài bìxū xiàng gè dàren yīyàng yǒnggǎn.
sentences.english: He looked at me and said I was like a child, but now I must be brave like an adult.

sentences.chinese: 我紧张地闭上嘴，不敢说话。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jǐnzhāng de bì shàng zuǐ, bù gǎn shuōhuà.
sentences.english: I nervously closed my mouth, not daring to speak.

sentences.chinese: 段先生拿出一张旧图片，上面画着这座房子的结构。
sentences.pinyin: Duàn xiānshēng ná chū yī zhāng jiù túpiàn, shàngmiàn huàzhe zhè zuò fángzi de jiégòu.
sentences.english: Mr. Duan took out an old picture showing the structure of the house.

sentences.chinese: 图片中心有一个红色的圆圈，那是秘密通道的名称。
sentences.pinyin: Túpiàn zhōngxīn yǒu yīgè hóngsè de yuánquān, nà shì mìmì tōngdào de míngchēng.
sentences.english: In the center of the picture was a red circle, which was the name of the secret passage.

sentences.chinese: 他说，这个通道在很多年前的一个周年纪念日被封住了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, zhège tōngdào zài hěnduō nián qián de yīgè zhōunián jìniànrì bèi fēng zhù le.
sentences.english: He said this passage had been sealed on an anniversary many years ago.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，在这个故事里，我不再是写小说的人，而是主角。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, zài zhège gùshì lǐ, wǒ bù zài shì xiě xiǎoshuō de rén, ér shì zhǔjué.
sentences.english: He told me that in this story, I was no longer the person writing a novel, but the protagonist.

sentences.chinese: 我们需要快速行动，不能让对方发现我们的位置。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào kuàisù xíngdòng, bùnéng ràng duìfāng fāxiàn wǒmen de wèizhi.
sentences.english: We needed to act fast and not let the other party discover our location.

sentences.chinese: 段先生说，逃跑的主要原因是我们掌握了太多的信息。
sentences.pinyin: Duàn xiānshēng shuō, táopǎo de zhǔyào yuányīn shì wǒmen zhǎngwò le tài duō de xìnxī.
sentences.english: Mr. Duan said the main reason for escaping was that we possessed too much information.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，在我的大学学期里，我学过很多地理知识，这很有用。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, zài wǒ de dàxué xuéqī lǐ, wǒ xuéguò hěnduō dìlǐ zhīshi, zhè hěn yǒuyòng.
sentences.english: He told me that during my college semester, I had learned a lot of geography, which was very useful.

sentences.chinese: 他举了一个例子，说地图上的符号就像数学的分数一样需要计算。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jǔ le yīgè lìzi, shuō dìtú shàng de fúhào jiù xiàng shùxué de fēnshù yīyàng xūyào jìsuàn.
sentences.english: He gave an example, saying the symbols on the map needed to be calculated like mathematical fractions.

sentences.chinese: 他说，生活并不总是公平的，但我们可以改变结果。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, shēnghuó bìng bù zǒngshì gōngpíng de, dàn wǒmen kěyǐ gǎibiàn jiéguǒ.
sentences.english: He said life isn't always fair, but we can change the outcome.

sentences.chinese: 我看着窗外，那个黑衣人的个子很高，像一座小山。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe chuāngwài, nàge hēiyīrén de gèzi hěn gāo, xiàng yī zuò xiǎo shān.
sentences.english: I looked out the window; the man in black was very tall in stature, like a small mountain.

sentences.chinese: 他头顶上的帽子遮住了脸，看起来一点也不可爱。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tóudǐng shàng de màozi zhē zhù le liǎn, kàn qǐlái yīdiǎn yě bù kě'ài.
sentences.english: The hat on top of his head covered his face, and he didn't look cute at all.

sentences.chinese: 段先生低声说，我们得习惯在这种压力下思考。
sentences.pinyin: Duàn xiānshēng dīshēng shuō, wǒmen děi xíguàn zài zhèzhǒng yālì xià sīkǎo.
sentences.english: Mr. Duan whispered that we had to get used to thinking under this kind of pressure.

sentences.chinese: 他提醒我，保持健康和体力在旅行中非常重要。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tíxǐng wǒ, bǎochí jiànkāng hé tǐlì zài lǚxíng zhōng fēicháng zhòngyào.
sentences.english: He reminded me that staying healthy and having stamina is very important during travel.

sentences.chinese: 这时，后院里传来了一声奇怪的声音，像是有什么东西在动。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, hòuyuàn lǐ chuánlái le yī shēng qíguài de shēngyīn, xiàng shì yǒu shéme dōngxi zài dòng.
sentences.english: Just then, a strange sound came from the backyard, as if something was moving.

sentences.chinese: 段先生说，这可能是对方的狗，或者某种小动物。
sentences.pinyin: Duàn xiānshēng shuō, zhè kěnéng shì duìfāng de gǒu, huòzhě mǒu zhǒng xiǎo dòngwù.
sentences.english: Mr. Duan said it might be the opponent's dog or some kind of small animal.

sentences.chinese: 他问我，在学校里，老师给你的作业通常是什么样的？
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn wǒ, zài xuéxiào lǐ, lǎoshī gěi nǐ de zuòyè tōngcháng shì shénme yàng de?
sentences.english: He asked me what the assignments given by teachers at school were usually like.

sentences.chinese: 我愣住了，不知道为什么他现在要问这种事情。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ lèng zhù le, bù zhīdào wèishéme tā xiànzài yào wèn zhèzhǒng shìqing.
sentences.english: I was stunned, not knowing why he wanted to ask about such a matter now.

sentences.chinese: 他笑了笑，说这只是为了让我放松心情。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiào le xiào, shuō zhè zhǐshì wèile ràng wǒ fàngsōng xīnqíng.
sentences.english: He smiled and said it was just to help me relax.

sentences.chinese: 我们悄悄走到了后门，那里有一块很大的木板，大小刚好能遮住我们。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen qiāoqiāo zǒu dào le hòumén, nàlǐ yǒu yī kuài hěn dà de mùbǎn, dàxiǎo gānghǎo néng zhē zhù wǒmen.
sentences.english: We quietly walked to the back door, where there was a large wooden board, the size of which was just enough to cover us.

sentences.chinese: 木板后面是一条通往大海的小路。
sentences.pinyin: Mùbǎn hòumiàn shì yī tiáo tōng wǎng dàhǎi de xiǎo lù.
sentences.english: Behind the board was a small path leading to the sea.

sentences.chinese: 我想起在凉州吃的中餐，那时候的生活多么简单。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngqǐ zài Liángzhōu chī de zhōngcān, nà shíhou de shēnghuó duōme jiǎndān.
sentences.english: I thought of the Chinese meals I ate in Liangzhou; how simple life was then.

sentences.chinese: 现在，我成了这个秘密计划中的一名成员。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài, wǒ chéng le zhège mìmì jìhuà zhōng de yī míng chéngyuán.
sentences.english: Now, I had become a member of this secret plan.

sentences.chinese: 我们终于走出了房子，但就在这时，身后传来了巨大的关门声。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zhōngyú zǒu chū le fángzi, dàn jiù zài zhèshí, shēnhòu chuánlái le jùdà de guānmén shēng.
sentences.english: We finally walked out of the house, but just then, a loud sound of a door closing came from behind us.

chapters.title_chinese: 第十九章：海边的秘密约定
chapters.title_english: Chapter 19: The Secret Agreement by the Sea

sentences.chinese: 巨大的关门声在我们身后响起，我的心里非常紧张。
sentences.pinyin: Jù dà de guān mén shēng zài wǒ men shēn hòu xiǎng qǐ, wǒ de xīn lǐ fēi cháng jǐn zhāng.
sentences.english: A loud slamming sound echoed behind us, and I felt very nervous in my heart.

sentences.chinese: 我们沿着那条小路快速奔跑，直到看到了大海。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men yán zhe nà tiáo xiǎo lù kuài sù bēn pǎo, zhí dào kàn dào le dà hǎi.
sentences.english: We ran quickly along that small path until we saw the sea.

sentences.chinese: 海边的气很新鲜，让我稍微感觉舒服了一点。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎi biān de qì hěn xīn xiān, ràng wǒ shāo wēi gǎn jué shū fú le yī diǎn.
sentences.english: The air by the sea was very fresh, making me feel a little more comfortable.

sentences.chinese: 向导停下来，看着远方的星星，他的样子显得很疲惫。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo tíng xià lái, kàn zhe yuǎn fāng de xīng xing, tā de yàng zi xiǎn de hěn pí bèi.
sentences.english: The guide stopped and looked at the distant stars; he looked very exhausted.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，这次旅行对我来说是一个学习的机会。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ, zhè cì lǚ xíng duì wǒ lái shuō shì yī gè xué xí de jī huì.
sentences.english: He told me that this journey was an opportunity for me to learn.

sentences.chinese: 他认为我在很多方面都进步了，尤其是勇敢的程度。
sentences.pinyin: Tā rèn wéi wǒ zài hěn duō fāng miàn dōu jìn bù le, yóu qí shì yǒng gǎn de chéng dù.
sentences.english: He believed I had made progress in many aspects, especially in my degree of courage.

sentences.chinese: 我心中充满了感激，我对他低声说：“非常感谢你的帮助。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xīn zhōng chōng mǎn le gǎn jī, wǒ duì tā dī shēng shuō: “Fēi cháng gǎn xiè nǐ de bāng zhù.”
sentences.english: My heart was filled with gratitude, and I whispered to him, "Thank you very much for your help."

sentences.chinese: 他笑了笑，说在寻找地图的路上，每个人都是平等的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiào le xiào, shuō zài xún zhǎo dì tú de lù shàng, měi gè rén dōu shì píng děng de.
sentences.english: He smiled and said that on the road to finding the map, everyone is equal.

sentences.chinese: 这时候，我们遇到了一位住在海边小屋的少年。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí hou, wǒ men yù dào le yī wèi zhù zài hǎi biān xiǎo wū de shào nián.
sentences.english: At this moment, we met a youth living in a seaside cottage.

sentences.chinese: 这个少年看起来像是个高中生，大概在十一年级。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè gè shào nián kàn qǐ lái xiàng shì gè gāo zhōng shēng, dà gài zài shí yī nián jí.
sentences.english: This youth looked like a high school student, probably in the eleventh grade.

sentences.chinese: 他手里拿着一份旧报纸，上面有一些奇怪的数字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shǒu lǐ ná zhe yī fèn jiù bào zhǐ, shàng miàn yǒu yī xiē qí guài de shù zì.
sentences.english: He was holding an old newspaper with some strange numbers on it.

sentences.chinese: 向导看着那些数字，眼神突然变得很急。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo kàn zhe nà xiē shù zì, yǎn shén tū rán biàn de hěn jí.
sentences.english: The guide looked at those numbers, and his gaze suddenly became urgent.

sentences.chinese: 他说，这些数字代表了地图第二部分的具体方向。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, zhè xiē shù zì dài biǎo le dì tú dì èr bù fèn de jù tǐ fāng xiàng.
sentences.english: He said these numbers represented the specific direction of the second part of the map.

sentences.chinese: 少年告诉我们，他曾经想成为一名电影明星，经常看各种影片。
sentences.pinyin: Shào nián gào sù wǒ men, tā céng jīng xiǎng chéng wéi yī míng diàn yǐng míng xīng, jīng cháng kàn gè zhǒng yǐng piàn.
sentences.english: The youth told us that he once wanted to be a movie star and often watched various films.

sentences.chinese: 他觉得生活在小镇上的日子太无聊，所以想找点有意思的事情做。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jué de shēng huó zài xiǎo zhèn shàng de rì zi tài wú liáo, suǒ yǐ xiǎng zhǎo diǎn yǒu yì si de shì qing zuò.
sentences.english: He felt the days of living in the small town were too boring, so he wanted to find something interesting to do.

sentences.chinese: 少年对我们的态度很友好，他邀请我们去他家吃晚餐。
sentences.pinyin: Shào nián duì wǒ men de tài du hào hěn yǒu hǎo, tā yāo qǐng wǒ men qù tā jiā chī wǎn cān.
sentences.english: The youth's attitude toward us was very friendly, and he invited us to his home for dinner.

sentences.chinese: 因为时间太晚，我们只能简单地吃了一些快餐。
sentences.pinyin: Yīn wèi shí jiān tài wǎn, wǒ men zhǐ néng jiǎn dān de chī le yī xiē kuài cān.
sentences.english: Because it was too late, we could only eat some simple fast food.

sentences.chinese: 在吃饭时，少年分享了他的看法，他给了我们一些很有用的意见。
sentences.pinyin: Zài chī fàn shí, shào nián fēn xiǎng le tā de kàn fǎ, tā gěi le wǒ men yī xiē hěn yǒu yòng de yì jiàn.
sentences.english: While eating, the youth shared his views and gave us some very useful suggestions.

sentences.chinese: 他说，想要找到秘密，必须用一种特别的方法。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, xiǎng yào zhǎo dào mì mì, bì xū yòng yī zhǒng tè bié de fāng fǎ.
sentences.english: He said that to find the secret, one must use a special method.

sentences.chinese: 他认为我的中文水平很高，能够读懂地图上的古文字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā rèn wéi wǒ de zhōng wén shuǐ píng hěn gāo, néng gòu dú dǒng dì tú shàng de gǔ wén zì.
sentences.english: He believed my Chinese level was very high and that I could understand the ancient characters on the map.

sentences.chinese: 向导点头同意，说只有具备这种才的人才能完成任务。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo diǎn tóu tóng yì, shuō zhǐ yǒu jù bèi zhè zhǒng cái de rén cái néng wán chéng rèn wu.
sentences.english: The guide nodded in agreement, saying that only a person with such talent could complete the mission.

sentences.chinese: 我听到这话，心情突然变得很好。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tīng dào zhè huà, xīn qíng tū rán biàn de hěn hǎo.
sentences.english: Hearing this, my mood suddenly became very good.

sentences.chinese: 我问他，这些文字的意思是什么。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā, zhè xiē wén zì de yì si shì shén me.
sentences.english: I asked him what the meaning of these characters was.

sentences.chinese: 少年指着报纸说，这就像学校里的成绩单一样，需要仔细分析。
sentences.pinyin: Shào nián zhǐ zhe bào zhǐ shuō, zhè jiù xiàng xué xiào lǐ de chéng jì dān yī yàng, xū yào zǐ xì fēn xī.
sentences.english: The youth pointed to the newspaper and said it was like a school report card; it required careful analysis.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，远处传来了“当”的一声，像是某种巨大的钟声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, yuǎn chù chuán lái le “dāng” de yī shēng, xiàng shì mǒu zhǒng jù dà de zhōng shēng.
sentences.english: Just then, a "dong" sound came from the distance, like some kind of huge bell.

sentences.chinese: 我们意识到，敌人的搜寻范围已经扩大了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men yì shí dào, dí rén de sōu xún fàn wéi yǐ jīng kuò dà le.
sentences.english: We realized that the enemy's search area had already expanded.

sentences.chinese: 我们必须立刻决定接下来的行动计划。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men bì xū lì kè jué dìng jiē xià lái de xíng dòng jì huà.
sentences.english: We had to immediately decide on the next course of action.

sentences.chinese: 少年看着我们，眼神里充满了好奇。
sentences.pinyin: Shào nián kàn zhe wǒ men, yǎn shén lǐ chōng mǎn le hào qí.
sentences.english: The youth looked at us, his eyes full of curiosity.

sentences.chinese: 他问我们是否愿意让他加入这个危险的计划。
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn wǒ men shì fǒu yuàn yì ràng tā jiā rù zhè gè wēi xiǎn de jì huà.
sentences.english: He asked if we were willing to let him join this dangerous plan.

sentences.chinese: 向导犹豫了，因为这可能会给少年带来麻烦。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo yóu yù le, yīn wèi zhè kě néng huì gěi shào nián dài lái má fan.
sentences.english: The guide hesitated because this might bring trouble to the youth.

sentences.chinese: 但我感觉这个少年能帮到我们。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ gǎn jué zhè gè shào nián néng bāng dào wǒ men.
sentences.english: But I felt that this youth could help us.

sentences.chinese: 我们决定带他一起走，向着大海深处出发。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men jué dìng dài tā yī qǐ zǒu, xiàng zhe dà hǎi shēn chù chū fā.
sentences.english: We decided to take him with us and set off toward the depths of the sea.

sentences.chinese: 然而，就在我们准备离开时，海滩上出现了一个熟悉的身影。
sentences.pinyin: Rán ér, jiù zài wǒ men zhǔn bèi lí kāi shí, hǎi tān shàng chū xiàn le yī gè shú xī de shēn yǐng.
sentences.english: However, just as we were preparing to leave, a familiar figure appeared on the beach.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十章：海边的旧画室
chapters.title_english: Chapter 20: The Old Studio by the Sea

sentences.chinese: 海滩上的那个身影是之前的出租车司机，他的眼神依然很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎitān shàng de nàge shēnyǐng shì zhīqián de chūzūchē sījī, tā de yǎnshén yīrán hěn qíguài.
sentences.english: The figure on the beach was the previous taxi driver, and his gaze was still very strange.

sentences.chinese: 向导低声说，我们的目的现在必须改变，因为敌人离我们太近了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo dīshēng shuō, wǒmen de mùdì xiànzài bìxū gǎibiàn, yīnwèi dírén lí wǒmen tài jìn le.
sentences.english: The guide whispered that our purpose must change now because the enemy is too close to us.

sentences.chinese: 为了安全，我们决定先去海边的一座旧房子里躲起来。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile ānquán, wǒmen juédìng xiān qù hǎibiān de yī zuò jiù fángzi lǐ duǒ qǐlái.
sentences.english: For safety, we decided to first hide in an old house by the sea.

sentences.chinese: 那座房子非常漂亮，周围的空气也很新鲜。
sentences.pinyin: Nà zuò fángzi fēicháng piàoliang, zhōuwéi de kōngqì yě hěn xīnxiān.
sentences.english: That house was very beautiful, and the surrounding air was very fresh.

sentences.chinese: 走进房子，我看到墙上挂着很多红色的画儿。
sentences.pinyin: Zǒujìn fángzi, wǒ kàndào qiáng shàng guàzhe hěnduō hóngsè de huàr.
sentences.english: Walking into the house, I saw many red paintings hanging on the wall.

sentences.chinese: 这些画儿的特点是颜色非常亮，看起来像是在讲一个关于爱情的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē huàr de tèdiǎn shì yánsè fēicháng liàng, kàn qǐlái xiàng shì zài jiǎng yīgè guānyú àiqíng de gùshì.
sentences.english: The characteristic of these paintings was that the colors were very bright, looking like they were telling a story about romance.

sentences.chinese: 房间的角落里有一盏旧灯，灯光照在桌子上的一个瓶子上。
sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān de jiǎoluò lǐ yǒu yī zhǎn jiù dēng, dēngguāng zhào zài zhuōzi shàng de yīgè píngzi shàng.
sentences.english: In the corner of the room, there was an old lamp, and the light shone on a bottle on the table.

sentences.chinese: 桌上还有一支笔，和一张写着科学知识的纸片。
sentences.pinyin: Zhuō shàng hái yǒu yī zhī bǐ, hé yī zhāng xiězhe kēxué zhīshì de zhǐpiàn.
sentences.english: On the table, there was also a pen and a piece of paper written with scientific knowledge.

sentences.chinese: 向导告诉我，这些东西属于一个研究生物科的教授。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo gàosù wǒ, zhèxiē dōngxī shǔyú yīgè yánjiū shēngwù kē de jiàoshòu.
sentences.english: The guide told me that these things belonged to a professor of the biology department.

sentences.chinese: 教授在老年时期喜欢在这里生活，寻找自由的感觉。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshòu zài lǎonián shíqī xǐhuān zài zhèlǐ shēnghuó, xúnzhǎo zìyóu de gǎnjué.
sentences.english: The professor liked to live here in his old age, seeking a feeling of freedom.

sentences.chinese: 我拿起一张照片，照片里的教授正对着镜头微笑。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ ná qǐ yī zhāng zhàopiàn, zhàopiàn lǐ de jiàoshòu zhèng duìzhe jìngtóu wēixiào.
sentences.english: I picked up a photograph; the professor in the photo was smiling at the camera.

sentences.chinese: 向导说，教授的理想是把地图的秘密用科学的方法记录下来。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo shuō, jiàoshòu de lǐxiǎng shì bǎ dìtú de mìmì yòng kēxué de fāngfǎ jìlù xiàlái.
sentences.english: The guide said the professor's ideal was to record the secrets of the map using scientific methods.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，我的手机收到了一条短信，是那个神秘人的警告。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, wǒ de shǒujī shōudào le yī tiáo duǎnxìn, shì nàge shénmì rén de jǐnggào.
sentences.english: Just then, my phone received a text message, a warning from that mysterious person.

sentences.chinese: 我把短信给向导看，他皱起眉头，思考着对方的行为。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ duǎnxìn gěi xiàngdǎo kàn, tā zhòu qǐ méitóu, sīkǎozhe duìfāng de xíngwéi.
sentences.english: I showed the text to the guide, and he frowned, thinking about the other party's behavior.

sentences.chinese: 他认为从不同的角度看，这个警告可能是一个陷阱。
sentences.pinyin: Tā rènwéi cóng bùtóng de jiǎodù kàn, zhège jǐnggào kěnéng shì yīgè xiànjǐng.
sentences.english: He believed that from a different angle, this warning might be a trap.

sentences.chinese: 我对这个观点有不同的看法，我觉得对方是在帮我们。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ duì zhège guāndiǎn yǒu bùtóng de kànfǎ, wǒ juédé duìfāng shì zài bāng wǒmen.
sentences.english: I had a different view on this standpoint; I felt the other party was helping us.

sentences.chinese: 我们讨论了很久，试图从不同的角度分析这个计划。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen tǎolùn le hěnjiǔ, shìtú cóng bùtóng de jiǎodù fēnxī zhège jìhuà.
sentences.english: We discussed for a long time, trying to analyze this plan from different angles.

sentences.chinese: 突然，少年指着地板说，这里太脏了，有很多油渍。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, shàonián zhǐzhe dìbǎn shuō, zhèlǐ tài zàng le, yǒu hěnduō yóuzì.
sentences.english: Suddenly, the youth pointed to the floor and said it was too dirty, with many oil stains.

sentences.chinese: 我低头看，发现油渍的形状像是一个脚印，指向地下室。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dītóu kàn, fāxiàn yóuzì de xíngzhuàng xiàng shì yīgè jiǎoyìn, zhǐxiàng dìxiàshì.
sentences.english: I looked down and found that the shape of the oil stain looked like a footprint, pointing toward the basement.

sentences.chinese: 我们小心地走下去，发现地下室里有一个像节日一样热闹的布置。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiǎoxīn de zǒu xiàqù, fāxiàn dìxiàshì lǐ yǒu yīgè xiàng jiérì yīyàng rènào de bùzhì.
sentences.english: We walked down carefully and found that the basement had a festive arrangement, like a holiday.

sentences.chinese: 那里有很多庆祝节日的礼物，还有一个旧的电视机在播放节目。
sentences.pinyin: Nàlǐ yǒu hěnduō zhìqìng jiérì de lǐwù, hái yǒu yīgè jiù de diànshìjī zài bōfàng jiémù.
sentences.english: There were many gifts for celebrating holidays, and an old television was playing a program.

sentences.chinese: 向导说，教授可能把地图的第二部分藏在这些东西中间。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo shuō, jiàoshòu kěnéng bǎ dìtú de dì èr bùfèn cáng zài zhèxiē dōngxī zhōngjiān.
sentences.english: The guide said the professor might have hidden the second part of the map among these things.

sentences.chinese: 我感觉到教授是一个非常热情的人，他把生活变成了艺术。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gǎnjué dào jiàoshòu shì yīgè fēicháng rèqíng de rén, tā bǎ shēnghuó biànchéng le yìshù.
sentences.english: I felt the professor was a very enthusiastic person who turned life into art.

sentences.chinese: 我的眼光在房间里扫视，试图找到那个关键的线索。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de yǎn guāng zài fángjiān lǐ sǎoshì, shìtú zhǎodào nàge guānjiàn de xiànsuǒ.
sentences.english: My eyes scanned the room, trying to find that key clue.

sentences.chinese: 我们知道，现在的每一个级别决定了我们能否成功逃脱。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zhīdào, xiànzài de měi yīgè jíbié juédìng le wǒmen néng fǒu chénggōng táotuō.
sentences.english: We knew that every level now decided whether we could successfully escape.

sentences.chinese: 在这个充满秘密的房间里，我们重新制定了接下来的计划。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège chōngmǎn mìmì de fángjiān lǐ, wǒmen chóngxīn zhìdìng le jiē xiàlái de jìhuà.
sentences.english: In this room full of secrets, we redesigned the plan for what comes next.

sentences.chinese: 但就在我们准备离开时，地下室的门突然被关上了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn jiù zài wǒmen zhǔnbèi líkāi shí, dìxiàshì de mén tūrán bèi guān shàng le.
sentences.english: But just as we were preparing to leave, the basement door was suddenly closed.

sentences.chinese: 外面传来了沉重的脚步声，有人在敲门。
sentences.pinyin: Wàimiàn chuánlái le chénzhòng de jiǎobùshēng, yǒurén zài qiāomén.
sentences.english: Heavy footsteps were heard outside, and someone was knocking on the door.

sentences.chinese: 那个声音低沉而冰冷，听起来像是那个司机的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge shēngyīn dīchén ér bīnglěng, tīng qǐlái xiàng shì nàge sījī de shēngyīn.
