sentences.english: The voice was low and cold, sounding like that driver's voice.

sentences.chinese: 我们被困在了这个漂亮的画室里，没有出口。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen bèi kùn zài le zhège piàoliang de huàshì lǐ, méiyǒu chūkǒu.
sentences.english: We were trapped in this beautiful studio with no exit.

sentences.chinese: 这时，我发现墙上的画儿后面有一个小洞，里面藏着一样东西。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shí, wǒ fāxiàn qiáng shàng de huàr hòumiàn yǒu yīgè xiǎo dòng, lǐmiàn cángzhe yīyàng dōngxī.
sentences.english: At this moment, I discovered a small hole behind the painting on the wall, with something hidden inside.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十一章：画室里的秘密包裹
chapters.title_english: Chapter 21: The Secret Package in the Studio

sentences.chinese: 我把手伸进那个小洞，拿出了一个旧袋子。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ shǒu shēn jìn nà gè xiǎo dòng, ná chū le yī gè jiù dài zi.
sentences.english: I reached my hand into the small hole and pulled out an old bag.

sentences.chinese: 袋子里面有很多奇怪的东西。
sentences.pinyin: Dài zi lǐ miàn yǒu hěn duō qí guài de dōng xi.
sentences.english: There were many strange things inside the bag.

sentences.chinese: 我看到了一张旧信用卡，还有一本红色的护照。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào le yī zhāng jiù xìn yòng kǎ, hái yǒu yī běn hóng sè de hù zhào.
sentences.english: I saw an old credit card and a red passport.

sentences.chinese: 向导看着我的手表，低声说：“我们没有时间了。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo kàn zhe wǒ de shǒu biǎo, dī shēng shuō: “Wǒ men méi yǒu shí jiān le.”
sentences.english: The guide looked at my wristwatch and whispered, "We have no more time."

sentences.chinese: 在这个关键的节骨眼上，我们必须快点离开。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè gè guān jiàn de jié gǔ yǎn shàng, wǒ men bì xū kuài diǎn lí kāi.
sentences.english: At this critical juncture, we must leave quickly.

sentences.chinese: 袋子里还有一个小瓶子，里面有两颗白色的药片。
sentences.pinyin: Dài zi lǐ hái yǒu yī gè xiǎo píng zi, lǐ miàn yǒu liǎng kē bái sè de yào piàn.
sentences.english: There was also a small bottle in the bag with two white medicine pills inside.

sentences.chinese: 我不知道这些药片是做什么用的，但我把它们放进了口袋。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhī dào zhè xiē yào piàn shì zuò shén me yòng de, dàn wǒ bǎ tā men fàng jìn le kǒu dài.
sentences.english: I didn't know what these pills were for, but I put them in my pocket.

sentences.chinese: 我发现袋子里还有一副筷子和一盒方便面。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ fā xiàn dài zi lǐ hái yǒu yī fù kuài zi hé yī hé fāng biàn miàn.
sentences.english: I discovered there were also a pair of chopsticks and a box of instant noodles in the bag.

sentences.chinese: 这看起来像是某个旅行者留下的生活用品。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè kàn qǐ lái xiàng shì mǒu gè lǚ xíng zhě liú xià de shēng huó yòng pǐn.
sentences.english: This looked like daily necessities left behind by some traveler.

sentences.chinese: 在袋子的底部，我看到了一双白色的球鞋。
sentences.pinyin: Zài dài zi de dǐ bù, wǒ kàn dào le yī shuāng bái sè de qiú xié.
sentences.english: At the bottom of the bag, I saw a pair of white athletic shoes.

sentences.chinese: 虽然这双鞋太小，但我还是把它拿了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Suī rán zhè shuāng xié tài xiǎo, dàn wǒ hái shì bǎ tā ná le qǐ lái.
sentences.english: Although these shoes were too small, I still picked them up.

sentences.chinese: 我突然想起，我长大以后也想成为一名旅行家。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tū rán xiǎng qǐ, wǒ zhǎng dà yǐ hòu yě xiǎng chéng wéi yī míng lǚ xíng jiā.
sentences.english: I suddenly remembered that I wanted to become a traveler when I grew up.

sentences.chinese: 向导指着墙上的一个黑板，上面写着一个名字：“周先生”。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàng dǎo zhǐ zhe qiáng shàng de yī gè hēi bǎn, shàng miàn xiě zhe yī gè míng zi: “Zhōu xiān sheng”.
sentences.english: The guide pointed to a blackboard on the wall, on which a name was written: "Mr. Zhou".

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，周先生曾经在这个画室里教学生。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gào sù wǒ, Zhōu xiān sheng céng jīng zài zhè gè huà shì lǐ jiāo xué shēng.
sentences.english: He told me that Mr. Zhou used to teach students in this studio.

sentences.chinese: 黑板旁边放着一个篮球和一个排球。
sentences.pinyin: Hēi bǎn páng biān fàng zhe yī gè lán qiú hé yī gè pái qiú.
sentences.english: Next to the blackboard were a basketball and a volleyball.

sentences.chinese: 这里以前可能是一个体育教室，后来变成了画室。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lǐ yǐ qián kě néng shì yī gè tǐ yù jiào shì, hòu lái biàn chéng le huà shì.
sentences.english: This place might have been a sports classroom before it became a studio.

sentences.chinese: 我们听到门外的人在喊，声音越来越近。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men tīng dào mén wài de rén zài hǎn, shēng yīn yuè lái yuè jìn.
sentences.english: We heard the people outside shouting, their voices getting closer and closer.

sentences.chinese: 我们必须选一个最安全的出口离开这里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men bì xū xuǎn yī gè zuì ān quán de chū kǒu lí kāi zhè lǐ.
sentences.english: We must choose the safest exit to leave this place.

sentences.chinese: 我换上了舒适的鞋，准备好奔跑。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ huàn shàng le shū shì de xié, zhǔn bèi hǎo bēn pǎo.
sentences.english: I put on comfortable shoes and prepared to run.

sentences.chinese: 我们从地下室的窗户爬出去，跑向两公里外的地铁站。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ men cóng dì xià shì de chuāng hu pá chū qù, pǎo xiàng liǎng gōng lǐ wài de dì tiě zhàn.
sentences.english: We climbed out of the basement window and ran toward the subway station two kilometers away.

sentences.chinese: 就在我们跑的时候，我突然听到窗外传来了大门乐队的音乐声。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài wǒ men pǎo de shí hòu, wǒ tū rán tīng dào chuāng wài chuán lái le Dà mén yuè duì de yīn yuè shēng.
sentences.english: Just as we were running, I suddenly heard the music of the band The Doors coming from outside the window.

sentences.chinese: 那是司机的车里在播放音乐，他就在我们身后！
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì sī jī de chē lǐ zài bō fàng yīn yuè, tā jiù zài wǒ men shēn hòu!
sentences.english: That was the music playing in the driver's car; he was right behind us!

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十二章：地铁站的掩护
chapters.title_english: Chapter 22: Cover at the Metro Station

sentences.chinese: 我们拼命跑向地铁站，心跳越来越快。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen pīnmìng pǎo xiàng dìtiězhàn, xīntiào yuè lái yuè kuài.
sentences.english: We ran desperately toward the metro station, our hearts beating faster and faster.

sentences.chinese: 天空是多云的，灰色的云遮住了太阳。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānkōng shì duōyún de, huīsè de yún zhēzhù le tàiyáng.
sentences.english: The sky was cloudy, with gray clouds covering the sun.

sentences.chinese: 当我们进入车站时，发现这里有许多人们在走动。
sentences.pinyin: Dāng wǒmen jìnrù chēzhàn shí, fāxiàn zhèlǐ yǒu xǔduō rénmen zài zǒudòng.
sentences.english: When we entered the station, we found many people moving around.

sentences.chinese: 这里的人数非常多，因为现在是上下班时间。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de rénshù fēicháng duō, yīnwèi xiànzài shì shàng xià bān shíjiān.
sentences.english: The number of people here was very large because it was rush hour.

sentences.chinese: 在这个大城市，人口有几亿，所以我们很容易在这里消失。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège dà chéngshì, rénkǒu yǒu jǐ yì, suǒyǐ wǒmen hěn róngyì zài zhèlǐ xiāoshī.
sentences.english: In this big city, the population is several hundred million, so it is easy for us to disappear here.

sentences.chinese: 我看到不少人在看手机，没有人注意到我们。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàndào bùshǎo rén zài kàn shǒujī, méiyǒu rén zhùyì dào wǒmen.
sentences.english: I saw quite a few people looking at their phones; no one noticed us.

sentences.chinese: 大多数人都在匆忙地走，只有少数人在慢悠悠地聊天。
sentences.pinyin: Dàduōshù rén dōu zài cōngmáng de zǒu, zhǐyǒu shǎoshù rén zài mànyōuyōu de liáotiān.
sentences.english: The great majority of people were walking hurriedly, and only a few were chatting leisurely.

sentences.chinese: 向导低声说，我们要进入人群，让司机找不到我们。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo dīshēng shuō, wǒmen yào jìnrù rénqún, ràng sījī zhǎo bù dào wǒmen.
sentences.english: The guide whispered that we should blend into the crowd so the driver couldn't find us.

sentences.chinese: 大部分的乘客都穿着黑色的衣服，这大大地帮助了我们的掩护。
sentences.pinyin: Dàbùfen de chéngkè dōu chuānzhe hēisè de yīfú, zhè dàdà de bāngzhù le wǒmen de yǎnhù.
sentences.english: Most of the passengers were wearing black clothes, which greatly helped our cover.

sentences.chinese: 突然，有人在大声地说话，我吓了一跳，以为是那个司机。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, yǒurén zài dàshēng de shuōhuà, wǒ xià le yī tiào, yǐwéi shì nàge sījī.
sentences.english: Suddenly, someone spoke in a loud voice, and I jumped, thinking it was that driver.

sentences.chinese: 但我回头看，那只是一个在和全家说话的游客。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ huítóu kàn, nà zhǐshì yīgè zài hé quánjiā shuōhuà de yóukè.
sentences.english: But I looked back and saw it was just a tourist talking to their whole family.

sentences.chinese: 那个游客说话很流利，听起来像是一个满族人。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge yóukè shuōhuà hěn liúlì, tīng qǐlái xiàng shì yīgè Mǎnzú rén.
sentences.english: That tourist spoke fluently and sounded like a Manchu person.

sentences.chinese: 在这个国家，多数的人都说普通话，但有些地方有不同的语言。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège guójiā, duōshù de rén dōu shuō pǔtōnghuà, dàn yǒuxiē dìfāng yǒu bùtóng de yǔyán.
sentences.english: In this country, the majority of people speak Mandarin, but some places have different languages.

sentences.chinese: 大家都在排队买票，队伍里有大量的人在等待。
sentences.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zài páiduì mǎi piào, duìwǔ lǐ yǒu dàliàng de rén zài děngdài.
sentences.english: Everyone was lining up to buy tickets, and there was a large quantity of people waiting in line.

sentences.chinese: 我发现好多人都在看着地铁的屏幕。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ fāxiàn hǎoduō rén dōu zài kànzhe dìtiě de píngmù.
sentences.english: I noticed quite a lot of people were looking at the metro screens.

sentences.chinese: 虽然我们现在很安全，但我知道敌人还没有放弃。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen xiànzài hěn ānjuán, dàn wǒ zhīdào dírén hái méiyǒu fàngqì.
sentences.english: Although we are safe for now, I know the enemy has not given up.

sentences.chinese: 我们必须快点离开，因为那个司机的车还在外面转圈。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū kuài diǎn líkāi, yīnwèi nàge sījī de chē hái zài wàimiàn zhuànquān.
sentences.english: We must leave quickly because the driver's car is still circling outside.

sentences.chinese: 我们买了两张票，准备去下一个秘密地点。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen mǎi le liǎng zhāng piào, zhǔnbèi qù xià yīgè mìmì dìdiǎn.
sentences.english: We bought two tickets and prepared to go to the next secret location.

sentences.chinese: 就在车门即将关闭的时候，我突然在人群中看到了一个熟悉的黑色身影。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài chēmén jíjiāng guānbì de shíhòu, wǒ tūrán zài rénqún zhōng kàndào le yīgè shúxī de hēisè shēnyǐng.
sentences.english: Just as the train doors were about to close, I suddenly saw a familiar black figure in the crowd.

sentences.chinese: 那个身影正盯着我们，眼神里充满了杀气。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge shēnyǐng zhèng dīngzhe wǒmen, yǎnshén lǐ chōngmǎn le shāqì.
sentences.english: That figure was staring at us, eyes full of murderous intent.

sentences.chinese: 他怎么可能这么快就进到车站里来的？
sentences.pinyin: Tā zěnme kěnéng zhème kuài jiù jìn dào chēzhàn lǐ lái de?
sentences.english: How could he have entered the station so quickly?

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十三章：地铁里的追逐

sentences.chinese: 我看着那个黑色的身影，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe nàge hēisè de shēnyǐng, xīntiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: I looked at that black figure, my heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 向导拉住我的手，低声说：“快走，不要回头！”
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo lāzhù wǒ de shǒu, dīshēng shuō: “Kuài zǒu, bùyào huítóu!”
sentences.english: The guide grabbed my hand and whispered, "Go quickly, don't look back!"

sentences.chinese: 我们赶紧走进车厢，车门终于关上了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen gǎnjǐn zǒujìn chēxiāng, chēmén zhōngyú guānshàng le.
sentences.english: We hurried into the carriage, and the doors finally closed.

sentences.chinese: 我看着窗外，那个司机还在车站里，他好像在寻找我们。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe chuāngwài, nàge sījī hái zài chēzhàn lǐ, tā hǎoxiàng zài xúnzhǎo wǒmen.
sentences.english: I looked out the window; the driver was still in the station, and he seemed to be searching for us.

sentences.chinese: 我问向导：“为什么他能这么快找到我们？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn xiàngdǎo: “Wèishénme tā néng zhème kuài zhǎodào wǒmen?”
sentences.english: I asked the guide, "Why was he able to find us so quickly?"

sentences.chinese: 向导叹了一口气，说：“因为他不但知道我们的计划，而且知道所有的路线。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo tànle yī kǒuqì, shuō: “Yīnwèi tā bùdàn zhīdào wǒmen de jìhuà, érqiě zhīdào suǒyǒu de lùxiàn.”
sentences.english: The guide sighed and said, "Because he not only knows our plan, but also knows all the routes."

sentences.chinese: 我感到很害怕，因为这次旅行太危险了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gǎndào hěn hàipà, yīnwèi zhè cì lǚxíng tài wēixiǎn le.
sentences.english: I felt very scared because this trip was too dangerous.

sentences.chinese: 向导告诉我，今后我们要更加小心。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo gàosù wǒ, jīnhòu wǒmen yào gèngjiā xiǎoxīn.
sentences.english: The guide told me that henceforth we must be more careful.

sentences.chinese: 他说，如果对方有更多的助手，我们的处境会更糟糕。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, rúguǒ duìfāng yǒu gèng duō de zhùshǒu, wǒmen de chǔjìng huì gèng zāogāo.
sentences.english: He said that if the other side had more assistants, our situation would be even worse.

sentences.chinese: 我问他，那个司机是什么样的人？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā, nàge sījī shì shénmeyàng de rén?
sentences.english: I asked him what kind of person that driver was.

sentences.chinese: 向导说，他原来是一个专业的特工，所以他很聪明。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo shuō, tā yuánlái shì yīgè zhuānyè de tègōng, suǒyǐ tā hěn cōngmíng.
sentences.english: The guide said that he was originally a professional agent, so he was very clever.

sentences.chinese: 不过，他只在乎那张地图，并不在乎我们。
sentences.pinyin: Bùguò, tā zhǐ zàihū nà zhāng dìtú, bìng bù zàihū wǒmen.
sentences.english: However, he only cares about that map and does not care about us.

sentences.chinese: 我看着窗外的景色，感觉这里和凉州完全不同。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe chuāngwài de jǐngsè, gǎnjué zhèlǐ hé Liángzhōu wánquán bùtóng.
sentences.english: I looked at the scenery outside the window and felt that this place was completely different from Liangzhou.

sentences.chinese: 在凉州，生活是那么简单，而在这里，每一步都像是在冒险。
sentences.pinyin: Zài Liángzhōu, shēnghuó shì nàme jiǎndān, ér zài zhèlǐ, měi yī bù dōu xiàng shì zài màoxiǎn.
sentences.english: In Liangzhou, life was so simple, while here, every step felt like an adventure.

sentences.chinese: 向导说，我们要去的地方在两公里以外。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo shuō, wǒmen yào qù de dìfāng zài liǎng gōnglǐ yǐwài.
sentences.english: The guide said the place we were going to was more than two kilometers away.

sentences.chinese: 他说，只要我们能到达那里，就可以暂时安全。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, zhǐyào wǒmen néng dàodá nàlǐ, jiù kěyǐ zànshí ānquán.
sentences.english: He said as long as we could reach there, we could be temporarily safe.

sentences.chinese: 可是，我心里的不安并没有消失。
sentences.pinyin: Kěshì, wǒ xīnlǐ de bù'ān bìng méiyǒu xiāoshī.
sentences.english: But the unease in my heart did not disappear.

sentences.chinese: 我想，也许他现在已经在买下一班车的票了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng, yěxǔ tā xiànzài yǐjīng zài mǎi xià yī bān chē de piào le.
sentences.english: I thought perhaps he was already buying a ticket for the next train.

sentences.chinese: 他可能通过其他方式追踪我们，例如利用车站的监控摄像头。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kěnéng tōngguò qítā fāngshì zhuīzōng wǒmen, lìrú lìyòng chēzhàn de jiānkòng shèxiàng.
sentences.english: He might be tracking us through other means, for example, by using the station's surveillance cameras.

sentences.chinese: 在所有的追踪方法中，其中最可怕的就是他能预判我们的方向。
sentences.pinyin: Zài suǒyǒu de zhuīzōng fāngfǎ zhōng, qízhōng zuì kěpà de jiùshì tā néng yùpàn wǒmen de fāngxiàng.
sentences.english: Among all the tracking methods, the most terrifying is that he can predict our direction.

sentences.chinese: 向导看着我，问我感觉怎么样。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo kànzhe wǒ, wèn wǒ gǎnjué zěnmeyàng.
sentences.english: The guide looked at me and asked me how I was feeling.

sentences.chinese: 我告诉他，我多么希望这一切快点结束。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gàosù tā, wǒ duōme xīwàng zhè yīqiè kuàidiǎn jiéshù.
sentences.english: I told him how much I hoped all of this would end quickly.

sentences.chinese: 他笑了笑，说：“但这也是一种成长，你会变得更勇敢。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàole xiào, shuō: “Dàn zhè yěshì yī zhǒng chéngzhǎng, nǐ huì biàndé gèng yǒnggǎn.”
sentences.english: He smiled and said, "But this is also a kind of growth; you will become braver."

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，以后我们要学习如何隐藏自己的行踪。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, yǐhòu wǒmen yào xuéxí rúhé yǐncáng zìjǐ de xíngzōng.
sentences.english: He told me that later we must learn how to hide our tracks.

sentences.chinese: 他说，在地图的秘密以上，还有更深层的秘密等着我们。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, zài dìtú de mìmì yǐshàng, hái yǒu gèng shēncéng de mìmì děngzhe wǒmen.
sentences.english: He said that above the secrets of the map, there are even deeper secrets waiting for us.

sentences.chinese: 而在这之以下，是我们必须面对的危险。
sentences.pinyin: Ér zài zhè zhī yǐxià, shì wǒmen bìxū miànduì de wēixiǎn.
sentences.english: And below this are the dangers we must face.

sentences.chinese: 后来，车子突然减速了，我担心我们又被发现了。
sentences.pinyin: Hòulái, chēzi tūrán jiǎnsù le, wǒ dānxīn wǒmen yòu bèi fāxiàn le.
sentences.english: Later, the train suddenly slowed down, and I worried that we had been discovered again.

sentences.chinese: 我看着车厢里的其他乘客，他们看起来都很正常，但我不一定能信任每一个人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe chēxiāng lǐ de qítā chéngkè, tāmen kàn qǐlái dōu hěn zhèngcháng, dàn wǒ bù yīdìng néng xìnrèn měi yīgè rén.
sentences.english: I looked at the other passengers in the carriage; they all looked normal, but I cannot necessarily trust every single person.

sentences.chinese: 同样，我也不能完全相信这个向导，虽然他帮了我很多。
sentences.pinyin: Tóngyàng, wǒ yě bùnéng wánquán xiāngxìn zhège xiàngdǎo, suīrán tā bāngle wǒ hěnduō.
sentences.english: Similarly, I cannot completely trust this guide, although he has helped me a lot.

sentences.chinese: 啊！我突然发现，那个黑色身影竟然就在我们车厢的另一端！
sentences.pinyin: Ā! Wǒ tūrán fāxiàn, nàge hēisè shēnyǐng jìngrán jiù zài wǒmen chēxiāng de lìng yī duān!
sentences.english: Ah! I suddenly discovered that the black figure was actually at the other end of our carriage!

sentences.chinese: 但是，他没有走过来，只是在远处盯着我们。
sentences.pinyin: Dànshì, tā méiyǒu zǒu guòlái, zhǐshì zài yuǎnchù dīngzhe wǒmen.
sentences.english: But he did not walk over; he just stared at us from a distance.

sentences.chinese: 我意识到，这场游戏才刚刚开始。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yìshí dào, zhè chǎng yóuxì cái gānggāng kāishǐ.
sentences.english: I realized that this game had only just begun.

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十四章：地铁里的心理战
chapters.title_english: Chapter 24: Psychological Warfare in the Subway

sentences.chinese: 我紧紧地看着那个黑色的身影，心里在想，他究竟想怎样。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jǐnjǐn de kànzhe nàge hēisè de shēnyǐng, xīnlǐ zài xiǎng, tā jiūjìng xiǎng zěnyàng.
sentences.english: I stared intently at that black figure, wondering in my heart just what he wanted.

sentences.chinese: 虽然他现在没有走过来，但我能感觉到他在观察我们。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán tā xiànzài méiyǒu zǒu guòlái, dàn wǒ néng gǎnjué dào tā zài guānchá wǒmen.
sentences.english: Although he hasn't walked over now, I can feel him observing us.

sentences.chinese: 我低声问向导，我们现在该怎么办。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dīshēng wèn xiàngdǎo, wǒmen xiànzài gāi zěnme bàn.
sentences.english: I whispered to the guide, asking what we should do now.

sentences.chinese: 向导看着窗外，低声说，如果对方不行动的话，我们就先走。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo kànzhe chuāngwài, dīshēng shuō, rúguǒ duìfāng bù xíngdòng de huà, wǒmen jiù xiān zǒu.
sentences.english: The guide looked out the window and whispered that if the other party doesn't act, we will leave first.

sentences.chinese: 我们需要决定是快步离开，或者在下一个车站换乘。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào juédìng shì kuàibù líkāi, huòzhě zài xià yīgè chēzhàn huànchéng.
sentences.english: We need to decide whether to leave quickly or transfer at the next station.

sentences.chinese: 在这个时候，我们需要一个计划，比如先分散开来。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège shíhòu, wǒmen xūyào yīgè jìhuà, bǐrú xiān fēnsàn kāilái.
sentences.english: At this moment, we need a plan, for example, to disperse first.

sentences.chinese: 比如说，我可以先走，然后你再走。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐrú shuō, wǒ kěyǐ xiān zǒu, ránhòu nǐ zài zǒu.
sentences.english: For instance, I could leave first, and then you leave.

sentences.chinese: 这样，对方就不能一次抓住我们所有人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèyàng, duìfāng jiù bùnéng yīcì zhuā zhù wǒmen suǒyǒu rén.
sentences.english: This way, the other party cannot catch all of us at once.

sentences.chinese: 而且，如果对方有相同的人在车站等他，情况会更糟糕。
sentences.pinyin: Érqiě, rúguǒ duìfāng yǒu xiāngtóng de rén zài chēzhàn děng tā, qíngkuàng huì gèng zāogāo.
sentences.english: Moreover, if the other party has identical people waiting for him at the station, the situation will be even worse.

sentences.chinese: 所以，我们必须非常小心，不能随便相信任何人。
sentences.pinyin: Suǒyǐ, wǒmen bìxū fēicháng xiǎoxīn, bùnéng suíbiàn xiāngxìn rènhé rén.
sentences.english: Therefore, we must be very careful and cannot trust anyone randomly.

sentences.chinese: 我看着自己颤抖的手，意识到我不能像之前那样害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe zìjǐ chàndǒu de shǒu, yìshí dào wǒ bùnéng xiàng zhīqián nàyàng hàipà.
sentences.english: Looking at my own trembling hands, I realized I cannot be afraid like that before.

sentences.chinese: 我不能那么软弱，我必须重新找回我的勇气。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bùnéng nàme ruǎnruò, wǒ bìxū chóngxīn zhǎohuí wǒ de yǒngqì.
sentences.english: I cannot be so weak; I must regain my courage once more.

sentences.chinese: 如果我继续那样担心，我永远无法完成这次旅行。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ wǒ jìxù nàyàng dānxīn, wǒ yǒngyuǎn wúfǎ wánchéng zhè cì lǚxíng.
sentences.english: If I continue to worry like that, I will never be able to complete this journey.

sentences.chinese: 这种感觉很奇怪，就像我们在玩一个危险的游戏。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng gǎnjué hěn qíguài, jiù xiàng wǒmen zài wán yīgè wēixiǎn de yóuxì.
sentences.english: This feeling is very strange, as if we are playing a dangerous game.

sentences.chinese: 这个黑衣人也许是司机，或是一个我不认识的新敌人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège hēiyīrén yěxǔ shì sījī, huò shì yīgè wǒ bù rènshí de xīn dírén.
sentences.english: This man in black might be the driver, or a new enemy I don't know.

sentences.chinese: 我看着车厢里的乘客，他们看起来这么安静，但谁知道呢？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe chēxiāng lǐ de chéngkè, tāmen kàn qǐlái zhème ānjìng, dàn shéi zhīdào ne?
sentences.english: I looked at the passengers in the carriage; they look so quiet, but who knows?

sentences.chinese: 在这种环境下，每个人都可能在隐藏秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè zhǒng huánjìng xià, měi gèrén dōu kěnéng zài yǐncáng mìmì.
sentences.english: In this kind of environment, everyone might be hiding a secret.

sentences.chinese: 我们终于到了车站，车门打开了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zhōngyú dàole chēzhàn, chēmén dǎkāile.
sentences.english: We finally arrived at the station, and the doors opened.

sentences.chinese: 就在我们走出车厢的一瞬间，那个黑色的身影突然快速跑了过来！
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài wǒmen zǒuchū chēxiāng de yī shùnjiān, nàge hēisè de shēnyǐng tūrán kuàisù pǎole guòlái!
sentences.english: Just as we stepped out of the carriage, that black figure suddenly ran over quickly!

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十五章：车站的混乱与线索

sentences.chinese: 我以为他会直接抓住我，但那个黑衣人突然停了下来。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi tā huì zhíjiē zhuā zhù wǒ, dàn nàge hēiyīrén tūrán tíngle xiàlái.
sentences.english: I thought he would grab me directly, but the man in black suddenly stopped.

sentences.chinese: 他穿着一件很奇怪的黑色外套，手里拿着一份旧的晚报。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chuānzhe yī jiàn hěn qíguài de hēisè wàitào, shǒulǐ názhe yī fèn jiù de wǎnbào.
sentences.english: He was wearing a very strange black coat and holding a copy of an old evening newspaper.

sentences.chinese: 他没有说话，只是用一种奇怪的读音喊了一个名字。
sentences.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu shuōhuà, zhǐshì yòng yī zhǒng qíguài de dúyīn hǎnle yīgè míngzì.
sentences.english: He didn't speak, but shouted a name using a strange pronunciation.

sentences.chinese: 我发现他的眼神不像司机那样凶，反而像是在寻找什么。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ fāxiàn tā de yǎnshén bù xiàng sījī nàyàng xiōng, fǎn'ér xiàng shì zài xúnzhǎo shénme.
sentences.english: I noticed his eyes weren't as fierce as the driver's; instead, he seemed to be looking for something.

sentences.chinese: 向导低声对我说：“快点儿！我们得离开这里！”
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo dīshēng duì wǒ shuō: “Kuài diǎn r! Wǒmen děi líkāi zhèlǐ!”
sentences.english: The guide whispered to me, "Hurry up! We have to leave here!"

sentences.chinese: 我们跑向车站的出口，周围的人群非常拥挤。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen pǎo xiàng chēzhàn de chūkǒu, zhōuwéi de rénqún fēicháng yōngjǐ.
sentences.english: We ran toward the station exit, and the surrounding crowd was very congested.

sentences.chinese: 在这个大单位的车站里，人们行色匆匆。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège dà dānwèi de chēzhàn lǐ, rénmen xíngsè cōngcōng.
sentences.english: In this large unit of a station, people were rushing about.

sentences.chinese: 我突然想起在克罗地亚旅行的时候，也遇到过类似的紧张气氛。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tūrán xiǎngqǐ zài Kèluódìyà lǚxíng de shíhòu, yě yùdào guò lèisì de jǐnzhāng qìfēn.
sentences.english: I suddenly remembered when I was traveling in Croatia, I encountered a similar tense atmosphere.

sentences.chinese: 我们躲在几个大箱子后面，像猫一样安静地观察着。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen duǒ zài jǐ gè dà xiāngzi hòumiàn, xiàng māo yīyàng ānjìng de guāncházhe.
sentences.english: We hid behind several large boxes, observing quietly like cats.

sentences.chinese: 向导从包里拿出一个黄色的小本子，那是他的旅行笔记。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo cóng bāo lǐ ná chū yīgè huángsè de xiǎo běnzi, nà shì tā de lǚxíng bǐjì.
sentences.english: The guide took out a yellow notebook from his bag; it was his travel notes.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，地图的第二部分可能就在一个古老的词典里。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, dìtú de dì èr bùfèn kěnéng jiù zài yīgè gǔlǎo de cídiǎn lǐ.
sentences.english: He told me that the second part of the map might be in an ancient dictionary.

sentences.chinese: 他翻开本子，指着几个生词，说这些词语是打开秘密的钥匙。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fān kāi běnzi, zhǐzhe jǐ gè shēngcí, shuō zhèxiē cíyǔ shì dǎkāi mìmì de yàoshi.
sentences.english: He opened the notebook and pointed to a few new words, saying these terms were the keys to unlocking the secret.

sentences.chinese: 我看着那些复杂的汉字，觉得自己需要一本字典来帮助我。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe nàxiē fùzá de hànzì, juéde zìjǐ xūyào yī běn zìdiǎn lái bāngzhù wǒ.
sentences.english: Looking at those complex characters, I felt I needed a character dictionary to help me.

sentences.chinese: 我的想法很简单：只要能找到地图，我们就安全了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de xiǎngfǎ hěn jiǎndān: zhǐyào néng zhǎodào dìtú, wǒmen jiù ānquánle.
sentences.english: My way of thinking was simple: as long as we could find the map, we would be safe.

sentences.chinese: 向导说，现在的条件很不利，因为敌人的人数更多。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo shuō, xiànzài de tiáojiàn hěn bùlì, yīnwèi dírén de rénshù gèng duō.
sentences.english: The guide said the current conditions were unfavorable because the enemies were more numerous.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，在那个时代，这种加密的方法非常流行。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, zài nàge shídài, zhè zhǒng jiāmì de fāngfǎ fēicháng liúxíng.
sentences.english: He told me that in that era, this method of encryption was very popular.

sentences.chinese: 他拿起相机，快速拍了一张车站墙上的绿色的画。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ná qǐ xiàngjī, kuàisù pāile yī zhāng chēzhàn qiáng shàng de lǜsè de huà.
sentences.english: He picked up the camera and quickly took a photo of a green painting on the station wall.

sentences.chinese: 那幅画看起来很普通，但向导说那是重点，需要重新分析。
sentences.pinyin: Nà fú huà kàn qǐlái hěn pǔtōng, dàn xiàngdǎo shuō nà shì zhòngdiǎn, xūyào chóngxīn fēnxī.
sentences.english: That painting looked ordinary, but the guide said it was the key point and needed to be re-evaluated.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，这张画的颜色和线条里藏着方向。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, zhè zhāng huà de yánsè hé xiàntiáo lǐ cángzhe fāngxiàng.
sentences.english: He told me that the colors and lines of the painting hid the direction.

sentences.chinese: 突然，我闻到了一股奇怪的味道，像是旧书和灰尘混合在一起。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, wǒ wéndàole yī gǔ qíguài de wèidào, xiàng shì jiù shū hé huīchén hùnhé zài yīqǐ.
sentences.english: Suddenly, I smelled a strange scent, like a mix of old books and dust.

sentences.chinese: 我们跑进一家旧书店，店主是一个正在干活儿的老人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen pǎo jìn yī jiā jiù shūdiàn, diànzhǔ shì yīgè zhèngzài gàn huó r de lǎorén.
sentences.english: We ran into an old bookstore; the owner was an old man who was working.

sentences.chinese: 老人看着我们，笑了笑说：“寻找秘密是一件好事。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén kànzhe wǒmen, xiàole xiào shuō: “Xúnzhǎo mìmì shì yī jiàn hǎoshì.”
sentences.english: The old man looked at us, smiled, and said, "Searching for secrets is a good thing."

sentences.chinese: 他给了我们一本很旧的词典，封面已经破损了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gěile wǒmen yī běn hěn jiù de cídiǎn, fēngmiàn yǐjīng pòsǔnle.
sentences.english: He gave us a very old dictionary with a cover that was already damaged.

sentences.chinese: 我翻开书，发现里面夹着一张从越南越国传来的信件。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ fān kāi shū, fāxiàn lǐmiàn jiázhe yī zhāng cóng Yuènán Yuè guó chuán lái de xìnjiàn.
sentences.english: I opened the book and found a letter tucked inside that had come from Vietnam.

sentences.chinese: 信上写着，真正的地图被分成了不同的单位来计算距离。
sentences.pinyin: Xìn shàng xiězhe, zhēnzhèng de dìtú bèi fēnchéngle bùtóng de dānwèi lái jìsuàn jùlí.
sentences.english: The letter stated that the real map was divided into different units to calculate the distance.

sentences.chinese: 向导看着信，表情变得非常严肃。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo kànzhe xìn, biǎoqíng biàn de fēicháng yánsù.
sentences.english: The guide looked at the letter, his expression becoming very serious.

sentences.chinese: 我们意识到，这场追逐战已经从城市变成了跨国的冒险。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yìshí dào, zhè chǎng zhuīzhú zhàn yǐjīng cóng chéngshì biànchéngle kuàguó de màoxiǎn.
sentences.english: We realized that this chase had turned from a city struggle into an international adventure.

sentences.chinese: 就在我们准备离开书店时，门外突然传来了急促的脚步声！
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài wǒmen zhǔnbèi líkāi shūdiàn shí, mén wài tūrán chuánláile jícù de jiǎobù shēng!
sentences.english: Just as we were preparing to leave the bookstore, hurried footsteps suddenly sounded outside the door!

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十六章：越国的秘密约定
chapters.title_english: Chapter 26: The Secret Agreement in Vietnam

sentences.chinese: 我们快速跑出书店，通过一条狭窄的小路躲开了追赶的人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen kuàisù pǎo chū shūdiàn, tōngguò yī tiáo xiǎozhǎi de xiǎolù duǒ kāile zhuīgǎn de rén.
sentences.english: We quickly ran out of the bookstore, passing through a narrow alley to avoid the pursuers.

sentences.chinese: 向导告诉我，我们要去越南，那里有地图的最后一部分。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngdǎo gàosù wǒ, wǒmen yào qù Yuènán, nàlǐ yǒu dìtú de zuìhòu yī bùfèn.
sentences.english: The guide told me that we were going to Vietnam, where the final part of the map was located.

sentences.chinese: 为了能准确地找到那个地方，我们需要一个当地的向导。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile néng zhǔnquè de zhǎodào nàgè dìfāng, wǒmen xūyào yīgè dāngdì de xiàngdǎo.
sentences.english: In order to find that place accurately, we needed a local guide.

sentences.chinese: 在飞机的旅途中，我努力地学习一些简单的越南语。
sentences.pinyin: Zài fēijī de lǚtú zhōng, wǒ nǔlì de xuéxí yīxiē jiǎndān de Yuènányǔ.
sentences.english: During the flight, I made an effort to learn some simple Vietnamese.

sentences.chinese: 我想，如果能懂一点当地语言，旅行会更加方便。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng, rúguǒ néng dǒng yīdiǎn dāngdì yǔyán, lǚxíng huì gèngjiā fāngbiàn.
sentences.english: I thought that if I could understand a bit of the local language, the trip would be more convenient.

sentences.chinese: 到达河内后，我们走过很多热闹的街道，寻找一个叫林先生的人。
sentences.pinyin: Dàodá Hénèi hòu, wǒmen zǒuguò hěnduō rènào de jiēdào, xúnzhǎo yīgè jiào Lín xiānshēng de rén.
sentences.english: After arriving in Hanoi, we walked past many bustling streets searching for a man named Mr. Lin.

sentences.chinese: 林先生是我们之前的合作伙伴，他是一个非常有名的好人。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng shì wǒmen zhīqián de hézuò huǒbàn, tā shì yīgè fēicháng yǒumíng de hǎorén.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin was a former partner of ours, and he is a very well-known good person.

sentences.chinese: 当我们见到他时，他对我这个陌生人特别热情。
sentences.pinyin: Dāng wǒmen jiàn dào tā shí, tā duì wǒ zhège mòshēng rén tèbié rèqíng.
sentences.english: When we met him, he was especially warm toward me, a stranger.

sentences.chinese: 他带我们去了一家小餐馆，那里有很多地道的越南美食。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dài wǒmen qùle yī jiā xiǎo cānguǎn, nàlǐ yǒu hěnduō dìdao de Yuènán měishí.
sentences.english: He took us to a small restaurant that had many authentic Vietnamese delicacies.

sentences.chinese: 我吃了很多春卷，直到肚子完全饱了，我才觉得很满意。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ chīle hěnduō chūnjuǎn, zhídào dùzi wánquán bǎo le, wǒ cái juéde hěn mǎnyì.
sentences.english: I ate many spring rolls, and only when my stomach was completely full did I feel satisfied.

sentences.chinese: 林先生看着那封信，说他懂得这些奇怪的距离计算方法。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng kànzhe nà fēng xìn, shuō tā dǒngde zhèxiē qíguài de jùlí jìsuàn fāngfǎ.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin looked at the letter and said he understood these strange distance calculation methods.

sentences.chinese: 他答应帮我们完成这个任务，但条件是我们必须相信他。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dāying bāng wǒmen wánchéng zhège rènwù, dàn tiáojiàn shì wǒmen bìxū xiāngxìn tā.
sentences.english: He agreed to help us complete this mission, but the condition was that we must believe him.

sentences.chinese: 我看着他诚恳的眼神，心里终于放心了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe tā chéngkěn de yǎnshén, xīnlǐ zhōngyú fàngxīn le.
sentences.english: Looking at his sincere eyes, I finally felt relieved.

sentences.chinese: 林先生说，想要找到秘密地点，必须经过一座古老的桥。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng shuō, xiǎngyào zhǎodào mìmì dìdiǎn, bìxū jīngguò yī zuò gǔlǎo de qiáo.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin said that to find the secret location, we must pass through an ancient bridge.

sentences.chinese: 这座桥很长，走过去的时间会超过一个小时。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo hěn cháng, zǒu guòqù de shíjiān huì chāoguò yī gè xiǎoshí.
sentences.english: This bridge is very long; the time to walk across it would exceed one hour.

sentences.chinese: 他说，只有对这里非常熟的人，才能在森林里走通那条路。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, zhǐyǒu duì zhèlǐ fēicháng shú de rén, cáinéng zài sēnlín lǐ zǒutōng nà tiáo lù.
sentences.english: He said that only people who are very familiar with the area could find the way through the forest.

sentences.chinese: 我问他：“这条路真的合适吗？会不会太危险？”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Zhè tiáo lù zhēnde héshì ma? Huì bù huì tài wēixiǎn?”
sentences.english: I asked him, "Is this path really suitable? Could it be too dangerous?"

sentences.chinese: 林先生笑了，他说只要我们足够勇敢，就没问题。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng xiào le, tā shuō zhǐyào wǒmen zúgòu yǒnggǎn, jiù méi wèntí.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin smiled and said as long as we are brave enough, there would be no problem.

sentences.chinese: 我们在这座城市里生活了几天，渐渐地，我对这里的环境很清楚了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zài zhè zuò chéngshì lǐ shēnghuóle jǐ tiān, jiànjiàn de, wǒ duì zhèlǐ de huánjìng hěn qīngchu le.
sentences.english: We lived in this city for a few days, and gradually, I became clear about the environment here.

sentences.chinese: 我们一起讨论计划，直到把所有细节都说完。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yīqǐ tǎolùn jìhuà, zhídào bǎ suǒyǒu xìjié dōu shuō wán.
sentences.english: We discussed the plan together until we had finished talking through all the details.

sentences.chinese: 林先生教我如何观察地图上的标记，让我真正懂了其中的秘密。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng jiào wǒ rúhé guānchá dìtú shàng de biāojì, ràng wǒ zhēnzhèng dǒng le qízhōng de mìmì.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin taught me how to observe the markers on the map, allowing me to truly understand the secret within.

sentences.chinese: 在那次深入的交谈后，我感到非常开心，因为我离真相更近了。
sentences.pinyin: Zài nà cì shēnrù de jiāotán hòu, wǒ gǎndào fēicháng kāixīn, yīnwèi wǒ lí zhēnxiàng gèng jìn le.
sentences.english: After that deep conversation, I felt very happy because I was closer to the truth.

sentences.chinese: 然而，就在我们准备出发前往古桥的那天早晨，林先生突然消失了。
sentences.pinyin: Rán'ér, jiù zài wǒmen zhǔnbèi chūfā qiánwǎng gǔqiáo de nà tiān zǎochén, Lín xiānshēng tūrán xiāoshī le.
sentences.english: However, on the morning we were preparing to set off for the ancient bridge, Mr. Lin suddenly disappeared.

sentences.chinese: 他的房间里只留了一张纸条，上面写着：“他们找到了我。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā de fángjiān lǐ zhǐ liúle yī zhāng zhǐtiáo, shàngmiàn xiězhe: “Tāmen zhǎodào wǒ le.”
sentences.english: In his room, only a note was left, which read: "They found me."

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十七章：消失的线索

sentences.chinese: 我看着那张纸条，心跳得很快。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe nà zhāng zhǐtiáo, xīntiào de hěn kuài.
sentences.english: I looked at the note, my heart beating fast.

sentences.chinese: 林先生怎么会突然消失？
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng zěnme huì tūrán xiāoshī?
sentences.english: How could Mr. Lin suddenly disappear?

sentences.chinese: 我走出房间，看到很多行人正在街道上走动。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǒuchū fángjiān, kàndào hěnduō xíngrén zhèngzài jiēdào shàng zǒudòng.
sentences.english: I walked out of the room and saw many pedestrians walking on the street.

sentences.chinese: 我决定立刻出门寻找他。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ juédìng lìkè chūmén xúnzhǎo tā.
sentences.english: I decided to go out immediately to look for him.

sentences.chinese: 在这个外地的小城市，我感到很孤独。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhège wàidì de xiǎo chéngshì, wǒ gǎndào hěn gūdú.
sentences.english: In this small city in a foreign place, I felt very lonely.

sentences.chinese: 我走到街角，向一名游客问路。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zǒu dào jiējiǎo, xiàng yī míng yóukè wènlù.
sentences.english: I walked to the corner and asked a tourist for directions.

sentences.chinese: 他告诉我，林先生可能去了市中心的医院。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosù wǒ, Lín xiānshēng kěnéng qùle shì zhōngxīn de yīyuàn.
sentences.english: He told me that Mr. Lin might have gone to the city center hospital.

sentences.chinese: 我赶紧跑向医院，在出口看到了一个熟悉的人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gǎnjǐn pǎo xiàng yīyuàn, zài chūkǒu kàndào le yīgè shúxī de rén.
sentences.english: I rushed to the hospital and saw a familiar person at the exit.

sentences.chinese: 那是林先生的助手，他看起来很担心。
sentences.pinyin: Nà shì Lín xiānshēng de zhùshǒu, tā kàn qǐlái hěn dānxīn.
sentences.english: It was Mr. Lin's assistant; he looked very worried.

sentences.chinese: 助手告诉我，林先生因为身体不好，必须住院治疗。
sentences.pinyin: Zhùshǒu gàosù wǒ, Lín xiānshēng yīnwèi shēntǐ bù hǎo, bìxū zhùyuàn zhìliáo.
sentences.english: The assistant told me that because of poor health, Mr. Lin had to be hospitalized for treatment.

sentences.chinese: 但我知道，这一定是一个秘密信号。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒ zhīdào, zhè yīdìng shì yīgè mìmì xìnhào.
sentences.english: But I knew this must be a secret signal.

sentences.chinese: 林先生不是在休假，他是在躲避那些黑色的车。
sentences.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng búshì zài xiūjià, tā shì zài duǒbì nàxiē hēisè de chē.
sentences.english: Mr. Lin wasn't on vacation; he was hiding from those black cars.

sentences.chinese: 助手低声说：“他已经出院了，但现在必须立刻离开这里。”
sentences.pinyin: Zhùshǒu dīshēng shuō: “Tā yǐjīng chūyuàn le, dàn xiànzài bìxū lìkè líkāi zhèlǐ.”
sentences.english: The assistant whispered, "He has already been discharged, but he must leave here immediately."

sentences.chinese: 我问他林先生去了哪里，助手给了我一张新的地址。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā Lín xiānshēng qùle nǎlǐ, zhùshǒu gěile wǒ yī zhāng xīn de dìzhǐ.
sentences.english: I asked him where Mr. Lin had gone, and the assistant gave me a new address.

sentences.chinese: 他说，林先生现在像一个普通的旅客一样，在古桥附近旅行。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō, Lín xiānshēng xiànzài xiàng yīgè pǔtōng de lǚkè yīyàng, zài gǔqiáo fùjìn lǚxíng.
sentences.english: He said Mr. Lin was now traveling near the Ancient Bridge, just like an ordinary traveler.

sentences.chinese: 为了不被发现，林先生在当地的一家小餐馆打工。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bù bèi fāxiàn, Lín xiānshēng zài dāngdì de yī jiā xiǎo cānguǎn dǎgōng.
sentences.english: To avoid being discovered, Mr. Lin was working a part-time job at a local small restaurant.

sentences.chinese: 我在餐馆看到了很多正在旅游的人。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zài cānguǎn kàndào le hěnduō zhèngzài lǚyóu de rén.
sentences.english: I saw many people touring in the restaurant.

sentences.chinese: 其中有一个留学生，他告诉我林先生刚才在这里点了一份外卖。
sentences.pinyin: Qízhōng yǒu yīgè liúxuéshēng, tā gàosù wǒ Lín xiānshēng gāngcái zài zhèlǐ diǎnle yī fèn wàimài.
sentences.english: Among them was an exchange student who told me Mr. Lin had just ordered takeout here.

sentences.chinese: 那个外卖员离开的时候，林先生在他耳边说了些什么。
sentences.pinyin: Nàgè wàimàiyuán líkāi de shíhòu, Lín xiānshēng zài tā ěrbian shuōle xiē shénme.
sentences.english: When the delivery man left, Mr. Lin whispered something in his ear.

sentences.chinese: 我想去问那个外卖员，但一个黑色的身影突然出现，对他大喊：“走开！”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù wèn nàgè wàimàiyuán, dàn yīgè hēisè de shēnyǐng tūrán chūxiàn, duì tā dàhǎn: “Zǒukāi!”
sentences.english: I wanted to ask the delivery man, but a black figure suddenly appeared and shouted at him, "Go away!"

sentences.chinese: 我意识到，敌人也在这里寻找林先生。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yìshí dào, dírén yě zài zhèlǐ xúnzhǎo Lín xiānshēng.
sentences.english: I realized that the enemies were also here looking for Mr. Lin.

sentences.chinese: 我必须在林先生出国之前找到他，或者帮他回国。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bìxū zài Lín xiānshēng chūguó zhīqián zhǎodào tā, huòzhě bāng tā huíguó.
sentences.english: I must find Mr. Lin before he goes abroad, or help him return to his home country.

sentences.chinese: 我想在他离开之前，和他一起参观那个古桥，拿到地图的最后一部分。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zài tā líkāi zhīqián, hé tā yīqǐ cānguān nàgè gǔqiáo, nádào dìtú de zuìhòu yī bùfèn.
sentences.english: I wanted to visit that ancient bridge with him before he left and get the last part of the map.

sentences.chinese: 我对着远方低声说：“林先生，请一路平安，一定要一路顺风。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ duìzhe yuǎnfāng dīshēng shuō: “Lín xiānshēng, qǐng yī lù píng ān, yī dìng yào yī lù shùn fēng.”
sentences.english: I whispered toward the distance, "Mr. Lin, please have a pleasant journey, and may you have a smooth trip."

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，我的手机突然响了，是一个陌生号码发来的短信：
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, wǒ de shǒujī tūrán xiǎng le, shì yīgè mòshēng hàomǎ fā lái de duǎnxìn:
sentences.english: Just then, my phone suddenly rang; it was a text message from an unknown number:

sentences.chinese: “快跑！他们就在你身后！”
sentences.pinyin: “Kuài pǎo! Tāmen jiù zài nǐ shēnhòu!”
sentences.english: "Run! They are right behind you!"

chapters.title_chinese: 第二十八章：最后的追逐

sentences.chinese: 我看到身后出现了一辆黑色的车，心里非常害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàndào shēnhòu chūxiànle yī liàng hēisè de chē, xīnlǐ fēicháng hàipà.
sentences.english: I saw a black car appear behind me, and I was very scared.

sentences.chinese: 我立刻关机，因为我知道他们可以通过手机找到我。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ lìkè guānjī, yīnwèi wǒ zhīdào tāmen kěyǐ tōngguò shǒujī zhǎodào wǒ.
sentences.english: I immediately turned off my phone because I knew they could find me through it.

sentences.chinese: 我开始在街道上快速地骑车，希望能甩掉他们。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kāishǐ zài jiēdào shàng kuàisù de qíchē, xīwàng néng shuǎidiào tāmen.
sentences.english: I started riding my bike quickly on the street, hoping to shake them off.

sentences.chinese: 这里的交通非常糟糕，很多车在路中间停了下来。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de jiāotōng fēicháng zāogāo, hěnduō chē zài lù zhōngjiān tíngle xiàlái.
sentences.english: The traffic here was terrible; many cars had stopped in the middle of the road.

sentences.chinese: 我看到一辆车在停车加油，我赶紧从旁边跑过去。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàndào yī liàng chē zài tíngchē jiāyóu, wǒ gǎnjǐn cóng pángbiān pǎoguòqù.
sentences.english: I saw a car pulling up to refuel, and I quickly ran past it.

sentences.chinese: 我突然想到，林先生可能在那个著名的公园里等我。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tūrán xiǎngdào, Lín xiānshēng kěnéng zài nàgè zhùmíng de gōngyuán lǐ děng wǒ.
sentences.english: I suddenly thought that Mr. Lin might be waiting for me in that famous park.

sentences.chinese: 为了不被发现，我决定在公园的树林里活动一下。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile bù bèi fāxiàn, wǒ juédìng zài gōngyuán de shùlín lǐ huódòng yīxià.
sentences.english: To avoid being discovered, I decided to move around in the woods of the park.

sentences.chinese: 我看到很多人在公园里运动，有的在跑步，有的在爬山。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàndào hěnduō rén zài gōngyuán lǐ yùndòng, yǒu de zài pǎobù, yǒu de zài páshān.
sentences.english: I saw many people exercising in the park, some running and some hiking up the mountain.

sentences.chinese: 我看到一个男人在照相，他看起来很像林先生。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàndào yīgè nánrén zài zhàoxiàng, tā kàn qǐlái hěn xiàng Lín xiānshēng.
sentences.english: I saw a man taking a photograph; he looked a lot like Mr. Lin.

sentences.chinese: 我快速跑向他，大声喊道：“林先生！”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kuàisù pǎo xiàng tā, dàshēng hǎndào: “Lín xiānshēng!”
sentences.english: I ran toward him quickly and shouted loudly, "Mr. Lin!"

sentences.chinese: 但那个男人回头看了我一眼，冷冷地说：“站住！”
sentences.pinyin: Dàn nàgè nánrén huítóu kànle wǒ yīyǎn, lěnglěng de shuō: “Zhànzhù!”
sentences.english: But the man looked back at me and said coldly, "Stop!"

sentences.chinese: 他不是林先生，而是敌人的一个成员。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bùshì Lín xiānshēng, ér shì dírén de yīgè chéngyuán.
sentences.english: He wasn't Mr. Lin, but a member of the enemy.

sentences.chinese: 我意识到我的行动被发现了，必须立刻离开这里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yìshí dào wǒ de xíngdòng bèi fāxiànle, bìxū lìkè líkāi zhèlǐ.
sentences.english: I realized my operation had been discovered and I had to leave immediately.

sentences.chinese: 我跑向路边，看到一辆摩托车，我决定骑上去快速逃跑。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ pǎo xiàng lùbiān, kàndào yī liàng mótuōchē, wǒ juédìng qí shàngqù kuàisù táopǎo.
sentences.english: I ran to the roadside, saw a motorcycle, and decided to mount it and escape quickly.

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，我的手机突然开机了，收到了一条紧急通知。
sentences.pinyin: Jiù zài zhè shí, wǒ de shǒujī tūrán kāijīle, shōudào le yī tiáo jǐnjí tōngzhī.
sentences.english: Just then, my phone suddenly booted up and I received an urgent notification.

sentences.chinese: 短信说：“快去机场，我的飞机马上就要起飞了！”
sentences.pinyin: Shùnxìn shuō: “Kuài qù jīchǎng, wǒ de fēijī mǎshàng jiù yào qǐfēi le!”
sentences.english: The message said: "Hurry to the airport, my plane is about to take off!"

sentences.chinese: 我心里只有一个问题：我还能在最后一刻找到他吗？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xīnlǐ zhǐyǒu yīgè wèntí: Wǒ hái néng zài zuìhòu yīkè zhǎodào tā ma?
sentences.english: There was only one question in my mind: Could I still find him at the last moment?

sentences.chinese: 我想起林先生以前告诉我，他习惯在下午午睡，所以现在他一定已经醒了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngqǐ Lín xiānshēng yǐqián gàosù wǒ, tā xíguàn zài xiàwǔ wǔshuì, suǒyǐ xiànzài tā yīdìng yǐjīng xǐngle.
